Array.name: dialog_Balatro_VillageTalk_001
Array.english: Hmm... The villagers seem a bit different than usual.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... The villagers seem a bit different than usual.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_VillageTalk_002
Array.english: It looks like they are enjoying some type of card game...
Array.indonesia: It looks like they are enjoying some type of card game...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_VillageTalk_003
Array.english: Should I go to the <color=#F1DC2B>Game Parlor</color> and ask?
Array.indonesia: Should I go to the <color=#F1DC2B>Game Parlor</color> and ask?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_001
Array.english: <size=33> Haha! Ho! Human, it's been a while! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33> Haha! Ho! Human, it's been a while! </size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(…It feels different here.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(…It feels different here.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_003
Array.english: The villagers all seem to be busy with something…\nwhat is happening?
Array.indonesia: The villagers all seem to be busy with something…\nwhat is happening?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_004
Array.english: <size=33>Haha…so you have seen...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha…so you have seen...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_005
Array.english: <size=34> It's a game called <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34> It's a game called <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_006
Array.english: <size=36><color=#1DFEAF> Jimbo's game </color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#1DFEAF> Jimbo's game </color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>That's right! A game recorded in an ancient book I found... deep in the sea at night...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That's right! A game recorded in an ancient book I found... deep in the sea at night...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_008
Array.english: <size=33>It's all the rage at the Sea People Village, hehehe...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It's all the rage at the Sea People Village, hehehe...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_009
Array.english: Hmm... How fun could it be?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... How fun could it be?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_010
Array.english: Are you interested?
Array.indonesia: Are you interested?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_011
Array.english: You too, human, will be captivated by it. Hehe...
Array.indonesia: You too, human, will be captivated by it. Hehe...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionStart_012
Array.english: <size=35>I will teach you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I will teach you!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Ramo_001
Array.english: By any chance... Have you heard of <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>?
Array.indonesia: By any chance... Have you heard of <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Ramo_002
Array.english: <size=33>Of course! It's all the rage in the Sea People village!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Of course! It's all the rage in the Sea People village!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Ramo_003
Array.english: Really...? Hmm. Junak told me about it...\nDo you want to try playing?
Array.indonesia: Really...? Hmm. Junak told me about it...\nDo you want to try playing?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Ramo_004
Array.english: <size=35>Haha! You are no match for me!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha! You are no match for me!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_001
Array.english: <size=35>Woah…! It's gotten weird again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Woah…! It's gotten weird again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_002
Array.english: <size=34>Mhahaha! That's the charm of this game!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mhahaha! That's the charm of this game!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_003
Array.english: <size=35> So? Are you ready for a duel?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35> So? Are you ready for a duel?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_001
Array.english: Pfft…a human? Playing <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>…?
Array.indonesia: Pfft…a human? Playing <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>…?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_002
Array.english: Junak at the Game Parlor taught me...\nI thought I should get some practice.
Array.indonesia: Junak at the Game Parlor taught me...\nI thought I should get some practice.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_003
Array.english: You seriously thought I could be your practice partner?
Array.indonesia: You seriously thought I could be your practice partner?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_004
Array.english: Skill gap...
Array.indonesia: Skill gap...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Suwam_005
Array.english: <size=35>I will make you understand what that's about!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I will make you understand what that's about!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_001
Array.english: <size=34>Woah... it changed again…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Woah... it changed again…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_002
Array.english: Hehehe... I feel a big victory coming today...
Array.indonesia: Hehehe... I feel a big victory coming today...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_003
Array.english: <size=35>Bring it on! Rookie!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bring it on! Rookie!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Kazhin_001
Array.english: <size=34>Mm? You know this game, too?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mm? You know this game, too?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Kazhin_002
Array.english: Yes, it looks quite fun, so I am learning how to play it.
Array.indonesia: Yes, it looks quite fun, so I am learning how to play it.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Kazhin_003
Array.english: Haha, then I shouldn't miss this chance to play with you.
Array.indonesia: Haha, then I shouldn't miss this chance to play with you.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_001
Array.english: Ack! Kazhin, you look...!
Array.indonesia: Ack! Kazhin, you look...!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_002
Array.english: It's the charm of this game.
Array.indonesia: It's the charm of this game.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Mima_001
Array.english: Oh, is this game popular among humans, too?
Array.indonesia: Oh, is this game popular among humans, too?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Mima_002
Array.english: I just thought it seemed fun, so I'm learning how to play.
Array.indonesia: I just thought it seemed fun, so I'm learning how to play.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Mima_003
Array.english: In that case! Mind if I teach you a thing or two?
Array.indonesia: In that case! Mind if I teach you a thing or two?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_001
Array.english: Hohoho! Don't I look like a Queen?
Array.indonesia: Hohoho! Don't I look like a Queen?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_002
Array.english: You look a bit scary…
Array.indonesia: You look a bit scary…

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_003
Array.english: Humans don't grasp the concept of elegance.
Array.indonesia: Humans don't grasp the concept of elegance.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Gumo_001
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>… Yes, I know it.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>… Yes, I know it.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Gumo_002
Array.english: It's a great game to pass the time while waiting for the crops to grow.
Array.indonesia: It's a great game to pass the time while waiting for the crops to grow.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Gumo_003
Array.english: I'll play with you, if you want.
Array.indonesia: I'll play with you, if you want.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_001
Array.english: Hehehe, I transformed again.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe, I transformed again.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_002
Array.english: You are the 11th person to witness this form...
Array.indonesia: You are the 11th person to witness this form...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_003
Array.english: ...That's quite a lot.
Array.indonesia: ...That's quite a lot.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_004
Array.english: ...Silence. En garde!
Array.indonesia: ...Silence. En garde!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Junak_001
Array.english: I've defeated 5 people, as you asked.
Array.indonesia: I've defeated 5 people, as you asked.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Junak_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oho... I must have underestimated you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oho... I must have underestimated you.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameTalk_Junak_003
Array.english: Very well. Then I, Junak, the master of <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>, will take you on.
Array.indonesia: Very well. Then I, Junak, the master of <color=#1DFEAF>Jimbo's Game</color>, will take you on.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_001
Array.english: Hehe... I didn't think I would get to show you this side of me again.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... I didn't think I would get to show you this side of me again.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_002
Array.english: <size=35> I hope your practice has paid off!! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35> I hope your practice has paid off!! </size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_Cancel_001
Array.english: Aw, that was too easy.
Array.indonesia: Aw, that was too easy.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_Cancel_002
Array.english: Come back after you get better!
Array.indonesia: Come back after you get better!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Cancel_001
Array.english: You're not even going to try…
Array.indonesia: You're not even going to try…

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Cancel_002
Array.english: Overwhelmed by my presence? Heh.
Array.indonesia: Overwhelmed by my presence? Heh.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_Cancel_001
Array.english: Drop by anytime you're ready.
Array.indonesia: Drop by anytime you're ready.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_Cancel_001
Array.english: Aw, it was so close.
Array.indonesia: Aw, it was so close.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_Cancel_002
Array.english: You can come back anytime you want, dear.
Array.indonesia: You can come back anytime you want, dear.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_Cancel_001
Array.english: Heh, no need to hurry.
Array.indonesia: Heh, no need to hurry.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_Cancel_002
Array.english: Come back when you'd like.
Array.indonesia: Come back when you'd like.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_Cancel_001
Array.english: Oh, are you giving up now?
Array.indonesia: Oh, are you giving up now?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_Cancel_002
Array.english: Feel free to come back any time, I shall be here waiting.
Array.indonesia: Feel free to come back any time, I shall be here waiting.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Ramo_001
Array.english: Ha, it seems you need more practice.
Array.indonesia: Ha, it seems you need more practice.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Suwam_001
Array.english: Hehe, no shame in being beaten by me.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, no shame in being beaten by me.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Suwam_002
Array.english: <size=35>It is only natural.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It is only natural.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Kazhin_001
Array.english: Hahaha! Luck is a part of the game. Don't be too discouraged.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Luck is a part of the game. Don't be too discouraged.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Mima_001
Array.english: Hohoho! I love the thrill of victory!
Array.indonesia: Hohoho! I love the thrill of victory!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Mima_002
Array.english: That is why I fell in love with this game.
Array.indonesia: That is why I fell in love with this game.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Gumo_001
Array.english: Ha, you're a noob.\nCome back after gaining more experience.
Array.indonesia: Ha, you're a noob.\nCome back after gaining more experience.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Junak_001
Array.english: Ah, did I assign you too easy of a task?
Array.indonesia: Ah, did I assign you too easy of a task?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveLose_Junak_002
Array.english: My bad, hehe.
Array.indonesia: My bad, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_Retry_001
Array.english: Challenging me again?
Array.indonesia: Challenging me again?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Ramo_Retry_002
Array.english: Accepting is no trouble at all!
Array.indonesia: Accepting is no trouble at all!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Retry_001
Array.english: A rematch...
Array.indonesia: A rematch...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Retry_002
Array.english: Why play again when we already know who the winner will be?
Array.indonesia: Why play again when we already know who the winner will be?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Suwam_Retry_003
Array.english: <size=35>Bring it on, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bring it on, human!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_Retry_001
Array.english: You want another match?
Array.indonesia: You want another match?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Kazhin_Retry_002
Array.english: I would feel bad if I beat you too easily, hehe.
Array.indonesia: I would feel bad if I beat you too easily, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Mima_Retry_001
Array.english: Are you ready to be bested again?
Array.indonesia: Are you ready to be bested again?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_Retry_001
Array.english: It's you again. I see you have some tenacity.
Array.indonesia: It's you again. I see you have some tenacity.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Gumo_Retry_002
Array.english: But the result will be the same!
Array.indonesia: But the result will be the same!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_Retry_001
Array.english: Are you challenging me again?
Array.indonesia: Are you challenging me again?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameStart_Junak_Retry_002
Array.english: I hope you'd put some practice in. An easy opponent is quite boring, hehe.
Array.indonesia: I hope you'd put some practice in. An easy opponent is quite boring, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Ramo_001
Array.english: Ha! You caught me off guard.
Array.indonesia: Ha! You caught me off guard.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Ramo_002
Array.english: Well, a promise is a promise...
Array.indonesia: Well, a promise is a promise...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Ramo_003
Array.english: Here is my <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card! Hope you use it well.
Array.indonesia: Here is my <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card! Hope you use it well.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Suwam_001
Array.english: I knew this game was strange! There must have been a trick!
Array.indonesia: I knew this game was strange! There must have been a trick!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Suwam_002
Array.english: But I am a man of my word...
Array.indonesia: But I am a man of my word...

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Suwam_003
Array.english: A <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card. Keep it.
Array.indonesia: A <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card. Keep it.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Kazhin_001
Array.english: You are better than I thought! It's your win.
Array.indonesia: You are better than I thought! It's your win.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Kazhin_002
Array.english: Here is the <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card I promised. It's yours!
Array.indonesia: Here is the <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card I promised. It's yours!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Mima_001
Array.english: My goodness, I lost!?
Array.indonesia: My goodness, I lost!?

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Mima_002
Array.english: Well, what matters is that we had fun!
Array.indonesia: Well, what matters is that we had fun!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Mima_003
Array.english: Here is the <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card. Take this with you!
Array.indonesia: Here is the <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card. Take this with you!

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Gumo_001
Array.english: I did not see that coming…
Array.indonesia: I did not see that coming…

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionGameDaveWin_Gumo_002
Array.english: I accept my defeat. Here, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card.
Array.indonesia: I accept my defeat. Here, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Joker</color> card.

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_001
Array.english: <size=35>What...? I, Junak, the master of Jimbo's Game, have been defeated?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>What...? I, Junak, the master of Jimbo's Game, have been defeated?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Balatro_MissionEnd_002

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150001

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150002
Array.english: Tuna Yacht Party!
Array.indonesia: Tuna Yacht Party!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150002
Array.english:
Hello residents! Blue Hole Tourism Board here!
The Blue Hole is getting more and more well known, and interest is growing! In 3 days a <color=#00a583>Yacht Party</color> will be held! As a lot of wealthy people will likely come, if there is a restaurant that can handle preparing high class <color=#00a583>Tuna dishes</color> this could significantly increase sales! We ask for your support until it becomes the best attraction in the world!

Blue Hole Tourism Committee

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150009
Array.english: Storm Shark Party!
Array.indonesia: Storm Shark Party!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150009
Array.english:
Hello, folks! This is the Blue Hole Tourism Committee! According to the national weather service, a storm will hit the Blue Hole hard for three days, and amazingly people have started to report sightings of a variety of sharks roaming the coastal areas.
The committee decided to utilize this opportunity and release a new tourism product! It’s called the <color=#00a583>Storm Shark Party</color>! 

Dear store owners, do not miss this opportunity to rack up revenue! We have <color=#00a583>special breeds of sharks</color> sighted as well!

Blue Hole Tourism Committee

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150010
Array.english: The Cucumberholics
Array.indonesia: The Cucumberholics

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150010
Array.english:
Hello, folks! We are a group of people who are just addicted to cucumber. You can simply call us the <color=#00a583>Cucumberholics</color>.

If you see anyone picking cucumber out of their food, tell them they need to learn how to appreciate the true taste of cucumber!

We will host a <color=#00a583>cucumber party</color> in three days to educate people on cucumber's great taste. They’re delicious, and they’re great for your skin. Any store owners who serve dishes containing cucumber may participate in the cooking contest! Remember, cucumber is green love.

The Cucumberholics

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150011
Array.english: Marlin Party!
Array.indonesia: Marlin Party!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150011
Array.english:
Hello, this is the Blue Hole Tourism Committee!
I am sure you all know the story of an old man who couldn’t catch a fish for 84 days off the coast of the Gulf of Mexico. 
The fish he finally caught was a <color=#00a583>marlin</color>.
And now, marlins are beginning to be sighted in the waters near the Blue Hole!
To seize this opportunity, the committee decided to host a <color=#00a583>Marlin Party</color>  three days from today.
Local restaurant owners are encouraged to participate in the event to rack up revenue!
Rumor has it that some even sighted sailfish, not very often though!

The Blue Hole Tourism Committee

Array.name: PartyEvent_Title_14150012
Array.english: Curry Party!
Array.indonesia: Curry Party!

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150012
Array.english:
Hello, everyone. This is the Spice Lab. We research the perfect combination of various spices and ingredients.

We’ve heard that the waters of the Blue Hole are like a world fair that exhibit all kinds of marine species!
What kind of palatal surprises shall we find when various fish and spices meet?
We will embark on this culinary journey in three days. Our chosen ingredient is <color=#00a583>curry</color>!
Curry is well known for its anticancer and antidementia properties. Meet the new tastes of the Blue Hole at the party!

The Spice Lab

Array.name: PartyEvent_Message_14150013

Greetings! It’s your Blue Hole Tourism Committee again! 
You all know Blue Hole is home to big, fat, and juicy shrimp.
The excellent taste of the shrimps must be known to the whole world.
This time, we’re hosting a <color=#00a583>Shrimp Party</color>!
If you own a restaurant with fine shrimp recipes, don’t miss out on this opportunity!

Array.name: ContentsDesc_FarmOpen
Array.english: <size=24>You can now visit the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color>!\nThe Farm is where you can grow and harvest \nvarious crops needed for cooking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now visit the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color>!\nThe Farm is where you can grow and harvest \nvarious crops needed for cooking.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Farm
Array.english: <size=24>Otto will grow rice for you in the Farm!\nIf you don’t visit often to remove the <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color>\nthe Soil Health Score may drop, causing pests to appear.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Otto will grow rice for you in the Farm!\nIf you don’t visit often to remove the <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color>\nthe Soil Health Score may drop, causing pests to appear.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Field
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Vegetable Farm</color>!\nThe Vegetable Farm is where you can grow various vegetables.\nTry growing various vegetables needed to research new recipes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Vegetable Farm</color>!\nThe Vegetable Farm is where you can grow various vegetables.\nTry growing various vegetables needed to research new recipes!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Animal
Array.english: <size=24>You can now raise <color=#F1DC2B>Chickens</color>!\nYou can acquire eggs in the morning.\nTry developing new recipes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now raise <color=#F1DC2B>Chickens</color>!\nYou can acquire eggs in the morning.\nTry developing new recipes!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Craft
Array.english:
<size=24>You can craft weapons at <color=#F1DC2B>Duff’s Weapon Shop</color>!
Acquiring a weapon a certain number of times will complete a <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprint</color>, 
making the weapon craftable. Go hunting with powerful weapons!</size>
<color=#C3C3C3><size=21>* Weapons can be crafted multiple times.</size></color>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>You can craft weapons at <color=#F1DC2B>Duff’s Weapon Shop</color>!
Acquiring a weapon a certain number of times will complete a <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprint</color>, 
making the weapon craftable. Go hunting with powerful weapons!</size>
<color=#C3C3C3><size=21>* Weapons can be crafted multiple times.</size></color>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Enhanced
Array.english: <size=24>You can now <color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> your guns at Duff’s Weapon Shop!\nCollect various materials and Gun Fragments\nand make your weapons more powerful!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now <color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> your guns at Duff’s Weapon Shop!\nCollect various materials and Gun Fragments\nand make your weapons more powerful!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SubMission
Array.english: <size=23>Sometimes characters will come to Dave for help.\nIf there is a <color=#F39321>Time</color> icon, the objective has to be accomplished within the day.\nComplete their quests and receive rewards!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=23>Sometimes characters will come to Dave for help.\nIf there is a <color=#F39321>Time</color> icon, the objective has to be accomplished within the day.\nComplete their quests and receive rewards!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Research
Array.english: <size=24>You can now research new recipes.\nUse the <color=#1DFEAF>Artisan’s Flame</color> to expand your Menu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now research new recipes.\nUse the <color=#1DFEAF>Artisan’s Flame</color> to expand your Menu!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SushiBarOpen
Array.english: <size=24>The sushi bar is only open at <color=#F1DC2B>night</color>.\nCollect lots of ingredients during the day and get rich!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>The sushi bar is only open at <color=#F1DC2B>night</color>.\nCollect lots of ingredients during the day and get rich!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SushiMenu
Array.english: <size=24>Customers will order dishes from the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.\nDon’t forget to register dishes to the Menu before the sushi bar opens!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Customers will order dishes from the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.\nDon’t forget to register dishes to the Menu before the sushi bar opens!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SNSLevel
Array.english: <size=24>Raise your rating in Cooksta!\nMore customers will visit and new foods will be unlocked!\nThe unlock conditions of new ratings can be seen in the <color=#F1DC2B>Cooksta App</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Raise your rating in Cooksta!\nMore customers will visit and new foods will be unlocked!\nThe unlock conditions of new ratings can be seen in the <color=#F1DC2B>Cooksta App</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SushiStaff
Array.english: <size=24>Hire <color=#F1DC2B>employees</color> to reduce the workload!\nEmployees help serve food in the Dining Area\nor make cooking food faster.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Hire <color=#F1DC2B>employees</color> to reduce the workload!\nEmployees help serve food in the Dining Area\nor make cooking food faster.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_QTE_Drink
Array.english: <size=24>Customers will now sometimes order <color=#F1DC2B>Beer</color> after their meal.\nPour them their drinks and create additional revenue!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Customers will now sometimes order <color=#F1DC2B>Beer</color> after their meal.\nPour them their drinks and create additional revenue!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_CobraShop
Array.english: <size=23>You can buy Auxilliary Items and sell your items at the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color>!\nThe Cobra Shop is only accessible in the morning and afternoon.\nPurchased Items can only be used for one day, so keep that in mind!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=23>You can buy Auxilliary Items and sell your items at the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color>!\nThe Cobra Shop is only accessible in the morning and afternoon.\nPurchased Items can only be used for one day, so keep that in mind!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Idiver
Array.english: <size=23>The <color=#F1DC2B>iDiver</color> app allows you to enhance various diving equipment.\nUpgrade equipment with the money you make at the sushi bar\nand elsewhere and explore deeper waters!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=23>The <color=#F1DC2B>iDiver</color> app allows you to enhance various diving equipment.\nUpgrade equipment with the money you make at the sushi bar\nand elsewhere and explore deeper waters!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_GasCutting
Array.english: <size=24>Power up the <color=#F1DC2B>Cutter</color>, then use <image=MiniGame.CuttingMove, preset=ContentsGuide_CN/><image=MiniGame.CuttingMoveMouse, preset=ContentsGuide_CN/> to move.\nBe sure to stay inside the <color=#00FF00>circle</color> while moving!</size><Touch> <color=#00FF00>Press and hold anywhere on the left side of the screen</color> to power up the <color=#F1DC2B>Cutter</color>.\nDrag to the right to start cutting. Don't move outside the <color=#00FF00>circle</color>!</Touch>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Power up the <color=#F1DC2B>Cutter</color>, then use <image=MiniGame.CuttingMove, preset=ContentsGuide_CN/><image=MiniGame.CuttingMoveMouse, preset=ContentsGuide_CN/> to move.\nBe sure to stay inside the <color=#00FF00>circle</color> while moving!</size><Touch> <color=#00FF00>Press and hold anywhere on the left side of the screen</color> to power up the <color=#F1DC2B>Cutter</color>.\nDrag to the right to start cutting. Don't move outside the <color=#00FF00>circle</color>!</Touch>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_FirstPickupGun
Array.english: <size=24>Picking up new weapons will allow you to collect <color=#F1DC2B>Blueprints</color>.\nWhen you reach a certain number of Blueprints, \nyou’ll be able to craft the new weapon.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Picking up new weapons will allow you to collect <color=#F1DC2B>Blueprints</color>.\nWhen you reach a certain number of Blueprints, \nyou’ll be able to craft the new weapon.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_FirstExecuteWasabi
Array.english: <size=24>You won’t be able to produce food if you run out of <color=#F1DC2B>Wasabi</color>!\nGrind and refill the wasabi before it runs out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You won’t be able to produce food if you run out of <color=#F1DC2B>Wasabi</color>!\nGrind and refill the wasabi before it runs out!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Mission_RamoConvoy
Array.english: <size=24>Get to the target location safely with Ramo on your back.\nRamo has the ability to open up Tubeworm paths.\nWatch your surroundings carefully and escort her safely!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Get to the target location safely with Ramo on your back.\nRamo has the ability to open up Tubeworm paths.\nWatch your surroundings carefully and escort her safely!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_FirstPickupUVLight
Array.english: <size=24>The Tubeworms will shrink away from <color=#F1DC2B>UV Light</color>, allowing you to pass.\nFind a UV Light in a nearby chest.\nIf you can’t find one... maybe try a melee attack?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>The Tubeworms will shrink away from <color=#F1DC2B>UV Light</color>, allowing you to pass.\nFind a UV Light in a nearby chest.\nIf you can’t find one... maybe try a melee attack?</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_FirstPickupPikeaxe
Array.english: <size=24>Some minerals can only be mined with a <color=#F1DC2B>Pickaxe</color>.\nAcquire valuable minerals with your Pickaxe \nand upgrade your weapons.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Some minerals can only be mined with a <color=#F1DC2B>Pickaxe</color>.\nAcquire valuable minerals with your Pickaxe \nand upgrade your weapons.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_NightDive
Array.english:
<size=23>You can now dive once every <color=#F1DC2B>night</color>.
There are many vicious nocturnal fish out at night, 
but you’ll also see exotic fish.
Always pay attention to the sushi bar’s opening hours!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=23>You can now dive once every <color=#F1DC2B>night</color>.
There are many vicious nocturnal fish out at night, 
but you’ll also see exotic fish.
Always pay attention to the sushi bar’s opening hours!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SushiDash
Array.english:
<size=24>You can <color=#F1DC2B>dash</color> while serving customers!
Use <image=Dave.Sushi_Dash, preset=ContentsGuide_CN/> to move faster.
Remember to keep an eye on your stamina!</size><Touch><size=24> You can <color=#F1DC2B>dash</color> while serving customers!
Remember to keep an eye on your stamina!</size></Touch>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>You can <color=#F1DC2B>dash</color> while serving customers!

Remember to keep an eye on your stamina!</size><Touch><size=24> You can <color=#F1DC2B>dash</color> while serving customers!
Remember to keep an eye on your stamina!</size></Touch>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_EcoWatcher
Array.english: <size=24>Use the <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color> app to check on various ecological missions.\nGather points to receive various rewards.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Use the <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color> app to check on various ecological missions.\nGather points to receive various rewards.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Charm
Array.english: <size=23>You can equip <color=#F1DC2B>Charms</color> and swap them out in the Inventory.\nCharms have various effects that will help you out in the game,\nso don’t forget to try them out if you find them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=23>You can equip <color=#F1DC2B>Charms</color> and swap them out in the Inventory.\nCharms have various effects that will help you out in the game,\nso don’t forget to try them out if you find them!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_FishFarm
Array.english: <size=24>When catching fish, you’ll sometimes acquire <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Eggs</color>.\nThese can be hatched in the Fish Farm.\nIf hunting isn’t a viable option, try getting ingredients from the Fish Farm!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>When catching fish, you’ll sometimes acquire <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Eggs</color>.\nThese can be hatched in the Fish Farm.\nIf hunting isn’t a viable option, try getting ingredients from the Fish Farm!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_FishFarm_Breed
Array.english: <size=24>If you have 2 or more of the same kind of fish\nthere’s a chance for a <color=#F1DC2B>Baby Fish</color> to be born!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>If you have 2 or more of the same kind of fish\nthere’s a chance for a <color=#F1DC2B>Baby Fish</color> to be born!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Catcher
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Bug Net</color> to capture small creatures\nlike Seahorses and Clione, which can’t be caught with a Harpoon.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Bug Net</color> to capture small creatures\nlike Seahorses and Clione, which can’t be caught with a Harpoon.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_FishCard
Array.english: <size=24>Catching fish will allow you to automatically acquire <color=#F1DC2B>Marine Cards</color>.\nYou’ll get fancier cards for catching higher-grade fish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Catching fish will allow you to automatically acquire <color=#F1DC2B>Marine Cards</color>.\nYou’ll get fancier cards for catching higher-grade fish!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_FishCard_NewPack
Array.english: <size=24>Entering a new region will open up a new <color=#F1DC2B>Card Pack List</color>.\nUse the <color=#F1DC2B>Marine Card</color> app to check on new fish! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Entering a new region will open up a new <color=#F1DC2B>Card Pack List</color>.\nUse the <color=#F1DC2B>Marine Card</color> app to check on new fish! </size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Mirror
Array.english: <size=24>You can use the <color=#F1DC2B>Mirror</color> Tenzhin gave you to immediately \ntravel to the Sea People Village.\nThe mirror is solar-powered, so it cannot be used at night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can use the <color=#F1DC2B>Mirror</color> Tenzhin gave you to immediately \ntravel to the Sea People Village.\nThe mirror is solar-powered, so it cannot be used at night.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SpecialCustomer
Array.english:
<size=23>Sometimes, special customers with a backstory will 
hear of the sushi bar and visit.
Learn dishes that the customers want through <color=#F1DC2B>Research</color> 
and serve them to the customers!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=23>Sometimes, special customers with a backstory will 
hear of the sushi bar and visit.
Learn dishes that the customers want through <color=#F1DC2B>Research</color> 
and serve them to the customers!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_VIPCustomer
Array.english: <size=24>Sometimes a VIP customer will order a dish that’s not on the menu.\nProcure the ingredients by the <color=#F1DC2B>Designated Date</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Sometimes a VIP customer will order a dish that’s not on the menu.\nProcure the ingredients by the <color=#F1DC2B>Designated Date</color>!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Phone
Array.english: <size=24>You can use your phone to access various types of content.\nCheck your current missions and more!</size>\n<size=21><color=#C3C3C3>* Game Settings can be accessed from the Phone.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can use your phone to access various types of content.\nCheck your current missions and more!</size>\n<size=21><color=#C3C3C3>* Game Settings can be accessed from the Phone.</color></size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_WeaponBreak
Array.english: <size=23>You can now disassemble Guns, Harpoon Tips, and other weapons.\nUse the Weapon Fragments acquired from disassembling \nto request Duff to enhance your weapons.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=23>You can now disassemble Guns, Harpoon Tips, and other weapons.\nUse the Weapon Fragments acquired from disassembling \nto request Duff to enhance your weapons.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_LongDash
Array.english: <size=24>You can wear the <color=#F1DC2B>Dolphin Necklace</color> to move faster.\nKeep in mind that oxygen will be used up faster!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can wear the <color=#F1DC2B>Dolphin Necklace</color> to move faster.\nKeep in mind that oxygen will be used up faster!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_ShortDash
Array.english: <size=24>Equip the <color=#F1DC2B>Octopus Bracelet</color>, and you can use <image=InGame.ShortDash, preset=ContentsGuide_CN/> to dash a short distance.\nAlthough this doesn't use up any oxygen, you'll need to wait for the cooldown timer before using it again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Equip the <color=#F1DC2B>Octopus Bracelet</color>, and you can use <image=InGame.ShortDash, preset=ContentsGuide_CN/> to dash a short distance.\nAlthough this doesn't use up any oxygen, you'll need to wait for the cooldown timer before using it again!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SeahorseRacing01
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Cheer</color><image=SeahorseRace.Accel, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> to increase the seahorse’s speed\nand win the race!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Cheer</color><image=SeahorseRace.Accel, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> to increase the seahorse’s speed\nand win the race!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SeahorseRacing02
Array.english: <size=24>If your <color=#F1DC2B>gauge</color> goes past the green bars,\nyou will slow down so be careful!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>If your <color=#F1DC2B>gauge</color> goes past the green bars,\nyou will slow down so be careful!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SeahorseRacing03
Array.english: <size=24>There are different grades and types of races.\nHurdle and Combined races offer greater prizes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>There are different grades and types of races.\nHurdle and Combined races offer greater prizes!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SharkGame
Array.english: <size=24>This is the game of Sharks, which you play with Junak.\nRemember the <color=#F1DC2B>Shark Cavity</color> that you’ll sometimes get a glimpse of!\nNumbers between 1-3 are selected and whoever touches it first will lose.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>This is the game of Sharks, which you play with Junak.\nRemember the <color=#F1DC2B>Shark Cavity</color> that you’ll sometimes get a glimpse of!\nNumbers between 1-3 are selected and whoever touches it first will lose.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Interior
Array.english: <size=24>You can now freely change up the interior of Bancho Sushi!\nUse the <color=#F1DC2B>Interior Tab</color> to select a style to your liking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now freely change up the interior of Bancho Sushi!\nUse the <color=#F1DC2B>Interior Tab</color> to select a style to your liking.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_WeeklyFish
Array.english: <size=23>Strange creatures will sometimes appear in the Giant Blue Hole.\nThey’re called <color=#F1DC2B>FishMon</color> and are anything but easy to catch.\nGet information from the journalist Udo, who comes on Saturdays!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Gardon_Die
Array.english:
<size=23><color=#F1DC2B>Gadon</color> is the name of ancient sea people 
who were mutated for some reason.
No guns or knives can kill them.
Escape the cave without being spotted!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=23><color=#F1DC2B>Gadon</color> is the name of ancient sea people 
who were mutated for some reason.
No guns or knives can kill them.
Escape the cave without being spotted!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Gardon_Hide
Array.english: <size=24>Hide behind a <color=#F1DC2B>stone statue</color> to avoid being seen by Gadon.\nUse the stone statue when you’re in danger.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Hide behind a <color=#F1DC2B>stone statue</color> to avoid being seen by Gadon.\nUse the stone statue when you’re in danger.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_BattleVIP_Cook
Array.english: <size=24>Bancho is set to battle a celebrity chef on an all-new TV show.\nPrepare the <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients</color> Bancho needs and win the competition!\n(Default joystick mode. Motion controls can be changed in Settings.)</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Bancho is set to battle a celebrity chef on an all-new TV show.\nPrepare the <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients</color> Bancho needs and win the competition!\n(Default joystick mode. Motion controls can be changed in Settings.)</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DayEvent
Array.english: <size=24>Special customers arrive during <color=#F1DC2B>events</color>.\nPrepare the dishes they like in advance.\nYou might hit the jackpot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Special customers arrive during <color=#F1DC2B>events</color>.\nPrepare the dishes they like in advance.\nYou might hit the jackpot!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_PhotoZone01
Array.english: <size=24>A <color=#F1DC2B>camera</color> icon indicates that you can take pictures.\nCheck your objective on the top left. </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>A <color=#F1DC2B>camera</color> icon indicates that you can take pictures.\nCheck your objective on the top left. </size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_PhotoZone02
Array.english:
<size=24>After focusing with <image=MiniGame.CaptureShot, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, lift your finger to take the photo.
Snap the shot when the indicator turns green!</size><Touch><color=#F1DC2B> dragging the focus slider, </color>you can adjust the camera zoom.
Hold the shutter button to focus, then release to take the photo.
Snap the shot when the indicator turns green!</Touch>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>After focusing with <image=MiniGame.CaptureShot, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, lift your finger to take the photo.
Snap the shot when the indicator turns green!</size><Touch><color=#F1DC2B> dragging the focus slider, </color>you can adjust the camera zoom.
Hold the shutter button to focus, then release to take the photo.
Snap the shot when the indicator turns green!</Touch>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Drone
Array.english: <size=24>Large fish caught with the net can be retrieved using the <color=#F1DC2B>salvage drone</color>.\nYou only have a limited number, but it can be upgraded in the iDiver.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Large fish caught with the net can be retrieved using the <color=#F1DC2B>salvage drone</color>.\nYou only have a limited number, but it can be upgraded in the iDiver.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_EscapePod
Array.english: <size=24>Use the <color=#F1DC2B>Escape Pod</color> to escape to your boat as quickly as possible.\nCheck your surroundings first as the calling process takes some time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Use the <color=#F1DC2B>Escape Pod</color> to escape to your boat as quickly as possible.\nCheck your surroundings first as the calling process takes some time!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_GreenTea
Array.english: <size=24>Customers who drink green tea of a GOOD \nor higher grade will pay more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Customers who drink green tea of a GOOD \nor higher grade will pay more.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_UdoPhotoZone
Array.english: <size=24>You can take pictures of living creatures at a <color=#F1DC2B>Photo Spot</color>.\nTake your pictures to Udo to claim rewards!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can take pictures of living creatures at a <color=#F1DC2B>Photo Spot</color>.\nTake your pictures to Udo to claim rewards!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Stealth
Array.english: <size=24>Get <color=#F1DC2B>special suit components</color> from the top floor!\nBe careful not to get caught by soldiers or cameras!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Get <color=#F1DC2B>special suit components</color> from the top floor!\nBe careful not to get caught by soldiers or cameras!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Flashlight
Array.english: <size=24>Find Linchen’s pet squid, <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color>!\nUse the flashlight to look around closely.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Find Linchen’s pet squid, <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color>!\nUse the flashlight to look around closely.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_PhoneGame
Array.english: <size=24>A new mobile game called <color=#F1DC2B>Leahs RUN!</color> is now available!\nYou can play the game from your phone’s Game Factory.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>A new mobile game called <color=#F1DC2B>Leahs RUN!</color> is now available!\nYou can play the game from your phone’s Game Factory.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_HermitCrabGame
Array.english: <size=24>In this game you try to find the hermit crab that hid the <color=#F1DC2B>pearl</color>.\nGuess which of the fast-moving hermit crabs hid the pearl!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In this game you try to find the hermit crab that hid the <color=#F1DC2B>pearl</color>.\nGuess which of the fast-moving hermit crabs hid the pearl!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_OverWeight
Array.english:
<size=24>If you exceed your weight limit, you will slow down.
If you exceed an even higher amount,
you won't be able to carry any more.
Press <image=InGame.Menu, preset=ContentsGuide_EN/> to organize!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>If you exceed your weight limit, you will slow down.
If you exceed an even higher amount,
you won't be able to carry any more.
Press <image=InGame.Menu, preset=ContentsGuide_EN/> to organize!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_BelugaTaxi
Array.english: <size=24>Summon a Beluga using <image=InGame.MVCallTaxi, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>.\nYou can move faster than normal riding the Beluga.\nOf course, it is not free.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Summon a Beluga using <image=InGame.MVCallTaxi, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>.\nYou can move faster than normal riding the Beluga.\nOf course, it is not free.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_CardMatchGame
Array.english: <size=24>Flip cards to pair up the matching ones.\nWhoever pairs up the most matching cards wins.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Flip cards to pair up the matching ones.\nWhoever pairs up the most matching cards wins.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_MVSeedShop
Array.english: <size=24>You can cultivate many different seaweeds at Gumo’s Farm.\nSeed breeding is available at Kazhin's Seed Shop.
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can cultivate many different seaweeds at Gumo’s Farm.\nSeed breeding is available at Kazhin's Seed Shop.

Array.name: ContentsDesc_MimaRestaurant
Array.english:
<size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Mima’s Dumplings</color> can be ordered twice a day, 
once in the morning and once in the afternoon.
Dumplings give you a special effect that will last 
until you leave the water.
See what that effect is in the pause screen.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Mima’s Dumplings</color> can be ordered twice a day, 
once in the morning and once in the afternoon.
Dumplings give you a special effect that will last 
until you leave the water.
See what that effect is in the pause screen.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_MVBlacksmith
Array.english: <size=24>You can purchase <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients</color> from Duwa’s Workshop \nto enhance weapons.\nDuwa exchanges certain ingredients for Bei.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can purchase <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients</color> from Duwa’s Workshop \nto enhance weapons.\nDuwa exchanges certain ingredients for Bei.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Cocktail
Array.english: <size=24>From now on, customers will begin to order <color=#F1DC2B>Cocktails</color>.\nServe Cocktails as requested in the right order!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>From now on, customers will begin to order <color=#F1DC2B>Cocktails</color>.\nServe Cocktails as requested in the right order!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_SushiBar_Branch
Array.english: <size=24>A branch of <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color> is now open!\nAssign a manager and employees to the branch and send the required ingredients to run the business automatically.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>A branch of <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color> is now open!\nAssign a manager and employees to the branch and send the required ingredients to run the business automatically.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_PDA
Array.english: <size=24>You can now press <image=InGame.PDA, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> to use the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Tracker</color> underwater.\nEven underwater, you can easily check ingredient quantities at the Fish Farm and Sushi Bar, as well as the level of fish you've caught!</size><Touch><size=24> You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Tracker</color> underwater.\nEven underwater, you can easily check ingredient quantities at the Fish Farm and Sushi Bar, as well as the level of fish you've caught!</size></Touch>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now press <image=InGame.PDA, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> to use the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Tracker</color> underwater.\nEven underwater, you can easily check ingredient quantities at the Fish Farm and Sushi Bar, as well as the level of fish you've caught!</size><Touch><size=24> You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Tracker</color> underwater.\nEven underwater, you can easily check ingredient quantities at the Fish Farm and Sushi Bar, as well as the level of fish you've caught!</size></Touch>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_NightPhotospot
Array.english: <size=24>From now on, photo spots will appear <color=#F1DC2B>at night</color> as well.\nTake nice evening pictures!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>From now on, photo spots will appear <color=#F1DC2B>at night</color> as well.\nTake nice evening pictures!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_ManagementApp
Array.english: <size=24>You can check Bancho’s Sushi Bar information using the <color=#F1DC2B>Management</color> app.\nCheck it on your phone!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can check Bancho’s Sushi Bar information using the <color=#F1DC2B>Management</color> app.\nCheck it on your phone!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_iDiver_Suit_Lv2
Array.english: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>Cold-resistant Suit</color> that protects you from the cold environment of the Glacial Area! \nUpgrade it further using iDiver to dive even deeper. </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>Cold-resistant Suit</color> that protects you from the cold environment of the Glacial Area! \nUpgrade it further using iDiver to dive even deeper. </size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Gyao01
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>GYAO!</color> is a digital fish that keeps you company in your mobile phone.\nFeed it and make it happy and you can see it mutate into a variety of new creatures.\nTake care of your digital fish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>GYAO!</color> is a digital fish that keeps you company in your mobile phone.\nFeed it and make it happy and you can see it mutate into a variety of new creatures.\nTake care of your digital fish!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Gyao01_2
Array.english: <size=24>If GYAO! falls ill, give him a <color=#F1DC2B>shot</color>.\nAlso, remember to turn off <color=#F1DC2B>the light</color> at night \nso that he can have a good night’s sleep!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>If GYAO! falls ill, give him a <color=#F1DC2B>shot</color>.\nAlso, remember to turn off <color=#F1DC2B>the light</color> at night \nso that he can have a good night’s sleep!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Gyao01_3
Array.english: <size=24>If a <color=#F1DC2B>warning icon</color> shows up, check his Hunger and Affection levels.\nIf there's no issue but he's still calling you, some <color=#F1DC2B>discipline</color> might be necessary!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>If a <color=#F1DC2B>warning icon</color> shows up, check his Hunger and Affection levels.\nIf there's no issue but he's still calling you, some <color=#F1DC2B>discipline</color> might be necessary!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Gyao02
Array.english: <size=24>If you go to Options and turn on <color=#F1DC2B>Notifications</color>, you'll get updates about the status of GYAO! even without turning on your smartphone.\nMake sure to check up on him!</size></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>If you go to Options and turn on <color=#F1DC2B>Notifications</color>, you'll get updates about the status of GYAO! even without turning on your smartphone.\nMake sure to check up on him!</size></size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_3rdWeaponTree
Array.english: <size=24>You can now create weapons with the Sea People’s materials!\nVisit the <color=#F1DC2B>Workshop</color> at the Sea People Village to find out about new materials available!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now create weapons with the Sea People’s materials!\nVisit the <color=#F1DC2B>Workshop</color> at the Sea People Village to find out about new materials available!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_CrabTrap01
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Traps</color>!\nPut some bait in the trap and place it in certain rocky crevices.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now use <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Traps</color>!\nPut some bait in the trap and place it in certain rocky crevices.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_CrabTrap02
Array.english: <size=24>Upon catching a crab, the <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color> will start shaking.\nRemember, unretrieved Crab Traps disappear when you leave the water. Make sure you retrieve them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Upon catching a crab, the <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color> will start shaking.\nRemember, unretrieved Crab Traps disappear when you leave the water. Make sure you retrieve them!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_01
Array.english: <size=24>You can now purchase a machine that will help you run the Chicken Farm!\nIf you purchase an <color=#F1DC2B>Egg Storage Box</color>, you can store up to 50 eggs without harvesting them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now purchase a machine that will help you run the Chicken Farm!\nIf you purchase an <color=#F1DC2B>Egg Storage Box</color>, you can store up to 50 eggs without harvesting them.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_02
Array.english: <size=24>You can use a <color=#F1DC2B>Chicken Feeder</color> to automatically feed your chickens.\nYou can increase the egg production rate depending on the type of feed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can use a <color=#F1DC2B>Chicken Feeder</color> to automatically feed your chickens.\nYou can increase the egg production rate depending on the type of feed.</size>

Array.name: ContentDesc_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_01
Array.english: <size=24>From now on, you can hire <color=#F1DC2B>Sammy</color> to work on your farm.\nSammy can harvest crops, sow seeds, and fertilize and weed fields.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>From now on, you can hire <color=#F1DC2B>Sammy</color> to work on your farm.\nSammy can harvest crops, sow seeds, and fertilize and weed fields.</size>

Array.name: ContentDesc_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_02
Array.english: <size=24>Let Sammy take care of your seeds and fertilizers—he will make farming much easier!\nYou can select how to use fertilizer and the type of seed to plant.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Let Sammy take care of your seeds and fertilizers—he will make farming much easier!\nYou can select how to use fertilizer and the type of seed to plant.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Merchant_Jango
Array.english: <size=24>From now on, <color=#F1DC2B>Jango</color> will visit BANCHO SUSHI every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday afternoon. Jango has special items in stock—visit the sushi restaurant at the right time to see his wares!
Array.indonesia: <size=24>From now on, <color=#F1DC2B>Jango</color> will visit BANCHO SUSHI every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday afternoon. Jango has special items in stock—visit the sushi restaurant at the right time to see his wares!

Array.name: ContentsDesc_IcePicking
Array.english: <size=24>Use an <color=#F1DC2B>Ice Pick</color> to break the ice by striking its weak points!\nFind the right spot before your Ice Pick breaks.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Use an <color=#F1DC2B>Ice Pick</color> to break the ice by striking its weak points!\nFind the right spot before your Ice Pick breaks.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_EALock_Gold
Array.english: <size=24>In Early Access, the maximum amount of Gold \nyou can hold is limited to <color=#F1DC2B>9999</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In Early Access, the maximum amount of Gold \nyou can hold is limited to <color=#F1DC2B>9999</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_EALock_Fire
Array.english: <size=24>In Early Access, the maximum amount of Artisan's Flames \nyou can hold is limited to <color=#F1DC2B>99</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In Early Access, the maximum amount of Artisan's Flames \nyou can hold is limited to <color=#F1DC2B>99</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_EALock_Bei
Array.english: <size=24>In Early Access, the maxmium amount of Bei \nyou can hold is limited to <color=#F1DC2B>999</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In Early Access, the maxmium amount of Bei \nyou can hold is limited to <color=#F1DC2B>999</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_EALock_Item
Array.english: <size=24>In Early Access, the maxmium amount of each item\nyou can hold is limited to <color=#F1DC2B>99</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In Early Access, the maxmium amount of each item\nyou can hold is limited to <color=#F1DC2B>99</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_EALock_Calendar
Array.english: <size=24>In Early Access, <color=#F1DC2B>10/29</color> is the last date.\nBut gameplay is continuously accessible.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In Early Access, <color=#F1DC2B>10/29</color> is the last date.\nBut gameplay is continuously accessible.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_EALock_End
Array.english: <size=23>The main missions provided in Early Access have been completed.\nMissions will be added in the full version.\nHowever, in the meantime you can continue to play as much as you want!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=23>The main missions provided in Early Access have been completed.\nMissions will be added in the full version.\nHowever, in the meantime you can continue to play as much as you want!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Momo_Chasing_01
Array.english: <size=24>Momo disappears every night. Let’s tail Momo!\nTail Momo without being detected using walking and running.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Momo disappears every night. Let’s tail Momo!\nTail Momo without being detected using walking and running.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Momo_Chasing_02
Array.english: <size=24>Momo is sensitive to <color=#F1DC2B>noise</color>.\nBe careful with any objects that might make noise.\nKeep silent by crouching or walking slowly!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Momo is sensitive to <color=#F1DC2B>noise</color>.\nBe careful with any objects that might make noise.\nKeep silent by crouching or walking slowly!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_BelugaDungeon
Array.english: <size=24>In this cave, you can move around with the <color=#F1DC2B>Beluga</color>!\nPress <image=InGame.ShortDash, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> to destroy obstacles in your way!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In this cave, you can move around with the <color=#F1DC2B>Beluga</color>!\nPress <image=InGame.ShortDash, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/> to destroy obstacles in your way!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_GlacialDungeon03_A
Array.english: <size=24>Here, you can switch between <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color>.\nChoose the character that fits the situation to clear the path!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Here, you can switch between <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color>.\nChoose the character that fits the situation to clear the path!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_GlacialDungeon03_B_1
Array.english: <size=24>From this point, you can control both <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> simultaneously.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>From this point, you can control both <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> simultaneously.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_GlacialDungeon03_B_2
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> has the ability to open the Tube worm path and penetrate through sea currents by using Dash. \nHelp Dave reach the destination safely!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> has the ability to open the Tube worm path and penetrate through sea currents by using Dash. \nHelp Dave reach the destination safely!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_iDiver_Basic_Knife
Array.english: <size=24>You can now enhance <color=#F1DC2B>Dive Knife</color> in iDiver.\nEnhancing the knife increases base damage and allows you to gather higher-grade materials.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now enhance <color=#F1DC2B>Dive Knife</color> in iDiver.\nEnhancing the knife increases base damage and allows you to gather higher-grade materials.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_StellaLaser
Array.english: <size=24>Duff has unlocked the drone's <color=#F1DC2B>laser</color> function.\n Hold the <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=ContentsGuide_EN/> to charge the laser\nand release to fire!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Duff has unlocked the drone's <color=#F1DC2B>laser</color> function.\n Hold the <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=ContentsGuide_EN/> to charge the laser\nand release to fire!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Dredge
Array.english: <size=24>During foggy evenings, you can catch <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>.\nMove your boat to find a dive spot.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>During foggy evenings, you can catch <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>.\nMove your boat to find a dive spot.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DredgeingMinigame
Array.english: <size=24>You can dredge up valuables from the sea.\nPress <image=UI.Ok, preset=ContentsGuide_EN/> to avoid the gaps and salvage items.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can dredge up valuables from the sea.\nPress <image=UI.Ok, preset=ContentsGuide_EN/> to avoid the gaps and salvage items.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Dredge_Sushibar
Array.english: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Hooded Figures</color> will constantly order aberrant fish until you close for the day.\nNote that normal guests do not eat aberrant fish. Make sure to prepare other dishes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24><color=#F1DC2B>Hooded Figures</color> will constantly order aberrant fish until you close for the day.\nNote that normal guests do not eat aberrant fish. Make sure to prepare other dishes!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_MeleeWeapon
Array.english: <size=24>Melee weapons can be discarded from the <color=#F1DC2B>pause menu</color>..\nSwitch to the melee weapon best for your situation!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Melee weapons can be discarded from the <color=#F1DC2B>pause menu</color>..\nSwitch to the melee weapon best for your situation!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_Exploration
Array.english: <size=24>Find cooking ingredients and weapon materials more easily!\nYou can check the ingredients and materials needed for a recipe underwater.\nWeapons can be registered at the <color=#F1DC2B>Weapon Shop</color> and dishes through the <color=#F1DC2B>Management App</color> or at <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Find cooking ingredients and weapon materials more easily!\nYou can check the ingredients and materials needed for a recipe underwater.\nWeapons can be registered at the <color=#F1DC2B>Weapon Shop</color> and dishes through the <color=#F1DC2B>Management App</color> or at <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>

Array.name: XDContentsGuide_Custom1
