Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_Firsttalk_001
Array.english: Woah,\nlooks like there’re a lot more tourists around these days.
Array.indonesia: Woah,\nlooks like there’re a lot more tourists around these days.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_Firsttalk_002
Array.english: Indeed. The Blue Hole appears to be gaining fame.
Array.indonesia: Indeed. The Blue Hole appears to be gaining fame.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_Firsttalk_003
Array.english: I must strive even harder in cooking to live up to expectations.
Array.indonesia: I must strive even harder in cooking to live up to expectations.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_001
Array.english: <size=34>Sorry to barge in, I know it's late, but…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sorry to barge in, I know it's late, but…</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_002
Array.english: Hm...? Who might you be? We’re closed for the day.
Array.indonesia: Hm...? Who might you be? We’re closed for the day.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_003
Array.english: Ah, guess it’s already over… Just my luck.
Array.indonesia: Ah, guess it’s already over… Just my luck.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_004
Array.english: Sorry about this, we’re tourists from Japan.
Array.indonesia: Sorry about this, we’re tourists from Japan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_005
Array.english: The roaming connection was bad, and the map wouldn’t load properly, so we had a hard time finding this place...
Array.indonesia: The roaming connection was bad, and the map wouldn’t load properly, so we had a hard time finding this place...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_006
Array.english: <size=32>We haven’t eaten since this morning…\nI know it’s rude to ask, but is there anything we could eat?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>We haven’t eaten since this morning…\nI know it’s rude to ask, but is there anything we could eat?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_007
Array.english: Well... I’ve just cleaned up... \nUnfortunately, there’s nothing at the moment.
Array.indonesia: Well... I’ve just cleaned up... \nUnfortunately, there’s nothing at the moment.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_008
Array.english: Well then... never mind the food.
Array.indonesia: Well then... never mind the food.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_009
Array.english: Oh? There's some liquor over there.\nWould you be able to make something refreshing,\nlike a <color=#1DFEAF>cocktail</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh? There's some liquor over there.\nWould you be able to make something refreshing,\nlike a <color=#1DFEAF>cocktail</color>?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchosushi_Kasuga_Enter_010
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Cocktail</color> should be fine!\nI'll make one for you right away! Here you go!
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Cocktail</color> should be fine!\nI'll make one for you right away! Here you go!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Thank you... Wait...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Thank you... Wait...!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_002
Array.english: <size=32>What’s wrong?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What’s wrong?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_003
Array.english: This mixture tastes off… Perhaps there’s an issue with the way the ingredients are stored?
Array.indonesia: This mixture tastes off… Perhaps there’s an issue with the way the ingredients are stored?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_004
Array.english: Never mind. I suppose I shouldn’t expect much more from a small town like this.
Array.indonesia: Never mind. I suppose I shouldn’t expect much more from a small town like this.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_005
Array.english: <size=31>... What do you mean? \nAre you saying it tastes foul?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>... What do you mean? \nAre you saying it tastes foul?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_006
Array.english: It’s not that bad…\nIt seems you haven’t really studied cocktails professionally?
Array.indonesia: It’s not that bad…\nIt seems you haven’t really studied cocktails professionally?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_007
Array.english: Uhh... the cocktail is a skill we have only recently acquired.\nOur true specialty, of course, lies in fish dishes.
Array.indonesia: Uhh... the cocktail is a skill we have only recently acquired.\nOur true specialty, of course, lies in fish dishes.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_008
Array.english: Hmph. Well, that’s a relief.
Array.indonesia: Hmph. Well, that’s a relief.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_009
Array.english: <size=33>Hmph...! What do you mean by that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmph...! What do you mean by that?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_010
Array.english: Sorry! He didn’t mean anything by it.\nHe’s just a bit on edge from the long journey and being hungry.
Array.indonesia: Sorry! He didn’t mean anything by it.\nHe’s just a bit on edge from the long journey and being hungry.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_011
Array.english: Still, this place is way cooler than the photos in the guidebook.
Array.indonesia: Still, this place is way cooler than the photos in the guidebook.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_012
Array.english: And a sushi spot right by the beach?\nThe location’s amazing!
Array.indonesia: And a sushi spot right by the beach?\nThe location’s amazing!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail01_013
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks for the meal! We’re kinda tired from our late flight, haha. We’ll get going then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thanks for the meal! We’re kinda tired from our late flight, haha. We’ll get going then!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_001
Array.english: They left like a storm, but they were interesting people.
Array.indonesia: They left like a storm, but they were interesting people.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_002
Array.english: Um... the cocktail...\nwas perfectly fine... what could be the issue?
Array.indonesia: Um... the cocktail...\nwas perfectly fine... what could be the issue?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_003
Array.english: Come on, don’t overthink it!\nThey’re just tourists after all.
Array.indonesia: Come on, don’t overthink it!\nThey’re just tourists after all.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_004
Array.english: Maybe I didn’t mix it right, who knows!
Array.indonesia: Maybe I didn’t mix it right, who knows!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_005
Array.english: The cleaning’s all done, so let’s head home!
Array.indonesia: The cleaning’s all done, so let’s head home!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_FirstBanchoSushi_AfterCocktail02_006
Array.english: …Alright, got it...
Array.indonesia: …Alright, got it...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_001
Array.english: Now that I think about it, we had some tough-looking customers from Japan yesterday.
Array.indonesia: Now that I think about it, we had some tough-looking customers from Japan yesterday.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? Did they cause trouble?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh? Did they cause trouble?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_003
Array.english: Nope, nothing like that...\nThey just looked a little scary, I guess?
Array.indonesia: Nope, nothing like that...\nThey just looked a little scary, I guess?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_004
Array.english: A scar-faced person criticized our cocktail and caused \nsome tension.
Array.indonesia: A scar-faced person criticized our cocktail and caused \nsome tension.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Bancho Sushi isn’t exactly known for its drinks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Bancho Sushi isn’t exactly known for its drinks!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_2_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Thanks again for yesterday!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Thanks again for yesterday!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue01_2_002
Array.english: Hmm?
Array.indonesia: Hmm?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Man! This place is really great for beating the heat! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Man! This place is really great for beating the heat! </size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_002
Array.english: Oh, you’re that scary guy from last time. \nEnjoying your vacation?
Array.indonesia: Oh, you’re that scary guy from last time. \nEnjoying your vacation?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_003
Array.english: Yeah, the waves are calm and there are all kinds of fish...\nThis place is the best!
Array.indonesia: Yeah, the waves are calm and there are all kinds of fish...\nThis place is the best!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_004
Array.english: Cool! Well, stop by our restaurant for a meal next time.
Array.indonesia: Cool! Well, stop by our restaurant for a meal next time.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_005
Array.english: Haha! Sure. \nOh, I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Kasuga</color>, by the way.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Sure. \nOh, I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Kasuga</color>, by the way.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_006
Array.english: The guy that was with me that time... Um... \nJust call him <color=#F1DC2B>Bartender</color>.
Array.indonesia: The guy that was with me that time... Um... \nJust call him <color=#F1DC2B>Bartender</color>.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_007
Array.english: I’m Dave, and this is Cobra.
Array.indonesia: I’m Dave, and this is Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_008
Array.english: Hahaha! Funny hairstyle!\nDid you get caught in an explosion or something?
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Funny hairstyle!\nDid you get caught in an explosion or something?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_009
Array.english: Ah this...\nI was going for a punch perm, but it failed spectacularly.
Array.indonesia: Ah this...\nI was going for a punch perm, but it failed spectacularly.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue02_010
Array.english: <size=33>Huh?\nThat sounded like a dolphin?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh?\nThat sounded like a dolphin?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oi! Get outta my way, old man!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oi! Get outta my way, old man!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_002
Array.english: Are you... talkin’ to me?
Array.indonesia: Are you... talkin’ to me?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_003
Array.english: <size=33>Of course I’m talkin’ to you!\nYou’re gettin’ in the way of us catchin’ dolphins!\nYou wanna get shot at?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Of course I’m talkin’ to you!\nYou’re gettin’ in the way of us catchin’ dolphins!\nYou wanna get shot at?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_004
Array.english: <size=33>Catching dolphins...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Catching dolphins...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_005
Array.english: <size=35>It's those Sea Blue guys again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It's those Sea Blue guys again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_006
Array.english: Huh? That’s the guy who snuck into our base...!
Array.indonesia: Huh? That’s the guy who snuck into our base...!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_007
Array.english: You think hidin’ behind a mask would fool us?\nWe got chewed out by the boss ‘cuz of you!
Array.indonesia: You think hidin’ behind a mask would fool us?\nWe got chewed out by the boss ‘cuz of you!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue03_008
Array.english: <size=35>Nice runnin’ into you! Get ready to eat lead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Nice runnin’ into you! Get ready to eat lead!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue04_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh...! Why the heck are his punches so darn strong...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh...! Why the heck are his punches so darn strong...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue04_002
Array.english: <size=35>You’ll regret this, you bastards!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>You’ll regret this, you bastards!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_001
Array.english: What’s with these dudes?
Array.indonesia: What’s with these dudes?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_002
Array.english: They’re from <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, an organization running an illegal dolphin-poaching operation.
Array.indonesia: They’re from <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, an organization running an illegal dolphin-poaching operation.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_003
Array.english: I guess they aren’t ordinary pirates, huh?
Array.indonesia: I guess they aren’t ordinary pirates, huh?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_004
Array.english: I snuck into their base the other day, but...
Array.indonesia: I snuck into their base the other day, but...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_005
Array.english: Turned out they were running a meat processing plant.
Array.indonesia: Turned out they were running a meat processing plant.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_006
Array.english: They even had some kind of experiment plans written \non the walls...
Array.indonesia: They even had some kind of experiment plans written \non the walls...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_007
Array.english: That's fishy, like they’re trying to do something with dolphins.\nPeople like that, if you leave them alone, they’ll just multiply like cockroaches.
Array.indonesia: That's fishy, like they’re trying to do something with dolphins.\nPeople like that, if you leave them alone, they’ll just multiply like cockroaches.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_008
Array.english: <size=32>It seems we were fated to meet. Lemme help ya out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It seems we were fated to meet. Lemme help ya out!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_009
Array.english: Um... Thanks for the offer, but the entrance to their base is hidden behind a thick steel gate under the sea.
Array.indonesia: Um... Thanks for the offer, but the entrance to their base is hidden behind a thick steel gate under the sea.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_010
Array.english: I managed to tail a drone to enter the gate before…\nBut now, security's probably much stricter than before.
Array.indonesia: I managed to tail a drone to enter the gate before…\nBut now, security's probably much stricter than before.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_010_1
Array.english: <size=32>I might not seem like it, but I've survived plenty of brutal fights back in Japan. Just leave it to me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I might not seem like it, but I've survived plenty of brutal fights back in Japan. Just leave it to me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_011
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Just telling me to leave it to you? \nYou're a funny one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Just telling me to leave it to you? \nYou're a funny one!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_012
Array.english: Your hair reminded me of somethin’...
Array.indonesia: Your hair reminded me of somethin’...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_013
Array.english: I’ve got a spare <color=#1DFEAF>Large Explosive</color> with me!\nShould be enough to blow open that door!
Array.indonesia: I’ve got a spare <color=#1DFEAF>Large Explosive</color> with me!\nShould be enough to blow open that door!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_014
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Why would you keep spare explosives on you...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Why would you keep spare explosives on you...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_015
Array.english: So... Looks like this will depend on you and your great swimming abilities, Dave.
Array.indonesia: So... Looks like this will depend on you and your great swimming abilities, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_016
Array.english: We’ll definitely run into more pirates on the way too...
Array.indonesia: We’ll definitely run into more pirates on the way too...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_017
Array.english: Can you swim, Kasuga?
Array.indonesia: Can you swim, Kasuga?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_018
Array.english: Haha! Of course! But I’m not that great at it, though.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Of course! But I’m not that great at it, though.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_019
Array.english: Then I’ll lend you some diving gear. \nYou can escort Dave.
Array.indonesia: Then I’ll lend you some diving gear. \nYou can escort Dave.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_020
Array.english: That means you’ll be carrying the bomb, Dave.
Array.indonesia: That means you’ll be carrying the bomb, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_020_1
Array.english: …But it looks very heavy.
Array.indonesia: …But it looks very heavy.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_020_2
Array.english: Hahaha! Being underwater should make it easier than on land.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Being underwater should make it easier than on land.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_021
Array.english: Let's see...\nA late night like last time might be too dangerous for Kasuga…
Array.indonesia: Let's see...\nA late night like last time might be too dangerous for Kasuga…

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_022
Array.english: <size=33>Evening would be best, before it gets too dark!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Evening would be best, before it gets too dark!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_023
Array.english: You guys should head out before the sushi bar opens at night.
Array.indonesia: You guys should head out before the sushi bar opens at night.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BoatSeaBlue05_024
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s gather back here after your afternoon dive!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s gather back here after your afternoon dive!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Great! You’re all back. \nAre you guys ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Great! You’re all back. \nAre you guys ready?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat01_002
Array.english: Of course! I’m itching for a fight!
Array.indonesia: Of course! I’m itching for a fight!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! I like your enthusiasm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! I like your enthusiasm.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat01_004
Array.english: All right. Dave, grab that <color=#1DFEAF>Large Explosive</color> over there.
Array.indonesia: All right. Dave, grab that <color=#1DFEAF>Large Explosive</color> over there.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat02_001
Array.english: Ugh... This is really heavy. \nCarrying this is gonna be a pain.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... This is really heavy. \nCarrying this is gonna be a pain.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat02_002
Array.english: Fear not! I’ll escort you.
Array.indonesia: Fear not! I’ll escort you.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat02_003
Array.english: Hahaha! That’s the spirit. \nI’ll leave it to you guys then!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! That’s the spirit. \nI’ll leave it to you guys then!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Boat02_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s end this once and for all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s end this once and for all!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Diving_001
Array.english: You got that radar I gave you, Kasuga?
Array.indonesia: You got that radar I gave you, Kasuga?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Diving_002
Array.english: Sure thing. Do I just follow what it says on here?
Array.indonesia: Sure thing. Do I just follow what it says on here?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Diving_003
Array.english: <size=35>Looks really simple!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Looks really simple!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_001
Array.english: Huh? Diving at this hour...?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Diving at this hour...?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>Suspicious! What’re ya up to?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Suspicious! What’re ya up to?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_003
Array.english: <size=34>We’re gonna blow up your base...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>We’re gonna blow up your base...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_004
Array.english: Ah, Kasuga... If you say something like that...!
Array.indonesia: Ah, Kasuga... If you say something like that...!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_005
Array.english: You’ve got some nerve saying that so bluntly!\nI’ll make sure you learn the hard way if you try to get in our way!
Array.indonesia: You’ve got some nerve saying that so bluntly!\nI’ll make sure you learn the hard way if you try to get in our way!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_006
Array.english: <size=32>Ya not gonna get away this time!\nNot with that heavy thing in ya hand!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ya not gonna get away this time!\nNot with that heavy thing in ya hand!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>Pfft. I’ll take you on!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Pfft. I’ll take you on!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01End_001
Array.english: Those Sea Blue guys, looks like they were up to something at this hour.
Array.indonesia: Those Sea Blue guys, looks like they were up to something at this hour.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01End_002
Array.english: I think there are more of them around.
Array.indonesia: I think there are more of them around.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage01End_003
Array.english: <size=32>Don’t matter how many there are!\nI’ll beat the lights out of ‘em!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Don’t matter how many there are!\nI’ll beat the lights out of ‘em!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whatcha think ya doin’?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whatcha think ya doin’?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh! It’s those pirate guys again...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh! It’s those pirate guys again...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02Start_003
Array.english: Watch out. They might be carrying deadlier weapons.
Array.indonesia: Watch out. They might be carrying deadlier weapons.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02End_001
Array.english: Phew... What the heck are they even doin’ here?\nWhat’s with all the security?
Array.indonesia: Phew... What the heck are they even doin’ here?\nWhat’s with all the security?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02End_002
Array.english: Yeah, I mean, for just dolphin-poaching, this is a little over \nthe top...
Array.indonesia: Yeah, I mean, for just dolphin-poaching, this is a little over \nthe top...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage02End_003
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s just keep pressing forward.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s just keep pressing forward.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>That’s the door up ahead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>That’s the door up ahead!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03Start_002
Array.english: I knew it, there’re people guardin’ it.
Array.indonesia: I knew it, there’re people guardin’ it.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03Start_003
Array.english: Wait right here.
Array.indonesia: Wait right here.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>I’ll handle it right away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I’ll handle it right away!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03End_001
Array.english: Phew... It’s not easy fighting underwater...
Array.indonesia: Phew... It’s not easy fighting underwater...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03End_002
Array.english: I think that’s the last of them.
Array.indonesia: I think that’s the last of them.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Underwater_Stage03End_003
Array.english: <size=33>Glad to hear it. Let's head toward the door!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Glad to hear it. Let's head toward the door!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BombSet_001
Array.english: Time to set up the door with this explosive.
Array.indonesia: Time to set up the door with this explosive.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BombSet_002
Array.english: Just a sec, Kasuga.
Array.indonesia: Just a sec, Kasuga.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BombSet_Faraway_001
Array.english: <size=32>All right! It’s done.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>All right! It’s done.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BombSet_Faraway_002
Array.english: <size=34>Take a step back, and I’ll set it off!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Take a step back, and I’ll set it off!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseEnter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Awesome, it’s open! Let’s go in!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Awesome, it’s open! Let’s go in!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside01_001
Array.english: Ugh... This place is just as unpleasant the second time around.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... This place is just as unpleasant the second time around.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside01_002
Array.english: There’s gonna be a bunch of armed pirates up ahead.\nKeep your eyes peeled.
Array.indonesia: There’s gonna be a bunch of armed pirates up ahead.\nKeep your eyes peeled.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside01_003
Array.english: I’ve fought tougher guys than this. \nThis is a piece of cake...
Array.indonesia: I’ve fought tougher guys than this. \nThis is a piece of cake...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Cobra...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Cobra...?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_002
Array.english: Hahaha! Even if you're good at fighting, pal,\nI was still worried about letting you go alone.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Even if you're good at fighting, pal,\nI was still worried about letting you go alone.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_003
Array.english: Don’t overdo it, or you’re gonna hurt yourself, old man.
Array.indonesia: Don’t overdo it, or you’re gonna hurt yourself, old man.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_004
Array.english: Pfft. Don’t you worry about me. I’m ex-special forces... Although I left early due to certain circumstances.
Array.indonesia: Pfft. Don’t you worry about me. I’m ex-special forces... Although I left early due to certain circumstances.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Oh... This is the first time I heard about this.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Oh... This is the first time I heard about this.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_006
Array.english: <size=34>I’m itching for some action after so long!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’m itching for some action after so long!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_007
Array.english: <size=34>All right, this is a job for the ultimate trio then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>All right, this is a job for the ultimate trio then!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_008
Array.english: Dave... Hate to kill the mood... \nI need your help with something else…
Array.indonesia: Dave... Hate to kill the mood... \nI need your help with something else…

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_009
Array.english: ...Huh? But I’m going with you...!
Array.indonesia: ...Huh? But I’m going with you...!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_010
Array.english: <size=33>Ah! Why don’t you find us an escape route back to \nthe dry land? </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah! Why don’t you find us an escape route back to \nthe dry land? </size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_011
Array.english: <size=33>I need you on this top-secret mission! \nIt’s more important!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I need you on this top-secret mission! \nIt’s more important!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_012
Array.english: <size=34>I-I see! A secret mission!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I-I see! A secret mission!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_013
Array.english: <size=34>All right. I’ll let you handle the rest then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>All right. I’ll let you handle the rest then!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_BaseInside02_014
Array.english: <size=35>Let's go all out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let's go all out!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Heh, you've got some spirit, pal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Heh, you've got some spirit, pal.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha. Just try not to hurt your back, old man!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha. Just try not to hurt your back, old man!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Lab_001
Array.english: This place... Looks like some kinda lab.
Array.indonesia: This place... Looks like some kinda lab.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Lab_002
Array.english: Something is off here. Let’s keep going.
Array.indonesia: Something is off here. Let’s keep going.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_001
Array.english: <size=32>M-Mr. Torben! Intruders...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>M-Mr. Torben! Intruders...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_002
Array.english: Huh...? How did they get in here...?!
Array.indonesia: Huh...? How did they get in here...?!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_003
Array.english: This... ain’t just a slaughterhouse, is it?
Array.indonesia: This... ain’t just a slaughterhouse, is it?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_004
Array.english: They’re catching dolphins and experimenting on them.\nWhat in the world...
Array.indonesia: They’re catching dolphins and experimenting on them.\nWhat in the world...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_005
Array.english: Argh... I don’t know what you’re doing here,\nbut you’re not leaving this place alive...!
Array.indonesia: Argh... I don’t know what you’re doing here,\nbut you’re not leaving this place alive...!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss01_006
Array.english: <size=35>Take them out!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Take them out!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ha...! You’re pretty good...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha...! You’re pretty good...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss02_002
Array.english: As a sign of respect...\nI’ll take you on with my secret weapon!
Array.indonesia: As a sign of respect...\nI’ll take you on with my secret weapon!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss02_003
Array.english: <size=33>I’ll put you out of your misery soon enough!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I’ll put you out of your misery soon enough!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Uhh... I haven’t used this in a while, did it get rusty...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Uhh... I haven’t used this in a while, did it get rusty...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_002
Array.english: Guess I’ll have to inject some energy I harvested from the Blue Hole...
Array.indonesia: Guess I’ll have to inject some energy I harvested from the Blue Hole...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_003
Array.english: Though the research isn’t complete...\nthis will be a great opportunity for a test run! Hehe!
Array.indonesia: Though the research isn’t complete...\nthis will be a great opportunity for a test run! Hehe!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima01_001
Array.english: Ow... I twisted my ankle.
Array.indonesia: Ow... I twisted my ankle.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima01_002
Array.english: Uh... This is gonna be tough.
Array.indonesia: Uh... This is gonna be tough.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Now, I will end you with this final blow!!\nBrace yourselves! Hehe!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Now, I will end you with this final blow!!\nBrace yourselves! Hehe!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oi, frizzhead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oi, frizzhead!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_002
Array.english: ... Majima-san? How did you get here?
Array.indonesia: ... Majima-san? How did you get here?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_003
Array.english: Heard you were flyin’ overseas, so I followed you here,\nthought I’d get to meet Kiryu-chan...
Array.indonesia: Heard you were flyin’ overseas, so I followed you here,\nthought I’d get to meet Kiryu-chan...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_004
Array.english: <size=33>What’s with this mess?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What’s with this mess?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_005
Array.english: Uh... This is embarrassing.
Array.indonesia: Uh... This is embarrassing.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_006
Array.english: <size=33>Who’s Kiryu...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Who’s Kiryu...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_007
Array.english: The legend... the Dragon of Dojima, Kiryu Kazuma.
Array.indonesia: The legend... the Dragon of Dojima, Kiryu Kazuma.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_008
Array.english: He suddenly disappeared off somewhere.\nVanished into thin air...
Array.indonesia: He suddenly disappeared off somewhere.\nVanished into thin air...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_009
Array.english: Oh… So there was someone like that huh? \nAnyway, you with the eye patch, can you lend us a hand?
Array.indonesia: Oh… So there was someone like that huh? \nAnyway, you with the eye patch, can you lend us a hand?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_010
Array.english: Hee hee hee. I was just itching for a fight.\nI’ll lend you a hand!
Array.indonesia: Hee hee hee. I was just itching for a fight.\nI’ll lend you a hand!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_Majima02_011
Array.english: <size=33>Just sit there and watch, will ya!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Just sit there and watch, will ya!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End01_001
Array.english: <size=38>I-Impossible! My Killer Crab Mk-III...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I-Impossible! My Killer Crab Mk-III...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End01_002
Array.english: Argh... I won’t let you off so easily...
Array.indonesia: Argh... I won’t let you off so easily...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End01_003
Array.english: <size=32>I’m not letting just you guys get away.\nLet’s become Blue Hole’s shark bait together!! Hehehehe!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I’m not letting just you guys get away.\nLet’s become Blue Hole’s shark bait together!! Hehehehe!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Th-That guy’s planning to burn this whole place to the ground!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Th-That guy’s planning to burn this whole place to the ground!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... Let’s get outta here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... Let’s get outta here!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Boss03_End03_001
Array.english: <size=34>This way! I found our way out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This way! I found our way out!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001
Array.english: Phew... Close call.
Array.indonesia: Phew... Close call.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001_1
Array.english: That was close...\nWe wouldn't made it without Majima-san.
Array.indonesia: That was close...\nWe wouldn't made it without Majima-san.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001_2
Array.english: <size=32>I owe you big time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I owe you big time.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001_3
Array.english: You haven’t been getting too soft lately, have ya? \nHeh, I needed a little stretch anyway.
Array.indonesia: You haven’t been getting too soft lately, have ya? \nHeh, I needed a little stretch anyway.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_001_4
Array.english: You got me there…
Array.indonesia: You got me there…

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_002
Array.english: Anyways, those Sea Blue guys won’t be showin’ their faces around here for a while!
Array.indonesia: Anyways, those Sea Blue guys won’t be showin’ their faces around here for a while!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_003
Array.english: Hahaha! \nLet’s have a toast at the sushi bar once we close up!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! \nLet’s have a toast at the sushi bar once we close up!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_004
Array.english: Appreciate the sentiment but I’m gonna take off to go find Kiryu-chan.
Array.indonesia: Appreciate the sentiment but I’m gonna take off to go find Kiryu-chan.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_005
Array.english: Well, that was fun. \nCatch ya'll somewhere down the line!
Array.indonesia: Well, that was fun. \nCatch ya'll somewhere down the line!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_006
Array.english: Too bad, he seemed like an interesting fella.\nCatch you all later tonight then!
Array.indonesia: Too bad, he seemed like an interesting fella.\nCatch you all later tonight then!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Huh... But what exactly were they researching...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Huh... But what exactly were they researching...?)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BeltScroll01_Complete_008
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(That research director seemed oddly familiar, too...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(That research director seemed oddly familiar, too...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! This is the bomb!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! This is the bomb!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_002
Array.english: <size=31>I’ve never seen fish like this before, and they taste out of this world... This is amazing, Bancho-san!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>I’ve never seen fish like this before, and they taste out of this world... This is amazing, Bancho-san!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_003
Array.english: You flatter me.\nI am but merely drawing out the flavor of the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: You flatter me.\nI am but merely drawing out the flavor of the ingredients.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_004
Array.english: Hmm... This sushi is tasty without a doubt.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... This sushi is tasty without a doubt.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Try as you might, even you cannot find fault with my sushi.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Try as you might, even you cannot find fault with my sushi.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_006
Array.english: This is something I can’t help but acknowledge. Then, I will fully enjoy the sushi here… As for "that dish", I suppose I’ll have it once I return to Yokohama.</size>
Array.indonesia: This is something I can’t help but acknowledge. Then, I will fully enjoy the sushi here… As for "that dish", I suppose I’ll have it once I return to Yokohama.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_007
Array.english: <size=35>"That dish"? What do you speak of...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>"That dish"? What do you speak of...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_008
Array.english: <size=33>Ah, <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color>, that is. \nSince this is a sushi bar, I thought it would be difficult to have it here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah, <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color>, that is. \nSince this is a sushi bar, I thought it would be difficult to have it here.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_009
Array.english: <size=34>Don't underestimate me!\nThere is no dish I cannot prepare!!\nI shall make that Cold... <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color> and prove it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Don't underestimate me!\nThere is no dish I cannot prepare!!\nI shall make that Cold... <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color> and prove it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission01_010
Array.english: <size=35>Come back <color=#F1DC2B>3 days</color> later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Come back <color=#F1DC2B>3 days</color> later.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_001
Array.english: What’s gotten into you this time?
Array.indonesia: What’s gotten into you this time?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_002
Array.english: I can tolerate the cocktail, but I cannot bear anyone disparaging my cooking skills!
Array.indonesia: I can tolerate the cocktail, but I cannot bear anyone disparaging my cooking skills!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_003
Array.english: It is not merely about making <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color>. To silence that man, one requires a rather unexpected topping.
Array.indonesia: It is not merely about making <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color>. To silence that man, one requires a rather unexpected topping.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_004
Array.english: First, I’ll need some <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat</color> to make the noodles...
Array.indonesia: First, I’ll need some <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat</color> to make the noodles...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_005
Array.english: How about asking <color=#F1DC2B>Otto</color> at the farm?\nHe might have some buckwheat seeds.
Array.indonesia: How about asking <color=#F1DC2B>Otto</color> at the farm?\nHe might have some buckwheat seeds.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_006
Array.english: That works. What else do you need?
Array.indonesia: That works. What else do you need?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_007
Array.english: I’ll need <color=#1DFEAF>Stingrays</color> to craft a unique flavor.\nThree pieces should do.
Array.indonesia: I’ll need <color=#1DFEAF>Stingrays</color> to craft a unique flavor.\nThree pieces should do.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_008
Array.english: Ah, and <color=#1DFEAF>Eggs</color> as a topping would do the trick.\nI’m counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Ah, and <color=#1DFEAF>Eggs</color> as a topping would do the trick.\nI’m counting on you.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_009
Array.english: That’s a lot, but I’ll give it a try….
Array.indonesia: That’s a lot, but I’ll give it a try….

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission02_010
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Guess I’ll ask Otto if he has any <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat seeds</color> tomorrow.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Guess I’ll ask Otto if he has any <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat seeds</color> tomorrow.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hey, Otto!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hey, Otto!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_002
Array.english: Ayy, Dave. Long time no see.
Array.indonesia: Ayy, Dave. Long time no see.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_003
Array.english: <size=33>Ya need somethin’?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ya need somethin’?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_004
Array.english: <size=32>Um… I’m looking for <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat seeds</color> on behalf of Bancho.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Um… I’m looking for <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat seeds</color> on behalf of Bancho.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_005
Array.english: Ha! You’re in luck! I was cravin’ some buckwheat noodles and got my hands on some <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat Seeds</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ha! You’re in luck! I was cravin’ some buckwheat noodles and got my hands on some <color=#1DFEAF>Buckwheat Seeds</color>.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_006
Array.english: Since I can’t process them myself... I just left ‘em there.\nIt’ll be great if you can grow ‘em! Hahaha.
Array.indonesia: Since I can’t process them myself... I just left ‘em there.\nIt’ll be great if you can grow ‘em! Hahaha.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_007
Array.english: Oh! Perfect! Bancho is in need of some, too.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Perfect! Bancho is in need of some, too.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMission03_008
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll give it a shot then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’ll give it a shot then!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionFail_001
Array.english: Darn... I couldn’t gather all the ingredients for \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color>.
Array.indonesia: Darn... I couldn’t gather all the ingredients for \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color>.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionFail_002
Array.english: Guess you’ll have to ask Bartender to come some other time.
Array.indonesia: Guess you’ll have to ask Bartender to come some other time.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete01_001
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color> ingredients are ready.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>Cold Noodles</color> ingredients are ready.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete01_002
Array.english: It’s flawless. Excellent work!
Array.indonesia: It’s flawless. Excellent work!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete01_003
Array.english: Hehe.\nI’ll ask Bartender to drop by once we close for the day.
Array.indonesia: Hehe.\nI’ll ask Bartender to drop by once we close for the day.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete02_001
Array.english: I got Dave’s message... Is it really ready?
Array.indonesia: I got Dave’s message... Is it really ready?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete02_002
Array.english: Pfft, Bancho-san, aren’t you just a sushi expert?\nThere’s no need to go overboard.
Array.indonesia: Pfft, Bancho-san, aren’t you just a sushi expert?\nThere’s no need to go overboard.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=33>You talk too much. Just give it a taste.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You talk too much. Just give it a taste.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_001
Array.english: <size=37>Ha...! This certainly is delicious...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Ha...! This certainly is delicious...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_002
Array.english: <size=37>Umm... This fish...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Umm... This fish...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_003
Array.english: <size=33>It’s stingray.\nThey are usually eaten with cold noodles in Korea.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It’s stingray.\nThey are usually eaten with cold noodles in Korea.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_004
Array.english: I heard stingrays have a strong smell...
Array.indonesia: I heard stingrays have a strong smell...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_005
Array.english: But you can remove the smell by soaking it in soju and then mixing it with garlic and gochujang.
Array.indonesia: But you can remove the smell by soaking it in soju and then mixing it with garlic and gochujang.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_006
Array.english: It leaves a chewy texture that goes great with cold noodles.
Array.indonesia: It leaves a chewy texture that goes great with cold noodles.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_007
Array.english: <size=33>Haha... Seems I’ve lost. This I’ll admit.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha... Seems I’ve lost. This I’ll admit.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_008
Array.english: <size=35>You’re quite the chef.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>You’re quite the chef.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_009
Array.english: <size=32>The flavor of the drink was somewhat disappointing, though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The flavor of the drink was somewhat disappointing, though...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_010
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... You’re an unyielding man…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... You’re an unyielding man…</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_011
Array.english: Apologies, I’m particular about cold noodles.\nThat aside, allow me to assist you as a token of gratitude.
Array.indonesia: Apologies, I’m particular about cold noodles.\nThat aside, allow me to assist you as a token of gratitude.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete03_012
Array.english: <size=34>Here, a gift for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Here, a gift for you.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_001
Array.english: What’s this...?
Array.indonesia: What’s this...?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_002
Array.english: <size=33>A <color=#1DFEAF>Cocktail Shaker</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A <color=#1DFEAF>Cocktail Shaker</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_003
Array.english: You use it to make cocktails...\nIt helps you mix them a bit better.
Array.indonesia: You use it to make cocktails...\nIt helps you mix them a bit better.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_004
Array.english: And it’s fun watching it mix, haha.
Array.indonesia: And it’s fun watching it mix, haha.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_005
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! Looks like you two got along pretty well!\nGlad to see it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Looks like you two got along pretty well!\nGlad to see it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_006
Array.english: We were just starting to bond...\nShame it’s the last day of our vacation.
Array.indonesia: We were just starting to bond...\nShame it’s the last day of our vacation.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_007
Array.english: Ah... You’re flying back tomorrow, I see. What a pity.
Array.indonesia: Ah... You’re flying back tomorrow, I see. What a pity.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_008
Array.english: <size=35>Exactly. If you’re up for it...\nhow about we make the most of tonight?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Exactly. If you’re up for it...\nhow about we make the most of tonight?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_009
Array.english: <size=35>I even brought a karaoke machine just in case!\nHow ‘bout we sing a song together?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I even brought a karaoke machine just in case!\nHow ‘bout we sing a song together?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_010
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? A karaoke machine?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh? A karaoke machine?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_011
Array.english: <size=32>There’re a ton of portable ones these days.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>There’re a ton of portable ones these days.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_012
Array.english: <size=33>We love karaoke too. Let’s have fun!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>We love karaoke too. Let’s have fun!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_013
Array.english: <size=33>Then, I’ll sing a song while reminiscing about my memories with <color=#F1DC2B>Kiryu-san</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Then, I’ll sing a song while reminiscing about my memories with <color=#F1DC2B>Kiryu-san</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_014
Array.english: <size=33>Here, Dave! I’ll sing, and you play the tambourine to the beat of the music!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Here, Dave! I’ll sing, and you play the tambourine to the beat of the music!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_014_1
Array.english: <size=34>If you say so!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>If you say so!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete04_015
Array.english: <size=35>For <color=#F1DC2B>Kiryu-san</color>’s sake, let’s pump it up!\nHere comes <JUDGEMENT>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>For <color=#F1DC2B>Kiryu-san</color>’s sake, let’s pump it up!\nHere comes <JUDGEMENT>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! A tambourine really hypes things up!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! A tambourine really hypes things up!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_002
Array.english: Man, I had so much fun! This trip was awesome!
Array.indonesia: Man, I had so much fun! This trip was awesome!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_003
Array.english: <size=32>Time for us to get going.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Time for us to get going.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_004
Array.english: It was great meeting you, Kasuga and Bartender!
Array.indonesia: It was great meeting you, Kasuga and Bartender!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_005
Array.english: Hahaha! Nice work, Kasuga.\nThis place’s gonna be a bit more peaceful, thanks to you.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Nice work, Kasuga.\nThis place’s gonna be a bit more peaceful, thanks to you.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_006
Array.english: Oh, it must be fate, meeting like this.\nI should probably get you a gift!
Array.indonesia: Oh, it must be fate, meeting like this.\nI should probably get you a gift!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_007
Array.english: Here you go! A phone charm of a character called <color=#1DFEAF>Ono Michio</color>. He’s a really popular mascot in Japan!
Array.indonesia: Here you go! A phone charm of a character called <color=#1DFEAF>Ono Michio</color>. He’s a really popular mascot in Japan!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_008
Array.english: <size=34>Aww...! This is absolutely adorable!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aww...! This is absolutely adorable!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_009
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! I’m glad you like it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! I’m glad you like it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_010
Array.english: <size=32>Till we meet again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Till we meet again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_AfterBaseMissionComplete05_011
Array.english: <size=32>Have a safe trip home! It was great meeting you two!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Have a safe trip home! It was great meeting you two!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Kasuga?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Kasuga?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_002
Array.english: We’re safely back on Japan soil.
Array.indonesia: We’re safely back on Japan soil.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_003
Array.english: <size=33>That’s a relief!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That’s a relief!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_004
Array.english: If you ever make it to Yokohama, drop by a bar called \nSurvive Bar. My treat.
Array.indonesia: If you ever make it to Yokohama, drop by a bar called \nSurvive Bar. My treat.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_005
Array.english: Oh, and I’ve been telling everyone I know about \nyour restaurant!
Array.indonesia: Oh, and I’ve been telling everyone I know about \nyour restaurant!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_006
Array.english: <size=33>Who knows... \nMaybe someone would wanna work there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Who knows... \nMaybe someone would wanna work there.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_007
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! Then I should put up some <color=#F1DC2B>Recruitment Ads</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Then I should put up some <color=#F1DC2B>Recruitment Ads</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_008
Array.english: <size=35>Come to think of it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Come to think of it...</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_009
Array.english: Hmm? Is something wrong?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Is something wrong?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_010
Array.english: <size=33>I dropped my <color=#1DFEAF>Baseball Bat</color> into the sea.\nDid you happen to see it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I dropped my <color=#1DFEAF>Baseball Bat</color> into the sea.\nDid you happen to see it?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_011
Array.english: Hmm… What’s it like? Any special features?
Array.indonesia: Hmm… What’s it like? Any special features?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_012
Array.english: <size=33>It’s a baseball bat with some wires wrapped around it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It’s a baseball bat with some wires wrapped around it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_013
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Pretty dangerous thing to be carrying around...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Pretty dangerous thing to be carrying around...</color>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_014
Array.english: I saw a strange shadow in the water at night, so I jumped right in with the bat...
Array.indonesia: I saw a strange shadow in the water at night, so I jumped right in with the bat...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_015
Array.english: <size=35>Turns out, it was just seaweed! Haha!\nI probably dropped it around that time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Turns out, it was just seaweed! Haha!\nI probably dropped it around that time.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_016
Array.english: Uhh... Even if it's found, that thing’s kinda dangerous to send through mail...
Array.indonesia: Uhh... Even if it's found, that thing’s kinda dangerous to send through mail...

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_017
Array.english: <size=32>If you happen to come across it, you can have it! Hahaha!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If you happen to come across it, you can have it! Hahaha!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_018
Array.english: Um... Thanks, I guess?
Array.indonesia: Um... Thanks, I guess?

Array.name: dialog_LAD_Reward_NewStaffAdd_019
Array.english: Haha! All right, take care! \nTell your friends I said hi!
Array.indonesia: Haha! All right, take care! \nTell your friends I said hi!

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Where are you going, Kasuga?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Where are you going, Kasuga?</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oops, wrong way. Gotta pay attention to the radar.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oops, wrong way. Gotta pay attention to the radar.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_DaveDistance_001
Array.english: It’s kinda tough keeping up with you while carrying this thing, Kasuga.
Array.indonesia: It’s kinda tough keeping up with you while carrying this thing, Kasuga.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_DaveDistance_002
Array.english: <size=33>Sorry, I got ahead of myself there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sorry, I got ahead of myself there.</size>

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_WaveBlock_001
Array.english: Kasuga... We can’t move forward with these guys around.
Array.indonesia: Kasuga... We can’t move forward with these guys around.

Array.name: dialog_LAD_BaseEnter_Barricade_WaveBlock_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh right, of course!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh right, of course!</size>

Array.english: I couldn't swim before anyway...\nand now I sure wouldn't dare try.
Array.indonesia: I couldn't swim before anyway...\nand now I sure wouldn't dare try.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_FirstTalk_009

Array.indonesia: Oh, come to think of it, you're headin' into the water...\nAin't that kinda dangerous?

Array.indonesia: Yeah. So there's a lot going on underwater...\nbut I'm used to it now!

Array.indonesia: Sheesh. Don't get cocky and end up gettin' hooked on a fishin' line.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: When it comes to spices, <color=#F1DC2B>Herbalist Lathi</color> would know best. Head a bit up to the right from here and you'll find her.
Array.indonesia: When it comes to spices, <color=#F1DC2B>Herbalist Lathi</color> would know best. Head a bit up to the right from here and you'll find her.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, if you're looking for a carpenter, that'd be <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, if you're looking for a carpenter, that'd be <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Task_410050008_002
Array.english: <size=34>Head up to the right a bit from here and you'll find his house.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Head up to the right a bit from here and you'll find his house.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: Hmm... I think I saw <color=#F1DC2B>Carpenter</color> tools at the house on the far right side of the village.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I think I saw <color=#F1DC2B>Carpenter</color> tools at the house on the far right side of the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>? \nThere's a tree with round, green fruits.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>? \nThere's a tree with round, green fruits.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Mission01Progress_002
Array.english: <size=33>You can easily find it near the big tree north of the village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You can easily find it near the big tree north of the village!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: Ah... if you're looking for a carpenter, you probably mean <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah... if you're looking for a carpenter, you probably mean <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Task_410050008_002
Array.english: Peneb's house is at the far right end of the village!
Array.indonesia: Peneb's house is at the far right end of the village!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Oh my, you must be the outsider who came to study the dinosaurs.
Array.indonesia: Oh my, you must be the outsider who came to study the dinosaurs.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: <size=32>Nice to meet you, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Lipah</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nice to meet you, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Lipah</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Hello. I'm Dave.
Array.indonesia: Hello. I'm Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: It might be a little quiet for someone from the city, but...
Array.indonesia: It might be a little quiet for someone from the city, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: This village has so many beautiful insects.\nThat alone makes it feel like heaven to me.
Array.indonesia: This village has so many beautiful insects.\nThat alone makes it feel like heaven to me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: I can see why. I haven't seen anything like this in the city.
Array.indonesia: I can see why. I haven't seen anything like this in the city.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: Hehe. It's nice to meet someone who understands.\nI look forward to working with you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. It's nice to meet someone who understands.\nI look forward to working with you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... likewise.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... likewise.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello. You're the farmer who grows papayas and coconuts, right?
Array.indonesia: Hello. You're the farmer who grows papayas and coconuts, right?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: I'm Dave. I run the restaurant nearby.\nNice to meet you.
Array.indonesia: I'm Dave. I run the restaurant nearby.\nNice to meet you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: <size=36>Ha! So you're the outsider who's been using my coconuts.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ha! So you're the outsider who's been using my coconuts.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Uhm...? I guess so...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Uhm...? I guess so...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: <size=33>I see. So, you're here to lecture us about everything we don't have that the city does, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I see. So, you're here to lecture us about everything we don't have that the city does, right?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: N-No, not at all. That's not why I'm here...
Array.indonesia: N-No, not at all. That's not why I'm here...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: <size=33>I'll send the crops to the restaurant since the chief asked…\nBut don't run your mouth while you're here!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'll send the crops to the restaurant since the chief asked…\nBut don't run your mouth while you're here!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... he's really hostile. Getting close to him won't be easy.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... he's really hostile. Getting close to him won't be easy.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ha! You can't even find <color=#1DFEAF>Calamansi</color>? You really are clueless.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha! You can't even find <color=#1DFEAF>Calamansi</color>? You really are clueless.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Mission01Progress_002
Array.english: <size=34>It's the tree right in front of you? Tsk.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It's the tree right in front of you? Tsk.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: <size=33>The carpenter...? You mean <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>, on the right side of the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The carpenter...? You mean <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>, on the right side of the village.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Task_410050008_002
Array.english: <size=33>Don't go bothering him for no reason.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Don't go bothering him for no reason.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Dave, is something on your mind?
Array.indonesia: Dave, is something on your mind?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh, right. Uzme, thanks for earlier.
Array.indonesia: Oh, right. Uzme, thanks for earlier.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: That <color=#1DFEAF>Map</color> you gave me really makes it easier to get around the village!
Array.indonesia: That <color=#1DFEAF>Map</color> you gave me really makes it easier to get around the village!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: Hehehe, I'm glad to hear that.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe, I'm glad to hear that.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: Um... if you don't mind me asking...\nDoes the chef need anything else?
Array.indonesia: Um... if you don't mind me asking...\nDoes the chef need anything else?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: Hmm. Bancho can work with just about anything.\nI'm sure it'll turn out great.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Bancho can work with just about anything.\nI'm sure it'll turn out great.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: I see... Thanks for letting me know.
Array.indonesia: I see... Thanks for letting me know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_GoToBluehole_001
Array.english: Heading back to the <color=#F1DC2B>Blue Hole</color>?\nIt'll take about a day.
Array.indonesia: Heading back to the <color=#F1DC2B>Blue Hole</color>?\nIt'll take about a day.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_GoToBluehole_option1
Array.english: Go back
Array.indonesia: Go back

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_GoToBluehole_option2
Array.english: Don't go back
Array.indonesia: Don't go back

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_GoToBluehole_Go_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let's get going. If we hurry, we'll be there by tomorrow morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright, let's get going. If we hurry, we'll be there by tomorrow morning!</size>

Array.indonesia: Got it. Just let me know when you're ready.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_001
Array.english: <size=32>Dave, havin' any trouble gettin' around the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dave, havin' any trouble gettin' around the village?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_002
Array.english: Not really, but...\nwalking in this heat is pretty tiring.
Array.indonesia: Not really, but...\nwalking in this heat is pretty tiring.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_003
Array.english: Hehe. The village is actually pretty big, and it's quite a walk to get to the houses on the other side.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. The village is actually pretty big, and it's quite a walk to get to the houses on the other side.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_004
Array.english: <size=33>That's why I got a little somethin' for ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That's why I got a little somethin' for ya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... what's this...?\nA <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... what's this...?\nA <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_006
Array.english: Hehe, that's right. Ain't nothin' too fancy, but...
Array.indonesia: Hehe, that's right. Ain't nothin' too fancy, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_007
Array.english: <size=32>It'll make gettin' around the village a whole lot easier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It'll make gettin' around the village a whole lot easier.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_PreferenceLV3_008
Array.english: Wow... thanks, Rimbo! This'll make getting around way easier!
Array.indonesia: Wow... thanks, Rimbo! This'll make getting around way easier!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_001
Array.english: I heard that giving <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color> is a good way to get closer to the villagers.
Array.indonesia: I heard that giving <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color> is a good way to get closer to the villagers.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, everyone loves gifts, but round here we see it as an important tradition!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, everyone loves gifts, but round here we see it as an important tradition!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_003
Array.english: But I'm not sure where to find gifts people would like.
Array.indonesia: But I'm not sure where to find gifts people would like.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_004
Array.english: That's true. Folks all like different things.
Array.indonesia: That's true. Folks all like different things.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_005
Array.english: <size=32>I can sell ya some of the stuff I brought from the city.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I can sell ya some of the stuff I brought from the city.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_006
Array.english: <size=32>That way ya won't have to go lookin' all over the place.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That way ya won't have to go lookin' all over the place.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopOpen_007
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, that's a great idea.\nI'll come to you when I need something!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, that's a great idea.\nI'll come to you when I need something!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ain't it dangerous inside the lake?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ain't it dangerous inside the lake?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_002
Array.english: It is... The visibility's poor, and fish sometimes attack out of nowhere.
Array.indonesia: It is... The visibility's poor, and fish sometimes attack out of nowhere.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... then how 'bout just fishin' instead?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... then how 'bout just fishin' instead?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_004
Array.english: Well... Bancho likes to use all kinds of ingredients...\nSo if I catch them myself, I can bring in more variety.
Array.indonesia: Well... Bancho likes to use all kinds of ingredients...\nSo if I catch them myself, I can bring in more variety.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_005
Array.english: Sometimes I come back empty-handed, though...
Array.indonesia: Sometimes I come back empty-handed, though...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_006
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! I see!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! I see!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_007
Array.english: <size=33>Then when that happens, I could sell ya some of the fish I caught!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Then when that happens, I could sell ya some of the fish I caught!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_008
Array.english: It won't be as much variety as catchin' 'em yourself...\nbut it'll help when ya need somethin' quick.
Array.indonesia: It won't be as much variety as catchin' 'em yourself...\nbut it'll help when ya need somethin' quick.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_009
Array.english: That'll definitely come in handy when I'm short on ingredients!
Array.indonesia: That'll definitely come in handy when I'm short on ingredients!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_010
Array.english: Oh, and I've stocked better fishin' rods and bait than what I gave ya before.
Array.indonesia: Oh, and I've stocked better fishin' rods and bait than what I gave ya before.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_011
Array.english: <size=32>Just in case something breaks, I've got <color=#F1DC2B>Repair Tools</color> ready too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Just in case something breaks, I've got <color=#F1DC2B>Repair Tools</color> ready too!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_ShopOpen_012
Array.english: Oh, got it.\nI'll let you know when I need them!
Array.indonesia: Oh, got it.\nI'll let you know when I need them!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_001
Array.english: Oh, did you use the lemongrass I gave you?
Array.indonesia: Oh, did you use the lemongrass I gave you?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>Yes. Thanks to you, Bancho was able to make a wonderful dish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yes. Thanks to you, Bancho was able to make a wonderful dish.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_003
Array.english: I'm glad it helped, hehe.
Array.indonesia: I'm glad it helped, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_004
Array.english: If you need any other <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>, just let me know.
Array.indonesia: If you need any other <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>, just let me know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_005
Array.english: I can't give them away for free, but...\nI'll make sure you get a fair price.
Array.indonesia: I can't give them away for free, but...\nI'll make sure you get a fair price.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopOpen_006
Array.english: Oh, understood.\nI'll stop by when I need some.
Array.indonesia: Oh, understood.\nI'll stop by when I need some.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV3_001
Array.english: Ah, thank you for all your help.
Array.indonesia: Ah, thank you for all your help.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV3_002
Array.english: Hehe, it's nothing. I owe the village, so I'm happy to help however I can.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, it's nothing. I owe the village, so I'm happy to help however I can.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV3_003
Array.english: It's not much in return, but... I've stocked a few more <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>.
Array.indonesia: It's not much in return, but... I've stocked a few more <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV3_004

Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let me know if you need any.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_01_001

Array.indonesia: Woof!

Array.indonesia: Maybe it's because the villagers treat him so well,\nbut he's full of energy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_01_003

Array.indonesia: If we hadn't found him in that pit back then...\nIt's scary just to think about.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Marone_01_004

Array.indonesia: He does seem to have put on a bit of weight since coming to the village...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_001
Array.english: Muna's really passionate about her research.
Array.indonesia: Muna's really passionate about her research.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_002
Array.english: Haha! That kid's the type to dive into whatever she's interested in all day long!
Array.indonesia: Haha! That kid's the type to dive into whatever she's interested in all day long!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_003

Array.indonesia: It's a great quality for a researcher, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>The problem is, she doesn't care about time or place.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The problem is, she doesn't care about time or place.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_005
Array.english: One time, we went to a conference together,\nand she hogged the Q&A for a full 30 minutes...
Array.indonesia: One time, we went to a conference together,\nand she hogged the Q&A for a full 30 minutes...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_01_006

Array.indonesia: The staff had to drag her away.\nShe's unstoppable.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_001
Array.english: Still, I'm glad Muna's back from her hiatus.
Array.indonesia: Still, I'm glad Muna's back from her hiatus.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_002
Array.english: That girl... once she gets into something, she sees it\nthrough to the end...
Array.indonesia: That girl... once she gets into something, she sees it\nthrough to the end...

Array.indonesia: She got obsessed with blockchain technology and ended up putting her entire fortune into some unknown coin.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_004

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_005
