Lucky for her, she managed to recover her losses.
Otherwise, we might've lost a great talent.

Lucky for her, she managed to recover her losses.
Otherwise, we might've lost a great talent.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_02_006

Array.indonesia: She'd be better off focusing on her research...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_03_001

Array.indonesia: This region feels completely different from the Blue Hole.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_03_002
Array.english: Tell me about it! The cool ocean's nice, but a jungle like this has its own charm!!
Array.indonesia: Tell me about it! The cool ocean's nice, but a jungle like this has its own charm!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_03_003

Array.indonesia: <size=32>There are a lot of interesting insects here too.</size>

Array.indonesia: Be careful not to get bitten, you could catch some unknown disease and drop dead!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_Night01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! How could I sleep in a place with so much to study!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! How could I sleep in a place with so much to study!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_Night01_003
Array.english: Honestly, I'd love to take my time researching...
Array.indonesia: Honestly, I'd love to take my time researching...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_Night01_004
Array.english: but thinking about the villagers, I feel like I should solve this quickly.
Array.indonesia: but thinking about the villagers, I feel like I should solve this quickly.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bacon_Night01_005
Array.english: I've talked to them, and there are a lot of good people here. I hope we can help.
Array.indonesia: I've talked to them, and there are a lot of good people here. I hope we can help.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_001
Array.english: Bancho, you pick up ingredients from new places so quickly.
Array.indonesia: Bancho, you pick up ingredients from new places so quickly.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_002
Array.english: It helps that I traveled the world learning to cook when I was younger.
Array.indonesia: It helps that I traveled the world learning to cook when I was younger.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_003
Array.english:
I worked in restaurants in unfamiliar places,
learning the local cuisine and serving it to customers.
Array.indonesia:
I worked in restaurants in unfamiliar places,
learning the local cuisine and serving it to customers.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_004
Array.english: I see. So that's where your skills come from.
Array.indonesia: I see. So that's where your skills come from.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_01_005
Array.english: Learning something new is always difficult.\nI'm just grateful I had the chance.
Array.indonesia: Learning something new is always difficult.\nI'm just grateful I had the chance.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_02_001
Array.english: I heard you can't eat freshwater fish raw.
Array.indonesia: I heard you can't eat freshwater fish raw.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_02_002
Array.english:
Unfortunately, that's true. The taste isn't great,
and more importantly, they can carry parasites.
Array.indonesia:
Unfortunately, that's true. The taste isn't great,
and more importantly, they can carry parasites.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_02_003
Array.english: It's a shame I won't be able to have your sushi for a while, Bancho.
Array.indonesia: It's a shame I won't be able to have your sushi for a while, Bancho.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_02_004
Array.english: It is what it is. I'll make the best dishes I can with what I have.
Array.indonesia: It is what it is. I'll make the best dishes I can with what I have.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_001
Array.english: Sorry for dragging you all the way out here.
Array.indonesia: Sorry for dragging you all the way out here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_002
Array.english: Don't worry. I see this as part of my training.
Array.indonesia: Don't worry. I see this as part of my training.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_003
Array.english: When else would I get to come to a place like this and work with wild ingredients?
Array.indonesia: When else would I get to come to a place like this and work with wild ingredients?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_004
Array.english: Still, if you can't cook sushi, won't your skills get rusty?
Array.indonesia: Still, if you can't cook sushi, won't your skills get rusty?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_005
Array.english: To prevent that, I've been practicing my knife work whenever I can.
Array.indonesia: To prevent that, I've been practicing my knife work whenever I can.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_006
Array.english: <size=33>It's a shame I can't serve them as proper dishes, though.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It's a shame I can't serve them as proper dishes, though.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_03_007
Array.english: As expected, Bancho. You never let anything slip.
Array.indonesia: As expected, Bancho. You never let anything slip.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Another long day.\nYou've had it rough too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Another long day.\nYou've had it rough too.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's not easy getting used to this weather.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's not easy getting used to this weather.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_003
Array.english: <size=33>At least the evenings are cool, which is nice.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>At least the evenings are cool, which is nice.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_004
Array.english: Unlike the beach, you can hear the wild at night here.\nIt's different.
Array.indonesia: Unlike the beach, you can hear the wild at night here.\nIt's different.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_005
Array.english: <size=31>The sound of creatures fighting to survive...\neven while I rest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>The sound of creatures fighting to survive...\neven while I rest.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_006
Array.english: <size=32>It's humbling, thinking I get to rest in the middle of all that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's humbling, thinking I get to rest in the middle of all that.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_007
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, look at you getting all sentimental at night, Bancho.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, look at you getting all sentimental at night, Bancho.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_Night01_008
Array.english: <size=33>Th-That's not it.\nI was just thinking about what to cook!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Th-That's not it.\nI was just thinking about what to cook!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: I should've brought more tools...\nDidn't think that through.
Array.indonesia: I should've brought more tools...\nDidn't think that through.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: Tell me about it! But with a boat that small, there wasn't much we could do.
Array.indonesia: Tell me about it! But with a boat that small, there wasn't much we could do.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_01_003
Array.english: There should be folks in the village who can help.\nTake a look around.
Array.indonesia: There should be folks in the village who can help.\nTake a look around.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_01_004
Array.english: Some of them seem wary of outsiders...\nI'll have to do my best.
Array.indonesia: Some of them seem wary of outsiders...\nI'll have to do my best.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_001
Array.english: Phew. The jungle's definitely hot.
Array.indonesia: Phew. The jungle's definitely hot.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_002
Array.english: Have you ever been to the jungle before?
Array.indonesia: Have you ever been to the jungle before?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! I spent quite some time there back in my military days!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! I spent quite some time there back in my military days!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_004
Array.english: We'd pick wild fruits and hunt animals to cook...\nIt was rough.
Array.indonesia: We'd pick wild fruits and hunt animals to cook...\nIt was rough.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_02_005
Array.english: Sounds like it was good eating, though...
Array.indonesia: Sounds like it was good eating, though...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_03_001
Array.english: A dinosaur carcass drifting in here? \nThe villagers must've been shocked.
Array.indonesia: A dinosaur carcass drifting in here? \nThe villagers must've been shocked.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_03_002
Array.english: Tell me about it. I was shocked when I first saw it too.
Array.indonesia: Tell me about it. I was shocked when I first saw it too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_03_003
Array.english: It looks like an ordinary lake... \nI wonder what's going on down below?
Array.indonesia: It looks like an ordinary lake... \nI wonder what's going on down below?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_03_004
Array.english: You've handled worse in the Blue Hole, haven't you?\nWhy don't you go see for yourself?
Array.indonesia: You've handled worse in the Blue Hole, haven't you?\nWhy don't you go see for yourself?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_001
Array.english: Cobra, how's your arm holding up?
Array.indonesia: Cobra, how's your arm holding up?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_002
Array.english: I'm getting used to it quicker than I expected.
Array.indonesia: I'm getting used to it quicker than I expected.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_003
Array.english: Seems it works by reading my muscle movements…\nQuite the technology.
Array.indonesia: Seems it works by reading my muscle movements…\nQuite the technology.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_004
Array.english: In movies, robot arms can even stretch out…\nThat'd be super cool!
Array.indonesia: In movies, robot arms can even stretch out…\nThat'd be super cool!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_04_005
Array.english: <size=32>Gahaha! Then I could grab a beer from the fridge\nwithout even leaving the couch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Gahaha! Then I could grab a beer from the fridge\nwithout even leaving the couch!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_001
Array.english: Seeing Marone…\nReminds me of getting lost on a mission, way back!
Array.indonesia: Seeing Marone…\nReminds me of getting lost on a mission, way back!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_002
Array.english: Got cut off from my squad,\nspent about a week alone in the forest.
Array.indonesia: Got cut off from my squad,\nspent about a week alone in the forest.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_003
Array.english: Back then I caught and ate all sorts of wild animals…
Array.indonesia: Back then I caught and ate all sorts of wild animals…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_004
Array.english: Lizard meat suited my taste the best.
Array.indonesia: Lizard meat suited my taste the best.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_005
Array.english: Texture like chicken…\nAnd you can even taste a hint of sweetness!
Array.indonesia: Texture like chicken…\nAnd you can even taste a hint of sweetness!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_05_006
Array.english: <size=33>Just thinking about it makes my mouth water… Gahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Just thinking about it makes my mouth water… Gahaha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_001
Array.english: Honestly, it's more livable than I thought, but…
Array.indonesia: Honestly, it's more livable than I thought, but…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_002
Array.english: Just a shame the network connection's lousy.
Array.indonesia: Just a shame the network connection's lousy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_003
Array.english: Is there something important going on?
Array.indonesia: Is there something important going on?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_004
Array.english: Can't check the delivery status on my Blue Hole orders.
Array.indonesia: Can't check the delivery status on my Blue Hole orders.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_005
Array.english: You'll head back eventually, so just sit tight.
Array.indonesia: You'll head back eventually, so just sit tight.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_06_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hah… What are you saying? Business is all about timing.\nWaiting ain't good manners.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hah… What are you saying? Business is all about timing.\nWaiting ain't good manners.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_001
Array.english: Oh, come to think of it... aren't you uncomfortable sleeping in a hammock like that?
Array.indonesia: Oh, come to think of it... aren't you uncomfortable sleeping in a hammock like that?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_002
Array.english: Haha, it's more comfortable than you'd think.\nI used to sleep like this in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: Haha, it's more comfortable than you'd think.\nI used to sleep like this in the jungle.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_003
Array.english: <size=32>Wanna give it a try?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wanna give it a try?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_004
Array.english: <size=35>Sure!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sure!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_005
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_006
Array.english: ...Actually, never mind.\nMight not be such a great idea.
Array.indonesia: ...Actually, never mind.\nMight not be such a great idea.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_Night01_007
Array.english: <size=32>...Whats that supposed to mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Whats that supposed to mean?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: That's a really big tree.
Array.indonesia: That's a really big tree.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_002
Array.english: It's the guardian tree that has protected this village for generations.
Array.indonesia: It's the guardian tree that has protected this village for generations.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_003
Array.english: Coming-of-age ceremonies and other village events are usually held in front of it.
Array.indonesia: Coming-of-age ceremonies and other village events are usually held in front of it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_004
Array.english: I see. It really suits the atmosphere of the village.
Array.indonesia: I see. It really suits the atmosphere of the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_005
Array.english: Heh. I suppose it would look that way even to someone from a place with nothing but cold buildings.
Array.indonesia: Heh. I suppose it would look that way even to someone from a place with nothing but cold buildings.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_006
Array.english: Even in hard times, standing before this tree brings a sense of peace.
Array.indonesia: Even in hard times, standing before this tree brings a sense of peace.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_Night01_007
Array.english: That's likely why the villagers haven't been too shaken, even with all the strange happenings lately.
Array.indonesia: That's likely why the villagers haven't been too shaken, even with all the strange happenings lately.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, speaking of which... have you met my daughter?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, speaking of which... have you met my daughter?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Yes, we've met.\nHer name was...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Yes, we've met.\nHer name was...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_option1
Array.english: Uzme
Array.indonesia: Uzme

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_option2
Array.english: Uchiha
Array.indonesia: Uchiha

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_001
Array.english: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Uzme, right?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Uzme, right?</color></size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_002
Array.english: She's very kind. She even showed me around the village and gave me a map.
Array.indonesia: She's very kind. She even showed me around the village and gave me a map.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_003
Array.english: Hehe, I thought so.\nShe has a warm heart.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, I thought so.\nShe has a warm heart.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_004
Array.english: I wish she'd enjoy her youth a bit more...\nbut she's completely absorbed in her training.
Array.indonesia: I wish she'd enjoy her youth a bit more...\nbut she's completely absorbed in her training.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_005
Array.english: Ever since I injured my leg in a crocodile attack...\nshe's been saying she'll protect the village herself.
Array.indonesia: Ever since I injured my leg in a crocodile attack...\nshe's been saying she'll protect the village herself.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_006
Array.english: I wish she'd meet a good partner... but she has no interest in men at all...
Array.indonesia: I wish she'd meet a good partner... but she has no interest in men at all...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_007
Array.english: I see. I hope she meets someone nice.
Array.indonesia: I see. I hope she meets someone nice.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_008
Array.english: Anyone come to mind?
Array.indonesia: Anyone come to mind?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_009
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? I don't think so...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh? I don't think so...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_010
Array.english: Ah, never mind. I can't just set my daughter up with an outsider who doesn't know our ways.
Array.indonesia: Ah, never mind. I can't just set my daughter up with an outsider who doesn't know our ways.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Correct_011
Array.english: I shouldn't have said that.\nYou must be busy, so go on ahead.
Array.indonesia: I shouldn't have said that.\nYou must be busy, so go on ahead.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_001
Array.english: Uh... <color=#F1DC2B>Uchiha</color>, right?\nThat was it, wasn't it?
Array.indonesia: Uh... <color=#F1DC2B>Uchiha</color>, right?\nThat was it, wasn't it?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_002
Array.english: ...Is that some tribe from another village?
Array.indonesia: ...Is that some tribe from another village?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_003
Array.english: Seems like you need to get to know the villagers a bit better.
Array.indonesia: Seems like you need to get to know the villagers a bit better.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: Chief, have you lived in this village your whole life?
Array.indonesia: Chief, have you lived in this village your whole life?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: What kind of question is that? \nOf course I was born and raised here.
Array.indonesia: What kind of question is that? \nOf course I was born and raised here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: Wow... then you must know the village's history really well.
Array.indonesia: Wow... then you must know the village's history really well.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_004
Array.english: History... well, it's mostly just what I've seen myself...
Array.indonesia: History... well, it's mostly just what I've seen myself...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_005
Array.english: But I've heard there were many strange things in this region in ancient times.
Array.indonesia: But I've heard there were many strange things in this region in ancient times.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_006
Array.english: I've studied quite a few old texts about it.
Array.indonesia: I've studied quite a few old texts about it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_01_007
Array.english: I'd love to hear about that sometime.
Array.indonesia: I'd love to hear about that sometime.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: The villagers...\nare they uncomfortable with us being here?
Array.indonesia: The villagers...\nare they uncomfortable with us being here?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: It would be a lie to say outsiders aren't an inconvenience.
Array.indonesia: It would be a lie to say outsiders aren't an inconvenience.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: But with the recent earthquakes... and seeing that dinosaur carcass, they'll understand we need outside help.
Array.indonesia: But with the recent earthquakes... and seeing that dinosaur carcass, they'll understand we need outside help.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_02_004
Array.english: Some may be unfriendly...\nbut they're good people at heart, so try to get along.
Array.indonesia: Some may be unfriendly...\nbut they're good people at heart, so try to get along.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Chief, what kind of food do you like?
Array.indonesia: Chief, what kind of food do you like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Hmm... maybe it's because I'm getting older...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... maybe it's because I'm getting older...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <size=33>I've grown to like nourishing dishes... \nlike ones made with <color=#FF73C3>King Oyster Mushrooms</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I've grown to like nourishing dishes... \nlike ones made with <color=#FF73C3>King Oyster Mushrooms</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>King Oyster Mushrooms</color> are great for anti-aging too, Chief.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>King Oyster Mushrooms</color> are great for anti-aging too, Chief.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: <size=35>Are you saying I look old?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Are you saying I look old?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... that's not what I meant...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... that's not what I meant...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_03_001
Array.english: Since Utara Lake turned murky, the fish seem to have grown more aggressive.
Array.indonesia: Since Utara Lake turned murky, the fish seem to have grown more aggressive.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_03_002
Array.english: I suppose the change in their environment made them more sensitive...
Array.indonesia: I suppose the change in their environment made them more sensitive...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv01_03_003
Array.english: I wish it could return to how clear it once was...\nI wonder if there's a way.
Array.indonesia: I wish it could return to how clear it once was...\nI wonder if there's a way.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: Isn't it too hot for you here?
Array.indonesia: Isn't it too hot for you here?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah, it definitely is.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yeah, it definitely is.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: But when a cool breeze comes through, it feels really nice.
Array.indonesia: But when a cool breeze comes through, it feels really nice.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_004
Array.english: Haha, well, the village sits on high ground,\nso it stays a bit cooler.
Array.indonesia: Haha, well, the village sits on high ground,\nso it stays a bit cooler.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_005
Array.english: And with that lake over there, we're fairly self-sufficient.
Array.indonesia: And with that lake over there, we're fairly self-sufficient.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_006
Array.english: It's amazing that there's a lake this high up.
Array.indonesia: It's amazing that there's a lake this high up.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_007
Array.english: You've probably noticed during your investigation...\nthey say the lake connects to the sea below.
Array.indonesia: You've probably noticed during your investigation...\nthey say the lake connects to the sea below.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_008
Array.english: Strange, isn't it?\nThe same water, yet divided like this.
Array.indonesia: Strange, isn't it?\nThe same water, yet divided like this.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_009
Array.english: Maybe that's why so many strange things happen here.
Array.indonesia: Maybe that's why so many strange things happen here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_010
Array.english: Hehe... even so, the spirits of Setah Forest have watched over us, allowing our history to endure.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... even so, the spirits of Setah Forest have watched over us, allowing our history to endure.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_011
Array.english: But this time... it seems we'll need your help.
Array.indonesia: But this time... it seems we'll need your help.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_01_012
Array.english: Don't worry. We'll find the cause
Array.indonesia: Don't worry. We'll find the cause

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: Are you settling in well?
Array.indonesia: Are you settling in well?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: Yes. There are plenty of ingredients, and even the villagers who were wary at first are starting to warm up to us.
Array.indonesia: Yes. There are plenty of ingredients, and even the villagers who were wary at first are starting to warm up to us.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_003
Array.english: I see. Resources in this village tend to recover quickly.
Array.indonesia: I see. Resources in this village tend to recover quickly.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_004
Array.english: If you need anything, feel free to make use of them.
Array.indonesia: If you need anything, feel free to make use of them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_02_005
Array.english: The villagers won't give you a hard time about it.
Array.indonesia: The villagers won't give you a hard time about it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Oh... your face looks a bit redder than usual.
Array.indonesia: Oh... your face looks a bit redder than usual.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Haha... I had a glass of <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color> for a change.\nI suppose it shows.
Array.indonesia: Haha... I had a glass of <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color> for a change.\nI suppose it shows.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: I didn't know you liked <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color>, Chief...\nThat's unexpected.
Array.indonesia: I didn't know you liked <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color>, Chief...\nThat's unexpected.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Haha, is it? I started drinking a little to ease the pain after I injured my leg...
Array.indonesia: Haha, is it? I started drinking a little to ease the pain after I injured my leg...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Now it's become a habit to have a glass or two before bed.
Array.indonesia: Now it's become a habit to have a glass or two before bed.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english:
By the way... if you come across any good <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color>, 
I'd appreciate it if you brought some to me...
Array.indonesia:
By the way... if you come across any good <color=#FF73C3>Wine</color>, 
I'd appreciate it if you brought some to me...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=33>Just keep it between us. Uzme doesn't need to know. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Just keep it between us. Uzme doesn't need to know. Haha.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_001
Array.english: Hmm... I have to admit, your cooking was quite good.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I have to admit, your cooking was quite good.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_002
Array.english: Hehe. Bancho's cooking really is world-class!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Bancho's cooking really is world-class!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_003
Array.english: This village has plenty of delicious food too.
Array.indonesia: This village has plenty of delicious food too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_004
Array.english: But with the lake polluted, he probably had to adjust his cooking a bit.
Array.indonesia: But with the lake polluted, he probably had to adjust his cooking a bit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_005
Array.english: Haha, the ingredients here are so good.\nPerhaps we've relied on that a little too much.
Array.indonesia: Haha, the ingredients here are so good.\nPerhaps we've relied on that a little too much.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_006
Array.english: Food makes a big difference in people's lives, you know.
Array.indonesia: Food makes a big difference in people's lives, you know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv03_03_007
Array.english: We'll keep working on new recipes and make sure everyone gets to enjoy them!
Array.indonesia: We'll keep working on new recipes and make sure everyone gets to enjoy them!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: Uzme's mentioned your restaurant and chef a few times,\nsaying they're excellent.
Array.indonesia: Uzme's mentioned your restaurant and chef a few times,\nsaying they're excellent.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Haha! Bancho's cooking is the best!\nHonestly, he's always thinking about ingredients!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Bancho's cooking is the best!\nHonestly, he's always thinking about ingredients!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Heh heh... quite an unusual fellow, indeed. Are you planning to leave once the investigation is done?
Array.indonesia: Heh heh... quite an unusual fellow, indeed. Are you planning to leave once the investigation is done?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: Yes. We need to get back and run Bancho's restaurant.\nIt's temporarily closed, you see.
Array.indonesia: Yes. We need to get back and run Bancho's restaurant.\nIt's temporarily closed, you see.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: If it were up to me, I'd have him stay and keep the place running...
Array.indonesia: If it were up to me, I'd have him stay and keep the place running...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: Settle down in the village and all...
Array.indonesia: Settle down in the village and all...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: Who knows? Maybe that young chef will become the next village chief, haha!
Array.indonesia: Who knows? Maybe that young chef will become the next village chief, haha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_008
Array.english: An outsider becoming village chief...?\nDoes that actually happen?
Array.indonesia: An outsider becoming village chief...?\nDoes that actually happen?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_009
Array.english: Well... you never know. He might end up marrying someone from the village.
Array.indonesia: Well... you never know. He might end up marrying someone from the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_010
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not sure if Bancho's interested in getting married.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'm not sure if Bancho's interested in getting married.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_01_011
Array.english: ...Haha, I see.
Array.indonesia: ...Haha, I see.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_001
Array.english: As an outsider...
Array.indonesia: As an outsider...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_002
Array.english: what do you think this village still needs?
Array.indonesia: what do you think this village still needs?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1
Array.english: 5G connection
Array.indonesia: 5G connection

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2
Array.english: Paved roads for cars
Array.indonesia: Paved roads for cars

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, you mentioned the phone connection wasn't great here.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, you mentioned the phone connection wasn't great here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_002
Array.english: Yeah... some apps won't even run.
Array.indonesia: Yeah... some apps won't even run.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_003
Array.english: Hmm... that wasn't intentional...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... that wasn't intentional...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_004
Array.english: But setting up a stable connection would mean installing a base station in the village. That would be quite a large project.
Array.indonesia: But setting up a stable connection would mean installing a base station in the village. That would be quite a large project.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_005
Array.english: We'd likely need to put up several utility poles around the village as well...
Array.indonesia: We'd likely need to put up several utility poles around the village as well...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_006
Array.english: I see. That would ruin the village's scenery...
Array.indonesia: I see. That would ruin the village's scenery...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option1_answer_007
Array.english: Actually, I don't really need those things,\nso it's fine as it is!
Array.indonesia: Actually, I don't really need those things,\nso it's fine as it is!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_001
Array.english: A proper road for cars...
Array.indonesia: A proper road for cars...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_002
Array.english: That would be a massive undertaking, digging up land all across the village.
Array.indonesia: That would be a massive undertaking, digging up land all across the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_003
Array.english: Oh... I suppose it would.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I suppose it would.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_004
Array.english: We can't ruin this village's beautiful scenery.
Array.indonesia: We can't ruin this village's beautiful scenery.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv05_02_option2_answer_005
Array.english: We can just keep using Rimbo's truck like we do now,\nso I don't think we'll need one!
Array.indonesia: We can just keep using Rimbo's truck like we do now,\nso I don't think we'll need one!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? What's with you dropping by this late?\nThat's kinda rude!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? What's with you dropping by this late?\nThat's kinda rude!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: Come to think of it... how did you hurt your arm again?
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it... how did you hurt your arm again?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: Ah... well, I was chopping down a rubber tree on a hill in Setah Forest...
Array.indonesia: Ah... well, I was chopping down a rubber tree on a hill in Setah Forest...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>All of a sudden, there was a huge earthquake with a loud crash!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>All of a sudden, there was a huge earthquake with a loud crash!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_004
Array.english: So I lost my footing while holding the axe...
Array.indonesia: So I lost my footing while holding the axe...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_005
Array.english: ...and messed up all my limbs... That's a career-ending injury for a carpenter, you know.
Array.indonesia: ...and messed up all my limbs... That's a career-ending injury for a carpenter, you know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_006
Array.english: But you're doing great with just one arm.
Array.indonesia: But you're doing great with just one arm.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_01_007
Array.english: W-Well... that's nothing for me, ahem.
Array.indonesia: W-Well... that's nothing for me, ahem.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: Peneb, have you been in this village long?
Array.indonesia: Peneb, have you been in this village long?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: Hehe, of course. I was born and raised here.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, of course. I was born and raised here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: I see. It's a really beautiful village.
Array.indonesia: I see. It's a really beautiful village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_004
Array.english: Is there anything you don't like about it?
Array.indonesia: Is there anything you don't like about it?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_005
Array.english: Hmm... this village has a ton of <color=#F1DC2B>Bugs</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... this village has a ton of <color=#F1DC2B>Bugs</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_006
Array.english: <size=34>And I really hate <color=#F1DC2B>Bugs</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And I really hate <color=#F1DC2B>Bugs</color>...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_007
Array.english: But aren't some bugs pretty, like butterflies and fireflies?
Array.indonesia: But aren't some bugs pretty, like butterflies and fireflies?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_008
Array.english: <size=32>How can anything with that many legs be pretty...? Just thinking about it gives me the creeps!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>How can anything with that many legs be pretty...? Just thinking about it gives me the creeps!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_02_009
Array.english: I see...! Got it.
Array.indonesia: I see...! Got it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_03_001
Array.english: Your friend's cooking... I'm still not quite ready to try it yet...
Array.indonesia: Your friend's cooking... I'm still not quite ready to try it yet...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv01_03_002
Array.english: <size=33>If I get a stomachache out here, that'd be a real problem!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If I get a stomachache out here, that'd be a real problem!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Ugh. After work, I always crave something sweet...
Array.indonesia: Ugh. After work, I always crave something sweet...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Like <color=#FF73C3>Candy</color> or <color=#FF73C3>Chocolate</color>.
Array.indonesia: Like <color=#FF73C3>Candy</color> or <color=#FF73C3>Chocolate</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Come to think of it, there's nowhere in the village that sells them.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, there's nowhere in the village that sells them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Well, Rimbo brings some back from the city sometimes!\nBut they're not always available.
Array.indonesia: Well, Rimbo brings some back from the city sometimes!\nBut they're not always available.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Peneb likes <color=#FF73C3>Sweets</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Peneb likes <color=#FF73C3>Sweets</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: That... friend of yours.
Array.indonesia: That... friend of yours.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>He's pretty good at cooking, I'll give him that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>He's pretty good at cooking, I'll give him that.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, right? Bancho's the best chef!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, right? Bancho's the best chef!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_004
Array.english: But the restaurant's decor is a bit lacking...
Array.indonesia: But the restaurant's decor is a bit lacking...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_01_005
Array.english: Well, it's your taste, I suppose. If you ever want to redecorate, just let me know.
Array.indonesia: Well, it's your taste, I suppose. If you ever want to redecorate, just let me know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: I see. So you're a carpenter, but you work with stone too?
Array.indonesia: I see. So you're a carpenter, but you work with stone too?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: Hehe, wood's my main trade, but I picked up stonework as well.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, wood's my main trade, but I picked up stonework as well.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_003
Array.english: I've loved making things since I was a kid.
Array.indonesia: I've loved making things since I was a kid.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_004
Array.english: I used to gather my own wood for materials... but as you can see, it's not easy for me to get around much these days.
Array.indonesia: I used to gather my own wood for materials... but as you can see, it's not easy for me to get around much these days.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_02_005
Array.english: <size=33>I've written down what I need, so just bring the materials and I'll make it for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I've written down what I need, so just bring the materials and I'll make it for you.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_03_001
Array.english: Ugh... this arm of mine's injured, and it's a real pain. I can still work, but...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... this arm of mine's injured, and it's a real pain. I can still work, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_03_002
Array.english: If you want your bones to heal properly, you've got to eat regularly and get enough nutrients.
Array.indonesia: If you want your bones to heal properly, you've got to eat regularly and get enough nutrients.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_03_003
Array.english: Hehe. That's why I've been eating the bones too when I have fish!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. That's why I've been eating the bones too when I have fish!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv03_03_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I'm not sure that actually helps with bone healing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... I'm not sure that actually helps with bone healing.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Hey Peneb, which fish from the lake do you think is the most delicious?
Array.indonesia: Hey Peneb, which fish from the lake do you think is the most delicious?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ah! The villagers enjoy all kinds of fish...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah! The villagers enjoy all kinds of fish...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=33>But if we're talking taste, it's gotta be <color=#FF73C3>Sea Bass</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But if we're talking taste, it's gotta be <color=#FF73C3>Sea Bass</color>, right?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=33>Especially the <color=#FF73C3>Nile Perch</color> from this lake. The meat's great, but the skin is incredible!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Especially the <color=#FF73C3>Nile Perch</color> from this lake. The meat's great, but the skin is incredible!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=33>That thick meat with crispy skin together is just the best!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That thick meat with crispy skin together is just the best!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Ah... just hearing you talk about it is making me hungry... hehe.
Array.indonesia: Ah... just hearing you talk about it is making me hungry... hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: Shouldn't you rest a bit while you recover?
Array.indonesia: Shouldn't you rest a bit while you recover?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Nah... if I just sit around, my skills'll get rusty.
Array.indonesia: Nah... if I just sit around, my skills'll get rusty.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: <size=32>I gotta fix broken furniture and make more sculptures too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I gotta fix broken furniture and make more sculptures too!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: <size=34>The village can't run without me! Hehehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>The village can't run without me! Hehehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_001
Array.english: To be honest, when I first saw you folks, I was a bit worried.
Array.indonesia: To be honest, when I first saw you folks, I was a bit worried.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_002
Array.english: You didn't even bring a single axe or pickaxe with you...
Array.indonesia: You didn't even bring a single axe or pickaxe with you...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_003
Array.english: Like those outsiders who pass through, don't respect our traditions, just strut around like they own the place, then leave.
Array.indonesia: Like those outsiders who pass through, don't respect our traditions, just strut around like they own the place, then leave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_004
Array.english: But you folks are different, I'll admit.
Array.indonesia: But you folks are different, I'll admit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_005
Array.english: The way you pitch in with the village work...\nand your cooking's pretty darn good too...
Array.indonesia: The way you pitch in with the village work...\nand your cooking's pretty darn good too...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_006
Array.english: That archaeologist drops by at night sometimes,\nand we even grab a drink together!
Array.indonesia: That archaeologist drops by at night sometimes,\nand we even grab a drink together!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Carpenter_Lv05_02_007
Array.english: ...Dr. Bacon...\nGiving alcohol to an injured person...
Array.indonesia: ...Dr. Bacon...\nGiving alcohol to an injured person...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: <size=32>So when ya dive, ya get air from that tank on yer back?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>So when ya dive, ya get air from that tank on yer back?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: That's right. We call it an oxygen tank for convenience... but it's actually an air tank with 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen.
Array.indonesia: That's right. We call it an oxygen tank for convenience... but it's actually an air tank with 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: I thought about tryin' it once when an outsider came through... but just havin' the gear ain't enough to go in the water.
Array.indonesia: I thought about tryin' it once when an outsider came through... but just havin' the gear ain't enough to go in the water.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_004
Array.english: There's a lot to prepare... and I was too scared of critters like piranhas, so I gave up.
Array.indonesia: There's a lot to prepare... and I was too scared of critters like piranhas, so I gave up.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_005
Array.english: I see. Well, you're great at fishing anyway.\nThat's more than enough.
Array.indonesia: I see. Well, you're great at fishing anyway.\nThat's more than enough.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_01_006
Array.english: Hehe, looks like you know what you're talkin' about, mister.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, looks like you know what you're talkin' about, mister.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: Ain't catchin' no fish these days.
Array.indonesia: Ain't catchin' no fish these days.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: You sure it ain't 'cause you already caught 'em all?
Array.indonesia: You sure it ain't 'cause you already caught 'em all?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: Ah... I don't think so...!
Array.indonesia: Ah... I don't think so...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Well, don't go stirrin' up the water too much.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well, don't go stirrin' up the water too much.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_001
Array.english: There's plenty to eat in this village, but...
Array.indonesia: There's plenty to eat in this village, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_002
Array.english: Still, fish dishes are our staple, and with the lake gettin' that polluted...
Array.indonesia: Still, fish dishes are our staple, and with the lake gettin' that polluted...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_003
Array.english: It must've been cleaner before.
Array.indonesia: It must've been cleaner before.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_004
Array.english: The water was definitely clearer than it is now.
Array.indonesia: The water was definitely clearer than it is now.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_005
Array.english: <size=33>It was great for castin' a line too, made fishin' real enjoyable!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It was great for castin' a line too, made fishin' real enjoyable!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_006
Array.english: It'll be clean again like before once the investigation's done!
Array.indonesia: It'll be clean again like before once the investigation's done!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv01_03_007
Array.english: You sound mighty confident.\nWell then, I'll be watchin'.
Array.indonesia: You sound mighty confident.\nWell then, I'll be watchin'.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: You dive 'cause you like fish dishes?
Array.indonesia: You dive 'cause you like fish dishes?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Yes! Bancho's sushi is absolutely incredible.
Array.indonesia: Yes! Bancho's sushi is absolutely incredible.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Though I can't get it here...
Array.indonesia: Though I can't get it here...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Haha, then could ya make <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> sushi too?
Array.indonesia: Haha, then could ya make <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> sushi too?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Hmm... actually, we don't use freshwater fish for sushi. Too many parasites.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... actually, we don't use freshwater fish for sushi. Too many parasites.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Oh... I see.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I see.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: Well, no matter. <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> tastes great no matter how ya cook it. Grilled, steamed, ya name it.
Array.indonesia: Well, no matter. <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> tastes great no matter how ya cook it. Grilled, steamed, ya name it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: Sure would be nice if we could get it at your restaurant too, haha.
Array.indonesia: Sure would be nice if we could get it at your restaurant too, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: I heard this lake's pretty deep. What's it really like?
Array.indonesia: I heard this lake's pretty deep. What's it really like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: I thought it'd be shallow since it's a lake...\nbut it's over 70 meters deep.
Array.indonesia: I thought it'd be shallow since it's a lake...\nbut it's over 70 meters deep.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: Goodness... that's mighty deep. It won't be easy gettin' the line down to the bottom.
Array.indonesia: Goodness... that's mighty deep. It won't be easy gettin' the line down to the bottom.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like I'll be needin' your help for a while longer! Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Looks like I'll be needin' your help for a while longer! Haha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: Don't you get bored just waiting around when you fish?
Array.indonesia: Don't you get bored just waiting around when you fish?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: Well, sure I do.
Array.indonesia: Well, sure I do.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_02_003
Array.english: But the fish 'round here are so active, ya don't have to wait long at all.
Array.indonesia: But the fish 'round here are so active, ya don't have to wait long at all.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv03_02_004
Array.english: Just hum a Muse Dash tune and next thing ya know,\none's on the hook!
Array.indonesia: Just hum a Muse Dash tune and next thing ya know,\none's on the hook!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: So hit me up~♪\nSpeeding up fast♬~♪
Array.indonesia: So hit me up~♪\nSpeeding up fast♬~♪

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Huh? Basu, what song are you humming?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Basu, what song are you humming?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, it ain't nothin'!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, it ain't nothin'!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Wait, is that song...\nMuse Dash's Hit Me Up?
Array.indonesia: Wait, is that song...\nMuse Dash's Hit Me Up?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=35>Ooh?! You know 'em too?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ooh?! You know 'em too?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Of course. They're a super popular girl group right now.
Array.indonesia: Of course. They're a super popular girl group right now.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! You've got good taste!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! You've got good taste!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: Haha. I never would've guessed you're a Muse Dash fan, Basu.
Array.indonesia: Haha. I never would've guessed you're a Muse Dash fan, Basu.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=34>Do you collect their merch or anything?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Do you collect their merch or anything?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_010
Array.english: <size=34>W-well... I might have a few things...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>W-well... I might have a few things...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_InfoTalk02_011
Array.english: (Maybe I should get him some Muse Dash merch as a gift sometime?)
Array.indonesia: (Maybe I should get him some Muse Dash merch as a gift sometime?)

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: I've been seeing a lot of lizards around here.
Array.indonesia: I've been seeing a lot of lizards around here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Oh... you mean the <color=#F1DC2B>Big-Eyed Lizards</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh... you mean the <color=#F1DC2B>Big-Eyed Lizards</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Big-eyed lizards come in all sorts of colors and patterns.
Array.indonesia: Big-eyed lizards come in all sorts of colors and patterns.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: It's got a real cute look to it... and though it's timid, ya can befriend it if ya tame it.
Array.indonesia: It's got a real cute look to it... and though it's timid, ya can befriend it if ya tame it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: They're good eatin' too, makes 'em great prey for wild animals.
Array.indonesia: They're good eatin' too, makes 'em great prey for wild animals.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: Huh? Do you like big-eyed lizards too, like Lipah?\nYou sure know a lot about them.
Array.indonesia: Huh? Do you like big-eyed lizards too, like Lipah?\nYou sure know a lot about them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, no, it ain't like that... it's just...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, no, it ain't like that... it's just...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_008
Array.english: I gotta catch worms for fishin' bait...\nand I just happened to see 'em then and learned a bit!
Array.indonesia: I gotta catch worms for fishin' bait...\nand I just happened to see 'em then and learned a bit!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_009
Array.english: I see... Sounds like you've been studying up on them.
Array.indonesia: I see... Sounds like you've been studying up on them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv05_01_010
Array.english: <size=33>Wh-why would I go studyin' 'em? Ya just see 'em every day and ya get to know 'em, that's all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wh-why would I go studyin' 'em? Ya just see 'em every day and ya get to know 'em, that's all!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: Oh my... what are you doing up so late?
Array.indonesia: Oh my... what are you doing up so late?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_002
Array.english: The breeze is nice and cool here. I've been looking around to see if I missed anything.
Array.indonesia: The breeze is nice and cool here. I've been looking around to see if I missed anything.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_003
Array.english: I see, hehe. Macaques used to come down at night and cause trouble in the village...
Array.indonesia: I see, hehe. Macaques used to come down at night and cause trouble in the village...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_004
Array.english: But since the boulder blocked the path, they don't show up much anymore.
Array.indonesia: But since the boulder blocked the path, they don't show up much anymore.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_Night01_005
Array.english: Still, you never know when they might come back,\nso always be careful at night.
Array.indonesia: Still, you never know when they might come back,\nso always be careful at night.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Task_410050008_001
Array.english: Oh, haven't you seen it? The house right next door is the carpenter <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>'s place.
Array.indonesia: Oh, haven't you seen it? The house right next door is the carpenter <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>'s place.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: You've got quite a variety of herbs here.
Array.indonesia: You've got quite a variety of herbs here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: Oh, these aren't just any herbs, they're ingredients for cooking.
Array.indonesia: Oh, these aren't just any herbs, they're ingredients for cooking.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: I've also got some herbs that are good for restoring stamina.
Array.indonesia: I've also got some herbs that are good for restoring stamina.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_004
Array.english: It's been harder to get them since the boulder blocked the path...
Array.indonesia: It's been harder to get them since the boulder blocked the path...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv01_01_005
Array.english: Once I've got a bit more ready, I'll share some with you too, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Once I've got a bit more ready, I'll share some with you too, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Did you make good use of the bamboo shoots I brought you?
Array.indonesia: Did you make good use of the bamboo shoots I brought you?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Yes. Thanks to you, I was able to use some for herbs and eat the rest.
Array.indonesia: Yes. Thanks to you, I was able to use some for herbs and eat the rest.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Bamboo Shoots</color> have a bit of an astringent taste, don't they?
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Bamboo Shoots</color> have a bit of an astringent taste, don't they?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: I didn't find them very tasty.
Array.indonesia: I didn't find them very tasty.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Haha, they do if you eat them plain. But if you rinse them thoroughly and season them, only the sweetness remains.
Array.indonesia: Haha, they do if you eat them plain. But if you rinse them thoroughly and season them, only the sweetness remains.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Oh... I see.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I see.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: A chef would probably know how to prepare them properly.\nI'd love to eat some nicely cooked <color=#FF73C3>Bamboo Shoots</color>.
Array.indonesia: A chef would probably know how to prepare them properly.\nI'd love to eat some nicely cooked <color=#FF73C3>Bamboo Shoots</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: If you come across any herbs or spices while you're out and about, I'd be happy to buy them from you.
Array.indonesia: If you come across any herbs or spices while you're out and about, I'd be happy to buy them from you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: I'll make it worth your while... hehe.
Array.indonesia: I'll make it worth your while... hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Thanks to you, Dave, the lake's gotten clearer.\nThank you.
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you, Dave, the lake's gotten clearer.\nThank you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Not at all. I'm just glad I could help the village.
Array.indonesia: Not at all. I'm just glad I could help the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: When the lake got polluted, some fish disappeared.
Array.indonesia: When the lake got polluted, some fish disappeared.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: The Pirarucu was one of them.
Array.indonesia: The Pirarucu was one of them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Pirarucu Scales</color> are very hard, so they're perfect for peeling vegetables and herbs.
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Pirarucu Scales</color> are very hard, so they're perfect for peeling vegetables and herbs.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: But I'm relieved to hear the Pirarucu are back in the lake now, hehe.
Array.indonesia: But I'm relieved to hear the Pirarucu are back in the lake now, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should give her a <color=#FF73C3>Pirarucu Scale</color> if I find one.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should give her a <color=#FF73C3>Pirarucu Scale</color> if I find one.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_001
Array.english: Something I like...
Array.indonesia: Something I like...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_002
Array.english: I used to gather herbs from the forest, make drinks, \nand share them with the villagers.
Array.indonesia: I used to gather herbs from the forest, make drinks, \nand share them with the villagers.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_003
Array.english: But... after the earthquake not long ago blocked the path, I haven't been able to get to the forest....
Array.indonesia: But... after the earthquake not long ago blocked the path, I haven't been able to get to the forest....

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_004
Array.english: Still, there was such joy in looking after the villagers' health... It's a shame.
Array.indonesia: Still, there was such joy in looking after the villagers' health... It's a shame.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_InfoTalk03_005
Array.english: I can only hope no one falls ill before we can gather herbs again.
Array.indonesia: I can only hope no one falls ill before we can gather herbs again.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: You might not have noticed, Dave, but...
Array.indonesia: You might not have noticed, Dave, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: After the earthquake and the pollution in the lake,\nthe village felt quite bleak.
Array.indonesia: After the earthquake and the pollution in the lake,\nthe village felt quite bleak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: And the journalists who came poking around only made people more wary of outsiders.
Array.indonesia: And the journalists who came poking around only made people more wary of outsiders.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: But ever since you and the others arrived...
Array.indonesia: But ever since you and the others arrived...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: You've truly helped the villagers... and shared such wonderful meals with us. Thanks to you, the village feels lively again.
Array.indonesia: You've truly helped the villagers... and shared such wonderful meals with us. Thanks to you, the village feels lively again.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: I only did what I thought I should. It's a bit embarrassing to hear that.
Array.indonesia: I only did what I thought I should. It's a bit embarrassing to hear that.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: Huhu... As one of the villagers, I just wanted to thank you.
Array.indonesia: Huhu... As one of the villagers, I just wanted to thank you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: Hmm... where did I put those notes...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... where did I put those notes...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_001
Array.english: I see. Doing some research?
Array.indonesia: I see. Doing some research?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_002
Array.english: Yeah. This area's always had a unique ecosystem,\nso I've been wanting to come here.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. This area's always had a unique ecosystem,\nso I've been wanting to come here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_003
Array.english: But lately, with the sudden earthquakes and dinosaurs showing up...
Array.indonesia: But lately, with the sudden earthquakes and dinosaurs showing up...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_004
Array.english: There's been a surge in unusual phenomena...\nso there's even more to study now.
Array.indonesia: There's been a surge in unusual phenomena...\nso there's even more to study now.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_005
Array.english: Dr. Bacon insists on keeping the research private, so we don't cause trouble for the residents if word gets out...
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon insists on keeping the research private, so we don't cause trouble for the residents if word gets out...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe. If it were up to me, I'd be bragging to the whole world about this incredible research material!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe. If it were up to me, I'd be bragging to the whole world about this incredible research material!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_001
Array.english: Muna, have you been working with Dr. Bacon for long?
Array.indonesia: Muna, have you been working with Dr. Bacon for long?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_002
Array.english: Oh, he's been looking out for me since I was an undergrad.
Array.indonesia: Oh, he's been looking out for me since I was an undergrad.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_003
Array.english: Even when I got into trouble, he'd just brush it off,\nsaying I was just being curious...
Array.indonesia: Even when I got into trouble, he'd just brush it off,\nsaying I was just being curious...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_004
Array.english: <size=32>He even let me work here at the research institute!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>He even let me work here at the research institute!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_02_005
Array.english: <size=33>I have to... work harder... and do more research... to repay him... hehehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I have to... work harder... and do more research... to repay him... hehehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>Looking at the teeth and fins...\nI'm sure... it's a Basilosaurus...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Looking at the teeth and fins...\nI'm sure... it's a Basilosaurus...</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>But... it's way too small...\nCould it be... a baby...?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>But... it's way too small...\nCould it be... a baby...?</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_003
Array.english: What are you writing so diligently?
Array.indonesia: What are you writing so diligently?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_004
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, Dave! I'm... looking into the dinosaur that washed up on the beach...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, Dave! I'm... looking into the dinosaur that washed up on the beach...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_005
Array.english: <size=33>I think it's a species called <color=#F1DC2B>Basilosaurus</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I think it's a species called <color=#F1DC2B>Basilosaurus</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_006
Array.english: <size=31>Well, technically it's not a dinosaur, more like an ancient whale... But let's just call it that for convenience.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Well, technically it's not a dinosaur, more like an ancient whale... But let's just call it that for convenience.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_007
Array.english: <size=31>But its size does seem a bit small...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>But its size does seem a bit small...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv02_03_008
Array.english: <size=31>Well... it's not like there's any accurate ecological data on them anyway.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Well... it's not like there's any accurate ecological data on them anyway.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Looking into old texts is useful, but...
Array.indonesia: Looking into old texts is useful, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: when later generations write things down, inaccuracies can creep in.
Array.indonesia: when later generations write things down, inaccuracies can creep in.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: That's why I tend to trust information from <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color>.
Array.indonesia: That's why I tend to trust information from <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Is there something special about <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color>?
Array.indonesia: Is there something special about <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Yes! For one, it's content written by people from that era...
Array.indonesia: Yes! For one, it's content written by people from that era...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: and through appraisal, we can get other info too!\nHehe.
Array.indonesia: and through appraisal, we can get other info too!\nHehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: There should be <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color> left by the ancient Sunang people at the lake too.
Array.indonesia: There should be <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color> left by the ancient Sunang people at the lake too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <size=34>It's hard for me to go find them myself, though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It's hard for me to go find them myself, though...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk01_009
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm. If I find any <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color> at the lake,\nI should give them to her as a gift.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm. If I find any <color=#FF73C3>Stone Tablets</color> at the lake,\nI should give them to her as a gift.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_001
Array.english: Muna, what were you researching before all this?
Array.indonesia: Muna, what were you researching before all this?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_002
Array.english: You mean... before I went missing, right?
Array.indonesia: You mean... before I went missing, right?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Yeah...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yeah...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_004
Array.english: Well... I've always been researching the Sea People civilization with Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Well... I've always been researching the Sea People civilization with Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_005
Array.english: We've actually found traces of the Sea People in many places, not just here or the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: We've actually found traces of the Sea People in many places, not just here or the Blue Hole.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_006
Array.english: But what makes this region special is that it's believed to be where they originated.
Array.indonesia: But what makes this region special is that it's believed to be where they originated.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_007
Array.english: Our institute believes the ancient Sea People here followed the ocean currents and settled in other regions.
Array.indonesia: Our institute believes the ancient Sea People here followed the ocean currents and settled in other regions.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_008
Array.english: It's such ancient history that it'd be hard to find traces, but...
Array.indonesia: It's such ancient history that it'd be hard to find traces, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_009
Array.english: <size=34>Isn't it just so romantic~?<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> An undersea civilization deep beneath the ocean~<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Isn't it just so romantic~?<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> An undersea civilization deep beneath the ocean~<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv04_01_010
Array.english: Once this investigation is over, I want to go looking in other places too. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Once this investigation is over, I want to go looking in other places too. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Muna, is there any food you especially like?
Array.indonesia: Muna, is there any food you especially like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! I like <color=#FF73C3>Electric Eel</color> dishes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! I like <color=#FF73C3>Electric Eel</color> dishes!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Oh... is <color=#FF73C3>Electric Eel</color> actually tasty?
Array.indonesia: Oh... is <color=#FF73C3>Electric Eel</color> actually tasty?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=34>Yes, of course!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yes, of course!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Ah, actually, it's not like it's the absolute tastiest...
Array.indonesia: Ah, actually, it's not like it's the absolute tastiest...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <size=34>But you can only eat it here in the jungle!\nHehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>But you can only eat it here in the jungle!\nHehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: It's probably not really true... but I feel like I get a little tingle when I eat it, hehe.
Array.indonesia: It's probably not really true... but I feel like I get a little tingle when I eat it, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: An <color=#FF73C3>Electric Eel</color> dish cooked by Bancho would be amazing.
Array.indonesia: An <color=#FF73C3>Electric Eel</color> dish cooked by Bancho would be amazing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: The unusual minerals found in this region...
Array.indonesia: The unusual minerals found in this region...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Utara Crystals and Sunang Stones are things you hardly ever see anywhere else.
Array.indonesia: Utara Crystals and Sunang Stones are things you hardly ever see anywhere else.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Why do you think those minerals only formed here?
Array.indonesia: Why do you think those minerals only formed here?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: Hmm... I'm still looking into that, but...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'm still looking into that, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: I think it has to do with the Divine Trees growing in the sea beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: I think it has to do with the Divine Trees growing in the sea beneath the lake.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: The Blue Hole affected the surrounding terrain and ecosystem too, didn't it?
Array.indonesia: The Blue Hole affected the surrounding terrain and ecosystem too, didn't it?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: It seems like it's the same situation here.
Array.indonesia: It seems like it's the same situation here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_008
Array.english: Maybe the energy from the Divine Trees solidified when it met the freshwater lake, and that's what created <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>...
Array.indonesia: Maybe the energy from the Divine Trees solidified when it met the freshwater lake, and that's what created <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_009
Array.english: <size=33>That is the brilliant hypothesis of yours truly, the genius Muna!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That is the brilliant hypothesis of yours truly, the genius Muna!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv05_01_010
