Array.english: Now that you mention it, that does sound pretty convincing.
Array.indonesia: Now that you mention it, that does sound pretty convincing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, Dave. What brings ya out this late?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, Dave. What brings ya out this late?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_002
Array.english: Ah, saw ya workin' on the vehicle. Figured you'd still be at it this late.
Array.indonesia: Ah, saw ya workin' on the vehicle. Figured you'd still be at it this late.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_003
Array.english: Hahaha, gotta get it done at night if I wanna drive it tomorrow, ya know.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, gotta get it done at night if I wanna drive it tomorrow, ya know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_004
Array.english: Dave, do ya know how to drive?
Array.indonesia: Dave, do ya know how to drive?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_005
Array.english: Yeah. I don't drive much, but I've got a license.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. I don't drive much, but I've got a license.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_006
Array.english: Hahaha, I see.\nSo, what kinda car d'ya like?
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, I see.\nSo, what kinda car d'ya like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_option1
Array.english: A cool convertible car
Array.indonesia: A cool convertible car

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_option2
Array.english: A big, sturdy SUV
Array.indonesia: A big, sturdy SUV

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_001
Array.english: <size=33>If I had to pick, I'd definitely go for a cool sports car!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If I had to pick, I'd definitely go for a cool sports car!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_002
Array.english: <size=34>Haha, now you're talkin'!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha, now you're talkin'!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_003
Array.english: That feelin' of cuttin' through the wind with the top down... you can only get that in a convertible.
Array.indonesia: That feelin' of cuttin' through the wind with the top down... you can only get that in a convertible.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_004
Array.english: But truth be told, it's kinda hard drivin' a convertible in a place this hot.
Array.indonesia: But truth be told, it's kinda hard drivin' a convertible in a place this hot.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_005
Array.english: Feels great for a moment... but your head gets so hot ya wanna close it right away.
Array.indonesia: Feels great for a moment... but your head gets so hot ya wanna close it right away.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Correct_006
Array.english: <size=34>Come to think of it, my truck's the best choice after all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Come to think of it, my truck's the best choice after all!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_001
Array.english: Sports cars are a bit cramped... I think SUVs are more my style.
Array.indonesia: Sports cars are a bit cramped... I think SUVs are more my style.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_002
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, when it comes to style and practicality, nothin' beats an SUV!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, when it comes to style and practicality, nothin' beats an SUV!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_003
Array.english: Try showin' off in a sports car, and ya can't even fit your groceries if ya buy a lot.
Array.indonesia: Try showin' off in a sports car, and ya can't even fit your groceries if ya buy a lot.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_RelationEvent_01_Incorrect_004
Array.english: <size=34>Come to think of it, my truck's the best of all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Come to think of it, my truck's the best of all!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Mission01Progress_001
Array.english: Hmm, <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>? That'd be the tree with them little round green fruits.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, <color=#F1DC2B>Calamansi</color>? That'd be the tree with them little round green fruits.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Mission01Progress_002
Array.english: <size=32>I think I saw one in front of the village chief's house...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I think I saw one in front of the village chief's house...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_001
Array.english: That truck I gave ya a ride in...
Array.indonesia: That truck I gave ya a ride in...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>I've been drivin' it for over ten years now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I've been drivin' it for over ten years now.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_003
Array.english: And I bought it used... so it's actually a whole lot older than that.
Array.indonesia: And I bought it used... so it's actually a whole lot older than that.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_004
Array.english: Is that so...? It still seemed perfectly fine to me.
Array.indonesia: Is that so...? It still seemed perfectly fine to me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_005
Array.english: These days, a lot of people actually like cars with that retro vibe.
Array.indonesia: These days, a lot of people actually like cars with that retro vibe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_006
Array.english: <size=32>It might even be worth more, honestly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It might even be worth more, honestly.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_007
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, really? Well, that's good to hear!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, really? Well, that's good to hear!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_008
Array.english: Well... I'm pretty attached to it, so I've no intention of selling it, but...
Array.indonesia: Well... I'm pretty attached to it, so I've no intention of selling it, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_01_009
Array.english: <size=33>Someday, I'd sure love to drive a brand-new, fancy car! Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Someday, I'd sure love to drive a brand-new, fancy car! Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_001
Array.english: You go back and forth to the city quite a bit, don't you? Which do you like better?
Array.indonesia: You go back and forth to the city quite a bit, don't you? Which do you like better?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_002
Array.english: Hmm... that's a tough one.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... that's a tough one.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_003
Array.english: The city's got lots of interestin' stuff... but I always feel a bit of distance from the folks there.
Array.indonesia: The city's got lots of interestin' stuff... but I always feel a bit of distance from the folks there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_004
Array.english: But the village... it's got good folks, and there's somethin' real comforting about it.
Array.indonesia: But the village... it's got good folks, and there's somethin' real comforting about it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_005
Array.english: Well, if you brought stuff in from the city and shared it around the village, maybe that'd help!
Array.indonesia: Well, if you brought stuff in from the city and shared it around the village, maybe that'd help!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_006
Array.english: Oh... Dave, you're sharper than you look!
Array.indonesia: Oh... Dave, you're sharper than you look!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_02_007
Array.english: <size=34>What's that supposed to mean...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What's that supposed to mean...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_001
Array.english: You're always in the village, Rimbo...\nWhen do you head into the city?
Array.indonesia: You're always in the village, Rimbo...\nWhen do you head into the city?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_002
Array.english: <size=34>Uh... well...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Uh... well...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_003
Array.english: I usually go while you're out diving, or early in the morning.
Array.indonesia: I usually go while you're out diving, or early in the morning.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_004
Array.english: I see. Just got curious, that's all.
Array.indonesia: I see. Just got curious, that's all.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv02_03_005
Array.english: Hehe, dig too deep and... there are some things I'd rather not get into.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, dig too deep and... there are some things I'd rather not get into.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: You seem to like charms, Rimbo.
Array.indonesia: You seem to like charms, Rimbo.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Hehe, well... I do drive around a lot...\nand sometimes I gotta go through some dangerous places.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, well... I do drive around a lot...\nand sometimes I gotta go through some dangerous places.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <size=34>It's better to have a little peace of mind, ya know? Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It's better to have a little peace of mind, ya know? Hehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Are there other things besides <color=#FF73C3>Red Feathers</color> that bring good luck?
Array.indonesia: Are there other things besides <color=#FF73C3>Red Feathers</color> that bring good luck?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Hmm... they say havin' somethin' from a strong creature can ward off bad luck.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... they say havin' somethin' from a strong creature can ward off bad luck.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=34>Somethin' like a <color=#FF73C3>Black Caiman Tooth</color> would sure give me some peace of mind!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Somethin' like a <color=#FF73C3>Black Caiman Tooth</color> would sure give me some peace of mind!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I should give him a <color=#FF73C3>Black Caiman Tooth</color> if I find one.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(I should give him a <color=#FF73C3>Black Caiman Tooth</color> if I find one.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_001
Array.english: The road outta the village ain't fully paved,\nso long drives ain't easy.
Array.indonesia: The road outta the village ain't fully paved,\nso long drives ain't easy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_002
Array.english: Yeah, I noticed that on the way in.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, I noticed that on the way in.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_003
Array.english: By evening, I'm usually pretty worn out...
Array.indonesia: By evening, I'm usually pretty worn out...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_004
Array.english: But once I have some of Bancho's cooking, all that fatigue just melts away, haha.
Array.indonesia: But once I have some of Bancho's cooking, all that fatigue just melts away, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_005
Array.english: Good food really does bring your energy back and lift your spirits.
Array.indonesia: Good food really does bring your energy back and lift your spirits.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv04_01_006
Array.english: Talkin' about it is makin' me hungry again.
Array.indonesia: Talkin' about it is makin' me hungry again.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_001
Array.english: What I like, huh...
Array.indonesia: What I like, huh...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_002
Array.english: <size=34>I reckon I'm pretty attached to this here truck.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I reckon I'm pretty attached to this here truck.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_003
Array.english:
It's a PONY pickup truck...
Made in Korea.
Array.indonesia:
It's a PONY pickup truck...
Made in Korea.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_004
Array.english: She's been a real big help haulin' stuff through these rough jungle roads, hahaha!
Array.indonesia: She's been a real big help haulin' stuff through these rough jungle roads, hahaha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_005
Array.english:
I see.
The red color really looks great!
Array.indonesia:
I see.
The red color really looks great!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk04_006
Array.english:
<size=34>Heh, right?
It's my favorite color!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=34>Heh, right?
It's my favorite color!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Rimbo, is there any particular food you like?
Array.indonesia: Rimbo, is there any particular food you like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Ah, remember I told ya my lucky color's red?
Array.indonesia: Ah, remember I told ya my lucky color's red?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Yeah. You said you keep a red feather in your car as a charm.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. You said you keep a red feather in your car as a charm.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Haha! That's right!\nI like food with a bit of red in it too.
Array.indonesia: Haha! That's right!\nI like food with a bit of red in it too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: There used to be a fish called <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> in this lake...
Array.indonesia: There used to be a fish called <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> in this lake...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Its color was a beautiful deep red, and the meat was so tender... It was unbelievably good!
Array.indonesia: Its color was a beautiful deep red, and the meat was so tender... It was unbelievably good!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english:
But... since the lake got polluted like this,
I ain't seen a single one.
Array.indonesia:
But... since the lake got polluted like this,
I ain't seen a single one.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: I guess <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> are sensitive to water quality... They might've left the lake.
Array.indonesia: I guess <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> are sensitive to water quality... They might've left the lake.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: A real shame, ain't it?\nI'd sure love to have one again.
Array.indonesia: A real shame, ain't it?\nI'd sure love to have one again.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_001
Array.english: Come to think of it... the lake's been getting cleaner lately.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it... the lake's been getting cleaner lately.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_002
Array.english: Yeah. I was able to purify it with Martin's help.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. I was able to purify it with Martin's help.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_003
Array.english: Hahaha, if the water stays this clean, the <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> might come back to the lake!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, if the water stays this clean, the <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color> might come back to the lake!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_004
Array.english: Been a while since I had some, hahaha.
Array.indonesia: Been a while since I had some, hahaha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_InfoTalk03_005
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Rimbo likes <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color>... I should check if there are any in the lake.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Rimbo likes <color=#FF73C3>Sockeye Salmon</color>... I should check if there are any in the lake.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: It's been quite a while since ya came to the village, Dave.
Array.indonesia: It's been quite a while since ya came to the village, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: Yeah, it has. Thought I might end up in the wrong place, but you came out to meet me, so that was a relief.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, it has. Thought I might end up in the wrong place, but you came out to meet me, so that was a relief.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Haha, Muna told me what Dr. Bacon looked like,\nso I spotted him right away.
Array.indonesia: Haha, Muna told me what Dr. Bacon looked like,\nso I spotted him right away.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: What'd she say?
Array.indonesia: What'd she say?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: Said there'd be a skinny, middle-aged fella with a face all red like he'd been drinkin'...
Array.indonesia: Said there'd be a skinny, middle-aged fella with a face all red like he'd been drinkin'...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>...That's surprisingly accurate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...That's surprisingly accurate.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv05_01_007
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Glad it turned out to be such a fun bunch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Glad it turned out to be such a fun bunch!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_GoToBeach_Night_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? Ya wanna head to the beach this late at night?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? Ya wanna head to the beach this late at night?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_GoToBeach_Night_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... the road's pretty rough, and it ain't the best at night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... the road's pretty rough, and it ain't the best at night.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_GoToBeach_Night_003
Array.english: <size=32>Come back and ask me again in the daytime, alright!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Come back and ask me again in the daytime, alright!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Insects</color> here tend to grow larger than in other places.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>Insects</color> here tend to grow larger than in other places.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: So outsiders are sometimes surprised when they see them.
Array.indonesia: So outsiders are sometimes surprised when they see them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_01_003
Array.english: Aren't they cuter when they're bigger? Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Aren't they cuter when they're bigger? Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: Have you ever seen a <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Beetle</color> near water?
Array.indonesia: Have you ever seen a <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Beetle</color> near water?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: They may look calm, but they're actually incredibly fast hunters. They even snatch and eat small fish.
Array.indonesia: They may look calm, but they're actually incredibly fast hunters. They even snatch and eat small fish.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: If you're planning to catch one... I'd recommend approaching slowly and carefully.
Array.indonesia: If you're planning to catch one... I'd recommend approaching slowly and carefully.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_001
Array.english: Does the food in this village suit your palate?
Array.indonesia: Does the food in this village suit your palate?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_002
Array.english: Hmm... actually, it doesn't really suit me,\nso I've been eating what Bancho makes.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... actually, it doesn't really suit me,\nso I've been eating what Bancho makes.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_003
Array.english: Hehe, the food in our village isn't really something to boast about.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, the food in our village isn't really something to boast about.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_004
Array.english: Since the ingredients are so fresh, I feel like we've been a bit neglectful when it comes to cooking?
Array.indonesia: Since the ingredients are so fresh, I feel like we've been a bit neglectful when it comes to cooking?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_005
Array.english: On top of that... since the lake got polluted,\nthe taste of the fish has gone down too...
Array.indonesia: On top of that... since the lake got polluted,\nthe taste of the fish has gone down too...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_006
Array.english: I'm still a bit cautious, but... I'd love to try the food your friend makes.
Array.indonesia: I'm still a bit cautious, but... I'd love to try the food your friend makes.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_03_007
Array.english:
Bancho's cooking is the best! If you're interested,
feel free to visit the restaurant anytime.
Array.indonesia:
Bancho's cooking is the best! If you're interested,
feel free to visit the restaurant anytime.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_001
Array.english: The food at the shop was really delicious.\nI didn't leave a single bite.
Array.indonesia: The food at the shop was really delicious.\nI didn't leave a single bite.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_002
Array.english: Knowing Bancho's cooking holds up even out here \nmakes me proud.
Array.indonesia: Knowing Bancho's cooking holds up even out here \nmakes me proud.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_003
Array.english: The local ingredients here are so fresh and full of flavor.
Array.indonesia: The local ingredients here are so fresh and full of flavor.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_004
Array.english: The chef brings out the texture of the ingredients so beautifully. It's just wonderful.
Array.indonesia: The chef brings out the texture of the ingredients so beautifully. It's just wonderful.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv01_04_005
Array.english: I'll keep dropping by, so I'm counting on you. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: I'll keep dropping by, so I'm counting on you. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: To be honest, I prefer <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> over fish. Hehe...
Array.indonesia: To be honest, I prefer <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> over fish. Hehe...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> is always the answer.
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> is always the answer.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Oh, so you like it too, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Oh, so you like it too, Dave?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: I used to catch a lot of wild animals in the forest... but I haven't been able to eat much since the path was blocked.
Array.indonesia: I used to catch a lot of wild animals in the forest... but I haven't been able to eat much since the path was blocked.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: <size=33>I really miss it sometimes, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I really miss it sometimes, hehe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: There aren't many types of <color=#F1DC2B>Big-Eyed Lizards</color> in the village, but...
Array.indonesia: There aren't many types of <color=#F1DC2B>Big-Eyed Lizards</color> in the village, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: In new areas, you'll be able to find ones with different colors.
Array.indonesia: In new areas, you'll be able to find ones with different colors.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: It'd be a shame to see one and miss it...\nso always have lizard bait ready.
Array.indonesia: It'd be a shame to see one and miss it...\nso always have lizard bait ready.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: With the flower garden right next to my house, I can enjoy the scent of flowers anytime.
Array.indonesia: With the flower garden right next to my house, I can enjoy the scent of flowers anytime.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: When you fall asleep surrounded by a lovely fragrance, you won't have any bad dreams, you know.
Array.indonesia: When you fall asleep surrounded by a lovely fragrance, you won't have any bad dreams, you know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, what kind of food did you say you like, Lipah?
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, what kind of food did you say you like, Lipah?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh, I like <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> dishes.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I like <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> dishes.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: I like fish too, but... maybe because I ate so much of it growing up, <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> dishes just sound more appealing to me.
Array.indonesia: I like fish too, but... maybe because I ate so much of it growing up, <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color> dishes just sound more appealing to me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Oh, now that we can go to Setah Forest, I'll be able to get some meat.
Array.indonesia: Oh, now that we can go to Setah Forest, I'll be able to get some meat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=34>Once I get some <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color>, I'll serve you a meal at the restaurant!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Once I get some <color=#FF73C3>Meat</color>, I'll serve you a meal at the restaurant!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Though Bancho will be the one cooking it...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Though Bancho will be the one cooking it...)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=34>I'm looking forward to it! I'll order it when it shows up on the menu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I'm looking forward to it! I'll order it when it shows up on the menu!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: Big-Eyed Lizards are greedy eaters with flashy colors, so they often get eaten by wild animals.
Array.indonesia: Big-Eyed Lizards are greedy eaters with flashy colors, so they often get eaten by wild animals.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: They're very wary, so normally they run away the moment you get close, but...
Array.indonesia: They're very wary, so normally they run away the moment you get close, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: When they're eating, they let their guard down completely.
Array.indonesia: When they're eating, they let their guard down completely.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: Oh, but some of the rarer ones among them will dash off if you get close, even while they're eating.
Array.indonesia: Oh, but some of the rarer ones among them will dash off if you get close, even while they're eating.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Lipah_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: In that case... \nit'd be best to sneak up on them ever so quietly.
Array.indonesia: In that case... \nit'd be best to sneak up on them ever so quietly.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? What is it now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? What is it now?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Don't bother me. If you're bored, go chase the birds off that scarecrow over there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Don't bother me. If you're bored, go chase the birds off that scarecrow over there.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_02_001
Array.english: <size=32>What are you doing snooping around the farm?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What are you doing snooping around the farm?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_02_002
Array.english: I've already given you coconuts and papayas. What,\nyou need something else?
Array.indonesia: I've already given you coconuts and papayas. What,\nyou need something else?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv01_02_003
Array.english: Tch. Outsiders... never satisfied, are they.
Array.indonesia: Tch. Outsiders... never satisfied, are they.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Phew... when I'm working, I start craving something cold...
Array.indonesia: Phew... when I'm working, I start craving something cold...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: But it's so hot here, it goes lukewarm in no time.
Array.indonesia: But it's so hot here, it goes lukewarm in no time.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Come to think of it, I heard there's some kind of cup from the city that keeps drinks cold...
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, I heard there's some kind of cup from the city that keeps drinks cold...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Sounds pretty useful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sounds pretty useful.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Ah... are you talking about a <color=#FF73C3>Tumbler</color>?
Array.indonesia: Ah... are you talking about a <color=#FF73C3>Tumbler</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=32>How would I remember all those names?! Now that you mention it, yeah, that sounds about right!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>How would I remember all those names?! Now that you mention it, yeah, that sounds about right!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should get him a <color=#FF73C3>Tumbler</color> as a gift if I find one?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should get him a <color=#FF73C3>Tumbler</color> as a gift if I find one?)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_01_001
Array.english: Hmm... not bad. I'll give you that.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... not bad. I'll give you that.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>But it's the ingredients that matter most, right?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But it's the ingredients that matter most, right?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_01_003
Array.english: You oughta be grateful. The ingredients here are top-notch.
Array.indonesia: You oughta be grateful. The ingredients here are top-notch.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_01_004
Array.english: ...Not that I'm sayin' the chef isn't skilled.
Array.indonesia: ...Not that I'm sayin' the chef isn't skilled.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_02_001
Array.english: The folks in the village have been talkin' about your shop, y'know...
Array.indonesia: The folks in the village have been talkin' about your shop, y'know...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Don't go gettin' too full of yourself!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Don't go gettin' too full of yourself!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_02_003
Array.english: Anything tastes better when you eat it with the coconuts I grow.
Array.indonesia: Anything tastes better when you eat it with the coconuts I grow.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv03_02_004
Array.english: <size=32>You oughta be thankin' me, that's what!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You oughta be thankin' me, that's what!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Jepun, are there any ingredients you particularly like?
Array.indonesia: Jepun, are there any ingredients you particularly like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Hmm... I prefer cooking vegetable dishes myself.\nThey just taste better that way...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I prefer cooking vegetable dishes myself.\nThey just taste better that way...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: And fish dishes? Picking out all the bones is such a hassle.
Array.indonesia: And fish dishes? Picking out all the bones is such a hassle.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Oh, right! There are a few root vegetables that only grow in the forest...
Array.indonesia: Oh, right! There are a few root vegetables that only grow in the forest...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Dishes made with those are really good.
Array.indonesia: Dishes made with those are really good.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Things like <color=#FF73C3>Taro</color> or <color=#FF73C3>Cassava</color> are great even just roasted.
Array.indonesia: Things like <color=#FF73C3>Taro</color> or <color=#FF73C3>Cassava</color> are great even just roasted.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: Come to think of it, I haven't had any since the forest path got blocked.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, I haven't had any since the forest path got blocked.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <size=33>Now you had to go and bring that up and make me hungry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Now you had to go and bring that up and make me hungry!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... sorry...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... sorry...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk02_010
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Jepun likes dishes made with root vegetables like <color=#FF73C3>Taro</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Cassava</color>. I should write that down.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Jepun likes dishes made with root vegetables like <color=#FF73C3>Taro</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Cassava</color>. I should write that down.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_001
Array.english: Hmm... I wouldn't say I'm fond of it...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I wouldn't say I'm fond of it...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_002
Array.english: But I heard there's a farming tool from Korea called a <color=#FF73C3>Homi</color>.
Array.indonesia: But I heard there's a farming tool from Korea called a <color=#FF73C3>Homi</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_003
Array.english: They say it pulls weeds out clean, roots and all… real handy thing.
Array.indonesia: They say it pulls weeds out clean, roots and all… real handy thing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_004
Array.english: Pulling 'em out by hand or with a hoe every time gives me a real backache.
Array.indonesia: Pulling 'em out by hand or with a hoe every time gives me a real backache.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_InfoTalk03_005
Array.english:
<color=#E3E3E3>(I bet Jepun would love it if I got him a <color=#FF73C3>Homi</color>.
I should write that down.)</color>
Array.indonesia:
<color=#E3E3E3>(I bet Jepun would love it if I got him a <color=#FF73C3>Homi</color>.
I should write that down.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Seeing the crops growing so well in the garden... makes me proud!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Seeing the crops growing so well in the garden... makes me proud!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>You've been a big help, I'll give you that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You've been a big help, I'll give you that.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_003
Array.english: Hehe... hearing you say that makes me feel pretty good.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... hearing you say that makes me feel pretty good.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_004
Array.english: Hey, don't go getting a big head now! The faster they grow, the more often you'll have to plant!
Array.indonesia: Hey, don't go getting a big head now! The faster they grow, the more often you'll have to plant!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_005
Array.english: Don't go pretending you're too busy...\nCome by and take care of the crops regularly!
Array.indonesia: Don't go pretending you're too busy...\nCome by and take care of the crops regularly!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_01_006
Array.english: Yes, got it.\nI'll try planting new seeds every now and then.
Array.indonesia: Yes, got it.\nI'll try planting new seeds every now and then.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_02_001
Array.english: Like I told ya, the crops in this here garden grow at a ridiculous speed.
Array.indonesia: Like I told ya, the crops in this here garden grow at a ridiculous speed.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_02_002
Array.english: But if ya wanna see 'em grow even faster, try usin' some <color=#F1DC2B>Rapid Growth Fertilizer</color>.
Array.indonesia: But if ya wanna see 'em grow even faster, try usin' some <color=#F1DC2B>Rapid Growth Fertilizer</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_02_003
Array.english: And if ya wanna see big crops or unusual ones, there's fertilizer for that too.
Array.indonesia: And if ya wanna see big crops or unusual ones, there's fertilizer for that too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Farmer_Lv05_02_004
Array.english: Gimme yer leftover stuff and I'll turn it into fertilizer, so bring it by now and then to clear out yer bag!
Array.indonesia: Gimme yer leftover stuff and I'll turn it into fertilizer, so bring it by now and then to clear out yer bag!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv01_Night01_001
Array.english: Oh my, what brings you here this late?
Array.indonesia: Oh my, what brings you here this late?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv01_Night01_002
Array.english: I'm just checking if there's anything left to take care of.
Array.indonesia: I'm just checking if there's anything left to take care of.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv01_Night01_003
Array.english: You must be tired from running the shop...\nYou should get some rest.
Array.indonesia: You must be tired from running the shop...\nYou should get some rest.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv01_Night01_004
Array.english: Thanks for looking out for me, Uzme.
Array.indonesia: Thanks for looking out for me, Uzme.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_001
Array.english: It makes me a little sad to think you'll all be heading back home someday.
Array.indonesia: It makes me a little sad to think you'll all be heading back home someday.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>I know... but we still have our old restaurant to look after…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I know... but we still have our old restaurant to look after…</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Still, we'll do our best while we're here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Still, we'll do our best while we're here!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_004
Array.english: <size=32>That means a lot.\nBancho's cooking really is amazing...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That means a lot.\nBancho's cooking really is amazing...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_01_005
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, right? Bancho's cooking really is the best in the world!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, right? Bancho's cooking really is the best in the world!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_02_001
Array.english: I like collecting small <color=#F1DC2B>Seashells</color> and stringing them together.
Array.indonesia: I like collecting small <color=#F1DC2B>Seashells</color> and stringing them together.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Someday...\nI'd like to give them to someone I care about.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Someday...\nI'd like to give them to someone I care about.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_001
Array.english: Are you running the shop again today?
Array.indonesia: Are you running the shop again today?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_002
Array.english: Yeah, of course.\nBancho really hates closing the shop.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, of course.\nBancho really hates closing the shop.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_003
Array.english: He'd never close unless it's something really important.
Array.indonesia: He'd never close unless it's something really important.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_004
Array.english: When we caught that giant squid, he shut the place down and invited everyone over for a feast.
Array.indonesia: When we caught that giant squid, he shut the place down and invited everyone over for a feast.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_005
Array.english: So he has a warm side too...
Array.indonesia: So he has a warm side too...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_006
Array.english: I never would've guessed. I always see him with that stern look, completely focused on cooking.
Array.indonesia: I never would've guessed. I always see him with that stern look, completely focused on cooking.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_007
Array.english: Cooking is his whole life.
Array.indonesia: Cooking is his whole life.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_008
Array.english: I heard that when he was younger, he went to Japan on his own to learn the cuisine.
Array.indonesia: I heard that when he was younger, he went to Japan on his own to learn the cuisine.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv02_03_009
Array.english:
That's brave... With that kind of dedication,
it's no wonder he's as skilled as he is now.
Array.indonesia:
That's brave... With that kind of dedication,
it's no wonder he's as skilled as he is now.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Sometimes, beautiful <color=#FF73C3>Coral</color> washes up on this sandy beach.
Array.indonesia: Sometimes, beautiful <color=#FF73C3>Coral</color> washes up on this sandy beach.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: <size=33>But there shouldn't be coral in a lake, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But there shouldn't be coral in a lake, right?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: That's what I thought too, but...
Array.indonesia: That's what I thought too, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Old writings say there's an ocean beneath the lake...\nMaybe it drifted up from there?
Array.indonesia: Old writings say there's an ocean beneath the lake...\nMaybe it drifted up from there?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: If there's a place with such beautiful <color=#FF73C3>Coral</color>,\nI'd love to visit it someday.
Array.indonesia: If there's a place with such beautiful <color=#FF73C3>Coral</color>,\nI'd love to visit it someday.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Oh, but I suppose you've already seen plenty in the ocean, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Oh, but I suppose you've already seen plenty in the ocean, Dave?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english:
Haha, it's even more beautiful in the ocean.
I hope you get to see it for yourself someday, Uzme.
Array.indonesia:
Haha, it's even more beautiful in the ocean.
I hope you get to see it for yourself someday, Uzme.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Uzme likes <color=#FF73C3>Coral</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Uzme likes <color=#FF73C3>Coral</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_001
Array.english: You really train hard, Uzme.
Array.indonesia: You really train hard, Uzme.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_002
Array.english: Yeah... My dad's not in the best health.\nAnd he's getting older...
Array.indonesia: Yeah... My dad's not in the best health.\nAnd he's getting older...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_003
Array.english: So I have to be the one to protect him.
Array.indonesia: So I have to be the one to protect him.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_004
Array.english: Didn't you say a crocodile bit his leg?
Array.indonesia: Didn't you say a crocodile bit his leg?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_005
Array.english: Yeah... I was just a kid back then...\nIf my dad hadn't stepped in, I wouldn't be here today.
Array.indonesia: Yeah... I was just a kid back then...\nIf my dad hadn't stepped in, I wouldn't be here today.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_006
Array.english: That's why I train, to protect him.
Array.indonesia: That's why I train, to protect him.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_007
Array.english: The chief must be very proud to have a daughter like you, Uzme.
Array.indonesia: The chief must be very proud to have a daughter like you, Uzme.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_Lv04_01_008
Array.english: Oh... it's nothing special. It's just what any daughter would do...
Array.indonesia: Oh... it's nothing special. It's just what any daughter would do...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: I get really hungry after working out, but...
Array.indonesia: I get really hungry after working out, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: greasy food slows down muscle recovery, so I try to avoid it.
Array.indonesia: greasy food slows down muscle recovery, so I try to avoid it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: You're so disciplined...\nI eat a ton after diving...!
Array.indonesia: You're so disciplined...\nI eat a ton after diving...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Hehe, that's probably the more natural reaction.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, that's probably the more natural reaction.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Still, don't you need to eat enough?
Array.indonesia: Still, don't you need to eat enough?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Of course. As long as I eat high-protein meals,\nit's not a problem.
Array.indonesia: Of course. As long as I eat high-protein meals,\nit's not a problem.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: I heard that among fish, the <color=#FF73C3>Giant Snakehead</color> is almost all protein with barely any fat.
Array.indonesia: I heard that among fish, the <color=#FF73C3>Giant Snakehead</color> is almost all protein with barely any fat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Uzme_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <size=32>I can eat fish like that as much as I want, right? Hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I can eat fish like that as much as I want, right? Hehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_001
Array.english: Dave, you gettin' by alright in the forest?\nThe wild animals've been gettin' pretty fierce.
Array.indonesia: Dave, you gettin' by alright in the forest?\nThe wild animals've been gettin' pretty fierce.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_002
Array.english: I've got a weapon, so I'm mostly fine, but...
Array.indonesia: I've got a weapon, so I'm mostly fine, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_003
Array.english: sometimes when I run into really tough ones, it gets rough.
Array.indonesia: sometimes when I run into really tough ones, it gets rough.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_004
Array.english: Hehe, yeah.\nThey've gotten even fiercer lately.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, yeah.\nThey've gotten even fiercer lately.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_005
Array.english: That's why I brought in some <color=#F1DC2B>Weapons</color> from the city...
Array.indonesia: That's why I brought in some <color=#F1DC2B>Weapons</color> from the city...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_006
Array.english: They're a bit pricey, but...\nI reckon they'll come in handy.
Array.indonesia: They're a bit pricey, but...\nI reckon they'll come in handy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPG_007
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... nice!\nI'll let ya know when I need 'em!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... nice!\nI'll let ya know when I need 'em!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_001
Array.english: Looks like Muna's headin' into the forest with ya too.
Array.indonesia: Looks like Muna's headin' into the forest with ya too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_002
Array.english: Yeah. I tried to stop her... but she brought a whip and told me not to worry.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. I tried to stop her... but she brought a whip and told me not to worry.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_003
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, Muna sure is brave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, Muna sure is brave!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_004
Array.english: I've stocked some weapons at the shop that she can use.
Array.indonesia: I've stocked some weapons at the shop that she can use.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_ShopRPGLv2_005
Array.english: <size=32>Let me know if ya need any!\nI'll just charge ya cost.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let me know if ya need any!\nI'll just charge ya cost.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV4_001
Array.english: Bancho's cooking is really delicious.
Array.indonesia: Bancho's cooking is really delicious.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV4_002
Array.english: Some people are still cautious... but many others are really enjoying it.
Array.indonesia: Some people are still cautious... but many others are really enjoying it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV4_003
Array.english: I thought it might help, so I've stocked up on a few more <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>.
Array.indonesia: I thought it might help, so I've stocked up on a few more <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV4_004
Array.english: Just let me know if you need anything.
Array.indonesia: Just let me know if you need anything.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_001
Array.english: The lake became polluted, and the taste of the fish changed... so I haven't had much of an appetite lately.
Array.indonesia: The lake became polluted, and the taste of the fish changed... so I haven't had much of an appetite lately.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_002
Array.english: My body had been aching here and there as well...
Array.indonesia: My body had been aching here and there as well...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_003
Array.english: But thanks to your cooking, Bancho, my appetite has returned and I feel much healthier now.
Array.indonesia: But thanks to your cooking, Bancho, my appetite has returned and I feel much healthier now.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_004
Array.english: I'm truly grateful you're making such good use of the village's ingredients.
Array.indonesia: I'm truly grateful you're making such good use of the village's ingredients.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_005
Array.english: Thinking it might help, I've prepared a few more <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color> at the shop.
Array.indonesia: Thinking it might help, I've prepared a few more <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color> at the shop.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopLV5_006
Array.english: Well then, I'll be counting on you from now on.
Array.indonesia: Well then, I'll be counting on you from now on.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_001
Array.english: I heard you went to Setah Forest.
Array.indonesia: I heard you went to Setah Forest.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_002
Array.english: With all the recent earthquakes, the wild animals have become quite aggressive...
Array.indonesia: With all the recent earthquakes, the wild animals have become quite aggressive...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_003
Array.english: I've been growing some <color=#F1DC2B>Herbs</color> that only grow in Setah Forest...
Array.indonesia: I've been growing some <color=#F1DC2B>Herbs</color> that only grow in Setah Forest...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_004
Array.english: <size=32>If you need any, I can sell them to you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If you need any, I can sell them to you.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_005
Array.english: Herbs have all sorts of effects. Mixing them can make them even more potent.
Array.indonesia: Herbs have all sorts of effects. Mixing them can make them even more potent.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_006
Array.english: You can prepare them yourself using the <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color> in my room, so please feel free to use it.
Array.indonesia: You can prepare them yourself using the <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color> in my room, so please feel free to use it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_ShopRPG_007
Array.english: Oh, thanks!\nNow I can stock up before heading out!
Array.indonesia: Oh, thanks!\nNow I can stock up before heading out!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_002
Array.english: You folks... said you're here to investigate something,\nright?
Array.indonesia: You folks... said you're here to investigate something,\nright?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_003
Array.english: Yes. A giant dinosaur carcass washed up.
Array.indonesia: Yes. A giant dinosaur carcass washed up.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_004
Array.english: We think there's something strange going on at the bottom of the lake…so I'm investigating with Dr. Bacon and his assistant, Muna.
Array.indonesia: We think there's something strange going on at the bottom of the lake…so I'm investigating with Dr. Bacon and his assistant, Muna.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_005
Array.english: Oh... you mean the Basilomon carcass on the sandy beach.
Array.indonesia: Oh... you mean the Basilomon carcass on the sandy beach.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>...What?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...What?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_007
Array.english: Ah, I meant Basilosaurus. I mixed it up with a game I've been playing lately.
Array.indonesia: Ah, I meant Basilosaurus. I mixed it up with a game I've been playing lately.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_008
Array.english: The Basilosaurus is part of Marinca's <color=#F1DC2B>Ancient Creatures Pack</color>.
Array.indonesia: The Basilosaurus is part of Marinca's <color=#F1DC2B>Ancient Creatures Pack</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_009
Array.english: I wasn't sure if you could actually get the card...
Array.indonesia: I wasn't sure if you could actually get the card...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_01_010
Array.english: Looks like I came to the right place, haha.
Array.indonesia: Looks like I came to the right place, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_001
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>, using it well?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>, using it well?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_002
Array.english: Ah... I'm getting used to it.
Array.indonesia: Ah... I'm getting used to it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_003
Array.english: It's amazing how it automatically tracks my steps and swimming distance.
Array.indonesia: It's amazing how it automatically tracks my steps and swimming distance.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe! That's the power of technology!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe! That's the power of technology!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_005
Array.english: When you walk around, you keep getting notifications,\nso you can't help but check it.
Array.indonesia: When you walk around, you keep getting notifications,\nso you can't help but check it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_006
Array.english: With a regular Marinca, you tend to ignore it when you're not actively collecting.
Array.indonesia: With a regular Marinca, you tend to ignore it when you're not actively collecting.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_007
Array.english: I want to complete the collection quickly and make the flower bloom. So help me out.
Array.indonesia: I want to complete the collection quickly and make the flower bloom. So help me out.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_02_008
Array.english: ...Monmon.
Array.indonesia: ...Monmon.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_001
Array.english: But if collecting Marinca is your profession...\nhow do you make a living?
Array.indonesia: But if collecting Marinca is your profession...\nhow do you make a living?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ha, what a practical question!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha, what a practical question!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_003
Array.english: The World Marinca Association provides a small activity fund to registered Professional Marinca Collectors.
Array.indonesia: The World Marinca Association provides a small activity fund to registered Professional Marinca Collectors.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_004
Array.english: This allows us to gather information on unknown Marinca cards... and also helps promote Marinca.
Array.indonesia: This allows us to gather information on unknown Marinca cards... and also helps promote Marinca.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_005
Array.english: Currently, there are about 4,600 registered Professional Marinca Collectors worldwide...
Array.indonesia: Currently, there are about 4,600 registered Professional Marinca Collectors worldwide...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_006
Array.english: Among them, no one has completed the <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> yet.
Array.indonesia: Among them, no one has completed the <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> yet.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sato_03_007
Array.english: Finding this region was a blessing from the heavens...\nI will definitely be the first Super Marinca Completer.
Array.indonesia: Finding this region was a blessing from the heavens...\nI will definitely be the first Super Marinca Completer.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello. Looking for something?
Array.indonesia: Hello. Looking for something?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh my, you must be from far away. We haven't had many outsiders around here lately...
Array.indonesia: Oh my, you must be from far away. We haven't had many outsiders around here lately...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: <size=34>By the way, have you seen my husband, <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>By the way, have you seen my husband, <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? No...\nI don't think so.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh? No...\nI don't think so.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_005
Array.english:
He left all his laundry undone and went off somewhere.
Just wait till I get my hands on him!
Array.indonesia:
He left all his laundry undone and went off somewhere.
Just wait till I get my hands on him!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(She looks scary...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(She looks scary...)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: Well... anyway, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Chandra</color>.\nEnjoy your stay.
Array.indonesia: Well... anyway, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Chandra</color>.\nEnjoy your stay.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: If you see my husband doing anything strange,\nlet me know right away.
Array.indonesia: If you see my husband doing anything strange,\nlet me know right away.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello, I'm Dave. I came to this village for research.
Array.indonesia: Hello, I'm Dave. I came to this village for research.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh you're reading. Sorry to interrupt.
Array.indonesia: Oh you're reading. Sorry to interrupt.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Oh, it's fine. I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Kinah</color>.\nIt means "peace of mind."
Array.indonesia: Oh, it's fine. I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Kinah</color>.\nIt means "peace of mind."

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_001

Array.indonesia: Hello. I'm Dave. I came here to investigate.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_002

Array.indonesia: I saw in the stars recently that a large, round presence was approaching... I suppose that must be you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_003

Array.indonesia: Utara Village is a beautiful place, full of flowers and trees.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_004

Array.indonesia: It really does seem that way. \nI was expecting something more desolate.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: It is thanks to the spirit of <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>,\nwho has watched over us in peace all this time.
Array.indonesia: It is thanks to the spirit of <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>,\nwho has watched over us in peace all this time.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_FirstTalk_006

Array.indonesia: I cannot understand why such strange things have begun to occur so suddenly...

Array.indonesia: Perhaps my sight has dimmed, and I can no longer read the flow of the stars as I once did...

Array.indonesia: <size=32>It must be the spirit's will. All we can do is wait and see.</size>

Array.indonesia: Nice to meet you. I'm Dave, staying in this village for a while.

Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! I'm an adult now.</size>

Array.indonesia: Oh my, you must be from far away.\nI'm <color=#F1DC2B>Omila</color>.

Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well, it won't be easy, but please look into it for us.</size>

Array.indonesia: Hello. My name is Dave. I'll be staying in this village for a while.

Array.indonesia: No, it's alright. I was looking at the lake and remembered when <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> and my husband used to play there.

Array.indonesia: I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>, and I live in this village with my son.

Array.indonesia: We haven't had visitors in quite some time...\nIt's nice to see someone from outside again.

Array.indonesia: Though some people here might not be too happy about it.

Array.indonesia: I'll do my best not to cause any trouble.
