Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Harta's a fan of <color=#FF73C3>Gold Jewelry</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Harta's a fan of <color=#FF73C3>Gold Jewelry</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_001
Array.english: I don't get people who work hard all day...
Array.indonesia: I don't get people who work hard all day...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_002
Array.english: I mean, gambling's way faster...\nand it's more fun too.
Array.indonesia: I mean, gambling's way faster...\nand it's more fun too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_003
Array.english: But you could lose money too, couldn't you?
Array.indonesia: But you could lose money too, couldn't you?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, you think working guarantees money? Plenty of people go broke that way too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, you think working guarantees money? Plenty of people go broke that way too!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind01_005
Array.english:
If you're gonna lose it anyway, might as well have fun,
right? Don't you think?
Array.indonesia:
If you're gonna lose it anyway, might as well have fun,
right? Don't you think?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_001
Array.english: My son sometimes makes up stories that aren't even true...
Array.indonesia: My son sometimes makes up stories that aren't even true...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_002
Array.english: The villagers come to me about it...\nbut what am I supposed to do?
Array.indonesia: The villagers come to me about it...\nbut what am I supposed to do?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_003
Array.english: Maybe he just wants attention? He probably doesn't mean any harm.
Array.indonesia: Maybe he just wants attention? He probably doesn't mean any harm.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hmph! I was way more honest at his age!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmph! I was way more honest at his age!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind02_005
Array.english: He should learn from his dad... but he hangs out with those weird village kids, and that's why he's like this.
Array.indonesia: He should learn from his dad... but he hangs out with those weird village kids, and that's why he's like this.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind03_001
Array.english: <size=32>The coconut liquor from this village is seriously top-notch.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The coconut liquor from this village is seriously top-notch.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind03_002
Array.english:
That <color=#F1DC2B>Jepun</color>... he's got a difficult personality,
but he sure knows how to farm.
Array.indonesia:
That <color=#F1DC2B>Jepun</color>... he's got a difficult personality,
but he sure knows how to farm.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_NotKind03_003
Array.english: <size=33>That's what happens when all you care about is crops and land. No wonder the ladies aren't interested, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That's what happens when all you care about is crops and land. No wonder the ladies aren't interested, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Harta, is there a dish you like?
Array.indonesia: Harta, is there a dish you like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh... have you ever had <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> dishes?
Array.indonesia: Oh... have you ever had <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> dishes?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Of course. But I remember it having a pretty strong smell.
Array.indonesia: Of course. But I remember it having a pretty strong smell.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! You're talking about ocean stingrays!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! You're talking about ocean stingrays!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Freshwater Stingrays</color> barely have any smell.\nThey're light and really tasty.
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Freshwater Stingrays</color> barely have any smell.\nThey're light and really tasty.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: They used to be caught a lot before the lake got polluted... but I haven't seen them much lately.
Array.indonesia: They used to be caught a lot before the lake got polluted... but I haven't seen them much lately.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=33>Man... just talking about it makes me crave some <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> with a glass of coconut wine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Man... just talking about it makes me crave some <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> with a glass of coconut wine!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Harta_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Harta likes <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> dishes.\nI should write that down.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Harta likes <color=#FF73C3>Stingray</color> dishes.\nI should write that down.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: Ugh... I just said I was going for a short walk...\nI'll get in trouble if I'm late...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... I just said I was going for a short walk...\nI'll get in trouble if I'm late...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Hello. My name is Dave.
Array.indonesia: Hello. My name is Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: Oh, the outsider? I heard you came to investigate that dinosaur carcass over there.
Array.indonesia: Oh, the outsider? I heard you came to investigate that dinosaur carcass over there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: Nice to meet you. Is there... in this village...
Array.indonesia: Nice to meet you. Is there... in this village...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, sorry... I really need to finish carving this animal sculpture right now... can we talk later?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, sorry... I really need to finish carving this animal sculpture right now... can we talk later?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: ...Okay, got it.
Array.indonesia: ...Okay, got it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_001
Array.english: Isn't there some way to just kick back and live easy my whole life without working...?
Array.indonesia: Isn't there some way to just kick back and live easy my whole life without working...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_002
Array.english: Hmm... what about trying your hand at investing, like in stocks?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... what about trying your hand at investing, like in stocks?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_003
Array.english: Stocks...? \nAh, you mean buying and selling pieces of a company?
Array.indonesia: Stocks...? \nAh, you mean buying and selling pieces of a company?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_004
Array.english: Yes. There are even folks who make a living off investment returns instead of working.
Array.indonesia: Yes. There are even folks who make a living off investment returns instead of working.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_005
Array.english: But... if you invest wrong, don't you end up losing money instead?
Array.indonesia: But... if you invest wrong, don't you end up losing money instead?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_006
Array.english: <size=32>Well... that's true. \nBuy carelessly and you could lose it all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well... that's true. \nBuy carelessly and you could lose it all.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind01_007
Array.english: Ugh... if I lose money on stocks, I'm already scared of what my wife would say...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... if I lose money on stocks, I'm already scared of what my wife would say...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_001
Array.english: Just thinkin' about that weird place I ended up in still gives me the creeps.
Array.indonesia: Just thinkin' about that weird place I ended up in still gives me the creeps.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_002
Array.english: Next thing I knew, I was suddenly in that woman Mita's room!
Array.indonesia: Next thing I knew, I was suddenly in that woman Mita's room!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_003
Array.english: It seems Mita is an NPC that exists in several different versions.
Array.indonesia: It seems Mita is an NPC that exists in several different versions.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_004
Array.english: Why don't we ask the Mita who's here in the village right now?
Array.indonesia: Why don't we ask the Mita who's here in the village right now?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hii...! Just gettin' near her is terrifying!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hii...! Just gettin' near her is terrifying!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_Kind02_006
Array.english: ...And if Chandra saw me, she'd grill me for sure, y'know.
Array.indonesia: ...And if Chandra saw me, she'd grill me for sure, y'know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: This village is great, but there's not much to do for fun.
Array.indonesia: This village is great, but there's not much to do for fun.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: If I gamble with Harta, my wife gives me the stink eye...
Array.indonesia: If I gamble with Harta, my wife gives me the stink eye...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: What kind of things do you like?
Array.indonesia: What kind of things do you like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Hehe... well, you know... things like <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Game Consoles</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... well, you know... things like <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Game Consoles</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: I could get them if I wanted to, but she'd nag me endlessly, saying that stuff's for kids.
Array.indonesia: I could get them if I wanted to, but she'd nag me endlessly, saying that stuff's for kids.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=33>I mean, that's way better than actually losing money gambling, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I mean, that's way better than actually losing money gambling, right?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: I guess I'll have to get them in secret... and enjoy them on the sly.
Array.indonesia: I guess I'll have to get them in secret... and enjoy them on the sly.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Gesang likes things like <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Game Consoles</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Gesang likes things like <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> and <color=#FF73C3>Game Consoles</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_001
Array.english: You look a bit tired, Gesang. You okay?
Array.indonesia: You look a bit tired, Gesang. You okay?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_002
Array.english: Huh...? Do I?
Array.indonesia: Huh...? Do I?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_003
Array.english: This is bad... I snuck out last night and did a little gambling with Harta.
Array.indonesia: This is bad... I snuck out last night and did a little gambling with Harta.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_004
Array.english: Can't let that show...
Array.indonesia: Can't let that show...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_005
Array.english: Sounds like Chandra's a heavy sleeper.
Array.indonesia: Sounds like Chandra's a heavy sleeper.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_006
Array.english: Hehe! That's the best thing about my wife!
Array.indonesia: Hehe! That's the best thing about my wife!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_007
Array.english: Once she's out, nothing wakes her.
Array.indonesia: Once she's out, nothing wakes her.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_008
Array.english: Still, don't rely on that too much...\nShe might just be pretending to sleep.
Array.indonesia: Still, don't rely on that too much...\nShe might just be pretending to sleep.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind01_009
Array.english: Yikes... don't say stuff like that.
Array.indonesia: Yikes... don't say stuff like that.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_001
Array.english: I hear there are places in the city where folks gamble 24 hours a day?
Array.indonesia: I hear there are places in the city where folks gamble 24 hours a day?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Yes. They're called casinos... You buy chips with money and can play all sorts of games there.
Array.indonesia: Yes. They're called casinos... You buy chips with money and can play all sorts of games there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Ohh... that sounds like a whole lotta fun, doesn't it...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ohh... that sounds like a whole lotta fun, doesn't it...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_004
Array.english: I went once... but I lost all my money in no time and walked right out.
Array.indonesia: I went once... but I lost all my money in no time and walked right out.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_005
Array.english: Heh heh, that's just 'cause you've got no skill, pal! It'd be a different story if I went!
Array.indonesia: Heh heh, that's just 'cause you've got no skill, pal! It'd be a different story if I went!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_NotKind02_006
Array.english: <size=32>I don't think Chandra would let you go, though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I don't think Chandra would let you go, though...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Ah... now that I think about it, I heard you can go all the way down to the sea beneath the lake?
Array.indonesia: Ah... now that I think about it, I heard you can go all the way down to the sea beneath the lake?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Yes. Thanks to my new suit, I can go even deeper now.
Array.indonesia: Yes. Thanks to my new suit, I can go even deeper now.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! So, are there any squid down there?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh...! So, are there any squid down there?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Hmm... it's mostly ancient creatures... so not exactly squid, but I think there was something similar.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... it's mostly ancient creatures... so not exactly squid, but I think there was something similar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: I'm pretty sure it was called... <color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color>.
Array.indonesia: I'm pretty sure it was called... <color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: ...What a weird name.\nAnyway, I really love grilled squid.
Array.indonesia: ...What a weird name.\nAnyway, I really love grilled squid.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: But there are no squid in this lake...
Array.indonesia: But there are no squid in this lake...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: That Ortho...
Array.indonesia: That Ortho...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color>, you mean.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color>, you mean.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_010
Array.english: Yeah, that. If you catch one of those ancient squids,\nI'd love to grill it up nice and eat it, hehe!
Array.indonesia: Yeah, that. If you catch one of those ancient squids,\nI'd love to grill it up nice and eat it, hehe!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Gesang_InfoTalk02_011
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(If I catch an <color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color> in the deep sea, I should treat \nGesang to some.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(If I catch an <color=#FF73C3>Orthoceras</color> in the deep sea, I should treat \nGesang to some.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_001
Array.english: My husband and I? We were childhood friends,\nwe grew up together.
Array.indonesia: My husband and I? We were childhood friends,\nwe grew up together.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Then one day, out of nowhere, he confessed he'd liked me all along... hehehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Then one day, out of nowhere, he confessed he'd liked me all along... hehehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_003
Array.english: He's been lazy and frustrating since we were kids,\nso I never really saw him as a man...
Array.indonesia: He's been lazy and frustrating since we were kids,\nso I never really saw him as a man...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_004
Array.english: Well, what can you do. One thing led to another,\nand we ended up getting married.
Array.indonesia: Well, what can you do. One thing led to another,\nand we ended up getting married.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_005
Array.english: Still, as long as you've stayed together and been happy all this time, that's what matters.
Array.indonesia: Still, as long as you've stayed together and been happy all this time, that's what matters.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_006
Array.english: <size=34>A Divorce would be a huge scandal in our village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>A Divorce would be a huge scandal in our village!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_Kind01_007
Array.english: Even if he's a good-for-nothing husband, I still have to take care of him. Who else would? *Sigh.*
Array.indonesia: Even if he's a good-for-nothing husband, I still have to take care of him. Who else would? *Sigh.*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: That's a really nice bracelet.
Array.indonesia: That's a really nice bracelet.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ohohoho!! You've got a good eye!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ohohoho!! You've got a good eye!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's a <color=#FF73C3>Pearl</color> accessory my husband made for me himself.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's a <color=#FF73C3>Pearl</color> accessory my husband made for me himself.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=32>My husband's not just handsome, he's great with his hands too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>My husband's not just handsome, he's great with his hands too!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: The <color=#FF73C3>Pearls</color> from this lake have such a radiant glow,\nI just love them.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#FF73C3>Pearls</color> from this lake have such a radiant glow,\nI just love them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Chandra really loves <color=#FF73C3>Pearls</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Chandra really loves <color=#FF73C3>Pearls</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_001
Array.english: There's this man in the village named <color=#F1DC2B>Harta</color>...
Array.indonesia: There's this man in the village named <color=#F1DC2B>Harta</color>...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_002
Array.english: He never works, just drinks and gambles all day.
Array.indonesia: He never works, just drinks and gambles all day.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_003
Array.english: I'm worried because my husband seems to be getting close to him...
Array.indonesia: I'm worried because my husband seems to be getting close to him...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_004
Array.english: If you see the two of them up to something,\nyou absolutely have to tell me.
Array.indonesia: If you see the two of them up to something,\nyou absolutely have to tell me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_005
Array.english: Well... he's an adult, so isn't a little bit okay?
Array.indonesia: Well... he's an adult, so isn't a little bit okay?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_006
Array.english: <size=33>That's how it starts and before you know it, they've ruined their lives!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That's how it starts and before you know it, they've ruined their lives!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind01_007
Array.english: ...Alright, I get it.
Array.indonesia: ...Alright, I get it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_001
Array.english: Ugh... that coconut liquor.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... that coconut liquor.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Huh? Isn't that the village's traditional drink?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Isn't that the village's traditional drink?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_003
Array.english: It is, but...\ndon't you know how dangerous alcohol can be?
Array.indonesia: It is, but...\ndon't you know how dangerous alcohol can be?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_004
Array.english: When you drink, your judgment gets clouded...\nand you start getting swayed by women...
Array.indonesia: When you drink, your judgment gets clouded...\nand you start getting swayed by women...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Just the other day, he came home after drinking and suddenly...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Just the other day, he came home after drinking and suddenly...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_006
Array.english: <size=35>Oh my!! What am I saying!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh my!! What am I saying!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind02_007
Array.english: Anyway, I think he's been secretly drinking it at night. I should get rid of the bottles... tsk.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, I think he's been secretly drinking it at night. I should get rid of the bottles... tsk.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_001
Array.english: You seem like a pretty decent person, though...
Array.indonesia: You seem like a pretty decent person, though...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_002
Array.english: <size=33>You don't do things like gambling, do you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You don't do things like gambling, do you?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_003
Array.english: Oh... well... Things like Shark Tooth Challenges or Seahorse Races are fine, right?
Array.indonesia: Oh... well... Things like Shark Tooth Challenges or Seahorse Races are fine, right?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_004
Array.english: I don't know what those are, but... just don't go wasting your money on things like that!
Array.indonesia: I don't know what those are, but... just don't go wasting your money on things like that!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_005
Array.english: But isn't it fine if you keep it recreational?
Array.indonesia: But isn't it fine if you keep it recreational?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_006
Array.english: <size=32>Recreational?!\nOnce people start, they don't know when to stop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Recreational?!\nOnce people start, they don't know when to stop!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_007
Array.english: <size=33>And don't go putting ideas like that in my husband's head... seriously!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>And don't go putting ideas like that in my husband's head... seriously!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_NotKind03_008
Array.english: Okay... I get it.
Array.indonesia: Okay... I get it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Chandra, what kind of food do you like?
Array.indonesia: Chandra, what kind of food do you like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh my... can't you tell by looking at my skin?
Array.indonesia: Oh my... can't you tell by looking at my skin?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=31>Um... crocodile meat...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Um... crocodile meat...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Hah... you outsiders...\nyou really have no sense at all...
Array.indonesia: Hah... you outsiders...\nyou really have no sense at all...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <color=#FF73C3>Water Spinach</color>, of course! <color=#FF73C3>Water Spinach</color> is great for your skin!
Array.indonesia: <color=#FF73C3>Water Spinach</color>, of course! <color=#FF73C3>Water Spinach</color> is great for your skin!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: The stems are hollow, so they soak up flavor really well... and they're great for your skin, it's the best vegetable, hehe!
Array.indonesia: The stems are hollow, so they soak up flavor really well... and they're great for your skin, it's the best vegetable, hehe!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: It only grows near the water in <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>... so it's been hard to get lately, and I think my skin's getting worse because of it.
Array.indonesia: It only grows near the water in <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>... so it's been hard to get lately, and I think my skin's getting worse because of it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chandra_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Getting some <color=#FF73C3>Water Spinach</color> for Bancho would be easy. She'd probably love it if I brought her some next time.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Getting some <color=#FF73C3>Water Spinach</color> for Bancho would be easy. She'd probably love it if I brought her some next time.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_001
Array.english: You're always writing something, aren't you, Kinah?
Array.indonesia: You're always writing something, aren't you, Kinah?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... you noticed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... you noticed.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_003
Array.english: It's nothing special... I just write down little thoughts as they come to me.
Array.indonesia: It's nothing special... I just write down little thoughts as they come to me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_004
Array.english: If I write down how I feel in the moment like this...\nI can revisit those feelings later.
Array.indonesia: If I write down how I feel in the moment like this...\nI can revisit those feelings later.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_005
Array.english: There's so much in this village that can inspire you.
Array.indonesia: There's so much in this village that can inspire you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_006
Array.english: Like bananas... or tilapia...
Array.indonesia: Like bananas... or tilapia...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Kind01_007
Array.english: Mm... yes. Even food can be... a source of inspiration...
Array.indonesia: Mm... yes. Even food can be... a source of inspiration...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: It's a bit hard to get <color=#FF73C3>Novels</color> here in the village.
Array.indonesia: It's a bit hard to get <color=#FF73C3>Novels</color> here in the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Hmm. I'd imagine so...\nYou said reading's your hobby?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I'd imagine so...\nYou said reading's your hobby?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Yes. I really love this village, but...
Array.indonesia: Yes. I really love this village, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: There's nothing better than <color=#FF73C3>Novels</color> for experiencing other worlds.
Array.indonesia: There's nothing better than <color=#FF73C3>Novels</color> for experiencing other worlds.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: I don't really read anything besides comics...\nAren't comics more fun?
Array.indonesia: I don't really read anything besides comics...\nAren't comics more fun?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: But text-only stimulates the imagination more.\nWith pictures, there's... less room to imagine.
Array.indonesia: But text-only stimulates the imagination more.\nWith pictures, there's... less room to imagine.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: Come to think of it, you're always writing something.\nDo you write novels yourself?
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, you're always writing something.\nDo you write novels yourself?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, no! I'm not skilled enough to write novels... I just jot down my feelings in a <color=#FF73C3>Notebook</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, no! I'm not skilled enough to write novels... I just jot down my feelings in a <color=#FF73C3>Notebook</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk01_009
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I bet Kinah would love it if I gave her some <color=#FF73C3>Novels</color> or <color=#FF73C3>Writing Supplies</color> as gifts. I should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(I bet Kinah would love it if I gave her some <color=#FF73C3>Novels</color> or <color=#FF73C3>Writing Supplies</color> as gifts. I should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind01_001
Array.english: When inspiration strikes while I'm walking through the village, I write it down in my notebook.
Array.indonesia: When inspiration strikes while I'm walking through the village, I write it down in my notebook.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind01_002
Array.english: A hibiscus blooming crimson, bathed in red sunlight...\nIt's like...
Array.indonesia: A hibiscus blooming crimson, bathed in red sunlight...\nIt's like...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind01_003
Array.english: ...a bearded ma...
Array.indonesia: ...a bearded ma...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind01_004
Array.english: <size=32>...Sorry, but I'm having trouble concentrating... Could you give me some space...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Sorry, but I'm having trouble concentrating... Could you give me some space...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind02_001
Array.english: I used to gaze at the lake and come up with poetic ideas...
Array.indonesia: I used to gaze at the lake and come up with poetic ideas...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind02_002
Array.english: But lately, it's gotten so murky, which is a shame.
Array.indonesia: But lately, it's gotten so murky, which is a shame.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind02_003
Array.english: There are really amazing things in the water.\nTurning them into poetry sounds fun.
Array.indonesia: There are really amazing things in the water.\nTurning them into poetry sounds fun.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind02_004
Array.english: If you find anything interesting, let me know.
Array.indonesia: If you find anything interesting, let me know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind03_001
Array.english: A figure fallen cold, crossing through the rift in time\nEven its sharp teeth are slowly growing dull
Array.indonesia: A figure fallen cold, crossing through the rift in time\nEven its sharp teeth are slowly growing dull

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind03_002
Array.english: Oh, Dave. I was just trying to write a poem about the dinosaur on Lake Beach.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. I was just trying to write a poem about the dinosaur on Lake Beach.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind03_003
Array.english: If I'd seen it alive, I'd have been scared, but...\nnow it just looks a bit pitiful.
Array.indonesia: If I'd seen it alive, I'd have been scared, but...\nnow it just looks a bit pitiful.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_NotKind03_004
Array.english: True, it probably didn't want to come here either.
Array.indonesia: True, it probably didn't want to come here either.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Is there any particular fish from this region you especially like?
Array.indonesia: Is there any particular fish from this region you especially like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Ah... actually, there's a fish I absolutely love...\nand it has a rather romantic name.
Array.indonesia: Ah... actually, there's a fish I absolutely love...\nand it has a rather romantic name.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: It's called <color=#FF73C3>Moonlight Gourami</color>... True to its name, \nits body shines with a silver moonlight.
Array.indonesia: It's called <color=#FF73C3>Moonlight Gourami</color>... True to its name, \nits body shines with a silver moonlight.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: It's a small fish, but its flavor spreads gently and subtly in your mouth, like moonlight.
Array.indonesia: It's a small fish, but its flavor spreads gently and subtly in your mouth, like moonlight.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: Basu caught one <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing</color> before...\nI can't forget the taste.
Array.indonesia: Basu caught one <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing</color> before...\nI can't forget the taste.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So she loves the <color=#FF73C3>Moonlight Gourami</color>, which you can catch by fishing. I should catch one and serve it to her.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(So she loves the <color=#FF73C3>Moonlight Gourami</color>, which you can catch by fishing. I should catch one and serve it to her.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_001
Array.english: The sky feels especially clear here.
Array.indonesia: The sky feels especially clear here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_002
Array.english: Hehe, if you watch the flow of the sky, you can glimpse the future.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, if you watch the flow of the sky, you can glimpse the future.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_003
Array.english: What we humans can do is very small.
Array.indonesia: What we humans can do is very small.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_004
Array.english: We simply follow the greater flow... and prepare what we can.
Array.indonesia: We simply follow the greater flow... and prepare what we can.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind01_005
Array.english: Just like bees sensing the bloom of flowers and preparing for spring.
Array.indonesia: Just like bees sensing the bloom of flowers and preparing for spring.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_001
Array.english: So many strange things have been happening lately...
Array.indonesia: So many strange things have been happening lately...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_002
Array.english: I've been watching the movement of the stars closely.
Array.indonesia: I've been watching the movement of the stars closely.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_003
Array.english: Based on their current positions... it does read as a <color=#1DFEAF>Crisis</color>, but...
Array.indonesia: Based on their current positions... it does read as a <color=#1DFEAF>Crisis</color>, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_004
Array.english: a great comet, one that can be seen as <color=#1DFEAF>Hope</color>,\npassed by not long ago.
Array.indonesia: a great comet, one that can be seen as <color=#1DFEAF>Hope</color>,\npassed by not long ago.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Kind02_005
Array.english: Perhaps... that comet was a sign of you all, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Perhaps... that comet was a sign of you all, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Ms. Meilan, is there a flower you especially like?
Array.indonesia: Ms. Meilan, is there a flower you especially like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Hoho, every flower in the village is beautiful.
Array.indonesia: Hoho, every flower in the village is beautiful.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Watching them bloom with life each day brings me great joy.
Array.indonesia: Watching them bloom with life each day brings me great joy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: But the <color=#FF73C3>Hibiscus</color> that blooms near Surga Falls...\nI rarely get to see it, which is a shame.
Array.indonesia: But the <color=#FF73C3>Hibiscus</color> that blooms near Surga Falls...\nI rarely get to see it, which is a shame.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: That flower has no scent, so unless you see it yourself, you cannot truly feel its presence.
Array.indonesia: That flower has no scent, so unless you see it yourself, you cannot truly feel its presence.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: These old bones make the journey to <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> quite far... So I can only admire it from afar.
Array.indonesia: These old bones make the journey to <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> quite far... So I can only admire it from afar.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Ms. Meilan wishes to see the <color=#FF73C3>Hibiscus</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Ms. Meilan wishes to see the <color=#FF73C3>Hibiscus</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_001
Array.english: Grandma, you really love flowers, don't you?
Array.indonesia: Grandma, you really love flowers, don't you?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_002
Array.english: Flowers are a gift from nature. They share their fragrance and nectar for a brief time, then return to the earth.
Array.indonesia: Flowers are a gift from nature. They share their fragrance and nectar for a brief time, then return to the earth.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_003
Array.english: And in time, they wait to bloom once more.
Array.indonesia: And in time, they wait to bloom once more.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_004
Array.english: Now that you mention it, that's true. I just thought they were pretty plants.
Array.indonesia: Now that you mention it, that's true. I just thought they were pretty plants.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind01_005
Array.english: Hehe, our lives may seem long, but they are not.\nWe should always live with a giving heart.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, our lives may seem long, but they are not.\nWe should always live with a giving heart.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_001
Array.english: I heard the person with you is a chef...?
Array.indonesia: I heard the person with you is a chef...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Yes. Bancho is a chef who explores flavors from all kinds of ingredients across the world.
Array.indonesia: Yes. Bancho is a chef who explores flavors from all kinds of ingredients across the world.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_003
Array.english: He is probably studying the ingredients of this jungle right now too!
Array.indonesia: He is probably studying the ingredients of this jungle right now too!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_004
Array.english: Hehe, every gift of nature has its own unique flavor.\nExploring them is a meaningful pursuit.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, every gift of nature has its own unique flavor.\nExploring them is a meaningful pursuit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind02_005
Array.english: But do not forget that we are part of it as well,\nand always be grateful.
Array.indonesia: But do not forget that we are part of it as well,\nand always be grateful.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind03_001
Array.english: Did you say you read fortunes?
Array.indonesia: Did you say you read fortunes?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind03_002
Array.english: It is a small skill my mother taught me. If you follow the flow of nature, you can sense the direction.
Array.indonesia: It is a small skill my mother taught me. If you follow the flow of nature, you can sense the direction.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind03_003
Array.english: Of course, it is not always accurate.
Array.indonesia: Of course, it is not always accurate.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_NotKind03_004
Array.english: Perhaps it is because I have grown old...\nbut it seems even less so these days.
Array.indonesia: Perhaps it is because I have grown old...\nbut it seems even less so these days.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: That would be <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color>, hehe.
Array.indonesia: That would be <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color>, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh... I love <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color> too! It is a fruit, but it melts in your mouth like jelly. Truly delightful.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I love <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color> too! It is a fruit, but it melts in your mouth like jelly. Truly delightful.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Hehehe, I see.\nSo it is well known among outsiders as well.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe, I see.\nSo it is well known among outsiders as well.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: But... sadly, <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color> only grows near the waterfall at Lake Beach.
Array.indonesia: But... sadly, <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color> only grows near the waterfall at Lake Beach.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: It is a bit too far for me to travel...\nso I rarely get to enjoy it.
Array.indonesia: It is a bit too far for me to travel...\nso I rarely get to enjoy it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(If I manage to get some <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color>, I should prepare something for her.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(If I manage to get some <color=#FF73C3>Mangosteen</color>, I should prepare something for her.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_001
Array.english: Oh... I was just about to get a great musical idea.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I was just about to get a great musical idea.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_002
Array.english: Really? What kind of song were you working on?
Array.indonesia: Really? What kind of song were you working on?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_003
Array.english: I was imagining eight black bears dancing in a trance inside a dark cave.
Array.indonesia: I was imagining eight black bears dancing in a trance inside a dark cave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Uh... right. That's... quite something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Uh... right. That's... quite something.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind01_005
Array.english: It's the kind of song people in the city could never come up with. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: It's the kind of song people in the city could never come up with. Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_001
Array.english: No... this song's too predictable...
Array.indonesia: No... this song's too predictable...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_002
Array.english: I need something fresh, Dave.
Array.indonesia: I need something fresh, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_003
Array.english: Hey... could you get bitten by a crocodile and tell me what it feels like?
Array.indonesia: Hey... could you get bitten by a crocodile and tell me what it feels like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_004
Array.english: <size=33>What kind of request is that...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What kind of request is that...?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind02_005
Array.english: If I get bitten myself, I won't be able to finish the song...
Array.indonesia: If I get bitten myself, I won't be able to finish the song...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind03_001
Array.english: I heard there are a lot of talented musicians in the city.
Array.indonesia: I heard there are a lot of talented musicians in the city.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind03_002
Array.english: Yeah. But honestly, someone at your level would do just fine there.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. But honestly, someone at your level would do just fine there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind03_003
Array.english: Hmm. I'd love to play with them someday.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I'd love to play with them someday.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Kind03_004
Array.english: I'd definitely come watch.
Array.indonesia: I'd definitely come watch.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=32>The only thing I care about is music.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The only thing I care about is music.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: These beautiful Panting melodies...
Array.indonesia: These beautiful Panting melodies...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: And <color=#FF73C3>Earphones</color> that shut out the world...
Array.indonesia: And <color=#FF73C3>Earphones</color> that shut out the world...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Come to think of it, I heard there are ones that block out all ambient noise these days...
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, I heard there are ones that block out all ambient noise these days...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: With something like that, I could really focus on my music.
Array.indonesia: With something like that, I could really focus on my music.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Sometimes the birds and monkeys totally break my concentration...
Array.indonesia: Sometimes the birds and monkeys totally break my concentration...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Is he talking about <color=#FF73C3>Noise-Canceling Earphones</color>...?\nThat might make a good gift for Jaka.)</color>

Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm. I bet Bancho could cook <color=#FF73C3>Largemouth Bass</color> without that muddy taste. I should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind02_001
Array.english: Oh, I heard the person who came with you is opening a restaurant here.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I heard the person who came with you is opening a restaurant here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind02_002
Array.english: My kids do like fish dishes, but...
Array.indonesia: My kids do like fish dishes, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_NotKind02_003
Array.english: <size=33>For now, I'd still like to be the one cooking for them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>For now, I'd still like to be the one cooking for them.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Does the Chef only cook fish dishes?
Array.indonesia: Does the Chef only cook fish dishes?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Not at all. He's great with fruit and vegetable dishes too.
Array.indonesia: Not at all. He's great with fruit and vegetable dishes too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Oh... I see. Actually, I really love dishes made with <color=#FF73C3>Bananas</color>...
Array.indonesia: Oh... I see. Actually, I really love dishes made with <color=#FF73C3>Bananas</color>...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: But the kids love them so much, I always end up giving them away as snacks.
Array.indonesia: But the kids love them so much, I always end up giving them away as snacks.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: <size=33>I hope it makes it onto the menu, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I hope it makes it onto the menu, hehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Omila likes dishes made with <color=#FF73C3>Bananas</color>.\nI should write that down.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(So Omila likes dishes made with <color=#FF73C3>Bananas</color>.\nI should write that down.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind01_001
Array.english: If the kids wander off somewhere strange, please let me know.
Array.indonesia: If the kids wander off somewhere strange, please let me know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind01_002
Array.english: Especially my second, Saniah... she keeps showing interest in the forest...
Array.indonesia: Especially my second, Saniah... she keeps showing interest in the forest...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind02_001
Array.english: The food the chef makes is really delicious.
Array.indonesia: The food the chef makes is really delicious.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind02_002
Array.english: Right? Bancho's the best chef!
Array.indonesia: Right? Bancho's the best chef!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind02_003
Array.english: It's the same grilled fish, but it tastes completely different from when I make it.
Array.indonesia: It's the same grilled fish, but it tastes completely different from when I make it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Kind02_004
Array.english: I should ask him his secret when I get the chance
Array.indonesia: I should ask him his secret when I get the chance

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Raising children is mostly a joy, but...
Array.indonesia: Raising children is mostly a joy, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: sometimes they make me angry too.
Array.indonesia: sometimes they make me angry too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=34>Especially when they break my <color=#FF73C3>Dishes</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Especially when they break my <color=#FF73C3>Dishes</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: Just the other day, Eka was fooling around and broke one of my favorite <color=#FF73C3>Dishes</color>... I really scolded him.
Array.indonesia: Just the other day, Eka was fooling around and broke one of my favorite <color=#FF73C3>Dishes</color>... I really scolded him.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: I've always loved collecting pretty <color=#FF73C3>Dishes</color>,\nso I guess I got a bit sensitive about it.
Array.indonesia: I've always loved collecting pretty <color=#FF73C3>Dishes</color>,\nso I guess I got a bit sensitive about it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should get her a nice <color=#FF73C3>Dish</color> as a gift?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Maybe I should get her a nice <color=#FF73C3>Dish</color> as a gift?)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_001
Array.english: Seeing the kids run around always brings me joy.
Array.indonesia: Seeing the kids run around always brings me joy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_002
Array.english: Saniah and Eka...\nThey're both such sweet, pure kids.
Array.indonesia: Saniah and Eka...\nThey're both such sweet, pure kids.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_003
Array.english: And Bima too, of course.
Array.indonesia: And Bima too, of course.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_004
Array.english: Harta...\nI just wish he'd take better care of Bima...
Array.indonesia: Harta...\nI just wish he'd take better care of Bima...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_005
Array.english: But it's not really my place to step into another family's business.
Array.indonesia: But it's not really my place to step into another family's business.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Kind01_006
Array.english: I'd appreciate it if you could keep an eye on him too, Dave.
Array.indonesia: I'd appreciate it if you could keep an eye on him too, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: You really seem to enjoy playing with the kids, Perak.
Array.indonesia: You really seem to enjoy playing with the kids, Perak.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: Haha, I do. Even after a long day, playing with them helps me forget all about it.
Array.indonesia: Haha, I do. Even after a long day, playing with them helps me forget all about it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Saniah's easy to play with, she just needs dolls or toys...
Array.indonesia: Saniah's easy to play with, she just needs dolls or toys...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=33>But Eka's a handful since he's into games and comics.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But Eka's a handful since he's into games and comics.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Games and comics aren't necessarily a bad thing, are they?
Array.indonesia: Games and comics aren't necessarily a bad thing, are they?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: Haha, you're right. Still, exercise is better for their health.
Array.indonesia: Haha, you're right. Still, exercise is better for their health.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: I used to play <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> with him...\nbut it broke.
Array.indonesia: I used to play <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> with him...\nbut it broke.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: And it's not easy to get a new <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> in this village.
Array.indonesia: And it's not easy to get a new <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> in this village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk01_009
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He'd be so happy if I gave him a new <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> to play with Eka.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(He'd be so happy if I gave him a new <color=#FF73C3>Ball</color> to play with Eka.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_001
Array.english: It's been harder to get ore since the boulder blocked the path to the forest.
Array.indonesia: It's been harder to get ore since the boulder blocked the path to the forest.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_002
Array.english: If you bring me some, I'll smelt it into ingots for you.
Array.indonesia: If you bring me some, I'll smelt it into ingots for you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_003
Array.english: <size=32>The young woman with glasses asks me several times a day if I have any ingots...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The young woman with glasses asks me several times a day if I have any ingots...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... Muna can be pretty persistent when she sets her mind to something...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... Muna can be pretty persistent when she sets her mind to something...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_NotKind01_005
Array.english: She probably needs them to upgrade the Jungle Gun.\nI'll find some and bring them to you.
Array.indonesia: She probably needs them to upgrade the Jungle Gun.\nI'll find some and bring them to you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: Perak, what kind of food do you like most?
Array.indonesia: Perak, what kind of food do you like most?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Ah... well, it's just...
Array.indonesia: Ah... well, it's just...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: Hm? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hm? What is it?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: It's just... it's not very common...
Array.indonesia: It's just... it's not very common...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=33>I actually really like <color=#FF73C3>Snake Meat</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I actually really like <color=#FF73C3>Snake Meat</color>.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_006
Array.english: Oh... is <color=#FF73C3>Snake Meat</color> any good?
Array.indonesia: Oh... is <color=#FF73C3>Snake Meat</color> any good?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english:
Well... it depends on the person... but to me,
it tastes like chicken, just chewier and even better.
Array.indonesia:
Well... it depends on the person... but to me,
it tastes like chicken, just chewier and even better.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_008
Array.english: <size=33>And most importantly...\nit keeps you from getting tired at night!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>And most importantly...\nit keeps you from getting tired at night!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_009
Array.english: I'm pretty sure I ate snake meat the day Saniah was conceived too...
Array.indonesia: I'm pretty sure I ate snake meat the day Saniah was conceived too...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_010
Array.english: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.
Array.indonesia: ...I have no idea what you're talking about.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_InfoTalk02_011
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Perak enjoys dishes made with <color=#FF73C3>Snake Meat</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like Perak enjoys dishes made with <color=#FF73C3>Snake Meat</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_001
Array.english: Kids grow up so fast and drift away from their parents... That's just how it is.
Array.indonesia: Kids grow up so fast and drift away from their parents... That's just how it is.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_002
Array.english: I know that, but it still makes me a little sad sometimes.
Array.indonesia: I know that, but it still makes me a little sad sometimes.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_003
Array.english: Come to think of it, I was probably like that at his age too.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, I was probably like that at his age too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_004
Array.english: I even dyed my hair and got my ears pierced,\ntrying to rebel.
Array.indonesia: I even dyed my hair and got my ears pierced,\ntrying to rebel.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_005
Array.english: Oh, really?\nNow I'm curious.
Array.indonesia: Oh, really?\nNow I'm curious.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_006
Array.english: I actually have a photo...
Array.indonesia: I actually have a photo...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Kind01_007
Array.english: Ah... um...\nYou look much better now...
Array.indonesia: Ah... um...\nYou look much better now...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: When my husband was still around... my favorite time was when our whole family would play music together.
Array.indonesia: When my husband was still around... my favorite time was when our whole family would play music together.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_002
Array.english: My husband was really good at the drums...\nand I used to play the <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color>.
Array.indonesia: My husband was really good at the drums...\nand I used to play the <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_003
Array.english: Oh... so you used to play music too, Cinta?
Array.indonesia: Oh... so you used to play music too, Cinta?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: Hehe... I learned from an explorer who stayed in this village when I was young.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... I learned from an explorer who stayed in this village when I was young.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: He gave me a flute before he left... so when Jaka was little, our family would often gather and play together.
Array.indonesia: He gave me a flute before he left... so when Jaka was little, our family would often gather and play together.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_006
Array.english: I'm sure the reason Jaka wants to pursue music now is because of those memories.
Array.indonesia: I'm sure the reason Jaka wants to pursue music now is because of those memories.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_007
Array.english: After my husband's accident... I let go of everything tied to those memories by setting them afloat on the lake...
Array.indonesia: After my husband's accident... I let go of everything tied to those memories by setting them afloat on the lake...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_008
Array.english: Sometimes, though, I feel like playing the <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color> again,\nhehe.
Array.indonesia: Sometimes, though, I feel like playing the <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color> again,\nhehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk01_009
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Cinta misses the days she played the <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Cinta misses the days she played the <color=#FF73C3>Flute</color>.\nI should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind01_001
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> became very withdrawn after his father disappeared.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> became very withdrawn after his father disappeared.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind01_002
Array.english: But it would've been even harder for him without his instrument.
Array.indonesia: But it would've been even harder for him without his instrument.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind01_003
Array.english: Though he's so absorbed in practice, he hardly talks to me anymore.
Array.indonesia: Though he's so absorbed in practice, he hardly talks to me anymore.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_001
Array.english: There's so much to learn in the city, isn't there?
Array.indonesia: There's so much to learn in the city, isn't there?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_002
Array.english: Yes. There are many schools and people who can teach you.
Array.indonesia: Yes. There are many schools and people who can teach you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_003
Array.english: I see. I wish <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> could have studied in the city...
Array.indonesia: I see. I wish <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> could have studied in the city...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_004
Array.english: But I wasn't able to provide that for him.
Array.indonesia: But I wasn't able to provide that for him.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_005
Array.english: My husband did his best too, but...
Array.indonesia: My husband did his best too, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_006
Array.english: Oh, please don't cry. There are a lot of bad people in the city.
Array.indonesia: Oh, please don't cry. There are a lot of bad people in the city.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind02_007
Array.english: <size=32>He'll learn so much more from the good people here in the village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>He'll learn so much more from the good people here in the village!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_001
Array.english: After losing my husband, I thought about leaving this village...
Array.indonesia: After losing my husband, I thought about leaving this village...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_002
Array.english: <size=32>But honestly, nowhere feels as comfortable as here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But honestly, nowhere feels as comfortable as here.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_003
Array.english: The beautiful lake and the plants...
Array.indonesia: The beautiful lake and the plants...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_004
Array.english: Even the view from up high.\nThey've helped me heal so much.
Array.indonesia: Even the view from up high.\nThey've helped me heal so much.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_NotKind03_005
Array.english: Dave, I hope you won't just bury yourself in the case and actually take time to enjoy the village.
Array.indonesia: Dave, I hope you won't just bury yourself in the case and actually take time to enjoy the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: I really love looking at Jaka's childhood photos.
Array.indonesia: I really love looking at Jaka's childhood photos.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: I can't believe how fast he grew up...\nit's just amazing.
Array.indonesia: I can't believe how fast he grew up...\nit's just amazing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: I'm so glad I can preserve those happy memories like this in photos.
Array.indonesia: I'm so glad I can preserve those happy memories like this in photos.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_004
Array.english: But since I just keep them in a wooden box,\nthey sometimes fade or get damaged...
Array.indonesia: But since I just keep them in a wooden box,\nthey sometimes fade or get damaged...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Cinta would love it if I gave her a <color=#FF73C3>Photo Album</color> to take care of her photos. I should make a note of it.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Cinta would love it if I gave her a <color=#FF73C3>Photo Album</color> to take care of her photos. I should make a note of it.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind01_001
Array.english: The adults told me not to get too friendly with outsiders...
Array.indonesia: The adults told me not to get too friendly with outsiders...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind01_002
Array.english: They say they act nice, but lie a lot.
Array.indonesia: They say they act nice, but lie a lot.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind01_003
Array.english: But you seem like a good person, mister.
Array.indonesia: But you seem like a good person, mister.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_001
Array.english: Mister, do you have any other fun mobile games?
Array.indonesia: Mister, do you have any other fun mobile games?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_002
Array.english: Hmm... I don't have many installed...\nHow about this one?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I don't have many installed...\nHow about this one?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's a game where you join the Earth Defense Force and protect the city from giant monsters.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's a game where you join the Earth Defense Force and protect the city from giant monsters.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_004
Array.english: <size=32>You can also rescue citizens to generate resources.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You can also rescue citizens to generate resources.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Ooh..! Sounds fun!\nCan I try it for a bit?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ooh..! Sounds fun!\nCan I try it for a bit?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_006
Array.english: Of course. Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Of course. Here you go.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_007
Array.english: <size=35>Ooh...!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ooh...!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_008
Array.english: <size=40>Ooh...!!! Monster cards like this...!!! Awesome!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ooh...!!! Monster cards like this...!!! Awesome!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_009
Array.english: <size=40>Tap... tap!!! Swipe!!! Hiyah!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Tap... tap!!! Swipe!!! Hiyah!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_010
Array.english: <size=40>Wow! This is so fun!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wow! This is so fun!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind02_011
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. Just as I thought, everyone loves monster games.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. Just as I thought, everyone loves monster games.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_001
Array.english: I read in a book once that there are so many different kinds of dinosaurs.
Array.indonesia: I read in a book once that there are so many different kinds of dinosaurs.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_002
Array.english: I know, right? I heard there are over a thousand species.
Array.indonesia: I know, right? I heard there are over a thousand species.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_003
Array.english: <size=32>Wow...! Really? That many?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow...! Really? That many?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_004
Array.english: Mister, if you find any <color=#FF73C3>Dinosaur Bones</color>, could you bring them to me?
Array.indonesia: Mister, if you find any <color=#FF73C3>Dinosaur Bones</color>, could you bring them to me?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_005
Array.english: I've always wanted some... but I heard they're all underwater.
Array.indonesia: I've always wanted some... but I heard they're all underwater.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_Kind03_006
Array.english: Okay. If I see any, I'll pick some up.
Array.indonesia: Okay. If I see any, I'll pick some up.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_001
Array.english: Mister, don't you have any new games on your phone?\nCan't you let me play again?
Array.indonesia: Mister, don't you have any new games on your phone?\nCan't you let me play again?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk01_002

Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah! Mister, do you know a game console called <color=#FF73C3>SL63</color>?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind01_002

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind02_001

Array.indonesia: My younger sister, <color=#F1DC2B>Saniah</color>, is really curious.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind02_002

Array.indonesia: A while ago, she chased a butterfly all the way to the forest... I got scolded by Mom for not watching her properly.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind02_003

Array.indonesia: Oh, you must have been really worried.\nShe still looks so young.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind02_004

Array.indonesia: Yeah. I was actually relieved the path was blocked by a big boulder.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_001
Array.english: Mister, what's city life like?
Array.indonesia: Mister, what's city life like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_002
Array.english: Well, some people like it, but I prefer quiet places like this.
Array.indonesia: Well, some people like it, but I prefer quiet places like this.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_003

Array.indonesia: There's lots of tasty food too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_004
Array.english: Really? Some of the adults left saying they prefer the city.
Array.indonesia: Really? Some of the adults left saying they prefer the city.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_NotKind03_005
Array.english: But our whole family loves this village.
Array.indonesia: But our whole family loves this village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah... I'm curious...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah... I'm curious...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_002
Array.english: Hmm? What are you curious about?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? What are you curious about?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well, sometimes Uncle Rimbo brings me <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color>...\nand I'm dying to know what happens next.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well, sometimes Uncle Rimbo brings me <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color>...\nand I'm dying to know what happens next.</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> always cuts off right when it gets good...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh...! What happened to Sasuke after he got separated from his friends...? And what about the main character who merged with the Saw Shark Devil...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh...! What happened to Sasuke after he got separated from his friends...? And what about the main character who merged with the Saw Shark Devil...?</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ugh... I'm so curious!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBrother_InfoTalk02_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He'd probably love it if I gave him some <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> as a gift. I should make a note of that.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(He'd probably love it if I gave him some <color=#FF73C3>Manga</color> as a gift. I should make a note of that.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind01_001

Array.indonesia: I really love <color=#1DFEAF>Butterflies</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind01_002

Array.indonesia: They're like colorful paper, but they fly in the sky.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind02_001

Array.indonesia: Mister, Bima told me there was a really bad disease going around the city.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind02_002

Array.indonesia: People who got sick were biting each other...\nso everyone started wearing white masks!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind02_003

Array.indonesia: Hmm... I think that was for a different reason.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind02_004

Array.indonesia: Anyway, when someone's sick, make sure to cover your mouth properly. So you don't spread the illness.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind03_001

Array.indonesia: <size=32>I saw a tiny person in the forest once!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Kind03_002

Array.indonesia: I snuck out at night without Mom knowing to chase fireflies.

Array.indonesia: <size=32>I saw a tiny person running toward the forest.</size>

Array.indonesia: I see. That's amazing.

Array.indonesia: But sneaking out at night without your mom knowing is dangerous. I'll keep this a secret.

Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mister, I like <color=#FF73C3>Dolls</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk01_002

Array.indonesia: I see. What kind of <color=#FF73C3>Dolls</color> do you like?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk01_003

Array.indonesia: Hmm... I like animal dolls... and people dolls too...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk01_004
Array.english: <size=35>I like them all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I like them all!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk01_005
Array.english: Haha, I see. I'll remember that.
Array.indonesia: Haha, I see. I'll remember that.

Array.indonesia: Um... do outsiders really boil people alive and eat them as soup?

Array.indonesia: Bima did. He said they cut off the fingers and fry them separately.

Array.indonesia: He sure tells some strange stories.\nThat doesn't happen.

Array.indonesia: Uncle Rimbo gave me a drink before, and it was super fizzy!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind02_002

Array.indonesia: Oh, was it cola? It's the best on a hot day... haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind02_003

Array.indonesia: <size=32>That's right! That was the name!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind02_004

Array.indonesia: Bima told me they make it by bottling electricity,\nand that's why it's fizzy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind02_005

Array.indonesia: No. We came by boat, kiddo.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind03_003

Array.indonesia: <size=32>I wanna ride a plane!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind03_004

Array.indonesia: I heard they put a bunch of birds in the wings to make it fly, right? That's so cool!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_NotKind03_005

Array.indonesia: R-Right. That would be really cool...

Array.indonesia: Aww...

Array.indonesia: Hmm? Why are you crying?

Array.indonesia: Mommy told me not to eat too many <color=#FF73C3>Snacks</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_InfoTalk02_004

Array.indonesia: She said if I eat too many, my teeth and tongue will melt away!

Array.indonesia: Well, not your tongue, but... you should always brush your teeth well after eating <color=#FF73C3>Snacks</color>.

Array.indonesia: If you brush them well, I'll give you some <color=#FF73C3>Snacks</color>.

Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow! Okay!\nI'll definitely brush my teeth well!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_001

Array.indonesia: Mister, do you know about a snake called an anaconda?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_002

Array.indonesia: I think I've seen one in a movie. Isn't it a huge snake?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_003

Array.indonesia: It is! This is a secret...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_004

Array.indonesia: I went to the forest at night and saw a really,\nreally huge snake.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_005

Array.indonesia: It was way bigger than the tree in front of the chief's house!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_006

Array.indonesia: Oh, come on. There's no way a snake that big exists.\nSomeone in the village would've seen it by now.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_007

Array.indonesia: It was dark, so things probably just looked bigger than they were.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind01_008
Array.english: But it's true... Nobody believes me...
Array.indonesia: But it's true... Nobody believes me...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_001
Array.english: My dad's always telling me to study...
Array.indonesia: My dad's always telling me to study...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_002
Array.english: ...but all he does is drink and mess around.
Array.indonesia: ...but all he does is drink and mess around.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_003
