Array.indonesia: Sounds like you're talking about <color=#F1DC2B>Harta</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_004
Array.english: He seemed like a fun, kind person.
Array.indonesia: He seemed like a fun, kind person.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_005

Array.indonesia: He's only like that with other adults...\nHe doesn't even spend time with me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_006
Array.english: Maybe it's because you handle everything so well on your own?
Array.indonesia: Maybe it's because you handle everything so well on your own?

Array.indonesia: W-Well, that's true!\nI do handle everything pretty well!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_008

Array.indonesia: Maybe when you're a bit older, your dad will spend more time with you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind02_009

Array.indonesia: Dads sometimes don't know how to act around their kids,\nso they keep their distance.

Array.indonesia: Really? Hehe.\nHearing that makes me feel a bit better.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind03_001

Array.indonesia: Rhinoceros beetles and stag beetles are really cool.

Array.indonesia: There are a lot of really unique insects in this region.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_Kind03_004

Array.indonesia: <size=32>Especially the <color=#1DFEAF>Femoralis Fancy Stag Beetle</color>...\nit's just unbelievably cool!</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mister, do you know the movie <color=#FF73C3>Robot Samurai</color>?</size>

Array.indonesia: Of course! It's Bancho's favorite movie.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk01_003

Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, I see! It's really, really good!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_InfoTalk01_004

Array.indonesia: <size=32>There are so many explosions, my ears hurt though...</size>

Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(A <color=#FF73C3>Robot Samurai Action Figure</color>, huh...\nHe'd probably love it if I got him one.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_NotKind01_001

Array.indonesia: Mister, if I told you... creatures similar to humans live deep in the sea, would you believe me?

Array.english: ...With Kindred's advanced technology, you can even skip ahead.
Array.indonesia: ...With Kindred's advanced technology, you can even skip ahead.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_NoWatch_001
Array.english: Hmm... you're not being very honest, are you?\nI hope you'll watch it later.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... you're not being very honest, are you?\nI hope you'll watch it later.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_AfterWatch_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! How is it?\nKindred's technology is amazing, isn't it?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! How is it?\nKindred's technology is amazing, isn't it?!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_MartinTweed_VideoRewatch_AfterWatch_002
Array.english: Though without equipment, there's not much I can actually do...
Array.indonesia: Though without equipment, there's not much I can actually do...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_01_001
Array.english: I'm tellin' ya, I just love that heat hangin' in the air.
Array.indonesia: I'm tellin' ya, I just love that heat hangin' in the air.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Gets my musical inspiration flowin'!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Gets my musical inspiration flowin'!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_02_001
Array.english:
Sure wish our bandmates could've made the trip.
What a shame.
Array.indonesia:
Sure wish our bandmates could've made the trip.
What a shame.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_03_001
Array.english: Back when I was younger, I used to play my music loud as hell.
Array.indonesia: Back when I was younger, I used to play my music loud as hell.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_03_002
Array.english: But as I got older, I started leanin' more toward country.
Array.indonesia: But as I got older, I started leanin' more toward country.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_AfterJaka_01_001
Array.english: Well now... never thought I'd make it all the way out here and end up havin' such a fine jam session.
Array.indonesia: Well now... never thought I'd make it all the way out here and end up havin' such a fine jam session.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_CharlieBonnet_AfterJaka_01_002
Array.english: <size=33>That young fella, Jaka. He's got that rock 'n' roll spirit!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That young fella, Jaka. He's got that rock 'n' roll spirit!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Omnom_01_001
Array.english: (Om Nom is smiling brightly)
Array.indonesia: (Om Nom is smiling brightly)

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Omnom_02_001
Array.english: (Om Nom's mouth is wide open, lookin' hungry)
Array.indonesia: (Om Nom's mouth is wide open, lookin' hungry)

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Omnom_03_001
Array.english: (Om Nom is looking around curiously)
Array.indonesia: (Om Nom is looking around curiously)

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_01_001
Array.english: I ended up in this village out of nowhere, but I really like it here.
Array.indonesia: I ended up in this village out of nowhere, but I really like it here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>I guess I really like forest villages, hoho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I guess I really like forest villages, hoho!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_02_001
Array.english: It's pretty hot in this village.
Array.indonesia: It's pretty hot in this village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_02_002
Array.english: Wouldn't it be cooler if you took off your hat?
Array.indonesia: Wouldn't it be cooler if you took off your hat?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_02_003
Array.english: <size=32>No way! I really, really love this hat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>No way! I really, really love this hat!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_03_001
Array.english: You know the tall chef at the shop...
Array.indonesia: You know the tall chef at the shop...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_03_002
Array.english: <size=32>He's such an amazing cook!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>He's such an amazing cook!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_03_003
Array.english: I told him I was hungry and he made me something simple... and it was really, really delicious!
Array.indonesia: I told him I was hungry and he made me something simple... and it was really, really delicious!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Mita_03_004
Array.english: <size=32>Of course! Bancho's cooking is the best in the world!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Of course! Bancho's cooking is the best in the world!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_001
Array.english: Our Two Point County has an abandoned museum.
Array.indonesia: Our Two Point County has an abandoned museum.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_002
Array.english: I heard the previous curator was rather lazy and incompetent...
Array.indonesia: I heard the previous curator was rather lazy and incompetent...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_003
Array.english: So the new curator and I are working to bring the museum back to life!
Array.indonesia: So the new curator and I are working to bring the museum back to life!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_004
Array.english: My role is to find things like dinosaur bones...\nand mysterious artifacts from ancient times.
Array.indonesia: My role is to find things like dinosaur bones...\nand mysterious artifacts from ancient times.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_01_005
Array.english: Your help, Dave, would be a great boost to our town's revival.
Array.indonesia: Your help, Dave, would be a great boost to our town's revival.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_001
Array.english: This region truly has such diverse wildlife.
Array.indonesia: This region truly has such diverse wildlife.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Especially that... the bones of a giant dinosaur on the beach...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Especially that... the bones of a giant dinosaur on the beach...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_003
Array.english: Those appear to be basilosaurus bones, which are quite rare worldwide...
Array.indonesia: Those appear to be basilosaurus bones, which are quite rare worldwide...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_004
Array.english: To think something like that is just sitting here in the village...
Array.indonesia: To think something like that is just sitting here in the village...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_02_005
Array.english: <size=33>It seems I've come to the right place! Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It seems I've come to the right place! Haha!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_03_001
Array.english: Setah Forest was fairly dangerous as well, but...
Array.indonesia: Setah Forest was fairly dangerous as well, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_03_002
Array.english: it's nothing compared to the freezing mine I explored before.
Array.indonesia: it's nothing compared to the freezing mine I explored before.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Longbottom_03_003
Array.english: The blizzards... the frostbite... Ugh... just thinking about it gives me chills.
Array.indonesia: The blizzards... the frostbite... Ugh... just thinking about it gives me chills.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_01_001
Array.english: There are some unstable frequencies in the village,\nthough...
Array.indonesia: There are some unstable frequencies in the village,\nthough...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_01_002
Array.english: Compared to Solaris-3, this place is so much more peaceful. I don't sense any traces of Tacet Discords here, either.
Array.indonesia: Compared to Solaris-3, this place is so much more peaceful. I don't sense any traces of Tacet Discords here, either.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_01_003
Array.english: I think I'll stay for a while and rest.
Array.indonesia: I think I'll stay for a while and rest.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_02_001
Array.english: Something stirred in the bushes earlier, so I turned on my terminal...
Array.indonesia: Something stirred in the bushes earlier, so I turned on my terminal...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_02_002
Array.english: It was just an ordinary insect.
Array.indonesia: It was just an ordinary insect.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_02_003
Array.english: I suppose I can lower my guard a little here.
Array.indonesia: I suppose I can lower my guard a little here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_03_001
Array.english: There are so many different kinds of plants growing in this village.
Array.indonesia: There are so many different kinds of plants growing in this village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_03_002
Array.english: If Baizhi were here... I'm sure she'd collect some samples and analyze their composition.
Array.indonesia: If Baizhi were here... I'm sure she'd collect some samples and analyze their composition.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rover_03_003
Array.english: I'm starting to miss her endless curiosity.
Array.indonesia: I'm starting to miss her endless curiosity.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: The villagers have been telling me...
Array.indonesia: The villagers have been telling me...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: ...that they hope you will visit from time to time,\neven after this investigation is over.
Array.indonesia: ...that they hope you will visit from time to time,\neven after this investigation is over.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Is that so. That's truly heartening to hear.
Array.indonesia: Is that so. That's truly heartening to hear.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: You mentioned that where you come from, the underwater terrain shifts and new things appear as well, did you not?
Array.indonesia: You mentioned that where you come from, the underwater terrain shifts and new things appear as well, did you not?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Yes. It was quite similar to here.
Array.indonesia: Yes. It was quite similar to here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: I see. Did you also have pots like the ones in our village lake?
Array.indonesia: I see. Did you also have pots like the ones in our village lake?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: Yes. The contents were different, but I often came across pots as well.
Array.indonesia: Yes. The contents were different, but I often came across pots as well.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Haha, then this <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> should serve you well.
Array.indonesia: Haha, then this <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> should serve you well.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: It is a <color=#F1DC2B>Charm of Abundance</color> that allows you to obtain more items when opening a pot.
Array.indonesia: It is a <color=#F1DC2B>Charm of Abundance</color> that allows you to obtain more items when opening a pot.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Whether here... or in the place you come from...\nit should prove most useful.
Array.indonesia: Whether here... or in the place you come from...\nit should prove most useful.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Oh... thank you, Chief.
Array.indonesia: Oh... thank you, Chief.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: I've learned so much and met wonderful people in this village.
Array.indonesia: I've learned so much and met wonderful people in this village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: It's all thanks to your warm welcome, Chief!
Array.indonesia: It's all thanks to your warm welcome, Chief!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: Haha, things would have turned out quite differently without your efforts.
Array.indonesia: Haha, things would have turned out quite differently without your efforts.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv5Reward_015
Array.english: Take your time to explore this land while you are here,\nand carry its memory with you when you leave.
Array.indonesia: Take your time to explore this land while you are here,\nand carry its memory with you when you leave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Things would've been really tough if you hadn't come along with Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Things would've been really tough if you hadn't come along with Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Without you, Dave... the investigation would've taken much longer...
Array.indonesia: Without you, Dave... the investigation would've taken much longer...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: And without Bancho... we'd still be eating food that smells like hydrogen sulfide.
Array.indonesia: And without Bancho... we'd still be eating food that smells like hydrogen sulfide.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: <size=33>...And Dr. Bacon would've been drinking even more beer.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...And Dr. Bacon would've been drinking even more beer.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: So, to show my gratitude, there's something I've been working on for quite a while...
Array.indonesia: So, to show my gratitude, there's something I've been working on for quite a while...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: <size=34>And it's finally finished, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And it's finally finished, hehe!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: <size=36>Ta-da! This is called an <color=#F1DC2B>Anti-Gravity Device</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ta-da! This is called an <color=#F1DC2B>Anti-Gravity Device</color>!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: An <color=#F1DC2B>Anti-Gravity Device</color>...? What's that?
Array.indonesia: An <color=#F1DC2B>Anti-Gravity Device</color>...? What's that?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: It's a tool that lets you bring back up to 2 items when you're rescued underwater.
Array.indonesia: It's a tool that lets you bring back up to 2 items when you're rescued underwater.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... that's exactly what I needed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... that's exactly what I needed!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Every time I messed up and could only bring back one item, I felt so bad about it...
Array.indonesia: Every time I messed up and could only bring back one item, I felt so bad about it...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you so much! This is going to be a huge help!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thank you so much! This is going to be a huge help!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: Hehe... I wish I could've given it to you sooner...
Array.indonesia: Hehe... I wish I could've given it to you sooner...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: The research ended up needing more hands than I expected.
Array.indonesia: The research ended up needing more hands than I expected.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv5Reward_015
Array.english: <size=32>Anyway, I'll be counting on you from here on out too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Anyway, I'll be counting on you from here on out too!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, how's that kick scooter been treatin' ya?
Array.indonesia: Dave, how's that kick scooter been treatin' ya?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: It's been awesome. Honestly, I don't know how I would've managed without the scooter you gave me, Rimbo...
Array.indonesia: It's been awesome. Honestly, I don't know how I would've managed without the scooter you gave me, Rimbo...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: I've been zipping all over the village, chatting with just about everyone.
Array.indonesia: I've been zipping all over the village, chatting with just about everyone.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha, anything givin' ya trouble?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha, anything givin' ya trouble?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Hmm... maybe it'd be nice if it was a bit faster...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... maybe it'd be nice if it was a bit faster...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: And it kinda bogs down on beaches, which gets a little annoying.
Array.indonesia: And it kinda bogs down on beaches, which gets a little annoying.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: I see, I see. In that case...
Array.indonesia: I see, I see. In that case...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: <size=36>Go on, give this a spin!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Go on, give this a spin!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Oh... isn't this an <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Scooter</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh... isn't this an <color=#F1DC2B>Electric Scooter</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Hahaa! That's right.\nHad to splurge a bit, but I picked it up in the city!
Array.indonesia: Hahaa! That's right.\nHad to splurge a bit, but I picked it up in the city!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: I owe ya big time, Dave.\nThink of it as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> from me.
Array.indonesia: I owe ya big time, Dave.\nThink of it as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> from me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Wow... I love it!\nAnd the red, your lucky color, looks awesome too!
Array.indonesia: Wow... I love it!\nAnd the red, your lucky color, looks awesome too!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Rimbo_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: Hahaa! With that thing, I reckon we'll be runnin' into each other a whole lot more. If it ever acts up, you bring it straight to me.
Array.indonesia: Hahaa! With that thing, I reckon we'll be runnin' into each other a whole lot more. If it ever acts up, you bring it straight to me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Dave, you know how to restore your stamina out in the forest, don't you?
Array.indonesia: Dave, you know how to restore your stamina out in the forest, don't you?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Yes. I heard you just need to eat herbs.
Array.indonesia: Yes. I heard you just need to eat herbs.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Hehe. That's right.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. That's right.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: But if you grind them in a <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color> and turn them into a drink, you can recover much more.
Array.indonesia: But if you grind them in a <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color> and turn them into a drink, you can recover much more.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: And if you mix different herbs together, you can even stack the effects.
Array.indonesia: And if you mix different herbs together, you can even stack the effects.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: So, I was thinking...
Array.indonesia: So, I was thinking...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: I happen to have an extra <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color>.\nWhy don't you take it, Dave?
Array.indonesia: I happen to have an extra <color=#F1DC2B>Mortar</color>.\nWhy don't you take it, Dave?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: It must be a hassle having to come to me every time you want to make herbal drinks.
Array.indonesia: It must be a hassle having to come to me every time you want to make herbal drinks.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Oh... I really appreciate it, but...\nare you sure it's okay for me to handle it on my own?
Array.indonesia: Oh... I really appreciate it, but...\nare you sure it's okay for me to handle it on my own?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Hehe. I'll teach you all the recipes.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. I'll teach you all the recipes.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: I'm sure you can handle anything, Dave.
Array.indonesia: I'm sure you can handle anything, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Herbalist_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, thank you!\nI'll put it to good use!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, thank you!\nI'll put it to good use!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Heheh, brother. You been enjoyin' the fishin'?
Array.indonesia: Heheh, brother. You been enjoyin' the fishin'?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1
Array.english: Yeah! I'm really enjoying it
Array.indonesia: Yeah! I'm really enjoying it

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option2
Array.english: Nah... I haven't had much time for it
Array.indonesia: Nah... I haven't had much time for it

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_001
Array.english: Yeah. You catch different stuff than you would in the lake, and it's a lotta fun.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. You catch different stuff than you would in the lake, and it's a lotta fun.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_002
Array.english: Heheh, is that so.\nGlad to hear you're enjoyin' it.
Array.indonesia: Heheh, is that so.\nGlad to hear you're enjoyin' it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_003
Array.english: You've been helpin' me out in all sorts of ways, brother... and pitchin' in around the village too...
Array.indonesia: You've been helpin' me out in all sorts of ways, brother... and pitchin' in around the village too...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_004
Array.english: Figured I oughta give ya a proper <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> before you head out.
Array.indonesia: Figured I oughta give ya a proper <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color> before you head out.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_005
Array.english: This here's called the <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Fishing Rod</color>,\na fine rod that lets ya catch two fish at once!
Array.indonesia: This here's called the <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Fishing Rod</color>,\na fine rod that lets ya catch two fish at once!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_006
Array.english: Oh... are you sure you wanna give me something this nice?
Array.indonesia: Oh... are you sure you wanna give me something this nice?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_007
Array.english: Heheh! Me, I like catchin' 'em one at a time better anyhow.
Array.indonesia: Heheh! Me, I like catchin' 'em one at a time better anyhow.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Fisherman_Lv5Reward_option1_answer_008
Array.english: You folks gotta cook and all, so you'll be needin' it more than me, right?
Array.indonesia: You folks gotta cook and all, so you'll be needin' it more than me, right?

Array.english: Dave, would you accept this, if you don't mind?
Array.indonesia: Dave, would you accept this, if you don't mind?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Hm? What is this?
Array.indonesia: Hm? What is this?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Butterfly Necklace</color> I used to wear.
Array.indonesia: It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Butterfly Necklace</color> I used to wear.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: With everything that was happening in the village,\nI wore it to calm myself...
Array.indonesia: With everything that was happening in the village,\nI wore it to calm myself...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Thanks to you and your friends, Dave, things have settled down, so I don't think I'll need it anymore.
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you and your friends, Dave, things have settled down, so I don't think I'll need it anymore.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: As a token of my gratitude... I'd like to give it to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.
Array.indonesia: As a token of my gratitude... I'd like to give it to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: Are you sure?\nSomething might happen in the village again.
Array.indonesia: Are you sure?\nSomething might happen in the village again.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Hehe... from now on, I can calm my heart through poetry.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... from now on, I can calm my heart through poetry.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: I think I've grown a little through all of this too, hehe!
Array.indonesia: I think I've grown a little through all of this too, hehe!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_PoetryGirl_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: I understand, Kinah.\nI'll put it to good use. Thank you!
Array.indonesia: I understand, Kinah.\nI'll put it to good use. Thank you!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: You've caught <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=JungleFishCount/></color> fish since coming to this village...
Array.indonesia: You've caught <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=JungleFishCount/></color> fish since coming to this village...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: And you've picked <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=JungleFlowerCount/></color> flowers. Some of those were the ones I asked for...
Array.indonesia: And you've picked <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=JungleFlowerCount/></color> flowers. Some of those were the ones I asked for...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Huh?! How do you know all that?\nDid you ask an AI?
Array.indonesia: Huh?! How do you know all that?\nDid you ask an AI?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Hmm... AI...? What could that be...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... AI...? What could that be...?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Perhaps now that things have settled a little...\nI'm beginning to sense the flow of the village again.
Array.indonesia: Perhaps now that things have settled a little...\nI'm beginning to sense the flow of the village again.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: The spirits are always watching over what you have been doing here.
Array.indonesia: The spirits are always watching over what you have been doing here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: This may not be of immediate use to your work, but...
Array.indonesia: This may not be of immediate use to your work, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: If you are ever curious, come visit this old woman anytime.
Array.indonesia: If you are ever curious, come visit this old woman anytime.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: If the spirits are watching, I guess I can't get away with anything bad in the village!
Array.indonesia: If the spirits are watching, I guess I can't get away with anything bad in the village!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Hoho... everyone already knows you're not one to do such things.
Array.indonesia: Hoho... everyone already knows you're not one to do such things.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_FlowerGrandma_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: The spirits are watching over you all with gratitude as well.
Array.indonesia: The spirits are watching over you all with gratitude as well.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Have you ever been moved to tears by music, mister?
Array.indonesia: Have you ever been moved to tears by music, mister?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Hmm... I went to a concert once... I ended up yawning because it was so boring...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I went to a concert once... I ended up yawning because it was so boring...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: *Sigh*... I suppose sensitivity really does fade with age.
Array.indonesia: *Sigh*... I suppose sensitivity really does fade with age.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: For a man like you...\nI'll give you a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.
Array.indonesia: For a man like you...\nI'll give you a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: This is the OST from a masterpiece of a game called <color=#F1DC2B>To the Moon</color>.
Array.indonesia: This is the OST from a masterpiece of a game called <color=#F1DC2B>To the Moon</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Every time I listen to it... I can feel Johnny's longing for River, and it tugs at my heart.
Array.indonesia: Every time I listen to it... I can feel Johnny's longing for River, and it tugs at my heart.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: It's a piece with a beautiful melody, as if it's gathering scattered fragments of memory.
Array.indonesia: It's a piece with a beautiful melody, as if it's gathering scattered fragments of memory.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Oh... you know it too, Jaka?\nI really enjoyed playing it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... you know it too, Jaka?\nI really enjoyed playing it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: It dealt with heavy themes, but thanks to the quirky Dr. Rosalene and Dr. Watts, it never felt overwhelming. I liked that balance.
Array.indonesia: It dealt with heavy themes, but thanks to the quirky Dr. Rosalene and Dr. Watts, it never felt overwhelming. I liked that balance.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Hoho... your taste isn't as poor as I thought, mister.
Array.indonesia: Hoho... your taste isn't as poor as I thought, mister.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Then use the CD player I gave you to listen to this music and experience that emotion once more.
Array.indonesia: Then use the CD player I gave you to listen to this music and experience that emotion once more.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Heh. I guess I'd better have a handkerchief ready for the tears.
Array.indonesia: Heh. I guess I'd better have a handkerchief ready for the tears.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: This must be a treasured CD from your collection...\nThank you, Jaka.
Array.indonesia: This must be a treasured CD from your collection...\nThank you, Jaka.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungMan_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: Good music deserves to be shared with everyone! YEAH!
Array.indonesia: Good music deserves to be shared with everyone! YEAH!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Surely the hardest part of being underwater...\nmust be holding your breath.
Array.indonesia: Surely the hardest part of being underwater...\nmust be holding your breath.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Yeah... that's definitely the hardest part.
Array.indonesia: Yeah... that's definitely the hardest part.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Is that... air tank on your back really enough?
Array.indonesia: Is that... air tank on your back really enough?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Hmm... not really. But there are tools that refill your air underwater.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... not really. But there are tools that refill your air underwater.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: I see...\nThen perhaps this <color=#F1DC2B>Necklace</color> might be of use.
Array.indonesia: I see...\nThen perhaps this <color=#F1DC2B>Necklace</color> might be of use.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Huh? What is this?
Array.indonesia: Huh? What is this?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: This is what's known as an <color=#F1DC2B>Air Resonance Necklace</color>.
Array.indonesia: This is what's known as an <color=#F1DC2B>Air Resonance Necklace</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: After you refill your air underwater, the wearer's body resonates with the air for a short time.
Array.indonesia: After you refill your air underwater, the wearer's body resonates with the air for a short time.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: You could say it lets you recover for a little longer.
Array.indonesia: You could say it lets you recover for a little longer.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Oh... that's actually pretty nice!
Array.indonesia: Oh... that's actually pretty nice!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: It's just a bit surprising, seeing you be this considerate, Bonita.
Array.indonesia: It's just a bit surprising, seeing you be this considerate, Bonita.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: <size=32>C-considerate?! Th-that's not it at all...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>C-considerate?! Th-that's not it at all...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: <size=33>Y-yes, exactly! It just means you should stay underwater longer!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Y-yes, exactly! It just means you should stay underwater longer!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: Got it. I'll try not to get in your way.
Array.indonesia: Got it. I'll try not to get in your way.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_015
Array.english: No... well... within reason... let's just get along properly.
Array.indonesia: No... well... within reason... let's just get along properly.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Princessy_Lv5Reward_016
Array.english: Got it, Bonita! Thanks for the <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>!
Array.indonesia: Got it, Bonita! Thanks for the <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: It's been quite a while since you came to the village.
Array.indonesia: It's been quite a while since you came to the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: You're right. Time really flew by.
Array.indonesia: You're right. Time really flew by.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: I hope everything's okay back at the Blue Hole...
Array.indonesia: I hope everything's okay back at the Blue Hole...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english:
I'd love for you to stay a little longer, Dave,
but I know you'll have to return home someday...
Array.indonesia:
I'd love for you to stay a little longer, Dave,
but I know you'll have to return home someday...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: The kids have really grown fond of you too.
Array.indonesia: The kids have really grown fond of you too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Hehe... they really are such sweet, cheerful kids.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... they really are such sweet, cheerful kids.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: It might be a bit early, but... I prepared a <color=#F1DC2B>Handkerchief</color> as a keepsake for when you leave.
Array.indonesia: It might be a bit early, but... I prepared a <color=#F1DC2B>Handkerchief</color> as a keepsake for when you leave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Oh... did you embroider this yourself, Omila?
Array.indonesia: Oh... did you embroider this yourself, Omila?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Yes... it's a little embarrassing, but I made it myself.
Array.indonesia: Yes... it's a little embarrassing, but I made it myself.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: If you keep it with you when you're sweating or going through tough times, I'm sure it'll bring you comfort.
Array.indonesia: If you keep it with you when you're sweating or going through tough times, I'm sure it'll bring you comfort.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisMom_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Thank you for the <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, Omila! I'll never forget my time in this village!
Array.indonesia: Thank you for the <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, Omila! I'll never forget my time in this village!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: You've done so much for the village, Dave...
Array.indonesia: You've done so much for the village, Dave...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: But there's not much I can offer in return...
Array.indonesia: But there's not much I can offer in return...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: What are you talking about? Thanks to you, Perak, I can upgrade my tools and weapons!
Array.indonesia: What are you talking about? Thanks to you, Perak, I can upgrade my tools and weapons!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: It really means a lot to hear you say that.
Array.indonesia: It really means a lot to hear you say that.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: Still, I'd like to do something for you...
Array.indonesia: Still, I'd like to do something for you...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Would it be alright if I only charged <color=#FF73C3>Half</color> my usual fee as a small way of repaying you?
Array.indonesia: Would it be alright if I only charged <color=#FF73C3>Half</color> my usual fee as a small way of repaying you?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: Oh... are you sure? You really don't mind?
Array.indonesia: Oh... are you sure? You really don't mind?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Haha. Well, I've gotten used to the work by now...\nso I can make things more easily.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Well, I've gotten used to the work by now...\nso I can make things more easily.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: But of course, I do have a family to support... so I hope you understand I still need to charge a little.
Array.indonesia: But of course, I do have a family to support... so I hope you understand I still need to charge a little.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Of course, that goes without saying.
Array.indonesia: Of course, that goes without saying.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Thanks to you, I'll be able to forge the weapons I hadn't been able to upgrade yet with a lot less trouble.
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you, I'll be able to forge the weapons I hadn't been able to upgrade yet with a lot less trouble.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_BroSisDad_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Haha. Then I look forward to working with you again, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Then I look forward to working with you again, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Thanks to you, Dave, Jaka has become so much brighter...
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you, Dave, Jaka has become so much brighter...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: And I've been able to stop getting lost in memories of my husband too.
Array.indonesia: And I've been able to stop getting lost in memories of my husband too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: It's not because of me...\nYou did this yourself, Cinta.
Array.indonesia: It's not because of me...\nYou did this yourself, Cinta.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: When you say things like that, it almost makes me cry again...
Array.indonesia: When you say things like that, it almost makes me cry again...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: I've decided to try getting a little closer to the other villagers too.
Array.indonesia: I've decided to try getting a little closer to the other villagers too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: I can't stay the pitiful widow forever!
Array.indonesia: I can't stay the pitiful widow forever!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: As a way of letting go of the past, little by little...\nI'd like to give this to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, Dave.
Array.indonesia: As a way of letting go of the past, little by little...\nI'd like to give this to you as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: Huh? This is a <color=#F1DC2B>Belt</color>?
Array.indonesia: Huh? This is a <color=#F1DC2B>Belt</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Yes. My husband treasured it... He always wore it whenever he went somewhere dangerous.
Array.indonesia: Yes. My husband treasured it... He always wore it whenever he went somewhere dangerous.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: He said if you block an attack at just the right moment, it can restore you... though I never really understood what he meant.
Array.indonesia: He said if you block an attack at just the right moment, it can restore you... though I never really understood what he meant.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: It seems like such an important belonging...\nAre you sure I can have it?
Array.indonesia: It seems like such an important belonging...\nAre you sure I can have it?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_012
Array.english: Of course. If it's used by someone who needs it,\nI'm sure my husband would be happy too.
Array.indonesia: Of course. If it's used by someone who needs it,\nI'm sure my husband would be happy too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_013
Array.english: If you're sure... I'll make good use of it, wouldn't want to let him down.
Array.indonesia: If you're sure... I'll make good use of it, wouldn't want to let him down.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_014
Array.english: I would truly appreciate that.
Array.indonesia: I would truly appreciate that.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_YoungManMom_Lv5Reward_015
Array.english: We're glad to have you here. Enjoy your stay in the village.
Array.indonesia: We're glad to have you here. Enjoy your stay in the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_001
Array.english: Mister! Take this, mister!!
Array.indonesia: Mister! Take this, mister!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_002
Array.english: Huh? Isn't this a <color=#F1DC2B>Four-Leaf Clover</color>?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Isn't this a <color=#F1DC2B>Four-Leaf Clover</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_003
Array.english: Yes! That's right.\nI heard if you keep it, it brings you good luck.
Array.indonesia: Yes! That's right.\nI heard if you keep it, it brings you good luck.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_004
Array.english: Oh... you really know your stuff.
Array.indonesia: Oh... you really know your stuff.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_005
Array.english: It's something really special... Are you sure you want to give it to me?
Array.indonesia: It's something really special... Are you sure you want to give it to me?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_006
Array.english: Of course! I had so much fun because of you, mister...
Array.indonesia: Of course! I had so much fun because of you, mister...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_007
Array.english: <size=32>And you do all sorts of dangerous things, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>And you do all sorts of dangerous things, mister!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_008
Array.english: <size=32>I want you to stay safe and healthy, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I want you to stay safe and healthy, mister!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_009
Array.english: Hehe, I will.\nI'll take good care of it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, I will.\nI'll take good care of it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_010
Array.english: Yes!! I gave it to you, mister!\nDon't forget, okay!
Array.indonesia: Yes!! I gave it to you, mister!\nDon't forget, okay!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_KidSister_Lv5Reward_011
Array.english: Of course. Thank you, Saniah.
Array.indonesia: Of course. Thank you, Saniah.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, I never properly thanked you for performing at the festival.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, I never properly thanked you for performing at the festival.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_002
Array.english: Not at all. I enjoyed it too.
Array.indonesia: Not at all. I enjoyed it too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_003
Array.english: Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_004
Array.english: This is a traditional decoration from our village that we used at the festival... I'd like you to have it as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.
Array.indonesia: This is a traditional decoration from our village that we used at the festival... I'd like you to have it as a <color=#FF73C3>Gift</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_005
Array.english: Oh... are you sure I can take this?
Array.indonesia: Oh... are you sure I can take this?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_006
Array.english: You've done so much for the village, so I thought it would be nice to bring a piece of it into your home.
Array.indonesia: You've done so much for the village, so I thought it would be nice to bring a piece of it into your home.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_007
Array.english: <size=32>I'll be counting on you going forward.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll be counting on you going forward.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Chief_Lv3Reward_008
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you, Chief!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thank you, Chief!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Muna_Lv3Reward_001

Array.indonesia: <size=32>Take this <color=#F1DC2B>Keychain</color> made from coconut and use this instead!</size>

Array.indonesia: Oh... this is a really nice keychain.

Array.indonesia: I think the village has felt more lively since you all arrived, Dave.

Array.indonesia: <size=34>Eek...! That would be far too embarrassing...!</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... thanks! I'm sure I'll find a use for it!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Fisherman_01_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He's really focused on fishing...\nBetter not disturb him.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(He's really focused on fishing...\nBetter not disturb him.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Lathi_01_001
Array.english: I hope the ingredients I gave you turn out delicious.
Array.indonesia: I hope the ingredients I gave you turn out delicious.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_001
Array.english: How long have you been here, Muna?
Array.indonesia: How long have you been here, Muna?

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_002
Array.english: Oh, me? Um...\nI think it's been about two months.
Array.indonesia: Oh, me? Um...\nI think it's been about two months.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_003
Array.english: At first, the macaques would steal my snacks at night... it was really tough...
Array.indonesia: At first, the macaques would steal my snacks at night... it was really tough...

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_004
Array.english: <size=32>But after the earthquake blocked the forest path, the macaques stopped coming up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But after the earthquake blocked the forest path, the macaques stopped coming up!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Muna_01_005
Array.english: It's a shame I can't explore the forest anymore...\nbut life's gotten a lot easier, hehe.
Array.indonesia: It's a shame I can't explore the forest anymore...\nbut life's gotten a lot easier, hehe.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_001
Array.english: Shouldn't you be gettin' some rest on your first day?\nYou're quite the hard worker, aren't ya?
Array.indonesia: Shouldn't you be gettin' some rest on your first day?\nYou're quite the hard worker, aren't ya?

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_002
Array.english: Bancho promised the village chief food...
Array.indonesia: Bancho promised the village chief food...

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Guess the food didn't quite agree with ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Guess the food didn't quite agree with ya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_004
Array.english: Truth be told, the cookin' in this village was never all that great to begin with...
Array.indonesia: Truth be told, the cookin' in this village was never all that great to begin with...

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_005
Array.english:
But lately, with the lake gettin' polluted,
it's been tastin' even worse.
Array.indonesia:
But lately, with the lake gettin' polluted,
it's been tastin' even worse.

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Rimbo_01_006
Array.english: <size=32>So if ya cook up somethin' tasty, the chief'll surely love it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>So if ya cook up somethin' tasty, the chief'll surely love it!</size>

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Lipah_01_001
Array.english: Hehe, are you having fun exploring the village?
Array.indonesia: Hehe, are you having fun exploring the village?

Array.name: NPC_FirstDayTalk_JDLC_Lipah_01_002
Array.english: It's your first day, so don't push yourself too hard.
Array.indonesia: It's your first day, so don't push yourself too hard.

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_001
Array.english: Heading back to <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Village</color> again?\nIt'll take about a day.
Array.indonesia: Heading back to <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Village</color> again?\nIt'll take about a day.

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_option1
Array.english: Go back
Array.indonesia: Go back

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_option2
Array.english: Don't go back
Array.indonesia: Don't go back

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_Go_001
Array.english: <size=32>Then let's get moving. If we hurry, we'll be there by tomorrow morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Then let's get moving. If we hurry, we'll be there by tomorrow morning!</size>

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_Stay_001
Array.english: I see. Just let me know when you want to go.
Array.indonesia: I see. Just let me know when you want to go.

Array.name: Call_Bacon_GoToJungle_Night_001
Array.english: It's pretty late right now. Could be dangerous.\nCall me again tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: It's pretty late right now. Could be dangerous.\nCall me again tomorrow.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>Did you happen to hear that loud noise last night?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Did you happen to hear that loud noise last night?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_002
Array.english: Yeah, we heard a loud rumbling from far off.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, we heard a loud rumbling from far off.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_003
Array.english: Our researcher was out investigating that area...
Array.indonesia: Our researcher was out investigating that area...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_004
Array.english: <size=32>And she contacted me saying something strange happened.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>And she contacted me saying something strange happened.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_005
Array.english: Oh... I see...!\nShouldn't you go check it out?
Array.indonesia: Oh... I see...!\nShouldn't you go check it out?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_006
Array.english: I suppose I should.\nBut...
Array.indonesia: I suppose I should.\nBut...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>I'd like you folks to come along too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I'd like you folks to come along too!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_008
Array.english: <size=34>Us... too?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Us... too?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_009
Array.english: Yes, we need to investigate a lake in the jungle...
Array.indonesia: Yes, we need to investigate a lake in the jungle...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_010
Array.english: And no one is better than you for underwater exploration, Dave.
Array.indonesia: And no one is better than you for underwater exploration, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_011
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... I see...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... I see...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_012
Array.english: The Blue Hole's been quiet lately, and you've helped us a lot, Dr. Bacon...
Array.indonesia: The Blue Hole's been quiet lately, and you've helped us a lot, Dr. Bacon...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_013
Array.english: I'd love to go with you, but...
Array.indonesia: I'd love to go with you, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_014
Array.english: <size=33>I'm not sure it's a good idea to leave Bancho running the shop alone...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'm not sure it's a good idea to leave Bancho running the shop alone...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_015
Array.english: <size=35>Hahaha! No need to worry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hahaha! No need to worry!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_016
Array.english: The researcher doesn't seem too fond of the local food there...
Array.indonesia: The researcher doesn't seem too fond of the local food there...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_017
Array.english: <size=34>So I was hoping Bancho could come along too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>So I was hoping Bancho could come along too!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_018
Array.english: <size=34>Oh...! Then we don't have to worry about the shop...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh...! Then we don't have to worry about the shop...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_019
Array.english: But would Bancho want to come along?\nHe seems pretty happy with things here.
Array.indonesia: But would Bancho want to come along?\nHe seems pretty happy with things here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_020
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Bancho needs to get out once in a while for some cooking inspiration!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Bancho needs to get out once in a while for some cooking inspiration!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_Start_021
Array.english: <size=34>It'll be fun if we all go together. Let's head to the shop and try to convince him.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It'll be fun if we all go together. Let's head to the shop and try to convince him.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_001
Array.english: Bancho, how about we all take a trip and leave the shop \nfor a bit?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, how about we all take a trip and leave the shop \nfor a bit?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_002
Array.english: <size=33>What's this all of a sudden?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What's this all of a sudden?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_003
Array.english: We need to investigate a lake in the jungle...\nI think we could really use your cooking skills.
Array.indonesia: We need to investigate a lake in the jungle...\nI think we could really use your cooking skills.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_004
Array.english: I've heard the food there is pretty terrible.
Array.indonesia: I've heard the food there is pretty terrible.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_005
Array.english: Hmm. Ingredients from a new region do sound interesting...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Ingredients from a new region do sound interesting...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_006
Array.english: But I'm not comfortable leaving the shop unattended.
Array.indonesia: But I'm not comfortable leaving the shop unattended.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_007
Array.english: Bancho, you've been working nonstop this whole time. You haven't even been able to enjoy our team dinners since you're always busy cooking.
Array.indonesia: Bancho, you've been working nonstop this whole time. You haven't even been able to enjoy our team dinners since you're always busy cooking.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_008
Array.english: <size=33>A short trip to a new place might be just the change you need!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A short trip to a new place might be just the change you need!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_009
Array.english: Hmm... a lake means freshwater fish...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... a lake means freshwater fish...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_010
Array.english: The Blue Hole only has saltwater fish, so it's been a while since I've cooked freshwater dishes.
Array.indonesia: The Blue Hole only has saltwater fish, so it's been a while since I've cooked freshwater dishes.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_011
Array.english: <size=34>Alright. I'll come along.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright. I'll come along.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_012
Array.english: <size=34>Great decision!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Great decision!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_013
Array.english: But... I'm still not comfortable leaving the shop to someone else.
Array.indonesia: But... I'm still not comfortable leaving the shop to someone else.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_014
Array.english: <size=34>Do you think I should close it for a while?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Do you think I should close it for a while?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_015
Array.english: Yes. It won't be for long... I'll let the staff take a break while we're away.
Array.indonesia: Yes. It won't be for long... I'll let the staff take a break while we're away.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_016
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Everyone gets a trip! Lucky us!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Everyone gets a trip! Lucky us!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BanchoSushi_017
Array.english: <size=32>You'll probably need to wrap a few things up before we leave... Give me a <color=#F1DC2B>Call</color> when you're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You'll probably need to wrap a few things up before we leave... Give me a <color=#F1DC2B>Call</color> when you're ready!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, are you ready to go?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, are you ready to go?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_option1
Array.english: I'm ready!
Array.indonesia: I'm ready!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_option2
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_Go_001
Array.english: <size=33>Good! Then let's head to my boat!\nOff we go!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Good! Then let's head to my boat!\nOff we go!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_00_BaconCall_Stay_001
Array.english: Looks like you need a bit more time.\nCall me again when you're ready!
Array.indonesia: Looks like you need a bit more time.\nCall me again when you're ready!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBancho_001
Array.english: Ugh...
Array.indonesia: Ugh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBancho_002
Array.english: Bancho, are you still feeling sick?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, are you still feeling sick?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBancho_003
Array.english: ...Dr. Bacon's driving is way too rough...\nUgh...
Array.indonesia: ...Dr. Bacon's driving is way too rough...\nUgh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBancho_004
Array.english: I need to eat something when we get to town...\nI'm starving.
Array.indonesia: I need to eat something when we get to town...\nI'm starving.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalCobra_001
Array.english: Phew... It's been a while since I've been somewhere this humid.
Array.indonesia: Phew... It's been a while since I've been somewhere this humid.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalCobra_002
Array.english: Not sure there's much money to be made in a place like this...
Array.indonesia: Not sure there's much money to be made in a place like this...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalCobra_003
Array.english: But if there really are dinosaurs, tourism could turn into a solid business... mwahaha!
Array.indonesia: But if there really are dinosaurs, tourism could turn into a solid business... mwahaha!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_001
Array.english: We may have gotten a bit lost on the way...\nBut hey, we made it here safe and sound.
Array.indonesia: We may have gotten a bit lost on the way...\nBut hey, we made it here safe and sound.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_002
Array.english: You suddenly stopped at some weird island and had us stay there forever, too...
Array.indonesia: You suddenly stopped at some weird island and had us stay there forever, too...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_003
Array.english: Hahaha! Exploring new places is a scholar's duty, isn't it?
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Exploring new places is a scholar's duty, isn't it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_004
Array.english: ...If by that you mean drinking five cans of beer and not even getting started until the next afternoon.
Array.indonesia: ...If by that you mean drinking five cans of beer and not even getting started until the next afternoon.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrivalBacon_005
Array.english: ...Haha... it was just really hot that day.
Array.indonesia: ...Haha... it was just really hot that day.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! We finally made it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! We finally made it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_002
Array.english: Phew... that was way too far for a small boat.
Array.indonesia: Phew... that was way too far for a small boat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_003
Array.english: But... I don't see any town around here?
Array.indonesia: But... I don't see any town around here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_004
Array.english: Ugh...
Array.indonesia: Ugh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_005
Array.english: Bancho's been so seasick he hasn't been able to eat properly.
Array.indonesia: Bancho's been so seasick he hasn't been able to eat properly.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_BoatArrival_006
Array.english: Our guide should be here soon...\nLet's wait a bit.
Array.indonesia: Our guide should be here soon...\nLet's wait a bit.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindRimbo_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Looks like our guide has arrived!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Looks like our guide has arrived!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindRimbo_002
Array.english: <size=34>Go and talk to him.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Go and talk to him.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_001
Array.english: Hello... Are you the village guide by any chance?
Array.indonesia: Hello... Are you the village guide by any chance?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_002
Array.english: Oh, y'all must be the visitors from outta town.
Array.indonesia: Oh, y'all must be the visitors from outta town.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>You must be tired from that long ride.\nName's <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You must be tired from that long ride.\nName's <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_004
Array.english: Nice to meet you, Rimbo.\nI'm Dave.
Array.indonesia: Nice to meet you, Rimbo.\nI'm Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_005
Array.english: And over there is my colleague...
Array.indonesia: And over there is my colleague...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, looks like y'all had yourselves a long day. Let's save the introductions for the car!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, looks like y'all had yourselves a long day. Let's save the introductions for the car!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_RimboFirstTalk_007
Array.english: Sounds good, haha.
Array.indonesia: Sounds good, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_001
Array.english: Let me introduce myself again.\nName's <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Let me introduce myself again.\nName's <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_002
Array.english: Kuhaha! That's a fine name.\nI'm Cobra, a businessman!
Array.indonesia: Kuhaha! That's a fine name.\nI'm Cobra, a businessman!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_003
Array.english: I'm Bacon. Got a message from my assistant \nin the village, so I came on over.
Array.indonesia: I'm Bacon. Got a message from my assistant \nin the village, so I came on over.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_004
Array.english: I'm Ban... Urp...!
Array.indonesia: I'm Ban... Urp...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_005
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! You folks sure are interesting!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! You folks sure are interesting!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_006
Array.english: The place you're headin' to is called <color=#F1DC2B>Utara</color>...
Array.indonesia: The place you're headin' to is called <color=#F1DC2B>Utara</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_007
Array.english: <size=33>It's an old village by a <color=#1DFEAF>lake where the terrain keeps shiftin'</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It's an old village by a <color=#1DFEAF>lake where the terrain keeps shiftin'</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_008
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... that sounds like the Blue Hole...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... that sounds like the Blue Hole...!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_009
Array.english: <size=33>There's another place like that? Well now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>There's another place like that? Well now.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_010
Array.english: But lately... strange things have started happenin'.
Array.indonesia: But lately... strange things have started happenin'.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_011
Array.english: I heard a dinosaur carcass washed up.
Array.indonesia: I heard a dinosaur carcass washed up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_012
Array.english:
Right. Well... round here, the lake meets the sea,
so unusual creatures do show up sometimes, but...
Array.indonesia:
Right. Well... round here, the lake meets the sea,
so unusual creatures do show up sometimes, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_013
Array.english: A dinosaur, though... never would've thought. To think somethin' like that still exists in our world... My, oh my.
Array.indonesia: A dinosaur, though... never would've thought. To think somethin' like that still exists in our world... My, oh my.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_014
Array.english: What about the villagers? Would it be okay for outsiders like us to visit...?
Array.indonesia: What about the villagers? Would it be okay for outsiders like us to visit...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_015
Array.english: Well... there are quite a few ruins round the village, \nso we do get outsiders now and then.
Array.indonesia: Well... there are quite a few ruins round the village, \nso we do get outsiders now and then.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_016
Array.english: Because of that, some folks are friendly toward strangers... while others tend to be more cautious.
Array.indonesia: Because of that, some folks are friendly toward strangers... while others tend to be more cautious.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_017
Array.english: Still, the village chief's a kind man, so y'all should be fine stayin' for a while.
Array.indonesia: Still, the village chief's a kind man, so y'all should be fine stayin' for a while.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_018
Array.english: Oh, we're almost at the village. Road goes uphill from here, so it might get a little bumpy!
Array.indonesia: Oh, we're almost at the village. Road goes uphill from here, so it might get a little bumpy!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_DriveTalk_019
Array.english: Ugh...
Array.indonesia: Ugh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_ArrivalVillage_001
Array.english: It's already evening!\nWelcome to <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Village</color>.
Array.indonesia: It's already evening!\nWelcome to <color=#F1DC2B>Utara Village</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_ArrivalVillage_002
Array.english: The village is built pretty high up.
Array.indonesia: The village is built pretty high up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_ArrivalVillage_003
Array.english: Haha, that's why y'all get such a nice view.
Array.indonesia: Haha, that's why y'all get such a nice view.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_IntroduceVillage_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! What a magnificent village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! What a magnificent village!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_IntroduceVillage_002
Array.english: I'm feeling lucky that there'll be plenty of interesting research material here.
Array.indonesia: I'm feeling lucky that there'll be plenty of interesting research material here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! Dr. Bacon, you actually made it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh...! Dr. Bacon, you actually made it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_002
Array.english: <size=32>How've you been?\nGood to see you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>How've you been?\nGood to see you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_003
Array.english: Ah, these are the guys helping with the investigation…\nI'm <color=#F1DC2B>Muna</color>. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Ah, these are the guys helping with the investigation…\nI'm <color=#F1DC2B>Muna</color>. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_004
Array.english: She used to work as my assistant... \nbut she's been on something like a sabbatical...
Array.indonesia: She used to work as my assistant... \nbut she's been on something like a sabbatical...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_005
Array.english: Ah... wasn't there something about you going into hiding after a failed crypto investment...?
Array.indonesia: Ah... wasn't there something about you going into hiding after a failed crypto investment...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_006
Array.english: <size=33>...Oh no, I can't believe you brought that up...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Oh no, I can't believe you brought that up...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_007
Array.english: ...If you disappear without notice again, it won't be this easy to get reinstated, Muna.
Array.indonesia: ...If you disappear without notice again, it won't be this easy to get reinstated, Muna.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_008
Array.english: <size=33>N-Now that I've made back my initial investment, \nI've gotta work hard! Really hard!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>N-Now that I've made back my initial investment, \nI've gotta work hard! Really hard!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_009
Array.english: Let's get to it then. Where's that dinosaur carcass you mentioned?
Array.indonesia: Let's get to it then. Where's that dinosaur carcass you mentioned?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_010
Array.english: Ah, right! You should probably check that out first.
Array.indonesia: Ah, right! You should probably check that out first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_MeetMuna_011
Array.english: <size=34>Come on, this way!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Come on, this way!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! That's one massive dinosaur...!!\nHow on earth did it get here...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wow! That's one massive dinosaur...!!\nHow on earth did it get here...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_002
Array.english: This is a freshwater lake...\nIsn't this a marine species?
Array.indonesia: This is a freshwater lake...\nIsn't this a marine species?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_003
Array.english: The bottom of this lake is connected to the ocean.
Array.indonesia: The bottom of this lake is connected to the ocean.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_004
Array.english: The water forms layers due to differences in density between saltwater and freshwater... Maybe it came up from the sea... hmm.
Array.indonesia: The water forms layers due to differences in density between saltwater and freshwater... Maybe it came up from the sea... hmm.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_005
Array.english: <size=35>...Wait...! That dinosaur, its belly looks swollen...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Wait...! That dinosaur, its belly looks swollen...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_FindBasiloBaby_006
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...! You're right!\nWe should get out of here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa...! You're right!\nWe should get out of here!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... what the heck was that...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... what the heck was that...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_002
Array.english: Hmm. I once read about a whale carcass that washed ashore and exploded.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I once read about a whale carcass that washed ashore and exploded.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_003
Array.english: Methane gas builds up from microbes in the stomach and causes an explosion... Doesn't have anything to do with the dinosaur itself, but...
Array.indonesia: Methane gas builds up from microbes in the stomach and causes an explosion... Doesn't have anything to do with the dinosaur itself, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_004
Array.english: <size=35>Seeing it in person is pretty horrifying.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Seeing it in person is pretty horrifying.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_005
Array.english: Ahem.
Array.indonesia: Ahem.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_006
Array.english: Ah...! My apologies.\nMay I ask who you are, sir?
Array.indonesia: Ah...! My apologies.\nMay I ask who you are, sir?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_007
Array.english: <size=33>I am <color=#F1DC2B>Panutah</color>, the village chief of Utara Village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I am <color=#F1DC2B>Panutah</color>, the village chief of Utara Village.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_008
Array.english: Are you the outsiders who have come to investigate the strange occurrences in this village?
Array.indonesia: Are you the outsiders who have come to investigate the strange occurrences in this village?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_009
Array.english: Yes, we experienced a similar phenomenon where we're from... So we're looking for a connection.
Array.indonesia: Yes, we experienced a similar phenomenon where we're from... So we're looking for a connection.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_010
Array.english: Hmm... until recently, we had frequent earthquakes.\nThey've lessened quite a bit now, however.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... until recently, we had frequent earthquakes.\nThey've lessened quite a bit now, however.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_01_AfterExplosion_011
