Array.indonesia: <size=34>Thanks so much! Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindArtwall_001
Array.english: That must be one of the <color=#F1DC2B>Stone Tablets</color> Muna was talking about.
Array.indonesia: That must be one of the <color=#F1DC2B>Stone Tablets</color> Muna was talking about.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindArtwall_002
Array.english: She said there'd be <color=#1DFEAF>3</color>, right? Let me take a photo of this one first.
Array.indonesia: She said there'd be <color=#1DFEAF>3</color>, right? Let me take a photo of this one first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindArtwall01_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not exactly sure what's going on,\nbut it looks like they're gathered doing something.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'm not exactly sure what's going on,\nbut it looks like they're gathered doing something.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindArtwall02_001
Array.english: This one... looks like it's depicting someone diving?
Array.indonesia: This one... looks like it's depicting someone diving?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindArtwall02_002
Array.english: So the ancient Sunang people really did dive deep into the lake.
Array.indonesia: So the ancient Sunang people really did dive deep into the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindArtwall03_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? Are those Sea People... holding spears?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hm? Are those Sea People... holding spears?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindArtwall03_002
Array.english: <size=33>Don't tell me there were Sea People here too...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Don't tell me there were Sea People here too...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindArtwall03_003
Array.english: But their outfits are different from the Sea People I've seen... They look more menacing, too.
Array.indonesia: But their outfits are different from the Sea People I've seen... They look more menacing, too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindArtwallAll_001
Array.english: Alright. I've got photos of all the tablets.\nI should head back to Muna.
Array.indonesia: Alright. I've got photos of all the tablets.\nI should head back to Muna.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindFilter_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... what's that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... what's that?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindFilter_002
Array.english: <size=34>It looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>Breathing Apparatus</color> from that tablet earlier...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>Breathing Apparatus</color> from that tablet earlier...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindFilter_003
Array.english: That must be what Muna was talking about.\nI should take a closer look.
Array.indonesia: That must be what Muna was talking about.\nI should take a closer look.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindFilter_001
Array.english: Hmm... I can still make out the shape, but it's too damaged.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I can still make out the shape, but it's too damaged.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_AfterFindFilter_002
Array.english: Well... I'm sure Dr. Bacon and Muna can figure something out.
Array.indonesia: Well... I'm sure Dr. Bacon and Muna can figure something out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindMetagunMaterial_001
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa...! What was that?!\nSomething just shook the lake from below...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Whoa...! What was that?!\nSomething just shook the lake from below...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindMetagunMaterial_002
Array.english: <size=30>Hm? Something's glinting in that pile of fallen branches...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Hm? Something's glinting in that pile of fallen branches...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindMetagunMaterial_003
Array.english: <size=30>I've never seen a mineral like this before.\nI should take it with me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>I've never seen a mineral like this before.\nI should take it with me.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindHydrogenSulfide_001
Array.english: Oh... it looks even brighter up close.\nI should find out what this is.
Array.indonesia: Oh... it looks even brighter up close.\nI should find out what this is.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_FindHydrogenSulfide_002
Array.english: That aside... the hydrogen sulfide levels are really high here. \nI shouldn't go any deeper.
Array.indonesia: That aside... the hydrogen sulfide levels are really high here. \nI shouldn't go any deeper.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! This really does look like the breathing apparatus from that stone tablet!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa! This really does look like the breathing apparatus from that stone tablet!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_002
Array.english: Hmm... With this, I can finally start some real research.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... With this, I can finally start some real research.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_003
Array.english: <size=32>If I compare it with the records the village chief gave me... Hehe... heh...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If I compare it with the records the village chief gave me... Hehe... heh...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_004
Array.english: Oh, now that I think about it, I spotted something glowing down below.
Array.indonesia: Oh, now that I think about it, I spotted something glowing down below.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_005
Array.english: Everything else was stained yellow by the hydrogen sulfide... but this one piece stayed completely clean.
Array.indonesia: Everything else was stained yellow by the hydrogen sulfide... but this one piece stayed completely clean.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_006
Array.english: ...May I take a closer look?
Array.indonesia: ...May I take a closer look?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_007
Array.english: <size=36>Whaaat!?!! Could this be... a <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Stone</color>...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Whaaat!?!! Could this be... a <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Stone</color>...!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_008
Array.english: Have you ever heard of the <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Civilization</color>? It's said to have existed in this region in ancient times.
Array.indonesia: Have you ever heard of the <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Civilization</color>? It's said to have existed in this region in ancient times.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_009
Array.english: Hmm... I think I read about it in a book once. An ancient civilization wiped out by a sudden rise in sea level...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I think I read about it in a book once. An ancient civilization wiped out by a sudden rise in sea level...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_010
Array.english: But I thought it was just a legend?
Array.indonesia: But I thought it was just a legend?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_011
Array.english: It's real! Sure, later generations may have exaggerated parts of it, but the civilization itself did exist.
Array.indonesia: It's real! Sure, later generations may have exaggerated parts of it, but the civilization itself did exist.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_012
Array.english: About 12,000 years ago... the <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Civilization</color> thrived on abundant mineral resources...
Array.indonesia: About 12,000 years ago... the <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Civilization</color> thrived on abundant mineral resources...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_013
Array.english: ...but was submerged by a sudden ice age and massive flooding...
Array.indonesia: ...but was submerged by a sudden ice age and massive flooding...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_014
Array.english: But! The Sunang people scattered across the world... and are believed to have laid the foundations of modern human civilization!
Array.indonesia: But! The Sunang people scattered across the world... and are believed to have laid the foundations of modern human civilization!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_015
Array.english: <size=34>And...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_016
Array.english: <size=34>And...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_017
Array.english: <size=32>There's even a theory that those who were submerged evolved into the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color>! A truly revolutionary idea, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>There's even a theory that those who were submerged evolved into the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color>! A truly revolutionary idea, hehe!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_018
Array.english: Anyway... this <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Stone</color> was essential for creating various artifacts back then.
Array.indonesia: Anyway... this <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Stone</color> was essential for creating various artifacts back then.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_019
Array.english: It contains highly concentrated energy.\nHow you use it makes all the difference.
Array.indonesia: It contains highly concentrated energy.\nHow you use it makes all the difference.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_020
Array.english: <size=33>If we harness its energy...\nwe can make the <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color> even stronger!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If we harness its energy...\nwe can make the <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color> even stronger!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_021
Array.english: <size=34>You'll notice a whole new level of performance compared to the materials we've been using!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You'll notice a whole new level of performance compared to the materials we've been using!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_022
Array.english: Well then... I'll take a closer look at the breathing apparatus.
Array.indonesia: Well then... I'll take a closer look at the breathing apparatus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_02_MunaTalk03_023
Array.english: It feels like everything's finally starting to come together... thanks to the materials you've been finding. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: It feels like everything's finally starting to come together... thanks to the materials you've been finding. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaKnock_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yaaawn... who is it this early in the morning...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yaaawn... who is it this early in the morning...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaKnock_002
Array.english: Sounds like Muna...\nI should go check.
Array.indonesia: Sounds like Muna...\nI should go check.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaComing_001
Array.english: <size=33>What brings you here so early?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What brings you here so early?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaComing_002
Array.english: Hehe... sorry about that.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... sorry about that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaComing_003
Array.english: There's something important... Could you come to my tent?
Array.indonesia: There's something important... Could you come to my tent?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaComing_004
Array.english: Alright... yawn.
Array.indonesia: Alright... yawn.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_001
Array.english: Dave, I think I've figured it out after putting together all the materials you brought me.
Array.indonesia: Dave, I think I've figured it out after putting together all the materials you brought me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_002
Array.english: <size=34>Look! Right here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Look! Right here...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_003
Array.english: See? Someone wearing something on their head and going down into the sea?
Array.indonesia: See? Someone wearing something on their head and going down into the sea?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_004
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... you're right.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... you're right.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_005
Array.english: The ancient Sunang people used the breathing apparatus you found to survive even in hydrogen sulfide.
Array.indonesia: The ancient Sunang people used the breathing apparatus you found to survive even in hydrogen sulfide.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_006
Array.english: <size=34>And here in the book the chief gave me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And here in the book the chief gave me...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_007
Array.english: It looks like they're wearing some kind of cloth wrapped around their bodies...?
Array.indonesia: It looks like they're wearing some kind of cloth wrapped around their bodies...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_008
Array.english: <size=32>Exactly! Not just the breathing apparatus, they also wore special cloth to protect themselves!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Exactly! Not just the breathing apparatus, they also wore special cloth to protect themselves!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_009
Array.english: ...Haa... haa... let me catch my breath...
Array.indonesia: ...Haa... haa... let me catch my breath...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_010
Array.english: <size=36>Do you know what the really shocking part is?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Do you know what the really shocking part is?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_011
Array.english: <size=33>It's that... the Sunang breathing apparatus and protective gear are stored in a nearby <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It's that... the Sunang breathing apparatus and protective gear are stored in a nearby <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_012
Array.english: <size=42>...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_013
Array.english: <size=33>Then I guess we should head to that <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Then I guess we should head to that <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_014
Array.english: Hmm... from what I've found, it's within walking distance...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... from what I've found, it's within walking distance...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_015
Array.english: But the path through the forest was blocked by a recent earthquake.
Array.indonesia: But the path through the forest was blocked by a recent earthquake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_016
Array.english: Hmm... Maybe the village chief knows another way?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Maybe the village chief knows another way?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAndMuna_017
Array.english: That's possible. Let's go ask together!
Array.indonesia: That's possible. Let's go ask together!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! Wait a moment, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Wait a moment, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_002
Array.english: About that <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Stone</color> you showed me yesterday...
Array.indonesia: About that <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Stone</color> you showed me yesterday...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_003
Array.english: <size=33>Have you seen any other glowing minerals in the lake?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Have you seen any other glowing minerals in the lake?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_004
Array.english: Hmm... I think I might have...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I think I might have...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_005
Array.english: But the water was so murky, I can't be sure.
Array.indonesia: But the water was so murky, I can't be sure.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_006
Array.english: Hehe... Those minerals contain sparkling ore crystals inside...
Array.indonesia: Hehe... Those minerals contain sparkling ore crystals inside...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_007
Array.english: <size=33>I've developed a machine that melts the protective layer! Hehehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I've developed a machine that melts the protective layer! Hehehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_008
Array.english: <size=33>Behold, the <color=#F1DC2B>Laser Emitter Model S</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Behold, the <color=#F1DC2B>Laser Emitter Model S</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_009
Array.english: If you keep shining this on those minerals...
Array.indonesia: If you keep shining this on those minerals...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_010
Array.english: The protective layer melts away, and ta-da!\nYou can extract the <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Stone</color> inside!
Array.indonesia: The protective layer melts away, and ta-da!\nYou can extract the <color=#1DFEAF>Sunang Stone</color> inside!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_011
Array.english: Oh... with that stone, I could make the <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color> even stronger.
Array.indonesia: Oh... with that stone, I could make the <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color> even stronger.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_012
Array.english: Hehe. I'll give you this <color=#F1DC2B>Laser Emitter</color> for free for now.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. I'll give you this <color=#F1DC2B>Laser Emitter</color> for free for now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_013
Array.english: Though upgrading to a higher model will cost you.
Array.indonesia: Though upgrading to a higher model will cost you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_014
Array.english: <size=33>Thanks! I'll try it out in the lake right away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thanks! I'll try it out in the lake right away!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_015
Array.english: Ah, but first we should head to the <color=#F1DC2B>Village Chief's House</color> and ask for directions to the temple.
Array.indonesia: Ah, but first we should head to the <color=#F1DC2B>Village Chief's House</color> and ask for directions to the temple.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_EnergyEmitter_016
Array.english: You're right. Let's go see the chief first.
Array.indonesia: You're right. Let's go see the chief first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>Murau Temple</color>, you say... To reach it, you'll need to pass through Setah Forest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>Murau Temple</color>, you say... To reach it, you'll need to pass through Setah Forest.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_002
Array.english: However... as you know, a massive <color=#1DFEAF>Boulder</color> fell during the recent earthquake and is blocking the path.
Array.indonesia: However... as you know, a massive <color=#1DFEAF>Boulder</color> fell during the recent earthquake and is blocking the path.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_003
Array.english: So there's no way to reach the temple now...?
Array.indonesia: So there's no way to reach the temple now...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_004
Array.english: <size=34>It's not impossible.\nYou just need to move that <color=#1DFEAF>Boulder</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It's not impossible.\nYou just need to move that <color=#1DFEAF>Boulder</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_005
Array.english: <size=35>That huge boulder?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>That huge boulder?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_006
Array.english: It won't be easy with just the few of you.
Array.indonesia: It won't be easy with just the few of you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_007
Array.english: The villagers must be unhappy with the rock blocking the path like that... Couldn't we push it together?
Array.indonesia: The villagers must be unhappy with the rock blocking the path like that... Couldn't we push it together?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_008
Array.english: That's the problem... The villagers aren't bothered by the path being blocked.
Array.indonesia: That's the problem... The villagers aren't bothered by the path being blocked.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_009
Array.english: In fact, they prefer it. It keeps wild animals from coming up here.
Array.indonesia: In fact, they prefer it. It keeps wild animals from coming up here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_010
Array.english: They wouldn't be pleased if I asked them to move it just to help outsiders.
Array.indonesia: They wouldn't be pleased if I asked them to move it just to help outsiders.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_011
Array.english: Hmm... then what should we do?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... then what should we do?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_012
Array.english: You'd probably only need <color=#F1DC2B>3 More Adults</color> to move it...
Array.indonesia: You'd probably only need <color=#F1DC2B>3 More Adults</color> to move it...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_013
Array.english: <size=34>Why not get to know the villagers and ask for their help?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Why not get to know the villagers and ask for their help?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_014
Array.english: If they trust you, they'll help. Even with difficult requests.
Array.indonesia: If they trust you, they'll help. Even with difficult requests.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_015
Array.english: You'll be staying here for a while anyway.\nIt wouldn't hurt to build some relationships.
Array.indonesia: You'll be staying here for a while anyway.\nIt wouldn't hurt to build some relationships.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_016
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>First, we need to get closer to the villagers...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>First, we need to get closer to the villagers...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HelpChief_017
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>Building trust at the Sea People Village was pretty exhausting. ...Guess we'd better get started.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Building trust at the Sea People Village was pretty exhausting. ...Guess we'd better get started.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BeforePushRock_001
Array.english: Hmm... a huge boulder is blocking the path.\nCan't go this way.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... a huge boulder is blocking the path.\nCan't go this way.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ReadyToMove_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright. I've got three people to help move the boulder.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright. I've got three people to help move the boulder.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ReadyToMove_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's head back to the <color=#1DFEAF>Village Chief's House</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's head back to the <color=#1DFEAF>Village Chief's House</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ReportChief_001
Array.english: Oh... so the villagers decided to help you.
Array.indonesia: Oh... so the villagers decided to help you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ReportChief_002
Array.english: Yes. Luckily, I found three people willing to help.
Array.indonesia: Yes. Luckily, I found three people willing to help.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ReportChief_003
Array.english: I see. Then let's head to the boulder together.
Array.indonesia: I see. Then let's head to the boulder together.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MoveTheRock_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm. Looks like everyone's already here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm. Looks like everyone's already here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MoveTheRock_002
Array.english: With this many people, you should be able to move it.\nYou won't need me.
Array.indonesia: With this many people, you should be able to move it.\nYou won't need me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MoveTheRock_003
Array.english: Just watch, Chief!\nWe'll handle it ourselves!
Array.indonesia: Just watch, Chief!\nWe'll handle it ourselves!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MoveTheRock_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. Alright then, let's get started.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. Alright then, let's get started.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_001
Array.english: <size=35>Phew... that was heavy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Phew... that was heavy.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_002
Array.english: Haha. When everyone works together, even something that big can be moved.
Array.indonesia: Haha. When everyone works together, even something that big can be moved.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_003
Array.english: Haha! Now we can finally use this path to reach the forest!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Now we can finally use this path to reach the forest!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_004
Array.english: That's true, but with the recent earthquakes and unstable conditions, the wild animals have become more aggressive.
Array.indonesia: That's true, but with the recent earthquakes and unstable conditions, the wild animals have become more aggressive.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_005
Array.english: If you head out there unprepared, you'll be easy prey.
Array.indonesia: If you head out there unprepared, you'll be easy prey.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_006
Array.english: Ugh... you're right. Going alone won't be easy.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... you're right. Going alone won't be easy.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_007
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! I know my way around land better than you do!! How about I tag along?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! I know my way around land better than you do!! How about I tag along?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_008
Array.english: Oh! I'd feel a lot safer with you.
Array.indonesia: Oh! I'd feel a lot safer with you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_009
Array.english: Now, you'll need a weapon if you're heading into the forest...
Array.indonesia: Now, you'll need a weapon if you're heading into the forest...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_010
Array.english: <size=32>Take this <color=#F1DC2B>Club</color>.\nI'll bring a gun.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Take this <color=#F1DC2B>Club</color>.\nI'll bring a gun.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_011
Array.english: <size=33>...I'd like to use a gun too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...I'd like to use a gun too.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_012
Array.english: You know firearms on land require a separate license!
Array.indonesia: You know firearms on land require a separate license!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_013
Array.english: <size=33>Don't worry. I'll keep you safe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Don't worry. I'll keep you safe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_014
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm... but...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm... but...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_015
Array.english: I haven't used a <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color> in a while... Feels like I'm a bit rusty.
Array.indonesia: I haven't used a <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color> in a while... Feels like I'm a bit rusty.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_016
Array.english: It'd be nice if there were somewhere nearby to get in some <color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Practice</color>... Could you check around for me?
Array.indonesia: It'd be nice if there were somewhere nearby to get in some <color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Practice</color>... Could you check around for me?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_017
Array.english: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Practice</color>, huh.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Practice</color>, huh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_UnlockThePath_018
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color> knows this area pretty well.\nHe might have an idea, I'll ask him.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Rimbo</color> knows this area pretty well.\nHe might have an idea, I'll ask him.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Rimbo_001
Array.english: <size=35><color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Practice</color>, you say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Practice</color>, you say?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Rimbo_002
Array.english: Hmm... truth be told, I used to do a bit of shooting myself.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... truth be told, I used to do a bit of shooting myself.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Rimbo_003
Array.english: <size=33>These days I've just been drivin', so I've forgotten \nmost of it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>These days I've just been drivin', so I've forgotten \nmost of it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Rimbo_004
Array.english: <size=33>There's a spot deeper out by the beach where I used to practice.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>There's a spot deeper out by the beach where I used to practice.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Rimbo_005
Array.english: <size=34>Come along. I'll show ya the way.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Come along. I'll show ya the way.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Ladder_001
Array.english: Phew. Had to set it up way out here 'cause of the noise... That's why we need this ladder.
Array.indonesia: Phew. Had to set it up way out here 'cause of the noise... That's why we need this ladder.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Ladder_002
Array.english: Haven't been comin' out here much lately, so I took \nthe ladder down...
Array.indonesia: Haven't been comin' out here much lately, so I took \nthe ladder down...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Ladder_003
Array.english: But I'll leave it here from now on.
Array.indonesia: But I'll leave it here from now on.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Ladder_004
Array.english: <size=32>Alright then, follow me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright then, follow me!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Intro01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... there are so many colorful flowers here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... there are so many colorful flowers here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Intro01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. The soil's a bit different from the village, so the plants and critters are different too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. The soil's a bit different from the village, so the plants and critters are different too.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Intro02_001
Array.english: If ya go further in, you'll see even more unusual flora and fauna...
Array.indonesia: If ya go further in, you'll see even more unusual flora and fauna...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Intro02_002
Array.english: The undergrowth's gotten real thick...\nYou'd need somethin' like a <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> to get through it.
Array.indonesia: The undergrowth's gotten real thick...\nYou'd need somethin' like a <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> to get through it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Intro03_001
Array.english: Now let's head up the path to the <color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Range</color>.
Array.indonesia: Now let's head up the path to the <color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Range</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Barricade_Forest_001
Array.english: We gotta find a place where Cobra can practice shooting. Let's come back when we're ready to go into the forest.
Array.indonesia: We gotta find a place where Cobra can practice shooting. Let's come back when we're ready to go into the forest.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Barricade_Ladder_001
Array.english: Cobra and Rimbo are waitin' up there, right?\nBetter head on up.
Array.indonesia: Cobra and Rimbo are waitin' up there, right?\nBetter head on up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? Not doin' any shooting practice?\nSince you're here, why not give it a try?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? Not doin' any shooting practice?\nSince you're here, why not give it a try?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv1_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright then, let's start with somethin' easy, just to get the feel for it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright then, let's start with somethin' easy, just to get the feel for it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv1_Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>See that <color=#F1DC2B>Target</color> up ahead?\nJust hit that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>See that <color=#F1DC2B>Target</color> up ahead?\nJust hit that.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv1_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! That's a piece of cake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! That's a piece of cake!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv1_Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe, go on and give it a shot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe, go on and give it a shot!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv1_Clear_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... looks like you've got some skill.\nLet's try the next level.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... looks like you've got some skill.\nLet's try the next level.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv2_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>This time, try shootin' at a <color=#F1DC2B>Moving Target</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This time, try shootin' at a <color=#F1DC2B>Moving Target</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv2_Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>It'll be tougher than a still target, but... \nWith your skills, Cobra, it shouldn't be much trouble.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It'll be tougher than a still target, but... \nWith your skills, Cobra, it shouldn't be much trouble.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv2_Start_003
Array.english: <size=33>If it's too tricky, try <color=#F1DC2B>Focusing</color>. \nIt'll make things a lot easier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If it's too tricky, try <color=#F1DC2B>Focusing</color>. \nIt'll make things a lot easier.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv2_Clear_001
Array.english: <size=33>Just as I thought! That was a walk in the park for ya! \nHow 'bout we make it a bit harder?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Just as I thought! That was a walk in the park for ya! \nHow 'bout we make it a bit harder?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv3_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Now over there you'll see <color=#F1DC2B>Human-Shaped Targets</color>... \nBest not hit those.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Now over there you'll see <color=#F1DC2B>Human-Shaped Targets</color>... \nBest not hit those.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv3_Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>Just hit the animal targets and avoid the human ones. Let's get started!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Just hit the animal targets and avoid the human ones. Let's get started!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv3_Clear_001
Array.english: <size=33>Excellent! Well done.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Excellent! Well done.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Lv3_Clear_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's call it a day.\nThat oughta do it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's call it a day.\nThat oughta do it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_Fail_001
Array.english: Hmm... not going as well as I thought.\nLet me try one more time.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... not going as well as I thought.\nLet me try one more time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Now I'm getting the hang of it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Now I'm getting the hang of it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete_002
Array.english: Hehe. That's a relief. I'll leave the <color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Range</color> open, \nso feel free to use it anytime.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. That's a relief. I'll leave the <color=#F1DC2B>Shooting Range</color> open, \nso feel free to use it anytime.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete_003
Array.english: Oh... can I come here and practice too?
Array.indonesia: Oh... can I come here and practice too?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe! Of course.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe! Of course.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete_005
Array.english: Besides what Cobra tried earlier, there are two more difficult stages.
Array.indonesia: Besides what Cobra tried earlier, there are two more difficult stages.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete_006
Array.english: <size=32>Whenever ya want to use it, just climb up this ladder here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Whenever ya want to use it, just climb up this ladder here!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! I'm getting warmed up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! I'm getting warmed up!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete02_002
Array.english: I'll clean the firearms today, and we'll head out at dawn tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: I'll clean the firearms today, and we'll head out at dawn tomorrow.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Let's meet at the entrance to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's meet at the entrance to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GunPractice_complete02_004
Array.english: Alright, got it. I should get ready too.
Array.indonesia: Alright, got it. I should get ready too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GoToForest_Start_001
Array.english: Today, I'm heading to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> with Cobra, right?
Array.indonesia: Today, I'm heading to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> with Cobra, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GoToForest_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's head to where the big boulder was.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's head to where the big boulder was.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GoToForest_Ask_001
Array.english: <size=34>You're here!\nReady to head into the forest?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You're here!\nReady to head into the forest?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GoToTheForest_Option01
Array.english: Yes, I'm ready
Array.indonesia: Yes, I'm ready

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GoToTheForest_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Not yet

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GoToForest_Go_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Then let's get going!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Then let's get going!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_GoToForest_Later_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. Come back when you're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright. Come back when you're ready!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_EnterForest_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow...! The trees are so dense here...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow...! The trees are so dense here...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_EnterForest_002
Array.english: <size=34>Now this is a proper jungle!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Now this is a proper jungle!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_EnterForest_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's dangerous on your own, so don't fall behind.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's dangerous on your own, so don't fall behind.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_Forest_Event_FirstMonsterFound_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... there's a really big wild rat...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... there's a really big wild rat...!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_Forest_Event_FirstMonsterFound_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... the chief did say the creatures in this forest have gotten more aggressive.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... the chief did say the creatures in this forest have gotten more aggressive.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_Forest_Event_FirstMonsterFound_003
Array.english: <size=34>Be careful, they might attack if you get too close!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Be careful, they might attack if you get too close!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_BattleTutorial_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah...! We're under attack...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah...! We're under attack...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_BattleTutorial_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>Just like we heard, the animals are aggressive!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Just like we heard, the animals are aggressive!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_BattleTutorial_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Time to use our weapons!\nStay sharp!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Time to use our weapons!\nStay sharp!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Sound_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hm? Did you hear that too?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hm? Did you hear that too?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Sound_002
Array.english: Huh? I think I heard a dog whimpering...
Array.indonesia: Huh? I think I heard a dog whimpering...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Sound_003
Array.english: <size=32>Sounds like it came from the left path.\nLet's go check it out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sounds like it came from the left path.\nLet's go check it out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Sound_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Weren't we heading toward where we heard the puppy?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Weren't we heading toward where we heard the puppy?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FirstMeet_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh...! There's a puppy stuck down there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh...! There's a puppy stuck down there!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FirstMeet_002
Array.english: Hmm... poor thing. It's not a deep pit, but it won't be easy for it to get out on its own.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... poor thing. It's not a deep pit, but it won't be easy for it to get out on its own.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FirstMeet_003
Array.english: And it seems wary of us. It's hiding deeper inside and won't come out.
Array.indonesia: And it seems wary of us. It's hiding deeper inside and won't come out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FirstMeet_004
Array.english: We'll probably need to lure it out with some food...
Array.indonesia: We'll probably need to lure it out with some food...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FirstMeet_005
Array.english: It must be hungry. How about we grill some <color=#F1DC2B>Meat</color>?
Array.indonesia: It must be hungry. How about we grill some <color=#F1DC2B>Meat</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FirstMeet_006
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, that's a good idea!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, that's a good idea!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_HaveMeat_001
Array.english: <size=32>I did bring some <color=#F1DC2B>Raw Meat</color>...\nWe just need a place to start a fire.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I did bring some <color=#F1DC2B>Raw Meat</color>...\nWe just need a place to start a fire.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_NoMeat_001
Array.english: Let's start by hunting nearby wildlife to get some <color=#F1DC2B>Raw Meat</color>.
Array.indonesia: Let's start by hunting nearby wildlife to get some <color=#F1DC2B>Raw Meat</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_AfterGetMeat_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. I got the <color=#F1DC2B>Raw Meat</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright. I got the <color=#F1DC2B>Raw Meat</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_AfterGetMeat_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's look around for a place nearby where we can cook it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's look around for a place nearby where we can cook it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Meat_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like I can get some <color=#F1DC2B>Raw Meat</color> if I hunt that wild animal up ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Looks like I can get some <color=#F1DC2B>Raw Meat</color> if I hunt that wild animal up ahead.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FindFireSite_001
Array.english: <size=32>We can start a fire over there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>We can start a fire over there!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FindFireSite_002
Array.english: <size=33>Nice find! Let's get a fire going!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Nice find! Let's get a fire going!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_GetCookedMeat_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! It's grilled to perfection!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! It's grilled to perfection!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_GetCookedMeat_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's head back to the puppy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's head back to the puppy!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_BeforeMinigame_001
Array.english: Now let's try luring it out with the fresh grilled meat.
Array.indonesia: Now let's try luring it out with the fresh grilled meat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_BeforeMinigame_002
Array.english: <size=32>Dave, grab my legs. I'll have to pull it up myself. \nGrabbing you might be a challenge for me, huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dave, grab my legs. I'll have to pull it up myself. \nGrabbing you might be a challenge for me, huh?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_BeforeMinigame_003
Array.english: <size=34>Yeah... I know, you don't have to say it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yeah... I know, you don't have to say it...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Minigame_First_001
Array.english: <size=33>Looks like he was hungry after all!\nNow that he's close, I'll try pulling him up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Looks like he was hungry after all!\nNow that he's close, I'll try pulling him up.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Minigame_Fail_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... he's still a bit wary...\nGive him a little more food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... he's still a bit wary...\nGive him a little more food!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Minigame_Second_001
Array.english: <size=32>Good. Looks less tense than before.\nLet's give him a bit more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Good. Looks less tense than before.\nLet's give him a bit more.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Minigame_Third_001
Array.english: <size=33>He's letting his guard down!\nI'll scoop him up now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>He's letting his guard down!\nI'll scoop him up now!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Minigame_GrabFail_001
Array.english: Ah... I lost my grip...\nLet's try again.
Array.indonesia: Ah... I lost my grip...\nLet's try again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Minigame_GrabComplete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hahaha! What an adorable little guy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hahaha! What an adorable little guy!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Minigame_GrabComplete_002
Array.english: Haha, he looks happy to be out.
Array.indonesia: Haha, he looks happy to be out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_Minigame_GrabComplete_003
Array.english: Now don't get lost and head home safely!
Array.indonesia: Now don't get lost and head home safely!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? He's following us?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? He's following us?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_002
Array.english: <size=32>You don't have anywhere to go...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You don't have anywhere to go...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_003
Array.english: We're heading somewhere dangerous. You should head back to the village.
Array.indonesia: We're heading somewhere dangerous. You should head back to the village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_004
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! That tail won't stop wagging! Looks like he's taken a liking to you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! That tail won't stop wagging! Looks like he's taken a liking to you.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_005
Array.english: Hmm... this is tricky... It'd feel wrong to just leave him here.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... this is tricky... It'd feel wrong to just leave him here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_006
Array.english: <size=33>Alright... let's take him with us!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright... let's take him with us!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_007
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Exploring ruins with a puppy...\nNow that's a first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Exploring ruins with a puppy...\nNow that's a first!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_008
Array.english: <size=34>We should give this little guy a name.\nDave, got anything in mind?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>We should give this little guy a name.\nDave, got anything in mind?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_009
Array.english: <size=38>Hmm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hmm...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_010
Array.english: <size=33>How about <color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color>? He was the main character in a cartoon I watched as a kid.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>How about <color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color>? He was the main character in a cartoon I watched as a kid.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_011
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! I've seen that one too! Wasn't there an episode where he got trapped in a cave and escaped? Fits him perfectly!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! I've seen that one too! Wasn't there an episode where he got trapped in a cave and escaped? Fits him perfectly!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_FollowDave_012
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, let's head to the ruins with <color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright, let's head to the ruins with <color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Marone_BeforeRescue_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>I can't just leave the puppy behind, can I?\nBetter rescue it first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I can't just leave the puppy behind, can I?\nBetter rescue it first.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindDungeon_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh...! There's an entrance to some ruins over there...! Could that be it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh...! There's an entrance to some ruins over there...! Could that be it?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindDungeon_002
Array.english: <size=33>Yeah, that looks like the place.\nLet's head inside.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Yeah, that looks like the place.\nLet's head inside.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindDungeon_003
Array.english: Yeah... looks kind of creepy. There aren't any dangerous animals in there, right?
Array.indonesia: Yeah... looks kind of creepy. There aren't any dangerous animals in there, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindDungeon_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Relax.\nAt worst, it'll just be some bats!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Relax.\nAt worst, it'll just be some bats!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FirstEnterDungeon_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... it's pretty dark in here...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... it's pretty dark in here...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FirstEnterDungeon_002
Array.english: Good thing I brought a <color=#F1DC2B>Lantern</color>!
Array.indonesia: Good thing I brought a <color=#F1DC2B>Lantern</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FirstEnterDungeon_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Came prepared, huh?\nLet's head deeper inside!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Came prepared, huh?\nLet's head deeper inside!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindFirstDoor_001
Array.english: There's a tightly sealed stone door over there...
Array.indonesia: There's a tightly sealed stone door over there...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindFirstDoor_002
Array.english: There must be a way to open it... \nShould we try pushing that <color=#F1DC2B>Big Stone</color>?
Array.indonesia: There must be a way to open it... \nShould we try pushing that <color=#F1DC2B>Big Stone</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FirstOpenDoor_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! It actually opened...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoa...! It actually opened...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FirstOpenDoor_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha!! Now that I think about it, I've seen this kind of contraption before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha!! Now that I think about it, I've seen this kind of contraption before!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FirstOpenDoor_003
Array.english: <size=32>I'm sure there'll be more blocked paths like this ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm sure there'll be more blocked paths like this ahead.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FirstOpenDoor_004
Array.english: <size=33>There's gotta be a way to activate them, \nso keep your eyes open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>There's gotta be a way to activate them, \nso keep your eyes open!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondGimmick_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... looks like there are more contraptions here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... looks like there are more contraptions here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondGimmick_002
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like they're meant to keep intruders out...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Looks like they're meant to keep intruders out...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondGimmick_003
Array.english: <size=33>Still, there's definitely a way to open them.\nTake a close look at how they work.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Still, there's definitely a way to open them.\nTake a close look at how they work.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindStairsDown_001
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindStairsDown_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... there are stairs behind the door...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... there are stairs behind the door...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindStairsDown_003
Array.english: <size=32>If we want the ancient Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>, \nwe'll have to go down...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If we want the ancient Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>, \nwe'll have to go down...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindStairsDown_004
Array.english: <size=34>Pretty creepy...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Pretty creepy...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindStairsDown_005
Array.english: <size=32>But we didn't come all this way to turn back, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But we didn't come all this way to turn back, right?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindStairsDown_006
Array.english: <size=32>I've got your back, go on down.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I've got your back, go on down.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorFirstPuzzle_001
Array.english: <size=33>Looks like there are more contraptions here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Looks like there are more contraptions here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorFirstPuzzle_002
Array.english: <size=33>They look a bit more complicated though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>They look a bit more complicated though...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorFirstPuzzle_003
Array.english: <size=33>Doesn't look too different from the one upstairs. \nI'm counting on you, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Doesn't look too different from the one upstairs. \nI'm counting on you, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorFirstPuzzleSolve_001
Array.english: <size=34>I'm getting tired of pushing these stones...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I'm getting tired of pushing these stones...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorFirstPuzzleSolve_002
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! We're almost there!\nHead through the open door!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! We're almost there!\nHead through the open door!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorFirstPuzzleSolve_003
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorPuzzleEnter_001
Array.english: <size=33>That looks like the door over there...\nbut the path isn't connected.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That looks like the door over there...\nbut the path isn't connected.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorPuzzleEnter_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... there must be a contraption to move the path. \nLook for it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... there must be a contraption to move the path. \nLook for it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorPuzzleSolve_001
Array.english: <size=35>Nice work! The door's open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Nice work! The door's open!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorPuzzleSolve_002
Array.english: Woof woof!!
Array.indonesia: Woof woof!!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorPuzzleSolve_003
Array.english: <size=32>Marone's really excited.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Marone's really excited.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_SecondFloorPuzzleSolve_004
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! We've come this far... Let's keep going until we find the ancient Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright! We've come this far... Let's keep going until we find the ancient Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_001
Array.english: <size=32>This floor is flooded.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>This floor is flooded.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_002
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm... this smell...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm... this smell...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_003
Array.english: <size=34>This isn't freshwater...?\nIt's saltwater!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This isn't freshwater...?\nIt's saltwater!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_004
Array.english: <size=32>Really...? I thought the ocean was pretty far from here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Really...? I thought the ocean was pretty far from here...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_005
Array.english: <size=32>If it connects to the ocean... there's a better chance the <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color> is behind that door!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If it connects to the ocean... there's a better chance the <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color> is behind that door!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_006
Array.english: Hmm... that groove under the pattern...\nFeels like something's meant to fit in there.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... that groove under the pattern...\nFeels like something's meant to fit in there.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_007
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... what's that...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... what's that...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_008
Array.english: <size=33>It's the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Moon</color> Crests! \nLooks like there's one at the end of each path.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It's the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Moon</color> Crests! \nLooks like there's one at the end of each path.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_009
Array.english: Huh? How do you know?
Array.indonesia: Huh? How do you know?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_010
Array.english: <size=32>...Just a vague memory from a game I played before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Just a vague memory from a game I played before!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorEnter_011
Array.english: <size=33>Let's head through the <color=#F1DC2B>Left</color> door first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's head through the <color=#F1DC2B>Left</color> door first.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorSunPickUp_001
Array.english: <size=34>This is... the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Crest</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This is... the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Crest</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorSunPickUp_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's see if it fits into the slot first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's see if it fits into the slot first.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMonster_001
Array.english: Grrrr!
Array.indonesia: Grrrr!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMonster_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ah! Looks like something triggered one of the contraptions!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah! Looks like something triggered one of the contraptions!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMonster_003
Array.english: <size=34>Let's deal with these guys first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let's deal with these guys first!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorCageOpen_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew, that was close.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew, that was close.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorCageOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>If they set up a trap like this, there must be something important inside.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If they set up a trap like this, there must be something important inside.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorCageOpen_003
Array.english: <size=32>We're almost there. Let's try placing the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Crest</color> into \nthe slot first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>We're almost there. Let's try placing the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Crest</color> into \nthe slot first!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorSunInsert_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... half the door is glowing blue...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... half the door is glowing blue...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorSunInsert_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Put in the other relic and it should work!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Put in the other relic and it should work!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorSunInsert_003
Array.english: <size=32>The right side's open. Let's go get the <color=#1DFEAF>Moon Crest</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The right side's open. Let's go get the <color=#1DFEAF>Moon Crest</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorSunInsert_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hey, Dave! Why don't we try placing the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Crest</color> in the door first?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hey, Dave! Why don't we try placing the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Crest</color> in the door first?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonEnter_001
Array.english: <size=33>These contraptions are pretty complex...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>These contraptions are pretty complex...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonEnter_002
Array.english: <size=32>Told you.\nThey're protecting something important!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Told you.\nThey're protecting something important!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonEnter_003
Array.english: <size=33>Let's tackle them one at a time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's tackle them one at a time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonEnter_004
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonSolve_001
Array.english: <size=34>Nice! It's the <color=#1DFEAF>Moon Crest</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Nice! It's the <color=#1DFEAF>Moon Crest</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonSolve_002
Array.english: <size=34>Let's go back to the central door!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let's go back to the central door!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonDoorStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, try fitting the relic into the door matching its shape.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, try fitting the relic into the door matching its shape.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonDoorOpen_001
Array.english: <size=34>Excellent! The door's opened!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Excellent! The door's opened!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonDoorOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>The ancient Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color> should be inside. \nLet's go.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The ancient Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color> should be inside. \nLet's go.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_ThirdFloorMoonDoorOpen_003
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_NoSun_001
Array.english: I think we'll need the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Crest</color>... Let's look around.
Array.indonesia: I think we'll need the <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Crest</color>... Let's look around.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_NoMoon_001
Array.english: I think we'll need the <color=#1DFEAF>Moon Crest</color>... Let's look around.
Array.indonesia: I think we'll need the <color=#1DFEAF>Moon Crest</color>... Let's look around.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindObjects_001
Array.english: <size=34>There's something up ahead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>There's something up ahead!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindObjects_002
Array.english: <size=32>Mwahaha! Sitting on an altar like that...\nThat's gotta be it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mwahaha! Sitting on an altar like that...\nThat's gotta be it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindObjects_003
Array.english: <size=35>Grab it quick and let's get out of here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Grab it quick and let's get out of here!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_FindObjects_004
Array.english: <size=35>Hmm... but usually in situations like this...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hmm... but usually in situations like this...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_MeetMudSkipperBoss_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...! It's a giant goby...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa...! It's a giant goby...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_MeetMudSkipperBoss_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh...! Knew it wouldn't be that easy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh...! Knew it wouldn't be that easy!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_MeetMudSkipperBoss_003
Array.english: <size=34>You've picked up plenty of skills by now, right? \nIf we work together, we can take it down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You've picked up plenty of skills by now, right? \nIf we work together, we can take it down!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WinMudSkipperBoss_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! You've gotten stronger, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! You've gotten stronger, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WinMudSkipperBoss_002
Array.english: <size=33>Marone, you did great too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Marone, you did great too!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WinMudSkipperBoss_003
Array.english: Woof!!
Array.indonesia: Woof!!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WinMudSkipperBoss_004
Array.english: Gobies usually live where rivers meet the sea...\nSo this must've been the perfect spot for it.
Array.indonesia: Gobies usually live where rivers meet the sea...\nSo this must've been the perfect spot for it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WinMudSkipperBoss_005
Array.english: And with no real predators around, even more so.
Array.indonesia: And with no real predators around, even more so.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WinMudSkipperBoss_006
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, let's grab that Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright, let's grab that Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_MudSkipperBossRetry_001
Array.english: <size=32>That goby from before...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That goby from before...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_MudSkipperBossRetry_002
Array.english:
<size=33>Ready to go?
Let's take it down once more!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33>Ready to go?
Let's take it down once more!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_001
Array.english: Oh... so this is what the ancient Sunang people used to dive...!
Array.indonesia: Oh... so this is what the ancient Sunang people used to dive...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_002
Array.english: Pretty well preserved for something this old.
Array.indonesia: Pretty well preserved for something this old.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_003
Array.english: It's pretty intricate too. Looks like the Sunang had impressive technology.
Array.indonesia: It's pretty intricate too. Looks like the Sunang had impressive technology.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_004
Array.english: This fabric's really thick, should handle hydrogen sulfide \njust fine.
Array.indonesia: This fabric's really thick, should handle hydrogen sulfide \njust fine.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Find_OldFilter_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Then let's take it to Muna and have her upgrade the equipment!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Then let's take it to Muna and have her upgrade the equipment!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_AfterFind_OldFilter_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, looks like Marone found a <color=#1DFEAF>Lift</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, looks like Marone found a <color=#1DFEAF>Lift</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_AfterFind_OldFilter_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's ride it up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's ride it up!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_AfterFind_OldFilter_003
Array.english: Uh... is it safe...?
Array.indonesia: Uh... is it safe...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_AfterFind_OldFilter_004
Array.english: <size=33>Mwahaha! Marone found it!\nNothing to worry about!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mwahaha! Marone found it!\nNothing to worry about!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_OldFilter_001
Array.english: <size=32>Going back now doesn't seem like a good idea.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Going back now doesn't seem like a good idea.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_B2to1_01_001
Array.english: Phew... that rattling had me worried, but it works fine.
Array.indonesia: Phew... that rattling had me worried, but it works fine.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_B2to1_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's already evening...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's already evening...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_B2to1_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's head back before it gets any darker.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's head back before it gets any darker.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_B2to1_003
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_DrainageRoomDoor_001
Array.english: <size=32>What's this door...? There's something written on it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What's this door...? There's something written on it...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_DrainageRoomDoor_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should ask Muna about it later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should ask Muna about it later.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_Ladder_001
Array.english: <size=32>There's a ladder here...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>There's a ladder here...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_Ladder_002
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe there used to be a way down there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maybe there used to be a way down there.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... it's pretty lively out here...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... it's pretty lively out here...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, Dave! Perfect timing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, Dave! Perfect timing!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_003
Array.english: <size=32>There's a coming-of-age ceremony tonight!\nIt's about to start!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>There's a coming-of-age ceremony tonight!\nIt's about to start!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_004
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...? What a cute puppy...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...? What a cute puppy...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_004_02
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_005
Array.english: Oh, we found him stuck in a pit in the forest...\nHe kept following us after that.
Array.indonesia: Oh, we found him stuck in a pit in the forest...\nHe kept following us after that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_006
Array.english: <size=32>He may look cute, but he's pretty fierce in a fight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>He may look cute, but he's pretty fierce in a fight!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_007
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... I hope it stays in the village<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... I hope it stays in the village<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_008
Array.english: Oh, right... Did you manage to bring back the items from \nthe temple?
Array.indonesia: Oh, right... Did you manage to bring back the items from \nthe temple?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_009
Array.english: Yes. I think this is the <color=#F1DC2B>Breathing Apparatus</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Cloth</color> the chief mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Yes. I think this is the <color=#F1DC2B>Breathing Apparatus</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Cloth</color> the chief mentioned.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_010
Array.english: <size=32>Ooh... it really was there!!\nWhat a lucky day!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ooh... it really was there!!\nWhat a lucky day!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_011
Array.english: Hehehe... nice work. I think I can come up with something interesting after studying this... hehe.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe... nice work. I think I can come up with something interesting after studying this... hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_012
Array.english: Glad to hear that. I'm going to get some rest...\nI'm exhausted after that trip.
Array.indonesia: Glad to hear that. I'm going to get some rest...\nI'm exhausted after that trip.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_013
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! What are you talking about?! On a day like this, \nwe should enjoy the festival!!</size>
