Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! What are you talking about?! On a day like this, \nwe should enjoy the festival!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_014
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...? Me too...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh...? Me too...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_Festival_015
Array.english: <size=34>Ku-haha!! Perfect timing, I was just getting hungry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ku-haha!! Perfect timing, I was just getting hungry!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? What's with the puppy?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? What's with the puppy?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_002
Array.english: Oh... we found him in the forest... \nWould it be alright if he stayed in the village?
Array.indonesia: Oh... we found him in the forest... \nWould it be alright if he stayed in the village?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_003
Array.english: Sure, why not. \nJust make sure it doesn't get eaten by a crocodile!
Array.indonesia: Sure, why not. \nJust make sure it doesn't get eaten by a crocodile!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_004
Array.english: That's a scary thought...
Array.indonesia: That's a scary thought...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Chief! Anyway...\nI'm starving, got anything to eat?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Chief! Anyway...\nI'm starving, got anything to eat?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_006
Array.english: Heh, didn't you say the food in this village didn't taste good?
Array.indonesia: Heh, didn't you say the food in this village didn't taste good?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_007
Array.english: Hahaha. That's a bit harsh! It's just that Bancho's got a picky palate!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha. That's a bit harsh! It's just that Bancho's got a picky palate!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_008
Array.english: Hehe. I'm joking.\nLet me get you something to eat and drink.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. I'm joking.\nLet me get you something to eat and drink.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_009
Array.english: But under one condition...
Array.indonesia: But under one condition...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_010
Array.english: <size=33>...A condition?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...A condition?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_011
Array.english: Today is <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color>'s coming-of-age ceremony.\nHe still seems like a kid, but he's already grown.
Array.indonesia: Today is <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color>'s coming-of-age ceremony.\nHe still seems like a kid, but he's already grown.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_012
Array.english: For these ceremonies, Peneb always played the <color=#F1DC2B>Drums</color>...\nBut as you know, he injured his arm and can't play.
Array.indonesia: For these ceremonies, Peneb always played the <color=#F1DC2B>Drums</color>...\nBut as you know, he injured his arm and can't play.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_013
Array.english: <size=33>I spoke with Peneb...\nand he suggested you could take his place.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I spoke with Peneb...\nand he suggested you could take his place.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_014
Array.english: Given how much you've helped the village, it would be just right for you to also participate in the celebration.
Array.indonesia: Given how much you've helped the village, it would be just right for you to also participate in the celebration.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_015
Array.english: ...I appreciate it, but... \nI've never really played <color=#F1DC2B>Drums</color> before...
Array.indonesia: ...I appreciate it, but... \nI've never really played <color=#F1DC2B>Drums</color> before...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_016
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, don't overthink it. Just hit the center and the edge in rhythm with the beat.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, don't overthink it. Just hit the center and the edge in rhythm with the beat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_017
Array.english: I'll give you a signal when it's your turn,\nso just enjoy the ceremony until then.
Array.indonesia: I'll give you a signal when it's your turn,\nso just enjoy the ceremony until then.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Arrive_Festival_018
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... Alright. Got it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... Alright. Got it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_1F_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>It'd be a waste to turn back now.\nLet's keep going.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It'd be a waste to turn back now.\nLet's keep going.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_B1F_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>It'd be a waste to turn back now.\nLet's keep going.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It'd be a waste to turn back now.\nLet's keep going.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_B2F_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=34>It'd be a waste to turn back now.\nLet's keep going.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It'd be a waste to turn back now.\nLet's keep going.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_FestivalMinigame_001
Array.english: <size=35>Dave, now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dave, now!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Before_FestivalMinigame_002
Array.english: <size=35>Listen to the rhythm and follow the beat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Listen to the rhythm and follow the beat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_StartFreeTime_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, well done. You helped make Jaka's coming-of-age ceremony a success.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, well done. You helped make Jaka's coming-of-age ceremony a success.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_StartFreeTime_002
Array.english: You've come back from the Setah Forest. You must be tired... Take a look around and get some rest.
Array.indonesia: You've come back from the Setah Forest. You must be tired... Take a look around and get some rest.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! This village's coconut wine is incredible!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! This village's coconut wine is incredible!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_002
Array.english: <size=33>Feels like all the fatigue from the day is just melting away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Feels like all the fatigue from the day is just melting away!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_003
Array.english: <size=34>You're not having any?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You're not having any?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_004
Array.english: I was so tense today, I'm exhausted.\nAnd I even had to play the drums.
Array.indonesia: I was so tense today, I'm exhausted.\nAnd I even had to play the drums.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Cobra_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! I can imagine. There's plenty of good food, \nat least fill your stomach!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! I can imagine. There's plenty of good food, \nat least fill your stomach!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_001
Array.english: What are you writing, Bancho?
Array.indonesia: What are you writing, Bancho?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_002
Array.english: I helped prepare some of the festival dishes earlier today... \nbut I'm not fully satisfied with them.
Array.indonesia: I helped prepare some of the festival dishes earlier today... \nbut I'm not fully satisfied with them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_003
Array.english: I still haven't fully grasped the local herbs and spices, \nso the balance was off.
Array.indonesia: I still haven't fully grasped the local herbs and spices, \nso the balance was off.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_004
Array.english: <size=32>I thought they were really good, though?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I thought they were really good, though?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_005
Array.english: Your standards are too high, Bancho.\nAll the villagers are really enjoying it.
Array.indonesia: Your standards are too high, Bancho.\nAll the villagers are really enjoying it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bancho_006
Array.english: Still... learning new ingredients in a place like this is enlightening.
Array.indonesia: Still... learning new ingredients in a place like this is enlightening.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_001
Array.english: Dr. Bacon, you've already had quite a bit...
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon, you've already had quite a bit...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! The festival atmosphere is amazing...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! The festival atmosphere is amazing...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_003
Array.english: <size=33>You need to unwind like this once in a while for things to go well!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You need to unwind like this once in a while for things to go well!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'm really hitting it off with the locals here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm really hitting it off with the locals here!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Bacon_005
Array.english: You still need to look at the Sunang civilization artifacts, \nso don't drink too much...
Array.indonesia: You still need to look at the Sunang civilization artifacts, \nso don't drink too much...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_001
Array.english: It's been a while since you arrived.\nHow are you settling in?
Array.indonesia: It's been a while since you arrived.\nHow are you settling in?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_002
Array.english: Yeah, I was worried at first. But once you get to know people, most of them are really kind.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, I was worried at first. But once you get to know people, most of them are really kind.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_003
Array.english: <size=35>Haha, glad to hear it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha, glad to hear it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_004
Array.english: We've had quite a few strange outsiders pass through...
Array.indonesia: We've had quite a few strange outsiders pass through...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_005
Array.english: Some even damaged our heritage... or brought in invasive species...
Array.indonesia: Some even damaged our heritage... or brought in invasive species...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_006
Array.english: <size=33>But you're different.\nYou're doing well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But you're different.\nYou're doing well.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chief_007
Array.english: <size=33>It's a good day, so relax and enjoy yourselves.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It's a good day, so relax and enjoy yourselves.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Muna_001
Array.english: ...Cut the cloth like this... \nand the breathing apparatus goes here...
Array.indonesia: ...Cut the cloth like this... \nand the breathing apparatus goes here...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Muna_002
Array.english: Hmm? Muna, aren't you enjoying the festival?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Muna, aren't you enjoying the festival?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Muna_003
Array.english: Hehe, I already ate.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, I already ate.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Muna_004
Array.english: I actually enjoy the festival more when I'm working on the things you bring me, Dave.
Array.indonesia: I actually enjoy the festival more when I'm working on the things you bring me, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rimbo_001
Array.english: That was a wonderful performance, Rimbo!
Array.indonesia: That was a wonderful performance, Rimbo!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rimbo_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, Dave, for your first time, ya kept the rhythm real well!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, Dave, for your first time, ya kept the rhythm real well!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rimbo_003
Array.english: Hehe, glad I didn't mess it up.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, glad I didn't mess it up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Rimbo_004
Array.english: <size=32>Well then, go on and enjoy the festival!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well then, go on and enjoy the festival!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Herbalist_001
Array.english: Oh, are you enjoying the festival?
Array.indonesia: Oh, are you enjoying the festival?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Herbalist_002
Array.english: Yes, I really like the atmosphere.
Array.indonesia: Yes, I really like the atmosphere.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Herbalist_003
Array.english: Heh. The festival, combined with the coming-of-age ceremony, is truly remarkable.
Array.indonesia: Heh. The festival, combined with the coming-of-age ceremony, is truly remarkable.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Herbalist_004
Array.english: I hope you enjoy your time here.
Array.indonesia: I hope you enjoy your time here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Fisherman_001
Array.english: <size=33>I caught the fish they served at today's festival!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I caught the fish they served at today's festival!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Fisherman_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... really! It was delicious!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... really! It was delicious!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Fisherman_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Reeled in some mighty fine fish!\nLuck was on my side today!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Reeled in some mighty fine fish!\nLuck was on my side today!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Carpenter_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, it's nice to get out like this once in a while.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, it's nice to get out like this once in a while.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Carpenter_002
Array.english: That makes sense, you're usually working at home.
Array.indonesia: That makes sense, you're usually working at home.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Carpenter_003
Array.english: Still, you need to recover, so don't drink too much.
Array.indonesia: Still, you need to recover, so don't drink too much.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Lipah_001
Array.english: Hehe. Thank you for joining our festival.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Thank you for joining our festival.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Lipah_002
Array.english: <size=32>Your performance earlier was wonderful!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Your performance earlier was wonderful!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Lipah_003
Array.english: ...Hehe, it was nothing.\nI'm just glad the chief invited us.
Array.indonesia: ...Hehe, it was nothing.\nI'm just glad the chief invited us.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Lipah_004
Array.english: And the food's really good too...
Array.indonesia: And the food's really good too...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Farmer_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He's completely absorbed in dancing.\nBetter not interrupt... or he'll give me an earful.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(He's completely absorbed in dancing.\nBetter not interrupt... or he'll give me an earful.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_001
Array.english: You did great today, Dave.
Array.indonesia: You did great today, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_002
Array.english: Dad asked you out of nowhere. \nThat must've caught you off guard, huh?
Array.indonesia: Dad asked you out of nowhere. \nThat must've caught you off guard, huh?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_003
Array.english: Well... it did, but...
Array.indonesia: Well... it did, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_004
Array.english: <size=32>It was still fun, though!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It was still fun, though!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_005
Array.english: Haha, you did pretty well for your first time.
Array.indonesia: Haha, you did pretty well for your first time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_006
Array.english: I used to play something like this at the arcade back in the day.
Array.indonesia: I used to play something like this at the arcade back in the day.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_007
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, I see, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, I see, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_008
Array.english: Oh, about the food today...\nBancho helped out too.
Array.indonesia: Oh, about the food today...\nBancho helped out too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Uzme_009
Array.english: Ah, that explains why it tasted so familiar.
Array.indonesia: Ah, that explains why it tasted so familiar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Harta_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Best part of festival day? Free booze!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Best part of festival day? Free booze!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Harta_002
Array.english: <size=32>And you can eat and drink all you want, \nthe chief won't say a word!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>And you can eat and drink all you want, \nthe chief won't say a word!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Gesang_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... it's festival day and I can't even gamble...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... it's festival day and I can't even gamble...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Gesang_002
Array.english: Hm? Why not? It's supposed to be a fun day.
Array.indonesia: Hm? Why not? It's supposed to be a fun day.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Gesang_003
Array.english: Over there... my wife's watching me...
Array.indonesia: Over there... my wife's watching me...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Gesang_004
Array.english: If I lose even a little money... she won't let me hear the end of it at home...!
Array.indonesia: If I lose even a little money... she won't let me hear the end of it at home...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chandra_001
Array.english: <size=34>Shh...! Keep it down...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Shh...! Keep it down...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chandra_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'm keeping an eye on him. Making sure he doesn't do anything foolish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm keeping an eye on him. Making sure he doesn't do anything foolish.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Chandra_003
Array.english: <size=32>Men always pick up bad habits the moment they let their guard down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Men always pick up bad habits the moment they let their guard down!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_001
Array.english: The blazing sun turns to a bonfire, sharing the night with us.
Array.indonesia: The blazing sun turns to a bonfire, sharing the night with us.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_002
Array.english: Even the ancient spirits move with the rhythm of the beating drums.
Array.indonesia: Even the ancient spirits move with the rhythm of the beating drums.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_003
Array.english: Oh... that's a really beautiful poem.\nDid you just come up with it?
Array.indonesia: Oh... that's a really beautiful poem.\nDid you just come up with it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_004
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you heard me...! \nHow embarrassing...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, you heard me...! \nHow embarrassing...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_005
Array.english: Yes... I wrote it while watching the festival.
Array.indonesia: Yes... I wrote it while watching the festival.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_PoetryGirl_006
Array.english: It really made me see the festival in a new light.
Array.indonesia: It really made me see the festival in a new light.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_FlowerGrandma_001
Array.english: Hehe... even this old soul finds joy in the festival.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... even this old soul finds joy in the festival.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_FlowerGrandma_002
Array.english: The music and energy of the festival breathe new life into me.
Array.indonesia: The music and energy of the festival breathe new life into me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungMan_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... is alcohol always this strong...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... is alcohol always this strong...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungMan_002
Array.english: <size=33>They say people drink it to dull the pain when getting tattoos...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>They say people drink it to dull the pain when getting tattoos...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungMan_003
Array.english: <size=33>Why would anyone want this...</size>\n<size=45>Uuurgh!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Why would anyone want this...</size>\n<size=45>Uuurgh!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Princessy_001
Array.english: I sat in front of the bonfire too long and my makeup's running.
Array.indonesia: I sat in front of the bonfire too long and my makeup's running.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Princessy_002
Array.english: Even though it's a ceremony to honor our ancestors...
Array.indonesia: Even though it's a ceremony to honor our ancestors...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_Princessy_003
Array.english: <size=32>An event so steeped in drink and indulgence really isn't for me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>An event so steeped in drink and indulgence really isn't for me.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisMom_001
Array.english: Hehe, children really love festivals.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, children really love festivals.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisMom_002
Array.english: This festival honors our ancestors and celebrates coming of age, but...
Array.indonesia: This festival honors our ancestors and celebrates coming of age, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisMom_003
Array.english: They can come to understand that in time.\nFor now, they just need to have fun.
Array.indonesia: They can come to understand that in time.\nFor now, they just need to have fun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisDad_001
Array.english: Preparing for the festival is physically tiring, but...
Array.indonesia: Preparing for the festival is physically tiring, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_BroSisDad_002
Array.english: <size=32>Seeing the children enjoy themselves makes all the exhaustion disappear, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Seeing the children enjoy themselves makes all the exhaustion disappear, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_001
Array.english: Jaka's become an adult...
Array.indonesia: Jaka's become an adult...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_002
Array.english: It feels like just yesterday he was a baby...\nTime really does fly.
Array.indonesia: It feels like just yesterday he was a baby...\nTime really does fly.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_003
Array.english: Now that he's a proper adult, he'll be more mature.
Array.indonesia: Now that he's a proper adult, he'll be more mature.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_004
Array.english: Hehe... they say children are always children.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... they say children are always children.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_YoungManMom_005
Array.english: Still, now that he's an adult, we should trust him more.
Array.indonesia: Still, now that he's an adult, we should trust him more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidBrother_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yah! Take that!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yah! Take that!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidBrother_002
Array.english: <size=33>The winner gets the biggest piece of meat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The winner gets the biggest piece of meat!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidSister_001
Array.english: <size=33>The food is so good!!\nThis is amazing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The food is so good!!\nThis is amazing!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hah! Hyah!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah! Hyah!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_KidBroFriend_002
Array.english: <size=34>Not backing down from my blade? Not bad!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Not backing down from my blade? Not bad!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_Marone_001
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_Marone_002
Array.english: Looks like Marone's in a good mood too.
Array.indonesia: Looks like Marone's in a good mood too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_NPCTalk_JDLC_Marone_003
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... I'm starting to feel tired.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew... I'm starting to feel tired.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_002
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe I should head home and get some rest for tomorrow.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maybe I should head home and get some rest for tomorrow.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_Option01
Array.english: Head home
Array.indonesia: Head home

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_Option02
Array.english: Stay a bit longer
Array.indonesia: Stay a bit longer

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_GoHome_001
Array.english: <size=32>I think I've seen enough.\nLet's head home.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I think I've seen enough.\nLet's head home.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_FinishFestival_Stay_001
Array.english: <size=32>Since it's a festival...\nLet's look around a bit more before bed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Since it's a festival...\nLet's look around a bit more before bed!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_001
Array.english: A lot happened today.
Array.indonesia: A lot happened today.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_002
Array.english: We went to that creepy forest... \nEven went deep into the temple...
Array.indonesia: We went to that creepy forest... \nEven went deep into the temple...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_003
Array.english: But I'm glad we could help the people of Utara Village.
Array.indonesia: But I'm glad we could help the people of Utara Village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_004
Array.english: There are some eccentric folks... But everyone really seems to love this village.
Array.indonesia: There are some eccentric folks... But everyone really seems to love this village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_005
Array.english: Muna said she'd study that ancient diving equipment we brought back today, right?
Array.indonesia: Muna said she'd study that ancient diving equipment we brought back today, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_006
Array.english: Maybe she'll have something new to show us tomorrow!
Array.indonesia: Maybe she'll have something new to show us tomorrow!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_007
Array.english: I'm getting sleepy now that I'm full... yawn.
Array.indonesia: I'm getting sleepy now that I'm full... yawn.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_DaveBeforeSleep_008
Array.english: I'll get a good night's sleep and start fresh tomorrow!
Array.indonesia: I'll get a good night's sleep and start fresh tomorrow!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>Since it's my first time at the festival...\nI shouldn't wander too far.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Since it's my first time at the festival...\nI shouldn't wander too far.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_Festival_Barricade_Door_001
Array.english: <size=32>It feels rude to go into someone's house while everyone's out enjoying the festival...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It feels rude to go into someone's house while everyone's out enjoying the festival...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_DaveAsk_001
Array.english: Um... I'm trying to clear the boulder blocking the path to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>...
Array.indonesia: Um... I'm trying to clear the boulder blocking the path to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_DaveAsk_002
Array.english: <size=34>Could you give me a hand?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Could you give me a hand?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: Didn't I say I'd help earlier?
Array.indonesia: Didn't I say I'd help earlier?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>Why don't you go gather more people?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Why don't you go gather more people?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want me to help push a boulder...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You want me to help push a boulder...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_002
Array.english: Well... my arm's injured. I can't use my full strength like this.
Array.indonesia: Well... my arm's injured. I can't use my full strength like this.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_003
Array.english: But you still do amazing work with one hand.
Array.indonesia: But you still do amazing work with one hand.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Th-That's... don't say stuff like that...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> It's really not a big deal<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Th-That's... don't say stuff like that...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> It's really not a big deal<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_005
Array.english: ...Ahem. Well, yeah, I could push a boulder like that with one arm. Sure.
Array.indonesia: ...Ahem. Well, yeah, I could push a boulder like that with one arm. Sure.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_006
Array.english: Of course, I don't mean alone...\nOnce people gather, I'll join in.
Array.indonesia: Of course, I don't mean alone...\nOnce people gather, I'll join in.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterYes_007
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you, Peneb!\nI'll see you at the boulder when we're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thank you, Peneb!\nI'll see you at the boulder when we're ready!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterNo_001
Array.english: <size=33>Push that huge boulder together...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Push that huge boulder together...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterNo_002
Array.english: Well, my arm's a bit injured and all...\nThat might be difficult...
Array.indonesia: Well, my arm's a bit injured and all...\nThat might be difficult...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CarpenterNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: Ha! I already said I'd help earlier...
Array.indonesia: Ha! I already said I'd help earlier...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=34>Go gather more people!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Go gather more people!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>A big boulder on the forest path...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>A big boulder on the forest path...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_002
Array.english: Ha! You're not planning to make me do it while you sit around, are you?
Array.indonesia: Ha! You're not planning to make me do it while you sit around, are you?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_003
Array.english: Can't trust outsiders at all.
Array.indonesia: Can't trust outsiders at all.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_004
Array.english: Still... well, you've helped me out before,\nso I'll lend a hand with this.
Array.indonesia: Still... well, you've helped me out before,\nso I'll lend a hand with this.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerYes_005
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you, Jepun! I'll see you at the boulder when everything's ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thank you, Jepun! I'll see you at the boulder when everything's ready!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? You want me to help push a boulder?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh? You want me to help push a boulder?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerNo_002
Array.english: No way, that rock keeps wild animals from coming up here. It's so convenient.
Array.indonesia: No way, that rock keeps wild animals from coming up here. It's so convenient.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerNo_003
Array.english: Why bother moving that thing?\nOutsiders just don't think, do they.
Array.indonesia: Why bother moving that thing?\nOutsiders just don't think, do they.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FarmerNo_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? Ya mean movin' that boulder?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Ya mean movin' that boulder?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>I already said I'd help earlier.\nYour memory ain't so good, is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I already said I'd help earlier.\nYour memory ain't so good, is it?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanYes_001
Array.english: <size=33>You mean that big boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You mean that big boulder on the forest path?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanYes_002
Array.english: Well... if a few folks pitch in, it ain't impossible...
Array.indonesia: Well... if a few folks pitch in, it ain't impossible...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Good chance to show what I'm made of!\nAlright, I'll help ya out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Good chance to show what I'm made of!\nAlright, I'll help ya out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Basu!\nI'll see you at the boulder when we're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thanks, Basu!\nI'll see you at the boulder when we're ready!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You wanna move that boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You wanna move that boulder on the forest path?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanNo_002
Array.english: <size=32>Well, I ain't feelin' too great today... Might wanna ask someone else.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well, I ain't feelin' too great today... Might wanna ask someone else.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_FishermanNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? I did say I'd help you earlier...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? I did say I'd help you earlier...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>I can't do it alone, so I'll come once the others gather.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I can't do it alone, so I'll come once the others gather.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>You mean pushing that big boulder on the forest path together...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You mean pushing that big boulder on the forest path together...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistYes_002
Array.english: Hmm... all right.\nPlease gather more people.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... all right.\nPlease gather more people.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you! I'll see you at the rock when everything's ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thank you! I'll see you at the rock when everything's ready!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want me to help push that big boulder on the forest path...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You want me to help push that big boulder on the forest path...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistNo_002
Array.english: I'm getting on in years, so... I'm not sure I can be of much help. Sorry about that.
Array.indonesia: I'm getting on in years, so... I'm not sure I can be of much help. Sorry about that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_HerbalistNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh my... Didn't I already say I'd help move that boulder?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh my... Didn't I already say I'd help move that boulder?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: <size=32>You just wanted to make sure, didn't you? Hehe.\nDon't worry, I'll help you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You just wanted to make sure, didn't you? Hehe.\nDon't worry, I'll help you.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>You mean that big boulder on the forest path, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You mean that big boulder on the forest path, right?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahYes_002
Array.english: Well... The animals have been having trouble getting past it too.
Array.indonesia: Well... The animals have been having trouble getting past it too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahYes_003
Array.english: Alright, we might as well clear it, hehe.\nJust let me know when everyone's ready.
Array.indonesia: Alright, we might as well clear it, hehe.\nJust let me know when everyone's ready.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Lipah!\nI'll meet you at the boulder once we're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thanks, Lipah!\nI'll meet you at the boulder once we're ready!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want us to push that big boulder on the forest path together...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You want us to push that big boulder on the forest path together...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahNo_002
Array.english: Hmm... I'd like it gone too, but... some people think it's fine the way it is...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'd like it gone too, but... some people think it's fine the way it is...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahNo_003
Array.english: Sorry. Maybe try asking someone else?
Array.indonesia: Sorry. Maybe try asking someone else?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_LipahNo_004
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboAlreadyAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>I already told ya I'd help, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I already told ya I'd help, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboAlreadyAgreed_002
Array.english: Even I can't do it alone, so go round up a few more folks.
Array.indonesia: Even I can't do it alone, so go round up a few more folks.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboYes_001
Array.english: <size=33>That big boulder on the forest path, huh...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That big boulder on the forest path, huh...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboYes_002
Array.english: <size=33>Well, reckon we can move it if we get a few folks together. Go on and round 'em up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well, reckon we can move it if we get a few folks together. Go on and round 'em up!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks, Rimbo!\nI'll meet you at the boulder once we're all set!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thanks, Rimbo!\nI'll meet you at the boulder once we're all set!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... ya mean the boulder on the forest path?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... ya mean the boulder on the forest path?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboNo_002
Array.english: I'm not sure if the villagers really want it moved.
Array.indonesia: I'm not sure if the villagers really want it moved.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboNo_003
Array.english: Reckon I'll think on it a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Reckon I'll think on it a bit more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_RimboNo_004

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_YoungManMomNo_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... Seems like we need to be a bit closer before I can ask for favors...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChiefAgreed_001
Array.english: Well... I would like to help, but my legs aren't what they used to be, so I'm not sure I'd be much help.
Array.indonesia: Well... I would like to help, but my legs aren't what they used to be, so I'm not sure I'd be much help.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChiefAgreed_002
Array.english: Try gathering around <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> other villagers.
Array.indonesia: Try gathering around <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> other villagers.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_ChiefAgreed_003
Array.english: They won't just help a stranger right away...\nYou'll need to build some rapport with them first.
Array.indonesia: They won't just help a stranger right away...\nYou'll need to build some rapport with them first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah! Of course I'll help!\nThere's a temple behind that forest, right?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah! Of course I'll help!\nThere's a temple behind that forest, right?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_MunaAgreed_002
Array.english: But the boulder's so huge... We'll need at least <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> more villagers besides me.
Array.indonesia: But the boulder's so huge... We'll need at least <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> more villagers besides me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CobraAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? You don't even need to ask!\nOf course I'll help!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? You don't even need to ask!\nOf course I'll help!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_CobraAgreed_002
Array.english: Still, we'll need more hands... Go gather around <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> more villagers.
Array.indonesia: Still, we'll need more hands... Go gather around <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> more villagers.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BanchoAgreed_001
Array.english: Hmm. You mean that big boulder on the far side of the village.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. You mean that big boulder on the far side of the village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BanchoAgreed_002
Array.english: If it's you asking, of course I should help. I'm curious about what kind of ingredients might come from the forest, too.
Array.indonesia: If it's you asking, of course I should help. I'm curious about what kind of ingredients might come from the forest, too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BanchoAgreed_003
Array.english: Judging by the size, we'll need more villagers.
Array.indonesia: Judging by the size, we'll need more villagers.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BanchoAgreed_004
Array.english: Try convincing around <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> villagers to help.
Array.indonesia: Try convincing around <color=#F1DC2B>3</color> villagers to help.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAgreed_001
Array.english: <size=32>You want to move that big boulder on the far side of the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You want to move that big boulder on the far side of the village?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAgreed_002
Array.english: I heard that's the only way to reach the ruins in the forest.
Array.indonesia: I heard that's the only way to reach the ruins in the forest.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_BaconAgreed_003
Array.english: Let's all work together and move it!\nAsk the <color=#F1DC2B>Villagers</color> for help too.
Array.indonesia: Let's all work together and move it!\nAsk the <color=#F1DC2B>Villagers</color> for help too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_001
Array.english: <size=34>Dave, look at this!\n<color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color> brought back a bird from somewhere!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave, look at this!\n<color=#F1DC2B>Marone</color> brought back a bird from somewhere!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_002
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... I thought he was just a cute pup, but looks like he's got some hunting instincts.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... I thought he was just a cute pup, but looks like he's got some hunting instincts.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_004
Array.english: <size=32>Come to think of it, I used to go bird hunting with a gun back in the day...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Come to think of it, I used to go bird hunting with a gun back in the day...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_005
Array.english: <size=35>Would be fun to go with this little guy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Would be fun to go with this little guy!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_006
Array.english: <size=32>If you spot any <color=#1DFEAF>Bushes</color> in the forest, check them out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If you spot any <color=#1DFEAF>Bushes</color> in the forest, check them out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Unlock_007
Array.english: <size=33>There's a good chance birds are hiding in there! Perfect conditions for <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Hunting</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>There's a good chance birds are hiding in there! Perfect conditions for <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Hunting</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_001
Array.english: Woof! Woof!!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Woof!!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! There's a <color=#1DFEAF>Bush</color> over there!\nBet there are birds hiding inside!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! There's a <color=#1DFEAF>Bush</color> over there!\nBet there are birds hiding inside!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_003
Array.english: <size=34>How about we try some <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Hunting</color> to clear our heads?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>How about we try some <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Hunting</color> to clear our heads?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Option01
Array.english: Sounds good!
Array.indonesia: Sounds good!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Option02
Array.english: Maybe later
Array.indonesia: Maybe later

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Yes_001
Array.english: <size=34>Sounds good! Let's give it a try!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sounds good! Let's give it a try!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Yes_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Bird hunting after all this time! I'm fired up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Bird hunting after all this time! I'm fired up!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_Yes_003
Array.english: <size=33>Wild birds are quite fast!\nDon't even blink!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wild birds are quite fast!\nDon't even blink!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_No_001
Array.english: Hmm... I think we should handle other things first.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I think we should handle other things first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnter_No_002
Array.english: <size=32>Fair enough.\nLet's aim for it next time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Fair enough.\nLet's aim for it next time!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha!! That's what I'm talking about, the thrill!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha!! That's what I'm talking about, the thrill!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_002
Array.english: Marone... he's better at bringing things back than I expected. No need to train him at all.
Array.indonesia: Marone... he's better at bringing things back than I expected. No need to train him at all.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_003
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_004
Array.english: Right? And we even got some tasty-looking <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Meat</color> out of it...
Array.indonesia: Right? And we even got some tasty-looking <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Meat</color> out of it...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! We can roast it out here or take it to Bancho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! We can roast it out here or take it to Bancho!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=34>The types of birds you get vary depending on where you <color=#F1DC2B>Hunt Birds</color>. Try other spots too!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>The types of birds you get vary depending on where you <color=#F1DC2B>Hunt Birds</color>. Try other spots too!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_ZoneEnterRetry_001
Array.english: <size=33>That <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Hunting</color> we skipped before...\nHow about now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That <color=#F1DC2B>Bird Hunting</color> we skipped before...\nHow about now?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_BridHunting_End_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm. I think we've done enough for today.\nGotta save some ammo.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm. I think we've done enough for today.\nGotta save some ammo.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_CatchStagBeetle_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... Is that a <color=#1DFEAF>Stag Beetle</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Is that a <color=#1DFEAF>Stag Beetle</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_CatchStagBeetle_002
Array.english: First time I've seen one around here. When it comes to collecting, you can't beat stag beetles and rhinoceros beetles.
Array.indonesia: First time I've seen one around here. When it comes to collecting, you can't beat stag beetles and rhinoceros beetles.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_CatchStagBeetle_003
Array.english: <size=34>Alright. Let's see if I can catch one...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright. Let's see if I can catch one...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_TornNet_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... the net tore.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... the net tore.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_TornNet_002
Array.english: That stag beetle's jaws are strong... this net won't hold up.
Array.indonesia: That stag beetle's jaws are strong... this net won't hold up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_TornNet_003
Array.english: First, I should go to <color=#F1DC2B>Muna</color> and have her fix it.
Array.indonesia: First, I should go to <color=#F1DC2B>Muna</color> and have her fix it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaBeforeFixNet_001
Array.english: Oh... your net tore?
Array.indonesia: Oh... your net tore?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaBeforeFixNet_002
Array.english: Yeah... I was trying to catch a stag beetle.
Array.indonesia: Yeah... I was trying to catch a stag beetle.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaBeforeFixNet_003
Array.english: Fixing it's no problem!\nJust a second.
Array.indonesia: Fixing it's no problem!\nJust a second.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaAfterFixNet_001
Array.english: Here you go. Good as new, right?
Array.indonesia: Here you go. Good as new, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaAfterFixNet_002
Array.english: Thanks. But how am I supposed to catch stag beetles?
Array.indonesia: Thanks. But how am I supposed to catch stag beetles?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaAfterFixNet_003
Array.english: Oh, the stag beetles around here are incredibly tough.\nSame goes for rhinoceros beetles.
Array.indonesia: Oh, the stag beetles around here are incredibly tough.\nSame goes for rhinoceros beetles.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_MunaAfterFixNet_004
Array.english: I figured.\nMaybe I should just give up on those insects...
Array.indonesia: I figured.\nMaybe I should just give up on those insects...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh...! Dave?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh...! Dave?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_002
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...! Udo, what are you doing here?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh...! Udo, what are you doing here?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_003
Array.english: What a coincidence... running into you here.
Array.indonesia: What a coincidence... running into you here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_004
Array.english: Actually, our publishing house is launching a new magazine project...
Array.indonesia: Actually, our publishing house is launching a new magazine project...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_005
Array.english: It's called <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Insects</color>!! We're covering insects from jungle regions like this.
Array.indonesia: It's called <color=#5dd3bb>Weekly Insects</color>!! We're covering insects from jungle regions like this.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_006
Array.english: <size=33>If I can make this project a success...\nI'll finally... become editor-in-chief! Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If I can make this project a success...\nI'll finally... become editor-in-chief! Haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_007
Array.english: Dave, I see you're carrying a net...\nHave you caught any insects around here?
Array.indonesia: Dave, I see you're carrying a net...\nHave you caught any insects around here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_008
Array.english: Yeah. There are quite a few interesting ones.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. There are quite a few interesting ones.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_009
Array.english: Ooh... well, since you're catching insects anyway,\nhow about helping me with my coverage?
Array.indonesia: Ooh... well, since you're catching insects anyway,\nhow about helping me with my coverage?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_010
Array.english: The editorial team set me up with this <color=#72ff0a>Insectagram</color> app before I came here... You can check all the insects you've caught with it.
Array.indonesia: The editorial team set me up with this <color=#72ff0a>Insectagram</color> app before I came here... You can check all the insects you've caught with it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_011
Array.english: Let me install it on your phone too, Dave...\nJust scan this QR code like this, and...
Array.indonesia: Let me install it on your phone too, Dave...\nJust scan this QR code like this, and...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_012
Array.english:
Ta-da! Hehe. Now it's synced with mine!
Any insect you catch will be logged to my account too.
Array.indonesia:
Ta-da! Hehe. Now it's synced with mine!
Any insect you catch will be logged to my account too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_013
Array.english: <size=33>Uh... are you sure that's okay...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Uh... are you sure that's okay...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_014
Array.english: Anyway... I think I can catch other insects if I approach them carefully, but...
Array.indonesia: Anyway... I think I can catch other insects if I approach them carefully, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_015
Array.english:
<color=#1DFEAF>Stag Beetles</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Rhinoceros Beetles</color>...
there's no way to catch those with a regular net.
Array.indonesia:
<color=#1DFEAF>Stag Beetles</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Rhinoceros Beetles</color>...
there's no way to catch those with a regular net.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_016
Array.english: Ha! The beetles around here are incredibly strong!\nThere's no way you'll catch them with just a net.
Array.indonesia: Ha! The beetles around here are incredibly strong!\nThere's no way you'll catch them with just a net.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_017
Array.english: From what I studied before coming here... if you place a similar species nearby, they'll start fighting.
Array.indonesia: From what I studied before coming here... if you place a similar species nearby, they'll start fighting.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_018
Array.english: The loser will be weakened...\nand that's when you catch it!
Array.indonesia: The loser will be weakened...\nand that's when you catch it!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_019
Array.english: Oh... I see. But how do I catch the beetle I need for the fight?
Array.indonesia: Oh... I see. But how do I catch the beetle I need for the fight?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_020
Array.english: Haha. For that, I'll give you this <color=#1DFEAF>Baby Stag Beetle</color>.\nTry it out with this one.
Array.indonesia: Haha. For that, I'll give you this <color=#1DFEAF>Baby Stag Beetle</color>.\nTry it out with this one.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_UdoAppear_021
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... okay, got it.\nI'll try to catch some good ones.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... okay, got it.\nI'll try to catch some good ones.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_FirstBattle_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... there's a beetle...!\nShould I try to catch it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... there's a beetle...!\nShould I try to catch it?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_FirstBattle_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh wait... a regular net would just tear right away...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh wait... a regular net would just tear right away...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_InsectCollector_FirstBattle_003
Array.english: <size=33>I should try battling it with the <color=#1DFEAF>Baby Stag Beetle</color> Udo gave me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I should try battling it with the <color=#1DFEAF>Baby Stag Beetle</color> Udo gave me.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstNight_001
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? I hear some kind of loud noise.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Huh? I hear some kind of loud noise.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstNight_002
Array.english: <size=32>Sounds like it's coming from the upper part of the village... I should go check it out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sounds like it's coming from the upper part of the village... I should go check it out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_001
Array.english: Huff... huff... Excuse me... Have you seen anything glowing in the sky around here?!
Array.indonesia: Huff... huff... Excuse me... Have you seen anything glowing in the sky around here?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_002
Array.english: Uh...? Not that I've seen.
Array.indonesia: Uh...? Not that I've seen.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_003
Array.english: But it has to be here... \nMy UFO radar is pointing straight at this village.
Array.indonesia: But it has to be here... \nMy UFO radar is pointing straight at this village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_004
Array.english: (Muttering...)
Array.indonesia: (Muttering...)

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_005
Array.english: Excuse me! Would it be okay if we stayed in this village for a while? *Pant*
Array.indonesia: Excuse me! Would it be okay if we stayed in this village for a while? *Pant*

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_006
Array.english: We came all this way... We can't leave without finding any trace of the UFO.
Array.indonesia: We came all this way... We can't leave without finding any trace of the UFO.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_007
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not really the one who can give you permission...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'm not really the one who can give you permission...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_008
Array.english: But the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color> should be fine. Why don't you stay over there?
Array.indonesia: But the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color> should be fine. Why don't you stay over there?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_009
Array.english: Phew...Thank you. Okay.
Array.indonesia: Phew...Thank you. Okay.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_010
Array.english: <size=32>Everyone! Let's rest up and search again tomorrow.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Everyone! Let's rest up and search again tomorrow.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_011
Array.english: <size=32>In the name of the Shimano University Mystery Research Club! We will find that UFO!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>In the name of the Shimano University Mystery Research Club! We will find that UFO!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstAppearance_012
Array.english: <size=38>Aye aye, sir!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aye aye, sir!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_001
Array.english: Come to think of it... those weird students from yesterday. They said they were here to photograph a UFO.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it... those weird students from yesterday. They said they were here to photograph a UFO.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_002
Array.english: <size=33>Don't tell me there's actually something there...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Don't tell me there's actually something there...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_003
Array.english: I think they headed up the hill on the right side of the village…\nI should go check it out.
Array.indonesia: I think they headed up the hill on the right side of the village…\nI should go check it out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_Retry_001
Array.english: Apropos...those weird students... They said they came to photograph UFOs, right?
Array.indonesia: Apropos...those weird students... They said they came to photograph UFOs, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NextNight_Retry_002
Array.english: I think they're up on the <color=#1DFEAF>hill on the right side</color> of the village... Let's follow them.
Array.indonesia: I think they're up on the <color=#1DFEAF>hill on the right side</color> of the village... Let's follow them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_001
Array.english: Hey, guys. Find anything?
Array.indonesia: Hey, guys. Find anything?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_002
Array.english: Oh, Sir. Keep your voice down. \nI've got a good feeling about today.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Sir. Keep your voice down. \nI've got a good feeling about today.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_003
Array.english: Alright, got it. \nBut... weren't there three of you before...?
Array.indonesia: Alright, got it. \nBut... weren't there three of you before...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_004
Array.english: Sigh... Yasuto... He got bitten by a wild spider on the way here and came down with a high fever.
Array.indonesia: Sigh... Yasuto... He got bitten by a wild spider on the way here and came down with a high fever.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_005
Array.english: He won't be able to join today's expedition.
Array.indonesia: He won't be able to join today's expedition.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_006
Array.english: I see... So you're using that telescope to look for UFOs?
Array.indonesia: I see... So you're using that telescope to look for UFOs?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_007
Array.english: That's right. I, Fukuo... In the name of Shimano University Mystery Research Club...
Array.indonesia: That's right. I, Fukuo... In the name of Shimano University Mystery Research Club...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_008
Array.english: <size=34>Will prove the existence of UFOs today!\nYou're with me on this, right, Takeru!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Will prove the existence of UFOs today!\nYou're with me on this, right, Takeru!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_009
Array.english: <size=40>Aye aye, sir!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Aye aye, sir!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_010
Array.english: <size=32>Ah... Sir. Yasuto's <color=#1DFEAF>Telecamera</color>...\nCould you handle it for us?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah... Sir. Yasuto's <color=#1DFEAF>Telecamera</color>...\nCould you handle it for us?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_011
Array.english: <size=35>Huh...? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh...? Me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_012
Array.english: Yes, Sir.\nWe can't let Yasuto's sacrifice be in vain!
Array.indonesia: Yes, Sir.\nWe can't let Yasuto's sacrifice be in vain!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_013
Array.english: Hmm... Alright. Can you tell me what I need to do?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Alright. Can you tell me what I need to do?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_014
Array.english: <size=32>I'll show you. \nFirst, go to the <color=#1DFEAF>Telecamera</color> and look up at the sky.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll show you. \nFirst, go to the <color=#1DFEAF>Telecamera</color> and look up at the sky.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FindUFO_Barricade_001
Array.english: The students asked me to check the telecamera.\nA UFO might actually show up, I should take a look.
Array.indonesia: The students asked me to check the telecamera.\nA UFO might actually show up, I should take a look.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_TakePicture_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh... A glowing object...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh... A glowing object...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_TakePicture_002
Array.english: <size=35>Wait?! What is that...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wait?! What is that...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_TakePicture_003
Array.english: <size=34>Sir! Take a <color=#F1DC2B>Photo</color>!!\nSo Yasuto's soul can cherish the moment!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sir! Take a <color=#F1DC2B>Photo</color>!!\nSo Yasuto's soul can cherish the moment!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_TakePicture_004
Array.english: <size=35><color=#E3E3E3>(...Yasuto's still alive though.)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#E3E3E3>(...Yasuto's still alive though.)</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstPicture_001
Array.english: <size=33>Excellent! That's a great shot.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Excellent! That's a great shot.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FirstPicture_002
Array.english: <size=33>But one photo might look fake.\nTake another!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But one photo might look fake.\nTake another!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_SecondPicture_001
Array.english: <size=34>Perfect!!! But...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Perfect!!! But...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_SecondPicture_002
Array.english: <size=33>I feel like it's getting closer...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I feel like it's getting closer...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_SecondPicture_003
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe it just came out clearer? \nOne more shot and we'll know for sure.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maybe it just came out clearer? \nOne more shot and we'll know for sure.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_ThirdPicture_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... It definitely looks bigger than before...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... It definitely looks bigger than before...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_GrowingUFO_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa! It's really getting bigger...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa! It's really getting bigger...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_GrowingUFO_002
Array.english: <size=36>S-Sir! It's heading straight for us!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>S-Sir! It's heading straight for us!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_GrowingUFO_003
Array.english: <size=38>Aaahhh...!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aaahhh...!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_001
Array.english: *Pant* Is everyone okay?
Array.indonesia: *Pant* Is everyone okay?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_002
Array.english: Thank goodness it missed us... Fukuo, don't tell me you used that sealed psychokinetic energy to save us...?
Array.indonesia: Thank goodness it missed us... Fukuo, don't tell me you used that sealed psychokinetic energy to save us...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_003
Array.english: Who knows. \nMaybe I sensed the danger... and it just slipped out.
Array.indonesia: Who knows. \nMaybe I sensed the danger... and it just slipped out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_004
Array.english: Right now, we should go after the crashed UFO first.
Array.indonesia: Right now, we should go after the crashed UFO first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_005
Array.english: You're so calm even in a situation like this, Fukuo.\nThat's real leadership.
Array.indonesia: You're so calm even in a situation like this, Fukuo.\nThat's real leadership.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_006
Array.english: I can't believe there was actually a UFO...
Array.indonesia: I can't believe there was actually a UFO...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_FallingUFO_007
Array.english: Judging by the direction it fell, it's probably near the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>. Let's go check it out.
Array.indonesia: Judging by the direction it fell, it's probably near the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>. Let's go check it out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...!? Is it really a spaceship?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa...!? Is it really a spaceship?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_002
Array.english: <size=35>*Pant* Told you, Sir...\nWe picked up a signal here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>*Pant* Told you, Sir...\nWe picked up a signal here...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_003
Array.english: <size=35>Our long investigation has finally paid off...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Our long investigation has finally paid off...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_004
Array.english: <size=35>Shimano University Mystery Research Club...\nMay we shine forever!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Shimano University Mystery Research Club...\nMay we shine forever!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_005
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? Wait, I think someone's coming out...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh? Wait, I think someone's coming out...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_EncounterUFO_006
Array.english: <size=38>A-Alien lifeform...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>A-Alien lifeform...!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_001
Array.english: <size=35>...A middle-aged man...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...A middle-aged man...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_002
Array.english: <size=31>Ugh... where am I...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Ugh... where am I...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_003
Array.english: This is Utara Village.\nYou're in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: This is Utara Village.\nYou're in the jungle.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_004
Array.english: More importantly... is this Earth?
Array.indonesia: More importantly... is this Earth?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Aha! So you are an alien!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aha! So you are an alien!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_006
Array.english:
Two eyes... one mouth... You copied the human form...
but the hair... you only got it half right...!
Array.indonesia:
Two eyes... one mouth... You copied the human form...
but the hair... you only got it half right...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_007
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... what is this guy talking about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... what is this guy talking about?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_008
Array.english: I'm the CEO of Kindred Aerospace, <color=#F1DC2B>Martin Tweed</color>.
Array.indonesia: I'm the CEO of Kindred Aerospace, <color=#F1DC2B>Martin Tweed</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear01_009
Array.english: Kindred is the world's fourth-largest spacecraft manufacturer. You've heard of us, right?
Array.indonesia: Kindred is the world's fourth-largest spacecraft manufacturer. You've heard of us, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_option01
Array.english: Yes, I think I have
Array.indonesia: Yes, I think I have

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_option02
Array.english: Hmm... never heard of it
Array.indonesia: Hmm... never heard of it
