Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_yes_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ha! Even out here, we're known!\nOur marketing team's doing great.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ha! Even out here, we're known!\nOur marketing team's doing great.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_no_001
Array.english: Hmm... what exactly does our marketing team do all day...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... what exactly does our marketing team do all day...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_no_002
Array.english: <size=34>Would you like to see our company's promo video?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Would you like to see our company's promo video?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_no_option01
Array.english: Yes, I'm curious
Array.indonesia: Yes, I'm curious

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_no_option02
Array.english: No... I'm good
Array.indonesia: No... I'm good

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_Watch_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! Then let's take a look!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Then let's take a look!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_Watch_002
Array.english: ...With Kindred's cutting-edge technology, \nyou can even skip ahead.
Array.indonesia: ...With Kindred's cutting-edge technology, \nyou can even skip ahead.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_NoWatch_001
Array.english: Hmm... you must be busy.\nMaybe next time.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... you must be busy.\nMaybe next time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear_AfterWatch_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! What do you think? Kindred's technological prowess is amazing, isn't it?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! What do you think? Kindred's technological prowess is amazing, isn't it?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_001
Array.english: By the way…\nThe signal here isn't great.
Array.indonesia: By the way…\nThe signal here isn't great.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_002
Array.english: I was testing a prototype spacecraft, and the GPS got scrambled.
Array.indonesia: I was testing a prototype spacecraft, and the GPS got scrambled.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_003
Array.english: Those engineers...\ncan't believe they missed that.
Array.indonesia: Those engineers...\ncan't believe they missed that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_004
Array.english: It'll take a while for my rescue signal to reach HQ.
Array.indonesia: It'll take a while for my rescue signal to reach HQ.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear02_005
Array.english: <size=33>I'll be staying in this village until then.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'll be staying in this village until then.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_001
Array.english: Hmm... not an alien after all...\nI'm disappointed.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... not an alien after all...\nI'm disappointed.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_002
Array.english: If he came from space, doesn't that still make him an alien?
Array.indonesia: If he came from space, doesn't that still make him an alien?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_003
Array.english: Well... aliens usually have, you know... big eyes and no hair...
Array.indonesia: Well... aliens usually have, you know... big eyes and no hair...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_004
Array.english: <size=32>So in that sense... maybe he kind of counts?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>So in that sense... maybe he kind of counts?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_005
Array.english: Anyway, we should head back and discuss this properly.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, we should head back and discuss this properly.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_006
Array.english: <size=33>Let's call it a day, Takeru!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's call it a day, Takeru!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_MartinAppear03_007
Array.english: <size=38>Aye aye, sir!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aye aye, sir!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... Sir, perfect timing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Sir, perfect timing.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_002
Array.english: <size=32>Good news. \nOur friend Yasuto has fully recovered from his illness!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Good news. \nOur friend Yasuto has fully recovered from his illness!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_003
Array.english: Ah... the one who got bitten by a spider and couldn't join the investigation... That's a relief.
Array.indonesia: Ah... the one who got bitten by a spider and couldn't join the investigation... That's a relief.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_004
Array.english: Phew... I had a nightmare all night about being chased by thousands of spiders.
Array.indonesia: Phew... I had a nightmare all night about being chased by thousands of spiders.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_005
Array.english: It's a real shame I couldn't take part in the investigation…\nbut thanks to you, Sir, we managed to get a photo of the UFO!
Array.indonesia: It's a real shame I couldn't take part in the investigation…\nbut thanks to you, Sir, we managed to get a photo of the UFO!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_006
Array.english: There's definitely some kind of mysterious power in this village.
Array.indonesia: There's definitely some kind of mysterious power in this village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_007
Array.english: So, about that... Fukuo, Takeru...
Array.indonesia: So, about that... Fukuo, Takeru...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_008
Array.english: <size=35>I've decided to stay in this village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I've decided to stay in this village.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_009
Array.english: <size=33>What?! You're not coming with us on our grand journey?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What?! You're not coming with us on our grand journey?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_010
Array.english: It's not like that. I just feel like there are more mysteries to uncover here.
Array.indonesia: It's not like that. I just feel like there are more mysteries to uncover here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_011
Array.english: I'd love for you guys to stay too, but...
Array.indonesia: I'd love for you guys to stay too, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_012
Array.english: <size=33>You have a duty...\nto seek out other mysteries.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You have a duty...\nto seek out other mysteries.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_013
Array.english: *Sniff*... You're right. It's a choice we must make for the greater good.
Array.indonesia: *Sniff*... You're right. It's a choice we must make for the greater good.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_014
Array.english: <size=32>*Sniff*... It's an unavoidable fate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>*Sniff*... It's an unavoidable fate.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_015
Array.english: Yasuto, your noble sacrifice will be remembered!\nEven if we part ways here...
Array.indonesia: Yasuto, your noble sacrifice will be remembered!\nEven if we part ways here...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_016
Array.english: <size=33>The Shimano University Mystery Research Club will always be together!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The Shimano University Mystery Research Club will always be together!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_Farewell_017
Array.english: <size=38>Aye aye, sirrrrr!!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Aye aye, sirrrrr!!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_001
Array.english: As I mentioned, I'm planning to stay here for a while.
Array.indonesia: As I mentioned, I'm planning to stay here for a while.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_002
Array.english: Right. Get some rest and keep up with your research.
Array.indonesia: Right. Get some rest and keep up with your research.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_003
Array.english: But just staying doing nothing but research feels a bit awkward, so...
Array.indonesia: But just staying doing nothing but research feels a bit awkward, so...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_004
Array.english: <size=33>Would it be alright if I worked at your restaurant?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Would it be alright if I worked at your restaurant?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_005
Array.english: My father runs a ramen shop. I know a bit about cooking and serving.
Array.indonesia: My father runs a ramen shop. I know a bit about cooking and serving.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_006
Array.english: <size=32>That sounds great! We've actually been a bit short-handed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That sounds great! We've actually been a bit short-handed.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_007
Array.english: <size=33>I'm sure Bancho will be happy to hear that, haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'm sure Bancho will be happy to hear that, haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_008
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, thank you for having me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, thank you for having me.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_009
Array.english: Oh, now that I think about it...
Array.indonesia: Oh, now that I think about it...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_010
Array.english: <size=33>This morning, I noticed webs coming out of my hands.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This morning, I noticed webs coming out of my hands.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_011
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? Like... like that character?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh? Like... like that character?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_012
Array.english: Yeah... when I bend my wrist like this, white threads come out...
Array.indonesia: Yeah... when I bend my wrist like this, white threads come out...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_013
Array.english: Maybe we could use this to help with <color=#1DFEAF>Serving</color>?
Array.indonesia: Maybe we could use this to help with <color=#1DFEAF>Serving</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MysteryClub_NewEmployee_014
Array.english: It might work. Then let's meet at the shop when you're ready!
Array.indonesia: It might work. Then let's meet at the shop when you're ready!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa..?! Do I smell...\nHydrogen sulfide!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa..?! Do I smell...\nHydrogen sulfide!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... hello.\nYes, that's right. You have a keen nose.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... hello.\nYes, that's right. You have a keen nose.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart01_003
Array.english: I know that smell well. We sometimes get it during experiments at the lab. But why is it so strong near the lake...?
Array.indonesia: I know that smell well. We sometimes get it during experiments at the lab. But why is it so strong near the lake...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_001
Array.english: Hehe, I'm Muna, a researcher.\nI couldn't help overhearing... let me explain.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, I'm Muna, a researcher.\nI couldn't help overhearing... let me explain.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_002
Array.english: Hydrogen sulfide forming layers from biological remains is a natural phenomenon.
Array.indonesia: Hydrogen sulfide forming layers from biological remains is a natural phenomenon.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_003
Array.english: But as you may have seen from the carcass at Lake Beach, ancient creatures started rising from the bottom of the lake one day.
Array.indonesia: But as you may have seen from the carcass at Lake Beach, ancient creatures started rising from the bottom of the lake one day.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_004
Array.english: They were either poisoned by hydrogen sulfide on the way up... or couldn't adapt to the lake's composition and died...
Array.indonesia: They were either poisoned by hydrogen sulfide on the way up... or couldn't adapt to the lake's composition and died...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_005
Array.english:
The buildup of corpses keeps fueling the cycle,
increasing the hydrogen sulfide concentration...
Array.indonesia:
The buildup of corpses keeps fueling the cycle,
increasing the hydrogen sulfide concentration...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_006
Array.english: <size=32>...That's what this genius, Muna, has figured out. Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...That's what this genius, Muna, has figured out. Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_007
Array.english: I see... This situation isn't normal...\nAt this rate, the lake's ecosystem could be in danger.
Array.indonesia: I see... This situation isn't normal...\nAt this rate, the lake's ecosystem could be in danger.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_008
Array.english: Is there a place at the bottom of the lake where <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> flows out? If so, we might be able to use some parts from my spacecraft...
Array.indonesia: Is there a place at the bottom of the lake where <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> flows out? If so, we might be able to use some parts from my spacecraft...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_009
Array.english: Hmm. I think I might have seen something like that...\nI'll check.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I think I might have seen something like that...\nI'll check.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_010
Array.english: It'll take a while for the rescue team to arrive anyway…\nTime to show what I can do, haha!
Array.indonesia: It'll take a while for the rescue team to arrive anyway…\nTime to show what I can do, haha!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_MissionStart02_011
Array.english: <size=33>Let me know if you find a spot with clean water! \nAnd tell me what the terrain looks like too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let me know if you find a spot with clean water! \nAnd tell me what the terrain looks like too.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? Is that...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Is that...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_002
Array.english: <size=33>Martin said to let him know if I found where <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> is coming out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Martin said to let him know if I found where <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> is coming out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_003
Array.english: <size=34>I should head back up and tell him!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I should head back up and tell him!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_Far01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm...? I hear water flowing from somewhere...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm...? I hear water flowing from somewhere...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_Far02_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> is coming out from over there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> is coming out from over there.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PureWaterFound_Far02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Martin asked me to let him know if I found where the clean water comes out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Martin asked me to let him know if I found where the clean water comes out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... the lake still smells like hydrogen sulfide...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... the lake still smells like hydrogen sulfide...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_002
Array.english: <size=32>Did you happen to find where that <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> I mentioned earlier comes from...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Did you happen to find where that <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> I mentioned earlier comes from...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_003
Array.english:
Yes. I found a spot where <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> is flowing out,
and I was just about to tell you.
Array.indonesia:
Yes. I found a spot where <color=#1DFEAF>Clean Water</color> is flowing out,
and I was just about to tell you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_004
Array.english: The current was really strong, so I couldn't get inside.
Array.indonesia: The current was really strong, so I couldn't get inside.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... if it's spring water, that's even better!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... if it's spring water, that's even better!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_006
Array.english: <size=32>If we connect some pipes, we can draw up\na large amount of water.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If we connect some pipes, we can draw up\na large amount of water.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_007
Array.english: Did you see anything inside we could latch onto?
Array.indonesia: Did you see anything inside we could latch onto?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_008
Array.english: Hmm... there were signs of ancient ruins, so there should be something to hook onto... Why?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... there were signs of ancient ruins, so there should be something to hook onto... Why?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_009
Array.english:
While I was checking the wreckage of my spacecraft,
I found some wire and hooks. So...
Array.indonesia:
While I was checking the wreckage of my spacecraft,
I found some wire and hooks. So...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_010
Array.english: <size=34>Ta-da! I made this <color=#F1DC2B>Hook Gun</color>!\nHere, take it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ta-da! I made this <color=#F1DC2B>Hook Gun</color>!\nHere, take it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_011
Array.english: If there's something to latch onto, you can use this to move quickly. It should help you push through the current too.
Array.indonesia: If there's something to latch onto, you can use this to move quickly. It should help you push through the current too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_012
Array.english: Oh... I see. That does sound useful.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I see. That does sound useful.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_013
Array.english: Haha! Then... could you go into that cave where the clean water is coming from and connect this <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color>?
Array.indonesia: Haha! Then... could you go into that cave where the clean water is coming from and connect this <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_014
Array.english: Once it's connected, bring the pipe out and attach it to the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Device</color> I'll lower down.
Array.indonesia: Once it's connected, bring the pipe out and attach it to the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Device</color> I'll lower down.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_GrapplingGunAcquired_015
Array.english: Alright. Got it. I'll check it out.
Array.indonesia: Alright. Got it. I'll check it out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationStart01_001
Array.english: Martin asked me to connect a <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color> where the clean water flows out.
Array.indonesia: Martin asked me to connect a <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color> where the clean water flows out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationStart02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Should I try using the hook gun on that <color=#F1DC2B>Latch</color> sticking out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Should I try using the hook gun on that <color=#F1DC2B>Latch</color> sticking out?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationCheck01_001
Array.english: Whew... moving that fast made my ears pop.
Array.indonesia: Whew... moving that fast made my ears pop.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationCheck02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let's install the <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color> at that water source like Martin said.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright, let's install the <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color> at that water source like Martin said.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PipingInstallationDone_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright, it's secured! Now let's grab the pipe and ride the current back out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright, it's secured! Now let's grab the pipe and ride the current back out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemIn_001
Array.english: <size=34>Phew... that made me dizzy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Phew... that made me dizzy.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemIn_002
Array.english: <size=32>Martin, I connected the pipe and brought it back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Martin, I connected the pipe and brought it back!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemIn_003
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, that's a perfect spot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, that's a perfect spot!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemIn_004
Array.english: <size=32>Alright then, I'll send the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Device</color> down to you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright then, I'll send the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Device</color> down to you.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow... so this is the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Device</color>. It's pretty big.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow... so this is the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Device</color>. It's pretty big.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Took quite a bit of work to build!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Took quite a bit of work to build!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>Now go ahead and connect the <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color> you brought to it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Now go ahead and connect the <color=#1DFEAF>Pipe</color> you brought to it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectStart_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>I need to connect the pipe to the purification device!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I need to connect the pipe to the purification device!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectEnd_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh...! The device is working!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ooh...! The device is working!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectEnd_002
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Just as expected, Kindred technology works perfectly anywhere!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Just as expected, Kindred technology works perfectly anywhere!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectEnd_003
Array.english: <size=32>The lake should be much clearer by tomorrow.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The lake should be much clearer by tomorrow.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_PurificationSystemConnectEnd_004
Array.english: <size=32>Glad it turned into a nice parting gift! I'll try contacting the rescue ship again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Glad it turned into a nice parting gift! I'll try contacting the rescue ship again.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_001
Array.english: Hm? What's wrong? Is something wrong with the lake purification?
Array.indonesia: Hm? What's wrong? Is something wrong with the lake purification?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_002
Array.english: Ah... I checked this morning, and the lake's been completely purified.
Array.indonesia: Ah... I checked this morning, and the lake's been completely purified.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_003
Array.english: But... the rescue ship that was supposed to arrive today was attacked by alien creatures and crashed.
Array.indonesia: But... the rescue ship that was supposed to arrive today was attacked by alien creatures and crashed.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_004
Array.english: Man... they're in the middle of upgrading to a new model... \nand that was the only one in operation.
Array.indonesia: Man... they're in the middle of upgrading to a new model... \nand that was the only one in operation.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_005
Array.english: It's going to take a while before the next rescue ship arrives...
Array.indonesia: It's going to take a while before the next rescue ship arrives...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_006
Array.english: <size=32>Would it be alright if I stayed in the village a bit longer to help out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Would it be alright if I stayed in the village a bit longer to help out?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_007
Array.english: Oh... sure. We'd love to have you, but...
Array.indonesia: Oh... sure. We'd love to have you, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_008
Array.english: The only thing you could really help with right now is at the restaurant. Would that be okay?
Array.indonesia: The only thing you could really help with right now is at the restaurant. Would that be okay?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_009
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh! You mean that place that always smells amazing?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh! You mean that place that always smells amazing?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_010
Array.english: I'm not exactly a master chef, but...\nI did build an automated assistance device.
Array.indonesia: I'm not exactly a master chef, but...\nI did build an automated assistance device.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_011
Array.english: <size=32>This should make things a bit easier, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>This should make things a bit easier, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_012
Array.english: I'll help out at the shop until the next rescue contact comes through.
Array.indonesia: I'll help out at the shop until the next rescue contact comes through.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_MartinTweedLakeClear_EmployeeOnboarding01_013
Array.english: <size=33>That sounds great! See you at the shop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That sounds great! See you at the shop!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, hey! You made it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, hey! You made it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Wanna try that <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> challenge I mentioned?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wanna try that <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> challenge I mentioned?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock_option01_001
Array.english: I'm in!
Array.indonesia: I'm in!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock_option01_002
Array.english: Maybe next time.
Array.indonesia: Maybe next time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock01_No_001
Array.english: Aww... that's too bad.\nCome find me when you feel like it.
Array.indonesia: Aww... that's too bad.\nCome find me when you feel like it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe. Now that's my kind of guy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe. Now that's my kind of guy!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock02_002
Array.english: The rules are simple. We take turns stacking these <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Blocks</color>, and whoever knocks them over first loses.
Array.indonesia: The rules are simple. We take turns stacking these <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Blocks</color>, and whoever knocks them over first loses.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock02_003
Array.english: Best way to learn? Try it yourself.\nLet's get started.
Array.indonesia: Best way to learn? Try it yourself.\nLet's get started.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Unlock01_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=34>How about it, wanna have a go at <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>How about it, wanna have a go at <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... this is pretty fun!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... this is pretty fun!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>Heh, glad to hear it, pal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Heh, glad to hear it, pal.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_003
Array.english: Plenty of folks around here love this game too.
Array.indonesia: Plenty of folks around here love this game too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_004
Array.english: Win a match, and I'll give you a <color=#F1DC2B>New Animal Block</color>.
Array.indonesia: Win a match, and I'll give you a <color=#F1DC2B>New Animal Block</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_005
Array.english: Bring me <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> of them... and I'll have a little something for you.
Array.indonesia: Bring me <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> of them... and I'll have a little something for you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_006
Array.english: <size=35>The more you collect, the more fun it gets. Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>The more you collect, the more fun it gets. Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_007
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, you're past the beginner stage...\nSo let's play for <color=#F1DC2B>Doni</color> this time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright, you're past the beginner stage...\nSo let's play for <color=#F1DC2B>Doni</color> this time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_End_008
Array.english: <size=34>How about we wager <color=#F1DC2B>30 Doni</color>? Just to make things interesting. You can raise the stakes if you want, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>How about we wager <color=#F1DC2B>30 Doni</color>? Just to make things interesting. You can raise the stakes if you want, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_NoMoney_001
Array.english: Huh? You don't have enough money.\nCome back next time.
Array.indonesia: Huh? You don't have enough money.\nCome back next time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_NoMoney_002
Array.english: <size=33>You'll need at least <color=#F1DC2B>30 Doni</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You'll need at least <color=#F1DC2B>30 Doni</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Start_001
Array.english: Oh... you thinking about a <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> match?
Array.indonesia: Oh... you thinking about a <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> match?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Start_Yes_001
Array.english: <size=34>Heh, let's get started.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Heh, let's get started.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Start_End_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, that was fun.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, that was fun.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Start_End_002
Array.english: <size=33>Come by again when you're bored.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Come by again when you're bored.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_Limit_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>I think I've played enough for today...\nBetter take it easy.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>I think I've played enough for today...\nBetter take it easy.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstNight_001
Array.english: I'm pretty used to life in the village now.
Array.indonesia: I'm pretty used to life in the village now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstNight_002
Array.english: Preparing ingredients in this heat is tough, though...
Array.indonesia: Preparing ingredients in this heat is tough, though...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? At this hour...\nWhat brings you here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hm? At this hour...\nWhat brings you here?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_002
Array.english: <size=32>Whew... finally found some civilization. Thought I was gonna end up spendin' the night out in them woods.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Whew... finally found some civilization. Thought I was gonna end up spendin' the night out in them woods.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_003
Array.english: <size=35>Lemme wet my whistle first...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Lemme wet my whistle first...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_004
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa... gasoline...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa... gasoline...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! It's water!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! It's water!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_006
Array.english: Back home in Tennessee, it gets real hot... so during shows,\nI fill this up with water and sip on it.
Array.indonesia: Back home in Tennessee, it gets real hot... so during shows,\nI fill this up with water and sip on it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_007
Array.english: It's just as hot out here, no joke... I was wanderin' around earlier and nearly got light-headed.
Array.indonesia: It's just as hot out here, no joke... I was wanderin' around earlier and nearly got light-headed.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_008
Array.english: You look like a musician...\nhow'd you end up here?
Array.indonesia: You look like a musician...\nhow'd you end up here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_009
Array.english: Oh, just lookin' for some inspiration for my new album.
Array.indonesia: Oh, just lookin' for some inspiration for my new album.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_010
Array.english: I was after a whole new kind of place...\nand this area fit the bill just right.
Array.indonesia: I was after a whole new kind of place...\nand this area fit the bill just right.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_011
Array.english: Nothin' but woods as far as the eye can see, flowers everywhere... and critters I've never seen in my life.
Array.indonesia: Nothin' but woods as far as the eye can see, flowers everywhere... and critters I've never seen in my life.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_012
Array.english: <size=32>I only meant to look around a bit, but I got turned around and ended up all the way out here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I only meant to look around a bit, but I got turned around and ended up all the way out here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_013
Array.english: But man...\nhaulin' two guitars around's about to do me in.
Array.indonesia: But man...\nhaulin' two guitars around's about to do me in.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_014
Array.english: Y'all know anywhere nearby I could crash for a bit?\nI'm about ready to kick my feet up.
Array.indonesia: Y'all know anywhere nearby I could crash for a bit?\nI'm about ready to kick my feet up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_015
Array.english: Hmm... If you stay near the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>, you should be fine without bothering the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... If you stay near the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>, you should be fine without bothering the villagers.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_016
Array.english: <size=33>Lucky me! I sure appreciate it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lucky me! I sure appreciate it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_FirstAppearance_017
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, by the way... name's <color=#F1DC2B>Charlie Bonnet III</color>.\nDon't you forget it! Rock 'n' roll, y'hear?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, by the way... name's <color=#F1DC2B>Charlie Bonnet III</color>.\nDon't you forget it! Rock 'n' roll, y'hear?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_ AfterLeave_001
Array.english: Coming all this way just to write music...\nYou must really love it.
Array.indonesia: Coming all this way just to write music...\nYou must really love it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_001
Array.english: Um... that guy who just showed up at Lake Beach...
Array.indonesia: Um... that guy who just showed up at Lake Beach...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_002
Array.english: <size=34>Is he a musician?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Is he a musician?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_003
Array.english: Yeah, I think so. He said he came all this way to work on a new song.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, I think so. He said he came all this way to work on a new song.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_004
Array.english: <size=33>I saw him playing as I walked by...\nHe was really good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I saw him playing as I walked by...\nHe was really good!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_005
Array.english: Really? Then why not go talk to him?
Array.indonesia: Really? Then why not go talk to him?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_006
Array.english: <size=34>What?! But that guy...\nHe was drinking oil!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What?! But that guy...\nHe was drinking oil!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_007
Array.english: He said it was water...
Array.indonesia: He said it was water...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_008
Array.english: <size=32>If you're nervous, I can go with you. What do you think?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If you're nervous, I can go with you. What do you think?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaInterest_009
Array.english: Uh... okay.
Array.indonesia: Uh... okay.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? Who's this young fella?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Who's this young fella?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_002
Array.english: He's a friend of mine who plays music here...\nHe got curious after hearing your guitar.
Array.indonesia: He's a friend of mine who plays music here...\nHe got curious after hearing your guitar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! A fella who knows his music!!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! A fella who knows his music!!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_004
Array.english: Now hold on, is that a local instrument you're carryin'? \nSix strings too, kinda like a guitar.
Array.indonesia: Now hold on, is that a local instrument you're carryin'? \nSix strings too, kinda like a guitar.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_005
Array.english: Yes. It's called <color=#1DFEAF>Panting</color>... \nA traditional string instrument from this region.
Array.indonesia: Yes. It's called <color=#1DFEAF>Panting</color>... \nA traditional string instrument from this region.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_006
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh... Mind givin' me a little taste?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ooh... Mind givin' me a little taste?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_007
Array.english: <size=36>W-What?! That's... so sudden...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>W-What?! That's... so sudden...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_008
Array.english: <size=33>Have some confidence! You're a great player!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Have some confidence! You're a great player!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie01_009
Array.english: Ugh... okay, just a short one...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... okay, just a short one...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh... that's real nice...! Your chord work and finger movement are solid!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh... that's real nice...! Your chord work and finger movement are solid!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_002
Array.english: Been playin' a while, ain't ya?
Array.indonesia: Been playin' a while, ain't ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Say... I've got an electric sittin' around. \nWanna give it a try?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Say... I've got an electric sittin' around. \nWanna give it a try?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_004
Array.english: <size=34>What?! An electric guitar?!\nI've never played one before?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What?! An electric guitar?!\nI've never played one before?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Don't you worry!\nIt's all just strings and frets, ain't it?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Don't you worry!\nIt's all just strings and frets, ain't it?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_006
Array.english: <size=32>I'll handle the vocals and rhythm on my acoustic. You just sprinkle in some nice fills when it feels right.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll handle the vocals and rhythm on my acoustic. You just sprinkle in some nice fills when it feels right.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_JakaMeetChalie02_007
Array.english: <size=33>Just go with your gut, buddy. Play what feels right!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Just go with your gut, buddy. Play what feels right!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_PlaytheGuitar_Ask_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh no... what should I do...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh no... what should I do...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_PlaytheGuitar_Option01
Array.english: Give it a try! <color=#fde221><size=20>(A mini-game will begin.)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: Give it a try! <color=#fde221><size=20>(A mini-game will begin.)</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_PlaytheGuitar_Option02
Array.english: Maybe next time
Array.indonesia: Maybe next time

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_StartGame_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! Let's do this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright! Let's do this!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_StartGame_002
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Love that energy!\nI'll start us off, you just follow my lead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Love that energy!\nI'll start us off, you just follow my lead.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NextTime_001
Array.english: I... I think I need a bit more time.\nI'll come back!
Array.indonesia: I... I think I need a bit more time.\nI'll come back!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NextTime_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Don't you go gettin' all nervous on me now! No rush, come by when you're ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Don't you go gettin' all nervous on me now! No rush, come by when you're ready!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>Now... I think I can play with that guy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Now... I think I can play with that guy!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Option01
Array.english: Start right away <color=#fde221><size=20>(The mini-game will begin.)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: Start right away <color=#fde221><size=20>(The mini-game will begin.)</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Option02
Array.english: Tell him you'll do it later
Array.indonesia: Tell him you'll do it later

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Now_001
Array.english: <size=33>Sounds exciting!\nLet's head to Lake Beach right now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sounds exciting!\nLet's head to Lake Beach right now.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Later_001
Array.english: Oh... I've got something I need to finish.\nI'll come back later!
Array.indonesia: Oh... I've got something I need to finish.\nI'll come back later!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Move_001
Array.english: The musician should be over by Lake Beach.
Array.indonesia: The musician should be over by Lake Beach.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Start_001
Array.english: Well looky here! Somebody's ready to rock!\nThis here's the electric for ya.
Array.indonesia: Well looky here! Somebody's ready to rock!\nThis here's the electric for ya.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_Retry_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'm gonna lay down the rhythm, you go ahead and throw a nice solo on top.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm gonna lay down the rhythm, you go ahead and throw a nice solo on top.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! That was a blast!!\nYou've got real talent!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! That was a blast!!\nYou've got real talent!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_002
Array.english: Wow!! The electric guitar really hits you right in the chest!
Array.indonesia: Wow!! The electric guitar really hits you right in the chest!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe. Ain't this place somethin'?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe. Ain't this place somethin'?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_004
Array.english: I think I'll stick around a while and let the music come to me. Might even write a song about this town.
Array.indonesia: I think I'll stick around a while and let the music come to me. Might even write a song about this town.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_005
Array.english: Oh... could I learn some music from you while you're here?
Array.indonesia: Oh... could I learn some music from you while you're here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_006
Array.english: <size=34>Of course! I'll teach ya here and there when we get the chance!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Of course! I'll teach ya here and there when we get the chance!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_007
Array.english: Say, speakin' of... somebody nearby's got some barbecue goin', and it smells incredible!
Array.indonesia: Say, speakin' of... somebody nearby's got some barbecue goin', and it smells incredible!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_008
Array.english: Oh, that's Bancho's place. He's with us.\nI help out there too.
Array.indonesia: Oh, that's Bancho's place. He's with us.\nI help out there too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_009
Array.english: Ooh... back in Nashville, we got some famous barbecue too. \nI used to fire up the grill for my family all the time.
Array.indonesia: Ooh... back in Nashville, we got some famous barbecue too. \nI used to fire up the grill for my family all the time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_010
Array.english: <size=33>Well now... how 'bout I help out at the shop while I'm stayin' here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well now... how 'bout I help out at the shop while I'm stayin' here?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_011
Array.english: I'm runnin' low on supplies, and it don't feel right freeloadin'.
Array.indonesia: I'm runnin' low on supplies, and it don't feel right freeloadin'.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_012
Array.english: <size=32>Oh...! That'd be amazing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh...! That'd be amazing!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_CharlieBonnet_NewEmployee_013
Array.english: <size=35>See you at the shop, Charlie!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>See you at the shop, Charlie!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm? Dr. Bacon, what are you digging up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm? Dr. Bacon, what are you digging up?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, Dave. This is... something called an <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystal</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, Dave. This is... something called an <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystal</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_003
Array.english: It's a unique mineral found only in this region... I've been studying it since it might be useful for crafting tools.
Array.indonesia: It's a unique mineral found only in this region... I've been studying it since it might be useful for crafting tools.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>Take a look at this!\nCan you feel that energy coming off it?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Take a look at this!\nCan you feel that energy coming off it?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... there's a kind of shimmering light flowing through it...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... there's a kind of shimmering light flowing through it...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_006
Array.english: Haha! It's a fascinating material.
Array.indonesia: Haha! It's a fascinating material.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_007
Array.english: The only issue is you can only extract a small amount from each crystal... I could use your help with that.
Array.indonesia: The only issue is you can only extract a small amount from each crystal... I could use your help with that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_008
Array.english: Hmm? How can I help?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? How can I help?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_009
Array.english: You should be able to find solidified <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color> scattered around the village and the lake.
Array.indonesia: You should be able to find solidified <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color> scattered around the village and the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_010
Array.english: <size=33>Bring me around <color=#1DFEAF>7</color> of them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bring me around <color=#1DFEAF>7</color> of them.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_011
Array.english: I'll study those and try to make some tools you can use at the lake.
Array.indonesia: I'll study those and try to make some tools you can use at the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_012
Array.english: Oh... I was just wishing I had some of Cobra's tools.\nPerfect timing.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I was just wishing I had some of Cobra's tools.\nPerfect timing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_Start_013
Array.english: <size=32>I'll collect them whenever I come across any in the village or lake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll collect them whenever I come across any in the village or lake.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_End_001
Array.english: Oh, did you manage to gather 7 <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, did you manage to gather 7 <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_CheckDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, here they are
Array.indonesia: Yes, here they are

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_CheckDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here they are.
Array.indonesia: Here they are.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! This should be more than enough!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh...! This should be more than enough!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: First, I've made some simple tools using the crystals \nI gathered.
Array.indonesia: First, I've made some simple tools using the crystals \nI gathered.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=33>If you bring me more <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>, I can continue my research!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If you bring me more <color=#E6ABFF>Utara Crystals</color>, I can continue my research!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: <size=34>Got it. I'll pick them up whenever I spot any!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Got it. I'll pick them up whenever I spot any!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_GiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, I haven't found them all yet!\nI'll keep looking.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I haven't found them all yet!\nI'll keep looking.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Bacon_Lab_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Hmm... I haven't found them yet. \nI'll search around the village and lake a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I haven't found them yet. \nI'll search around the village and lake a bit more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... this won't do...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... this won't do...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_002
Array.english: Hm? Rimbo, something on your mind?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Rimbo, something on your mind?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_003
Array.english: Ah, well... I had a <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> charm hanging in my truck, \nbut it broke.
Array.indonesia: Ah, well... I had a <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> charm hanging in my truck, \nbut it broke.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_004
Array.english: It's supposed to keep you safe on the road, so...\nhavin' it busted's got me a bit uneasy.
Array.indonesia: It's supposed to keep you safe on the road, so...\nhavin' it busted's got me a bit uneasy.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_005
Array.english: I see. If I come across a <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color>, want me to grab it for you?
Array.indonesia: I see. If I come across a <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color>, want me to grab it for you?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_006
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, I'd sure appreciate that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, I'd sure appreciate that!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_007
Array.english: Past the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>, there's a spot where birds gather…\nYou might find one there.
Array.indonesia: Past the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>, there's a spot where birds gather…\nYou might find one there.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerStart_008
Array.english: Got it. I'll check around the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>.
Array.indonesia: Got it. I'll check around the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerFindItem_001
Array.english: Hm? That looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> Rimbo mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Hm? That looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> Rimbo mentioned.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerFindItem_002
Array.english: <size=32>Should I go pick it up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Should I go pick it up?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerItemMove_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa?! What's with that sudden gust...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa?! What's with that sudden gust...?!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerItemMove_002
Array.english: <size=35>It's going to blow away...\nI should move in slowly and grab it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It's going to blow away...\nI should move in slowly and grab it.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerFailMissionItem_001
Array.english: Ugh... I lost it. If I run toward it, it flies away.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... I lost it. If I run toward it, it flies away.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerFailMissionItem_002
Array.english: Next time I see it, I'll approach more slowly.
Array.indonesia: Next time I see it, I'll approach more slowly.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerRetryMissionItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, it's the <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> I missed earlier!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, it's the <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color> I missed earlier!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerRetryMissionItem_002
Array.english: Running toward it made it fly away, right?
Array.indonesia: Running toward it made it fly away, right?

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerRetryMissionItem_003
Array.english: <size=33>This time, I'll catch it for sure.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This time, I'll catch it for sure.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGetMissionItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... finally caught it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew... finally caught it.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGetMissionItem_002

Array.indonesia: It looks even prettier up close. \nMust be from a magnificent bird.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGetMissionItem_003

Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should take it to Rimbo!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! <color=#F1DC2B>Did ya get the red feather</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! <color=#F1DC2B>Did ya get the red feather</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, I got it
Array.indonesia: Yes, I got it

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: This is it, right? The <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color>.
Array.indonesia: This is it, right? The <color=#F1DC2B>Red Feather</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! That's the one!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! That's the one!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Hehe, now I can fix my charm. Might sound like superstition, but I haven't had a single accident since I hung it up.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, now I can fix my charm. Might sound like superstition, but I haven't had a single accident since I hung it up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=33>Thank ya, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thank ya, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Oughta give ya somethin' in return...
Array.indonesia: Oughta give ya somethin' in return...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: <size=33>Ah! The village is pretty big, so gettin' around ain't easy... Why don't ya take this <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah! The village is pretty big, so gettin' around ain't easy... Why don't ya take this <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: <size=32>It's red, which just so happens to be my lucky color, haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's red, which just so happens to be my lucky color, haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... a <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... a <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe. This will make getting around a lot easier!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe. This will make getting around a lot easier!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_Finished_010
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe. Then I reckon I'll be seein' ya more often!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe. Then I reckon I'll be seein' ya more often!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Here you go.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm? Feels like somethin's missin'.\nTake another look, will ya?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Feels like somethin's missin'.\nTake another look, will ya?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Ah... guess I was mistaken.\nI haven't found it yet.
Array.indonesia: Ah... guess I was mistaken.\nI haven't found it yet.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerGiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll keep looking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_02_MVillagerRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Not yet... I'll keep looking a bit longer.
Array.indonesia: Not yet... I'll keep looking a bit longer.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... they all flew away...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... they all flew away...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_002
Array.english: What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: What's wrong?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Fireflies</color> I kept in a jar for light at home...\nthey all escaped.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>Fireflies</color> I kept in a jar for light at home...\nthey all escaped.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_004
Array.english: I had them instead of lanterns so the lizards wouldn't be uncomfortable at night.
Array.indonesia: I had them instead of lanterns so the lizards wouldn't be uncomfortable at night.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_005
Array.english: I see...\nIs there anything I can help with?
Array.indonesia: I see...\nIs there anything I can help with?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_006
Array.english: Ah... I tried catching them again, but it's not going very well...
Array.indonesia: Ah... I tried catching them again, but it's not going very well...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>Could you catch <color=#F1DC2B>3 Fireflies</color> for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Could you catch <color=#F1DC2B>3 Fireflies</color> for me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_008
Array.english: Oh... but I don't have anything to catch them with...
Array.indonesia: Oh... but I don't have anything to catch them with...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_009
Array.english: Ah! Right...\nThen...
Array.indonesia: Ah! Right...\nThen...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_010
Array.english: <size=33>Here, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Bug Net</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Here, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Bug Net</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_011
Array.english: Oh... this should work!
Array.indonesia: Oh... this should work!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerStart_012
Array.english: <size=32>Leave it to me, haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Leave it to me, haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerDelivery_001
Array.english: Oh, Dave. Were you able to catch the <color=#F1DC2B>Fireflies</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. Were you able to catch the <color=#F1DC2B>Fireflies</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, I got them
Array.indonesia: Yes, I got them

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Hmm... not yet
Array.indonesia: Hmm... not yet

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: <size=31>Here are <color=#F1DC2B>3 Fireflies</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Here are <color=#F1DC2B>3 Fireflies</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh my, thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh my, thank you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Now I can have some light at night so the lizards won't be uncomfortable.
Array.indonesia: Now I can have some light at night so the lizards won't be uncomfortable.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you, Dave.\nYou're really very kind.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thank you, Dave.\nYou're really very kind.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: <size=33>Ha... haha! It's nothing, really...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha... haha! It's nothing, really...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Please keep up the good work.
Array.indonesia: Please keep up the good work.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: <size=33>Here you go, Lipah.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Here you go, Lipah.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Oh, that's not 3 yet.\nI'll need a little more.
Array.indonesia: Oh, that's not 3 yet.\nI'll need a little more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerGiveItem_NoItem_001

Array.indonesia: Actually, I haven't caught them yet.\nI'll let you know when I do!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_04_FMVillagerRefuseGiveItem_001

Array.indonesia: <size=33>Not yet. I'll catch them next time!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_GoodMorning_001

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeupMAX_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, it's already this late?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeupMAX_002
Array.english: <size=32>I totally overslept...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I totally overslept...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeupMAX02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... already this late...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... already this late...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Morning_LateWakeupMAX02_002
Array.english: <size=30>Stayed up late and slept like a rock.\nBetter get moving.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Stayed up late and slept like a rock.\nBetter get moving.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_SushiBarTime_001
Array.english: <size=33>It's about time to head to the restaurant.\nLet's go help with prep.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It's about time to head to the restaurant.\nLet's go help with prep.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_AfterWorkDefault01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew, long day.\nMaybe I'll look around a bit before bed?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew, long day.\nMaybe I'll look around a bit before bed?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_001

Array.indonesia: I'm getting pretty tired... If I stay up much longer,\nit'll affect tomorrow.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_Option01

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_Option02
Array.english: <image=UI_Jungle_Dialogue_Noti_Icon_Sleep, preset=Dialogue_KR/>Go to bed
Array.indonesia: <image=UI_Jungle_Dialogue_Noti_Icon_Sleep, preset=Dialogue_KR/>Go to bed

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_PlayMore_001
Array.english: I'm a bit tired, but... let's explore just a bit more.
Array.indonesia: I'm a bit tired, but... let's explore just a bit more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightPenalty_GoToBed_001
Array.english: <size=32>I should get some rest for tomorrow.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should get some rest for tomorrow.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightFinish_001
Array.english: Ugh... too tired to go on... Z... Z... Z...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... too tired to go on... Z... Z... Z...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightWarning01_001
Array.english: If I stay up too late, tomorrow's gonna be rough...\nHmm?
Array.indonesia: If I stay up too late, tomorrow's gonna be rough...\nHmm?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightWarning02_001
Array.english: I'm so sleepy my eyes are starting to close... ugh.
Array.indonesia: I'm so sleepy my eyes are starting to close... ugh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTimeFirstDay_001
Array.english: Hmm... the bed looks a bit stiff.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... the bed looks a bit stiff.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTimeFirstDay_002
Array.english: But the village chief went out of his way to set this up for me.
Array.indonesia: But the village chief went out of his way to set this up for me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTimeFirstDay_003
Array.english: I'm so tired, I'll probably fall asleep right away anyway...
Array.indonesia: I'm so tired, I'll probably fall asleep right away anyway...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTime_001
Array.english: <size=33>Time to call it a night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Time to call it a night.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_LateNightBedTime_001
Array.english: <size=33>It's getting pretty late...</size>

Array.english: <image=UI_Jungle_Dialogue_Noti_Icon_Sleep, preset=Dialogue_KR/>Go to sleep
Array.indonesia: <image=UI_Jungle_Dialogue_Noti_Icon_Sleep, preset=Dialogue_KR/>Go to sleep

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTime_Option02
Array.english: Look around a bit more
Array.indonesia: Look around a bit more

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTime_PlayMore_001
Array.english: Not that sleepy yet. I'll look around a bit more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_NightBedTime_GoToBed_001
Array.english: Better get some sleep for tomorrow. Yawn.
