Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_GetNPCRequestMission_001
Array.english: <size=32>Got a request. I should jot it down.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Got a request. I should jot it down.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_TimeOverToDive_001
Array.english: Can't go back in there today.\nLet's get the shop ready.
Array.indonesia: Can't go back in there today.\nLet's get the shop ready.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Common_NotNowMinigame_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm... now's not really the time for games.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm... now's not really the time for games.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Greetings, outsider.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Greetings, outsider.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse01_002
Array.english: Yes, Chief? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Yes, Chief? What is it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse01_003
Array.english: I was so occupied discussing cooking earlier that I neglected to mention...
Array.indonesia: I was so occupied discussing cooking earlier that I neglected to mention...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_001
Array.english: <size=34>You may use this house as well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You may use this house as well.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_002
Array.english: It is a bit old, but... It should suffice for you to stay in for a while.
Array.indonesia: It is a bit old, but... It should suffice for you to stay in for a while.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_003
Array.english: Oh, and you are... a diver, was it?
Array.indonesia: Oh, and you are... a diver, was it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_004
Array.english: Yes. I'm a professional with quite a bit of experience.\nHaha.
Array.indonesia: Yes. I'm a professional with quite a bit of experience.\nHaha.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DaveHouse02_005
Array.english: I see. If you wish to enter the lake, use the deck over there.
Array.indonesia: I see. If you wish to enter the lake, use the deck over there.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Introduce_DivingDeck_001
Array.english: The lake is not in great condition at the moment,\nso do not go too deep.
Array.indonesia: The lake is not in great condition at the moment,\nso do not go too deep.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_001
Array.english: <size=32>It seems you are ready to open.\nMost impressive.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It seems you are ready to open.\nMost impressive.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_002
Array.english: Oh, Chief! Thanks to you, we got everything sorted out quickly.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Chief! Thanks to you, we got everything sorted out quickly.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_003
Array.english: We're planning to start serving food to the villagers today. We've stocked up on ingredients as well.
Array.indonesia: We're planning to start serving food to the villagers today. We've stocked up on ingredients as well.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_004
Array.english: I have informed the villagers that you will be opening a restaurant... but I am unsure how many will come.
Array.indonesia: I have informed the villagers that you will be opening a restaurant... but I am unsure how many will come.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_005
Array.english: As you build rapport with the residents, they will gradually lower their guard.
Array.indonesia: As you build rapport with the residents, they will gradually lower their guard.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_006
Array.english: <size=33>If I leave you a <color=#ff885f>Badge</color> of recognition here, the villagers may trust you a bit more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If I leave you a <color=#ff885f>Badge</color> of recognition here, the villagers may trust you a bit more.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_007
Array.english: <size=33>For now, I shall hang this <color=#ff885f>Mouse-Deer Badge</color> here. The villagers will take it as a sign that the food is good.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>For now, I shall hang this <color=#ff885f>Mouse-Deer Badge</color> here. The villagers will take it as a sign that the food is good.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_008
Array.english: Oh, thank you! Let's hope the villagers feel more at ease now!
Array.indonesia: Oh, thank you! Let's hope the villagers feel more at ease now!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_009
Array.english: Hmm. But how do I raise the <color=#ff885f>Badge</color>'s Rating?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. But how do I raise the <color=#ff885f>Badge</color>'s Rating?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_010
Array.english: I shall tell you a few conditions.\nFulfill them, and I will grant you a new badge.
Array.indonesia: I shall tell you a few conditions.\nFulfill them, and I will grant you a new badge.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_SushibarGrade_011
Array.english: Got it. We'll do well.
Array.indonesia: Got it. We'll do well.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haa... haa... finally... a village... with people...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haa... haa... finally... a village... with people...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_002
Array.english: <size=36>...Sato?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>...Sato?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_003
Array.english: <size=32>Huh...?! Dave? Is that you...?\nWhat are the odds...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh...?! Dave? Is that you...?\nWhat are the odds...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_004
Array.english: <size=33>W-Water... please... just water first...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>W-Water... please... just water first...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_005
Array.english: <size=33>Y-Yeah... here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Y-Yeah... here!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Gulp... gulp...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Gulp... gulp...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_007
Array.english: <size=35>Phew!! That hit the spot!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Phew!! That hit the spot!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_008
Array.english: What are you doing out here?
Array.indonesia: What are you doing out here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_009
Array.english: Oh, I'm staying in the village with Dr. Bacon while we do some research in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I'm staying in the village with Dr. Bacon while we do some research in the jungle.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_010
Array.english: Ohhh, got it! Well, since we ran into each other...
Array.indonesia: Ohhh, got it! Well, since we ran into each other...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_011
Array.english: <size=34>Mind if I stay here for a while too?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mind if I stay here for a while too?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_012
Array.english: Of course. You can stay near the tents, away from the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Of course. You can stay near the tents, away from the villagers.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_013
Array.english: How did you end up all the way out here?
Array.indonesia: How did you end up all the way out here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_014
Array.english: I was using this new app called <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>...\nand next thing I knew, I was here.
Array.indonesia: I was using this new app called <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>...\nand next thing I knew, I was here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_015
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>...?\nIs that different from Marinca?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>...?\nIs that different from Marinca?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_016
Array.english: Yes! Exactly! There were some complaints about the original app...
Array.indonesia: Yes! Exactly! There were some complaints about the original app...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_017
Array.english: People would swim forever, walk for ages to collect Marinca... but none of it was being tracked!
Array.indonesia: People would swim forever, walk for ages to collect Marinca... but none of it was being tracked!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_018
Array.english: <size=33>So they made a spin-off app, <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>So they made a spin-off app, <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_019
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> tracks your steps... and even your swimming distance!
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> tracks your steps... and even your swimming distance!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_020
Array.english: <size=32>All that gets turned into points to grow a <color=#1DFEAF>Giant Flower</color> \nin the app!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>All that gets turned into points to grow a <color=#1DFEAF>Giant Flower</color> \nin the app!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_021
Array.english: When the <color=#1DFEAF>Giant Flower</color> blooms, you're supposed to get some kind of reward... Though, I haven't confirmed that yet. Still working on my collection.
Array.indonesia: When the <color=#1DFEAF>Giant Flower</color> blooms, you're supposed to get some kind of reward... Though, I haven't confirmed that yet. Still working on my collection.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_022
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! By the way...\nDid you bring your phone?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! By the way...\nDid you bring your phone?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_023
Array.english: Yeah... but most apps don't work here. It's too remote.
Array.indonesia: Yeah... but most apps don't work here. It's too remote.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_024
Array.english: Haha! That's the best part! <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> uses the Space Network. No connection issues, even out here!
Array.indonesia: Haha! That's the best part! <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> uses the Space Network. No connection issues, even out here!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_025
Array.english: Actually, it's still in beta, so you need a friend code... \nAnd you're in luck, I've got one left!
Array.indonesia: Actually, it's still in beta, so you need a friend code... \nAnd you're in luck, I've got one left!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_026
Array.english: <size=34>Wanna take your first step as a Marinca Bloom collector?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wanna take your first step as a Marinca Bloom collector?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01
Array.english: Sounds fun!
Array.indonesia: Sounds fun!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02
Array.english: Not right now...
Array.indonesia: Not right now...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_001
Array.english: <size=32>That sounds great!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That sounds great!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_002
Array.english: But... how do I get started?
Array.indonesia: But... how do I get started?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_003
Array.english: Haha! Take out your phone.\nI'll send you the code!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Take out your phone.\nI'll send you the code!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_004
Array.english: Hm? I got some kind of link.
Array.indonesia: Hm? I got some kind of link.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_005
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Just install it from there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Just install it from there!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_006
Array.english: Basically, just like Marinca. Catch fish, unlock cards, completion goes up automatically.
Array.indonesia: Basically, just like Marinca. Catch fish, unlock cards, completion goes up automatically.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_007
Array.english: But just collecting cards isn't enough to grow the <color=#F1DC2B>Seed</color>.
Array.indonesia: But just collecting cards isn't enough to grow the <color=#F1DC2B>Seed</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_008
Array.english: You'll need to keep its health up...
Array.indonesia: You'll need to keep its health up...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_009
Array.english: For that, you'll need <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>.
Array.indonesia: For that, you'll need <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_010
Array.english: I see. And how do I get those?
Array.indonesia: I see. And how do I get those?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_011
Array.english: That's where <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> works its magic! \nYour steps and swimming distance get converted into points!
Array.indonesia: That's where <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> works its magic! \nYour steps and swimming distance get converted into points!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_012
Array.english: Anyway, better to try it yourself than listen to me ramble!
Array.indonesia: Anyway, better to try it yourself than listen to me ramble!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_013
Array.english: I'll be around the village, so just ask if you need anything.
Array.indonesia: I'll be around the village, so just ask if you need anything.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option01Answer_014
Array.english: <size=35>Chu... I mean, Monmon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Chu... I mean, Monmon!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_001
Array.english: I've got a lot to focus on right now...\nso this might be a bit tough.
Array.indonesia: I've got a lot to focus on right now...\nso this might be a bit tough.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! Dave! \nThat's exactly who <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> is for!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Dave! \nThat's exactly who <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> is for!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_003
Array.english: The distance you cover underwater...\nThe steps you take on land...
Array.indonesia: The distance you cover underwater...\nThe steps you take on land...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_004
Array.english: It all gets tracked and converted into\n<color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>!
Array.indonesia: It all gets tracked and converted into\n<color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_005
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>...?\nHow do I use those?
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>...?\nHow do I use those?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_006
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> works pretty much like Marinca. Catch fish, unlock cards, and your completion goes up automatically.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> works pretty much like Marinca. Catch fish, unlock cards, and your completion goes up automatically.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_007
Array.english: But collecting cards alone isn't enough to grow the <color=#F1DC2B>Seed</color>.
Array.indonesia: But collecting cards alone isn't enough to grow the <color=#F1DC2B>Seed</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_008
Array.english: You'll need to keep its health up...
Array.indonesia: You'll need to keep its health up...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_009
Array.english: For that, you'll need <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>.
Array.indonesia: For that, you'll need <color=#F1DC2B>Nutrients</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Water</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_010
Array.english: Anyway, better to try it yourself than listen to me ramble!
Array.indonesia: Anyway, better to try it yourself than listen to me ramble!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_011
Array.english: I just sent you an invite link, go ahead and install it!
Array.indonesia: I just sent you an invite link, go ahead and install it!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_012
Array.english: I'll be resting in the village, so feel free to ask if you need anything.
Array.indonesia: I'll be resting in the village, so feel free to ask if you need anything.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_ContentsUnlock_MarincaBloom_option02Answer_013
Array.english: <size=35>Chu... I mean, Monmon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Chu... I mean, Monmon!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_BeforeTalk_001
Array.english: Hmm. Just as I thought, not many villagers are coming by.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Just as I thought, not many villagers are coming by.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_BeforeTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah...\nI think they're a bit wary of us.
Array.indonesia: Yeah...\nI think they're a bit wary of us.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hello... you must be the outsiders?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hello... you must be the outsiders?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_002
Array.english: Who are you...?\nOh, were you the one who brought us food...?
Array.indonesia: Who are you...?\nOh, were you the one who brought us food...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_003
Array.english: Yes, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Uzme</color>, the village chief's daughter.
Array.indonesia: Yes, I'm <color=#F1DC2B>Uzme</color>, the village chief's daughter.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_004
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you for the food yesterday.\nThe taste was quite terri...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thank you for the food yesterday.\nThe taste was quite terri...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_005
Array.english: <size=39>Bancho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=39>Bancho!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_006
Array.english: Hahaha, it's okay! I tried a proper chef's cooking at the restaurant earlier... and it was on a whole different level.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, it's okay! I tried a proper chef's cooking at the restaurant earlier... and it was on a whole different level.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_007
Array.english: <size=34>Call me Bancho.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Call me Bancho.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_008
Array.english: <size=32>Nice to meet you, Bancho...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nice to meet you, Bancho...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_009
Array.english: <size=32>And who's this with you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>And who's this with you?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_010
Array.english: I'm Dave. A professional diver.
Array.indonesia: I'm Dave. A professional diver.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_011
Array.english: Nice to meet you, Dave.\nIf you don't mind...
Array.indonesia: Nice to meet you, Dave.\nIf you don't mind...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_012
Array.english: <size=34>How about I show you around the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>How about I show you around the village?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_013
Array.english: Oh... that sounds great. I've been curious about a lot of things while exploring.
Array.indonesia: Oh... that sounds great. I've been curious about a lot of things while exploring.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_014
Array.english: Haha... You'll be staying here for a while... I thought it'd be nice if you got to know the village a bit better.
Array.indonesia: Haha... You'll be staying here for a while... I thought it'd be nice if you got to know the village a bit better.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_015
Array.english: Hmm. I have some cleaning up to do...\nThank you for the offer, but you two go ahead.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I have some cleaning up to do...\nThank you for the offer, but you two go ahead.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_FirstMeet_016
Array.english: <size=42><color=#E3E3E3>(...)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42><color=#E3E3E3>(...)</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Stone_001
Array.english: Have you heard... about the recent earthquakes?
Array.indonesia: Have you heard... about the recent earthquakes?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Stone_002
Array.english: Yes. I heard the fish have become more sensitive because of it.
Array.indonesia: Yes. I heard the fish have become more sensitive because of it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Stone_003
Array.english: That's right. Recently, there was a major earthquake, and rocks fell... The path to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> has been blocked.
Array.indonesia: That's right. Recently, there was a major earthquake, and rocks fell... The path to <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> has been blocked.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Stone_004
Array.english: It's good that wild animals can't get in, but... I'm worried, since things that never used to happen are happening lately.
Array.indonesia: It's good that wild animals can't get in, but... I'm worried, since things that never used to happen are happening lately.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_NightDive_001
Array.english: Now, crocodiles come to the lake to rest at night.
Array.indonesia: Now, crocodiles come to the lake to rest at night.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_NightDive_002
Array.english: They won't attack without warning, but...\nIt's still best not to go into the lake at night.
Array.indonesia: They won't attack without warning, but...\nIt's still best not to go into the lake at night.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_NightDive_003
Array.english: When I was young, my father... was injured by a crocodile while trying to save me.
Array.indonesia: When I was young, my father... was injured by a crocodile while trying to save me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_NightDive_004
Array.english: So that's why he has trouble with his leg...
Array.indonesia: So that's why he has trouble with his leg...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Beach_001
Array.english: This is the sandy beach. It's where villagers gather by the bonfire or enjoy the night air.
Array.indonesia: This is the sandy beach. It's where villagers gather by the bonfire or enjoy the night air.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Beach_002
Array.english: It's a beautiful place, but that dinosaur carcass does smell \na bit...
Array.indonesia: It's a beautiful place, but that dinosaur carcass does smell \na bit...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Beach_003
Array.english: I heard it suddenly floated in at night and startled the residents.
Array.indonesia: I heard it suddenly floated in at night and startled the residents.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_Beach_004
Array.english: I can imagine how shocking that must've been.
Array.indonesia: I can imagine how shocking that must've been.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_CampFire_001
Array.english: There are some men sitting by the bonfire today.
Array.indonesia: There are some men sitting by the bonfire today.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_CampFire_002
Array.english: <size=32>I wonder if they're gossiping about their wives? Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I wonder if they're gossiping about their wives? Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_001
Array.english: I... come here to look at the lake when I have a lot on my mind.
Array.indonesia: I... come here to look at the lake when I have a lot on my mind.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_002
Array.english: Dave, do you have any worries?
Array.indonesia: Dave, do you have any worries?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_003
Array.english: Well... I'm a bit worried that the villagers aren't really coming to our restaurant, even though we worked hard preparing the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Well... I'm a bit worried that the villagers aren't really coming to our restaurant, even though we worked hard preparing the ingredients.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_004
Array.english: Haha. The villagers probably won't be quick to try an outsider's cooking.
Array.indonesia: Haha. The villagers probably won't be quick to try an outsider's cooking.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_005
Array.english: Try talking with them, or...
Array.indonesia: Try talking with them, or...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_006
Array.english: <size=35>How about giving them <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>How about giving them <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_007
Array.english: It's a tradition in our village to give and receive <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color>.
Array.indonesia: It's a tradition in our village to give and receive <color=#FF73C3>Gifts</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_008
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, that sounds like a good idea!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, that sounds like a good idea!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_GiftUnlock_009
Array.english: Everyone has different tastes... so it'd be a good idea to learn their preferences.
Array.indonesia: Everyone has different tastes... so it'd be a good idea to learn their preferences.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_001
Array.english: Oh, now that I think about it... have you had any trouble getting around the village?
Array.indonesia: Oh, now that I think about it... have you had any trouble getting around the village?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_002
Array.english: Actually... the houses all look pretty similar,\nand I'm not used to it yet, so it's a bit confusing.
Array.indonesia: Actually... the houses all look pretty similar,\nand I'm not used to it yet, so it's a bit confusing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_003
Array.english: Hehe! That happens when you're new somewhere.
Array.indonesia: Hehe! That happens when you're new somewhere.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_004
Array.english: <size=33>Here... this is a <color=#1DFEAF>Map</color> of the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Here... this is a <color=#1DFEAF>Map</color> of the village.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_005
Array.english: With this, you'll be able to find people and places much more easily.
Array.indonesia: With this, you'll be able to find people and places much more easily.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_006
Array.english: <size=35>Oh... this will really help.\nThank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh... this will really help.\nThank you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_RelationEvent_Uzme_IntroduceVillage_MiniMapUnlock_007
Array.english: Same goes for Bancho... I'm happy when everyone feels comfortable here.
Array.indonesia: Same goes for Bancho... I'm happy when everyone feels comfortable here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FirstEntryHazardZone_001
Array.english: Oh... It's actually fine with the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>.\nBetter explore before it runs out!
Array.indonesia: Oh... It's actually fine with the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>.\nBetter explore before it runs out!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FirstDay_HazardZoneLook_001
Array.english: <size=33>Down there... it looks really murky...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Down there... it looks really murky...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_FirstDay_HazardZoneLook_002
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color> usually stay near the surface...\nSo I don't need to go too deep.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Tilapia</color> usually stay near the surface...\nSo I don't need to go too deep.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_Lake_A_WoodenBarricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? This area's blocked off with stakes.\nI wonder why...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? This area's blocked off with stakes.\nI wonder why...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_HazardWarning_NeedFilterUpgrade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... the hydrogen sulfide is too dense down here. I'd better not go any deeper with this <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... the hydrogen sulfide is too dense down here. I'd better not go any deeper with this <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_Event_HazardWarning_NeedFilterUpgrade_002
Array.english: <size=32>Come to think of it, Muna said she could modify the <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color>. I should go see her later.</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=33>I was just about to come up with a good melody... Well, take care.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Oh? Sounds like you have something specific to say to me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh? Sounds like you have something specific to say to me?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>I'm not quite ready, but... go on.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'm not quite ready, but... go on.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>You really want to keep talking...\nI suppose I can't stop you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You really want to keep talking...\nI suppose I can't stop you.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=31>I appreciate you wanting to chat, but...\nDon't let it interfere with your work.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>I appreciate you wanting to chat, but...\nDon't let it interfere with your work.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Wait. Don't come any closer.\nTalk from there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wait. Don't come any closer.\nTalk from there.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>You didn't come just to chat, did you?\nKeep it short. And simple.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You didn't come just to chat, did you?\nKeep it short. And simple.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>What do you need now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What do you need now?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_Princessy_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=31>I thought you were here to investigate...\nStay focused.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>I thought you were here to investigate...\nStay focused.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, what's going on?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, what's going on?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Ah, what should we talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah, what should we talk about?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Need something else?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Need something else?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=33>Well, have a good day. If anything happens with the kids, let me know right away.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well, have a good day. If anything happens with the kids, let me know right away.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... what's the matter?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... what's the matter?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>What should we talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What should we talk about?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>Need something else?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Need something else?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisMom_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=33>I should go get some snacks for the kids.\nSee you later.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I should go get some snacks for the kids.\nSee you later.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Need something?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Need something?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Haha, chatting's nice too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha, chatting's nice too.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like you have more to say.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Looks like you have more to say.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Take care in the village.\nLet me know if you need anything.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Take care in the village.\nLet me know if you need anything.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, is there something you're curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, is there something you're curious about?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Go ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Go ahead.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like you have more to say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Looks like you have more to say?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_BroSisDad_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Well then, make yourself comfortable.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Well then, make yourself comfortable.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>What can I do for you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What can I do for you?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>What would you like to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What would you like to talk about?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Sure, let's talk a bit more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sure, let's talk a bit more.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Thank you for helping our village.\nI hope you've been comfortable here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Thank you for helping our village.\nI hope you've been comfortable here.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Is there something you need...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Is there something you need...?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Yes. Go ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yes. Go ahead.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>You have more to say.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You have more to say.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_YoungManMom_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>I'm counting on you to help take care of things in the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I'm counting on you to help take care of things in the village.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe, Dave! Hi!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe, Dave! Hi!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Got any fun stories?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Got any fun stories?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Hehe. What else are you curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hehe. What else are you curious about?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, you're leaving? Okay!\nCome talk to me again soon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, you're leaving? Okay!\nCome talk to me again soon!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, hello mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, hello mister!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>What should we talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What should we talk about?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Got more questions?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Got more questions?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBrother_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>See you later, mister!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>See you later, mister!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, mister...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hello, mister...!</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>What should we talk about...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What should we talk about...?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Want to talk more?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Want to talk more?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Outsiders aren't as scary as I thought, hehe.\nLet's talk again, mister.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Outsiders aren't as scary as I thought, hehe.\nLet's talk again, mister.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, it's Mister Outsider. Hello.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, it's Mister Outsider. Hello.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Mom says I'll get in trouble if I talk to outsiders too much.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Mom says I'll get in trouble if I talk to outsiders too much.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Got something else to talk about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Got something else to talk about?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidSister_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Goodbye.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Goodbye.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Dave, what's up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave, what's up?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Talk_Select_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>What do you want to hear about!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What do you want to hear about!?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_Return_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>Glad you liked my story. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Glad you liked my story. Haha.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_End_Kind01
Array.english: <size=34>See you next time! Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>See you next time! Hehe.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... mister, what brings you here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... mister, what brings you here?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Talk_Select_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>You seem to have a lot of questions.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You seem to have a lot of questions.</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_Return_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>I shouldn't say too much...\nWhat else are you curious about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I shouldn't say too much...\nWhat else are you curious about?</size>

Array.name: JDLC_Villager_KidBroFriend_Interaction_End_NotKind01
Array.english: <size=34>Take care! Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Take care! Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_DoNotSkip_001
Array.english: <size=34>I should look around the village and see what there is to do.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I should look around the village and see what there is to do.</size>

Array.indonesia: Hmm... I might need a better <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Line</color>...

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_Fishing_FishingRod_Warning_003

Array.english: <size=32>I think I'm ready!\nLet's head into the forest!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_NotNow_001

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_Barricade_Night_001
Array.english: <size=32><color=#C3C3C3>It'd be dangerous to go into the forest at night. I'll go with Cobra tomorrow.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#C3C3C3>It'd be dangerous to go into the forest at night. I'll go with Cobra tomorrow.</color></size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveToForestScene_Barricade_Common_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... I think it's better not to go right now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... I think it's better not to go right now.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_001
Array.english: <size=34>Should I head back to the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Should I head back to the village?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_Option01
Array.english: Head back <color=#fde221><size=20>(Time Passes)</size></color>
Array.indonesia: Head back <color=#fde221><size=20>(Time Passes)</size></color>

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_Option02

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_Move_001
Array.english: I think I've been here long enough. Better head back to the village and rest.

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_ForestToVillage_NotNow_001
Array.english: I still have things to do.\nI should look around a bit more.
Array.indonesia: I still have things to do.\nI should look around a bit more.

Array.english: Enter

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_EnterDungeon_Move_001

Array.name: Dialogue_JDLC_MoveScene_EnterDungeon_NotNow_001

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_001
Array.english: <size=35>Excuse me, you there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Excuse me, you there!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_002
Array.english: <size=33>...Yes?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Yes?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>This fishy smell… isn't there anything you can do about it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This fishy smell… isn't there anything you can do about it?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_004
Array.english: Hmm… I keep it sealed up as much as I can, but…
Array.indonesia: Hmm… I keep it sealed up as much as I can, but…

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_005
Array.english:
It doesn't come through in the food at all, you know!
Would you like to try a piece?
Array.indonesia:
It doesn't come through in the food at all, you know!
Would you like to try a piece?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_006
Array.english:
<size=33>No thank you! Smells of old moss and muddy earth…
Just thinking about it makes me queasy.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33>No thank you! Smells of old moss and muddy earth…
Just thinking about it makes me queasy.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_007
Array.english:
You go a bit too far, my lady.
Surely this evening you caught a whiff of well-cooked dishes drifting through the air.
Array.indonesia:
You go a bit too far, my lady.
Surely this evening you caught a whiff of well-cooked dishes drifting through the air.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_008
Array.english:
<size=33>…That must be from the spices, surely.
There's no way that scent could come from fish.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33>…That must be from the spices, surely.
There's no way that scent could come from fish.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_009
Array.english:
In that case…
would you partake of an aquatic creature that is not a fish?
Array.indonesia:
In that case…
would you partake of an aquatic creature that is not a fish?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_010
Array.english: <size=32>Pardon…? What sort of creature do you mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Pardon…? What sort of creature do you mean?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_011
Array.english: <size=33>A creature that lives in the water yet carries no fishy smell…Allow me to serve you a dish prepared from such a creature!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A creature that lives in the water yet carries no fishy smell…Allow me to serve you a dish prepared from such a creature!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_012
Array.english: <size=32>I haven't the faintest idea what you're talking about.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I haven't the faintest idea what you're talking about.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_013
Array.english: <size=33>Come again in <color=#F1DC2B>2 days</color>. By then, I shall have prepared a dish even you, my lady, would marvel at.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Come again in <color=#F1DC2B>2 days</color>. By then, I shall have prepared a dish even you, my lady, would marvel at.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_014
Array.english:
Such bold claims… 
I do hope you intend to take responsibility for your words.
Array.indonesia:
Such bold claims… 
I do hope you intend to take responsibility for your words.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart_015
Array.english: No matter how heavily you smother it in spices, you cannot fool this Bonita's discerning palate.
Array.indonesia: No matter how heavily you smother it in spices, you cannot fool this Bonita's discerning palate.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_001
Array.english: ...You made another promise...
Array.indonesia: ...You made another promise...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_002
Array.english: Rather than outright refusal, it would be better to show her the true taste.
Array.indonesia: Rather than outright refusal, it would be better to show her the true taste.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_003
Array.english: I believe a dish of truly fine flavor has the power to break through prejudice.
Array.indonesia: I believe a dish of truly fine flavor has the power to break through prejudice.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_004
Array.english: <size=32>I, Bancho, shall awaken a new sense of taste within her!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I, Bancho, shall awaken a new sense of taste within her!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_005
Array.english: Hmm... so what ingredients should I prepare?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... so what ingredients should I prepare?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_006
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Crocodile</color> would be ideal. \nThere are some fierce ones in this lake.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Crocodile</color> would be ideal. \nThere are some fierce ones in this lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_007
Array.english: <size=32>I'll use a <color=#1DFEAF>Black Caiman Tail</color> to show the lady a whole new flavor!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll use a <color=#1DFEAF>Black Caiman Tail</color> to show the lady a whole new flavor!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_008
Array.english: ...Uhm... using something that dangerous as an ingredient...?
Array.indonesia: ...Uhm... using something that dangerous as an ingredient...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_009
Array.english: Still, it'd be nice if Bonita could try your cooking.
Array.indonesia: Still, it'd be nice if Bonita could try your cooking.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_010
Array.english: Do you need anything else?
Array.indonesia: Do you need anything else?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_011
Array.english: Besides the Black Caiman Tail...\nI'll need <color=#1DFEAF>Thai Chili</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Palm Sugar</color>.
Array.indonesia: Besides the Black Caiman Tail...\nI'll need <color=#1DFEAF>Thai Chili</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Palm Sugar</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_012
Array.english: Okay. Got it. I'll go get them.
Array.indonesia: Okay. Got it. I'll go get them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_013
Array.english: Besides the Black Caiman Tail...\nI'll need <color=#1DFEAF>Thai Chili</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Palm Sugar</color>.
Array.indonesia: Besides the Black Caiman Tail...\nI'll need <color=#1DFEAF>Thai Chili</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Palm Sugar</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaStart02_014
Array.english: Okay. Got it. I'll go get them.
Array.indonesia: Okay. Got it. I'll go get them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterTutorial_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Select <color=#F1DC2B>Craft</color> below!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Select <color=#F1DC2B>Craft</color> below!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_001
Array.english: The more I think about it, the less I want to attend this dinner.
Array.indonesia: The more I think about it, the less I want to attend this dinner.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_002
Array.english: Preparing a dish with meat I'm unfamiliar with...\nI'm already losing my appetite.
Array.indonesia: Preparing a dish with meat I'm unfamiliar with...\nI'm already losing my appetite.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_003
Array.english: There's only one reason I accepted the invitation.
Array.indonesia: There's only one reason I accepted the invitation.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_004
Array.english: <size=32>It's just flavor created by seasoning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's just flavor created by seasoning!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_005
Array.english: <size=32>The point being, there is no such thing as a fish dish without a fishy smell!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The point being, there is no such thing as a fish dish without a fishy smell!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_01_006
Array.english: I'll taste it myself and tell everyone.
Array.indonesia: I'll taste it myself and tell everyone.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_001
Array.english: The villagers keep talking more and more about your restaurant's food.
Array.indonesia: The villagers keep talking more and more about your restaurant's food.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_002
Array.english: Everyone is so... short-sighted.
Array.indonesia: Everyone is so... short-sighted.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_003
Array.english: It's just that the lake was polluted, so the food doesn't taste as good. That's all.
Array.indonesia: It's just that the lake was polluted, so the food doesn't taste as good. That's all.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_004
Array.english: But I shouldn't criticize without trying it...\nso you'd better be ready.
Array.indonesia: But I shouldn't criticize without trying it...\nso you'd better be ready.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_02_005
Array.english: <size=32>Because I'm going to prove it's nothing more than spices and seasoning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Because I'm going to prove it's nothing more than spices and seasoning!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_010
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... and...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... and...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_03_001
Array.english: Sigh... if you're not confident, just give up.
Array.indonesia: Sigh... if you're not confident, just give up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_011
Array.english: <size=32>I made this <color=#F1DC2B>Sign Decoration</color> as a test... take it if you want.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I made this <color=#F1DC2B>Sign Decoration</color> as a test... take it if you want.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_02_01_CarpenterCraftDone_012
Array.english: Oh... I'll use it when I feel like changing things up.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I'll use it when I feel like changing things up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_03_002
Array.english: You're making all these bold claims, but you can't even handle the ingredients properly.
Array.indonesia: You're making all these bold claims, but you can't even handle the ingredients properly.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_03_003
Array.english: I need to at least taste it so I can point out just how pretentious this dish is...
Array.indonesia: I need to at least taste it so I can point out just how pretentious this dish is...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaTalk_03_004
Array.english: I expect everything to be properly prepared by the time I come back.
Array.indonesia: I expect everything to be properly prepared by the time I come back.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete01_001
Array.english:
<size=32>Ugh… a crocodile's tail…
In the end, isn't this nothing more than a lizard-shaped fish?</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=32>Ugh… a crocodile's tail…
In the end, isn't this nothing more than a lizard-shaped fish?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete01_002
Array.english:
…It is an entirely different class of creature.
Do try a single bite first, my lady.
Array.indonesia:
…It is an entirely different class of creature.
Do try a single bite first, my lady.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete01_003
Array.english: Well… since you went through all this trouble, \nI shall try just a bite.
Array.indonesia: Well… since you went through all this trouble, \nI shall try just a bite.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=33>How is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>How is it?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh…! it's good…! It's delicious!! It's almost like chicken, \nbut with just a touch more bite to it!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh…! it's good…! It's delicious!! It's almost like chicken, \nbut with just a touch more bite to it!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=34>The spice of the <color=#1DFEAF>Thai Chili</color>...\nis resonating with the richness of the crocodile meat...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>The spice of the <color=#1DFEAF>Thai Chili</color>...\nis resonating with the richness of the crocodile meat...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_004
Array.english: <size=34>And… that sweet finish at the end is palm sugar! With such fragrance and texture, I could happily eat several more dishes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And… that sweet finish at the end is palm sugar! With such fragrance and texture, I could happily eat several more dishes!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_005
Array.english: I am pleased. With the right cooking method, the fishy smell you so dislike can be removed entirely.
Array.indonesia: I am pleased. With the right cooking method, the fishy smell you so dislike can be removed entirely.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_006
Array.english: The crocodile tail is, in truth, a part with little fishy smell to begin with… If this has made you a touch more familiar with such fare, then I am glad.
Array.indonesia: The crocodile tail is, in truth, a part with little fishy smell to begin with… If this has made you a touch more familiar with such fare, then I am glad.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_007
Array.english: I have also removed the fishy smell from the other fish dishes with salt and mirin. Perhaps you might try one another time.
Array.indonesia: I have also removed the fishy smell from the other fish dishes with salt and mirin. Perhaps you might try one another time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_008
Array.english:
…Well… it is not as though I am entirely won over, 
but…
Array.indonesia:
…Well… it is not as though I am entirely won over, 
but…

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_009
Array.english: <size=33>If you can keep things at this level, then stopping by your shop now and then would not be so bad after all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If you can keep things at this level, then stopping by your shop now and then would not be so bad after all.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_010
Array.english: Everyone keeps saying your food is delicious... and honestly, it was a bit awkward not being able to join those conversations.
Array.indonesia: Everyone keeps saying your food is delicious... and honestly, it was a bit awkward not being able to join those conversations.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_011
Array.english:
<size=32>We'll have plenty of good ingredients ready, 
so feel free to drop by anytime!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=32>We'll have plenty of good ingredients ready, 
so feel free to drop by anytime!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_012
Array.english: I'd like to give you something in return...
Array.indonesia: I'd like to give you something in return...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_013
Array.english: But all I have is Rover merch...
Array.indonesia: But all I have is Rover merch...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_014
Array.english: <size=34>No, it's okay...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>No, it's okay...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaComplete02_015
Array.english: <size=33>Huh?! The Rover merch is suddenly glowing...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh?! The Rover merch is suddenly glowing...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_001
Array.english: <size=32>I felt some kind of resonance...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I felt some kind of resonance...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_002
Array.english: <size=40>R-Rover...?! Is it really you, Rover?!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>R-Rover...?! Is it really you, Rover?!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Yes... Do you perhaps know me...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Yes... Do you perhaps know me...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Yes. I'm Resonator Bonita.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yes. I'm Resonator Bonita.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_005
Array.english: ...You're on a slightly different frequency... It feels different from what I sense from the people of Solaris-3...
Array.indonesia: ...You're on a slightly different frequency... It feels different from what I sense from the people of Solaris-3...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_006
Array.english: Would it be alright if I stayed in this village for a while?
Array.indonesia: Would it be alright if I stayed in this village for a while?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_007
Array.english: I've traveled quite far, so I need some time to regroup.
Array.indonesia: I've traveled quite far, so I need some time to regroup.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_008
Array.english: <size=42>...Of course, Rover<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>...Of course, Rover<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_009
Array.english: Bonita... we should ask the village chief...
Array.indonesia: Bonita... we should ask the village chief...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_010
Array.english: But I think the Lake Beach area should be fine.
Array.indonesia: But I think the Lake Beach area should be fine.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_011
Array.english: Anywhere is fine. Thank you.
Array.indonesia: Anywhere is fine. Thank you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_012
Array.english: By the way... it smells amazing in this shop!
Array.indonesia: By the way... it smells amazing in this shop!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_013
Array.english: A scent like this only comes from perfectly balanced ingredients... I can tell.
Array.indonesia: A scent like this only comes from perfectly balanced ingredients... I can tell.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_014
Array.english: I used to cook a bit myself...\nIf you'd like, I can help out at the shop.
Array.indonesia: I used to cook a bit myself...\nIf you'd like, I can help out at the shop.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_015
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... that would be great!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... that would be great!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_016
Array.english: Now that Bonita will be coming for meals too...\nI think we'll be even busier.
Array.indonesia: Now that Bonita will be coming for meals too...\nI think we'll be even busier.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_017
Array.english: Of course<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> I'll be having dinner here every day now<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> \nWhether it's fish or meat...
Array.indonesia: Of course<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> I'll be having dinner here every day now<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> \nWhether it's fish or meat...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_018
Array.english: Oh, as thanks for letting me stay, I'll share one of my favorite recipes.
Array.indonesia: Oh, as thanks for letting me stay, I'll share one of my favorite recipes.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_RoverAppear01_019
Array.english: <size=33>Well then... I'll be in your care for a while.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well then... I'll be in your care for a while.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_001
Array.english: Did you get the dish I asked for ready?
Array.indonesia: Did you get the dish I asked for ready?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_002
Array.english: About that... we're not quite ready with the ingredients yet... My apologies.
Array.indonesia: About that... we're not quite ready with the ingredients yet... My apologies.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_003
Array.english: Hah... I knew this would happen.
Array.indonesia: Hah... I knew this would happen.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_004
Array.english: All talk and no accountability.
Array.indonesia: All talk and no accountability.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_005
Array.english: That's harsh! Getting the ingredients was harder than I expected!
Array.indonesia: That's harsh! Getting the ingredients was harder than I expected!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_006
Array.english: <size=32>I'll have everything ready in <color=#F1DC2B>2 Days</color>, so please come back then.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll have everything ready in <color=#F1DC2B>2 Days</color>, so please come back then.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_007
Array.english: I'd like to refuse, but if I end things here, I won't be able to point out just how flawed this dish is...
Array.indonesia: I'd like to refuse, but if I end things here, I won't be able to point out just how flawed this dish is...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_008
Array.english: Alright. I'll come back in <color=#F1DC2B>2 Days</color>.
Array.indonesia: Alright. I'll come back in <color=#F1DC2B>2 Days</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_23_BonitaFail_009
Array.english: <size=32>I don't want another wasted trip.\nI'm a busy person, you know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I don't want another wasted trip.\nI'm a busy person, you know.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_TwoPointMuseum_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? I think someone's collapsed over there...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? I think someone's collapsed over there...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_TwoPointMuseum_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like it...! Go check on him!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Looks like it...! Go check on him!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_LongbottomFound_001
Array.english: Are you alright...?
Array.indonesia: Are you alright...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_LongbottomFound_002
Array.english: Hmm... looks like he's unconscious.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... looks like he's unconscious.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_LongbottomFound_003
Array.english: Looking at him, it seems like dehydration...\nWe should get some water into him.
Array.indonesia: Looking at him, it seems like dehydration...\nWe should get some water into him.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_LongbottomFound_004
Array.english: Good thing I have some with me. Here...
Array.indonesia: Good thing I have some with me. Here...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_001
Array.english: <size=34>Phew...! I'm alive...!!\nThank you...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Phew...! I'm alive...!!\nThank you...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_002
Array.english: I'm <color=#F1DC2B>William Longbottom</color>, a prehistory specialist.\nPlease, call me William.
Array.indonesia: I'm <color=#F1DC2B>William Longbottom</color>, a prehistory specialist.\nPlease, call me William.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_003
Array.english: That was close. Any later and it would've been bad.\nSo what brings you all the way out here?
Array.indonesia: That was close. Any later and it would've been bad.\nSo what brings you all the way out here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_004
Array.english: Ah, I'm helping the <color=#F1DC2B>Two Point Museum</color> collect prehistoric fossils.
Array.indonesia: Ah, I'm helping the <color=#F1DC2B>Two Point Museum</color> collect prehistoric fossils.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_005
Array.english: My research shows... there are <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus</color> fossils in this area.
Array.indonesia: My research shows... there are <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus</color> fossils in this area.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_006
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_007
Array.english: <size=32>Yes! A giant dinosaur with a horn on its head!! There wasn't much proof it existed, but traces have been found in this region!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yes! A giant dinosaur with a horn on its head!! There wasn't much proof it existed, but traces have been found in this region!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_008
Array.english: I'd almost collected all the bones in this forest...\nbut then I fell and lost most of them.
Array.indonesia: I'd almost collected all the bones in this forest...\nbut then I fell and lost most of them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_009
Array.english: I counted... and I'll need <color=#1DFEAF>42 More</color> to complete the collection.
Array.indonesia: I counted... and I'll need <color=#1DFEAF>42 More</color> to complete the collection.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_010
Array.english: <size=33>...That's quite a lot.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...That's quite a lot.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_011
Array.english: Sir... I'm sorry, but could you help me find these <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>?
Array.indonesia: Sir... I'm sorry, but could you help me find these <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_012
Array.english: In my current state... I don't think I can keep exploring.
Array.indonesia: In my current state... I don't think I can keep exploring.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_013
Array.english: Hehe. That sounds pretty interesting. Why don't we help? \nI'll pitch in too!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. That sounds pretty interesting. Why don't we help? \nI'll pitch in too!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_014
Array.english: If even Muna's helping...\nAlright then.
Array.indonesia: If even Muna's helping...\nAlright then.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_015
Array.english: So how do we find the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>?
Array.indonesia: So how do we find the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_016
Array.english: After I passed out, it seems the forest animals took the bones from my bag.
Array.indonesia: After I passed out, it seems the forest animals took the bones from my bag.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_017
Array.english: If you fight the animals, they might drop some of what they took.
Array.indonesia: If you fight the animals, they might drop some of what they took.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_018
Array.english: As I mentioned... I'd really appreciate it if you could collect the remaining <color=#1DFEAF>42</color>.
Array.indonesia: As I mentioned... I'd really appreciate it if you could collect the remaining <color=#1DFEAF>42</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_019
Array.english: Got it. We'll search thoroughly.
Array.indonesia: Got it. We'll search thoroughly.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_AfterWater_020
Array.english: For now, you should head to the village and rest.\nI'll have Rimbo come pick you up.
Array.indonesia: For now, you should head to the village and rest.\nI'll have Rimbo come pick you up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_VillageWilliam_001
Array.english: I wonder... if William fully recovered?
Array.indonesia: I wonder... if William fully recovered?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_VillageWilliam_002
Array.english: He's probably over by Lake Beach... I should go check on him?
Array.indonesia: He's probably over by Lake Beach... I should go check on him?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! You're back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! You're back!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_002
Array.english: Thanks to you, I've fully recovered.\nThe chef took good care of me.
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you, I've fully recovered.\nThe chef took good care of me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_003
Array.english: I was a bit out of it earlier... but I did mention the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>, right?
Array.indonesia: I was a bit out of it earlier... but I did mention the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_004
Array.english: Yes. You asked us to find the remaining ones.
Array.indonesia: Yes. You asked us to find the remaining ones.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_005
Array.english: That's right. I'd like to go with you, but...
Array.indonesia: That's right. I'd like to go with you, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_006
Array.english: The forest creatures are pretty aggressive...\nIt's not easy for me to head out there.
Array.indonesia: The forest creatures are pretty aggressive...\nIt's not easy for me to head out there.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_BeachWilliam_007
Array.english: Instead, I've been assembling some dinosaur bones here at Lake Beach. Want to take a look?
Array.indonesia: Instead, I've been assembling some dinosaur bones here at Lake Beach. Want to take a look?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... dinosaur fossils...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... dinosaur fossils...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_002
Array.english: Yes. I've been assembling the Unihornus bones I had.
Array.indonesia: Yes. I've been assembling the Unihornus bones I had.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_003
Array.english: I'll use this as a base and gradually fit in the bones you bring me.
Array.indonesia: I'll use this as a base and gradually fit in the bones you bring me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_004
Array.english: It's a much bigger dinosaur than I expected...
Array.indonesia: It's a much bigger dinosaur than I expected...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_005
Array.english: Got it. I'll bring you the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color> as soon as I collect them.
Array.indonesia: Got it. I'll bring you the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color> as soon as I collect them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_ShowBoneCollection_006
Array.english: Yes. I'm sorry to impose on you like this.\nI'll be counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Yes. I'm sorry to impose on you like this.\nI'll be counting on you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk01_001
Array.english: To attract more visitors to the museum, we need to keep showcasing new exhibits.
Array.indonesia: To attract more visitors to the museum, we need to keep showcasing new exhibits.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk01_002
Array.english: And for that, we have to explore places like this to find unique specimens!
Array.indonesia: And for that, we have to explore places like this to find unique specimens!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk02_001
Array.english: Previously, I collected various dinosaur fossils from a place called the Bone Lands.
Array.indonesia: Previously, I collected various dinosaur fossils from a place called the Bone Lands.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk02_002
Array.english: Even then, finding Unihornus bones wasn't easy...
Array.indonesia: Even then, finding Unihornus bones wasn't easy...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamCollectingTalk02_003
Array.english: But I'm glad you're helping me this time!
Array.indonesia: But I'm glad you're helping me this time!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamHornTalk01_001
Array.english: I think I lost the horn in the swamp.
Array.indonesia: I think I lost the horn in the swamp.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamHornTalk01_002
Array.english: A snakehead suddenly lunged at me, and I grabbed my bag and ran.
Array.indonesia: A snakehead suddenly lunged at me, and I grabbed my bag and ran.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_WillamHornTalk01_003
Array.english: Please find it for me... I'm begging you.
Array.indonesia: Please find it for me... I'm begging you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectComplete_001
Array.english: Looks like I've collected all the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>.
Array.indonesia: Looks like I've collected all the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectComplete_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should take them to William at Lake Beach!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should take them to William at Lake Beach!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectDeliver_001
Array.english: I've gathered all the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color> you mentioned.
Array.indonesia: I've gathered all the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Bones</color> you mentioned.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectDeliver_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh!! Really!! Thank you so much!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh!! Really!! Thank you so much!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_CollectDeliver_003
Array.english: Now, let me try assembling the bones you brought.
Array.indonesia: Now, let me try assembling the bones you brought.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_001
Array.english: Hmm... oh no...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... oh no...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_002
Array.english: What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: What's wrong?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_003
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>The Horn</color> is missing...\nI'm sure it was with the other bones...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>The Horn</color> is missing...\nI'm sure it was with the other bones...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_004
Array.english: <size=32>Without the horn, the Unihornus isn't complete...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Without the horn, the Unihornus isn't complete...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_005
Array.english: Hmm... do you have any idea where it might be?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... do you have any idea where it might be?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_006
