Array.english: Now that you mention it... a giant <color=#F1DC2B>Snakehead</color> suddenly lunged at me in the forest swamp, and I ran in a panic...
Array.indonesia: Now that you mention it... a giant <color=#F1DC2B>Snakehead</color> suddenly lunged at me in the forest swamp, and I ran in a panic...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_007
Array.english: Maybe I dropped it then...
Array.indonesia: Maybe I dropped it then...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_008
Array.english: I see. I'll check when I go back to the forest.
Array.indonesia: I see. I'll check when I go back to the forest.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_009
Array.english: <size=32>Thank you...!\nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Swamp</color> is near where I collapsed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thank you...!\nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Swamp</color> is near where I collapsed.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_NoHorn_010
Array.english: <size=32>There were a lot of dangerous animals there, so make sure you're well prepared...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>There were a lot of dangerous animals there, so make sure you're well prepared...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossAppear_001
Array.english: <size=32>I think this is the area William mentioned...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I think this is the area William mentioned...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossAppear_002
Array.english: <size=32>But I don't see the Unihornus horn anywhere...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But I don't see the Unihornus horn anywhere...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa...! That's a massive snakehead...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Whoa...! That's a massive snakehead...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>That must be the thing that attacked William!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That must be the thing that attacked William!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Horn</color> he mentioned... Do you think that thing swallowed it?
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>Horn</color> he mentioned... Do you think that thing swallowed it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_004
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not sure, but either way, we can't investigate with that thing around.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'm not sure, but either way, we can't investigate with that thing around.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossStart_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! The answer's obvious! Let's take it down with everything we've got!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! The answer's obvious! Let's take it down with everything we've got!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_001
Array.english: Phew... Those fins were thrashing so much, it was hard to focus.
Array.indonesia: Phew... Those fins were thrashing so much, it was hard to focus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_002
Array.english: Just as we thought, that thing had swallowed the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Horn</color>.
Array.indonesia: Just as we thought, that thing had swallowed the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Horn</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's so hard and smooth... Really magnificent...! Hehehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's so hard and smooth... Really magnificent...! Hehehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_004
Array.english: This looks like the final piece of the Unihornus skeleton.
Array.indonesia: This looks like the final piece of the Unihornus skeleton.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossClear_005
Array.english: Let's head back to the village and give it to William at Lake Beach!
Array.indonesia: Let's head back to the village and give it to William at Lake Beach!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossRetry_001
Array.english: <size=33>That colossal snakehead from before...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That colossal snakehead from before...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossRetry_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'm sure that thing swallowed the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Horn</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm sure that thing swallowed the <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Horn</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_SwampBossRetry_003
Array.english: <size=34>This time, we'll defeat it for sure!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This time, we'll defeat it for sure!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ohhh! You found it! The <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Horn</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ohhh! You found it! The <color=#F1DC2B>Unihornus Horn</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_002
Array.english: Yeah... a snakehead had swallowed it.
Array.indonesia: Yeah... a snakehead had swallowed it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_003
Array.english: I'm so sorry you had to go through all that trouble because of me...
Array.indonesia: I'm so sorry you had to go through all that trouble because of me...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_004
Array.english: But thanks to you, we finally have all the Unihornus bones!
Array.indonesia: But thanks to you, we finally have all the Unihornus bones!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete01_005
Array.english: Now, let me place the horn...
Array.indonesia: Now, let me place the horn...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow... Look at this...! Isn't it amazing...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow... Look at this...! Isn't it amazing...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_002
Array.english: That one horn really makes a huge difference.
Array.indonesia: That one horn really makes a huge difference.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=32>It looks incredible.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It looks incredible.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_004
Array.english: Hahaha! Thank you so much!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Thank you so much!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_005
Array.english: <size=33>But there's one problem...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But there's one problem...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_006
Array.english: Before you got back, I contacted the museum to arrange transport for the fossil...
Array.indonesia: Before you got back, I contacted the museum to arrange transport for the fossil...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_007
Array.english: They said they don't have a helicopter available right now...
Array.indonesia: They said they don't have a helicopter available right now...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_008
Array.english: And honestly, even when they do send one, it's such an old helicopter that it'll take quite a while to get here.
Array.indonesia: And honestly, even when they do send one, it's such an old helicopter that it'll take quite a while to get here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_009
Array.english:
So, I was thinking... Until the helicopter's ready,
how about I help out around the village?
Array.indonesia:
So, I was thinking... Until the helicopter's ready,
how about I help out around the village?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_010
Array.english: I'd like to repay the chef who prepared those meals for me as well.
Array.indonesia: I'd like to repay the chef who prepared those meals for me as well.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_011
Array.english: In that case, maybe you could help out at the restaurant in the evenings!
Array.indonesia: In that case, maybe you could help out at the restaurant in the evenings!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_012
Array.english:
You mean cooking and serving!
No problem at all!
Array.indonesia:
You mean cooking and serving!
No problem at all!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_013
Array.english: Then let me display this Unihornus skeleton here for now.
Array.indonesia: Then let me display this Unihornus skeleton here for now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_24_MissionComplete02_014
Array.english: It'll be a great attraction for villagers who don't get many chances to visit faraway museums!
Array.indonesia: It'll be a great attraction for villagers who don't get many chances to visit faraway museums!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_InprogressPushRock01_001
Array.english: I need 3 villagers to move the boulder. I should ask around for help.
Array.indonesia: I need 3 villagers to move the boulder. I should ask around for help.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_01_InprogressPushRock02_001
Array.english: Alright! I've found 3 people to help move the boulder.\nLet's go see the village chief.
Array.indonesia: Alright! I've found 3 people to help move the boulder.\nLet's go see the village chief.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_BattleTutorial_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, Dave! Looks like you're warmed up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright, Dave! Looks like you're warmed up!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_BattleTutorial_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>Keep an eye on your health and stay focused!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Keep an eye on your health and stay focused!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_WhatMudSkipper_001
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? Eyes in the ground...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh? Eyes in the ground...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Barricade_Elevator_001
Array.english: <size=32>I should take the elevator up first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should take the elevator up first.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_001
Array.english: <size=32>Should I take the lift?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Should I take the lift?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_option01
Array.english: Ride
Array.indonesia: Ride

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_option02
Array.english: Let's look around a bit more
Array.indonesia: Let's look around a bit more

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_Go_001
Array.english: Time to head back.\nLet's take the lift.
Array.indonesia: Time to head back.\nLet's take the lift.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_Go_002
Array.english: Hope it works properly...
Array.indonesia: Hope it works properly...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Ask_Stay_001
Array.english: I should look around a bit more before I go.\nBecause I might have missed something.
Array.indonesia: I should look around a bit more before I go.\nBecause I might have missed something.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Awake_001
Array.english: <size=32>Now that I've got the ancient Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>, should we head back to the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Now that I've got the ancient Sunang <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Equipment</color>, should we head back to the village?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_03_02_Elevator_Awake_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's try activating the elevator on the left that Marone found.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's try activating the elevator on the left that Marone found.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaKnock_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yawn... who could it be this early in the morning...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yawn... who could it be this early in the morning...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaKnock_002
Array.english: <size=33>Sounds like Muna.\nI should go check.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sounds like Muna.\nI should go check.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaComing_001
Array.english: Hehe... sorry for dropping by so early.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... sorry for dropping by so early.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaComing_002
Array.english: I overdid it yesterday. Between the forest and the festival drinks, I'm feeling pretty sluggish today.
Array.indonesia: I overdid it yesterday. Between the forest and the festival drinks, I'm feeling pretty sluggish today.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaComing_003
Array.english: Well... it's about the breathing apparatus and cloth you brought yesterday...
Array.indonesia: Well... it's about the breathing apparatus and cloth you brought yesterday...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MunaComing_004
Array.english: Could you come to my tent? Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Could you come to my tent? Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ta-da! This is the new suit I made using the breathing apparatus and fabric you brought yesterday!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ta-da! This is the new suit I made using the breathing apparatus and fabric you brought yesterday!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_002
Array.english: <size=33>It filters out most of the hydrogen sulfide...\nand keeps it from seeping into your skin!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It filters out most of the hydrogen sulfide...\nand keeps it from seeping into your skin!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_003
Array.english: <size=35>Oh...! That's amazing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh...! That's amazing!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_004
Array.english: <size=31>You made this in just one day...\nThat's seriously impressive.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>You made this in just one day...\nThat's seriously impressive.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hehehe!! So, why don't you try on this masterpiece by the genius Muna!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehehe!! So, why don't you try on this masterpiece by the genius Muna!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet_006
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. I'll put it on and head to the deck.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright. I'll put it on and head to the deck.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh... it fits perfectly!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh... it fits perfectly!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_002
Array.english: So, how does it feel to actually wear it?!
Array.indonesia: So, how does it feel to actually wear it?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_003
Array.english: It feels sturdy with no gaps, yet so light.\nI can't believe this is made from ancient materials.
Array.indonesia: It feels sturdy with no gaps, yet so light.\nI can't believe this is made from ancient materials.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_004
Array.english: Hehe...! With that, even the hydrogen sulfide layer won't be a problem. I've tested it with all sorts of strong chemicals.
Array.indonesia: Hehe...! With that, even the hydrogen sulfide layer won't be a problem. I've tested it with all sorts of strong chemicals.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_JungleSuitGet02_005
Array.english: Thanks. I'll head down to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea</color> beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Thanks. I'll head down to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea</color> beneath the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomHazardPass_001
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks to the new suit, the hydrogen sulfide doesn't sting at all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thanks to the new suit, the hydrogen sulfide doesn't sting at all.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomHazardPass_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's head down to the sea below!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's head down to the sea below!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter01_001
Array.english: The atmosphere here feels completely different from the lake...?!
Array.indonesia: The atmosphere here feels completely different from the lake...?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter01_002
Array.english: An ancient civilization... No, wait, there are signs it was used until recently.
Array.indonesia: An ancient civilization... No, wait, there are signs it was used until recently.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter01_003
Array.english: And... ancient creatures...?\nHow are they living here?
Array.indonesia: And... ancient creatures...?\nHow are they living here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter01_004
Array.english: <size=32>Something feels off.\nLet's go a bit further down.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Something feels off.\nLet's go a bit further down.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter02_001
Array.english: That blue thing... could it be...?
Array.indonesia: That blue thing... could it be...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter02_002
Array.english: <size=32><color=#63F9FF>A Divine Tree Fruit</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#63F9FF>A Divine Tree Fruit</color>?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter02_003
Array.english: Hmm... the one I saw before was yellow...\nCould this be a different variety...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... the one I saw before was yellow...\nCould this be a different variety...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_LakeBottomAreaEnter02_004
Array.english: It's a bit creepy, but since I'm here, I should take a closer look.
Array.indonesia: It's a bit creepy, but since I'm here, I should take a closer look.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ahh...?! Ancient creatures are coming out of a passage in the floor...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ahh...?! Ancient creatures are coming out of a passage in the floor...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Dave! Dave... can you hear me?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dave! Dave... can you hear me?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, Dr. Bacon... yes, I can hear you clearly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, Dr. Bacon... yes, I can hear you clearly.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_004
Array.english: <size=32>The door in the floor... it's opening, and ancient creatures are coming out...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The door in the floor... it's opening, and ancient creatures are coming out...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_005
Array.english: <size=32>I'm watching through the camera feed.\nThat's definitely...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm watching through the camera feed.\nThat's definitely...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_006
Array.english: <size=32>...the gate to the ancient past described in the Sunang civilization writings...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...the gate to the ancient past described in the Sunang civilization writings...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_007
Array.english: <size=32>So it really existed...! The writings said it was sealed... \nhow did it open...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>So it really existed...! The writings said it was sealed... \nhow did it open...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind01_008
Array.english: <size=32>Could it have been opened by that big earthquake we had at the Blue Hole?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Could it have been opened by that big earthquake we had at the Blue Hole?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_001
Array.english: <size=32>What was that huge tremor just now, Dave!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What was that huge tremor just now, Dave!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_002
Array.english: <size=33>A giant dinosaur is trying to come through the gate...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A giant dinosaur is trying to come through the gate...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's stuck and can't get through right now... but given its size, it's only a matter of time before it breaks through!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's stuck and can't get through right now... but given its size, it's only a matter of time before it breaks through!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_004
Array.english: <size=32>The water's too deep, so the signal's weak...\nand the camera isn't working, so I can't see it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The water's too deep, so the signal's weak...\nand the camera isn't working, so I can't see it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, could you take a <color=#1DFEAF>Photo</color> of it for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, could you take a <color=#1DFEAF>Photo</color> of it for me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_006
Array.english: <size=33>...What? In this situation?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...What? In this situation?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_007
Array.english: <size=32>Please. I need to know what kind of creature it is to assess the situation!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Please. I need to know what kind of creature it is to assess the situation!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BottomDoorFind02_008
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... alright. I'll try to get a shot.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... alright. I'll try to get a shot.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BasiloPhotoBarricade_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dr. Bacon asked me to take a <color=#1DFEAF>Photo</color> of that giant dinosaur.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Dr. Bacon asked me to take a <color=#1DFEAF>Photo</color> of that giant dinosaur.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BasiloPhotoBarricade_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(It's terrifying, but... I should try to take it carefully.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(It's terrifying, but... I should try to take it carefully.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BasiloPhotoClear_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright. I think this one turned out pretty well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright. I think this one turned out pretty well.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_BasiloPhotoClear_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's head back to the village and show it to Dr. Bacon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's head back to the village and show it to Dr. Bacon!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Enter01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! A spear just came flying out of nowhere...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoa...! A spear just came flying out of nowhere...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Enter01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Who's down here this deep...? Don't tell me it's the Sea People...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Who's down here this deep...? Don't tell me it's the Sea People...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Enter01_003
Array.english: <size=33>I should get out of the way first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I should get out of the way first.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start01_001
Array.english: Phew... I think I barely shook them off...
Array.indonesia: Phew... I think I barely shook them off...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start01_002
Array.english: But where am I...?
Array.indonesia: But where am I...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start02_001
Array.english: <size=33>What the heck is that...?! A shark...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What the heck is that...?! A shark...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! The cage broke...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoa...! The cage broke...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start04_001
Array.english: Ugh... the exit's blocked too...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... the exit's blocked too...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_Start04_002
Array.english: I've got no choice but to take it down...
Array.indonesia: I've got no choice but to take it down...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_Looting_001
Array.english: Phew... that was one weird-looking creature.
Array.indonesia: Phew... that was one weird-looking creature.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_Looting_002
Array.english: Maybe I should check if there's anything worth taking from the shark.
Array.indonesia: Maybe I should check if there's anything worth taking from the shark.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_01_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_Looting_Barricade_001
Array.english: Let's see if there's anything we can take from the shark before we leave.
Array.indonesia: Let's see if there's anything we can take from the shark before we leave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_ReturnTown_001
Array.english: Phew... what appeared earlier seemed to be Sea People...
Array.indonesia: Phew... what appeared earlier seemed to be Sea People...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_ReturnTown_002
Array.english: Unlike the Sea People from the Blue Hole, they were extremely hostile.
Array.indonesia: Unlike the Sea People from the Blue Hole, they were extremely hostile.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_Stethacanthus_End_ReturnTown_003
Array.english: For now, I should head up to the village and give Dr. Bacon the <color=#F1DC2B>Photos</color>.
Array.indonesia: For now, I should head up to the village and give Dr. Bacon the <color=#F1DC2B>Photos</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! You're safe! What a relief!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! You're safe! What a relief!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_002
Array.english: <size=31>I was worried sick when the comms cut out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>I was worried sick when the comms cut out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_003
Array.english: We suddenly ran into a shark with a weird anvil on its head...
Array.indonesia: We suddenly ran into a shark with a weird anvil on its head...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_004
Array.english: That shark looked like some kind of ancient creature too.
Array.indonesia: That shark looked like some kind of ancient creature too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_005
Array.english:
An anvil on its head...
Could it be a <color=#F1DC2B>Stethacanthus</color>...?!
Array.indonesia:
An anvil on its head...
Could it be a <color=#F1DC2B>Stethacanthus</color>...?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_006
Array.english: Hmm. None of these creatures should be alive in this era...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. None of these creatures should be alive in this era...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_007
Array.english: Show me the <color=#F1DC2B>Photos</color> you took, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Show me the <color=#F1DC2B>Photos</color> you took, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_008
Array.english: Sure. Here they are.
Array.indonesia: Sure. Here they are.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_009
Array.english: <size=31>This... it's the same species as the one that washed up on the beach a while back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>This... it's the same species as the one that washed up on the beach a while back!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_010
Array.english: Judging by its larger size... it might be the mother.
Array.indonesia: Judging by its larger size... it might be the mother.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_011
Array.english: So it came out looking for its baby?
Array.indonesia: So it came out looking for its baby?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_012
Array.english: It probably knows by instinct that its baby is dead.\nThat's why it's in such a rage right now.
Array.indonesia: It probably knows by instinct that its baby is dead.\nThat's why it's in such a rage right now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_013
Array.english: I feel a bit sorry for it, but... if it keeps coming out like this, \nit'll destroy the whole lake and village.
Array.indonesia: I feel a bit sorry for it, but... if it keeps coming out like this, \nit'll destroy the whole lake and village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_014
Array.english: But even if we try to send it back now, it'll be pointless with the gate still open.
Array.indonesia: But even if we try to send it back now, it'll be pointless with the gate still open.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_015
Array.english: The ones who manage this area, the Sea People...\nshould know how to operate that gate.
Array.indonesia: The ones who manage this area, the Sea People...\nshould know how to operate that gate.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_016
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... the ones who suddenly attacked me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... the ones who suddenly attacked me...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_017
Array.english: Hmm... according to the local writings, these Sea People are \na tribe called the <color=#1DFEAF>Mahoni</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... according to the local writings, these Sea People are \na tribe called the <color=#1DFEAF>Mahoni</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_018
Array.english: They're quite hostile toward humans entering their territory... or so it says.
Array.indonesia: They're quite hostile toward humans entering their territory... or so it says.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_019
Array.english: Hmm. We'll need to work with them to close that gate...\nThis won't be easy.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. We'll need to work with them to close that gate...\nThis won't be easy.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_020
Array.english: Oh, Dave. Do you still have the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Translator</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. Do you still have the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Translator</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_021
Array.english: Yes. It's still attached to my gear.
Array.indonesia: Yes. It's still attached to my gear.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_022
Array.english: Great! Then why don't you try talking to the Sea People directly and ask them to close the gate?
Array.indonesia: Great! Then why don't you try talking to the Sea People directly and ask them to close the gate?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_023
Array.english: <size=32>What? But they attacked me on sight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What? But they attacked me on sight!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_024
Array.english: True, but... they must be having quite a bit of trouble with that ancient creature too. We share the same goal.
Array.indonesia: True, but... they must be having quite a bit of trouble with that ancient creature too. We share the same goal.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_025
Array.english: If you meet their chief, I'm sure you'll find a way to work together!
Array.indonesia: If you meet their chief, I'm sure you'll find a way to work together!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_026
Array.english: Hmm... I doubt they'll even agree to meet me.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I doubt they'll even agree to meet me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_027
Array.english: <size=32>Then just break in and meet them face-to-face!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Then just break in and meet them face-to-face!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_028
Array.english: All Mahoni devices run on energy from <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>.
Array.indonesia: All Mahoni devices run on energy from <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_029
Array.english: Which means... the entrance to their settlement is sealed with that same energy.
Array.indonesia: Which means... the entrance to their settlement is sealed with that same energy.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_030
Array.english: If we can harness that energy... we can break into their settlement and meet the Mahoni chief!
Array.indonesia: If we can harness that energy... we can break into their settlement and meet the Mahoni chief!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_031
Array.english: <size=34>...That sounds like a pretty reckless solution.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...That sounds like a pretty reckless solution.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_032
Array.english: It's a forced approach, but it does make sense in a way.
Array.indonesia: It's a forced approach, but it does make sense in a way.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_033
Array.english: Hmm... so I need to go down to the deep sea and get some <color=#63F9FF>Divine Tree Berries</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... so I need to go down to the deep sea and get some <color=#63F9FF>Divine Tree Berries</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_034
Array.english: That'd be pretty risky. They're heavy, and... you could get attacked by ancient creatures on the way back.
Array.indonesia: That'd be pretty risky. They're heavy, and... you could get attacked by ancient creatures on the way back.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_035
Array.english: <size=32>Ah! About that <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color> you visited, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah! About that <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color> you visited, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_036
Array.english: <size=32>Was there any way to go further down from the basement?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Was there any way to go further down from the basement?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_037
Array.english: Hmm... I think I saw a ladder, but...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I think I saw a ladder, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_038
Array.english: <size=33>The water's too high, so I won't be able to go down.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The water's too high, so I won't be able to go down.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_039
Array.english: <size=32>Just as I thought! Muna's prediction was right again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Just as I thought! Muna's prediction was right again!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_040
Array.english: This Divine Tree seems to extend all the way down to the temple's basement. Which means you can harvest <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Berries</color> down there.
Array.indonesia: This Divine Tree seems to extend all the way down to the temple's basement. Which means you can harvest <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Berries</color> down there.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_041
Array.english: Hmm... even if that's true, how do we drain the water?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... even if that's true, how do we drain the water?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_042
Array.english: Hehe. Leave the ancient contraptions to me.\nThat's my specialty.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Leave the ancient contraptions to me.\nThat's my specialty.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_043
Array.english: <size=33>First, take me to the <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>First, take me to the <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_044
Array.english: There are a lot of dangerous wild animals there.\nAre you sure you'll be okay?
Array.indonesia: There are a lot of dangerous wild animals there.\nAre you sure you'll be okay?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_045
Array.english: Hehe, don't worry.\nI've had some special training myself.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, don't worry.\nI've had some special training myself.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_046
Array.english: I'll get everything ready today, so let's meet at the forest entrance <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>, hahaha!!
Array.indonesia: I'll get everything ready today, so let's meet at the forest entrance <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>, hahaha!!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_04_02_MahoniCave_End_047
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>Hmm... is this really a good idea...?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Hmm... is this really a good idea...?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_DaveMorning_001
Array.english: Muna asked me to go to the temple with her, right?
Array.indonesia: Muna asked me to go to the temple with her, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_DaveMorning_002
Array.english: Once I'm done here, I'll head toward the forest.
Array.indonesia: Once I'm done here, I'll head toward the forest.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_001
Array.english: Hmm? Rimbo. Are you setting something up?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Rimbo. Are you setting something up?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_002
Array.english: Ah, now that the forest path's open, I've been lookin' around and puttin' up some <color=#1DFEAF>Signposts</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah, now that the forest path's open, I've been lookin' around and puttin' up some <color=#1DFEAF>Signposts</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_003
Array.english: If ya call me from one of them <color=#1DFEAF>Signposts</color> in the forest,\nI'll come pick ya up in the truck right away.
Array.indonesia: If ya call me from one of them <color=#1DFEAF>Signposts</color> in the forest,\nI'll come pick ya up in the truck right away.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_004
Array.english: Not just the village... you can go anywhere there's a <color=#1DFEAF>Signpost</color> set up.
Array.indonesia: Not just the village... you can go anywhere there's a <color=#1DFEAF>Signpost</color> set up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_005
Array.english: Oh... the forest's pretty dangerous, so that's a relief!
Array.indonesia: Oh... the forest's pretty dangerous, so that's a relief!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_RimboSignpost_006
Array.english: <size=31>Hehe! You've been workin' hard for the village,\nso I gotta help out somehow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hehe! You've been workin' hard for the village,\nso I gotta help out somehow!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! You're already here...!\nI'm a bit late... hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! You're already here...!\nI'm a bit late... hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_002
Array.english: You seem excited.\nDid you bring your weapon?
Array.indonesia: You seem excited.\nDid you bring your weapon?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Of course!! We're heading into the jungle! \nAnd the ruins!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Of course!! We're heading into the jungle! \nAnd the ruins!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_004
Array.english: <size=33>Ta-da!! It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Whip</color>, see!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ta-da!! It's a <color=#F1DC2B>Whip</color>, see!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_005
Array.english: <size=32>I'll take them all down with this, swish swish! \nSo don't you worry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll take them all down with this, swish swish! \nSo don't you worry!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_MunaJoin_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Sounds good. Let's get going then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Sounds good. Let's get going then!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BeforeEntertheDungeon_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ooh... so this is the Murau Temple...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ooh... so this is the Murau Temple...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BeforeEntertheDungeon_002
Array.english: I can smell a mysterious adventure brewing... hehehe.
Array.indonesia: I can smell a mysterious adventure brewing... hehehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BeforeEntertheDungeon_003
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let's head in!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright, let's head in!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_ElevatorReminder_001
Array.english: <size=31>...Hm? What's that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>...Hm? What's that?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_ElevatorReminder_002
Array.english: Oh, right! That's the elevator I used to come up last time!
Array.indonesia: Oh, right! That's the elevator I used to come up last time!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_ElevatorReminder_003
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha, that's right.\nIt'll be much easier if we take that down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha, that's right.\nIt'll be much easier if we take that down!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_001
Array.english: This is where the ancient breathing apparatus was.
Array.indonesia: This is where the ancient breathing apparatus was.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_002
Array.english: Hmm. This is probably where most of the rituals were performed.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. This is probably where most of the rituals were performed.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_003
Array.english: But the fact that there's a ladder on the right...
Array.indonesia: But the fact that there's a ladder on the right...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_004
Array.english: <size=31>Means there's a way down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Means there's a way down!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_Arrived_005
Array.english: That makes sense.\nLet's take a look around.
Array.indonesia: That makes sense.\nLet's take a look around.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_001
Array.english: Oh... this door... I think I can open it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... this door... I think I can open it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_002
Array.english: Huh? I don't see any kind of mechanism nearby.
Array.indonesia: Huh? I don't see any kind of mechanism nearby.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_003
Array.english: Hehe... this door opens by touch.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... this door opens by touch.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_004
Array.english: ...Did they have something like that in ancient times?
Array.indonesia: ...Did they have something like that in ancient times?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_005
Array.english: The more I study the Sunang civilization, the more fascinating it gets.
Array.indonesia: The more I study the Sunang civilization, the more fascinating it gets.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_006
Array.english: There are markings here that match the ones in the ancient texts...
Array.indonesia: There are markings here that match the ones in the ancient texts...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_007
Array.english: <size=32>And look, only those markings on the door have handprints on them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>And look, only those markings on the door have handprints on them!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_008
Array.english: <size=33>I'm sure if I touch these...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'm sure if I touch these...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoomOpen_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! This genius Muna was right!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! This genius Muna was right!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoomOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>There's definitely a drainage system inside.\nLet's go in.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>There's definitely a drainage system inside.\nLet's go in.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_Lever_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you're right.\nThere really is a drainage system here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, you're right.\nThere really is a drainage system here!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_Lever_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... I'll give it a pull then.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... I'll give it a pull then.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_AfterLever_001
Array.english: Oh! Now that the water's gone down, I can climb down the ladder.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Now that the water's gone down, I can climb down the ladder.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_DrainageRoom_AfterLever_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, let's head back to the ladder!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, let's head back to the ladder!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_001
Array.english: Alright then, shall we head down?
Array.indonesia: Alright then, shall we head down?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_002
Array.english: There might be something dangerous down there...\nAre you sure about this?
Array.indonesia: There might be something dangerous down there...\nAre you sure about this?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_003
Array.english: Haha!! I've got you two with me, what's there to be afraid of!
Array.indonesia: Haha!! I've got you two with me, what's there to be afraid of!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_004
Array.english: ...Oh, of course, you too, Marone!
Array.indonesia: ...Oh, of course, you too, Marone!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_005
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B2_FindLadder_006
Array.english: You're unbelievable.\nAlright, let's head down.
Array.indonesia: You're unbelievable.\nAlright, let's head down.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_Arrived_001
Array.english: Oh! Just as I thought, there are <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Berries</color>!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Just as I thought, there are <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Berries</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_Arrived_002
Array.english: Hmm... but they're too high up to reach.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... but they're too high up to reach.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_Arrived_003
Array.english: You're right. Let's head a bit further in for now.
Array.indonesia: You're right. Let's head a bit further in for now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_1stPuzzle_001
Array.english: Hmm. There's some kind of device here too.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. There's some kind of device here too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_1stPuzzle_002
Array.english: Hmm... If we want to move forward, we should try activating it first.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... If we want to move forward, we should try activating it first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_1stPuzzleSolve_001
Array.english: <size=31>Oh... a bridge just appeared...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Oh... a bridge just appeared...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_1stPuzzleSolve_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. Let's cross over.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. Let's cross over.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzle_001
Array.english: Hmm. Looks like there's another device like the last one.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Looks like there's another device like the last one.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzle_002
Array.english: Haha! This one looks a bit more complicated than before... \nbut for the great Muna, it's a piece of cake!
Array.indonesia: Haha! This one looks a bit more complicated than before... \nbut for the great Muna, it's a piece of cake!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzle_003
Array.english: <size=32>Let's look around and see what we can find!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's look around and see what we can find!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzleSolve_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hehehe, success!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hehehe, success!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_2ndtPuzzleSolve_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Looks like there's no more water ahead! \nLet's keep going!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Looks like there's no more water ahead! \nLet's keep going!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_FindFruit_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! I think I can reach that <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> up ahead!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! I think I can reach that <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> up ahead!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_FindFruit_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... but it's kinda creepy here.\nLet's grab it and head back up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... but it's kinda creepy here.\nLet's grab it and head back up.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! What kind of fish is that?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa! What kind of fish is that?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_002
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like... a giant Fringehead...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Looks like... a giant Fringehead...!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well... it's seawater here, so I guess that makes sense.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well... it's seawater here, so I guess that makes sense.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_004
Array.english: <size=33>We'll have to take it down before we can get past here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>We'll have to take it down before we can get past here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_005
Array.english: <size=32>In that case...\nI'll have to give it a taste of my whip!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>In that case...\nI'll have to give it a taste of my whip!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringehead_006
Array.english: Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_WinFringehead_001
Array.english: Phew... that startled me.
Array.indonesia: Phew... that startled me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_WinFringehead_002
Array.english: Nothing else will get in our way now, right?
Array.indonesia: Nothing else will get in our way now, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_WinFringehead_003
Array.english: Hurry, grab the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> and let's head back up.
Array.indonesia: Hurry, grab the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> and let's head back up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringeheadRetry_001
Array.english: Looks like we'll have to defeat that Fringehead before we can get the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>....
Array.indonesia: Looks like we'll have to defeat that Fringehead before we can get the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>....

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_MeetFringeheadRetry_002
Array.english:
<size=33>Hahaha! I'm ready!
Let's go at it again!!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33>Hahaha! I'm ready!
Let's go at it again!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_001
Array.english: Wow... so this is a <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>...\nWhat a radiant glow... it's beautiful...
Array.indonesia: Wow... so this is a <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>...\nWhat a radiant glow... it's beautiful...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_002
Array.english: Be careful. It has strong energy, so it could explode if handled improperly.
Array.indonesia: Be careful. It has strong energy, so it could explode if handled improperly.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_003
Array.english: Got it. I've stored it safely in my bag, so shall we head back up now?!
Array.indonesia: Got it. I've stored it safely in my bag, so shall we head back up now?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_004
Array.english: But how do we get back up?
Array.indonesia: But how do we get back up?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_005
Array.english: Usually, places like this have some kind of mechanism to get back up...
Array.indonesia: Usually, places like this have some kind of mechanism to get back up...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_006
Array.english: Shall we search ahead?
Array.indonesia: Shall we search ahead?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GetFruit_Barricade_001
Array.english: There's got to be an easier way up.\nLet me check ahead.
Array.indonesia: There's got to be an easier way up.\nLet me check ahead.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GotoWildBoar01_001
Array.english: There's a rope with a handle up ahead...
Array.indonesia: There's a rope with a handle up ahead...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GotoWildBoar02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright!\nI bet if I pull that...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright!\nI bet if I pull that...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GotoWildBoar03_001
Array.english: <size=33>As expected! Now, let's climb up this ladder!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>As expected! Now, let's climb up this ladder!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_GotoWildBoar03_002
Array.english: Woof! Woof!
Array.indonesia: Woof! Woof!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_B3_AfterWildBoar_001
Array.english: Looks like that boar brought the whole cave down.\nNo way up from here.
Array.indonesia: Looks like that boar brought the whole cave down.\nNo way up from here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_StepTail_001
Array.english: Hm? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hm? What is it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_StepTail_002
Array.english: Oh, I think I just stepped on something mushy...
Array.indonesia: Oh, I think I just stepped on something mushy...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_StepTail_003
Array.english: <size=32>Did you step in some monkey poop or something? Hahaha!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Did you step in some monkey poop or something? Hahaha!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_StepTail_004
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... it's so gross...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... it's so gross...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Outside_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Fresh air feels so much better!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Fresh air feels so much better!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Outside_002
Array.english: <size=32>Phew. Still, I'm glad we made it out safely.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew. Still, I'm glad we made it out safely.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Start_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm...? Did something just shake really hard...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm...? Did something just shake really hard...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>Aaah...!! I think something's coming out...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aaah...!! I think something's coming out...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Minigame_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, Rimbo!! How'd you get all the way out here?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, Rimbo!! How'd you get all the way out here?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Minigame_002
Array.english: <size=33>You hadn't come by in a while, so I figured somethin' might be up and came to check... Glad I did!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You hadn't come by in a while, so I figured somethin' might be up and came to check... Glad I did!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Minigame_003
Array.english: <size=35>There are plenty of trees up ahead!\nHold on tight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>There are plenty of trees up ahead!\nHold on tight!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_Runaway_001
Array.english: <size=35>There are plenty of trees up ahead!\nHold on tight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>There are plenty of trees up ahead!\nHold on tight!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End_001
Array.english: Phew... that was a close one.
Array.indonesia: Phew... that was a close one.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End_002
Array.english: I'm alive thanks to you, Rimbo...
Array.indonesia: I'm alive thanks to you, Rimbo...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End_003
Array.english: Haha, you got lucky! Let's head back to the village together.
Array.indonesia: Haha, you got lucky! Let's head back to the village together.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End02_001
Array.english: Phew... That was one massive boar...\nI barely got away.
Array.indonesia: Phew... That was one massive boar...\nI barely got away.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End02_002
Array.english: At least I made it back with the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> in one piece.
Array.indonesia: At least I made it back with the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> in one piece.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_WildBoar_End02_003
Array.english: <size=33>I should go tell Dr. Bacon about this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I should go tell Dr. Bacon about this!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh! This is a <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ooh! This is a <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_002
Array.english: It was a real pain to get.\nA wild boar even chased me...
Array.indonesia: It was a real pain to get.\nA wild boar even chased me...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_003
Array.english: Haha. But you made it back safe and sound, didn't you!
Array.indonesia: Haha. But you made it back safe and sound, didn't you!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_004
Array.english: Now, if we attach this <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> to the harpoon, we'll be able to activate the Sea People's contraption.
Array.indonesia: Now, if we attach this <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> to the harpoon, we'll be able to activate the Sea People's contraption.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_005
Array.english: Hmm. I'll work on it today.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I'll work on it today.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_05_BaconTalk_006
Array.english: Come back <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color> and you'll be able to see it, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Come back <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color> and you'll be able to see it, hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaKnock_001
Array.english: <size=32>That's Muna's voice...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That's Muna's voice...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaKnock_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... right, we were going to modify the harpoon with the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>, weren't we? Is it already done?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... right, we were going to modify the harpoon with the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color>, weren't we? Is it already done?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_001
Array.english: Hehe... look at this.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... look at this.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_002
Array.english: <size=33>I modified the harpoon like I said yesterday! Ta-da!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I modified the harpoon like I said yesterday! Ta-da!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_003
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! It's glowing blue... looks so cool...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! It's glowing blue... looks so cool...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... I channeled the energy from the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> into it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... I channeled the energy from the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> into it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_005
Array.english: <size=33>If you touch the Mahoni contraptions with this harpoon, they should react.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If you touch the Mahoni contraptions with this harpoon, they should react.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_006
Array.english: <size=32>I can't think of any other way to talk to the Mahoni chief.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I can't think of any other way to talk to the Mahoni chief.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniHook_MunaTalk_007
Array.english: <size=32>Got it. I should head back down to the lake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Got it. I should head back down to the lake.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateFruit_001
Array.english: <size=31>If I hit the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> above the door with my modified harpoon, it should react, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>If I hit the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> above the door with my modified harpoon, it should react, right?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateFruit_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>I need to hurry and meet the Mahoni chief to ask how to close the gate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I need to hurry and meet the Mahoni chief to ask how to close the gate.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateFruit_Barricade_002
Array.english: <size=32>If I hit the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> above the gate with my harpoon, it should react. I'd better try it now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If I hit the <color=#63F9FF>Blue Divine Tree Fruit</color> above the gate with my harpoon, it should react. I'd better try it now.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateOpen_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh wow... it's actually working...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh wow... it's actually working...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>Muna, you might seem clumsy, but you're actually pretty skilled.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Muna, you might seem clumsy, but you're actually pretty skilled.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateOpen_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's a bit scary, but... I have no choice but to ask the chief for help to close the ancient gate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's a bit scary, but... I have no choice but to ask the chief for help to close the ancient gate.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_MainGateOpen_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let's go through the gate!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let's go through the gate!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_LivingArea_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! I didn't expect it to be right here...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoa...! I didn't expect it to be right here...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_LivingArea_002
Array.english: <size=32>It looks really angry...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It looks really angry...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_LivingArea02_001
Array.english: <size=32>First, I need to get out through that hole...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>First, I need to get out through that hole...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_WaterWayArea_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... unlike the Sea People in the Blue Hole, these ones are extremely aggressive. I need to be careful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew... unlike the Sea People in the Blue Hole, these ones are extremely aggressive. I need to be careful.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_WaterWayArea_002
Array.english: <size=32>Luckily, there's a path I can use here too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Luckily, there's a path I can use here too.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_WaterWayArea_003
Array.english: <size=33>Let's keep moving for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's keep moving for now!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_WaterWayArea_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=33>No going back now...\nLet's keep moving forward.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>No going back now...\nLet's keep moving forward.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah...! The guards are watching the path from here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah...! The guards are watching the path from here...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Start_002
Array.english: Is there any way I can sneak past them without being noticed...?
Array.indonesia: Is there any way I can sneak past them without being noticed...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Start02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... If I hide behind those <color=#1DFEAF>Water Plants</color>, I might be able to slip by...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... If I hide behind those <color=#1DFEAF>Water Plants</color>, I might be able to slip by...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Busted_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ahh...! They spotted me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ahh...! They spotted me!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_Busted_002
Array.english: <size=32>No choice...\nI need to make them back off a bit first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>No choice...\nI need to make them back off a bit first.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... fighting Sea People with weapons...\nThis isn't easy...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew... fighting Sea People with weapons...\nThis isn't easy...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea1_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>He opened the door while retreating.\nLet's head there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>He opened the door while retreating.\nLet's head there.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Start_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh...! There are guards here too...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh...! There are guards here too...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Start_002
Array.english: Let's try sneaking past again without being seen.
Array.indonesia: Let's try sneaking past again without being seen.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Busted_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh! Why are they so sharp-eyed...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh! Why are they so sharp-eyed...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Busted_002
Array.english: <size=32>They probably know this area inside out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>They probably know this area inside out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_Busted_003
Array.english: <size=32>No choice...\nI need to get out of here first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>No choice...\nI need to get out of here first.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... is it a tradition to leave doors open...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... is it a tradition to leave doors open...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_PatrolArea2_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe the chief's room is up ahead?\nLet's go a bit further.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maybe the chief's room is up ahead?\nLet's go a bit further.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter01_001
Array.english: <size=32>Thank goodness I made it back up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thank goodness I made it back up.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Now, which way is the chief's room...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Now, which way is the chief's room...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa...! He looks incredibly strong...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Whoa...! He looks incredibly strong...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter02_002
Array.english: <size=31>I don't think he's noticed me yet...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>I don't think he's noticed me yet...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Maybe I can slip past him...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Maybe I can slip past him...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter03_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... knew it wouldn't be that easy...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... knew it wouldn't be that easy...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_Enter03_002
Array.english: <size=33>He's got a big <color=#F1DC2B>Shield</color>...\nThis won't be easy...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>He's got a big <color=#F1DC2B>Shield</color>...\nThis won't be easy...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_End01_001
Array.english: I heard a loud noise from inside...
Array.indonesia: I heard a loud noise from inside...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_Mahoni_BossArea_End01_002
Array.english: <size=32>That must be the Mahoni chief!\nLet's follow them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That must be the Mahoni chief!\nLet's follow them!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... that voice is...\npretty unique...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... that voice is...\npretty unique...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk01_002
Array.english: It sounds like he's saying something to me...\nBut what is he saying?
Array.indonesia: It sounds like he's saying something to me...\nBut what is he saying?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk01_003
Array.english: Oh! Right, I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Translator</color> with me.\nI should turn it on.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Right, I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Translator</color> with me.\nI should turn it on.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=35>What are you fiddling with over there?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>What are you fiddling with over there?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Oh... the Sea People translator is working here too...?!)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Oh... the Sea People translator is working here too...?!)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Um... I'm here to see the chief.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Um... I'm here to see the chief.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=35>Me...? For what reason...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Me...? For what reason...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_005
Array.english: You must know about the ancient creatures roaming outside... and the giant dinosaur stuck there, right?
Array.indonesia: You must know about the ancient creatures roaming outside... and the giant dinosaur stuck there, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_006
Array.english: Of course. We can't even go outside properly because of them.
Array.indonesia: Of course. We can't even go outside properly because of them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_007
Array.english: A massive earthquake some time ago...\nopened a gate that had been sealed since ancient times.
Array.indonesia: A massive earthquake some time ago...\nopened a gate that had been sealed since ancient times.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_008
Array.english: To seal the gate again, we need to insert the <color=#1DFEAF>Star Relic</color> into it...
Array.indonesia: To seal the gate again, we need to insert the <color=#1DFEAF>Star Relic</color> into it...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=33>but it's pointless as long as that giant dinosaur is stuck there...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>but it's pointless as long as that giant dinosaur is stuck there...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_010
Array.english: <size=33>What if...\nwe could make the dinosaur back off?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What if...\nwe could make the dinosaur back off?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_011
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm? What are you talking about?\nMake it back off...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm? What are you talking about?\nMake it back off...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_012
Array.english: <size=32>I've got some capable friends with me! I'm sure they can draw it back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I've got some capable friends with me! I'm sure they can draw it back!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_013
Array.english: <size=32>And while it's backing up, you Sea People can close the gate... and mission accomplished!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>And while it's backing up, you Sea People can close the gate... and mission accomplished!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_014
Array.english: Hmm... asking us to help you, are you...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... asking us to help you, are you...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_015
Array.english: It's not impossible, but... I'm not keen on trusting humans and working together.
Array.indonesia: It's not impossible, but... I'm not keen on trusting humans and working together.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_016
Array.english: You see, humans are such a selfish species...
Array.indonesia: You see, humans are such a selfish species...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_017
Array.english: We've been betrayed several times before...\nso most of our tribe doesn't think highly of humans.
Array.indonesia: We've been betrayed several times before...\nso most of our tribe doesn't think highly of humans.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_018
Array.english: Hmm... but shouldn't we solve this problem together...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... but shouldn't we solve this problem together...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_019
Array.english: Given the situation, we probably should.\nI know you're suffering too.
Array.indonesia: Given the situation, we probably should.\nI know you're suffering too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_020
Array.english: In that case...
Array.indonesia: In that case...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_021
Array.english: <size=32>To test your strength... how about you solve one of our tribe's problems?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>To test your strength... how about you solve one of our tribe's problems?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_022
Array.english: <size=32>Us Mahoni are a militant people, so we trust strength...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Us Mahoni are a militant people, so we trust strength...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_023
Array.english: <size=34>and there is one issue troubling our people.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>and there is one issue troubling our people.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_024
Array.english: <size=35>I have a bad feeling about this...\nWhat is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I have a bad feeling about this...\nWhat is it?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_025
Array.english: There's one particularly ferocious creature among those that came through the gate...
Array.indonesia: There's one particularly ferocious creature among those that came through the gate...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_026
Array.english: We managed to trap it in the <color=#F1DC2B>Right Residential Area</color>...
Array.indonesia: We managed to trap it in the <color=#F1DC2B>Right Residential Area</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_027
Array.english: But it has sharp teeth and can chew through the walls…\nIt'll surely break out once the food runs out.
Array.indonesia: But it has sharp teeth and can chew through the walls…\nIt'll surely break out once the food runs out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_028
Array.english: <size=34>Defeat it, and the whole tribe will acknowledge you.</size>
