Array.indonesia: <size=34>Defeat it, and the whole tribe will acknowledge you.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_029
Array.english: Ugh... just hearing that sounds terrifying...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... just hearing that sounds terrifying...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_030
Array.english: If that's the only way to get you on our side...\nI guess I have no choice.
Array.indonesia: If that's the only way to get you on our side...\nI guess I have no choice.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_031
Array.english: I'll get ready and head to the <color=#F1DC2B>Right Residential Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: I'll get ready and head to the <color=#F1DC2B>Right Residential Area</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_032
Array.english: Oh... you've got guts.\nI like that.
Array.indonesia: Oh... you've got guts.\nI like that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_033
Array.english: Torang! Clear the stones blocking the entrance.\nLet the human pass.
Array.indonesia: Torang! Clear the stones blocking the entrance.\nLet the human pass.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_034
Array.english: <size=36>Y-Yes! Understood.\nWe'll have it cleared by <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Y-Yes! Understood.\nWe'll have it cleared by <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_035
Array.english: Human, head to the <color=#F1DC2B>Right Residential Area</color> tomorrow.\nI'll have the gate opened for you.
Array.indonesia: Human, head to the <color=#F1DC2B>Right Residential Area</color> tomorrow.\nI'll have the gate opened for you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_036
Array.english: I'll order the others to stand down...\nThey won't attack you anymore.
Array.indonesia: I'll order the others to stand down...\nThey won't attack you anymore.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_01_MahoniChiefTalk02_037
Array.english: ...As long as you don't do anything foolish.
Array.indonesia: ...As long as you don't do anything foolish.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hey! Didn't you hear? I'm working on this until <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hey! Didn't you hear? I'm working on this until <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, and...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, and...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_003
Array.english: <size=33>Earlier, I was holding back so I wouldn't damage the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Earlier, I was holding back so I wouldn't damage the village.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_004
Array.english: <size=34>If I went all out, I could knock you out with a single strike!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>If I went all out, I could knock you out with a single strike!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hmph. I'll have these rocks cleared by <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>, so come back then.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmph. I'll have these rocks cleared by <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>, so come back then.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier01_001
Array.english: Hey, hey... don't get in our way.
Array.indonesia: Hey, hey... don't get in our way.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier01_002
Array.english: We gotta hustle if we want these rocks cleared by <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>.
Array.indonesia: We gotta hustle if we want these rocks cleared by <color=#F1DC2B>Tomorrow</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier02_001
Array.english: Heard you went after the chief while he was worn out from training?
Array.indonesia: Heard you went after the chief while he was worn out from training?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier02_002
Array.english: Someone at your level won't stand a chance against the beast in there.
Array.indonesia: Someone at your level won't stand a chance against the beast in there.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BeforeGateOpen_Soldier02_003
Array.english: You're gonna regret it...tch.
Array.indonesia: You're gonna regret it...tch.

Array.name: dialogue_Barricade_MahoniCheifTooClose_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hey! Don't come any closer, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hey! Don't come any closer, human.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... Dave! You're safe!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... Dave! You're safe!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's head to the tent, get some rest, and talk.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's head to the tent, get some rest, and talk.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_001
Array.english: You look exhausted... \nSo? Did you manage to meet the Mahoni chief?
Array.indonesia: You look exhausted... \nSo? Did you manage to meet the Mahoni chief?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_002
Array.english: Yes... getting there wasn't easy, but...\nI managed to meet him.
Array.indonesia: Yes... getting there wasn't easy, but...\nI managed to meet him.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_003
Array.english: I see. Good work.\nWhat did he say?
Array.indonesia: I see. Good work.\nWhat did he say?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_004
Array.english: Well... they're having a lot of trouble with those ancient creatures that suddenly showed up.
Array.indonesia: Well... they're having a lot of trouble with those ancient creatures that suddenly showed up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... then working together should be more than possible!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... then working together should be more than possible!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_006
Array.english: But... the tribe is very hostile toward humans...
Array.indonesia: But... the tribe is very hostile toward humans...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_007
Array.english: They gave me a task to prove myself: defeat a ferocious ancient creature.
Array.indonesia: They gave me a task to prove myself: defeat a ferocious ancient creature.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_008
Array.english: They said it's a creature that can chew through walls with its teeth...
Array.indonesia: They said it's a creature that can chew through walls with its teeth...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_009
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... that's probably a <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... that's probably a <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_010
Array.english: It's known for its drill-like teeth...\nand for being extremely aggressive.
Array.indonesia: It's known for its drill-like teeth...\nand for being extremely aggressive.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_011
Array.english: <size=34>...Suddenly I don't want to go down there anymore.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Suddenly I don't want to go down there anymore.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_012
Array.english: But if the Basilosaurus down below makes its way up to the lake, things will get much worse.
Array.indonesia: But if the Basilosaurus down below makes its way up to the lake, things will get much worse.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_013
Array.english: I understand...
Array.indonesia: I understand...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_014
Array.english: By the way, we need to make the Basilosaurus back off before the Sea People close the gate. How do we do that?
Array.indonesia: By the way, we need to make the Basilosaurus back off before the Sea People close the gate. How do we do that?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_015
Array.english: Hehe... I've got an idea.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... I've got an idea.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_016
Array.english: <size=33>I've got some emergency <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color>... hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I've got some emergency <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color>... hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_017
Array.english: <size=35>...Why do you have those?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Why do you have those?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_018
Array.english: I was planning to use them for self-defense in case I got attacked by wild animals in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: I was planning to use them for self-defense in case I got attacked by wild animals in the jungle.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_019
Array.english: Let me think about how we can use them first.
Array.indonesia: Let me think about how we can use them first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_020
Array.english: For now, the priority is to defeat the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> and get the Mahoni tribe on our side.
Array.indonesia: For now, the priority is to defeat the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> and get the Mahoni tribe on our side.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_MahoniReportTalk02_021
Array.english: <size=32>It's a dangerous creature... so make sure you're fully prepared before going in.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's a dangerous creature... so make sure you're fully prepared before going in.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Reminder_001
Array.english: Hmm. The Sea People said they'd clear the rocks blocking the cave where the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> is trapped, right?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. The Sea People said they'd clear the rocks blocking the cave where the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> is trapped, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Reminder_002
Array.english: I should head back down to the lake bed once everything's ready.
Array.indonesia: I should head back down to the lake bed once everything's ready.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_001
Array.english: Oh... you cleared all the rocks.
Array.indonesia: Oh... you cleared all the rocks.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_002
Array.english: I thought my shoulder was gonna give out.
Array.indonesia: I thought my shoulder was gonna give out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_003
Array.english: I could go in and take it down myself... but moving those rocks took more out of me than I expected.
Array.indonesia: I could go in and take it down myself... but moving those rocks took more out of me than I expected.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_004
Array.english: But since it's the chief's order... I'll let you take this one.
Array.indonesia: But since it's the chief's order... I'll let you take this one.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard_005
Array.english: <size=32>Just don't end up as its next meal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Just don't end up as its next meal.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard02_001
Array.english: Looks like the way into the settlement is open now.
Array.indonesia: Looks like the way into the settlement is open now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard02_002
Array.english: So there's a really vicious ancient creature inside...?
Array.indonesia: So there's a really vicious ancient creature inside...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_GateGuard02_003
Array.english: <size=32>I'll probably need some pretty strong gear.\nI'll head in once I'm ready.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll probably need some pretty strong gear.\nI'll head in once I'm ready.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_DungeonEnter_001
Array.english: Hmm... the place is completely wrecked...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... the place is completely wrecked...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_DungeonEnter_002
Array.english: Sounds like it's as violent as I heard.\nBetter be careful...
Array.indonesia: Sounds like it's as violent as I heard.\nBetter be careful...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BossEnter_001
Array.english: Judging by all these fish bones, the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> must be up ahead.
Array.indonesia: Judging by all these fish bones, the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color> must be up ahead.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BossEnter_002
Array.english: <size=32>Should I go in now...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Should I go in now...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BossEnter_Select_Yes
Array.english: I'm ready.
Array.indonesia: I'm ready.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_BossEnter_Select_No
Array.english: I'm not ready yet
Array.indonesia: I'm not ready yet

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Appear_001
Array.english: <size=33>That's the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color>...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That's the <color=#F1DC2B>Xiphactinus</color>...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Appear_002
Array.english: It looks even more vicious than I heard...
Array.indonesia: It looks even more vicious than I heard...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Appear_003
Array.english: But I have to take it down if I want the Mahoni tribe on our side.
Array.indonesia: But I have to take it down if I want the Mahoni tribe on our side.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Appear_004
Array.english: No matter how strong it looks, there has to be an opening. \nI should watch how it moves first.
Array.indonesia: No matter how strong it looks, there has to be an opening. \nI should watch how it moves first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_FightBarricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>I was told I need to defeat it to get the Mahoni tribe on our side. I can't back down now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I was told I need to defeat it to get the Mahoni tribe on our side. I can't back down now!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_CarvingBarricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Let me see if there's anything worth taking with me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let me see if there's anything worth taking with me...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Carving_001
Array.english: Hmm... now that I'm seeing it up close...\nit actually looks kind of tasty...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... now that I'm seeing it up close...\nit actually looks kind of tasty...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_Carving_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should check if there are any parts worth taking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should check if there are any parts worth taking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. That should do it.\nI should head back to the chief's room.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright. That should do it.\nI should head back to the chief's room.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_001
Array.english: I took care of that ferocious ancient creature.
Array.indonesia: I took care of that ferocious ancient creature.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_002
Array.english: Oh... impressive...\nI have to admit, that's something.
Array.indonesia: Oh... impressive...\nI have to admit, that's something.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I still can't get used to that voice...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(I still can't get used to that voice...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_004
Array.english: <size=34>What are you thinking about!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What are you thinking about!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_005
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, nothing at all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, nothing at all!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_006
Array.english: <size=32>Well... you kept your promise, so...\nI'll help you close the gate.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well... you kept your promise, so...\nI'll help you close the gate.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_007
Array.english: As we discussed... for us to close the gate,\nyou'll need to make that giant creature back off first.
Array.indonesia: As we discussed... for us to close the gate,\nyou'll need to make that giant creature back off first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_008
Array.english: <size=32>Do you have a plan in mind?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Do you have a plan in mind?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_009
Array.english: Yes. We have some <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color>.\nIf we hit it with those, it should back off.
Array.indonesia: Yes. We have some <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color>.\nIf we hit it with those, it should back off.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_010
Array.english: <size=32>Tsk. Humans still rely on such crude methods.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tsk. Humans still rely on such crude methods.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_011
Array.english: I'll have Torang insert the star relic the moment the creature backs off.
Array.indonesia: I'll have Torang insert the star relic the moment the creature backs off.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReport_012
Array.english: I never thought the Mahoni would work with humans...\nOur ancestors would have something to say about this.
Array.indonesia: I never thought the Mahoni would work with humans...\nOur ancestors would have something to say about this.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReportEnd_001
Array.english: Fortunately, I managed to get the Mahoni tribe on our side.
Array.indonesia: Fortunately, I managed to get the Mahoni tribe on our side.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReportEnd_002
Array.english: Now I just need to use Muna's <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color> to make the Basilosaurus back off a bit.
Array.indonesia: Now I just need to use Muna's <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color> to make the Basilosaurus back off a bit.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReportEnd_003
Array.english: She said she'd figure out how to set them up...
Array.indonesia: She said she'd figure out how to set them up...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Xiphactinus_ChiefReportEnd_004
Array.english: First, let's head back up to the village.
Array.indonesia: First, let's head back up to the village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_001
Array.english: <size=32>You're here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You're here!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_002
Array.english: About those <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color>... \nI've been thinking about how to set them up...
Array.indonesia: About those <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bombs</color>... \nI've been thinking about how to set them up...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_003
Array.english: If I go down in the diving bell, it'll be hard to position them... and if I use a drone, the depth makes it hard to see anything...
Array.indonesia: If I go down in the diving bell, it'll be hard to position them... and if I use a drone, the depth makes it hard to see anything...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_004
Array.english: <size=34>I think it'd be best if someone went down there and set them up directly...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I think it'd be best if someone went down there and set them up directly...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive01_005
Array.english: Someone who can actually go that deep...
Array.indonesia: Someone who can actually go that deep...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_001
Array.english: <size=34>...Got it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Got it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_002
Array.english: So what do I need to do?
Array.indonesia: So what do I need to do?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_003
Array.english: <size=32>It's actually really simple. Just drop this <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color> into the Basilosaurus's mouth!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's actually really simple. Just drop this <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Bomb</color> into the Basilosaurus's mouth!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Then boom! It'll get startled and back off!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Then boom! It'll get startled and back off!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_005
Array.english: Wouldn't blowing up a bomb inside it hurt it too much?
Array.indonesia: Wouldn't blowing up a bomb inside it hurt it too much?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_006
Array.english: Nah... for something that size, it's nothing!
Array.indonesia: Nah... for something that size, it's nothing!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_007
Array.english: For a human, it'd be like...\neating a single spicy pepper?
Array.indonesia: For a human, it'd be like...\neating a single spicy pepper?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_008
Array.english: Hmm... alright.\nI just do it like when I took that photo?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... alright.\nI just do it like when I took that photo?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_009
Array.english: <size=31>Yep, yep. Pretty much the same!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Yep, yep. Pretty much the same!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_010
Array.english: Oh, just in case, you should take a <color=#F1DC2B>Spare Bomb</color> with you too.
Array.indonesia: Oh, just in case, you should take a <color=#F1DC2B>Spare Bomb</color> with you too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_011
Array.english: This one needs a bit of prep, though...\nI'll give it to you tomorrow morning.
Array.indonesia: This one needs a bit of prep, though...\nI'll give it to you tomorrow morning.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_012
Array.english: <size=32>You must be tired, so get some rest today, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You must be tired, so get some rest today, hehe!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCMainMission_06_02_Bomb_Receive02_013
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! This should wrap things up nicely!\nGood luck out there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! This should wrap things up nicely!\nGood luck out there!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, Dave. Thanks to you, my Insectagram is filling up nicely. Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, Dave. Thanks to you, my Insectagram is filling up nicely. Thank you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_002
Array.english: But... they're mostly common insects...
Array.indonesia: But... they're mostly common insects...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_003
Array.english: I don't really have anything to write for the upcoming special 10th issue...
Array.indonesia: I don't really have anything to write for the upcoming special 10th issue...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_004
Array.english: By any chance...
Array.indonesia: By any chance...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_005
Array.english: <size=34>I have a feeling you're about to ask for a favor...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I have a feeling you're about to ask for a favor...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_006
Array.english: Hehe... have you heard the rumor about a giant red stag beetle in <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hehe... have you heard the rumor about a giant red stag beetle in <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_007
Array.english: No... that's my first time hearing it.
Array.indonesia: No... that's my first time hearing it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_008
Array.english: According to our magazine's research, there's a <color=#1DFEAF>Giant Stag Beetle</color> in this forest... about three times the size of a normal one, with flame-like patterns.
Array.indonesia: According to our magazine's research, there's a <color=#1DFEAF>Giant Stag Beetle</color> in this forest... about three times the size of a normal one, with flame-like patterns.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_009
Array.english: <size=33>If you could catch that for me, this special issue would be a huge success!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If you could catch that for me, this special issue would be a huge success!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_010
Array.english: ...I'm begging you.
Array.indonesia: ...I'm begging you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_011
Array.english: ...Hmm. Alright. But how am I supposed to catch something that big?
Array.indonesia: ...Hmm. Alright. But how am I supposed to catch something that big?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_012
Array.english: Hmm. Of course, catching it with just one bug won't work like before.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Of course, catching it with just one bug won't work like before.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_013
Array.english: I saw people in a nearby village catching large stag beetles... by battling them with multiple bugs.
Array.indonesia: I saw people in a nearby village catching large stag beetles... by battling them with multiple bugs.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_014
Array.english: <size=32>How about you try using multiple bugs at once, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>How about you try using multiple bugs at once, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_015
Array.english: Hmm... multiple bugs, huh...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... multiple bugs, huh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Start_016
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, I'll look for that giant beetle in the forest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright, I'll look for that giant beetle in the forest.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FindBoss_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa...! Is that the giant stag beetle Udo mentioned...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa...! Is that the giant stag beetle Udo mentioned...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FindBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's red and massive... looks really strong...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's red and massive... looks really strong...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FindBoss_003
Array.english: <size=32>I should send out several beetles at once.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should send out several beetles at once.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_WinBoss_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... that was intense.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew... that was intense.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_WinBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>Now that I've caught it safely, I should bring it to Udo.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Now that I've caught it safely, I should bring it to Udo.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_LoseBoss_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's strong, as expected...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's strong, as expected...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_LoseBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should catch some stronger insects...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should catch some stronger insects...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_RetryBoss_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>The Flame-Patterned Stag Beetle</color> from before...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>The Flame-Patterned Stag Beetle</color> from before...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_RetryBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>Should I go for a rematch...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Should I go for a rematch...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FightBoss_option01
Array.english: Battle
Array.indonesia: Battle

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_FightBoss_option02
Array.english: I'll try next time
Array.indonesia: I'll try next time

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Giveup_001
Array.english: I don't think I'm ready to take that on yet...\nI should do it later.
Array.indonesia: I don't think I'm ready to take that on yet...\nI should do it later.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Unsatisfied_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'll need at least three to take that on.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'll need at least three to take that on.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Unsatisfied_002
Array.english: Let's catch a few more and try again.
Array.indonesia: Let's catch a few more and try again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Satisfied_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright! Let's take on that flame-patterned stag beetle!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright! Let's take on that flame-patterned stag beetle!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_001
Array.english: Here... I caught that flame-patterned stag beetle for you.
Array.indonesia: Here... I caught that flame-patterned stag beetle for you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=32>Wow...! I've never seen this species before!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow...! I've never seen this species before!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_003
Array.english: That vivid red pattern... that incredible size...
Array.indonesia: That vivid red pattern... that incredible size...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=33>This is more than enough for a headline!\nThank you!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This is more than enough for a headline!\nThank you!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_005
Array.english: Now that the article's covered... I'd like to repay you somehow, Dave...
Array.indonesia: Now that the article's covered... I'd like to repay you somehow, Dave...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=32>Is there anything I can help with at Bancho's restaurant?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Is there anything I can help with at Bancho's restaurant?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_007
Array.english: Oh... do you know how to cook or serve?
Array.indonesia: Oh... do you know how to cook or serve?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_008
Array.english: I used to work part-time at a restaurant before joining the magazine.
Array.indonesia: I used to work part-time at a restaurant before joining the magazine.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_009
Array.english: Customers loved it when I took their photos! Hehe!
Array.indonesia: Customers loved it when I took their photos! Hehe!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleBoss_Complete_010
Array.english: <size=32>If you're offering, we'd love the help!\nI'm counting on you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If you're offering, we'd love the help!\nI'm counting on you.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hah...! Dave...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hah...! Dave...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>You've caught every insect in this region?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You've caught every insect in this region?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah... looks like it.\nIt wasn't easy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yeah... looks like it.\nIt wasn't easy.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_004
Array.english: <size=32>But thanks to you, Udo, I got to see a lot of fascinating insects!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But thanks to you, Udo, I got to see a lot of fascinating insects!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe, I'm glad to hear that.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_006
Array.english: <size=33>Then I'll submit my completion report to the editor-in-chief...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Then I'll submit my completion report to the editor-in-chief...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_007
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_008
Array.english: <size=33>Huh!? There's still one uncaught species...?!\nThat can't be right...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh!? There's still one uncaught species...?!\nThat can't be right...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_009
Array.english: <size=32>Aaah...!!! This is the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color>...!?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aaah...!!! This is the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color>...!?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_010
Array.english: I see... I must've been mistaken... To think the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> lives in this region...
Array.indonesia: I see... I must've been mistaken... To think the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> lives in this region...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_011
Array.english: Without catching this one, I can't truly say the encyclopedia is complete... *sigh*...
Array.indonesia: Without catching this one, I can't truly say the encyclopedia is complete... *sigh*...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_012
Array.english: I feel terrible asking you for even more help, Dave...\nI really shouldn't...
Array.indonesia: I feel terrible asking you for even more help, Dave...\nI really shouldn't...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_013
Array.english: <size=33>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_014
Array.english: <size=48>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_015
Array.english: <size=32>...Alright.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Alright.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_016
Array.english: Where does the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> live?
Array.indonesia: Where does the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> live?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_017
Array.english: Well... it says the B2 of <color=#1DFEAF>Murau Temple</color>...
Array.indonesia: Well... it says the B2 of <color=#1DFEAF>Murau Temple</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_018
Array.english: Ah... that place with the drainage system...
Array.indonesia: Ah... that place with the drainage system...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_019
Array.english: Alright...\nI'll go take a look.
Array.indonesia: Alright...\nI'll go take a look.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Start_020
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! Dave!!\nI'll never forget this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa! Dave!!\nI'll never forget this!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Arrived_001
Array.english: Hmm... Udo said the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> lives here, right?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Udo said the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> lives here, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Arrived_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's see if I can find it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's see if I can find it...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Found_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! Is that a <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> over there...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! Is that a <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> over there...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Found_002
Array.english: It's massive... Just like that flame-patterned stag beetle, I'll probably need to send out three at once.
Array.indonesia: It's massive... Just like that flame-patterned stag beetle, I'll probably need to send out three at once.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_WinBoss_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... that was tough...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew... that was tough...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_WinBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>But I managed to catch it.\nLooks like I picked the right team!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But I managed to catch it.\nLooks like I picked the right team!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_WinBoss_003
Array.english: <size=32>This was the last one, right...?\nLet's bring it to Udo.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>This was the last one, right...?\nLet's bring it to Udo.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_LoseBoss_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's strong, just like I thought...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's strong, just like I thought...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_LoseBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should catch some stronger insects...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should catch some stronger insects...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_RetryBoss_001
Array.english: <size=33>That <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> from before...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> from before...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_RetryBoss_002
Array.english: <size=32>Should I go for a rematch...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Should I go for a rematch...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_FightBoss_option01
Array.english: Battle
Array.indonesia: Battle

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_FightBoss_option02
Array.english: I'll try next time
Array.indonesia: I'll try next time

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Giveup_001
Array.english: I don't think I'm ready to take that on yet...\nLet's do it later.
Array.indonesia: I don't think I'm ready to take that on yet...\nLet's do it later.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Unsatisfied_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'll need at least three to take that on.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'll need at least three to take that on.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Unsatisfied_002
Array.english: Let's catch a few more and try again.
Array.indonesia: Let's catch a few more and try again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Satisfied_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright! Let's take on that <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright! Let's take on that <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_001
Array.english: Here... I caught the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Here... I caught the <color=#F1DC2B>Golden Tiger Beetle</color> you asked for.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=32>Whoaa...!! What a sturdy, massive specimen...\nThis... is cover-worthy material!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Whoaa...!! What a sturdy, massive specimen...\nThis... is cover-worthy material!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_003
Array.english: Dave, thank you so much. Thanks to you, I was able to cover every insect in this region.
Array.indonesia: Dave, thank you so much. Thanks to you, I was able to cover every insect in this region.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_004
Array.english: I had a lot of fun too.
Array.indonesia: I had a lot of fun too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_005
Array.english: I even brought a <color=#F1DC2B>Model</color> to photograph in case I couldn't find any giant insects, but looks like I won't need it.
Array.indonesia: I even brought a <color=#F1DC2B>Model</color> to photograph in case I couldn't find any giant insects, but looks like I won't need it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_006
Array.english: ...Wouldn't that be misleading your readers?
Array.indonesia: ...Wouldn't that be misleading your readers?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=33>N-no, not at all! It's just a bit of staging to help readers understand!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>N-no, not at all! It's just a bit of staging to help readers understand!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_008
Array.english: Hmm... but I only heard it was a giant beetle,\nso I ended up making it way too big.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... but I only heard it was a giant beetle,\nso I ended up making it way too big.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_009
Array.english: Looks like I won't need it anymore...
Array.indonesia: Looks like I won't need it anymore...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_010
Array.english: If you have space to display it, how about taking it home as a keepsake, Dave?
Array.indonesia: If you have space to display it, how about taking it home as a keepsake, Dave?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_011
Array.english: Oh... I appreciate it, but... it seems a bit too big to keep inside the house...
Array.indonesia: Oh... I appreciate it, but... it seems a bit too big to keep inside the house...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_012
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... then how about hanging it above the door?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... then how about hanging it above the door?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=31>Hmm... that's actually not a bad idea.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hmm... that's actually not a bad idea.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_014
Array.english: <size=33>I'll try hanging it above my door!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'll try hanging it above my door!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_015
Array.english: Hehe. Then I'll stay in the village a bit longer and keep working on the article.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Then I'll stay in the village a bit longer and keep working on the article.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Udo_BeatleBattleFinalBoss_Complete_016
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you again for all your help, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thank you again for all your help, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeYes_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! I won't go easy on you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright! I won't go easy on you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, heading out? Let's play together next time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, heading out? Let's play together next time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>I won! I used to play with my dad a lot when I was little, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I won! I used to play with my dad a lot when I was little, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>That was enough fun for today. Let's play again another time after you've practiced.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That was enough fun for today. Let's play again another time after you've practiced.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeReward_001
Array.english: <size=34>You're really good! I thought I was pretty decent myself.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You're really good! I thought I was pretty decent myself.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeReward_002
Array.english: <size=33>I'll give you this <color=#1DFEAF>Gorilla Block</color> my dad gave me a while back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'll give you this <color=#1DFEAF>Gorilla Block</color> my dad gave me a while back.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeReward_003
Array.english: <size=32>It'll be even more fun if you mix it in with the others blocks.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It'll be even more fun if you mix it in with the others blocks.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=33>Shall we have an <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> challenge?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Shall we have an <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> challenge?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>That was fun, hehe.\nCome talk to me again when you have time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That was fun, hehe.\nCome talk to me again when you have time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_UzmeStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... you're a bit short on cash.\nYou need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... you're a bit short on cash.\nYou need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, you say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, you say?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaYes_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, let's have a round.\nI don't hold back, so be ready.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, let's have a round.\nI don't hold back, so be ready.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? Leaving already?\nI was going to go easy on you... See you around.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Leaving already?\nI was going to go easy on you... See you around.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh dear... I ended up winning.\nPerhaps I should have gone easier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh dear... I ended up winning.\nPerhaps I should have gone easier.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>That's enough for today.\nCome back after you've practiced more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That's enough for today.\nCome back after you've practiced more.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaReward_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...? You're quite good.\nI let my guard down...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...? You're quite good.\nI let my guard down...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaReward_002
Array.english: <size=32>This is my prized <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Bear Block</color>. It'll be more enjoyable if you add it to your collection.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>This is my prized <color=#1DFEAF>Sun Bear Block</color>. It'll be more enjoyable if you add it to your collection.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaReward_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well then, let's play again next time we have a chance.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well then, let's play again next time we have a chance.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, would you like to challenge me to a match?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, would you like to challenge me to a match?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, that was enjoyable.\nLet's play again when we have time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, that was enjoyable.\nLet's play again when we have time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PanutaStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah, but I'm a bit short on money. You need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> for it to be worthwhile. Come back next time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah, but I'm a bit short on money. You need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> for it to be worthwhile. Come back next time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? You know <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh? You know <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's been a while... but I reckon I'm still better than ya.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's been a while... but I reckon I'm still better than ya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuYes_002
Array.english: <size=33>Alright then, let's have a match.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright then, let's have a match.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, not playin'? I was gonna go easy on ya.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, not playin'? I was gonna go easy on ya.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Well now, I went and won!\nGuess I haven't lost my touch, haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well now, I went and won!\nGuess I haven't lost my touch, haha.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>All that focus's got me tuckered out. That's all I've got in me for today.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>All that focus's got me tuckered out. That's all I've got in me for today.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuReward_001
Array.english: <size=32>Aw shucks... made a bit of a mistake there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Aw shucks... made a bit of a mistake there.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuReward_002
Array.english: <size=32>You win. Take this as a gift.\nIt's an <color=#1DFEAF>Anaconda Block</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You win. Take this as a gift.\nIt's an <color=#1DFEAF>Anaconda Block</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuReward_003
Array.english: <size=32>It'll be more fun if ya add it to yer collection.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It'll be more fun if ya add it to yer collection.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> wanna play a round?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> wanna play a round?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_Betting_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'm feelin' real good today...\nAin't gonna go easy on ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm feelin' real good today...\nAin't gonna go easy on ya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, that was fun.\nLet's play again sometime.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, that was fun.\nLet's play again sometime.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_BasuStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe, looks like you're a little short on cash, don't ya? You'll need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> to really enjoy it, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe, looks like you're a little short on cash, don't ya? You'll need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> to really enjoy it, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>It's a traditional game in our village...\nThink you can beat me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's a traditional game in our village...\nThink you can beat me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakYes_002
Array.english: <size=33>Well, I like your confidence.\nLet's get started!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well, I like your confidence.\nLet's get started!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, not playing?\nCome on, don't be scared.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, not playing?\nCome on, don't be scared.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Told you!\nI've been playing since I was a kid.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Told you!\nI've been playing since I was a kid.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>Alright, let's call it a day for now. I'll take you on again another time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright, let's call it a day for now. I'll take you on again another time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakReward_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... can't believe I lost.\nLet my guard down a bit.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... can't believe I lost.\nLet my guard down a bit.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakReward_002
Array.english: <size=33>That was an impressive match.\nHere, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Rhinoceros Hornbill Block</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That was an impressive match.\nHere, take this <color=#1DFEAF>Rhinoceros Hornbill Block</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, huh?\nAlright, go ahead.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>, huh?\nAlright, go ahead.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, that was fun.\nCome find me when you want to play again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, that was fun.\nCome find me when you want to play again.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_PerakStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>...You need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color>.\nAsk me again when you have it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...You need at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color>.\nAsk me again when you have it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>...You want to play <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...You want to play <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>...If my wife sees this, I'm in trouble...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...If my wife sees this, I'm in trouble...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangYes_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'd better win this quick before that happens... hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'd better win this quick before that happens... hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangNo_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? Not playing?\nI was looking forward to a little fun for once.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Not playing?\nI was looking forward to a little fun for once.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangNo_002
Array.english: <size=32>Well, hit me up next time you've got a minute!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well, hit me up next time you've got a minute!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! I won!\nYou didn't go easy on me, did you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! I won!\nYou didn't go easy on me, did you?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangEnd_002
Array.english: <size=33>If I keep playing... my wife's gonna catch me.\nI'll call it a day for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If I keep playing... my wife's gonna catch me.\nI'll call it a day for now.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangReward_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh man...! I lost.\nI used to be better than this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh man...! I lost.\nI used to be better than this.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangReward_002
Array.english: <size=32>Well, a loss is a loss. Here. Take it. \nIt's a <color=#1DFEAF>Chicken Block</color> I made myself.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well, a loss is a loss. Here. Take it. \nIt's a <color=#1DFEAF>Chicken Block</color> I made myself.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangReward_003
Array.english: <size=32>Let's play again sometime when we both have time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's play again sometime when we both have time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangStart_Betting_001
Array.english: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> is fun, ain't it... hehe.\nHow about a round?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> is fun, ain't it... hehe.\nHow about a round?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangStart_BettingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah, that was fun.\nHit me up again sometime, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah, that was fun.\nHit me up again sometime, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_GesangStart_Betting_Nomoney_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... you should have at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> on you.\nOtherwise it's just chump change isn't it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... you should have at least <color=#1DFEAF>30 Doni</color> on you.\nOtherwise it's just chump change isn't it?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! You beat the villagers and collected all three blocks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! You beat the villagers and collected all three blocks!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_002
Array.english: <size=32>You're better than you look, ain't ya? Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You're better than you look, ain't ya? Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_003
Array.english: They were all pretty good.\nI barely won.
Array.indonesia: They were all pretty good.\nI barely won.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_004
Array.english: You can now use these blocks in battle.
Array.indonesia: You can now use these blocks in battle.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_005
Array.english: Truth is...\nI lost these in a bet a while back.
Array.indonesia: Truth is...\nI lost these in a bet a while back.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_006
Array.english: Thanks for getting them back for me.\nWouldn't feel right not to repay you.
Array.indonesia: Thanks for getting them back for me.\nWouldn't feel right not to repay you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_007
Array.english: Here, this is an ornament made from animal blocks...\nGo ahead and hang it up in your shop!
Array.indonesia: Here, this is an ornament made from animal blocks...\nGo ahead and hang it up in your shop!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_ATS_MissionAllClear_008
Array.english: <size=32>Well then, I'll be seein' ya around! Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well then, I'll be seein' ya around! Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_001
Array.english: Oh... you're not open yet...
Array.indonesia: Oh... you're not open yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_002
Array.english: Oh, Cinta, hello.\nIs there something you need?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Cinta, hello.\nIs there something you need?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_003
Array.english: The chef here...\nI heard he can make all kinds of dishes...
Array.indonesia: The chef here...\nI heard he can make all kinds of dishes...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_004
Array.english: <size=32>I was hoping Bancho could cook something for me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I was hoping Bancho could cook something for me.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_005
Array.english: Well... if it's possible, I'll do my best.\nWhat is it?
Array.indonesia: Well... if it's possible, I'll do my best.\nWhat is it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_006
Array.english: <size=33>By any chance... do you know a plant called the <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>By any chance... do you know a plant called the <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_007
Array.english: Of course. It's a plant that grows in damp areas in the mountains. Its crisp, crunchy texture is exquisite.
Array.indonesia: Of course. It's a plant that grows in damp areas in the mountains. Its crisp, crunchy texture is exquisite.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_008
Array.english: Just as I heard, you're very knowledgeable... Chef.
Array.indonesia: Just as I heard, you're very knowledgeable... Chef.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_009
Array.english: Could you make a dish with <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color> simmered in coconut milk?
Array.indonesia: Could you make a dish with <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color> simmered in coconut milk?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_010
Array.english: Hmm. I specialize in fish.\nFor vegetables, someone else might be better.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I specialize in fish.\nFor vegetables, someone else might be better.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_011
Array.english: ...I see. I'm sorry...
Array.indonesia: ...I see. I'm sorry...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_012
Array.english: It's something my late husband used to make for me...\nPerhaps it's better left as a memory.
Array.indonesia: It's something my late husband used to make for me...\nPerhaps it's better left as a memory.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_013
Array.english: Uh... n-no.\nI didn't say I couldn't do it.
Array.indonesia: Uh... n-no.\nI didn't say I couldn't do it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_014
Array.english: But looking around the village... \nI don't think I saw anything like that?
Array.indonesia: But looking around the village... \nI don't think I saw anything like that?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_015
Array.english: Oh... <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color> grows on the hill near Suruga Falls.
Array.indonesia: Oh... <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color> grows on the hill near Suruga Falls.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_016
Array.english: Oh, you mean near the shooting range. But there are so many vines growing there, it looks hard to get in.
Array.indonesia: Oh, you mean near the shooting range. But there are so many vines growing there, it looks hard to get in.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_017
Array.english: Since the villagers don't go there much these days,\nthat would make sense.
Array.indonesia: Since the villagers don't go there much these days,\nthat would make sense.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_018
Array.english: If we had my husband's <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>, we could cut through it easily.
Array.indonesia: If we had my husband's <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>, we could cut through it easily.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_019
Array.english: Oh, then could I borrow it?
Array.indonesia: Oh, then could I borrow it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_020
Array.english:
Well... I gave it to the carpenter <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>...
He was close with my husband.
Array.indonesia:
Well... I gave it to the carpenter <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>...
He was close with my husband.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_021
Array.english: If you speak with <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>,\nhe might lend it to you.
Array.indonesia: If you speak with <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>,\nhe might lend it to you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_CintaVisit_BanchoGrill_022
Array.english: I see.\nThen I'll go ask him.
Array.indonesia: I see.\nThen I'll go ask him.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_001
Array.english: By any chance... do you still have the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> Cinta's husband used to carry?
Array.indonesia: By any chance... do you still have the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> Cinta's husband used to carry?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_002
Array.english: Oh, of course.\nWhy do you ask?
Array.indonesia: Oh, of course.\nWhy do you ask?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_003
Array.english: Well, I want to head up to the waterfall on the hill...\nbut the vines are too overgrown.
Array.indonesia: Well, I want to head up to the waterfall on the hill...\nbut the vines are too overgrown.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_004
Array.english: Ah, a machete will cut right through those, haha!
Array.indonesia: Ah, a machete will cut right through those, haha!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_005
Array.english: Oh. Could I borrow it then?
Array.indonesia: Oh. Could I borrow it then?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_006
Array.english: Aw... just lending it out is no fun.
Array.indonesia: Aw... just lending it out is no fun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_007
Array.english: As you know, I'm injured and can't go chop wood.\nMy hands are itching to get back to work...
Array.indonesia: As you know, I'm injured and can't go chop wood.\nMy hands are itching to get back to work...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_008
Array.english: How about you bring me 2 pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color>?
Array.indonesia: How about you bring me 2 pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_009
Array.english: Rubber trees only grow in <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>... and in my condition, there's no way I can head in there.
Array.indonesia: Rubber trees only grow in <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color>... and in my condition, there's no way I can head in there.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Machete_010
Array.english: Hmm. You mean the forest on the way to the ruins.\nAlright, got it.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. You mean the forest on the way to the ruins.\nAlright, got it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Delivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did you bring me 2 <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, did you bring me 2 <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: I got them

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_001
Array.english: Yes. Here it is.
Array.indonesia: Yes. Here it is.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh... you actually brought it back?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh... you actually brought it back?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_003
Array.english: A promise is a promise!\nHere's the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>.
Array.indonesia: A promise is a promise!\nHere's the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_004
Array.english: Just swing it at the vines and they'll clear out easily.
Array.indonesia: Just swing it at the vines and they'll clear out easily.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_Finished_005
Array.english: Be careful not to cut yourself and end up bandaged like me.
Array.indonesia: Be careful not to cut yourself and end up bandaged like me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here, I brought it.
Array.indonesia: Here, I brought it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... this doesn't look like enough?\nI need 2 <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... this doesn't look like enough?\nI need 2 <color=#F1DC2B>Rubberwood</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah... I don't have any on me right now.\nI'll bring them next time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah... I don't have any on me right now.\nI'll bring them next time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Peneb_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll keep looking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_ReadytoCook_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, I got all the ingredients for the braised ostrich fern. Let's head to the shop and serve it to <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright, I got all the ingredients for the braised ostrich fern. Let's head to the shop and serve it to <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_001
Array.english: <size=38>Th-this is... The coconut milk gently wrapping around the bitterness of the <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Th-this is... The coconut milk gently wrapping around the bitterness of the <color=#FF73C3>Ostrich Fern</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_002
Array.english: <size=37>It reminds me of the taste... when he smiled and made it for me for the first time...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>It reminds me of the taste... when he smiled and made it for me for the first time...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_003
Array.english: I-I'm sorry. The tears are coming again...
Array.indonesia: I-I'm sorry. The tears are coming again...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_004
Array.english: It was my first time making it, so I'm glad you liked it.
Array.indonesia: It was my first time making it, so I'm glad you liked it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_005
Array.english: ...It's not that it was good... He was clumsy the first time he made it as well.
Array.indonesia: ...It's not that it was good... He was clumsy the first time he made it as well.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_006
Array.english: <size=36>...Hmm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>...Hmm.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_007
Array.english: Anyway, thank you so much for bringing back those memories.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, thank you so much for bringing back those memories.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_008
Array.english: This is a small gift... \nIf you like it, please hang it up in the shop.
Array.indonesia: This is a small gift... \nIf you like it, please hang it up in the shop.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_009
Array.english: My husband was so happy when he caught a leopard and made this... but I don't need it anymore.
Array.indonesia: My husband was so happy when he caught a leopard and made this... but I don't need it anymore.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_010
Array.english: Oh... this is amazing.\nThank you!
Array.indonesia: Oh... this is amazing.\nThank you!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_SpecialGuest_Cinta_AfterEatDish_011
Array.english: Well then... I'll be counting on you from now on.\nThank you... for the meal.
Array.indonesia: Well then... I'll be counting on you from now on.\nThank you... for the meal.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_001
Array.english: Ah, outsider. Good to see you.\nCould I ask you a favor?
Array.indonesia: Ah, outsider. Good to see you.\nCould I ask you a favor?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_002
Array.english: Sure, what can I help you with?
Array.indonesia: Sure, what can I help you with?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_003
Array.english: I've been mixing various herbs, and I think I could use some more <color=#F1DC2B>Bamboo Shoots</color>.
Array.indonesia: I've been mixing various herbs, and I think I could use some more <color=#F1DC2B>Bamboo Shoots</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_004
Array.english: <size=33>Could you gather <color=#F1DC2B>3 Bamboo Shoots</color> from nearby?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Could you gather <color=#F1DC2B>3 Bamboo Shoots</color> from nearby?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_005
Array.english: Sure. That shouldn't be a problem.
Array.indonesia: Sure. That shouldn't be a problem.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_006
Array.english: Bamboo shoots... They should be near bamboo, right?
Array.indonesia: Bamboo shoots... They should be near bamboo, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_HerbalistStart_007
Array.english: You're quite sharp, hehe.\nI'll be counting on you.
Array.indonesia: You're quite sharp, hehe.\nI'll be counting on you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_CheckDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Have you managed to find the <color=#F1DC2B>3 Bamboo Shoots</color> I asked for?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Have you managed to find the <color=#F1DC2B>3 Bamboo Shoots</color> I asked for?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_CheckDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, I found them
Array.indonesia: Yes, I found them

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_CheckDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Not yet

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here are the bamboo shoots you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Here are the bamboo shoots you asked for.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Oh, thank you. This will be enough for my research.
Array.indonesia: Oh, thank you. This will be enough for my research.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: It's not much, but please accept this as a token of my gratitude, outsider.
Array.indonesia: It's not much, but please accept this as a token of my gratitude, outsider.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Here you go.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... it's not enough. Could you get me some more, please?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... it's not enough. Could you get me some more, please?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Ah... you're right. Okay, I'll look for more.
Array.indonesia: Ah... you're right. Okay, I'll look for more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_GiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english:
Oh... I think I was mistaken.
I'll look for it again.
Array.indonesia:
Oh... I think I was mistaken.
I'll look for it again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_01_RefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: I haven't gotten it yet. I'll bring it later.
Array.indonesia: I haven't gotten it yet. I'll bring it later.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_001
Array.english: Good grief... just can't seem to catch any.
Array.indonesia: Good grief... just can't seem to catch any.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_002
Array.english: Hmm? Something wrong, Basu?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Something wrong, Basu?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_003
Array.english: Well... there's this fish called a <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>...\nThey're mighty tasty when grilled.
Array.indonesia: Well... there's this fish called a <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>...\nThey're mighty tasty when grilled.
