Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_004
Array.english: But they just won't bite a hook.\nThey hide in the mud, you see.
Array.indonesia: But they just won't bite a hook.\nThey hide in the mud, you see.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_005
Array.english: Could you maybe catch <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> for me next time you go to the lake?
Array.indonesia: Could you maybe catch <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> for me next time you go to the lake?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_006
Array.english: I don't think catching them would be hard if I spot them…\nbut won't they be hard to find if they're hiding in the mud?
Array.indonesia: I don't think catching them would be hard if I spot them…\nbut won't they be hard to find if they're hiding in the mud?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_007
Array.english: <size=33>Haha, ain't no need to worry! \nThey'll jump out and go after anything that passes by!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha, ain't no need to worry! \nThey'll jump out and go after anything that passes by!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_008
Array.english: <size=34>Oh... I see. Right...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh... I see. Right...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_009
Array.english: Haha, best grilled whole...\nso bring 'em back <color=#1DFEAF>Alive</color>.
Array.indonesia: Haha, best grilled whole...\nso bring 'em back <color=#1DFEAF>Alive</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanStart_010
Array.english: If you've got a <color=#F1DC2B>Net</color>, you could catch 'em all at once.
Array.indonesia: If you've got a <color=#F1DC2B>Net</color>, you could catch 'em all at once.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did ya happen to catch the <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, did ya happen to catch the <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Here you go
Array.indonesia: Here you go

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_000
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did ya manage to catch the <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, did ya manage to catch the <color=#F1DC2B>Walking Catfish</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: They were tough to find, hidin' in the mud...
Array.indonesia: They were tough to find, hidin' in the mud...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=34>But I caught them anyway, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>But I caught them anyway, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Thanks a bunch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Thanks a bunch!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Doesn't look too tasty just lookin' at it...\nbut they say it's amazing fried.
Array.indonesia: Doesn't look too tasty just lookin' at it...\nbut they say it's amazing fried.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: <size=33>Hope I get to try it at your shop sometime!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hope I get to try it at your shop sometime!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Here you go.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... this ain't quite enough. Come back when you've got what you promised.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... this ain't quite enough. Come back when you've got what you promised.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oops, I was mistaken.\nI haven't caught it yet.
Array.indonesia: Oops, I was mistaken.\nI haven't caught it yet.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanGiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should write it down properly so I don't mess up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should write it down properly so I don't mess up.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_03_FishermanRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Not yet...\nI'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Not yet...\nI'll keep looking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>He's so stubborn...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>He's so stubborn...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_002
Array.english: Is something bothering you?
Array.indonesia: Is something bothering you?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_003
Array.english: Ah... I'm sorry. It's about my father.
Array.indonesia: Ah... I'm sorry. It's about my father.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_004
Array.english: Ah... your father... the village chief.
Array.indonesia: Ah... your father... the village chief.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_005
Array.english: Yes. The reason my dad's leg is like that...\nis actually my fault.
Array.indonesia: Yes. The reason my dad's leg is like that...\nis actually my fault.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>When I was young, he got hurt trying to save me from a vicious saltwater crocodile.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>When I was young, he got hurt trying to save me from a vicious saltwater crocodile.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_007
Array.english: That's why I promised myself I'd never grow up to be weak... and I've trained every single day since.
Array.indonesia: That's why I promised myself I'd never grow up to be weak... and I've trained every single day since.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_008
Array.english: But...\nthat doesn't make my dad's leg any better.
Array.indonesia: But...\nthat doesn't make my dad's leg any better.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_009
Array.english: He often gets severe pain when it rains...\nbut he really hates using medicine.
Array.indonesia: He often gets severe pain when it rains...\nbut he really hates using medicine.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_010
Array.english: Applying medicine would ease the pain a bit...\nbut he's stubborn about the strangest things.
Array.indonesia: Applying medicine would ease the pain a bit...\nbut he's stubborn about the strangest things.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_011
Array.english: I've been secretly applying it while he sleeps...\nbut I'm about to run out.
Array.indonesia: I've been secretly applying it while he sleeps...\nbut I'm about to run out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_012
Array.english: The medicine is made from an aquatic plant called <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>. If you find any in the lake, could you bring it to me?
Array.indonesia: The medicine is made from an aquatic plant called <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>. If you find any in the lake, could you bring it to me?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_013
Array.english: <size=33>I think about <color=#1DFEAF>5 Stalks</color> should be enough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I think about <color=#1DFEAF>5 Stalks</color> should be enough.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeStart_014
Array.english: Got it. I'll pick some up if I see any in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Got it. I'll pick some up if I see any in the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did you manage to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, did you manage to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: I got them

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here, I brought five <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>.
Array.indonesia: Here, I brought five <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Oh... this is it! This should be enough to make Dad's medicine.
Array.indonesia: Oh... this is it! This should be enough to make Dad's medicine.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Thank you, Dave.\nI'll be sure to repay you someday.
Array.indonesia: Thank you, Dave.\nI'll be sure to repay you someday.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: You really don't have to. \nI already owe you and the chief so much.
Array.indonesia: You really don't have to. \nI already owe you and the chief so much.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Hehe, it's my duty to help you feel at home in the village. \nI'll be counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, it's my duty to help you feel at home in the village. \nI'll be counting on you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Hornwort</color> you asked for.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Oh... thank you, but I need <color=#1DFEAF>5 Stalks</color> to make the medicine. This isn't quite enough.
Array.indonesia: Oh... thank you, but I need <color=#1DFEAF>5 Stalks</color> to make the medicine. This isn't quite enough.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Ah... I must have misread the amount.\nI'll go get more.
Array.indonesia: Ah... I must have misread the amount.\nI'll go get more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Um... I was mistaken.\nI haven't gotten it yet.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Um... I was mistaken.\nI haven't gotten it yet.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_05_UzmeRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>I haven't found it yet...\nI'll keep looking a bit longer.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I haven't found it yet...\nI'll keep looking a bit longer.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaHideNSeek_Option001
Array.english: Alright
Array.indonesia: Alright

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaHideNSeek_Option002
Array.english: Not right now
Array.indonesia: Not right now

Array.name: JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_Title
Array.english: Hide-and-seek
Array.indonesia: Hide-and-seek

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRepeat_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you mean the <color=#F1DC2B>Hide-and-Seek</color> we didn't finish last time?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, you mean the <color=#F1DC2B>Hide-and-Seek</color> we didn't finish last time?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRepeat_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's play hide-and-seek together.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's play hide-and-seek together.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRepeat_003
Array.english: Hehe. You're not scared of my stealth skills again, are you?
Array.indonesia: Hehe. You're not scared of my stealth skills again, are you?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRepeat_004
Array.english: <size=33>Wanna play hide-and-seek again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wanna play hide-and-seek again?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_001
Array.english: Hehe. You couldn't find us last time.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. You couldn't find us last time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_002
Array.english: I was just hidden too well... Maybe I should've gone easy on you.
Array.indonesia: I was just hidden too well... Maybe I should've gone easy on you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_003
Array.english: We won! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: We won! Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_004
Array.english: Wanna play hide-and-seek with us again?
Array.indonesia: Wanna play hide-and-seek with us again?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_005
Array.english: The rules are the same!\nWe'll hide in the village, and if you find us, you win.
Array.indonesia: The rules are the same!\nWe'll hide in the village, and if you find us, you win.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaRetry_006
Array.english: Just close your eyes and open them when I count to three. Got it?
Array.indonesia: Just close your eyes and open them when I count to three. Got it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Mister, mister! Have you ever played <color=#F1DC2B>Hide-and-Seek</color> before?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Mister, mister! Have you ever played <color=#F1DC2B>Hide-and-Seek</color> before?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_002
Array.english: Huh? Yeah, I used to play it a lot with my friends when I was a kid.
Array.indonesia: Huh? Yeah, I used to play it a lot with my friends when I was a kid.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>Wow. Then please play with us.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow. Then please play with us.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_004
Array.english: Wanna play <color=#F1DC2B>Hide-and-Seek</color> with us?
Array.indonesia: Wanna play <color=#F1DC2B>Hide-and-Seek</color> with us?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_005
Array.english: If you find all three of us... we'll give you our precious treasure!
Array.indonesia: If you find all three of us... we'll give you our precious treasure!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_006
Array.english: Oh... treasure, huh? That sounds pretty tempting.
Array.indonesia: Oh... treasure, huh? That sounds pretty tempting.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>Wait!? You're really giving that away?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wait!? You're really giving that away?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_008
Array.english: Hehe. We know this village inside out.\nNo way he'll find us that easily!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. We know this village inside out.\nNo way he'll find us that easily!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaStart_009
Array.english: <size=32>Please play with us, mister.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Please play with us, mister.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaAsk_001
Array.english: <size=33>So, wanna play hide-and-seek?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>So, wanna play hide-and-seek?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaYes_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe! Alright!\nYou won't find us that easily!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe! Alright!\nYou won't find us that easily!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaYes_002
Array.english: <size=32>We're really good at hiding behind trees or in the bushes, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>We're really good at hiding behind trees or in the bushes, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaYes_003
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... this sounds fun.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow... this sounds fun.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaYes_004
Array.english: <size=32>No peeking! Okay, let's start!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>No peeking! Okay, let's start!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaCount_001
Array.english: <size=38>One... two... three!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>One... two... three!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaNo_001
Array.english: Aww... giving up already because you think you can't find us?
Array.indonesia: Aww... giving up already because you think you can't find us?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaNo_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! I'll make it easier for you.\nDon't worry too much!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! I'll make it easier for you.\nDon't worry too much!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaNo_003
Array.english: Aww... come play with us.
Array.indonesia: Aww... come play with us.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaNo_004
Array.english: Come talk to me when you're ready! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Come talk to me when you're ready! Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaFind_001
Array.english: <size=34>So this is where you were. Found you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>So this is where you were. Found you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaFind_002
Array.english: <size=34>Tsk, you got me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tsk, you got me!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_EkaFind_003
Array.english: <size=32>You're pretty good, huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You're pretty good, huh?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_SaniahFind_001
Array.english: <size=34>There you are!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>There you are!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_SaniahFind_002
Array.english: Huh...? But I hid so well...! You're really good, mister.
Array.indonesia: Huh...? But I hid so well...! You're really good, mister.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_BimaFind_001
Array.english: <size=34>Found it! So this is where it was!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Found it! So this is where it was!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_BimaFind_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ah...! How did you see through my perfect camouflage?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah...! How did you see through my perfect camouflage?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_BimaFind_003
Array.english: You've got incredible eyes, mister.\nI admit it.
Array.indonesia: You've got incredible eyes, mister.\nI admit it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_001
Array.english: <size=33>You found all three of us!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You found all three of us!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_002
Array.english: Guess I underestimated you... oops.
Array.indonesia: Guess I underestimated you... oops.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_003
Array.english: <size=32>That was fun!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That was fun!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_004
Array.english: Hehe. Don't underestimate my eyes, trained underwater.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Don't underestimate my eyes, trained underwater.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. I'll keep my promise!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. I'll keep my promise!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_006
Array.english: Here, this is... a <color=#F1DC2B>Red Sunang Stone</color> I found by the lake!
Array.indonesia: Here, this is... a <color=#F1DC2B>Red Sunang Stone</color> I found by the lake!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_007
Array.english: <size=34>I've been hiding it in secret... but I'll give it to you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I've been hiding it in secret... but I'll give it to you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_008
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... thanks!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_009
Array.english: I can use this ore to make my weapons stronger.\nI'll make good use of it!
Array.indonesia: I can use this ore to make my weapons stronger.\nI'll make good use of it!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_010
Array.english: So it's not just a regular gem?\nEven better if it helps!
Array.indonesia: So it's not just a regular gem?\nEven better if it helps!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_06_AllFind_011
Array.english: <size=32>Alright then, let's play again next time I find something cool!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright then, let's play again next time I find something cool!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! You're gonna get me some <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>?\nAbout 5 pieces should do.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! You're gonna get me some <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>?\nAbout 5 pieces should do.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=32>I'll carve you a nice animal sculpture in return... so please help me out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll carve you a nice animal sculpture in return... so please help me out.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Retry_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... what should I do?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... what should I do?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'm almost out of <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'm almost out of <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_002
Array.english: Hello?
Array.indonesia: Hello?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_003
Array.english: <size=35>Yikes!! I'm sorry!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Yikes!! I'm sorry!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_004
Array.english: ...Ah... oh, it's you.\nYou startled me.
Array.indonesia: ...Ah... oh, it's you.\nYou startled me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_005
Array.english: Oh, sorry... You looked lost in thought.
Array.indonesia: Oh, sorry... You looked lost in thought.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_006
Array.english: Ah... well... I've been secretly carving sculptures to make a bit of pocket money without my wife knowing...
Array.indonesia: Ah... well... I've been secretly carving sculptures to make a bit of pocket money without my wife knowing...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_007
Array.english: But I've run out of the <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color> I use for carving.
Array.indonesia: But I've run out of the <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color> I use for carving.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_008
Array.english: I could probably find some near the lake... but I'm worried my wife will question me if she sees me there.
Array.indonesia: I could probably find some near the lake... but I'm worried my wife will question me if she sees me there.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_009
Array.english: Ah... I saw you going into the lake before...
Array.indonesia: Ah... I saw you going into the lake before...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_010
Array.english: Could you maybe get me about 5 pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>?
Array.indonesia: Could you maybe get me about 5 pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_011
Array.english: I'll carve you a nice animal block as thanks...\nPretty please?
Array.indonesia: I'll carve you a nice animal block as thanks...\nPretty please?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_012
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... what should I do? I hope I don't get scolded too.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... what should I do? I hope I don't get scolded too.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Option01
Array.english: Got it
Array.indonesia: Got it

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Option02
Array.english: I don't think I can do it
Array.indonesia: I don't think I can do it

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Yes_001
Array.english: Got it. So I just need to bring you some <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color> from the lake, right?
Array.indonesia: Got it. So I just need to bring you some <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color> from the lake, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Yes_002
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! Yes! Thank you!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! Yes! Thank you!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_Yes_003
Array.english: Then I'm counting on you...\nAnd if anyone asks, don't say I sent you...
Array.indonesia: Then I'm counting on you...\nAnd if anyone asks, don't say I sent you...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_No_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'm afraid I can't...\nI think I'd get in trouble too.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'm afraid I can't...\nI think I'd get in trouble too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_No_002
Array.english: Hmm... that's a problem...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... that's a problem...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangStart_No_003
Array.english: If you change your mind, let me know!\nI really need it...
Array.indonesia: If you change your mind, let me know!\nI really need it...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... did you bring me <color=#F1DC2B>5 Driftwood</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... did you bring me <color=#F1DC2B>5 Driftwood</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got it
Array.indonesia: I got it

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_001
Array.english: Yes. Here are 5 pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>.
Array.indonesia: Yes. Here are 5 pieces of <color=#F1DC2B>Driftwood</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! Nice...!\nThese are good quality.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh...! Nice...!\nThese are good quality.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_003
Array.english: Hehe... I'll use these to carve more animal blocks and make some pocket money.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... I'll use these to carve more animal blocks and make some pocket money.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Reward_001
Array.english: Oh, right.\nI promised to make one and give it to you, didn't I?
Array.indonesia: Oh, right.\nI promised to make one and give it to you, didn't I?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Reward_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hey, which do you like better, dogs or cats?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hey, which do you like better, dogs or cats?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Option01
Array.english: A loyal dog
Array.indonesia: A loyal dog

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Option02
Array.english: A cute cat
Array.indonesia: A cute cat

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Dog_001
Array.english: Haha! They say people who like dogs are more outgoing than cat people.
Array.indonesia: Haha! They say people who like dogs are more outgoing than cat people.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Dog_002
Array.english: Let's hang out and play Animal Block Stacking sometime!
Array.indonesia: Let's hang out and play Animal Block Stacking sometime!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Dog_003
Array.english: Hold on a sec.\nI'll carve it right away.
Array.indonesia: Hold on a sec.\nI'll carve it right away.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_001
Array.english: Oh... they say people who like cats are more sensitive than dog people.
Array.indonesia: Oh... they say people who like cats are more sensitive than dog people.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_002
Array.english: You don't quite look the type, though.
Array.indonesia: You don't quite look the type, though.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_003
Array.english: <size=33>What's that supposed to mean...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What's that supposed to mean...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_004
Array.english: Haha! Just kidding.\nThey say cat lovers are sensitive... guess it's true.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Just kidding.\nThey say cat lovers are sensitive... guess it's true.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished01_Cat_005
Array.english: Alright, give me a second.\nI'll have it ready in no time.
Array.indonesia: Alright, give me a second.\nI'll have it ready in no time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Here you go! What do you think?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Here you go! What do you think?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh...! It feels kinda different?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh...! It feels kinda different?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_003
Array.english: I think I've seen something like this in a famous vampire game...
Array.indonesia: I think I've seen something like this in a famous vampire game...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_004
Array.english: Hehe... yeah, I played it on my friend's console when he came from the city, and it was really fun.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... yeah, I played it on my friend's console when he came from the city, and it was really fun.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_005
Array.english: I thought of the animals from that game when I made this.
Array.indonesia: I thought of the animals from that game when I made this.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_006
Array.english: <size=32>That's awesome. Thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That's awesome. Thanks!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_Finished02_007
Array.english: <size=32>Use it for our animal block stacking matches, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Use it for our animal block stacking matches, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Here you go.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... I need 5...\nbut this isn't quite enough.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I need 5...\nbut this isn't quite enough.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Oh, you're right.\nI'll go find some more.
Array.indonesia: Oh, you're right.\nI'll go find some more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, I don't have it. I must've been mistaken.\nI'll come back once I get it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I don't have it. I must've been mistaken.\nI'll come back once I get it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_07_GesangRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>I haven't gotten it yet. I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I haven't gotten it yet. I'll keep looking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_001
Array.english: Oh, outsider! Um...
Array.indonesia: Oh, outsider! Um...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_002
Array.english: Yes? Go ahead.
Array.indonesia: Yes? Go ahead.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>I heard there are fish in the lake that kiss each other. \nIs that true?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I heard there are fish in the lake that kiss each other. \nIs that true?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_004
Array.english: Oh, you mean <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gouramis</color>. They're interesting fish, the way they press their lips together.
Array.indonesia: Oh, you mean <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gouramis</color>. They're interesting fish, the way they press their lips together.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_005
Array.english: <size=34>Oh~ that's so romantic<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nFish that kiss...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh~ that's so romantic<color=#ff61e3>♥</color>\nFish that kiss...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_006
Array.english: <size=33>Um... could you catch some of those fish for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Um... could you catch some of those fish for me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_007
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? But if I catch them... they won't be able to kiss anymore...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Huh? But if I catch them... they won't be able to kiss anymore...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_008
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm... then could you catch them alive for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm... then could you catch them alive for me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_009
Array.english: I want to write about them... but I think I need to see them for myself to feel inspired.
Array.indonesia: I want to write about them... but I think I need to see them for myself to feel inspired.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_010
Array.english: Hmm... alive, huh...\nI'll do my best.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... alive, huh...\nI'll do my best.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahStart_011
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! Thank you! Then please bring me a living <color=#1DFEAF>Pair</color>... \nI'm counting on you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! Thank you! Then please bring me a living <color=#1DFEAF>Pair</color>... \nI'm counting on you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, did you manage to catch a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, did you manage to catch a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Here you go
Array.indonesia: Here you go

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_000
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, did you manage to catch a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, did you manage to catch a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here's a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s.
Array.indonesia: Here's a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! They're such cute fish! I'll put them in the tank right away and watch them kiss!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! They're such cute fish! I'll put them in the tank right away and watch them kiss!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: In the murky lake our time together stood still the warmth of your tiny lips...
Array.indonesia: In the murky lake our time together stood still the warmth of your tiny lips...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: In the silent water your faint heartbeat reaches me through your lips...
Array.indonesia: In the silent water your faint heartbeat reaches me through your lips...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Hehe, it just came to me, so I said it out loud.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, it just came to me, so I said it out loud.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Wow, that was a beautiful poem.\nYou've got real talent!
Array.indonesia: Wow, that was a beautiful poem.\nYou've got real talent!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: But I heard when Kissing Gouramis "kiss," it's actually a territorial fight.
Array.indonesia: But I heard when Kissing Gouramis "kiss," it's actually a territorial fight.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... did you have to say that...?\nYou just ruined the mood.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... did you have to say that...?\nYou just ruined the mood.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: Anyway, thanks.\nHere, take this as a small gift from me.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, thanks.\nHere, take this as a small gift from me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you are.
Array.indonesia: Here you are.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Oh... um... this is just one... I need a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s.
Array.indonesia: Oh... um... this is just one... I need a pair of <color=#F1DC2B>Kissing Gourami</color>s.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: <size=33>You're right. I got the number wrong.\nI'll look for more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You're right. I got the number wrong.\nI'll look for more.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... I must have mistaken it for something else. I'll look again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... I must have mistaken it for something else. I'll look again.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_08_KinahRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Not yet.\nI think I need a bit more time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Not yet.\nI think I need a bit more time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_001
Array.english: Excuse me... young traveler.
Array.indonesia: Excuse me... young traveler.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_002
Array.english: Yes? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Yes? What is it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_003
Array.english: If it's not too much trouble... could you do this old woman a small favor?
Array.indonesia: If it's not too much trouble... could you do this old woman a small favor?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_004
Array.english: There's a flower called the <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primrose</color> that only blooms at night... but my eyesight isn't what it used to be, so it's hard for me to go out after dark.
Array.indonesia: There's a flower called the <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primrose</color> that only blooms at night... but my eyesight isn't what it used to be, so it's hard for me to go out after dark.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_005
Array.english: Of course, I'll pick some if I come across them.\nWhat color are they?
Array.indonesia: Of course, I'll pick some if I come across them.\nWhat color are they?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_006
Array.english: Thank you. There are two types of evening primroses, pink and yellow... If you don't mind, I'd be grateful if you could bring me <color=#1DFEAF>three of each</color>.
Array.indonesia: Thank you. There are two types of evening primroses, pink and yellow... If you don't mind, I'd be grateful if you could bring me <color=#1DFEAF>three of each</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanStart_007
Array.english: Got it. I'll look for the <color=#F1DC2B>Pink and Yellow Evening Primroses</color>.
Array.indonesia: Got it. I'll look for the <color=#F1DC2B>Pink and Yellow Evening Primroses</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanDelivery_001
Array.english: Oh... you brought me <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primroses</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh... you brought me <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primroses</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: I got them

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Yes. Here are the <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primroses</color> I gathered for you.
Array.indonesia: Yes. Here are the <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primroses</color> I gathered for you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Oh my... they're truly beautiful... I've never been able to see them bloom like this during the day...
Array.indonesia: Oh my... they're truly beautiful... I've never been able to see them bloom like this during the day...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Thanks to you, young man, I can finally see them this way. Thank you.
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you, young man, I can finally see them this way. Thank you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Hehe, it's nothing. Just let me know if you need anything else.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, it's nothing. Just let me know if you need anything else.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primroses</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Evening Primroses</color> you asked for.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english:
I asked for <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> pink and <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> yellow evening primroses,
but it seems you're a bit short...
Array.indonesia:
I asked for <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> pink and <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> yellow evening primroses,
but it seems you're a bit short...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Ah... I must have written it down wrong.\nI'll go find more.
Array.indonesia: Ah... I must have written it down wrong.\nI'll go find more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Ah... I misunderstood.\nI haven't gathered them yet.
Array.indonesia: Ah... I misunderstood.\nI haven't gathered them yet.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanGiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: I'll keep looking.
Array.indonesia: I'll keep looking.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_09_MeilanRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: I think I need a bit more time... I'll come back once I have them.
Array.indonesia: I think I need a bit more time... I'll come back once I have them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh no... what should I do...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh no... what should I do...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_002
Array.english: Hmm? What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? What's wrong?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_003
Array.english: Ah... I was doing the dishes and stepped away for a moment when I heard the kids...
Array.indonesia: Ah... I was doing the dishes and stepped away for a moment when I heard the kids...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_004
Array.english: And a few of my dishes got swept away by the current...
Array.indonesia: And a few of my dishes got swept away by the current...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_005
Array.english: Luckily, I found most of them... but I can't find my favorite <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color>...
Array.indonesia: Luckily, I found most of them... but I can't find my favorite <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_006
Array.english: My mother gave it to me as a wedding gift...
Array.indonesia: My mother gave it to me as a wedding gift...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_007
Array.english: I see...
Array.indonesia: I see...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_008
Array.english: <size=32>If it fell into the lake, I can look for it next time I go in.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If it fell into the lake, I can look for it next time I go in.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_009
Array.english: Oh, really? I heard you're a good swimmer, so I was thinking of asking you...
Array.indonesia: Oh, really? I heard you're a good swimmer, so I was thinking of asking you...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_010
Array.english: Thank you so much for offering first.
Array.indonesia: Thank you so much for offering first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaStart_011
Array.english: <size=32>Don't worry! I'm sure I can find it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Don't worry! I'm sure I can find it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaFindPlate_001
Array.english: Hmm? That plate looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color> Omila mentioned...
Array.indonesia: Hmm? That plate looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color> Omila mentioned...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaFindPlate_002
Array.english: <size=34>I should take it with me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I should take it with me!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaDelivery_001
Array.english: Did you... manage to find the <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color>?
Array.indonesia: Did you... manage to find the <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I brought it
Array.indonesia: I brought it

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Could this be the <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color> you mentioned?
Array.indonesia: Could this be the <color=#F1DC2B>Floral Plate</color> you mentioned?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh my! You really found it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh my! You really found it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Thank you so much...\nI don't know how to repay you.
Array.indonesia: Thank you so much...\nI don't know how to repay you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Oh, now that I think about it, you're grilling skewers at your shop, right?
Array.indonesia: Oh, now that I think about it, you're grilling skewers at your shop, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Yeah. It's a bit of a hassle, with all the smoke and how long it takes.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. It's a bit of a hassle, with all the smoke and how long it takes.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Hehe, why don't you try using this <color=#F1DC2B>Fan</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hehe, why don't you try using this <color=#F1DC2B>Fan</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: I used to use it when cooking for the kids...\nFanning the flames helps things cook faster.
Array.indonesia: I used to use it when cooking for the kids...\nFanning the flames helps things cook faster.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... this would be perfect for grilling skewers!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... this would be perfect for grilling skewers!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: <size=35>I'll put it to good use. Thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I'll put it to good use. Thanks!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, my mistake. I'll look for it again.
Array.indonesia: Oh, my mistake. I'll look for it again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_10_OmilaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Not yet...\nI'll keep looking a bit longer.
Array.indonesia: Not yet...\nI'll keep looking a bit longer.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_001
Array.english: Ah, um... by any chance...
Array.indonesia: Ah, um... by any chance...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_002
Array.english: What is it?
Array.indonesia: What is it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_003
Array.english: If you have a moment, could you do me a favor?
Array.indonesia: If you have a moment, could you do me a favor?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_004
Array.english: Of course. Go ahead.
Array.indonesia: Of course. Go ahead.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_005
Array.english: My son, <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color>, spends all day playing his instrument...\nand his meals are completely irregular.
Array.indonesia: My son, <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color>, spends all day playing his instrument...\nand his meals are completely irregular.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_006
Array.english: A while ago, he got mouth sores and could barely speak...
Array.indonesia: A while ago, he got mouth sores and could barely speak...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_007
Array.english: So I want to at least give him some fruit...\nbut he gets irritated if I interrupt his practice.
Array.indonesia: So I want to at least give him some fruit...\nbut he gets irritated if I interrupt his practice.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_008
Array.english: It's a delicate age.
Array.indonesia: It's a delicate age.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_009
Array.english: <size=33>Fortunately, he absolutely loves a fruit called <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Fortunately, he absolutely loves a fruit called <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_010
Array.english: He says it's the perfect fruit for a future star like himself, or something like that...
Array.indonesia: He says it's the perfect fruit for a future star like himself, or something like that...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_011
Array.english: <size=32>The problem is, I've run out of the ones I saved…\nso I'm sorry to ask, but could you get some for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The problem is, I've run out of the ones I saved…\nso I'm sorry to ask, but could you get some for me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_012
Array.english: Alright, got it.\nWhere can I find them?
Array.indonesia: Alright, got it.\nWhere can I find them?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_013
Array.english: Ah, they grow near the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah, they grow near the <color=#1DFEAF>Lake Beach</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_014
Array.english: Oh, you mean where that dinosaur carcass washed ashore.
Array.indonesia: Oh, you mean where that dinosaur carcass washed ashore.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_015
Array.english: Alright. I'll see what I can find!
Array.indonesia: Alright. I'll see what I can find!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaStart_016
Array.english: Thank you...\nIn that case, could I ask for about <color=#1DFEAF>4</color>?
Array.indonesia: Thank you...\nIn that case, could I ask for about <color=#1DFEAF>4</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=32>Did you... manage to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Did you... manage to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, here you go
Array.indonesia: Yes, here you go

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Not yet

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_001
Array.english: Here are the <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruits</color>.
Array.indonesia: Here are the <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruits</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... you really brought them...\nYou must be busy... thank you so much...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... you really brought them...\nYou must be busy... thank you so much...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_003
Array.english: ...I'm sorry to keep asking for favors...
Array.indonesia: ...I'm sorry to keep asking for favors...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_004
Array.english: Jaka gets a bit embarrassed when his mother gives him things...
Array.indonesia: Jaka gets a bit embarrassed when his mother gives him things...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_005
Array.english: Could you please give these to <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> for me...?
Array.indonesia: Could you please give these to <color=#F1DC2B>Jaka</color> for me...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_006
Array.english: It's no trouble at all.\nLeave it to me.
Array.indonesia: It's no trouble at all.\nLeave it to me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem01_007
Array.english: Thank you. Please wait just a moment.\nLet me slice them so they're easier to eat.
Array.indonesia: Thank you. Please wait just a moment.\nLet me slice them so they're easier to eat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Here, please give him this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Here, please give him this.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... they really are star-shaped, huh?\nThat's amazing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... they really are star-shaped, huh?\nThat's amazing.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_003
Array.english: Hehe, he's still just a kid, thinking eating star-shaped fruit will make him a star.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, he's still just a kid, thinking eating star-shaped fruit will make him a star.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_004
Array.english: I see. I'll make sure he gets them, so don't worry too much, Cinta.
Array.indonesia: I see. I'll make sure he gets them, so don't worry too much, Cinta.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem02_005
Array.english: Thank you...
Array.indonesia: Thank you...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, my mistake. I'll look for it again.
Array.indonesia: Oh, my mistake. I'll look for it again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_CintaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Not yet...\nI'll keep looking a bit longer.
Array.indonesia: Not yet...\nI'll keep looking a bit longer.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_001
Array.english: Drifting away~ more and more each day~♪\nLike a binturong wandering the forest~♪
Array.indonesia: Drifting away~ more and more each day~♪\nLike a binturong wandering the forest~♪

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_002
Array.english: Uh...
Array.indonesia: Uh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_003
Array.english: Ahh... interrupting me again... \nI was just getting to the best part...
Array.indonesia: Ahh... interrupting me again... \nI was just getting to the best part...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_004
Array.english: Ah... sorry.\nBut I have something for you.
Array.indonesia: Ah... sorry.\nBut I have something for you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_005
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? What is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hm? What is it?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_006
Array.english: <size=33>Here... your mom asked me to bring you <color=#FF73C3>Starfruit</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Here... your mom asked me to bring you <color=#FF73C3>Starfruit</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_007
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh...! My favorite...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh...! My favorite...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_008
Array.english: Ahem... just leave it there. I'll eat it when I feel like it.
Array.indonesia: Ahem... just leave it there. I'll eat it when I feel like it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_009
Array.english: Okay. Make sure you thank your mom later.
Array.indonesia: Okay. Make sure you thank your mom later.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGift_010
Array.english: <size=33>I-I'll do it when I feel like it!\nRespect my freedom!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I-I'll do it when I feel like it!\nRespect my freedom!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGiftComplete_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I should tell her Jaka liked it to put her mind at ease.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(I should tell her Jaka liked it to put her mind at ease.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_JakaGetGiftComplete_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Let's go tell <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Let's go tell <color=#F1DC2B>Cinta</color>.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_001
Array.english: I just gave Jaka the <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>.
Array.indonesia: I just gave Jaka the <color=#F1DC2B>Starfruit</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... thank you.\nDid Jaka like it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... thank you.\nDid Jaka like it?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_003
Array.english: Yeah. He clearly liked it, just tried to hide it.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. He clearly liked it, just tried to hide it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_004
Array.english: I told him to thank his mother.
Array.indonesia: I told him to thank his mother.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_005
Array.english: Hehe... I can't picture him actually doing that.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... I can't picture him actually doing that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_006
Array.english: Anyway, thank you for taking care of such a troublesome request.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, thank you for taking care of such a troublesome request.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_007
Array.english: This is just a small token of my appreciation...\nplease take it.
Array.indonesia: This is just a small token of my appreciation...\nplease take it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_11_GoBackCinta_008
Array.english: Oh... it was nothing, really.\nI'll make good use of it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... it was nothing, really.\nI'll make good use of it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_001
Array.english: Geez... where am I supposed to get that...
Array.indonesia: Geez... where am I supposed to get that...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, outsider! Think you can help me out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, outsider! Think you can help me out?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_003
Array.english: Wh-what's going on?
Array.indonesia: Wh-what's going on?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_004
Array.english: Well... I went to the village nearby a while back and lost at gambling...
Array.indonesia: Well... I went to the village nearby a while back and lost at gambling...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_005
Array.english: I pretended to be drunk and slipped out.
Array.indonesia: I pretended to be drunk and slipped out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_006
Array.english: But now those guys from that village are suddenly coming over...
Array.indonesia: But now those guys from that village are suddenly coming over...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_007
Array.english: I need to pay off the debt... but I don't have anything on me right now...
Array.indonesia: I need to pay off the debt... but I don't have anything on me right now...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_008
Array.english: Guess it's fate we ran into each other. Help me out, pal...
Array.indonesia: Guess it's fate we ran into each other. Help me out, pal...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_009
Array.english: Hmm... what do you need?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... what do you need?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_010
Array.english: First, I need something valuable...\nOh, right! Could you grab some <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color> from the lake?
Array.indonesia: First, I need something valuable...\nOh, right! Could you grab some <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color> from the lake?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_011
Array.english: I heard it's highly valued over there.
Array.indonesia: I heard it's highly valued over there.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_012
Array.english: Isn't amber made from tree resin? Why would it be in the lake?
Array.indonesia: Isn't amber made from tree resin? Why would it be in the lake?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_013
Array.english: You might've heard, this area used to be land in ancient times.
Array.indonesia: You might've heard, this area used to be land in ancient times.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_014
Array.english: Then the water level rose and everything got submerged.\nThe amber's probably from back then.
Array.indonesia: Then the water level rose and everything got submerged.\nThe amber's probably from back then.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_015
Array.english: Then it must be pretty valuable. Alright, I'll keep an eye out.
Array.indonesia: Then it must be pretty valuable. Alright, I'll keep an eye out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_016
Array.english: Hehe... thanks a lot.\nYou're saving my life here.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... thanks a lot.\nYou're saving my life here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_017
Array.english: ...Oh, I did the math, and I'll need about <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> to pay it off. \nI'm counting on you.
Array.indonesia: ...Oh, I did the math, and I'll need about <color=#1DFEAF>3</color> to pay it off. \nI'm counting on you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaStart_018
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(What a hopeless guy...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(What a hopeless guy...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, hey! Did you get the <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, hey! Did you get the <color=#F1DC2B>Amber</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I brought it
Array.indonesia: I brought it

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here are the 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Here are the 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color> you asked for.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh! That's exactly it!\nNice work, thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh! That's exactly it!\nNice work, thanks!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hey, Harta! Got the Doni ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hey, Harta! Got the Doni ready?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_002
Array.english: Good grief... can't believe you don't trust me.\nThese three <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color> should be more than enough.
Array.indonesia: Good grief... can't believe you don't trust me.\nThese three <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color> should be more than enough.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_003
Array.english: Ha! This covers the debt, but...
Array.indonesia: Ha! This covers the debt, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_004
Array.english: <size=35>You still owe interest, don't you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>You still owe interest, don't you?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_005
Array.english: What? It's only been three days and you're already talking interest? That's too much.
Array.indonesia: What? It's only been three days and you're already talking interest? That's too much.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_006
Array.english: If you don't have the money, just hand over some of this stuff. Like these animal blocks... and those liquor bottles...
Array.indonesia: If you don't have the money, just hand over some of this stuff. Like these animal blocks... and those liquor bottles...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_007
Array.english: <size=32>That's unreasonable!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That's unreasonable!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_008
Array.english: <size=33>What's this? Who's this guy that looks like a coconut liquor bottle?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What's this? Who's this guy that looks like a coconut liquor bottle?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_009
Array.english: <size=34>If you're that upset, how about a game? Win, and I'll let it slide.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>If you're that upset, how about a game? Win, and I'll let it slide.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_010
Array.english: <size=32>It's simple. Just find the cup with the amber under it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's simple. Just find the cup with the amber under it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_011
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Huh? Isn't this the same game I played in the Sea People Village...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Huh? Isn't this the same game I played in the Sea People Village...?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_012
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! Let's do it.\nIf I win, you'll clear Harta's debt, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright! Let's do it.\nIf I win, you'll clear Harta's debt, right?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_013
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, you've got guts! Let's see what you've got.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, you've got guts! Let's see what you've got.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_1st lose_001
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! That one doesn't count, just a warm-up!\nNow let's do it for real!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! That one doesn't count, just a warm-up!\nNow let's do it for real!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_1st_001
Array.english: <size=32>Tch, not bad...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Tch, not bad...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_1st_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hey hey! Move over, Nagzu.\nI'm good at this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hey hey! Move over, Nagzu.\nI'm good at this.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_1st_003
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, that's right! Kiyu.\nGo on, show them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, that's right! Kiyu.\nGo on, show them.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_2nd_lose_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh dear... did I mix them too fast...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh dear... did I mix them too fast...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_2nd_lose_002
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like I went a bit too easy on a beginner, hehe.\nI'll give you another chance.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Looks like I went a bit too easy on a beginner, hehe.\nI'll give you another chance.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ooh! Outsider! Nice job!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ooh! Outsider! Nice job!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... you're pretty good...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... you're pretty good...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_003
Array.english: <size=35>Tsk... that's enough Kiyu, Nagzu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tsk... that's enough Kiyu, Nagzu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_004
Array.english: <size=32>We'll call it here, Harta.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>We'll call it here, Harta.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_005
Array.english: <size=32>I'll count today's fun as payment.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll count today's fun as payment.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_006
Array.english: <size=33>Next time, pay up on time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Next time, pay up on time!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_2nd_007
Array.english: <size=32>Or win!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Or win!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, outsider! Nice job!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, outsider! Nice job!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_002
Array.english: <size=32>Ah... I really underestimated you...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah... I really underestimated you...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well... a deal's a deal... I'll just take this amber. I'll waive the interest.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well... a deal's a deal... I'll just take this amber. I'll waive the interest.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Creditor_win_004
Array.english: <size=33>Next time, play fair and square!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Next time, play fair and square!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished02_001
Array.english: Phew... that took years off my life.
Array.indonesia: Phew... that took years off my life.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished02_002
Array.english: Don't make bets like that again...
Array.indonesia: Don't make bets like that again...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished02_003
Array.english: Haha! I was a bit tipsy that day...!
Array.indonesia: Haha! I was a bit tipsy that day...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_Finished02_004
Array.english: Anyway, thanks outsider. Here, take this as a small token of my gratitude.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, thanks outsider. Here, take this as a small token of my gratitude.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Here you go.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... didn't I say I needed 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... didn't I say I needed 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Ambers</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: I'll need more.
Array.indonesia: I'll need more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, my mistake. I'll look again.
Array.indonesia: Oh, my mistake. I'll look again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_12_HartaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: Not yet... I'll look a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Not yet... I'll look a bit more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>No... where on earth is he going at this hour...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>No... where on earth is he going at this hour...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_002
Array.english: What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: What's wrong?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_003
Array.english: Well... my husband Gesang keeps sneaking off somewhere every night.
Array.indonesia: Well... my husband Gesang keeps sneaking off somewhere every night.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_004
Array.english: I'm worried... what if he's seeing another woman behind my back...? Oh... no... it couldn't be... that girl Lipah...?
Array.indonesia: I'm worried... what if he's seeing another woman behind my back...? Oh... no... it couldn't be... that girl Lipah...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_005
Array.english: Hmm. Have you tried asking him directly?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Have you tried asking him directly?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>If I ask, he'll get scared and stop! Then I'll never find out the real reason!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If I ask, he'll get scared and stop! Then I'll never find out the real reason!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_007
Array.english: He seemed pretty close with Harta...\nMaybe Harta knows something?
Array.indonesia: He seemed pretty close with Harta...\nMaybe Harta knows something?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_008
Array.english: That's possible.\nBut he wouldn't tell me even if I asked.
Array.indonesia: That's possible.\nBut he wouldn't tell me even if I asked.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_009
Array.english: The other day, it was raining and he ran off without even folding the laundry, so I went looking for him and found him making a bet with Harta!
Array.indonesia: The other day, it was raining and he ran off without even folding the laundry, so I went looking for him and found him making a bet with Harta!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_010
Array.english: I dragged him straight back... but Harta was furious since he was about to win.
Array.indonesia: I dragged him straight back... but Harta was furious since he was about to win.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_011
Array.english: <size=33>Right, you should ask Harta for me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Right, you should ask Harta for me.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_012
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh? Me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_013
Array.english: <size=31>Yes. I saw you two playing that Animal Block Stacking together, so you must be close...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Yes. I saw you two playing that Animal Block Stacking together, so you must be close...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_014
Array.english: <size=33>Just ask him casually!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Just ask him casually!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_015
Array.english: Ugh... I really don't want to get dragged into this...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... I really don't want to get dragged into this...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_ChandraStart_016
Array.english: ...Alright, fine. I'll ask him.
Array.indonesia: ...Alright, fine. I'll ask him.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_001
Array.english: Do you... happen to know where Gesang goes at night?
Array.indonesia: Do you... happen to know where Gesang goes at night?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did Chandra put you up to this...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, did Chandra put you up to this...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_003
Array.english: Yeah... I don't like getting mixed up in other people's business either... but she was pretty intense about it.
Array.indonesia: Yeah... I don't like getting mixed up in other people's business either... but she was pretty intense about it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_004
Array.english: <size=34>I really don't know...!\nI swear I'm not covering for him...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I really don't know...!\nI swear I'm not covering for him...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_005
Array.english: <size=34>...You know something, don't you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...You know something, don't you?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_006
Array.english: No... well... we made a bet the other day...
Array.indonesia: No... well... we made a bet the other day...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_007
Array.english: <size=32>...and I lost. By a hair, I tell ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...and I lost. By a hair, I tell ya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_008
Array.english: But I didn't have any Doni left, so instead...\nI gave him a <color=#F1DC2B>Cell Phone</color> I found in the forest...
Array.indonesia: But I didn't have any Doni left, so instead...\nI gave him a <color=#F1DC2B>Cell Phone</color> I found in the forest...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_009
Array.english: <size=33>Ever since then, he hasn't asked me to bet at all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ever since then, he hasn't asked me to bet at all.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_010
Array.english: <size=33>Come to think of it...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Come to think of it...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_011
Array.english: <size=32>I think I saw him running toward <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> at night recently!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I think I saw him running toward <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> at night recently!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_012
Array.english: <size=34>Looked like something exciting was going on... I called out to him a few times from behind, but he didn't even turn around!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Looked like something exciting was going on... I called out to him a few times from behind, but he didn't even turn around!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_013
Array.english: Hmm. I see.\nI'll have to check out <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> at night.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I see.\nI'll have to check out <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color> at night.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_014
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, but don't tell Chandra...\nCould you go check it out yourself?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, but don't tell Chandra...\nCould you go check it out yourself?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_015
Array.english: If Chandra goes, things will get complicated...\nYou should go and persuade him to come home.
Array.indonesia: If Chandra goes, things will get complicated...\nYou should go and persuade him to come home.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideHartaTalk_016
Array.english: You're probably right.\nAlright. I'll go alone.
Array.indonesia: You're probably right.\nAlright. I'll go alone.
