Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFoundGesang_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Oh... Gesang's over there.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Oh... Gesang's over there.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFoundGesang_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like he's on his phone...\nI should go talk to him.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Looks like he's on his phone...\nI should go talk to him.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFoundGesang_Barricade
Array.english: I should see what Gesang's up to.
Array.indonesia: I should see what Gesang's up to.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_001
Array.english: Gesang... what are you doing out here this late?
Array.indonesia: Gesang... what are you doing out here this late?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_002
Array.english: <size=35>Aaaah!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Aaaah!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_003
Array.english: ...Oh, it's you. I thought...
Array.indonesia: ...Oh, it's you. I thought...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_004
Array.english: Chandra's looking for you. She says you've been sneaking out every night...
Array.indonesia: Chandra's looking for you. She says you've been sneaking out every night...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_005
Array.english: I think you should head back before she gets really mad.
Array.indonesia: I think you should head back before she gets really mad.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_006
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... that old hag...!!\nTrying to interrupt my time with Mita...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... that old hag...!!\nTrying to interrupt my time with Mita...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_007
Array.english: <size=32>Mita... never yells at me...\nalways... just gives me a warm smile... hehe...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mita... never yells at me...\nalways... just gives me a warm smile... hehe...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_008
Array.english: <size=34>She's nothing like that mean wife of mine!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>She's nothing like that mean wife of mine!!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_009
Array.english: Hmm... you don't look like you're in your right mind...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... you don't look like you're in your right mind...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideGesangMad_010
Array.english: This isn't good...\nI should go get Chandra.
Array.indonesia: This isn't good...\nI should go get Chandra.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wait! Who do you think you are, trying to take my man away all of a sudden!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wait! Who do you think you are, trying to take my man away all of a sudden!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_002
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa... who are you?!\nWhere did you come from...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa... who are you?!\nWhere did you come from...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_003
Array.english: <size=32>I'm <color=#E36462>Mita</color>.\nAnd I won't let you take Gesang away from me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm <color=#E36462>Mita</color>.\nAnd I won't let you take Gesang away from me.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_004
Array.english: <size=34>Gesang has someone waiting for him! And you don't even exist in the real world.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Gesang has someone waiting for him! And you don't even exist in the real world.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_005
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... then I'll just take Gesang to my world.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... then I'll just take Gesang to my world.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideMitaAppear_006
Array.english: <size=34>Come on, Gesang! Let's go to my world together! We can be together forever...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Come on, Gesang! Let's go to my world together! We can be together forever...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFollowMita_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...!? They both got sucked into the phone...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa...!? They both got sucked into the phone...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFollowMita_002
Array.english: <size=32>At this rate, Gesang won't make it back...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>At this rate, Gesang won't make it back...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_MisideFollowMita_003
Array.english: <size=34>This looks dangerous, but...\nI have to follow them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This looks dangerous, but...\nI have to follow them.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...? Where am I...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoa...? Where am I...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_002
Array.english: Dave...? What are you doing here?
Array.indonesia: Dave...? What are you doing here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_003
Array.english: <size=33><color=#E36462>You promised to play a game with me, <color=#E36462>Mita</color>.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#E36462>You promised to play a game with me, <color=#E36462>Mita</color>.</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_004
Array.english: Huh...? What are you talking about...?
Array.indonesia: Huh...? What are you talking about...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_005
Array.english: Hah... so you don't remember...
Array.indonesia: Hah... so you don't remember...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_006
Array.english: See this <color=#F1DC2B>Timer</color> in the middle?
Array.indonesia: See this <color=#F1DC2B>Timer</color> in the middle?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_007
Array.english: It's a game where we see who hits the <color=#F1DC2B>Timer</color> first when it reaches 0!
Array.indonesia: It's a game where we see who hits the <color=#F1DC2B>Timer</color> first when it reaches 0!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_008
Array.english: If you miss the timing... or press it when a skull appears...
Array.indonesia: If you miss the timing... or press it when a skull appears...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_009
Array.english: <size=33>You just smash their head with this hammer next to me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You just smash their head with this hammer next to me!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_010
Array.english: <size=34>Smash their head with a hammer...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Smash their head with a hammer...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_011
Array.english: It's fine.\nYou'll get used to it as we play.
Array.indonesia: It's fine.\nYou'll get used to it as we play.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Start_012
Array.english: <size=34>First to win 3 rounds takes it!\nLet's begin!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>First to win 3 rounds takes it!\nLet's begin!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame01_Retry_001
Array.english: Hmm... need a moment to adjust?\nYou can try again.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... need a moment to adjust?\nYou can try again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>Heh... you beat <color=#E36462>Mita</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Heh... you beat <color=#E36462>Mita</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>...Did you really want to take Gesang away from me that badly?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Did you really want to take Gesang away from me that badly?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_003
Array.english: <size=35>Ugh...!! Where am I...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ugh...!! Where am I...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! Gesang's coming to...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Gesang's coming to...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_005
Array.english: <size=32>Alright... then...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright... then...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_006
Array.english: <size=33>If I activate that device over there, he'll get pulled back to reality!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If I activate that device over there, he'll get pulled back to reality!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Start_007
Array.english: <size=34>Hmph... there's no way you can solve it.\nBut go ahead and try!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmph... there's no way you can solve it.\nBut go ahead and try!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame02_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ahaha! See? I told you it wouldn't work!\nGo on, try again... it'll be the same.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ahaha! See? I told you it wouldn't work!\nGo on, try again... it'll be the same.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa...?! Where am I?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa...?! Where am I?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, you're awake Gesang.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, you're awake Gesang.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_003
Array.english: We're... inside the phone you won in that bet...
Array.indonesia: We're... inside the phone you won in that bet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_004
Array.english: A girl named <color=#E36462>Mita</color>... I think she trapped you in here.
Array.indonesia: A girl named <color=#E36462>Mita</color>... I think she trapped you in here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_005
Array.english: <size=32>Mi... Mita? That's the girl from the game on this phone, right...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Mi... Mita? That's the girl from the game on this phone, right...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_006
Array.english: <size=33>...She was so cute, I couldn't stop playing for days... hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...She was so cute, I couldn't stop playing for days... hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>Ge...sang... stay... here with me... forever...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ge...sang... stay... here with me... forever...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_008
Array.english: <size=34>Aaaah...!? Mita...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aaaah...!? Mita...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_009
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like some kind of system failure...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Looks like some kind of system failure...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_010
Array.english: <size=33>There's a car over there.\nIf we want out, now's our chance! Get in!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>There's a car over there.\nIf we want out, now's our chance! Get in!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_011
Array.english: <size=35>I won't let you... escape...\nI'll trap you here forever...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I won't let you... escape...\nI'll trap you here forever...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Start_012
Array.english: What is going on...?
Array.indonesia: What is going on...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>...Gesang... is... mine... forever...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Gesang... is... mine... forever...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! I destroyed Mita's core!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright! I destroyed Mita's core!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MiniGame03_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=35>Ugh...! No...!\nDon't... leave me... behind...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ugh...! No...!\nDon't... leave me... behind...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_001
Array.english: Phew... finally back to reality.
Array.indonesia: Phew... finally back to reality.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_002
Array.english: What just happened...? All I did was play a game on that phone I got from Harta...
Array.indonesia: What just happened...? All I did was play a game on that phone I got from Harta...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_003
Array.english: ...You'd be in real trouble if Chandra hadn't sent me looking for you.
Array.indonesia: ...You'd be in real trouble if Chandra hadn't sent me looking for you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_004
Array.english: <size=34>W-Wait, my wife sent you?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>W-Wait, my wife sent you?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Oh no... I'm dead...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh no... I'm dead...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_006
Array.english: Um...
Array.indonesia: Um...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_007
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...?! M-Mita...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa...?! M-Mita...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_008
Array.english: Yes... that's my name...\nBut where am I?
Array.indonesia: Yes... that's my name...\nBut where am I?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_009
Array.english: Hmm...? You don't remember anything?
Array.indonesia: Hmm...? You don't remember anything?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_010
Array.english: No... there are many versions of Mita...\nI think you met a different one.
Array.indonesia: No... there are many versions of Mita...\nI think you met a different one.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_011
Array.english: Hmm... if that's true, I can't really blame you...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... if that's true, I can't really blame you...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_012
Array.english: I'm overwhelmed too, suddenly ending up here...\nAnd I don't know how to get back yet.
Array.indonesia: I'm overwhelmed too, suddenly ending up here...\nAnd I don't know how to get back yet.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_013
Array.english: Um... would it be alright if I stayed in this village for a while?
Array.indonesia: Um... would it be alright if I stayed in this village for a while?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_014
Array.english: Well, it's not really up to me... but staying near the beach should be fine.
Array.indonesia: Well, it's not really up to me... but staying near the beach should be fine.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_015
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! Thank you!!\nIs there anything I can help with?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! Thank you!!\nIs there anything I can help with?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_016
Array.english: <size=32>I can't just sit around doing nothing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I can't just sit around doing nothing!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_017
Array.english: Oh, this guy and his friend run a restaurant.\nLooks like they could use an extra hand.
Array.indonesia: Oh, this guy and his friend run a restaurant.\nLooks like they could use an extra hand.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_018
Array.english: <size=32>How about helping out at the restaurant?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>How about helping out at the restaurant?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_019
Array.english: <size=32>Sounds great! I'm actually pretty good at cooking and serving!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sounds great! I'm actually pretty good at cooking and serving!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_020
Array.english: Hmm... alright. That works.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... alright. That works.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete01_021
Array.english: <size=32>Come by the restaurant in the evening!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Come by the restaurant in the evening!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=33>That aside...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That aside...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete02_002
Array.english: <size=33>...I should go talk to Chandra, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...I should go talk to Chandra, right?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Hiiiieee!! Help me...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hiiiieee!! Help me...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_001
Array.english: <size=33>...What did you say...?\nYou went to some strange world?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...What did you say...?\nYou went to some strange world?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_002
Array.english: <size=35>If you're going to defend him, at least make it believable!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>If you're going to defend him, at least make it believable!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_003
Array.english: But it's true...
Array.indonesia: But it's true...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_004
Array.english: I can't believe that's the best excuse you could come up with... You're both pathetic.
Array.indonesia: I can't believe that's the best excuse you could come up with... You're both pathetic.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_005
Array.english: Honey, you're on dish duty for the rest of the month,\ngot it?!
Array.indonesia: Honey, you're on dish duty for the rest of the month,\ngot it?!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_006
Array.english: *Sigh*... Alright... I must've been possessed or something...
Array.indonesia: *Sigh*... Alright... I must've been possessed or something...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_007
Array.english: Mita suddenly started saying sweet things...
Array.indonesia: Mita suddenly started saying sweet things...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_008
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! Maybe we shouldn't get into that...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! Maybe we shouldn't get into that...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_009
Array.english: <size=35>What was that just now...? Mi...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>What was that just now...? Mi...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_010
Array.english: Oh, I meant Harta!\nHe said Harta tricked him...!
Array.indonesia: Oh, I meant Harta!\nHe said Harta tricked him...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_011
Array.english: Hmm... Alright.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Alright.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_012
Array.english: Anyway, thanks for bringing him back.\nI'll deal with him myself.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, thanks for bringing him back.\nI'll deal with him myself.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_13_Miside_MissionComplete03_013
Array.english: <size=35>...*Sniffle*...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...*Sniffle*...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_001
Array.english: In the flowing waterfall~ I let my sorrow drift away~♪
Array.indonesia: In the flowing waterfall~ I let my sorrow drift away~♪

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_002
Array.english: Does the flying hornbill~ understand my heart~♪
Array.indonesia: Does the flying hornbill~ understand my heart~♪

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_003
Array.english: The blue sky...\n...Oh!
Array.indonesia: The blue sky...\n...Oh!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_004
Array.english: Ah... my pick snapped...\nGuess I got a little too into it.
Array.indonesia: Ah... my pick snapped...\nGuess I got a little too into it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_005
Array.english: That was great, though... shame about the pick.
Array.indonesia: That was great, though... shame about the pick.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_006
Array.english: Oh, mister outsider... Could you get me a <color=#F1DC2B>Black Piranha Tooth</color> from the lake?
Array.indonesia: Oh, mister outsider... Could you get me a <color=#F1DC2B>Black Piranha Tooth</color> from the lake?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_007
Array.english: It's harder than the red-bellied piranha tooth I'm using now.
Array.indonesia: It's harder than the red-bellied piranha tooth I'm using now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaStart_008
Array.english: Just one will do. Before this idea slips away...\nplease hurry.
Array.indonesia: Just one will do. Before this idea slips away...\nplease hurry.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did you get the <color=#F1DC2B>Black Piranha Tooth</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, did you get the <color=#F1DC2B>Black Piranha Tooth</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yeah, I got it
Array.indonesia: Yeah, I got it

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet
Array.indonesia: Not yet

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: <size=32>Here, I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Black Piranha Tooth</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Here, I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Black Piranha Tooth</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Ooh... this sharpness... this hardness... it's a work of art.
Array.indonesia: Ooh... this sharpness... this hardness... it's a work of art.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Thank you, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Thank you, hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=32>This is a <color=#F1DC2B>CD Player</color> I got from Rimbo. Take it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>This is a <color=#F1DC2B>CD Player</color> I got from Rimbo. Take it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: Oh... are you sure? \nShouldn't you keep it for listening to music?
Array.indonesia: Oh... are you sure? \nShouldn't you keep it for listening to music?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: ...Who even listens to music on CDs anymore?\nEveryone streams it now.
Array.indonesia: ...Who even listens to music on CDs anymore?\nEveryone streams it now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: <size=33><color=#FF73C3>CDs</color> are just for collecting these days.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#FF73C3>CDs</color> are just for collecting these days.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: Uh... right.\nAnyway, thanks. I'll make good use of it.
Array.indonesia: Uh... right.\nAnyway, thanks. I'll make good use of it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah... my mistake.\nI haven't gotten it yet.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah... my mistake.\nI haven't gotten it yet.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_14_JacaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Not yet. I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Not yet. I'll keep looking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hey, mister! That restaurant you opened there…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hey, mister! That restaurant you opened there…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_002
Array.english:
<size=34>The fishy smell is dreadful…
isn't that a bit inconsiderate of you?!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=34>The fishy smell is dreadful…
isn't that a bit inconsiderate of you?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_003
Array.english:
Ah… I'm so sorry. 
I'll be a little more careful with how I store them.
Array.indonesia:
Ah… I'm so sorry. 
I'll be a little more careful with how I store them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_004
Array.english: <size=32>I'm already feeling dizzy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'm already feeling dizzy.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_005
Array.english: <size=33>This fishy smell has completely killed my appetite.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This fishy smell has completely killed my appetite.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_006
Array.english: So, why don't you…
Array.indonesia: So, why don't you…

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_007
Array.english: <size=34>Go get me some <color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnuts</color> from the lake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Go get me some <color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnuts</color> from the lake.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_008
Array.english: <size=34>They're the best for stimulating your appetite.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>They're the best for stimulating your appetite.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_009
Array.english:
Since you're the one who ruined mine...
you should at least do that much.
Array.indonesia:
Since you're the one who ruined mine...
you should at least do that much.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_010
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>5</color> should be enough. They probably grow on the far right side of the lake.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>5</color> should be enough. They probably grow on the far right side of the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaStart_011
Array.english: Ugh... fine.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... fine.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnuts</color>... did you get them?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnuts</color>... did you get them?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: I got them

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: <size=33>This is it, right? <color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnut</color>. It was hidden somewhere I almost missed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This is it, right? <color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnut</color>. It was hidden somewhere I almost missed.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=35>Oh...! That's exactly it!\nJust looking at it makes me hungry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh...! That's exactly it!\nJust looking at it makes me hungry!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Why on earth would anyone eat smelly fish, when you can make plenty of delicious dishes with just vegetables and meat?
Array.indonesia: Why on earth would anyone eat smelly fish, when you can make plenty of delicious dishes with just vegetables and meat?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: For my skin's sake, I shall have chicken breast topped with blanched water chestnuts tonight.
Array.indonesia: For my skin's sake, I shall have chicken breast topped with blanched water chestnuts tonight.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english:
Well… I suppose I must thank you for what you brought.
But from now on, do be a little more careful about the smell of fish.
Array.indonesia:
Well… I suppose I must thank you for what you brought.
But from now on, do be a little more careful about the smell of fish.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here, I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnuts</color>.
Array.indonesia: Here, I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Water Chestnuts</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haah... I said <color=#1DFEAF>5</color>, didn't I...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haah... I said <color=#1DFEAF>5</color>, didn't I...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Yeah, I'm a bit short...\nI'll go find more.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, I'm a bit short...\nI'll go find more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... I must've mistaken it for something else.\nI'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... I must've mistaken it for something else.\nI'll keep looking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_15_BonitaRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Not yet. I'll search a bit more.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Not yet. I'll search a bit more.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_001
Array.english: I've heard people in the city are always in a rush,\nbusy all the time.
Array.indonesia: I've heard people in the city are always in a rush,\nbusy all the time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_002
Array.english: Hmm... not always, but yeah, it does tend to be like that.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... not always, but yeah, it does tend to be like that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_003
Array.english: Living a full, busy day is nice, but... sometimes, if you slow down and look around, you notice new things.
Array.indonesia: Living a full, busy day is nice, but... sometimes, if you slow down and look around, you notice new things.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_004
Array.english: ...I'd like to write a poem about that.\nIs there anything I could use as inspiration?
Array.indonesia: ...I'd like to write a poem about that.\nIs there anything I could use as inspiration?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_005
Array.english: Hmm... if we're talking about something slow...\nmaybe a <color=#F1DC2B>Snail</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... if we're talking about something slow...\nmaybe a <color=#F1DC2B>Snail</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>Wow! That's a great idea! Watching a snail move slowly might really inspire me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow! That's a great idea! Watching a snail move slowly might really inspire me!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_007
Array.english: But <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> only come out when it rains... If I try to write while watching them, my notebook will get soaked.
Array.indonesia: But <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> only come out when it rains... If I try to write while watching them, my notebook will get soaked.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_008
Array.english: Sorry to ask out of nowhere, but... \ncould you catch three <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> for me?
Array.indonesia: Sorry to ask out of nowhere, but... \ncould you catch three <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> for me?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_009
Array.english: Well, they're not dangerous...\nI'll grab some if I see them.
Array.indonesia: Well, they're not dangerous...\nI'll grab some if I see them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_010
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, thank you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahStart_011
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> only appear when it rains. You should be able to find them in grassy areas.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> only appear when it rains. You should be able to find them in grassy areas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahDelivery_001
Array.english: Oh, did you bring me the <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, did you bring me the <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, I got them
Array.indonesia: Yes, I got them

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here are the three <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> you asked for.
Array.indonesia: Here are the three <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color> you asked for.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: They're so slimy.\nThe container's covered in mucus.
Array.indonesia: They're so slimy.\nThe container's covered in mucus.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: Hehe, I suppose it can't be helped if they want to crawl on grass and trees.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, I suppose it can't be helped if they want to crawl on grass and trees.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Watching them move so slowly is already inspiring me again. Hmm...
Array.indonesia: Watching them move so slowly is already inspiring me again. Hmm...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: O brave snails... walking across dewy blades of grass, untouched by the world's pace...
Array.indonesia: O brave snails... walking across dewy blades of grass, untouched by the world's pace...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Not even minding each other's steps, your composure is steady and upright, just like your shells.
Array.indonesia: Not even minding each other's steps, your composure is steady and upright, just like your shells.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: ...I just said it as it came to me, so it might sound a bit awkward, hehe.
Array.indonesia: ...I just said it as it came to me, so it might sound a bit awkward, hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: Not at all. It was really good! Coming up with a poem like that on the spot is amazing!
Array.indonesia: Not at all. It was really good! Coming up with a poem like that on the spot is amazing!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: Now that I think about it, I read a book about snails once.
Array.indonesia: Now that I think about it, I read a book about snails once.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_010
Array.english: Wow, I'm curious.\nWhat was it about?
Array.indonesia: Wow, I'm curious.\nWhat was it about?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_011
Array.english: Well... there was this student who only came to school on rainy days... and then a snail shell suddenly started growing on his back.
Array.indonesia: Well... there was this student who only came to school on rainy days... and then a snail shell suddenly started growing on his back.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_012
Array.english: Then he turned into a real snail... and his friends started turning into snails too... that's the story.
Array.indonesia: Then he turned into a real snail... and his friends started turning into snails too... that's the story.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_013
Array.english: Hmm... yeah. I don't think that's really my kind of story.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... yeah. I don't think that's really my kind of story.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_014
Array.english: Anyway, thank you! I got some great inspiration.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, thank you! I got some great inspiration.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_Finished_015
Array.english:
This is just a small token of my thanks.
It's a beautiful coral I found on the beach.
Array.indonesia:
This is just a small token of my thanks.
It's a beautiful coral I found on the beach.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here, I brought you the <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color>.
Array.indonesia: Here, I brought you the <color=#F1DC2B>Snails</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... this isn't quite enough. I think I need at least three for inspiration.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... this isn't quite enough. I think I need at least three for inspiration.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: <size=32>Please find a few more!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Please find a few more!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh... I got it wrong.\nI'll look again.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I got it wrong.\nI'll look again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_17_KinahRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: I haven't got them ready yet. I'll keep looking a bit longer.
Array.indonesia: I haven't got them ready yet. I'll keep looking a bit longer.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... this is bad...\nI'm gonna get in trouble...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... this is bad...\nI'm gonna get in trouble...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_002
Array.english: What's wrong?
Array.indonesia: What's wrong?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>My wife's birthday is coming up, and I have no idea what to get her!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>My wife's birthday is coming up, and I have no idea what to get her!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_004
Array.english: Hmm. Maybe some jewelry or accessories?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Maybe some jewelry or accessories?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_005
Array.english: She'd probably like that, but... where am I supposed to find something like that on short notice?
Array.indonesia: She'd probably like that, but... where am I supposed to find something like that on short notice?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_006
Array.english: <size=34>Oh!! Wait, I just remembered. There are <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color> in the lake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh!! Wait, I just remembered. There are <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color> in the lake!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_007
Array.english: I gave her one I won from Basu in a bet once.\nShe loved it.
Array.indonesia: I gave her one I won from Basu in a bet once.\nShe loved it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_008
Array.english: <size=33>Hey... I heard you're pretty good at diving... Could you get me some <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color> from the lake?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hey... I heard you're pretty good at diving... Could you get me some <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color> from the lake?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_009
Array.english: <size=32>I think I could make something if I had about <color=#1DFEAF>3</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I think I could make something if I had about <color=#1DFEAF>3</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_010
Array.english: <size=32>Think of it as saving a man's life...\nPlease!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Think of it as saving a man's life...\nPlease!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_011
Array.english: Come to think of it, yeah, there are pearls in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, yeah, there are pearls in the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangStart_012
Array.english: Alright. I'll bring some back if I find any.
Array.indonesia: Alright. I'll bring some back if I find any.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... did you bring me some <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... did you bring me some <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangDelivery_Option01
Array.english: I got them
Array.indonesia: I got them

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Here, I got you 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color>.
Array.indonesia: Here, I got you 3 <color=#F1DC2B>Freshwater Pearls</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... thank you!! This should do it, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... thank you!! This should do it, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: When my wife gets mad, it lasts a whole month...\nIt's terrifying...
Array.indonesia: When my wife gets mad, it lasts a whole month...\nIt's terrifying...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe. It's not much, but here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe. It's not much, but here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Here you go.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... I need three...\nbut this isn't quite enough.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I need three...\nbut this isn't quite enough.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_NeedMore_003
Array.english: Ah, you're right.\nI'll go find more.
Array.indonesia: Ah, you're right.\nI'll go find more.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, I don't have it. Must've been mistaken.\nI'll come back when I get it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I don't have it. Must've been mistaken.\nI'll come back when I get it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_18_GesangRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haven't found them yet. I'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haven't found them yet. I'll keep looking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... my shoulder's killing me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... my shoulder's killing me...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_002
Array.english: What's wrong, Jepun?
Array.indonesia: What's wrong, Jepun?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_003
Array.english: The chief asked me to plant some <color=#F1DC2B>Mangoes</color>...\nbut there's not enough space in the field.
Array.indonesia: The chief asked me to plant some <color=#F1DC2B>Mangoes</color>...\nbut there's not enough space in the field.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_004
Array.english: I could clear some room by cutting down a coconut tree…\nbut if a coconut hits my head, I'm done for.
Array.indonesia: I could clear some room by cutting down a coconut tree…\nbut if a coconut hits my head, I'm done for.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_005
Array.english: So I've been picking the coconuts first.\nDid it all day and now my shoulder's killing me.
Array.indonesia: So I've been picking the coconuts first.\nDid it all day and now my shoulder's killing me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>Wish someone would give me a hand...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wish someone would give me a hand...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_option01
Array.english: I'll help you
Array.indonesia: I'll help you

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_option02
Array.english: Sorry, can't right now
Array.indonesia: Sorry, can't right now

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_001
Array.english: <size=32>Want me to give you a hand?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Want me to give you a hand?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_002
Array.english: <size=34>You?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_003
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! No outsider helps for nothing!\nWhat's your angle?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! No outsider helps for nothing!\nWhat's your angle?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_004
Array.english: Those coconuts from your farm helped me make some great drinks for my customers.
Array.indonesia: Those coconuts from your farm helped me make some great drinks for my customers.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_005
Array.english: <size=34>So I want to return the favor!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>So I want to return the favor!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... not sure I buy that...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... not sure I buy that...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_007
Array.english: <size=34>Fine... go knock a few down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Fine... go knock a few down!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_008
Array.english: <size=32>Use this <color=#1DFEAF>Long Pole</color> to smack the coconuts a few times and they'll drop.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Use this <color=#1DFEAF>Long Pole</color> to smack the coconuts a few times and they'll drop.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_009
Array.english: But it'll hurt if one lands on you.
Array.indonesia: But it'll hurt if one lands on you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_Yes_010
Array.english: <size=35>So watch it and dodge!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>So watch it and dodge!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_No_001
Array.english: <size=34>Tsk! Useless when it actually matters!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tsk! Useless when it actually matters!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_No_002
Array.english: <size=32>I heard they've been using my coconuts well at the shop...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I heard they've been using my coconuts well at the shop...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunStart_No_003
Array.english: <size=33>If you want to pay me back, I'll give you another shot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If you want to pay me back, I'll give you another shot!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunRetry_001
Array.english: Hmm... wish someone would help me gather coconuts...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... wish someone would help me gather coconuts...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_JepunMinigame_EasySuccess_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! Better than I expected!\nGo on, try the next tree!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! Better than I expected!\nGo on, try the next tree!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... already got them all?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... already got them all?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_002
Array.english: Hmm... this should be enough to plant a <color=#F1DC2B>Mango</color> tree.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... this should be enough to plant a <color=#F1DC2B>Mango</color> tree.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_003
Array.english: The soil here is special, so anything you plant grows fast.
Array.indonesia: The soil here is special, so anything you plant grows fast.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_004
Array.english: I should be able to harvest the <color=#F1DC2B>Mangoes</color> soon and send them to your shop.
Array.indonesia: I should be able to harvest the <color=#F1DC2B>Mangoes</color> soon and send them to your shop.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_005
Array.english: Wow... that fast?
Array.indonesia: Wow... that fast?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_JepunEnd_006
Array.english: <size=32>I'll send them over in the evening, so go wait at the shop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll send them over in the evening, so go wait at the shop!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_001
Array.english: A sharp-looking farmer came by and gave me some <color=#F1DC2B>Mangoes</color>.
Array.indonesia: A sharp-looking farmer came by and gave me some <color=#F1DC2B>Mangoes</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_002
Array.english: <size=33>Wow, they really do grow fast!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow, they really do grow fast!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_003
Array.english: He gave them to me, but what should I make with them?
Array.indonesia: He gave them to me, but what should I make with them?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_004
Array.english: Hmm. I've only been serving coconut juice so far.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I've only been serving coconut juice so far.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_005
Array.english: <size=32>How about we try a <color=#F1DC2B>Mango Shake</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>How about we try a <color=#F1DC2B>Mango Shake</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_006
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_007
Array.english: <size=34>...Just thinking about it sounds delicious...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Just thinking about it sounds delicious...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_008
Array.english: I'll get the equipment ready. \nI'm sure customers will start ordering right away.
Array.indonesia: I'll get the equipment ready. \nI'm sure customers will start ordering right away.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_19_AfterJepun_009
Array.english: <size=33>Got it! I bet they'll love it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Got it! I bet they'll love it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_001
Array.english: Ever seen a <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color>?
Array.indonesia: Ever seen a <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01
Array.english: Of course
Array.indonesia: Of course

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02
Array.english: What kind of fish was that again...
Array.indonesia: What kind of fish was that again...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_001
Array.english: <size=33>Of course. It's that giant freshwater catfish, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Of course. It's that giant freshwater catfish, right?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_002
Array.english: I heard its mouth is big enough to swallow a person.
Array.indonesia: I heard its mouth is big enough to swallow a person.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_003
Array.english: <size=33>Why do you ask?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Why do you ask?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_004
Array.english: Ah... I just love catfish dishes. \nBeen wantin' to catch one real bad...
Array.indonesia: Ah... I just love catfish dishes. \nBeen wantin' to catch one real bad...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_005
Array.english: But there's no way I can catch it with a fishing rod.
Array.indonesia: But there's no way I can catch it with a fishing rod.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_006
Array.english: Even if I hook one, it's so strong it just snaps everything.
Array.indonesia: Even if I hook one, it's so strong it just snaps everything.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_007
Array.english:
If you run into a <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> while diving,
could ya bring me some of its meat?
Array.indonesia:
If you run into a <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> while diving,
could ya bring me some of its meat?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_008
Array.english: I heard it's way more vicious than the Walking Catfish you asked for before...?
Array.indonesia: I heard it's way more vicious than the Walking Catfish you asked for before...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_009
Array.english: I know, but... please, I'm beggin' ya.\nI'll make it up to ya, I swear.
Array.indonesia: I know, but... please, I'm beggin' ya.\nI'll make it up to ya, I swear.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option01Answer_010
Array.english: Hmm... alright.\nBut I'll need to be well-equipped.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... alright.\nBut I'll need to be well-equipped.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I think I've seen one... but I'm not sure.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... I think I've seen one... but I'm not sure.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_002
Array.english: <size=34>Haha, can't believe ya don't know that big, nasty fella... Guess jungle fish ain't your thing, huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha, can't believe ya don't know that big, nasty fella... Guess jungle fish ain't your thing, huh?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_003
Array.english: <size=32>N-No, I do!\nJust mixed up the name for a second.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>N-No, I do!\nJust mixed up the name for a second.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_004
Array.english: Anyway... I love catfish dishes, so I really wanna catch one...
Array.indonesia: Anyway... I love catfish dishes, so I really wanna catch one...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_005
Array.english: <size=33>But there's no way I can catch it with a fishing rod.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But there's no way I can catch it with a fishing rod.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_006
Array.english: Even if I hook one, it's so strong it just snaps the line.
Array.indonesia: Even if I hook one, it's so strong it just snaps the line.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_007
Array.english:
If you run into a <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> while diving,
could ya bring me some of its meat?
Array.indonesia:
If you run into a <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> while diving,
could ya bring me some of its meat?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_008
Array.english: <size=32>Didn't you just say it's huge and dangerous?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Didn't you just say it's huge and dangerous?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_009
Array.english: <size=33>...Haha! With your skills, you'll be just fine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Haha! With your skills, you'll be just fine!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_010
Array.english: I'll make it worth your while, so please help me out.
Array.indonesia: I'll make it worth your while, so please help me out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanStart_option02Answer_011
Array.english: Hmm... alright.\nBut I'll need to be well-equipped.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... alright.\nBut I'll need to be well-equipped.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanDelivery_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, did ya manage to get some <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> meat?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, did ya manage to get some <color=#FF73C3>Piraiba Catfish</color> meat?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Here you go
Array.indonesia: Here you go

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: Ugh... that thing was insanely aggressive.\nIt nearly swallowed me whole.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... that thing was insanely aggressive.\nIt nearly swallowed me whole.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: <size=32>Still... I managed to get some meat.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Still... I managed to get some meat.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Thank ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Thank ya!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english: Believe it or not, catfish meat's real tender with a nice bite.
Array.indonesia: Believe it or not, catfish meat's real tender with a nice bite.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_005
Array.english: <size=33>If I make some <color=#FF73C3>Steamed Piraiba Catfish</color> with this, it'll be pure heaven!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If I make some <color=#FF73C3>Steamed Piraiba Catfish</color> with this, it'll be pure heaven!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_006
Array.english: Oh right, since ya helped me out, I should give ya somethin' in return.
Array.indonesia: Oh right, since ya helped me out, I should give ya somethin' in return.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_007
Array.english: No matter how good ya are, diving at night's still dangerous.
Array.indonesia: No matter how good ya are, diving at night's still dangerous.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_008
Array.english: <size=33>Here, take this <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Rod</color>. It'll make catchin' fish easier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Here, take this <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Rod</color>. It'll make catchin' fish easier.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_009
Array.english: <size=33>Oh... now that you mention it, it's been forever since I went <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh... now that you mention it, it's been forever since I went <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_010
Array.english: You're right, the lake's dangerous, so it'd be safer to <color=#F1DC2B>Fish</color> too!
Array.indonesia: You're right, the lake's dangerous, so it'd be safer to <color=#F1DC2B>Fish</color> too!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_011
Array.english: Hehe, plenty of spots to <color=#F1DC2B>Fish</color> besides the lake!
Array.indonesia: Hehe, plenty of spots to <color=#F1DC2B>Fish</color> besides the lake!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_012
Array.english: <size=33>You might even hook something you won't find in the lake, so keep your eyes peeled.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You might even hook something you won't find in the lake, so keep your eyes peeled.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_013
Array.english: Oh, and if ya wanna catch tougher fish...\nyou'll need a better <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Rod</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Bait</color>...
Array.indonesia: Oh, and if ya wanna catch tougher fish...\nyou'll need a better <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Rod</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Bait</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_014
Array.english: I can set ya up later if ya bring some Doni.\nTakes a bit of work to make 'em.
Array.indonesia: I can set ya up later if ya bring some Doni.\nTakes a bit of work to make 'em.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_Finished_015
Array.english: <size=32>The spot in front of my place is perfect for fishin', so use it anytime!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The spot in front of my place is perfect for fishin', so use it anytime!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_NeedMore_001
Array.english: Here you go.
Array.indonesia: Here you go.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_NeedMore_002
Array.english: Hmm... this ain't quite enough. Come back when you've got the full amount.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... this ain't quite enough. Come back when you've got the full amount.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oops, my mistake.\nHaven't caught it yet.
Array.indonesia: Oops, my mistake.\nHaven't caught it yet.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanGiveItem_NoItem_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should write it down properly so I don't mess it up again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should write it down properly so I don't mess it up again.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_20_FishermanRefuseGiveItem_001
Array.english: <size=32>Not yet...\nI'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Not yet...\nI'll keep looking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_001
Array.english: Hmm... but I'd need some wood to make it...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... but I'd need some wood to make it...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_002
Array.english: Is something wrong?
Array.indonesia: Is something wrong?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_003
Array.english: Oh, Dave. It's just... Saniah's been really into this character lately...
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. It's just... Saniah's been really into this character lately...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_004
Array.english: I want to make her a toy of it... but metal feels a bit unsafe.
Array.indonesia: I want to make her a toy of it... but metal feels a bit unsafe.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_005
Array.english: I see. What character is it?
Array.indonesia: I see. What character is it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_006
Array.english: It's from a game Bima showed her...\ncalled <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color>, I think.
Array.indonesia: It's from a game Bima showed her...\ncalled <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color>, I think.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_007
Array.english: Oh, you mean from <color=#1DFEAF>Terraria</color>, right? \nThose Slime Town Pets are adorable!
Array.indonesia: Oh, you mean from <color=#1DFEAF>Terraria</color>, right? \nThose Slime Town Pets are adorable!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_008
Array.english: Though they're pretty rare...
Array.indonesia: Though they're pretty rare...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_009
Array.english: I see. Saniah really loves that one.
Array.indonesia: I see. Saniah really loves that one.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_010
Array.english: She says the arrow stuck in its head is hilarious...\nStrange taste, huh?
Array.indonesia: She says the arrow stuck in its head is hilarious...\nStrange taste, huh?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_011
Array.english: If I want to make it out of wood…\nI'd probably have to ask <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>...
Array.indonesia: If I want to make it out of wood…\nI'd probably have to ask <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_012
Array.english: But I can't leave the furnace right now...\nCould you ask him if he has any wood?
Array.indonesia: But I can't leave the furnace right now...\nCould you ask him if he has any wood?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PerakStart_013
Array.english: Sure. No problem. I'll ask him.
Array.indonesia: Sure. No problem. I'll ask him.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_001
Array.english: Do you know any wood that's good for making a toy for Saniah?
Array.indonesia: Do you know any wood that's good for making a toy for Saniah?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_002
Array.english: Hmm? For a kid like Saniah, something smooth and light would be best.
Array.indonesia: Hmm? For a kid like Saniah, something smooth and light would be best.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_003
Array.english: The wood around here tends to be pretty rough...
Array.indonesia: The wood around here tends to be pretty rough...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_004
Array.english: There's a tree in the forest called the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Tree</color>... It's tough to cut, but very light. Perfect for kids' toys!!
Array.indonesia: There's a tree in the forest called the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Tree</color>... It's tough to cut, but very light. Perfect for kids' toys!!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_005
Array.english: A <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Tree</color>?\nWhat does it look like...?
Array.indonesia: A <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Tree</color>?\nWhat does it look like...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_006
Array.english: Hmm... hold on... I'll sketch it for you.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... hold on... I'll sketch it for you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_007
Array.english: It looks like this...\nI'll mark the location on your map!
Array.indonesia: It looks like this...\nI'll mark the location on your map!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_008
Array.english: Got it. I'll go take a look.
Array.indonesia: Got it. I'll go take a look.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_009
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, wait! This tree is really tough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, wait! This tree is really tough.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_010
Array.english: It won't be easy to chop down... You'll probably need something like a <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Axe</color>.
Array.indonesia: It won't be easy to chop down... You'll probably need something like a <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Axe</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_NoGoldAxe_001
Array.english: Hmm... my current axe won't cut it. I'll need to gather materials and ask Perak for help.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... my current axe won't cut it. I'll need to gather materials and ask Perak for help.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AskPeneb_YesGoldAxe_001
Array.english: <size=32>Then I can use the axe I have now!\nI'll go find it in the forest!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Then I can use the axe I have now!\nI'll go find it in the forest!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_FindTree_001
Array.english: Hmm. This must be the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Tree</color> Peneb mentioned...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. This must be the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Tree</color> Peneb mentioned...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_FindTree_NoGoldAxe_001
Array.english: Just like he said, it's incredibly sturdy...\nI'll need something like a <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Axe</color>...
Array.indonesia: Just like he said, it's incredibly sturdy...\nI'll need something like a <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Axe</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_FindTree_NoGoldAxe_002
Array.english: I should gather some <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Ore</color> and ask Perak for help.
Array.indonesia: I should gather some <color=#F1DC2B>Black Iron Ore</color> and ask Perak for help.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_FindTree_YesGoldAxe_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright. Let's give this a swing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright. Let's give this a swing!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AfterCutTree_001
Array.english: Phew... this thing's solid.
Array.indonesia: Phew... this thing's solid.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_AfterCutTree_002
Array.english: But the grain's so smooth.\nPerfect for making toys.
Array.indonesia: But the grain's so smooth.\nPerfect for making toys.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? Did those bushes just move...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hm? Did those bushes just move...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa...?! That's a giant toad...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa...?! That's a giant toad...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Looks like the noise from chopping the tree ticked it off... It's really angry.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Looks like the noise from chopping the tree ticked it off... It's really angry.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_003
Array.english: Looks like we'll have to defeat it to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>...
Array.indonesia: Looks like we'll have to defeat it to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_004
Array.english: Looks that way...
Array.indonesia: Looks that way...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear02_005
Array.english: <size=33>It's definitely poisonous. Be careful!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It's definitely poisonous. Be careful!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_001
Array.english: Looks like I'll have to defeat that toad to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>.
Array.indonesia: Looks like I'll have to defeat that toad to get the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=34>If you're ready, let's start the fight!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>If you're ready, let's start the fight!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_Option01_001
Array.english: Start the battle
Array.indonesia: Start the battle

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_Option01_002
Array.english: Retreat
Array.indonesia: Retreat

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossAppear_Retry_No_001
Array.english: <size=32>I should prepare a bit more and come back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should prepare a bit more and come back.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossWin_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... that was rough.\nI really hate toads.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew... that was rough.\nI really hate toads.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossWin_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Nice work! By the way, toad meat stays poisonous even when cooked, so don't even think about taking it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Nice work! By the way, toad meat stays poisonous even when cooked, so don't even think about taking it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_BossWin_003
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, let's grab this <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright, let's grab this <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_GetTimber_001
Array.english: Oh, it really is sturdy and light, isn't it?
Array.indonesia: Oh, it really is sturdy and light, isn't it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_GetTimber_002
Array.english: Let's head back to the village and give it to Peneb.
Array.indonesia: Let's head back to the village and give it to Peneb.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_GetTimber_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm? Where are you going?\nYou need to grab the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm? Where are you going?\nYou need to grab the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebDelivery_001
Array.english: Huh? Did you bring the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Did you bring the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebDelivery_Option01
Array.english: Yes, here it is
Array.indonesia: Yes, here it is

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebDelivery_Option02
Array.english: Not yet...
Array.indonesia: Not yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Finished_001
Array.english: I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>.
Array.indonesia: I brought the <color=#F1DC2B>Purity Wood</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Finished_002
Array.english: Oh... I heard that place is crawling with dangerous creatures. How'd you manage to get it!?
Array.indonesia: Oh... I heard that place is crawling with dangerous creatures. How'd you manage to get it!?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Finished_003
Array.english: <size=33>...You could've told me that earlier.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...You could've told me that earlier.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Finished_004
Array.english:
Hehe, anyway, I'll make Saniah a toy with this.
Just give me a moment.
Array.indonesia:
Hehe, anyway, I'll make Saniah a toy with this.
Just give me a moment.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_001
Array.english: Phew... it's so tough, my wrist's killing me.
Array.indonesia: Phew... it's so tough, my wrist's killing me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_002
Array.english: Here you go. I tried to match the character Saniah likes as closely as I could.
Array.indonesia: Here you go. I tried to match the character Saniah likes as closely as I could.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... you did an amazing job!\nSaniah's gonna love it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... you did an amazing job!\nSaniah's gonna love it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_004
Array.english:
<size=33>It's nothing...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> 
Way easier than that big village sculpture<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=33>It's nothing...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color> 
Way easier than that big village sculpture<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebComplete_005
Array.english: Ahem... anyway, I hope Saniah likes it.
Array.indonesia: Ahem... anyway, I hope Saniah likes it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_NoItem_001
Array.english: Oh, my mistake. I'll look for it again.
Array.indonesia: Oh, my mistake. I'll look for it again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PenebGiveItem_Refuse_001
Array.english: <size=32>Not yet...\nI'll keep looking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Not yet...\nI'll keep looking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_001
Array.english: Here's a <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color> wooden toy.\nPeneb made it.
Array.indonesia: Here's a <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color> wooden toy.\nPeneb made it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ooh... this is really well made...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ooh... this is really well made...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_003
Array.english: The smooth finish and light weight...\nit's perfect for a kid's toy.
Array.indonesia: The smooth finish and light weight...\nit's perfect for a kid's toy.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_004
Array.english: I'll have to thank Peneb later.
Array.indonesia: I'll have to thank Peneb later.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_005
Array.english: Glad you like it.\nHope Saniah does too.
Array.indonesia: Glad you like it.\nHope Saniah does too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah_006
Array.english: Hehe, let's call her over.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, let's call her over.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah02_001
Array.english: Saniah, come here. Dave brought you something you'll like.
Array.indonesia: Saniah, come here. Dave brought you something you'll like.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah02_002
Array.english: <size=34>...Whoa! Isn't this <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color>!?\nWooow...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Whoa! Isn't this <color=#F1DC2B>Clumsy Slime</color>!?\nWooow...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah02_003
Array.english: <size=33>I can even pull the arrow out of its head! Wow! Thank you so, so much!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I can even pull the arrow out of its head! Wow! Thank you so, so much!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_001
Array.english: Seeing her this happy is really sweet.
Array.indonesia: Seeing her this happy is really sweet.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_002
Array.english: Hehe, Dave. Thanks so much.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, Dave. Thanks so much.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_003
Array.english: <size=33>As a small token of my thanks... I'll give you a <color=#1DFEAF>20%</color> discount on all my work from now on!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>As a small token of my thanks... I'll give you a <color=#1DFEAF>20%</color> discount on all my work from now on!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_004
Array.english: Oh... are you sure about that?
Array.indonesia: Oh... are you sure about that?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_005
Array.english: Haha. Seeing Saniah this happy, I can't not do something!
Array.indonesia: Haha. Seeing Saniah this happy, I can't not do something!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_21_PeraknSaniah03_006
Array.english: Well then, I'll be counting on you from now on.
Array.indonesia: Well then, I'll be counting on you from now on.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_001
Array.english: Hmm... the offerings I leave at the sacred tree keep disappearing...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... the offerings I leave at the sacred tree keep disappearing...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_002
Array.english: Could it be monkeys stealing them?
Array.indonesia: Could it be monkeys stealing them?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_003
Array.english: If it were fruit, I'd say it's monkeys...\nbut strangely, they only take the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.
