Array.indonesia: If it were fruit, I'd say it's monkeys...\nbut strangely, they only take the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_004
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>...? What's that?
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>...? What's that?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_005
Array.english: Ah, right. I haven't told you about it yet.
Array.indonesia: Ah, right. I haven't told you about it yet.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_006
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> is a traditional snack in our village. It's made with coconut milk and rice, so it's soft and sweet.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> is a traditional snack in our village. It's made with coconut milk and rice, so it's soft and sweet.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_007
Array.english: We use <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> not just as food, but also as offerings to our ancestors.
Array.indonesia: We use <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> not just as food, but also as offerings to our ancestors.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_008
Array.english: That's why I leave them in front of this sacred tree...\nbut lately, they've been disappearing every night.
Array.indonesia: That's why I leave them in front of this sacred tree...\nbut lately, they've been disappearing every night.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_009
Array.english: It leaves the fruit and other food behind, and only takes the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>... It's quite strange.
Array.indonesia: It leaves the fruit and other food behind, and only takes the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>... It's quite strange.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_010
Array.english: Rimbo says this started after a strange cardboard box labeled <color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color> appeared near the village.
Array.indonesia: Rimbo says this started after a strange cardboard box labeled <color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color> appeared near the village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_011
Array.english: Hmm... could there be a connection to the cardboard box?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... could there be a connection to the cardboard box?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_012
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, don't you have a <color=#1DFEAF>Camera</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, don't you have a <color=#1DFEAF>Camera</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_013
Array.english: Yes... we brought one to take pictures underwater.
Array.indonesia: Yes... we brought one to take pictures underwater.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_014
Array.english: Then could you take a picture of whoever's been taking the offerings at night?
Array.indonesia: Then could you take a picture of whoever's been taking the offerings at night?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_015
Array.english: If it's not monkeys, it might be the village children... \nand if so, they'll need to be scolded.
Array.indonesia: If it's not monkeys, it might be the village children... \nand if so, they'll need to be scolded.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_016
Array.english: We don't want them eating it before you get a shot...\nso I'll give you a few <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.
Array.indonesia: We don't want them eating it before you get a shot...\nso I'll give you a few <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_017
Array.english: Place them in front of the sacred tree at night,\nand watch with your <color=#1DFEAF>Camera</color>.
Array.indonesia: Place them in front of the sacred tree at night,\nand watch with your <color=#1DFEAF>Camera</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_PanutaStart_018
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. Stealing the village's offerings...\nLet's find out who it is.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright. Stealing the village's offerings...\nLet's find out who it is.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Night_001
Array.english: The chief asked me to film whoever's been stealing the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>, right?
Array.indonesia: The chief asked me to film whoever's been stealing the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Night_002
Array.english: I should set up a camera near <color=#F1DC2B>Sacred Tree</color>.
Array.indonesia: I should set up a camera near <color=#F1DC2B>Sacred Tree</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Night_Retry_001
Array.english: Oh right... the chief asked me to film whoever's been stealing the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh right... the chief asked me to film whoever's been stealing the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Night_Retry_002
Array.english: I should place the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> under the sacred tree and set up the camera.
Array.indonesia: I should place the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> under the sacred tree and set up the camera.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_KuiReady_001
Array.english: Alright, this should be enough <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>...
Array.indonesia: Alright, this should be enough <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_KuiReady_002
Array.english: Maybe I'll set the <color=#1DFEAF>Camera</color> up a little farther away?
Array.indonesia: Maybe I'll set the <color=#1DFEAF>Camera</color> up a little farther away?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_SetCamera_001
Array.english: Alright, camera's set...
Array.indonesia: Alright, camera's set...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_SetCamera_002
Array.english: Now let's wait for the thief to show up.
Array.indonesia: Now let's wait for the thief to show up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_NotComing_001
Array.english: Hmm... doesn't look like anyone's coming...\nWas this a bust?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... doesn't look like anyone's coming...\nWas this a bust?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_OmNomComing_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh!? What's that?\nA green creature...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh!? What's that?\nA green creature...!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_OmNomComing_002
Array.english: <size=33>Gotta snap a photo first...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Gotta snap a photo first...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraComplete_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... it ran off toward the forest...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... it ran off toward the forest...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraComplete_002
Array.english: I've never seen anything like that...\nCould it be native to this region?
Array.indonesia: I've never seen anything like that...\nCould it be native to this region?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraComplete_003
Array.english: I should ask the chief about it tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: I should ask the chief about it tomorrow.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_001
Array.english: I checked yesterday...
Array.indonesia: I checked yesterday...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_002
Array.english: <size=32>A green creature like this was stealing the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>A green creature like this was stealing the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_003
Array.english: Hmm...? I've never seen anything like this...\nDoesn't seem native to this area.
Array.indonesia: Hmm...? I've never seen anything like this...\nDoesn't seem native to this area.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_004
Array.english: I see. No wonder it looked so strange.
Array.indonesia: I see. No wonder it looked so strange.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_005
Array.english: If we leave it alone, the offerings will keep disappearing.
Array.indonesia: If we leave it alone, the offerings will keep disappearing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_006
Array.english: <size=32>We'll have to catch it or drive it off!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>We'll have to catch it or drive it off!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_007
Array.english: It really seems to like Kui... What if we lure it with Kui on a string?
Array.indonesia: It really seems to like Kui... What if we lure it with Kui on a string?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_008
Array.english: That's a good idea. First, we need to find where it's hiding.
Array.indonesia: That's a good idea. First, we need to find where it's hiding.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_009
Array.english: I saw some <color=#F1DC2B>Footprints</color> earlier...\nWhy don't you follow them?
Array.indonesia: I saw some <color=#F1DC2B>Footprints</color> earlier...\nWhy don't you follow them?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CameraNextDay_010
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. I'll check the <color=#F1DC2B>Footprints</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright. I'll check the <color=#F1DC2B>Footprints</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CheckFootstep_001
Array.english: Here are the green creature's <color=#F1DC2B>Footprints</color>.
Array.indonesia: Here are the green creature's <color=#F1DC2B>Footprints</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_CheckFootstep_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's follow them one by one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's follow them one by one!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_FootstepFollow_001
Array.english: Hmm... strange-looking tracks.\nLet's keep following them.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... strange-looking tracks.\nLet's keep following them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_FootstepSecond_001
Array.english: <size=32>The tracks keep going.\nLet's follow them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The tracks keep going.\nLet's follow them.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_FootstepEnd_001
Array.english: <size=31>Huh? The tracks end here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Huh? The tracks end here?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_FootstepEnd_002
Array.english: <size=32>Could it be... up near that cliff?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Could it be... up near that cliff?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_GameStart_001
Array.english: There it is, hiding over there... that little guy.
Array.indonesia: There it is, hiding over there... that little guy.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_GameStart_002
Array.english: Alright, let's tie the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> the chief gave me to a string and lure him out.
Array.indonesia: Alright, let's tie the <color=#F1DC2B>Kui</color> the chief gave me to a string and lure him out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Stage01Clear_001
Array.english: You really love Kui...
Array.indonesia: You really love Kui...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_Stage01Clear_002
Array.english: Just a few more tries and I can pull him up!
Array.indonesia: Just a few more tries and I can pull him up!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_GameComplete_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! He fell asleep with the candy in his mouth!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! He fell asleep with the candy in his mouth!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_GameComplete_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's pull him up now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's pull him up now!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_OmNomCapture_001
Array.english: It's actually pretty cute up close...
Array.indonesia: It's actually pretty cute up close...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_OmNomCapture_002
Array.english: Doesn't look like it'll wake up anytime soon,\nso I'll take it to the chief like this.
Array.indonesia: Doesn't look like it'll wake up anytime soon,\nso I'll take it to the chief like this.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete01_001
Array.english: Hmm... that's a very unusual creature.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... that's a very unusual creature.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete01_002
Array.english: I know. What should we do with it?
Array.indonesia: I know. What should we do with it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Haha, this little guy... looks like he really likes this place, probably because of the food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha, this little guy... looks like he really likes this place, probably because of the food!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_002
Array.english: <size=32>If you're okay with it, how about we let him stay here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If you're okay with it, how about we let him stay here?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? Here at the restaurant...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh? Here at the restaurant...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_004
Array.english: Well... if Bancho's okay with it...
Array.indonesia: Well... if Bancho's okay with it...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_005
Array.english: Heh. Why not.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Why not.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_006
Array.english: As long as he doesn't eat all my ingredients.
Array.indonesia: As long as he doesn't eat all my ingredients.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_007
Array.english: Then let's have him run some small errands,\nsince he seems to like it here.
Array.indonesia: Then let's have him run some small errands,\nsince he seems to like it here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_008
Array.english: What should we call him?
Array.indonesia: What should we call him?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_009
Array.english: The box he came in had <color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color> written on it...\nWhy not call him that?
Array.indonesia: The box he came in had <color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color> written on it...\nWhy not call him that?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_MissionComplete02_010
Array.english: <size=33><color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color>... what a cute name!\nIt fits him perfectly!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#A8DC23>Om Nom</color>... what a cute name!\nIt fits him perfectly!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_BoxInteraction_001
Array.english: A box just appeared out of nowhere...\nWonder what was inside?
Array.indonesia: A box just appeared out of nowhere...\nWonder what was inside?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_22_CutTheRope_KuiEmptyInteraction_001
Array.english: The Kui that green creature ate...\nLooks pretty tasty.
Array.indonesia: The Kui that green creature ate...\nLooks pretty tasty.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLakeEvent_TigerFishLook01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm...? Looks like the Goliath Tigerfish is being chased by something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm...? Looks like the Goliath Tigerfish is being chased by something.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLakeEvent_TigerFishLook02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! Is that the freshwater shark Basu was talking about...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoa...! Is that the freshwater shark Basu was talking about...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLakeEvent_TigerFishLook02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Seeing a shark in a lake feels so strange...\nI'll have to be careful around here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Seeing a shark in a lake feels so strange...\nI'll have to be careful around here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_MorningHouse_001
Array.english: Hmm... it's kind of noisy outside.\nWhat's going on...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... it's kind of noisy outside.\nWhat's going on...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_001
Array.english: <size=34>It's him...\n<color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It's him...\n<color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_002
Array.english: The beast that disappeared... Why is he back all of a sudden...?
Array.indonesia: The beast that disappeared... Why is he back all of a sudden...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_003
Array.english: Judging by the bite marks, he's gotten even bigger...
Array.indonesia: Judging by the bite marks, he's gotten even bigger...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_004
Array.english: <size=33>A bull shark... dead?\nWhat happened here...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A bull shark... dead?\nWhat happened here...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_005
Array.english: The saltwater crocodile that injured my father's leg...\nI think <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> is back.
Array.indonesia: The saltwater crocodile that injured my father's leg...\nI think <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> is back.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_006
Array.english:
A saltwater crocodile... The one Basu mentioned?
The one that moves between freshwater and saltwater?
Array.indonesia:
A saltwater crocodile... The one Basu mentioned?
The one that moves between freshwater and saltwater?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_007
Array.english: Yes... they're one of the largest crocodile species.
Array.indonesia: Yes... they're one of the largest crocodile species.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_008
Array.english: This area's a perfect habitat, since the sea and the lake are connected.
Array.indonesia: This area's a perfect habitat, since the sea and the lake are connected.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_009
Array.english: But they don't usually come up to the village to hunt.\nThey're actually quite timid.
Array.indonesia: But they don't usually come up to the village to hunt.\nThey're actually quite timid.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_010
Array.english: But there was one exception...\n<color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> was different.
Array.indonesia: But there was one exception...\n<color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> was different.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_011
Array.english: Even when he wasn't fully grown, he was bigger than the others...and he'd come up to the village and hunt our chickens.
Array.indonesia: Even when he wasn't fully grown, he was bigger than the others...and he'd come up to the village and hunt our chickens.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_012
Array.english: When I was a child... <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> came at me while I was playing by the water.
Array.indonesia: When I was a child... <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> came at me while I was playing by the water.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_013
Array.english: My father stepped in to protect me...\nand <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> bit his leg...
Array.indonesia: My father stepped in to protect me...\nand <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> bit his leg...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_014
Array.english: Since then, my father walked with a limp...\nand I've trained to protect the village from <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>.
Array.indonesia: Since then, my father walked with a limp...\nand I've trained to protect the village from <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_015
Array.english: Oh... sorry. I got carried away talking about the past.
Array.indonesia: Oh... sorry. I got carried away talking about the past.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_016
Array.english: That's quite a story... But why would he suddenly reappear after all this time?
Array.indonesia: That's quite a story... But why would he suddenly reappear after all this time?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_017
Array.english: We set up a <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> of stakes along his path to stop him.
Array.indonesia: We set up a <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> of stakes along his path to stop him.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_018
Array.english: Maybe... now that he's fully grown, Sulong broke through the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color>...
Array.indonesia: Maybe... now that he's fully grown, Sulong broke through the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_019
Array.english: Dave... I'm sorry, but could you check if the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> at the lake is still intact?
Array.indonesia: Dave... I'm sorry, but could you check if the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> at the lake is still intact?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_020
Array.english: It's set up about <color=#1DFEAF>10m</color> deep, at the left end of the lake.
Array.indonesia: It's set up about <color=#1DFEAF>10m</color> deep, at the left end of the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BullSharkLobbyEvent_Village_021
Array.english: Sure, I'll check it out.
Array.indonesia: Sure, I'll check it out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_WallCheck_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...? Just like Uzme said... The <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color>'s broken...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh...? Just like Uzme said... The <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color>'s broken...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_WallCheck_002
Array.english: <size=32>Did that saltwater crocodile really break through it...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Did that saltwater crocodile really break through it...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_WallCheck_003
Array.english: <size=32>I should head back to the village and tell Uzme first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should head back to the village and tell Uzme first.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_SulongZone_BeforeReport_001
Array.english: <size=33>I shouldn't go in yet.\nI need to tell Uzme about the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I shouldn't go in yet.\nI need to tell Uzme about the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> first.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCBarricade_Ingame_SulongZone_NotInSunset_001
Array.english:
It doesn't seem to be the time Uzme mentioned yet.
I should come back at sunset.
Array.indonesia:
It doesn't seem to be the time Uzme mentioned yet.
I should come back at sunset.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_001
Array.english: Um... about the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> at the lake you mentioned...
Array.indonesia: Um... about the <color=#1DFEAF>Barrier</color> at the lake you mentioned...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_002
Array.english: <size=33>You were right. It was completely destroyed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You were right. It was completely destroyed.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_003
Array.english: Haaah... I knew it...
Array.indonesia: Haaah... I knew it...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_004
Array.english: To break those sturdy stakes... \nit must have grown stronger over time.
Array.indonesia: To break those sturdy stakes... \nit must have grown stronger over time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_005
Array.english: If we leave it alone, it'll keep attacking livestock and people... just like before.
Array.indonesia: If we leave it alone, it'll keep attacking livestock and people... just like before.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>Hmm... Dave... I think you should handle this for the village.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>Hmm... Dave... I think you should handle this for the village.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>...I was already thinking the same thing.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>...I was already thinking the same thing.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>I just didn't have the nerve to say it out loud...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>I just didn't have the nerve to say it out loud...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_009
Array.english: <size=35>Uzme... what if I go hunt the Sulong?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Uzme... what if I go hunt the Sulong?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_010
Array.english: <size=32>What...? Even if you're a master diver, taking on something that dangerous...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What...? Even if you're a master diver, taking on something that dangerous...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_011
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Dave's a pro who's taken down everything from giant deep-sea creatures to dinosaurs. Looks can be deceiving!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Dave's a pro who's taken down everything from giant deep-sea creatures to dinosaurs. Looks can be deceiving!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_012
Array.english: <size=34>...'looks can be deceiving'?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...'looks can be deceiving'?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_013
Array.english: I'd love to take it down myself, but... the Sulong is nocturnal and stays in the water most of the time... so... ugh...
Array.indonesia: I'd love to take it down myself, but... the Sulong is nocturnal and stays in the water most of the time... so... ugh...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_014
Array.english: If it's nocturnal, couldn't we attack during the day while it's sleeping?
Array.indonesia: If it's nocturnal, couldn't we attack during the day while it's sleeping?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_015
Array.english: Well... I looked into its habits before, and it seems to hide in its den during the day and come out at night.
Array.indonesia: Well... I looked into its habits before, and it seems to hide in its den during the day and come out at night.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_016
Array.english: That means it's hard to find during the day,\neven if you search underwater.
Array.indonesia: That means it's hard to find during the day,\neven if you search underwater.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_017
Array.english: <size=34>However...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>However...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_018
Array.english: <size=33>it's a different story at <color=#F1DC2B>Dusk</color>, when the sun starts to set.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>it's a different story at <color=#F1DC2B>Dusk</color>, when the sun starts to set.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_019
Array.english: <size=33>Sulong will have just woken up, so it won't be at full strength... and you'll still have enough light to see!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sulong will have just woken up, so it won't be at full strength... and you'll still have enough light to see!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_020
Array.english: Oh... that makes sense.\nWe'd have a better shot at <color=#F1DC2B>Dusk</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh... that makes sense.\nWe'd have a better shot at <color=#F1DC2B>Dusk</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_021
Array.english: Uzme will tell you when the time is right.\nWe're counting on you.
Array.indonesia: Uzme will tell you when the time is right.\nWe're counting on you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_022
Array.english: Got it.\nI'll make sure my gear is ready too.
Array.indonesia: Got it.\nI'll make sure my gear is ready too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_023
Array.english: I'm sorry I can't help directly, Dave.
Array.indonesia: I'm sorry I can't help directly, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_ReportUzme_024
Array.english: Instead, I'll give you some <color=#F1DC2B>Ore</color> I have.\nHope it helps you upgrade your gear.
Array.indonesia: Instead, I'll give you some <color=#F1DC2B>Ore</color> I have.\nHope it helps you upgrade your gear.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCTimeEvent_Sulong_WallCheck_001
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> should be on the move by now.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> should be on the move by now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_StartFail_001
Array.english: Didn't see Sulong today. I'll check again tomorrow around sunset.
Array.indonesia: Didn't see Sulong today. I'll check again tomorrow around sunset.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BattleEnter_001
Array.english: I can sense something dangerous inside...
Array.indonesia: I can sense something dangerous inside...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BattleEnter_002
Array.english: Looks like Uzme was right... <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> really is here at this hour.
Array.indonesia: Looks like Uzme was right... <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color> really is here at this hour.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_BattleEnter_003
Array.english: This is going to be a tough fight...\nLet me check my gear first.
Array.indonesia: This is going to be a tough fight...\nLet me check my gear first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...! So that's <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoa...! So that's <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's way bigger than I thought...\nUh... what should I do...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's way bigger than I thought...\nUh... what should I do...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>I can't back down now! For the chief and the village! I've fought bigger things back in the Blue Hole!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I can't back down now! For the chief and the village! I've fought bigger things back in the Blue Hole!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_004
Array.english: <size=32>If I watch its movements carefully, there has to be an opening.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If I watch its movements carefully, there has to be an opening.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_ReTry_001
Array.english: <size=32>I wasn't prepared enough before.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I wasn't prepared enough before.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightStart_ReTry_002
Array.english: <size=33>This time, I'll stay focused and take it down for sure!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This time, I'll stay focused and take it down for sure!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingStart_001
Array.english: <size=32>Phew... what a massive and vicious creature.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Phew... what a massive and vicious creature.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingStart_002
Array.english: <size=33>Still, the village won't be attacked anymore now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Still, the village won't be attacked anymore now!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>I heard crocodile meat's pretty good... Maybe I should see if there's anything worth taking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I heard crocodile meat's pretty good... Maybe I should see if there's anything worth taking.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>This should be enough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>This should be enough.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightEnd_CarvingEnd_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's head back and tell Uzme.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's head back and tell Uzme.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_FightFail_001
Array.english: <size=32>I can't take it on yet...\nI should prepare more and try again...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I can't take it on yet...\nI should prepare more and try again...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_001
Array.english: <size=34>Dave, you're safe!\nWhat happened to <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave, you're safe!\nWhat happened to <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>I barely managed to take it down...\nIt was incredibly vicious.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I barely managed to take it down...\nIt was incredibly vicious.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_003
Array.english: <size=33>Oh my... really? It's finally gone... I don't know how to thank you...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh my... really? It's finally gone... I don't know how to thank you...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_004
Array.english: That's incredible...\nYou defeated Sulong...
Array.indonesia: That's incredible...\nYou defeated Sulong...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_005
Array.english: Now we're finally at peace... It was terrifying knowing that thing was roaming around.
Array.indonesia: Now we're finally at peace... It was terrifying knowing that thing was roaming around.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_006
Array.english: Everyone was so scared they wouldn't even leave their homes... We barely spoke to each other.
Array.indonesia: Everyone was so scared they wouldn't even leave their homes... We barely spoke to each other.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_007
Array.english: The villagers managed to band together and drive it off once... but I feared it would return.
Array.indonesia: The villagers managed to band together and drive it off once... but I feared it would return.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_008
Array.english: Thanks to you... we can finally protect our village in peace. Thank you.
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you... we can finally protect our village in peace. Thank you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_009
Array.english: I owed you all anyway.\nI'm just glad I could help.
Array.indonesia: I owed you all anyway.\nI'm just glad I could help.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_010
Array.english: Hehe, I wish all outsiders were like you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, I wish all outsiders were like you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_011
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, about that <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong's Tooth</color> you brought...\nThey say it grants mysterious strength.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, about that <color=#F1DC2B>Sulong's Tooth</color> you brought...\nThey say it grants mysterious strength.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_012
Array.english: <size=33>I made it into a <color=#F1DC2B>Bracelet</color> so you can wear it. Go on, take it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I made it into a <color=#F1DC2B>Bracelet</color> so you can wear it. Go on, take it.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_013
Array.english: Oh... thank you. I'll make good use of it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... thank you. I'll make good use of it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_014
Array.english: It's a good thing Sulong is gone, but...
Array.indonesia: It's a good thing Sulong is gone, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... no matter how much I cut them, they just keep growing back... What's going on here...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... no matter how much I cut them, they just keep growing back... What's going on here...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_002
Array.english: Huh...? What's going on?
Array.indonesia: Huh...? What's going on?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>Sigh... it's these <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Sigh... it's these <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_004
Array.english: Some strange power must be flowing through this garden... \nNo matter how much I cut the <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color>, they grow right back.
Array.indonesia: Some strange power must be flowing through this garden... \nNo matter how much I cut the <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color>, they grow right back.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_005
Array.english: If I pulled them all out at once, they wouldn't have roots to grow back from...
Array.indonesia: If I pulled them all out at once, they wouldn't have roots to grow back from...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_006
Array.english: <size=33>But I've been at it all day, and my back's killing me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But I've been at it all day, and my back's killing me.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_007
Array.english: So, outsider.\nHow about helping out for once?
Array.indonesia: So, outsider.\nHow about helping out for once?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_008
Array.english: <size=33>How about you cut some of these <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color></size>?
Array.indonesia: <size=33>How about you cut some of these <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color></size>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_009
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? Me...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh? Me...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_010
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(What should I do...? Should I help him clear out the weeds?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(What should I do...? Should I help him clear out the weeds?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_option01
Array.english: I'll help
Array.indonesia: I'll help

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_option02
Array.english: I'll help later
Array.indonesia: I'll help later

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_001
Array.english: Sure, I'll help.\nWhat do I need to do?
Array.indonesia: Sure, I'll help.\nWhat do I need to do?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_002
Array.english: Ooh... finally making yourself useful, huh.
Array.indonesia: Ooh... finally making yourself useful, huh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_003
Array.english: You gotta pull all the <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color> you see here.
Array.indonesia: You gotta pull all the <color=#F1DC2B>Weeds</color> you see here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_004
Array.english: But some of them are long... You'll need to wiggle those a bit to make 'em easier to pull.
Array.indonesia: But some of them are long... You'll need to wiggle those a bit to make 'em easier to pull.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_005
Array.english: Well, you'll get the hang of it once you try.\nAnd there's one more thing to watch out for...
Array.indonesia: Well, you'll get the hang of it once you try.\nAnd there's one more thing to watch out for...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_006
Array.english: The weeds in this garden grow crazy fast. If you take too long, the ones you pulled will grow back.
Array.indonesia: The weeds in this garden grow crazy fast. If you take too long, the ones you pulled will grow back.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Yes_007
Array.english: <size=33>So stay focused and get it done right!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>So stay focused and get it done right!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_No_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'm a bit busy right now. Can I come back later and help?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'm a bit busy right now. Can I come back later and help?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_No_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! If you don't wanna help, just say so. All these excuses!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! If you don't wanna help, just say so. All these excuses!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_No_003
Array.english: <size=32>Gonna take a while for my back to heal... I'll be watchin' to see if you come back.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Gonna take a while for my back to heal... I'll be watchin' to see if you come back.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ugh... these damn weeds...\nWhy do they grow so fast...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ugh... these damn weeds...\nWhy do they grow so fast...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunStart_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? Changed your mind?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh? Changed your mind?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh...? You got rid of all the weeds?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh...? You got rid of all the weeds?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_002
Array.english: Phew... I was rushing to pull them all out before they grew back. I'm outta breath.
Array.indonesia: Phew... I was rushing to pull them all out before they grew back. I'm outta breath.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_003
Array.english: Ha! Good work!\nHere, have a glass of coconut juice.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Good work!\nHere, have a glass of coconut juice.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_004
Array.english: (Gulp... gulp...)
Array.indonesia: (Gulp... gulp...)

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_005
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! That was delicious! I feel totally refreshed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! That was delicious! I feel totally refreshed!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_006
Array.english: Ha! My farm's coconuts are the best.
Array.indonesia: Ha! My farm's coconuts are the best.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_007
Array.english: Oh, about that garden...
Array.indonesia: Oh, about that garden...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_008
Array.english: <size=33>I'm thinkin' of planting some crops there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'm thinkin' of planting some crops there.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_009
Array.english: Crops grow crazy fast here... so if I plant fruits and vegetables, they'll be huge in no time!
Array.indonesia: Crops grow crazy fast here... so if I plant fruits and vegetables, they'll be huge in no time!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_010
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... that's a great idea!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... that's a great idea!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_26_JepunEnd_011
Array.english: <size=31>Ha! Should be mostly ready by tomorrow, so swing by if you're curious!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Ha! Should be mostly ready by tomorrow, so swing by if you're curious!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... those damn things...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... those damn things...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_002
Array.english: Huh? The farm's a mess?
Array.indonesia: Huh? The farm's a mess?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_003
Array.english: <size=33>A whole bunch of <color=#F1DC2B>Macaques</color> came in last night and tore the whole place up!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A whole bunch of <color=#F1DC2B>Macaques</color> came in last night and tore the whole place up!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_004
Array.english: <size=32>The crops grew just like I expected... but those damn <color=#F1DC2B>Macaques</color> went and snatched them all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The crops grew just like I expected... but those damn <color=#F1DC2B>Macaques</color> went and snatched them all!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_005
Array.english: They only pull this at night when everyone's asleep...\nso it's hard to get help in time...
Array.indonesia: They only pull this at night when everyone's asleep...\nso it's hard to get help in time...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hey, you!\nHow about helpin' me drive off those <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color>!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hey, you!\nHow about helpin' me drive off those <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color>!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_007
Array.english: <size=32>Huh? Me...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh? Me...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_008
Array.english: <size=32>Yeah! Instead of just mooching off the village, do something useful for once!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yeah! Instead of just mooching off the village, do something useful for once!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_009
Array.english: Uhm... alright.\nWhat should I do?
Array.indonesia: Uhm... alright.\nWhat should I do?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunStart_010
Array.english: <size=34>Come back this evening!\nWe'll talk then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Come back this evening!\nWe'll talk then!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_DaveGotoJepun_001
Array.english: Jepun asked me to get rid of those <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color>.
Array.indonesia: Jepun asked me to get rid of those <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_DaveGotoJepun_002
Array.english: <size=32>I should head over to Jepun's farm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I should head over to Jepun's farm.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hey...! What took you so long?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hey...! What took you so long?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_002
Array.english: Ah... sorry.\nI came straight here after closing the shop...
Array.indonesia: Ah... sorry.\nI came straight here after closing the shop...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_003
Array.english: <size=34>Those damn monkeys already made off with the <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color> I harvested!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Those damn monkeys already made off with the <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color> I harvested!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_004
Array.english: I gotta stay here and protect what's left...
Array.indonesia: I gotta stay here and protect what's left...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_005
Array.english: <size=32>You go get those dragon fruits back from the Monkeys, brat!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You go get those dragon fruits back from the Monkeys, brat!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_006
Array.english: ...Alright, fine.\nWhat do I need to do?
Array.indonesia: ...Alright, fine.\nWhat do I need to do?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_007
Array.english: Those bastards took about 10 <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color>.
Array.indonesia: Those bastards took about 10 <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_008
Array.english: <size=33>Grab a broom and teach those Monkeys a lesson!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Grab a broom and teach those Monkeys a lesson!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_009
Array.english: They'll drop the <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color>, and you grab 'em!
Array.indonesia: They'll drop the <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color>, and you grab 'em!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_010
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color> are running all over the place,\nor hiding somewhere.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color> are running all over the place,\nor hiding somewhere.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight_011
Array.english: <size=34>Get those <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color> back before they get too far!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Get those <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruits</color> back before they get too far!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Aaah!! Look, a whole group of <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color> just showed up...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Aaah!! Look, a whole group of <color=#F1DC2B>Monkeys</color> just showed up...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight02_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...! You're right...! There's a lot of them...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...! You're right...! There's a lot of them...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunNight02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! Like I said, go teach them a lesson!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! Like I said, go teach them a lesson!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ha! Nice work!\nThose monkeys... they've all backed off!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ha! Nice work!\nThose monkeys... they've all backed off!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_002
Array.english: Whew... those things are fast.
Array.indonesia: Whew... those things are fast.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_003
Array.english: Still, after that, they won't dare come back anytime soon! \nGood work.
Array.indonesia: Still, after that, they won't dare come back anytime soon! \nGood work.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_004
Array.english: It's not much of a reward, but...
Array.indonesia: It's not much of a reward, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_005
Array.english: <size=33>Why don't you have this <color=#1DFEAF>Garden</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Why don't you have this <color=#1DFEAF>Garden</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_006
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh...? Me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_007
Array.english: I've already got my hands full with coconuts and papayas.
Array.indonesia: I've already got my hands full with coconuts and papayas.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_008
Array.english: Besides dragon fruits, I've got all kinds of seeds...\nHow about you plant and grow them?
Array.indonesia: Besides dragon fruits, I've got all kinds of seeds...\nHow about you plant and grow them?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_009
Array.english: I gotta clean up the mess those monkeys made...
Array.indonesia: I gotta clean up the mess those monkeys made...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_010
Array.english: Stop by again tomorrow.\nI'll explain everything then.
Array.indonesia: Stop by again tomorrow.\nI'll explain everything then.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunEnd_011
Array.english: Okay, got it. See you tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Okay, got it. See you tomorrow.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_Barricade01_001
Array.english: <size=32>The monkeys couldn't have gone this far...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The monkeys couldn't have gone this far...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_Barricade02_001
Array.english: <size=32>The monkeys wouldn't have gone inside the tent...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The monkeys wouldn't have gone inside the tent...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_Barricade03_001
Array.english: <size=32>There are people around...\nthey wouldn't have gone into the house.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>There are people around...\nthey wouldn't have gone into the house.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_DaveSleepy_001
Array.english: Phew... running around's left me worn out...
Array.indonesia: Phew... running around's left me worn out...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_DaveSleepy_002
Array.english: I'll have a quick look around, then turn in.
Array.indonesia: I'll have a quick look around, then turn in.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ha! So you're here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ha! So you're here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_002
Array.english: Like I said, plants grow unusually fast in this <color=#1DFEAF>Garden</color>.
Array.indonesia: Like I said, plants grow unusually fast in this <color=#1DFEAF>Garden</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_003
Array.english: If you plant crops here, you'll be able to harvest them in no time.
Array.indonesia: If you plant crops here, you'll be able to harvest them in no time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_004
Array.english: But... I still need to deliver coconuts and papayas to your shop...
Array.indonesia: But... I still need to deliver coconuts and papayas to your shop...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_005
Array.english: <size=32>so it's hard for me to plant and harvest here often.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>so it's hard for me to plant and harvest here often.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_006
Array.english: That's why I figured you could plant and grow them yourself and use them at the shop!
Array.indonesia: That's why I figured you could plant and grow them yourself and use them at the shop!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_007
Array.english: Oh... that sounds like a good idea.
Array.indonesia: Oh... that sounds like a good idea.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_008
Array.english: But how do I get <color=#F1DC2B>seeds</color>?
Array.indonesia: But how do I get <color=#F1DC2B>seeds</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_009
Array.english: Well... you might find some lying around...\nbut I've got some <color=#F1DC2B>Seeds</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Fertilizer</color> on me.
Array.indonesia: Well... you might find some lying around...\nbut I've got some <color=#F1DC2B>Seeds</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Fertilizer</color> on me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_010
Array.english: <size=32>I'll give you some <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruit</color> seeds, so go ahead and try it out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll give you some <color=#1DFEAF>Dragon Fruit</color> seeds, so go ahead and try it out!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_011
Array.english: If you need other <color=#F1DC2B>Seeds</color>, just let me know.\nI'll sell you what I've got on hand.
Array.indonesia: If you need other <color=#F1DC2B>Seeds</color>, just let me know.\nI'll sell you what I've got on hand.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_012
Array.english: Things grow so fast here that seeds spoil quickly,\nso what I have changes from time to time.
Array.indonesia: Things grow so fast here that seeds spoil quickly,\nso what I have changes from time to time.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_013
Array.english: And you can also gather materials you don't need and turn them into <color=#F1DC2B>Fertilizer</color>.
Array.indonesia: And you can also gather materials you don't need and turn them into <color=#F1DC2B>Fertilizer</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_014
Array.english: Use <color=#F1DC2B>Fertilizer</color> to grow things faster and harvest even more!
Array.indonesia: Use <color=#F1DC2B>Fertilizer</color> to grow things faster and harvest even more!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_015
Array.english: Hmm... a mysterious <color=#F1DC2B>Garden</color> where everything grows fast...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... a mysterious <color=#F1DC2B>Garden</color> where everything grows fast...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_27_JepunReward_016
Array.english: <size=32>Got it! I'll give it a shot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Got it! I'll give it a shot!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_001
Array.english: Wow... you've caught quite a few fish, haven't you?
Array.indonesia: Wow... you've caught quite a few fish, haven't you?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_002
Array.english: I got a notification about a new rare card activation... Let's see...
Array.indonesia: I got a notification about a new rare card activation... Let's see...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_003
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! Is this... a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa! Is this... a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_004
Array.english: Huh? <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtles</color> aren't native to this region, though. That's strange.
Array.indonesia: Huh? <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtles</color> aren't native to this region, though. That's strange.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_005
Array.english: Hmm... but the chances of the World Marinca Association making a mistake are very slim.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... but the chances of the World Marinca Association making a mistake are very slim.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_006
Array.english: How about asking the locals around here what's going on?
Array.indonesia: How about asking the locals around here what's going on?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_007
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... who would know...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... who would know...?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Start_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(I guess Chief <color=#F1DC2B>Panutah</color>, who knows the village well...\nand Mr. <color=#F1DC2B>Basu</color>, who fishes a lot, might know.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(I guess Chief <color=#F1DC2B>Panutah</color>, who knows the village well...\nand Mr. <color=#F1DC2B>Basu</color>, who fishes a lot, might know.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm? A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm? A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_002
Array.english: Well now... I dunno...
Array.indonesia: Well now... I dunno...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_003
Array.english:
But now that I think about it... 
I was fishin' before, and I caught a fish...
Array.indonesia:
But now that I think about it... 
I was fishin' before, and I caught a fish...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_004
Array.english: <size=32>and then this real long neck shot out and snatched my fish right up!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>and then this real long neck shot out and snatched my fish right up!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_005
Array.english: Back then I thought I'd seen a ghost or somethin'...
Array.indonesia: Back then I thought I'd seen a ghost or somethin'...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_006
Array.english: <size=32>but come to think of it, its face looked like a turtle!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>but come to think of it, its face looked like a turtle!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_007
Array.english: Maybe that was a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>, I reckon.\nThere ain't no turtles in this lake, ya see.
Array.indonesia: Maybe that was a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>, I reckon.\nThere ain't no turtles in this lake, ya see.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskBasu_008
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... a turtle with a really long neck...\nThat sounds like a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... a turtle with a really long neck...\nThat sounds like a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm...? A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm...? A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_002
Array.english: Ah, you mean the one with the pointy shell and long neck?
Array.indonesia: Ah, you mean the one with the pointy shell and long neck?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_003
Array.english: Yes, that's right. That kind of turtle.
Array.indonesia: Yes, that's right. That kind of turtle.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_004
Array.english: Tsk... must be that turtle the TV crew brought here back then.
Array.indonesia: Tsk... must be that turtle the TV crew brought here back then.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_005
Array.english: What...? A TV crew?
Array.indonesia: What...? A TV crew?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_006
Array.english: That's right. About 10 years ago... \nthey came to the village to film a survival show.
Array.indonesia: That's right. About 10 years ago... \nthey came to the village to film a survival show.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_007
Array.english: They'd pretend to starve, then eat catered food when the cameras were off...
Array.indonesia: They'd pretend to starve, then eat catered food when the cameras were off...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_008
Array.english: They even brought in animals that don't belong here just for the show.
Array.indonesia: They even brought in animals that don't belong here just for the show.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_009
Array.english: And when filming wrapped, they just left without cleaning up!
Array.indonesia: And when filming wrapped, they just left without cleaning up!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_010
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> they brought for that biting scene...
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> they brought for that biting scene...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_011
Array.english: <size=32>They must've just left it behind too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>They must've just left it behind too.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_012
Array.english: I figured there was no way it could survive this long in this environment...
Array.indonesia: I figured there was no way it could survive this long in this environment...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_013
Array.english: But Basu said he spotted a huge turtle recently... and there have been dead fish with strange bite marks...
Array.indonesia: But Basu said he spotted a huge turtle recently... and there have been dead fish with strange bite marks...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_014
Array.english: <size=32>Don't tell me it's really in this lake? \nThat could be disastrous for the local wildlife.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Don't tell me it's really in this lake? \nThat could be disastrous for the local wildlife.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskPanuta_015
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> abandoned by a TV crew 10 years ago... Could it really have survived this long...?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> abandoned by a TV crew 10 years ago... Could it really have survived this long...?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskEnd_001
Array.english: Alright. I think I've got enough info on the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>.
Array.indonesia: Alright. I think I've got enough info on the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AskEnd_002
Array.english: <size=33>Let's go tell Sato.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's go tell Sato.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_001
Array.english: I looked into it... and it seems a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> left behind by a TV crew years ago has been living here.
Array.indonesia: I looked into it... and it seems a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> left behind by a TV crew years ago has been living here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_002
Array.english: But... I heard it's gotten pretty big.
Array.indonesia: But... I heard it's gotten pretty big.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_003
Array.english: Some people even saw it catching fish in the lake.
Array.indonesia: Some people even saw it catching fish in the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_004
Array.english: So that's what happened...! \nNo wonder there's a species here that doesn't belong.
Array.indonesia: So that's what happened...! \nNo wonder there's a species here that doesn't belong.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_005
Array.english: Meanwhile... I did some research while you were investigating.
Array.indonesia: Meanwhile... I did some research while you were investigating.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_006
Array.english: This <color=#F1DC2B>Digital Monster Radar</color>...\nor DMR for short, can show its approximate location.
Array.indonesia: This <color=#F1DC2B>Digital Monster Radar</color>...\nor DMR for short, can show its approximate location.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_007
Array.english: <size=32>It's showing a turtle-shaped signal at a <color=#1DFEAF>Depth of 60m on the Left Side</color> of the lake.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's showing a turtle-shaped signal at a <color=#1DFEAF>Depth of 60m on the Left Side</color> of the lake.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_008
Array.english: The villagers seem to be having trouble because of it...
Array.indonesia: The villagers seem to be having trouble because of it...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_009
Array.english: <size=35>How about you go catch it for us?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>How about you go catch it for us?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_010
Array.english: <size=33>...Isn't this just to fill your Marinca collection?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...Isn't this just to fill your Marinca collection?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_011
Array.english: ...Well, there is that added bonus, haha.
Array.indonesia: ...Well, there is that added bonus, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_012
Array.english: I've set it to show a <color=#F1DC2B>Yellow Signal</color> at the suspected location, so follow it when you see it.
Array.indonesia: I've set it to show a <color=#F1DC2B>Yellow Signal</color> at the suspected location, so follow it when you see it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_013
Array.english: It can do that too...?
Array.indonesia: It can do that too...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_014
Array.english: Got it. Well... catching one turtle shouldn't be a problem.
Array.indonesia: Got it. Well... catching one turtle shouldn't be a problem.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_ReportSato_015
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Left Side, 60m Deep</color>, right?\nI'll go check it out.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Left Side, 60m Deep</color>, right?\nI'll go check it out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked01_001
Array.english: <size=32>The signal's coming from here...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The signal's coming from here...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked01_002
Array.english: Could there be a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> inside...?
Array.indonesia: Could there be a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> inside...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked01_003
Array.english: I should cut through these roots.
Array.indonesia: I should cut through these roots.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked02_001
Array.english: Hmm... these roots are pretty thick...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... these roots are pretty thick...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked02_002
Array.english: My <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> isn't sharp enough to cut them right now.
Array.indonesia: My <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> isn't sharp enough to cut them right now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked02_003
Array.english: I should head back up first.
Array.indonesia: I should head back up first.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whoa...!? What was that...!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoa...!? What was that...!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked03_002
Array.english: <size=32>...That was way too strong to be just a turtle...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...That was way too strong to be just a turtle...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceBlocked03_003
Array.english: <size=32>...Don't tell me there are other creatures in there too...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...Don't tell me there are other creatures in there too...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_001
Array.english: I found where the <color=#F1DC2B>snapping turtle</color> is...
Array.indonesia: I found where the <color=#F1DC2B>snapping turtle</color> is...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_002
Array.english: <size=32>But it's absolutely massive...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But it's absolutely massive...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_003
Array.english: Ha! All the more reason we need to catch it for the villagers! We have to protect this beautiful village!
Array.indonesia: Ha! All the more reason we need to catch it for the villagers! We have to protect this beautiful village!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_004
Array.english: Hmm... but to get deeper inside, I need to cut through some thick roots...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... but to get deeper inside, I need to cut through some thick roots...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_005
Array.english: My <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> is too dull. No way I can cut them.
Array.indonesia: My <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> is too dull. No way I can cut them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_006
Array.english: I see... If there's someone in the village who's good with tools, they might be able to help...
Array.indonesia: I see... If there's someone in the village who's good with tools, they might be able to help...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_007
Array.english: Come to think of it, <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color> might be able to help with the machete.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color> might be able to help with the machete.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TurtleReportSato_008
Array.english: Looks like there's someone who could use a hand.\nGo on then, take a look.
Array.indonesia: Looks like there's someone who could use a hand.\nGo on then, take a look.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_001
Array.english: Hmm? You want me to sharpen your <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> even more?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? You want me to sharpen your <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> even more?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_002
Array.english: Hmm... from what I can tell, it's already pretty sharp...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... from what I can tell, it's already pretty sharp...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_003
Array.english: Of course, I can make it even sharper.
Array.indonesia: Of course, I can make it even sharper.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_004
Array.english: <size=33>If I had that whetstone...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If I had that whetstone...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_005
Array.english: <size=32>That... whetstone?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That... whetstone?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_006
Array.english: Yes. It's made from a rare, pure white <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color> found in the sea beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Yes. It's made from a rare, pure white <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color> found in the sea beneath the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_007
Array.english: My father passed it down to me... \nbut it's worn down over time and can't be used anymore.
Array.indonesia: My father passed it down to me... \nbut it's worn down over time and can't be used anymore.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_008
Array.english: I see. I can dive down there now, so I'll bring it back if I find it.
Array.indonesia: I see. I can dive down there now, so I'll bring it back if I find it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_TalkToPerak_009
Array.english: Oh... I'd already given up on it...\nIf you can find it, I'd really appreciate it.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I'd already given up on it...\nIf you can find it, I'd really appreciate it.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_FindDeepSeaStone_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... could that white stone be the <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color> Perak mentioned...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... could that white stone be the <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color> Perak mentioned...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_FindDeepSeaStone_002
Array.english: <size=32>I bet I can mine it with a pickaxe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I bet I can mine it with a pickaxe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_PickDeepSeaStone_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright, I got the <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color>.\nLet's take it to Perak!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright, I got the <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color>.\nLet's take it to Perak!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak01_001
Array.english: Here... I found this <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color> in the sea beneath the lake. Is this it?
Array.indonesia: Here... I found this <color=#F1DC2B>Deep-Sea Ore</color> in the sea beneath the lake. Is this it?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak01_002
Array.english: Oh... yes, it is. This white, solid texture... It's the same material as the whetstone my father passed down!
Array.indonesia: Oh... yes, it is. This white, solid texture... It's the same material as the whetstone my father passed down!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak01_003
Array.english: Give me a moment.\nI'll sharpen your machete.
Array.indonesia: Give me a moment.\nI'll sharpen your machete.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak02_001
Array.english: Here you go.\nThis should be enough to cut even thick roots.
Array.indonesia: Here you go.\nThis should be enough to cut even thick roots.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak02_002
Array.english: Oh... thank you!
Array.indonesia: Oh... thank you!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_SeaStoneToPerak02_003
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Alright, I should head back down to where the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> is.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Alright, I should head back down to where the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> is.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BeforeMacheteSato_001
Array.english: Are you looking for a way to sharpen your <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>?
Array.indonesia: Are you looking for a way to sharpen your <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BeforeMacheteSato_002
Array.english: It'd be great if someone in the village could help.
Array.indonesia: It'd be great if someone in the village could help.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AfterMacheteSato_001
Array.english: I managed to sharpen my <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> with some help from the villagers.
Array.indonesia: I managed to sharpen my <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color> with some help from the villagers.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AfterMacheteSato_002
Array.english: <size=32>Wow... excellent!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow... excellent!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_AfterMacheteSato_003
Array.english: ...Then I'll leave the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...\nin your hands.
Array.indonesia: ...Then I'll leave the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>...\nin your hands.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceReturn_001
Array.english: <size=32>There's a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> in here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>There's a <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> in here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceReturn_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's try cutting these roots with the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>!</size>
