Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's try cutting these roots with the <color=#F1DC2B>Machete</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceOpen_001
Array.english: <size=32>Alright! It's definitely cutting well!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright! It's definitely cutting well!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceOpen_002
Array.english: <size=32>So... should I go deeper...?\nI've got a bad feeling about this...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>So... should I go deeper...?\nI've got a bad feeling about this...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_EntranceOpen_003
Array.english: <size=32>Well, how big can a turtle really get?\nBetter catch it quick!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well, how big can a turtle really get?\nBetter catch it quick!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa!! It got this big...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa!! It got this big...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossBattleStart_001
Array.english: <size=34>...Its neck... stretched out so far...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Its neck... stretched out so far...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossBattleStart_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... I don't think I can just catch it and leave...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... I don't think I can just catch it and leave...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossBattleStart_003
Array.english: <size=32>And... it looks pretty angry...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>And... it looks pretty angry...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossBattleStart_004
Array.english: <size=32>No choice. The villagers asked for this...\nI'll have to take it down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>No choice. The villagers asked for this...\nI'll have to take it down!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Fail_001
Array.english: Oh... I should've gone to the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>'s den...
Array.indonesia: Oh... I should've gone to the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>'s den...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Fail_002
Array.english: <size=32>Let's not miss it next time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let's not miss it next time.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BattleComplete_Fail_001
Array.english: <size=32>That thing was seriously tough... I'll need to prepare better and try again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That thing was seriously tough... I'll need to prepare better and try again.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=32>Seeing it again... it's still horrifying...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Seeing it again... it's still horrifying...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=32>It's been disrupting the ecosystem here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It's been disrupting the ecosystem here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_BossEncounter_Retry_003
Array.english: <size=32>I have to take it down no matter what!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I have to take it down no matter what!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_Looting_001
Array.english: Phew... what a bizarre turtle... It was like having a tiny nightmare.
Array.indonesia: Phew... what a bizarre turtle... It was like having a tiny nightmare.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_Looting_002
Array.english: Before I leave...
Array.indonesia: Before I leave...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_Looting_003
Array.english: I should check if there's anything I can take with me.
Array.indonesia: I should check if there's anything I can take with me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_Looting_Barricade_001
Array.english: Before I leave, I should see if there's anything I can take from the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>.
Array.indonesia: Before I leave, I should see if there's anything I can take from the <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_End_ReturnTown_001
Array.english: Alright. Let's head back up and tell Sato.
Array.indonesia: Alright. Let's head back up and tell Sato.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_001
Array.english: Sato, well...
Array.indonesia: Sato, well...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=34>Thanks!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Thanks!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_003
Array.english: ...Huh? I haven't even said anything yet...
Array.indonesia: ...Huh? I haven't even said anything yet...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=33>Woo! I got a notification on my <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> right away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Woo! I got a notification on my <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca Bloom</color> right away!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_005
Array.english: A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> card... this is rare.
Array.indonesia: A <color=#F1DC2B>Snapping turtle</color> card... this is rare.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_006
Array.english: My Marinca collector ranking is gonna shoot up! Heh.
Array.indonesia: My Marinca collector ranking is gonna shoot up! Heh.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_007
Array.english: This village... I really like it here.
Array.indonesia: This village... I really like it here.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_008
Array.english: Feels like I can collect a lot of rare cards here...
Array.indonesia: Feels like I can collect a lot of rare cards here...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_009
Array.english: <size=32>How about I stick around and help out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>How about I stick around and help out?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_010
Array.english: ...Huh? I mean, I'd appreciate the help, but...
Array.indonesia: ...Huh? I mean, I'd appreciate the help, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_011
Array.english: Our research isn't just about fish, you know?
Array.indonesia: Our research isn't just about fish, you know?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_012
Array.english: Haha. When it comes to researching fish, we're already partners!
Array.indonesia: Haha. When it comes to researching fish, we're already partners!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_013
Array.english: Besides...\nI owe Bancho for the meals back at the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: Besides...\nI owe Bancho for the meals back at the Blue Hole.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_014
Array.english: He's still making amazing food here even with limited facilities.
Array.indonesia: He's still making amazing food here even with limited facilities.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_015
Array.english:
If there's anything I can help with at the restaurant,
I'd be happy to... What do you think?
Array.indonesia:
If there's anything I can help with at the restaurant,
I'd be happy to... What do you think?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_016
Array.english: Oh... I'm sure Bancho would really appreciate that.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I'm sure Bancho would really appreciate that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_017
Array.english: Hehe. I won't be collecting Marinca much in the evenings anyway, so I can help out then.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. I won't be collecting Marinca much in the evenings anyway, so I can help out then.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_018
Array.english: Then just let me know whenever you need something.
Array.indonesia: Then just let me know whenever you need something.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Sato_WolfTurtle_Complete_019
Array.english: <size=34>...Monmon.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...Monmon.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hah... hah... so this is it...\nThe place the outsider's running.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hah... hah... so this is it...\nThe place the outsider's running.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_002
Array.english: Oh, are you the farmer who supplies the coconuts and papayas?
Array.indonesia: Oh, are you the farmer who supplies the coconuts and papayas?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_003
Array.english: <size=32>That's right. Name's <color=#F1DC2B>Jepun</color>.\nI run the farm up north.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That's right. Name's <color=#F1DC2B>Jepun</color>.\nI run the farm up north.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_004
Array.english: Don't know what you're here for, but...
Array.indonesia: Don't know what you're here for, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_005
Array.english: <size=33>You're probably here to tell us what we're missing compared to the city... then leave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You're probably here to tell us what we're missing compared to the city... then leave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_006
Array.english: Ah... no. That's not my intention at all...
Array.indonesia: Ah... no. That's not my intention at all...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_007
Array.english: <size=33>The chief asked, so I'll deliver the crops.\nJust stay out of my way.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The chief asked, so I'll deliver the crops.\nJust stay out of my way.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut_008
Array.english: And you'd better appreciate the premium coconuts.\nGrew them with my own blood and sweat.
Array.indonesia: And you'd better appreciate the premium coconuts.\nGrew them with my own blood and sweat.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut02_001
Array.english: Um... he's pretty hostile.
Array.indonesia: Um... he's pretty hostile.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut02_002
Array.english: Just as the chief said, some villagers are wary of outsiders.
Array.indonesia: Just as the chief said, some villagers are wary of outsiders.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut02_003
Array.english: I guess not every outsider treats people here with respect...
Array.indonesia: I guess not every outsider treats people here with respect...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_Jepun_Coconut02_004
Array.english: Still, if we help them with what they need,\nwe might be able to bridge the gap.
Array.indonesia: Still, if we help them with what they need,\nwe might be able to bridge the gap.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodenStatue01_001
Array.english: A peculiar-looking statue.
Array.indonesia: A peculiar-looking statue.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodenStatue02_001
Array.english: It's a tall statue.\nMust've been tough to set up.
Array.indonesia: It's a tall statue.\nMust've been tough to set up.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodenStatue03_001
Array.english: That's a scary-looking statue...
Array.indonesia: That's a scary-looking statue...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodenStatue04_001
Array.english: It's a large face carving... I wonder if it's meant to be an ancestor of the village.
Array.indonesia: It's a large face carving... I wonder if it's meant to be an ancestor of the village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_StoneMalayanTapir_001
Array.english: That long snout is unusual...\nWas it called a Malayan tapir?
Array.indonesia: That long snout is unusual...\nWas it called a Malayan tapir?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodBear01_001
Array.english: It's a wooden bear. Nicely made.
Array.indonesia: It's a wooden bear. Nicely made.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_WoodBear_001
Array.english: It's a wooden bear...\nLooks nicely carved.
Array.indonesia: It's a wooden bear...\nLooks nicely carved.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_StoneStatues01_001
Array.english: What a cute statue.\nIs it supposed to be children?
Array.indonesia: What a cute statue.\nIs it supposed to be children?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_StoneBear01_001
Array.english: I see a lot of bear statues.\nWhat could they mean?
Array.indonesia: I see a lot of bear statues.\nWhat could they mean?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_InteractionObject_StoneBear02_001

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_001
Array.english: <size=35>Come on, hurry up and carve it, Gesang!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Come on, hurry up and carve it, Gesang!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_002
Array.english: <size=33>Don't rush me... I might cut myself...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Don't rush me... I might cut myself...</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_003
Array.english: What are you making?
Array.indonesia: What are you making?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_004
Array.english: <size=32>Say... where you're from, do you have things like <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> challenges?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Say... where you're from, do you have things like <color=#F1DC2B>Animal Block Stacking</color> challenges?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_005
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? What's that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh? What's that?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_006
Array.english: Ah. City folks really are no fun.
Array.indonesia: Ah. City folks really are no fun.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_007
Array.english: You stack animal blocks, and whoever knocks them over loses...
Array.indonesia: You stack animal blocks, and whoever knocks them over loses...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_008
Array.english: A few of mine broke... so I've got <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color> here making me some new ones.
Array.indonesia: A few of mine broke... so I've got <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color> here making me some new ones.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_009
Array.english: <size=32>Figured he could make a little side cash while he's at it... behind his scary wife's back, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Figured he could make a little side cash while he's at it... behind his scary wife's back, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_010
Array.english: <size=34>H-Hey! Don't say stuff like that in front of outsiders!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>H-Hey! Don't say stuff like that in front of outsiders!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_011
Array.english: <size=33>But it's true, isn't it? You can't even buy a few coconut drinks with that tiny allowance.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But it's true, isn't it? You can't even buy a few coconut drinks with that tiny allowance.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_012
Array.english: If word gets out about this... I might not get any allowance at all...
Array.indonesia: If word gets out about this... I might not get any allowance at all...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_013
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Guess it's the same everywhere...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Guess it's the same everywhere...)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_014
Array.english: Outsider, if you're interested in the <color=#1DFEAF>Animal Block Stacking Challenge</color>, come find me in the afternoon.
Array.indonesia: Outsider, if you're interested in the <color=#1DFEAF>Animal Block Stacking Challenge</color>, come find me in the afternoon.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_015
Array.english: <size=33>I tend to sleep in a bit, hahaha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I tend to sleep in a bit, hahaha.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Campfire02_DeepTalk_016
Array.english: <size=33>I'll be by the blocked boulder.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'll be by the blocked boulder.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Muna's looking at something...\nShould I go talk to her?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Muna's looking at something...\nShould I go talk to her?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Talk to her
Array.indonesia: Talk to her

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Leave her be
Array.indonesia: Leave her be

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Did you find anything unusual?
Array.indonesia: Did you find anything unusual?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Oh, Dave. It's nothing major.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave. It's nothing major.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: I was just examining the soil around here.\nJust like in my research, it's quite acidic.
Array.indonesia: I was just examining the soil around here.\nJust like in my research, it's quite acidic.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: It's hard to grow crops in acidic soil.
Array.indonesia: It's hard to grow crops in acidic soil.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: Which means the farmer in the village must be putting in a lot of care.
Array.indonesia: Which means the farmer in the village must be putting in a lot of care.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... so she means that grumpy guy.\nGuess he treats his crops well.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hmm... so she means that grumpy guy.\nGuess he treats his crops well.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: By the way... I heard things got pretty intense with Dr. Bacon in the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: By the way... I heard things got pretty intense with Dr. Bacon in the Blue Hole.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: Yeah. Honestly, I only went because they said I could eat all the sushi I wanted...
Array.indonesia: Yeah. Honestly, I only went because they said I could eat all the sushi I wanted...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_009
Array.english: But it was still fun!\nAnd I made a lot of good friends.
Array.indonesia: But it was still fun!\nAnd I made a lot of good friends.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_010
Array.english: Heh... just seeing the photos, it looked like a blast.\nI'm jealous...
Array.indonesia: Heh... just seeing the photos, it looked like a blast.\nI'm jealous...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_011
Array.english: Next time, take me with you!\nI'll study up a lot!
Array.indonesia: Next time, take me with you!\nI'll study up a lot!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_012
Array.english: Haha, it'd be fun to go together.
Array.indonesia: Haha, it'd be fun to go together.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_StartEvent_013
Array.english: Though hopefully it's not as dangerous as last time.
Array.indonesia: Though hopefully it's not as dangerous as last time.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_NotNow_001
Array.english: (Looks like she's busy, better not bother her...)
Array.indonesia: (Looks like she's busy, better not bother her...)

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Repeat_001
Array.english: The sea people... deep-sea glaciers... giant squid...\nI want to see them too...
Array.indonesia: The sea people... deep-sea glaciers... giant squid...\nI want to see them too...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Muna01_Repeat_002
Array.english: <size=35>I'm jealous...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I'm jealous...</size>

Array.name: RelationEvent_Muna01_SelectText
Array.english: Subject of observation
Array.indonesia: Subject of observation

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hm? Peneb's fixing one of the village sculptures.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Hm? Peneb's fixing one of the village sculptures.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Start_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Should I go talk to him?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Should I go talk to him?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Go talk to him
Array.indonesia: Go talk to him

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Better not disturb him
Array.indonesia: Better not disturb him

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Peneb, are you fixing the sculpture?
Array.indonesia: Peneb, are you fixing the sculpture?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Yeah. Gotta touch it up now and then to keep the shine.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. Gotta touch it up now and then to keep the shine.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: Especially after it rains, you should wipe it down with a soft cloth...
Array.indonesia: Especially after it rains, you should wipe it down with a soft cloth...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: then apply some walnut oil like this to keep it looking good, hehe.
Array.indonesia: then apply some walnut oil like this to keep it looking good, hehe.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: Oh, and to keep pests away... set some fragrant plants nearby and you're all set!
Array.indonesia: Oh, and to keep pests away... set some fragrant plants nearby and you're all set!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: Oh... so you're not just good at making them,\nbut maintaining them too?
Array.indonesia: Oh... so you're not just good at making them,\nbut maintaining them too?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: <size=33>...It's just common sense, nothing special...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...It's just common sense, nothing special...<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: ...Well, I made them myself. So it's only right I take care of them.
Array.indonesia: ...Well, I made them myself. So it's only right I take care of them.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_009
Array.english: Can you imagine how upset my ancestors would be if pests ruined these sculptures?
Array.indonesia: Can you imagine how upset my ancestors would be if pests ruined these sculptures?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_010
Array.english: <size=33>Anyway... was there something you wanted to ask about the sculptures?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Anyway... was there something you wanted to ask about the sculptures?</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_011
Array.english: Oh, now that you mention it...
Array.indonesia: Oh, now that you mention it...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Option01
Array.english: Does this village worship bears?
Array.indonesia: Does this village worship bears?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Option02
Array.english: What's with that scary face carving?
Array.indonesia: What's with that scary face carving?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Bear_001
Array.english: Ah, you mean the Sun Bear. That's right. This village has worshiped bears since ancient times.
Array.indonesia: Ah, you mean the Sun Bear. That's right. This village has worshiped bears since ancient times.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Bear_002
Array.english: The pattern on the Sun Bear's chest glows with a golden light.
Array.indonesia: The pattern on the Sun Bear's chest glows with a golden light.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Bear_003
Array.english: It's seen as a sacred guardian that protects the village, keeping it warm and prosperous
Array.indonesia: It's seen as a sacred guardian that protects the village, keeping it warm and prosperous

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Face_001
Array.english: Ah, that scary face represents an ancient guardian spirit.
Array.indonesia: Ah, that scary face represents an ancient guardian spirit.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Face_002
Array.english: <size=32>Just because they're evil spirits doesn't mean they're fearless!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Just because they're evil spirits doesn't mean they're fearless!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Face_003
Array.english: If there's a carving that fierce watching over the village, they wouldn't dare come near.
Array.indonesia: If there's a carving that fierce watching over the village, they wouldn't dare come near.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Face_004
Array.english: Though... I gotta admit, it still startles me sometimes at night
Array.indonesia: Though... I gotta admit, it still startles me sometimes at night

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Complete_001
Array.english: Phew... I should wrap this up soon and get some rest.
Array.indonesia: Phew... I should wrap this up soon and get some rest.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Complete_002
Array.english: Would be nice if my arm felt better... but if I leave this too long, it won't be fixable later.
Array.indonesia: Would be nice if my arm felt better... but if I leave this too long, it won't be fixable later.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_StartEvent_Complete_003
Array.english: Now that I know what these statues mean, I should appreciate them more.
Array.indonesia: Now that I know what these statues mean, I should appreciate them more.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_NotNow_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(He looks busy, better ask later.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(He looks busy, better ask later.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Repeat_001
Array.english: Still working on it, huh.
Array.indonesia: Still working on it, huh.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Carpenter01_Repeat_002
Array.english: I'm trying to finish it properly, so it's taking a bit longer, hehe.
Array.indonesia: I'm trying to finish it properly, so it's taking a bit longer, hehe.

Array.name: RelationEvent_Carpenter01_SelectText
Array.english: Repairing the statue
Array.indonesia: Repairing the statue

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Basu doesn't seem to be in a good mood.\nShould I ask what's wrong?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Basu doesn't seem to be in a good mood.\nShould I ask what's wrong?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Ask why he's angry
Array.indonesia: Ask why he's angry

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Leave him be
Array.indonesia: Leave him be

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Basu, is something wrong?
Array.indonesia: Basu, is something wrong?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Ah... well, the thing is... I set up some traps to catch new fish...
Array.indonesia: Ah... well, the thing is... I set up some traps to catch new fish...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: <size=33>But them dang crocodiles went and tore 'em all up and took the fish!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But them dang crocodiles went and tore 'em all up and took the fish!!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: They've always been mean, but ever since the quake muddied the water... They've gotten even worse.
Array.indonesia: They've always been mean, but ever since the quake muddied the water... They've gotten even worse.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: Oh, speakin' of which, you said you dive in the ocean,\nright?
Array.indonesia: Oh, speakin' of which, you said you dive in the ocean,\nright?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: Yeah. I taught diving and helped with explorations too.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. I taught diving and helped with explorations too.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: <size=33>Well now, I reckon you've seen sharks before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well now, I reckon you've seen sharks before!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: Say, did you know there are sharks in freshwater too?
Array.indonesia: Say, did you know there are sharks in freshwater too?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01
Array.english: I think I've heard of it
Array.indonesia: I think I've heard of it

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02
Array.english: Never heard of it
Array.indonesia: Never heard of it

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01Answer_001
Array.english: Ah, I think I've heard of it.\nBull shark, right?
Array.indonesia: Ah, I think I've heard of it.\nBull shark, right?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01Answer_002
Array.english: That's the one! Lives in the ocean, but it can swim up rivers.
Array.indonesia: That's the one! Lives in the ocean, but it can swim up rivers.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01Answer_003
Array.english: Heard one even made it all the way up here to Utara Lake...
Array.indonesia: Heard one even made it all the way up here to Utara Lake...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option01Answer_004
Array.english: <size=33>Crocodiles and sharks both? That'd be the worst... \nYou take care now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Crocodiles and sharks both? That'd be the worst... \nYou take care now!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_001
Array.english: A shark that comes up the river... never heard of that before!
Array.indonesia: A shark that comes up the river... never heard of that before!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_002
Array.english: Hehe, it's a species called the bull shark that originally lives in the sea... but it seems they swim up rivers too.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, it's a species called the bull shark that originally lives in the sea... but it seems they swim up rivers too.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_003
Array.english: Someone even spotted one here in Utara Lake...
Array.indonesia: Someone even spotted one here in Utara Lake...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_004
Array.english: Crocodiles and now sharks... makes me want to go in the lake even less.
Array.indonesia: Crocodiles and now sharks... makes me want to go in the lake even less.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_StartEvent_Option02Answer_005
Array.english: <size=34>You be careful too.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You be careful too.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_NotNow_001
Array.english: He's in a bad mood...\nbetter leave him alone.
Array.indonesia: He's in a bad mood...\nbetter leave him alone.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Repeat_001
Array.english: Ugh... these damn crocodiles... my precious fish...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... these damn crocodiles... my precious fish...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Fisherman01_Repeat_002
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Ah... he mentioned earlier that crocodiles ate all the fish in his trap.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Ah... he mentioned earlier that crocodiles ate all the fish in his trap.)</color>

Array.name: RelationEvent_Fisherman01_SelectText
Array.english: Reason for anger
Array.indonesia: Reason for anger

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Start_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(What is she doing by the door?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(What is she doing by the door?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Start_Option01
Array.english: Ask her
Array.indonesia: Ask her

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Start_Option02
Array.english: Leave it
Array.indonesia: Leave it

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_001
Array.english: Chandra, what are you doing by the door?
Array.indonesia: Chandra, what are you doing by the door?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_002
Array.english: Oh, it's nothing much. I'm just watching my husband <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color> in case he tries to sneak out at night.
Array.indonesia: Oh, it's nothing much. I'm just watching my husband <color=#F1DC2B>Gesang</color> in case he tries to sneak out at night.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_003
Array.english: <size=33>He got caught sneaking out once before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>He got caught sneaking out once before!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_004
Array.english: He was off gambling with... that guy, Harta, I think?
Array.indonesia: He was off gambling with... that guy, Harta, I think?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_005
Array.english: Hmm. He's an adult though. Shouldn't he have some free time?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. He's an adult though. Shouldn't he have some free time?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_006
Array.english: <size=34>What are you talking about?!\nFamily comes first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What are you talking about?!\nFamily comes first!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_007
Array.english: And besides, he's so handsome, other women might hit on him...
Array.indonesia: And besides, he's so handsome, other women might hit on him...

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_StartEvent_008
Array.english: <size=34>Right? Isn't my husband handsome?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Right? Isn't my husband handsome?</size>

Array.name: RelationEvent_Chandra01_Option01
Array.english: Yeah. Really handsome
Array.indonesia: Yeah. Really handsome

Array.name: RelationEvent_Chandra01_Option02
Array.english: Hmm... I didn't notice
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I didn't notice

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_001
Array.english: <size=32>O-Of course! He's incredibly handsome.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>O-Of course! He's incredibly handsome.</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_002
Array.english: <size=33>Ohoho! See? I knew it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ohoho! See? I knew it!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_003
Array.english: Even when I'm mad, one look at his face and it all just melts away!
Array.indonesia: Even when I'm mad, one look at his face and it all just melts away!

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_004
Array.english: So even outsiders can see it. I really married well.
Array.indonesia: So even outsiders can see it. I really married well.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Happy_005
Array.english: <size=33>Or rather, he's the one who married well, right? Ohoho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Or rather, he's the one who married well, right? Ohoho!</size>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_001
Array.english: Hmm... I'm not sure...\nI've never really thought about it.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I'm not sure...\nI've never really thought about it.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_002
Array.english: Wow... you really have no taste.
Array.indonesia: Wow... you really have no taste.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_003
Array.english: Outsiders have such strange taste... honestly.
Array.indonesia: Outsiders have such strange taste... honestly.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_004
Array.english: Haven't you noticed all the women in the village sneaking glances at him?
Array.indonesia: Haven't you noticed all the women in the village sneaking glances at him?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_005
Array.english: Especially that Lipah... that sly little thing.\nAlways smiling like that.
Array.indonesia: Especially that Lipah... that sly little thing.\nAlways smiling like that.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_006
Array.english: Anyway, if you ever see my husband doing anything suspicious, tell me. Got it?
Array.indonesia: Anyway, if you ever see my husband doing anything suspicious, tell me. Got it?

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotHappy_007
Array.english: Yeah... if I notice anything.
Array.indonesia: Yeah... if I notice anything.

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_NotNow_001
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(Better not ask.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Better not ask.)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Chandra01_Repeat_001

Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(Huh? What kind of exercise is she doing?)</color>

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_Start_Option01

Array.name: Dialogue_RelationEvent_Princessy01_Start_Option02
