Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleEnding_001
Array.english: I was able to study many recipes in the jungle.
Array.indonesia: I was able to study many recipes in the jungle.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleEnding_002
Array.english: But... without the same ingredients, it's hard to recreate those flavors here.
Array.indonesia: But... without the same ingredients, it's hard to recreate those flavors here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleEnding_003
Array.english: It seems the finest recipes truly call for the finest ingredients.
Array.indonesia: It seems the finest recipes truly call for the finest ingredients.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleReturn_001
Array.english: I must say, I'm still a bit more at home with ingredients from the sea.
Array.indonesia: I must say, I'm still a bit more at home with ingredients from the sea.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleReturn_002
Array.english: Of course, cooking with freshwater fish and fruit has been a great learning experience.
Array.indonesia: Of course, cooking with freshwater fish and fruit has been a great learning experience.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Bancho_JungleReturn_003
Array.english: I ought to take my time and study it while I'm at the village.
Array.indonesia: I ought to take my time and study it while I'm at the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Basu_BullSharkAppear_001
Array.english: Come to think of it... ever since ya took down Sulong, I been seein' fish carcasses floatin' up all chewed to bits.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it... ever since ya took down Sulong, I been seein' fish carcasses floatin' up all chewed to bits.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Basu_BullSharkAppear_002
Array.english: Could be that shark's roamin' around again now that its predator's gone.
Array.indonesia: Could be that shark's roamin' around again now that its predator's gone.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Basu_BullSharkAppear_003
Array.english: Them two species got similar habits. Both come out around sundown and all.
Array.indonesia: Them two species got similar habits. Both come out around sundown and all.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Basu_BullSharkAppear_004
Array.english: Just in case, be careful headin' into the lake come evenin'.
Array.indonesia: Just in case, be careful headin' into the lake come evenin'.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_001
Array.english: Come to think of it...
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_002
Array.english: How did you escape from the lake with your arm injured like that?
Array.indonesia: How did you escape from the lake with your arm injured like that?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=32>Ah! Well, you see...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah! Well, you see...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>So that's what happened...\nI feel like I caused everyone a lot of trouble.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>So that's what happened...\nI feel like I caused everyone a lot of trouble.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_002
Array.english: <size=32>Don't be so hard on yourself! The villagers were overjoyed to see you safe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Don't be so hard on yourself! The villagers were overjoyed to see you safe.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_003
Array.english: <size=32>The hero who saved the village from crisis had returned, after all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The hero who saved the village from crisis had returned, after all!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_004
Array.english: <size=32>Hehe... that's a little embarrassing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hehe... that's a little embarrassing.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_005
Array.english: <size=32>Cobra... the villagers... I'm just so grateful to you all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Cobra... the villagers... I'm just so grateful to you all.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_006
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Anyone would've done the same in my place!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Anyone would've done the same in my place!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_End_007
Array.english: <size=34>You're Dave, the diver we all love, after all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You're Dave, the diver we all love, after all.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene01_001
Array.english: <size=33>The moment she saw I was hurt...\nUzme jumped right into the lake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The moment she saw I was hurt...\nUzme jumped right into the lake!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene02_001
Array.english: <size=32>She swam over to me at incredible speed...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>She swam over to me at incredible speed...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_001
Array.english: <size=33>And knocked out all the crocodiles with her bare fists!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>And knocked out all the crocodiles with her bare fists!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_002
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa... Uzme is incredible...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Whoa... Uzme is incredible...!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_003
Array.english: <size=32>Come to think of it, she did say she trained to protect herself from the crocodiles.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Come to think of it, she did say she trained to protect herself from the crocodiles.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_004
Array.english: <size=32>She showed up right when I thought it was truly over. I couldn't have been more grateful...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>She showed up right when I thought it was truly over. I couldn't have been more grateful...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_005
Array.english: <size=32>But it was just too much for Uzme to drag the both of us out on her own.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But it was just too much for Uzme to drag the both of us out on her own.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene03_006
Array.english: <size=32>And just as the downed crocodiles started creeping back toward us...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>And just as the downed crocodiles started creeping back toward us...</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene04_001
Array.english: <size=32>The village blacksmith, <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>, threw us a rope!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The village blacksmith, <color=#F1DC2B>Perak</color>, threw us a rope!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_EndingTalk02_Scene05_001
Array.english: <size=32>Uzme held on tight to the rope...\nand the villagers pulled with all their might.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Uzme held on tight to the rope...\nand the villagers pulled with all their might.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleEnding_001
Array.english: Being alone on the boat makes me miss the hustle and bustle of Utara Village.
Array.indonesia: Being alone on the boat makes me miss the hustle and bustle of Utara Village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleEnding_002
Array.english: Right? It feels empty without Rimbo's hearty laugh or the sound of Jaka's Panting.
Array.indonesia: Right? It feels empty without Rimbo's hearty laugh or the sound of Jaka's Panting.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleEnding_003
Array.english: We can head back anytime, so let's go visit again when we've got time!
Array.indonesia: We can head back anytime, so let's go visit again when we've got time!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleReturn_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hahaha! Nothing beats the cool weather here in the Blue Hole!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hahaha! Nothing beats the cool weather here in the Blue Hole!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleReturn_002
Array.english: Right? It did get pretty hot in Utara Village during the day.
Array.indonesia: Right? It did get pretty hot in Utara Village during the day.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Cobra_JungleReturn_003
Array.english: Though I guess that's why so many tasty fruits grow there.
Array.indonesia: Though I guess that's why so many tasty fruits grow there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! You folks are back now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! You folks are back now?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_002
Array.english: Yes. Our research in the jungle village is all done.
Array.indonesia: Yes. Our research in the jungle village is all done.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_003
Array.english: Did somethin' bad happen out there?\nThat Cobra fella's arm...
Array.indonesia: Did somethin' bad happen out there?\nThat Cobra fella's arm...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_004
Array.english: Yes... There were some dangerous moments...\nCobra got hurt trying to save me.
Array.indonesia: Yes... There were some dangerous moments...\nCobra got hurt trying to save me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_005
Array.english: My my... That's a real shame.\nDon't you go blamin' yourself too much.
Array.indonesia: My my... That's a real shame.\nDon't you go blamin' yourself too much.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_006
Array.english: Still, that fella was drinkin' his beer as cheerful as ever.
Array.indonesia: Still, that fella was drinkin' his beer as cheerful as ever.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_007
Array.english: <size=33>Looked like he had a mighty good time travelin' with ya!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Looked like he had a mighty good time travelin' with ya!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_008
Array.english: Havin' a good partner is a real blessin', for you and for him both.
Array.indonesia: Havin' a good partner is a real blessin', for you and for him both.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_009
Array.english: If you feel sorry about somethin', you just treat each other better from now on! Ya got that?
Array.indonesia: If you feel sorry about somethin', you just treat each other better from now on! Ya got that?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleEnding_010
Array.english: You're right.\nWhat matters more is being better to each other from now on.
Array.indonesia: You're right.\nWhat matters more is being better to each other from now on.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_001
Array.english: Ha! I was wonderin' why I hadn't seen you folks around...
Array.indonesia: Ha! I was wonderin' why I hadn't seen you folks around...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_002
Array.english: Heard ya went off to some jungle far away. Is that true?
Array.indonesia: Heard ya went off to some jungle far away. Is that true?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_003
Array.english: Yes. We went to help Dr. Bacon with his research,\nso we've been staying over there.
Array.indonesia: Yes. We went to help Dr. Bacon with his research,\nso we've been staying over there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_004
Array.english: Whew... The weather there must be awful muggy.
Array.indonesia: Whew... The weather there must be awful muggy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_005
Array.english: Come to think of it, I've been in a tropical rainforest myself once!
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, I've been in a tropical rainforest myself once!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_006
Array.english: My buddies talked me into it, sayin' there was treasure hidden in some old ruins...
Array.indonesia: My buddies talked me into it, sayin' there was treasure hidden in some old ruins...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_007
Array.english: But then... on the way, I tripped over this huge log and fell flat...
Array.indonesia: But then... on the way, I tripped over this huge log and fell flat...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_008
Array.english: <size=33>Turns out it was one enormous anaconda!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Turns out it was one enormous anaconda!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_009
Array.english: <size=33>So I just socked it right on the snout...\nPOW! And it started backin' away real slow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>So I just socked it right on the snout...\nPOW! And it started backin' away real slow!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_010
Array.english: <color=#E3E3E3>(...It's been a while since I heard one of Otto's stories. Pretty fun, actually.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#E3E3E3>(...It's been a while since I heard one of Otto's stories. Pretty fun, actually.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Otto_JungleReturn_011
Array.english: <size=32>Anyway, I'm takin' good care of the farm, so don't you worry one bit!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Anyway, I'm takin' good care of the farm, so don't you worry one bit!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_001
Array.english: Hey, Dave! You're back!
Array.indonesia: Hey, Dave! You're back!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_002
Array.english: It was hella boring around the Blue Hole without you three, you know.
Array.indonesia: It was hella boring around the Blue Hole without you three, you know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_003
Array.english: It was straight-up... a roar in the silence, a need for defiance... YEAH!
Array.indonesia: It was straight-up... a roar in the silence, a need for defiance... YEAH!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_004
Array.english: Haha. You've still got that vibe going, Sammy.
Array.indonesia: Haha. You've still got that vibe going, Sammy.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_005
Array.english: I heard a whole lot went down out there.\nThe jungle sounds like one dangerous place, yo.
Array.indonesia: I heard a whole lot went down out there.\nThe jungle sounds like one dangerous place, yo.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_006
Array.english: Someday I wanna turn your story into a song, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Someday I wanna turn your story into a song, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_007
Array.english: For the title, I'll channel how it felt steppin' into the jungle for the first time... Welcome to the...
Array.indonesia: For the title, I'll channel how it felt steppin' into the jungle for the first time... Welcome to the...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleEnding_008
Array.english: Ah... A title like that is gonna land you in big trouble later...!
Array.indonesia: Ah... A title like that is gonna land you in big trouble later...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleReturn_001
Array.english: Hey, what's up! Long time no see, Dave!
Array.indonesia: Hey, what's up! Long time no see, Dave!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleReturn_002
Array.english: Yeah. I've been staying in a jungle village far away.\nJust stopped by for a bit.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. I've been staying in a jungle village far away.\nJust stopped by for a bit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleReturn_003
Array.english: Haha! I bet you came 'cause you were worried about the farm, right?
Array.indonesia: Haha! I bet you came 'cause you were worried about the farm, right?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Sammy_JungleReturn_004
Array.english: No worries.\nMe and my pops are taking real good care of it! YEAH.
Array.indonesia: No worries.\nMe and my pops are taking real good care of it! YEAH.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_01_001
Array.english: Nothing's as fun as fishing.
Array.indonesia: Nothing's as fun as fishing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_01_002
Array.english: You never know what you'll catch! That thrill gets me every time!
Array.indonesia: You never know what you'll catch! That thrill gets me every time!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_02_001
Array.english: I heard humans can't stay underwater for long.
Array.indonesia: I heard humans can't stay underwater for long.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_02_002
Array.english: We Surs can stay in the water forever!
Array.indonesia: We Surs can stay in the water forever!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Barung_02_003
Array.english: Though there's no avoiding getting hungry...
Array.indonesia: Though there's no avoiding getting hungry...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Basarr_01_001
Array.english: Hehe... I want some tasty fruit.
Array.indonesia: Hehe... I want some tasty fruit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Basarr_02_001
Array.english: Being underwater felt so stuffy.\nThe village really is better.
Array.indonesia: Being underwater felt so stuffy.\nThe village really is better.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Danu_01_001
Array.english: Aren't you the human who saved me back then?
Array.indonesia: Aren't you the human who saved me back then?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Danu_01_002
Array.english: I was hiding from the crocodile, but...\ncome to think of it, crocodiles can't even see us!
Array.indonesia: I was hiding from the crocodile, but...\ncome to think of it, crocodiles can't even see us!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Danu_02_001
Array.english: There are lots of fish here in Utara Lake.
Array.indonesia: There are lots of fish here in Utara Lake.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Danu_02_002
Array.english: Coming down to watch them once in a while is pretty fun, too.
Array.indonesia: Coming down to watch them once in a while is pretty fun, too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_01_001
Array.english: I'd only heard legends about the Sea People living deep in the lake.
Array.indonesia: I'd only heard legends about the Sea People living deep in the lake.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_01_002
Array.english: Seeing it in person was absolutely amazing.
Array.indonesia: Seeing it in person was absolutely amazing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_01_003
Array.english: <size=32>The Sea People's chief especially was so dignified!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The Sea People's chief especially was so dignified!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_01_004
Array.english: ...Until he started talking, that is.
Array.indonesia: ...Until he started talking, that is.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_02_001
Array.english: The Sea People here in the lake are really good with weapons.
Array.indonesia: The Sea People here in the lake are really good with weapons.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Karang_02_002
Array.english: I saw them hunting fish, and they were so quick!
Array.indonesia: I saw them hunting fish, and they were so quick!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Kicco_01_001
Array.english: You know how the crops in this village grow super fast, right?
Array.indonesia: You know how the crops in this village grow super fast, right?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Kicco_01_002
Array.english: That's because we Surs keep looking after them! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: That's because we Surs keep looking after them! Hehe.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Kicco_02_001
Array.english: It's great to be back and see my friends again.\nThe village really is the best.
Array.indonesia: It's great to be back and see my friends again.\nThe village really is the best.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Kicco_02_002
Array.english: I heard the terrain there keeps changing…\nEven spirits would get confused by that!
Array.indonesia: I heard the terrain there keeps changing…\nEven spirits would get confused by that!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Luu_01_001
Array.english: Hehe. I love this village. There's so much tasty food here.
Array.indonesia: Hehe. I love this village. There's so much tasty food here.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Luu_01_002
Array.english: The fruit especially tastes absolutely amazing.
Array.indonesia: The fruit especially tastes absolutely amazing.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Luu_02_001
Array.english: Being stuck in the lake with no fruit to eat was rough.
Array.indonesia: Being stuck in the lake with no fruit to eat was rough.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Luu_02_002
Array.english: Thanks for saving me, human.
Array.indonesia: Thanks for saving me, human.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mahesa_01_001
Array.english: I don't know why I'm so sleepy all day...
Array.indonesia: I don't know why I'm so sleepy all day...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mahesa_01_002
Array.english: Listening to the sound of the falls always puts me to sleep...
Array.indonesia: Listening to the sound of the falls always puts me to sleep...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mahesa_02_001
Array.english: Drifting along the currents in the lake was really fun.
Array.indonesia: Drifting along the currents in the lake was really fun.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mahesa_02_002
Array.english: I totally forgot I was supposed to go back to the village...!
Array.indonesia: I totally forgot I was supposed to go back to the village...!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_01_001
Array.english: We have protected this region for a very long time.
Array.indonesia: We have protected this region for a very long time.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_01_002
Array.english: And yet we never knew there was such a huge passage beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: And yet we never knew there was such a huge passage beneath the lake.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_01_003
Array.english: Thank you for warding off a great misfortune.
Array.indonesia: Thank you for warding off a great misfortune.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_001
Array.english: You lot seem to have come from a faraway land, yes?
Array.indonesia: You lot seem to have come from a faraway land, yes?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_002
Array.english: Yes. Strange phenomena started happening in this region, so we came to investigate.
Array.indonesia: Yes. Strange phenomena started happening in this region, so we came to investigate.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_003
Array.english: The energy here was unstable, but it has settled greatly since you all arrived.
Array.indonesia: The energy here was unstable, but it has settled greatly since you all arrived.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_004
Array.english: You've come a long way. Well done, all of you.
Array.indonesia: You've come a long way. Well done, all of you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_005
Array.english: I'm just glad we could be of some help to this village.
Array.indonesia: I'm just glad we could be of some help to this village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Marula_02_006
Array.english: Heh. For a human from foreign lands, you have a good heart.\nI like you.
Array.indonesia: Heh. For a human from foreign lands, you have a good heart.\nI like you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_01_001
Array.english: I only just learned that fruit doesn't grow in the lake.
Array.indonesia: I only just learned that fruit doesn't grow in the lake.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_01_002
Array.english: I searched forever, and all I found were water chestnuts.
Array.indonesia: I searched forever, and all I found were water chestnuts.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_01_003
Array.english: Land fruit really suits my taste best.
Array.indonesia: Land fruit really suits my taste best.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_02_001
Array.english: If you need anything from the forest, just say the word.
Array.indonesia: If you need anything from the forest, just say the word.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Mutu_02_002
Array.english: I'll taste it first to check for poison, so don't you worry!
Array.indonesia: I'll taste it first to check for poison, so don't you worry!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Segera_01_001
Array.english: It's a shame I didn't get to see the shark with the anvil, but...
Array.indonesia: It's a shame I didn't get to see the shark with the anvil, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Segera_01_002
Array.english: Still, I'm glad I made it back to the village.
Array.indonesia: Still, I'm glad I made it back to the village.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Segera_02_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, I saw a pointy shell in the sea beneath the lake.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, I saw a pointy shell in the sea beneath the lake.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Segera_02_002
Array.english: It looked like a spear...\nbut it had legs and moved around!
Array.indonesia: It looked like a spear...\nbut it had legs and moved around!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Semak_01_001
Array.english: Shh. Keep it down!
Array.indonesia: Shh. Keep it down!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Semak_01_002
Array.english: Someone might be listening in on us.
Array.indonesia: Someone might be listening in on us.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Semak_02_001
Array.english: If you need anything from the forest, let me know.
Array.indonesia: If you need anything from the forest, let me know.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Semak_02_002
Array.english: I'll sneak in and grab it before anyone even notices.
Array.indonesia: I'll sneak in and grab it before anyone even notices.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_LastSpirit_001
Array.english: Looks like I've rescued all 9 of the lost spirits.
Array.indonesia: Looks like I've rescued all 9 of the lost spirits.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_LastSpirit_002
Array.english: Once I'm back up, I should stop by <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color>.
Array.indonesia: Once I'm back up, I should stop by <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Undu_01_001
Array.english: Thanks for saving me from the lake.
Array.indonesia: Thanks for saving me from the lake.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Undu_01_002
Array.english: It was way deeper than I expected, what a shock...\nI saw a dinosaur corpse down there.
Array.indonesia: It was way deeper than I expected, what a shock...\nI saw a dinosaur corpse down there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Undu_02_001
Array.english: I'm 350 years old, but I'd never seen the creatures at the bottom of the lake before.
Array.indonesia: I'm 350 years old, but I'd never seen the creatures at the bottom of the lake before.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Undu_02_002
Array.english: There's still so much I don't know about the world.
Array.indonesia: There's still so much I don't know about the world.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Wulan_01_001
Array.english: The lake was really scary...
Array.indonesia: The lake was really scary...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Wulan_01_002
Array.english: Thanks for saving me...\nIf you hadn't, I'd still be stuck in that clam.
Array.indonesia: Thanks for saving me...\nIf you hadn't, I'd still be stuck in that clam.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Wulan_02_001
Array.english: I'm never going into the lake again.
Array.indonesia: I'm never going into the lake again.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Spirit_Wulan_02_002
Array.english: But here in the village, feel free to ask me for anything.
Array.indonesia: But here in the village, feel free to ask me for anything.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_001
Array.english: Ah, come to think of it, I haven't told you about <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> yet.
Array.indonesia: Ah, come to think of it, I haven't told you about <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> yet.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_002
Array.english: Beetles absolutely love <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color>.
Array.indonesia: Beetles absolutely love <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_003
Array.english: If you give <color=#F1DC2B>Insect jelly</color> to a fainted beetle, it'll recover in no time.
Array.indonesia: If you give <color=#F1DC2B>Insect jelly</color> to a fainted beetle, it'll recover in no time.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_004
Array.english: There's also <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> you can use during battle.
Array.indonesia: There's also <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> you can use during battle.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_005
Array.english: Some power up your type... others boost your defense...
Array.indonesia: Some power up your type... others boost your defense...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_006
Array.english: I've got some <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> with me, so I'll share a few with you.
Array.indonesia: I've got some <color=#F1DC2B>Jelly</color> with me, so I'll share a few with you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_007
Array.english: Just let me know if you need more!
Array.indonesia: Just let me know if you need more!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_JDLC_Udo_ShopOpen_008
Array.english: <size=32>...I'll give you a good price, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>...I'll give you a good price, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_015
Array.english: With that fierce predator gone, the <color=#F1DC2B>Bull Sharks</color> that were hiding may start roaming about.
Array.indonesia: With that fierce predator gone, the <color=#F1DC2B>Bull Sharks</color> that were hiding may start roaming about.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_016
Array.english: They're also active when the sun sets.\nThat's probably how that one got caught by Sulong.
Array.indonesia: They're also active when the sun sets.\nThat's probably how that one got caught by Sulong.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_25_Sulong_End_017
Array.english: <size=32>Just in case, do be careful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Just in case, do be careful.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FastMove_001
Array.english: A boar attacked Rimbo's truck...
Array.indonesia: A boar attacked Rimbo's truck...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FastMove_002
Array.english: Better not call the truck into the forest for now.
Array.indonesia: Better not call the truck into the forest for now.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FindFootPrint_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Are these boar tracks...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Are these boar tracks...?!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FindFootPrint_002
Array.english: If we follow the tracks...\nwe might find the boar!
Array.indonesia: If we follow the tracks...\nwe might find the boar!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_FindFootPrint_003
Array.english: You'd best be well prepared before you head in...
Array.indonesia: You'd best be well prepared before you head in...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_GetTusk_001
Array.english: That <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> is enormous...!
Array.indonesia: That <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> is enormous...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_GetTusk_002
Array.english: I can't believe it was attacking us with this...
Array.indonesia: I can't believe it was attacking us with this...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_GetTusk_003
Array.english: <size=33>Let's go see Rimbo now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let's go see Rimbo now!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_GetTusk_Barricade_001
Array.english: Oh, why don't we take that broken <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> with us?
Array.indonesia: Oh, why don't we take that broken <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> with us?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Meet_001
Array.english: <size=33>Aah...! It's that boar that chased us at the temple...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aah...! It's that boar that chased us at the temple...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Meet_002
Array.english: <size=33>It looks really, really angry...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It looks really, really angry...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Meet_003
Array.english: <size=32>We'd better calm it down before it does any more damage to the village...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>We'd better calm it down before it does any more damage to the village...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Meet_004
Array.english: <size=34>Stay focused, everyone!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Stay focused, everyone!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Morning_001
Array.english: Hm? Rimbo, what's the matter?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Rimbo, what's the matter?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Morning_002
Array.english: Well... ya remember that boar that fell off the cliff, don'tcha?
Array.indonesia: Well... ya remember that boar that fell off the cliff, don'tcha?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Morning_003
Array.english: Looks like that fella's still alive and kickin'.
Array.indonesia: Looks like that fella's still alive and kickin'.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Morning_004
Array.english: <size=32>Come on over here for a sec.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Come on over here for a sec.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_NightNoise_001
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? I thought I heard a loud noise...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Huh? I thought I heard a loud noise...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_NightNoise_002
Array.english: <size=32>Was it just a dream...? I should get back to sleep...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Was it just a dream...? I should get back to sleep...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=34>It's that giant boar...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It's that giant boar...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Retry_002
Array.english: <size=32>This time, we'll send it back home for good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>This time, we'll send it back home for good!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Retry_003
Array.english: <size=32>Watch out for its charge attacks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Watch out for its charge attacks!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Here ya go.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Here ya go.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk02_002
Array.english: Oh... it looks great...!
Array.indonesia: Oh... it looks great...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=33>I'll hang it up in front of my house as a keepsake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'll hang it up in front of my house as a keepsake!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_001
Array.english: We took down the giant boar in Setah Forest.\nIt won't be coming down to the forest anymore.
Array.indonesia: We took down the giant boar in Setah Forest.\nIt won't be coming down to the forest anymore.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... mighty fine work!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... mighty fine work!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_003
Array.english: <size=33>I got the truck all fixed up in the meantime, too.\nJust give me a holler whenever ya need a ride through the forest!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I got the truck all fixed up in the meantime, too.\nJust give me a holler whenever ya need a ride through the forest!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_004
Array.english: Oh, right! I brought back the boar's <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color>.\nNot sure what to do with it, though.
Array.indonesia: Oh, right! I brought back the boar's <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color>.\nNot sure what to do with it, though.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_005
Array.english: My, that's a big one!\nSomethin' this size'd look better hangin' outside the house than in.
Array.indonesia: My, that's a big one!\nSomethin' this size'd look better hangin' outside the house than in.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_RimboTalk_006
Array.english: Lemme fix it up for ya real nice, haha.
Array.indonesia: Lemme fix it up for ya real nice, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Take a look at this here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Take a look at this here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_002
Array.english: <size=32>The headlights are completely wrecked!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The headlights are completely wrecked!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_003
Array.english: Somethin' came and rammed into it durin' the night...\nJudgin' by the marks, looks like boar tusks to me.
Array.indonesia: Somethin' came and rammed into it durin' the night...\nJudgin' by the marks, looks like boar tusks to me.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_004
Array.english: The truck I can fix up later...\nBut with that boar all riled up, drivin' through <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> ain't gonna be easy.
Array.indonesia: The truck I can fix up later...\nBut with that boar all riled up, drivin' through <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> ain't gonna be easy.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_005
Array.english: If I take this truck in there, that thing's sure to ram it again.
Array.indonesia: If I take this truck in there, that thing's sure to ram it again.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_006
Array.english: Yeah, probably...
Array.indonesia: Yeah, probably...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_007
Array.english: And it might come back to attack the village again, too.
Array.indonesia: And it might come back to attack the village again, too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_008
Array.english: I'll head into <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> with Cobra and Muna and check things out.
Array.indonesia: I'll head into <color=#1DFEAF>Setah Forest</color> with Cobra and Muna and check things out.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_009
Array.english: <size=32>If that boar comes at us, we'll teach it a lesson and send it right back home!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If that boar comes at us, we'll teach it a lesson and send it right back home!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_010
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... that's mighty reassurin'. \nMuch obliged if ya could!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... that's mighty reassurin'. \nMuch obliged if ya could!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_011
Array.english: I'm countin' on ya, Dave.
Array.indonesia: I'm countin' on ya, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Start_012
Array.english: Oh, and unlike the forest trail, the path to the <color=#F1DC2B>beach</color> is safe. Just say the word if ya need it!
Array.indonesia: Oh, and unlike the forest trail, the path to the <color=#F1DC2B>beach</color> is safe. Just say the word if ya need it!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_001
Array.english: Phew... I think we sent it back home safely...
Array.indonesia: Phew... I think we sent it back home safely...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_002
Array.english: It probably won't come down to the forest anymore.
Array.indonesia: It probably won't come down to the forest anymore.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_003
Array.english: Now we can get around in Rimbo's truck again!
Array.indonesia: Now we can get around in Rimbo's truck again!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_004
Array.english: Oh, there's a <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> on the ground. It must've broken off during the fight.
Array.indonesia: Oh, there's a <color=#1DFEAF>Tusk</color> on the ground. It must've broken off during the fight.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLCSideMission_WildBoar_Win_005
Array.english: <size=33>I'll take it as a souvenir, hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'll take it as a souvenir, hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_001
Array.english: Oh... do I feel somehow lighter?
Array.indonesia: Oh... do I feel somehow lighter?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_002
Array.english: Now you can carry one more <color=#F1DC2B>charm</color> with you.
Array.indonesia: Now you can carry one more <color=#F1DC2B>charm</color> with you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=32>Whoa... so that's what spirit powers can do...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Whoa... so that's what spirit powers can do...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=34>Thank you so much!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Thank you so much!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_005
Array.english: Heh heh... using our powers for things like this is what makes them worthwhile.
Array.indonesia: Heh heh... using our powers for things like this is what makes them worthwhile.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_006
Array.english: Well then, we'll be right here. Come visit anytime.
Array.indonesia: Well then, we'll be right here. Come visit anytime.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_007
Array.english: Once again, thank you for saving our village, human.
Array.indonesia: Once again, thank you for saving our village, human.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=32>Wherever you go, never lose that warm heart of yours.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wherever you go, never lose that warm heart of yours.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_001
Array.english: Thanks to you, all the Surs made it back to the village safely.
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you, all the Surs made it back to the village safely.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_002
Array.english: As I told you...\nwe Surs have long watched over this region.
Array.indonesia: As I told you...\nwe Surs have long watched over this region.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_003
Array.english: So that this land stays bountiful...
Array.indonesia: So that this land stays bountiful...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_004
Array.english: and the people of Utara Village stay healthy...
Array.indonesia: and the people of Utara Village stay healthy...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_005
Array.english: we'll keep watching over you and helping from behind the scenes.
Array.indonesia: we'll keep watching over you and helping from behind the scenes.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_006
Array.english: So don't worry too much, whenever you may leave.
Array.indonesia: So don't worry too much, whenever you may leave.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_007
Array.english: Knowing the spirits are protecting them puts my mind at ease too.
Array.indonesia: Knowing the spirits are protecting them puts my mind at ease too.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_008
Array.english: They're truly wonderful people.\nPlease keep looking after them.
Array.indonesia: They're truly wonderful people.\nPlease keep looking after them.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_009
Array.english: Heh. You truly are a human worthy of the villagers' deep trust.
Array.indonesia: Heh. You truly are a human worthy of the villagers' deep trust.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_010
Array.english: But... accepting such great help and doing nothing in return? That is not our tradition.
Array.indonesia: But... accepting such great help and doing nothing in return? That is not our tradition.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_011
Array.english: We'd like to combine our powers and awaken a new ability in you.
Array.indonesia: We'd like to combine our powers and awaken a new ability in you.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindAllSpirits_012
Array.english: <size=33>Come over here for a moment.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Come over here for a moment.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindBasarr_001
Array.english: Ohh... how did you know I was here, human?
Array.indonesia: Ohh... how did you know I was here, human?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindBasarr_002
Array.english: I smelled a saltwater crocodile and came looking, but then I got lost...
Array.indonesia: I smelled a saltwater crocodile and came looking, but then I got lost...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindBasarr_003
Array.english: And now the crocodile's gone too...\nI want to go home...
Array.indonesia: And now the crocodile's gone too...\nI want to go home...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindDanu_001
Array.english: Did you see the black crocodile that was around here?
Array.indonesia: Did you see the black crocodile that was around here?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindDanu_002
Array.english: It looked scarier than I expected, so I was hiding...\nHelp me get out of here!
Array.indonesia: It looked scarier than I expected, so I was hiding...\nHelp me get out of here!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindKarang_001
Array.english: Whoa... so that's the Sea People's chief...!
Array.indonesia: Whoa... so that's the Sea People's chief...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindKarang_002
Array.english: It's huge...!
Array.indonesia: It's huge...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindKarang_003
Array.english: Oh, everyone's waiting up top?\nGot it... I should head up soon.
Array.indonesia: Oh, everyone's waiting up top?\nGot it... I should head up soon.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMahesa_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? Did you come looking for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? Did you come looking for me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMahesa_002
Array.english: I was just playing, riding the currents like a slide...
Array.indonesia: I was just playing, riding the currents like a slide...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMahesa_003
Array.english: Oh, I'll head back now, so not a word to Elder Marula!
Array.indonesia: Oh, I'll head back now, so not a word to Elder Marula!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMutu_001
Array.english: I was looking around for something to eat and got lost...
Array.indonesia: I was looking around for something to eat and got lost...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMutu_002
Array.english: I don't really know where the others went.
Array.indonesia: I don't really know where the others went.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindMutu_003
Array.english: I'm hungry now, so I'm heading back to the village!
Array.indonesia: I'm hungry now, so I'm heading back to the village!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_001
Array.english: Hmm... it should be right around here...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... it should be right around here...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_002
Array.english: What are you looking for?
Array.indonesia: What are you looking for?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_003
Array.english: I heard there's a shark with an anvil on its back...\nWhy isn't it here...?
Array.indonesia: I heard there's a shark with an anvil on its back...\nWhy isn't it here...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_004
Array.english: Umm... about that, actually, I...
Array.indonesia: Umm... about that, actually, I...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_005
Array.english: ...Anyway, your friends are waiting in the village. Let's head back together.
Array.indonesia: ...Anyway, your friends are waiting in the village. Let's head back together.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSegera_006
Array.english: ...Okay.
Array.indonesia: ...Okay.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSemak_001
Array.english: Hah...! I've been spotted...!
Array.indonesia: Hah...! I've been spotted...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSemak_002
Array.english: Fine, I admit defeat.\nI'll return to the village!
Array.indonesia: Fine, I admit defeat.\nI'll return to the village!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_001
Array.english: <size=35>...Human, you can see me!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...Human, you can see me!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_002
Array.english: Yes... it seems so.\nI can even hear you talk...!
Array.indonesia: Yes... it seems so.\nI can even hear you talk...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_003
Array.english: That necklace...\nI see. Those who could speak with us always wore that.
Array.indonesia: That necklace...\nI see. Those who could speak with us always wore that.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_004
Array.english: So, what brings you here all of a sudden...?
Array.indonesia: So, what brings you here all of a sudden...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_005
Array.english: Grandma Meilan from the village said the spirits' power has weakened, and asked me to come take a look.
Array.indonesia: Grandma Meilan from the village said the spirits' power has weakened, and asked me to come take a look.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_006
Array.english: Did something happen...?
Array.indonesia: Did something happen...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_007
Array.english: Ah... so it's about that...\nWe heard Utara Lake was not doing well...
Array.indonesia: Ah... so it's about that...\nWe heard Utara Lake was not doing well...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_008
Array.english: A few of our own went to check on the lake.
Array.indonesia: A few of our own went to check on the lake.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_009
Array.english: But when they didn't come back...\nothers went looking for them... and then more went looking...
Array.indonesia: But when they didn't come back...\nothers went looking for them... and then more went looking...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_010
Array.english: <size=33>In the end, <color=#1DFEAF>9</color> of us went missing!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>In the end, <color=#1DFEAF>9</color> of us went missing!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_011
Array.english: <size=34>...That's quite a lot.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...That's quite a lot.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_012
Array.english: We cannot send any more of our Surs.
Array.indonesia: We cannot send any more of our Surs.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_013
Array.english: Come to think of it...\nI believe I've seen you going into the lake...
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it...\nI believe I've seen you going into the lake...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_014
Array.english: <size=33>Would you be willing to rescue our Surs?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Would you be willing to rescue our Surs?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_015
Array.english: <size=33>Huh...? Where would I even find the spirits...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh...? Where would I even find the spirits...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_016
Array.english: I've spent at least 200 years with them.\nI have a rough idea of where they'd be.
Array.indonesia: I've spent at least 200 years with them.\nI have a rough idea of where they'd be.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_017
Array.english: I'll write down the places that come to mind, so go take a look.
Array.indonesia: I'll write down the places that come to mind, so go take a look.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_018
Array.english: Hmm... so there are <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color> in the lake, right?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... so there are <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color> in the lake, right?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_019
Array.english: That's right. And I won't ask you to do it for nothing.
Array.indonesia: That's right. And I won't ask you to do it for nothing.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_020
Array.english: In return for finding our Surs, the Surs who remain here will bring you ingredients and minerals.
Array.indonesia: In return for finding our Surs, the Surs who remain here will bring you ingredients and minerals.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_021
Array.english: The spirits will bring me ingredients?
Array.indonesia: The spirits will bring me ingredients?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_023
Array.english: That's right. We're asking a great deal of you, so we ought to do something in return.
Array.indonesia: That's right. We're asking a great deal of you, so we ought to do something in return.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_024
Array.english: If you're willing to go that far...\nthen I can't just sit back either.
Array.indonesia: If you're willing to go that far...\nthen I can't just sit back either.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindSpirits_025
Array.english: <size=32>Alright. I'll go take a look around.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright. I'll go take a look around.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindUndu_001
Array.english: This lake was way deeper than I thought...
Array.indonesia: This lake was way deeper than I thought...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindUndu_002
Array.english: I didn't know how to get back up. Perfect timing!
Array.indonesia: I didn't know how to get back up. Perfect timing!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindUndu_003
Array.english: <size=33>Lead the way, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Lead the way, human!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_001
Array.english: <size=33>Waaah... somebody save me...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Waaah... somebody save me...!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_002
Array.english: <size=32>Huh...? A human...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh...? A human...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_003
Array.english: Wulan... right? Your friends are waiting in the village. Let's go together.
Array.indonesia: Wulan... right? Your friends are waiting in the village. Let's go together.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_004
Array.english: <size=33>Whaa...? How can a human speak our language...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whaa...? How can a human speak our language...?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_FindWulan_005
Array.english: ...I-I'll come with you, just save me...!
Array.indonesia: ...I-I'll come with you, just save me...!

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_001
Array.english: Do you have a moment to talk...?
Array.indonesia: Do you have a moment to talk...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_002
Array.english: Ah, yes, Chief. We just closed up for the day, so now's fine.\nWhat can I do for you?
Array.indonesia: Ah, yes, Chief. We just closed up for the day, so now's fine.\nWhat can I do for you?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_003
Array.english: Do you remember what this old man once told you about the <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Do you remember what this old man once told you about the <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color>...?

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_004
Array.english: Yes. You said there are <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color> protecting this village.
Array.indonesia: Yes. You said there are <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color> protecting this village.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_005
Array.english: That's right... I could always feel their energy watching over this village, but...
Array.indonesia: That's right... I could always feel their energy watching over this village, but...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_006
Array.english: Lately, the energy of the <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color> has grown much weaker.
Array.indonesia: Lately, the energy of the <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color> has grown much weaker.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_007
Array.english: I'd love to go see what's happening myself, but...\nas you can see, this old woman's eyes aren't what they used to be.
Array.indonesia: I'd love to go see what's happening myself, but...\nas you can see, this old woman's eyes aren't what they used to be.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_008
Array.english: <size=33>...You can actually see them?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...You can actually see them?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_009
Array.english: Only those who have earned the village's deep trust can see them.\nRight now, that's only Meilan...
Array.indonesia: Only those who have earned the village's deep trust can see them.\nRight now, that's only Meilan...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_010
Array.english: <size=32>You can't... see them, Chief?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You can't... see them, Chief?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_011
Array.english: ...Well... it seems that Uzme fellow doesn't quite trust me enough...
Array.indonesia: ...Well... it seems that Uzme fellow doesn't quite trust me enough...

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_012
Array.english: <size=34>...I see.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...I see.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_013
Array.english: It's weaker than before, but...\nI can still feel the spirits' energy at <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color>.
Array.indonesia: It's weaker than before, but...\nI can still feel the spirits' energy at <color=#1DFEAF>Surga Falls</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_014
Array.english: If you wear this <color=#F1DC2B>Spirit Necklace</color>, you'll be able to see the spirits.
Array.indonesia: If you wear this <color=#F1DC2B>Spirit Necklace</color>, you'll be able to see the spirits.

Array.name: dialogue_JDLC_SideMission_Spirits_Start_015
Array.english: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color>, huh...\nAlright. I'll go take a look.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... <color=#F1DC2B>spirits</color>, huh...\nAlright. I'll go take a look.

Array.indonesia: A green papaya that isn't fully ripe yet. It has a crisp texture and a sweet-and-sour flavor.

Array.name: BambooShoot_desc
Array.english: A young bamboo shoot with a clean, subtle flavor.
Array.indonesia: A young bamboo shoot with a clean, subtle flavor.

Array.name: Bamboo_desc
Array.english: A large herbaceous plant with hollow, segmented stems. Flexible and sturdy, it's used for crafts and construction.
Array.indonesia: A large herbaceous plant with hollow, segmented stems. Flexible and sturdy, it's used for crafts and construction.

Array.name: WildTomato_desc
Array.english: A bright red wild-grown tomato with an exquisite sweet-and-sour flavor.
Array.indonesia: A bright red wild-grown tomato with an exquisite sweet-and-sour flavor.

Array.name: Pineapple_desc
Array.english: A fruit that resembles a pinecone. Some people even put it on pizza.
Array.indonesia: A fruit that resembles a pinecone. Some people even put it on pizza.

Array.name: KingTrumpetMushroom_desc
Array.english: A mushroom with a mild aroma and a chewy texture.
Array.indonesia: A mushroom with a mild aroma and a chewy texture.

Array.name: Taro_desc
Array.english: A root vegetable with a texture similar to sweet potato with a slight sweetness. When cooked, it releases a slippery mucus.
Array.indonesia: A root vegetable with a texture similar to sweet potato with a slight sweetness. When cooked, it releases a slippery mucus.

Array.name: Cassava_desc
Array.english: A bush-grown plant whose texture changes significantly depending on how it's cooked. It's used to make tapioca pearls.
Array.indonesia: A bush-grown plant whose texture changes significantly depending on how it's cooked. It's used to make tapioca pearls.

Array.name: WaterSpinach_desc
Array.english: Its hollow stems give it a crisp texture, and it grows in clusters near water or in damp soil.
Array.indonesia: Its hollow stems give it a crisp texture, and it grows in clusters near water or in damp soil.

Array.name: Loot_CapirlimeLeaf_desc
Array.english: Known for its fresh, exotic aroma, it's often used to add flavor to dishes.
Array.indonesia: Known for its fresh, exotic aroma, it's often used to add flavor to dishes.

Array.name: Loot_Shallot_desc
Array.english: Similar to onions, but milder and slightly sweeter.
Array.indonesia: Similar to onions, but milder and slightly sweeter.

Array.name: Banana_desc
Array.english: Soft white flesh inside a yellow peel. Delicious.
Array.indonesia: Soft white flesh inside a yellow peel. Delicious.

Array.name: BananaBlossom_desc
Array.english: It has a reddish-purple outer skin and pale yellow inner petals.
Array.indonesia: It has a reddish-purple outer skin and pale yellow inner petals.

Array.name: BananaLeaf_desc
Array.english: A green banana leaf. A versatile ingredient used for both cooking and decoration.
Array.indonesia: A green banana leaf. A versatile ingredient used for both cooking and decoration.

Array.name: Calamansi_desc
Array.english: A fruit with a sharp, tangy flavor, often used in sauces and dressings.
Array.indonesia: A fruit with a sharp, tangy flavor, often used in sauces and dressings.

Array.name: Mangosteen_desc
Array.english: Its flesh, shaped like garlic cloves, is as soft and moist as ice cream.
Array.indonesia: Its flesh, shaped like garlic cloves, is as soft and moist as ice cream.

Array.name: InsectBattle_Beetle_Gracilicornis_Desc

Array.indonesia: A rhinoceros beetle with one long horn on its head and four smaller ones on its thorax. It feeds on bamboo sap and is mainly active during the day.

Array.name: InsectBattle_Beetle_Siamensis_Desc

Array.name: InsectBattle_Beetle_Birmanicus_Desc

Array.indonesia: A rhinoceros beetle with one horn on its head and four on its thorax. The upper pair of thoracic horns is large and extends vertically.

Array.name: InsectBattle_Beetle_Pfeifferi_Desc

Array.indonesia: A small species of rhinoceros beetle. Fine ochre hairs cover its body from thorax to elytra, giving it a rusty appearance.

Array.name: InsectBattle_Beetle_Gideon_Desc

Array.indonesia: A highly aggressive rhinoceros beetle. When threatened, it rubs its elytra against its abdomen to make noise and may lash out with its front legs.

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_TimeController
Array.english: <size=24>In the jungle, time flows in <color=#F1DC2B>Real Time</color>.\nDuring the day, dive in the lake or gather resources to prepare for the restaurant at night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In the jungle, time flows in <color=#F1DC2B>Real Time</color>.\nDuring the day, dive in the lake or gather resources to prepare for the restaurant at night.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_EscapeBell
Array.english: <size=24>Use a <color=#F1DC2B>Coconut Pod</color> to quickly return to the village!\nCut the coconut tied to the rock to call a rescue pod!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Use a <color=#F1DC2B>Coconut Pod</color> to quickly return to the village!\nCut the coconut tied to the rock to call a rescue pod!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MetaGun
Array.english: <size=24>You've received a <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color>!\nThe Jungle Gun can transform into different types of firearms.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You've received a <color=#F1DC2B>Jungle Gun</color>!\nThe Jungle Gun can transform into different types of firearms.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MetaGun_Tech
Array.english: <size=24>You can <color=#F1DC2B>Upgrade</color> your Jungle Gun into different forms through Muna.\nGather the required materials to upgrade your weapon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can <color=#F1DC2B>Upgrade</color> your Jungle Gun into different forms through Muna.\nGather the required materials to upgrade your weapon!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_MetaGun_Swap
Array.english:
<Touch><size=24>The Jungle Gun can <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> forms for different situations!
<color=#F1DC2B>Hold <image=枪支切换, preset=Dialogue_KR/></color> and <color=#F1DC2B>drag</color> to switch forms.</size></Touch> <size=24>The Jungle Gun can <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> forms for different situations!
Use <image=InGame.MetaGunChange, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to switch forms.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<Touch><size=24>The Jungle Gun can <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> forms for different situations!
<color=#F1DC2B>Hold <image=枪支切换, preset=Dialogue_KR/></color> and <color=#F1DC2B>drag</color> to switch forms.</size></Touch> <size=24>The Jungle Gun can <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> forms for different situations!
Use <image=InGame.MetaGunChange, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to switch forms.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_HerbalistShop
Array.english: <size=24>Herbalist Lathi buys and sells various <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>.\nPick up the ingredients you need for cooking!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Herbalist Lathi buys and sells various <color=#F1DC2B>Spices</color>.\nPick up the ingredients you need for cooking!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Gift
Array.english: <size=24>You can now give gifts to villagers!\nIf they like your gift, you'll gain a lot of <color=#F1DC2B>Affinity</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now give gifts to villagers!\nIf they like your gift, you'll gain a lot of <color=#F1DC2B>Affinity</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi
Array.english: <size=24>In Utara Village, you'll be running the <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Grill</color>, specializing in grilled dishes.\nGather quality ingredients and serve up delicious grilled food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>In Utara Village, you'll be running the <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Grill</color>, specializing in grilled dishes.\nGather quality ingredients and serve up delicious grilled food!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Collecting_Wood
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use an <color=#F1DC2B>Axe</color> to gather lumber.\nLook for a <color=#F1DC2B>Tree</color> you can chop nearby!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now use an <color=#F1DC2B>Axe</color> to gather lumber.\nLook for a <color=#F1DC2B>Tree</color> you can chop nearby!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Collecting_Rock
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use a <color=#F1DC2B>Pickaxe</color> to gather stone!\nTry mining a <color=#F1DC2B>Boulder</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now use a <color=#F1DC2B>Pickaxe</color> to gather stone!\nTry mining a <color=#F1DC2B>Boulder</color>!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi_Furniture_01
Array.english: <size=24>Gather materials and bring them to <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color> to craft <color=#F1DC2B>Furniture</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Gather materials and bring them to <color=#F1DC2B>Peneb</color> to craft <color=#F1DC2B>Furniture</color>.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi_Furniture_02
Array.english: <size=24>Place crafted furniture from the restaurant's <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> menu.\nCraft more to decorate your shop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Place crafted furniture from the restaurant's <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> menu.\nCraft more to decorate your shop!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi_Grill
Array.english: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Grill</color>!\nTry grilling different ingredients and serving them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can now use the <color=#F1DC2B>Grill</color>!\nTry grilling different ingredients and serving them!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BanchoSushi_Grade
Array.english:
<size=24>Run your shop well to earn higher-grade <color=#ff885f>Badges</color>.
These <color=#ff885f>Badges</color> are awarded by Village Chief Panutah.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>Run your shop well to earn higher-grade <color=#ff885f>Badges</color>.
These <color=#ff885f>Badges</color> are awarded by Village Chief Panutah.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_HydrogenSulfide_01
Array.english: <size=24>The lake is filled with <color=#F1DC2B>Hydrogen Sulfide</color>.\nWithout protection, your oxygen will deplete rapidly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>The lake is filled with <color=#F1DC2B>Hydrogen Sulfide</color>.\nWithout protection, your oxygen will deplete rapidly.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_HydrogenSulfide_02
Array.english: <size=24>To dive deep into the hydrogen sulfide-filled lake,\na <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color> is essential.\nBe sure to monitor your filter's remaining charge as you explore!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>To dive deep into the hydrogen sulfide-filled lake,\na <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color> is essential.\nBe sure to monitor your filter's remaining charge as you explore!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Sneak
Array.english:
<Touch><size=24>Sneak closer and grab the red feather!
Move slowly with <image=移动模式按钮3, preset=Dialogue_KR/> and approach quietly.
This trick also works for bug catching!</size></Touch> <size=24>Sneak closer and grab the red feather!
Move slowly with <image=Dave.SubInteraction2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> and approach quietly.
This trick also works for bug catching!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<Touch><size=24>Sneak closer and grab the red feather!
Move slowly with <image=移动模式按钮3, preset=Dialogue_KR/> and approach quietly.
This trick also works for bug catching!</size></Touch> <size=24>Sneak closer and grab the red feather!

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Fishing
Array.english: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Rod</color> from Basu the fisherman.\nTry fishing wherever you see the fishing icon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>Fishing Rod</color> from Basu the fisherman.\nTry fishing wherever you see the fishing icon!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Fishing_01
Array.english: <size=24>Once fishing starts, tap <image=开始钓鱼, preset=Dialogue_KR/> or shake your phone to cast the line!\n(Default joystick mode. Motion controls require a gyroscope and can be changed in Settings.)</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Once fishing starts, tap <image=开始钓鱼, preset=Dialogue_KR/> or shake your phone to cast the line!\n(Default joystick mode. Motion controls require a gyroscope and can be changed in Settings.)</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Fishing_02
Array.english: <size=24>When the fish struggles, follow the icon prompts\nand drag the joystick left/right <image=收线, preset=Dialogue_KR/> or tilt your phone to reel it in!\n(Default joystick mode. Motion controls require a gyroscope and can be changed in Settings.)</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>When the fish struggles, follow the icon prompts\nand drag the joystick left/right <image=收线, preset=Dialogue_KR/> or tilt your phone to reel it in!\n(Default joystick mode. Motion controls require a gyroscope and can be changed in Settings.)</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_BugNet
Array.english: <size=24>You got a familiar <color=#F1DC2B>Bug Net</color>!\nSneak up on bugs with <image=Dave.SubInteraction2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to catch them more easily.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You got a familiar <color=#F1DC2B>Bug Net</color>!\nSneak up on bugs with <image=Dave.SubInteraction2, preset=Dialogue_KR/> to catch them more easily.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Kickboard_01
Array.english: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color> from Rimbo!\nUse it to move around the village faster.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You got a <color=#F1DC2B>Kick Scooter</color> from Rimbo!\nUse it to move around the village faster.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Kickboard_02
Array.english:
<size=24>Try dashing to go even faster!
Just don't crash!</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>Try dashing to go even faster!
Just don't crash!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Bed
Array.english: <size=24>At home, you can use your <color=#F1DC2B>Bed</color> to sleep until the next day or rest for a certain amount of time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>At home, you can use your <color=#F1DC2B>Bed</color> to sleep until the next day or rest for a certain amount of time.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_NightTime
Array.english: <size=24>You can still do activities after business hours.\nBut if you stay up too late, it will affect your performance the next day.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can still do activities after business hours.\nBut if you stay up too late, it will affect your performance the next day.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_FilterUpgade
Array.english: <size=24>You can upgrade your <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color> to dive deeper!\nCheck with Muna for the required materials!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can upgrade your <color=#F1DC2B>Purification Filter</color> to dive deeper!\nCheck with Muna for the required materials!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_RequestMission
Array.english:
<size=24>Villagers' requests are recorded in the <color=#F1DC2B>Resident Note</color>.
Villagers whose Friendship has grown will visit the restaurant.</size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=24>Villagers' requests are recorded in the <color=#F1DC2B>Resident Note</color>.
Villagers whose Friendship has grown will visit the restaurant.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectCollector_01
Array.english: <size=24>The insects you catch are now recorded in the <color=#F1DC2B>Insectagram</color>.\nTry to collect all the insects that live in this area!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>The insects you catch are now recorded in the <color=#F1DC2B>Insectagram</color>.\nTry to collect all the insects that live in this area!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectCollector_02
Array.english: <size=24>An alert will sound when a new <color=#F1DC2B>Insect</color> is nearby.\nYou can turn it off in the Insectagram app.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>An alert will sound when a new <color=#F1DC2B>Insect</color> is nearby.\nYou can turn it off in the Insectagram app.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectCollector_03
Array.english: <size=24>You can battle other beetles using the lesser stag beetle Udo gave you!\nWin the fight and try to catch the insect!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>You can battle other beetles using the lesser stag beetle Udo gave you!\nWin the fight and try to catch the insect!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_InsectCollector_04
Array.english: <size=24>Collect different insects to complete your field guide and earn rewards!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>Collect different insects to complete your field guide and earn rewards!</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_GrillContainer
Array.english: <size=24>If you place a <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Rack</color>, you can store well-cooked skewers.\nSkewers on the holder will get cold over time, so you must serve them quickly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=24>If you place a <color=#F1DC2B>Skewer Rack</color>, you can store well-cooked skewers.\nSkewers on the holder will get cold over time, so you must serve them quickly.</size>

Array.name: ContentsDesc_DLC_Jungle_Grill_HowToUse_01
Array.english: <size=24>Customers will now order <color=#F1DC2B>Skewers</color>.\nDave needs to pick the ingredients, cook them, and serve them himself!</size>
