Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050001
Array.english: Let's go talk to Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Let's go talk to Bancho.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050002
Array.english: I was supposed to call <color=#4AFFDB>Bacon</color> once I'm ready, right?
Array.indonesia: I was supposed to call <color=#4AFFDB>Bacon</color> once I'm ready, right?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050003
Array.english: A guide was supposed to show me to the village... that must be him!
Array.indonesia: A guide was supposed to show me to the village... that must be him!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050004
Array.english: I need to prepare a dish to present to the village chief. Catch me some <color=#4AFFDB>Tilapia</color> from the lake.
Array.indonesia: I need to prepare a dish to present to the village chief. Catch me some <color=#4AFFDB>Tilapia</color> from the lake.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050005
Array.english: I've got everything Bancho asked for. Let's go give it to him.
Array.indonesia: I've got everything Bancho asked for. Let's go give it to him.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050006
Array.english: Please take this dish to the village chief.
Array.indonesia: Please take this dish to the village chief.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050007
Array.english: Phew. What a long day... time to get some sleep.
Array.indonesia: Phew. What a long day... time to get some sleep.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050008
Array.english: To fix the house, we'll need vines and wood. Ask the village carpenter for help.
Array.indonesia: To fix the house, we'll need vines and wood. Ask the village carpenter for help.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050009
Array.english: To fix the house, we'll need <color=#4AFFDB>5 Pieces of Wood</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>2 Vines</color>. You can find wood from nearby trees and vines in the water!
Array.indonesia: To fix the house, we'll need <color=#4AFFDB>5 Pieces of Wood</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>2 Vines</color>. You can find wood from nearby trees and vines in the water!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050010
Array.english: I've got all the materials. Let's go see Cobra!
Array.indonesia: I've got all the materials. Let's go see Cobra!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050011
Array.english: The house is all fixed now, so go check with Bancho if he needs anything!
Array.indonesia: The house is all fixed now, so go check with Bancho if he needs anything!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050012
Array.english: I should ask the village <color=#4AFFDB>Carpenter</color> to build me a skewer grill.
Array.indonesia: I should ask the village <color=#4AFFDB>Carpenter</color> to build me a skewer grill.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058012
Array.english: If you need a <color=#4AFFDB>Pickaxe</color>, go see our village <color=#4AFFDB>Blacksmith, Perak</color>.
Array.indonesia: If you need a <color=#4AFFDB>Pickaxe</color>, go see our village <color=#4AFFDB>Blacksmith, Perak</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058013
Array.english: To make a pickaxe, I need to start a fire.\nBring me 3 <color=#4AFFDB>Chunks of Bamboo</color>.
Array.indonesia: To make a pickaxe, I need to start a fire.\nBring me 3 <color=#4AFFDB>Chunks of Bamboo</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050013
Array.english: The carpenter, <color=#4AFFDB>Peneb</color>, asked me to get \n<color=#4AFFDB>3 Stones</color>, right?
Array.indonesia: The carpenter, <color=#4AFFDB>Peneb</color>, asked me to get \n<color=#4AFFDB>3 Stones</color>, right?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050015
Array.english: Peneb made me a <color=#4AFFDB>Skewer Grill</color>.\nLet's take it to Bancho
Array.indonesia: Peneb made me a <color=#4AFFDB>Skewer Grill</color>.\nLet's take it to Bancho

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050020
Array.english: Muna asked me to find the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Statue</color> in the lake, right?
Array.indonesia: Muna asked me to find the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Statue</color> in the lake, right?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050021
Array.english: I got the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Statue</color>. Let's go see Muna!
Array.indonesia: I got the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Statue</color>. Let's go see Muna!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050022
Array.english: Please take photos of the <color=#4AFFDB>3 Stone Tablets</color> in the lake.\nYou'll need to upgrade your purification filter in advance!
Array.indonesia: Please take photos of the <color=#4AFFDB>3 Stone Tablets</color> in the lake.\nYou'll need to upgrade your purification filter in advance!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050023
Array.english: I took photos of the 3 stone tablets. Let's go see Muna!
Array.indonesia: I took photos of the 3 stone tablets. Let's go see Muna!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058024
Array.english: Could you get me a <color=#4AFFDB>Broken Breathing Apparatus</color> from the depths of the lake?
Array.indonesia: Could you get me a <color=#4AFFDB>Broken Breathing Apparatus</color> from the depths of the lake?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058125
Array.english: Let's pick up the <color=#4AFFDB>Shiny Object</color> and take it with us.
Array.indonesia: Let's pick up the <color=#4AFFDB>Shiny Object</color> and take it with us.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058025
Array.english: I got the <color=#4AFFDB>Broken Breathing Apparatus</color>. Let's go see Muna
Array.indonesia: I got the <color=#4AFFDB>Broken Breathing Apparatus</color>. Let's go see Muna

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050024
Array.english: The path to the ancient ruins is blocked by a boulder... I should ask the village chief for help.
Array.indonesia: The path to the ancient ruins is blocked by a boulder... I should ask the village chief for help.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050025
Array.english: You'll need <color=#4AFFDB>3 Villagers</color> to push that boulder. Build some rapport and ask them.
Array.indonesia: You'll need <color=#4AFFDB>3 Villagers</color> to push that boulder. Build some rapport and ask them.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410059025
Array.english: If you're ready to push the boulder, come talk to me.
Array.indonesia: If you're ready to push the boulder, come talk to me.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050026
Array.english: The villagers agreed to help! Let's go push the boulder!
Array.indonesia: The villagers agreed to help! Let's go push the boulder!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050027
Array.english: I'm supposed to head to the forest with Cobra, right? Let's meet him at the entrance.
Array.indonesia: I'm supposed to head to the forest with Cobra, right? Let's meet him at the entrance.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050028
Array.english: It's a bit creepy, but... let's head into the forest.
Array.indonesia: It's a bit creepy, but... let's head into the forest.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050029
Array.english: There should be an <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> in the ruins deep in the forest. Let's find it.
Array.indonesia: There should be an <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> in the ruins deep in the forest. Let's find it.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050030
Array.english: I think I heard something whimpering... let's head toward the sound.
Array.indonesia: I think I heard something whimpering... let's head toward the sound.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050031
Array.english: The puppy looks scared.\nI should give it something to eat to calm it down.
Array.indonesia: The puppy looks scared.\nI should give it something to eat to calm it down.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410058031
Array.english: I should grill the raw meat before giving it to him.\nLet's find a <color=#4AFFDB>Campfire</color>
Array.indonesia: I should grill the raw meat before giving it to him.\nLet's find a <color=#4AFFDB>Campfire</color>

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050032
Array.english: Let's grill some raw meat at the campfire and bring it to the puppy!
Array.indonesia: Let's grill some raw meat at the campfire and bring it to the puppy!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050033
Array.english: Alright, that should be cooked just right. Let's head back to the puppy.
Array.indonesia: Alright, that should be cooked just right. Let's head back to the puppy.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050034
Array.english: Let's explore Setah Forest with Marone.
Array.indonesia: Let's explore Setah Forest with Marone.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050035
Array.english: These are ruins from the ancient Sunang civilization. It's a bit scary, but... I have to go in, right?
Array.indonesia: These are ruins from the ancient Sunang civilization. It's a bit scary, but... I have to go in, right?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050036
Array.english: Let's operate the device and head down to the lower floor.
Array.indonesia: Let's operate the device and head down to the lower floor.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050037
Array.english: Let's operate the device and head down to the lower floor.
Array.indonesia: Let's operate the device and head down to the lower floor.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050038
Array.english: Hmm. There's a huge door. I need to find a relic that fits that slot.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. There's a huge door. I need to find a relic that fits that slot.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050039
Array.english: Hmm. There's a huge door. I need to find a relic that fits that slot.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. There's a huge door. I need to find a relic that fits that slot.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050040
Array.english: Let's find the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> Muna mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Let's find the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> Muna mentioned.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050041
Array.english: Let's find the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> Muna mentioned.
Array.indonesia: Let's find the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> Muna mentioned.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050042
Array.english: This must be the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> Muna mentioned. Let's take it back up.
Array.indonesia: This must be the <color=#4AFFDB>Ancient Breathing Apparatus</color> Muna mentioned. Let's take it back up.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050043
Array.english: Looks like Marone found the way up. Let's hop on!
Array.indonesia: Looks like Marone found the way up. Let's hop on!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410050044
Array.english: We should be able to take the elevator back up.

Array.indonesia: I can't just lend you the machete. Bring me 2 rubber tree timbers and we'll trade!

Array.indonesia: Let's cut through the vines with the machete and head into the waterfall area.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052127

Array.indonesia: A <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color> that doesn't live around here was spotted? Maybe the village chief and Basu know something.

Array.indonesia: Alright, I got some info on the <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color>. Let's go tell Sato.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052129

Array.indonesia: They said a <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color> signal was detected 60m deep on the left, right? Let's go check it out.

Array.indonesia: Hmm... these roots are too tough to get through. Let's report back to Sato for now.

Array.indonesia: Let's ask Perak to upgrade the machete.

Array.indonesia: Nice. Got the <color=#4AFFDB>Deep Sea Ore</color>. Let's bring it to Perak.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052134

Array.indonesia: With this machete, I should be able to cut through the roots. The roots were around 60m deep, on the left side... right?

Array.indonesia: Alright. Cut through the roots! Let's head into the <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color>'s habitat...!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_410052136

Array.indonesia: Its neck reaches that far...? Keep your distance and take down the <color=#4AFFDB>Snapping Turtle</color>!

Array.indonesia: Phew... I can't believe a turtle could be that vicious. Let's see if there's anything worth taking.
