Array.english: …Well, we can discuss that later..\nI heard you took a break from diving. How about warming up?
Array.indonesia: …Well, we can discuss that later..\nI heard you took a break from diving. How about warming up?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_010
Array.english: <size=32>I'll guide you from here.\nGo ahead and go on in.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I'll guide you from here.\nGo ahead and go on in.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission01_011
Array.english: Hm…I don't have a good feeling about this…
Array.indonesia: Hm…I don't have a good feeling about this…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_001_01
Array.english: Nice form! Ha ha ha ha!\nAlright, how about try stretching out a bit.
Array.indonesia: Nice form! Ha ha ha ha!\nAlright, how about try stretching out a bit.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_001_02
Array.english: <size=36>Try moving to the marked area.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Try moving to the marked area.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_001_03
Array.english: Use <image=InGame.LongDash, preset=Dialogue_CN/> to move quickly.\n But you'll use up oxygen faster, so watch yourself!<Touch> Tilt the Left Joystick all the way to move faster.\n But you'll use up oxygen faster, so watch yourself!</Touch>
Array.indonesia: Use <image=InGame.LongDash, preset=Dialogue_CN/> to move quickly.\n But you'll use up oxygen faster, so watch yourself!<Touch> Tilt the Left Joystick all the way to move faster.\n But you'll use up oxygen faster, so watch yourself!</Touch>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_002
Array.english: Good! Looks like your skills are intact!\nYour moves are as nimble as a freshwater snail.
Array.indonesia: Good! Looks like your skills are intact!\nYour moves are as nimble as a freshwater snail.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_002_2
Array.english: Let’s now practice using the weapon you’ll need in contingencies, the <color=#F1DC2B>Dive Knife</color>.
Array.indonesia: Let’s now practice using the weapon you’ll need in contingencies, the <color=#F1DC2B>Dive Knife</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_003
Array.english: <size=30>Try using the Survival Knife on small fish.\nYou can use <image=InGame.Melee, preset=Dialogue_EN/>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Try using the Survival Knife on small fish.\nYou can use <image=InGame.Melee, preset=Dialogue_EN/>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_004
Array.english: <size=33>Well done!\nSmooth and quick!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well done!\nSmooth and quick!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_005
Array.english: And finally...\nYou haven’t forgotten how to use the <color=#F1DC2B>Harpoon</color>, have you?
Array.indonesia: And finally...\nYou haven’t forgotten how to use the <color=#F1DC2B>Harpoon</color>, have you?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_006
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Harpoon</color>? Well, I haven’t used one in a long time...\nDo you aim first? And then... Hmm...
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>Harpoon</color>? Well, I haven’t used one in a long time...\nDo you aim first? And then... Hmm...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_007
Array.english: Hmm... Looks like you’ll need some practice.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Looks like you’ll need some practice.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_007_02
Array.english: Let’s try using the Harpoon to catch... \nlet’s say... three fish.
Array.indonesia: Let’s try using the Harpoon to catch... \nlet’s say... three fish.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_008
Array.english: <size=30>Use <image=InGame.Aim, preset=Dialogue_CN/> to aim! Fire with <image=InGame.Fire, preset=Dialogue_CN/>!\n Go ahead, give it a try.</size><Touch> Press and hold the harpoon button on the right to aim, then release to fire!\n Go ahead, give it a try.</Touch>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Use <image=InGame.Aim, preset=Dialogue_CN/> to aim! Fire with <image=InGame.Fire, preset=Dialogue_CN/>!\n Go ahead, give it a try.</size><Touch> Press and hold the harpoon button on the right to aim, then release to fire!\n Go ahead, give it a try.</Touch>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_009
Array.english: I think that should get you back on track in no time.
Array.indonesia: I think that should get you back on track in no time.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission02_010
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, come back up to the boat.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright, come back up to the boat.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_001
Array.english: Okay. Now that you got the hang of it, \nlet's get down to business!
Array.indonesia: Okay. Now that you got the hang of it, \nlet's get down to business!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_002
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, you love sushi, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, you love sushi, right?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_003
Array.english: For sure! That soft fish meat with oily rice…\nOh man! That's just the best!
Array.indonesia: For sure! That soft fish meat with oily rice…\nOh man! That's just the best!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_004
Array.english: Aha! Well listen up. I have a friend who is a <color=#F1DC2B>sushi chef</color>\nwho left the business for a while.
Array.indonesia: Aha! Well listen up. I have a friend who is a <color=#F1DC2B>sushi chef</color>\nwho left the business for a while.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_005
Array.english: He has a bit of a sharp tongue, and a slight temper…\nBut he has one skill that I can guarantee is unmatched in the world.
Array.indonesia: He has a bit of a sharp tongue, and a slight temper…\nBut he has one skill that I can guarantee is unmatched in the world.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_006
Array.english: <size=30>It is right here that I started a restaurant \nwith my friend that sells one of a kind sushi!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>It is right here that I started a restaurant \nwith my friend that sells one of a kind sushi!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_007
Array.english: The sushi sold here is made from fresh fish caught \nin the <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color>, where fish from all over the world can be found!
Array.indonesia: The sushi sold here is made from fresh fish caught \nin the <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color>, where fish from all over the world can be found!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_008
Array.english: <size=34>Don't you think people will just go nuts for it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Don't you think people will just go nuts for it?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_009
Array.english: <size=34>Yum… I'm already craving it!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yum… I'm already craving it!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_010
Array.english: Haha, I bet!!\nSo…
Array.indonesia: Haha, I bet!!\nSo…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_011
Array.english: <size=35>Why don't you join in on this awesome venture\nas well? What do you say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Why don't you join in on this awesome venture\nas well? What do you say?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_012
Array.english: I mean…I love eating but…\nI don't know a thing about cooking.
Array.indonesia: I mean…I love eating but…\nI don't know a thing about cooking.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_013
Array.english: <size=32>Nothing to worry about!\nThe restaurant is all ready…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Nothing to worry about!\nThe restaurant is all ready…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_014
Array.english: <size=33>All you need to do is dive to get the ingredients!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>All you need to do is dive to get the ingredients!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_015
Array.english: <size=38>Doesn't sound too bad, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Doesn't sound too bad, right?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1
Array.english: Accept
Array.indonesia: Accept

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option2
Array.english: Decline
Array.indonesia: Decline

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_001
Array.english: Um…I don't really have any money on me…\nI don’t think I can pay…
Array.indonesia: Um…I don't really have any money on me…\nI don’t think I can pay…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_002
Array.english: Hm…That reminds me…
Array.indonesia: Hm…That reminds me…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_003
Array.english: <size=32>I just remembered that a while ago you broke my underwater drone.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I just remembered that a while ago you broke my underwater drone.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_004
Array.english: The repair cost was about 500 Gold...\nbut I didn't charge you for it.
Array.indonesia: The repair cost was about 500 Gold...\nbut I didn't charge you for it.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_005
Array.english: Um, it broke after 5 seconds of use.\nIt was broken already wasn't it?
Array.indonesia: Um, it broke after 5 seconds of use.\nIt was broken already wasn't it?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_006
Array.english: <size=32>What do you mean?!\nIt…it was totally fine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What do you mean?!\nIt…it was totally fine!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option1_linked_007
Array.english: Well…Okay.\nSo what should I do?
Array.indonesia: Well…Okay.\nSo what should I do?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option2_linked_001
Array.english: <size=35>So I can eat as much sushi as I want?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>So I can eat as much sushi as I want?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option2_linked_002
Array.english: <size=36>Yeah…sure.</size>\n<color=#C3C3C3><size=26>You have to pay though...</size></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Yeah…sure.</size>\n<color=#C3C3C3><size=26>You have to pay though...</size></size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_option2_linked_003
Array.english: <size=32>Can't wait to check it out!\nA sushi restaurant next to a Blue Hole!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Can't wait to check it out!\nA sushi restaurant next to a Blue Hole!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_01_AfterOption_001
Array.english: It was supposed to open tonight.\nBut I'm not sure if it's ready.
Array.indonesia: It was supposed to open tonight.\nBut I'm not sure if it's ready.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_01_AfterOption_002
Array.english: <size=34>Let's go have a chat at the restaurant!\nAh ha ha!!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let's go have a chat at the restaurant!\nAh ha ha!!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hey! <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>! \nAre we all ready to open?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hey! <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>! \nAre we all ready to open?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_002
Array.english: As you can see.\nIt's ready just in time.
Array.indonesia: As you can see.\nIt's ready just in time.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Oh…It's already…finished?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh…It's already…finished?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_004
Array.english: <size=31>You?\nAh, you are the fisherman Cobra was talking about.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>You?\nAh, you are the fisherman Cobra was talking about.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Well, I'm more of a diver than a fisherman.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well, I'm more of a diver than a fisherman.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_006
Array.english: Alright. Anyway, it's nice to meet you. \nI'm <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.\r<size=34>So, you like sushi?</size>
Array.indonesia: Alright. Anyway, it's nice to meet you. \nI'm <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.\r<size=34>So, you like sushi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_007
Array.english: I sure do!!\nTuna belly…eel, sea urchin…
Array.indonesia: I sure do!!\nTuna belly…eel, sea urchin…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_008
Array.english: Oh boy…\nJust thinking about it makes my mouth water.
Array.indonesia: Oh boy…\nJust thinking about it makes my mouth water.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_009
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm. Just as mediocre as expected!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm. Just as mediocre as expected!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_010
Array.english: Sushi is a food that combines the <color=#F1DC2B>soul</color> of sea and land.\nIt symbolizes Mother Nature herself.
Array.indonesia: Sushi is a food that combines the <color=#F1DC2B>soul</color> of sea and land.\nIt symbolizes Mother Nature herself.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_011
Array.english: Most people, however, have only tasted\nmore accessible fish just like you...
Array.indonesia: Most people, however, have only tasted\nmore accessible fish just like you...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_012
Array.english: <size=35>How empty a life is one that ends without ever tasting\nthe beauty mother nature can offer!!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>How empty a life is one that ends without ever tasting\nthe beauty mother nature can offer!!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_02_013
Array.english: <size=38>My calling is to bring the taste of mother nature to everyon.…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>My calling is to bring the taste of mother nature to everyon.…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_001
Array.english: <size=42>An…an earthquake?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>An…an earthquake?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm…The interior is really quite a mess.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm…The interior is really quite a mess.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_003
Array.english: Yeah…\nIt looks like we will have to delay the opening today.
Array.indonesia: Yeah…\nIt looks like we will have to delay the opening today.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_004
Array.english: <size=34>You know what…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You know what…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_005
Array.english: I spent all my money getting this restaurant ready...\nI'll have to recover the <color=#F1DC2B>repair cost</color> through doing business….
Array.indonesia: I spent all my money getting this restaurant ready...\nI'll have to recover the <color=#F1DC2B>repair cost</color> through doing business….

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_006
Array.english: <size=40>…In this state?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>…In this state?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_007
Array.english: <size=34>…Bwahaha!\nIn the end the importance of a restaurant is the taste!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>…Bwahaha!\nIn the end the importance of a restaurant is the taste!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_008
Array.english: <size=35>First we need ingredients…\nDid you bring anything?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>First we need ingredients…\nDid you bring anything?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_009
Array.english: Well, I have something I just caught…
Array.indonesia: Well, I have something I just caught…

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_010
Array.english: <size=55>…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=55>…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_011
Array.english: <size=34>Only three fish?...\nThis won't be nearly enough to serve the guests!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Only three fish?...\nThis won't be nearly enough to serve the guests!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_012
Array.english: <size=34>Please go and catch <color=#1DFEAF>7 more fish</color> first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Please go and catch <color=#1DFEAF>7 more fish</color> first.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_013
Array.english: <size=37>Oh, and…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh, and…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_014
Array.english: <size=35>The restaurant is going to be open only \nin the <color=#F1DC2B>evening</color></size>.
Array.indonesia: <size=35>The restaurant is going to be open only \nin the <color=#F1DC2B>evening</color></size>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_015
Array.english: <size=31>Hm. Won't that decrease sales?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hm. Won't that decrease sales?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_016
Array.english: <size=31>So you think it's right to invite customers without\nadequate preparation just to make a little more money?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>So you think it's right to invite customers without\nadequate preparation just to make a little more money?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_017
Array.english: <size=29>It is a chef's duty to prepare the best possible food with meticulous precision, just as a warrior sharpens his sword on a whetstone!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=29>It is a chef's duty to prepare the best possible food with meticulous precision, just as a warrior sharpens his sword on a whetstone!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_018
Array.english: <size=32>You will need to get me the best quality ingredients \nduring the day.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You will need to get me the best quality ingredients \nduring the day.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission03_03_019
Array.english: <size=37>Okay.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Okay.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_001
Array.english: It seems <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> is really passionate about his work...
Array.indonesia: It seems <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> is really passionate about his work...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_002
Array.english: He may not talk about personal stuff\nbut this guy can talk about sushi all night. Bwahaha!
Array.indonesia: He may not talk about personal stuff\nbut this guy can talk about sushi all night. Bwahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_003
Array.english: I haven’t seen Bancho so enthusiastic since <color=#9E7BFF>the incident</color>.\nIt’s nice to see him like this.
Array.indonesia: I haven’t seen Bancho so enthusiastic since <color=#9E7BFF>the incident</color>.\nIt’s nice to see him like this.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_004
Array.english: <size=38><color=#9E7BFF>The incident</color>…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#9E7BFF>The incident</color>…?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Oops…Maybe I shouldn't have brought it up…</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Oops…Maybe I shouldn't have brought it up…</color>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission04_006
Array.english: Well, anyway we need more ingredients, \nso go catch <color=#1DFEAF>7 fish</color> first!
Array.indonesia: Well, anyway we need more ingredients, \nso go catch <color=#1DFEAF>7 fish</color> first!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission05_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright, looks like you caught quite a few!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright, looks like you caught quite a few!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission05_002
Array.english: <size=32>At this rate we’ll make boatloads of money in no time.\nBwahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>At this rate we’ll make boatloads of money in no time.\nBwahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission05_003
Array.english: <size=33>My my, would you look at the time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>My my, would you look at the time.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission05_004
Array.english: We’ll have to hurry up and get things ready.\nWhy don’t you head to the sushi bar?
Array.indonesia: We’ll have to hurry up and get things ready.\nWhy don’t you head to the sushi bar?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission06_001
Array.english: <size=33>By the way, you’ll only be able to dive\n<color=#F1DC2B>once in the morning and once in the afternoon</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>By the way, you’ll only be able to dive\n<color=#F1DC2B>once in the morning and once in the afternoon</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission06_002
Array.english: <size=33>Get the ingredients ready before the dinner \nhours start!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Get the ingredients ready before the dinner \nhours start!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_001
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, \nHow are the preparations coming along?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, \nHow are the preparations coming along?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm. I think we’re mostly set.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm. I think we’re mostly set.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_003
Array.english: <size=33>That’s good. \nHere’s to a great evening!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That’s good. \nHere’s to a great evening!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_004
Array.english: <size=34>Where do you think you’re going?\nDidn’t you hear from Cobra?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Where do you think you’re going?\nDidn’t you hear from Cobra?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_005
Array.english: <size=33>You're to help me run the sushi bar\nfrom today onwards!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You're to help me run the sushi bar\nfrom today onwards!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_006
Array.english: <size=34>What? I... I don’t understand...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What? I... I don’t understand...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_007
Array.english: Cobra told me that there would be somebody to help with \nthe ingredients and serving. He said all I needed to do is cook.
Array.indonesia: Cobra told me that there would be somebody to help with \nthe ingredients and serving. He said all I needed to do is cook.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_008
Array.english: <size=34>And who else is there for that, but you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And who else is there for that, but you!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_009
Array.english: Wait, I’ve never worked at a restaurant before...
Array.indonesia: Wait, I’ve never worked at a restaurant before...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_010
Array.english: <size=32>The guests will be here soon!\nI’ll give you a quick primer, so pay attention!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The guests will be here soon!\nI’ll give you a quick primer, so pay attention!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_010_2
Array.english: <size=36>What?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>What?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_011
Array.english: <size=33>Open the <color=#F1DC2B>Ingredients</color> below.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Open the <color=#F1DC2B>Ingredients</color> below.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_012
Array.english: Here, you can check your fish, crops, sauces,\nand all the other materials you have.\r<size=34>For now, that's all you need to know.\nCome back later for more information.</size>
Array.indonesia: Here, you can check your fish, crops, sauces,\nand all the other materials you have.\r<size=34>For now, that's all you need to know.\nCome back later for more information.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_013
Array.english: Alright.\nNow I’ll show you how to register actual items to the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.
Array.indonesia: Alright.\nNow I’ll show you how to register actual items to the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_014
Array.english: New recipes need to be added to the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> before \nthey can be sold to customers.\rThere’s a sushi recipe for the fish you acquired earlier,\nso try registering that to the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.
Array.indonesia: New recipes need to be added to the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> before \nthey can be sold to customers.\rThere’s a sushi recipe for the fish you acquired earlier,\nso try registering that to the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_015
Array.english: <size=33>Alright. \nThat probably wasn’t that hard.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright. \nThat probably wasn’t that hard.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_015_2
Array.english: Setting ingredients to <color=#F1DC2B>Auto-supply</color>\nwill make things a bit more convenient.
Array.indonesia: Setting ingredients to <color=#F1DC2B>Auto-supply</color>\nwill make things a bit more convenient.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_015_3
Array.english: Let me repeat: Only food on the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> can be sold.\nIf you run out of ingredients, you’ll have to replace items on the menu or refill the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Let me repeat: Only food on the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> can be sold.\nIf you run out of ingredients, you’ll have to replace items on the menu or refill the ingredients.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_015_4
Array.english: You can also <color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> the flavor of the dishes,\nso try it out when you have enough ingredients.
Array.indonesia: You can also <color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> the flavor of the dishes,\nso try it out when you have enough ingredients.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_016
Array.english: <size=35>Now, use the ingredients you caught to fill out \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> as much as you can!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Now, use the ingredients you caught to fill out \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> as much as you can!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_017
Array.english: Now then, \nlet’s take a look at how you can deliver the food...
Array.indonesia: Now then, \nlet’s take a look at how you can deliver the food...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>How long are you going to stand there talking!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>How long are you going to stand there talking!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_002
Array.english: <size=35>Give me a cup of <color=#F1DC2B>Green Tea</color> to quench my thirst!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Give me a cup of <color=#F1DC2B>Green Tea</color> to quench my thirst!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_003
Array.english: <size=31>Hmm... Have you perhaps...\npoured <color=#F1DC2B>Green Tea</color> before?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Hmm... Have you perhaps...\npoured <color=#F1DC2B>Green Tea</color> before?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_004
Array.english: No... Only soft drinks, I think...
Array.indonesia: No... Only soft drinks, I think...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_Start_005
Array.english: Tsk. I’ll tell you how. Go over to Cobra.
Array.indonesia: Tsk. I’ll tell you how. Go over to Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission07_2_End_001
Array.english: <size=32>Bwahaha! As expected, Bancho’s <color=#F1DC2B>Green Tea</color> is \nquite something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bwahaha! As expected, Bancho’s <color=#F1DC2B>Green Tea</color> is \nquite something.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_001
Array.english: <size=30>Mm! That tea really got my appetite going!\nIs there <color=#F1DC2B>something to eat</color>, perhaps?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>Mm! That tea really got my appetite going!\nIs there <color=#F1DC2B>something to eat</color>, perhaps?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_002
Array.english: Demanding as always.\nWhy don’t you try serving him some food, while you’re at it?
Array.indonesia: Demanding as always.\nWhy don’t you try serving him some food, while you’re at it?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_003
Array.english: <size=32>Come over to where I am and take this food.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Come over to where I am and take this food.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_004
Array.english: <size=40>Hello!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Hello!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_005
Array.english: <size=32>You sent the package last week, you say?\nWhat in the world! Let me check on that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You sent the package last week, you say?\nWhat in the world! Let me check on that!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_006
Array.english: Cobra didn’t even eat...\nHe’s always distracted like that.\rThe food...\ncan’t be reused, so we’ll have to throw it out.
Array.indonesia: Cobra didn’t even eat...\nHe’s always distracted like that.\rThe food...\ncan’t be reused, so we’ll have to throw it out.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_007
Array.english: <size=34>It seems like such a waste to throw it away.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It seems like such a waste to throw it away.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_008
Array.english: <size=32>Bancho Sushi never reuses food!\nWe do not put food made for guests on the table twice!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bancho Sushi never reuses food!\nWe do not put food made for guests on the table twice!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_009
Array.english: <size=32>Well... alright.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well... alright.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_010
Array.english: Everything looks 'bout ready.\nHm. I haven't cooked for customers in a while. Kinda nervous.
Array.indonesia: Everything looks 'bout ready.\nHm. I haven't cooked for customers in a while. Kinda nervous.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Mission08_011
Array.english: <size=35>Don't forget to press <color=#F1DC2B><image=Dave.Sushi_OpenConfirm, preset=Dialogue_EN/></color> after filling the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> \nfor business to begin.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Don't forget to press <color=#F1DC2B><image=Dave.Sushi_OpenConfirm, preset=Dialogue_EN/></color> after filling the <color=#F1DC2B>Menu</color> \nfor business to begin.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Now then, let me tell you how to use <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Now then, let me tell you how to use <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_Start_002
Array.english: I’ll install the app for you, so unlock your <color=#72ff0a>phone</color> first!
Array.indonesia: I’ll install the app for you, so unlock your <color=#72ff0a>phone</color> first!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_End_001
Array.english: Good!\nNow you’ll be able to venture a bit deeper.
Array.indonesia: Good!\nNow you’ll be able to venture a bit deeper.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_End_002
Array.english: Once you have enough money, use <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color> to enhance\nyour equipment. You can enhance your suit as well as your Cargo Box and Oxygen Tank.
Array.indonesia: Once you have enough money, use <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color> to enhance\nyour equipment. You can enhance your suit as well as your Cargo Box and Oxygen Tank.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_End_003
Array.english: <size=33>Never forget that anything can happen in deep waters!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Never forget that anything can happen in deep waters!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_IDiver_End_004
Array.english: <size=42>I’ll be in touch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>I’ll be in touch!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Start_001
Array.english: Ahem. Let me tell you how to recruit <color=#F1DC2B>staff</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ahem. Let me tell you how to recruit <color=#F1DC2B>staff</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Start_002
Array.english: <size=35>Pay close attention to what I say!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Pay close attention to what I say!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Hire_001
Array.english: <size=40>Good.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Good.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Hire_002
Array.english: The recruitment results become available <color=#F1DC2B>the following day</color>.
Array.indonesia: The recruitment results become available <color=#F1DC2B>the following day</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Hire_003
Array.english: I’ll tell you more tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: I’ll tell you more tomorrow.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Hire_list_001
Array.english: Well! There’s an <color=#F1DC2B>applicant</color> for the Bancho Sushi Hiring Notice!\nTime to have a looksy.
Array.indonesia: Well! There’s an <color=#F1DC2B>applicant</color> for the Bancho Sushi Hiring Notice!\nTime to have a looksy.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Employ_001
Array.english: Ooh. I wasn’t expecting an applicant so quickly.
Array.indonesia: Ooh. I wasn’t expecting an applicant so quickly.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Employ_002
Array.english: Let’s check out who we have.
Array.indonesia: Let’s check out who we have.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Employ_list_001
Array.english: This is a pretty nice resume we have here.
Array.indonesia: This is a pretty nice resume we have here.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Employ_list_002
Array.english: Let’s <color=#F1DC2B>hire</color> this person right away.
Array.indonesia: Let’s <color=#F1DC2B>hire</color> this person right away.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_001
Array.english: Alright. Looks like we have our first staff.
Array.indonesia: Alright. Looks like we have our first staff.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_002
Array.english: Hired staff must be <color=#F1DC2B>placed</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hired staff must be <color=#F1DC2B>placed</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_List_001
Array.english: Staff can be placed in the <color=#F1DC2B>Kitchen</color> or the <color=#F1DC2B>Dining Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Staff can be placed in the <color=#F1DC2B>Kitchen</color> or the <color=#F1DC2B>Dining Area</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_List_002
Array.english: Add them to your <color=#F1DC2B>Kitchen</color> to cook more quickly,\nand to your <color=#F1DC2B>Dining Area</color> to serve food more quickly.
Array.indonesia: Add them to your <color=#F1DC2B>Kitchen</color> to cook more quickly,\nand to your <color=#F1DC2B>Dining Area</color> to serve food more quickly.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_Placement_List_003
Array.english: As for our first staff...\nLet’s try a <color=#F1DC2B>Dining Area</color> assignment for now.
Array.indonesia: As for our first staff...\nLet’s try a <color=#F1DC2B>Dining Area</color> assignment for now.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_End_001
Array.english: I think that should be enough to go on for now.
Array.indonesia: I think that should be enough to go on for now.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_End_002
Array.english: I’m stating the obvious, but...\nthings will get tough without staff to help once more customers start coming in.
Array.indonesia: I’m stating the obvious, but...\nthings will get tough without staff to help once more customers start coming in.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Staff_End_003
Array.english: There’s also <color=#F1DC2B>Training</color> to consider, besides hiring.\nThat’s all for now.
Array.indonesia: There’s also <color=#F1DC2B>Training</color> to consider, besides hiring.\nThat’s all for now.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_1_End_001
Array.english: Good!\nPluck the weeds out like that and I’ll do the watering.
Array.indonesia: Good!\nPluck the weeds out like that and I’ll do the watering.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_1_End_002
Array.english: I’m pretty sure that even that picky director would be satisfied with rice of this quality.
Array.indonesia: I’m pretty sure that even that picky director would be satisfied with rice of this quality.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_1_End_003
Array.english: As I said before, I’ll update you on the growth of the rice\nstarting tomorrow with the <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color> app!
Array.indonesia: As I said before, I’ll update you on the growth of the rice\nstarting tomorrow with the <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color> app!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_Harvest_phone_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hoho, the rice has already grown!\nThere’s an odd energy to this region.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hoho, the rice has already grown!\nThere’s an odd energy to this region.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_Harvest_phone_002
Array.english: <size=35>Come over to the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Come over to the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_Start_001
Array.english: The rice has already grown!\nLet’s try <color=#F1DC2B>harvesting</color> it!
Array.indonesia: The rice has already grown!\nLet’s try <color=#F1DC2B>harvesting</color> it!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_001
Array.english: <size=35>You’ve got the hang of <color=#F1DC2B>harvesting</color> now, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>You’ve got the hang of <color=#F1DC2B>harvesting</color> now, right?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_002
Array.english: Yes. But can I plant more rice immediately\nafter harvesting?
Array.indonesia: Yes. But can I plant more rice immediately\nafter harvesting?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_003
Array.english: Ah, well, the land needs some time to recover, \nyou know.
Array.indonesia: Ah, well, the land needs some time to recover, \nyou know.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_004
Array.english: You just need to wait <color=#F1DC2B>half a day</color>\nand you’ll be able to plant more rice.
Array.indonesia: You just need to wait <color=#F1DC2B>half a day</color>\nand you’ll be able to plant more rice.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_005
Array.english: In any case, rice this quality should satisfy\nthat director guy as well.
Array.indonesia: In any case, rice this quality should satisfy\nthat director guy as well.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_006
Array.english: <size=36>I should get this to Bancho.\nThank you, Otto!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I should get this to Bancho.\nThank you, Otto!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_2_End_007
Array.english: <size=34>Come by every now and then to manage the land.\nIt’d be such a waste for crops to fall victim to insects!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Come by every now and then to manage the land.\nIt’d be such a waste for crops to fall victim to insects!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_001
Array.english: Ya get yourself some sleep Dave?
Array.indonesia: Ya get yourself some sleep Dave?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_002
Array.english: Um, Yeah. I guess.
Array.indonesia: Um, Yeah. I guess.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_003
Array.english: Yesterday you said you needed ingredients for \n<color=#1DFEAF>vegetable sushi</color> right?
Array.indonesia: Yesterday you said you needed ingredients for \n<color=#1DFEAF>vegetable sushi</color> right?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_004
Array.english: Yeah. Some customers were looking for that.\nBut I think Sushi tastes best when made from fish.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. Some customers were looking for that.\nBut I think Sushi tastes best when made from fish.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Start_005
Array.english: Come on over to the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color> first!\nI got somethin' to show ya!
Array.indonesia: Come on over to the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color> first!\nI got somethin' to show ya!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh? There's a new space!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh? There's a new space!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_002
Array.english: Heh heh. That's right. \nJust growin' rice would be boring, now wouldn' it?
Array.indonesia: Heh heh. That's right. \nJust growin' rice would be boring, now wouldn' it?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_003
Array.english: I tinkered around yesterday and made a <color=#F1DC2B>garden</color> next to it.
Array.indonesia: I tinkered around yesterday and made a <color=#F1DC2B>garden</color> next to it.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_004
Array.english: <size=34>A <color=#F1DC2B>garden</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>A <color=#F1DC2B>garden</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_005
Array.english: You betcha! \nA place where you can grow vegetables and fruits!
Array.indonesia: You betcha! \nA place where you can grow vegetables and fruits!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_006
Array.english: Not just for <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>, but all sorts of stuff for dishes.
Array.indonesia: Not just for <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>, but all sorts of stuff for dishes.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Intro_007
Array.english: <size=34>Oh…Sounds great!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh…Sounds great!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Step01_001
Array.english: Now, since you’ll have to manage the farms yourself, I’ll give you an explanation.\nListen up.
Array.indonesia: Now, since you’ll have to manage the farms yourself, I’ll give you an explanation.\nListen up.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Step01_002
Array.english: First of all, I’ll give you some <color=#F1DC2B>Tools</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Seeds</color> you’ll \nneed to farm with. Take them.
Array.indonesia: First of all, I’ll give you some <color=#F1DC2B>Tools</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Seeds</color> you’ll \nneed to farm with. Take them.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Step02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Now try planting the <color=#F1DC2B>eggplant</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>carrot</color> seeds \nI gave you in the soil.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Now try planting the <color=#F1DC2B>eggplant</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>carrot</color> seeds \nI gave you in the soil.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_Step02_002
Array.english: There are <size=35>3 bundles in each, so you can fill \n<color=#F1DC2B>one row</color> with two packs!</size>
Array.indonesia: There are <size=35>3 bundles in each, so you can fill \n<color=#F1DC2B>one row</color> with two packs!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Sunny_01
Array.english: <size=36>After planting, don't forget to use the <color=#F1DC2B>watering can</color> to water them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>After planting, don't forget to use the <color=#F1DC2B>watering can</color> to water them.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Sunny_02
Array.english: <size=38>…You get all that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>…You get all that?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Rainy_01
Array.english: <size=36>There ya go. You got it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>There ya go. You got it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Rainy_02
Array.english: Now time to water them…
Array.indonesia: Now time to water them…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Otto_FarmOpen_Weather_Dialogue_Rainy_03
Array.english: There’s no need to pour water on rainy days like this...\nBut try for practice now.
Array.indonesia: There’s no need to pour water on rainy days like this...\nBut try for practice now.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_001
Array.english: Well, you learn quick.\nI knew you’d make a great farmer.
Array.indonesia: Well, you learn quick.\nI knew you’d make a great farmer.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_002
Array.english: What you get back from the crops, \nis equal to the work put in...
Array.indonesia: What you get back from the crops, \nis equal to the work put in...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_003
Array.english: <size=36>Stop by often to pull the<color=#F1DC2B> weeds </color>and<color=#F1DC2B> water </color>the plants.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Stop by often to pull the<color=#F1DC2B> weeds </color>and<color=#F1DC2B> water </color>the plants.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_004
Array.english: The status of the crops can be checked in the <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color> app, so don't forget to take care of them!
Array.indonesia: The status of the crops can be checked in the <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color> app, so don't forget to take care of them!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_End_005
Array.english: <size=35>Got it! With these I can prepare the ingredients for <color=#1DFEAF> Vegetable Sushi</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Got it! With these I can prepare the ingredients for <color=#1DFEAF> Vegetable Sushi</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_call_001
Array.english: Hey, Dave! The crops planted a couple of days ago are ready to be harvested.
Array.indonesia: Hey, Dave! The crops planted a couple of days ago are ready to be harvested.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_call_002
Array.english: <size=35>Seriously?\nThey grow so fast!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Seriously?\nThey grow so fast!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_call_003
Array.english: Haha, all kinds of unexpected things happen \nat the Blue Hole!
Array.indonesia: Haha, all kinds of unexpected things happen \nat the Blue Hole!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_call_004
Array.english: <size=32>We need to prepare the ingredients for <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> before the customers come. Hurry to the farm!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>We need to prepare the ingredients for <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> before the customers come. Hurry to the farm!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_01_001
Array.english: The weather here is incredible!\nThe crops are growing so well!
Array.indonesia: The weather here is incredible!\nThe crops are growing so well!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_01_002
Array.english: <size=36>Go harvest them for yourself!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Go harvest them for yourself!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_001
Array.english: <size=37>Wow! The <color=#F1DC2B>Eggplants</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Carrots</color> look really nice!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Wow! The <color=#F1DC2B>Eggplants</color> and <color=#F1DC2B>Carrots</color> look really nice!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_002
Array.english: Visit often and show your love, and the plants will \nrepay in kind.
Array.indonesia: Visit often and show your love, and the plants will \nrepay in kind.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_003
Array.english: Now, take them all and go help make <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>.
Array.indonesia: Now, take them all and go help make <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_004
Array.english: I have other vegetable seeds as well. \nI will sell them at a reasonable price if you want them.
Array.indonesia: I have other vegetable seeds as well. \nI will sell them at a reasonable price if you want them.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_005
Array.english: <size=34>And don’t forget that good ingredients\nare what make a good dish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And don’t forget that good ingredients\nare what make a good dish.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_006
Array.english: <size=32>Thanks! Now all I need to make <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> is \nsome White Rice.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thanks! Now all I need to make <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> is \nsome White Rice.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_3_harvest_02_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>By the way, who ordered Vegetable Sushi...?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>By the way, who ordered Vegetable Sushi...?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hello, Dave. Have a good night’s sleep?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hello, Dave. Have a good night’s sleep?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_002
Array.english: Yes. Did you spend enough time talking with Sammy yesterday?
Array.indonesia: Yes. Did you spend enough time talking with Sammy yesterday?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_003
Array.english: Of course, we had not seen each other for so long before yesterday, so we definitely had a good time!
Array.indonesia: Of course, we had not seen each other for so long before yesterday, so we definitely had a good time!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_004
Array.english: By the way...\nI want to show you something.
Array.indonesia: By the way...\nI want to show you something.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_ChickenFarm_call_005
Array.english: <size=37>Come to the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color> if you have time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Come to the <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color> if you have time!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_001
Array.english: <size=43>Huh? Chickens?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Huh? Chickens?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_002
Array.english: <size=40>And…um…Sammy, \nwhat happened to your clothes??</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>And…um…Sammy, \nwhat happened to your clothes??</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_003
Array.english: Hey, yo! I talked to my pops yesterday and\ngot all sentimental, you know what I’m saying?
Array.indonesia: Hey, yo! I talked to my pops yesterday and\ngot all sentimental, you know what I’m saying?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_004
Array.english: I became a rapper because I love music,\nbut I got tired of that celeb life.
Array.indonesia: I became a rapper because I love music,\nbut I got tired of that celeb life.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_005
Array.english: I think we could use them to cook with...\nI’ll give them to you when you get here. Take them to the cook.
Array.indonesia: I think we could use them to cook with...\nI’ll give them to you when you get here. Take them to the cook.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_006
Array.english: So, you quit music?
Array.indonesia: So, you quit music?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_007
Array.english: No, no. I will stay here to enjoy my rural life and nature\nwhile writing new songs, yeah.
Array.indonesia: No, no. I will stay here to enjoy my rural life and nature\nwhile writing new songs, yeah.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_008
Array.english: You know, I can release new songs at any time online these days, it’s so easy to do that.
Array.indonesia: You know, I can release new songs at any time online these days, it’s so easy to do that.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_009
Array.english: Aha...\nBy the way, what’s up with that <color=#F1DC2B>Chicken</color>?
Array.indonesia: Aha...\nBy the way, what’s up with that <color=#F1DC2B>Chicken</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_010
Array.english: Heh, I shared some food with neighbors\nand they gave me this chicken in return.
Array.indonesia: Heh, I shared some food with neighbors\nand they gave me this chicken in return.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_011
Array.english: I wanted to make a yummy fried chicken,\nbut my son wanted to let it lay <color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color>.
Array.indonesia: I wanted to make a yummy fried chicken,\nbut my son wanted to let it lay <color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_012
Array.english: And he made a <color=#1DFEAF>Chicken Farm</color> over night!\nHe reminds me of my younger self.
Array.indonesia: And he made a <color=#1DFEAF>Chicken Farm</color> over night!\nHe reminds me of my younger self.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_013
Array.english: Haha, and I got inspiration from\nthe rhythm of the hammer, you know!
Array.indonesia: Haha, and I got inspiration from\nthe rhythm of the hammer, you know!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_014
Array.english: It warms my heart to see you and your son together.
Array.indonesia: It warms my heart to see you and your son together.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_015
Array.english: Speaking of the chicken, from now on, \nI will offer you <color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color> at my farm.
Array.indonesia: Speaking of the chicken, from now on, \nI will offer you <color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color> at my farm.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_016
Array.english: <size=36>Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color>, you say?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh? <color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color>, you say?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_017
Array.english: I can’t give you more than one egg because there is only one chicken on the farm.
Array.indonesia: I can’t give you more than one egg because there is only one chicken on the farm.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_018
Array.english: If you want more chickens, ask <color=#F1DC2B>Sammy</color>!
Array.indonesia: If you want more chickens, ask <color=#F1DC2B>Sammy</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_019
Array.english: Remember, only one egg per chicken a day, no more.
Array.indonesia: Remember, only one egg per chicken a day, no more.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_020
Array.english: There are two grades for eggs: <color=#1DFEAF>Grade A and B</color>.\nGood-grade chickens lay good-grade eggs.
Array.indonesia: There are two grades for eggs: <color=#1DFEAF>Grade A and B</color>.\nGood-grade chickens lay good-grade eggs.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_021
Array.english: <size=37>I will stay here with my pops.\nCome visit me often, yo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>I will stay here with my pops.\nCome visit me often, yo!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Farm_4_Start_022
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color>, huh?\nBancho’s menu will be expanded for sure!</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><color=#F1DC2B>Eggs</color>, huh?\nBancho’s menu will be expanded for sure!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_PhoneCall_01
Array.english: Did you sleep well?\nYesterday I told you I’d tell you something good.
Array.indonesia: Did you sleep well?\nYesterday I told you I’d tell you something good.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_PhoneCall_02
Array.english: <size=37>Take the boat and come behind the restaurant.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Take the boat and come behind the restaurant.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_01
Array.english: <size=40>Wow! What is this place?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wow! What is this place?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_02
Array.english: Looks like you’re doing quite a lot of hard work\ncatching fish every day.
Array.indonesia: Looks like you’re doing quite a lot of hard work\ncatching fish every day.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_03
Array.english: So I got to making a <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Farm</color>\nand finished it in a single day yesterday!
Array.indonesia: So I got to making a <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Farm</color>\nand finished it in a single day yesterday!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_04
Array.english: <size=38>What... A single day?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>What... A single day?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_05
Array.english: In any case... This is where you can grow fish\nand also let them multiply.
Array.indonesia: In any case... This is where you can grow fish\nand also let them multiply.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_06
Array.english: I’ll explain slowly, so listen closely.
Array.indonesia: I’ll explain slowly, so listen closely.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_Visit_07
Array.english: <size=38>First, come over to the <color=#1DFEAF>First Section</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>First, come over to the <color=#1DFEAF>First Section</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_01
Array.english: Fish farms need to have the right environments for their fish.\nEach section has fish from a different depth.
Array.indonesia: Fish farms need to have the right environments for their fish.\nEach section has fish from a different depth.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_02
Array.english: This is where you can grow fish that live at depths of <color=#1DFEAF>0-50m</color>.
Array.indonesia: This is where you can grow fish that live at depths of <color=#1DFEAF>0-50m</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_03
Array.english: Each section has limited space and once the density\nreaches <color=#1DFEAF>100%</color>, no more fish can fit.
Array.indonesia: Each section has limited space and once the density\nreaches <color=#1DFEAF>100%</color>, no more fish can fit.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_04
Array.english: Of course, you can pay a bit of money to <color=#F1DC2B>expand them</color>...\nHahaha.
Array.indonesia: Of course, you can pay a bit of money to <color=#F1DC2B>expand them</color>...\nHahaha.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_05
Array.english: Each section is equipped with its own camera\nso you can look inside.
Array.indonesia: Each section is equipped with its own camera\nso you can look inside.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SimplePopUp_06
Array.english: Now, come along.
Array.indonesia: Now, come along.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_01
Array.english: Nice, isn’t it?\nI added a few fish to start you off.
Array.indonesia: Nice, isn’t it?\nI added a few fish to start you off.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_02
Array.english: Wow... It’s like an aquarium.
Array.indonesia: Wow... It’s like an aquarium.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_03
Array.english: Just staring into the water\nis enough to make you all peaceful inside...
Array.indonesia: Just staring into the water\nis enough to make you all peaceful inside...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_04
Array.english: <size=35>But that isn’t the purpose of this Fish Farm, \nof course!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>But that isn’t the purpose of this Fish Farm, \nof course!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_01_05
Array.english: I’ll teach you how to pluck them out so they can be eaten...\nPay attention.
Array.indonesia: I’ll teach you how to pluck them out so they can be eaten...\nPay attention.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_02_01
Array.english: Fish in the Fish Farm can be sent to Bancho Sushi\nto be used as ingredients or sold directly.
Array.indonesia: Fish in the Fish Farm can be sent to Bancho Sushi\nto be used as ingredients or sold directly.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_DetailPopUp_02_02
Array.english: <size=35>Even if you fail to catch fish because you are so busy exploring, you won’t need to worry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Even if you fail to catch fish because you are so busy exploring, you won’t need to worry!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_01
Array.english: But how do we add fish to the farm?\nSimply catching them will... kill them.
Array.indonesia: But how do we add fish to the farm?\nSimply catching them will... kill them.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_02
Array.english: <size=35>Good question! \nYou can farm them by collecting <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Eggs</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good question! \nYou can farm them by collecting <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Eggs</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_03
Array.english: If you capture some fish alive, you’ll sometimes get\n<color=#F1DC2B>Fish Eggs</color>.
Array.indonesia: If you capture some fish alive, you’ll sometimes get\n<color=#F1DC2B>Fish Eggs</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_04
Array.english: Those eggs will automatically be sent here.\nOh, and one more thing...
Array.indonesia: Those eggs will automatically be sent here.\nOh, and one more thing...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_05
Array.english: If you have two or more of the same type,\nthey can also <color=#1DFEAF>multiply</color>!
Array.indonesia: If you have two or more of the same type,\nthey can also <color=#1DFEAF>multiply</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_06
Array.english: <size=38>Wow... I see!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow... I see!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_07
Array.english: I’ve placed two fish each,\nso you should be able to see the results tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: I’ve placed two fish each,\nso you should be able to see the results tomorrow.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_FirstTutorial_End_08
Array.english: <size=38>Try coming back <color=#F39321>tomorrow</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Try coming back <color=#F39321>tomorrow</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_First_SystemBlock_01
Array.english: Come on! Just wait a day, Dave!\nI’m sure new fish will be waiting to greet you tomorrow!
Array.indonesia: Come on! Just wait a day, Dave!\nI’m sure new fish will be waiting to greet you tomorrow!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_PhoneCall_01
Array.english: Dave, the fish in the farm yesterday...\nThey multiplied!
Array.indonesia: Dave, the fish in the farm yesterday...\nThey multiplied!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_PhoneCall_02
Array.english: <size=36>Hurry on over to the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Farm</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hurry on over to the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Farm</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_Visit_01
Array.english: I’ve marked the sections with new fish\nwith <color=#ff61e3>hearts</color> so they’re easy to recognize.
Array.indonesia: I’ve marked the sections with new fish\nwith <color=#ff61e3>hearts</color> so they’re easy to recognize.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_Visit_02
Array.english: Go and see for yourself.
Array.indonesia: Go and see for yourself.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_00
Array.english: <size=36>Wow... The mysteries of nature never cease to amaze me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wow... The mysteries of nature never cease to amaze me...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_01
Array.english: I’ll tell you once the eggs hatch.
Array.indonesia: I’ll tell you once the eggs hatch.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_02
Array.english: I’ll mark them with <color=#ff61e3>hearts</color> if fish have multiplied.
Array.indonesia: I’ll mark them with <color=#ff61e3>hearts</color> if fish have multiplied.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_03
Array.english: Speaking of eggs...
Array.indonesia: Speaking of eggs...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_04
Array.english: <size=40>I’m reminded of my <color=#9E7BFF>son</color>, who I haven’t seen in a long time...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>I’m reminded of my <color=#9E7BFF>son</color>, who I haven’t seen in a long time...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_05
Array.english: <size=38>You... have a son?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>You... have a son?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_06
Array.english: <size=28>It was a windy and rainy day... I went too far out on my ship,\nand the storm flipped my ship over...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=28>It was a windy and rainy day... I went too far out on my ship,\nand the storm flipped my ship over...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_07
Array.english: I haven’t been able to go back\nto see my son since... *sniff*
Array.indonesia: I haven’t been able to go back\nto see my son since... *sniff*

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_08
Array.english: Well... I didn’t know that...
Array.indonesia: Well... I didn’t know that...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_09
Array.english: Alright.\nI’ll come by often to check.
Array.indonesia: Alright.\nI’ll come by often to check.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_FishFarm_Second_NewFishPopUp_10
Array.english: <size=36>Thanks to you, Otto,\nI’ll feel much less pressure to catch fish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Thanks to you, Otto,\nI’ll feel much less pressure to catch fish!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Start_001
Array.english: Here, these are special <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color>\nmade in our research facility!
Array.indonesia: Here, these are special <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color>\nmade in our research facility!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Start_002
Array.english: With these, you’ll be able to pick up various objects in the water!
Array.indonesia: With these, you’ll be able to pick up various objects in the water!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Why don’t you test them out yourself?\nEnter the water!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Why don’t you test them out yourself?\nEnter the water!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step01_001
Array.english: Objects that can be picked up\nwill show a <color=#F1DC2B>button</color> when you go near them.
Array.indonesia: Objects that can be picked up\nwill show a <color=#F1DC2B>button</color> when you go near them.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step01_002
Array.english: First try grabbing the <color=#1DFEAF>pile of rocks</color> over there and dropping them.
Array.indonesia: First try grabbing the <color=#1DFEAF>pile of rocks</color> over there and dropping them.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step01_003
Array.english: That’s weak wood, so you should be able to break through.
Array.indonesia: That’s weak wood, so you should be able to break through.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Wow! Very nice!\nLet’s try going down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Wow! Very nice!\nLet’s try going down!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step03_001
Array.english: The current’s strong!\nGrab that <color=#1DFEAF>Anchor</color> so it won’t sweep you away!
Array.indonesia: The current’s strong!\nGrab that <color=#1DFEAF>Anchor</color> so it won’t sweep you away!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step04_001
Array.english: Good! You can grab onto objects like that to anchor yourself.\nThat’ll come in handy in places with strong currents.
Array.indonesia: Good! You can grab onto objects like that to anchor yourself.\nThat’ll come in handy in places with strong currents.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step05_001
Array.english: Oh! I see something shiny back there!\nGrab the <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> in front of you and pull.
Array.indonesia: Oh! I see something shiny back there!\nGrab the <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> in front of you and pull.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_Step06_001
Array.english: Awesome!! Since the path is open, grab the treasure up top\nbefore coming up!
Array.indonesia: Awesome!! Since the path is open, grab the treasure up top\nbefore coming up!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Grab_End_001
Array.english: Alright, see you in the boat!
Array.indonesia: Alright, see you in the boat!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Warning_01
Array.english: Let’s train somewhere close for now!
Array.indonesia: Let’s train somewhere close for now!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Warning_02
Array.english: Always watch your oxygen levels!\nThis time I’ll give you an extra Oxygen Tank!
Array.indonesia: Always watch your oxygen levels!\nThis time I’ll give you an extra Oxygen Tank!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Warning_03
Array.english: Dave... All this costs money...
Array.indonesia: Dave... All this costs money...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_01
Array.english: <size=37>Dave, have you read the email you just got?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Dave, have you read the email you just got?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_02
Array.english: Yes! It says that there will be a <color=#F1DC2B>Tuna Party</color> soon!
Array.indonesia: Yes! It says that there will be a <color=#F1DC2B>Tuna Party</color> soon!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_03
Array.english: Right! And tuna is sushi’s best friend!\nWe can sell them for a good profit!
Array.indonesia: Right! And tuna is sushi’s best friend!\nWe can sell them for a good profit!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_04
Array.english: I haven’t seen tuna in the Blue Hole for a while.\nIt’s the beginning of tuna season now.
Array.indonesia: I haven’t seen tuna in the Blue Hole for a while.\nIt’s the beginning of tuna season now.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_05
Array.english: <size=38>We will be able to make a fortune using this party!\nHahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>We will be able to make a fortune using this party!\nHahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_06
Array.english: Hm, but isn’t it difficult to catch tuna?\nI hear that they are very fast swimmers.
Array.indonesia: Hm, but isn’t it difficult to catch tuna?\nI hear that they are very fast swimmers.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_07
Array.english: <size=35>Wahaha! That’s why investment is needed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wahaha! That’s why investment is needed!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Start_08
Array.english: In the afternoon, I will bring a <color=#1DFEAF>tool that can catch tuna</color>.\nI will see you later then!
Array.indonesia: In the afternoon, I will bring a <color=#1DFEAF>tool that can catch tuna</color>.\nI will see you later then!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_01
Array.english: Well, let’s <color=#F1DC2B>Hunt Tuna</color> for real, shall we?
Array.indonesia: Well, let’s <color=#F1DC2B>Hunt Tuna</color> for real, shall we?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_02
Array.english: <size=38>Take this.\nIt’s a <color=#1DFEAF>Steel Net Sensor Trap</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Take this.\nIt’s a <color=#1DFEAF>Steel Net Sensor Trap</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_03
Array.english: Even the swiftest and biggest tuna\ncannot escape this trap!
Array.indonesia: Even the swiftest and biggest tuna\ncannot escape this trap!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_04
Array.english: And I got a secret weapon for today’s hunt!
Array.indonesia: And I got a secret weapon for today’s hunt!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_05
Array.english: <size=38>The <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Drone</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>The <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Drone</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_06
Array.english: It took me quite some time to replace the one you broke \nlast time. It’s very expensive stuff to buy, you know?
Array.indonesia: It took me quite some time to replace the one you broke \nlast time. It’s very expensive stuff to buy, you know?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_07
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>But that wasn’t my fault! It broke the moment I activated it...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>But that wasn’t my fault! It broke the moment I activated it...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_08
Array.english: <size=35>I made a big investment for moments like this!\nThis is what a business man does!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I made a big investment for moments like this!\nThis is what a business man does!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_09
Array.english: Let me show you how to use that. Just follow my instructions.
Array.indonesia: Let me show you how to use that. Just follow my instructions.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Item_10
Array.english: <size=38>Dive in the water!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dive in the water!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_BeforeCatch_01
Array.english: Aha, I sense a school of tuna coming this way.\nGreat luck!
Array.indonesia: Aha, I sense a school of tuna coming this way.\nGreat luck!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_BeforeCatch_02
Array.english: <size=37>Lay the <color=#1DFEAF>Net Trap with Large Sensor</color> in their path!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Lay the <color=#1DFEAF>Net Trap with Large Sensor</color> in their path!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Catch_01
Array.english: <size=38>Nice! We got tuna!\nGo near the net!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Nice! We got tuna!\nGo near the net!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Catch_02
Array.english: Hm...\nThe fish is too big for me to drag up...
Array.indonesia: Hm...\nThe fish is too big for me to drag up...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Catch_03
Array.english: Hahaha!\nThat’s why I prepared this <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Drone</color>!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha!\nThat’s why I prepared this <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Drone</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Catch_04
Array.english: <size=38>Let’s call the drone to bring in the fish.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Let’s call the drone to bring in the fish.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_01
Array.english: Oh, it can get this big tuna without a problem!\nI am impressed!
Array.indonesia: Oh, it can get this big tuna without a problem!\nI am impressed!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_02
Array.english: It’s very powerful, so if you ever catch a big fish,\nuse the drone.
Array.indonesia: It’s very powerful, so if you ever catch a big fish,\nuse the drone.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_03
Array.english: You will need one of these drones to keep the grade \nof your catch. Fish with wounds can’t have a high grade.
Array.indonesia: You will need one of these drones to keep the grade \nof your catch. Fish with wounds can’t have a high grade.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_04
Array.english: <size=37>I will lend that drone to you for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>I will lend that drone to you for now.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_05
Array.english: It’s the basic model without any options because it’s expensive. Bring that to <color=#F1DC2B>iDiver</color> if you want upgrades.
Array.indonesia: It’s the basic model without any options because it’s expensive. Bring that to <color=#F1DC2B>iDiver</color> if you want upgrades.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Salvage_06
Array.english: <size=37>Now, let’s collect as many ingredients as we can before the tuna party!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Now, let’s collect as many ingredients as we can before the tuna party!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Appear_01
Array.english: Oh! I see <color=#1DFEAF>Tuna</color>!
Array.indonesia: Oh! I see <color=#1DFEAF>Tuna</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Tuna_Appear_02
Array.english: The fish is big but fast...
Array.indonesia: The fish is big but fast...

Array.english: I would love to catch them...\nShould I use a <color=#1DFEAF>tool</color>?
Array.indonesia: I would love to catch them...\nShould I use a <color=#1DFEAF>tool</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_01
Array.english: Dave! Don't you wonder how the <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Drones</color> locate sea creatures with such precision?
Array.indonesia: Dave! Don't you wonder how the <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Drones</color> locate sea creatures with such precision?

Array.english: Now that I think of it, it is pretty interesting. How do they do it?
Array.indonesia: Now that I think of it, it is pretty interesting. How do they do it?

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_03
Array.english: <size=34>Muwahaha! It's because the boat has a scanning feature!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Muwahaha! It's because the boat has a scanning feature!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_04
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, what is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, what is that?</size>

Array.english: It's a feature that shows the locations of various vegetation around Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: It's a feature that shows the locations of various vegetation around Blue Hole.

Array.indonesia: It helps identify the exact location for the drones to navigate to.

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_07
Array.english: This feature can also help you spot ingredients or materials you're searching for.
Array.indonesia: This feature can also help you spot ingredients or materials you're searching for.

Array.english: That's neat! I always have a hard time finding the things I need.

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_09
Array.english: Well, you do need to be close to whatever you're looking for to know its exact location...\nBut it should still be useful.
Array.indonesia: Well, you do need to be close to whatever you're looking for to know its exact location...\nBut it should still be useful.

Array.name: dialog_Ingredient_search_10
Array.english: <size=33>I added the <color=#F1DC2B>Tracking</color> button to where it will be most practical.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I added the <color=#F1DC2B>Tracking</color> button to where it will be most practical.</size>

Array.english: <size=35>Long time no see, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Long time no see, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_002
Array.english: I wanted to tell you that I am back in the restaurant business,\nbut couldn’t find your number, hoho!
Array.indonesia: I wanted to tell you that I am back in the restaurant business,\nbut couldn’t find your number, hoho!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_003

Array.indonesia: <size=36>The famous local dish of the village, Mima’s <color=#F1DC2B>Sea Weed Dumplings</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_004
Array.english: The dumpling skin is tight enough to maintain its form\neven in the water. You should try some!
Array.indonesia: The dumpling skin is tight enough to maintain its form\neven in the water. You should try some!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_005

Array.english: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_008
Array.english: <size=38>Hahaha!\nWhy don’t you try one now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hahaha!\nWhy don’t you try one now?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_009
Array.english: <size=35>I will make you a special version!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I will make you a special version!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step01_010
Array.english: <size=33>I am always down for delicious food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I am always down for delicious food!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! It’s really delicious!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wow! It’s really delicious!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_002
Array.english: I feel like I am energized.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_003
Array.english: Oh, it’s not just a feeling. It actually energizes you!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_004

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_MimaRestaurant_Step02_005

Array.indonesia: Oh, the effect of Sea Weed Dumplings dissipates when you leave the water,\nso visit me whenever you need the effect!
