Array.english: <size=35>See you around, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>See you around, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_001
Array.english: Ah, Ms. Lois?
Array.indonesia: Ah, Ms. Lois?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_002
Array.english: <size=32>The <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> is ready for business.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> is ready for business.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_003
Array.english: <size=34>That quickly?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>That quickly?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_004
Array.english: *Smiling* The administrative agility of the B&C Group is \nthe top in the industry.
Array.indonesia: *Smiling* The administrative agility of the B&C Group is \nthe top in the industry.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_StartCall_005
Array.english: <size=32>Visit the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> with Bancho.\nI will see you there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Visit the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> with Bancho.\nI will see you there.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_FirstImpressions_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! This is the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>!\nThe place gives off a tropical vibe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! This is the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>!\nThe place gives off a tropical vibe!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_FirstImpressions_002
Array.english: Not exactly my taste,\nbut it blends in well with the surrounding environment.
Array.indonesia: Not exactly my taste,\nbut it blends in well with the surrounding environment.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_FirstImpressions_003
Array.english: <size=34>Ho ho! This is a time-proven theme for restaurants on the beach.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ho ho! This is a time-proven theme for restaurants on the beach.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_FirstImpressions_004
Array.english: <size=33>Let me explain how to run your branch.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Let me explain how to run your branch.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu_001
Array.english: <size=32>Obviously, you need <color=#1DFEAF>staff members</color> to run your business.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Obviously, you need <color=#1DFEAF>staff members</color> to run your business.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu_002
Array.english: <size=34>Open the <color=#1DFEAF>Staff</color> menu below.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Open the <color=#1DFEAF>Staff</color> menu below.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_001
Array.english: You need at least <color=#1DFEAF>three</color> staff members to run the store.
Array.indonesia: You need at least <color=#1DFEAF>three</color> staff members to run the store.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_002
Array.english: Hm, do I need that many?
Array.indonesia: Hm, do I need that many?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_003
Array.english: Yes, because neither you nor Dave will be there at the branch.
Array.indonesia: Yes, because neither you nor Dave will be there at the branch.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_004
Array.english: So you need to hire a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> to supervise \nthe business there.
Array.indonesia: So you need to hire a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> to supervise \nthe business there.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_005
Array.english: And of course, you need to staff the <color=#1DFEAF>Dining Area</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Kitchen</color> as well, just like at the HQ.
Array.indonesia: And of course, you need to staff the <color=#1DFEAF>Dining Area</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Kitchen</color> as well, just like at the HQ.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_006
Array.english: That is why you need a minimum of three staff members to open and run the branch.
Array.indonesia: That is why you need a minimum of three staff members to open and run the branch.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu01_007
Array.english: Hm, a manager...
Array.indonesia: Hm, a manager...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Right! \nThe <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> is the most important!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Right! \nThe <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color> is the most important!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_002
Array.english: It’s because the number of ingredients available and the number of customers depend on the stats of your manager.
Array.indonesia: It’s because the number of ingredients available and the number of customers depend on the stats of your manager.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_003
Array.english: It is best to appoint a staff member with the highest stats to the manager position.
Array.indonesia: It is best to appoint a staff member with the highest stats to the manager position.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_004
Array.english: Oh...If I appoint a manager, \nthey will run the business on their own?
Array.indonesia: Oh...If I appoint a manager, \nthey will run the business on their own?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_005
Array.english: Nope. Your manager cannot run the business \nagainst the operation policy of the HQ.
Array.indonesia: Nope. Your manager cannot run the business \nagainst the operation policy of the HQ.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_006
Array.english: You need to set an <color=#1DFEAF>Operation Policy</color> to give guidance to the manager, according to which the manager will prepare the menu appropriately.
Array.indonesia: You need to set an <color=#1DFEAF>Operation Policy</color> to give guidance to the manager, according to which the manager will prepare the menu appropriately.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_007
Array.english: <size=30>So, I could instruct the manager what to serve as I see fit, right? Like expensive dishes or dishes with the most ingredients first?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=30>So, I could instruct the manager what to serve as I see fit, right? Like expensive dishes or dishes with the most ingredients first?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckStaffMenu02_008
Array.english: <size=33>Yes, exactly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Yes, exactly.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_CheckIngredientMenu_001
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s talk about ingredients.\nOpen the <color=#1DFEAF>Ingredient</color> menu below.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s talk about ingredients.\nOpen the <color=#1DFEAF>Ingredient</color> menu below.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu01_001
Array.english: The grade of your manager determines the <color=#1DFEAF>ingredients</color> used \nat the branch.
Array.indonesia: The grade of your manager determines the <color=#1DFEAF>ingredients</color> used \nat the branch.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu01_002
Array.english: Check the <color=#1DFEAF>ingredients</color> currently available and predict \nthe sales revenue.
Array.indonesia: Check the <color=#1DFEAF>ingredients</color> currently available and predict \nthe sales revenue.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu01_003
Array.english: Well, it seems like there are no ingredients at the branch \nat the moment.
Array.indonesia: Well, it seems like there are no ingredients at the branch \nat the moment.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu01_004
Array.english: That’s because it’s not open yet. You can bring ingredients from the HQ or the Fish Farm at any time.
Array.indonesia: That’s because it’s not open yet. You can bring ingredients from the HQ or the Fish Farm at any time.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Would you click the <color=#1DFEAF>Deliver</color> button below?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Would you click the <color=#1DFEAF>Deliver</color> button below?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu03_001
Array.english: <size=34>You can send or receive ingredients from here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You can send or receive ingredients from here.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_IngredientMenu03_002
Array.english: As I said earlier, your manager cannot use ingredients\nwhose grade is higher than theirs.
Array.indonesia: As I said earlier, your manager cannot use ingredients\nwhose grade is higher than theirs.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_001
Array.english: I am sure that you now understand what to do with the branch.
Array.indonesia: I am sure that you now understand what to do with the branch.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ba Ha ha! I now own a second restaurant!\nThat means twice the revenue!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ba Ha ha! I now own a second restaurant!\nThat means twice the revenue!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_003
Array.english: Only if you run it successfully, I might add.
Array.indonesia: Only if you run it successfully, I might add.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_004
Array.english: We will see how it goes, okay?
Array.indonesia: We will see how it goes, okay?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_Branch_Complete_005
Array.english: Let more people experience your culinary revolution.\nI am sure they will love your recipes.
Array.indonesia: Let more people experience your culinary revolution.\nI am sure they will love your recipes.

Array.english: The restaurant is still open,\nso let’s not go too far.
Array.indonesia: The restaurant is still open,\nso let’s not go too far.

Array.english: An important customer is coming today.\nLet's go to Bancho Sushi.
Array.indonesia: An important customer is coming today.\nLet's go to Bancho Sushi.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ah... But…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah... But…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_002
Array.english: As Dr. Bacon said, if the remains of Sea People are found here,\ncustomers will indeed come, but…
Array.indonesia: As Dr. Bacon said, if the remains of Sea People are found here,\ncustomers will indeed come, but…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_003
Array.english: This area is kind of remote. \nSo, I think I will need a way to advertise the store until then.
Array.indonesia: This area is kind of remote. \nSo, I think I will need a way to advertise the store until then.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_004
Array.english: Yeah…These days it's just about impossible to attract \ncustomers without publicity.
Array.indonesia: Yeah…These days it's just about impossible to attract \ncustomers without publicity.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Ah!!! \nHave you tried the social media app named <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah!!! \nHave you tried the social media app named <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>?</size>

Array.english: You mean…the social media app young people use to\npost pictures of the food they eat?
Array.indonesia: You mean…the social media app young people use to\npost pictures of the food they eat?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_007
Array.english: Yeah. That's how all businesses are promoting\nthemselves lately!
Array.indonesia: Yeah. That's how all businesses are promoting\nthemselves lately!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_008
Array.english: I simply can’t understand why people would waste their time\nlike that.
Array.indonesia: I simply can’t understand why people would waste their time\nlike that.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_009
Array.english: <size=35>Sushi makes an impression on the heart,\nnot photographs!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sushi makes an impression on the heart,\nnot photographs!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_010
Array.english: Hmm... even so, isn’t it better to use it than to keep\npeople ignorant of your food, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... even so, isn’t it better to use it than to keep\npeople ignorant of your food, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_011
Array.english: <size=36>…You have a point there...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>…You have a point there...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_012
Array.english: Making an account is simple, so let’s try it out.\rYou first register and make the hashtag #bancho_sushi\nthen...
Array.indonesia: Making an account is simple, so let’s try it out.\rYou first register and make the hashtag #bancho_sushi\nthen...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_013
Array.english: <size=43>Done!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Done!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_014
Array.english: Hmm... Well, it’s not as complicated as I expected...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Well, it’s not as complicated as I expected...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_015
Array.english: Now customers happy with your food will follow <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color>.
Array.indonesia: Now customers happy with your food will follow <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_016
Array.english: Hm. I'm not sure about this…but okay. \nI got it.
Array.indonesia: Hm. I'm not sure about this…but okay. \nI got it.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission02_017
Array.english: I'll also install the <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color> app on my phone\nand check the followers' posts!
Array.indonesia: I'll also install the <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color> app on my phone\nand check the followers' posts!

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_001
Array.english: Dave, did you get to loosen up yesterday?
Array.indonesia: Dave, did you get to loosen up yesterday?

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_002
Array.english: Hmm... I saw a lot of nasty fish.\nIt won’t be easy to go any deeper.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I saw a lot of nasty fish.\nIt won’t be easy to go any deeper.

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_003
Array.english: Hmm... I did notice that the fish in the <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color>\nhave an odd violent streak.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I did notice that the fish in the <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color>\nhave an odd violent streak.

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_004
Array.english: Perhaps something puts them on edge?
Array.indonesia: Perhaps something puts them on edge?

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_005
Array.english: Speaking of which, why don’t you also take a <color=#1DFEAF>Gun</color>\nin addition to the Harpoon?
Array.indonesia: Speaking of which, why don’t you also take a <color=#1DFEAF>Gun</color>\nin addition to the Harpoon?

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_006
Array.english: <size=38>A <color=#1DFEAF>Gun</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>A <color=#1DFEAF>Gun</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_SecondDayDuff_007
Array.english: I have a friend who’s knowledgeable about guns...\nI’ll introduce you to him.
Array.indonesia: I have a friend who’s knowledgeable about guns...\nI’ll introduce you to him.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_001
Array.english: Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>, it’s been a while. \nWho is the goofy looking guy next to you?
Array.indonesia: Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>, it’s been a while. \nWho is the goofy looking guy next to you?

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_002
Array.english: Sorry, that wasn’t the nicest thing to say to a stranger.\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>, a professional diver.
Array.indonesia: Sorry, that wasn’t the nicest thing to say to a stranger.\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>, a professional diver.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_003
Array.english: Interesting. I thought divers were athletic and muscular...\nYou seem to defy my prior knowledge.
Array.indonesia: Interesting. I thought divers were athletic and muscular...\nYou seem to defy my prior knowledge.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_004
Array.english: <size=35>People who live in glass houses...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>People who live in glass houses...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_005
Array.english: So, what’s this about? \nI’d like you to get straight to the point...
Array.indonesia: So, what’s this about? \nI’d like you to get straight to the point...

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_006
Array.english: I’ve begun a very interesting business. Hahaha!
Array.indonesia: I’ve begun a very interesting business. Hahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_006_02
Array.english: And now I’m in need of some weapons.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>, I need your help.
Array.indonesia: And now I’m in need of some weapons.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>, I need your help.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_007
Array.english: Hmm... Season 2 of <color=#1DFEAF>Stra Stella</color> just ended anyway…\nI’ll give you a listen.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Season 2 of <color=#1DFEAF>Stra Stella</color> just ended anyway…\nI’ll give you a listen.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_008
Array.english: Alright. I actually discovered a fascinating <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>. \nThe terrain and ecology inside it changes every time you go inside.
Array.indonesia: Alright. I actually discovered a fascinating <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>. \nThe terrain and ecology inside it changes every time you go inside.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_008_02
Array.english: Oddly, any equipment found inside breaks down \nwhen brought out.
Array.indonesia: Oddly, any equipment found inside breaks down \nwhen brought out.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_009
Array.english: <size=34>I’d like you to make us a weapon that can be \nused inside.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’d like you to make us a weapon that can be \nused inside.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_010
Array.english: Hmm... That is rather interesting. You’ve piqued my interest \nas a weapon researcher...you could say.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... That is rather interesting. You’ve piqued my interest \nas a weapon researcher...you could say.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_011
Array.english: My hypothesis is that…anything that’s not made from materials found in the <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color> will continue to break down.\rThis will be especially true of <color=#1DFEAF>Guns</color>, which have precision parts.
Array.indonesia: My hypothesis is that…anything that’s not made from materials found in the <color=#90CDFF>Blue Hole</color> will continue to break down.\rThis will be especially true of <color=#1DFEAF>Guns</color>, which have precision parts.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_012
Array.english: Hmm... \nSo we’ll have to get the materials from the sea ourselves...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... \nSo we’ll have to get the materials from the sea ourselves...

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_013
Array.english: Heh. Dave, you’ll have to prove yourself as a diver\nto this master <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.
Array.indonesia: Heh. Dave, you’ll have to prove yourself as a diver\nto this master <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_014
Array.english: I’m not sure why I should have to prove myself to you...\nJust tell me what you need.
Array.indonesia: I’m not sure why I should have to prove myself to you...\nJust tell me what you need.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_015
Array.english: Since it appears you have no guns at all, let’s start with something easy. I think I’ll need <color=#1DFEAF>1 Rope and 1 Scrap Iron</color>...
Array.indonesia: Since it appears you have no guns at all, let’s start with something easy. I think I’ll need <color=#1DFEAF>1 Rope and 1 Scrap Iron</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_016
Array.english: You heard him, right Dave?\nEnter the Blue Hole and bring back <color=#1DFEAF>Rope</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Scrap Iron</color>.
Array.indonesia: You heard him, right Dave?\nEnter the Blue Hole and bring back <color=#1DFEAF>Rope</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Scrap Iron</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_IntroduceDuff_017
Array.english: By the way, if you run out of oxygen midway,\nyou’ll only be able to make it back with <color=#F1DC2B>1 item</color>. \nAlways keep that in mind!
Array.indonesia: By the way, if you run out of oxygen midway,\nyou’ll only be able to make it back with <color=#F1DC2B>1 item</color>. \nAlways keep that in mind!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_001
Array.english: Well. To think you’d actually manage to bring it back...\nI expected you to quietly expire in the depths... you could say.
Array.indonesia: Well. To think you’d actually manage to bring it back...\nI expected you to quietly expire in the depths... you could say.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=50>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_003
Array.english: Seems I have underestimated you slightly.\nVery well.
Array.indonesia: Seems I have underestimated you slightly.\nVery well.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_004
Array.english: I’ll show you how to make the <color=#1DFEAF>Basic Underwater Rifle</color> with \nthese materials.
Array.indonesia: I’ll show you how to make the <color=#1DFEAF>Basic Underwater Rifle</color> with \nthese materials.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff01_Complete_005
Array.english: First of all, download <color=#72ff0a>Duff’s Weapon Shop</color> on your phone.\nIt’s well optimized. Only 42MB... you could say.
Array.indonesia: First of all, download <color=#72ff0a>Duff’s Weapon Shop</color> on your phone.\nIt’s well optimized. Only 42MB... you could say.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_01
Array.english: Heh. With a neat explanation like that,\neven someone like you should have understood.
Array.indonesia: Heh. With a neat explanation like that,\neven someone like you should have understood.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_02
Array.english: <size=36>Well, I guess...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Well, I guess...</size>

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_03
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, and one more thing.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, and one more thing.</size>

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_04
Array.english: <size=33>I’ve taken some measures to allow you to open\n<color=#F1DC2B>Weapon Chests</color> underwater.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I’ve taken some measures to allow you to open\n<color=#F1DC2B>Weapon Chests</color> underwater.</size>

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_05
Array.english: <size=36>Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Weapon Chests</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Weapon Chests</color>?</size>

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_06
Array.english: You can’t bring them out of the sea,\nbut they can still come in handy... you could say.
Array.indonesia: You can’t bring them out of the sea,\nbut they can still come in handy... you could say.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_07
Array.english: Oh, but I’ll collect info about the weapons you pick up\nand create <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprints</color> for you.
Array.indonesia: Oh, but I’ll collect info about the weapons you pick up\nand create <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprints</color> for you.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_08
Array.english: Weapons made with a <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprint</color> won’t break down\nunderwater... you could say.
Array.indonesia: Weapons made with a <color=#1DFEAF>Blueprint</color> won’t break down\nunderwater... you could say.

Array.name: Tutorial08_DuffWeapon_End_09
Array.english: In any case, this master will be watching you.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: In any case, this master will be watching you.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Are you <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> by any chance?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Are you <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> by any chance?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_002
Array.english: Yes. What is it, sir?
Array.indonesia: Yes. What is it, sir?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_003
Array.english: Wow! I’m always right about these things! Haha!
Array.indonesia: Wow! I’m always right about these things! Haha!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_004
Array.english: Nice to meet you. I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dr. Bacon</color>. \nI’m an archeologist who studies the Sea People civilization.
Array.indonesia: Nice to meet you. I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dr. Bacon</color>. \nI’m an archeologist who studies the Sea People civilization.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_005
Array.english: <size=33>The... <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People civilization</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The... <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People civilization</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_006
Array.english: Haha! I’ll explain it to you!\nAren’t you lucky, to have an expert like me tell you about them!
Array.indonesia: Haha! I’ll explain it to you!\nAren’t you lucky, to have an expert like me tell you about them!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... Maybe I shouldn’t have asked...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... Maybe I shouldn’t have asked...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_008
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>The Sea People civilization</color> lives in legends.\nThey are said to have occupied this region a very long time ago.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>The Sea People civilization</color> lives in legends.\nThey are said to have occupied this region a very long time ago.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_009
Array.english: They worshipped fish and had gills allowing them \nto live underwater.
Array.indonesia: They worshipped fish and had gills allowing them \nto live underwater.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_010
Array.english: They lived in the depths, allowing them to flourish\nwithout any concern for invasions by other civilizations...
Array.indonesia: They lived in the depths, allowing them to flourish\nwithout any concern for invasions by other civilizations...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_011
Array.english: But sudden changes to the sea bottom brought about their abrupt downfall...
Array.indonesia: But sudden changes to the sea bottom brought about their abrupt downfall...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_011_2
Array.english: That’s about all there is to the story.
Array.indonesia: That’s about all there is to the story.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_012
Array.english: Everyone thinks it's a myth and nothing more, \nof course...
Array.indonesia: Everyone thinks it's a myth and nothing more, \nof course...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_013
Array.english: <size=34>But proof that they were real was found\nright in the vicinity of this place!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>But proof that they were real was found\nright in the vicinity of this place!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_014
Array.english: <size=38>Huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Huh?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_015
Array.english: This is an amazing find, \none that could turn the whole academic world upside down.\r<size=32>An ancient civilization under the sea…\nyou’d only see such things in comic books or games!</size>
Array.indonesia: This is an amazing find, \none that could turn the whole academic world upside down.\r<size=32>An ancient civilization under the sea…\nyou’d only see such things in comic books or games!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_016
Array.english: What makes you so sure they were real?
Array.indonesia: What makes you so sure they were real?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_017
Array.english: My assistant closely analyzed an artifact found nearby\nand found that it is from no known civilization.
Array.indonesia: My assistant closely analyzed an artifact found nearby\nand found that it is from no known civilization.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_018
Array.english: It’s dated to around 1,500 years ago as well...\nThere were no civilizations in these parts back then.
Array.indonesia: It’s dated to around 1,500 years ago as well...\nThere were no civilizations in these parts back then.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_019
Array.english: Hmm, that is interesting.\nBut what business do you have with me?
Array.indonesia: Hmm, that is interesting.\nBut what business do you have with me?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_020
Array.english: Well, you see...My assistant’s cryptocurrency investments didn’t pan out and he won’t be around for a good while...
Array.indonesia: Well, you see...My assistant’s cryptocurrency investments didn’t pan out and he won’t be around for a good while...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_021
Array.english: <size=36>That’s why I’d like you to help me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>That’s why I’d like you to help me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_022
Array.english: <size=33>Oh...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_023
Array.english: My assistant told me that the artifact was found \n<color=#1DFEAF>70m</color> or so below the surface... please go take a look!
Array.indonesia: My assistant told me that the artifact was found \n<color=#1DFEAF>70m</color> or so below the surface... please go take a look!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_024
Array.english: We’re busy with the sushi bar.\nI don’t think we can...
Array.indonesia: We’re busy with the sushi bar.\nI don’t think we can...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_025
Array.english: <size=35>Haha! Sorry to interrupt the conversation!\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>! I work with Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha! Sorry to interrupt the conversation!\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>! I work with Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_026
Array.english: <size=33>Of course we should help you.\nWe’ll gladly do so. Yahahah!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Of course we should help you.\nWe’ll gladly do so. Yahahah!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_027
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>What? We don’t have the time to swim around\nsearching for artifacts...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>What? We don’t have the time to swim around\nsearching for artifacts...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_030
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Think about it! If an underwater civilization is discovered,\ncountless people will flock here.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Think about it! If an underwater civilization is discovered,\ncountless people will flock here.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_031
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=35>Bancho Sushi will be bursting at the seams!</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=35>Bancho Sushi will be bursting at the seams!</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_033_2
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=32>Um... I suppose you have a point.</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=32>Um... I suppose you have a point.</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_034
Array.english: <size=36>Alright. I’ll help!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Alright. I’ll help!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_035
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Isn’t that lucky!\nOh, of course, I won’t be asking you to work for free.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Isn’t that lucky!\nOh, of course, I won’t be asking you to work for free.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_036
Array.english: <size=32>I’ll upgrade the <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Suit</color> you’re wearing for free!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I’ll upgrade the <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Suit</color> you’re wearing for free!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_037
Array.english: <size=36>Wow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_038
Array.english: With an enhanced Diving Suit, you’ll be able to venture deeper.\nThis is essential for exploration.
Array.indonesia: With an enhanced Diving Suit, you’ll be able to venture deeper.\nThis is essential for exploration.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_039
Array.english: These days even such things can be handled by an app.\nTechnological advancements are amazing, eh?
Array.indonesia: These days even such things can be handled by an app.\nTechnological advancements are amazing, eh?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_040
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s first install the <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color> app on the phone before \nwe proceed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s first install the <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color> app on the phone before \nwe proceed!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_01
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! You brought it out safely!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright! You brought it out safely!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_02
Array.english: It seems to be in very good condition.\nAlmost as if it was stored somewhere until recently...
Array.indonesia: It seems to be in very good condition.\nAlmost as if it was stored somewhere until recently...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_03
Array.english: Hmm... Very interesting.\nThis may be the find of the century, even...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Very interesting.\nThis may be the find of the century, even...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_04
Array.english: Alright! Dave! Let’s continue to work together and uncover \nthe secrets of the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People civilization</color>!
Array.indonesia: Alright! Dave! Let’s continue to work together and uncover \nthe secrets of the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People civilization</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_05
Array.english: <size=33>What? I thought I’d only be helping you once...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>What? I thought I’d only be helping you once...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_06
Array.english: <size=38>Bwahaha! Of course, say no more!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Bwahaha! Of course, say no more!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_07
Array.english: <size=36>Just put our restaurant\nat the top of the list of affiliates!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Just put our restaurant\nat the top of the list of affiliates!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_08
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_09
Array.english: <size=32>That won’t be hard to do!\nI’ve a very lucky feeling about this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>That won’t be hard to do!\nI’ve a very lucky feeling about this!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission01_Complete_10
Array.english: <size=40>I’ll be in touch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>I’ll be in touch!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_001
Array.english: <size=36>Uh, Dave... are you busy?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Uh, Dave... are you busy?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_002
Array.english: Not at the moment.\nWhat is it?
Array.indonesia: Not at the moment.\nWhat is it?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_003
Array.english: We have a <color=#1DFEAF>strange customer</color> at the sushi bar...
Array.indonesia: We have a <color=#1DFEAF>strange customer</color> at the sushi bar...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_004
Array.english: <size=34>Could you come over for a moment?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Could you come over for a moment?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_005
Array.english: As the manager this is something I can't overlook!\nI’ll come over right away!
Array.indonesia: As the manager this is something I can't overlook!\nI’ll come over right away!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission04_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=40>Huh? Who dares interrupt me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Huh? Who dares interrupt me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_001
Array.english: <size=36>I’m sorry, we’re not open yet.\nYou can’t come in like this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I’m sorry, we’re not open yet.\nYou can’t come in like this!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_002
Array.english: Well, aren’t you strict! I was simply saying a few words. \nI haven’t been to the beach in a while and it brings back old memories!
Array.indonesia: Well, aren’t you strict! I was simply saying a few words. \nI haven’t been to the beach in a while and it brings back old memories!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_003
Array.english: <size=34>I was an amazing diver before \nI took a harpoon in the knee!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I was an amazing diver before \nI took a harpoon in the knee!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_004
Array.english: So you were a diver...\nI’m also a diver.
Array.indonesia: So you were a diver...\nI’m also a diver.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_005
Array.english: <size=32>Heh heh! Then you must know the diver’s dream of swimming in all the seas of the world!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Heh heh! Then you must know the diver’s dream of swimming in all the seas of the world!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_006
Array.english: <size=34>Forests of coral! Pods of sperm whales!\nFights to the death with tiger sharks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Forests of coral! Pods of sperm whales!\nFights to the death with tiger sharks!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_007
Array.english: Hmm... \nThat brings to mind a dish I’d really love to eat.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... \nThat brings to mind a dish I’d really love to eat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_008
Array.english: <size=40>What dish do you mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>What dish do you mean?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_009
Array.english: When I was little, \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Moray Eel Curry</color> at my fishing village was famous...\r<size=32>I can’t forget its taste.</size>
Array.indonesia: When I was little, \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Moray Eel Curry</color> at my fishing village was famous...\r<size=32>I can’t forget its taste.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_010
Array.english: If you could make that dish, perhaps...\nI’ll give you a nice gift, hehe.
Array.indonesia: If you could make that dish, perhaps...\nI’ll give you a nice gift, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_011
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm. <color=#F1DC2B>Moray Eel Curry</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm. <color=#F1DC2B>Moray Eel Curry</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_012
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Moray Eels</color> hide in the rocks, making them difficult to catch.\nHow do you get one?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Moray Eels</color> hide in the rocks, making them difficult to catch.\nHow do you get one?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_013
Array.english: Heh heh! You know how to dive,\nbut you don’t know much of the ecology, do you?
Array.indonesia: Heh heh! You know how to dive,\nbut you don’t know much of the ecology, do you?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_014
Array.english: <size=32><color=#1DFEAF>Moray Eels</color> are nocturnal and only come out at night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32><color=#1DFEAF>Moray Eels</color> are nocturnal and only come out at night.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_015
Array.english: Do you have gear for night diving?
Array.indonesia: Do you have gear for night diving?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_016
Array.english: Oh... I did get a <color=#1DFEAF>Flashlight</color> recently...
Array.indonesia: Oh... I did get a <color=#1DFEAF>Flashlight</color> recently...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_017
Array.english: <size=40>That should do just fine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>That should do just fine!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_018
Array.english: Moray Eels are nocturnal!\nPlease go <color=#F1DC2B>night diving</color> and catch a Moray Eel to fulfill my wish.
Array.indonesia: Moray Eels are nocturnal!\nPlease go <color=#F1DC2B>night diving</color> and catch a Moray Eel to fulfill my wish.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_019
Array.english: Hmm... I haven’t gone diving at night for a while...\nMaybe I will try it...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I haven’t gone diving at night for a while...\nMaybe I will try it...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=50>*Sob* That’s the taste I remember!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>*Sob* That’s the taste I remember!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_002
Array.english: Oh, I’m glad you like it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I’m glad you like it.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_003
Array.english: The food brings back memories...
Array.indonesia: The food brings back memories...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_004
Array.english: One time a young man who lived with a sick mother\nin my village was bitten by a Moray Eel,\nkeeping them from going into the sea any longer.
Array.indonesia: One time a young man who lived with a sick mother\nin my village was bitten by a Moray Eel,\nkeeping them from going into the sea any longer.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=32>I was twelve then, and I went out into the pitch-black darkness and plunged a Harpoon into that Moray Eel’s gills!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I was twelve then, and I went out into the pitch-black darkness and plunged a Harpoon into that Moray Eel’s gills!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_006
Array.english: I brought them the dead Moray Eel, and the mother\nmade me <color=#1DFEAF>Moray Curry</color> in thanks.
Array.indonesia: I brought them the dead Moray Eel, and the mother\nmade me <color=#1DFEAF>Moray Curry</color> in thanks.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_007
Array.english: Thinking of that woman’s kind eyes\nbrings tears to my eyes... *sniff*
Array.indonesia: Thinking of that woman’s kind eyes\nbrings tears to my eyes... *sniff*

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission05_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=38>In any case, thanks for the food.\nThat was some fantastic cooking!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>In any case, thanks for the food.\nThat was some fantastic cooking!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_001
Array.english: Oh right, I said I’d tell you something nice, right?
Array.indonesia: Oh right, I said I’d tell you something nice, right?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_002
Array.english: Nearly forgot amid all that nostalgia,\nhaha!
Array.indonesia: Nearly forgot amid all that nostalgia,\nhaha!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_003
Array.english: <size=34>Come see me in the <color=#1DFEAF>empty lot</color> behind this building.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Come see me in the <color=#1DFEAF>empty lot</color> behind this building.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_01
Array.english: <size=35>Hello there, Dave. \nHave a good night’s sleep?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hello there, Dave. \nHave a good night’s sleep?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_02
Array.english: Well... I suppose so.\nYou sound tired.
Array.indonesia: Well... I suppose so.\nYou sound tired.

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_03
Array.english: <size=33>Haha! Well, I stayed up all night working on something!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Haha! Well, I stayed up all night working on something!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_04
Array.english: What were you working on?
Array.indonesia: What were you working on?

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Call_05
Array.english: I’ll show you. Get on the boat and come on over\n<color=#F1DC2B>next to the Fish Farm</color>!
Array.indonesia: I’ll show you. Get on the boat and come on over\n<color=#F1DC2B>next to the Fish Farm</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=40>Wow... What is this place?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wow... What is this place?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_002
Array.english: Hehe. I tried some food at the restaurant...\nThe sushi has Annam rice mixed in, doesn’t it?
Array.indonesia: Hehe. I tried some food at the restaurant...\nThe sushi has Annam rice mixed in, doesn’t it?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_003
Array.english: Yes…\nThat’s the only rice we can manage to find around here...
Array.indonesia: Yes…\nThat’s the only rice we can manage to find around here...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_004
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> has got superb skills, but... \nYou won’t meet that picky movie director’s standards with that kind of grain.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> has got superb skills, but... \nYou won’t meet that picky movie director’s standards with that kind of grain.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_005
Array.english: Since you’re staying here a bit longer anyway,\nI thought you might help me grow some <color=#1DFEAF>White Rice</color>.
Array.indonesia: Since you’re staying here a bit longer anyway,\nI thought you might help me grow some <color=#1DFEAF>White Rice</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! That’s very nice!\nThank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wow! That’s very nice!\nThank you!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_007
Array.english: Hmm... The thing is, I’m not much of a farmer...\nWhat should I do first?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... The thing is, I’m not much of a farmer...\nWhat should I do first?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_008
Array.english: I’ve seen how busy you are all day.\nI’ll help you a little with <color=#F1DC2B>growing the rice</color>.
Array.indonesia: I’ve seen how busy you are all day.\nI’ll help you a little with <color=#F1DC2B>growing the rice</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_009
Array.english: It takes about a year in the real world to grow rice,\nbut this is no rice farming game, is it?
Array.indonesia: It takes about a year in the real world to grow rice,\nbut this is no rice farming game, is it?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_010
Array.english: You’ll be able to see results in <color=#1DFEAF>2-3 days</color>.
Array.indonesia: You’ll be able to see results in <color=#1DFEAF>2-3 days</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_011
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, but the thing is... I’ve injured my legs...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, but the thing is... I’ve injured my legs...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_012
Array.english: <size=32>You’ll have to pluck out the <color=#1DFEAF>weeds</color>.\nThat’ll prevent insects from harming the crop.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You’ll have to pluck out the <color=#1DFEAF>weeds</color>.\nThat’ll prevent insects from harming the crop.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=32>Of course!\nIf we can have good rice, plucking <color=#1DFEAF>weeds</color> is no problem!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Of course!\nIf we can have good rice, plucking <color=#1DFEAF>weeds</color> is no problem!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_014
Array.english: To think there’s a rice paddy right behind the restaurant...\nThat's really great! Haha, thanks!
Array.indonesia: To think there’s a rice paddy right behind the restaurant...\nThat's really great! Haha, thanks!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_015
Array.english: <size=34>Bwahaha! Glad to see you like it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bwahaha! Glad to see you like it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_016
Array.english: Oh! As for the state of the rice paddy... Technology has come\na long way and you can use a <color=#F1DC2B>mobile app</color> to check on it.
Array.indonesia: Oh! As for the state of the rice paddy... Technology has come\na long way and you can use a <color=#F1DC2B>mobile app</color> to check on it.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_017
Array.english: <size=32>The app’s called <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color>.\nI’ll update you on the status every morning through the app.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The app’s called <color=#72ff0a>FarmNow</color>.\nI’ll update you on the status every morning through the app.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_018
Array.english:
<size=36>Hmm. That reminds me...
I remember when I used to be a novice farmer.</size><size=25><color=#C8C8C8>I’d gone to a farming village in Thailand on a very hot day. 
I was resting in the shade and a white-haired village chief came over,
looked right into my eyes, and told me...</color></size>
Array.indonesia:
<size=36>Hmm. That reminds me...
I remember when I used to be a novice farmer.</size><size=25><color=#C8C8C8>I’d gone to a farming village in Thailand on a very hot day. 
I was resting in the shade and a white-haired village chief came over,
looked right into my eyes, and told me...</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_019
Array.english: <size=52>Enough!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=52>Enough!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_020
Array.english: Now, now, cool your temper...\nAs it happens, I see some <color=#1DFEAF>weeds</color> over there.
Array.indonesia: Now, now, cool your temper...\nAs it happens, I see some <color=#1DFEAF>weeds</color> over there.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission06_Complete_021
Array.english: <size=43>Go and pluck them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Go and pluck them.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hey Dave!\nI’ve got the luckiest news!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hey Dave!\nI’ve got the luckiest news!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_002
Array.english: What is it, <color=#F1DC2B>Dr. Bacon</color>?\nYou look happy.
Array.indonesia: What is it, <color=#F1DC2B>Dr. Bacon</color>?\nYou look happy.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_003
Array.english: I analyzed the artifact you brought me\nand a large amount of an unknown substance was detected.
Array.indonesia: I analyzed the artifact you brought me\nand a large amount of an unknown substance was detected.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_004
Array.english: I think it must be iron compressed deep underwater,\nbut it gives off a unique wavelength...
Array.indonesia: I think it must be iron compressed deep underwater,\nbut it gives off a unique wavelength...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_005
Array.english: <size=36>I went ahead and developed a <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color>\nto track those waves!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I went ahead and developed a <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color>\nto track those waves!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_006
Array.english: Oh... And why is that news... lucky?
Array.indonesia: Oh... And why is that news... lucky?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_007
Array.english: Haha! Being coy today, are we?\nThis <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color> is bound to come in useful on your next expedition!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Being coy today, are we?\nThis <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color> is bound to come in useful on your next expedition!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_008
Array.english: What do you mean, my next expedition?\nCobra forced me to go along last time...
Array.indonesia: What do you mean, my next expedition?\nCobra forced me to go along last time...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_009
Array.english: Hmm... I was given a contract with your name on it.\nThe cancellation charge for breaking the contract is over 20...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I was given a contract with your name on it.\nThe cancellation charge for breaking the contract is over 20...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_010
Array.english: <size=36>What?\nWhat in the world were you two talking about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>What?\nWhat in the world were you two talking about?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_011
Array.english: Haha! Don’t be so by-the-book!\nCheck the signal for me to test out the <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color>!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Don’t be so by-the-book!\nCheck the signal for me to test out the <color=#1DFEAF>Radar</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_012
Array.english: *Sigh* Give it to me...\nI’ll tell you if it works, and no more...
Array.indonesia: *Sigh* Give it to me...\nI’ll tell you if it works, and no more...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! So this is the place!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow! So this is the place!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_002
Array.english: Let’s see... hmm...\nThe signal is coming from <color=#1DFEAF>inside</color>...
Array.indonesia: Let’s see... hmm...\nThe signal is coming from <color=#1DFEAF>inside</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=31>There are letters I’ve never seen before written on the pillar!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>There are letters I’ve never seen before written on the pillar!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_004
Array.english: Hmm... If we had a tool of some sort, we could move aside that <color=#1DFEAF>pile of rocks</color> and try going inside...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... If we had a tool of some sort, we could move aside that <color=#1DFEAF>pile of rocks</color> and try going inside...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>I think it would be best to talk this over with <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I think it would be best to talk this over with <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=40>Come on up for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Come on up for now!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_MermanWhisper_001
Array.english: <size=45>???</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>???</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_1_MermanWhisper_002
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm... I thought I heard something...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm... I thought I heard something...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_Complete_001
Array.english: Hmm. I found a place with a signal from the Sea People civilization...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I found a place with a signal from the Sea People civilization...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=36>I can’t hold back my academic thirst\nto check it out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I can’t hold back my academic thirst\nto check it out!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>I’m at an important symposium right now...\nPlease talk it over with <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color> first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’m at an important symposium right now...\nPlease talk it over with <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra</color> first!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission07_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=38>I’ll come by tomorrow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I’ll come by tomorrow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? How to get rid of rock piles?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huh? How to get rid of rock piles?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_002
Array.english: <size=35>You’ll have to use a <color=#1DFEAF>Bomb</color>, of course!\nHahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>You’ll have to use a <color=#1DFEAF>Bomb</color>, of course!\nHahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_003
Array.english: Is it okay to detonate bombs underwater?
Array.indonesia: Is it okay to detonate bombs underwater?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_004
Array.english: Weren’t you talking about a rock pile somewhere deep below?\nI’m sure it’ll be fine...
Array.indonesia: Weren’t you talking about a rock pile somewhere deep below?\nI’m sure it’ll be fine...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_005
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s put a little trust in the sea’s regenerative power!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s put a little trust in the sea’s regenerative power!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_006
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>He’s trying to gloss things over again...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>He’s trying to gloss things over again...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_007
Array.english: <size=36>But there’s an issue.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>But there’s an issue.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_008
Array.english: The delivery ships haven’t been arriving lately...\nI need to get a delivery from a Bomb expert I know...
Array.indonesia: The delivery ships haven’t been arriving lately...\nI need to get a delivery from a Bomb expert I know...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_009
Array.english: Apparently the ship’s gone off the radar.\nI think it’s sunk...
Array.indonesia: Apparently the ship’s gone off the radar.\nI think it’s sunk...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_010
Array.english: If I could use the <color=#1DFEAF>Drone</color> I ordered,\nwe could retrieve the supplies...
Array.indonesia: If I could use the <color=#1DFEAF>Drone</color> I ordered,\nwe could retrieve the supplies...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_011
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, could you go into the sea and retrieve\n<color=#1DFEAF>Drone Materials</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, could you go into the sea and retrieve\n<color=#1DFEAF>Drone Materials</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_012
Array.english: <size=31><color=#1DFEAF>Drone Materials</color>?\nHow am I supposed to find them in the ocean? \nIt’s huge!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31><color=#1DFEAF>Drone Materials</color>?\nHow am I supposed to find them in the ocean? \nIt’s huge!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_013
Array.english: <size=34>Delivery boxes are likely to have been carried by the ocean currents. Look for a <color=#F1DC2B>place with ocean currents!</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Delivery boxes are likely to have been carried by the ocean currents. Look for a <color=#F1DC2B>place with ocean currents!</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_014
Array.english: <size=38>Hmm, that sounds dangerous...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hmm, that sounds dangerous...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! \nWe should be able to deploy a drone with this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright! \nWe should be able to deploy a drone with this!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm? You look pretty exhausted.\nHahaha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm? You look pretty exhausted.\nHahaha.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>Well, the sea currents did knock me around a bit...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Well, the sea currents did knock me around a bit...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=34>Haha... I see!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha... I see!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_005
Array.english: It’ll take a bit of time to repair the drone and deploy it.\nYou're gonna have to wait.
Array.indonesia: It’ll take a bit of time to repair the drone and deploy it.\nYou're gonna have to wait.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission08_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=33>It should be done by <color=#F1DC2B>tomorrow morning</color>!\nGo about your business until then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It should be done by <color=#F1DC2B>tomorrow morning</color>!\nGo about your business until then!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_PreYosie_001
Array.english: It’s already evening...
Array.indonesia: It’s already evening...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_PreYosie_002
Array.english: I feel stiff...\nEven so, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho’s</color> working alone. I should probably help.
Array.indonesia: I feel stiff...\nEven so, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho’s</color> working alone. I should probably help.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_PreYosie_003
Array.english: <size=33>It’s not easy to manage with two people\nwith more customers coming in...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It’s not easy to manage with two people\nwith more customers coming in...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_001
Array.english: <size=45>Good morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Good morning!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_002
Array.english: Sorry I couldn’t come by yesterday because of the symposium.\nDid you speak with Cobra?
Array.indonesia: Sorry I couldn’t come by yesterday because of the symposium.\nDid you speak with Cobra?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_003
Array.english: Oh, come to think of it, I got materials\nsince Cobra said he was repairing a drone yesterday...
Array.indonesia: Oh, come to think of it, I got materials\nsince Cobra said he was repairing a drone yesterday...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_004
Array.english: Oh! A bit late, aren’t I? Hahaha!\nI repaired the drone just fine thanks to you! I got some supplies as well.
Array.indonesia: Oh! A bit late, aren’t I? Hahaha!\nI repaired the drone just fine thanks to you! I got some supplies as well.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_005
Array.english: Here’s the <color=#1DFEAF>Bombs</color> you asked for.\n<size=43>Also...</size>
Array.indonesia: Here’s the <color=#1DFEAF>Bombs</color> you asked for.\n<size=43>Also...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_006
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, thank you!\nDr. Bacon, will these do?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, thank you!\nDr. Bacon, will these do?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_007
Array.english: <size=32>Alright! Let’s head back to that <color=#F1DC2B>rock pile</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Alright! Let’s head back to that <color=#F1DC2B>rock pile</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_008
Array.english: <size=48>Oh, wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Oh, wait!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_009
Array.english: <size=32>I haven’t finished!\nStarting today…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I haven’t finished!\nStarting today…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_010
Array.english: <size=40>The <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color> is officially open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>The <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color> is officially open!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_011
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? What is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh? What is that?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_012
Array.english: Hahaha! Deliveries have stopped,\nbut with the drone in working order,
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Deliveries have stopped,\nbut with the drone in working order,

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_013
Array.english: I can transport <color=#1DFEAF>three types of items</color> in a day.
Array.indonesia: I can transport <color=#1DFEAF>three types of items</color> in a day.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_014
Array.english: Talk to me and select the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color> to see a list that \nchanges every day.
Array.indonesia: Talk to me and select the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color> to see a list that \nchanges every day.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_015
Array.english: I’ll also buy some stuff you don’t need.\nCheck out the <color=#F1DC2B>Sell</color> tab as well.
Array.indonesia: I’ll also buy some stuff you don’t need.\nCheck out the <color=#F1DC2B>Sell</color> tab as well.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_019
Array.english: I have a feeling you’ll charge high prices...\nBut it’s nice to be able to prepare.
Array.indonesia: I have a feeling you’ll charge high prices...\nBut it’s nice to be able to prepare.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_020
Array.english: <size=28>Hahaha! I won’t charge high prices just because I’ve got \nthe only business here, so don’t be afraid to visit often!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=28>Hahaha! I won’t charge high prices just because I’ve got \nthe only business here, so don’t be afraid to visit often!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_021
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I feel like you let your business tactic slip just now...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>I feel like you let your business tactic slip just now...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_022
Array.english: In any case, it’s time to head back to the <color=#F1DC2B>rock pile</color>\nwhere the signal from the Sea People was detected.
Array.indonesia: In any case, it’s time to head back to the <color=#F1DC2B>rock pile</color>\nwhere the signal from the Sea People was detected.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_001
Array.english: Ah,  just in case there is something worth documenting inside…
Array.indonesia: Ah,  just in case there is something worth documenting inside…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_002
Array.english: <size=33>How about taking this <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Camera</color> with you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>How about taking this <color=#1DFEAF>Underwater Camera</color> with you?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_003
Array.english: <size=35>A Camera?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>A Camera?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_004
Array.english: That's right! It will be important for research to\nrecord important data with photos!
Array.indonesia: That's right! It will be important for research to\nrecord important data with photos!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_GiveCamera_005
Array.english: <size=33>Take the Camera and I'll let you know when I find \nthe right place to use it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Take the Camera and I'll let you know when I find \nthe right place to use it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_0_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>We’re here! Try placing\none of the <color=#1DFEAF>Bombs</color> Cobra gave you on that rock pile!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>We’re here! Try placing\none of the <color=#1DFEAF>Bombs</color> Cobra gave you on that rock pile!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=32>All good?\nYou know, it's sort of hard to see through the radio.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>All good?\nYou know, it's sort of hard to see through the radio.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_1_Complete_002
Array.english: We can’t have you torn into a thousand pieces\nand become FOOD for the sharks!
Array.indonesia: We can’t have you torn into a thousand pieces\nand become FOOD for the sharks!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>That’s a scary thing to say in such a casual voice...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>That’s a scary thing to say in such a casual voice...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_1_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=37>Now, back away from the Bomb for a bit.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Now, back away from the Bomb for a bit.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_001
Array.english: There, that should be enough.
Array.indonesia: There, that should be enough.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_002
Array.english: <size=45>Here it goes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Here it goes!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Nice. Now the road is clear.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Nice. Now the road is clear.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_Complete_002
Array.english: There’s a faint light coming from inside...\nGo on inside.
Array.indonesia: There’s a faint light coming from inside...\nGo on inside.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_Complete_003
Array.english: Ugh... What if there’s a monster or something inside?
Array.indonesia: Ugh... What if there’s a monster or something inside?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_2_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=38>That would also be an amazing scientific discovery!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>That would also be an amazing scientific discovery!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! This place is... wow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow! This place is... wow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=33>It appears to be some kind of Sea People <color=#F1DC2B>Record Chamber</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It appears to be some kind of Sea People <color=#F1DC2B>Record Chamber</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=32>My lucky feeling was correct!\nThere definitely was a Sea People civilization in this region!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>My lucky feeling was correct!\nThere definitely was a Sea People civilization in this region!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_004
Array.english: Look at that mural back there...\nNo human could have painted that so deep underwater.
Array.indonesia: Look at that mural back there...\nNo human could have painted that so deep underwater.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_005
Array.english: Maybe these are from some ancient civilization\nthat sank from seismic activity?
Array.indonesia: Maybe these are from some ancient civilization\nthat sank from seismic activity?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_006
Array.english: A good point! But, that style of painting and architecture can’t been seen anywhere above ground.
Array.indonesia: A good point! But, that style of painting and architecture can’t been seen anywhere above ground.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_Complete_007
Array.english: Please first <color=#F1DC2B>investigate</color> this place!\nI’m sure you’ll be able to find a variety of interesting clues.
Array.indonesia: Please first <color=#F1DC2B>investigate</color> this place!\nI’m sure you’ll be able to find a variety of interesting clues.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Good. That should be enough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Good. That should be enough.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_3_1_Complete_002
Array.english: I would like to research a little more, so please take a photo\nwith the <color=#F1DC2B>Camera</color> that I gave you.
Array.indonesia: I would like to research a little more, so please take a photo\nwith the <color=#F1DC2B>Camera</color> that I gave you.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_Charm_001
Array.english: Huh? I see something on the floor there...
Array.indonesia: Huh? I see something on the floor there...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_Charm_002
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! It might be another Sea People artifact.\nBring it to me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! It might be another Sea People artifact.\nBring it to me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_001
Array.english: <size=43>It’s the sound from before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>It’s the sound from before!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_002
Array.english: Hmm... a Record Chamber filled with Sea People symbols...\nWhat could they have written?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... a Record Chamber filled with Sea People symbols...\nWhat could they have written?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_003
Array.english: <size=32>More importantly, didn’t you hear something?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>More importantly, didn’t you hear something?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_004
Array.english: <size=32>What do you mean?\nI didn’t hear anything over the radio...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What do you mean?\nI didn’t hear anything over the radio...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_4_005
Array.english: <size=37>Come back up to the boat for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Come back up to the boat for now!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm...<color=#F1DC2B> A Sea People artifact</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm...<color=#F1DC2B> A Sea People artifact</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=45>Hmm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Hmm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=44>Very interesting!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Very interesting!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_004
Array.english: Well... I’m glad you like it.
Array.indonesia: Well... I’m glad you like it.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_005
Array.english: I’ll have to analyze this artifact and the mural\nfurther at my lab.
Array.indonesia: I’ll have to analyze this artifact and the mural\nfurther at my lab.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=38>I’ll be in touch soon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I’ll be in touch soon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_001
Array.english: <size=42>Hey hey, you there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Hey hey, you there!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_002
Array.english: <size=36>I heard an explosion in the sea.\nDo you know what’s going on?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I heard an explosion in the sea.\nDo you know what’s going on?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_003
Array.english: <size=32>Oh, about that... um...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh, about that... um...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_004
Array.english: <size=42>We are <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>We are <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_005
Array.english: <size=32>We are an organization that tracks down people \nwho pollute this beautiful sea, and reports them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>We are an organization that tracks down people \nwho pollute this beautiful sea, and reports them.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_006
Array.english: <size=34>I sometimes carry out justice myself\nfor those that commit particularly evil deeds!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I sometimes carry out justice myself\nfor those that commit particularly evil deeds!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_007
Array.english: <size=33>I’ve had reports of someone who has been engaging in \nmindless destruction of the environment in these parts.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I’ve had reports of someone who has been engaging in \nmindless destruction of the environment in these parts.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_008
Array.english: I don’t know if it was you,\nbut you better be aware of this.
Array.indonesia: I don’t know if it was you,\nbut you better be aware of this.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_009
Array.english: Whoever harms the great sea will have to \ncontend with <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...
Array.indonesia: Whoever harms the great sea will have to \ncontend with <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_010
Array.english: <size=38>And me, <color=#F1DC2B>John Watson</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>And me, <color=#F1DC2B>John Watson</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_011
Array.english: Now then, be ever grateful to the sea\nand never lose your love for it!
Array.indonesia: Now then, be ever grateful to the sea\nand never lose your love for it!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_012
Array.english: I’ll be leaving for now.
Array.indonesia: I’ll be leaving for now.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_013
Array.english: <size=48>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_014
Array.english: <size=44>We’re watching you….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>We’re watching you….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_001
Array.english: What a creepy dude...\nWill we be okay?
Array.indonesia: What a creepy dude...\nWill we be okay?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_002
Array.english: <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...\nThat group is infamous. They commit acts of violence under the pretext of environmental protection...
Array.indonesia: <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>...\nThat group is infamous. They commit acts of violence under the pretext of environmental protection...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_003
Array.english: It’s mostly the large corporations with big fishing businesses...
Array.indonesia: It’s mostly the large corporations with big fishing businesses...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_004
Array.english: ... and not the small fisheries, that harm the environment\nthe most...They say nothing to the corporations, however.
Array.indonesia: ... and not the small fisheries, that harm the environment\nthe most...They say nothing to the corporations, however.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_005
Array.english: I expect they’re taking bribes or something <color=#9E7BFF>unsavory</color> like that...
Array.indonesia: I expect they’re taking bribes or something <color=#9E7BFF>unsavory</color> like that...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_006
Array.english: That guy looked like bad news.
Array.indonesia: That guy looked like bad news.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_SeaBlue_02_007
Array.english: It won’t do you any good to be on their radar...\nBe careful.
Array.indonesia: It won’t do you any good to be on their radar...\nBe careful.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission09_RoomBlock_001
Array.english: First finish investigating this place!
Array.indonesia: First finish investigating this place!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_001
Array.english: <size=37>Hmm! Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Hmm! Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_002
Array.english: <size=34>Yes, Dr. Bacon?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yes, Dr. Bacon?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_003
Array.english: <size=45>Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_004
Array.english: <size=38>Yes...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Yes...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_005
Array.english: <size=32>Do you want to hear the good news,\nor the bad news?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Do you want to hear the good news,\nor the bad news?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_006
Array.english: <size=32>The good news...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The good news...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_007
Array.english: <size=36>Haha! You’re the positive type!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Haha! You’re the positive type!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_008
Array.english: I studied the <color=#F1DC2B>bracelet</color>\nyou brought me yesterday...
Array.indonesia: I studied the <color=#F1DC2B>bracelet</color>\nyou brought me yesterday...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_009
Array.english: <size=36>It was from the Sea People, as I expected!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>It was from the Sea People, as I expected!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_010
Array.english: Wow... so it’s an ancient artifact?
Array.indonesia: Wow... so it’s an ancient artifact?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_011
Array.english: The bracelet seems to be imbued\nwith a mysterious power.
Array.indonesia: The bracelet seems to be imbued\nwith a mysterious power.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_012
Array.english: <size=38>Here, you can wear this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Here, you can wear this.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_013
Array.english: What? Me?\nI mean, I’m grateful, but why?
Array.indonesia: What? Me?\nI mean, I’m grateful, but why?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_014
Array.english: Haha! Who knows, there might be some frightening\nSea People curse on it!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Who knows, there might be some frightening\nSea People curse on it!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_015
Array.english: <size=50>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_016
Array.english: Well, in any case...\ntry it on first!
