Array.indonesia: Well, in any case...\ntry it on first!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_000
Array.english: <size=34>Wow...\nI feel some kind of new power inside me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow...\nI feel some kind of new power inside me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_000_2
Array.english: Haha! Glad to hear nothing bad happened!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Glad to hear nothing bad happened!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_001
Array.english: You’ll be able to check your <color=#F1DC2B>Diver Box</color>\nfor more information about the charm you’re wearing.
Array.indonesia: You’ll be able to check your <color=#F1DC2B>Diver Box</color>\nfor more information about the charm you’re wearing.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_002
Array.english: Oh, and I have more great news.
Array.indonesia: Oh, and I have more great news.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_003
Array.english: I’ve analyzed the artifacts and investigation data...
Array.indonesia: I’ve analyzed the artifacts and investigation data...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_004
Array.english: <size=37>I was able to find a very strong signal\nin these <color=#F1DC2B>ocean depths</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>I was able to find a very strong signal\nin these <color=#F1DC2B>ocean depths</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_005
Array.english: This was the right place.\nThe objects didn’t just float over here.
Array.indonesia: This was the right place.\nThe objects didn’t just float over here.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_006
Array.english: I have a feeling the Giant Blue Hole that suddenly appeared\nis serving as a conduit to a Sea People site.
Array.indonesia: I have a feeling the Giant Blue Hole that suddenly appeared\nis serving as a conduit to a Sea People site.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_007
Array.english: <size=38>A very lucky opportunity!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>A very lucky opportunity!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_008
Array.english: That just sounds like I have to risk my life again...
Array.indonesia: That just sounds like I have to risk my life again...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_009
Array.english: <size=34>So... what’s the bad news?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>So... what’s the bad news?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_010
Array.english: Hmm... In order to venture deep,\nyou’ll need a <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... In order to venture deep,\nyou’ll need a <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_011
Array.english: Deliveries have stopped right now for some reason,\nso getting one is out of the question.
Array.indonesia: Deliveries have stopped right now for some reason,\nso getting one is out of the question.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_012
Array.english: Maybe <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> will have one?\nHe has all sorts of things.
Array.indonesia: Maybe <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> will have one?\nHe has all sorts of things.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_AfterCharmTutorial_013
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm. You’re right.\nTry contacting <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> first, will you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm. You’re right.\nTry contacting <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> first, will you?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=40>Arrrgh!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Arrrgh!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_002
Array.english: Why are you so angry, Duff?
Array.indonesia: Why are you so angry, Duff?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=38>I ordered a limited-edition\n<color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> figurine!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I ordered a limited-edition\n<color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> figurine!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=38>But it hasn’t come for over a week, \nwould you believe it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>But it hasn’t come for over a week, \nwould you believe it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=38>It’s got a serial number,\nand a limited-edition-only artbook!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>It’s got a serial number,\nand a limited-edition-only artbook!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_006
Array.english: Whoa... Calm down a bit.\nEveryone seems upset with the deliveries having stopped.
Array.indonesia: Whoa... Calm down a bit.\nEveryone seems upset with the deliveries having stopped.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=32>I think there must have been some kind of accident.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I think there must have been some kind of accident.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_008
Array.english: To see what's going on, I will need the <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.
Array.indonesia: To see what's going on, I will need the <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_009
Array.english: <size=36>Dr. Bacon says you might have one.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Dr. Bacon says you might have one.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_010
Array.english: Oho! Well, of course I have one of those in my safe storage.
Array.indonesia: Oho! Well, of course I have one of those in my safe storage.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_011
Array.english: <size=37>But I can’t give it to you for free.\nThere’s a condition.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>But I can’t give it to you for free.\nThere’s a condition.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_012
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I think I know what’s coming...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(I think I know what’s coming...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=38>Please find my <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> figurine.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Please find my <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> figurine.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_014
Array.english: <size=33>It’s in a <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color>.\nYou’ll know it when you see it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It’s in a <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color>.\nYou’ll know it when you see it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_015
Array.english: I requested special care for the package,\nso it should not have been washed away.
Array.indonesia: I requested special care for the package,\nso it should not have been washed away.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_016
Array.english: If the ship carrying it sank...\nIt’s likely to be <color=#F1DC2B>somewhere nearby</color>.
Array.indonesia: If the ship carrying it sank...\nIt’s likely to be <color=#F1DC2B>somewhere nearby</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_017
Array.english: Find it for me and I’ll give you the <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.
Array.indonesia: Find it for me and I’ll give you the <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_1_Complete_018
Array.english: *Sigh* I’ll have to first find the location of \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Sunken Transport Ship</color>.
Array.indonesia: *Sigh* I’ll have to first find the location of \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Sunken Transport Ship</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_001
Array.english: <size=40>There!\nMy precious <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>There!\nMy precious <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_002
Array.english: <size=33>Bring it to me quick.\nFinish your mission.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bring it to me quick.\nFinish your mission.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wh-what was that just now?\nM-my <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wh-what was that just now?\nM-my <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_002
Array.english: <size=38>She disappeared into the unfathomable depths!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>She disappeared into the unfathomable depths!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_003
Array.english: It seems to have been some kind of giant life form...
Array.indonesia: It seems to have been some kind of giant life form...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_004
Array.english: <size=38>Please go and retrieve her.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Please go and retrieve her.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_005
Array.english: <size=37>Wait, that obviously looks dangerous.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Wait, that obviously looks dangerous.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_006
Array.english: Besides, the doors on the ship\nare all locked, so I can’t go inside.
Array.indonesia: Besides, the doors on the ship\nare all locked, so I can’t go inside.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_007
Array.english: Do you really think I didn’t think of that\nbefore concocting <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan’s rescue plan</color>?
Array.indonesia: Do you really think I didn’t think of that\nbefore concocting <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan’s rescue plan</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_008
Array.english: <size=38>I’ll provide you with my secret weapon,\nthe <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I’ll provide you with my secret weapon,\nthe <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_009
Array.english: Even at this moment Leahs-chan\nawaits her master.
Array.indonesia: Even at this moment Leahs-chan\nawaits her master.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_010
Array.english: <size=35>Come to the boat, will you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Come to the boat, will you?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_2_AfterTimeline_011
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(This guy is incorrigible...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(This guy is incorrigible...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_Complete_001
Array.english: I’m still having trouble calming down, just like Leahs-chan did when she first came face-to-face with Fenrir.
Array.indonesia: I’m still having trouble calming down, just like Leahs-chan did when she first came face-to-face with Fenrir.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission10_Complete_002
Array.english: Since you’ve found the location, I’ll reward you for it.\nI like to do honest dealings...
Array.indonesia: Since you’ve found the location, I’ll reward you for it.\nI like to do honest dealings...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_001
Array.english: <size=34>Now then, let’s begin the <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan rescue mission</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Now then, let’s begin the <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan rescue mission</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_002
Array.english: <size=35>Take this <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Take this <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_003
Array.english: You’ll see a spot that can be cut into when you reach the ship.\n<color=#C3C3C3>There will be a button prompt...</color>
Array.indonesia: You’ll see a spot that can be cut into when you reach the ship.\n<color=#C3C3C3>There will be a button prompt...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_004
Array.english: Cut the weak point in the iron door\nand you’ll be able to enter the ship.
Array.indonesia: Cut the weak point in the iron door\nand you’ll be able to enter the ship.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_005
Array.english: Just retrieve the <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color> that has Leahs-chan, from inside the ship. Should be simpler than you’d think.
Array.indonesia: Just retrieve the <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color> that has Leahs-chan, from inside the ship. Should be simpler than you’d think.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_006
Array.english: But I saw a huge <color=#F1DC2B>Tentacle</color> taking the ship...\nIt looks extremely dangerous...
Array.indonesia: But I saw a huge <color=#F1DC2B>Tentacle</color> taking the ship...\nIt looks extremely dangerous...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_007
Array.english: <size=32>Do you mean to say that it’s okay for <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> to \nexpire in the darkness down there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Do you mean to say that it’s okay for <color=#ff61e3>Leahs-chan</color> to \nexpire in the darkness down there?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_008
Array.english: <size=37>This mission must not be delayed\nfor a moment longer.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>This mission must not be delayed\nfor a moment longer.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_009
Array.english: Ugh, alright, I get it.\nOh well. I’ll try going down there.
Array.indonesia: Ugh, alright, I get it.\nOh well. I’ll try going down there.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_1_CutStart_001
Array.english: <size=35><color=#C3C3C3>This must be the door.\nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color> from Duff could help cut through.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#C3C3C3>This must be the door.\nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color> from Duff could help cut through.</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oho... I was in too much of a hurry to properly\ntell you how to use it, but you figured it out.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oho... I was in too much of a hurry to properly\ntell you how to use it, but you figured it out.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_1_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=40>Go in through the open door now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Go in through the open door now.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Leahs-chan... Your master is coming...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Leahs-chan... Your master is coming...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_2_Complete_001
Array.english: Huh? The space below seems larger than expected.\nTake a look around, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Huh? The space below seems larger than expected.\nTake a look around, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_3_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wait…\nwere those Sea People just now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wait…\nwere those Sea People just now?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_3_Complete_002
Array.english: Huh? What do you mean?\nAll I can see is the <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color>.
Array.indonesia: Huh? What do you mean?\nAll I can see is the <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_3_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>Bring it back quickly!\nIt’s awaiting rescue!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bring it back quickly!\nIt’s awaiting rescue!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_3_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=33><color=#C3C3C3>Telling him won’t do any good...\nI’ll have to go up and tell Dr. Bacon.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#C3C3C3>Telling him won’t do any good...\nI’ll have to go up and tell Dr. Bacon.</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_4_LegCutEvent_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Hmm... The <color=#1DFEAF>box</color> is pinned under a squid tentacle...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Hmm... The <color=#1DFEAF>box</color> is pinned under a squid tentacle...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_4_LegCutEvent_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I’ll have to cut it... I wonder if it’s edible?\nI should try taking it to <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>I’ll have to cut it... I wonder if it’s edible?\nI should try taking it to <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_4_WrongWay_001
Array.english: Oh, I almost forgot to pick up Duff's <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color>!
Array.indonesia: Oh, I almost forgot to pick up Duff's <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=42>Yes! Leahs-chan! Leahs-chan!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Yes! Leahs-chan! Leahs-chan!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=34>To think she hasn’t been damaged...\nOh... There’s saltwater everywhere...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>To think she hasn’t been damaged...\nOh... There’s saltwater everywhere...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll clean you up<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>\n<size=41><color=#ff61e3>Here comes Leahs!</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’ll clean you up<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>\n<size=41><color=#ff61e3>Here comes Leahs!</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=33>Whoops. I said Leahs-chan’s line by accident, \nthough I’m the master.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoops. I said Leahs-chan’s line by accident, \nthough I’m the master.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=50>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_006
Array.english: Ahem. In any case.\nA promise is a promise.
Array.indonesia: Ahem. In any case.\nA promise is a promise.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=33>Here you are. \nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Here you are. \nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_008
Array.english: It’s a recent model\nthat turns on automatically as necessary...
Array.indonesia: It’s a recent model\nthat turns on automatically as necessary...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission11_Complete_009
Array.english: I must go help Leahs-chan recover.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: I must go help Leahs-chan recover.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_001
Array.english: Phew. I guess that’s over for now.
Array.indonesia: Phew. I guess that’s over for now.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_002
Array.english: Come to think of it...\nI did bring this...
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it...\nI did bring this...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_003
Array.english: <size=36>What will I do with this <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid Tentacle</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>What will I do with this <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid Tentacle</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_004
Array.english: It smells so awful...\nI’m not sure it can be used for cooking.
Array.indonesia: It smells so awful...\nI’m not sure it can be used for cooking.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_005
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll have to give <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> a call.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’ll have to give <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> a call.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_CallBancho_001
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll have to give <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> a call.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’ll have to give <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> a call.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>What is it, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>What is it, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_002
Array.english: I... I was helping Duff,\nand I defeated a Giant Squid...
Array.indonesia: I... I was helping Duff,\nand I defeated a Giant Squid...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=40>That’s... incredible.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>That’s... incredible.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_004
Array.english: I couldn’t bring the whole thing, so I cut off a bit of its tentacle...\nIs this edible, perhaps?
Array.indonesia: I couldn’t bring the whole thing, so I cut off a bit of its tentacle...\nIs this edible, perhaps?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=42>Hmm. Of course.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Hmm. Of course.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_006
Array.english: The ammonium chloride that helps it float\ngives it an awful stench, however...
Array.indonesia: The ammonium chloride that helps it float\ngives it an awful stench, however...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_007
Array.english: And because it’s very tough, it’s difficult to cook\nusing conventional methods.
Array.indonesia: And because it’s very tough, it’s difficult to cook\nusing conventional methods.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_008
Array.english: I don’t think we’ll be able to offer it to our customers anyway...
Array.indonesia: I don’t think we’ll be able to offer it to our customers anyway...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_009
Array.english: <size=36>Why don’t we close up shop for the day and hold\na <color=#F1DC2B>party</color> with the squid?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Why don’t we close up shop for the day and hold\na <color=#F1DC2B>party</color> with the squid?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_010
Array.english: I’ve been so busy since we opened that I haven’t treated you\nto any proper food, despite your hard work.
Array.indonesia: I’ve been so busy since we opened that I haven’t treated you\nto any proper food, despite your hard work.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_011
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! That sounds fantastic!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow! That sounds fantastic!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_012
Array.english: <size=35>Let me clean up a bit.\nCome to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sushi Bar</color> when you’re ready.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let me clean up a bit.\nCome to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sushi Bar</color> when you’re ready.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission12_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=33><color=#C3C3C3>(Dr. Bacon will be there as well,\nso I can tell him about the fish people I saw.)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#C3C3C3>(Dr. Bacon will be there as well,\nso I can tell him about the fish people I saw.)</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Enter_001
Array.english: Dave, you’re a bit late!\nEveryone’s been waiting for you.
Array.indonesia: Dave, you’re a bit late!\nEveryone’s been waiting for you.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Enter_002
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! You finished all the cooking already!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow! You finished all the cooking already!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Enter_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>When did everyone arrive, though?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>When did everyone arrive, though?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_001
Array.english: Uh, Dr. Bacon?
Array.indonesia: Uh, Dr. Bacon?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_002
Array.english: Oh Dave! What is it?
Array.indonesia: Oh Dave! What is it?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_003
Array.english: <size=36>I saw the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color> down below.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I saw the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color> down below.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_004
Array.english: <size=44>You what!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>You what!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_005
Array.english: You really saw <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color> and not dugongs?\nWhat did they look like? Were they dressed? \nDid they resemble humans?
Array.indonesia: You really saw <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People</color> and not dugongs?\nWhat did they look like? Were they dressed? \nDid they resemble humans?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_006
Array.english: Um... Their torsos look like our own, but the sight of me scared them off into the <color=#F1DC2B>depths</color>. I couldn’t get a good look...
Array.indonesia: Um... Their torsos look like our own, but the sight of me scared them off into the <color=#F1DC2B>depths</color>. I couldn’t get a good look...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_007
Array.english: <size=38>That’s too bad!\nIt could have been an amazing find!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>That’s too bad!\nIt could have been an amazing find!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_008
Array.english: That means we might encounter them in the depths!\nThat’s where the <color=#1DFEAF>signal</color> is strongest.
Array.indonesia: That means we might encounter them in the depths!\nThat’s where the <color=#1DFEAF>signal</color> is strongest.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_009
Array.english: <size=36>Perhaps there’s even a <color=#F1DC2B>village</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Perhaps there’s even a <color=#F1DC2B>village</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_010
Array.english: <size=44>A <color=#F1DC2B>village</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>A <color=#F1DC2B>village</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_011
Array.english: Yes. They have artifacts, murals, a language...\nThey are beings with a unique civilization.
Array.indonesia: Yes. They have artifacts, murals, a language...\nThey are beings with a unique civilization.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_012
Array.english: <size=38>It would not be surprising in the least for them to live together in a <color=#F1DC2B>village</color> of sorts.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>It would not be surprising in the least for them to live together in a <color=#F1DC2B>village</color> of sorts.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_013
Array.english: <size=35>That would be quite the find indeed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>That would be quite the find indeed!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_014
Array.english: <size=32>An ancient civilization under the sea could be \nrevealed to us!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>An ancient civilization under the sea could be \nrevealed to us!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_01_015
Array.english: <size=36>Dave, you’re my best hope.\nKeep up the good work!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Dave, you’re my best hope.\nKeep up the good work!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_02_001
Array.english: To think Sea People were real!
Array.indonesia: To think Sea People were real!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bacon_02_002
Array.english: <size=38>Now then, let’s enjoy ourselves today, Dave!\nTo the success of our research!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Now then, let’s enjoy ourselves today, Dave!\nTo the success of our research!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_001
Array.english: A <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color> tentacle...\nIt is not exactly an easy ingredient to use…
Array.indonesia: A <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color> tentacle...\nIt is not exactly an easy ingredient to use…

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_002
Array.english: Suppressing the stench should allow me to reach its essence.
Array.indonesia: Suppressing the stench should allow me to reach its essence.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_003
Array.english: You’re still studying the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: You’re still studying the ingredients.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_004
Array.english: Good work today, bringing back precious ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Good work today, bringing back precious ingredients.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_005
Array.english: This is a difficult sort to prepare,\nbut that’s part of the fun of cooking.
Array.indonesia: This is a difficult sort to prepare,\nbut that’s part of the fun of cooking.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_006
Array.english: <size=38>So, how does it taste?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>So, how does it taste?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_007
Array.english: The food’s always been great, but today’s is even more...
Array.indonesia: The food’s always been great, but today’s is even more...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_008
Array.english: <size=44>Spectacular!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Spectacular!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_009
Array.english: Since there was a lot of it, I made many different dishes,\nthough we won’t be able to offer these to customers.
Array.indonesia: Since there was a lot of it, I made many different dishes,\nthough we won’t be able to offer these to customers.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_010
Array.english: There seems to be no end to the path of the chef.\nIt’s a fortunate thing to have a path to pursue.
Array.indonesia: There seems to be no end to the path of the chef.\nIt’s a fortunate thing to have a path to pursue.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_011
Array.english: The same can be said of the study of ingredients.\nDave, please keep persevering and one day we’ll succeed.
Array.indonesia: The same can be said of the study of ingredients.\nDave, please keep persevering and one day we’ll succeed.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_01_012
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I’m not sure what you mean, but...)</color>\n<size=33>Sure, I’ll be sure to bring back more fish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(I’m not sure what you mean, but...)</color>\n<size=33>Sure, I’ll be sure to bring back more fish!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Bancho_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Bon appetit!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Bon appetit!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Bwahaha! Dave, congratulations! \nWord of Bancho Sushi is now getting around!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Bwahaha! Dave, congratulations! \nWord of Bancho Sushi is now getting around!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He looks to be in a very good mood...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(He looks to be in a very good mood...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_003
Array.english: Look at this <color=#F1DC2B>Squid Tentacle</color>!\nIt’s the sort of thing you dream of eating as a child!
Array.indonesia: Look at this <color=#F1DC2B>Squid Tentacle</color>!\nIt’s the sort of thing you dream of eating as a child!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_004
Array.english: <size=35>I’ll bet more people will flock here\nif such things are offered on the menu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I’ll bet more people will flock here\nif such things are offered on the menu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_005
Array.english: Aren’t we eating this because\nit’s difficult to serve to customers, though?
Array.indonesia: Aren’t we eating this because\nit’s difficult to serve to customers, though?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_006
Array.english: Kgh... You’re right!\nWhat a pity. Everyone would want to try something that looks like this, regardless of the taste.
Array.indonesia: Kgh... You’re right!\nWhat a pity. Everyone would want to try something that looks like this, regardless of the taste.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_007
Array.english: Regardless of the flavor, you say?\nThere’s no way Bancho could stomach that.
Array.indonesia: Regardless of the flavor, you say?\nThere’s no way Bancho could stomach that.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_008
Array.english: Let’s go with something else.
Array.indonesia: Let’s go with something else.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_009
Array.english: Alright. About the... <color=#F1DC2B>depths</color>.\nI have a feeling there must be things down there,
Array.indonesia: Alright. About the... <color=#F1DC2B>depths</color>.\nI have a feeling there must be things down there,

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_010
Array.english: <size=36>things that’ll make people jump out of their seats.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>things that’ll make people jump out of their seats.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_011
Array.english: If Dr. Bacon’s research is successful,\nthis place will be famous and filled with people!
Array.indonesia: If Dr. Bacon’s research is successful,\nthis place will be famous and filled with people!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_012
Array.english: Hmm. You’re right.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. You’re right.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_013
Array.english: <size=38>When that happens, we’ll make <color=#F1DC2B>tons of money</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>When that happens, we’ll make <color=#F1DC2B>tons of money</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_01_014
Array.english: <size=34>So let’s keep at it, Dave!\nLet’s get rich together. Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>So let’s keep at it, Dave!\nLet’s get rich together. Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Cobra_02_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wonderful food, good drinks, and a plan for becoming rich!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wonderful food, good drinks, and a plan for becoming rich!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_001
Array.english: A <color=#F1DC2B>party</color> with customers...\nThere’s been a lot of progress. Very good.
Array.indonesia: A <color=#F1DC2B>party</color> with customers...\nThere’s been a lot of progress. Very good.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Has there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Has there?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_003
Array.english: Restaurants should put their customers first.\nFood, drinks, service... and customers are the basic foundations of a restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Restaurants should put their customers first.\nFood, drinks, service... and customers are the basic foundations of a restaurant.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>In the past, there was only a rigorous chef\nand his cooking.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>In the past, there was only a rigorous chef\nand his cooking.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_005
Array.english: <size=36>Um... I was also here from the beginning...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Um... I was also here from the beginning...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_006
Array.english: <size=36>Yes, but you weren’t very noticeable.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Yes, but you weren’t very noticeable.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_007
Array.english: Do you remember what I told you back then?\nAbout the reviews on <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>.
Array.indonesia: Do you remember what I told you back then?\nAbout the reviews on <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_008
Array.english: <size=36>You said...</size>\nThere wasn’t any real mention of me...
Array.indonesia: <size=36>You said...</size>\nThere wasn’t any real mention of me...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_009
Array.english: But now people do mention you,\nalbeit rarely.
Array.indonesia: But now people do mention you,\nalbeit rarely.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_010
Array.english: They say things like “He poured me hot green tea,” \n“He was working hard preparing the wasabi,”\n“He was friendly,” “He looked busy...”
Array.indonesia: They say things like “He poured me hot green tea,” \n“He was working hard preparing the wasabi,”\n“He was friendly,” “He looked busy...”

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_011
Array.english: <size=36>Oh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_012
Array.english: <size=33>The customers are recognizing your hard work.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The customers are recognizing your hard work.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_013
Array.english: <size=36>Well! That makes me feel good.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Well! That makes me feel good.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_014
Array.english: Customers are honest and intuitive, more so than you think.\nThey know if you're sincere, kind, diligent, or skilled, and they react accordingly.
Array.indonesia: Customers are honest and intuitive, more so than you think.\nThey know if you're sincere, kind, diligent, or skilled, and they react accordingly.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_015
Array.english: That’s why this moment is hard to believe. To think that such an obstinate Bancho would be working with people and holding parties...
Array.indonesia: That’s why this moment is hard to believe. To think that such an obstinate Bancho would be working with people and holding parties...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_016
Array.english: <size=34>I think it’s thanks to you, <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I think it’s thanks to you, <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_017
Array.english: <size=33>That makes me wonder what he was like in the past...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That makes me wonder what he was like in the past...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_018
Array.english: I can’t divulge details about someone else’s past.
Array.indonesia: I can’t divulge details about someone else’s past.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_01_019
Array.english: But maybe someday, if the opportunity presents itself...\nI might be able to tell you.
Array.indonesia: But maybe someday, if the opportunity presents itself...\nI might be able to tell you.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Yoshie_02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, holding a party...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, holding a party...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Phew. That’s good stuff.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Phew. That’s good stuff.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_002
Array.english: Bancho’s food is so nice.\nI can understand the growing popularity of the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Bancho’s food is so nice.\nI can understand the growing popularity of the restaurant.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_003
Array.english: Or maybe it’s because I caught the fish?
Array.indonesia: Or maybe it’s because I caught the fish?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>In any case, there's been a lot of stuff going on.\nA Giant Squid... Sea People...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>In any case, there's been a lot of stuff going on.\nA Giant Squid... Sea People...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_005
Array.english: <size=36>There’s no end to the mysteries of the ocean,\neven if it’s dangerous.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>There’s no end to the mysteries of the ocean,\neven if it’s dangerous.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>I suppose I’ll go even deeper tomorrow.</size>\n<size=33>I wonder what I’ll find?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I suppose I’ll go even deeper tomorrow.</size>\n<size=33>I wonder what I’ll find?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_007
Array.english: Eh, whatever.\nI’ll think about that tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Eh, whatever.\nI’ll think about that tomorrow.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Dave_01_008
Array.english: <size=36>Time to toast with everyone and rest!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Time to toast with everyone and rest!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_001
Array.english: Haha! The wind is always cool and nice at night.\nI am sobering up now.
Array.indonesia: Haha! The wind is always cool and nice at night.\nI am sobering up now.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_002
Array.english: (Beep, beep, beep)
Array.indonesia: (Beep, beep, beep)

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_003
Array.english: <size=36>Mm? The radar of the Sea People detected something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mm? The radar of the Sea People detected something.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_004
Array.english: But it's not from the water.\nJust how?
Array.indonesia: But it's not from the water.\nJust how?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_005
Array.english: Well, I am feeling lucky today.
Array.indonesia: Well, I am feeling lucky today.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Monologue_006
Array.english: <size=36>I should go check what it is.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I should go check what it is.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>I am receiving signals from this cave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I am receiving signals from this cave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Start_002
Array.english: This cave doesn’t look like it was naturally formed.
Array.indonesia: This cave doesn’t look like it was naturally formed.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Worth an investigation.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Worth an investigation.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InCave_001
Array.english: <size=37>What a surprise. \nA <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color> in a place like this?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>What a surprise. \nA <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color> in a place like this?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InCave_002
Array.english: Well, it’s quite different from the murals of the Sea People \nI saw in the sea.
Array.indonesia: Well, it’s quite different from the murals of the Sea People \nI saw in the sea.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InCave_003
Array.english: <size=35>Let me examine it closely.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let me examine it closely.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Password_001
Array.english: There is a device of some sort here.\nAnd I think I have seen some of these <color=#F1DC2B>letters</color> on the mural.
Array.indonesia: There is a device of some sort here.\nAnd I think I have seen some of these <color=#F1DC2B>letters</color> on the mural.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_OpenSecretRoom_001
Array.english: <size=35>Bravo! The door is open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bravo! The door is open!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_OpenSecretRoom_002
Array.english: It looks dark and creepy, but a true archaeologist will never miss this kind of opportunity.
Array.indonesia: It looks dark and creepy, but a true archaeologist will never miss this kind of opportunity.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_OpenSecretRoom_003
Array.english: <size=35>Let’s see what’s inside!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let’s see what’s inside!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InTortureChamber_001
Array.english: <size=35>This place...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>This place...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InTortureChamber_002
Array.english: <size=32>Look at all these bones and torture devices...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Look at all these bones and torture devices...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_InTortureChamber_003
Array.english: I must first examine the <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color> in the back \nto find some clues.
Array.indonesia: I must first examine the <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color> in the back \nto find some clues.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_AfterChamberResearch_001
Array.english: <size=34>So, that’s what happened, huh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>So, that’s what happened, huh?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_AfterChamberResearch_002
Array.english: Humans could live in harmony with the Sea People\nwere it not for small misunderstandings.
Array.indonesia: Humans could live in harmony with the Sea People\nwere it not for small misunderstandings.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_AfterChamberResearch_003
Array.english: Let’s first bring this <color=#F1DC2B>artifact</color> for further research.
Array.indonesia: Let’s first bring this <color=#F1DC2B>artifact</color> for further research.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_PickupTreasure_001
Array.english: <size=36>Wow, this...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wow, this...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_PickupTreasure_002
Array.english: Looks like a sort of <color=#1DFEAF>breathing apparatus</color>.
Array.indonesia: Looks like a sort of <color=#1DFEAF>breathing apparatus</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_PickupTreasure_003
Array.english: Maybe a Sea People device made for humans?
Array.indonesia: Maybe a Sea People device made for humans?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_CaveNoise_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hm? What’s that noise outside?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hm? What’s that noise outside?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>What? Who is that?\nWhy is he here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What? Who is that?\nWhy is he here?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>Agh! Pirates!\nWhat are they doing here? Raiding?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Agh! Pirates!\nWhat are they doing here? Raiding?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Start_003
Array.english: <size=32>Back to the boat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Back to the boat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Boat_Chasing_001
Array.english: <size=34>This is our turf!\nGive us whatever you have right now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This is our turf!\nGive us whatever you have right now!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Boat_Chasing_002
Array.english: <size=33>They won’t let us go easily if we stop now.\nLet’s get away as far as we can!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>They won’t let us go easily if we stop now.\nLet’s get away as far as we can!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Clear_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whew, I almost fainted.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whew, I almost fainted.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_Chasing_Clear_002
Array.english: <size=32>I must take this Sea People <color=#1DFEAF>breathing apparatus</color> for further study.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I must take this Sea People <color=#1DFEAF>breathing apparatus</color> for further study.</size>

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oy, got some sleep?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oy, got some sleep?</size>

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_002
Array.english: Yes. But not enough though.
Array.indonesia: Yes. But not enough though.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_003
Array.english: I went to a cave nearby last night\nand found this by chance.
Array.indonesia: I went to a cave nearby last night\nand found this by chance.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_004
Array.english: I think it is an apparatus that allows you to breathe underwater like Sea People do.
Array.indonesia: I think it is an apparatus that allows you to breathe underwater like Sea People do.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_005
Array.english: I speculate that Sea People possibly made this for humans.
Array.indonesia: I speculate that Sea People possibly made this for humans.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_006
Array.english: Anyway, it was lying deep in the cave,\nnever used.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, it was lying deep in the cave,\nnever used.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_007
Array.english: <size=34>Maybe it could prove useful somewhere.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Maybe it could prove useful somewhere.</size>

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_008
Array.english: I will keep it in the lab just in case.
Array.indonesia: I will keep it in the lab just in case.

Array.name: dialog_intermission_Chapter4_Bacon_NextMorning_009
Array.english: <size=34>Say hi to the Sea People for me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Say hi to the Sea People for me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_001
Array.english: <size=38>Dave, is everything going well?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dave, is everything going well?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_002
Array.english: Um, I opened the passage to the Glacial Area, but...
Array.indonesia: Um, I opened the passage to the Glacial Area, but...

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_003
Array.english: <size=32>I can’t explore the area because it’s too cold.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I can’t explore the area because it’s too cold.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_004
Array.english: Oh, your current suit is not warm enough, I see.
Array.indonesia: Oh, your current suit is not warm enough, I see.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_005
Array.english: So the Sea People gave me this <color=#1DFEAF>cloth</color>,\nbut I don’t know how to use it.
Array.indonesia: So the Sea People gave me this <color=#1DFEAF>cloth</color>,\nbut I don’t know how to use it.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_006
Array.english: <size=36>The cloth is warm to the touch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>The cloth is warm to the touch!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_007
Array.english: This is the <color=#1DFEAF>breathing apparatus</color> found in the Sea People’s cave.
Array.indonesia: This is the <color=#1DFEAF>breathing apparatus</color> found in the Sea People’s cave.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_008
Array.english: I could make a Cold-resistant Suit\nif I had a <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical part</color> that could patch up the items.
Array.indonesia: I could make a Cold-resistant Suit\nif I had a <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical part</color> that could patch up the items.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_009
Array.english: <size=35>Mechanical part...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Mechanical part...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_010
Array.english: Don’t you have one from John Watson’s suit?
Array.indonesia: Don’t you have one from John Watson’s suit?

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_011
Array.english: You’re right. \nActually, I brought some complex mechanical parts.
Array.indonesia: You’re right. \nActually, I brought some complex mechanical parts.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_012
Array.english: This is a device that automatically adjusts water pressure.\nI may be able to do something with this.
Array.indonesia: This is a device that automatically adjusts water pressure.\nI may be able to do something with this.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_013
Array.english: <size=36>But...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>But...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_014
Array.english: It’s too damaged to be used without repair.\nIf only you could find one intact somewhere.
Array.indonesia: It’s too damaged to be used without repair.\nIf only you could find one intact somewhere.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_015
Array.english: <size=38>Oh! I have a good idea!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh! I have a good idea!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_016
Array.english: <size=35>What is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>What is it?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_017
Array.english: <size=36>I will tell you later in the <color=#1DFEAF>evening</color>. \nI need to organize my thoughts. Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I will tell you later in the <color=#1DFEAF>evening</color>. \nI need to organize my thoughts. Haha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Bacon_MorningTalk_018
Array.english: I have a bad feeling about this.
Array.indonesia: I have a bad feeling about this.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_001
Array.english: So, what is the idea you mentioned earlier?
Array.indonesia: So, what is the idea you mentioned earlier?

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_002
Array.english: Oh, that...
Array.indonesia: Oh, that...

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_003
Array.english: <size=36>What if you infiltrate the Sea Blue base \nand retrieve the <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical part</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>What if you infiltrate the Sea Blue base \nand retrieve the <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical part</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_004
Array.english: <size=38>Me? Go to their base?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Me? Go to their base?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_005
Array.english: Sea Blue folks were scouting the area\nusing underwater drones at night.
Array.indonesia: Sea Blue folks were scouting the area\nusing underwater drones at night.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_006
Array.english: Follow those drones and you will find their base.
Array.indonesia: Follow those drones and you will find their base.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_007
Array.english: <size=38>That sounds very dangerous...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>That sounds very dangerous...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_008
Array.english: Hahaha, don’t worry.\nI will prepare an <color=#F1DC2B>infiltration suit</color> with camouflage patterns.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha, don’t worry.\nI will prepare an <color=#F1DC2B>infiltration suit</color> with camouflage patterns.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_009
Array.english: <size=35>It will hide you from plain sight at night!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It will hide you from plain sight at night!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_010
Array.english: ...no guarantees though.
Array.indonesia: ...no guarantees though.

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_011
Array.english: <size=38>Umm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Umm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission21_Stealth_Evening_012
Array.english: Anyways, it’s not dark enough yet, so I will see you later\nwhen I close the bar. Hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Anyways, it’s not dark enough yet, so I will see you later\nwhen I close the bar. Hahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_BoatTalk_001
Array.english: Whew, this should be enough.
Array.indonesia: Whew, this should be enough.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_BoatTalk_002
Array.english: Dave, you’re here.
Array.indonesia: Dave, you’re here.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_BoatTalk_003
Array.english: It’s so dark, are you sure there’s something there?
Array.indonesia: It’s so dark, are you sure there’s something there?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_BoatTalk_004
Array.english: Hehehe, just put on this infiltration gear.\nIt will help you stay unnoticed.
Array.indonesia: Hehehe, just put on this infiltration gear.\nIt will help you stay unnoticed.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, I feel like a secret agent!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, I feel like a secret agent!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_002
Array.english: Dressed for success!\nYou look ready to enter Dark Moses Island in that!
Array.indonesia: Dressed for success!\nYou look ready to enter Dark Moses Island in that!

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_003
Array.english: Well, into the water now.\nYou will see roaming drones underwater.
Array.indonesia: Well, into the water now.\nYou will see roaming drones underwater.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_004
Array.english: Follow them unnoticed.\nI bet they will lead you to Sea Blue’s base.
Array.indonesia: Follow them unnoticed.\nI bet they will lead you to Sea Blue’s base.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_005
Array.english: <size=37>Oh, right.\nLeave your weapons here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh, right.\nLeave your weapons here.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_006
Array.english: <size=38>What? You want me to infiltrate their base unarmed?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>What? You want me to infiltrate their base unarmed?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_007
Array.english: Sea Blue runs a tight security system with sentry drones \nand sensors.
Array.indonesia: Sea Blue runs a tight security system with sentry drones \nand sensors.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_008
Array.english: If one of the drones detects a weapon, \nthey will alert the base immediately.
Array.indonesia: If one of the drones detects a weapon, \nthey will alert the base immediately.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_009
Array.english: <size=32>This is a covert mission. You’ll go in quietly, retrieve the mechanical part, and return undetected. Simple enough, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>This is a covert mission. You’ll go in quietly, retrieve the mechanical part, and return undetected. Simple enough, right?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_AfterCostumeChange_010
Array.english: Why am I here losing sleep…
Array.indonesia: Why am I here losing sleep…

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_FollowDrone_001
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>That must be one of Sea Blue’s sentry drones.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>That must be one of Sea Blue’s sentry drones.</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_FollowDrone_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I should follow it from a distance.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>I should follow it from a distance.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_FindSeaBlue_001
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>Oh, a hidden entrance?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>Oh, a hidden entrance?</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Stealth_FindSeaBlue_002
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>I should hurry before the door closes.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>I should hurry before the door closes.</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>Isn’t this too big to be a hidden base?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>Isn’t this too big to be a hidden base?</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>What are these facilities for?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>What are these facilities for?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start02_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Machines processing dolphin meat...?!</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Machines processing dolphin meat...?!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start02_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I am confused. Aren't Sea Blue environmentalists?\nWhat in the world are these for?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>I am confused. Aren't Sea Blue environmentalists?\nWhat in the world are these for?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_Start02_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I must find some <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical parts</color> for now.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>I must find some <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical parts</color> for now.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_End_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>This looks like an office.\nIt looks like it contains some <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical parts</color> here.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>This looks like an office.\nIt looks like it contains some <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical parts</color> here.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Stealth_End_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Man, I miss my warm, clean bed at home.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Man, I miss my warm, clean bed at home.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Find_Item_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=38>Good! Here it is!</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=38>Good! Here it is!</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_Find_Item_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=38>Let me take it.</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=38>Let me take it.</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oh, Dave!\nYou came back in one piece!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh, Dave!\nYou came back in one piece!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_002
Array.english: Well... I sense a lack of trust in your voice \nregarding my survival skills...
Array.indonesia: Well... I sense a lack of trust in your voice \nregarding my survival skills...

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_003
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! C’mon. Take a look at this thing. \nSea Blue’s <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical part</color>! In pristine condition!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! C’mon. Take a look at this thing. \nSea Blue’s <color=#1DFEAF>mechanical part</color>! In pristine condition!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_004
Array.english: Why didn’t you warn me of the armed pirates?
Array.indonesia: Why didn’t you warn me of the armed pirates?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_005
Array.english: <size=35>Honestly, I didn’t know of their presence!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Honestly, I didn’t know of their presence!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_006
Array.english: Anyway…
Array.indonesia: Anyway…

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_007
Array.english: I found many pieces of equipment used to\nprocess and freeze fish at Sea Blue’s base.
Array.indonesia: I found many pieces of equipment used to\nprocess and freeze fish at Sea Blue’s base.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_008
Array.english: And I believe they caught some dolphins as well.
Array.indonesia: And I believe they caught some dolphins as well.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_009
Array.english: Isn’t Sea Blue a group of environmentalists?\nDoesn’t that make them hypocrites?
Array.indonesia: Isn’t Sea Blue a group of environmentalists?\nDoesn’t that make them hypocrites?

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_010
Array.english: Knowing they have been exposed might make them \nmore dangerous. You better be careful.
Array.indonesia: Knowing they have been exposed might make them \nmore dangerous. You better be careful.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_011
Array.english: Anyways, get some rest. It’s getting late.
Array.indonesia: Anyways, get some rest. It’s getting late.

Array.name: dialog_Intermission_Chapter5_Dave_End_012
Array.english: <size=37>I will talk to Dr. Bacon tomorrow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>I will talk to Dr. Bacon tomorrow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_001
Array.english: <size=38>Good morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Good morning!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_002
Array.english: I must have drank too much yesterday... I feel sick.
Array.indonesia: I must have drank too much yesterday... I feel sick.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_003
Array.english: You did seem a bit excited...
Array.indonesia: You did seem a bit excited...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_004
Array.english: Haha! You don’t get gatherings like that every day!\nThat sort of occasion calls for joviality...
Array.indonesia: Haha! You don’t get gatherings like that every day!\nThat sort of occasion calls for joviality...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_005
Array.english: <size=50>Hrrk...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>Hrrk...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_006
Array.english: <size=42>You can’t throw up here, Dr. Bacon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>You can’t throw up here, Dr. Bacon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_007
Array.english: Oof... I’m not the drinker I used to be.\nIn any case...
Array.indonesia: Oof... I’m not the drinker I used to be.\nIn any case...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_008
Array.english: Take the <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color> Duff gave you\nand try venturing down into the depths.
Array.indonesia: Take the <color=#1DFEAF>Deep Sea Headlamp</color> Duff gave you\nand try venturing down into the depths.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_009
Array.english: It’ll probably turn on automatically when you reach the right depth.
Array.indonesia: It’ll probably turn on automatically when you reach the right depth.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_009_2
Array.english: And don’t forget... You’ll have to enhance your <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Suit</color>\nif you want to venture into the depths!
Array.indonesia: And don’t forget... You’ll have to enhance your <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Suit</color>\nif you want to venture into the depths!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_010
Array.english: I’ll have to <color=#F1DC2B>enhance my equipment</color> first, then.\nBy the way, do you happen to have scuba—
Array.indonesia: I’ll have to <color=#F1DC2B>enhance my equipment</color> first, then.\nBy the way, do you happen to have scuba—

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_011
Array.english: <size=50>Blaargh!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>Blaargh!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_012
Array.english: Ugh...\nHe’s asking me to enter the water after that?
Array.indonesia: Ugh...\nHe’s asking me to enter the water after that?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_CobraShop_001
Array.english: <size=40>Oh! Dave, by the way...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Oh! Dave, by the way...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_CobraShop_002
Array.english: I’ve added some <color=#1DFEAF>new tools</color> to the Cobra Shop.
Array.indonesia: I’ve added some <color=#1DFEAF>new tools</color> to the Cobra Shop.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_CobraShop_003
Array.english: <size=40>Talk to me when you have the time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Talk to me when you have the time!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=45>Wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Wait!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_002
Array.english: So it was you...\nThe one who’s been harming the ocean!
Array.indonesia: So it was you...\nThe one who’s been harming the ocean!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_002_01
Array.english: <size=38>You even vomited, you disgusting creature!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>You even vomited, you disgusting creature!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_003
Array.english: Wait... That wasn’t me, it was...
Array.indonesia: Wait... That wasn’t me, it was...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=38>I have no time for your petty excuses!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I have no time for your petty excuses!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_005
Array.english: Now that you’ve been caught by John Watson of <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, \nthe Guardians of the Sea, you won’t be leaving so easily.
Array.indonesia: Now that you’ve been caught by John Watson of <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, \nthe Guardians of the Sea, you won’t be leaving so easily.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=42>I’ll turn you into fish food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>I’ll turn you into fish food!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_001
Array.english: <size=47>Oh my Poseidon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=47>Oh my Poseidon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_002
Array.english: This is all your fault.\nYou did this to the precious sea...
Array.indonesia: This is all your fault.\nYou did this to the precious sea...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_003
Array.english: You’re the one shooting bombs...
Array.indonesia: You’re the one shooting bombs...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_004
Array.english: And all I do is catch a few fish to keep the restaurant running...
Array.indonesia: And all I do is catch a few fish to keep the restaurant running...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_005
Array.english: Why don’t you look into the fishing vessels responsible for catching thousands of fish, not individual divers like me!
Array.indonesia: Why don’t you look into the fishing vessels responsible for catching thousands of fish, not individual divers like me!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_006
Array.english: <size=55>...</size>\r<size=68>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=55>...</size>\r<size=68>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_007
Array.english: <size=38>Enough blabbing!\nI’ll shut that yapper of yours!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Enough blabbing!\nI’ll shut that yapper of yours!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_1_Timeline2_008
Array.english: <size=48>Here goes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Here goes!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_Complete_001
Array.english: Kgh... How dare you fight back against me, \nJohn Watson, formerly of the Navy Seals...
Array.indonesia: Kgh... How dare you fight back against me, \nJohn Watson, formerly of the Navy Seals...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_Complete_002
Array.english: That should serve as an adequate warning\nso I’ll back away for now to protect the environment...
Array.indonesia: That should serve as an adequate warning\nso I’ll back away for now to protect the environment...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=33>But I won’t let you go unpunished \nif you persist in damaging the ocean!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But I won’t let you go unpunished \nif you persist in damaging the ocean!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=44>We’re watching you...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>We’re watching you...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: A path has opened up in the direction of John Watson’s escape.
Array.indonesia: A path has opened up in the direction of John Watson’s escape.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_2_AfterTimeline_002
Array.english: Let’s go that way to reach the <color=#F1DC2B>signal</color>.
Array.indonesia: Let’s go that way to reach the <color=#F1DC2B>signal</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=40>Huh? It’s the Sea People from before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Huh? It’s the Sea People from before!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: Um... They’re saying something...\nI can’t tell what they’re saying...
Array.indonesia: Um... They’re saying something...\nI can’t tell what they’re saying...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_002
Array.english: I’ll have to call Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: I’ll have to call Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_003
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_004
Array.english: <size=48>My goodness! Wow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>My goodness! Wow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_005
Array.english: To... to think the Sea People were real...\nIt’s simply incredible!
Array.indonesia: To... to think the Sea People were real...\nIt’s simply incredible!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_006
Array.english: Um... they’re saying something to me,\nbut I can’t understand them.
Array.indonesia: Um... they’re saying something to me,\nbut I can’t understand them.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_007
Array.english: Hmm. I think analyzing the patterns\nmight allow us to translate...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I think analyzing the patterns\nmight allow us to translate...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_3_AfterTimeline_008
Array.english: Come back up to the boat for now.\nI’ll try and think of a way to translate!
Array.indonesia: Come back up to the boat for now.\nI’ll try and think of a way to translate!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_Complete_001
Array.english: Hmm! I did expect the Sea People civilization to be real,\nbut to think there are living Sea People...
Array.indonesia: Hmm! I did expect the Sea People civilization to be real,\nbut to think there are living Sea People...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission13_Complete_002
Array.english: This is truly the find of the century!\nThis is thanks to you, Dave.
Array.indonesia: This is truly the find of the century!\nThis is thanks to you, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_002
Array.english: <size=36>Hahaha!\nLet’s tell all the news outlets in the world about this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hahaha!\nLet’s tell all the news outlets in the world about this!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_003
Array.english: Wait! I think that might be risky...
Array.indonesia: Wait! I think that might be risky...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_004
Array.english: But why?\nThat’s how we’ll get people flocking to this place!
Array.indonesia: But why?\nThat’s how we’ll get people flocking to this place!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_005
Array.english: It wouldn’t matter if we were talking about some ruins,\nbut these are living Sea People. Poachers are bound to show up.
Array.indonesia: It wouldn’t matter if we were talking about some ruins,\nbut these are living Sea People. Poachers are bound to show up.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_006
Array.english: They’ll start hunting the Sea People,\nsince that will be a way to get a lot of attention.
Array.indonesia: They’ll start hunting the Sea People,\nsince that will be a way to get a lot of attention.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_007
Array.english: Y-you have a point there...
Array.indonesia: Y-you have a point there...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_008
Array.english: How about we first make a <color=#F1DC2B>Translator</color> to analyze their sound waves and figure out what they’re saying?
Array.indonesia: How about we first make a <color=#F1DC2B>Translator</color> to analyze their sound waves and figure out what they’re saying?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_009
Array.english: I think they have something to tell us.
Array.indonesia: I think they have something to tell us.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_010
Array.english: We’ll first need a <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Stone Tablet</color>\nwith their writing on it...
Array.indonesia: We’ll first need a <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Stone Tablet</color>\nwith their writing on it...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_011
Array.english: As well as a <color=#1DFEAF>Microphone</color> and an <color=#1DFEAF>Amethyst</color>.
Array.indonesia: As well as a <color=#1DFEAF>Microphone</color> and an <color=#1DFEAF>Amethyst</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_012
Array.english: If I’m guessing right...The <color=#1DFEAF>Microphone</color> should be below the sunken ship and the <color=#1DFEAF>Stone Tablet</color> is likely to be in their Record Chamber...\rI hear you can mine <color=#1DFEAF>Amethyst</color> at 100m or deeper with a <color=#F1DC2B>Pickaxe</color>!
Array.indonesia: If I’m guessing right...The <color=#1DFEAF>Microphone</color> should be below the sunken ship and the <color=#1DFEAF>Stone Tablet</color> is likely to be in their Record Chamber...\rI hear you can mine <color=#1DFEAF>Amethyst</color> at 100m or deeper with a <color=#F1DC2B>Pickaxe</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_013
Array.english: Um... The Record Chamber, the ship... and...
Array.indonesia: Um... The Record Chamber, the ship... and...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_014
Array.english: If you can’t remember the locations, check the <color=#72ff0a>To-Do App</color>.\nI’ll add the information there!
Array.indonesia: If you can’t remember the locations, check the <color=#72ff0a>To-Do App</color>.\nI’ll add the information there!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! You had to visit a lot of places,\nbut you managed to get everything!\nNow that’s what I call lucky!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! You had to visit a lot of places,\nbut you managed to get everything!\nNow that’s what I call lucky!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_Complete_002
Array.english: I’ll use these to try and make a <color=#F1DC2B>Translator</color> in my lab.
Array.indonesia: I’ll use these to try and make a <color=#F1DC2B>Translator</color> in my lab.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_Complete_003
Array.english: I’ll need some time to make it...\nYou can go about your business in the meantime!
Array.indonesia: I’ll need some time to make it...\nYou can go about your business in the meantime!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=36>I’ll be in touch soon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I’ll be in touch soon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_PickItem_First_001
Array.english: Found one of the components of the Translator…\nNow there’s just <color=#1DFEAF>{0}</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>{1}</color> left.
Array.indonesia: Found one of the components of the Translator…\nNow there’s just <color=#1DFEAF>{0}</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>{1}</color> left.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_PickItem_Second_001
Array.english: Now, I just need <color=#1DFEAF>{0}</color> to create the Sea People Translator!
Array.indonesia: Now, I just need <color=#1DFEAF>{0}</color> to create the Sea People Translator!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_PickItem_Third_001
Array.english: Good. I got all the materials.\nI should be able to make the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Translator</color> now, I think.
Array.indonesia: Good. I got all the materials.\nI should be able to make the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Translator</color> now, I think.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission14_PickItem_Third_002
Array.english: <size=35>I should deliver it to Dr. Bacon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I should deliver it to Dr. Bacon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_001
Array.english: Phew. I tried to do it alone, but it was too tough.\nI got a bit of help from <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.
Array.indonesia: Phew. I tried to do it alone, but it was too tough.\nI got a bit of help from <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_002
Array.english: Thanks to his help, we can now translate\nyour words into the Sea People’s language as well.
Array.indonesia: Thanks to his help, we can now translate\nyour words into the Sea People’s language as well.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_003
Array.english: Wow!\nI’m curious to know what they have to say as well.
Array.indonesia: Wow!\nI’m curious to know what they have to say as well.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_004
Array.english: I’ll first make my way back to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People’s location</color>.
