Array.indonesia: I’ll first make my way back to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People’s location</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Let’s try out the Sea People Translator\nfrom Dr. Bacon and see how it works.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Let’s try out the Sea People Translator\nfrom Dr. Bacon and see how it works.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ah... Ah... Can you... hear me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah... Ah... Can you... hear me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=42>What!\nHow is a human speaking our language?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>What!\nHow is a human speaking our language?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_003
Array.english: An interesting creature...His body looks different from\nthat of the humans we occasionally see...
Array.indonesia: An interesting creature...His body looks different from\nthat of the humans we occasionally see...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_005
Array.english: Well, in any case!\nRight. I should introduce myself.
Array.indonesia: Well, in any case!\nRight. I should introduce myself.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=36>My name is <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>My name is <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_007
Array.english: Among us <color=#90CDFF>Low-Dwellers</color>...\nOh, you said you call us Sea People, right?
Array.indonesia: Among us <color=#90CDFF>Low-Dwellers</color>...\nOh, you said you call us Sea People, right?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_008
Array.english: You could say I’m the bravest and coolest male\namong them. Ahem!
Array.indonesia: You could say I’m the bravest and coolest male\namong them. Ahem!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_009
Array.english: Suwam... Nice to meet you.\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.
Array.indonesia: Suwam... Nice to meet you.\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_010
Array.english: Hehe, Dave…in our language, \nyour name sounds very similar to <color=#90CDFF>“broken toilet lid.”</color>
Array.indonesia: Hehe, Dave…in our language, \nyour name sounds very similar to <color=#90CDFF>“broken toilet lid.”</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_011
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>What is with this creature?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>What is with this creature?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_012
Array.english: In any case! The person lying here\nis the daughter of the Sea People village chief... <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>!
Array.indonesia: In any case! The person lying here\nis the daughter of the Sea People village chief... <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_013
Array.english: Ever since being kidnapped by that stupid giant squid,\nshe has been unconscious...
Array.indonesia: Ever since being kidnapped by that stupid giant squid,\nshe has been unconscious...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_014
Array.english: If I’d known about it a little earlier...\nI’d have shown that squid a thing or two!
Array.indonesia: If I’d known about it a little earlier...\nI’d have shown that squid a thing or two!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_015
Array.english: Don’t get a big head for defeating that insignificant squid, human! I am the one that guards <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>!
Array.indonesia: Don’t get a big head for defeating that insignificant squid, human! I am the one that guards <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_016
Array.english: You really are a noisy one.\nIn any case, you seem to have something to say... what is it?
Array.indonesia: You really are a noisy one.\nIn any case, you seem to have something to say... what is it?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_017
Array.english: Oh, about that.\nIn order to allow Ramo to recover, we need some <color=#F1DC2B>Medicinal Herbs</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, about that.\nIn order to allow Ramo to recover, we need some <color=#F1DC2B>Medicinal Herbs</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_018
Array.english: I’m unable to leave, as I must stay\nand look after her!
Array.indonesia: I’m unable to leave, as I must stay\nand look after her!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_019
Array.english: Human, you must acquire some <color=#F1DC2B>Medicinal Herbs</color>\nto help Ramo recover.
Array.indonesia: Human, you must acquire some <color=#F1DC2B>Medicinal Herbs</color>\nto help Ramo recover.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_020
Array.english: The <color=#1DFEAF>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Lily Coral</color> grow in these parts.\nPlease make them edible and bring them to me.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#1DFEAF>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Lily Coral</color> grow in these parts.\nPlease make them edible and bring them to me.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_021
Array.english: Make them edible?\nHow do I do that?
Array.indonesia: Make them edible?\nHow do I do that?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_022
Array.english: That’s for you to figure out, human!\nGo find a <color=#F1DC2B>chef</color> to help you or something!
Array.indonesia: That’s for you to figure out, human!\nGo find a <color=#F1DC2B>chef</color> to help you or something!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_2_Complete_023
Array.english: Hmm... She’s ill, so I can’t refuse to help her...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Lily Coral</color>, huh? \nI guess I’ll take a look around first...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... She’s ill, so I can’t refuse to help her...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Lily Coral</color>, huh? \nI guess I’ll take a look around first...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_Complete_001
Array.english: Phew. It seems I got everything that fussy half-fish\nasked me for.
Array.indonesia: Phew. It seems I got everything that fussy half-fish\nasked me for.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_Suwam_Normal_01
Array.english: Good, follow along.\nMake sure Ramo isn’t hurt!
Array.indonesia: Good, follow along.\nMake sure Ramo isn’t hurt!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_Suwam_Normal_02
Array.english: Hey now, human... Don’t tell me you’re tired already?\nBring her carefully!
Array.indonesia: Hey now, human... Don’t tell me you’re tired already?\nBring her carefully!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission15_Suwam_Wait_WithOutRamo_01
Array.english: Why are you alone? Where did you leave Ramo?\nI knew it, humans aren’t to be trusted!
Array.indonesia: Why are you alone? Where did you leave Ramo?\nI knew it, humans aren’t to be trusted!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_001
Array.english: He wanted me to make this coral edible, right?
Array.indonesia: He wanted me to make this coral edible, right?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_002
Array.english: <size=37>I’ll have to ask <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> for help.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>I’ll have to ask <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> for help.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_001
Array.english: Hmm... So this coral has to be prepared so\nit’s easy to eat for Sea People...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... So this coral has to be prepared so\nit’s easy to eat for Sea People...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_002
Array.english: Well, I think we could start with a <color=#1DFEAF>porridge</color> of sorts...\nGive me a moment.
Array.indonesia: Well, I think we could start with a <color=#1DFEAF>porridge</color> of sorts...\nGive me a moment.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_003
Array.english: Here you go.\nI softened the coral to make it easy to eat, so it should be fine.
Array.indonesia: Here you go.\nI softened the coral to make it easy to eat, so it should be fine.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_004
Array.english: Wow, thank you, Bancho.\nYou’re so quick.
Array.indonesia: Wow, thank you, Bancho.\nYou’re so quick.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_1_Complete_005
Array.english: Alright! Let’s take this to <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>.
Array.indonesia: Alright! Let’s take this to <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Complete_001
Array.english: Here, I brought some <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color>.
Array.indonesia: Here, I brought some <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Complete_002
Array.english: Oho! You really brought it?\n*sniff* Seems to be right.
Array.indonesia: Oho! You really brought it?\n*sniff* Seems to be right.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Complete_003
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>! This is Coral Porridge!\nI prepared it myself!
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>! This is Coral Porridge!\nI prepared it myself!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_001
Array.english: <size=40>Phew! I feel much better now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Phew! I feel much better now!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_002
Array.english: I can’t remember anything after\nseeing squid tentacles...
Array.indonesia: I can’t remember anything after\nseeing squid tentacles...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_003
Array.english: <size=42>Huh? A human? What is a human doing here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Huh? A human? What is a human doing here?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_004
Array.english: Well... you could say I saved you.\nI defeated the Giant Squid and brought you the Coral Porridge...
Array.indonesia: Well... you could say I saved you.\nI defeated the Giant Squid and brought you the Coral Porridge...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_005
Array.english: <size=45>Hmm? Is that so?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Hmm? Is that so?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_006
Array.english: Wait, Ramo, that’s not it!\nI’m actually the one who...
Array.indonesia: Wait, Ramo, that’s not it!\nI’m actually the one who...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_007
Array.english: <size=37>Alright, then! Human!\nYou shall <color=#F1DC2B>escort</color> me back to my village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Alright, then! Human!\nYou shall <color=#F1DC2B>escort</color> me back to my village!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_008
Array.english: <size=40>Me? Why should I?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Me? Why should I?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_009
Array.english: I’m an injured lady!\nYou need to keep anything dangerous from happening!
Array.indonesia: I’m an injured lady!\nYou need to keep anything dangerous from happening!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_010
Array.english: Ramo, I can escort you to...
Array.indonesia: Ramo, I can escort you to...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_011
Array.english: <size=34>Suwam! You go ahead and scout our path!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Suwam! You go ahead and scout our path!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_012
Array.english: What? How could you let a human escort you!\nI can keep you safe and...
Array.indonesia: What? How could you let a human escort you!\nI can keep you safe and...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_013
Array.english: You haven’t even passed the village tactics exam!\nIt was tough enough coming here.
Array.indonesia: You haven’t even passed the village tactics exam!\nIt was tough enough coming here.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_014
Array.english: <size=45>Argh! That’s a sore spot for me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Argh! That’s a sore spot for me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_015
Array.english: Suwam!\nStop complaining and be our lookout for the path ahead.
Array.indonesia: Suwam!\nStop complaining and be our lookout for the path ahead.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_016
Array.english: As for you, human, you’ll have to <color=#F1DC2B>carry</color> me on your back.
Array.indonesia: As for you, human, you’ll have to <color=#F1DC2B>carry</color> me on your back.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_017
Array.english: On my... back?\nIt’s hard enough to move around as it is down here.
Array.indonesia: On my... back?\nIt’s hard enough to move around as it is down here.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_018
Array.english: Ow... My injured fin is hurting again...
Array.indonesia: Ow... My injured fin is hurting again...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_2_Timeline_019
Array.english: You are impossible.\nI’ll take you to the village and no further... alright?
Array.indonesia: You are impossible.\nI’ll take you to the village and no further... alright?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_MidEvent_001
Array.english: What is this vibration?
Array.indonesia: What is this vibration?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_MidEvent_002
Array.english: It’s rare to experience one so strong...
Array.indonesia: It’s rare to experience one so strong...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_MidEvent_003
Array.english: <size=35>Did something happen to the village?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Did something happen to the village?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_MidEvent_004
Array.english: <size=35>We must return quick.\nHurry, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>We must return quick.\nHurry, human!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=36>Ramo... This...\nOur path in is blocked with rock!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ramo... This...\nOur path in is blocked with rock!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_002
Array.english: Oh no! What is going on?
Array.indonesia: Oh no! What is going on?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_003
Array.english: Um... It must have been the vibrations earlier...
Array.indonesia: Um... It must have been the vibrations earlier...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_004
Array.english: Suwam! Think of something.\nI need to get back quick before my father scolds me again!
Array.indonesia: Suwam! Think of something.\nI need to get back quick before my father scolds me again!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_005
Array.english: Um...\n<size=45>Hmm...</size>
Array.indonesia: Um...\n<size=45>Hmm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=37>Maybe we can open up a path by dropping\nthe loose <color=#F1DC2B>rock pile</color> over there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Maybe we can open up a path by dropping\nthe loose <color=#F1DC2B>rock pile</color> over there?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Stone_001
Array.english: <size=36>If we can topple it and make it fall...\nIt might just do the trick!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>If we can topple it and make it fall...\nIt might just do the trick!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Stone_002
Array.english: Well... I suppose it might work.\nHow do we make the rocks fall, though?
Array.indonesia: Well... I suppose it might work.\nHow do we make the rocks fall, though?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_001
Array.english: Hmm? I see a <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> over there...\nMaybe if we pull it out?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? I see a <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> over there...\nMaybe if we pull it out?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_002
Array.english: Human! Can you pull out that <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> over there?
Array.indonesia: Human! Can you pull out that <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> over there?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_003
Array.english: The Stake?\nI think I’ll hurt my hands with the <color=#F1DC2B>Gloves</color> I’m wearing...
Array.indonesia: The Stake?\nI think I’ll hurt my hands with the <color=#F1DC2B>Gloves</color> I’m wearing...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_004
Array.english: I could probably do it with <color=#F1DC2B>Gloves</color> that are thicker and offer a better grip.
Array.indonesia: I could probably do it with <color=#F1DC2B>Gloves</color> that are thicker and offer a better grip.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_004_02
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_005
Array.english: Dave... My apologies...\nI left the microphone on because I was dying\nto know what you were talking about.
Array.indonesia: Dave... My apologies...\nI left the microphone on because I was dying\nto know what you were talking about.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_006
Array.english: If it’s enhanced <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color> you need,\nI think my lab could help you out.
Array.indonesia: If it’s enhanced <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color> you need,\nI think my lab could help you out.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_007
Array.english: Huh? New gloves?
Array.indonesia: Huh? New gloves?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_008
Array.english: <size=36>Haha, equipment goes hand-in-hand with exploration, does it not? Come up to the boat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Haha, equipment goes hand-in-hand with exploration, does it not? Come up to the boat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_009
Array.english: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_010
Array.english: I think there must be a way...\nCould you wait here for a moment?
Array.indonesia: I think there must be a way...\nCould you wait here for a moment?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_011
Array.english: Hold it, human.\nYou plan to leave Ramo in a dangerous place like this?
Array.indonesia: Hold it, human.\nYou plan to leave Ramo in a dangerous place like this?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_3_Anchor_012
Array.english: Luckily she has me guarding her...\nStill, be back quick!
Array.indonesia: Luckily she has me guarding her...\nStill, be back quick!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_001
Array.english: Hmm! The road back to the Sea People village, huh...
Array.indonesia: Hmm! The road back to the Sea People village, huh...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=46>How fascinating!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>How fascinating!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_003
Array.english: My lab has developed some <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color>\nto be used for retrieving artifacts.
Array.indonesia: My lab has developed some <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color>\nto be used for retrieving artifacts.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_004
Array.english: I see! That should let me pull out a <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color>\nwithout my hands slipping, right?
Array.indonesia: I see! That should let me pull out a <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color>\nwithout my hands slipping, right?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_005
Array.english: Haha! Of course. It has various safety measures built in \nthat’ll let you move <color=#1DFEAF>many other objects</color> besides stakes.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Of course. It has various safety measures built in \nthat’ll let you move <color=#1DFEAF>many other objects</color> besides stakes.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_006
Array.english: The long dive must have been tiring.\nGet some rest, I’ll explain the details tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: The long dive must have been tiring.\nGet some rest, I’ll explain the details tomorrow.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=38>I’ll come to the boat tomorrow morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I’ll come to the boat tomorrow morning!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission16_WrongWay_001
Array.english: Not this way, human!\nLet's go follow <color=#1DFEAF>Suwam</color>.
Array.indonesia: Not this way, human!\nLet's go follow <color=#1DFEAF>Suwam</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_001
Array.english: Looks like Dr. Bacon left abruptly again\nafter finishing his explanation.
Array.indonesia: Looks like Dr. Bacon left abruptly again\nafter finishing his explanation.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_002
Array.english: In any case, these <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color> look like they could \ncome in very handy.
Array.indonesia: In any case, these <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color> look like they could \ncome in very handy.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_003
Array.english: I heard that the Sea People are waiting for you.\nGo down there and try pulling out the <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color>!
Array.indonesia: I heard that the Sea People are waiting for you.\nGo down there and try pulling out the <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_001
Array.english: Oh, you’re back, human.\nI was afraid you’d been eaten by a frilled shark on the way back.
Array.indonesia: Oh, you’re back, human.\nI was afraid you’d been eaten by a frilled shark on the way back.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>She talks like someone I know...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>She talks like someone I know...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_003
Array.english: I think I’ll be able to pull out the Stake if I use the <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color>\nfrom Dr. Bacon, who lives on land.
Array.indonesia: I think I’ll be able to pull out the Stake if I use the <color=#F1DC2B>Diving Gloves</color>\nfrom Dr. Bacon, who lives on land.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_004
Array.english: Bacon... Hehe.\nIn our language, that name sounds like <color=#90CDFF>“spoiled whale meat”</color>. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Bacon... Hehe.\nIn our language, that name sounds like <color=#90CDFF>“spoiled whale meat”</color>. Hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_1_Complete_005
Array.english: Um... okay.\nWait a moment. Let me try and pull.
Array.indonesia: Um... okay.\nWait a moment. Let me try and pull.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Complete_001
Array.english: It was effective, but not enough... Hmm.
Array.indonesia: It was effective, but not enough... Hmm.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=32>I think one more attempt might cut it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I think one more attempt might cut it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Complete_003
Array.english: Human! There’s another rock pile over there.
Array.indonesia: Human! There’s another rock pile over there.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Stones_001
Array.english: Um... There’s no movable device over there.\nI’ll have to go check it out first.
Array.indonesia: Um... There’s no movable device over there.\nI’ll have to go check it out first.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_2_Barricade_001
Array.english: Let's pull that Stake first!
Array.indonesia: Let's pull that Stake first!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_3_WrongSide_001
Array.english: Hmm... There’s nothing that can be done on this side...\nI’ll have to try going around back.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... There’s nothing that can be done on this side...\nI’ll have to try going around back.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_3_Complete_001
Array.english: There’s a <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> in the back!\nIf I pull that out...
Array.indonesia: There’s a <color=#1DFEAF>Stake</color> in the back!\nIf I pull that out...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow, human!\nGood, we have a path!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow, human!\nGood, we have a path!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_002
Array.english: You’re more useful than you look!
Array.indonesia: You’re more useful than you look!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_003
Array.english: The village is very close.\nCome in through the hole you just made. I’ll go ahead.
Array.indonesia: The village is very close.\nCome in through the hole you just made. I’ll go ahead.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=31>Wait, I can leave now, can’t I?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Wait, I can leave now, can’t I?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=32>Would you listen to yourself! \nAren’t you worried for Ramo?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Would you listen to yourself! \nAren’t you worried for Ramo?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_006
Array.english: Besides, I have a request for you.\nSo…I would like you to come to the village with us.
Array.indonesia: Besides, I have a request for you.\nSo…I would like you to come to the village with us.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=35>The Sea People village? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>The Sea People village? Me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_008
Array.english: Yes. There’s a reason I came all the way up to the human sea.\nI have a request.
Array.indonesia: Yes. There’s a reason I came all the way up to the human sea.\nI have a request.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_4_Complete_009
Array.english: Oh... Okay.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Okay.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_Complete_001
Array.english: Ugh... I’m getting real spooky vibes.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... I’m getting real spooky vibes.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: <size=33>So-something just moved past me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>So-something just moved past me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_AfterTimeline_002
Array.english: <size=38>Human! Go on ahead and be our lookout!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Human! Go on ahead and be our lookout!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_AfterTimeline_003
Array.english: But... it’s so dark!
Array.indonesia: But... it’s so dark!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_5_AfterTimeline_004
Array.english: <size=32>I feel like there might be something dangerous there... Ugh.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I feel like there might be something dangerous there... Ugh.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_enter_001
Array.english: Hmm... I went in the <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> and ended up here...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I went in the <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> and ended up here...

Array.name: dialog_boss001_enter_002
Array.english: Maybe these are things that were brought here by the storm…
Array.indonesia: Maybe these are things that were brought here by the storm…

Array.name: dialog_boss001_enter02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hm?\nI think that big truck just moved...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm?\nI think that big truck just moved...</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_start_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ahh! A moving truck...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ahh! A moving truck...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_start_002
Array.english: <size=34>It’s not a truck, it’s a giant hermit crab!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It’s not a truck, it’s a giant hermit crab!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_start_003
Array.english: I don’t think a gun will do anything...\nWhat do I do?
Array.indonesia: I don’t think a gun will do anything...\nWhat do I do?

Array.name: dialog_boss001_end_001
Array.english: <size=35>That thing was really nothing without the shell.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>That thing was really nothing without the shell.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss001_end_002
Array.english: I hope the <color=#1DFEAF>Boss Card</color> Sato was talking about has been activated.
Array.indonesia: I hope the <color=#1DFEAF>Boss Card</color> Sato was talking about has been activated.

Array.name: dialog_boss001_end_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> came back after defeating the hermit crab.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> came back after defeating the hermit crab.

Array.name: dialog_boss001_end_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s go back to the boat using that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s go back to the boat using that!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss002_enter_001
Array.english: What is this?\nWhy is there debris so deep down here?
Array.indonesia: What is this?\nWhy is there debris so deep down here?

Array.name: dialog_boss002_earthquake_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oh no... those vibrations again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh no... those vibrations again?</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss002_earthquake_002
Array.english: Something has to be here...\nWhy did he tell me to come alone?
Array.indonesia: Something has to be here...\nWhy did he tell me to come alone?

Array.name: dialog_boss002_firstcontact_001
Array.english: Wh-what is that?\nThere are Wolf Eels that big?
Array.indonesia: Wh-what is that?\nThere are Wolf Eels that big?

Array.name: dialog_boss002_firstcontact_002
Array.english: Ugh... I don’t think I can run...\nOh, whatever!
Array.indonesia: Ugh... I don’t think I can run...\nOh, whatever!

Array.name: dialog_boss002_firstdash_001
Array.english: <size=36>Ugh... It looks really tough!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ugh... It looks really tough!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss002_firstdash_002
Array.english: Huh? The shining spot on its <color=#F1DC2B>tail</color>...\nIt looks weaker than the rest of its body.
Array.indonesia: Huh? The shining spot on its <color=#F1DC2B>tail</color>...\nIt looks weaker than the rest of its body.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_001
Array.english: Ugh...\nHow can a Wolf Eel be so big?
Array.indonesia: Ugh...\nHow can a Wolf Eel be so big?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_002
Array.english: Ahem. I was just about to come and defeat it.\nI guess I came too late.
Array.indonesia: Ahem. I was just about to come and defeat it.\nI guess I came too late.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_002_2
Array.english: Haha! You’re stronger than I expected, human.
Array.indonesia: Haha! You’re stronger than I expected, human.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_003
Array.english: Now, you see that big gate over there?\nThat’s the entrance to the village.
Array.indonesia: Now, you see that big gate over there?\nThat’s the entrance to the village.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=36>Take the lead, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Take the lead, human!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_7_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: Hmm. Looks safe now.\nGood work, human!
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Looks safe now.\nGood work, human!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_001
Array.english: Phew. We’re finally back to the village entrance passageway.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>, you have a key, right?
Array.indonesia: Phew. We’re finally back to the village entrance passageway.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Ramo</color>, you have a key, right?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=38>Oh no! I left the key back at the...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh no! I left the key back at the...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_003
Array.english: Just kidding, hehe.\nI have it here in my bag!
Array.indonesia: Just kidding, hehe.\nI have it here in my bag!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_004
Array.english: Phew. I thought you would ask me to take you again...
Array.indonesia: Phew. I thought you would ask me to take you again...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_8_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s insert the key...\nAnd get back to the village!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s insert the key...\nAnd get back to the village!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=44>Wow... So this is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Wow... So this is...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_Complete_002
Array.english: Haha, that’s right!\nThis is the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Village</color> we live in!
Array.indonesia: Haha, that’s right!\nThis is the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Village</color> we live in!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_Complete_003
Array.english: To think there would be a place like this under the sea...
Array.indonesia: To think there would be a place like this under the sea...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_001
Array.english: <size=40>Wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wait!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_002
Array.english: How... how did a human get in here?
Array.indonesia: How... how did a human get in here?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_003
Array.english: Huh? Ramo and Suwam?\nWere you kidnapped by this human?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Ramo and Suwam?\nWere you kidnapped by this human?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_004
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Tenzhin</color> awaits you. \nHe’s lost sleep worrying about you.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Tenzhin</color> awaits you. \nHe’s lost sleep worrying about you.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_005
Array.english: Um... It’s kind of hard to explain...
Array.indonesia: Um... It’s kind of hard to explain...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_006
Array.english: Haha! Allow me!\nI rescued Ramo after she was kidnapped by a squid...
Array.indonesia: Haha! Allow me!\nI rescued Ramo after she was kidnapped by a squid...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_NawangAwang_007
Array.english: Forget it. Just take me to my father.\nIt’ll be faster for me to explain things to him.
Array.indonesia: Forget it. Just take me to my father.\nIt’ll be faster for me to explain things to him.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_001
Array.english: <size=45>Oh my goodness! Ramo! My daughter! <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Oh my goodness! Ramo! My daughter! <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_002
Array.english: <size=36>Where were you, my precious girl! Your daddy...\nYour daddy was worried out of his wits! <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Where were you, my precious girl! Your daddy...\nYour daddy was worried out of his wits! <color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Are you hurt?\nDid the humans do something to you, my daughter?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Are you hurt?\nDid the humans do something to you, my daughter?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_004
Array.english: <size=45>Wait! Who is this next to you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Wait! Who is this next to you?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_005
Array.english: <size=38>I thought you’d brought a blue manatee,\nbut this is a human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I thought you’d brought a blue manatee,\nbut this is a human!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_01_006
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_001
Array.english: What is going on here?\nI’d like an explanation.
Array.indonesia: What is going on here?\nI’d like an explanation.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_002
Array.english: You know that strange things have been happening\naround here recently, right?
Array.indonesia: You know that strange things have been happening\naround here recently, right?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_003
Array.english: For example, the tremors...\nand the ice melting off the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: For example, the tremors...\nand the ice melting off the Divine Tree.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_004
Array.english: Of course, Ramo.\nI’ve been looking into the causes.
Array.indonesia: Of course, Ramo.\nI’ve been looking into the causes.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_005
Array.english: It’s already been two years!\nYou know our technology has its limits.
Array.indonesia: It’s already been two years!\nYou know our technology has its limits.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_006
Array.english: We-well, the ancient texts have all been lost\nand we need to figure out new methods again...
Array.indonesia: We-well, the ancient texts have all been lost\nand we need to figure out new methods again...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_007
Array.english: We can’t simply keep waiting, Father.
Array.indonesia: We can’t simply keep waiting, Father.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_008
Array.english: Humans are selfish, but they have good technology.\nWe need their help.
Array.indonesia: Humans are selfish, but they have good technology.\nWe need their help.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_009
Array.english: <size=40>No, not the humans!\nThey can’t be trusted!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>No, not the humans!\nThey can’t be trusted!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_010
Array.english: They dirtied our home and even hunted our kind to put on display...
Array.indonesia: They dirtied our home and even hunted our kind to put on display...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_02_011
Array.english: They’re wicked creatures looking to hunt us\nand steal from us. We can’t ally with the likes of—
Array.indonesia: They’re wicked creatures looking to hunt us\nand steal from us. We can’t ally with the likes of—

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_001
Array.english: <size=40>Another huge tremor!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Another huge tremor!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_002
Array.english: <size=33>See?\nSomething really bad will happen if we don’t do anything.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>See?\nSomething really bad will happen if we don’t do anything.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_003
Array.english: <size=36>Um... Hmm…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Um... Hmm…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_004
Array.english: When I was taken by the Giant Squid in human waters,\n<color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> here helped me out.
Array.indonesia: When I was taken by the Giant Squid in human waters,\n<color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color> here helped me out.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Suwam said he was the one who did that earlier...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Suwam said he was the one who did that earlier...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_006
Array.english: Try asking him.\nNot all humans can be bad, can they?
Array.indonesia: Try asking him.\nNot all humans can be bad, can they?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_007
Array.english: I mean... well...
Array.indonesia: I mean... well...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_008
Array.english: Even... even if I wanted this,\nthe villagers would not agree.
Array.indonesia: Even... even if I wanted this,\nthe villagers would not agree.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_009
Array.english: Help from humans?\nNo one would believe it.
Array.indonesia: Help from humans?\nNo one would believe it.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_010
Array.english: <size=32>If this man can gain the <color=#1DFEAF>village’s trust</color>,\nI’ll consider your suggestion!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>If this man can gain the <color=#1DFEAF>village’s trust</color>,\nI’ll consider your suggestion!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_011
Array.english: Hmm... The <color=#1DFEAF>village’s trust</color>...\nHow does he go about winning that?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... The <color=#1DFEAF>village’s trust</color>...\nHow does he go about winning that?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_012
Array.english: How about asking around\nto see what they need?
Array.indonesia: How about asking around\nto see what they need?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_013
Array.english: Alright. \nSince today’s long trip must have been pretty tiring...
Array.indonesia: Alright. \nSince today’s long trip must have been pretty tiring...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_014
Array.english: Human! Come back here tomorrow!\nYou’ll have to listen to the villager’s requests!
Array.indonesia: Human! Come back here tomorrow!\nYou’ll have to listen to the villager’s requests!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission17_MeetTenzhin_03_015
Array.english: Wait, I didn’t even agree yet...\nHow am I supposed to come all the way here?
Array.indonesia: Wait, I didn’t even agree yet...\nHow am I supposed to come all the way here?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_001
Array.english: Hmm. Since you say you helped my daughter, Ramo...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Since you say you helped my daughter, Ramo...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_002
Array.english: I suppose it wouldn’t be fitting for my people\nto ignore your needs, even if you’re a human.
Array.indonesia: I suppose it wouldn’t be fitting for my people\nto ignore your needs, even if you’re a human.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_003
Array.english: <size=38>Use this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Use this.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_004
Array.english: What is this? It looks like an ordinary mirror.
Array.indonesia: What is this? It looks like an ordinary mirror.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_005
Array.english: This <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color>, once installed,\nwill let you instantly travel to this village.
Array.indonesia: This <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color>, once installed,\nwill let you instantly travel to this village.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_006
Array.english: <size=39>Wow! Is such a thing possible?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=39>Wow! Is such a thing possible?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_007
Array.english: Various disasters have caused our decline,\nbut our ancestors were a very advanced civilization once.
Array.indonesia: Various disasters have caused our decline,\nbut our ancestors were a very advanced civilization once.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_008
Array.english: Right now all we have left is a few of their relics...\nSadly.
Array.indonesia: Right now all we have left is a few of their relics...\nSadly.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_009
Array.english: In any case, installing this in your village\nwill allow you to come to this village whenever you need.
Array.indonesia: In any case, installing this in your village\nwill allow you to come to this village whenever you need.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_010
Array.english: <size=32>It will recognize your face,\nso only you’ll be able to use it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It will recognize your face,\nso only you’ll be able to use it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_011
Array.english: It also operates from the light of the Divine Tree or the sun,\nso you can only use it <color=#F39321>during the day</color>.
Array.indonesia: It also operates from the light of the Divine Tree or the sun,\nso you can only use it <color=#F39321>during the day</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_011_2
Array.english: Oh, and... I’ll give you a <color=#1DFEAF>Village Map</color> to use.\nIt’ll help you find the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Oh, and... I’ll give you a <color=#1DFEAF>Village Map</color> to use.\nIt’ll help you find the villagers.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_012
Array.english: Hmm. A teleportation device...\nThat’s pretty amazing.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. A teleportation device...\nThat’s pretty amazing.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_give_mirror_013
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll have to go back to the boat with this mirror for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’ll have to go back to the boat with this mirror for now.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_receive_mirror_001
Array.english: I guess I’ll install this <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color> on the boat.
Array.indonesia: I guess I’ll install this <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color> on the boat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_receive_mirror_002
Array.english: He said I could go to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Village</color> with this during the day right?\nI should go tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: He said I could go to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Village</color> with this during the day right?\nI should go tomorrow.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_receive_mirror_003
Array.english: Oh no... Look at the time!\nBancho Sushi must have opened already.
Array.indonesia: Oh no... Look at the time!\nBancho Sushi must have opened already.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_tenzhin_receive_mirror_004
Array.english: I should drop by and check if anything of note happened.
Array.indonesia: I should drop by and check if anything of note happened.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_001
Array.english: Oh! Dave!\nYou weren’t around yesterday, so I was a bit worried!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Dave!\nYou weren’t around yesterday, so I was a bit worried!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_002
Array.english: I couldn’t get in touch with you via radio, either...
Array.indonesia: I couldn’t get in touch with you via radio, either...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_003
Array.english: I was... at the Sea People Village yesterday...
Array.indonesia: I was... at the Sea People Village yesterday...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_004
Array.english: <size=45>You... you what?\nWhat happened?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>You... you what?\nWhat happened?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_005
Array.english: Well, you see...
Array.indonesia: Well, you see...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_001
Array.english: I see... I envy you, I do!\nWhat a lucky experience...
Array.indonesia: I see... I envy you, I do!\nWhat a lucky experience...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_002
Array.english: I’m not sure how I can help,\nbut it’s clear they have problems to deal with.
Array.indonesia: I’m not sure how I can help,\nbut it’s clear they have problems to deal with.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_003
Array.english: Why don’t you go talk with the residents first?\nI’d love to go as well, but...
Array.indonesia: Why don’t you go talk with the residents first?\nI’d love to go as well, but...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_004
Array.english: As you said, only one person can use the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color>.\nWhat a pity!
Array.indonesia: As you said, only one person can use the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color>.\nWhat a pity!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_005
Array.english: Hahaha! What an unexpected\nturn of events!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! What an unexpected\nturn of events!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_006
Array.english: If you need any of my tools, don't forget to\ncheck out the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color>!!
Array.indonesia: If you need any of my tools, don't forget to\ncheck out the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color>!!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Lobby_AfterFade_007
Array.english: Yes. I’ll have to use the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color> first\nto visit their village.
Array.indonesia: Yes. I’ll have to use the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Mirror</color> first\nto visit their village.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_001
Array.english: It seems the villagers seem to trust you quite a lot.
Array.indonesia: It seems the villagers seem to trust you quite a lot.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_002
Array.english: I’d first like to thank you for everything you’ve done\nfor our village.
Array.indonesia: I’d first like to thank you for everything you’ve done\nfor our village.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_003
Array.english: It seems everyone’s friendlier than I thought.
Array.indonesia: It seems everyone’s friendlier than I thought.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_004
Array.english: I don’t trust you fully just yet, but...\nWe could use all the help we could get right now...
Array.indonesia: I don’t trust you fully just yet, but...\nWe could use all the help we could get right now...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_005
Array.english: Let me tell you a little about this village.
Array.indonesia: Let me tell you a little about this village.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=36>Did you see the <color=#F1DC2B>tree</color> at the center of the village?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Did you see the <color=#F1DC2B>tree</color> at the center of the village?</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_007
Array.english: Yes... It was huge and covered in ice...
Array.indonesia: Yes... It was huge and covered in ice...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_008
Array.english: Yes. We call it the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree</color>.
Array.indonesia: Yes. We call it the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_009
Array.english: We use the fruit of this tree as an energy source.
Array.indonesia: We use the fruit of this tree as an energy source.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_010
Array.english: The tree's roots are far below,\nusing geothermal heat to create energy…
Array.indonesia: The tree's roots are far below,\nusing geothermal heat to create energy…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_011
Array.english: Because the fruits are created from this energy,\nthere is a giant glacier under this tree—that is, under our village.
Array.indonesia: Because the fruits are created from this energy,\nthere is a giant glacier under this tree—that is, under our village.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_012
Array.english: A glacier on the sea bottom…\nI’ve never heard of such a thing...
Array.indonesia: A glacier on the sea bottom…\nI’ve never heard of such a thing...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_013
Array.english: But as of late... The heat coming from deep in the earth has grown hotter, melting the ice slowly...
Array.indonesia: But as of late... The heat coming from deep in the earth has grown hotter, melting the ice slowly...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_014
Array.english: As the temperature of the tree increases,\nmore and more villagers are falling ill.
Array.indonesia: As the temperature of the tree increases,\nmore and more villagers are falling ill.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_015
Array.english: We keep praying to King Long, but...\nBut we know things aren’t so simple as that.
Array.indonesia: We keep praying to King Long, but...\nBut we know things aren’t so simple as that.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_016
Array.english: We need to check on the glacier below the surface...
Array.indonesia: We need to check on the glacier below the surface...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_017
Array.english: Because we’ve relied on only agriculture for so long,\nwe don’t have the equipment or the technology to explore down there, embarrassing as it is.
Array.indonesia: Because we’ve relied on only agriculture for so long,\nwe don’t have the equipment or the technology to explore down there, embarrassing as it is.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_018
Array.english: That’s why I told you we need the humans’ help.
Array.indonesia: That’s why I told you we need the humans’ help.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_019
Array.english: I must admit that is now our only option, my daughter...
Array.indonesia: I must admit that is now our only option, my daughter...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_020
Array.english: In any case, I know it’s a difficult task,\nbut will you check out the glacial area below the village for us?
Array.indonesia: In any case, I know it’s a difficult task,\nbut will you check out the glacial area below the village for us?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_021
Array.english: *Sigh* That sounds very dangerous...\nBut alright.
Array.indonesia: *Sigh* That sounds very dangerous...\nBut alright.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_022
Array.english: There have been more tremors on the surface as well.\nI think all this might be connected somehow.
Array.indonesia: There have been more tremors on the surface as well.\nI think all this might be connected somehow.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_023
Array.english: <size=36>Thank you! \nWe’ll be sure to recompense you somehow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Thank you! \nWe’ll be sure to recompense you somehow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_024
Array.english: Now then, you’ll need the key down to the Glacial Passage...\nThe key...
Array.indonesia: Now then, you’ll need the key down to the Glacial Passage...\nThe key...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_025
Array.english: <size=50>Where is the key?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>Where is the key?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_026
Array.english: Tenzhin... When we sealed the Glacial Passsage,\nwe put the key inside the <color=#F1DC2B>Abandoned Cave</color>, remember?
Array.indonesia: Tenzhin... When we sealed the Glacial Passsage,\nwe put the key inside the <color=#F1DC2B>Abandoned Cave</color>, remember?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_027
Array.english: <size=48>Oh dear! You’re right!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Oh dear! You’re right!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_028
Array.english: I sense something is not right again...
Array.indonesia: I sense something is not right again...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_029
Array.english: <size=38>Human! Please go and get the <color=#1DFEAF>key</color> to the Glacial Passage from the Abandoned Cave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Human! Please go and get the <color=#1DFEAF>key</color> to the Glacial Passage from the Abandoned Cave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_030
Array.english: Suwam will take you there.
Array.indonesia: Suwam will take you there.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_031
Array.english: It’s not dangerous, is it?
Array.indonesia: It’s not dangerous, is it?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_032
Array.english: <size=38>Nothing has happened there for the last century!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Nothing has happened there for the last century!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_033
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>...No one’s ventured in there for 100 years.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>...No one’s ventured in there for 100 years.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_034
Array.english: Anyways... We need to find out what’s going on\nin the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> before it’s too late.
Array.indonesia: Anyways... We need to find out what’s going on\nin the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> before it’s too late.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_035
Array.english: It’s getting late, so come back tomorrow when the sun is up.
Array.indonesia: It’s getting late, so come back tomorrow when the sun is up.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete_036
Array.english: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> will guide you on this path.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> will guide you on this path.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_029
Array.english: <size=32>Hm! Human!\nYou need to go get the key now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hm! Human!\nYou need to go get the key now!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_030
Array.english: <size=36>For now, \nwe're gonna wait until <color=#F1DC2B>Official Launch</color> for this part.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>For now, \nwe're gonna wait until <color=#F1DC2B>Official Launch</color> for this part.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_031
Array.english: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Official Launch?</color> Huh?\nWhat's that mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Official Launch?</color> Huh?\nWhat's that mean?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_032
Array.english: <size=32>Um. Kinda hard to explain here!!\nHumans use this thing called <color=#9E7BFF>Discord.</color> Try asking there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Um. Kinda hard to explain here!!\nHumans use this thing called <color=#9E7BFF>Discord.</color> Try asking there!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_033
Array.english: I have no idea what you are talking about….\nThis <color=#9E7BFF>Discord</color> thing….
Array.indonesia: I have no idea what you are talking about….\nThis <color=#9E7BFF>Discord</color> thing….

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_034
Array.english: Anyway... \nFirst work on helping the land and the village.
Array.indonesia: Anyway... \nFirst work on helping the land and the village.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_035
Array.english: <size=35>Don't forget to tell <color=#1DFEAF>them</color> if you have any problems!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Don't forget to tell <color=#1DFEAF>them</color> if you have any problems!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_EA_Complete_036
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? Who are <color=#1DFEAF>They</color>?…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huh? Who are <color=#1DFEAF>They</color>?…?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete02_001
Array.english: Phew. I was so busy with Sea People Village\nwork that it’s already opening time.
Array.indonesia: Phew. I was so busy with Sea People Village\nwork that it’s already opening time.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete02_002
Array.english: I’m tired...\nBut I should be there.
Array.indonesia: I’m tired...\nBut I should be there.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission18_Complete02_003
Array.english: <size=38>Let’s cheer up and raise our profits!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Let’s cheer up and raise our profits!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Start_001
Array.english: By the way...
Array.indonesia: By the way...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Start_002
Array.english: Tenzhin asked me to bring him the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color>.
Array.indonesia: Tenzhin asked me to bring him the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Start_003
Array.english: <size=34>I must return to the elder’s place in the Sea People Village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I must return to the elder’s place in the Sea People Village.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, you have returned, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, you have returned, human.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_002
Array.english: The Abandoned Cave is an old, abandoned Sea People’s storage.
Array.indonesia: The Abandoned Cave is an old, abandoned Sea People’s storage.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color> is in that place.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color> is in that place.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_004
Array.english: Suwam will guide you.\nGodspeed.
Array.indonesia: Suwam will guide you.\nGodspeed.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_005
Array.english: <size=36>Oh! I thought you fled, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh! I thought you fled, human.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_TenzhinroomTalk_006
Array.english: Suwam, the best warrior of the Sea People, \nwill guide you to the place. Follow me.
Array.indonesia: Suwam, the best warrior of the Sea People, \nwill guide you to the place. Follow me.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_01
Array.english: <size=35>Here, human.\nGo bring me the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Here, human.\nGo bring me the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_02
Array.english: So dreary and dark.\nWhy is this place locked anyway?
Array.indonesia: So dreary and dark.\nWhy is this place locked anyway?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_03
Array.english: Hm, I am not sure.\nI heard stories about some crazy Sea People locked up somewhere, though.
Array.indonesia: Hm, I am not sure.\nI heard stories about some crazy Sea People locked up somewhere, though.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_04
Array.english: I heard the insane ones attacked other Sea People.
Array.indonesia: I heard the insane ones attacked other Sea People.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_05
Array.english: But that was like a thousand years ago.\nSea People only live about 300 years, so don’t worry.
Array.indonesia: But that was like a thousand years ago.\nSea People only live about 300 years, so don’t worry.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_06
Array.english: Hm, I am nervous.\nAre you coming with me?
Array.indonesia: Hm, I am nervous.\nAre you coming with me?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_07
Array.english: I am the best warrior of my people.\nYou want me to do such a mundane task?
Array.indonesia: I am the best warrior of my people.\nYou want me to do such a mundane task?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_08
Array.english: I will stay here and protect the area.\nHurry up and bring me the key.
Array.indonesia: I will stay here and protect the area.\nHurry up and bring me the key.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_09
Array.english: I knew you wouldn't go in.
Array.indonesia: I knew you wouldn't go in.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_10
Array.english: It’s hidden in one of the deepest areas.\nLook for a room with a <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color>.
Array.indonesia: It’s hidden in one of the deepest areas.\nLook for a room with a <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_WareHouse_11
Array.english: <size=35>Let me know when you are ready, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let me know when you are ready, human.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_Office_01
Array.english: <size=36>Ow, it’s cold.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ow, it’s cold.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Goto_Office_02
Array.english: The key should be deeper inside.\nA room with a <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color>, if I remember correctly.
Array.indonesia: The key should be deeper inside.\nA room with a <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color>, if I remember correctly.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage01
Array.english: What a cute sea bream.\nIt must have come through that small crack.
Array.indonesia: What a cute sea bream.\nIt must have come through that small crack.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage02_001
Array.english: <size=40>Holy cow! What is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Holy cow! What is that?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage02_002
Array.english: The ancient Sea People Suwam talked about?
Array.indonesia: The ancient Sea People Suwam talked about?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage02_003
Array.english: They are still alive?
Array.indonesia: They are still alive?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Gardon_InCage02_004
Array.english: It’s fortunate that they are still locked in the cells.\nI should not draw their attention.
Array.indonesia: It’s fortunate that they are still locked in the cells.\nI should not draw their attention.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key_01
Array.english: This must be the mural room\nSuwam was talking about.
Array.indonesia: This must be the mural room\nSuwam was talking about.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key_02
Array.english: But... Where is the <color=#F1DC2B>key</color>?
Array.indonesia: But... Where is the <color=#F1DC2B>key</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key_03

Array.indonesia: <size=36>That must be the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Passage Key</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Find_Key2_02

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_Return_Tenzhin_03

Array.indonesia: I should probably head back to the Sea People village now.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_After_Earthquake01_001

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_After_Earthquake02_002

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_After_Earthquake02_003

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_LeaveCave02

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_CaveOut_001

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission19_CaveOut_002
