Array.english: I think I can melt it using the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit Device</color>.
Array.indonesia: I think I can melt it using the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit Device</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03RotatePuzzle_03
Array.english: I must find a way to redirect\nthe <color=#F1DC2B>light</color> to that ice wall.
Array.indonesia: I must find a way to redirect\nthe <color=#F1DC2B>light</color> to that ice wall.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03IceWallMelt_01
Array.english: <size=35>Nice! The ice wall has melted!\nLet me go inside.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Nice! The ice wall has melted!\nLet me go inside.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03WallPainting_01
Array.english: <size=34>There is a mural here as well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>There is a mural here as well.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03WallPainting_02
Array.english: I should take its <color=#1DFEAF>picture</color> and show it to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: I should take its <color=#1DFEAF>picture</color> and show it to Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03MovePuzzle_01
Array.english: Mm, the mirrors here are not well aligned.\nIs there a way to align them?
Array.indonesia: Mm, the mirrors here are not well aligned.\nIs there a way to align them?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03IceWallMelt2_01
Array.english: <size=35>Good! The ice wall blocking the exit has melted away.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good! The ice wall blocking the exit has melted away.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03IceWallMelt2_02
Array.english: Now, if I go past it, I will find a door to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Now, if I go past it, I will find a door to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area03IceWallMelt2_03
Array.english: Whew, this place is really cold.\nI could use a hot cup of Green Tea right now.
Array.indonesia: Whew, this place is really cold.\nI could use a hot cup of Green Tea right now.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Enter1_01
Array.english: This place is too dark\nto see anything.
Array.indonesia: This place is too dark\nto see anything.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Enter1_02
Array.english: Right, I hit this fruit and it glowed.\nI should use this.
Array.indonesia: Right, I hit this fruit and it glowed.\nI should use this.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04GiantGardonWakeUp_01
Array.english: <size=35>Ack! What is that thing?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ack! What is that thing?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04GiantGardonWakeUp_02
Array.english: <size=33>That Gadon is humongous!\nIt’s almost unreal!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That Gadon is humongous!\nIt’s almost unreal!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04GiantGardonWakeUp_03
Array.english: Oh, it’s thankfully chained.
Array.indonesia: Oh, it’s thankfully chained.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04GiantGardonWakeUp_04
Array.english: <size=36>Let me escape this place riding the current!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Let me escape this place riding the current!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Escape_01
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, no! I will be eaten by that thing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, no! I will be eaten by that thing!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Escape_02
Array.english: <size=36>Why don’t I ride the current?\nHere goes nothing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Why don’t I ride the current?\nHere goes nothing!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EscapeGlacialPassage_01
Array.english: <size=34>I managed to escape.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I managed to escape.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EscapeGlacialPassage_02
Array.english: <size=34>I must barricade the entrance before the Gadon \ncomes after me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I must barricade the entrance before the Gadon \ncomes after me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EscapeGlacialPassage_03
Array.english: <size=33>Good, now if I nudge that <color=#1DFEAF>pile of stones</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Good, now if I nudge that <color=#1DFEAF>pile of stones</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_01
Array.english: <size=38>Suwam?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Suwam?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_02
Array.english: Ha! Of course a human can't handle this.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Of course a human can't handle this.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_03
Array.english: <size=36>You would have already been eaten by \nthe deep-sea fish were I not there for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>You would have already been eaten by \nthe deep-sea fish were I not there for you.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_04
Array.english: I admit it this time.\nThank you, Suwam.
Array.indonesia: I admit it this time.\nThank you, Suwam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_05
Array.english: Hahaha! Well, go and find out what’s happening\nin the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> as you promised me, human.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Well, go and find out what’s happening\nin the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> as you promised me, human.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_06
Array.english: Ah, I didn’t imagine this place would be this cold.\nI will freeze to death if I go down further.
Array.indonesia: Ah, I didn’t imagine this place would be this cold.\nI will freeze to death if I go down further.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_07
Array.english: Oh, you helpless human. You do not have any gear or clothes \nto protect your body from the cold then?
Array.indonesia: Oh, you helpless human. You do not have any gear or clothes \nto protect your body from the cold then?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_08
Array.english: Well, I must first return to Cobra and ask him.\nHe may have something to protect me from the cold.
Array.indonesia: Well, I must first return to Cobra and ask him.\nHe may have something to protect me from the cold.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_09
Array.english: Well, we have no other option then.\nLet’s return to the village.
Array.indonesia: Well, we have no other option then.\nLet’s return to the village.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_10
Array.english: You see that <color=#F1DC2B>Huge Mirror</color> in the back?\nActivate it again and you will be whisked away to the village.
Array.indonesia: You see that <color=#F1DC2B>Huge Mirror</color> in the back?\nActivate it again and you will be whisked away to the village.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobby_AfterSaveDave_11
Array.english: You pull the right <color=#1DFEAF>lever</color>.\nI will pull the left one.
Array.indonesia: You pull the right <color=#1DFEAF>lever</color>.\nI will pull the left one.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_MirrorPortal_01
Array.english: <size=34>All right! We pull these levers at once on my signal,\n okay?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>All right! We pull these levers at once on my signal,\n okay?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_MirrorPortal_end_01
Array.english: What are you doing? Grab the <color=#1DFEAF>lever</color> on the right, human.
Array.indonesia: What are you doing? Grab the <color=#1DFEAF>lever</color> on the right, human.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_01
Array.english: <size=34>Good!\nNow, we can access this place straight from the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Good!\nNow, we can access this place straight from the village.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_02
Array.english: Go back to the village and find a way to withstand the cold, human.
Array.indonesia: Go back to the village and find a way to withstand the cold, human.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_03
Array.english: Tsk, tsk. Humans are so fragile. This is something \nunthinkable for a superior warrior like me, Suwam.
Array.indonesia: Tsk, tsk. Humans are so fragile. This is something \nunthinkable for a superior warrior like me, Suwam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_04
Array.english: Your tail has been shaking for some time now.\nAre you really all right?
Array.indonesia: Your tail has been shaking for some time now.\nAre you really all right?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_05
Array.english: <size=36>W-What are you talking about?\nYou are clearly mistaken, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>W-What are you talking about?\nYou are clearly mistaken, human!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_06
Array.english: <size=35>Let’s return to the village for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let’s return to the village for now.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_07
Array.english: <size=39>Achu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=39>Achu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_ReturnMermanVillage_08
Array.english: Urgh, I guess krill went up my nose.
Array.indonesia: Urgh, I guess krill went up my nose.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_01
Array.english: <size=38>Oh, you came.\nHow was the Glacial Area?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh, you came.\nHow was the Glacial Area?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_02
Array.english: Um...\nThere was a huge Gadon in the passage so...
Array.indonesia: Um...\nThere was a huge Gadon in the passage so...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_03
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> is too cold for me to explore.\nI need something.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> is too cold for me to explore.\nI need something.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_04
Array.english: Ah, you’re ill-equipped to explore the area for sure\nwith your light diving suit.
Array.indonesia: Ah, you’re ill-equipped to explore the area for sure\nwith your light diving suit.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_05
Array.english: Our people wear clothes with Divine Tree Fruits\nand can withstand the cold.
Array.indonesia: Our people wear clothes with Divine Tree Fruits\nand can withstand the cold.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_06
Array.english: <size=34>I am curious...\nCan your people tailor the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree Fruit Cloths</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I am curious...\nCan your people tailor the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree Fruit Cloths</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_07
Array.english: <size=38>Tailoring?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Tailoring?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_08
Array.english: Cobra or Dr. Bacon may know how.
Array.indonesia: Cobra or Dr. Bacon may know how.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_TenzhinSuitTalk_09
Array.english: You seem to have talented friends.\nTake this <color=#1DFEAF>cloth</color> and ask your friends.
Array.indonesia: You seem to have talented friends.\nTake this <color=#1DFEAF>cloth</color> and ask your friends.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_01
Array.english: Hm... <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree Fruit Cloths</color>...
Array.indonesia: Hm... <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree Fruit Cloths</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_02
Array.english: I need to tailor it into a suit.\nIt may protect me from the cold.
Array.indonesia: I need to tailor it into a suit.\nIt may protect me from the cold.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_03
Array.english: It’s already dinner time.
Array.indonesia: It’s already dinner time.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_End_04
Array.english: <size=36>I should visit <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color> first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I should visit <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color> first.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02Barricade_01
Array.english: I need to open the door up there to quickly return to the village.\nI should find a way to open it.
Array.indonesia: I need to open the door up there to quickly return to the village.\nI should find a way to open it.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby02ShortcutFound_01
Array.english: It looks like the <color=#1DFEAF>contraption</color> over there could open the door.
Array.indonesia: It looks like the <color=#1DFEAF>contraption</color> over there could open the door.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Enter_01
Array.english: Similar contraptions here as well.
Array.indonesia: Similar contraptions here as well.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Area02Enter_02
Array.english: I guess it should work just like last time.
Array.indonesia: I guess it should work just like last time.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_Lobby04Barricade_01
Array.english: It’s too dark to see anything.\nI must hit a Divine Tree Fruit to illuminate the place.
Array.indonesia: It’s too dark to see anything.\nI must hit a Divine Tree Fruit to illuminate the place.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission20_EndLobbyBarricade_01
Array.english: <size=35>It’s too cold!\nI can’t go further down without proper gear.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It’s too cold!\nI can’t go further down without proper gear.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk01_001
Array.english: I went home late and couldn’t sleep well last night.
Array.indonesia: I went home late and couldn’t sleep well last night.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk01_002
Array.english: Haha, you did a good job last night.\nLet’s go report to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Haha, you did a good job last night.\nLet’s go report to Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hey, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hey, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_002
Array.english: <size=33>I heard that you acquired an intact mechanical part?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I heard that you acquired an intact mechanical part?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_003
Array.english: Yes... With difficulties.
Array.indonesia: Yes... With difficulties.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_004
Array.english: <size=35>Here, take it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Here, take it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_005
Array.english: <size=36>Yes! This is it!\nGood job, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Yes! This is it!\nGood job, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_006
Array.english: Okay, now I have everything I need.\nI will go to the lab and craft a <color=#F1DC2B>Cold-resistant Suit</color>. But...
Array.indonesia: Okay, now I have everything I need.\nI will go to the lab and craft a <color=#F1DC2B>Cold-resistant Suit</color>. But...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_007
Array.english: <size=34>I am worried about the fact that the Glacial Area is unstable.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I am worried about the fact that the Glacial Area is unstable.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_008
Array.english: <size=35>I suggest you get a good <color=#1DFEAF>weapon</color> as well as \na good suit.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I suggest you get a good <color=#1DFEAF>weapon</color> as well as \na good suit.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_009
Array.english: Ah. There was a new material developed at the lab...
Array.indonesia: Ah. There was a new material developed at the lab...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_010
Array.english: <size=34>The<color=#1DFEAF> Dive Knife</color> can be upgraded!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>The<color=#1DFEAF> Dive Knife</color> can be upgraded!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_011
Array.english: As usual, you can upgrade it through <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color>.
Array.indonesia: As usual, you can upgrade it through <color=#72ff0a>iDiver</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_012
Array.english: Upgrading the <color=#1DFEAF>Dive Knife</color> not only increases its attack power…
Array.indonesia: Upgrading the <color=#1DFEAF>Dive Knife</color> not only increases its attack power…

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_012_2
Array.english: <size=33>but you can also mine minerals that previously could \nonly be mined with a pickaxe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>but you can also mine minerals that previously could \nonly be mined with a pickaxe!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_013
Array.english: Oh…\nThen I won't have to go looking for the pickaxe!
Array.indonesia: Oh…\nThen I won't have to go looking for the pickaxe!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk02_014
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! Give me <color=#1DFEAF>a day</color> to craft the suit.\nI will see you tomorrow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Give me <color=#1DFEAF>a day</color> to craft the suit.\nI will see you tomorrow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_001
Array.english: A Cold-resistant Suit... I wonder what that will look like.
Array.indonesia: A Cold-resistant Suit... I wonder what that will look like.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_002
Array.english: Like Dr. Bacon said, \na suit won't be enough to protect yourself.
Array.indonesia: Like Dr. Bacon said, \na suit won't be enough to protect yourself.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_003
Array.english: Don’t you think you should bring a weapon?
Array.indonesia: Don’t you think you should bring a weapon?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_004
Array.english: I think so, too.
Array.indonesia: I think so, too.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_BaconMorningTalk03_005
Array.english: I will go ask <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.
Array.indonesia: I will go ask <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_001
Array.english: How’s it going, Dave?\nIt’s been a while, what can I do for you?
Array.indonesia: How’s it going, Dave?\nIt’s been a while, what can I do for you?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_002
Array.english: Uh, I am going to explore the Glacial Area and\nI am not sure if the weapon I have will be enough.
Array.indonesia: Uh, I am going to explore the Glacial Area and\nI am not sure if the weapon I have will be enough.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_003
Array.english: Ah, the huge glacier in the deep sea.\nI’ve heard about your mission.
Array.indonesia: Ah, the huge glacier in the deep sea.\nI’ve heard about your mission.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_004
Array.english: <size=35>I planted a tracker in the gun.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I planted a tracker in the gun.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>You could have told me that earlier...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>You could have told me that earlier...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_006
Array.english: But the one I can craft right now with the ingredients I have\nwill not be that different.
Array.indonesia: But the one I can craft right now with the ingredients I have\nwill not be that different.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_007
Array.english: Unless I can get my hands on some new <color=#1DFEAF>minerals</color>.
Array.indonesia: Unless I can get my hands on some new <color=#1DFEAF>minerals</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_008
Array.english: Dave, I know you frequent the Sea People Village.
Array.indonesia: Dave, I know you frequent the Sea People Village.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_009
Array.english: Why don’t you look for new materials there?
Array.indonesia: Why don’t you look for new materials there?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_010
Array.english: Speaking of the village... I wonder how the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Workshop</color> is going.
Array.indonesia: Speaking of the village... I wonder how the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Workshop</color> is going.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Call_011
Array.english: I should pay it a visit.
Array.indonesia: I should pay it a visit.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, that’s a new type of mineral...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, that’s a new type of mineral...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_002
Array.english: How do you know when we’re talking over the phone?
Array.indonesia: How do you know when we’re talking over the phone?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=35>Heh, because I installed a CCTV on your boat?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Heh, because I installed a CCTV on your boat?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=36>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_005
Array.english: Anyways.\nI will work on a new weapon when the mineral arrives.
Array.indonesia: Anyways.\nI will work on a new weapon when the mineral arrives.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_006
Array.english: I will add the ingredients I need to the <color=#F1DC2B>list</color>. \nSecure them and let me know.
Array.indonesia: I will add the ingredients I need to the <color=#F1DC2B>list</color>. \nSecure them and let me know.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_007
Array.english: I will eagerly wait for the\nnever-before-seen <color=#F1DC2B>minerals</color> to arrive.
Array.indonesia: I will eagerly wait for the\nnever-before-seen <color=#F1DC2B>minerals</color> to arrive.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Duff_MermanWeapon_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=36><color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★ ★</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★ ★</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_001
Array.english: *Coughs* I am still not feeling well,
Array.indonesia: *Coughs* I am still not feeling well,

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_002
Array.english: but good enough to reopen the <color=#F1DC2B>Workshop</color>.
Array.indonesia: but good enough to reopen the <color=#F1DC2B>Workshop</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_003
Array.english: Oh! You’re open! What do you sell?
Array.indonesia: Oh! You’re open! What do you sell?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_004
Array.english: Well, I’ll have a wide variety of minerals available. \nI’ll give you a good deal on them.
Array.indonesia: Well, I’ll have a wide variety of minerals available. \nI’ll give you a good deal on them.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_005
Array.english: If you know someone who knows what to do with minerals, \nit’d be good to bring them to them.
Array.indonesia: If you know someone who knows what to do with minerals, \nit’d be good to bring them to them.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_006
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, and...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, and...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_007
Array.english: If you find something in the sea, bring it to me.\nI will buy it at a good price.
Array.indonesia: If you find something in the sea, bring it to me.\nI will buy it at a good price.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_008
Array.english: Sure, I will stop by your place before going up.
Array.indonesia: Sure, I will stop by your place before going up.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen01_009
Array.english: Anyways, it’s good to know that you’re getting better!\nI will keep in touch, Duwa!
Array.indonesia: Anyways, it’s good to know that you’re getting better!\nI will keep in touch, Duwa!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_001
Array.english: Wait. You are heading to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color>, aren’t you?
Array.indonesia: Wait. You are heading to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color>, aren’t you?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_002
Array.english: Yes, I need to investigate the roots of the Divine Tree\nto find what is causing the earthquakes.
Array.indonesia: Yes, I need to investigate the roots of the Divine Tree\nto find what is causing the earthquakes.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_003
Array.english: This place used to be very peaceful...\nThe ecosystem is unstable now and the creatures will become more aggressive.
Array.indonesia: This place used to be very peaceful...\nThe ecosystem is unstable now and the creatures will become more aggressive.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_004
Array.english: I will set up the shop today.\nVisit me <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color>.
Array.indonesia: I will set up the shop today.\nVisit me <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithOpen02_005
Array.english: All right. Don’t spread yourself too thin.
Array.indonesia: All right. Don’t spread yourself too thin.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_BlacksmithNotOpen_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I’d rather ask for weapon materials after Duwa is fully recovered...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(I’d rather ask for weapon materials after Duwa is fully recovered...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Doowa_Unlock_Glacial_NewMaterial_001
Array.english: I can now collect some more materials as we have secured a route to the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: I can now collect some more materials as we have secured a route to the Glacial Area.

Array.name: dialog_Doowa_Unlock_Glacial_NewMaterial_002
Array.english: They will help me craft a new weapon.
Array.indonesia: They will help me craft a new weapon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Give_NewSuit_001
Array.english: Whew, it’s not easy crafting a suit in one day.
Array.indonesia: Whew, it’s not easy crafting a suit in one day.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Give_NewSuit_002
Array.english: <size=36>But I am me! So I did it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>But I am me! So I did it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Give_NewSuit_003
Array.english: Oh, that looks nice!
Array.indonesia: Oh, that looks nice!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Give_NewSuit_004
Array.english: <size=34>Ba ha ha! Why don’t you go ahead and try it on?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ba ha ha! Why don’t you go ahead and try it on?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oho! That suits you well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oho! That suits you well.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_002
Array.english: <size=34>Haha, the size is perfect as well.\nThank you, Dr. Bacon.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha, the size is perfect as well.\nThank you, Dr. Bacon.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_003
Array.english: It feels warm.\nMaybe because it’s made from the Divine Tree Fruit cloth.
Array.indonesia: It feels warm.\nMaybe because it’s made from the Divine Tree Fruit cloth.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_004
Array.english: With that suit, you can not only roam underwater \nbut also cold places freely.
Array.indonesia: With that suit, you can not only roam underwater \nbut also cold places freely.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_After_NewSuit_005
Array.english: <size=36>Good.\nTime to go down to the Glacial Area!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Good.\nTime to go down to the Glacial Area!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Enter_GlacialArea_001
Array.english: Wow, it’s really warm.\nIt’s completely different from before.
Array.indonesia: Wow, it’s really warm.\nIt’s completely different from before.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Enter_GlacialArea_002
Array.english: Well, time to really explore the area.
Array.indonesia: Well, time to really explore the area.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialArea_Dungeon2_barricade_001
Array.english: Oh, the current here is too strong\nto enter.
Array.indonesia: Oh, the current here is too strong\nto enter.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialArea_GoDown_barricade_001
Array.english: Wait! I feel some heat coming up.
Array.indonesia: Wait! I feel some heat coming up.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialArea_GoDown_barricade_002
Array.english: I can’t go down further now.
Array.indonesia: I can’t go down further now.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Find_Dungeon01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Mm, a door?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mm, a door?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Find_Dungeon01_002
Array.english: And there is a stone slab with text in front of the door.
Array.indonesia: And there is a stone slab with text in front of the door.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_Find_Dungeon01_003
Array.english: I should take a picture of it and ask Dr. Bacon to decipher.
Array.indonesia: I should take a picture of it and ask Dr. Bacon to decipher.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TakePhoto_Dungeon01_001
Array.english: This picture is good enough.
Array.indonesia: This picture is good enough.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TakePhoto_Dungeon01_002
Array.english: Let me go up and show it to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Let me go up and show it to Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TenzhinBeforeDecript_001
Array.english: Oh, a stone slab in front of a giant door?
Array.indonesia: Oh, a stone slab in front of a giant door?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TenzhinBeforeDecript_002
Array.english: But the inscriptions are rather worn out and they are hard to read.
Array.indonesia: But the inscriptions are rather worn out and they are hard to read.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission22_TenzhinBeforeDecript_003
Array.english: I wish I could see the letters more clearly.
Array.indonesia: I wish I could see the letters more clearly.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_001
Array.english: Dr. Bacon, could you take a look at this picture?
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon, could you take a look at this picture?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! An ancient stone slab of the Sea People?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! An ancient stone slab of the Sea People?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_003
Array.english: But it is very old and poorly weathered.
Array.indonesia: But it is very old and poorly weathered.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_004
Array.english: No matter, should be enough to run \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Decoding Equipment</color> with.
Array.indonesia: No matter, should be enough to run \nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Decoding Equipment</color> with.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DecriptStoneTablet_005
Array.english: <size=35>Can you hold that picture for a moment?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Can you hold that picture for a moment?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good! I can read them!\nHow lucky!</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good! I can read them!\nHow lucky!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_002
Array.english: Oh, what a relief.\nWhat does it read?
Array.indonesia: Oh, what a relief.\nWhat does it read?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_003
Array.english: It seems to be some sort of... <color=#1DFEAF>spell</color>?
Array.indonesia: It seems to be some sort of... <color=#1DFEAF>spell</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_004
Array.english: <size=33>The letters are unfamiliar to me, \nso it is hard to decipher them clearly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The letters are unfamiliar to me, \nso it is hard to decipher them clearly.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_005
Array.english: Why don’t you ask the Sea People?
Array.indonesia: Why don’t you ask the Sea People?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_006
Array.english: There must be someone who has knowledge of \ncryptography or spells.
Array.indonesia: There must be someone who has knowledge of \ncryptography or spells.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_DaveSolo_001
Array.english: An ancient spell that even Dr. Bacon cannot decipher? \nHm...
Array.indonesia: An ancient spell that even Dr. Bacon cannot decipher? \nHm...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_DaveSolo_002
Array.english: Ah, I remember seeing many old books \nin the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Temple</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ah, I remember seeing many old books \nin the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Temple</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDecriptStoneTablet_DaveSolo_003
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color> may be of help.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color> may be of help.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? Suwam? What are you doing here?\nAre you reading a book?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Huh? Suwam? What are you doing here?\nAre you reading a book?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_002
Array.english: Heh, are you surprised?\nMy keen analytic abilities come from the books I read.
Array.indonesia: Heh, are you surprised?\nMy keen analytic abilities come from the books I read.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_003
Array.english: Oh, long time no see, human.\nI was sorting books.
Array.indonesia: Oh, long time no see, human.\nI was sorting books.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_004
Array.english: How can I help you?
Array.indonesia: How can I help you?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_005
Array.english: Can you take a look at this picture?\nIt looks like an ancient spell, but I can’t understand what it means.
Array.indonesia: Can you take a look at this picture?\nIt looks like an ancient spell, but I can’t understand what it means.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_006
Array.english: <size=36>Hm, hm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hm, hm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_007
Array.english: I can roughly understand it.\nWhere was this stone slab located?
Array.indonesia: I can roughly understand it.\nWhere was this stone slab located?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_008
Array.english: In front of a large, closed door in the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: In front of a large, closed door in the Glacial Area.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_009
Array.english: I see. According to the book...
Array.indonesia: I see. According to the book...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_010
Array.english: <size=35>There are three large doors in the Glacial Area.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>There are three large doors in the Glacial Area.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_011
Array.english: And inside those doors is a <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> that will lead to \nthe Divine Tree Control Room.
Array.indonesia: And inside those doors is a <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> that will lead to \nthe Divine Tree Control Room.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_012
Array.english: <size=35>I did an analysis and found that the earthquakes were\ncoming from the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Control Room</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I did an analysis and found that the earthquakes were\ncoming from the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Control Room</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_013
Array.english: Activate all the switches and you will be able to access the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Control Room</color>!
Array.indonesia: Activate all the switches and you will be able to access the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Control Room</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_014
Array.english: That’s not going to be easy. \nHow am I supposed to open the big door?
Array.indonesia: That’s not going to be easy. \nHow am I supposed to open the big door?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_015
Array.english: I have materials referring to the door.\nLet me see...
Array.indonesia: I have materials referring to the door.\nLet me see...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_016
Array.english: Here it is. You need to cast a <color=#1DFEAF>spell</color> to open the door.
Array.indonesia: Here it is. You need to cast a <color=#1DFEAF>spell</color> to open the door.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_017
Array.english: <size=33>Um, but I don’t speak the language of the Sea People.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Um, but I don’t speak the language of the Sea People.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_018
Array.english: Ah, of course not. Then...
Array.indonesia: Ah, of course not. Then...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_019
Array.english: <size=36>Why don’t you bring <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> with you then?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Why don’t you bring <color=#F1DC2B>Suwam</color> with you then?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_020
Array.english: Uh, Suwam, you say?
Array.indonesia: Uh, Suwam, you say?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_021
Array.english: <size=35>Human! You can do nothing without me! Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Human! You can do nothing without me! Haha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_022
Array.english: Well, it looks like you’re in trouble.\nI will give you a hand this time.
Array.indonesia: Well, it looks like you’re in trouble.\nI will give you a hand this time.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_023
Array.english: Oh, I am not sure about this...
Array.indonesia: Oh, I am not sure about this...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_024
Array.english: Best of luck to you, Suwam.\nMay King Long’s protection be with you.
Array.indonesia: Best of luck to you, Suwam.\nMay King Long’s protection be with you.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_TalkNiamo01_025
Array.english: Stop worrying about me,\njust lead the way, human.
Array.indonesia: Stop worrying about me,\njust lead the way, human.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ArrivedDungeon01Gate_001
Array.english: Hmph, this must be the door.
Array.indonesia: Hmph, this must be the door.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ArrivedDungeon01Gate_002
Array.english: Well, I am supposed to cast the spell <color=#1DFEAF>Niamo</color> taught me.
Array.indonesia: Well, I am supposed to cast the spell <color=#1DFEAF>Niamo</color> taught me.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ArrivedDungeon01Gate_003
Array.english: <size=35>Watch and learn, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Watch and learn, human!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_001
Array.english: <size=36>Wow, the door really opened!\nI am impressed, Suwam!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wow, the door really opened!\nI am impressed, Suwam!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_002
Array.english: Haha, now you realize my greatness.
Array.indonesia: Haha, now you realize my greatness.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_003
Array.english: You said it was a spell, \nand you had to dance as well to open it?
Array.indonesia: You said it was a spell, \nand you had to dance as well to open it?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_004
Array.english: Oh, that is...\nI needed to dance to keep with the beat.
Array.indonesia: Oh, that is...\nI needed to dance to keep with the beat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_005
Array.english: Got it... \nShall we get inside and check out the place, Suwam?
Array.indonesia: Got it... \nShall we get inside and check out the place, Suwam?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_006
Array.english: Uh, my back hurts from dancing.
Array.indonesia: Uh, my back hurts from dancing.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_007
Array.english: Unfortunately, you will have to go alone today, human.
Array.indonesia: Unfortunately, you will have to go alone today, human.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_AfterDungeon01GateOpen_008
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Shakes head)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Shakes head)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_BackToNiamo_001
Array.english: There should be a <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> on the other side of the big door.\nDo you think you can turn it on?
Array.indonesia: There should be a <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> on the other side of the big door.\nDo you think you can turn it on?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_BackToNiamo_002
Array.english: May King Long’s protection be with you.
Array.indonesia: May King Long’s protection be with you.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_EnterDungeon01_001
Array.english: There must be a <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> to operate the Divine Tree Control Room inside.
Array.indonesia: There must be a <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> to operate the Divine Tree Control Room inside.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_EnterDungeon01_002
Array.english: My gut feeling is this passage will cause me trouble, but I have no other choice.\nI need to be careful.
Array.indonesia: My gut feeling is this passage will cause me trouble, but I have no other choice.\nI need to be careful.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_FindRotateGimmik_001
Array.english: A piece of strange rotating equipment is blocking my way.
Array.indonesia: A piece of strange rotating equipment is blocking my way.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_FindRotateGimmik_002
Array.english: I think I can start it by myself.
Array.indonesia: I think I can start it by myself.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_UseRotateGimmik_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, the equipment is working\nand the stakes started moving.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, the equipment is working\nand the stakes started moving.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_UseRotateGimmik_002
Array.english: I must avoid them.
Array.indonesia: I must avoid them.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterStonePuzzleRoom_001
Array.english: The passage down there is blocked by ice.
Array.indonesia: The passage down there is blocked by ice.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterStonePuzzleRoom_002
Array.english: I should do something with this <color=#F1DC2B>rotating equipment</color>.
Array.indonesia: I should do something with this <color=#F1DC2B>rotating equipment</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_ClearStonePuzzle_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good! The ice is broken!\nTime to go on down!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good! The ice is broken!\nTime to go on down!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterFinalRoom_001
Array.english: Another room?
Array.indonesia: Another room?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterFinalRoom_002
Array.english: This is the statue of King Long,\n but it looks somewhat strange.
Array.indonesia: This is the statue of King Long,\n but it looks somewhat strange.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_DG01_EnterFinalRoom_003
Array.english: His pose is slightly different from that of King Long \ndepicted in the <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color>. Maybe it means...
Array.indonesia: His pose is slightly different from that of King Long \ndepicted in the <color=#1DFEAF>mural</color>. Maybe it means...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_001
Array.english: Wow, is this really the ancient Sea People’s technology?\nImpressive.
Array.indonesia: Wow, is this really the ancient Sea People’s technology?\nImpressive.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_002
Array.english: I hear some noise from afar.
Array.indonesia: I hear some noise from afar.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_003
Array.english: That must be the first contraption Niamo told me about.
Array.indonesia: That must be the first contraption Niamo told me about.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_004
Array.english: The path up is now open.\nLet me return to the village and tell Tenzhin about this.
Array.indonesia: The path up is now open.\nLet me return to the village and tell Tenzhin about this.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_Dungeon01Clear_005
Array.english: And I am hungry.
Array.indonesia: And I am hungry.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_001
Array.english: Hmph, Niamo told me the story. The Divine Tree Control Room is malfunctioning and is causing earthquakes, yes?
Array.indonesia: Hmph, Niamo told me the story. The Divine Tree Control Room is malfunctioning and is causing earthquakes, yes?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_002
Array.english: Yes, I need to operate three switches to enter \nthe Control Room.
Array.indonesia: Yes, I need to operate three switches to enter \nthe Control Room.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_003
Array.english: I already activated one of them.
Array.indonesia: I already activated one of them.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_004
Array.english: Well done.\nI am ashamed of our people having to \nrely on you in this matter.
Array.indonesia: Well done.\nI am ashamed of our people having to \nrely on you in this matter.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_005
Array.english: Please don’t be. \nThe earthquakes are a problem for us, too.
Array.indonesia: Please don’t be. \nThe earthquakes are a problem for us, too.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_006
Array.english: I remember something. \nIt was written in one of the ancient books.
Array.indonesia: I remember something. \nIt was written in one of the ancient books.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_007
Array.english: After some workers mutated into Gadons\ndue to Engineer Dasche's reckless use of energy,
Array.indonesia: After some workers mutated into Gadons\ndue to Engineer Dasche's reckless use of energy,

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_008
Array.english: My ancestors created switches to access the Control Room and scattered them in the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: My ancestors created switches to access the Control Room and scattered them in the Glacial Area.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_009
Array.english: They created those switches to tighten the security,
Array.indonesia: They created those switches to tighten the security,

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_010
Array.english: but they have turned into obstacles now denying access to \nthe Control Room.
Array.indonesia: but they have turned into obstacles now denying access to \nthe Control Room.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_011
Array.english: It’s still cold, but the heat coming from the ground\nis melting the ice.
Array.indonesia: It’s still cold, but the heat coming from the ground\nis melting the ice.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_012
Array.english: Maybe the Control Room is overheating, \ncausing the water temperature to rise.
Array.indonesia: Maybe the Control Room is overheating, \ncausing the water temperature to rise.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_013

Array.indonesia: Stabilize the device and the water temperature will \nreturn to normal.

Array.english: I know it’s rather impolite of me, but please hurry \nbefore our ancestral home is completely destroyed.
Array.indonesia: I know it’s rather impolite of me, but please hurry \nbefore our ancestral home is completely destroyed.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission23_ClearTalkTenzhin_015

Array.indonesia: There are two doors remaining.\nI will try locating them.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>You haven’t found it yet? \n Where did you search?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>You haven’t found it yet? \n Where did you search?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_002
Array.english: I searched the whole village but no luck.
Array.indonesia: I searched the whole village but no luck.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_003
Array.english: Huh? What’s going on, Ramo?
Array.indonesia: Huh? What’s going on, Ramo?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_004
Array.english: Oh, Dave.\nMm... I think <color=#F1DC2B>the Beluga</color> has suddenly gone missing.
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave.\nMm... I think <color=#F1DC2B>the Beluga</color> has suddenly gone missing.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_005
Array.english: If he is not in the village, he could have gone to the other side of the Glacial Passage through the open door.
Array.indonesia: If he is not in the village, he could have gone to the other side of the Glacial Passage through the open door.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_006
Array.english: <size=33>He is a very curious kind, you know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>He is a very curious kind, you know.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_007
Array.english: <size=36>You didn't hide him did you, human?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>You didn't hide him did you, human?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_008
Array.english: Why would I?
Array.indonesia: Why would I?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_009
Array.english: All right. I will let you know if I find him.
Array.indonesia: All right. I will let you know if I find him.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_010
Array.english: <size=36>Thanks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Thanks!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Start_011
Array.english: <size=34>Nawang! Awang!\nWhat are you doing? Go find the Beluga!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Nawang! Awang!\nWhat are you doing? Go find the Beluga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Progress_RamoTalk_001
Array.english: Any update on the Beluga’s whereabouts?\nWhere did it go?
Array.indonesia: Any update on the Beluga’s whereabouts?\nWhere did it go?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Complete_RamoTalk_001
Array.english: It’s good to see the Beluga safely back again!
Array.indonesia: It’s good to see the Beluga safely back again!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissingBeluga_Complete_RamoTalk_002
Array.english: Doesn’t the Beluga look more imposing than before?
Array.indonesia: Doesn’t the Beluga look more imposing than before?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ManateeTaxi_001
Array.english: <size=35>That’s a Manatee, not a Beluga.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>That’s a Manatee, not a Beluga.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ManateeTaxi_002
Array.english: It looks very slow...
Array.indonesia: It looks very slow...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ManateeTaxi_003
Array.english: But I have no choice. I should ride it.
Array.indonesia: But I have no choice. I should ride it.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_001
Array.english: <size=36>Brrr... It’s cold.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Brrr... It’s cold.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_002
Array.english: Human, your clothes look very warm...
Array.indonesia: Human, your clothes look very warm...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_003
Array.english: Why don’t you...
Array.indonesia: Why don’t you...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_004
Array.english: Go inside and take a look? Achu!
Array.indonesia: Go inside and take a look? Achu!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_MissionBeluga_ColdAwang_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=36>You are weaker than you look.</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=36>You are weaker than you look.</size></color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_FindBeluga01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! A Beluga!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! A Beluga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_FindBeluga01_002
Array.english: Why is it here?
Array.indonesia: Why is it here?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_FindAntarcticOctopus_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh? Is this an Antarctic Octopus?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh? Is this an Antarctic Octopus?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_FindAntarcticOctopus_002
Array.english: It’s venomous... Maybe poisoned?
Array.indonesia: It’s venomous... Maybe poisoned?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingOctopus_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ack! Why you little!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ack! Why you little!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingOctopus_Start_002
Array.english: <size=34>I’m not letting you go. Stop there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’m not letting you go. Stop there!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_001
Array.english: <size=34>*Pants*\nI cornered this one.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>*Pants*\nI cornered this one.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(It looks kind of pitiful up close...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(It looks kind of pitiful up close...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(No, I can’t be weak now.\nI will show it who's boss!)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(No, I can’t be weak now.\nI will show it who's boss!)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_Option01_001
Array.english: Harvest
Array.indonesia: Harvest

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_Option02_001
Array.english: Rescue
Array.indonesia: Rescue

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_FindAntidote_001
Array.english: Mm? What is this <color=#F1DC2B>bottle</color>? The octopus dropped it.
Array.indonesia: Mm? What is this <color=#F1DC2B>bottle</color>? The octopus dropped it.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_ChasingEnd_FindAntidote_002
Array.english: Antidote perhaps?\nI should go back to the Beluga.
Array.indonesia: Antidote perhaps?\nI should go back to the Beluga.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga01_001
Array.english: You don’t look well.
Array.indonesia: You don’t look well.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga01_002
Array.english: Do you want to try this?
Array.indonesia: Do you want to try this?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! You look better now!\nI am relieved.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! You look better now!\nI am relieved.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga02_002
Array.english: Why don’t you return to the village? You can get there alone, right?
Array.indonesia: Why don’t you return to the village? You can get there alone, right?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBeluga03_001
Array.english: Now that I found the Beluga, I should explore some more.
Array.indonesia: Now that I found the Beluga, I should explore some more.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission24_CureBelugaBarricade_001
Array.english: We can't just leave the Beluga here!\nLet's give it an <color=#F1DC2B>antidote</color>!
Array.indonesia: We can't just leave the Beluga here!\nLet's give it an <color=#F1DC2B>antidote</color>!

Array.name: Main_Mission24_CureBelugaBarricade_Antidote
Array.english: <size=34>Oops, I need to get the <color=#F1DC2B>antidote</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oops, I need to get the <color=#F1DC2B>antidote</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_Start_001
Array.english: I have to enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Cave with an Out-Flowing Current</color> to turn on the second Control Room switch...
Array.indonesia: I have to enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Cave with an Out-Flowing Current</color> to turn on the second Control Room switch...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>Is there any way to enter the cave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Is there any way to enter the cave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_Start_003
Array.english: The current may be weaker today. I should go check.
Array.indonesia: The current may be weaker today. I should go check.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_ArrivedDungeon02Gate_001
Array.english: There must be a second switch somewhere inside.
Array.indonesia: There must be a second switch somewhere inside.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_ArrivedDungeon02Gate_002
Array.english: But the strong current is blocking access.\nWhat should I do?
Array.indonesia: But the strong current is blocking access.\nWhat should I do?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_FindBeluga_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh? The Beluga!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh? The Beluga!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_FindBeluga_002
Array.english: What are you doing here?\nIt’s dangerous here. Go back!
Array.indonesia: What are you doing here?\nIt’s dangerous here. Go back!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga01_001
Array.english: What? You want me to ride on your back?
Array.indonesia: What? You want me to ride on your back?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga01_002
Array.english: The Beluga could swim against the current.
Array.indonesia: The Beluga could swim against the current.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga01_003
Array.english: Oh, boy... I don't even have a harness.
Array.indonesia: Oh, boy... I don't even have a harness.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga02_001
Array.english: Maybe I should grab on here?
Array.indonesia: Maybe I should grab on here?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_RideBeluga02_002
Array.english: <size=36>Oops, wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oops, wait!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_InsideDungeon_001
Array.english: Wow! I passed through the current.
Array.indonesia: Wow! I passed through the current.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_InsideDungeon_002
Array.english: Beluga, help me find the <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> if you’re not going back.
Array.indonesia: Beluga, help me find the <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color> if you’re not going back.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_RoomEnter_001

Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, is this... a mommy jellyfish?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_BattleStart_001
Array.english: No, we didn’t come to hunt small fish...
Array.indonesia: No, we didn’t come to hunt small fish...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_BattleStart_002
Array.english: It looks all riled up.\nI must first calm it down.
Array.indonesia: It looks all riled up.\nI must first calm it down.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_BattleStart_003
Array.english: I can’t use a weapon in this state.
Array.indonesia: I can’t use a weapon in this state.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_BattleStart_004
Array.english: It would be good if I could hit those glowing <color=#F1DC2B>eyes</color>.
Array.indonesia: It would be good if I could hit those glowing <color=#F1DC2B>eyes</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_die01_001
Array.english: Whew, lucky me. It went away.
Array.indonesia: Whew, lucky me. It went away.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_die02_001
Array.english: The back door is open. Let's go through that.
Array.indonesia: The back door is open. Let's go through that.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_PhantomJelly_PickUp_001
Array.english: Let me see if there is anything to pick up.
Array.indonesia: Let me see if there is anything to pick up.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom01_001
Array.english: Oh, that must be the <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, that must be the <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Should I activate it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Should I activate it?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_BelugaTalk_001
Array.english: I could get here\nthanks to your help.
Array.indonesia: I could get here\nthanks to your help.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom_Complete01_001
Array.english: I heard big machinery operating outside.
Array.indonesia: I heard big machinery operating outside.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom_Complete02_001
Array.english: A door is open there.\nMaybe it leads outside?
Array.indonesia: A door is open there.\nMaybe it leads outside?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom_Complete03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, I feel less heat than before.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, I feel less heat than before.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_SwitchRoom_Complete03_002
Array.english: <size=35>Maybe I can go down now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Maybe I can go down now?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_NoEnterControlRoom_001
Array.english: Hm… We need to activate one more device for the door to open.
Array.indonesia: Hm… We need to activate one more device for the door to open.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission25_NoEnterControlRoom_002
Array.english: Let's look for a cave that might have the third switch.
Array.indonesia: Let's look for a cave that might have the third switch.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_001
Array.english: <size=35>Suwam? What are you doing here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Suwam? What are you doing here?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_002
Array.english: Well, I came all the way here as the heat under \nthe Glacial Area has been reduced.
Array.indonesia: Well, I came all the way here as the heat under \nthe Glacial Area has been reduced.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_003
Array.english: I can’t fully trust humans like you.
Array.indonesia: I can’t fully trust humans like you.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_004
Array.english: So, I, the hero of the Sea People who defeated \nthe giant Gadon, came here to activate the thing myself.
Array.indonesia: So, I, the hero of the Sea People who defeated \nthe giant Gadon, came here to activate the thing myself.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_005
Array.english: <size=35>But...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>But...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_006
Array.english: I need your help because the inside is quite a mess now.
Array.indonesia: I need your help because the inside is quite a mess now.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_007
Array.english: Oh yeah? How messy?
Array.indonesia: Oh yeah? How messy?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonFront_008
Array.english: You will see for yourself.
Array.indonesia: You will see for yourself.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_EnterOption_001
Array.english: <size=35>Are you ready to enter, human?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Are you ready to enter, human?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Um, there is no water up here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Um, there is no water up here.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_002
Array.english: This is near the roots of the Divine Tree. \nThey are sucking the ground heat.
Array.indonesia: This is near the roots of the Divine Tree. \nThey are sucking the ground heat.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_003
Array.english: As the tree has mutated, it seems to have absorbed \neverything, leaving the soil around it completely dry.
Array.indonesia: As the tree has mutated, it seems to have absorbed \neverything, leaving the soil around it completely dry.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_004
Array.english: I need to open the inner <color=#F1DC2B>waterway</color> to fill the water again.
Array.indonesia: I need to open the inner <color=#F1DC2B>waterway</color> to fill the water again.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_005
Array.english: But I can’t reach the contraption up there as it is \nnot in the water.
Array.indonesia: But I can’t reach the contraption up there as it is \nnot in the water.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_006
Array.english: <size=34>Human, you go up there and activate the contraption \non my signal!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Human, you go up there and activate the contraption \non my signal!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_007
Array.english: <size=36>You want me to go up there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>You want me to go up there?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonEnter_008
Array.english: Of course, you can’t go up there...\nAll right, wait a moment.
Array.indonesia: Of course, you can’t go up there...\nAll right, wait a moment.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonLever01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, there is a lever here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, there is a lever here.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonLever01_002
Array.english: There you are.\nYes, pull that lever.
Array.indonesia: There you are.\nYes, pull that lever.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonLever02_001
Array.english: There is another lever down here.\nI will pull this one myself.
Array.indonesia: There is another lever down here.\nI will pull this one myself.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonLever02_002
Array.english: <size=34>Send me a signal when you’re ready, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Send me a signal when you’re ready, human.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! The water began to flow from the top!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! The water began to flow from the top!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_002
Array.english: <size=34>Good! It looked like an important device, and is filling the place with water.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Good! It looked like an important device, and is filling the place with water.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_003
Array.english: <size=35>You pulled it without knowing what it does?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>You pulled it without knowing what it does?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_004
Array.english: <size=32>I trust my gut feeling, you know.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I trust my gut feeling, you know.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_005
Array.english: The water is filling up. \nI must suit up.
Array.indonesia: The water is filling up. \nI must suit up.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonAfterLever_006
Array.english: There seems to be a path inside. \nLet’s go in there!
Array.indonesia: There seems to be a path inside. \nLet’s go in there!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_001
Array.english: Fortunately, this path is filled with water.
Array.indonesia: Fortunately, this path is filled with water.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_002
Array.english: The place is packed with Divine Tree branches.
Array.indonesia: The place is packed with Divine Tree branches.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_003
Array.english: <size=36>Is there something stimulating the tree?\nThis level of growth is not normal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Is there something stimulating the tree?\nThis level of growth is not normal.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_004
Array.english: I need to enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> to figure out what’s what.
Array.indonesia: I need to enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> to figure out what’s what.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_005
Array.english: We move to the inner switch, human!
Array.indonesia: We move to the inner switch, human!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_006
Array.english: <size=36>Follow me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Follow me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_end_001
Array.english: Huh, matching my rhythm underwater.\nHumans aren't as hopeless as they seem.
Array.indonesia: Huh, matching my rhythm underwater.\nHumans aren't as hopeless as they seem.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_3rdDungeonTogether_end_002
Array.english: All right, let's proceed through the door ahead and flip the switch.
Array.indonesia: All right, let's proceed through the door ahead and flip the switch.

Array.english: <size=35>Ack! What is that creature!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ack! What is that creature!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_RoomEnter_002
Array.english: <size=35>Look at its snout! It’s scary!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Look at its snout! It’s scary!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_RoomEnter_003
Array.english: I have seen it before in the Ancient Creature Codex.\nIt is called a <color=#F1DC2B>Helicoprion</color> if my memory is correct.
Array.indonesia: I have seen it before in the Ancient Creature Codex.\nIt is called a <color=#F1DC2B>Helicoprion</color> if my memory is correct.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_RoomEnter_004
Array.english: But it went extinct 200 million years ago...
Array.indonesia: But it went extinct 200 million years ago...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_RoomEnter_005
Array.english: <size=34>Maybe it’s been trapped in ice and has now been \nreleased as the ice melts in this region!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Maybe it’s been trapped in ice and has now been \nreleased as the ice melts in this region!</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oops, we've been spotted! What should we do, Suwam?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart01_002
Array.english: <size=38> Suwam? Su-</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38> Suwam? Su-</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=34>Human! This place looks strategically important!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart02_002
Array.english: <size=32>Since that is an ancient deep-sea creature, \nit won’t sense bright light.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Since that is an ancient deep-sea creature, \nit won’t sense bright light.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart02_003
Array.english: <size=32>I will hit a <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> here to blind it,\nand you lure the creature!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I will hit a <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> here to blind it,\nand you lure the creature!</size>

Array.english: Hm, it sounds like a reasonable tactic, but...\nall you do is just hide, it seems...
Array.indonesia: Hm, it sounds like a reasonable tactic, but...\nall you do is just hide, it seems...

Array.indonesia: Anyways, that saw blade looks extremely dangerous.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_BattleStart03_003
Array.english: I should either hide somewhere or\nuse the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree Fruit</color> as Suwam suggested.
Array.indonesia: I should either hide somewhere or\nuse the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree Fruit</color> as Suwam suggested.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_Die_001
Array.english: Haha. Praise my strategical brain, it brought us victory.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Praise my strategical brain, it brought us victory.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_Die_002

Array.indonesia: If you say so...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_Die_003
Array.english: Now, the monster is gone and we can access the door.
Array.indonesia: Now, the monster is gone and we can access the door.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Helicoprion_Die_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s go in, human.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s go in, human.</size>

Array.indonesia: Wait. Check if you’re leaving anything behind.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom01_001

Array.indonesia: Here is the last <color=#F1DC2B>switch</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom01_002

Array.indonesia: It’s larger than the one in the second room. \nHelp me, Suwam.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom01_003

Array.indonesia: You can’t do anything without me, human!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom_Complete_001
Array.english: Good, I activated the last switch.\nThe door to the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> should be open now.
Array.indonesia: Good, I activated the last switch.\nThe door to the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> should be open now.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=34>I must get out through the exit and see \nwhat’s going on outside.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I must get out through the exit and see \nwhat’s going on outside.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom_SuwamBeforeTalk_001
