Array.indonesia: Stop dallying and pull that lever, human.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission26_SwitchRoom_SuwamAfterTalk_001
Array.english: What are you doing, human?\nGo check the situation outside.
Array.indonesia: What are you doing, human?\nGo check the situation outside.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDeep_FishEncounter_001
Array.english: <size=33>Holy moly! Are these ancient creatures?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Holy moly! Are these ancient creatures?</size>

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDeep_FishEncounter_002
Array.english: They must have been released from the melting glacial ice.
Array.indonesia: They must have been released from the melting glacial ice.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDeep_FishEncounter_003
Array.english: I wonder if those are of any use to Bancho for his sushi place.\nI will bring him some samples if I catch any of them.
Array.indonesia: I wonder if those are of any use to Bancho for his sushi place.\nI will bring him some samples if I catch any of them.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh?\nThe Control Room door is still closed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huh?\nThe Control Room door is still closed!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_Start_002
Array.english: The door is stuck by the Divine Tree roots growing \nfrom the inside.
Array.indonesia: The door is stuck by the Divine Tree roots growing \nfrom the inside.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_001
Array.english: <size=36>I knew you would be found here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I knew you would be found here!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_002
Array.english: <size=33>John Watson? How did you follow me here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>John Watson? How did you follow me here?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_003
Array.english: Made of eco-friendly materials and titanium,\nthere is no place the <color=#1DFEAF>Dekken-9</color> cannot reach!
Array.indonesia: Made of eco-friendly materials and titanium,\nthere is no place the <color=#1DFEAF>Dekken-9</color> cannot reach!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_004
Array.english: <size=34>I saw a passage in a strange village, \nso I just broke through it. Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I saw a passage in a strange village, \nso I just broke through it. Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_005
Array.english: You don’t mind destroying this beautiful primordial place, \ndo you? I can’t believe this.
Array.indonesia: You don’t mind destroying this beautiful primordial place, \ndo you? I can’t believe this.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_006
Array.english: You are a germ in this world and I am about to\nsterilize you!
Array.indonesia: You are a germ in this world and I am about to\nsterilize you!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_007
Array.english: <size=32>What a hypocrite!\nI know what your <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color> did in secret!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What a hypocrite!\nI know what your <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color> did in secret!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_008
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_009
Array.english: So, it was you… That is why the description of the suspect perfectly matches you.
Array.indonesia: So, it was you… That is why the description of the suspect perfectly matches you.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_010
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I am suddenly very curious about how I was portrayed \nin the description...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(I am suddenly very curious about how I was portrayed \nin the description...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_011
Array.english: <size=35>More reason that I can’t let you go free!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>More reason that I can’t let you go free!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Enter_012
Array.english: <size=35>I, John Watson of <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, the Guardians of the Sea,\nwill rid the sea of impurity!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I, John Watson of <color=#90CDFF>Sea Blue</color>, the Guardians of the Sea,\nwill rid the sea of impurity!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_BattleStart_001
Array.english: How tenacious!\nTime to finish my business with this guy.
Array.indonesia: How tenacious!\nTime to finish my business with this guy.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_BattleStart_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Um, how am I supposed to neutralize that sturdy Submarine?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Um, how am I supposed to neutralize that sturdy Submarine?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_BattleStart_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Let’s find a way while evading its attacks!</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Let’s find a way while evading its attacks!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Die_001
Array.english: <size=35>Haha, you are running like a rat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha, you are running like a rat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Die_002
Array.english: <size=35>You can't evade this one!\nThe Kirisame of Death!!!!</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>You can't evade this one!\nThe Kirisame of Death!!!!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_JohnWatson3_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=34>We can’t outrun that thing. We need to find a better way to deal with it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>We can’t outrun that thing. We need to find a better way to deal with it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_001
Array.english: <size=38>W-What is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>W-What is that?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_002
Array.english: <size=36>An ancient creature of the Plesiosaurus family?\nMaybe a Kronosaurus?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>An ancient creature of the Plesiosaurus family?\nMaybe a Kronosaurus?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_003
Array.english: <size=35>Unbelievable! A monster of that size\nhidden in the deep-sea glacier?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Unbelievable! A monster of that size\nhidden in the deep-sea glacier?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_004
Array.english: Fighting such a monster would be ridiculous, but...
Array.indonesia: Fighting such a monster would be ridiculous, but...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_005
Array.english: if it has recently come out of the ice,\nit may still be sluggish and weak.
Array.indonesia: if it has recently come out of the ice,\nit may still be sluggish and weak.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart01_006
Array.english: Besides, there is no way we can get to\nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> without confronting it.
Array.indonesia: Besides, there is no way we can get to\nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> without confronting it.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hm? Isn’t that a <color=#1DFEAF>missile launcher</color> that came off \nof John Watson’s Submarine?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hm? Isn’t that a <color=#1DFEAF>missile launcher</color> that came off \nof John Watson’s Submarine?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_BattleStart02_002
Array.english: <size=38>What if I can shoot the missiles?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>What if I can shoot the missiles?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_Barricade_001
Array.english: I really want to run, but...
Array.indonesia: I really want to run, but...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_Barricade_002
Array.english: It’s an opportunity to do something as it is hurt now!
Array.indonesia: It’s an opportunity to do something as it is hurt now!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_Die_001

Array.indonesia: Whew, it will be a nightmare if one of those monsters \nreaches land.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Kronosaurus_Die_002

Array.indonesia: I’ve got to hurry to the Divine Tree Control Room and \nrestore the device.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Mm, what is this drone?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Mm, what is this drone?</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hey, Dave! Sorry, I am late!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_003
Array.english: I was making an explorer drone to aid you as \nthe Glacial Area looks dangerous, and it has just been completed.
Array.indonesia: I was making an explorer drone to aid you as \nthe Glacial Area looks dangerous, and it has just been completed.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_004
Array.english: Dr. Bacon! \nI didn’t know the signal could reach this deep.
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon! \nI didn’t know the signal could reach this deep.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_005
Array.english: Haha! It’s the pride and joy of my lab.
Array.indonesia: Haha! It’s the pride and joy of my lab.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_006
Array.english: This drone not only communicates but also...
Array.indonesia: This drone not only communicates but also...

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_007
Array.english: <size=35>does many activities underwater.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>does many activities underwater.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_008
Array.english: <size=33>All thanks to <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>All thanks to <color=#F1DC2B>Duff</color> here.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_009
Array.english: <size=35>It’s good to see you, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It’s good to see you, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_010
Array.english: Such a large glacial ice in this depth.\nIt is as if it was touched by Gabriela and her cold fingers.
Array.indonesia: Such a large glacial ice in this depth.\nIt is as if it was touched by Gabriela and her cold fingers.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_011
Array.english: Only if I could soothe her loneliness.
Array.indonesia: Only if I could soothe her loneliness.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_012
Array.english: Hmph, anyways.
Array.indonesia: Hmph, anyways.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_013
Array.english: It looks like the roots are blocking the door.\nThe drone can cut the roots using a <color=#1DFEAF>laser cutter</color>.
Array.indonesia: It looks like the roots are blocking the door.\nThe drone can cut the roots using a <color=#1DFEAF>laser cutter</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_014
Array.english: Oh, isn’t that handy?
Array.indonesia: Oh, isn’t that handy?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_015
Array.english: Haha, I foresaw your hardship and added the feature.
Array.indonesia: Haha, I foresaw your hardship and added the feature.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_016
Array.english: <size=32>Haha. Lucky!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha. Lucky!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete01_017
Array.english: Well, why don’t you activate the laser cutter?
Array.indonesia: Well, why don’t you activate the laser cutter?

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete02_001
Array.english: The Divine Tree is extremely hard unlike ordinary trees.
Array.indonesia: The Divine Tree is extremely hard unlike ordinary trees.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete02_002
Array.english: <size=32>It will take <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color> to get it done.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It will take <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color> to get it done.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete02_003
Array.english: Do your thing until I am done.
Array.indonesia: Do your thing until I am done.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission27_complete02_004
Array.english: <size=35>I will let you know when I am done.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I will let you know when I am done.</size>

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk01_001
Array.english: This tree is very sturdy.
Array.indonesia: This tree is very sturdy.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk01_002
Array.english: This mutated state is strange as well. \nIt will take quite some time.
Array.indonesia: This mutated state is strange as well. \nIt will take quite some time.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk01_003
Array.english: I will give you a call.
Array.indonesia: I will give you a call.

Array.english: Let me explain what this drone is capable of.
Array.indonesia: Let me explain what this drone is capable of.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_002
Array.english: It can apply a filter in a video call.
Array.indonesia: It can apply a filter in a video call.

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_003
Array.english: <size=38>Like this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Like this.</size>

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_004
Array.english: What do you think? Haha.
Array.indonesia: What do you think? Haha.

Array.indonesia: Hello, master!♥\nI will always be at your side!

Array.name: dialog_GlacialDrone_Talk02_006
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall01_001
Array.english: Whew, I barely managed to cut it.\nIt’s very thick and tough.
Array.indonesia: Whew, I barely managed to cut it.\nIt’s very thick and tough.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall01_002
Array.english: It is large enough now for a person to go through...
Array.indonesia: It is large enough now for a person to go through...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Come down here when you’re ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Come down here when you’re ready!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall02_001
Array.english: Finally, I’m in the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color>.
Array.indonesia: Finally, I’m in the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color>.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall02_002
Array.english: It’s common sense to clear all the missions\nbefore fighting the boss in an RPG.
Array.indonesia: It’s common sense to clear all the missions\nbefore fighting the boss in an RPG.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_BaconCall02_003
Array.english: This is not an RPG game,\nbut being overly prepared doesn’t hurt.
Array.indonesia: This is not an RPG game,\nbut being overly prepared doesn’t hurt.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_Glacial_Earthquake_001
Array.english: <size=37>Yikes! The ground is rumbling again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Yikes! The ground is rumbling again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_Glacial_Earthquake_002
Array.english: It’s getting more intense.\nI should quickly go down to the Control Room.
Array.indonesia: It’s getting more intense.\nI should quickly go down to the Control Room.

Array.english: Now, you’ll be able to go in.
Array.indonesia: Now, you’ll be able to go in.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_EnterControlRoom_002
Array.english: I feel hot air coming out from inside.
Array.indonesia: I feel hot air coming out from inside.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_EnterControlRoom_003
Array.english: Well, that is not a good sign...\nBe careful.
Array.indonesia: Well, that is not a good sign...\nBe careful.

Array.name: dialog_EnterControlRoomTalk01_001
Array.english: Get yourself prepared before diving.
Array.indonesia: Get yourself prepared before diving.

Array.name: dialog_EnterControlRoomTalk02_001
Array.english: Even I, a man with a heart of steel, feel a bit nervous now.
Array.indonesia: Even I, a man with a heart of steel, feel a bit nervous now.

Array.name: dialog_EnterControlRoomTalk02_002
Array.english: May the Pixies guide you...
Array.indonesia: May the Pixies guide you...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom01_001
Array.english: <size=35>The roots have severely mutated...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>The roots have severely mutated...</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom02_001
Array.english: That door is blocked by <color=#1DFEAF>tree sap</color>...
Array.indonesia: That door is blocked by <color=#1DFEAF>tree sap</color>...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom02_002
Array.english: There should be a way to go inside.
Array.indonesia: There should be a way to go inside.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom03_001
Array.english: <size=33>Alright, I passed it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Alright, I passed it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom04_001
Array.english: <size=34>No! The path is cut off...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>No! The path is cut off...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom04_002
Array.english: Other paths are blocked by the tree sap as well.
Array.indonesia: Other paths are blocked by the tree sap as well.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom04_003

Array.indonesia: A sea scorpion and mutated Divine Tree fruit.\nThis is terrible.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom04_004
Array.english: I must somehow find a way.
Array.indonesia: I must somehow find a way.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom05_001

Array.indonesia: Oh! I can pop the <color=#1DFEAF>sap</color> using this mutated Divine Tree fruit!

Array.indonesia: What if I drop this mutated Divine Tree fruit onto the door \nI saw earlier?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom06_001
Array.english: Mm, the hydrothermal vent is blocking the door.
Array.indonesia: Mm, the hydrothermal vent is blocking the door.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom06_002
Array.english: <size=33>Is there any way to stop the water jet?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Is there any way to stop the water jet?</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom07_001
Array.english: <size=33>Nice! It’s been stopped!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Nice! It’s been stopped!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom07_002
Array.english: I’d better pass it before it moves again.
Array.indonesia: I’d better pass it before it moves again.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom08_001
Array.english: <size=34>That is a massive crater.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>That is a massive crater.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom09_001
Array.english: The top wall looks loose.
Array.indonesia: The top wall looks loose.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom09_002

Array.indonesia: It may collapse if the crater erupts a little higher.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom10_001
Array.english: <size=34>The way up is now open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>The way up is now open!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom10_002
Array.english: <size=33>I should bring the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit</color> here with me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I should bring the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit</color> here with me.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom11_001
Array.english: <size=33>The door is open!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>The door is open!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom11_002
Array.english: It looks spooky inside.
Array.indonesia: It looks spooky inside.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom11_003
Array.english: I should be careful.
Array.indonesia: I should be careful.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom12_001
Array.english: <size=35>Yikes! What are those gross looking eggs?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Yikes! What are those gross looking eggs?</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom12_002
Array.english: <size=35>Why are they attached to the Divine Tree roots?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Why are they attached to the Divine Tree roots?</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_001
Array.english: <size=35>Strange creatures have hatched from the eggs!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Strange creatures have hatched from the eggs!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_002
Array.english: Wait! Those creatures...\nI have seen them in one of the Sea People’s murals.
Array.indonesia: Wait! Those creatures...\nI have seen them in one of the Sea People’s murals.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_003
Array.english: Oh, right. Tenzhin once told me that an ancient engineer altered creatures by infusing the Divine Tree energy...
Array.indonesia: Oh, right. Tenzhin once told me that an ancient engineer altered creatures by infusing the Divine Tree energy...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_004
Array.english: These may be the creatures. They have survived for \nsuch a long period of time, still breeding...
Array.indonesia: These may be the creatures. They have survived for \nsuch a long period of time, still breeding...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom13_005
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, I don’t know what’s happening.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, I don’t know what’s happening.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom14_001
Array.english: <size=34>There are even more eggs here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>There are even more eggs here!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom14_002
Array.english: They look like they’re ready to hatch, \nbut I can’t go back now.
Array.indonesia: They look like they’re ready to hatch, \nbut I can’t go back now.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom15_001
Array.english: There is a door there...
Array.indonesia: There is a door there...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom15_002
Array.english: If I could melt the mucus covering the door!
Array.indonesia: If I could melt the mucus covering the door!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom16_001
Array.english: There is an intact <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color>!
Array.indonesia: There is an intact <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color>!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom16_002
Array.english: <size=35>Should I put it in that <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit device</color>?
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Should I put it in that <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit device</color>?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom_NoActionAlert_001
Array.english: The eggs may hatch at any moment.\nI must open the door in front of me as quickly as possible.
Array.indonesia: The eggs may hatch at any moment.\nI must open the door in front of me as quickly as possible.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom_NoActionAlert_002
Array.english: I’ll try activating the contraption using the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color>!
Array.indonesia: I’ll try activating the contraption using the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color>!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom17_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good, the contraption is working!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good, the contraption is working!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom17_002
Array.english: Maybe I can melt the mucus by projecting the light from \nthis Divine Tree fruit?
Array.indonesia: Maybe I can melt the mucus by projecting the light from \nthis Divine Tree fruit?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom18_001
Array.english: Oh, no! The eggs are hatching!
Array.indonesia: Oh, no! The eggs are hatching!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom18_002
Array.english: I need to get rid of them before I can melt the mucus...
Array.indonesia: I need to get rid of them before I can melt the mucus...

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom19_001
Array.english: Whew, that was the last of them.
Array.indonesia: Whew, that was the last of them.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom19_002
Array.english: <size=34>Let me melt the mucus covering the door!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let me melt the mucus covering the door!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom20_001
Array.english: <size=35>Grrr, more eggs are hatching!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Grrr, more eggs are hatching!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom20_002
Array.english: Again, I need to get rid of them before doing anything else.
Array.indonesia: Again, I need to get rid of them before doing anything else.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom21_001
Array.english: They are growing in number.
Array.indonesia: They are growing in number.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom21_002
Array.english: I must open the door and escape.
Array.indonesia: I must open the door and escape.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom22_001
Array.english: <size=34>God! More are hatching!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>God! More are hatching!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom22_002
Array.english: <size=34>This time, I will eliminate them once and for all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This time, I will eliminate them once and for all!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom23_001
Array.english: *Panting* That should be the last of them.
Array.indonesia: *Panting* That should be the last of them.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom23_002
Array.english: I must quickly melt the mucus covering the door \nbefore anything else shows up!
Array.indonesia: I must quickly melt the mucus covering the door \nbefore anything else shows up!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom24_001
Array.english: <size=34>Nice, the mucus is all gone!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Nice, the mucus is all gone!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom24_002
Array.english: It must be the core of the Control Room over there.
Array.indonesia: It must be the core of the Control Room over there.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission28_ControlRoom24_003
Array.english: Let’s find out what it is.
Array.indonesia: Let’s find out what it is.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh… The offspring of that ancient creature is \nclinging to something!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh… The offspring of that ancient creature is \nclinging to something!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Is that...\nthe nucleus of the Divine Tree?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Is that...\nthe nucleus of the Divine Tree?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter01_003
Array.english: Could that be why the Divine Tree is acting strange…?
Array.indonesia: Could that be why the Divine Tree is acting strange…?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter01_004
Array.english: <size=34>I'll need to get rid of these creatures first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I'll need to get rid of these creatures first!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Looks like the Divine Tree's nucleus has stabilized again.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Looks like the Divine Tree's nucleus has stabilized again.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter02_002
Array.english: I guess this should do it?
Array.indonesia: I guess this should do it?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter02_003
Array.english: Phew... I hope the earthquakes will stop now.
Array.indonesia: Phew... I hope the earthquakes will stop now.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_FinalRoomEnter02_004
Array.english: I should start heading back to land…
Array.indonesia: I should start heading back to land…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BossAppear_001
Array.english: <size=35>Arghh!! What on earth is that?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Arghh!! What on earth is that?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BossAppear_002
Array.english: <size=34>Is that... the mom of those creatures I saw earlier?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Is that... the mom of those creatures I saw earlier?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BossAppear_003
Array.english: <size=33>No wonder there were eggs everywhere...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>No wonder there were eggs everywhere...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_001
Array.english: <size=33>I tracked you down in case you needed help...\nWhat's going on here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I tracked you down in case you needed help...\nWhat's going on here?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_002
Array.english: That huge monster came out from the lava...
Array.indonesia: That huge monster came out from the lava...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_003
Array.english: Hmm! I know what that is... I’ve seen it a lot in the texts \nabout the ancient civilization of the Sea People...
Array.indonesia: Hmm! I know what that is... I’ve seen it a lot in the texts \nabout the ancient civilization of the Sea People...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_004
Array.english: <size=35>Looks like the creature known as <color=#1DFEAF>Yawie</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Looks like the creature known as <color=#1DFEAF>Yawie</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_005
Array.english: An ancient beast from legend, still alive...\nand it's massively bigger.
Array.indonesia: An ancient beast from legend, still alive...\nand it's massively bigger.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_006
Array.english: The Sea People elder told me about some old experiment.
Array.indonesia: The Sea People elder told me about some old experiment.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_007
Array.english: It must have absorbed the Divine Tree and the geothermal energy to get this big!
Array.indonesia: It must have absorbed the Divine Tree and the geothermal energy to get this big!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_008
Array.english: We have to defeat it to stabilize the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: We have to defeat it to stabilize the Divine Tree.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_009
Array.english: <size=33>Dave, I'm counting on you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Dave, I'm counting on you!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_010
Array.english: <size=32>What?! \nHow can I possibly defeat such a huge ancient creature?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What?! \nHow can I possibly defeat such a huge ancient creature?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_011
Array.english: <size=34>You took down a dinosaur just a moment ago!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You took down a dinosaur just a moment ago!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear01_012
Array.english: <size=35>No, that was a different situation! \nI don't even have any weapons or bullets now...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>No, that was a different situation! \nI don't even have any weapons or bullets now...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_001
Array.english: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Zaaap...</color><i>
Array.indonesia: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Zaaap...</color><i>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_002
Array.english: Dave, isn't the weapon right here?
Array.indonesia: Dave, isn't the weapon right here?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_003
Array.english: Huh? Duff, what are you talking about?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Duff, what are you talking about?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_004
Array.english: I told you...\nthis drone has all kinds of hidden features.
Array.indonesia: I told you...\nthis drone has all kinds of hidden features.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_005
Array.english: I knew this day would come,\nbut it was a bit sooner than expected.
Array.indonesia: I knew this day would come,\nbut it was a bit sooner than expected.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear02_006
Array.english: <size=34>I'll input the activation code for the drone's attack mode.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I'll input the activation code for the drone's attack mode.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! It can do that?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wow! It can do that?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_002
Array.english: This drone can maintain oxygen levels, fire unlimited bullets,\nand even <color=#F1DC2B>manipulate time</color>.
Array.indonesia: This drone can maintain oxygen levels, fire unlimited bullets,\nand even <color=#F1DC2B>manipulate time</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_003
Array.english: <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Manipulate time</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Manipulate time</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_004
Array.english: Yes. \n<image=InGame.Aim, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>If you press this, you can temporarily manipulate time.
Array.indonesia: Yes. \n<image=InGame.Aim, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>If you press this, you can temporarily manipulate time.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_005
Array.english: It should give you some time to dodge attacks.\nOf course, you need to be quick.
Array.indonesia: It should give you some time to dodge attacks.\nOf course, you need to be quick.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_006
Array.english: This is all the help I can give right now.
Array.indonesia: This is all the help I can give right now.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_007
Array.english: I hope we won't be saying our final goodbyes.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-T...</color>, no...
Array.indonesia: I hope we won't be saying our final goodbyes.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-T...</color>, no...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_DroneAppear03_008
Array.english: <color=#ff61e3>SEE YOU AGAI-ETERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: <color=#ff61e3>SEE YOU AGAI-ETERNITY★</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BattleStart_001
Array.english: <size=33>I can't just run away now, not after getting this far.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I can't just run away now, not after getting this far.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_BattleStart_002
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! Let's deal with this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright! Let's deal with this!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=35>I can't just run away now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I can't just run away now!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_001
Array.english: Our current attack level might not be enough...\nThis enemy's tougher than we expected.
Array.indonesia: Our current attack level might not be enough...\nThis enemy's tougher than we expected.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_002
Array.english: I didn't want to go this far but...\nLet's unlock the Limiter.
Array.indonesia: I didn't want to go this far but...\nLet's unlock the Limiter.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_003
Array.english: <size=33>Why didn't you do that from the start?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Why didn't you do that from the start?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_004
Array.english: <size=34>Who brings out their trump card right at the beginning \nof a game?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Who brings out their trump card right at the beginning \nof a game?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser01_005
Array.english: <size=34>Just watch this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Just watch this.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_001
Array.english: <size=35>I call this, <color=#ff61e3>Stella★Laser</color>!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I call this, <color=#ff61e3>Stella★Laser</color>!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_002
Array.english: A super-powered laser combining all our tech.\nNever thought we'd use it underwater… hm...
Array.indonesia: A super-powered laser combining all our tech.\nNever thought we'd use it underwater… hm...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_003
Array.english: <Touch><size=32>Pay attention.\nIf you hold <image=时间图标1, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, you can gather Stella energy.</size></Touch><size=32>Pay attention.\nIf you hold <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, you can gather Stella energy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <Touch><size=32>Pay attention.\nIf you hold <image=时间图标1, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, you can gather Stella energy.</size></Touch><size=32>Pay attention.\nIf you hold <image=InGame.Interaction, preset=ContentsGuide_KR/>, you can gather Stella energy.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_004
Array.english: <size=32>Let go of the button to fire.\nEasy, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let go of the button to fire.\nEasy, right?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_005
Array.english: <size=32>But keep in mind that you'll move slower while charging.\nSo be careful.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>But keep in mind that you'll move slower while charging.\nSo be careful.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_006
Array.english: <size=35>Good luck, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good luck, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_007
Array.english: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Zaaap...</color><i>
Array.indonesia: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Zaaap...</color><i>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_008
Array.english: A charge and fire laser, huh...
Array.indonesia: A charge and fire laser, huh...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Anomalocalis_StellaLaser02_009
Array.english: <size=35>Great!\nLet's finish with this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Great!\nLet's finish with this!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossRunAway_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh…! It's trying to run away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh…! It's trying to run away!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossRunAway_002
Array.english: <size=33>If we don't kill it now, it will continue to cause problems.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If we don't kill it now, it will continue to cause problems.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossRunAway_003
Array.english: <size=35>Let's put an end to this once and for all!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let's put an end to this once and for all!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossTired_001
Array.english: <size=33>Oh! It seems like it's finally tired!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh! It seems like it's finally tired!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Mission29_BossTired_002
Array.english: <size=33>Now’s our chance, Dave!\nWe need to end...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Now’s our chance, Dave!\nWe need to end...</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DaveRunAway_001
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa!! That was close…!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa!! That was close…!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DaveRunAway_002
Array.english: Look, it’s using its last bit of strength...!
Array.indonesia: Look, it’s using its last bit of strength...!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DaveRunAway_003
Array.english: <size=32>Dave, move to that open path for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Dave, move to that open path for now!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DaveRunAway_004
Array.english: <size=33>It won't be able to hold on much longer!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It won't be able to hold on much longer!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_DeadEnd_001
Array.english: <size=35>It's a dead end.\nWhat should I do…?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It's a dead end.\nWhat should I do…?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_BossTrapped_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ha! It's entangled in the Divine Tree!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ha! It's entangled in the Divine Tree!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_BossTrapped_002
Array.english: <size=34>This is a lucky opportunity to finish it off.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This is a lucky opportunity to finish it off.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_BossTrapped_003
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm. The drone seems to be malfunctioning.\nI can't pick up the weapon signal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm. The drone seems to be malfunctioning.\nI can't pick up the weapon signal.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_BossTrapped_004
Array.english: Well, what should I do?\nIs there anything useful around here?
Array.indonesia: Well, what should I do?\nIs there anything useful around here?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserCannon_001
Array.english: There's a huge <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit device</color> over there…!
Array.indonesia: There's a huge <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit device</color> over there…!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserCannon_002
Array.english: The Divine Tree fruit seems to have returned to normal.\nWhat if I put it in there and operate it?
Array.indonesia: The Divine Tree fruit seems to have returned to normal.\nWhat if I put it in there and operate it?

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserCannon_003
Array.english: No... It's too big.\nI can't possibly move and aim it all by myself.
Array.indonesia: No... It's too big.\nI can't possibly move and aim it all by myself.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_001
Array.english: <size=35>Are you alright, human?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Are you alright, human?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_002
Array.english: <size=33>Oh… Sea People…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh… Sea People…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_003
Array.english: We came down here because you didn't come up even though the Divine Tree was stabilized.
Array.indonesia: We came down here because you didn't come up even though the Divine Tree was stabilized.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_004
Array.english: <size=34>I-Is that <color=#F1DC2B>Yawie</color>!?\nHas it grown that big over this long period of time?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I-Is that <color=#F1DC2B>Yawie</color>!?\nHas it grown that big over this long period of time?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_005
Array.english: It seems like we need to defeat that creature to end this…
Array.indonesia: It seems like we need to defeat that creature to end this…

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_006
Array.english: <size=34>This is our chance while it's tied up! \nLet's finish it off…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This is our chance while it's tied up! \nLet's finish it off…</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_007
Array.english: That won't be enough. \nUnless we use the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit device</color> over there.
Array.indonesia: That won't be enough. \nUnless we use the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit device</color> over there.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_008
Array.english: Well, given my expertise in both physics and math, it seems like we might need to adjust the angle of the device upwards.
Array.indonesia: Well, given my expertise in both physics and math, it seems like we might need to adjust the angle of the device upwards.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_009
Array.english: <size=32>Well… that might work,\nbut it looks incredibly heavy.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Well… that might work,\nbut it looks incredibly heavy.</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_010
Array.english: <size=34>We'll help!! If five of us combine our strengths, \nwe can do it somehow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>We'll help!! If five of us combine our strengths, \nwe can do it somehow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_MVAppear_011
Array.english: <size=35>You bring the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> and put it in!\nThere's no time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>You bring the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> and put it in!\nThere's no time!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Waiting_001
Array.english: <size=35>What are you doing, human!!\nIt's so heavy, I'm dying here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>What are you doing, human!!\nIt's so heavy, I'm dying here!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Waiting_002
Array.english: <size=35>Hurry up and put the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> in the device!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hurry up and put the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> in the device!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserReady_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! I'm ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright! I'm ready!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserReady_002
Array.english: <size=34>The device is responding!\nIt's time to end our long history!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>The device is responding!\nIt's time to end our long history!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_LaserReady_003
Array.english: <size=34>You pesky nuisance! Take this!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You pesky nuisance! Take this!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Room2BossDead_001
Array.english: My aim was precise.\nIt won't recover from that state.
Array.indonesia: My aim was precise.\nIt won't recover from that state.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Room2BossDead_002
Array.english: Phew… This has really been an incredible journey.
Array.indonesia: Phew… This has really been an incredible journey.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Room2BossDead_003
Array.english: You did a great job, human.\nLet’s go back to the Sea People Village and talk.
Array.indonesia: You did a great job, human.\nLet’s go back to the Sea People Village and talk.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_001
Array.english: The water temperature has stabilized and the Divine Tree fruit is also in good condition.
Array.indonesia: The water temperature has stabilized and the Divine Tree fruit is also in good condition.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_002
Array.english: The villagers who were ill seem to be slowly improving.
Array.indonesia: The villagers who were ill seem to be slowly improving.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_003
Array.english: We've faced many challenges, but it's a relief that \nwe've managed to overcome them!
Array.indonesia: We've faced many challenges, but it's a relief that \nwe've managed to overcome them!

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_004
Array.english: I think the earthquakes on the mainland will stop as well.
Array.indonesia: I think the earthquakes on the mainland will stop as well.

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>How about going up and checking the status?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>How about going up and checking the status?</size>

Array.name: dialog_MainMission29_Complete_006
Array.english: Good job, human!\nCome and visit us often!
Array.indonesia: Good job, human!\nCome and visit us often!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Boat_001
Array.english: <size=34>It's already nighttime?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It's already nighttime?</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Boat_002
Array.english: It's been a long day...
Array.indonesia: It's been a long day...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Boat_003
Array.english: <size=34>I think I'll drop by <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I think I'll drop by <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_NoPhone_001
Array.english: <size=34>I think I'll drop by <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I think I'll drop by <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hey there, Dave!\nYou're finally back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hey there, Dave!\nYou're finally back!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh?! Everyone's gathered here?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh?! Everyone's gathered here?</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_003
Array.english: We heard from Dr. Bacon.\nYou've accomplished a lot.
Array.indonesia: We heard from Dr. Bacon.\nYou've accomplished a lot.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_004
Array.english: You did a good job.\nHow about we all relax today and enjoy some food together?
Array.indonesia: You did a good job.\nHow about we all relax today and enjoy some food together?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_005
Array.english: Whoa, awesome… \nI was worried I might have to get right back to work.
Array.indonesia: Whoa, awesome… \nI was worried I might have to get right back to work.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Enter_006
Array.english: <size=35>Great! We should all celebrate together!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Great! We should all celebrate together!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_001
Array.english: I still can't believe what happened.
Array.indonesia: I still can't believe what happened.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_002
Array.english: Not just the Sea People’s civilization, but the village too...
Array.indonesia: Not just the Sea People’s civilization, but the village too...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_003
Array.english: <size=35>You even solved their crisis!\nGreat job!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>You even solved their crisis!\nGreat job!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_004
Array.english: From now on, we should keep this civilization secret.
Array.indonesia: From now on, we should keep this civilization secret.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_01_005
Array.english: They need to maintain the peace they've regained.
Array.indonesia: They need to maintain the peace they've regained.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_02_001
Array.english: Ahh... Beer tastes great today.
Array.indonesia: Ahh... Beer tastes great today.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bacon_02_002
Array.english: Maybe it's 'cause I'm in a good mood and having a good time, hahaha!!
Array.indonesia: Maybe it's 'cause I'm in a good mood and having a good time, hahaha!!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_001
Array.english: I'm sorry I couldn't be of much help, \nI was busy with the shop.
Array.indonesia: I'm sorry I couldn't be of much help, \nI was busy with the shop.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_002
Array.english: What are you talking about, Bancho!
Array.indonesia: What are you talking about, Bancho!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_003
Array.english: The Sea People loved your cooking!
Array.indonesia: The Sea People loved your cooking!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_004
Array.english: Hmm. If that's the case, I'm glad.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. If that's the case, I'm glad.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Now there are no more earthquakes, \nlet's get to work!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Now there are no more earthquakes, \nlet's get to work!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_02_001
Array.english: I've prepared my best dishes for today.
Array.indonesia: I've prepared my best dishes for today.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Bancho_02_002
Array.english: Isn't this the best I can do on a day like this?
Array.indonesia: Isn't this the best I can do on a day like this?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_001
Array.english: Dave, you've worked really hard.
Array.indonesia: Dave, you've worked really hard.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_002
Array.english: It's gratifying to see your venture prospering.
Array.indonesia: It's gratifying to see your venture prospering.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_003
Array.english: That’s largely thanks to you for providing such reliable staff.
Array.indonesia: That’s largely thanks to you for providing such reliable staff.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_004
Array.english: You must have had your plate full with all kinds of things.\nBut now, I hope you can support Bancho in running the restaurant effectively.
Array.indonesia: You must have had your plate full with all kinds of things.\nBut now, I hope you can support Bancho in running the restaurant effectively.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_01_005
Array.english: Bancho's a bit stubborn and might stir up some problems if left to his own devices!
Array.indonesia: Bancho's a bit stubborn and might stir up some problems if left to his own devices!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_02_001
Array.english: The sea breeze is especially refreshing today.
Array.indonesia: The sea breeze is especially refreshing today.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Yoshie_02_002
Array.english: The food is truly excellent.\nBancho's cooking is surely exceptional!
Array.indonesia: The food is truly excellent.\nBancho's cooking is surely exceptional!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good job, Dave!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good job, Dave!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: I only opened a shop here because this place has \nplenty of fish! Who knew it had such a secret?
Array.indonesia: I only opened a shop here because this place has \nplenty of fish! Who knew it had such a secret?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_003
Array.english: Well, you’ve solved the problem, \nand my business is booming now…
Array.indonesia: Well, you’ve solved the problem, \nand my business is booming now…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_004
Array.english: <size=35>I guess my decision was right after all, hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I guess my decision was right after all, hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_005
Array.english: ...It was a fun experience.\nComing here was a good idea.
Array.indonesia: ...It was a fun experience.\nComing here was a good idea.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_006
Array.english: I’m thinking about seeking out another adventure.\nWhat do you think?
Array.indonesia: I’m thinking about seeking out another adventure.\nWhat do you think?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_01_007
Array.english: Let's just rest for now, Cobra.
Array.indonesia: Let's just rest for now, Cobra.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Cobra_02_001
Array.english: It's peaceful now without those pesky pirates!
Array.indonesia: It's peaceful now without those pesky pirates!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_001
Array.english: First time seeing you in the shop, huh?
Array.indonesia: First time seeing you in the shop, huh?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_002
Array.english: Well… I just finished submitting my paper…\nSo I'm a bit free.
Array.indonesia: Well… I just finished submitting my paper…\nSo I'm a bit free.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_003
Array.english: Good, I'm glad for you.
Array.indonesia: Good, I'm glad for you.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_004
Array.english: Eh? That <color=#1DFEAF>eco-bag</color> there? I haven't seen it before.
Array.indonesia: Eh? That <color=#1DFEAF>eco-bag</color> there? I haven't seen it before.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_005
Array.english: <size=33>Ahaha! You have sharp eyes!\nIt's the reward for maxing out the <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color> level!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ahaha! You have sharp eyes!\nIt's the reward for maxing out the <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color> level!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_006
Array.english: <size=33>It’s a service that prints the faces of users committed to environmental protection, on a bag!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It’s a service that prints the faces of users committed to environmental protection, on a bag!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_01_007
Array.english: You've really been putting a lot of work in since you got \nsome free time. I can't fall behind.
Array.indonesia: You've really been putting a lot of work in since you got \nsome free time. I can't fall behind.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_02_001
Array.english: Maybe I should get more into diving?\nIt seems like a lot of fun.
Array.indonesia: Maybe I should get more into diving?\nIt seems like a lot of fun.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_02_002
Array.english: That's a great idea.\nIf you need help, I can teach you.
Array.indonesia: That's a great idea.\nIf you need help, I can teach you.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_02_003
Array.english: Nah… If I'm going to learn, I might as well learn from \na cool instructor.
Array.indonesia: Nah… If I'm going to learn, I might as well learn from \na cool instructor.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Ellie_02_004
Array.english: <size=35>Umm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Umm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hahaha!! A true feast!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hahaha!! A true feast!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_002
Array.english: You're always so busy, we've hardly had the time to chat…
Array.indonesia: You're always so busy, we've hardly had the time to chat…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_003
Array.english: Now that things are calmer, I'll have plenty of time to share with you some more of my stories.
Array.indonesia: Now that things are calmer, I'll have plenty of time to share with you some more of my stories.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_004
Array.english: Um, sir…
Array.indonesia: Um, sir…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_005
Array.english: Back in my diving days, \nI was mostly into free diving.
Array.indonesia: Back in my diving days, \nI was mostly into free diving.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_006
Array.english: And I wore the necklace my father gave me!!\nBut Barracudas have a tendency to attack anything that shines!
Array.indonesia: And I wore the necklace my father gave me!!\nBut Barracudas have a tendency to attack anything that shines!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_007
Array.english: <size=33>Out of nowhere, a school of barracudas came at me!!\nEven worse, I didn't even have a harpoon that day!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Out of nowhere, a school of barracudas came at me!!\nEven worse, I didn't even have a harpoon that day!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_008
Array.english: I figured fleeing might be more dangerous,\nso I swam straight toward the barracudas...
Array.indonesia: I figured fleeing might be more dangerous,\nso I swam straight toward the barracudas...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_009
Array.english: <size=37>...Whoa! I think the ground just shook!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>...Whoa! I think the ground just shook!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_01_010
Array.english: <size=34>Huh?! Eh?! I didn't feel anything!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Huh?! Eh?! I didn't feel anything!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Otto_02_001
Array.english: Now that the big event's over, let's have a beer sometime soon,\nand pick up where we left off, haha.
Array.indonesia: Now that the big event's over, let's have a beer sometime soon,\nand pick up where we left off, haha.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_001
Array.english: Hey, Dave! Your assistance has really helped elevate \nmy status at the company.
Array.indonesia: Hey, Dave! Your assistance has really helped elevate \nmy status at the company.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_002
Array.english: We have a new reporter now, which lightens my load a bit.
Array.indonesia: We have a new reporter now, which lightens my load a bit.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_003
Array.english: So I can even afford to join in these evening gatherings.
Array.indonesia: So I can even afford to join in these evening gatherings.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Since I cannot drink beer, I stick to non-alcoholic drinks, though. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Since I cannot drink beer, I stick to non-alcoholic drinks, though. Haha.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_005
Array.english: I'm happy to hear that I was helpful. So, you don't need me\nto help with the reporting anymore, right?
Array.indonesia: I'm happy to hear that I was helpful. So, you don't need me\nto help with the reporting anymore, right?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_006
Array.english: <size=34>What are you talking about?! \nI still don't know how to dive!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What are you talking about?! \nI still don't know how to dive!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_01_007
Array.english: <size=35>Haha! If there's anything I need help with, \nI'll come looking for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha! If there's anything I need help with, \nI'll come looking for you.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_02_001
Array.english: Ah, the reason I can't drink beer?
Array.indonesia: Ah, the reason I can't drink beer?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_02_002
Array.english: There was an unfortunate incident at a company dinner where I got too drunk and even spilled on the face of my chief editor...
Array.indonesia: There was an unfortunate incident at a company dinner where I got too drunk and even spilled on the face of my chief editor...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Udo_02_003
Array.english: <size=35>Ah…! Forget what I just said!! I simply have a low tolerance for alcohol, haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah…! Forget what I just said!! I simply have a low tolerance for alcohol, haha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hohoho!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hohoho!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_002
Array.english: Ah… Sato, you made it too?
Array.indonesia: Ah… Sato, you made it too?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_003
Array.english: Haha! I heard you've been venturing into Glacial Area to \ncollect Marinca, and I thought I'd show some support.
Array.indonesia: Haha! I heard you've been venturing into Glacial Area to \ncollect Marinca, and I thought I'd show some support.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_004
Array.english: Well… That's not quite true but...
Array.indonesia: Well… That's not quite true but...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_005
Array.english: Haha. Thanks to you, my world ranking keeps getting \nbetter and better.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Thanks to you, my world ranking keeps getting \nbetter and better.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_006
Array.english: Now that the big event is behind us, \nlet's see about gathering the remaining Marinca.
Array.indonesia: Now that the big event is behind us, \nlet's see about gathering the remaining Marinca.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_01_007
Array.english: Oops, just remembered, I forgot to turn off the lights \nafter <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color> went to sleep!
Array.indonesia: Oops, just remembered, I forgot to turn off the lights \nafter <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color> went to sleep!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_001
Array.english: I'm in a good mood today, the drinks are going down smooth.
Array.indonesia: I'm in a good mood today, the drinks are going down smooth.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_002
Array.english: I have to get to <color=#1DFEAF>the gym</color> the first thing tomorrow morning.
Array.indonesia: I have to get to <color=#1DFEAF>the gym</color> the first thing tomorrow morning.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_003
Array.english: Uh oh… That sounds risky...
Array.indonesia: Uh oh… That sounds risky...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_004
Array.english: What? I've been feeling stiff lately, so I've been going to \nthe gym for some exercise. Is there something wrong?
Array.indonesia: What? I've been feeling stiff lately, so I've been going to \nthe gym for some exercise. Is there something wrong?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sato_02_005
Array.english: Haha… got it. Just remember not to drink too much!
Array.indonesia: Haha… got it. Just remember not to drink too much!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_001
Array.english: Oh, Vincent.\nAre you here alone tonight?
Array.indonesia: Oh, Vincent.\nAre you here alone tonight?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_002
Array.english: I didn't come here to rate your restaurant today, \nso don't stress.Take it easy.
Array.indonesia: I didn't come here to rate your restaurant today, \nso don't stress.Take it easy.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_003
Array.english: When I dine in peace, I can savor the intricate flavors more. \nIt's delicious.
Array.indonesia: When I dine in peace, I can savor the intricate flavors more. \nIt's delicious.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_004
Array.english: I'm happy to hear that.
Array.indonesia: I'm happy to hear that.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_005
Array.english: Hmm… I guess my prejudices have worn off…\nbut there's no denying that there has been a slight change to the taste.
Array.indonesia: Hmm… I guess my prejudices have worn off…\nbut there's no denying that there has been a slight change to the taste.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_006
Array.english: Really? The taste changed?
Array.indonesia: Really? The taste changed?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_007
Array.english: It’s a bit...\nsmoother, you could say it’s softer.
Array.indonesia: It’s a bit...\nsmoother, you could say it’s softer.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_008
Array.english: Before, the dishes were brimming with the chef's strong-willed style, but now it feels more accommodating to the consumer.
Array.indonesia: Before, the dishes were brimming with the chef's strong-willed style, but now it feels more accommodating to the consumer.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_009
Array.english: Interesting. So that translates into the taste as well.
Array.indonesia: Interesting. So that translates into the taste as well.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_01_010
Array.english: Well, that might just be my perception.
Array.indonesia: Well, that might just be my perception.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_02_001
Array.english: It's a bit difficult to truly savor the dishes when filming.
Array.indonesia: It's a bit difficult to truly savor the dishes when filming.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_02_002
Array.english: Before a camera, I end up scrutinizing everything to deliver \na solid critique.
Array.indonesia: Before a camera, I end up scrutinizing everything to deliver \na solid critique.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Vincent_02_003
Array.english: Heh… I’m feeling particularly relaxed today. Very relaxing.
Array.indonesia: Heh… I’m feeling particularly relaxed today. Very relaxing.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_001
Array.english: It's been a while, BANCHO SUSHI.
Array.indonesia: It's been a while, BANCHO SUSHI.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_002
Array.english: How are you, Sammy? Are you enjoying your life here?
Array.indonesia: How are you, Sammy? Are you enjoying your life here?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_003
Array.english: <size=33>You know it! There are times when I get a bit bored… \nbut it's also incredibly inspiring, YO.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You know it! There are times when I get a bit bored… \nbut it's also incredibly inspiring, YO.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_004
Array.english: The new song that I recently released online has been getting great feedback, you know.
Array.indonesia: The new song that I recently released online has been getting great feedback, you know.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_005
Array.english: So, you’re still making music, huh?
Array.indonesia: So, you’re still making music, huh?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_01_006
Array.english: For sure! The sound of a hoe hitting the ground, \nthe clucking of a hen, it's all just one big BEAT to me, YO.
Array.indonesia: For sure! The sound of a hoe hitting the ground, \nthe clucking of a hen, it's all just one big BEAT to me, YO.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_02_001
Array.english: These sudden earthquakes had been scaring the chickens and causing me many sleepless nights.
Array.indonesia: These sudden earthquakes had been scaring the chickens and causing me many sleepless nights.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Sammy_02_002
Array.english: I was thinking about writing a song about it, but I'm starting to think I should change the theme yo!
Array.indonesia: I was thinking about writing a song about it, but I'm starting to think I should change the theme yo!

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_001
Array.english: Why didn't he come in person…?
Array.indonesia: Why didn't he come in person…?

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_002
Array.english: <size=35>Because I am waiting for an important parcel today.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Because I am waiting for an important parcel today.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_003
Array.english: I've been inspired from afar by your bravery, Dave.
Array.indonesia: I've been inspired from afar by your bravery, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_004
Array.english: The way you fought tirelessly to save the Sea People Village...
Array.indonesia: The way you fought tirelessly to save the Sea People Village...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_005
Array.english: If you were a beautiful girl, I might've joined your fandom.
Array.indonesia: If you were a beautiful girl, I might've joined your fandom.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_006
Array.english: I'll pour all my energy into weapon research to prepare for \nany upcoming crises.
Array.indonesia: I'll pour all my energy into weapon research to prepare for \nany upcoming crises.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_007
Array.english: As your “colleague,” I'm counting on your continued efforts, Dave.
Array.indonesia: As your “colleague,” I'm counting on your continued efforts, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_01_008
Array.english: Hmm... All right.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... All right.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_02_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>If there's an earthquake while I'm gone... \nmy toy figure display will be ruined…</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>If there's an earthquake while I'm gone... \nmy toy figure display will be ruined…</color>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_02_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>That’s why I can't leave the house empty…</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>That’s why I can't leave the house empty…</color>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_02_003
Array.english: <size=33>...That's the reason?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>...That's the reason?</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Duff_02_004
Array.english: <size=34>What, you've been eavesdropping?\nWould you please act like a gentleman?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What, you've been eavesdropping?\nWould you please act like a gentleman?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_01_001
Array.english: Although it was quite the roller coaster, I've learned so much from Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Although it was quite the roller coaster, I've learned so much from Bancho.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_01_002
Array.english: I wonder if I was too focused on fancy food and missed out \non what true 'flavor' is...
Array.indonesia: I wonder if I was too focused on fancy food and missed out \non what true 'flavor' is...

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_01_003
Array.english: <size=34>But, I still can't get myself to eat that grilled shark head over there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>But, I still can't get myself to eat that grilled shark head over there.</size>

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_01_004
Array.english: Anyhow, please keep running the branch smoothly \nand sharing more wonderful dishes with people, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Anyhow, please keep running the branch smoothly \nand sharing more wonderful dishes with people, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_02_001
Array.english: Bancho's cooking seems more fitting for this kind of open beachfront.
Array.indonesia: Bancho's cooking seems more fitting for this kind of open beachfront.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Lois_02_002
Array.english: Maybe the sea breeze is part of the recipe. *Giggles*
Array.indonesia: Maybe the sea breeze is part of the recipe. *Giggles*

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_001
Array.english: Phew…\nIt was a lot tougher than I thought, but…
Array.indonesia: Phew…\nIt was a lot tougher than I thought, but…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_002
Array.english: I met a lot of nice people in the end.
Array.indonesia: I met a lot of nice people in the end.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_003
Array.english: Looking back, it was a fun adventure.
Array.indonesia: Looking back, it was a fun adventure.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_004
Array.english: I never would've visited a place like the Sea People Village \nin my life, were I not given the opportunity.
Array.indonesia: I never would've visited a place like the Sea People Village \nin my life, were I not given the opportunity.

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_005
Array.english: Okay, let's relax and…
Array.indonesia: Okay, let's relax and…

Array.name: dialog_EndingIntermission_Dave_006
Array.english: <size=37>go for another exciting dive!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>go for another exciting dive!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_enter_01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Phew...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Phew...</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_enter_01_002
Array.english: That thing should be too big to get out.\nNow, I just have to escape with this current…
Array.indonesia: That thing should be too big to get out.\nNow, I just have to escape with this current…

Array.name: dialog_boss005_enter_02_001
Array.english: <size=38>No... No way!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>No... No way!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_enter_02_002
Array.english: <size=35>I'm going to die if I get caught...\nI need to run!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I'm going to die if I get caught...\nI need to run!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Found_LightBerry_01_001
Array.english: Something doesn’t seem right...\nI think it’s preparing an attack... What do I do?
Array.indonesia: Something doesn’t seem right...\nI think it’s preparing an attack... What do I do?

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Found_LightBerry_02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wait... That’s the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wait... That’s the <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Found_LightBerry_02_002
Array.english: <size=33>It hates light, so if we hit that...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It hates light, so if we hit that...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_deadend_01_001
Array.english: <size=38>Ugh! It’s a dead end!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ugh! It’s a dead end!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_deadend_01_002
Array.english: <size=35>There’s no way out!\nMy goodness!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>There’s no way out!\nMy goodness!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_vertical_01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Phew... That was a close call.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Phew... That was a close call.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_vertical_01_002
Array.english: <size=32>... I think it fainted...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>... I think it fainted...</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_vertical_02_001
Array.english: A path opened up after we hit it earlier.
Array.indonesia: A path opened up after we hit it earlier.

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_vertical_02_002
Array.english: <size=34>I should escape before it awakes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I should escape before it awakes!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_vertical_001
Array.english: <size=38>It’s awake already?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>It’s awake already?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_vertical_002
Array.english: <size=35>What a disgusting creature.\nI have to get away!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>What a disgusting creature.\nI have to get away!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_horizontal_001
Array.english: Did I lose the creature?
Array.indonesia: Did I lose the creature?

Array.name: dialog_boss005_turn_horizontal_002
Array.english: <size=35>... What is this vibration...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>... What is this vibration...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_horizontal_001
Array.english: I shouldn’t let my guard down...
Array.indonesia: I shouldn’t let my guard down...

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_horizontal_002
Array.english: The current is flowing back to the right.\nThere should be a way out nearby.
Array.indonesia: The current is flowing back to the right.\nThere should be a way out nearby.

Array.name: dialog_boss005_Start_horizontal_003
Array.english: <size=35>I should run before it awakes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I should run before it awakes!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss005_horizontal_end_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ah! There’s light!\nI’ll be able to escape that way!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah! There’s light!\nI’ll be able to escape that way!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_001
Array.english: <size=36>There it is!\nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color> with Leahs-chan inside!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>There it is!\nThe <color=#1DFEAF>Pink Delivery Box</color> with Leahs-chan inside!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_002
Array.english: <size=36>Wait, more importantly...\nLook at that Giant Squid!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wait, more importantly...\nLook at that Giant Squid!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_003
Array.english: So that’s our culprit. I guess it knows a good thing\nwhen it sees it, even though it’s just a squid.
Array.indonesia: So that’s our culprit. I guess it knows a good thing\nwhen it sees it, even though it’s just a squid.

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_004
Array.english: <size=34>It seems to be asleep...\nSneak up and bring it back quietly.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It seems to be asleep...\nSneak up and bring it back quietly.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_005
Array.english: Ugh... I’ve come too far to go back empty-handed...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... I’ve come too far to go back empty-handed...

Array.name: dialog_boss000_enter_006
Array.english: I guess I’ll try approaching quietly...
Array.indonesia: I guess I’ll try approaching quietly...

Array.name: dialog_boss000_start_001
Array.english: <size=37>Ugh... It’s awake!\nI need to get out of here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Ugh... It’s awake!\nI need to get out of here!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_start_002
Array.english: <size=35>Dave! \nDon’t tell me you’re going to chicken out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Dave! \nDon’t tell me you’re going to chicken out!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_start_003
Array.english: <size=35>Use the <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color> I gave you.\nThe Harpoon will be of no use.</size>
