Array.indonesia: <size=35>Use the <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color> I gave you.\nThe Harpoon will be of no use.</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_start_004
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Leahs-chan... Here we come!</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Leahs-chan... Here we come!</color>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_exit_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yes. That’s the one!\nCome back up to the boat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yes. That’s the one!\nCome back up to the boat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_boss000_exit_002
Array.english: <size=38><color=#C3C3C3>I’m so relieved... Leahs-chan...</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#C3C3C3>I’m so relieved... Leahs-chan...</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_001
Array.english: <size=46>Ho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>Ho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_002
Array.english: Long time no see, Sato.\nHave you been well?
Array.indonesia: Long time no see, Sato.\nHave you been well?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_003
Array.english: Of course. My passion never dies.
Array.indonesia: Of course. My passion never dies.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_004
Array.english: Hey... Have you ever heard about the <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color>?
Array.indonesia: Hey... Have you ever heard about the <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_005
Array.english: Umm... I have no idea, but it does sound very rare.
Array.indonesia: Umm... I have no idea, but it does sound very rare.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_006
Array.english: Ugh! You haven’t heard of the <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color>, a Marinca collector’s greatest wish?
Array.indonesia: Ugh! You haven’t heard of the <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color>, a Marinca collector’s greatest wish?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_007
Array.english: It’s a legendary card that gets activated\nwhen catching a large creature that isn’t common in ordinary weather...
Array.indonesia: It’s a legendary card that gets activated\nwhen catching a large creature that isn’t common in ordinary weather...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_008
Array.english: <size=34>The card’s signal was detected\nagain at this Giant Blue Hole!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>The card’s signal was detected\nagain at this Giant Blue Hole!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_009
Array.english: My investigation has revealed that you’ll be able to catch the creature...\non <color=#1DFEAF>the night of a storm</color>...
Array.indonesia: My investigation has revealed that you’ll be able to catch the creature...\non <color=#1DFEAF>the night of a storm</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_010
Array.english: These clouds suggest a storm could be coming in the next few days.
Array.indonesia: These clouds suggest a storm could be coming in the next few days.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_011
Array.english: I’ll keep checking the weather and get in touch.
Array.indonesia: I’ll keep checking the weather and get in touch.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_012
Array.english: I’ll collect these super rare cards and help you become\nthe Advanced Marinca Collector that you wanted to be!
Array.indonesia: I’ll collect these super rare cards and help you become\nthe Advanced Marinca Collector that you wanted to be!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_013
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I don’t think I ever said that I wanted that...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>I don’t think I ever said that I wanted that...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_Unlock_014
Array.english: <size=34>Then... I’ll be in touch soon, so look forward to it!\nHo ho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Then... I’ll be in touch soon, so look forward to it!\nHo ho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ho! The storm is getting rowdy...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ho! The storm is getting rowdy...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_002
Array.english: Tonight, the creature that gives the\n<color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color> will most likely appear...
Array.indonesia: Tonight, the creature that gives the\n<color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color> will most likely appear...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_003
Array.english: <size=35>Doesn’t it excite you as a Marinca collector?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Doesn’t it excite you as a Marinca collector?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_004
Array.english: Not really...
Array.indonesia: Not really...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_005
Array.english: Ho... Ho! If you go in the evening, \nyou’ll see the <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> that was created by the storm.
Array.indonesia: Ho... Ho! If you go in the evening, \nyou’ll see the <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> that was created by the storm.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_006
Array.english: You’ll find the creature once you go inside the <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color>.
Array.indonesia: You’ll find the creature once you go inside the <color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_007
Array.english: I would go if my diving skills were better.\nIt’s too bad...
Array.indonesia: I would go if my diving skills were better.\nIt’s too bad...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Start_008
Array.english: <size=36>Then, I wish you luck!\nHo ho ho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Then, I wish you luck!\nHo ho ho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_01_PickUpItem_001
Array.english: A piece of the Hermit Crab pincer came off.
Array.indonesia: A piece of the Hermit Crab pincer came off.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss_01_PickUpItem_002
Array.english: Should I pick up a piece?
Array.indonesia: Should I pick up a piece?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wha-a?! You…found the <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card!?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wha-a?! You…found the <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card!?</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_002
Array.english: Astounding…\nYou must be a natural born Marinca collector….
Array.indonesia: Astounding…\nYou must be a natural born Marinca collector….

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_003
Array.english: The sea was unrelenting…with all those terrifying sea creatures…\nThat was serious stuff.
Array.indonesia: The sea was unrelenting…with all those terrifying sea creatures…\nThat was serious stuff.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_004
Array.english: Haha! \nMeh. That's no big deal compared to this awesome <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color>!
Array.indonesia: Haha! \nMeh. That's no big deal compared to this awesome <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>But, I went through all that….</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>But, I went through all that….</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_006
Array.english: …Now, tap 'Share Card with Friends' like this…
Array.indonesia: …Now, tap 'Share Card with Friends' like this…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=35>Alright. There we go!\nKeep up the good work! Ho ho!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright. There we go!\nKeep up the good work! Ho ho!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Restart_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ho! The storm is getting rowdy again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ho! The storm is getting rowdy again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Restart_002
Array.english: About the Super Rare Boss Card...\nHow about we try to get it again?
Array.indonesia: About the Super Rare Boss Card...\nHow about we try to get it again?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Restart_003
Array.english: You’ll be able to meet the creature by going into the\n<color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> that was created by the storm.
Array.indonesia: You’ll be able to meet the creature by going into the\n<color=#F1DC2B>vortex</color> that was created by the storm.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_SpecialBoss01_Restart_004
Array.english: <size=36>Don’t lose the opportunity,\nMarinca collector!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Don’t lose the opportunity,\nMarinca collector!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_001
Array.english: <size=37>*Pants*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>*Pants*</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_002
Array.english: What’s going on? You’re riding a raft...
Array.indonesia: What’s going on? You’re riding a raft...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_003
Array.english: My name is <color=#F1DC2B>Clara</color>.\nI didn’t expect to see a person on the sea in this storm.
Array.indonesia: My name is <color=#F1DC2B>Clara</color>.\nI didn’t expect to see a person on the sea in this storm.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_004
Array.english: Have you seen a Great White Shark around here, \nyoung one?
Array.indonesia: Have you seen a Great White Shark around here, \nyoung one?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_005
Array.english: Nope. I’ve seen many sharks but no Great White.
Array.indonesia: Nope. I’ve seen many sharks but no Great White.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_006
Array.english: <size=35>That can’t be true! <color=#F1DC2B>Klaus</color>, the enemy of my husband \nmust be around somewhere!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>That can’t be true! <color=#F1DC2B>Klaus</color>, the enemy of my husband \nmust be around somewhere!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_007
Array.english: All traces lead to this place for sure.
Array.indonesia: All traces lead to this place for sure.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_008
Array.english: Klaus is known to be sighted only on stormy nights.
Array.indonesia: Klaus is known to be sighted only on stormy nights.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_009
Array.english: On a stormy night just like this, it took my husband... \nthat was 36 years ago.
Array.indonesia: On a stormy night just like this, it took my husband... \nthat was 36 years ago.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_010
Array.english: It will appear here for sure.\nEverything leads me to this place.
Array.indonesia: It will appear here for sure.\nEverything leads me to this place.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_011
Array.english: By the way, I’ve dived several times and I noticed \nthat the terrain changed every time.
Array.indonesia: By the way, I’ve dived several times and I noticed \nthat the terrain changed every time.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_012
Array.english: Oh, you’re not mistaken.\nThe sea around here is very confusing for newcomers.
Array.indonesia: Oh, you’re not mistaken.\nThe sea around here is very confusing for newcomers.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_013
Array.english: Gosh, I just don’t have enough time to get used to it...
Array.indonesia: Gosh, I just don’t have enough time to get used to it...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_014
Array.english: <size=37>Young one? Can you find Klaus for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Young one? Can you find Klaus for me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_015
Array.english: <size=38>Huh? Me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Huh? Me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_016
Array.english: Yes, you. You are familiar with this place.\nI need to find it before the storm passes.
Array.indonesia: Yes, you. You are familiar with this place.\nI need to find it before the storm passes.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_017
Array.english: Just locate it and I will take care of the rest.\nHelp this old lady, please.
Array.indonesia: Just locate it and I will take care of the rest.\nHelp this old lady, please.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_018
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Ah, she looks desperate.\nOkay, all I have to do is just find it...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Ah, she looks desperate.\nOkay, all I have to do is just find it...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_019
Array.english: All right. I will sweep the area.
Array.indonesia: All right. I will sweep the area.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_020
Array.english: <size=33>Oh, really?\nThank you, young one.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Oh, really?\nThank you, young one.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Start_021
Array.english: Just give me a holler when you find <color=#1DFEAF>Klaus’s Hideout</color>.\nAnd I will come right to you.
Array.indonesia: Just give me a holler when you find <color=#1DFEAF>Klaus’s Hideout</color>.\nAnd I will come right to you.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_FindVortex_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa, a Vortex.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa, a Vortex.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_FindVortex_002
Array.english: Does this mean the Great White Shark’s <color=#1DFEAF>hideout</color> is inside?
Array.indonesia: Does this mean the Great White Shark’s <color=#1DFEAF>hideout</color> is inside?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_FindVortex_003
Array.english: I will just go check inside, and call the old lady.
Array.indonesia: I will just go check inside, and call the old lady.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_RoomEnter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ack! I knew it was here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ack! I knew it was here!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_RoomEnter_002
Array.english: I must quickly call the old lady.\nWhere is the walkie-talkie?
Array.indonesia: I must quickly call the old lady.\nWhere is the walkie-talkie?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_RoomEnter_003
Array.english: <size=37>Oh my god, I didn’t ask her phone number!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh my god, I didn’t ask her phone number!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_RoomEnter_004
Array.english: How ferocious looking.\nI should find a way out before it opens...
Array.indonesia: How ferocious looking.\nI should find a way out before it opens...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_BattleStart_001
Array.english: <size=38>Ack! It woke up!?!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ack! It woke up!?!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_BattleStart_002
Array.english: <size=35>Urgh, I need to buy time until that old lady returns!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Urgh, I need to buy time until that old lady returns!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_001
Array.english: <size=38>Finally got you, Klaus!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Finally got you, Klaus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_002
Array.english: <size=33>I am sorry, young one. I couldn’t get familiar with this area after all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I am sorry, young one. I couldn’t get familiar with this area after all.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_003
Array.english: A Great White Shark making a whirlpool?...\nI didn’t see this coming!
Array.indonesia: A Great White Shark making a whirlpool?...\nI didn’t see this coming!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_004
Array.english: How ruthless.\nThe whirlpool claimed my husband’s life... *sobs*
Array.indonesia: How ruthless.\nThe whirlpool claimed my husband’s life... *sobs*

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_005
Array.english: Anyways, you gave it what it deserved.\nI must express my gratitude somehow...
Array.indonesia: Anyways, you gave it what it deserved.\nI must express my gratitude somehow...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_die_006
Array.english: <size=33>I will see you at the boat.\nI will be waiting for you from up there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I will see you at the boat.\nI will be waiting for you from up there.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUpItem_001
Array.english: Whew, that thing was extra ferocious.
Array.indonesia: Whew, that thing was extra ferocious.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUpItem_002
Array.english: Now, let me find a trophy to write home about.
Array.indonesia: Now, let me find a trophy to write home about.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUpItem_barricade_001
Array.english: There should be something worth taking with me.\nI should explore the area.
Array.indonesia: There should be something worth taking with me.\nI should explore the area.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUp_001
Array.english: The meat is very tough.
Array.indonesia: The meat is very tough.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_PickUp_002
Array.english: It is fatty though. Bancho will like it.
Array.indonesia: It is fatty though. Bancho will like it.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_ReStart_001
Array.english: Another stormy night, young one.
Array.indonesia: Another stormy night, young one.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_ReStart_002
Array.english: Find the <color=#1DFEAF>hideout</color> of Klaus the Great White Shark!\nSo I can end it for good!
Array.indonesia: Find the <color=#1DFEAF>hideout</color> of Klaus the Great White Shark!\nSo I can end it for good!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_001
Array.english: I was finally able to complete my long-waited revenge, thanks to you!
Array.indonesia: I was finally able to complete my long-waited revenge, thanks to you!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_002
Array.english: As long as it gave you peace.
Array.indonesia: As long as it gave you peace.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_003
Array.english: This is for you. It is a <color=#F1DC2B>necklace made of the teeth</color> I broke off of it during my first encounter.
Array.indonesia: This is for you. It is a <color=#F1DC2B>necklace made of the teeth</color> I broke off of it during my first encounter.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_004
Array.english: Oh, a Shark Tooth Necklace.\nI can sense some power within it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, a Shark Tooth Necklace.\nI can sense some power within it.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_005
Array.english: I don’t need it anymore.\nBut it will help you in your adventure.
Array.indonesia: I don’t need it anymore.\nBut it will help you in your adventure.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete01_006
Array.english: <size=34>May you live in peace.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>May you live in peace.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? I received a notification and...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh? I received a notification and...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_002
Array.english: <size=35>A Super Rare Great White Shark Boss Card!!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>A Super Rare Great White Shark Boss Card!!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_003
Array.english: Oh, you must be a hardcore Marinca collector.\nI bet you would risk your life to get rare Marinca.
Array.indonesia: Oh, you must be a hardcore Marinca collector.\nI bet you would risk your life to get rare Marinca.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_004
Array.english: I, uh, didn’t do this to collect cards...
Array.indonesia: I, uh, didn’t do this to collect cards...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_005
Array.english: Am I seeing a <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color> in the making?
Array.indonesia: Am I seeing a <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color> in the making?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_006
Array.english: <size=35>Yeah,\nI guess it’s time for me to make way for the future generation.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Yeah,\nI guess it’s time for me to make way for the future generation.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_007
Array.english: I will keep an eye on you.
Array.indonesia: I will keep an eye on you.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Klaus_Complete02_008
Array.english: <size=35>Godspeed. YIPPEEE!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Godspeed. YIPPEEE!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Wow, it’s a nasty storm today!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wow, it’s a nasty storm today!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_002
Array.english: Oh, you again. \nLooking for a <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color> as usual?
Array.indonesia: Oh, you again. \nLooking for a <color=#1DFEAF>Super Rare Boss Card</color> as usual?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_003
Array.english: Ho ho! I felt an energy of something extremely powerful today.
Array.indonesia: Ho ho! I felt an energy of something extremely powerful today.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_004
Array.english: I can’t help you today.
Array.indonesia: I can’t help you today.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_005
Array.english: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Vortex </color>! Remember the Vortex!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Vortex </color>! Remember the Vortex!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_006
Array.english: The storm is gaining strength.\nI will see you around!
Array.indonesia: The storm is gaining strength.\nI will see you around!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>Chuchu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Chuchu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_EnterBossRoom_001
Array.english: I ended up in a strange place again.
Array.indonesia: I ended up in a strange place again.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_EnterBossRoom_002
Array.english: Well, this place looks uninhabited.
Array.indonesia: Well, this place looks uninhabited.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_001
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? A crawfish wearing a pair of boxing gloves?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh? A crawfish wearing a pair of boxing gloves?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_002
Array.english: I think I know what it is. It must be a <color=#F1DC2B>Mantis Shrimp</color>.
Array.indonesia: I think I know what it is. It must be a <color=#F1DC2B>Mantis Shrimp</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_003
Array.english: <size=36>But its size is unreal.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>But its size is unreal.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_004
Array.english: I guess it could crush me with one hit.
Array.indonesia: I guess it could crush me with one hit.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_BeforeBattle_005
Array.english: It would be nice if I could find <color=#F1DC2B>something tough</color> to \nblock that thing’s punches.
Array.indonesia: It would be nice if I could find <color=#F1DC2B>something tough</color> to \nblock that thing’s punches.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_PickUpItem_001
Array.english: <size=33>Whew, that was close.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whew, that was close.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_PickUpItem_002
Array.english: <size=33>There must be something worth picking up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>There must be something worth picking up.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_PickUp_001
Array.english: Um, I guess that should be enough.\nI should go up and tell Sato.
Array.indonesia: Um, I guess that should be enough.\nI should go up and tell Sato.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_ReStart_001
Array.english: It’s stormy again.
Array.indonesia: It’s stormy again.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_ReStart_002
Array.english: Don’t miss this opportunity.
Array.indonesia: Don’t miss this opportunity.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_ReStart_003
Array.english: <size=34>Chuchu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Chuchu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Yes! This is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Yes! This is...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_002
Array.english: A <color=#1DFEAF>Mantis Shrimp Boss Card</color>!
Array.indonesia: A <color=#1DFEAF>Mantis Shrimp Boss Card</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_003
Array.english: I haven’t seen it even at the gym.
Array.indonesia: I haven’t seen it even at the gym.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_004
Array.english: Oh, I mean the gym I workout at.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I mean the gym I workout at.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_005
Array.english: Okay, look, if you transfer this card using Share...
Array.indonesia: Okay, look, if you transfer this card using Share...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=36>Okay! I got it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Okay! I got it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_007
Array.english: See you then. Keep in touch. \nKeep collecting cards!
Array.indonesia: See you then. Keep in touch. \nKeep collecting cards!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_MantisShrimp_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=35>Chuchu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Chuchu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_001
Array.english: *Gasp* I just received the Marinca social notification…
Array.indonesia: *Gasp* I just received the Marinca social notification…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_002
Array.english: Did you really collect all the cards?
Array.indonesia: Did you really collect all the cards?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_003
Array.english: Yes, apparently.
Array.indonesia: Yes, apparently.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_004
Array.english: You did it… Unbelievable….
Array.indonesia: You did it… Unbelievable….

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_005
Array.english: <size=34>I'll drop by in the near future to celebrate!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I'll drop by in the near future to celebrate!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca01_006
Array.english: …Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: …Chuchu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_001
Array.english: Hmm, this is incredible no matter how many times I look at it…\nA completed collection.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, this is incredible no matter how many times I look at it…\nA completed collection.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_002
Array.english: Even I couldn’t do it, and I've been collecting Marinca for 32 years.
Array.indonesia: Even I couldn’t do it, and I've been collecting Marinca for 32 years.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_003
Array.english: …Has Marinca been around for that long?
Array.indonesia: …Has Marinca been around for that long?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_004
Array.english: Haha! It used to be a sticker that came with chocolate snacks.
Array.indonesia: Haha! It used to be a sticker that came with chocolate snacks.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_005
Array.english: My mom once gave me an earful because I would keep the stickers and throw away the snacks.
Array.indonesia: My mom once gave me an earful because I would keep the stickers and throw away the snacks.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_006
Array.english: I see. I guess these cards have a lot of stories to tell.
Array.indonesia: I see. I guess these cards have a lot of stories to tell.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_007
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm… Wait a second…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm… Wait a second…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_008
Array.english: <size=36>This silhouette…\nIt’s <color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color>…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>This silhouette…\nIt’s <color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color>…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_009
Array.english: What do you mean?
Array.indonesia: What do you mean?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_010
Array.english: So it was true…\nIt's the hidden card that appears once all cards have been collected…
Array.indonesia: So it was true…\nIt's the hidden card that appears once all cards have been collected…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_011
Array.english: This silhouette must be that of the legendary monster in Blue Hole…\n<color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color>!
Array.indonesia: This silhouette must be that of the legendary monster in Blue Hole…\n<color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_012
Array.english: If you wish to achieve your dream of becoming a Marinca Completer, you'll need this card.
Array.indonesia: If you wish to achieve your dream of becoming a Marinca Completer, you'll need this card.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_013
Array.english: Huh? But I…
Array.indonesia: Huh? But I…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_014
Array.english: <size=33>I'll contact you the next <color=#1DFEAF>stormy night</color>.\nThis is nerve-racking… but also exciting.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'll contact you the next <color=#1DFEAF>stormy night</color>.\nThis is nerve-racking… but also exciting.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_CompleteMarinca02_015
Array.english: …Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: …Chuchu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Woah! Today’s storm feels especially strong!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Woah! Today’s storm feels especially strong!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_002
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color> is here… I can feel it!
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Lusca</color> is here… I can feel it!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_003
Array.english: Ah, the hidden card you mentioned earlier…
Array.indonesia: Ah, the hidden card you mentioned earlier…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_004
Array.english: Good luck.\nThis is the opportunity to fulfill your dreams of becoming a <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color>!
Array.indonesia: Good luck.\nThis is the opportunity to fulfill your dreams of becoming a <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_005
Array.english: But I really don't mind if I don't become one…
Array.indonesia: But I really don't mind if I don't become one…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_006
Array.english: I'll wait for the notification.\nThis is exciting.
Array.indonesia: I'll wait for the notification.\nThis is exciting.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Start_007
Array.english: <size=40>Chuchu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Chuchu!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_ReStart_001
Array.english: Hmm, it wasn’t easy, I take it? Of course it wasn't…
Array.indonesia: Hmm, it wasn’t easy, I take it? Of course it wasn't…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_ReStart_002
Array.english: But there's always a next time!
Array.indonesia: But there's always a next time!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=36>I saw the notification! *Gasp* A Lusca card…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I saw the notification! *Gasp* A Lusca card…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_002
Array.english: Incredible… the Marinca collection is finally complete. It’s glorious...
Array.indonesia: Incredible… the Marinca collection is finally complete. It’s glorious...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_003
Array.english: I’ve seen monsters like it only in movies. I never thought it would actually exist.
Array.indonesia: I’ve seen monsters like it only in movies. I never thought it would actually exist.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_004
Array.english: To think I'd actually see this card in my lifetime… As a Marinca collector, I'm… *sob*
Array.indonesia: To think I'd actually see this card in my lifetime… As a Marinca collector, I'm… *sob*

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_005
Array.english: Thank you, Dave.\nYou've earned the right to call yourself a Marinca Completer.
Array.indonesia: Thank you, Dave.\nYou've earned the right to call yourself a Marinca Completer.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_006
Array.english: I hereby give you...
Array.indonesia: I hereby give you...

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=35>This <color=#F1DC2B>hat</color>, given by my Marinca master.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>This <color=#F1DC2B>hat</color>, given by my Marinca master.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_008
Array.english: Woah… But this hat means a lot to you, doesn't it?
Array.indonesia: Woah… But this hat means a lot to you, doesn't it?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_009
Array.english: Haha… It's nothing compared to the joy you’ve given me.
Array.indonesia: Haha… It's nothing compared to the joy you’ve given me.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_010
Array.english: Thank you, Sato!
Array.indonesia: Thank you, Sato!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_011
Array.english: The hat is a little big for me. I'll use it as a decoration for BANCHO SUSHI.
Array.indonesia: The hat is a little big for me. I'll use it as a decoration for BANCHO SUSHI.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_012
Array.english: Haha. Sounds like a wonderful idea.
Array.indonesia: Haha. Sounds like a wonderful idea.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_013
Array.english: Ah, wait a moment.
Array.indonesia: Ah, wait a moment.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_014
Array.english: <size=45>….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>….</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_015
Array.english: <size=38>This should do it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>This should do it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_016
Array.english: <size=36>...The same hat…?! You have multiple same hats?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>...The same hat…?! You have multiple same hats?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_017
Array.english: The same? Nonsense. The hat I gave you is the original, the one and only.
Array.indonesia: The same? Nonsense. The hat I gave you is the original, the one and only.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_018
Array.english: It's just that I grew fond of its design, so I bought a similar one.
Array.indonesia: It's just that I grew fond of its design, so I bought a similar one.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_019
Array.english: Umm… Alright.
Array.indonesia: Umm… Alright.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_020
Array.english: Anyway, thanks, Sato.\nI’ve enjoyed Marinca as well!
Array.indonesia: Anyway, thanks, Sato.\nI’ve enjoyed Marinca as well!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_021
Array.english: Haha. If a new Marinca expansion comes out…\nI'll come find you then.
Array.indonesia: Haha. If a new Marinca expansion comes out…\nI'll come find you then.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Complete_022
Array.english: Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: Chuchu.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom01_001
Array.english: Hmm… This place is even bigger than the other places…
Array.indonesia: Hmm… This place is even bigger than the other places…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom01_002
Array.english: Is this where the Monster of Blue Hole lives…?
Array.indonesia: Is this where the Monster of Blue Hole lives…?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Woah… Is that… a great white shark?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Woah… Is that… a great white shark?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom02_002
Array.english: Wait… It has arms like an octopus…
Array.indonesia: Wait… It has arms like an octopus…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_EnterBossRoom02_003
Array.english: Are the shark and octopus in some—
Array.indonesia: Are the shark and octopus in some—

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_001
Array.english: <size=35>Arghh…! What the…?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Arghh…! What the…?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_002
Array.english: The head of a shark and the arms of an octopus…\nIt's something you'd see in a low-budget creature film!
Array.indonesia: The head of a shark and the arms of an octopus…\nIt's something you'd see in a low-budget creature film!

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_003
Array.english: Does Sato really want me to defeat this creature…?
Array.indonesia: Does Sato really want me to defeat this creature…?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_004
Array.english: …Is it because he thinks I'm up to the task? Haha.
Array.indonesia: …Is it because he thinks I'm up to the task? Haha.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_005
Array.english: Wait, now's not the time to get cocky…
Array.indonesia: Wait, now's not the time to get cocky…

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Encounter_006
Array.english: <size=35>Now I have to defeat it, no matter what!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Now I have to defeat it, no matter what!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_001
Array.english: *Pant*
Array.indonesia: *Pant*

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_002
Array.english: How could something so big be so fast?
Array.indonesia: How could something so big be so fast?

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_003
Array.english: No wonder there's so few sightings of it.
Array.indonesia: No wonder there's so few sightings of it.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_004
Array.english: I should return to the boat and check my <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca</color>.
Array.indonesia: I should return to the boat and check my <color=#1DFEAF>Marinca</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_Die_005
Array.english: Ah! Before that, I should see if it has any edible parts.
Array.indonesia: Ah! Before that, I should see if it has any edible parts.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_PickUp_001
Array.english: I see this as a big win, since I can get both shark and octopus meat.
Array.indonesia: I see this as a big win, since I can get both shark and octopus meat.

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_PickUp_002
Array.english: Though I’m not sure it'll be tasty….
Array.indonesia: Though I’m not sure it'll be tasty….

Array.name: dialog_Boss_Lusca_PickUp_003
Array.english: I’m done collecting. I should head back up.
Array.indonesia: I’m done collecting. I should head back up.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission00_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=37>Oh, Dave!\nYou collected <color=#F1DC2B>100 Gold</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh, Dave!\nYou collected <color=#F1DC2B>100 Gold</color>!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission00_Complete_002
Array.english: Great job!\nThis should be enough to repair what's broken!
Array.indonesia: Great job!\nThis should be enough to repair what's broken!

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission00_Complete_003
Array.english: Then give me some time!\nThese repairs need to be done right.
Array.indonesia: Then give me some time!\nThese repairs need to be done right.

Array.name: dialog_Main_Mission00_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=35>I really hope the customers keep coming!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I really hope the customers keep coming!</size>

Array.name: dialog_C_Area_Block_001
Array.english: It’s too dark down here...\nIt’ll be dangerous to venture down in this state.
Array.indonesia: It’s too dark down here...\nIt’ll be dangerous to venture down in this state.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_001
Array.english: <size=40>Hola... Amigo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Hola... Amigo!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_002
Array.english: Who... are you?
Array.indonesia: Who... are you?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_003
Array.english: Well... I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Jose Da Silva</color>.\nI’m a Brazilian soccer player.
Array.indonesia: Well... I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Jose Da Silva</color>.\nI’m a Brazilian soccer player.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_004
Array.english: Oh! I’ve seen you on TV!\nI haven’t heard much about you lately, though.
Array.indonesia: Oh! I’ve seen you on TV!\nI haven’t heard much about you lately, though.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_005
Array.english: <size=31>Actually... I haven’t been able to shoot the ball accurately of late! It’s a huge slump, I’m telling you! It’s very sad indeed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>Actually... I haven’t been able to shoot the ball accurately of late! It’s a huge slump, I’m telling you! It’s very sad indeed.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_006
Array.english: That’s why I’ve come here to train by myself.\nI, <color=#F1DC2B>Jose</color>, will get back up again!
Array.indonesia: That’s why I’ve come here to train by myself.\nI, <color=#F1DC2B>Jose</color>, will get back up again!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_007
Array.english: Alright! Good luck. I’ll be cheering for you.
Array.indonesia: Alright! Good luck. I’ll be cheering for you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_008
Array.english: But you see... I kicked my ball into the water...\nIt’s a <color=#1DFEAF>soccer ball made out of steel</color> for my training sessions...
Array.indonesia: But you see... I kicked my ball into the water...\nIt’s a <color=#1DFEAF>soccer ball made out of steel</color> for my training sessions...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_009
Array.english: Well, that’s terrible news...
Array.indonesia: Well, that’s terrible news...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_010
Array.english: So! Amigo! Can you help me out?\nI, <color=#F1DC2B>Jose</color>, need that ball desperately!
Array.indonesia: So! Amigo! Can you help me out?\nI, <color=#F1DC2B>Jose</color>, need that ball desperately!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_011
Array.english: Jose is very scared of the water! Ever since I fell into the water on a beach in Copacabana...\nThe sea gives me the woozies...
Array.indonesia: Jose is very scared of the water! Ever since I fell into the water on a beach in Copacabana...\nThe sea gives me the woozies...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_012
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(But why is he training on the beach anyway?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(But why is he training on the beach anyway?)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_013
Array.english: I’ve kicked it far enough to land it about <color=#F1DC2B>30m</color> deep.\nYou’ll find it for me, I’m sure.
Array.indonesia: I’ve kicked it far enough to land it about <color=#F1DC2B>30m</color> deep.\nYou’ll find it for me, I’m sure.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_014
Array.english: Alright... I guess I’ll try and look for it...
Array.indonesia: Alright... I guess I’ll try and look for it...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Yes_01
Array.english: Wow! Thank you!\nI’m sorry to press you, but I need it <color=#F39321>today</color>. It’s very important.
Array.indonesia: Wow! Thank you!\nI’m sorry to press you, but I need it <color=#F39321>today</color>. It’s very important.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Yes_02
Array.english: It’s somewhere at <color=#F1DC2B>30m</color>.\nJose will be waiting for you here.
Array.indonesia: It’s somewhere at <color=#F1DC2B>30m</color>.\nJose will be waiting for you here.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_No_01
Array.english: Oh, well... can’t be helped.\nI will still continue to train.
Array.indonesia: Oh, well... can’t be helped.\nI will still continue to train.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_No_02
Array.english: I’m sure we’ll meet again.\nStay healthy. Adios!
Array.indonesia: I’m sure we’ll meet again.\nStay healthy. Adios!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_01
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! Wow! Thank you!\nThis is it! </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! Wow! Thank you!\nThis is it! </size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_02
Array.english: I can resume training again.\nI can be the best again.
Array.indonesia: I can resume training again.\nI can be the best again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_03
Array.english: Thank you, Dave.\nYou are a true ami-go. Obriga-do!
Array.indonesia: Thank you, Dave.\nYou are a true ami-go. Obriga-do!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_04
Array.english: It’s not much, but I’ve prepared a small gift. Please take it.
Array.indonesia: It’s not much, but I’ve prepared a small gift. Please take it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Complete_05
Array.english: <size=33>Hope to see you again next time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hope to see you again next time!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Fail_01
Array.english: Oh... You couldn’t find it... Oh well.
Array.indonesia: Oh... You couldn’t find it... Oh well.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission01_Fail_02
Array.english: <size=33>It’s okay! See you next time, ami-go!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It’s okay! See you next time, ami-go!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Otto_001
Array.english: <size=45>What? Sea people..?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>What? Sea people..?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Otto_002
Array.english: It's hard to believe that something I've only heard of \nin legend is real.
Array.indonesia: It's hard to believe that something I've only heard of \nin legend is real.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Otto_003
Array.english: If there is good beer in that area I wouldn't mind trying some!
Array.indonesia: If there is good beer in that area I wouldn't mind trying some!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Otto_004
Array.english: I don’t think there will be drinks underwater…
Array.indonesia: I don’t think there will be drinks underwater…

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_001
Array.english: Looks like this is the only place to eat...\nThis is what I don’t like about remote areas.
Array.indonesia: Looks like this is the only place to eat...\nThis is what I don’t like about remote areas.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_002
Array.english: This decrepit place can’t possibly make sushi\nthat will inspire me. I’ll just have to fill my belly\nwith what I can get.
Array.indonesia: This decrepit place can’t possibly make sushi\nthat will inspire me. I’ll just have to fill my belly\nwith what I can get.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_003
Array.english: Um... What a rude customer.\nWhat do you want?
Array.indonesia: Um... What a rude customer.\nWhat do you want?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_004
Array.english: Allow me to introduce myself.\nI’m the movie director <color=#F1DC2B>Michael Bang</color>.
Array.indonesia: Allow me to introduce myself.\nI’m the movie director <color=#F1DC2B>Michael Bang</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_005
Array.english: <size=38>Wait... Didn’t you direct <color=#5dd3bb>Robot Samurai</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wait... Didn’t you direct <color=#5dd3bb>Robot Samurai</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_006
Array.english: Ha! Looks like your eyes are functional!\nYes, I’m the great action film director, Michael Bang.
Array.indonesia: Ha! Looks like your eyes are functional!\nYes, I’m the great action film director, Michael Bang.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I can’t believe he’s talking like that about himself...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>I can’t believe he’s talking like that about himself...</color>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_008
Array.english: I’m filming my new movie, <color=#5dd3bb>The Stone</color>, around these parts\nand I can’t seem to get the ending scene right...
Array.indonesia: I’m filming my new movie, <color=#5dd3bb>The Stone</color>, around these parts\nand I can’t seem to get the ending scene right...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_009
Array.english: I think I might find new inspiration with food\nthat’ll clear up my head!
Array.indonesia: I think I might find new inspiration with food\nthat’ll clear up my head!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_010
Array.english: It doesn’t seem likely I’ll find anything here.\nI’m leaving.
Array.indonesia: It doesn’t seem likely I’ll find anything here.\nI’m leaving.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_011
Array.english: <size=50>Wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>Wait!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_012
Array.english: <color=#5dd3bb>Robot Samurai</color>... was an amazing movie.\nI watched it multiple times, and was moved every time.
Array.indonesia: <color=#5dd3bb>Robot Samurai</color>... was an amazing movie.\nI watched it multiple times, and was moved every time.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_013
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>All I can remember is explosions...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>All I can remember is explosions...</color>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_014
Array.english: If you can make another such great movie through my food,\nI’d be willing to cook for you.
Array.indonesia: If you can make another such great movie through my food,\nI’d be willing to cook for you.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_015
Array.english: Oh? So you’re a fan? I’m grateful, but...\nCan you pull it off?
Array.indonesia: Oh? So you’re a fan? I’m grateful, but...\nCan you pull it off?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_016
Array.english: I’ve got high standards when it comes to sushi.\nThe rice they use in these parts is terrible, by the way.
Array.indonesia: I’ve got high standards when it comes to sushi.\nThe rice they use in these parts is terrible, by the way.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_017
Array.english: That’s why we use the best rice we can find\nin this region.
Array.indonesia: That’s why we use the best rice we can find\nin this region.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_018
Array.english: <size=32>Give me <color=#1DFEAF>3 days</color>. I’ll prepare food that will make your head \nall but explode with inspiration.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Give me <color=#1DFEAF>3 days</color>. I’ll prepare food that will make your head \nall but explode with inspiration.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_019
Array.english: Well, alright... I’ll be back in <color=#1DFEAF>3 days</color>.\nDon’t disappoint me, Chef.
Array.indonesia: Well, alright... I’ll be back in <color=#1DFEAF>3 days</color>.\nDon’t disappoint me, Chef.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_001
Array.english: Bancho, do you have a plan?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, do you have a plan?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_002
Array.english: Hmm. Cooking is an art form.\nI know well the pain of an auteur.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Cooking is an art form.\nI know well the pain of an auteur.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_003
Array.english: I’ll prepare food that will inspire him.
Array.indonesia: I’ll prepare food that will inspire him.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_004
Array.english: However…\nAs he said, the rice I use is the Annam rice of this region...
Array.indonesia: However…\nAs he said, the rice I use is the Annam rice of this region...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_005
Array.english: It bothers me that the ingredient has limits\nwhen it comes to creating the best possible sushi.
Array.indonesia: It bothers me that the ingredient has limits\nwhen it comes to creating the best possible sushi.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_006
Array.english: <size=38>Hehe. I’ve been listening in to your conversation...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hehe. I’ve been listening in to your conversation...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_007
Array.english: <size=36>If its <color=#1DFEAF>rice</color>...\nI think I could come up with something.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>If its <color=#1DFEAF>rice</color>...\nI think I could come up with something.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_008
Array.english: Hmm? Do you have an idea, Otto?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Do you have an idea, Otto?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_009
Array.english: <size=33>Hehe. Give me just a <color=#F1DC2B>day</color>.\nI’ll be in touch in the morning.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hehe. Give me just a <color=#F1DC2B>day</color>.\nI’ll be in touch in the morning.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_010
Array.english: Hmm. If we can get high-quality rice...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. If we can get high-quality rice...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_011
Array.english: We can make sushi with three kinds of fish...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Titan Triggerfish</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>Harlequin Hind</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Trout</color>.
Array.indonesia: We can make sushi with three kinds of fish...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Titan Triggerfish</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>Harlequin Hind</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Trout</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_012
Array.english: <size=33>That’s a lot of ingredients.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That’s a lot of ingredients.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_leave_013
Array.english: He appreciates flourish...\nPlease don’t be late.
Array.indonesia: He appreciates flourish...\nPlease don’t be late.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_01
Array.english: Phew... This place is rather hot...
Array.indonesia: Phew... This place is rather hot...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_02
Array.english: Is the food ready yet?\nBe honest now, I won’t chide you for it if it isn’t.
Array.indonesia: Is the food ready yet?\nBe honest now, I won’t chide you for it if it isn’t.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_03
Array.english: Here you are.\nThis food will make your inspiration skyrocket.
Array.indonesia: Here you are.\nThis food will make your inspiration skyrocket.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_04
Array.english: Haha... Looks like an explosive dish, alright.\nIt looks nice, but will the taste justify its fanciness?
Array.indonesia: Haha... Looks like an explosive dish, alright.\nIt looks nice, but will the taste justify its fanciness?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete01_05
Array.english: Try it first.
Array.indonesia: Try it first.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_01
Array.english: <size=44>RRRGGGGARR! It’s coming to me! Yes!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>RRRGGGGARR! It’s coming to me! Yes!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_02
Array.english: <size=44>Such powerful inspiration\nis filling my soul!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Such powerful inspiration\nis filling my soul!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_03
Array.english: *Pant* I haven’t felt this way in a while.
Array.indonesia: *Pant* I haven’t felt this way in a while.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_04
Array.english: This rice... It’s not easy to find such rice in these parts...\nHow did you...
Array.indonesia: This rice... It’s not easy to find such rice in these parts...\nHow did you...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_05
Array.english: I had some help from a friend.\nI’m glad to see you like it.
Array.indonesia: I had some help from a friend.\nI’m glad to see you like it.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_06
Array.english: If you’ll continue making your masterful movies that pluck at the heartstrings, you’re welcome to eat here whenever you like.
Array.indonesia: If you’ll continue making your masterful movies that pluck at the heartstrings, you’re welcome to eat here whenever you like.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_07
Array.english: Hmm... you’re quite the man.\nI like your style.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... you’re quite the man.\nI like your style.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_08
Array.english: Perhaps my next movie should be about\na sushi bar...
Array.indonesia: Perhaps my next movie should be about\na sushi bar...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_09
Array.english: It should feature a man with a missile launcher in one hand...
Array.indonesia: It should feature a man with a missile launcher in one hand...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_10
Array.english: <size=42>What... kind of story is that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>What... kind of story is that?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_11
Array.english: Hahaha! In any case, I think I’m all set,\nthanks to you!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! In any case, I think I’m all set,\nthanks to you!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_12
Array.english: This is a <color=#1DFEAF>Robot Samurai Poster</color> with my autograph.\nYou can have it as a gift!
Array.indonesia: This is a <color=#1DFEAF>Robot Samurai Poster</color> with my autograph.\nYou can have it as a gift!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_13
Array.english: <size=40>My gosh... Robot... Samurai...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>My gosh... Robot... Samurai...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Complete02_14
Array.english: Hahaha! You can look forward to the next movie!\nIt’s sure to be an exhilarating one!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! You can look forward to the next movie!\nIt’s sure to be an exhilarating one!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Fail_01
Array.english: Tsk... I knew you wouldn’t have it ready,\nfor all your bluster.
Array.indonesia: Tsk... I knew you wouldn’t have it ready,\nfor all your bluster.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Fail_02
Array.english: There’s not many places to eat around here, though,\nso I’ll come back another time!
Array.indonesia: There’s not many places to eat around here, though,\nso I’ll come back another time!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_MichaelBang01_Phone_Fail_001
Array.english: Hmph! Closing the restaurant when I’d made a reservation!\nThat’s rude!!!
Array.indonesia: Hmph! Closing the restaurant when I’d made a reservation!\nThat’s rude!!!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_MichaelBang01_Phone_Fail_002
Array.english: Next time, you’d better show me that you’re a professional!
Array.indonesia: Next time, you’d better show me that you’re a professional!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_MichaelBang01_Revisit_Reservation_001

Array.indonesia: Today We’ve come to a seaside sushi bar that’s all the rage on Cooksta, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color>!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_003

Array.indonesia: In this sushi bar that's famous for its exotic sushi, we have with us the legendary sushi expert <color=#F1DC2B>Vincent Yamaoka</color>!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_004

Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ahem!\nI am <color=#F1DC2B>Vincent Yamaoka</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_005
Array.english: Hello Vincent.\nHow would you define "Sushi"?
Array.indonesia: Hello Vincent.\nHow would you define "Sushi"?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_006
Array.english: Sushi is a very simple dish.\rThere’s only rice, vinegar, wasabi, and the fish that goes on top.\nEverything hangs upon these ingredients. However...
Array.indonesia: Sushi is a very simple dish.\rThere’s only rice, vinegar, wasabi, and the fish that goes on top.\nEverything hangs upon these ingredients. However...

Array.indonesia: Simple does not mean easy!\nListen!!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_008
Array.english: How good the ingredients are, how they were stored and aged,\nhow they were cut, how the rice was cooked,\nand how it was molded.
Array.indonesia: How good the ingredients are, how they were stored and aged,\nhow they were cut, how the rice was cooked,\nand how it was molded.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_009

Array.indonesia: All those things matter in the art of sushi!\nYes!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_010

Array.indonesia: I see. In that case, what do you think of the exotic sushi\nthat Bancho Sushi is famous for?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_011
Array.english: The ingredients for sushi have long been similar... \nThe king of fish, the tuna, and particularly the belly...\rBelow that the olive flounder and amberjack with white and red meat....All verified ingredients, you understand.\rTo dare to use new ingredients despite the many proven ones that existed from the Edo era...
Array.indonesia: The ingredients for sushi have long been similar... \nThe king of fish, the tuna, and particularly the belly...\rBelow that the olive flounder and amberjack with white and red meat....All verified ingredients, you understand.\rTo dare to use new ingredients despite the many proven ones that existed from the Edo era...

Array.indonesia: <size=36>Regardless of the taste,\nthis shows a lack of respect!</size>

Array.indonesia: We’re curious to see what your opinion on \nBancho Sushi will be!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_015

Array.indonesia: Now then, let’s start by introducing the star of today’s show!\nThis is the owner, <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>!

Array.indonesia: <size=35>Um... This is a bit sudden.</size>\n<size=28><color=#C8C8C8>I’m called Ban—</color></size>

Array.indonesia: <size=38>He’s quite reticent!</size>\nThat can only mean he speaks through his cooking!!

Array.indonesia: This is amazing...I can taste the sea as soon as I\nbite into it, and the jellyfish is nice and firm!

Array.indonesia: Hmm... I can’t help but admit it...\nThis sushi is amazing, based on a very deep understanding of the ingredients.

Array.indonesia: But why is it that you use such unknown ingredients\ninstead of the proven ones?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_10
Array.english: <size=35>The first reason is the taste.</size>\rJellyfish has a gentle, mild taste with a strong texture,\nmaking it a perfect match for the scent and flavor of SeaGrape.
Array.indonesia: <size=35>The first reason is the taste.</size>\rJellyfish has a gentle, mild taste with a strong texture,\nmaking it a perfect match for the scent and flavor of SeaGrape.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_11

Array.indonesia: The second reason is the potential.\nThere are so many kinds of ingredients out there.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_12

Array.indonesia: Insisting on using only the verified few,\nis the same as ignoring the infinite possibilities.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_13

Array.indonesia: <size=32>Thank you for those amazing words, Bancho!\nNow then, it’s time for the evaluation... Vincent?</size>

Array.indonesia: Now! This is the Jellyfish Sushi that made Vincent marvel!\nAnd Mr.Bancho who created this dish!\r<size=40>What will the score be?</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=38>I’ll give Bancho Sushi... <color=#FF6F23>80 points</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission03_Complete_03_21

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_002
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_003
Array.english: <size=36>Hello? Kid?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hello? Kid?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_004
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_005
Array.english: Um... you look like a student... we haven’t opened yet.\nCome back a bit later.
Array.indonesia: Um... you look like a student... we haven’t opened yet.\nCome back a bit later.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_006
Array.english: <size=40>Listen, you %$@#!\nI heard you the one time, so stop babbling!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Listen, you %$@#!\nI heard you the one time, so stop babbling!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_007
Array.english: <size=42>Wh-what in the world?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Wh-what in the world?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_008
Array.english: I-I’m sorry! It wasn’t me...
Array.indonesia: I-I’m sorry! It wasn’t me...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_009
Array.english: <size=40>You rotten blowfish, you!\nGet me food, food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>You rotten blowfish, you!\nGet me food, food!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_010
Array.english: Um... What in the world is going on here?
Array.indonesia: Um... What in the world is going on here?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_011
Array.english: I think I’ve read about this somewhere.
Array.indonesia: I think I’ve read about this somewhere.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_012
Array.english: There’s a therapy method that involves letting \ntraumatized kids speak their mind through dolls.
Array.indonesia: There’s a therapy method that involves letting \ntraumatized kids speak their mind through dolls.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_013
Array.english: <size=40>Doll? How dare you!\nYou idiots don’t deserve to live!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Doll? How dare you!\nYou idiots don’t deserve to live!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_014
Array.english: <size=36>I... suppose it could be something more complicated.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I... suppose it could be something more complicated.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_015
Array.english: Let’s ask what she wants first.
Array.indonesia: Let’s ask what she wants first.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_016
Array.english: <size=40><color=#1DFEAF>Kombu and White Trevally Ochazuke</color>!\nI want it! I do!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40><color=#1DFEAF>Kombu and White Trevally Ochazuke</color>!\nI want it! I do!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_017
Array.english: Um... That sounds likes something older men would want.
Array.indonesia: Um... That sounds likes something older men would want.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_018
Array.english: I don’t know what’s going on, but we’ll have to give her \nwhat she wants for us to try and have a conversation...
Array.indonesia: I don’t know what’s going on, but we’ll have to give her \nwhat she wants for us to try and have a conversation...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Start_019
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Kombu and White Trevally Ochazuke</color>...\nLet’s check the ingredients first.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Kombu and White Trevally Ochazuke</color>...\nLet’s check the ingredients first.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_001
Array.english: *Sob* *Sob*
Array.indonesia: *Sob* *Sob*

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_002
Array.english: Huh? Why are you crying suddenly?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Why are you crying suddenly?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=40>It’s too good! You $#%#$!\nThis is way too good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>It’s too good! You $#%#$!\nThis is way too good!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=40>Damn it, it’s too good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Damn it, it’s too good!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_005
Array.english: It... reminds me of my father... *sob*
Array.indonesia: It... reminds me of my father... *sob*

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_006
Array.english: Wh-what’s going on, kid?
Array.indonesia: Wh-what’s going on, kid?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_007
Array.english: My name is Maki... I’m looking for my father...
Array.indonesia: My name is Maki... I’m looking for my father...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_008
Array.english: My father left to explore the depths...\nAnd I can’t get in touch with him anymore.
Array.indonesia: My father left to explore the depths...\nAnd I can’t get in touch with him anymore.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_009
Array.english: His favorite food was\n<color=#1DFEAF>Kombu and White Trevally Ochazuke</color>,\nand I heard you sell it here...
Array.indonesia: His favorite food was\n<color=#1DFEAF>Kombu and White Trevally Ochazuke</color>,\nand I heard you sell it here...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_009_2
Array.english: <size=37>I thought he might have come by here...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>I thought he might have come by here...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_010
Array.english: That’s a pity...\nI’ll be sure to tell you if we see someone that looks like your father.
Array.indonesia: That’s a pity...\nI’ll be sure to tell you if we see someone that looks like your father.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_011
Array.english: And what is that doll?
Array.indonesia: And what is that doll?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_012
Array.english: This is a <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color> plushie. My father gave it to me\nbefore he left.
Array.indonesia: This is a <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color> plushie. My father gave it to me\nbefore he left.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_013
Array.english: Oh! I have a favor to ask. It’s about the Clione...
Array.indonesia: Oh! I have a favor to ask. It’s about the Clione...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_014
Array.english: <size=33>I’ve never seen one in person.\nCould you catch one for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I’ve never seen one in person.\nCould you catch one for me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_015
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? A <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh? A <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_016
Array.english: Um... We can’t catch something so small with a Harpoon...\nWhat do we do?
Array.indonesia: Um... We can’t catch something so small with a Harpoon...\nWhat do we do?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_017
Array.english: <size=36>Could we use this?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Could we use this?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_018
Array.english: <size=38>Oh? A <color=#F1DC2B>Bug Net</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh? A <color=#F1DC2B>Bug Net</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_019
Array.english: Hmm... I think it might work.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I think it might work.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_020
Array.english: <size=36>Alright. I’ll give it a shot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Alright. I’ll give it a shot!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_021
Array.english: <size=40>What are you doing, you walrus!\nGet your tights on and jump in the water!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>What are you doing, you walrus!\nGet your tights on and jump in the water!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_022
Array.english: Oh... I’m so sorry…\nI can’t control my emotions that well yet...
Array.indonesia: Oh... I’m so sorry…\nI can’t control my emotions that well yet...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission01_Complete_023
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_4th_complete_beforeTimeline
Array.english: I just need one more.\nI should look around more.
Array.indonesia: I just need one more.\nI should look around more.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_4th_complete_afterTimeline
Array.english: Just now... Did I see a huge Clione?
Array.indonesia: Just now... Did I see a huge Clione?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_5th_complete
Array.english: Phew. All done.\nShould I go back up now?
Array.indonesia: Phew. All done.\nShould I go back up now?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_enter_001
Array.english: What! What is this place?
Array.indonesia: What! What is this place?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_enter_002
Array.english: Oh no...\nThat’s such a big Clione!
Array.indonesia: Oh no...\nThat’s such a big Clione!

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_start_001
Array.english: Ugh... I probably won’t get away without a fight...
Array.indonesia: Ugh... I probably won’t get away without a fight...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_start_002
Array.english: Whatever. Let’s defeat it first!
Array.indonesia: Whatever. Let’s defeat it first!

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_01_001
Array.english: <size=38>Phew... What a monster...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Phew... What a monster...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_01_002
Array.english: It still stings.
Array.indonesia: It still stings.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_01_003
Array.english: Let me see if there's anything useful to pick up.
Array.indonesia: Let me see if there's anything useful to pick up.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_BossCarving_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? I see something shiny over there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huh? I see something shiny over there.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_BossCarving_002
Array.english: <size=34>I should go have a look.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I should go have a look.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_02_001
Array.english: <size=38>Huh? A photo of <color=#F1DC2B>Maki</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Huh? A photo of <color=#F1DC2B>Maki</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_boss_end_02_002
Array.english: <size=36>I’ll have to take it back up.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I’ll have to take it back up.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_01
Array.english: Here, a <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color> like you asked.
Array.indonesia: Here, a <color=#1DFEAF>Clione</color> like you asked.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_02
Array.english: It’s so beautiful!\nThank you... Dave.
Array.indonesia: It’s so beautiful!\nThank you... Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_03
Array.english: And... I found this.
Array.indonesia: And... I found this.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_04
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? Is this a photo of me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh? Is this a photo of me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_05
Array.english: There was a huge Clione...\nI found this in its home.
Array.indonesia: There was a huge Clione...\nI found this in its home.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_06
Array.english: There’s a button on the back...\nI’ll try pressing it.
Array.indonesia: There’s a button on the back...\nI’ll try pressing it.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_07
Array.english: <size=42><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_07_02
Array.english: <size=38>Maki... It’s your father.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Maki... It’s your father.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_08
Array.english: <size=50>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_09
Array.english: If you’re watching this, then...\nI’ve probably failed my expedition.
Array.indonesia: If you’re watching this, then...\nI’ve probably failed my expedition.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_10
Array.english: I couldn’t really take care of you with my busy schedule...\nMy greed for more work has turned me into an irresponsible father.
Array.indonesia: I couldn’t really take care of you with my busy schedule...\nMy greed for more work has turned me into an irresponsible father.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_11
Array.english: You haven’t been able to make many friends\nbecause we kept moving around because of my work.
Array.indonesia: You haven’t been able to make many friends\nbecause we kept moving around because of my work.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_12
Array.english: Even so, I want you to forgive me for being a terrible father,\nand live a confident life.
Array.indonesia: Even so, I want you to forgive me for being a terrible father,\nand live a confident life.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_13
Array.english: And your dream of becoming a chef...\nI hope it comes true.
Array.indonesia: And your dream of becoming a chef...\nI hope it comes true.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_14
Array.english: I’ll keep watching you from afar,\nso don’t ever lose your smile...
Array.indonesia: I’ll keep watching you from afar,\nso don’t ever lose your smile...

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_14_02
Array.english: <size=42><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42><color=#C3C3C3>*Static*</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_15
Array.english: <size=36>Um... It seems to have cut off.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Um... It seems to have cut off.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_17
Array.english: Don’t be too upset...\nIt seems your father really loved you, Maki.
Array.indonesia: Don’t be too upset...\nIt seems your father really loved you, Maki.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_18
Array.english: <size=40>Please let me work here!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Please let me work here!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_19
Array.english: <size=38>What? So suddenly?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>What? So suddenly?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_20
Array.english: Yes. \nMy father wouldn’t like to see me so lethargic and sad.
Array.indonesia: Yes. \nMy father wouldn’t like to see me so lethargic and sad.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_21
Array.english: I want to show him that I’m doing fine and working hard.
Array.indonesia: I want to show him that I’m doing fine and working hard.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_22
Array.english: And as you’ve showed concern for me and helped me,\nI’d like to help you as well.
Array.indonesia: And as you’ve showed concern for me and helped me,\nI’d like to help you as well.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_23
Array.english: Um... Bancho, what do you think?
Array.indonesia: Um... Bancho, what do you think?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_24
Array.english: <size=35>Hmm. What a spirited child.\nI like her.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hmm. What a spirited child.\nI like her.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_25
Array.english: <size=37>You can start working here today.\nBut you won’t be getting any special treatment!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>You can start working here today.\nBut you won’t be getting any special treatment!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Customer_Maki_Mission02_Complete_26
Array.english: Yes! Okay!\nI’ll work hard to learn and become an amazing chef!
Array.indonesia: Yes! Okay!\nI’ll work hard to learn and become an amazing chef!

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>*Huff*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>*Huff*</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_002
Array.english: Hmm? Is something wrong?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Is something wrong?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_003
Array.english: <size=36>C-Cold… It's too cold…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>C-Cold… It's too cold…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_004
Array.english: Uh… This place averages at 27 degrees Celsius even during the evening…
Array.indonesia: Uh… This place averages at 27 degrees Celsius even during the evening…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_005
Array.english: M-My whole body is aching…\nI'll freeze to death…
