Array.indonesia: M-My whole body is aching…\nI'll freeze to death…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_006
Array.english: You… Is there anywhere I can plant some <color=#1DFEAF>Seeds</color>?
Array.indonesia: You… Is there anywhere I can plant some <color=#1DFEAF>Seeds</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_007
Array.english: <size=37>…Seeds?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>…Seeds?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_008
Array.english: Yes. When I was climbing a snowy mountain of some far away country, a local cooked me a meal with some peppers…
Array.indonesia: Yes. When I was climbing a snowy mountain of some far away country, a local cooked me a meal with some peppers…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_009
Array.english: It warmed me up. I could conserve my heart…\nI mean, my health. I was able to reach the top, thanks to that dish.
Array.indonesia: It warmed me up. I could conserve my heart…\nI mean, my health. I was able to reach the top, thanks to that dish.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_010
Array.english: The local gave me some <color=#1DFEAF>Pepper Seeds</color>. Here.
Array.indonesia: The local gave me some <color=#1DFEAF>Pepper Seeds</color>. Here.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_011
Array.english: Hmm… I'm still not sure.\nWhat am I supposed to make with this?
Array.indonesia: Hmm… I'm still not sure.\nWhat am I supposed to make with this?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_012
Array.english: One of my friends used to love this song that was inspired by\n<color=#1DFEAF>Hot Pepper Tuna</color>…
Array.indonesia: One of my friends used to love this song that was inspired by\n<color=#1DFEAF>Hot Pepper Tuna</color>…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_013
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Ah, he's talking about Sammy's song…)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Ah, he's talking about Sammy's song…)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_014
Array.english: He said just listening to the song warms him up.
Array.indonesia: He said just listening to the song warms him up.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_015
Array.english: Can you cook me some <color=#1DFEAF>Hot Pepper Tuna</color>, please?
Array.indonesia: Can you cook me some <color=#1DFEAF>Hot Pepper Tuna</color>, please?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_016
Array.english: I don't know what the ingredients are…\nbut I'm sure that dish will warm me up.
Array.indonesia: I don't know what the ingredients are…\nbut I'm sure that dish will warm me up.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_017
Array.english: Hmm, let me see if I can plant these seeds first.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, let me see if I can plant these seeds first.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_018
Array.english: *Coughing* Make it quick, please.
Array.indonesia: *Coughing* Make it quick, please.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_1st_Start_019
Array.english: I'm freezing here…
Array.indonesia: I'm freezing here…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero01_001
Array.english: Hmm. Cuisine made with pepper.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Cuisine made with pepper.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero01_002
Array.english: First, I should take this <color=#1DFEAF>Pepper Seed</color> to Otto.
Array.indonesia: First, I should take this <color=#1DFEAF>Pepper Seed</color> to Otto.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero01_003
Array.english: And since Sammy wrote the song "Hot Pepper Tuna", he might know something about it.
Array.indonesia: And since Sammy wrote the song "Hot Pepper Tuna", he might know something about it.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero01_004
Array.english: Then talk to those two first.
Array.indonesia: Then talk to those two first.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_001
Array.english: Otto. A customer gave me some <color=#1DFEAF>Pepper Seeds</color>…\nCan we plant it?
Array.indonesia: Otto. A customer gave me some <color=#1DFEAF>Pepper Seeds</color>…\nCan we plant it?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_002
Array.english: <size=36>*Gasp* This is…!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>*Gasp* This is…!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_003
Array.english: This is no ordinary pepper. You brought me <color=#1DFEAF>Habanero</color> seeds.
Array.indonesia: This is no ordinary pepper. You brought me <color=#1DFEAF>Habanero</color> seeds.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_004
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Habanero</color>?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Habanero</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_005
Array.english: Yessiree. The fifth spiciest pepper in the world. Can't even harvest it without wearing gloves.
Array.indonesia: Yessiree. The fifth spiciest pepper in the world. Can't even harvest it without wearing gloves.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_006
Array.english: Still, it won't be difficult to grow here.
Array.indonesia: Still, it won't be difficult to grow here.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_007
Array.english: Oh…! Then I should give it a try.
Array.indonesia: Oh…! Then I should give it a try.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_008
Array.english: We got a customer wrapped in thick clothes, saying he feels cold even in this weather…
Array.indonesia: We got a customer wrapped in thick clothes, saying he feels cold even in this weather…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_009
Array.english: Oh, right. Sammy, do you know the recipe for <color=#1DFEAF>Hot Pepper Tuna</color>?
Array.indonesia: Oh, right. Sammy, do you know the recipe for <color=#1DFEAF>Hot Pepper Tuna</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_010
Array.english: The customer mentioned your song and wanted to try the dish.
Array.indonesia: The customer mentioned your song and wanted to try the dish.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_011
Array.english: <size=34>I have a fan! I'm flattered!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I have a fan! I'm flattered!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_012
Array.english: Hot Pepper Tuna… The song was inspired by a dish my mom would sometimes cook for me.
Array.indonesia: Hot Pepper Tuna… The song was inspired by a dish my mom would sometimes cook for me.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_013
Array.english: My mom's pepper dish… Especially her Peppered Tuna… It was the best.
Array.indonesia: My mom's pepper dish… Especially her Peppered Tuna… It was the best.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_014
Array.english: Hahaha! I can still remember Sammy drenched in sweat, gobbling up every last bit.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! I can still remember Sammy drenched in sweat, gobbling up every last bit.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_015
Array.english: He would spend the entire next day in the toilet, then he would eat it again!
Array.indonesia: He would spend the entire next day in the toilet, then he would eat it again!

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_016
Array.english: C'mon Dad, you're embarrassing me.\nAnyhow…
Array.indonesia: C'mon Dad, you're embarrassing me.\nAnyhow…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_017
Array.english: A recipe… I don't know the exact recipe, but I know what ingredients you need.
Array.indonesia: A recipe… I don't know the exact recipe, but I know what ingredients you need.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_018
Array.english: That should be enough for Bancho to come up with something.\nTell me!
Array.indonesia: That should be enough for Bancho to come up with something.\nTell me!

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Habanero02_019
Array.english: Hmm. A <color=#1DFEAF>habanero</color>…\nI should get my hands on more of those seeds, haha.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. A <color=#1DFEAF>habanero</color>…\nI should get my hands on more of those seeds, haha.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_2nd_Start_001
Array.english: *Huff* The afternoon I can handle… but it's too cold in the evening…\nI'm freezing to death here…
Array.indonesia: *Huff* The afternoon I can handle… but it's too cold in the evening…\nI'm freezing to death here…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_2nd_Start_002
Array.english: Made any progress on that <color=#1DFEAF>Hot Pepper Tuna</color>?
Array.indonesia: Made any progress on that <color=#1DFEAF>Hot Pepper Tuna</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_2nd_Start_003
Array.english: Yes! I happened to know the man who made that song…\nSo I asked for a recipe.
Array.indonesia: Yes! I happened to know the man who made that song…\nSo I asked for a recipe.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_2nd_Start_004
Array.english: <size=35>Good! Wonderful!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good! Wonderful!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_2nd_Start_005
Array.english: Then please… Make me that dish before I freeze to death.\nI'll be waiting.
Array.indonesia: Then please… Make me that dish before I freeze to death.\nI'll be waiting.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Woah! The heat is…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Woah! The heat is…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_002
Array.english: <size=36>I can feel the warmth…! Ahh…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I can feel the warmth…! Ahh…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_003
Array.english: *Pant* I'm sweating…
Array.indonesia: *Pant* I'm sweating…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_004
Array.english: That's quite a reaction.\nGlad you're not cold anymore.
Array.indonesia: That's quite a reaction.\nGlad you're not cold anymore.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_005
Array.english: Phew, you saved me.\nAh, you don't even know my name yet.
Array.indonesia: Phew, you saved me.\nAh, you don't even know my name yet.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_006
Array.english: <size=35>I am <color=#F1DC2B>Jango</color>, a wandering merchant.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I am <color=#F1DC2B>Jango</color>, a wandering merchant.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_007
Array.english: I collect and sell rare ingredients from all over the world.
Array.indonesia: I collect and sell rare ingredients from all over the world.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_008
Array.english: <size=35>Ingredients?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ingredients?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_009
Array.english: Chef, thanks for the fine meal. If you don't mind, I'll drop by once in a while to sell my products at a good price.
Array.indonesia: Chef, thanks for the fine meal. If you don't mind, I'll drop by once in a while to sell my products at a good price.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_010
Array.english: Most of them, you'll be able to acquire on your own…
Array.indonesia: Most of them, you'll be able to acquire on your own…

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_011
Array.english: <size=35>But I bet you don't have a <color=#1DFEAF>truffle</color>! Haha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>But I bet you don't have a <color=#1DFEAF>truffle</color>! Haha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_012
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm! A <color=#1DFEAF>truffle</color>…!\nA rare mushroom that's hard to come by…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm! A <color=#1DFEAF>truffle</color>…!\nA rare mushroom that's hard to come by…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_013
Array.english: This is a gift in exchange for your dish.\nAnd here's a recipe that requires a truffle.
Array.indonesia: This is a gift in exchange for your dish.\nAnd here's a recipe that requires a truffle.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_014
Array.english: It should be worth looking into. Thank you.
Array.indonesia: It should be worth looking into. Thank you.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_015
Array.english: Let's see… I'll be passing by this place on <color=#F39321>Tuesdays</color>, <color=#F39321>Thursdays</color>, and <color=#F39321>Saturdays</color>.
Array.indonesia: Let's see… I'll be passing by this place on <color=#F39321>Tuesdays</color>, <color=#F39321>Thursdays</color>, and <color=#F39321>Saturdays</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_016
Array.english: Since it's cold in the evening, I'll drop by in the <color=#F39321>afternoons</color>.\nI'll try to get good ingredients for you.
Array.indonesia: Since it's cold in the evening, I'll drop by in the <color=#F39321>afternoons</color>.\nI'll try to get good ingredients for you.

Array.name: dialog_Special_Jango_Mission_Complete01_017
Array.english: Now if you'll excuse me. See you on <color=#F39321>Tuesday</color>, <color=#F39321>Thursday</color>, and <color=#F39321>Saturday</color> afternoons. Haha.
Array.indonesia: Now if you'll excuse me. See you on <color=#F39321>Tuesday</color>, <color=#F39321>Thursday</color>, and <color=#F39321>Saturday</color> afternoons. Haha.

Array.name: dialog_MasterFire_Get
Array.english: You earned <color=#FF42AD>Artisan’s Flame</color>
Array.indonesia: You earned <color=#FF42AD>Artisan’s Flame</color>

Array.name: dialog_SushiBar_OpenReady
Array.english: Wrap up your day and get things ready at Bancho Sushi.
Array.indonesia: Wrap up your day and get things ready at Bancho Sushi.

Array.name: dialog_SushiBar_OpenConfirm
Array.english: Open Bancho Sushi
Array.indonesia: Open Bancho Sushi

Array.name: dialog_Cutscene01_001
Array.english: Phew. Work’s finally done for the day.\nMy back and legs hurt.
Array.indonesia: Phew. Work’s finally done for the day.\nMy back and legs hurt.

Array.name: dialog_Cutscene01_002
Array.english: You were a bit clumsy, but... not bad for a first day.\nTry a little harder next time.
Array.indonesia: You were a bit clumsy, but... not bad for a first day.\nTry a little harder next time.

Array.name: dialog_Cutscene01_003
Array.english: I suppose coming from you, that’s a compliment. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: I suppose coming from you, that’s a compliment. Hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Cutscene01_004
Array.english: <size=35>A man should not feel gratification from simple compliments!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>A man should not feel gratification from simple compliments!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Cutscene01_005
Array.english: Yeah, yeah... Alright.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, yeah... Alright.

Array.name: dialog_Cutscene01_006
Array.english: <size=34>In any case, \na toast to the opening of <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>In any case, \na toast to the opening of <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_IngameCutscene_start_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oh! Dave!\nI think that’s the one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh! Dave!\nI think that’s the one!</size>

Array.name: dialog_IngameCutscene_start_002
Array.english: <size=35>Come back to the boat safely!\nI’ll be waiting.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Come back to the boat safely!\nI’ll be waiting.</size>

Array.name: dialog_IngameCutscene_end_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wh-what was that just now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wh-what was that just now?</size>

Array.name: dialog_IngameCutscene_end_002
Array.english: <size=36>I should get back to the boat right away.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I should get back to the boat right away.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Tutorial001_01
Array.english: <size=32>I’ve placed <color=#1DFEAF>White Rice</color> seed in the <color=#FF42AD>Storage Box</color> below.\nTry opening it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I’ve placed <color=#1DFEAF>White Rice</color> seed in the <color=#FF42AD>Storage Box</color> below.\nTry opening it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Tutorial001_02
Array.english: <size=32>I’ll put the items you purchase from me in the box from now on.\nDon’t forget to take them out and use them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I’ll put the items you purchase from me in the box from now on.\nDon’t forget to take them out and use them!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Cooking_Amount_Suffix
Array.english: selected.\nChoose the number you’d like to select.
Array.indonesia: selected.\nChoose the number you’d like to select.

Array.name: dialog_SushiBar_Warning_001
Array.english: There are no items on the menu.
Array.indonesia: There are no items on the menu.

Array.name: dialog_Mining_levelError
Array.english: The Mining Level of the equipment is lower than that of the mineral.
Array.indonesia: The Mining Level of the equipment is lower than that of the mineral.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_001
Array.english: It’s been a while, Bancho.
Array.indonesia: It’s been a while, Bancho.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>*Looks around*</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>*Looks around*</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_003
Array.english: <size=36>This is Bancho’s sushi place, huh?\nHmm...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>This is Bancho’s sushi place, huh?\nHmm...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_004
Array.english: <size=40>M-miss <color=#F1DC2B>Yoshie</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>M-miss <color=#F1DC2B>Yoshie</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_005
Array.english: I came by because I heard this place is getting popular on <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>. The name gave me pause, but to think it’s really your place!
Array.indonesia: I came by because I heard this place is getting popular on <color=#ff61e3>Cooksta</color>. The name gave me pause, but to think it’s really your place!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_006
Array.english: “New food using never-before-seen ingredients”.... \n“Can’t taste this anywhere else" “A taciturn but masculine chef"…
Array.indonesia: “New food using never-before-seen ingredients”.... \n“Can’t taste this anywhere else" “A taciturn but masculine chef"…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_007
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! Do they mention me, too?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! Do they mention me, too?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_008
Array.english: <size=38>No... not really.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>No... not really.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_009
Array.english: <size=36>Tsk...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tsk...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_010
Array.english: In any case... What brings you all the way here, \nMiss <color=#F1DC2B>Yoshie</color>?
Array.indonesia: In any case... What brings you all the way here, \nMiss <color=#F1DC2B>Yoshie</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_011
Array.english: Oh, various reasons. I wanted to check out the restaurant. \nLooks like you're…still the same.
Array.indonesia: Oh, various reasons. I wanted to check out the restaurant. \nLooks like you're…still the same.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_012
Array.english: Well, there is nothing to change.\nI simply continue on day by day, training myself.
Array.indonesia: Well, there is nothing to change.\nI simply continue on day by day, training myself.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_013
Array.english: My goodness, that is the problem!\nYou refused to listen to me last time in a similar fashion, and that’s what got you booted from the hotel!
Array.indonesia: My goodness, that is the problem!\nYou refused to listen to me last time in a similar fashion, and that’s what got you booted from the hotel!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_014
Array.english: <size=32>You’re talking about that again...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>You’re talking about that again...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_014_2
Array.english: <size=33>That’s the customer’s fault for judging \nthe food without even trying it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>That’s the customer’s fault for judging \nthe food without even trying it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_015
Array.english: <size=32>How long will you continue treating customers that way?</size>\r<size=32>To keep making that terrible food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>How long will you continue treating customers that way?</size>\r<size=32>To keep making that terrible food!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_016
Array.english: <size=32>What do you mean, terrible! \n<color=#1DFEAF>Whole-Roasted Shark Head</color> is an excellent dish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>What do you mean, terrible! \n<color=#1DFEAF>Whole-Roasted Shark Head</color> is an excellent dish!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_017
Array.english: Shark has been used in cuisine in both the west and the east,\nand in Korea it was even used in ancestral rituals...
Array.indonesia: Shark has been used in cuisine in both the west and the east,\nand in Korea it was even used in ancestral rituals...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_018
Array.english: <size=32>Stop! You’ve not changed one bit. Let me judge for myself then, whether it’s food fit for consumption.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Stop! You’ve not changed one bit. Let me judge for myself then, whether it’s food fit for consumption.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_018_2
Array.english: <size=34>Then I can tell you why I came.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Then I can tell you why I came.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_019
Array.english: <size=40>Fine then, I'll show you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Fine then, I'll show you!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_020
Array.english: <size=36>I’ll make sure you know the true taste of \nshark head meat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I’ll make sure you know the true taste of \nshark head meat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_021
Array.english: <size=32>Bancho, isn’t this development a bit sudden?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bancho, isn’t this development a bit sudden?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_022
Array.english: <size=34>Dave! As a chef, this is a fight I can’t back out of!\nMy pride hangs in the balance!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave! As a chef, this is a fight I can’t back out of!\nMy pride hangs in the balance!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_023
Array.english: <size=35>Please get me a <color=#1DFEAF>Whitetip Reef Shark Head</color> and\n<color=#1DFEAF>Olive Oil</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Please get me a <color=#1DFEAF>Whitetip Reef Shark Head</color> and\n<color=#1DFEAF>Olive Oil</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_024
Array.english: <size=36>You want me to catch a <color=#1DFEAF>Whitetip Reef Shark</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>You want me to catch a <color=#1DFEAF>Whitetip Reef Shark</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_025
Array.english: <size=32>Yes. With your skills,\nit should be easy enough to do.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Yes. With your skills,\nit should be easy enough to do.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_026
Array.english: <size=31>But a Harpoon’s not likely to be enough...\nTake a good <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color> with you into battle.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>But a Harpoon’s not likely to be enough...\nTake a good <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color> with you into battle.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_027
Array.english: <size=32>Even so, fighting a shark sounds\nway too dangerous...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Even so, fighting a shark sounds\nway too dangerous...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_028
Array.english: <size=34>Do you mean to say you’ll just stand by and watch \nwhile my pride is trampled?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Do you mean to say you’ll just stand by and watch \nwhile my pride is trampled?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_029
Array.english: <size=32>The Whitetip Reef Shark is usually found <color=#F1DC2B>in the ocean far \nto the right</color>. Good luck.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The Whitetip Reef Shark is usually found <color=#F1DC2B>in the ocean far \nto the right</color>. Good luck.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_030
Array.english: He suddenly wants me to get him a shark head? \nThis is preposterous. \nAnd it can only be killed with a gun…?
Array.indonesia: He suddenly wants me to get him a shark head? \nThis is preposterous. \nAnd it can only be killed with a gun…?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_031
Array.english: I’ll have to ask Duff to make me a <color=#F1DC2B>gun</color>...\nOr search for one in the Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: I’ll have to ask Duff to make me a <color=#F1DC2B>gun</color>...\nOr search for one in the Blue Hole.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Ugh... disgusting as usual...\nThe look of it just ruins my appetite.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ugh... disgusting as usual...\nThe look of it just ruins my appetite.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_01_02
Array.english: <size=34>Even so, a promise is a promise…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Even so, a promise is a promise…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_01
Array.english: <size=38>Huh? What? This flavor...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Huh? What? This flavor...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_02
Array.english: <size=36>How do you like it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>How do you like it?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_03
Array.english: <size=34>It’s good... It’s tasty! I can taste the Whitetip Reef Shark fat inside the crispy whole roast!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It’s good... It’s tasty! I can taste the Whitetip Reef Shark fat inside the crispy whole roast!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_04
Array.english: <size=35>But it’s not an overly cloying flavor!\nIs... is this ginger?</size>\r<size=35>The ginger scent\nmixes with the strong flavor of the head...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>But it’s not an overly cloying flavor!\nIs... is this ginger?</size>\r<size=35>The ginger scent\nmixes with the strong flavor of the head...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_05
Array.english: <size=50><color=#ff61e3>It’s! Quite Lovely!</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50><color=#ff61e3>It’s! Quite Lovely!</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_06
Array.english: <size=34>A-ahem. Pardon me.\nI wasn’t expecting it to be this good.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>A-ahem. Pardon me.\nI wasn’t expecting it to be this good.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_07
Array.english: The Book of Five Rings states that one should look at the essence of something instead of its appearance.
Array.indonesia: The Book of Five Rings states that one should look at the essence of something instead of its appearance.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_08
Array.english: Sharks look terrible on the outside,\nbut they have robust meat and their head has a delicious taste.
Array.indonesia: Sharks look terrible on the outside,\nbut they have robust meat and their head has a delicious taste.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_09
Array.english: <size=32>This <color=#1DFEAF>Whole-Roasted Shark Head</color>\nbrings such traits to their maximum potential.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>This <color=#1DFEAF>Whole-Roasted Shark Head</color>\nbrings such traits to their maximum potential.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_10
Array.english: I must admit it.\nThis is good. You pass, Bancho.\rLet me tell you why I’m here, then.\nThis restaurant needs to hire people. I can help you with that.
Array.indonesia: I must admit it.\nThis is good. You pass, Bancho.\rLet me tell you why I’m here, then.\nThis restaurant needs to hire people. I can help you with that.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_11
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? What do you mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huh? What do you mean?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_12
Array.english: Do you still mean to go it alone, Bancho?\nThis place is already operating at full capacity.\rThings might be okay for now,\nbut you won’t be able to cope when even more customers come.
Array.indonesia: Do you still mean to go it alone, Bancho?\nThis place is already operating at full capacity.\rThings might be okay for now,\nbut you won’t be able to cope when even more customers come.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_13
Array.english: I can’t continue working alone, but...\nIt’s not easy to find people I can trust.
Array.indonesia: I can’t continue working alone, but...\nIt’s not easy to find people I can trust.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_14
Array.english: I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Yoshie the Recruiter</color>.\nThis is what I do these days.
Array.indonesia: I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Yoshie the Recruiter</color>.\nThis is what I do these days.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mission03_Complete_02_15
Array.english: <size=32>Let’s start by putting out a <color=#1DFEAF>Hiring Ad</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Let’s start by putting out a <color=#1DFEAF>Hiring Ad</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_001
Array.english: Hmm. Are you the man who’s been diving around here?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Are you the man who’s been diving around here?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_002
Array.english: Yeah... I think so.
Array.indonesia: Yeah... I think so.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_003
Array.english: Tsk. I was expecting a more professional looking guy…
Array.indonesia: Tsk. I was expecting a more professional looking guy…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_004
Array.english: I can hear you, you know...
Array.indonesia: I can hear you, you know...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_005
Array.english: In any case. Can you do something for me?
Array.indonesia: In any case. Can you do something for me?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_006
Array.english: Shouldn’t you tell me who you are first?
Array.indonesia: Shouldn’t you tell me who you are first?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_007
Array.english: I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Ellie</color>. I study Biology at the local graduate school.
Array.indonesia: I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Ellie</color>. I study Biology at the local graduate school.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_008
Array.english: I’ve come out to investigate after reports of anomalies \nin the area.
Array.indonesia: I’ve come out to investigate after reports of anomalies \nin the area.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_009
Array.english: <size=42>Satisfied?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Satisfied?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_010
Array.english: Okay...\nSo what do you want?
Array.indonesia: Okay...\nSo what do you want?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_011
Array.english: I’d like to study the ecology of this Blue Hole...\nGet me some <color=#1DFEAF>Agar</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Red Starfish</color> first.
Array.indonesia: I’d like to study the ecology of this Blue Hole...\nGet me some <color=#1DFEAF>Agar</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Red Starfish</color> first.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_012
Array.english: I don’t think it’s a good idea to ask for just 1 of each...\nGet me <color=#F1DC2B>2</color> of each.
Array.indonesia: I don’t think it’s a good idea to ask for just 1 of each...\nGet me <color=#F1DC2B>2</color> of each.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_013
Array.english: Your tone...\nMakes me want to refuse.
Array.indonesia: Your tone...\nMakes me want to refuse.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_014
Array.english: Hmm. I’ve got a <color=#F1DC2B>reward</color>, but...\nIf you don’t want it, that’s fine by me.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I’ve got a <color=#F1DC2B>reward</color>, but...\nIf you don’t want it, that’s fine by me.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_015
Array.english: <size=35>A re-reward...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>A re-reward...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_016
Array.english: Well, I wasn’t refusing.\nI’m just saying, you could ask more nicely.
Array.indonesia: Well, I wasn’t refusing.\nI’m just saying, you could ask more nicely.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_017
Array.english: <size=34>In any case... Please hurry.\nDon’t dally!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>In any case... Please hurry.\nDon’t dally!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_Complete_001
Array.english: Hmm. You actually brought them back?\nI guess I expected too little of you.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. You actually brought them back?\nI guess I expected too little of you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_Complete_002
Array.english: Alright. This should do for now.
Array.indonesia: Alright. This should do for now.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_Complete_003
Array.english: I’ll give you a <color=#F1DC2B>reward</color> as promised, \nsince you helped me do my research.
Array.indonesia: I’ll give you a <color=#F1DC2B>reward</color> as promised, \nsince you helped me do my research.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_Complete_004
Array.english: The sudden ecological changes in this region will need to be\nstudied further, so I’ll continue to need your services.
Array.indonesia: The sudden ecological changes in this region will need to be\nstudied further, so I’ll continue to need your services.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_01_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=38>Add my number!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Add my number!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_001
Array.english: <size=32>Hey... You haven’t quit diving yet, have you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hey... You haven’t quit diving yet, have you?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_002
Array.english: Um...\nWhat is it this time?
Array.indonesia: Um...\nWhat is it this time?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_003
Array.english: Um... I’m doing some investigating for an important paper.\nI’m going to need some help.
Array.indonesia: Um... I’m doing some investigating for an important paper.\nI’m going to need some help.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_004
Array.english: Get me three <color=#1DFEAF>Blue Shells</color> and three <color=#1DFEAF>Brown Shells</color>.
Array.indonesia: Get me three <color=#1DFEAF>Blue Shells</color> and three <color=#1DFEAF>Brown Shells</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_005
Array.english: Okay, but...\nAren’t you supposed to do this sort of thing yourself?
Array.indonesia: Okay, but...\nAren’t you supposed to do this sort of thing yourself?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_006
Array.english: Are you kidding me?\nWriting a paper requires a ton of research and investigation!
Array.indonesia: Are you kidding me?\nWriting a paper requires a ton of research and investigation!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_007
Array.english: What you’re doing is only a very tiny part of it all.
Array.indonesia: What you’re doing is only a very tiny part of it all.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_008
Array.english: So don’t let it get to your head. Hurry along.\nI don’t have much time until the deadline.
Array.indonesia: So don’t let it get to your head. Hurry along.\nI don’t have much time until the deadline.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_009
Array.english: <size=34>You really are impossible...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You really are impossible...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_010
Array.english: But since you say it’s for a paper...\nWas it <color=#1DFEAF>Blue Shells</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Brown Shells</color>?
Array.indonesia: But since you say it’s for a paper...\nWas it <color=#1DFEAF>Blue Shells</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Brown Shells</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm... already?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm... already?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_002
Array.english: Phew. That was harder than I expected. \nThese are hard to find.
Array.indonesia: Phew. That was harder than I expected. \nThese are hard to find.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_003
Array.english: Well, this isn’t bad.\nNow then... If I just complete the delivery to <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color>...
Array.indonesia: Well, this isn’t bad.\nNow then... If I just complete the delivery to <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_004
Array.english: <size=36>Tada! Haha! Research level gained!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Tada! Haha! Research level gained!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Huh? <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_006
Array.english: Oh... You don’t know? <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color> is a mission-based app made to protect the environment.
Array.indonesia: Oh... You don’t know? <color=#72ff0a>Ecowatcher</color> is a mission-based app made to protect the environment.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_007
Array.english: You get points for completing missions on the app\nand get rewards for reaching certain levels!
Array.indonesia: You get points for completing missions on the app\nand get rewards for reaching certain levels!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_008
Array.english: So this was for points on the app,\nnot for a paper?
Array.indonesia: So this was for points on the app,\nnot for a paper?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_009
Array.english: Oh... Uh, well... \nYou could say they’re basically the same thing...
Array.indonesia: Oh... Uh, well... \nYou could say they’re basically the same thing...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Ellie_02_Complete_010
Array.english: You try it out too, if you’re interested!\nSee you!
Array.indonesia: You try it out too, if you’re interested!\nSee you!

Array.name: dialog_SushiBarWarning_Bancho_001
Array.english: Dave! A customer is still eating!
Array.indonesia: Dave! A customer is still eating!

Array.name: dialog_SushiBarWarning_Bancho_VIP_001
Array.english: Why would you throw away such carefully prepared dishes?\nWhat are you thinking?
Array.indonesia: Why would you throw away such carefully prepared dishes?\nWhat are you thinking?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? A dolphin?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huh? A dolphin?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin01_Start_002
Array.english: Hmm... It seems to be asking me to follow.\nShould I try and follow?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... It seems to be asking me to follow.\nShould I try and follow?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin01_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! A pink dolphin is caught in the net!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! A pink dolphin is caught in the net!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin01_1_Complete_002
Array.english: So it was asking me to rescue its friend.
Array.indonesia: So it was asking me to rescue its friend.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin01_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=37>I should cut that <color=#F1DC2B>Net</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>I should cut that <color=#F1DC2B>Net</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin01_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Huh?\nIt seems to have left a <color=#F1DC2B>Gift</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh?\nIt seems to have left a <color=#F1DC2B>Gift</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin01_Complete_002
Array.english: I didn’t know even dolphins had mates….
Array.indonesia: I didn’t know even dolphins had mates….

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin01_Retry_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oh! It seems to be that dolphin from before!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh! It seems to be that dolphin from before!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin01_Retry_002
Array.english: I should follow it properly this time.
Array.indonesia: I should follow it properly this time.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? You must be the dolphin from before.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh? You must be the dolphin from before.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_Start_002
Array.english: Why does it look like it’s in a hurry?\nI wonder if something’s going on?
Array.indonesia: Why does it look like it’s in a hurry?\nI wonder if something’s going on?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_Start_003
Array.english: Come to think of it, I don't see the <color=#F1DC2B>Pink Dolphin</color> this time...\nI should follow!
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, I don't see the <color=#F1DC2B>Pink Dolphin</color> this time...\nI should follow!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_1_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! The pink dolphin...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! The pink dolphin...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_1_Complete_002
Array.english: Pirates must have captured it illegally.
Array.indonesia: Pirates must have captured it illegally.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_1_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=36>I should quickly cut its <color=#F1DC2B>Net</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I should quickly cut its <color=#F1DC2B>Net</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh! They left another <color=#F1DC2B>Gift</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh! They left another <color=#F1DC2B>Gift</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_Complete_002
Array.english: I hope neither of them get caught again.
Array.indonesia: I hope neither of them get caught again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_Retry_001
Array.english: Um... I think the dolphin wanted something.
Array.indonesia: Um... I think the dolphin wanted something.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin02_Warning_001
Array.english: I have to rescue the dolphin first!
Array.indonesia: I have to rescue the dolphin first!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_Start_001
Array.english: Huh? I hear loud noises from over there.
Array.indonesia: Huh? I hear loud noises from over there.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_Start_002
Array.english: I should go check things out.
Array.indonesia: I should go check things out.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_StartInTimeline_001
Array.english: <size=38>Hey! Why do you keep bothering these dolphins?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hey! Why do you keep bothering these dolphins?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_StartInTimeline_002
Array.english: So you’re the one who keeps on interrupting our plans!\nI can tell just by your silhouette!
Array.indonesia: So you’re the one who keeps on interrupting our plans!\nI can tell just by your silhouette!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_StartInTimeline_003
Array.english: You need to be taught a lesson!\nYou better be ready!
Array.indonesia: You need to be taught a lesson!\nYou better be ready!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_StartAfterTimeline_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Oof, I was just looking to scare them...\nOh well, I’ll have to see if I can defeat them!</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Oof, I was just looking to scare them...\nOh well, I’ll have to see if I can defeat them!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_CompleteInTimeline_001
Array.english: <size=42>Ugh... We’re retreating for the day!\nYou’ll hear from us again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Ugh... We’re retreating for the day!\nYou’ll hear from us again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_Complete_001
Array.english: Huh? It left something like an old charm.
Array.indonesia: Huh? It left something like an old charm.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_Complete_002
Array.english: I should identify it later.
Array.indonesia: I should identify it later.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_Complete_003
Array.english: In any case, I’m glad the dolphins are alright.
Array.indonesia: In any case, I’m glad the dolphins are alright.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_Complete_004
Array.english: I hope they don’t get caught again.
Array.indonesia: I hope they don’t get caught again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_Retry_001
Array.english: This noise...\nThey aren’t bothering the dolphins again, are they?
Array.indonesia: This noise...\nThey aren’t bothering the dolphins again, are they?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Dolphin03_Warning_001
Array.english: Let’s teach the pirates a lesson first!
Array.indonesia: Let’s teach the pirates a lesson first!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? What’s with that strange coral?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huh? What’s with that strange coral?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Retry_001
Array.english: Um... I think I’ve seen that coral somewhere before...\nShould I check?
Array.indonesia: Um... I think I’ve seen that coral somewhere before...\nShould I check?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Complete01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Blargh! That octopus!\nIt sprayed me with ink!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Blargh! That octopus!\nIt sprayed me with ink!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Complete01_002
Array.english: <size=36>Just wait till I catch you!\nHere I come!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Just wait till I catch you!\nHere I come!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Hide_001
Array.english: *Huff* I finally caught up.\nYou stay right...
Array.indonesia: *Huff* I finally caught up.\nYou stay right...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Hide_AfterTimeline_001
Array.english: Oh no! It escaped through a door crack!\nUm... I don’t think I can fit in there....
Array.indonesia: Oh no! It escaped through a door crack!\nUm... I don’t think I can fit in there....

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Hide_AfterTimeline_002
Array.english: Come to think of it... I can probably use the <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color>\nfrom Duff to cut my way in!
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it... I can probably use the <color=#1DFEAF>Gas Cutter</color>\nfrom Duff to cut my way in!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Hide_AfterTimeline_003
Array.english: <size=36>Just you wait, you octopus!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Just you wait, you octopus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Complete02_001
Array.english: <size=36>You! You’ve got nowhere to run now!\nGive up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>You! You’ve got nowhere to run now!\nGive up!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Complete02_002
Array.english: <size=31>I guess I’ll have octopus sashimi for dinner—</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=31>I guess I’ll have octopus sashimi for dinner—</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Complete02_AfterTimeline01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ugh... It escaped again!\nIt’s so quick.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ugh... It escaped again!\nIt’s so quick.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Complete02_AfterTimeline02_001
Array.english: Huh? It dropped something.
Array.indonesia: Huh? It dropped something.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus01_Complete_001
Array.english: It seems to be an <color=#F1DC2B>Artifact</color>...\nI’ll have to identify it back at the surface.
Array.indonesia: It seems to be an <color=#F1DC2B>Artifact</color>...\nI’ll have to identify it back at the surface.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? Is that pile of rocks moving around...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huh? Is that pile of rocks moving around...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Retry_001
Array.english: Um... The swaying pile of rocks...\nI think I’ve seen it before.
Array.indonesia: Um... The swaying pile of rocks...\nI think I’ve seen it before.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_AfterAttack_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ergh! It’s the octopus from last time!\nIt’s spraying ink again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ergh! It’s the octopus from last time!\nIt’s spraying ink again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_AfterAttack_002
Array.english: <size=36>I won’t let you get away this time!\nJust wait!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I won’t let you get away this time!\nJust wait!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Hide_001
Array.english: <size=33>It went in between the wooden boards...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It went in between the wooden boards...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Hide_002
Array.english: Hm... It looks a bit too small for me to go in.
Array.indonesia: Hm... It looks a bit too small for me to go in.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Hide_003
Array.english: I think the wooden board will break if I throw a<color=#1DFEAF>heavy object</color> on it...
Array.indonesia: I think the wooden board will break if I throw a<color=#1DFEAF>heavy object</color> on it...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Hide_004
Array.english: <size=34>Let’s take a look around!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let’s take a look around!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Hide_AfterStone_001
Array.english: <size=32>Great! The path is clear.\nJust wait, you octopus!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Great! The path is clear.\nJust wait, you octopus!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Complete01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hey! How dare you spray ink twice?\nI won’t let you get away with this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hey! How dare you spray ink twice?\nI won’t let you get away with this!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Complete01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Ask Bancho for takoyaki...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ask Bancho for takoyaki...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Complete01_AfterTimeline01_001
Array.english: Ah, it ran away again...\nIt’s definitely quick.
Array.indonesia: Ah, it ran away again...\nIt’s definitely quick.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Complete02_001
Array.english: Hm? It dropped something again.
Array.indonesia: Hm? It dropped something again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Red_Octopus02_Complete02_002
Array.english: Hm... It always leaves something behind.\nIt might not be as bad as I thought...
Array.indonesia: Hm... It always leaves something behind.\nIt might not be as bad as I thought...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale01_Appear_001
Array.english: <size=42>Wow! It’s a humpback whale!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Wow! It’s a humpback whale!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale01_Appear_002
Array.english: It’s so big that it makes the Blue Hole look smaller.
Array.indonesia: It’s so big that it makes the Blue Hole look smaller.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale02_Appear_001
Array.english: Huh? I think it has something to say…
Array.indonesia: Huh? I think it has something to say…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale02_Appear_002
Array.english: I should record its cries and ask <color=#F1DC2B>Ellie</color> about it.
Array.indonesia: I should record its cries and ask <color=#F1DC2B>Ellie</color> about it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_001
Array.english: Huh? What's going on?
Array.indonesia: Huh? What's going on?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_002
Array.english: A humpback whale appeared in the Blue Hole\nI think it might have something to say.
Array.indonesia: A humpback whale appeared in the Blue Hole\nI think it might have something to say.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_003
Array.english: I recorded its cries. Have a listen.
Array.indonesia: I recorded its cries. Have a listen.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_004
Array.english: Hm…
Array.indonesia: Hm…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_005
Array.english: <size=37>It sounds like it's looking for its <color=#1DFEAF>offspring</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>It sounds like it's looking for its <color=#1DFEAF>offspring</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_006
Array.english: <size=40>…Offspring?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>…Offspring?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_007
Array.english: Yeah… They must be lost somewhere nearby.
Array.indonesia: Yeah… They must be lost somewhere nearby.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_008
Array.english: <size=36>How about helping me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>How about helping me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_009
Array.english: As you're going about if you hear a <color=#1DFEAF>young one's cries</color>\ncan you let me know?
Array.indonesia: As you're going about if you hear a <color=#1DFEAF>young one's cries</color>\ncan you let me know?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale03_CallEllie_010
Array.english: Hm…Well, I can't just ignore that.\nOkay. I'll take a look!
Array.indonesia: Hm…Well, I can't just ignore that.\nOkay. I'll take a look!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_EllieNotice_001
Array.english: <size=36>Maybe it's this sound...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Maybe it's this sound...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_EllieNotice_002
Array.english: <size=40>Yes! That's the sound of a baby humpback whale!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Yes! That's the sound of a baby humpback whale!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_EllieNotice_003
Array.english: Please take a look around.\nThere must be a baby whale nearby.
Array.indonesia: Please take a look around.\nThere must be a baby whale nearby.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_DoorFound_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ah. The crying sound coming from behind that pile of rocks…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ah. The crying sound coming from behind that pile of rocks…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_DoorFound_002
Array.english: Hm…Those <color=#F1DC2B>stones</color> will need to be removed to enter.
Array.indonesia: Hm…Those <color=#F1DC2B>stones</color> will need to be removed to enter.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_EnterDoor
Array.english: Okay…They've all been removed. Let's head inside.
Array.indonesia: Okay…They've all been removed. Let's head inside.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_FoundWhaleCub_01_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! There's a baby whale in here!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow! There's a baby whale in here!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_FoundWhaleCub_02_001
Array.english: Hm. It seems frightened.
Array.indonesia: Hm. It seems frightened.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_FoundWhaleCub_02_002
Array.english: <size=40>Should I go and comfort it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Should I go and comfort it?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_PettingWhale01_001
Array.english: I think it’s still a bit scared...\nShould I pet it a little?
Array.indonesia: I think it’s still a bit scared...\nShould I pet it a little?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_PettingWhale02_001
Array.english: I think it’s less scared now!\nLet’s keep on petting it.
Array.indonesia: I think it’s less scared now!\nLet’s keep on petting it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_WhaleCubFollow_001
Array.english: It seems to have let its guard down.
Array.indonesia: It seems to have let its guard down.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_WhaleCubFollow_002
Array.english: If we go to a brighter area\nthe mom should come right?
Array.indonesia: If we go to a brighter area\nthe mom should come right?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale04_WhaleCubFollow_003
Array.english: I need to be careful bringing it back up.
Array.indonesia: I need to be careful bringing it back up.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_WhaleArrived_001
Array.english: Phew, that was dangerous.
Array.indonesia: Phew, that was dangerous.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_WhaleArrived_002
Array.english: It looks a bit safer here.\nWait a bit here and mom should come.
Array.indonesia: It looks a bit safer here.\nWait a bit here and mom should come.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_FirstEnemyEncounter_001
Array.english: <size=37>Ah... There are vicious barracuda in the way!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Ah... There are vicious barracuda in the way!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_FirstEnemyEncounter_002
Array.english: I have to get rid of them\nfor the baby whale to follow..
Array.indonesia: I have to get rid of them\nfor the baby whale to follow..

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_FirstEnemyEncounter_complete_001
Array.english: Phew. Everything looks safe now.
Array.indonesia: Phew. Everything looks safe now.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_FirstEnemyEncounter_complete_002
Array.english: Let’s try taking the baby whale again.
Array.indonesia: Let’s try taking the baby whale again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_SecondEnemyEncounter_001
Array.english: <size=38>Ugh...\nThis place is full of lionfish...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ugh...\nThis place is full of lionfish...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_SecondEnemyEncounter_002
Array.english: Since the baby whale is timid,\nI’ll have to get rid of them first.
Array.indonesia: Since the baby whale is timid,\nI’ll have to get rid of them first.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_SecondEnemyEncounter_complete_001
Array.english: Phew... Hopefully this is enough.
Array.indonesia: Phew... Hopefully this is enough.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_SecondEnemyEncounter_complete_002
Array.english: Let’s try taking it to the surface of the sea again.
Array.indonesia: Let’s try taking it to the surface of the sea again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_ThirdEnemyEncounter_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oh! There’s a white reef shark up there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh! There’s a white reef shark up there!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_ThirdEnemyEncounter_002
Array.english: Unless I defeat the shark, the baby whale is not going to follow me...
Array.indonesia: Unless I defeat the shark, the baby whale is not going to follow me...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_ThirdEnemyEncounter_complete_001
Array.english: Phew...\nThere are a lot of vicious fish today.
Array.indonesia: Phew...\nThere are a lot of vicious fish today.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_ThirdEnemyEncounter_complete_002
Array.english: We’re almost at the surface of the sea!\nLet’s go up a bit more.
Array.indonesia: We’re almost at the surface of the sea!\nLet’s go up a bit more.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_WrongWay_001
Array.english: It’ll be easier to find the mother whale at the surface.\nLet’s go up.
Array.indonesia: It’ll be easier to find the mother whale at the surface.\nLet’s go up.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_TooFar_001
Array.english: Since the baby whale is timid, I need to make sure it stays close by.
Array.indonesia: Since the baby whale is timid, I need to make sure it stays close by.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Whale06_SharkAttack_001
Array.english: <size=38>Ah! Sharks!\nWhat do I do?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ah! Sharks!\nWhat do I do?</size>

Array.name: Side_Whale06_WhaleLeave_001
Array.english: Wow…It's huge!
Array.indonesia: Wow…It's huge!

Array.name: Side_Whale06_WhaleLeave_002
Array.english: It's a mother's love for her offspring.\nI guess all animals are the same...
Array.indonesia: It's a mother's love for her offspring.\nI guess all animals are the same...

Array.name: Side_Whale06_WhaleLeave_003
Array.english: I feel like I should text my mom later.
Array.indonesia: I feel like I should text my mom later.

Array.name: Side_Whale06_BoatTalk_001
Array.english: Hmm, I see.\nI’m glad you took it to its mother.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, I see.\nI’m glad you took it to its mother.

Array.name: Side_Whale06_BoatTalk_002
Array.english: It wasn’t easy getting it out.\nIt got so easily frightened.
Array.indonesia: It wasn’t easy getting it out.\nIt got so easily frightened.

Array.name: Side_Whale06_BoatTalk_003
Array.english: <size=36>Maybe it didn’t like you, that’s all.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Maybe it didn’t like you, that’s all.</size>

Array.name: Side_Whale06_BoatTalk_004
Array.english: <size=46>…….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>…….</size>

Array.name: Side_Whale06_BoatTalk_005
Array.english: Anyways! Don’t spend all your time hunting.\nTry to be more helpful!
Array.indonesia: Anyways! Don’t spend all your time hunting.\nTry to be more helpful!

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_FoodPickUp_001
Array.english: <size=36>Cat food?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Cat food?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_FoodPickUp_002
Array.english: Should I give it to <color=#F1DC2B>Momo</color>?
Array.indonesia: Should I give it to <color=#F1DC2B>Momo</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Friendship_complete_001
Array.english: Momo looks pleased.\nHe’s usually fickle, but he seems to like you.
Array.indonesia: Momo looks pleased.\nHe’s usually fickle, but he seems to like you.

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Friendship_complete_002
Array.english: <size=38>But...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>But...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Friendship_complete_003
Array.english: What? Something wrong?
Array.indonesia: What? Something wrong?

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Friendship_complete_004
Array.english: <size=34>He disappears every night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>He disappears every night.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Friendship_complete_005
Array.english: I see. Maybe he made a new friend?
Array.indonesia: I see. Maybe he made a new friend?

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Friendship_complete_006
Array.english: I don’t know. Let me know if you see Momo at night.
Array.indonesia: I don’t know. Let me know if you see Momo at night.

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Night_Find_001
Array.english: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>(This sound is…)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>(This sound is…)</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>(Yep, it’s Momo’s meow!)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>(Yep, it’s Momo’s meow!)</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Start_002
Array.english: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>(I should follow him...)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>(I should follow him...)</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Finish01_001
Array.english: <size=38><color=#C3C3C3>(Oh! They are…Momo’s kitten?)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#C3C3C3>(Oh! They are…Momo’s kitten?)</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Finish01_002
Array.english: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>(Momo got a baby!)</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#C3C3C3>(Momo got a baby!)</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Finish02_001
Array.english: <size=37>Oh, it’s nothing. I was just...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh, it’s nothing. I was just...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=37>Mm? Three cats?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Mm? Three cats?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=37>Momo got new family members!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Momo got new family members!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, lovely.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, lovely.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Complete_004
Array.english: Let them stay here. There is lots of food around.
Array.indonesia: Let them stay here. There is lots of food around.

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>Dave, help me take care of the cats.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave, help me take care of the cats.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_side_Momo_Complete_006
Array.english: Sure!\nBANCHO SUSHI will have more mews!
Array.indonesia: Sure!\nBANCHO SUSHI will have more mews!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_001
Array.english: <size=37>Well, well. Are you the human we’ve been hearing rumors about?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Well, well. Are you the human we’ve been hearing rumors about?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_002
Array.english: Haha! Ho!\nYou don’t look as scary as I expected.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Ho!\nYou don’t look as scary as I expected.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_003
Array.english: My name is <color=#F1DC2B>Mima</color>.\nI run a restaurant in the village.
Array.indonesia: My name is <color=#F1DC2B>Mima</color>.\nI run a restaurant in the village.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_004
Array.english: I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.\nI’ll be... helping out at the village for a while.
Array.indonesia: I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Dave</color>.\nI’ll be... helping out at the village for a while.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_005
Array.english: Haha! Ho! Receiving help from a human...\nI never considered it a possibility before!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Ho! Receiving help from a human...\nI never considered it a possibility before!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_006
Array.english: Let’s see... It’s not like I can ask you to cook...\nHmm...
Array.indonesia: Let’s see... It’s not like I can ask you to cook...\nHmm...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_007
Array.english: My goodness, I forgot!\n<color=#F1DC2B>Awang and Nawang</color> ordered lunch boxes!
Array.indonesia: My goodness, I forgot!\n<color=#F1DC2B>Awang and Nawang</color> ordered lunch boxes!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_008
Array.english: Oh... The gatekeepers that were whispering earlier...
Array.indonesia: Oh... The gatekeepers that were whispering earlier...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_009
Array.english: Yes! Would you perhaps...\nTake the <color=#1DFEAF>Lunch Boxes</color> I left in front of the door?
Array.indonesia: Yes! Would you perhaps...\nTake the <color=#1DFEAF>Lunch Boxes</color> I left in front of the door?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Start_010
Array.english: They should still be on duty at the gate.\nPlease help me out, human!
Array.indonesia: They should still be on duty at the gate.\nPlease help me out, human!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_NawangAwang_001
Array.english: <size=38>Um. Human.\nWhat is it?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Um. Human.\nWhat is it?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_NawangAwang_002
Array.english: Uh... I was asked to bring you these Lunch Boxes.
Array.indonesia: Uh... I was asked to bring you these Lunch Boxes.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_NawangAwang_003
Array.english: Hmm... These are from Mima.\nYou didn’t add poison on the way here or anything, did you?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... These are from Mima.\nYou didn’t add poison on the way here or anything, did you?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_NawangAwang_004
Array.english: What? Why would I—
Array.indonesia: What? Why would I—

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_NawangAwang_005
Array.english: <size=35>Well... alright. Give it here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Well... alright. Give it here.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_NawangAwang_006
Array.english: Good work, I suppose.
Array.indonesia: Good work, I suppose.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Complete_001
Array.english: Oh! You delivered them, didn’t you?
Array.indonesia: Oh! You delivered them, didn’t you?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Complete_002
Array.english: Haha! Humans are not half bad!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Humans are not half bad!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima01_PicnicBox_Complete_003
Array.english: I’ll tell you if I need something done again!
Array.indonesia: I’ll tell you if I need something done again!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Start_001
Array.english: Oh no...
Array.indonesia: Oh no...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Start_002
Array.english: What is it, <color=#F1DC2B>Mima</color>?
Array.indonesia: What is it, <color=#F1DC2B>Mima</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Start_003
Array.english: I need to serve customers...\nbut I’m missing an ingredient.
Array.indonesia: I need to serve customers...\nbut I’m missing an ingredient.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Start_004
Array.english: Say...\nCould you venture into the <color=#F1DC2B>depths</color> for me?
Array.indonesia: Say...\nCould you venture into the <color=#F1DC2B>depths</color> for me?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Start_005
Array.english: Alright.\nWhat do you need?
Array.indonesia: Alright.\nWhat do you need?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Start_006
Array.english: Oh my, you’re helping? Hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Oh my, you’re helping? Hahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Start_007
Array.english: Well... I need <color=#1DFEAF>Tube Coral</color>, which looks like this...
Array.indonesia: Well... I need <color=#1DFEAF>Tube Coral</color>, which looks like this...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Start_008
Array.english: You’ll probably find it near the <color=#1DFEAF>Whale Bones</color>.\nDo help me out!
Array.indonesia: You’ll probably find it near the <color=#1DFEAF>Whale Bones</color>.\nDo help me out!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Start_009
Array.english: Whale Bones... I think I’ve seen them before.
Array.indonesia: Whale Bones... I think I’ve seen them before.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=40>Oh my! Yes, this is it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Oh my! Yes, this is it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Complete_002
Array.english: Thank you so much, haha!\nI can finally provide proper food to my customers.
Array.indonesia: Thank you so much, haha!\nI can finally provide proper food to my customers.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima02_DeepseaCoral_Complete_003
Array.english: I’d like to hear about you humans, too,\nso drop by to chat every now and then! Haha!
Array.indonesia: I’d like to hear about you humans, too,\nso drop by to chat every now and then! Haha!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Start_001
Array.english: Say... You’re Dave, right?
Array.indonesia: Say... You’re Dave, right?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Start_002
Array.english: Yes, <color=#F1DC2B>Mima</color>.
Array.indonesia: Yes, <color=#F1DC2B>Mima</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Start_003
Array.english: May I... make a slightly difficult request?
Array.indonesia: May I... make a slightly difficult request?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Start_004
Array.english: What is it?
Array.indonesia: What is it?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Start_005
Array.english: Uh... I’ve been curious about what humans eat...
Array.indonesia: Uh... I’ve been curious about what humans eat...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Start_006
Array.english: Well, I wouldn’t call it just curiosity...\nI’m a cook, so... it’s research! Yes, research!
Array.indonesia: Well, I wouldn’t call it just curiosity...\nI’m a cook, so... it’s research! Yes, research!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Start_007
Array.english: Hmm. I do have a chef I know... I’ll ask him.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I do have a chef I know... I’ll ask him.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Start_008
Array.english: Oh? You don’t have to do it if you don’t want to!\nPlease talk to this chef if you get the opportunity, hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Oh? You don’t have to do it if you don’t want to!\nPlease talk to this chef if you get the opportunity, hahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_BanchoTalk_001
Array.english: Hmm? One of the Sea People wants to know about human food?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? One of the Sea People wants to know about human food?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_BanchoTalk_002
Array.english: Hmm... I suppose sushi that uses raw fish\nmight not be the best thing to show the Sea People.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I suppose sushi that uses raw fish\nmight not be the best thing to show the Sea People.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_BanchoTalk_003
Array.english: <size=36>How’s this instead?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>How’s this instead?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_BanchoTalk_004
Array.english: <size=36><color=#1DFEAF>Shrimp Salad</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#1DFEAF>Shrimp Salad</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_BanchoTalk_005
Array.english: The Sea People in the depths probably haven’t tried\nKuruma Prawn, which live along the coast,
Array.indonesia: The Sea People in the depths probably haven’t tried\nKuruma Prawn, which live along the coast,

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_BanchoTalk_006
Array.english: not to mention fresh lettuce and vegetables.
Array.indonesia: not to mention fresh lettuce and vegetables.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_BanchoTalk_007
Array.english: That sounds good!\nI’ll try taking them!
Array.indonesia: That sounds good!\nI’ll try taking them!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_BanchoTalk_008
Array.english: But will it be okay to take them underwater?\nI’ll have to move them carefully...
Array.indonesia: But will it be okay to take them underwater?\nI’ll have to move them carefully...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=36>My goodness!\nSo this is human food?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>My goodness!\nSo this is human food?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Complete_002
Array.english: These are really different from the shrimp we see around here...
Array.indonesia: These are really different from the shrimp we see around here...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Complete_003
Array.english: And what is this green stuff?
Array.indonesia: And what is this green stuff?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Complete_004
Array.english: That’s lettuce...
Array.indonesia: That’s lettuce...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=38>That texture is so novel!\nIt is so interesting!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>That texture is so novel!\nIt is so interesting!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima03_HumanFood_Complete_006
Array.english: Thank you, Dave!\nDrop by whenever you want and tell me of the human world! Hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Thank you, Dave!\nDrop by whenever you want and tell me of the human world! Hahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? There are no customers today.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh? There are no customers today.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_002
Array.english: The thing is... There was a seaweed collector named \n<color=#F1DC2B>Tsuchi</color>. The collector provided seaweed to our restaurant.
Array.indonesia: The thing is... There was a seaweed collector named \n<color=#F1DC2B>Tsuchi</color>. The collector provided seaweed to our restaurant.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_003
Array.english: However, Tsuchi hasn’t been coming by...\nSo, we’re out of ingredients and can’t accept any customers.
Array.indonesia: However, Tsuchi hasn’t been coming by...\nSo, we’re out of ingredients and can’t accept any customers.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_004
Array.english: Oh, no!\nIs there a way to contact Tsuchi?
Array.indonesia: Oh, no!\nIs there a way to contact Tsuchi?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_005
Array.english: I have the <color=#1DFEAF>key</color> to Tsuchi’s house...\nBut I can’t just leave the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: I have the <color=#1DFEAF>key</color> to Tsuchi’s house...\nBut I can’t just leave the restaurant.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_006
Array.english: How did you get the key?
Array.indonesia: How did you get the key?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_007
Array.english: Oh...Tsuchi has a very large pet <color=#F1DC2B>turtle</color>.\nI used to go feed it from time to time... Oh ho ho.
Array.indonesia: Oh...Tsuchi has a very large pet <color=#F1DC2B>turtle</color>.\nI used to go feed it from time to time... Oh ho ho.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_008
Array.english: Dave...\nCan you go for me instead?
Array.indonesia: Dave...\nCan you go for me instead?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_009
Array.english: Oh... It must be tough to not be able to open your restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Oh... It must be tough to not be able to open your restaurant.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_010
Array.english: I’ll try going there.\nCan you tell me where it is?
Array.indonesia: I’ll try going there.\nCan you tell me where it is?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_011
Array.english: The thing is... It’s kind of hard to explain because the terrain keeps on changing.
Array.indonesia: The thing is... It’s kind of hard to explain because the terrain keeps on changing.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_012
Array.english: That turtle eats so many <color=#1DFEAF>jellyfish</color>.
Array.indonesia: That turtle eats so many <color=#1DFEAF>jellyfish</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_013
Array.english: Maybe there are traces nearby.
Array.indonesia: Maybe there are traces nearby.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Start_014
Array.english: Hm. Strange.\nI’ll try looking for it.
Array.indonesia: Hm. Strange.\nI’ll try looking for it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Jellyfish_Clue_001
Array.english: <size=32>Huh...? \nA jellyfish fragment...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Huh...? \nA jellyfish fragment...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Jellyfish_Clue_002
Array.english: Maybe it’s left over from what the seaweed collector’s turtle ate.
Array.indonesia: Maybe it’s left over from what the seaweed collector’s turtle ate.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Jellyfish_Clue_003
Array.english: <size=35>Let’s follow it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let’s follow it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_NoKey_001
Array.english: Hm...? Is this a sea people building?\nThe door is locked.
Array.indonesia: Hm...? Is this a sea people building?\nThe door is locked.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Location_Found_001
Array.english: <size=32>Oh... This must be the seaweed collector’s house.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Oh... This must be the seaweed collector’s house.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Location_Found_002
Array.english: I hear something from inside.\nShould I open the door and go inside?
Array.indonesia: I hear something from inside.\nShould I open the door and go inside?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Turtle_Rage_001
Array.english: <size=36>Ah! Please help me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ah! Please help me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Turtle_Rage_002
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Dona</color> might’ve eaten something weird! \nShe’s going crazy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Dona</color> might’ve eaten something weird! \nShe’s going crazy!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Turtle_Rage_003
Array.english: <size=32>She’s been gobbling up the jelly fish...\nSomething’s wrong with her!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>She’s been gobbling up the jelly fish...\nSomething’s wrong with her!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Turtle_Rage_004
Array.english: <size=36>Ah...? Human?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ah...? Human?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Turtle_Rage_005
Array.english: <size=32>I guess now is not the time to judge.\nPlease help!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I guess now is not the time to judge.\nPlease help!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Turtle_Rage_006
Array.english: <size=33>Um... What do I do?\nI’ll have to catch her and try calming her down.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Um... What do I do?\nI’ll have to catch her and try calming her down.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Turtle_CalmDown_001
