Array.english: <size=33>Ahh! This must belong to humans!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ahh! This must belong to humans!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Turtle_CalmDown_002
Array.english: <size=32>It’s a plastic bag...\nWho would throw something like this into the sea?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>It’s a plastic bag...\nWho would throw something like this into the sea?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_After_Turtle01_001
Array.english: Thank you, human.\nNow I’ll be able to gather seaweed with Dona again.
Array.indonesia: Thank you, human.\nNow I’ll be able to gather seaweed with Dona again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_After_Turtle01_002
Array.english: Phew, what a relief.\nAlmost choked by a plastic bag... That was a close call.
Array.indonesia: Phew, what a relief.\nAlmost choked by a plastic bag... That was a close call.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_After_Turtle01_003
Array.english: Anyways...
Array.indonesia: Anyways...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_After_Turtle01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Make sure to relay this message to the humans!\nTell them not to throw such things into the sea!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Make sure to relay this message to the humans!\nTell them not to throw such things into the sea!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_After_Turtle01_005
Array.english: Fishing to make a living is understandable.\nHowever, I don’t understand why they need to throw away such things!
Array.indonesia: Fishing to make a living is understandable.\nHowever, I don’t understand why they need to throw away such things!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_After_Turtle01_006
Array.english: <size=33>If they throw away such horrendous things again,\nI’ll give them a taste of my half-moon kick!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If they throw away such horrendous things again,\nI’ll give them a taste of my half-moon kick!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_After_Turtle02_001
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_After_Turtle02_002
Array.english: Well, looks like everything’s taken care of.\nI’ll have to visit Mima’s restaurant later.
Array.indonesia: Well, looks like everything’s taken care of.\nI’ll have to visit Mima’s restaurant later.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh ho ho! Thanks to you, Dave,\nI’m able to open the restaurant again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh ho ho! Thanks to you, Dave,\nI’m able to open the restaurant again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=33>It looks good!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It looks good!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Complete_003
Array.english: Um... I don’t want to call this repayment of debt...
Array.indonesia: Um... I don’t want to call this repayment of debt...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Complete_004
Array.english: But, I was thinking of making <color=#1DFEAF>food</color> that humans can eat.
Array.indonesia: But, I was thinking of making <color=#1DFEAF>food</color> that humans can eat.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=33>Really, Mima?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Really, Mima?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=32>Hey, I’m a better cook than any other sea person.\nI’m sure my food will surprise even humans.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hey, I’m a better cook than any other sea person.\nI’m sure my food will surprise even humans.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=32>I mean, I do need to experiment. Oh ho ho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I mean, I do need to experiment. Oh ho ho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll tell you when it’s ready.\nLook forward to it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’ll tell you when it’s ready.\nLook forward to it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Mima04_HerbMan_Tsuchi_Talk_001
Array.english: Well, good thing <color=#F1DC2B>Dona</color> calmed down.\nHe has quite the appetite.
Array.indonesia: Well, good thing <color=#F1DC2B>Dona</color> calmed down.\nHe has quite the appetite.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_001
Array.english: Huh? Are you that... Humam?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Are you that... Humam?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_002
Array.english: Human, not humam.
Array.indonesia: Human, not humam.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_003
Array.english: <size=35>Har har! You look interesting!\nYou don’t even have fins!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Har har! You look interesting!\nYou don’t even have fins!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_004
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>He reminds me of someone...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>He reminds me of someone...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_005
Array.english: What is this shop you’re running?
Array.indonesia: What is this shop you’re running?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_006
Array.english: I sell various seeds here\nas well as flowers to offer to <color=#F1DC2B>King Long</color>.
Array.indonesia: I sell various seeds here\nas well as flowers to offer to <color=#F1DC2B>King Long</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_007
Array.english: <size=40>King...long?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>King...long?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_008
Array.english: <size=35>My goodness! \nDon’t tell me you don’t know who King Long is!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>My goodness! \nDon’t tell me you don’t know who King Long is!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_009
Array.english: He is the great king who saved this village from disaster...
Array.indonesia: He is the great king who saved this village from disaster...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_010
Array.english: <size=35>It’s very difficult to hold a conversation with you, \nyou know that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It’s very difficult to hold a conversation with you, \nyou know that?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_011
Array.english: <size=34>Go and offer a flower to King Long first.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Go and offer a flower to King Long first.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Start_012
Array.english: The <color=#1DFEAF>Tribute Flowers</color> are on the platform outside. \nTake one!
Array.indonesia: The <color=#1DFEAF>Tribute Flowers</color> are on the platform outside. \nTake one!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Statue_001
Array.english: Oh... So this statue is of King Long...\nIt’s the same person as in the painting from the Record Chamber.
Array.indonesia: Oh... So this statue is of King Long...\nIt’s the same person as in the painting from the Record Chamber.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Statue_02_001
Array.english: I guess I can put the flower on the platform in front of the statue.
Array.indonesia: I guess I can put the flower on the platform in front of the statue.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Statue_03_001
Array.english: I’ve done what he asked,\nso I should go back and talk to him.
Array.indonesia: I’ve done what he asked,\nso I should go back and talk to him.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Complete_001
Array.english: I did peek a little and it seems you did okay...
Array.indonesia: I did peek a little and it seems you did okay...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Complete_002
Array.english: Even so, I can’t just trust a human\nwho doesn’t even know what King Long has done!
Array.indonesia: Even so, I can’t just trust a human\nwho doesn’t even know what King Long has done!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin01_MermanFlower_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=40>Go and do a bit of reading or something!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Go and do a bit of reading or something!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Where is the <color=#1DFEAF>book</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Where is the <color=#1DFEAF>book</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_002
Array.english: <size=33>Which book?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Which book?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_003
Array.english: Oh, human! Good to see you.\nThere’s a book that contains the famous words of King Long...
Array.indonesia: Oh, human! Good to see you.\nThere’s a book that contains the famous words of King Long...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_004
Array.english: I can’t find it.\nI wanted to read it in the evening while resting.
Array.indonesia: I can’t find it.\nI wanted to read it in the evening while resting.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_005
Array.english: Where is it? I remember borrowing it...
Array.indonesia: Where is it? I remember borrowing it...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_006
Array.english: Borrow? From where?
Array.indonesia: Borrow? From where?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_007
Array.english: From Niamo’s <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color>, of course.\nThe temple has many books about the history and doctrine of the sea people.
Array.indonesia: From Niamo’s <color=#F1DC2B>Temple</color>, of course.\nThe temple has many books about the history and doctrine of the sea people.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_008
Array.english: <size=34>Oh! Human! Can you borrow another book from the temple for me, while I look around?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh! Human! Can you borrow another book from the temple for me, while I look around?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_009
Array.english: It’s called Volume 2...
Array.indonesia: It’s called Volume 2...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_010
Array.english: <size=34>...That’s a long title.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>...That’s a long title.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_011
Array.english: Hahaha! It’s a novel that describes King Long’s great battles.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! It’s a novel that describes King Long’s great battles.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Start_012
Array.english: Anyways, please borrow the book for me from the temple.\nI borrowed Volume 1 before, so Niamo should know.
Array.indonesia: Anyways, please borrow the book for me from the temple.\nI borrowed Volume 1 before, so Niamo should know.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine01_001
Array.english: Oh... Human, what brings you here?
Array.indonesia: Oh... Human, what brings you here?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine01_002
Array.english: The... owner of the seed shop told me to borrow a book.
Array.indonesia: The... owner of the seed shop told me to borrow a book.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine01_003
Array.english: <size=32>The title... It was very long...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The title... It was very long...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine01_004
Array.english: <size=35>I forgot it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I forgot it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine01_005
Array.english: Haha. I understand.\nKazhin always reads strange books.
Array.indonesia: Haha. I understand.\nKazhin always reads strange books.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine01_006
Array.english: Niamo, I was told that you would know which one, as it was previously borrowed. Do you remember?
Array.indonesia: Niamo, I was told that you would know which one, as it was previously borrowed. Do you remember?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine01_007
Array.english: <size=32>Hmm... If it’s a book that Kazhin borrowed...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Hmm... If it’s a book that Kazhin borrowed...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine01_008
Array.english: <size=34>It might be one of these three.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It might be one of these three.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine02_001
Array.english: Hmm... Maybe it’s this book?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Maybe it’s this book?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine02_002
Array.english: How about you take it with you?
Array.indonesia: How about you take it with you?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine02_003
Array.english: Yes. That will work best.\nThank you!
Array.indonesia: Yes. That will work best.\nThank you!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine02_004
Array.english: Haha, please come by any time.\nMay King Long’s protection be with you.
Array.indonesia: Haha, please come by any time.\nMay King Long’s protection be with you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine_BookChange_001
Array.english: What’s going on?
Array.indonesia: What’s going on?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine_BookChange_002
Array.english: I think it’s a different book.
Array.indonesia: I think it’s a different book.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine_BookChange_003
Array.english: I see.\nHow about choosing again?
Array.indonesia: I see.\nHow about choosing again?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine_wrong_001
Array.english: Um... I guess it wasn’t that book. I’m sorry.
Array.indonesia: Um... I guess it wasn’t that book. I’m sorry.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine_wrong_002
Array.english: Oh... I see.\nIt’s alright.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I see.\nIt’s alright.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_Shrine_wrong_003
Array.english: Will you try choosing again?
Array.indonesia: Will you try choosing again?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Umm... This book...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Umm... This book...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book01_002
Array.english: This isn’t it. I own a seed shop,\nbut a Divine Tree isn’t something you can just plant and grow.
Array.indonesia: This isn’t it. I own a seed shop,\nbut a Divine Tree isn’t something you can just plant and grow.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book01_003
Array.english: It’d be nice to learn about it...\nBut, it’s mostly used as energy.
Array.indonesia: It’d be nice to learn about it...\nBut, it’s mostly used as energy.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book01_004
Array.english: <size=35>Anyways, please go look again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Anyways, please go look again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Umm... This book...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Umm... This book...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book02_002
Array.english: <size=34>This is it... I mean, what am I saying?\nWhat are you thinking, bringing a book like this?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This is it... I mean, what am I saying?\nWhat are you thinking, bringing a book like this?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book02_003
Array.english: I heard it’s something you borrowed before...
Array.indonesia: I heard it’s something you borrowed before...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book02_004
Array.english: <size=34>No…What's this?!! This is some kind of misunderstanding!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>No…What's this?!! This is some kind of misunderstanding!!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book02_005
Array.english: <size=35>Go and look again!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Go and look again!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=36>Umm... This book...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Umm... This book...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_002
Array.english: This is the one! Volume 2!
Array.indonesia: This is the one! Volume 2!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_003
Array.english: Great job on finding it, haha. Awesome. \nI’ll read it in the evening while drinking some seaweed wine.
Array.indonesia: Great job on finding it, haha. Awesome. \nI’ll read it in the evening while drinking some seaweed wine.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_004
Array.english: It’s not really a gift...But, please take this.
Array.indonesia: It’s not really a gift...But, please take this.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_005
Array.english: Is it a seed? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Is it a seed? What is it?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_006
Array.english: It’s a very flavorful <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed seed</color> that’s grown in our village.
Array.indonesia: It’s a very flavorful <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed seed</color> that’s grown in our village.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_007
Array.english: Oh...\nIt might be a bit difficult to grow on the farm.
Array.indonesia: Oh...\nIt might be a bit difficult to grow on the farm.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_008
Array.english: Tsk tsk... Human facilities, eh...
Array.indonesia: Tsk tsk... Human facilities, eh...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_009
Array.english: <size=35>Try going to the village’s farmer, <color=#F1DC2B>Gumo</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Try going to the village’s farmer, <color=#F1DC2B>Gumo</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin02_MermanBible_book03_Complete_010
Array.english: <size=33>If you’re lucky, Gumo might be able to help you grow the seaweed!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If you’re lucky, Gumo might be able to help you grow the seaweed!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hm? You’re asking me if I can harvest <color=#1DFEAF>Seaweed</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hm? You’re asking me if I can harvest <color=#1DFEAF>Seaweed</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_002
Array.english: Well... It can be harvested at the <color=#F1DC2B>Seaweed Farm</color> behind me...
Array.indonesia: Well... It can be harvested at the <color=#F1DC2B>Seaweed Farm</color> behind me...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_003
Array.english: But... I don’t want to do it for a human...
Array.indonesia: But... I don’t want to do it for a human...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_004
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(What an unkind sea person... \nShould I just leave?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(What an unkind sea person... \nShould I just leave?)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(No. Seaweed directly from here would be better for cooking...\nI’ll have to try my best to convince him.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(No. Seaweed directly from here would be better for cooking...\nI’ll have to try my best to convince him.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_006
Array.english: This is a seed that Kazhin gave me...\nCan you please help me?
Array.indonesia: This is a seed that Kazhin gave me...\nCan you please help me?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_007
Array.english: Kazhin gave it to a human? That’s strange.
Array.indonesia: Kazhin gave it to a human? That’s strange.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_008
Array.english: I’m not sure what a human will be able to make with \nthe seaweed...\rBut, I’ll think about it if you can make something that’s extraordinary.
Array.indonesia: I’m not sure what a human will be able to make with \nthe seaweed...\rBut, I’ll think about it if you can make something that’s extraordinary.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_009
Array.english: <size=35>Bring me a <color=#1DFEAF>dish</color> made of seaweed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bring me a <color=#1DFEAF>dish</color> made of seaweed.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Start_010
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hm... Looks like I’ll have to ask Bancho.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hm... Looks like I’ll have to ask Bancho.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Bancho_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm... Cuisine made with seaweed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm... Cuisine made with seaweed.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Bancho_002
Array.english: A simple dish using seaweed will not leave a strong impression.\nThey probably have that at the Sea People Village.
Array.indonesia: A simple dish using seaweed will not leave a strong impression.\nThey probably have that at the Sea People Village.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Bancho_003
Array.english: First, bring me <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>white rice</color>, and <color=#1DFEAF>sea urchin</color>.
Array.indonesia: First, bring me <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>white rice</color>, and <color=#1DFEAF>sea urchin</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Bancho_004
Array.english: <size=33>I’ll give them a harmonious blend of ingredients \nfrom the land and sea.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I’ll give them a harmonious blend of ingredients \nfrom the land and sea.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Bancho_005
Array.english: Hmm. <color=#1DFEAF>white rice</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>sea urchin</color>, and <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed</color>.\nI’ll have to try gathering them.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. <color=#1DFEAF>white rice</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>sea urchin</color>, and <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed</color>.\nI’ll have to try gathering them.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_GetAllIngredients_001
Array.english: Good. All the ingredients have been gathered, so I’ll ask <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> to make it.
Array.indonesia: Good. All the ingredients have been gathered, so I’ll ask <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> to make it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Bancho_Ready01_001
Array.english: You’ve brought the ingredients.\nThen I’ll start preparing <color=#1DFEAF>Sea Urchin Seaweed Rice</color>.
Array.indonesia: You’ve brought the ingredients.\nThen I’ll start preparing <color=#1DFEAF>Sea Urchin Seaweed Rice</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Bancho_Ready02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Here. The sea people should be satisfied with this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Here. The sea people should be satisfied with this.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Bancho_Ready02_002
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you, Bancho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thank you, Bancho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Bancho_Ready02_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Let’s bring it to the sea people farmer!)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Let’s bring it to the sea people farmer!)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_Eat_001
Array.english: <size=34>Here, this is cuisine made from seaweed.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Here, this is cuisine made from seaweed.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_Eat_002
Array.english: What are these little, round white balls?\nHuman cuisine... I can predict the taste, but I’ll give it a try.
Array.indonesia: What are these little, round white balls?\nHuman cuisine... I can predict the taste, but I’ll give it a try.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_001
Array.english: <size=36>Ah! This is a new taste...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Ah! This is a new taste...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_002
Array.english: <size=34>The soft texture of seaweed and the little white grains...\nThey go so well together!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>The soft texture of seaweed and the little white grains...\nThey go so well together!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_003
Array.english: <size=32>This yellow thing...\nit adds such rich flavor...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>This yellow thing...\nit adds such rich flavor...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_004
Array.english: They’re sea urchin eggs... \nIs this your first time seeing them?
Array.indonesia: They’re sea urchin eggs... \nIs this your first time seeing them?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_005
Array.english: <size=33>Sea urchins? That spiky creature?\nHumans eat that kind of stuff?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Sea urchins? That spiky creature?\nHumans eat that kind of stuff?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_006
Array.english: I guess humans are able to use various sea ingredients...\nI’m surprised.
Array.indonesia: I guess humans are able to use various sea ingredients...\nI’m surprised.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_007
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! Bancho is very serious about seafood!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Bancho is very serious about seafood!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_008
Array.english: Alright. A promise is a promise...
Array.indonesia: Alright. A promise is a promise...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_009
Array.english: <size=33>I’ll open up the <color=#1DFEAF>Seaweed Farm</color> for you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I’ll open up the <color=#1DFEAF>Seaweed Farm</color> for you.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_010
Array.english: <size=36>Oh!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_011
Array.english: However, I have to make a separate farm.\nTo avoid food supply issues to the village...
Array.indonesia: However, I have to make a separate farm.\nTo avoid food supply issues to the village...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_012
Array.english: It’s going to take some time.\nPlease wait.
Array.indonesia: It’s going to take some time.\nPlease wait.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_013
Array.english: Okay. Then I’ll be back later.\nThis is exciting!
Array.indonesia: Okay. Then I’ll be back later.\nThis is exciting!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_re_011
Array.english: You can purchase the seeds to be sowed at the Seaweed Farm from Kazhin’s <color=#F1DC2B>Seed Shop</color>.
Array.indonesia: You can purchase the seeds to be sowed at the Seaweed Farm from Kazhin’s <color=#F1DC2B>Seed Shop</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_re_012
Array.english: Bring me seeds and I will grow <color=#1DFEAF>Sea Weeds</color> for you.\nYou just come here and harvest them.
Array.indonesia: Bring me seeds and I will grow <color=#1DFEAF>Sea Weeds</color> for you.\nYou just come here and harvest them.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Kazhin03_GumoFarm_Gumo_AfterEat_re_013
Array.english: Oh, nice! Thank you!\nThen I will come back with some <color=#1DFEAF>seeds</color>!
Array.indonesia: Oh, nice! Thank you!\nThen I will come back with some <color=#1DFEAF>seeds</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Kazhin_Unlock_Glacial_NewSeed_001
Array.english: I am glad that you cleared the path to the Glacial Area. \nI was able to get some <color=#1DFEAF>Sea Weed Seeds</color>.
Array.indonesia: I am glad that you cleared the path to the Glacial Area. \nI was able to get some <color=#1DFEAF>Sea Weed Seeds</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Kazhin_Unlock_Glacial_NewSeed_002
Array.english: Check these out, too. \nYou can cultivate them at Gumo’s <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color>.
Array.indonesia: Check these out, too. \nYou can cultivate them at Gumo’s <color=#F1DC2B>Farm</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Mima_Unlock_Bladderwrack_Mandoo_001
Array.english: I heard you saved Tsuchi and Dona from a cave.\nThanks, Dave!
Array.indonesia: I heard you saved Tsuchi and Dona from a cave.\nThanks, Dave!

Array.name: dialog_Mima_Unlock_Bladderwrack_Mandoo_002
Array.english: Yeah… Escaping was quite a challenge.
Array.indonesia: Yeah… Escaping was quite a challenge.

Array.name: dialog_Mima_Unlock_Bladderwrack_Mandoo_003
Array.english: Tsuchi can be a bit single-minded when he's gathering seaweed.
Array.indonesia: Tsuchi can be a bit single-minded when he's gathering seaweed.

Array.name: dialog_Mima_Unlock_Bladderwrack_Mandoo_004
Array.english: But it's thanks to him I got some new seaweed. Haha!
Array.indonesia: But it's thanks to him I got some new seaweed. Haha!

Array.name: dialog_Mima_Unlock_Bladderwrack_Mandoo_005
Array.english: It’s called <color=#F1DC2B>Bladderwrack</color>.\nI thought I'd make some delicious dumplings with it!
Array.indonesia: It’s called <color=#F1DC2B>Bladderwrack</color>.\nI thought I'd make some delicious dumplings with it!

Array.name: dialog_Mima_Unlock_Bladderwrack_Mandoo_006
Array.english: <size=33>I added it to the menu. Try it later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I added it to the menu. Try it later!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Jango_Unlock_Secret_Recipe_001
Array.english: Hm..? A recipe I haven’t seen before.
Array.indonesia: Hm..? A recipe I haven’t seen before.

Array.name: dialog_Jango_Unlock_Secret_Recipe_002
Array.english: Jango has been traveling to various places to collect recipes and is now selling the ones he acquired.
Array.indonesia: Jango has been traveling to various places to collect recipes and is now selling the ones he acquired.

Array.name: dialog_Jango_Unlock_Secret_Recipe_003
Array.english: I’ve bought one, and it’s pretty unique.
Array.indonesia: I’ve bought one, and it’s pretty unique.

Array.name: dialog_Jango_Unlock_Secret_Recipe_004
Array.english: <size=33>I hope the customers will like it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I hope the customers will like it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Start_001
Array.english: <size=34>What's up, Dave? You doing good?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What's up, Dave? You doing good?</size>

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Start_002
Array.english: You seem energetic today!
Array.indonesia: You seem energetic today!

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Start_003
Array.english: Yeah man! Can you come to the Chicken Farm real quick?\nI got somethin' to show you!
Array.indonesia: Yeah man! Can you come to the Chicken Farm real quick?\nI got somethin' to show you!

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Start_004
Array.english: Okay.
Array.indonesia: Okay.

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_001
Array.english: What's going on, Sammy?
Array.indonesia: What's going on, Sammy?

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_002
Array.english: I was browsing the internet to buy a new instrument…
Array.indonesia: I was browsing the internet to buy a new instrument…

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_003
Array.english: And I found some awesome stuff on sale for a limited time, so I bought them just before the sale ended!
Array.indonesia: And I found some awesome stuff on sale for a limited time, so I bought them just before the sale ended!

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_004
Array.english: Now you don't need to worry about coming to the Chicken Farm when you're busy!
Array.indonesia: Now you don't need to worry about coming to the Chicken Farm when you're busy!

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_005
Array.english: Awesome stuff? What exactly did you…
Array.indonesia: Awesome stuff? What exactly did you…

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=36>Here it is! The first item is the <color=#F1DC2B>Egg Storage Box</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Here it is! The first item is the <color=#F1DC2B>Egg Storage Box</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_007
Array.english: This storage can keep up to 50 eggs.
Array.indonesia: This storage can keep up to 50 eggs.

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_008
Array.english: Now you don't have to collect eggs every day. You can just wait until it fills up and collect them all in one go.
Array.indonesia: Now you don't have to collect eggs every day. You can just wait until it fills up and collect them all in one go.

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_009
Array.english: Woah…
Array.indonesia: Woah…

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_010
Array.english: <size=35>That's not all!\nBehold… the <color=#F1DC2B>Chicken Feeder</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>That's not all!\nBehold… the <color=#F1DC2B>Chicken Feeder</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_011
Array.english: This machine automatically feeds your chickens and increases the egg production rate.
Array.indonesia: This machine automatically feeds your chickens and increases the egg production rate.

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_012
Array.english: With these machines you'll have the ultimate Chicken Farm!\nWhat do you think, Dave?
Array.indonesia: With these machines you'll have the ultimate Chicken Farm!\nWhat do you think, Dave?

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=36>They're amazing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>They're amazing!</size>

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_014
Array.english: But… I guess they're not free, right?
Array.indonesia: But… I guess they're not free, right?

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_015
Array.english: Nope. I'm a bit short on cash, since I'm preparing for a new album…
Array.indonesia: Nope. I'm a bit short on cash, since I'm preparing for a new album…

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_016
Array.english: But I bought them at a special discount! It was pretty much a steal!
Array.indonesia: But I bought them at a special discount! It was pretty much a steal!

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_017
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I don't think Sammy can say no as long there's a discount…)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(I don't think Sammy can say no as long there's a discount…)</color>

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_018
Array.english: I'll hold onto them for now. Just tell me when you need them.
Array.indonesia: I'll hold onto them for now. Just tell me when you need them.

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_019
Array.english: <size=34>I can install them for free. Haha.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I can install them for free. Haha.</size>

Array.name: dialog_ChickenFarm_NewMachine_Unlock_Complete_020
Array.english: Hmm. They seem pretty useful. I should think about it.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. They seem pretty useful. I should think about it.

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Start_001
Array.english: Hey… What's up… Dave…
Array.indonesia: Hey… What's up… Dave…

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Start_002
Array.english: Hm? You seem a little down today, Sammy.
Array.indonesia: Hm? You seem a little down today, Sammy.

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Start_003
Array.english: I want to discuss something with you. Can you come to the Chicken Farm?
Array.indonesia: I want to discuss something with you. Can you come to the Chicken Farm?

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Start_004
Array.english: Alright. Be there soon.
Array.indonesia: Alright. Be there soon.

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_001
Array.english: What is it, Sammy?
Array.indonesia: What is it, Sammy?

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_002
Array.english: Well… I'm preparing my new album and I haven't done any live shows…
Array.indonesia: Well… I'm preparing my new album and I haven't done any live shows…

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=33>So I’m a bit short on cash.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>So I’m a bit short on cash.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_004
Array.english: Oh… I see.
Array.indonesia: Oh… I see.

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_005
Array.english: I’d like to help you run your farm as a part-timer. what do you think?
Array.indonesia: I’d like to help you run your farm as a part-timer. what do you think?

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_006
Array.english: A <size=36>part-time job</size>?
Array.indonesia: A <size=36>part-time job</size>?

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_007
Array.english: Yeah! I'll help you harvest crops, sow seeds, and weed and fertilize your field!
Array.indonesia: Yeah! I'll help you harvest crops, sow seeds, and weed and fertilize your field!

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_008
Array.english: Hmm… That sounds pretty good.
Array.indonesia: Hmm… That sounds pretty good.

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_009
Array.english: Haha! I used to help my dad run his farm when I was a kid!
Array.indonesia: Haha! I used to help my dad run his farm when I was a kid!

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_010
Array.english: I mean, that was a while ago, but I can still handle a part-time job.
Array.indonesia: I mean, that was a while ago, but I can still handle a part-time job.

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_011
Array.english: Right. So, how do we do this?
Array.indonesia: Right. So, how do we do this?

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_012
Array.english: Talk to me whenever you need an extra hand.\nYou can even decide how many days you want me to work at your farm.
Array.indonesia: Talk to me whenever you need an extra hand.\nYou can even decide how many days you want me to work at your farm.

Array.name: dialog_Farm_Sammy_Hiring_Unlock_Complete_013
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! We can help each other out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright! We can help each other out!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_001
Array.english: What do I do?
Array.indonesia: What do I do?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_002
Array.english: Hmm? Kids, what’s going on?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Kids, what’s going on?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_003
Array.english: Well... We were playing ball outside the village\nwhen a <color=#1DFEAF>Megamouth Shark</color> suddenly appeared...
Array.indonesia: Well... We were playing ball outside the village\nwhen a <color=#1DFEAF>Megamouth Shark</color> suddenly appeared...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_004
Array.english: <size=38>It swallowed our <color=#F1DC2B>ball</color>! *Sniff*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>It swallowed our <color=#F1DC2B>ball</color>! *Sniff*</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_005
Array.english: <size=37>Megamouth? You mean the huge...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Megamouth? You mean the huge...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_006
Array.english: Yes.\nCan you go get it back for us, human?
Array.indonesia: Yes.\nCan you go get it back for us, human?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_007
Array.english: Um... It looked really scary...
Array.indonesia: Um... It looked really scary...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_008
Array.english: <size=44>*Sniff*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>*Sniff*</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_009
Array.english: Oh, uh... alright.\nI’ll get it back for you!
Array.indonesia: Oh, uh... alright.\nI’ll get it back for you!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_010
Array.english: Wow! Thank you so much, human!
Array.indonesia: Wow! Thank you so much, human!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Start_011
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>It’s so hard to refuse children...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>It’s so hard to refuse children...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_ContactMegaMouth_001
Array.english: Oh! That looks like the one that swallowed the ball!
Array.indonesia: Oh! That looks like the one that swallowed the ball!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Complete_001
Array.english: Wow! It’s the ball!\nYou really brought it back for us!
Array.indonesia: Wow! It’s the ball!\nYou really brought it back for us!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Complete_002
Array.english: Phew... It was real scary...
Array.indonesia: Phew... It was real scary...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Complete_003
Array.english: You kids stay inside the village\nfrom now on, okay?
Array.indonesia: You kids stay inside the village\nfrom now on, okay?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Complete_004
Array.english: Okay!
Array.indonesia: Okay!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Complete_005
Array.english: I guess humans aren’t all bad,\nunlike what we were told.
Array.indonesia: I guess humans aren’t all bad,\nunlike what we were told.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro01_FindBall_Complete_006
Array.english: Hope to see you again, human!
Array.indonesia: Hope to see you again, human!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_001
Array.english: Where could Maro have gone...
Array.indonesia: Where could Maro have gone...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_002
Array.english: Hm? Something wrong?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Something wrong?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_003
Array.english: Oh... Human... Actually...
Array.indonesia: Oh... Human... Actually...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_004
Array.english: <size=34>Maro disappeared!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Maro disappeared!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_005
Array.english: I’m sure Maro went to the <color=#F1DC2B>Underwater Lake</color>.\nI’m sure.
Array.indonesia: I’m sure Maro went to the <color=#F1DC2B>Underwater Lake</color>.\nI’m sure.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_006
Array.english: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Underwater Lake</color>...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Underwater Lake</color>...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_007
Array.english: Yes! It’s a mystical and beautiful place...\nTenzhin told us not to go, as there’s a frightening monster there.
Array.indonesia: Yes! It’s a mystical and beautiful place...\nTenzhin told us not to go, as there’s a frightening monster there.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_008
Array.english: The thing is...\nMaro said there’s a crack that we could fit through...
Array.indonesia: The thing is...\nMaro said there’s a crack that we could fit through...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_009
Array.english: I didn’t go because I was afraid I’d get scolded, but I think Maro went alone. What a troublemaker.
Array.indonesia: I didn’t go because I was afraid I’d get scolded, but I think Maro went alone. What a troublemaker.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_010
Array.english: <size=34>Where is this place?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Where is this place?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_011
Array.english: It’s closed off with a door in front of it so that no one can get in.\nBut there should be a <color=#1DFEAF>guide sign</color> nearby.
Array.indonesia: It’s closed off with a door in front of it so that no one can get in.\nBut there should be a <color=#1DFEAF>guide sign</color> nearby.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_012
Array.english: <size=35>The <color=#1DFEAF>sign</color> has this kind of writing on it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>The <color=#1DFEAF>sign</color> has this kind of writing on it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_013
Array.english: Please bring Maro back!\nTenzhin will be furious when he finds out!
Array.indonesia: Please bring Maro back!\nTenzhin will be furious when he finds out!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_014
Array.english: Okay. I’ll try looking.
Array.indonesia: Okay. I’ll try looking.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Start_015
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm... A <color=#1DFEAF>sign</color> with the language of the sea people...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm... A <color=#1DFEAF>sign</color> with the language of the sea people...</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_NotOpenYet_001
Array.english: What is this...? Is this a door for the sea people?
Array.indonesia: What is this...? Is this a door for the sea people?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_NotOpenYet_002
Array.english: There’s a small crack in the corner... I won’t be able to fit.
Array.indonesia: There’s a small crack in the corner... I won’t be able to fit.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Sign_001
Array.english: <size=34>This must be the sign to the <color=#F1DC2B>Underwater Lake</color> that the sea people children were talking about.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This must be the sign to the <color=#F1DC2B>Underwater Lake</color> that the sea people children were talking about.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Sign_002
Array.english: She said Maro hasn’t returned yet, right?\nMaybe I’ll follow the sign.
Array.indonesia: She said Maro hasn’t returned yet, right?\nMaybe I’ll follow the sign.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_hasPickAxe_001
Array.english: <size=33>Is this the door to the Underwater Lake...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Is this the door to the Underwater Lake...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_hasPickAxe_002
Array.english: The crumbled rocks are blocking the way.
Array.indonesia: The crumbled rocks are blocking the way.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_hasPickAxe_003
Array.english: Looks like we need a <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color>...
Array.indonesia: Looks like we need a <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_hasPickAxe_004
Array.english: <size=33>Thankfully, I have one!\nLet’s try using this!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thankfully, I have one!\nLet’s try using this!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_NoPickAxe_001
Array.english: <size=33>Is this the door to the Underwater Lake?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Is this the door to the Underwater Lake?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_NoPickAxe_002
Array.english: The crumbled rocks are blocking the way.
Array.indonesia: The crumbled rocks are blocking the way.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_NoPickAxe_003
Array.english: Looks like we need a <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color>...\nLet’s look around.
Array.indonesia: Looks like we need a <color=#1DFEAF>Pickaxe</color>...\nLet’s look around.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_OpenGate_001
Array.english: <size=33>Great! All the rocks are gone now!\nLooks like the door had crumbled due to the earthquakes.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Great! All the rocks are gone now!\nLooks like the door had crumbled due to the earthquakes.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_OpenGate_002
Array.english: I should head inside and find Maro.
Array.indonesia: I should head inside and find Maro.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Enter_001
Array.english: Hmm... It’s eerie inside...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... It’s eerie inside...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Enter_002
Array.english: It’s dark, so let’s be careful while moving.
Array.indonesia: It’s dark, so let’s be careful while moving.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Lake_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! This must be the Underwater Lake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! This must be the Underwater Lake!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Lake_002
Array.english: To see a lake under the sea...\nIt really is amazing.
Array.indonesia: To see a lake under the sea...\nIt really is amazing.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Lake_003
Array.english: <size=34>Maybe I should take a photo.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Maybe I should take a photo.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_AfterPhoto_001
Array.english: <size=35>...?!\nWhat was that sound...?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...?!\nWhat was that sound...?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Enter_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oh... Human!\nYou came to rescue me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh... Human!\nYou came to rescue me!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Enter_002
Array.english: <size=34>I’m here to rescue you...\nBut what is this monster?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’m here to rescue you...\nBut what is this monster?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Enter_003
Array.english: <size=34>I was just here to take a look at the lake... \nThat’s when...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I was just here to take a look at the lake... \nThat’s when...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Enter_004
Array.english: Ugh... This is a problem...\nLooks like I have to find a way.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... This is a problem...\nLooks like I have to find a way.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Die_001
Array.english: Whew... Barely defeated it.
Array.indonesia: Whew... Barely defeated it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Die_002
Array.english: Urgh... Thank you, human!
Array.indonesia: Urgh... Thank you, human!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Die_003
Array.english: Why are you in such a dangerous place?
Array.indonesia: Why are you in such a dangerous place?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Die_004
Array.english: Well.. I wanted to see the Underwater Lake...
Array.indonesia: Well.. I wanted to see the Underwater Lake...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Die_005
Array.english: Get a load of this kid.\nAnyway, let’s go back to the village.
Array.indonesia: Get a load of this kid.\nAnyway, let’s go back to the village.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=35>I can't just run away now!\nI have to save Maro!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I can't just run away now!\nI have to save Maro!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Die_Barricade_001
Array.english: Oh, I gotta go get Maro.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I gotta go get Maro.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_PhotoZone_Barricade_001
Array.english: This is a special place, so let's take a picture as a souvenir.
Array.indonesia: This is a special place, so let's take a picture as a souvenir.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_AfterPhotoZone_Barricade_001
Array.english: I heard a scream from inside!\nDid something happen to Maro...?
Array.indonesia: I heard a scream from inside!\nDid something happen to Maro...?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_AfterPhotoZone_Barricade_002
Array.english: <size=34>Let's hurry!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let's hurry!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Carving_001
Array.english: Boy... that sure was one ugly creature.
Array.indonesia: Boy... that sure was one ugly creature.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro02_LostKid_Boss_Carving_002
Array.english: I better go check if <color=#F1DC2B>Maro</color> is okay.
Array.indonesia: I better go check if <color=#F1DC2B>Maro</color> is okay.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro_LostKid_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=34>Maro, I was worried about you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Maro, I was worried about you!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro_LostKid_Complete_002
Array.english: I’m sorry... I’ve been wanting to go...
Array.indonesia: I’m sorry... I’ve been wanting to go...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro_LostKid_Complete_003
Array.english: How was it? Was it beautiful?\nWas there really a lake in the water?
Array.indonesia: How was it? Was it beautiful?\nWas there really a lake in the water?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro_LostKid_Complete_004
Array.english: I took a photo.\nDo you want to see it?
Array.indonesia: I took a photo.\nDo you want to see it?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro_LostKid_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>Whoa! It’s amazing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Whoa! It’s amazing!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro_LostKid_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=34>Wow!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro_LostKid_Complete_007
Array.english: I know you’re disappointed, but be satisfied with the photo.\nThere were dangerous monsters there.
Array.indonesia: I know you’re disappointed, but be satisfied with the photo.\nThere were dangerous monsters there.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro_LostKid_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=32>Okay.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Okay.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Maro_LostKid_Complete_009
Array.english: Anyways, thank you for saving me!\nI won’t leave the village now.
Array.indonesia: Anyways, thank you for saving me!\nI won’t leave the village now.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_001
Array.english: Oh... You must be the outsider.\nMay King Long’s protection be with you.
Array.indonesia: Oh... You must be the outsider.\nMay King Long’s protection be with you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_002
Array.english: Hello. What is this place?
Array.indonesia: Hello. What is this place?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_003
Array.english: Oh, this is where we commemorate King Long.\nIt’s also where we store records of our history.
Array.indonesia: Oh, this is where we commemorate King Long.\nIt’s also where we store records of our history.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_004
Array.english: Ah! I heard from Tenzhin that you’re helping out \nin the village.
Array.indonesia: Ah! I heard from Tenzhin that you’re helping out \nin the village.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_005
Array.english: Yes, well... That’s how it is for now.
Array.indonesia: Yes, well... That’s how it is for now.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_006
Array.english: Hmm... In that case,\nthere’s something I’d like your help with.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... In that case,\nthere’s something I’d like your help with.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_007
Array.english: There’s to be a wedding soon here in the village...
Array.indonesia: There’s to be a wedding soon here in the village...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_008
Array.english: A recent earthquake destroyed the <color=#1DFEAF>Stone Slate</color> we need for the wedding, however.
Array.indonesia: A recent earthquake destroyed the <color=#1DFEAF>Stone Slate</color> we need for the wedding, however.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_009
Array.english: I should have been more careful about storing it...
Array.indonesia: I should have been more careful about storing it...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_010
Array.english: Hmm. That sounds like a big deal.\nBut how can I help you with something like that?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. That sounds like a big deal.\nBut how can I help you with something like that?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_011
Array.english: In the days when we Sea People roamed the seas freely,\nwe left some records in human waters.
Array.indonesia: In the days when we Sea People roamed the seas freely,\nwe left some records in human waters.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_012
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh... He must be talking about the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Record Chamber</color>.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh... He must be talking about the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Record Chamber</color>.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_013
Array.english: There should be a <color=#1DFEAF>Stone Slate</color> in one of those places for certain.\nPlease do help me out, human.
Array.indonesia: There should be a <color=#1DFEAF>Stone Slate</color> in one of those places for certain.\nPlease do help me out, human.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_014
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... it was a song for the wedding, right?\nI guess I’ll go to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Record Chamber</color> first.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... it was a song for the wedding, right?\nI guess I’ll go to the <color=#F1DC2B>Sea People Record Chamber</color> first.</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_015
Array.english: <size=34>Alright.\nI’ll try and bring back the slab.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright.\nI’ll try and bring back the slab.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_016
Array.english: Would you do that for me?\nI’m truly grateful, human.
Array.indonesia: Would you do that for me?\nI’m truly grateful, human.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Start_017
Array.english: May the blessing of King Long go with you.
Array.indonesia: May the blessing of King Long go with you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_RecordRoom_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wait... why are there so many fish?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wait... why are there so many fish?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Find_001
Array.english: Hmm. This appears to be the slab.\nI should take it to the <color=#F1DC2B>Shrine</color> in the Sea People Village.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. This appears to be the slab.\nI should take it to the <color=#F1DC2B>Shrine</color> in the Sea People Village.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Complete_01_001
Array.english: <size=40>My goodness! Human!\nThis is the one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>My goodness! Human!\nThis is the one!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Complete_01_002
Array.english: Thanks to you, we’ll be able to have the wedding\nwithout any hiccups.
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you, we’ll be able to have the wedding\nwithout any hiccups.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Complete_02_001
Array.english: Human... Or rather, Dave, was it?
Array.indonesia: Human... Or rather, Dave, was it?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Complete_02_002
Array.english: I think if you participated,\nyou could become better acquainted with the villagers.
Array.indonesia: I think if you participated,\nyou could become better acquainted with the villagers.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Complete_02_003
Array.english: Um... A Sea People wedding, huh? That sounds interesting.
Array.indonesia: Um... A Sea People wedding, huh? That sounds interesting.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Complete_03_001
Array.english: Here we are, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Here we are, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Complete_03_002
Array.english: Wow... It feels different from a human wedding!
Array.indonesia: Wow... It feels different from a human wedding!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Complete_03_003
Array.english: Haha, is that so?
Array.indonesia: Haha, is that so?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_FindSong_Complete_03_004
Array.english: You can stay in the back.\nIt’ll begin soon.
Array.indonesia: You can stay in the back.\nIt’ll begin soon.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_Wedding_AfterEarthquake_001
Array.english: <size=48>Oh no! Another earthquake!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Oh no! Another earthquake!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo01_Wedding_AfterEarthquake_002
Array.english: <size=48>Ki-King Long’s arm!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=48>Ki-King Long’s arm!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oh dear!\nKing Long!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh dear!\nKing Long!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Start_002
Array.english: This is terrible...\nIt’s actually a very old statue...
Array.indonesia: This is terrible...\nIt’s actually a very old statue...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Start_003
Array.english: We don’t have the tools in this village to patch it up...
Array.indonesia: We don’t have the tools in this village to patch it up...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Start_004
Array.english: <size=37>Oh dear! This is not good.\nIs it an omen of an impending disaster, perhaps?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Oh dear! This is not good.\nIs it an omen of an impending disaster, perhaps?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Start_005
Array.english: Hey now... Calm down a bit...
Array.indonesia: Hey now... Calm down a bit...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Start_006
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Maybe Cobra will have something?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Maybe Cobra will have something?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Start_007
Array.english: I’ll try and see if there’s anything we can use\non the surface. Just wait for a bit.
Array.indonesia: I’ll try and see if there’s anything we can use\non the surface. Just wait for a bit.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Start_008
Array.english: Oh! Dave... Please do bring back something.
Array.indonesia: Oh! Dave... Please do bring back something.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Start_009
Array.english: King Long... We need your protection...
Array.indonesia: King Long... We need your protection...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_CobraTalk_001
Array.english: Hmm... <color=#1DFEAF>A stone adhesive</color> for use underwater?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... <color=#1DFEAF>A stone adhesive</color> for use underwater?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_CobraTalk_002
Array.english: Let’s see...
Array.indonesia: Let’s see...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_CobraTalk_002_2
Array.english: …I believe I saw it somewhere…
Array.indonesia: …I believe I saw it somewhere…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_CobraTalk_003
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, good! It was in the corner here! Hahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, good! It was in the corner here! Hahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_CobraTalk_004
Array.english: This should do.\nI should go back to the Sea People Village.
Array.indonesia: This should do.\nI should go back to the Sea People Village.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_CobraTalk_005
Array.english: I'll go back to the Sea People Village and attach <color=#1DFEAF>the arm of King Long's statue</color>.
Array.indonesia: I'll go back to the Sea People Village and attach <color=#1DFEAF>the arm of King Long's statue</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Complete_01_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oh! You’re back!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh! You’re back!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Complete_01_002
Array.english: My friend had something we could use.
Array.indonesia: My friend had something we could use.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Complete_01_003
Array.english: In that case... please start working on it immediately, Dave.
Array.indonesia: In that case... please start working on it immediately, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Complete_02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Wow! It looks completely undamaged!</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Wow! It looks completely undamaged!</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Complete_02_002
Array.english: Phew. Looks like I managed to glue it on quite well.
Array.indonesia: Phew. Looks like I managed to glue it on quite well.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Complete_02_003
Array.english: Thank you so much, Dave.\nWe won’t forget this.
Array.indonesia: Thank you so much, Dave.\nWe won’t forget this.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Complete_02_004
Array.english: Why do we keep getting these tremors?\nThey seem to be coming at shorter intervals...
Array.indonesia: Why do we keep getting these tremors?\nThey seem to be coming at shorter intervals...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Niamo02_FixStatue_Complete_02_005
Array.english: Oh King Long... Please protect our village...
Array.indonesia: Oh King Long... Please protect our village...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_001
Array.english: Heh.\nYou’re the human that’s been wandering about our village, right?
Array.indonesia: Heh.\nYou’re the human that’s been wandering about our village, right?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_002
Array.english: What fancy decorations...\nWhat is this place?
Array.indonesia: What fancy decorations...\nWhat is this place?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_003
Array.english: Heh. We Sea People work hard every single day.
Array.indonesia: Heh. We Sea People work hard every single day.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_004
Array.english: This is a place of…\npleasure for the hardworking villagers.
Array.indonesia: This is a place of…\npleasure for the hardworking villagers.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_005
Array.english: <size=36>So I can’t come in, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>So I can’t come in, right?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_006
Array.english: Heh. It’s alright.\nSpecies should not be a barrier to enjoyment, don't you think?
Array.indonesia: Heh. It’s alright.\nSpecies should not be a barrier to enjoyment, don't you think?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_007
Array.english: Oh right, you’re helping out at the village, isn’t that right?
Array.indonesia: Oh right, you’re helping out at the village, isn’t that right?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_008
Array.english: Yes, I guess that’s how it is for now.
Array.indonesia: Yes, I guess that’s how it is for now.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_009
Array.english: I’ve been needing help with something...
Array.indonesia: I’ve been needing help with something...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_010
Array.english: This establishment operates <color=#F1DC2B>Seahorse Races</color>,\nwhich are extremely popular.
Array.indonesia: This establishment operates <color=#F1DC2B>Seahorse Races</color>,\nwhich are extremely popular.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_011
Array.english: The recent earthquake destroyed the general quarters\nand all the <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorses</color> have run off.
Array.indonesia: The recent earthquake destroyed the general quarters\nand all the <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorses</color> have run off.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_012
Array.english: They should still be in the village...\nWill you go catch them for me?
Array.indonesia: They should still be in the village...\nWill you go catch them for me?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_013
Array.english: You want me to catch Seahorses?
Array.indonesia: You want me to catch Seahorses?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Start_014
Array.english: Yes. There are <color=#1DFEAF>5</color> total...\nThey should be hiding in various parts of the village.
Array.indonesia: Yes. There are <color=#1DFEAF>5</color> total...\nThey should be hiding in various parts of the village.

Array.name: dialog_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_CatchUnlocked_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, Maki gave me a <color=#1DFEAF>Bug Net</color>.\nI think I could catch Seahorses with it.
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, Maki gave me a <color=#1DFEAF>Bug Net</color>.\nI think I could catch Seahorses with it.

Array.name: dialog_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_CatchLocked_001
Array.english: Hmm... Seahorses... They’re too small to catch with a Harpoon...\nI’ll have to think of a way.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Seahorses... They’re too small to catch with a Harpoon...\nI’ll have to think of a way.

Array.name: dialog_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_CatchFail_001
Array.english: Hm…You can't just grab Seahorses with your hands.\nYou need some kind of <color=#1DFEAF>tool</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hm…You can't just grab Seahorses with your hands.\nYou need some kind of <color=#1DFEAF>tool</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Complete_001
Array.english: Well, well... you brought back all the Seahorses.
Array.indonesia: Well, well... you brought back all the Seahorses.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Complete_002
Array.english: They were quite difficult to find.
Array.indonesia: They were quite difficult to find.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen01_CatchSeahorse_Complete_003
Array.english: Heh. We can now resume our <color=#F1DC2B>Seahorse Races</color>.
Array.indonesia: Heh. We can now resume our <color=#F1DC2B>Seahorse Races</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen02_RegistSeahorse_Start_001
Array.english: I’ll give you a <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorse</color> as thanks for your help.
Array.indonesia: I’ll give you a <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorse</color> as thanks for your help.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen02_RegistSeahorse_Start_002
Array.english: Wow! Where can I get one?
Array.indonesia: Wow! Where can I get one?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen02_RegistSeahorse_Start_003
Array.english: Go speak to <color=#F1DC2B>Yami</color>, \nwho you can find in front of the racecourse.
Array.indonesia: Go speak to <color=#F1DC2B>Yami</color>, \nwho you can find in front of the racecourse.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen02_RegistSeahorse_Start_004
Array.english: Hope to see you around in the <color=#1DFEAF>Game Parlor</color>, human.
Array.indonesia: Hope to see you around in the <color=#1DFEAF>Game Parlor</color>, human.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_001
Array.english: You don’t look well...\nIs something wrong?
Array.indonesia: You don’t look well...\nIs something wrong?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_002
Array.english: Oh, human... Um...
Array.indonesia: Oh, human... Um...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_003
Array.english: My cute <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color> has disappeared.
Array.indonesia: My cute <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color> has disappeared.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_004
Array.english: <size=35>Ser... Selgio...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ser... Selgio...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_005
Array.english: Yes... He’s my purple pet squid...\nHe was gone when I woke up... *Sob*
Array.indonesia: Yes... He’s my purple pet squid...\nHe was gone when I woke up... *Sob*

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_006
Array.english: Well, he’s disappeared before...\nHe followed the <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>.
Array.indonesia: Well, he’s disappeared before...\nHe followed the <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_007
Array.english: A <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>...
Array.indonesia: A <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_008
Array.english: Human, can you please find Selgio for me?
Array.indonesia: Human, can you please find Selgio for me?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_009
Array.english: He’s timid, but put this\n<color=#1DFEAF>High-Quality Food</color> nearby when he’s calm to lure him.
Array.indonesia: He’s timid, but put this\n<color=#1DFEAF>High-Quality Food</color> nearby when he’s calm to lure him.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen03_Pet_Squid_Start_010
Array.english: Got it. I’ll try luring him with the food.
Array.indonesia: Got it. I’ll try luring him with the food.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Found_001
Array.english: <size=35>Huh? Is that a <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Huh? Is that a <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Found_002
Array.english: Maybe following the jellyfish will lead us to Linchen’s pet squid.
Array.indonesia: Maybe following the jellyfish will lead us to Linchen’s pet squid.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Arrived_001
Array.english: <size=32>Ah! The jellyfish disappeared from here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Ah! The jellyfish disappeared from here.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Arrived_002
Array.english: Maybe a pet squid might be hiding around here.\nLet’s take a look around.
Array.indonesia: Maybe a pet squid might be hiding around here.\nLet’s take a look around.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_HoleFound_001
Array.english: There’s a small hole here.\nMaybe it’s in here.
Array.indonesia: There’s a small hole here.\nMaybe it’s in here.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_HoleFound_002
Array.english: Let’s try using the flashlight.
Array.indonesia: Let’s try using the flashlight.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_FlashLight_01
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Huh? I think I just saw Linchen’s pet squid!)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Huh? I think I just saw Linchen’s pet squid!)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_FlashLight_02_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(There you are!)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(There you are!)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_FlashLight_02_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Okay. I'm sure it's inside.\nShould I check on it?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Okay. I'm sure it's inside.\nShould I check on it?)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_FlashLight_03
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(It seems to have calmed down a bit.\nLet’s try luring it outside.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(It seems to have calmed down a bit.\nLet’s try luring it outside.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Set_Food_001
Array.english: Let’s try putting the <color=#1DFEAF>High-Quality Food</color>\nhere that Linchen gave us.
Array.indonesia: Let’s try putting the <color=#1DFEAF>High-Quality Food</color>\nhere that Linchen gave us.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Eat_Food_001
Array.english: <size=35>There! I should use the bug net to catch it!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>There! I should use the bug net to catch it!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Caputured_001
Array.english: <size=34>Great. Now let’s take the squid to Linchen.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Great. Now let’s take the squid to Linchen.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ohhh... Selgio!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ohhh... Selgio!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you, human.\nI was afraid I’d never see my pet again…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thank you, human.\nI was afraid I’d never see my pet again…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Complete_003
Array.english: It wasn't easy bringing your pet here.
Array.indonesia: It wasn't easy bringing your pet here.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Complete_004
Array.english: Haha.\nI’ll make sure this never happens again.
Array.indonesia: Haha.\nI’ll make sure this never happens again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Complete_005
Array.english: And here’s another small gift for you...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Selgio’s Portrait</color>.
Array.indonesia: And here’s another small gift for you...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Selgio’s Portrait</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Complete_006
Array.english: Oh... Hm. I’ll hang it up in the restaurant.\nThank you.
Array.indonesia: Oh... Hm. I’ll hang it up in the restaurant.\nThank you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_linchen03_Pet_Squid_Complete_007
Array.english: Haha.\nPlease drop by the Game Parlor from time to time, human.
Array.indonesia: Haha.\nPlease drop by the Game Parlor from time to time, human.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Cough... Cough...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Cough... Cough...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_002
Array.english: Um... Are you not feeling well?
Array.indonesia: Um... Are you not feeling well?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_003
Array.english: <size=33>Human...\nNone of your business... Cough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Human...\nNone of your business... Cough.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_004
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... You look very ill...</size>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Um... You look very ill...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_005
Array.english: <size=33>Should I bring you something like <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Should I bring you something like <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_006
Array.english: Coral Porridge...!\nHow can a human make sea people food...?
Array.indonesia: Coral Porridge...!\nHow can a human make sea people food...?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_007
Array.english: Ramo had asked me to bring this before.
Array.indonesia: Ramo had asked me to bring this before.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_008
Array.english: Lies...\nHumans can’t be trusted.
Array.indonesia: Lies...\nHumans can’t be trusted.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_009
Array.english: Hmm... Well, looks like it’s needed, \nso I’ll ask <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> to make it.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Well, looks like it’s needed, \nso I’ll ask <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> to make it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Start_010
Array.english: <size=32>The ingredients were <color=#1DFEAF>feather coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>lily coral</color>, right?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>The ingredients were <color=#1DFEAF>feather coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>lily coral</color>, right?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_LobbyBoat_001
Array.english: Ah, right. I forgot that I needed Coral Porridge for the sea person at the Workshop.
Array.indonesia: Ah, right. I forgot that I needed Coral Porridge for the sea person at the Workshop.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_LobbyBoat_002
Array.english: All the ingredients have been gathered, so I’ll ask <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> to make it.
Array.indonesia: All the ingredients have been gathered, so I’ll ask <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> to make it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Bancho01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hmm. <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color>.\nSomething I’ve made before.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hmm. <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color>.\nSomething I’ve made before.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Bancho01_002
Array.english: Yes. There’s another sick sea person.\nHere’s the ingredient.
Array.indonesia: Yes. There’s another sick sea person.\nHere’s the ingredient.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Bancho01_003
Array.english: <size=35>Hmm. Alright. Hand it over to me.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hmm. Alright. Hand it over to me.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Bancho02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Here. Hmm... Corals.\nI don't imagine them tasting good.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Here. Hmm... Corals.\nI don't imagine them tasting good.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Bancho02_002
Array.english: <size=33>Thank you, Bancho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Thank you, Bancho!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Bancho02_003
Array.english: Awesome, I can take this to the sea person at the Workshop.
