Array.indonesia: Awesome, I can take this to the sea person at the Workshop.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh... This is...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh... This is...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Complete_002
Array.english: It’s <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color>.\nYou should eat it and rest.
Array.indonesia: It’s <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color>.\nYou should eat it and rest.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Complete_003
Array.english: Hmm... How can a human make our food?
Array.indonesia: Hmm... How can a human make our food?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Complete_004
Array.english: Put it there and go...\nI have to check if it’s poisoned.
Array.indonesia: Put it there and go...\nI have to check if it’s poisoned.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa01_CoralPorridge_Complete_005
Array.english: What an unreasonable sea person...\nWhatever.
Array.indonesia: What an unreasonable sea person...\nWhatever.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_001
Array.english: Hmm.. Uhh...
Array.indonesia: Hmm.. Uhh...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_002
Array.english: <size=36>Yes...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Yes...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_003
Array.english: Umm... I’m feeling a bit better after eating the Coral Porridge...
Array.indonesia: Umm... I’m feeling a bit better after eating the Coral Porridge...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_004
Array.english: By chance...
Array.indonesia: By chance...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_005
Array.english: I was wondering if you could gather <color=#1DFEAF>minerals</color> for me.
Array.indonesia: I was wondering if you could gather <color=#1DFEAF>minerals</color> for me.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_006
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Minerals</color>?\nWhat kind...?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Minerals</color>?\nWhat kind...?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_007
Array.english: It looks like this... I need quite a bit, so are you okay with that?
Array.indonesia: It looks like this... I need quite a bit, so are you okay with that?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_008
Array.english: Umm... This is <color=#F1DC2B>Opal</color>.
Array.indonesia: Umm... This is <color=#F1DC2B>Opal</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_009
Array.english: So, that’s what humans call it.\nIt’s a mineral that’s often used by the sea people to make weapons.
Array.indonesia: So, that’s what humans call it.\nIt’s a mineral that’s often used by the sea people to make weapons.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Start_010
Array.english: Hmm... Okay.\nI think I’ve seen some in the <color=#F1DC2B>deep sea</color>.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Okay.\nI think I’ve seen some in the <color=#F1DC2B>deep sea</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Pickup_001
Array.english: Oh, by the way, you said you needed <color=#F1DC2B>Opal</color> from the Sea People Village Workshop, right?
Array.indonesia: Oh, by the way, you said you needed <color=#F1DC2B>Opal</color> from the Sea People Village Workshop, right?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Pickup_002
Array.english: <size=34>I should stop by later and deliver it.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I should stop by later and deliver it.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Submit_001
Array.english: You brought <color=#F1DC2B>Opal</color>…\nGood. Now just a bit more.
Array.indonesia: You brought <color=#F1DC2B>Opal</color>…\nGood. Now just a bit more.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Submit_002
Array.english: <size=36>…cough</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>…cough</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_001
Array.english: Well, well... You gathered all the ingredients...
Array.indonesia: Well, well... You gathered all the ingredients...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_002
Array.english: I guess I have to thank you... human.
Array.indonesia: I guess I have to thank you... human.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_003
Array.english: Haha, it was nothing really. Are you feeling alright?
Array.indonesia: Haha, it was nothing really. Are you feeling alright?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_004
Array.english: Well... I should be able to prepare for work now.
Array.indonesia: Well... I should be able to prepare for work now.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=34>But...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>But...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_006
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> is needed to smelt minerals.\nThe heat has dissipated because I left it alone for too long.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Divine Tree fruit</color> is needed to smelt minerals.\nThe heat has dissipated because I left it alone for too long.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_007
Array.english: I need to go to the Divine Tree and get some <color=#1DFEAF>fruit</color>...\nI’m still not feeling well enough to do it alone... Cough.
Array.indonesia: I need to go to the Divine Tree and get some <color=#1DFEAF>fruit</color>...\nI’m still not feeling well enough to do it alone... Cough.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_008
Array.english: <size=33>I was hoping you could help me...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I was hoping you could help me...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_009
Array.english: You’re talking about that big tree at the back of the village, right?\nWhat do I need to do?
Array.indonesia: You’re talking about that big tree at the back of the village, right?\nWhat do I need to do?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_010
Array.english: You’re going to help me?\nI’ll guide you... Follow me.
Array.indonesia: You’re going to help me?\nI’ll guide you... Follow me.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_011
Array.english: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself, didn’t I?\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Duwa</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself, didn’t I?\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Duwa</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa02_Mining_Complete_012
Array.english: <size=35>Sure, <color=#F1DC2B>Duwa</color>.\nLet’s go and bring back the Divine Tree fruit!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sure, <color=#F1DC2B>Duwa</color>.\nLet’s go and bring back the Divine Tree fruit!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh... Up close, it’s magnificent...!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh... Up close, it’s magnificent...!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Start_002
Array.english: If it wasn’t for the Divine Tree, us sea people wouldn’t \nhave been able to survive.
Array.indonesia: If it wasn’t for the Divine Tree, us sea people wouldn’t \nhave been able to survive.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Start_003
Array.english: It was thanks to King Long’s sacrifice...\nWe’re forever grateful... Cough...
Array.indonesia: It was thanks to King Long’s sacrifice...\nWe’re forever grateful... Cough...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Start_004
Array.english: <size=35>Anyways...\nLet’s bring back the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Anyways...\nLet’s bring back the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree fruit</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Start_005
Array.english: Pick the Divine Tree fruit...\nAnd put it into this <color=#1DFEAF>basket</color> that I’m holding.
Array.indonesia: Pick the Divine Tree fruit...\nAnd put it into this <color=#1DFEAF>basket</color> that I’m holding.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Start_006
Array.english: My body isn’t fully recovered yet..\nSo I can’t wait for too long.
Array.indonesia: My body isn’t fully recovered yet..\nSo I can’t wait for too long.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Start_007
Array.english: <size=35>Bring me back <color=#F1DC2B>5 fruits</color> in time.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Bring me back <color=#F1DC2B>5 fruits</color> in time.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Start_008
Array.english: Hmm. Pick five Divine Tree fruits and\nput them into the basket, right?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Pick five Divine Tree fruits and\nput them into the basket, right?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Success_001
Array.english: <size=34>Great. This should be enough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Great. This should be enough.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Success_002
Array.english: It’s time to go back to the Workshop.
Array.indonesia: It’s time to go back to the Workshop.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Cough... Cough...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Cough... Cough...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Complete_002
Array.english: I guess I’m not yet well enough to travel...
Array.indonesia: I guess I’m not yet well enough to travel...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Complete_003
Array.english: Anyways... Thank you... human.\nDave, right?
Array.indonesia: Anyways... Thank you... human.\nDave, right?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Complete_004
Array.english: I’ll try opening up the <color=#F1DC2B>Workshop</color> when I recover...\nGive me some time.
Array.indonesia: I’ll try opening up the <color=#F1DC2B>Workshop</color> when I recover...\nGive me some time.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Complete_005
Array.english: Okay, Duwa. I’ll stop by sometimes,\nso please let me know if you need anything!
Array.indonesia: Okay, Duwa. I’ll stop by sometimes,\nso please let me know if you need anything!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa03_DryTree_Complete_006
Array.english: Hah... Alright.
Array.indonesia: Hah... Alright.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=36>Argh! Not again! Darn it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Argh! Not again! Darn it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_002
Array.english: Why are you so angry?
Array.indonesia: Why are you so angry?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_003
Array.english: Junak, that pile of whale poop\nmust have tricked me!
Array.indonesia: Junak, that pile of whale poop\nmust have tricked me!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_004
Array.english: <size=36>My <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>!\nI lost my precious whistle to him!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>My <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>!\nI lost my precious whistle to him!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_005
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_006
Array.english: Yes! The whistle that summons the Beluga\nanywhere in the village!
Array.indonesia: Yes! The whistle that summons the Beluga\nanywhere in the village!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_007
Array.english: I knew I shouldn’t have bet that whistle in the game.\nThat heartless swindler tricked me!
Array.indonesia: I knew I shouldn’t have bet that whistle in the game.\nThat heartless swindler tricked me!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_008
Array.english: <size=37>Human!\nCan you bring it back for me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Human!\nCan you bring it back for me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_009
Array.english: <size=38>Um, me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Um, me?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_010
Array.english: Yes! I have nothing left to bet in the card game.\nI am broke.
Array.indonesia: Yes! I have nothing left to bet in the card game.\nI am broke.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_011
Array.english: Uh, I am not good at cards...
Array.indonesia: Uh, I am not good at cards...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Start_012
Array.english: I will play a couple of games for fun.
Array.indonesia: I will play a couple of games for fun.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Junak_FirstTalk_001
Array.english: <size=38>Beluga Whistle</size>?
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Beluga Whistle</size>?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Junak_FirstTalk_002
Array.english: Haha!\nThe one the foul-tongued lady gave to me?
Array.indonesia: Haha!\nThe one the foul-tongued lady gave to me?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Junak_FirstTalk_003
Array.english: She lost five times straight and went all in.\nShe bet the whistle in the last game.
Array.indonesia: She lost five times straight and went all in.\nShe bet the whistle in the last game.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Junak_FirstTalk_004
Array.english: She looked like she needed it.\nCould you give it back to her?
Array.indonesia: She looked like she needed it.\nCould you give it back to her?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Junak_FirstTalk_005
Array.english: <size=36>Hehe, not for free.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hehe, not for free.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Junak_FirstTalk_006
Array.english: Play cards with me and win. Then I will give it back to the woman.
Array.indonesia: Play cards with me and win. Then I will give it back to the woman.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Junak_FirstTalk_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Quite an annoying dude...)</size>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Quite an annoying dude...)</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Junak_FirstTalk_008
Array.english: Well, if you say so.\nIf I win, you give the whistle back to her.
Array.indonesia: Well, if you say so.\nIf I win, you give the whistle back to her.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Junak_FirstTalk_009
Array.english: Sure, sure.\nLet’s play the game. You need to bet some money.
Array.indonesia: Sure, sure.\nLet’s play the game. You need to bet some money.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_NoMoney_001
Array.english: Oh, are you short on money?\nTalk to me again when you’re ready, hehe.
Array.indonesia: Oh, are you short on money?\nTalk to me again when you’re ready, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_Win_001
Array.english: <size=38>Ha, I can’t believe it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Ha, I can’t believe it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_Win_002
Array.english: I was beaten by a human? This hurts my pride.
Array.indonesia: I was beaten by a human? This hurts my pride.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_Win_003
Array.english: Well, a promise is a promise.
Array.indonesia: Well, a promise is a promise.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_Win_004
Array.english: Take this.\nIt’s the <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>.
Array.indonesia: Take this.\nIt’s the <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_Win_005
Array.english: Give that to the lady over there.
Array.indonesia: Give that to the lady over there.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_Lose_001
Array.english: Hehe, you’re having a wild dream.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, you’re having a wild dream.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_Lose_002
Array.english: I am good anytime. Just bring your purse.
Array.indonesia: I am good anytime. Just bring your purse.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_Waiting_001
Array.english: Junak again?! He wins every time I make a big bet.
Array.indonesia: Junak again?! He wins every time I make a big bet.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_CardGame_Waiting_002
Array.english: Go beat that annoying guy in the game and retrieve my <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>, human!
Array.indonesia: Go beat that annoying guy in the game and retrieve my <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>, human!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=36>Oh, I am impressed, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh, I am impressed, human!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_002
Array.english: Haha, this is it! The <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>!\nWell done.
Array.indonesia: Haha, this is it! The <color=#1DFEAF>Beluga Whistle</color>!\nWell done.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_003
Array.english: Mm, but...
Array.indonesia: Mm, but...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_004
Array.english: But what?
Array.indonesia: But what?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_005
Array.english: You need <color=#F1DC2B>Bei</color> to summon and ride the Beluga.
Array.indonesia: You need <color=#F1DC2B>Bei</color> to summon and ride the Beluga.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_006
Array.english: I went bankrupt playing games with that dude.
Array.indonesia: I went bankrupt playing games with that dude.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=34>Hey, you can have this whistle.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hey, you can have this whistle.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_008
Array.english: What? But I don’t even know how to use it.
Array.indonesia: What? But I don’t even know how to use it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_009
Array.english: Haha, it’s easy.\nYou just blow this whistle anywhere in the village to call the Beluga.
Array.indonesia: Haha, it’s easy.\nYou just blow this whistle anywhere in the village to call the Beluga.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_010
Array.english: Though you will need to pay some <color=#F1DC2B>Bei</color> to ride the Beluga.
Array.indonesia: Though you will need to pay some <color=#F1DC2B>Bei</color> to ride the Beluga.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_011
Array.english: Well, I am sure with your skills, \nyou can easily make money from the Game Parlor, no doubt!
Array.indonesia: Well, I am sure with your skills, \nyou can easily make money from the Game Parlor, no doubt!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Daphne01_Complete_012
Array.english: Hm, I should summon the Beluga when I have to cover a large distance.
Array.indonesia: Hm, I should summon the Beluga when I have to cover a large distance.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Start_001
Array.english: Where did it go?
Array.indonesia: Where did it go?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Start_002
Array.english: What happened, Gumo?
Array.indonesia: What happened, Gumo?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Start_003
Array.english: The manatee's baby...It just suddenly disappeared.
Array.indonesia: The manatee's baby...It just suddenly disappeared.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>Uh oh. that's a big problem…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Uh oh. that's a big problem…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Start_005
Array.english: The manatee's mom is also worried. \nThings are getting out of hand.
Array.indonesia: The manatee's mom is also worried. \nThings are getting out of hand.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Start_006
Array.english: Do you have any ideas?
Array.indonesia: Do you have any ideas?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Start_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Maybe it saw the Beluga, and went to the glacial area…?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Maybe it saw the Beluga, and went to the glacial area…?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Start_008
Array.english: <size=33>There is kind of a suspicious place. \nI'll go check it out!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>There is kind of a suspicious place. \nI'll go check it out!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Start_009
Array.english: Oh…Thank you, human. I will be waiting!
Array.indonesia: Oh…Thank you, human. I will be waiting!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Crying_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh? This crying sound is…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh? This crying sound is…?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Crying_002
Array.english: <size=33>I should go to where the crying sound is coming from.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I should go to where the crying sound is coming from.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Blocked_001
Array.english: There is a sound coming from here.
Array.indonesia: There is a sound coming from here.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Blocked_002
Array.english: It looks like the entrance was blocked after the baby went in.
Array.indonesia: It looks like the entrance was blocked after the baby went in.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Blocked_003
Array.english: Maybe I can break it if I drop <color=#1DFEAF>something heavy</color>?
Array.indonesia: Maybe I can break it if I drop <color=#1DFEAF>something heavy</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_DoorOpen_001
Array.english: <size=34>Alright! It's open!\nLet's go inside!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright! It's open!\nLet's go inside!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Patting_001
Array.english: <size=38>There's a baby manatee in there!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>There's a baby manatee in there!!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Patting_002
Array.english: It looks scared…\nWe need to calm it down.
Array.indonesia: It looks scared…\nWe need to calm it down.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Patting_Success_001
Array.english: <size=33>Okay. It's calmed down a bit.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Okay. It's calmed down a bit.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Patting_Success_002
Array.english: <size=34>Shall we head out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Shall we head out?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Patting_Fail
Array.english: Hm...I'll have to closely watch his reaction while petting him.\nLet's try again.
Array.indonesia: Hm...I'll have to closely watch his reaction while petting him.\nLet's try again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Narwhal_Start_001
Array.english: Oh?…A <color=#1DFEAF>Narwhal</color> came through the opening…!
Array.indonesia: Oh?…A <color=#1DFEAF>Narwhal</color> came through the opening…!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Narwhal_Start_002
Array.english: If I don't take care of it, the baby manatee won't come out….
Array.indonesia: If I don't take care of it, the baby manatee won't come out….

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Narwhal_End_001
Array.english: Phew. Shall we head out?
Array.indonesia: Phew. Shall we head out?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Pobeagle_Start_001
Array.english: <size=33>Ack! There's a shark in here too?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Ack! There's a shark in here too?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Pobeagle_Start_002
Array.english: I think I'm gonna have to take the shark down to to get out of here...
Array.indonesia: I think I'm gonna have to take the shark down to to get out of here...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Pobeagle_End_001
Array.english: <size=33>Okay. I guess we can leave now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Okay. I guess we can leave now?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Complete01_001
Array.english: Do you know how to get back?
Array.indonesia: Do you know how to get back?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Complete01_002
Array.english: <size=32>Get back safely to the village.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Get back safely to the village.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Complete02_001
Array.english: <size=33>Great, it got back safe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Great, it got back safe!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Complete02_002
Array.english: It went all by itself to the glacial area.
Array.indonesia: It went all by itself to the glacial area.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Complete02_003
Array.english: Children, whether human or animal, are full of curiosity.
Array.indonesia: Children, whether human or animal, are full of curiosity.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Complete02_004
Array.english: I'm glad to see the mom is now at ease also.
Array.indonesia: I'm glad to see the mom is now at ease also.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Complete02_005
Array.english: Human, you really have a good sense of smell!
Array.indonesia: Human, you really have a good sense of smell!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Complete02_006
Array.english: ...Well I didn't actually find it with my nose.
Array.indonesia: ...Well I didn't actually find it with my nose.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_Complete02_007
Array.english: Well...anyway. \nHere is something for my gratitude!
Array.indonesia: Well...anyway. \nHere is something for my gratitude!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_CaveBarricade_001
Array.english: Ah! I have to take the baby manatee!
Array.indonesia: Ah! I have to take the baby manatee!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Gumo_Manatee_GumoTalk_001
Array.english: Hm…Where did the baby manatee go?\nThe mom looks sad, doesn't she?
Array.indonesia: Hm…Where did the baby manatee go?\nThe mom looks sad, doesn't she?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Cobra_Talk_001
Array.english: <size=36>The Cucumberholics?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>The Cucumberholics?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Cobra_Talk_002
Array.english: Well, not everyone loves cucumber.
Array.indonesia: Well, not everyone loves cucumber.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Cobra_Talk_003
Array.english: In fact, I don’t like cucumber either.\nI can’t stand the smell.
Array.indonesia: In fact, I don’t like cucumber either.\nI can’t stand the smell.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Cobra_Talk_004
Array.english: There are many recipes that use fresh cucumber!
Array.indonesia: There are many recipes that use fresh cucumber!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Cobra_Talk_005
Array.english: Anyway, they are hosting an event around here?
Array.indonesia: Anyway, they are hosting an event around here?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Cobra_Talk_006
Array.english: <size=36>I need to be prepared to boost revenue that day!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I need to be prepared to boost revenue that day!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Cobra_Talk_007
Array.english: By the way, have I seen any <color=#1DFEAF>Cucumber</color> at the farm?
Array.indonesia: By the way, have I seen any <color=#1DFEAF>Cucumber</color> at the farm?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Cobra_Talk_008
Array.english: I should go ask Otto.
Array.indonesia: I should go ask Otto.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Otto_Complete_001
Array.english: Otto?\nCan you grow <color=#1DFEAF>Cucumber</color> in your patches?
Array.indonesia: Otto?\nCan you grow <color=#1DFEAF>Cucumber</color> in your patches?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Otto_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=36>Cucumber? Why would anyone want to grow something that tastes that horrible?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Cucumber? Why would anyone want to grow something that tastes that horrible?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Otto_Complete_003
Array.english: Cucumber does not taste horrible.\nIt has a fresh after-taste.
Array.indonesia: Cucumber does not taste horrible.\nIt has a fresh after-taste.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Otto_Complete_004
Array.english: I don’t understand.\nIt is neither nutritious nor delicious.
Array.indonesia: I don’t understand.\nIt is neither nutritious nor delicious.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Otto_Complete_005
Array.english: I do have some cucumber seeds though.\nIf you really want them, I will add them to the list.
Array.indonesia: I do have some cucumber seeds though.\nIf you really want them, I will add them to the list.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Bancho_Complete_001
Array.english: Bancho? Do you have recipes that use cucumbers?
Array.indonesia: Bancho? Do you have recipes that use cucumbers?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Bancho_Complete_002
Array.english: Well, I personally don’t like cucumbers, but a chef should be able to deal with any food ingredients given.
Array.indonesia: Well, I personally don’t like cucumbers, but a chef should be able to deal with any food ingredients given.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Bancho_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=36>I know a few recipes.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I know a few recipes.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Bancho_Complete_004
Array.english: Oh, nice! There will be an event hosted by the Cucumberers \nnot far from here.
Array.indonesia: Oh, nice! There will be an event hosted by the Cucumberers \nnot far from here.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Bancho_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=35>That is a strange name for a community.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>That is a strange name for a community.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Bancho_Complete_006
Array.english: Well, I will prepare several cucumber dishes. Add the dishes to the menu when you have the ingredients ready.
Array.indonesia: Well, I will prepare several cucumber dishes. Add the dishes to the menu when you have the ingredients ready.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Cucumber_Bancho_Complete_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I will need to wear a gas mask when cooking cucumber...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(I will need to wear a gas mask when cooking cucumber...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Sir! The picture you took was well received!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Sir! The picture you took was well received!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_002
Array.english: <size=35>Oh, great to hear that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh, great to hear that!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_003
Array.english: I hear my superiors want to assign me another task! \nHaha!
Array.indonesia: I hear my superiors want to assign me another task! \nHaha!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_004
Array.english: <size=33>If I bring them a picture as nice as the previous ones.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>If I bring them a picture as nice as the previous ones.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_005
Array.english: I have an offer for you. Do you want to join me and \ntake a picture that will stand the test of time?
Array.indonesia: I have an offer for you. Do you want to join me and \ntake a picture that will stand the test of time?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_006
Array.english: And what are you planning to take a picture of?
Array.indonesia: And what are you planning to take a picture of?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_007
Array.english: <size=34>Do you know about <color=#F1DC2B>Manta Rays</color>?
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Do you know about <color=#F1DC2B>Manta Rays</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_008
Array.english: Of course. They are one of the largest of their kind!\nI have seen one of those majestic creatures first-hand.
Array.indonesia: Of course. They are one of the largest of their kind!\nI have seen one of those majestic creatures first-hand.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_009
Array.english: Good, I am planning to take a picture of them.\nWhat do ya think?
Array.indonesia: Good, I am planning to take a picture of them.\nWhat do ya think?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_010
Array.english: All right, I am sold.
Array.indonesia: All right, I am sold.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_011
Array.english: <size=37>But...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>But...</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_012
Array.english: But?
Array.indonesia: But?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_013
Array.english: They are nocturnal so we need to move at <color=#1DFEAF>night</color>.
Array.indonesia: They are nocturnal so we need to move at <color=#1DFEAF>night</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_014
Array.english: And we need some <color=#F1DC2B>lure</color> to attract them.
Array.indonesia: And we need some <color=#F1DC2B>lure</color> to attract them.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_015
Array.english: Sir, I will prepare my equipment. \nCould you find a <color=#F1DC2B>lure</color> in the meantime?
Array.indonesia: Sir, I will prepare my equipment. \nCould you find a <color=#F1DC2B>lure</color> in the meantime?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_016
Array.english: Um, I don’t know what Manta Rays feed on.
Array.indonesia: Um, I don’t know what Manta Rays feed on.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_017
Array.english: I am sure you will figure that out in no time.
Array.indonesia: I am sure you will figure that out in no time.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_018
Array.english: I will count on you then.\nTell me when you’ve got the lure.
Array.indonesia: I will count on you then.\nTell me when you’ve got the lure.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_AfterCall_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm, what would Manta Rays feed on?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm, what would Manta Rays feed on?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Start_AfterCall_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><color=#F1DC2B>Ellie</color> is the best when it comes to ecology. \nShould I give her a call?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><color=#F1DC2B>Ellie</color> is the best when it comes to ecology. \nShould I give her a call?</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Start_001
Array.english: Oh, how’s it going?
Array.indonesia: Oh, how’s it going?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Start_002
Array.english: Do you know what Manta Rays feed on?
Array.indonesia: Do you know what Manta Rays feed on?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Start_003
Array.english: Mmm...
Array.indonesia: Mmm...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Start_004
Array.english: <size=34>I know what Manta Rays eat!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I know what Manta Rays eat!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Start_005
Array.english: Oh, really?
Array.indonesia: Oh, really?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Start_006
Array.english: They feed on plankton at night.\nDrop something that <color=#F1DC2B>lures</color> Glowing Plankton at night and they will come.
Array.indonesia: They feed on plankton at night.\nDrop something that <color=#F1DC2B>lures</color> Glowing Plankton at night and they will come.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Start_007
Array.english: And you will need\n<color=#F1DC2B>5 Kelp</color> to lure plankton.
Array.indonesia: And you will need\n<color=#F1DC2B>5 Kelp</color> to lure plankton.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Start_008
Array.english: Huh? It’s made of kelp?
Array.indonesia: Huh? It’s made of kelp?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Start_009
Array.english: Not necessarily. But they will work, too.\nJust bring me some.
Array.indonesia: Not necessarily. But they will work, too.\nJust bring me some.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh?! You got it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh?! You got it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_002
Array.english: Now, input this here…
Array.indonesia: Now, input this here…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=35>Woohoo! Got some Eco Points!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Woohoo! Got some Eco Points!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_004
Array.english: Hey, this has nothing to do with the lure...
Array.indonesia: Hey, this has nothing to do with the lure...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_005
Array.english: Aw, don’t be disappointed yet.
Array.indonesia: Aw, don’t be disappointed yet.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_006
Array.english: <size=35>Tada! The <color=#F1DC2B>Lure Capsule</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Tada! The <color=#F1DC2B>Lure Capsule</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_007
Array.english: <size=36>Oh?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_008
Array.english: Just drop this lure and you will lure all the plankton in the area. It’s made of quality ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Just drop this lure and you will lure all the plankton in the area. It’s made of quality ingredients.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_009
Array.english: Goodbye, then.
Array.indonesia: Goodbye, then.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_EllieTask_Complete_010
Array.english: I got the <color=#F1DC2B>Lure</color> now. I must tell Udo about it.
Array.indonesia: I got the <color=#F1DC2B>Lure</color> now. I must tell Udo about it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Complete_001
Array.english: Ah, this must be the lure for Manta Rays...
Array.indonesia: Ah, this must be the lure for Manta Rays...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Complete_002
Array.english: My mouth is watering!
Array.indonesia: My mouth is watering!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Complete_003
Array.english: I’m kidding.
Array.indonesia: I’m kidding.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Complete_004
Array.english: Anyways, I need to be prepared to take pictures at night.
Array.indonesia: Anyways, I need to be prepared to take pictures at night.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo01_Complete_005
Array.english: I will call you when I am ready, hehe.
Array.indonesia: I will call you when I am ready, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Start_001
Array.english: Sir? I am ready to take pictures of Manta Rays.
Array.indonesia: Sir? I am ready to take pictures of Manta Rays.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Start_002
Array.english: I hired some lighting guys and made them\nset up lighting fixtures at the right places.
Array.indonesia: I hired some lighting guys and made them\nset up lighting fixtures at the right places.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Start_003
Array.english: Oh, you must have spent some money?
Array.indonesia: Oh, you must have spent some money?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Start_004
Array.english: Haha, one can’t pass up an opportunity like this!
Array.indonesia: Haha, one can’t pass up an opportunity like this!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Start_005
Array.english: They told me that the lighting fixtures were set at \na <color=#F1DC2B>depth of 20 meters</color>. Can you please check them out?
Array.indonesia: They told me that the lighting fixtures were set at \na <color=#F1DC2B>depth of 20 meters</color>. Can you please check them out?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Start_006
Array.english: <size=35>I expect awesome pictures, then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I expect awesome pictures, then!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_FindSpotLight_001
Array.english: Those look like lighting fixtures.\nThe sharks must have knocked them down.
Array.indonesia: Those look like lighting fixtures.\nThe sharks must have knocked them down.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_FindSpotLight_002
Array.english: I need to prop them up and connect them again before taking pictures.
Array.indonesia: I need to prop them up and connect them again before taking pictures.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_FixedSpotLight_001
Array.english: Good, it looks better illuminated.
Array.indonesia: Good, it looks better illuminated.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_FixedSpotLight_002
Array.english: I should lure plankton by dropping the <color=#F1DC2B>Lure Capsule</color> \nin the middle.
Array.indonesia: I should lure plankton by dropping the <color=#F1DC2B>Lure Capsule</color> \nin the middle.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_UseBaitCapsule_001
Array.english: Oh, I see glowing worms. They make the scene surreal.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I see glowing worms. They make the scene surreal.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_UseBaitCapsule_002
Array.english: Ah, Manta Rays won’t come if I am here.
Array.indonesia: Ah, Manta Rays won’t come if I am here.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_UseBaitCapsule_003
Array.english: I should hide behind the <color=#1DFEAF>pile of rocks</color> over there until one appears.
Array.indonesia: I should hide behind the <color=#1DFEAF>pile of rocks</color> over there until one appears.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_FindMantaray_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! That is really a Manta Ray!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! That is really a Manta Ray!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_FindMantaray_002
Array.english: I must keep my distance so I don’t scare it off.
Array.indonesia: I must keep my distance so I don’t scare it off.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Fail_TooClose_001
Array.english: Ah, I got too close and the glowing worms dispersed...
Array.indonesia: Ah, I got too close and the glowing worms dispersed...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_PhotoShootSuccess_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good! This is fantastic!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good! This is fantastic!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_PhotoShootSuccess_002
Array.english: I should go up and talk to Udo now.
Array.indonesia: I should go up and talk to Udo now.

Array.name: Side_Udo02_Fail_MantarayGone_001
Array.english: There goes a Manta Ray.
Array.indonesia: There goes a Manta Ray.

Array.name: Side_Udo02_Fail_MantarayGone_002
Array.english: I should try again.
Array.indonesia: I should try again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Complete_001
Array.english: Here, take a look at this picture. What do you think?
Array.indonesia: Here, take a look at this picture. What do you think?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Complete_002
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! This is a Manta Ray!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! This is a Manta Ray!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Complete_003
Array.english: Look how majestic it is...
Array.indonesia: Look how majestic it is...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Complete_004
Array.english: My eyes are teary, you see?
Array.indonesia: My eyes are teary, you see?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Complete_005
Array.english: <size=35>...I’m just kidding.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...I’m just kidding.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Complete_006
Array.english: Our editors will love this picture for sure.
Array.indonesia: Our editors will love this picture for sure.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Complete_007
Array.english: You’re my hero!
Array.indonesia: You’re my hero!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Udo02_Complete_008
Array.english: I will see you again!
Array.indonesia: I will see you again!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Start01_001
Array.english: <size=34>*Coughing*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>*Coughing*</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Start01_002
Array.english: Duwa, your cough seems to have gotten worse. Are you alright?
Array.indonesia: Duwa, your cough seems to have gotten worse. Are you alright?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Start01_003
Array.english: Yes… It's just a cough… I'm feeling much better than I was before.
Array.indonesia: Yes… It's just a cough… I'm feeling much better than I was before.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Start01_004
Array.english: <size=34>*Coughing*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>*Coughing*</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Start01_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He's coughing too much…)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(He's coughing too much…)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Start01_006
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(I should ask Mima if there's any foods that are good for coughs.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(I should ask Mima if there's any foods that are good for coughs.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaTalk_001
Array.english: <size=35>Food that's good for coughs?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Food that's good for coughs?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaTalk_002
Array.english: Yeah. Duwa's coughing has worsened again.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. Duwa's coughing has worsened again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaTalk_003
Array.english: *Sigh* I told him it was too early to start working. Tsk.
Array.indonesia: *Sigh* I told him it was too early to start working. Tsk.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaTalk_004
Array.english: Back when I used to study cooking, I learned that <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crabs</color> are good for coughs.
Array.indonesia: Back when I used to study cooking, I learned that <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crabs</color> are good for coughs.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaTalk_005
Array.english: <size=34><color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crabs</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34><color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crabs</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaTalk_006
Array.english: That's right! <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crabs</color>, haha. The problem is that they dwell in the Glacial Area and live in crevices between rocks.
Array.indonesia: That's right! <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crabs</color>, haha. The problem is that they dwell in the Glacial Area and live in crevices between rocks.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaTalk_007
Array.english: And any record of how to catch them disappeared as the path to the Glacial Area got blocked off.
Array.indonesia: And any record of how to catch them disappeared as the path to the Glacial Area got blocked off.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaTalk_008
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hmm. How to catch a <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color>…)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hmm. How to catch a <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color>…)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaTalk_009
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(<color=#F1DC2B>Otto</color> used to be a diver… Maybe he knows?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(<color=#F1DC2B>Otto</color> used to be a diver… Maybe he knows?)</color>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_001
Array.english: <size=35>Eh? You want to catch a <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color>?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Eh? You want to catch a <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color>?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_002
Array.english: That's right. Apparently they live in crevices, so it's hard to catch them with harpoons or nets.
Array.indonesia: That's right. Apparently they live in crevices, so it's hard to catch them with harpoons or nets.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_003
Array.english: Hahaha! Of course you can't!\nYou'll need a <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Of course you can't!\nYou'll need a <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_004
Array.english: <size=36>A <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>A <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_005
Array.english: Yessiree! You put some bait inside the Crab Trap, place it between some rocks, and crabs or lobsters will walk right in! Hahaha!
Array.indonesia: Yessiree! You put some bait inside the Crab Trap, place it between some rocks, and crabs or lobsters will walk right in! Hahaha!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_006
Array.english: Wow… Then I could catch a <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color> with it…!
Array.indonesia: Wow… Then I could catch a <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color> with it…!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_007
Array.english: Do you have any?
Array.indonesia: Do you have any?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_008
Array.english: I'm retired. Of course I don't have one.
Array.indonesia: I'm retired. Of course I don't have one.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_009
Array.english: But I can make one for you, if you have the materials.
Array.indonesia: But I can make one for you, if you have the materials.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_010
Array.english: Alright. What kind of materials do you need?
Array.indonesia: Alright. What kind of materials do you need?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_011
Array.english: Eh, some Lumber, Scrap Iron, Rope… Ah, and you'll need a <color=#1DFEAF>Tiger Shark Tooth</color> for a good grip!
Array.indonesia: Eh, some Lumber, Scrap Iron, Rope… Ah, and you'll need a <color=#1DFEAF>Tiger Shark Tooth</color> for a good grip!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoTalk_012
Array.english: Hmm, okay. I'll try to get everything for you.
Array.indonesia: Hmm, okay. I'll try to get everything for you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoMat_End_001
Array.english: Good. I gathered everything I need to make a <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>. I should go back to Otto.
Array.indonesia: Good. I gathered everything I need to make a <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>. I should go back to Otto.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoMaking_001
Array.english: Good. You brought all the materials for the <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>.
Array.indonesia: Good. You brought all the materials for the <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_OttoMaking_002
Array.english: Alright, Time to work my magic. Let's see if I still got it!
Array.indonesia: Alright, Time to work my magic. Let's see if I still got it!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Obtained_001
Array.english: <size=34>Woah… So this is a <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Woah… So this is a <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Obtained_002
Array.english: Yessiree. Put it in a crevice where there's a lot of bubbles and wait for a bit.
Array.indonesia: Yessiree. Put it in a crevice where there's a lot of bubbles and wait for a bit.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Obtained_003
Array.english: When it catches a crab, the <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color> will start shaking—you'll know right away.
Array.indonesia: When it catches a crab, the <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color> will start shaking—you'll know right away.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Obtained_004
Array.english: Got it! With this, I can catch <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crabs</color>!
Array.indonesia: Got it! With this, I can catch <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crabs</color>!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Obtained_005
Array.english: Hahaha! Different things live in different areas, so try to put that to good use.
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! Different things live in different areas, so try to put that to good use.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_CrabCaptured_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! I caught a <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright! I caught a <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_CrabCaptured_002
Array.english: I should take it to Mima!
Array.indonesia: I should take it to Mima!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaCrabTalk_001
Array.english: Woah! A <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color>!?\nHow did you get one?
Array.indonesia: Woah! A <color=#1DFEAF>Horsehair Crab</color>!?\nHow did you get one?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaCrabTalk_002
Array.english: I used a Crab Trap. You can lure them into the trap with bait.
Array.indonesia: I used a Crab Trap. You can lure them into the trap with bait.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaCrabTalk_003
Array.english: Yeah, I think I've read about it. Anyway, this is great!
Array.indonesia: Yeah, I think I've read about it. Anyway, this is great!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaCrabTalk_004
Array.english: Horsehair Crab is most delicious and nourishing when steamed.
Array.indonesia: Horsehair Crab is most delicious and nourishing when steamed.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaCrabTalk_005
Array.english: I have a steamer. I can cook it for you in no time, haha!\nHere, allow me.
Array.indonesia: I have a steamer. I can cook it for you in no time, haha!\nHere, allow me.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaCrabTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! You steamed this crab to perfection!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wow! You steamed this crab to perfection!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaCrabTalk02_002
Array.english: It almost makes me want to eat it…
Array.indonesia: It almost makes me want to eat it…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_MimaCrabTalk02_003
Array.english: Haha, make sure you don't! Here, come to the door so I can give it to you.
Array.indonesia: Haha, make sure you don't! Here, come to the door so I can give it to you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_DuwaDoorEntrance_001
Array.english: Here, I packed it up for you.\nPlease give it to <color=#F1DC2B>Duwa</color>.
Array.indonesia: Here, I packed it up for you.\nPlease give it to <color=#F1DC2B>Duwa</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_DuwaDoorEntrance_End_001
Array.english: Duwa should be inside, right?
Array.indonesia: Duwa should be inside, right?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_DuwaDoorEntrance_End_002
Array.english: I should give him some Steamed Horsehair Crab for his coughs.
Array.indonesia: I should give him some Steamed Horsehair Crab for his coughs.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete01_001
Array.english: <size=34>*Coughing*</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>*Coughing*</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete01_002
Array.english: So, that nasty cough still hasn't gone away. Here, why don't you try this?
Array.indonesia: So, that nasty cough still hasn't gone away. Here, why don't you try this?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete01_003
Array.english: Huh? A Steamed Horsehair Crab?\nWhere did you…?
Array.indonesia: Huh? A Steamed Horsehair Crab?\nWhere did you…?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete01_004
Array.english: I caught one in the Glacial Area and gave it to Mima. She cooked a delicious meal out of it.
Array.indonesia: I caught one in the Glacial Area and gave it to Mima. She cooked a delicious meal out of it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete01_005
Array.english: They say it's good for coughing. Try it!
Array.indonesia: They say it's good for coughing. Try it!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete01_006
Array.english: It looks warm and delicious.\nLet me try...
Array.indonesia: It looks warm and delicious.\nLet me try...

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Woah…! I feel stronger!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Woah…! I feel stronger!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete02_002
Array.english: <size=36>I feel like I'm bursting with energy…\nIt's been a long time since I felt this way…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I feel like I'm bursting with energy…\nIt's been a long time since I felt this way…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete02_003
Array.english: I've never seen you so energetic before!\nThank goodness!
Array.indonesia: I've never seen you so energetic before!\nThank goodness!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete02_004
Array.english: Haha… I doubt I'm completely cured. But still, It's given me a good boost.
Array.indonesia: Haha… I doubt I'm completely cured. But still, It's given me a good boost.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete02_005
Array.english: Thanks, Dave. I can't give you much right now, but here, take it.
Array.indonesia: Thanks, Dave. I can't give you much right now, but here, take it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete02_006
Array.english: I wasn't hoping for a reward… But thanks! I'll put it to good use!
Array.indonesia: I wasn't hoping for a reward… But thanks! I'll put it to good use!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete02_007
Array.english: For the sake of everyone who's worried about me, I'll do my best to get my health back.
Array.indonesia: For the sake of everyone who's worried about me, I'll do my best to get my health back.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Doowa_CrabPot_Complete02_008
Array.english: <size=35>Drop by the Workshop anytime.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Drop by the Workshop anytime.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_CrabTrap_Start_001
Array.english: I see bubbles coming from the crevice…!
Array.indonesia: I see bubbles coming from the crevice…!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_CrabTrap_Start_002
Array.english: I should place the <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color> Otto made for me.
Array.indonesia: I should place the <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color> Otto made for me.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_CrabTrap_End_001
Array.english: <size=35>Good, it's ready!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good, it's ready!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_CrabTrap_End_002
Array.english: I should come back later. It'll take some time until something takes the bait.
Array.indonesia: I should come back later. It'll take some time until something takes the bait.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_start01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hmm? I heard a voice.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hmm? I heard a voice.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_start01_002
Array.english: It's coming from inside the cave…
Array.indonesia: It's coming from inside the cave…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_start01_003
Array.english: How do I break through this thick ice?
Array.indonesia: How do I break through this thick ice?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_start01_004
Array.english: I have to pierce it through the middle with something pointy. Otherwise, it won't even crack.
Array.indonesia: I have to pierce it through the middle with something pointy. Otherwise, it won't even crack.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_start01_005
Array.english: Wait… Something pointy?
Array.indonesia: Wait… Something pointy?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_start01_006
Array.english: <size=35>Maybe a <color=#F1DC2B>Narwhal</color> horn?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Maybe a <color=#F1DC2B>Narwhal</color> horn?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_start01_007
Array.english: Should I try luring a narwhal into the wall?
Array.indonesia: Should I try luring a narwhal into the wall?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_restart01_001
Array.english: Hmm. I heard someone calling from the inside.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I heard someone calling from the inside.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_restart01_002
Array.english: I should lure the <size=35><color=#F1DC2B>Narwhal</color> again to break the ice door.
Array.indonesia: I should lure the <size=35><color=#F1DC2B>Narwhal</color> again to break the ice door.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Narwhal_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! This should be enough.\nNow I gotta do my best to avoid it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright! This should be enough.\nNow I gotta do my best to avoid it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Narwhal_Success_001
Array.english: Phew. That was close.
Array.indonesia: Phew. That was close.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Narwhal_Success_002
Array.english: I broke through the ice wall…\nNow, to find the source of that sound.
Array.indonesia: I broke through the ice wall…\nNow, to find the source of that sound.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Enter_001
Array.english: <size=33>Woah…! The current is stronger than I thought…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Woah…! The current is stronger than I thought…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Enter_002
Array.english: I see some obstacles, too. I have to focus and get out of here!
Array.indonesia: I see some obstacles, too. I have to focus and get out of here!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Enter_Barricade_001
Array.english: I gotta look deeper inside! I can't leave now!
Array.indonesia: I gotta look deeper inside! I can't leave now!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_001
Array.english: <size=36>Huh? Tsuchi?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Huh? Tsuchi?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_002
Array.english: Oh…? You're that human from before. What brings you here?
Array.indonesia: Oh…? You're that human from before. What brings you here?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_003
Array.english: I heard a sound coming from inside. Are you trapped?
Array.indonesia: I heard a sound coming from inside. Are you trapped?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_004
Array.english: Yes. I came in here to find some new seaweed with Dona and got trapped here together.
Array.indonesia: Yes. I came in here to find some new seaweed with Dona and got trapped here together.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_005
Array.english: We've been living off of seaweed up until now…\nBut we were just about reaching our limits.
Array.indonesia: We've been living off of seaweed up until now…\nBut we were just about reaching our limits.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_006
Array.english: <size=34>You came to help us! Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You came to help us! Thank you!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_007
Array.english: No… Um… I think I'm trapped here, too…
Array.indonesia: No… Um… I think I'm trapped here, too…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_008
Array.english: <size=38>…! You useless…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>…! You useless…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_009
Array.english: <size=50>…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_010
Array.english: We might be able to get out if we manage to break through this ice wall…\nbut it's too thick.
Array.indonesia: We might be able to get out if we manage to break through this ice wall…\nbut it's too thick.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk01_011
Array.english: Dona would've been able to ram through it, but Dona is in no shape to do so.
Array.indonesia: Dona would've been able to ram through it, but Dona is in no shape to do so.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk02_001
Array.english: <size=36>Hmm? That's…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Hmm? That's…?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk02_002
Array.english: Maybe we can hook a rope to that end and catapult Dona into the wall to break it?
Array.indonesia: Maybe we can hook a rope to that end and catapult Dona into the wall to break it?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk02_003
Array.english: <size=35>Hmm…?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hmm…?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk02_004
Array.english: Sure, Dona's shell is rigid enough to break through the wall, but how do we throw Dona?
Array.indonesia: Sure, Dona's shell is rigid enough to break through the wall, but how do we throw Dona?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk02_005
Array.english: Well… If we tie your clothes together…
Array.indonesia: Well… If we tie your clothes together…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk02_006
Array.english: <size=35>What?! My clothes?!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>What?! My clothes?!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk02_007
Array.english: That's the only way.\nCome on now.
Array.indonesia: That's the only way.\nCome on now.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk02_008
Array.english: <size=36>Eeeek!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Eeeek!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk03_001
Array.english: This will do.
Array.indonesia: This will do.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk03_002
Array.english: <size=34>C-Cold! It's too cold!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>C-Cold! It's too cold!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk03_003
Array.english: Just hold on for a little longer. We can't escape if we do nothing.
Array.indonesia: Just hold on for a little longer. We can't escape if we do nothing.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_CaveTalk03_004
Array.english: Send Dona here. I'll launch Dona into the wall.
Array.indonesia: Send Dona here. I'll launch Dona into the wall.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_IceWallBreak01_001
Array.english: <size=35>Hahaha! That was a success! Good job, Dona!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hahaha! That was a success! Good job, Dona!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_IceWallBreak01_002
Array.english: <size=36>Achoo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Achoo!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_IceWallBreak01_003
Array.english: We can head out through that door!
Array.indonesia: We can head out through that door!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_IceWallBreak02_001
Array.english: Phew… I feel much better now.
Array.indonesia: Phew… I feel much better now.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_IceWallBreak02_002
Array.english: Now, we'll go with you.\nTalk to me when you're ready.
Array.indonesia: Now, we'll go with you.\nTalk to me when you're ready.

Array.name: Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Out_001
Array.english: <size=35>Are you ready to head out?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Are you ready to head out?</size>

Array.name: Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Out_Okay_001
Array.english: I'm ready!
Array.indonesia: I'm ready!

Array.name: Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Out_Cancel_001
Array.english: I need more time
Array.indonesia: I need more time

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Complete_001
Array.english: Phew… You got us out of there safely.
Array.indonesia: Phew… You got us out of there safely.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Complete_002
Array.english: Thank you, human.
Array.indonesia: Thank you, human.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Complete_003
Array.english: <size=34>Take this.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Take this.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Complete_004
Array.english: Hmm? What is this?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? What is this?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Complete_005
Array.english: An <color=#1DFEAF>Ice Pick</color>. You can break thin ice with it.
Array.indonesia: An <color=#1DFEAF>Ice Pick</color>. You can break thin ice with it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Complete_006
Array.english: With this, you should be able to reach small areas blocked off by ice.
Array.indonesia: With this, you should be able to reach small areas blocked off by ice.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Complete_007
Array.english: Oh… I see!
Array.indonesia: Oh… I see!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Complete_008
Array.english: I'm sure it'll come in handy! Thanks, Tsuchi!
Array.indonesia: I'm sure it'll come in handy! Thanks, Tsuchi!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Tsuchi_LockedCave_Complete_009
Array.english: Haha. See you later, human.
Array.indonesia: Haha. See you later, human.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_001
Array.english: Dave…
Array.indonesia: Dave…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_002
Array.english: Is something wrong, Linchen?
Array.indonesia: Is something wrong, Linchen?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_003
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color> ran away again.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color> ran away again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_004
Array.english: <size=36>What? Again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>What? Again?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_005
Array.english: Yes… I think something caught his attention…
Array.indonesia: Yes… I think something caught his attention…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_006
Array.english: Another <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>…?
Array.indonesia: Another <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>…?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_007
Array.english: I think so. I've seen one near the <color=#1DFEAF>Glacial Passage</color>.
Array.indonesia: I think so. I've seen one near the <color=#1DFEAF>Glacial Passage</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_008
Array.english: Dave, I'm sorry to ask you again…\nBut could you look for Selgio?
Array.indonesia: Dave, I'm sorry to ask you again…\nBut could you look for Selgio?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_009
Array.english: If he's hiding somewhere, you can lure him out with some <color=#F1DC2B>feed</color>.
Array.indonesia: If he's hiding somewhere, you can lure him out with some <color=#F1DC2B>feed</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Start_010
Array.english: Okay. I'll search around the <color=#1DFEAF>Glacial Passage</color>.
Array.indonesia: Okay. I'll search around the <color=#1DFEAF>Glacial Passage</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_001
Array.english: <size=34>Huh? A <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Huh? A <color=#F1DC2B>Shining Jellyfish</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_002
Array.english: That looks like something Selgio would like.\nI should follow it!
Array.indonesia: That looks like something Selgio would like.\nI should follow it!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_Timeattack_001
Array.english: It seems like the path collapsed when the giant Gadon woke up.
Array.indonesia: It seems like the path collapsed when the giant Gadon woke up.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_Timeattack_002
Array.english: <size=33>I've come this far. I can't lose it now!\nGotta keep following it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I've come this far. I can't lose it now!\nGotta keep following it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Timeattack_Barricade_001
Array.english: <size=32>I might lose the jelly fish!\nLet's keep after it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>I might lose the jelly fish!\nLet's keep after it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_gone_001
Array.english: Ah… The jellyfish disappeared.
Array.indonesia: Ah… The jellyfish disappeared.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_gone_002
Array.english: Hmm… Why don't I look around the area where it disappeared?
Array.indonesia: Hmm… Why don't I look around the area where it disappeared?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Barricade01_001
Array.english: Selgio's gotta be here. I should look around a bit more.
Array.indonesia: Selgio's gotta be here. I should look around a bit more.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_holefound_001
Array.english: Huh? I just heard something behind the ice.
Array.indonesia: Huh? I just heard something behind the ice.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_holefound_002
Array.english: I think <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color> is hiding behind this sheet of ice…
Array.indonesia: I think <color=#F1DC2B>Selgio</color> is hiding behind this sheet of ice…

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_holefound_003
Array.english: Oh, right! I have the <color=#1DFEAF>Ice Pick</color> Tsuchi gave me!
Array.indonesia: Oh, right! I have the <color=#1DFEAF>Ice Pick</color> Tsuchi gave me!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_holefound_004
Array.english: Stay right there, you little rascal.
Array.indonesia: Stay right there, you little rascal.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_food_start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! I broke the sheet of ice!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright! I broke the sheet of ice!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_food_start_002
Array.english: Now I should use the <color=#F1DC2B>feed</color> Linchen gave me to lure it.
Array.indonesia: Now I should use the <color=#F1DC2B>feed</color> Linchen gave me to lure it.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_capture_01_001
Array.english: Alright! Selgio came out!\nNow, time to capture it with a butterfly net!
Array.indonesia: Alright! Selgio came out!\nNow, time to capture it with a butterfly net!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_capture_02_001
Array.english: Selgio sure is fearless, considering it came all the way here.
Array.indonesia: Selgio sure is fearless, considering it came all the way here.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_capture_02_002
Array.english: I should go see Linchen now.
Array.indonesia: I should go see Linchen now.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete01_001
Array.english: Huh? Linchen, what brings you here?
Array.indonesia: Huh? Linchen, what brings you here?

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete01_002
Array.english: I was so worried about Selgio, I couldn't stay inside…\nYou found him!
Array.indonesia: I was so worried about Selgio, I couldn't stay inside…\nYou found him!

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete01_003
Array.english: Come here, Selgio.
Array.indonesia: Come here, Selgio.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete02_001
Array.english: Dave, I owe you again.
Array.indonesia: Dave, I owe you again.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete02_002
Array.english: Haha, not at all.\nI hope Selgio doesn't cause any more trouble.
Array.indonesia: Haha, not at all.\nI hope Selgio doesn't cause any more trouble.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete02_003
Array.english: *Giggles* Come visit the <color=#F1DC2B>Game Parlor</color> later. I have a small reward for you.
Array.indonesia: *Giggles* Come visit the <color=#F1DC2B>Game Parlor</color> later. I have a small reward for you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_complete02_004
Array.english: I'll be on my way, then.\nTake care, Dave.
Array.indonesia: I'll be on my way, then.\nTake care, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_001
Array.english: Dave, you're here.
Array.indonesia: Dave, you're here.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_002
Array.english: Thank you for saving Selgio.
Array.indonesia: Thank you for saving Selgio.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_003
Array.english: It seems he likes to wander around when there's no one watching him.
Array.indonesia: It seems he likes to wander around when there's no one watching him.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_004
Array.english: *Giggle* This is a small gift for you.
Array.indonesia: *Giggle* This is a small gift for you.

Array.name: dialog_Side_Linchen04_Pet_Squid_Jellyfish_reward01_005
Array.english: Here's to our friendship, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Here's to our friendship, Dave.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_GetMail_001
Array.english: <size=33>Huh? Some kind of mail is here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh? Some kind of mail is here.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_GetMail_002
Array.english: <size=33>Should I check it...?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Should I check it...?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh! A party!\nWhat a nice looking picture, pwhahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh! A party!\nWhat a nice looking picture, pwhahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_002
Array.english: I guess they’re trying to open this place for tourism.\nI just hope it doesn’t get too chaotic.
Array.indonesia: I guess they’re trying to open this place for tourism.\nI just hope it doesn’t get too chaotic.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_003
Array.english: Well, it’s a party held on a special day.\nWe just need to prepare for more customers!
Array.indonesia: Well, it’s a party held on a special day.\nWe just need to prepare for more customers!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_004
Array.english: The mail said the party’s theme was jellyfish.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Jellyfish</color> dishes should be popular!
Array.indonesia: The mail said the party’s theme was jellyfish.\n<color=#F1DC2B>Jellyfish</color> dishes should be popular!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_005
Array.english: <size=33>It’s <runtime_info type=next_moon_date value=HalfMoon/>... so we have <color=#1DFEAF>3 days</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It’s <runtime_info type=next_moon_date value=HalfMoon/>... so we have <color=#1DFEAF>3 days</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SushiBarEvent_Start_006
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! Make sure to prepare some <color=#F1DC2B>jellyfish</color>, \nwhatever kind it may be. Let’s hit the jackpot!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! Make sure to prepare some <color=#F1DC2B>jellyfish</color>, \nwhatever kind it may be. Let’s hit the jackpot!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Start_001
Array.english: <size=38>Oh my! You’re the human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Oh my! You’re the human!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Start_002
Array.english: I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Yami</color>.\nI’m in charge of this Seahorse Racecourse, hehe.
Array.indonesia: I’m <color=#F1DC2B>Yami</color>.\nI’m in charge of this Seahorse Racecourse, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Start_003
Array.english: *Sigh* I heard you caught all the Seahorses that ran off...\nThank you so much for that.
Array.indonesia: *Sigh* I heard you caught all the Seahorses that ran off...\nThank you so much for that.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Start_004
Array.english: I heard from Linchen already. \nWe’ll give you a nice, strong Sea Horse as a gift for your efforts!
Array.indonesia: I heard from Linchen already. \nWe’ll give you a nice, strong Sea Horse as a gift for your efforts!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_AfterReceive_001
Array.english: Wow... I’ve seen many Seahorses like this elsewhere as well.\nCan they also race here?
Array.indonesia: Wow... I’ve seen many Seahorses like this elsewhere as well.\nCan they also race here?

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_AfterReceive_002
Array.english: <size=34>Of course!\nBring them to me and I’ll register them for the races.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Of course!\nBring them to me and I’ll register them for the races.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_AfterReceive_003
Array.english: <size=36>Since you’re here, why don’t you try registering\nyour new Seahorse?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Since you’re here, why don’t you try registering\nyour new Seahorse?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_AfterReceive_004
Array.english: <size=40>Select the <color=#1DFEAF>Register</color> menu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Select the <color=#1DFEAF>Register</color> menu.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Register_001
Array.english: Hehe! This is where you can <color=#1DFEAF>Register</color>\nSeahorses you’ve caught for the races.
Array.indonesia: Hehe! This is where you can <color=#1DFEAF>Register</color>\nSeahorses you’ve caught for the races.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Register_002
Array.english: <size=40>Why don’t you try it out right now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Why don’t you try it out right now?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Register_Done_001
Array.english: Good.\nNext, select the <color=#1DFEAF>Race</color> menu to get ready to race!
Array.indonesia: Good.\nNext, select the <color=#1DFEAF>Race</color> menu to get ready to race!

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Management_001
Array.english: This is where you can check on the growth of your Seahorses.
Array.indonesia: This is where you can check on the growth of your Seahorses.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Management_002
Array.english: Seahorses that have grown fully can be used as <color=#1DFEAF>Coaches</color>.\nYou don’t have any grown ones yet, so check back later. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Seahorses that have grown fully can be used as <color=#1DFEAF>Coaches</color>.\nYou don’t have any grown ones yet, so check back later. Hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Management_003
Array.english: Now then, let’s get started with a race.\nPlease go to <color=#1DFEAF>Race</color>.
Array.indonesia: Now then, let’s get started with a race.\nPlease go to <color=#1DFEAF>Race</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_01_001
