Array.english: This is where you can select the course and begin a race.\nSince you’re new to this...
Array.indonesia: This is where you can select the course and begin a race.\nSince you’re new to this...

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_01_002
Array.english: <size=36>I suggest selecting <color=#1DFEAF>Course C</color> for starters.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I suggest selecting <color=#1DFEAF>Course C</color> for starters.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_02_001
Array.english: <size=36>We’ll select <color=#1DFEAF>General</color> now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>We’ll select <color=#1DFEAF>General</color> now.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_03_001
Array.english: This is where you can see the participants\nand check who you’re up against. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: This is where you can see the participants\nand check who you’re up against. Hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_03_002
Array.english: <size=34>Now then, shall we select a <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorse</color> for the race?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Now then, shall we select a <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorse</color> for the race?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_04_001
Array.english: This is where you can select one of\nthe <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorses</color> you’ve registered.
Array.indonesia: This is where you can select one of\nthe <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorses</color> you’ve registered.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_04_002
Array.english: Oh, the seahorses’ <color=#1DFEAF>stamina</color> is really important!\nAlways make sure to check the arrow on the right.
Array.indonesia: Oh, the seahorses’ <color=#1DFEAF>stamina</color> is really important!\nAlways make sure to check the arrow on the right.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_04_003
Array.english: Once seahorses race, they need to rest to recover their <color=#1DFEAF>stamina</color>.\nYou should have several seahorses ready for the race.
Array.indonesia: Once seahorses race, they need to rest to recover their <color=#1DFEAF>stamina</color>.\nYou should have several seahorses ready for the race.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_04_004
Array.english: <size=40>Let’s go with this one for now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Let’s go with this one for now.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_05_001
Array.english: This is where you can select their <color=#1DFEAF>Food</color>.
Array.indonesia: This is where you can select their <color=#1DFEAF>Food</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_05_002
Array.english: If you’d like to enhance the performance\nof your Seahorses, it’s crucial you provide them with good food.
Array.indonesia: If you’d like to enhance the performance\nof your Seahorses, it’s crucial you provide them with good food.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_05_003
Array.english: As with anything in this world...\nThe more expensive it is, the better the quality, hehe.
Array.indonesia: As with anything in this world...\nThe more expensive it is, the better the quality, hehe.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Play_06_001
Array.english: <size=40>Looks like you’re all set.\nLet’s get started!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Looks like you’re all set.\nLet’s get started!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Result_01_001
Array.english: <size=38>Wow! That’s impressive for your first race!\nI knew you had potential!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Wow! That’s impressive for your first race!\nI knew you had potential!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Result_02_001
Array.english: Oh dear... I must not have provided an adequate explanation.\nDon’t worry, everyone starts off like this.
Array.indonesia: Oh dear... I must not have provided an adequate explanation.\nDon’t worry, everyone starts off like this.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Result_linked_001
Array.english: Raise your Seahorse well, since their abilities grow\nas they themselves do.
Array.indonesia: Raise your Seahorse well, since their abilities grow\nas they themselves do.

Array.name: dialog_Tutorial_SeahorseRacing_Result_linked_002
Array.english: <size=38>Don’t forget to try out\nmore courses, either! Hehe.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Don’t forget to try out\nmore courses, either! Hehe.</size>

Array.name: dialog_SeahorseRacing_Yami_Talk_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh you're back, Human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh you're back, Human!</size>

Array.name: dialog_SeahorseRacing_Yami_Talk_002
Array.english: <size=33>Get ready for some exciting Seahorse racing!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Get ready for some exciting Seahorse racing!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Common_InGame_WrongWay
Array.english: This doesn’t seem to be the right way.
Array.indonesia: This doesn’t seem to be the right way.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Not_answering_01
Array.english: Hmm... not picking up.
Array.indonesia: Hmm... not picking up.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff01_001
Array.english: What is it?.\nI’m kind of busy right now with research.
Array.indonesia: What is it?.\nI’m kind of busy right now with research.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff01_002
Array.english: I hear a TV in the background, though...
Array.indonesia: I hear a TV in the background, though...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff01_003
Array.english: Y-you’re breaking up.\nSee you, then. <color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: Y-you’re breaking up.\nSee you, then. <color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff02_001
Array.english: <color=#ff61e3>Master. A new task has arrived.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#ff61e3>Master. A new task has arrived.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff02_002
Array.english: What was that?
Array.indonesia: What was that?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff02_003
Array.english: Whoops. That was my phone going off...\nI-it’s nothing. I’m hanging up now.
Array.indonesia: Whoops. That was my phone going off...\nI-it’s nothing. I’m hanging up now.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff03_001
Array.english: Dave, have you been collecting gun materials?
Array.indonesia: Dave, have you been collecting gun materials?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff03_002
Array.english: Yeah, whatever I can get my hands on…
Array.indonesia: Yeah, whatever I can get my hands on…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff03_003
Array.english: You can't just collect anything.\nYou can collect new materials in the Sea People Village, can't you?
Array.indonesia: You can't just collect anything.\nYou can collect new materials in the Sea People Village, can't you?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff03_004
Array.english: <size=34>See if you can get anything from there.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>See if you can get anything from there.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff04_001
Array.english: I couldn't go to the last meeting because I had some important parcel deli—I mean, important work to do.
Array.indonesia: I couldn't go to the last meeting because I had some important parcel deli—I mean, important work to do.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff04_002
Array.english: But I kind of regret not going.
Array.indonesia: But I kind of regret not going.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff04_003
Array.english: I'll drop by if there's another get-together.
Array.indonesia: I'll drop by if there's another get-together.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Duff04_004
Array.english: <size=33>Until then.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Until then.\n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra01_001
Array.english: What’s the point of calling when you’re so close! It’s a waste of phone fees!\nTalk to me in person.
Array.indonesia: What’s the point of calling when you’re so close! It’s a waste of phone fees!\nTalk to me in person.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra01_002
Array.english: <size=36>Oh... okay.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh... okay.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra02_001
Array.english: Hmm? Dave, you're not on the boat. Where are you?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Dave, you're not on the boat. Where are you?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra02_002
Array.english: I'm nearby—
Array.indonesia: I'm nearby—

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Cobra02_003
Array.english: <size=33>Okay. Let me know if you need me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Okay. Let me know if you need me!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon01_001
Array.english: What is it?\nDid you discover something new?
Array.indonesia: What is it?\nDid you discover something new?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon01_002
Array.english: That’s not it...
Array.indonesia: That’s not it...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon01_003
Array.english: I see...\nTell me if you see anything peculiar, whatever it may be!
Array.indonesia: I see...\nTell me if you see anything peculiar, whatever it may be!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_001
Array.english: There must be a reason we’re finding traces of the Sea People civilization here when they could be found nowhere else.
Array.indonesia: There must be a reason we’re finding traces of the Sea People civilization here when they could be found nowhere else.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_002
Array.english: What reason? Do you have any ideas?
Array.indonesia: What reason? Do you have any ideas?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_003
Array.english: I’m wondering if this Giant Blue Hole\nis somehow closely linked to their civilization.
Array.indonesia: I’m wondering if this Giant Blue Hole\nis somehow closely linked to their civilization.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_004
Array.english: But as they’re expected to have lived very deep under the sea,\nit’s difficult to conduct a detailed investigation with what we have right now.
Array.indonesia: But as they’re expected to have lived very deep under the sea,\nit’s difficult to conduct a detailed investigation with what we have right now.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon02_005
Array.english: Keep up the good work, Dave!
Array.indonesia: Keep up the good work, Dave!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_001
Array.english: You've actually been to the Sea People Village… Man, I'm so jealous.
Array.indonesia: You've actually been to the Sea People Village… Man, I'm so jealous.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_002
Array.english: You know, I've always been afraid of diving, but seeing you, I'm tempted to learn it.
Array.indonesia: You know, I've always been afraid of diving, but seeing you, I'm tempted to learn it.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_003
Array.english: Give it a try! I'll teach you.
Array.indonesia: Give it a try! I'll teach you.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_004
Array.english: <size=40>…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bacon03_005
Array.english: …Let me think about it a bit more. Haha!
Array.indonesia: …Let me think about it a bit more. Haha!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho01_001
Array.english: What is it?\nDo you want to learn to cook, perhaps...
Array.indonesia: What is it?\nDo you want to learn to cook, perhaps...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho01_002
Array.english: No, I just came to see if you needed any particular ingredients.
Array.indonesia: No, I just came to see if you needed any particular ingredients.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho01_003
Array.english: A master chef can cook with any ingredient.\nI’ll show you the best food possible, regardless of what you bring me.
Array.indonesia: A master chef can cook with any ingredient.\nI’ll show you the best food possible, regardless of what you bring me.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho01_004
Array.english: Just bring me lots of it.
Array.indonesia: Just bring me lots of it.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho02_001
Array.english: It was a unique experience to cook something as exotic as Giant Squid.
Array.indonesia: It was a unique experience to cook something as exotic as Giant Squid.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho02_002
Array.english: Make sure to bring me the ingredients if you defeat another giant creature.
Array.indonesia: Make sure to bring me the ingredients if you defeat another giant creature.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho02_003
Array.english: I will. I'm curious what you'll cook up with it.
Array.indonesia: I will. I'm curious what you'll cook up with it.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_001
Array.english: Dave, are you giving enough attention to the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> ?
Array.indonesia: Dave, are you giving enough attention to the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> ?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_002
Array.english: What? O-Of course!
Array.indonesia: What? O-Of course!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_003
Array.english: Then why does my question surprise you?
Array.indonesia: Then why does my question surprise you?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_004
Array.english: Well, I never expected you to care enough about the branch to ask.
Array.indonesia: Well, I never expected you to care enough about the branch to ask.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_005
Array.english: The place has my name on it. Of course I care.
Array.indonesia: The place has my name on it. Of course I care.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_006
Array.english: I can't go to each branch, so please take care of them and keep our customers satisfied.
Array.indonesia: I can't go to each branch, so please take care of them and keep our customers satisfied.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Bancho03_007
Array.english: Yes. I will.
Array.indonesia: Yes. I will.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto01_001
Array.english: The farming’s going well, don’t worry.
Array.indonesia: The farming’s going well, don’t worry.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto01_002
Array.english: You still have to drop by regularly\nand pull out the weeds!
Array.indonesia: You still have to drop by regularly\nand pull out the weeds!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto01_003
Array.english: Okay, okay. I’ll come by sometime.
Array.indonesia: Okay, okay. I’ll come by sometime.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_001
Array.english: Hmm? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? What is it?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_002
Array.english: I'm just calling to see if everything is alright.
Array.indonesia: I'm just calling to see if everything is alright.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_003
Array.english: Hahaha! You were bored, I see!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! You were bored, I see!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_004
Array.english: Speaking of boredom…
Array.indonesia: Speaking of boredom…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_005
Array.english: When I was 12… No, 13? I was playing ball with my friends at the beach.
Array.indonesia: When I was 12… No, 13? I was playing ball with my friends at the beach.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_006
Array.english: <size=34>But out of nowhere, a seagull snatched the ball and dropped it into the ocean!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>But out of nowhere, a seagull snatched the ball and dropped it into the ocean!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_007
Array.english: We didn't know what to do, and that was when my friend's father dove into the ocean and got the ball for us.
Array.indonesia: We didn't know what to do, and that was when my friend's father dove into the ocean and got the ball for us.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_008
Array.english: I decided to become a diver in that very moment!\nAnd I started training like there's no tomorrow!
Array.indonesia: I decided to become a diver in that very moment!\nAnd I started training like there's no tomorrow!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_009
Array.english: Did I mention what kind of training I did?
Array.indonesia: Did I mention what kind of training I did?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_010
Array.english: …Ah, you did. Hahaha. Of course I know about it!
Array.indonesia: …Ah, you did. Hahaha. Of course I know about it!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto02_011
Array.english: Hahaha! I see. Very well.\nCall me again whenever you're bored!
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! I see. Very well.\nCall me again whenever you're bored!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_001
Array.english: Haha. I thought I'd never see Sammy again, but here we are, running a farm together.
Array.indonesia: Haha. I thought I'd never see Sammy again, but here we are, running a farm together.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_002
Array.english: I'm glad you two could meet again.
Array.indonesia: I'm glad you two could meet again.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_003
Array.english: I wish I could talk with Sammy about the ol' days…
Array.indonesia: I wish I could talk with Sammy about the ol' days…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_004
Array.english: But after talking for a few days…\nHe went back to making music again and now we barely talk.
Array.indonesia: But after talking for a few days…\nHe went back to making music again and now we barely talk.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_005
Array.english: I still have so much to tell him… *sob*
Array.indonesia: I still have so much to tell him… *sob*

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_006
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Um… I think I know why.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Um… I think I know why.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_007
Array.english: How about you take it one small conversation at a time…?
Array.indonesia: How about you take it one small conversation at a time…?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_008
Array.english: Hmm? But wouldn't Sammy find that frustrating?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? But wouldn't Sammy find that frustrating?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_009
Array.english: …I'm sure he won't mind. Besides, it's easier to remember things that way.
Array.indonesia: …I'm sure he won't mind. Besides, it's easier to remember things that way.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Otto03_010
Array.english: You got a point. I'll give it a try.
Array.indonesia: You got a point. I'll give it a try.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_001
Array.english: Oh! Dave!\nI’m currently in the middle of some fierce soccer practice!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Dave!\nI’m currently in the middle of some fierce soccer practice!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_002
Array.english: My condition’s slowly improving!
Array.indonesia: My condition’s slowly improving!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_003
Array.english: That’s good.\nDon’t kick your ball into the water again.
Array.indonesia: That’s good.\nDon’t kick your ball into the water again.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_004
Array.english: No worries!\nI have you, Dave, my ami-go!
Array.indonesia: No worries!\nI have you, Dave, my ami-go!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Jose01_005
Array.english: Oh... Is that right...
Array.indonesia: Oh... Is that right...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie01_001
Array.english: What is it?\nI’m at the library right now.
Array.indonesia: What is it?\nI’m at the library right now.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie01_002
Array.english: Calling me so suddenly...\nWhere are your manners!?
Array.indonesia: Calling me so suddenly...\nWhere are your manners!?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie01_003
Array.english: <size=43><color=#C3C3C3>*Click*</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43><color=#C3C3C3>*Click*</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_001
Array.english: Haha! Ellie, I reached the maximum level in Ecowatcher, too!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Ellie, I reached the maximum level in Ecowatcher, too!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_002
Array.english: Woah, you did?
Array.indonesia: Woah, you did?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_003
Array.english: Then did you get a tote bag with your face printed on it?
Array.indonesia: Then did you get a tote bag with your face printed on it?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_004
Array.english: <size=34>Sure did! Here, look.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sure did! Here, look.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Huh… So you really did it. I have to admit, you're one of us now.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Huh… So you really did it. I have to admit, you're one of us now.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_006
Array.english: But with you…
Array.indonesia: But with you…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_007
Array.english: <size=34>I think you look better on the tote bag.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I think you look better on the tote bag.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_008
Array.english: <size=34>What's that supposed to mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What's that supposed to mean?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie02_009
Array.english: Haha! Nothing.\nAnyway, congratulations!
Array.indonesia: Haha! Nothing.\nAnyway, congratulations!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_001
Array.english: Dave, do you have any plans for all of us to meet up again?
Array.indonesia: Dave, do you have any plans for all of us to meet up again?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_002
Array.english: Hmm? No, not yet. Why?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? No, not yet. Why?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_003
Array.english: Oh, because that day was a lot of fun.
Array.indonesia: Oh, because that day was a lot of fun.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_004
Array.english: All I do is read and research all day… It was fun to be around people.
Array.indonesia: All I do is read and research all day… It was fun to be around people.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_005
Array.english: I get it. It felt nice to hang around with people without a care in the world.
Array.indonesia: I get it. It felt nice to hang around with people without a care in the world.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_006
Array.english: Alright, I'll set up another get-together.
Array.indonesia: Alright, I'll set up another get-together.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_007
Array.english: I'm just a poor student, so…\nYou're buying, right? Thanks!
Array.indonesia: I'm just a poor student, so…\nYou're buying, right? Thanks!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Ellie03_008
Array.english: Umm… Yeah.
Array.indonesia: Umm… Yeah.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie01_001
Array.english: Dave! Don’t just leave work to the staff.\nYou need to lead by example.
Array.indonesia: Dave! Don’t just leave work to the staff.\nYou need to lead by example.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie01_002
Array.english: Don’t forget, a serving job means they’ll see you as the face of the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Don’t forget, a serving job means they’ll see you as the face of the restaurant.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie01_003
Array.english: Okay, okay.
Array.indonesia: Okay, okay.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_001
Array.english: Is something the matter, Dave?
Array.indonesia: Is something the matter, Dave?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_002
Array.english: Oh… Nothing. I just wanted to thank you for telling me about Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Oh… Nothing. I just wanted to thank you for telling me about Bancho.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_003
Array.english: Heh… Sure you did.\nI've been meaning to talk to you as well.
Array.indonesia: Heh… Sure you did.\nI've been meaning to talk to you as well.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_004
Array.english: Bancho has changed a lot since then.
Array.indonesia: Bancho has changed a lot since then.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_005
Array.english: Of course, he's still a stubborn man.\nBut he learned how to get along with others.
Array.indonesia: Of course, he's still a stubborn man.\nBut he learned how to get along with others.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_006
Array.english: <size=34>And it's all thanks to people like you, Dave.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And it's all thanks to people like you, Dave.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_007
Array.english: Haha, you're making me blush. You know, it's a lot of fun, running a restaurant with Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Haha, you're making me blush. You know, it's a lot of fun, running a restaurant with Bancho.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_008
Array.english: Haha. It's strange how you two get along even though you're so different from each other.
Array.indonesia: Haha. It's strange how you two get along even though you're so different from each other.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie02_009
Array.english: Please keep it up, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Please keep it up, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_001
Array.english: Hm. I was just thinking of calling you.
Array.indonesia: Hm. I was just thinking of calling you.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_002
Array.english: Really? What did you want to talk about?
Array.indonesia: Really? What did you want to talk about?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_003
Array.english: The restaurant <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>. I was wondering if you've been managing it well.
Array.indonesia: The restaurant <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>. I was wondering if you've been managing it well.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_004
Array.english: As you already know, the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> is run by employees and employees only. You have to tell them exactly what to do.
Array.indonesia: As you already know, the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> is run by employees and employees only. You have to tell them exactly what to do.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_005
Array.english: It's important to assign the right employees, but how you manage the branch will also affect your revenue.
Array.indonesia: It's important to assign the right employees, but how you manage the branch will also affect your revenue.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_006
Array.english: Right. I have to go to the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> myself and give instructions, right?
Array.indonesia: Right. I have to go to the <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color> myself and give instructions, right?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Yoshie03_007
Array.english: Yes. You're running multiple restaurants now, Dave. Always take good care of them.
Array.indonesia: Yes. You're running multiple restaurants now, Dave. Always take good care of them.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent01_001
Array.english: Hmm? What is it? What happened?
Array.indonesia: Hmm? What is it? What happened?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent01_002
Array.english: I’m busy with all the filming.\nText me.
Array.indonesia: I’m busy with all the filming.\nText me.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_001
Array.english: What is it? We're about to film so make it quick.
Array.indonesia: What is it? We're about to film so make it quick.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_002
Array.english: Oh… I'm just calling to say hi.
Array.indonesia: Oh… I'm just calling to say hi.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_003
Array.english: Tsk… Boring. Just keep diving, will you?
Array.indonesia: Tsk… Boring. Just keep diving, will you?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_004
Array.english: <size=33>By the way, I'm considering you as the face of a new TV show I'm thinking of.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>By the way, I'm considering you as the face of a new TV show I'm thinking of.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_005
Array.english: <size=36>What…!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>What…!?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_006
Array.english: <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆The Diver</color>… How does it sound? Doesn't it sound fun?
Array.indonesia: <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆The Diver</color>… How does it sound? Doesn't it sound fun?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_007
Array.english: <size=35>…I-I'm not ready yet… I don't even know how to sign an autograph…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>…I-I'm not ready yet… I don't even know how to sign an autograph…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_008
Array.english: Hahaha! I'm joking. Stop worrying and help Bancho, alright?
Array.indonesia: Hahaha! I'm joking. Stop worrying and help Bancho, alright?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent02_009
Array.english: <size=36>…Umm.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>…Umm.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_001
Array.english: This is Vincent speaking. Oh, it’s you. What’s up?
Array.indonesia: This is Vincent speaking. Oh, it’s you. What’s up?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_002
Array.english: You told to me to call you if I want a rematch...
Array.indonesia: You told to me to call you if I want a rematch...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_003
Array.english: Oh, of course.\nAre you ready for another match?
Array.indonesia: Oh, of course.\nAre you ready for another match?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_004
Array.english: You know the rules. I will give you <color=#1DFEAF>three days</color> to prepare.\nI will see you at your place.
Array.indonesia: You know the rules. I will give you <color=#1DFEAF>three days</color> to prepare.\nI will see you at your place.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Vincent_BattleVIP_005
Array.english: Make sure that you are ready this time, all right?
Array.indonesia: Make sure that you are ready this time, all right?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Ho!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ho!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_002
Array.english: What is it?
Array.indonesia: What is it?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_003
Array.english: Ah, just calling. How's your Marinca collection going?
Array.indonesia: Ah, just calling. How's your Marinca collection going?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_004
Array.english: Very well! In fact, I completed my deep sea collection not too long ago. Haha!
Array.indonesia: Very well! In fact, I completed my deep sea collection not too long ago. Haha!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_005
Array.english: Woah… That's amazing! I still have lots to do.
Array.indonesia: Woah… That's amazing! I still have lots to do.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_006
Array.english: The key is to always catch new fish if you come across one.
Array.indonesia: The key is to always catch new fish if you come across one.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_007
Array.english: By the way, how do you collect them? You don't even dive.
Array.indonesia: By the way, how do you collect them? You don't even dive.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_008
Array.english: <size=50>…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato01_009
Array.english: <size=34>Try harder! Chuchu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Try harder! Chuchu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_001
Array.english: <size=34>GGGYAO!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>GGGYAO!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_002
Array.english: Were you playing <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color> Sato?
Array.indonesia: Were you playing <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color> Sato?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_003
Array.english: I was in the middle of a minigame, but you interrupted it with your call…
Array.indonesia: I was in the middle of a minigame, but you interrupted it with your call…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_004
Array.english: Oh… Sorry for interrupting.
Array.indonesia: Oh… Sorry for interrupting.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_005
Array.english: I'm sorry, my Ribbon Eel, my Josephine…
Array.indonesia: I'm sorry, my Ribbon Eel, my Josephine…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_006
Array.english: …You give them names?
Array.indonesia: …You give them names?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_007
Array.english: Of course! I get so attached to them once I name them, it breaks my heart whenever I have to revive them.
Array.indonesia: Of course! I get so attached to them once I name them, it breaks my heart whenever I have to revive them.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_008
Array.english: I'm amazed at how you're so passionate about everything you do.
Array.indonesia: I'm amazed at how you're so passionate about everything you do.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_009
Array.english: Heh. A true collector always plays their games with everything they've got.
Array.indonesia: Heh. A true collector always plays their games with everything they've got.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_010
Array.english: Josephine calls. I have to go now.
Array.indonesia: Josephine calls. I have to go now.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato02_011
Array.english: Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: Chuchu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_001
Array.english: The legendary monster of Blue Hole…
Array.indonesia: The legendary monster of Blue Hole…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_002
Array.english: If it appeared as a hidden card in Marinca, it means it really exists.
Array.indonesia: If it appeared as a hidden card in Marinca, it means it really exists.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_003
Array.english: Even its silhouette is frightening.
Array.indonesia: Even its silhouette is frightening.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_004
Array.english: Dave, I have faith in you.
Array.indonesia: Dave, I have faith in you.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_005
Array.english: But just in case anything happens to you…
Array.indonesia: But just in case anything happens to you…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_006
Array.english: Let me know your account name and password beforehand.
Array.indonesia: Let me know your account name and password beforehand.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_007
Array.english: <size=35>…What do you mean?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>…What do you mean?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_008
Array.english: <size=34>Oops! My desire to complete my Marinca collection got the better of me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oops! My desire to complete my Marinca collection got the better of me!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_009
Array.english: Anyway, good luck. I'll be waiting for a notification.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, good luck. I'll be waiting for a notification.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato03_010
Array.english: Chuchu.
Array.indonesia: Chuchu.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_001
Array.english: Every Marinca collector I know envies me, thanks to you!
Array.indonesia: Every Marinca collector I know envies me, thanks to you!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_002
Array.english: A Lusca card… Haha, I still can't believe it.
Array.indonesia: A Lusca card… Haha, I still can't believe it.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_003
Array.english: Of course, it has your name on it, since you shared it with me.
Array.indonesia: Of course, it has your name on it, since you shared it with me.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_004
Array.english: Haha! It feels good to be acknowledged!
Array.indonesia: Haha! It feels good to be acknowledged!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_005
Array.english: By the way, will Marinca ever be updated with new entries?
Array.indonesia: By the way, will Marinca ever be updated with new entries?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_006
Array.english: Well, that would depend on the dev—\nI mean, the discovery of new organisms.
Array.indonesia: Well, that would depend on the dev—\nI mean, the discovery of new organisms.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Sato04_007
Array.english: I'll let you know if there's any news.\nUntil then, enjoy the glory of being a <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color>!
Array.indonesia: I'll let you know if there's any news.\nUntil then, enjoy the glory of being a <color=#F1DC2B>Marinca Completer</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_001
Array.english: Sir, have you been keeping up with your photos?
Array.indonesia: Sir, have you been keeping up with your photos?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_002
Array.english: Remember, the more unique the organism, the more valuable the article.
Array.indonesia: Remember, the more unique the organism, the more valuable the article.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_003
Array.english: It'll be even more valuable if you manage to capture a special moment!
Array.indonesia: It'll be even more valuable if you manage to capture a special moment!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_004
Array.english: What if I don't like my photo?
Array.indonesia: What if I don't like my photo?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_005
Array.english: Haha! Don't worry. You can select <color=#F1DC2B>Take Again</color> in your phone's photo app to retake the photo.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Don't worry. You can select <color=#F1DC2B>Take Again</color> in your phone's photo app to retake the photo.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_006
Array.english: …Of course, it might be after the article's been distributed.
Array.indonesia: …Of course, it might be after the article's been distributed.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo01_007
Array.english: Anyway, I'll look forward for it. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, I'll look forward for it. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_001
Array.english: The text goes here… The photo goes to the right… Wait, no…
Array.indonesia: The text goes here… The photo goes to the right… Wait, no…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_002
Array.english: Oh, I didn't realize the call went through.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I didn't realize the call went through.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_003
Array.english: The <color=#F1DC2B>FishMon Project</color> has been keeping me busy.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>FishMon Project</color> has been keeping me busy.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_004
Array.english: I was trying to come up with a way to place your photos in my article to make it look cooler. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: I was trying to come up with a way to place your photos in my article to make it look cooler. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_005
Array.english: So please, don't forget about FishMon and the photos.
Array.indonesia: So please, don't forget about FishMon and the photos.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Udo02_006
Array.english: Alright. I'll do my best.
Array.indonesia: Alright. I'll do my best.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_001
Array.english: What's the matter?
Array.indonesia: What's the matter?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_002
Array.english: Ah… I had your number in my contacts.
Array.indonesia: Ah… I had your number in my contacts.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_003
Array.english: What a boring man. I'm very busy, you know.
Array.indonesia: What a boring man. I'm very busy, you know.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_004
Array.english: By the way… How is it with the branch? Is everything going well?
Array.indonesia: By the way… How is it with the branch? Is everything going well?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_005
Array.english: I guess so. But I'm still not used to it.
Array.indonesia: I guess so. But I'm still not used to it.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_006
Array.english: I don't expect Bancho to involve himself with all the finer matters.
Array.indonesia: I don't expect Bancho to involve himself with all the finer matters.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_007
Array.english: That's where you come in, Dave.
Array.indonesia: That's where you come in, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_008
Array.english: Since B&C is handling the basic management…
Array.indonesia: Since B&C is handling the basic management…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_009
Array.english: Please make sure to assign personnel and supply ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Please make sure to assign personnel and supply ingredients.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_010
Array.english: Okay. I'll take good care of it!
Array.indonesia: Okay. I'll take good care of it!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois01_011
Array.english: Heh, I'll be watching.\nTa-ta.
Array.indonesia: Heh, I'll be watching.\nTa-ta.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_001
Array.english: Hmm...
Array.indonesia: Hmm...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_002
Array.english: Is there something wrong, Lois?
Array.indonesia: Is there something wrong, Lois?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_003
Array.english: Ah… I'm worried that the quality of ingredients used in our restaurants has gone down.
Array.indonesia: Ah… I'm worried that the quality of ingredients used in our restaurants has gone down.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_004
Array.english: It's a complicated supply chain…\nAnd it's proving difficult to manage.
Array.indonesia: It's a complicated supply chain…\nAnd it's proving difficult to manage.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_005
Array.english: We wouldn't have to worry about it if we could get ingredients directly from the source like BANCHO SUSHI does.
Array.indonesia: We wouldn't have to worry about it if we could get ingredients directly from the source like BANCHO SUSHI does.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_006
Array.english: I can't imagine running a big company like that.
Array.indonesia: I can't imagine running a big company like that.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_007
Array.english: Haha! It's just a matter of size. In the end, it's just like managing a branch.
Array.indonesia: Haha! It's just a matter of size. In the end, it's just like managing a branch.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_008
Array.english: If you understand how to manage things on a small scale, managing things on a bigger scale will come naturally to you.
Array.indonesia: If you understand how to manage things on a small scale, managing things on a bigger scale will come naturally to you.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Lois02_009
Array.english: Hmm. I guess that makes sense.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I guess that makes sense.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_Start_001
Array.english: Hello,\nI hope you're having a great day!
Array.indonesia: Hello,\nI hope you're having a great day!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_Start_002
Array.english: Please note that this call is being recorded for quality assurance.
Array.indonesia: Please note that this call is being recorded for quality assurance.

Array.english: <size=34>What can I help you with today?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What can I help you with today?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_option1
Array.english: Claim Reward
Array.indonesia: Claim Reward

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_option2

Array.indonesia: My Information

Array.indonesia: Today's Fortune

Array.english: Exit
Array.indonesia: Exit

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_code_Start_002

Array.indonesia: Please enter the <color=#ff61e3>promotion code</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_code_end_001

Array.indonesia: <size=35>You've won a prize! Congratulations!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_code_wrong_001
Array.english: The <color=#ff61e3>promotion code</color> you entered does not exist.\nPlease try again.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#ff61e3>promotion code</color> you entered does not exist.\nPlease try again.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_code_cancel_001
Array.english: It seems you don't have the code.\nPlease visit next time.
Array.indonesia: It seems you don't have the code.\nPlease visit next time.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Start_001
Array.english: You've chosen to hear your fortune for today.\nHere it is…
Array.indonesia: You've chosen to hear your fortune for today.\nHere it is…

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Party01_001
Array.english: "Always be prepared, then you will earn large profits."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Always be prepared, then you will earn large profits."\n… Or so it says.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Party02_001
Array.english: "Don't forget and prepare the festival."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Don't forget and prepare the festival."\n… Or so it says.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_VIP01_001
Array.english: "A valued guest will come soon. Be prepared."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "A valued guest will come soon. Be prepared."\n… Or so it says.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_VIP02_001
Array.english: "An opportunity to show your talent will come. Don't miss it and be prepared."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "An opportunity to show your talent will come. Don't miss it and be prepared."\n… Or so it says.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Normal01_001
Array.english: "Happiness dwells in your mundane life. Diligence is the key."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Happiness dwells in your mundane life. Diligence is the key."\n… Or so it says.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_Normal02_001
Array.english: "Do not count on sheer luck. Work hard."\n… Or so it says.
Array.indonesia: "Do not count on sheer luck. Work hard."\n… Or so it says.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_End_001
Array.english: That's it for today's fortune telling.
Array.indonesia: That's it for today's fortune telling.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_fortune_ReSelect_001
Array.english: <size=34>Is there anything else you need?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Is there anything else you need?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Start_001
Array.english: I'll check your information…\nPlease hold.
Array.indonesia: I'll check your information…\nPlease hold.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Start_002
Array.english: (*Beep*)
Array.indonesia: (*Beep*)

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info01_001
Array.english: You have collected <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=ScrapCount/></color> items in total.
Array.indonesia: You have collected <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=ScrapCount/></color> items in total.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info01_01_001
Array.english: …That's not a lot.
Array.indonesia: …That's not a lot.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info01_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>You've worked hard!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You've worked hard!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info02_001
Array.english: You captured <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=KillFish/></color> fishes in total.
Array.indonesia: You captured <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=KillFish/></color> fishes in total.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info02_01_001
Array.english: …Still getting used to your harpoon?
Array.indonesia: …Still getting used to your harpoon?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info02_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>You must have fed a lot of customers!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You must have fed a lot of customers!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info03_001
Array.english: It's been <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=DayCount/></color> days since you came to Blue Hole.
Array.indonesia: It's been <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=DayCount/></color> days since you came to Blue Hole.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info03_01_001
Array.english: …Still get lost, right?
Array.indonesia: …Still get lost, right?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info03_02_001
Array.english: <size=34>I bet you can find your way around blind-folded!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I bet you can find your way around blind-folded!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info04_001
Array.english: The deepest you've dived was <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=DeepestDepth/></color> meters.
Array.indonesia: The deepest you've dived was <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=DeepestDepth/></color> meters.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info04_01_001
Array.english: …You're not scared of getting wet, are you?
Array.indonesia: …You're not scared of getting wet, are you?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_Info04_02_001
Array.english: <size=33>You can dive really deep. Outstanding!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You can dive really deep. Outstanding!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_MyInfo_End_001
Array.english: That concludes your personal information verification.
Array.indonesia: That concludes your personal information verification.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_CS_End_001
Array.english: Thank you for calling.\nPlease don't hesitate to call us again!
Array.indonesia: Thank you for calling.\nPlease don't hesitate to call us again!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050043_After_001
Array.english: Hurry up and get ingredients to treat Ramo with!
Array.indonesia: Hurry up and get ingredients to treat Ramo with!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050043_After_002
Array.english: Humans and their memory...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Lily Coral</color> should be around this area!
Array.indonesia: Humans and their memory...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Lily Coral</color> should be around this area!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050044_AfterLooting_001
Array.english: You just brought raw coral…\nIt should be cooked into a<color=#F1DC2B> dish</color>!
Array.indonesia: You just brought raw coral…\nIt should be cooked into a<color=#F1DC2B> dish</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050044_AfterLooting_002
Array.english: <size=34>Find a human worthy of cooking this into a dish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Find a human worthy of cooking this into a dish!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050047_After_001
Array.english: <size=40>Get the path open already, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Get the path open already, human!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050051_After_001
Array.english: I want to take the lead, but...\nI must protect Ramo.
Array.indonesia: I want to take the lead, but...\nI must protect Ramo.

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050051_After_002
Array.english: It’s not because I’m afraid. Of course it isn’t.
Array.indonesia: It’s not because I’m afraid. Of course it isn’t.

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050125_After_001
Array.english: Are you ready to enter, human?
Array.indonesia: Are you ready to enter, human?

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050125_After_Yes
Array.english: Yes, I'm Ready!
Array.indonesia: Yes, I'm Ready!

Array.name: dialogue_Suwam_Talk_10050125_After_No
Array.english: Not Yet…
Array.indonesia: Not Yet…

Array.name: dialogue_Ramo_Talk_10050047_After_001
Array.english: To think the path to the village is blocked...\nHurry up and do something!
Array.indonesia: To think the path to the village is blocked...\nHurry up and do something!

Array.name: dialogue_Ramo_Talk_10050051_After_001
Array.english: I hope nothing has happened to the village...\nPlease hurry, human.
Array.indonesia: I hope nothing has happened to the village...\nPlease hurry, human.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_boat_001
Array.english: Dave, while you were out at sea the repairs were completed.
Array.indonesia: Dave, while you were out at sea the repairs were completed.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_boat_004
Array.english: <size=42>Let's head to the restaurant!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Let's head to the restaurant!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_001
Array.english: <size=40>Wow..It's looking very nice!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Wow..It's looking very nice!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_002
Array.english: <size=32>Haha! It doesn't matter how delicious the food is, \nthe restaurant can't be a mess!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Haha! It doesn't matter how delicious the food is, \nthe restaurant can't be a mess!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoSushi_upgrade_003
Array.english: <size=34>Ah, If you want to change the interior,\nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> menu below is open, so please check it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah, If you want to change the interior,\nthe <color=#F1DC2B>Interior</color> menu below is open, so please check it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_001
Array.english: <size=35>This must be the place...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> are blocking the way, though...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>This must be the place...\n<color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> are blocking the way, though...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_002
Array.english: Dr. Bacon, I have <color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> blocking my path.\nIs there a solution?
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon, I have <color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> blocking my path.\nIs there a solution?

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_003
Array.english: Hmm... Let’s see...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Let’s see...

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_004
Array.english: Right! Tubeworms are said to hate <color=#F1DC2B>UV light</color>\nand will shrink away from it.
Array.indonesia: Right! Tubeworms are said to hate <color=#F1DC2B>UV light</color>\nand will shrink away from it.

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_005
Array.english: You don’t happen to have one lying around, do you?
Array.indonesia: You don’t happen to have one lying around, do you?

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_hasUVlight_006
Array.english: <size=36>Oh! You already have one!\nTry shining it on them!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh! You already have one!\nTry shining it on them!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_001
Array.english: <size=35>Oh no... <color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> are blocking my path...\nWhat do I do?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh no... <color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> are blocking my path...\nWhat do I do?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_002
Array.english: Dr. Bacon, I have <color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> blocking my path.\nIs there a solution?
Array.indonesia: Dr. Bacon, I have <color=#1DFEAF>Tubeworms</color> blocking my path.\nIs there a solution?

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_003
Array.english: Hmm... Let’s see...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... Let’s see...

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_004
Array.english: Right! Tubeworms are said to hate <color=#F1DC2B>UV light</color>\nand will shrink away from it.
Array.indonesia: Right! Tubeworms are said to hate <color=#F1DC2B>UV light</color>\nand will shrink away from it.

Array.name: dialogue_UVLightFirstEvent_NoUVLight_005
Array.english: <size=35>One might be nearby, \nso try opening the <color=#F1DC2B>Chests</color> nearby!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>One might be nearby, \nso try opening the <color=#F1DC2B>Chests</color> nearby!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(This is the <color=#1DFEAF>Dugong Hotel</color>... I worked here 12 years ago. \nIt’s a five-star hotel with both tradition and a long history.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(This is the <color=#1DFEAF>Dugong Hotel</color>... I worked here 12 years ago. \nIt’s a five-star hotel with both tradition and a long history.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(It looks a bit old, yes, but at the time\nthe quality of the food and service had been newly improved.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(It looks a bit old, yes, but at the time\nthe quality of the food and service had been newly improved.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_003
Array.english: Yoshie, do you have a moment?
Array.indonesia: Yoshie, do you have a moment?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>What is it, Manager?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>What is it, Manager?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_005
Array.english: Well... A troublesome customer left a reservation.
Array.indonesia: Well... A troublesome customer left a reservation.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_006
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>A troublesome customer?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>A troublesome customer?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_007
Array.english: Do you know the actress <color=#F1DC2B>Lois Crawford</color>?\nShe made a reservation at our hotel.
Array.indonesia: Do you know the actress <color=#F1DC2B>Lois Crawford</color>?\nShe made a reservation at our hotel.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_008
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Lois Crawford...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Lois Crawford...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option1
Array.english: Hotel
Array.indonesia: Hotel

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option2
Array.english: Manager
Array.indonesia: Manager

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option3
Array.english: Lois Crawford
Array.indonesia: Lois Crawford

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option1_linked_001
Array.english: Our <color=#1DFEAF>Dugong Hotel</color> is a luxury hotel with many years of history and tradition.\nIn the past we had nobles staying in our accommodations, and many notable films \nwere shot here.
Array.indonesia: Our <color=#1DFEAF>Dugong Hotel</color> is a luxury hotel with many years of history and tradition.\nIn the past we had nobles staying in our accommodations, and many notable films \nwere shot here.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option1_linked_002
Array.english: Many people seeking that sort of old-era nostalgia used our services,\nand we had very high standards for the services we provided.
Array.indonesia: Many people seeking that sort of old-era nostalgia used our services,\nand we had very high standards for the services we provided.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option2_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(The manager had spent his entire life at the hotel.\nIt was like he was a living embodiment of its history.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(The manager had spent his entire life at the hotel.\nIt was like he was a living embodiment of its history.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option2_linked_002
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He had a lot of knowledge about the etiquette used by the upper class of each country,\nand he was very used to servicing those of high rank.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(He had a lot of knowledge about the etiquette used by the upper class of each country,\nand he was very used to servicing those of high rank.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option2_linked_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Many VIPs sought his services.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Many VIPs sought his services.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option3_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Lois Crawford...\nShe was a leading actress with a long career.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Lois Crawford...\nShe was a leading actress with a long career.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene1_option3_linked_002
Array.english: (Her role as a spy in one of her most famous works, The 42nd Floor, \nwas extremely impressive. She appears to have hit a slight slump \nas her new movies haven’t been doing very well.)
Array.indonesia: (Her role as a spy in one of her most famous works, The 42nd Floor, \nwas extremely impressive. She appears to have hit a slight slump \nas her new movies haven’t been doing very well.)

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I’ve heard that Lois Crawford can be very picky.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>I’ve heard that Lois Crawford can be very picky.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>But we are a very high-quality hotel with history and tradition on our side.\nI don’t think there will be any issue if she comes.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>But we are a very high-quality hotel with history and tradition on our side.\nI don’t think there will be any issue if she comes.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_003
Array.english: Haha... So, there it is.\nNobody can beat the level of services and staff at this hotel.
Array.indonesia: Haha... So, there it is.\nNobody can beat the level of services and staff at this hotel.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_004
Array.english: We’ve won many prizes as well.\nJust one thing... you haven’t heard the rumors about her, have you?
Array.indonesia: We’ve won many prizes as well.\nJust one thing... you haven’t heard the rumors about her, have you?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_005
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3><size=40>The rumors?</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3><size=40>The rumors?</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_006
Array.english: <size=40>Take a look at this.</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Take a look at this.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(This is...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(This is...)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_008
Array.english: She’s famous not only as a chef but a gourmet.\nThat’s a blurb she published in a travel magazine recently.
Array.indonesia: She’s famous not only as a chef but a gourmet.\nThat’s a blurb she published in a travel magazine recently.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_009
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Hmm... It appears to be a description of her travels,\nbut it’s just her bashing on the hotel she stayed at.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Hmm... It appears to be a description of her travels,\nbut it’s just her bashing on the hotel she stayed at.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_010
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Gloria Hotels are the best of the best\nand yet she wrote such a scathing review...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Gloria Hotels are the best of the best\nand yet she wrote such a scathing review...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_011
Array.english: Bringing out the bad does make a person look...\nmore professional.
Array.indonesia: Bringing out the bad does make a person look...\nmore professional.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_012
Array.english: Her writing is mostly like this.\nWhat do you suggest we do, Yoshie?
Array.indonesia: Her writing is mostly like this.\nWhat do you suggest we do, Yoshie?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_013
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3><size=35>Well...</size></color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3><size=35>Well...</size></color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option1
Array.english: Decline Reservation
Array.indonesia: Decline Reservation

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option2
Array.english: Accept Reservation
Array.indonesia: Accept Reservation

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option1_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>How about we refuse the reservation?\nWe don’t really need to take a customer that will purposefully try to hurt our reputation, do we?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>How about we refuse the reservation?\nWe don’t really need to take a customer that will purposefully try to hurt our reputation, do we?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option1_linked_002
Array.english: If we do that...\nShe’ll probably use an even more crafty way to get at us.
Array.indonesia: If we do that...\nShe’ll probably use an even more crafty way to get at us.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option1_linked_003
Array.english: She’ll send out messages saying that we lack confidence,\nthat we’re picky about who we accept, and so on.
Array.indonesia: She’ll send out messages saying that we lack confidence,\nthat we’re picky about who we accept, and so on.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option2_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I suppose we can’t refuse the reservation,\nif only for the hotel’s reputation’s sake.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>I suppose we can’t refuse the reservation,\nif only for the hotel’s reputation’s sake.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene2_option2_linked_002
Array.english: In that case, we’ll have to think about how we’ll serve her.
Array.indonesia: In that case, we’ll have to think about how we’ll serve her.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>We’ll take the reservation,\nbut we also need to think of ways to satisfy her.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>We’ll take the reservation,\nbut we also need to think of ways to satisfy her.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_002
Array.english: I suppose you’re right.\nDo you have any ideas, Yoshie?
Array.indonesia: I suppose you’re right.\nDo you have any ideas, Yoshie?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_003
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Um...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Um...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Our hotel’s strengths are our long history and tradition\nas well as our high-quality service.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Our hotel’s strengths are our long history and tradition\nas well as our high-quality service.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_005
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>The way we can satisfy her will involve\nmaking good use of these things.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>The way we can satisfy her will involve\nmaking good use of these things.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_006
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Did she reserve a suite?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Did she reserve a suite?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_007
Array.english: <size=38>Yes, it’s a suite.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Yes, it’s a suite.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_008
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>We’ll need clean rooms and services that match her tastes.\nWe’ll treat her as a VIP.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>We’ll need clean rooms and services that match her tastes.\nWe’ll treat her as a VIP.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_009
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I’ll look into the drinks and amenities she prefers\nand place them as I also check on the state of the rooms.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>I’ll look into the drinks and amenities she prefers\nand place them as I also check on the state of the rooms.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_010
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>And about who will receive her...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>And about who will receive her...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_011
Array.english: <size=36>I suppose I’ll have to do that.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>I suppose I’ll have to do that.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_012
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Thank you.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Thank you.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_013
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>There’s no one that can handle such a tricky customer\nexcept you, with your long experience with many VIPs.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>There’s no one that can handle such a tricky customer\nexcept you, with your long experience with many VIPs.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_014
Array.english: I’m more tense than usual.
Array.indonesia: I’m more tense than usual.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_015
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>And about the meals. We can offer her the buffet for breakfast,\nbut we’ll also need to ready a dinner course.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>And about the meals. We can offer her the buffet for breakfast,\nbut we’ll also need to ready a dinner course.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_016
Array.english: The dinners at our hotel...
Array.indonesia: The dinners at our hotel...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option1
Array.english: Italian
Array.indonesia: Italian

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2
Array.english: French
Array.indonesia: French

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3
Array.english: Japanese
Array.indonesia: Japanese

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option1_linked_001
Array.english: Our hotel provides Italian food like a bistro, and in à la carte style.\nWe serve pasta or pizza with a simple wine.
Array.indonesia: Our hotel provides Italian food like a bistro, and in à la carte style.\nWe serve pasta or pizza with a simple wine.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option1_linked_002
Array.english: The chef learned to cook in Naples, and his margherita pizza was good, \nbut...
Array.indonesia: The chef learned to cook in Naples, and his margherita pizza was good, \nbut...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option1_linked_003
Array.english: It didn’t really go well with the dinner course.
Array.indonesia: It didn’t really go well with the dinner course.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2_linked_001
Array.english: We have fantastic French food at our hotel.
Array.indonesia: We have fantastic French food at our hotel.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2_linked_002
Array.english: It's the pride and joy of Dugong Hotel,\nwith a Michelin-starred head chef at the helm.
Array.indonesia: It's the pride and joy of Dugong Hotel,\nwith a Michelin-starred head chef at the helm.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2_linked_003
Array.english: But you came at the most inconvenient time.\nOur head chef is in France on a culinary research trip.
Array.indonesia: But you came at the most inconvenient time.\nOur head chef is in France on a culinary research trip.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option2_linked_004
Array.english: The sous-chef has taken his place for now and he cooks wonderfully as well.\nHowever, our upcoming customer is a very difficult one...
Array.indonesia: The sous-chef has taken his place for now and he cooks wonderfully as well.\nHowever, our upcoming customer is a very difficult one...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3_linked_001
Array.english: Dugong Hotel’s Japanese food has never been its strong suit.\nWe only served udon or simple donburi...
Array.indonesia: Dugong Hotel’s Japanese food has never been its strong suit.\nWe only served udon or simple donburi...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3_linked_002
Array.english: We’ve been making exponential progress, however, after we hired\n<color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, we've grown quite dramatically.
Array.indonesia: We’ve been making exponential progress, however, after we hired\n<color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, we've grown quite dramatically.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3_linked_003
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> is famous for his ability to reinterpret the use of ingredients,\nand his food was recently featured in an overseas magazine.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color> is famous for his ability to reinterpret the use of ingredients,\nand his food was recently featured in an overseas magazine.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene3_option3_linked_004
Array.english: <size=38>He might be our dark horse.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>He might be our dark horse.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>That means Japanese is likely to be our best choice...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>That means Japanese is likely to be our best choice...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Bancho hasn’t really proven himself yet. Do you think it’ll be alright?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Bancho hasn’t really proven himself yet. Do you think it’ll be alright?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_003
Array.english: Hmm. Bancho’s skill is indisputable.\nHowever...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Bancho’s skill is indisputable.\nHowever...

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_004
Array.english: One great drawback is that he doesn’t consider the preferences of his customers.\nHis sole focus is letting people try new flavors.
Array.indonesia: One great drawback is that he doesn’t consider the preferences of his customers.\nHis sole focus is letting people try new flavors.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_005
Array.english: That is what drives his creativity, of course,\nbut this time it won’t really serve us.
Array.indonesia: That is what drives his creativity, of course,\nbut this time it won’t really serve us.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_006
Array.english: We’re dealing with the infamous Lois Crawford, after all.
Array.indonesia: We’re dealing with the infamous Lois Crawford, after all.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_007
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I see. That’s a good point.\nHowever, I think the best we can do right now is try and persuade Bancho.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>I see. That’s a good point.\nHowever, I think the best we can do right now is try and persuade Bancho.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene4_008
Array.english: I agree.\nBest of luck, Yoshie.
Array.indonesia: I agree.\nBest of luck, Yoshie.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_001
Array.english: <size=36><color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, are you here?</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, are you here?</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_002
Array.english: Miss Yoshie? What are you doing here?
Array.indonesia: Miss Yoshie? What are you doing here?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_003
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Oh, you’re here. That’s good.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Oh, you’re here. That’s good.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I’ve come to check on the status of the manager’s request.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>I’ve come to check on the status of the manager’s request.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_005
Array.english: Look all you want.\nIt’s just an ordinary Japanese food kitchen.
Array.indonesia: Look all you want.\nIt’s just an ordinary Japanese food kitchen.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_006
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Bancho was a peculiar man. He suddenly appeared one day,\nhanding us a resume and explaining he’d been learning in Japan.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Bancho was a peculiar man. He suddenly appeared one day,\nhanding us a resume and explaining he’d been learning in Japan.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(All the sushi establishments listed in the resume were top-tier,\nbut Bancho never stayed in one place for long.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(All the sushi establishments listed in the resume were top-tier,\nbut Bancho never stayed in one place for long.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_008
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He told me that he moved on each time after learning enough. \nThe manager had a long talk with him and then left the operation of the Japanese Food Team to him.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(He told me that he moved on each time after learning enough. \nThe manager had a long talk with him and then left the operation of the Japanese Food Team to him.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_009
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He could always be found in the kitchen busy with something, day in and day out.\nHe researched food on his own when there were no customers.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(He could always be found in the kitchen busy with something, day in and day out.\nHe researched food on his own when there were no customers.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_010
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(He hated to be interrupted.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(He hated to be interrupted.)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_011
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Were you practicing?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Were you practicing?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_012
Array.english: Well... Yes.
Array.indonesia: Well... Yes.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_013
Array.english: “Training” means thousands and tens of thousands of attempts.\nPractice without rest is the only way to produce meaningful results.
Array.indonesia: “Training” means thousands and tens of thousands of attempts.\nPractice without rest is the only way to produce meaningful results.

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_014
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>...I see.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>...I see.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_015
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>I heard that you never skip research and practice, Bancho.\nIt relieves me to see you so hard at work.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>I heard that you never skip research and practice, Bancho.\nIt relieves me to see you so hard at work.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_016
Array.english: What do you mean, you’re relieved?
Array.indonesia: What do you mean, you’re relieved?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_017
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, would you be willing to try servicing a VIP?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Bancho, would you be willing to try servicing a VIP?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_018
Array.english: <size=38>Servicing a VIP?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Servicing a VIP?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option1
Array.english: VIP
Array.indonesia: VIP

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option2
Array.english: Service
Array.indonesia: Service

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option1_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>That’s right. We have an important guest who will increase our reputation...\nor rather, who might send it plummeting to the ground.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>That’s right. We have an important guest who will increase our reputation...\nor rather, who might send it plummeting to the ground.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option1_linked_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Her name is <color=#F1DC2B>Lois Crawford</color>...\nShe’s an actress that’s infamously hard to please, and also a gourmet reviewer.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Her name is <color=#F1DC2B>Lois Crawford</color>...\nShe’s an actress that’s infamously hard to please, and also a gourmet reviewer.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option2_linked_001
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>It’s been about a year since you joined the Dugong Hotel.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>It’s been about a year since you joined the Dugong Hotel.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option2_linked_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Our Japanese Food Team, which was never very strong,\nreceived much attention in a short span of time...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Our Japanese Food Team, which was never very strong,\nreceived much attention in a short span of time...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene5_option2_linked_003
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>And we can’t deny that your contribution to this was great.\nHowever, this means that we also get customers who want special treatment.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>And we can’t deny that your contribution to this was great.\nHowever, this means that we also get customers who want special treatment.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_001
Array.english: So you mean to say that I should try and please\nthis picky woman, Lois Crawford?
Array.indonesia: So you mean to say that I should try and please\nthis picky woman, Lois Crawford?

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_002
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>Yes. This is important, as Dugong Hotel’s reputation lies in the balance.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>Yes. This is important, as Dugong Hotel’s reputation lies in the balance.</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_003
Array.english: <size=40>Hmm…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Hmm…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_004
Array.english: <color=#A2F0F3>What do you say?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#A2F0F3>What do you say?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_005
Array.english: <size=32>For me, cooking has always been a battle with myself,\nnot with others. </size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>For me, cooking has always been a battle with myself,\nnot with others. </size>

Array.name: dialogue_BanchoStory_scene6_006
Array.english: <size=32>Making perfect food has always been my goal,\nand that won’t change no matter who I cook for.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Making perfect food has always been my goal,\nand that won’t change no matter who I cook for.</size>
