Array.indonesia: What kind of Fishmon was it?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_005
Array.english: <size=36>Vampire Squid... It really sucks blood!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Vampire Squid... It really sucks blood!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_006
Array.english: Vampire Squids normally do not really suck blood, but this one is different.\nThis one is vampiric indeed.
Array.indonesia: Vampire Squids normally do not really suck blood, but this one is different.\nThis one is vampiric indeed.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_007
Array.english: That’s not all! Its ink is volatile and explodes.\nIsn’t that scary?
Array.indonesia: That’s not all! Its ink is volatile and explodes.\nIsn’t that scary?

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_008
Array.english: This one looks dangerous. I’d rather skip it.
Array.indonesia: This one looks dangerous. I’d rather skip it.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_009
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, no! Dave!\nA diver of your caliber should not be afraid of it! You can do it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, no! Dave!\nA diver of your caliber should not be afraid of it! You can do it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_010
Array.english: I will pray for your safe return!\nGodspeed then!
Array.indonesia: I will pray for your safe return!\nGodspeed then!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_011
Array.english: <size=50>...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_012
Array.english: Oh, I forgot to tell you the location of the Fishmon.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I forgot to tell you the location of the Fishmon.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_013
Array.english: Our radar indicates that it is at the bottom most area of the <color=#1DFEAF>Passage to the Glacial Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Our radar indicates that it is at the bottom most area of the <color=#1DFEAF>Passage to the Glacial Area</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Start_014
Array.english: I will wait for you to return with good news!
Array.indonesia: I will wait for you to return with good news!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_001
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa… Yes, this is it…!\nThe <color=#F1DC2B>Explosive Vampire Squid</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa… Yes, this is it…!\nThe <color=#F1DC2B>Explosive Vampire Squid</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_002
Array.english: It even looks creepy!
Array.indonesia: It even looks creepy!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_003
Array.english: <size=45>Boom!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=45>Boom!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_004
Array.english: It looks like it’s ready to explode at any time.
Array.indonesia: It looks like it’s ready to explode at any time.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Success_005
Array.english: Anyhow, thank you!\nWe’ll send you your fee when the issue’s out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>!
Array.indonesia: Anyhow, thank you!\nWe’ll send you your fee when the issue’s out on <color=#F39321>Monday morning</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Restart_001
Array.english: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...
Array.indonesia: The fish we spotted with our Radar this week is...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Restart_002
Array.english: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Explosive Vampire Squid</color>, the same as last week!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>the <color=#F1DC2B>Explosive Vampire Squid</color>, the same as last week!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Restart_003
Array.english: Its location is the bottom-most area of the <color=#1DFEAF>Passage to the Glacial Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: Its location is the bottom-most area of the <color=#1DFEAF>Passage to the Glacial Area</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_Restart_004
Array.english: Here’s to another fruitful week, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Here’s to another fruitful week, Dave.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_Capture
Array.english: <size=35>Good! Captured the <color=#1DFEAF>Fishmon</color>!\nI should take it to Udo!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good! Captured the <color=#1DFEAF>Fishmon</color>!\nI should take it to Udo!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_FailFinished
Array.english: Oh, Dave... You failed to catch it.\nI guess our sales are going to flop this week...
Array.indonesia: Oh, Dave... You failed to catch it.\nI guess our sales are going to flop this week...

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_contact
Array.english: Ooh, Dave! That’s the one!\nPlease catch it without killing it!
Array.indonesia: Ooh, Dave! That’s the one!\nPlease catch it without killing it!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_01_contact_Ghost_Squid
Array.english: It will react to <color=#1DFEAF>Special Light</color>.
Array.indonesia: It will react to <color=#1DFEAF>Special Light</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_WeeeklyFishing_die
Array.english: Oof! You killed the FIshMon...\nWe have to get them alive. Alive!
Array.indonesia: Oof! You killed the FIshMon...\nWe have to get them alive. Alive!

Array.name: dialogue_WeeklyFishing_stun
Array.english: Oh! The FishMon is unconcious!\nNow’s your chance! Capture it!
Array.indonesia: Oh! The FishMon is unconcious!\nNow’s your chance! Capture it!

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_01
Array.english: Huh? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Huh? What is it?

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_02
Array.english: I spent some quality time with Leahs-chan\nand did some quiet thinking...
Array.indonesia: I spent some quality time with Leahs-chan\nand did some quiet thinking...

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_03
Array.english: I realized that paying people back for help received\nwas what a noble master would do.
Array.indonesia: I realized that paying people back for help received\nwas what a noble master would do.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_04
Array.english: Tell me, Dave. Are you satisfied with your <color=#F1DC2B>guns</color>?
Array.indonesia: Tell me, Dave. Are you satisfied with your <color=#F1DC2B>guns</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_05
Array.english: Um... They’re fine...\nIt’d be nice if they were stronger, though.
Array.indonesia: Um... They’re fine...\nIt’d be nice if they were stronger, though.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_06
Array.english: Heh. I guess it’s time I stepped into the spotlight, \nso to speak.
Array.indonesia: Heh. I guess it’s time I stepped into the spotlight, \nso to speak.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_07
Array.english: <size=34>I’ll help you <color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> your guns.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I’ll help you <color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> your guns.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_08
Array.english: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> them? How do you do that?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36><color=#F1DC2B>Enhance</color> them? How do you do that?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_09
Array.english: Heh. It’s about making them stronger...\nOr imbuing elements like poison or electricity.
Array.indonesia: Heh. It’s about making them stronger...\nOr imbuing elements like poison or electricity.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_10
Array.english: <size=36>There’s one thing you need to remember, though!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>There’s one thing you need to remember, though!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_11
Array.english: Only guns that have been created can be enhanced.\n<color=#C8C8C8>I speak at the risk of sounding obvious...</color>
Array.indonesia: Only guns that have been created can be enhanced.\n<color=#C8C8C8>I speak at the risk of sounding obvious...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_12
Array.english: Oh... I see! Gun enhancement...\nThat sounds pretty useful.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I see! Gun enhancement...\nThat sounds pretty useful.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_13
Array.english: Duff... \nyou’re a cooler person than I thought.
Array.indonesia: Duff... \nyou’re a cooler person than I thought.

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_14
Array.english: Wh-what are you saying! I-I’m just trying\nto be the best master I can be for Leahs-chan...
Array.indonesia: Wh-what are you saying! I-I’m just trying\nto be the best master I can be for Leahs-chan...

Array.name: dialogue_Contents_EnhancedWeapon_Duff_15
Array.english: I think I’ve provided an adequate explanation. \nIt’s back to the world of the Pixies for me. \n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.
Array.indonesia: I think I’ve provided an adequate explanation. \nIt’s back to the world of the Pixies for me. \n<color=#ff61e3>GOODBYE-TERNITY★</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MVSeedShop_Contents_Unlock_Gumo_001
Array.english: Oh, human.\nThe <color=#F1DC2B>Seaweed Farm</color> is ready.
Array.indonesia: Oh, human.\nThe <color=#F1DC2B>Seaweed Farm</color> is ready.

Array.name: dialogue_MVSeedShop_Contents_Unlock_Gumo_002
Array.english: I see you got some <color=#1DFEAF>Seaweed Seeds</color>.\nWant to try planting them?
Array.indonesia: I see you got some <color=#1DFEAF>Seaweed Seeds</color>.\nWant to try planting them?

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_001
Array.english: <size=46>Hopitty hop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>Hopitty hop!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_002
Array.english: You...\nDo you know a lot about this <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>?
Array.indonesia: You...\nDo you know a lot about this <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_003
Array.english: Well... I’m not sure what to say to that...\nIt’s different in there every time...
Array.indonesia: Well... I’m not sure what to say to that...\nIt’s different in there every time...

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_004
Array.english: Yes! That’s it!\nIt’s the best place to collect <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>!
Array.indonesia: Yes! That’s it!\nIt’s the best place to collect <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_005
Array.english: I could complete my collection in this place!\nAhaha!
Array.indonesia: I could complete my collection in this place!\nAhaha!

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_006
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>?
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_007
Array.english: What!? Don’t tell me you don’t know the highly popular \nocean life trading cards, <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>!
Array.indonesia: What!? Don’t tell me you don’t know the highly popular \nocean life trading cards, <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_008
Array.english: How can you not have heard of the futuristic trading cards that utilize an AI recognition system that automatically corresponds to fish in real life…
Array.indonesia: How can you not have heard of the futuristic trading cards that utilize an AI recognition system that automatically corresponds to fish in real life…

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_009
Array.english: Um... Never heard of them.\nIt sounds fun, though.
Array.indonesia: Um... Never heard of them.\nIt sounds fun, though.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_010
Array.english: *Sigh* You seem quite behind the times.
Array.indonesia: *Sigh* You seem quite behind the times.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_011
Array.english: Let me help you install the <color=#72ff0a>app</color>.
Array.indonesia: Let me help you install the <color=#72ff0a>app</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_012
Array.english: So you do this... Then press here...\nTouch that... add a friend...
Array.indonesia: So you do this... Then press here...\nTouch that... add a friend...

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_013
Array.english: <size=43>Done!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>Done!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_014
Array.english: Um, okay. So what do I do now?
Array.indonesia: Um, okay. So what do I do now?

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_015
Array.english: The amazing thing about these <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color> is...
Array.indonesia: The amazing thing about these <color=#1DFEAF>MarinCa</color> is...

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_016
Array.english: <size=38>You don’t really need to do anything special!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>You don’t really need to do anything special!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_017
Array.english: Just catch a new fish, and you’ll get a card.\nCheck the cards every now and then on the app, and you’re done.
Array.indonesia: Just catch a new fish, and you’ll get a card.\nCheck the cards every now and then on the app, and you’re done.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_018
Array.english: I see!\nI guess I’ll be able to easily see what fish I’ve caught so far.
Array.indonesia: I see!\nI guess I’ll be able to easily see what fish I’ve caught so far.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_019
Array.english: <size=38>That’s right! It’s almost like a...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>That’s right! It’s almost like a...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_020
Array.english: Whoa! You don’t want to be saying the name.\nI understand. I’ll try it out.
Array.indonesia: Whoa! You don’t want to be saying the name.\nI understand. I’ll try it out.

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_021
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, I forgot to introduce myself, didn’t I?\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Sato</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, I forgot to introduce myself, didn’t I?\nI’m <color=#F1DC2B>Sato</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Fishcard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_022
Array.english: I’ll give you my contact info, so hit me up if you have questions.\nSee you, then. Chu-chu!
Array.indonesia: I’ll give you my contact info, so hit me up if you have questions.\nSee you, then. Chu-chu!

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_001
Array.english: <size=46>YOWEE!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>YOWEE!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_002
Array.english: You seem... energetic today.
Array.indonesia: You seem... energetic today.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_003
Array.english: I saw a <color=#1DFEAF>Boss Card</color> acquisition notification pop up on \nyour Marine Card account.
Array.indonesia: I saw a <color=#1DFEAF>Boss Card</color> acquisition notification pop up on \nyour Marine Card account.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_004
Array.english: <size=40>It’s this <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color> boss card!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>It’s this <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color> boss card!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_005
Array.english: How did you get this?\nIt’s such a rare card...
Array.indonesia: How did you get this?\nIt’s such a rare card...

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_006
Array.english: Uh, well... I was just on my way to pick up a delivery, \nand as chance would have it...
Array.indonesia: Uh, well... I was just on my way to pick up a delivery, \nand as chance would have it...

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_007
Array.english: Okay, I don’t have a clue what that means, \nbut in any case you’ve made amazing progress.
Array.indonesia: Okay, I don’t have a clue what that means, \nbut in any case you’ve made amazing progress.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_008
Array.english: Try collecting all the rare Boss Cards.\nSomething good’s sure to happen!
Array.indonesia: Try collecting all the rare Boss Cards.\nSomething good’s sure to happen!

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_009
Array.english: Oh, and if you venture to new regions... \nfor example the depths, the automatic Marine Card AI system will unlock a <color=#1DFEAF>new Card Pack</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, and if you venture to new regions... \nfor example the depths, the automatic Marine Card AI system will unlock a <color=#1DFEAF>new Card Pack</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_010
Array.english: Don’t forget to collect fish cards in the new regions as well.
Array.indonesia: Don’t forget to collect fish cards in the new regions as well.

Array.name: dialogue_Bosscard_Contents_Unlock_Sato_011
Array.english: <size=40>Goodbye, then. Chu-chu!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Goodbye, then. Chu-chu!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_001
Array.english: <size=46>GYA-GYAO!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>GYA-GYAO!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_002
Array.english: Oh? A new greeting sound?
Array.indonesia: Oh? A new greeting sound?

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_003
Array.english: Nope. It’s from the new game I am playing these days.
Array.indonesia: Nope. It’s from the new game I am playing these days.

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_004
Array.english: What game are you playing?
Array.indonesia: What game are you playing?

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_005
Array.english: It’s <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color>...
Array.indonesia: It’s <color=#72ff0a>GYAO!</color>...

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_006
Array.english: <size=36>A game raising digital fish!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>A game raising digital fish!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_007
Array.english: You feed them and keep them happy \nand they grow and mutate!
Array.indonesia: You feed them and keep them happy \nand they grow and mutate!

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_008
Array.english: <size=34>That sounds somewhat familiar!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>That sounds somewhat familiar!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_009
Array.english: Sigh.. Lately I'm feeding GYAO! as soon as I get up in the morning…
Array.indonesia: Sigh.. Lately I'm feeding GYAO! as soon as I get up in the morning…

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_010
Array.english: <size=35>Ah!! Come to think about it, I completely forgot to do that today!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ah!! Come to think about it, I completely forgot to do that today!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_011
Array.english: Wait a sec.
Array.indonesia: Wait a sec.

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_012
Array.english: <size=46>……</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=46>……</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_013
Array.english: ...Alright. Now I'll give it a snack.
Array.indonesia: ...Alright. Now I'll give it a snack.

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_014
Array.english: <size=36>Haha! Look, GYAO! is satisfied!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Haha! Look, GYAO! is satisfied!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_015
Array.english: Why don’t you try it yourself? I shared the <color=#72ff0a>app</color> with you \nusing Share with Friend.
Array.indonesia: Why don’t you try it yourself? I shared the <color=#72ff0a>app</color> with you \nusing Share with Friend.

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_016
Array.english: You'll be able to experience something fun besides just catching fish!
Array.indonesia: You'll be able to experience something fun besides just catching fish!

Array.name: dialogue_Gyao_Contents_Unlock_Sato_017
Array.english: <size=36>Chuchu.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Chuchu.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_001
Array.english: I forgot to tell you something.
Array.indonesia: I forgot to tell you something.

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_002
Array.english: What is it, Miss Yoshie?
Array.indonesia: What is it, Miss Yoshie?

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_003
Array.english: When you hire more employees and purchase more ingredients, you will have to take care of many things all at once.
Array.indonesia: When you hire more employees and purchase more ingredients, you will have to take care of many things all at once.

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_004
Array.english: So I decided to give you a <color=#72ff0a>Management</color> app, which works on your smartphone. You can check the current status of BANCHO SUSHI at any time with it.
Array.indonesia: So I decided to give you a <color=#72ff0a>Management</color> app, which works on your smartphone. You can check the current status of BANCHO SUSHI at any time with it.

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_005
Array.english: You can check the status of your restaurant\nwithout having to go there.
Array.indonesia: You can check the status of your restaurant\nwithout having to go there.

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_006
Array.english: <size=35>That sounds handy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>That sounds handy!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_007
Array.english: I already linked the app. Why don’t you check it on your <color=#F1DC2B>smartphone</color>?
Array.indonesia: I already linked the app. Why don’t you check it on your <color=#F1DC2B>smartphone</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_ManagementApp_Contents_Unlock_Yoshie_008
Array.english: I am sure BANCHO SUSHI will grow bigger and prosper.
Array.indonesia: I am sure BANCHO SUSHI will grow bigger and prosper.

Array.name: dialogue_Dave_First_Dead_001
Array.english: Dave, this <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color> looks infinitely more dangerous\nthan any other place.
Array.indonesia: Dave, this <color=#90CDFF>Giant Blue Hole</color> looks infinitely more dangerous\nthan any other place.

Array.name: dialogue_Dave_First_Dead_002
Array.english: Always pay attention to your oxygen\nand use the <color=#1DFEAF>Escape Pod</color> when you’re in danger to get out quickly.
Array.indonesia: Always pay attention to your oxygen\nand use the <color=#1DFEAF>Escape Pod</color> when you’re in danger to get out quickly.

Array.name: dialogue_Dave_First_Dead_003
Array.english: I can rescue you if you run out of oxygen,\nbut you’ll only be able to bring back one of the items you collected!
Array.indonesia: I can rescue you if you run out of oxygen,\nbut you’ll only be able to bring back one of the items you collected!

Array.name: dialogue_TimelineDummy_001
Array.english: (not in use)
Array.indonesia: (not in use)

Array.name: dialogue_TimelineDummy_002
Array.english: (not in use)
Array.indonesia: (not in use)

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=38>Dear me... The tremors are getting worse...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Dear me... The tremors are getting worse...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_Ch3_Progress_002
Array.english: <size=36>Human! Hurry up and help the villagers\nto gain their trust!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Human! Hurry up and help the villagers\nto gain their trust!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm? Looks like you’ve made yourself quite well-known \nin the village.
Array.indonesia: Hmm? Looks like you’ve made yourself quite well-known \nin the village.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: Even so, don’t go about doing your own thing.\nHelp the villagers!
Array.indonesia: Even so, don’t go about doing your own thing.\nHelp the villagers!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Hey now, don’t go poking about in the village too much.
Array.indonesia: Hey now, don’t go poking about in the village too much.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_Ch3_Progress_002
Array.english: You might trip on seaweed with those silly legs of yours. \nPfft.
Array.indonesia: You might trip on seaweed with those silly legs of yours. \nPfft.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: I guess the villagers don’t know how terrible\nhumans can be.
Array.indonesia: I guess the villagers don’t know how terrible\nhumans can be.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: Remember that I’m always watching you, human.\nBest be on your best behavior.
Array.indonesia: Remember that I’m always watching you, human.\nBest be on your best behavior.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Ahem. I mean, I wouldn’t mind having a bit of help from you...
Array.indonesia: Ahem. I mean, I wouldn’t mind having a bit of help from you...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Progress_002
Array.english: <size=37>You’ll need the trust of the villagers as well.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>You’ll need the trust of the villagers as well.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Progress_003
Array.english: They’ve heard a lot of bad things about humans\nand stayed out of contact for a long time.
Array.indonesia: They’ve heard a lot of bad things about humans\nand stayed out of contact for a long time.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Progress_004
Array.english: <size=36>Go and help out the villagers first!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Go and help out the villagers first!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm... \nI’d like you to venture down to the glacial region now...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... \nI’d like you to venture down to the glacial region now...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: It’s been closed off for a long time,\nso I’m not sure if it’ll be okay...
Array.indonesia: It’s been closed off for a long time,\nso I’m not sure if it’ll be okay...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: Without King Long, the Sea People\nwould have died out already...
Array.indonesia: Without King Long, the Sea People\nwould have died out already...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: It’s a very easy thing that we do,\noffering flowers like this.
Array.indonesia: It’s a very easy thing that we do,\noffering flowers like this.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#2_Progress_001
Array.english: Huh? You haven't brought the <color=#1DFEAF>book</color> yet?
Array.indonesia: Huh? You haven't brought the <color=#1DFEAF>book</color> yet?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#2_Progress_002
Array.english: Volume 2….
Array.indonesia: Volume 2….

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#2_Progress_003
Array.english: I can't leave the shop now.\nPlease go on and borrow it from <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color> at the Shrine!
Array.indonesia: I can't leave the shop now.\nPlease go on and borrow it from <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color> at the Shrine!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_1Mission_Cleared_001
Array.english: There are more and more earthquakes lately…\nYour faith should be even stronger during times like these.
Array.indonesia: There are more and more earthquakes lately…\nYour faith should be even stronger during times like these.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_2Mission_Cleared_001
Array.english: Why don't you read some of the great works of King Long?
Array.indonesia: Why don't you read some of the great works of King Long?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_2Mission_Cleared_002
Array.english: But, I can't read the Sea People's language…
Array.indonesia: But, I can't read the Sea People's language…

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_2Mission_Cleared_003
Array.english: <size=34>Then how about I give you a <color=#1DFEAF>detailed</color> explanation?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Then how about I give you a <color=#1DFEAF>detailed</color> explanation?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_2Mission_Cleared_004
Array.english: …Nah. \nI'd rather just learn the Sea People's language.
Array.indonesia: …Nah. \nI'd rather just learn the Sea People's language.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#3_Progress_001
Array.english: There is no way this human <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed dish</color> can be good.\nWell go ahead and bring it. I'll wait.
Array.indonesia: There is no way this human <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed dish</color> can be good.\nWell go ahead and bring it. I'll wait.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#3_Progress_002
Array.english: <size=33>But, he's not the most friendly guy. \nI don't know if he's really gonna help. hm!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But, he's not the most friendly guy. \nI don't know if he's really gonna help. hm!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: I’m not sure if King Long’s greatness\nis something humans can understand, though...
Array.indonesia: I’m not sure if King Long’s greatness\nis something humans can understand, though...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_002
Array.english: Let me give you a bit of history.<size=24><color=#C3C3C3>It was in the year 1049 of our calendar... There was a sudden burst of magma, which also heated the sea. The Sea People were on the verge of destruction...</color></size>
Array.indonesia: Let me give you a bit of history.<size=24><color=#C3C3C3>It was in the year 1049 of our calendar... There was a sudden burst of magma, which also heated the sea. The Sea People were on the verge of destruction...</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_003
Array.english: <size=35>That’s when King Long appeared in front of everyone and claimed he would solve this problem! \nHe went into the Control Room all brave-like...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>That’s when King Long appeared in front of everyone and claimed he would solve this problem! \nHe went into the Control Room all brave-like...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_004
Array.english: *Sob* He saved the whole village, but he died\nfrom his injuries... The thought of it brings tears to my eyes...
Array.indonesia: *Sob* He saved the whole village, but he died\nfrom his injuries... The thought of it brings tears to my eyes...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_005
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>This conversation... sounds strangely familiar...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>This conversation... sounds strangely familiar...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Kazhin_#1_Cleared_006
Array.english: In any case! Keep the great King Long in your thoughts\nas you go about our village!
Array.indonesia: In any case! Keep the great King Long in your thoughts\nas you go about our village!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=38>Hmm... Human...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Hmm... Human...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=36>cough….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>cough….</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: Nothing to worry about…
Array.indonesia: Nothing to worry about…

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#1_Progress_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm…I really need to get the <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color> quickly….</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Hm…I really need to get the <color=#1DFEAF>Coral Porridge</color> quickly….</color>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: ….I guess I should be thankful for the porridge.
Array.indonesia: ….I guess I should be thankful for the porridge.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_#2_Progress_001
Array.english: To start the Blacksmith Workshop I'll need <color=#1DFEAF>Opal</color>.\nI would appreciate it if you could get it….
Array.indonesia: To start the Blacksmith Workshop I'll need <color=#1DFEAF>Opal</color>.\nI would appreciate it if you could get it….

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: I guess... humans aren’t as evil as I thought...
Array.indonesia: I guess... humans aren’t as evil as I thought...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Doowa_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: I’ll help you if you need something...\nI find that easier than making conversation...
Array.indonesia: I’ll help you if you need something...\nI find that easier than making conversation...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: The earthquake has allowed all the Seahorses to escape,\nand the <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorse Races</color> are on hold.
Array.indonesia: The earthquake has allowed all the Seahorses to escape,\nand the <color=#1DFEAF>Seahorse Races</color> are on hold.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: Please look throughout the village.\nI’ll be waiting here.
Array.indonesia: Please look throughout the village.\nI’ll be waiting here.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: Heh. This Game Parlor is open to anybody.
Array.indonesia: Heh. This Game Parlor is open to anybody.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Cleared_002
Array.english: Nothing’s as fair as play.
Array.indonesia: Nothing’s as fair as play.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#1_Cleared_003
Array.english: Come anytime you want.\nBring plenty of Bei as well, heh.
Array.indonesia: Come anytime you want.\nBring plenty of Bei as well, heh.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#3_Progress_001
Array.english: Selgio…\nfollowed the <color=#1DFEAF>Shining Jellyfish</color> again?!...
Array.indonesia: Selgio…\nfollowed the <color=#1DFEAF>Shining Jellyfish</color> again?!...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Linchen_#3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Thank you, human.\nSelgio shouldn't run away now.
Array.indonesia: Thank you, human.\nSelgio shouldn't run away now.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: Ugh... Nawang and Awang...\nThey’re so noisy when they’re hungry.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... Nawang and Awang...\nThey’re so noisy when they’re hungry.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: Please hurry, human,\nbefore they come to the restaurant and raise a ruckus again.
Array.indonesia: Please hurry, human,\nbefore they come to the restaurant and raise a ruckus again.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: Oh my, human.\nI’m running into you often.
Array.indonesia: Oh my, human.\nI’m running into you often.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#1_Cleared_002
Array.english: I think I might have another request for you soon...\nCome visit again, alright? Ehehe.
Array.indonesia: I think I might have another request for you soon...\nCome visit again, alright? Ehehe.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#2_Progress_001
Array.english: Oh dear... I need <color=#1DFEAF>Tube Coral</color> to cook...
Array.indonesia: Oh dear... I need <color=#1DFEAF>Tube Coral</color> to cook...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#2_Progress_002
Array.english: The coral looks like this... Please do get it for me.\nIt should be near the <color=#1DFEAF>Whale Bones</color>.
Array.indonesia: The coral looks like this... Please do get it for me.\nIt should be near the <color=#1DFEAF>Whale Bones</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#2_Cleared_001
Array.english: Wow! Thanks for all your help.
Array.indonesia: Wow! Thanks for all your help.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#2_Cleared_002
Array.english: I’ve been told humans are selfish...\nYou don’t seem half bad. Ehehe.
Array.indonesia: I’ve been told humans are selfish...\nYou don’t seem half bad. Ehehe.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3_Progress_001
Array.english: Hmm. I wonder how monstrous\nhuman food must be...
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I wonder how monstrous\nhuman food must be...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3_Progress_002
Array.english: Please do deliver it safely so I can have a look.
Array.indonesia: Please do deliver it safely so I can have a look.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_Herbman_Progress_001
Array.english: That Tsuchi…should be at home…
Array.indonesia: That Tsuchi…should be at home…

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_Herbman_Progress_002
Array.english: If you see <color=#1DFEAF>Jellyfish Pieces</color> follow them!\nBecause that's the food that those leatherback turtles love!
Array.indonesia: If you see <color=#1DFEAF>Jellyfish Pieces</color> follow them!\nBecause that's the food that those leatherback turtles love!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3-2_Cleared_001
Array.english: Ehehe, human.\nI’ve been hearing some good things about you...
Array.indonesia: Ehehe, human.\nI’ve been hearing some good things about you...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3-2_Cleared_002
Array.english: They’ve been saying they’re reevaluating humans, ehehe!
Array.indonesia: They’ve been saying they’re reevaluating humans, ehehe!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3-2_Cleared_003
Array.english: They may be a little stiff-backed, but the people here\nare all good-hearted.
Array.indonesia: They may be a little stiff-backed, but the people here\nare all good-hearted.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Mima_#3-2_Cleared_004
Array.english: Come over often! Ehehe!
Array.indonesia: Come over often! Ehehe!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Human... Don’t act all friendly.
Array.indonesia: Human... Don’t act all friendly.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm. Some of the villagers have been saying good things\nabout you.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Some of the villagers have been saying good things\nabout you.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: But humans are chronic liars...\nI’m not lowering my guard!
Array.indonesia: But humans are chronic liars...\nI’m not lowering my guard!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Mima#1_WaitLunch_001
Array.english: What do you want, human?\nDon't get on my nerves especially when I'm hungry.
Array.indonesia: What do you want, human?\nDon't get on my nerves especially when I'm hungry.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Mima#1_AfterGive_001
Array.english: Mima’s Lunch Box...\nIt tastes fantastic, as usual...
Array.indonesia: Mima’s Lunch Box...\nIt tastes fantastic, as usual...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Nawang_Mima#1_AfterGive_002
Array.english: Human! I’ll compliment you\nfor not stealing some of the food.
Array.indonesia: Human! I’ll compliment you\nfor not stealing some of the food.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Human…\nBe grateful you’re allowed to stay here at all.
Array.indonesia: Human…\nBe grateful you’re allowed to stay here at all.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm. Even if Tenzhin trusts you,\nAwang is different!
Array.indonesia: Hmm. Even if Tenzhin trusts you,\nAwang is different!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: I will not miss even the slightest danger\nto this village... You’d better believe it.
Array.indonesia: I will not miss even the slightest danger\nto this village... You’d better believe it.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_WaitLunch_001
Array.english: What are you doing wandering around here, human?
Array.indonesia: What are you doing wandering around here, human?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_WaitLunch_002
Array.english: You've been waiting for somebody to take off for lunch...\nYou are quite the sneaky species.
Array.indonesia: You've been waiting for somebody to take off for lunch...\nYou are quite the sneaky species.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_AfterGive_001
Array.english: <size=37>Yum... This... is what I’ve been craving!\nI love the taste of this food!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Yum... This... is what I’ve been craving!\nI love the taste of this food!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_AfterGive_002
Array.english: <size=43>What! Human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=43>What! Human!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Awang_Mima#1_AfterGive_003
Array.english: How long have you been peeping,\nyou treacherous creature...
Array.indonesia: How long have you been peeping,\nyou treacherous creature...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: Records of the song should be in the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Record Chamber</color>.
Array.indonesia: Records of the song should be in the <color=#1DFEAF>Sea People Record Chamber</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Progress_002
Array.english: Please help us, human...\nMay King Long protect you...
Array.indonesia: Please help us, human...\nMay King Long protect you...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: According to the records... King Long was killed in an attack\nby mutated Sea People.
Array.indonesia: According to the records... King Long was killed in an attack\nby mutated Sea People.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Cleared_002
Array.english: The mutants are called <color=#F1DC2B>Gadon</color>,\nand apparently very violent.
Array.indonesia: The mutants are called <color=#F1DC2B>Gadon</color>,\nand apparently very violent.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#1_Cleared_003
Array.english: I still don’t have enough data on\nthe events of this period...
Array.indonesia: I still don’t have enough data on\nthe events of this period...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=40>Oh no! King Long’s statue is broken...</color>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Oh no! King Long’s statue is broken...</color>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Progress_002
Array.english: This is all my fault!\nI failed to maintain it properly...
Array.indonesia: This is all my fault!\nI failed to maintain it properly...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Progress_003
Array.english: Oh human... Please find a way!
Array.indonesia: Oh human... Please find a way!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Cleared_001
Array.english: Thank you so much!
Array.indonesia: Thank you so much!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Cleared_002
Array.english: I would not have liked to meet my ancestors one day\nafter I let King Long’s statue break...
Array.indonesia: I would not have liked to meet my ancestors one day\nafter I let King Long’s statue break...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Cleared_003
Array.english: Everything seems solid now, thanks to you.\nI won’t forget what you’ve done for me.
Array.indonesia: Everything seems solid now, thanks to you.\nI won’t forget what you’ve done for me.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Niamo_#2_Cleared_004
Array.english: May the blessing of King Long go with you.
Array.indonesia: May the blessing of King Long go with you.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Maro_#1_Progress_001
Array.english: Please find the ball the Megamouth Shark\nswallowed... human.
Array.indonesia: Please find the ball the Megamouth Shark\nswallowed... human.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Maro_#1_Cleared_001
Array.english: Thanks to you, I can have fun with my friends again!\nThank you!
Array.indonesia: Thanks to you, I can have fun with my friends again!\nThank you!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Maro_#2_Cleared_001
Array.english: Heh….I'll be doing fine in the village.\nSo don't worry about me!
Array.indonesia: Heh….I'll be doing fine in the village.\nSo don't worry about me!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Beagi_Maro#2_Progress_001
Array.english: Ugh….Maro really is insufferable.
Array.indonesia: Ugh….Maro really is insufferable.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Beagi_Maro#2_Progress_002
Array.english: Maro must have gone to the undersea lake.\nFollow the <color=#1DFEAF>direction signs</color> to get there!
Array.indonesia: Maro must have gone to the undersea lake.\nFollow the <color=#1DFEAF>direction signs</color> to get there!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Padeuma_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: Oh my, I’ve never seen a human before...\nYou have legs... just like a crab...
Array.indonesia: Oh my, I’ve never seen a human before...\nYou have legs... just like a crab...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Padeuma_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm. I think I’m getting used to the sight of a human.\nIsn’t it uncomfortable to swim around when you look like that?
Array.indonesia: Hmm. I think I’m getting used to the sight of a human.\nIsn’t it uncomfortable to swim around when you look like that?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Padeuma_FindSeahorse_001
Array.english: Seahorses?\nI think I might have seen them near the <color=#1DFEAF>gate to the square</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seahorses?\nI think I might have seen them near the <color=#1DFEAF>gate to the square</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: <size=40>Ahee!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ahee!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_Ch3_Progress_002
Array.english: Don’t pop out of nowhere like that...\nSee my gills pumping?
Array.indonesia: Don’t pop out of nowhere like that...\nSee my gills pumping?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: <size=40>Ahee!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ahee!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_Ch3_Cleared_002
Array.english: I guess I’m... not as surprised as before.
Array.indonesia: I guess I’m... not as surprised as before.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_FindSeahorse_001
Array.english: <size=40>Ahee!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Ahee!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yese_FindSeahorse_002
Array.english: Seahorses? I think I’ve seen them enter the <color=#1DFEAF>Seed Shop</color>.
Array.indonesia: Seahorses? I think I’ve seen them enter the <color=#1DFEAF>Seed Shop</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Gumo_Ch3_Progress_001
Array.english: You’re getting in the way of my farming.
Array.indonesia: You’re getting in the way of my farming.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Gumo_FindSeahorse_001
Array.english: I was busy farming. I haven’t seen any Seahorse.
Array.indonesia: I was busy farming. I haven’t seen any Seahorse.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Gumo_Kazhin#3_Progress_001
Array.english: A human made <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed dish</color> can't be good.\nI'll wait for you to bring it.
Array.indonesia: A human made <color=#1DFEAF>seaweed dish</color> can't be good.\nI'll wait for you to bring it.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Gumo_Ch3_Cleared_001
Array.english: Hmm... I heard humans farm, too.\nI guess we have more in common than I thought...
Array.indonesia: Hmm... I heard humans farm, too.\nI guess we have more in common than I thought...

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Yami_Before_Racing_001
Array.english: This is troublesome…\nAll the Seahorses escaped.\rWe can’t hold races... \nand it’s tough putting food on the table.
Array.indonesia: This is troublesome…\nAll the Seahorses escaped.\rWe can’t hold races... \nand it’s tough putting food on the table.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Junak_first_talk_001
Array.english: <size=38>Heh, well look at you, human!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Heh, well look at you, human!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Junak_first_talk_002
Array.english: I’m sure you had a lot of trouble\ncoming all the way down here.
Array.indonesia: I’m sure you had a lot of trouble\ncoming all the way down here.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Junak_first_talk_003
Array.english: Nothing like a few games to get your adrenaline going\nwhen you’re tired, eh?
Array.indonesia: Nothing like a few games to get your adrenaline going\nwhen you’re tired, eh?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Junak_first_talk_004
Array.english: <size=40>Play a game with me, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Play a game with me, hehe!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_001
Array.english: That is...an interesting outfit.
Array.indonesia: That is...an interesting outfit.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_002
Array.english: It’s a suit made of the Divine Tree Fruit Cloth you gave me and some human contraption.
Array.indonesia: It’s a suit made of the Divine Tree Fruit Cloth you gave me and some human contraption.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_003
Array.english: I can explore the Glacial Area with this. It’s very warm.
Array.indonesia: I can explore the Glacial Area with this. It’s very warm.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_004
Array.english: <size=35>Good for you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Good for you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Tenzhin_NewSuit_005
Array.english: Then, can I ask you\nto explore the Glacial Area again to see what happened there?
Array.indonesia: Then, can I ask you\nto explore the Glacial Area again to see what happened there?

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_NewSuit_001
Array.english: You look different today.
Array.indonesia: You look different today.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_NewSuit_002
Array.english: That’s because I am wearing a Cold-resistant Suit to protect me from the coldness of the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: That’s because I am wearing a Cold-resistant Suit to protect me from the coldness of the Glacial Area.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Ramo_NewSuit_003
Array.english: You look good.\nKeep up the good work!
Array.indonesia: You look good.\nKeep up the good work!

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_NewSuit_001
Array.english: <size=34>What is that thing you’re wearing? A costume?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What is that thing you’re wearing? A costume?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_NewSuit_002
Array.english: Ha, you need that thing to survive down there?\nHumans are so fragile.
Array.indonesia: Ha, you need that thing to survive down there?\nHumans are so fragile.

Array.name: dialogue_MV_Suwam_NewSuit_003
Array.english: Good luck down there.\nI am on patrol.
Array.indonesia: Good luck down there.\nI am on patrol.

Array.name: dialogue_Glacial_Dungeon1_SuwamWait_001
Array.english: Ah, my waist hurts from intense training.\nI should have known...
Array.indonesia: Ah, my waist hurts from intense training.\nI should have known...

Array.name: dialogue_Glacial_Dungeon1_SuwamWait_002
Array.english: Take a look inside carefully, human.
Array.indonesia: Take a look inside carefully, human.

Array.name: dialogue_Duff_Concert_opening_01
Array.english: Phew.. I should call it a day.
Array.indonesia: Phew.. I should call it a day.

Array.name: dialogue_Duff_Concert_opening_02
Array.english: It’s a long road, becoming a great master…
Array.indonesia: It’s a long road, becoming a great master…

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_001
Array.english: Did you enjoy playing the game?
Array.indonesia: Did you enjoy playing the game?

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_002
Array.english: This is the version we have prepared for testing.
Array.indonesia: This is the version we have prepared for testing.

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_003
Array.english: There are no further stories ready yet,\nbut you can enjoy the game freely in your own way.
Array.indonesia: There are no further stories ready yet,\nbut you can enjoy the game freely in your own way.

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_004

Array.indonesia: Just play the game and give us feedback.\nYour feedback helps improving our game quality :)

Array.name: dialogue_FGT_TestEnd_005

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Um...Didn’t the manager say he saw someone who looked like Otto around here?</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Um...Didn’t the manager say he saw someone who looked like Otto around here?</color>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_002
Array.english: Hey, chef? May I ask you something?
Array.indonesia: Hey, chef? May I ask you something?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_003
Array.english: <size=40>Welcome to BANCHO SUSHI!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Welcome to BANCHO SUSHI!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_004
Array.english: You guys sell <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> here by any chance?
Array.indonesia: You guys sell <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> here by any chance?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_005
Array.english: <size=40>...<color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>...<color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_006
Array.english: Um, we don’t have that on the menu.\nNorimaki Sushi is the closest thing to that though.
Array.indonesia: Um, we don’t have that on the menu.\nNorimaki Sushi is the closest thing to that though.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_007
Array.english: Not Norimaki sushi. \nI want sushi made with fresh veggies.
Array.indonesia: Not Norimaki sushi. \nI want sushi made with fresh veggies.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy01_008
Array.english: Well, it’s okay then. I will get going.\nHave a good one!
Array.indonesia: Well, it’s okay then. I will get going.\nHave a good one!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_001
Array.english: Wait. This music...\nIt’s Hot Pepper Tuna, the title song from my first album!
Array.indonesia: Wait. This music...\nIt’s Hot Pepper Tuna, the title song from my first album!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_002
Array.english: This kind of music intrigues me.\nYou must be <color=#F1DC2B>MC Sammy</color>, I presume?
Array.indonesia: This kind of music intrigues me.\nYou must be <color=#F1DC2B>MC Sammy</color>, I presume?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_003
Array.english: <size=36>Heh! You recognize me?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Heh! You recognize me?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_004
Array.english: I am pleased to see one of my fans here.\nCould you perhaps make me some <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> then?
Array.indonesia: I am pleased to see one of my fans here.\nCould you perhaps make me some <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> then?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_005
Array.english: We do have some vegetables,\nbut Vegetable Sushi is not that simple.
Array.indonesia: We do have some vegetables,\nbut Vegetable Sushi is not that simple.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_006
Array.english: Give me three days and\nI will serve you some proper <color=#F1DC2B>Vegetable Sushi</color>.
Array.indonesia: Give me three days and\nI will serve you some proper <color=#F1DC2B>Vegetable Sushi</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_007
Array.english: Nice, yo!
Array.indonesia: Nice, yo!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy02_008
Array.english: I will come back in <color=#F1DC2B>three days</color> then!\nI can’t wait!
Array.indonesia: I will come back in <color=#F1DC2B>three days</color> then!\nI can’t wait!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_001
Array.english: Bancho, you got any good ideas?
Array.indonesia: Bancho, you got any good ideas?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_002
Array.english: <size=40>Nope.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Nope.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_003
Array.english: <size=40>Then what is your plan?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Then what is your plan?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_004
Array.english: Otto knows more about vegetables than I do.\nI was going to ask him.
Array.indonesia: Otto knows more about vegetables than I do.\nI was going to ask him.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy03_005
Array.english: Ah, that makes sense. I will give him a call.
Array.indonesia: Ah, that makes sense. I will give him a call.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_001
Array.english: <size=37>Hello, Dave! What’s up?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Hello, Dave! What’s up?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_002
Array.english: Oh, one of our customers asked us to make some <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>...And we need to secure the ingredients for it.
Array.indonesia: Oh, one of our customers asked us to make some <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>...And we need to secure the ingredients for it.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_003
Array.english: Huh? <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>?\nThat’s one of my favorites...
Array.indonesia: Huh? <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>?\nThat’s one of my favorites...

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_004
Array.english: <size=38>Haha, that customer knows true taste!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Haha, that customer knows true taste!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_005
Array.english: Give me some time.\nI will have to work through the night.
Array.indonesia: Give me some time.\nI will have to work through the night.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_006
Array.english: <size=38>I will call you tomorrow morning!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I will call you tomorrow morning!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy04_007
Array.english: Nice! I will visit your place in the morning.
Array.indonesia: Nice! I will visit your place in the morning.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_01_001
Array.english: <size=42>Hey, are you ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Hey, are you ready?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_01_002
Array.english: Right on time.
Array.indonesia: Right on time.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_01_003
Array.english: <size=40>Have a seat. It won’t take long.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Have a seat. It won’t take long.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_02_001
Array.english: <size=44>Yes! This is it!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=44>Yes! This is it!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_02_002
Array.english: <size=42>The taste of this <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>\nreminds me of my younger days!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>The taste of this <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>\nreminds me of my younger days!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_02_003
Array.english: <size=36>Your Vegetable Sushi is perfect.\nWhat’s the secret?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Your Vegetable Sushi is perfect.\nWhat’s the secret?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_02_004
Array.english: All I did was properly season it... Though my acquaintances have provided some assistance with the ingredients.
Array.indonesia: All I did was properly season it... Though my acquaintances have provided some assistance with the ingredients.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_001
Array.english: <size=42>Son?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Son?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_002
Array.english: <size=42>Dad?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=42>Dad?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_003
Array.english: <size=34>I wondered who’d eat something like <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>.\nI didn’t know it was you...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I wondered who’d eat something like <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color>.\nI didn’t know it was you...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_004
Array.english: I heard people talking about someone who looks like you. That's why I visited this place and ordered Vegetable Sushi.
Array.indonesia: I heard people talking about someone who looks like you. That's why I visited this place and ordered Vegetable Sushi.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_005
Array.english: It has been eight years since you left.\nYou never contacted us since.
Array.indonesia: It has been eight years since you left.\nYou never contacted us since.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_006
Array.english: Well, it’s a long story...\nThere was a storm and I got shipwrecked on an uninhabited island...
Array.indonesia: Well, it’s a long story...\nThere was a storm and I got shipwrecked on an uninhabited island...

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_006_2
Array.english: It was just trees and the sea...
Array.indonesia: It was just trees and the sea...

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_007
Array.english: <size=34>I worked hard to get food and water!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I worked hard to get food and water!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_008
Array.english: <size=34>And sometimes hunted wild animals with \na Harpoon Gun and roasted them.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>And sometimes hunted wild animals with \na Harpoon Gun and roasted them.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_009
Array.english: I had to spend some years on the island until I got \nrescued and settled here.
Array.indonesia: I had to spend some years on the island until I got \nrescued and settled here.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_010
Array.english: <size=38>What a story, dad.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>What a story, dad.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_011
Array.english: I wanted to visit home after securing a stable life here.
Array.indonesia: I wanted to visit home after securing a stable life here.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_012
Array.english: But it took so long and time flew.\nI am sorry, my boy.
Array.indonesia: But it took so long and time flew.\nI am sorry, my boy.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_013
Array.english: The folks at the village think you abandoned us, dad.
Array.indonesia: The folks at the village think you abandoned us, dad.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_014
Array.english: My friends pitied me.\nAnd some mocked me.
Array.indonesia: My friends pitied me.\nAnd some mocked me.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_015
Array.english: I began writing music and singing songs\nto relieve stress and I became a rapper.
Array.indonesia: I began writing music and singing songs\nto relieve stress and I became a rapper.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_016
Array.english: My son has grown into such a fine young man \neven without me. I am proud of you, son.
Array.indonesia: My son has grown into such a fine young man \neven without me. I am proud of you, son.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_017
Array.english: I blamed you so much at first,\nbut the music healed me. Gave me inner peace.
Array.indonesia: I blamed you so much at first,\nbut the music healed me. Gave me inner peace.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_018
Array.english: Oh, since you’ve come all the way here,\nwhy don’t you stay at my farm?
Array.indonesia: Oh, since you’ve come all the way here,\nwhy don’t you stay at my farm?

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_019
Array.english: Of course, like old times.
Array.indonesia: Of course, like old times.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_03_020
Array.english: Haha, since you are all grown up,\nwe can grab some beer together!
Array.indonesia: Haha, since you are all grown up,\nwe can grab some beer together!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_001
Array.english: What a plot twist.\nThat rapper was the son of Otto...
Array.indonesia: What a plot twist.\nThat rapper was the son of Otto...

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_002
Array.english: They have something in common.\nBoth are quite talkative.
Array.indonesia: They have something in common.\nBoth are quite talkative.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_003
Array.english: Yeah, I agree.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, I agree.

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_004
Array.english: This is a good thing.\nBANCHO SUSHI helped them to reunite!
Array.indonesia: This is a good thing.\nBANCHO SUSHI helped them to reunite!

Array.name: dialogue_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Complete_04_005
Array.english: The two must have much to say.\nI hope they can resolve their misunderstandings.
Array.indonesia: The two must have much to say.\nI hope they can resolve their misunderstandings.

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Fail_01
Array.english: Ow, <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> isn’t ready yet?
Array.indonesia: Ow, <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> isn’t ready yet?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Fail_02
Array.english: Yo, I will drop by later when it is available...
Array.indonesia: Yo, I will drop by later when it is available...

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Fail_03
Array.english: <size=34>I am disappointed, Chef...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I am disappointed, Chef...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Phone_Fail_01
Array.english: Can you bring <color=#1DFEAF>vegetable sushi</color> when you visit next time?
Array.indonesia: Can you bring <color=#1DFEAF>vegetable sushi</color> when you visit next time?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Phone_Fail_02
Array.english: It's a food that means a lot to me yo.\nPlease, please bro!
Array.indonesia: It's a food that means a lot to me yo.\nPlease, please bro!

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Revisit_01
Array.english: I couldn’t order <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> last time.\nCan I order it this time? Yo?
Array.indonesia: I couldn’t order <color=#1DFEAF>Vegetable Sushi</color> last time.\nCan I order it this time? Yo?

Array.name: dialog_VIP_Mission04_Sammy_Revisit_02
Array.english: <size=37>I will come back <color=#F1DC2B>tomorrow</color>! Peace!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>I will come back <color=#F1DC2B>tomorrow</color>! Peace!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_02
Array.english: Today, I present a new program called\n<color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> featuring Vincent Yamaoka!
Array.indonesia: Today, I present a new program called\n<color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> featuring Vincent Yamaoka!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_03
Array.english: It’s been a long time, everyone.\nI am Vincent Yamaoka.
Array.indonesia: It’s been a long time, everyone.\nI am Vincent Yamaoka.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_04
Array.english: <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> is a program set to discover\nmaster chefs of the world!
Array.indonesia: <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> is a program set to discover\nmaster chefs of the world!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_05
Array.english: The champion of the last season was <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, who was praised by Vincent! He will be the defending champion today...
Array.indonesia: The champion of the last season was <color=#F1DC2B>Bancho</color>, who was praised by Vincent! He will be the defending champion today...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_06
Array.english: <size=36>D-defending champion?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>D-defending champion?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_07
Array.english: <size=35>And this season’s first challenger\nis <color=#F1DC2B>Wang Pang</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>And this season’s first challenger\nis <color=#F1DC2B>Wang Pang</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_08
Array.english: <size=35>It’s my honor to be here. \nI am <color=#F1DC2B>Wang Pang</color> from Hong Kong.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It’s my honor to be here. \nI am <color=#F1DC2B>Wang Pang</color> from Hong Kong.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_09
Array.english: Nice to meet you, Wang Pang.
Array.indonesia: Nice to meet you, Wang Pang.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_10
Array.english: All right! We’ve met the contestants,\nnow let us begin the show!
Array.indonesia: All right! We’ve met the contestants,\nnow let us begin the show!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_11
Array.english: You two will compete with dishes on the same day \nat the same place on a given theme. Vincent Yamaoka will judge your dishes.
Array.indonesia: You two will compete with dishes on the same day \nat the same place on a given theme. Vincent Yamaoka will judge your dishes.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_12
Array.english: <size=33>Today’s theme for the contest is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Today’s theme for the contest is...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_13
Array.english: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Chinese cuisine</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38><color=#F1DC2B>Chinese cuisine</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_14
Array.english: Oh well, this isn’t good.
Array.indonesia: Oh well, this isn’t good.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_15
Array.english: As you know, Chinese cuisine\ndeveloped many different cooking styles in its long history.
Array.indonesia: As you know, Chinese cuisine\ndeveloped many different cooking styles in its long history.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_16
Array.english: When we talk about Chinese cuisine, many will think of \nstir-fried meat and vegetables. But that’s not all. There is more than that.
Array.indonesia: When we talk about Chinese cuisine, many will think of \nstir-fried meat and vegetables. But that’s not all. There is more than that.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_17
Array.english: This time, you two will compete for the dish using fish.\nGive me a Chinese-style fish dish. May the best chef win!
Array.indonesia: This time, you two will compete for the dish using fish.\nGive me a Chinese-style fish dish. May the best chef win!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_18
Array.english: I heard of you and your reputation, Bancho,\nbut I will beat you with a fabulous recipe from Hong Kong.
Array.indonesia: I heard of you and your reputation, Bancho,\nbut I will beat you with a fabulous recipe from Hong Kong.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_WangPang_Appear_19

Array.indonesia: The theme? It’s fried dishes.

Array.indonesia: Not quite right!\nThe theme for this contest was Fry the Sea!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_07
Array.english: Masterfully fried cod is good on its own,\nbut that alone does not represent the sea.
Array.indonesia: Masterfully fried cod is good on its own,\nbut that alone does not represent the sea.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_08
Array.english: <size=33>However, Bancho’s dish was...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>However, Bancho’s dish was...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_09
Array.english: <size=36>What kind of soy sauce did you use?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>What kind of soy sauce did you use?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_10

Array.indonesia: I added chopped green laver and added it to normal soy sauce.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_11
Array.english: <size=32>As I expected. I liked your shark and squid combination, \nbut the highlight was your soy sauce recipe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>As I expected. I liked your shark and squid combination, \nbut the highlight was your soy sauce recipe!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_12
Array.english: The soy sauce enriched with the flavor of the sea\nbetter represented the taste of the sea! What an impressive flavor!
Array.indonesia: The soy sauce enriched with the flavor of the sea\nbetter represented the taste of the sea! What an impressive flavor!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_13
Array.english: Your dish gave me a feeling of exploring the sea,\nfrom the coastal waters to the deep sea. That was a fabulous adventure!
Array.indonesia: Your dish gave me a feeling of exploring the sea,\nfrom the coastal waters to the deep sea. That was a fabulous adventure!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_14

Array.indonesia: The texture of your fried dish was good as well,\nbut the game changer was your soy sauce!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_15

Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alas...\nMy perfect fries were not enough to satisfy the judge...</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=35>You need to be careful when making the soy sauce.\nThat’s...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_19

Array.indonesia: <size=44>Thank you, Bancho!</size>\n<size=34>The champion prefers action over words and we love it!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_20

Array.indonesia: <size=33>And it’s time to wrap up today’s episode of <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color>. Today, Bancho won the contest! This is-</size>

Array.indonesia: Wait a moment.

Array.indonesia: I am pleased by today’s contest and\nI would like to give him a piece of advice.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_23

Array.indonesia: You, I see your menu is expanding,\nbut the drinks you offer stay the same, yes?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_24

Array.indonesia: <size=38>Because I am a chef, not a barkeep.</size>

Array.indonesia: You said the same thing before.\nDining is a comprehensive experience.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Alex_Win_26

Array.indonesia: What do you pair up with your pasta? A glass of wine,\na glass of cola, or just a glass of water? It will significantly change the dining experience.

Array.indonesia: Your place cannot satisfy the various tastes of customers \nwith a limited selection of drinks.

Array.indonesia: <size=38>This is my gift for you. It’s a <color=#F1DC2B>Cocktail Dispenser</color>!</size>

Array.indonesia: You can make interesting cocktails using sake as a base.
