Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear_02
Array.english: We have a very special guest today!
Array.indonesia: We have a very special guest today!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear_03
Array.english: As far as we know, our guest, in an ill-fated relationship \nwith Bancho, was a has-be...
Array.indonesia: As far as we know, our guest, in an ill-fated relationship \nwith Bancho, was a has-be...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear_04
Array.english: <size=34>I mean, legendary actress!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I mean, legendary actress!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_01
Array.english: <size=38>Loigi!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Loigi!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_02
Array.english: <size=35>Excuse me. The name is <color=#F1DC2B>Lois</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Excuse me. The name is <color=#F1DC2B>Lois</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_03
Array.english: Long time no see, Bancho.\nThe last time I saw you, you owned a restaurant at a five-star hotel, not this kind of shabby restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Long time no see, Bancho.\nThe last time I saw you, you owned a restaurant at a five-star hotel, not this kind of shabby restaurant.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_04
Array.english: <size=33>Shark dishes didn't sell well or something?\nHahaha!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Shark dishes didn't sell well or something?\nHahaha!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_05
Array.english: She’s rude.\nIs she the restaurant critic who defamed you?
Array.indonesia: She’s rude.\nIs she the restaurant critic who defamed you?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_06
Array.english: You heard stories from Miss Yoshie?\nRight. That’s she.
Array.indonesia: You heard stories from Miss Yoshie?\nRight. That’s she.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_07
Array.english: What brought you to a lowly place like this?\nI thought you review only prestigious restaurants?
Array.indonesia: What brought you to a lowly place like this?\nI thought you review only prestigious restaurants?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_08
Array.english: Well, my previous review of your restaurant...\nIt became a thorn in my side.
Array.indonesia: Well, my previous review of your restaurant...\nIt became a thorn in my side.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_09
Array.english: My reputation suffered from comments saying I was \n‘closed-minded,’ ‘disqualified as a taster,’ et cetera...
Array.indonesia: My reputation suffered from comments saying I was \n‘closed-minded,’ ‘disqualified as a taster,’ et cetera...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_10
Array.english: And my career as a restaurant critic has declined since then.
Array.indonesia: And my career as a restaurant critic has declined since then.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_11
Array.english: <size=36>All because you served me a disgusting dish…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>All because you served me a disgusting dish…!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_12
Array.english: She tried to make a comeback in movies, \nbut that didn't go well either. Peccato…
Array.indonesia: She tried to make a comeback in movies, \nbut that didn't go well either. Peccato…

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear02_13
Array.english: <size=36>No need to speak of that!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>No need to speak of that!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_01
Array.english: Let me introduce <color=#F1DC2B>Pastro Antogiovani</color>. I brought him from Italy\nto teach you what culinary elegance really means.
Array.indonesia: Let me introduce <color=#F1DC2B>Pastro Antogiovani</color>. I brought him from Italy\nto teach you what culinary elegance really means.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_02
Array.english: Ciao, amico. I heard a lot about you. An oddball of a chef\nwho uses strange ingredients to draw attention.
Array.indonesia: Ciao, amico. I heard a lot about you. An oddball of a chef\nwho uses strange ingredients to draw attention.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_03
Array.english: You are just a showman and I will prove that today.
Array.indonesia: You are just a showman and I will prove that today.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_04
Array.english: Why do chefs and cooks stick to certain ingredients? \nBecause they are time-tested and proven!
Array.indonesia: Why do chefs and cooks stick to certain ingredients? \nBecause they are time-tested and proven!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_05
Array.english: Replacing time-tested ingredients arbitrarily doesn’t \nmake a good dish. Your dishes are disgusting.
Array.indonesia: Replacing time-tested ingredients arbitrarily doesn’t \nmake a good dish. Your dishes are disgusting.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_06
Array.english: I will show you. You will learn why Italian cuisine has led the world for centuries.
Array.indonesia: I will show you. You will learn why Italian cuisine has led the world for centuries.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_07
Array.english: <size=36>Oh! Drama from the past!\nI can’t wait to see how it will develop!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Oh! Drama from the past!\nI can’t wait to see how it will develop!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_08
Array.english: <size=35>Well, today’s theme is...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Well, today’s theme is...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_09
Array.english: <size=40>Pasta!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>Pasta!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_10
Array.english: Why does the subject always benefit the challenger!
Array.indonesia: Why does the subject always benefit the challenger!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_11
Array.english: <size=33>A clash between two maestros!\nLet’s find out whom Vincent will choose!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>A clash between two maestros!\nLet’s find out whom Vincent will choose!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_12
Array.english: <size=35>As always, the contest will begin in <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color>.\nWe will meet here in 2 days!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>As always, the contest will begin in <color=#1DFEAF>2 days</color>.\nWe will meet here in 2 days!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Appear03_13
Array.english: <size=34>Stay tuned and see what\ntranspires in today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Stay tuned and see what\ntranspires in today’s <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color><color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_01
Array.english: Pasta?! Isn’t it too one-sided? \nThat Italian chef is definitely at an advantage.
Array.indonesia: Pasta?! Isn’t it too one-sided? \nThat Italian chef is definitely at an advantage.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_02
Array.english: I saw this show on TV, and found out that one of the sponsors of this show was the <color=#1DFEAF>B&C Company</color>.
Array.indonesia: I saw this show on TV, and found out that one of the sponsors of this show was the <color=#1DFEAF>B&C Company</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_03
Array.english: The <color=#1DFEAF>B&C Company</color>...\nThe famous restaurant franchise?
Array.indonesia: The <color=#1DFEAF>B&C Company</color>...\nThe famous restaurant franchise?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_04
Array.english: Their restaurants are all good.\nSo what is the problem?
Array.indonesia: Their restaurants are all good.\nSo what is the problem?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_05
Array.english: Of course, they serve good food.\nUse fresh ingredients as well. But...
Array.indonesia: Of course, they serve good food.\nUse fresh ingredients as well. But...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_06
Array.english: <size=35>...But?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>...But?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_07
Array.english: <size=36>The letter C in B&C represents <color=#F1DC2B>Crawford</color>. \nThat’s the problem.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>The letter C in B&C represents <color=#F1DC2B>Crawford</color>. \nThat’s the problem.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_08
Array.english: <size=37>What?! It’s Lois Crawford’s company!?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>What?! It’s Lois Crawford’s company!?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_09
Array.english: It’s her family business to be exact.\nAnd she will one day inherit it.
Array.indonesia: It’s her family business to be exact.\nAnd she will one day inherit it.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_10
Array.english: I see. That’s why she is quite knowledgeable \nin cooking for an actress.
Array.indonesia: I see. That’s why she is quite knowledgeable \nin cooking for an actress.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_11
Array.english: I bet she wanted to get back at you using the show!
Array.indonesia: I bet she wanted to get back at you using the show!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_12
Array.english: Quite possible.
Array.indonesia: Quite possible.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_13
Array.english: Still, all she can do is select the contest theme.\nAfter all, it’s Vincent’s call that matters in the end.
Array.indonesia: Still, all she can do is select the contest theme.\nAfter all, it’s Vincent’s call that matters in the end.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_14
Array.english: His palate doesn’t lie.\nI have a chance to win if I am well prepared.
Array.indonesia: His palate doesn’t lie.\nI have a chance to win if I am well prepared.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_15
Array.english: I will cook squid and shrimp this time. \nBring me some <color=#1DFEAF>Humboldt Squids</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>White Shrimp</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>Wheat</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Garlic</color>.
Array.indonesia: I will cook squid and shrimp this time. \nBring me some <color=#1DFEAF>Humboldt Squids</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>White Shrimp</color>, <color=#1DFEAF>Wheat</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Garlic</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_16
Array.english: <color=#1DFEAF>Humboldt squids</color> are nocturnal predators.\nYou need to dive at <color=#F1DC2B>night</color> to hunt them.
Array.indonesia: <color=#1DFEAF>Humboldt squids</color> are nocturnal predators.\nYou need to dive at <color=#F1DC2B>night</color> to hunt them.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_17
Array.english: I see.
Array.indonesia: I see.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Leave_18
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hm. This contest will not be easy for Bancho.)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Hm. This contest will not be easy for Bancho.)</color>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_01
Array.english: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hello, everyone!\nThis is <color=#F1DC2B>Yui</color> from NDC station!<color=#ff61e3>♥</color></size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_02
Array.english: Today is the day we've all been waiting for!\nWith whose victory will this longstanding conflict end?
Array.indonesia: Today is the day we've all been waiting for!\nWith whose victory will this longstanding conflict end?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_03
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, are you ready?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, are you ready?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_04
Array.english: <size=38>Yes.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>Yes.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_05
Array.english: <size=36>Pastro?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Pastro?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_06
Array.english: Sono pronto. Let’s get it started.
Array.indonesia: Sono pronto. Let’s get it started.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Complete01_07
Array.english: Excellent!\nThen let’s begin <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> now!
Array.indonesia: Excellent!\nThen let’s begin <color=#00d98f>Challenge◆the Chef</color> now!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_AngryOut_01
Array.english: Mamma mia! I can’t believe it!\nI, Pastro Antogiovani, defeated in a pasta contest?
Array.indonesia: Mamma mia! I can’t believe it!\nI, Pastro Antogiovani, defeated in a pasta contest?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_AngryOut_02
Array.english: I can’t accept the judge’s call. \nThis show is lame and not worth my time. ORRIBILE.
Array.indonesia: I can’t accept the judge’s call. \nThis show is lame and not worth my time. ORRIBILE.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_01
Array.english: Tsk, that guy is hot-tempered.\nHis carbonara was fantastic though. It was unbelievable.
Array.indonesia: Tsk, that guy is hot-tempered.\nHis carbonara was fantastic though. It was unbelievable.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_02
Array.english: I liked the combination of salty guanciale and \nsoft yolk sauce...It was heavenly.
Array.indonesia: I liked the combination of salty guanciale and \nsoft yolk sauce...It was heavenly.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_03
Array.english: <size=36>Then why didn’t he win, Vincent?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Then why didn’t he win, Vincent?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_04
Array.english: Ms. Lois. Do you know why squid ink\nis used in dishes?
Array.indonesia: Ms. Lois. Do you know why squid ink\nis used in dishes?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_05
Array.english: What? Isn’t that for the color?\nWhy bother making the color like that though?
Array.indonesia: What? Isn’t that for the color?\nWhy bother making the color like that though?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_06
Array.english: Not really, Ms. Lois.
Array.indonesia: Not really, Ms. Lois.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_07
Array.english: The visual is only a part of the reason.\nSquid ink is reminiscent of the taste of nature's seawater.
Array.indonesia: The visual is only a part of the reason.\nSquid ink is reminiscent of the taste of nature's seawater.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_08
Array.english: When I tasted Bancho’s pasta,\nI saw the dark and quiet sea.
Array.indonesia: When I tasted Bancho’s pasta,\nI saw the dark and quiet sea.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_09
Array.english: Black pasta...\nAnd nocturnal sea creatures dotting the black sea.
Array.indonesia: Black pasta...\nAnd nocturnal sea creatures dotting the black sea.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_10
Array.english: <size=34>I felt like diving into\nthe dark, quiet sea naked at night!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I felt like diving into\nthe dark, quiet sea naked at night!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_11
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Why naked though...)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Why naked though...)</color>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_12
Array.english: ‘Tastiness’ is a very subjective experience after all.\nEven for a critic like myself. It’s never easy to be objective.
Array.indonesia: ‘Tastiness’ is a very subjective experience after all.\nEven for a critic like myself. It’s never easy to be objective.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_13
Array.english: I liked the taste of both dishes equally.
Array.indonesia: I liked the taste of both dishes equally.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_14
Array.english: However, I gave more points to Bancho for his near-perfect representation of the theme in every nook and cranny of his dish.
Array.indonesia: However, I gave more points to Bancho for his near-perfect representation of the theme in every nook and cranny of his dish.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_15
Array.english: Your reasoning is so absurd!
Array.indonesia: Your reasoning is so absurd!

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_16
Array.english: <size=34>You do know who is the biggest sponsor of your program, don’t you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You do know who is the biggest sponsor of your program, don’t you?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_17
Array.english: <size=38>I do know!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=38>I do know!</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_18
Array.english: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Nolan Crawford</color>…\nThe chairman of the B&C Group, who is your father.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33><color=#F1DC2B>Nolan Crawford</color>…\nThe chairman of the B&C Group, who is your father.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_19
Array.english: He is also my Sensei.
Array.indonesia: He is also my Sensei.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_20
Array.english: <size=34>Y-you know my father personally? \nHow is that possible?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Y-you know my father personally? \nHow is that possible?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_01
Array.english: When I was young,\nI worked at your father’s restaurant in New York.
Array.indonesia: When I was young,\nI worked at your father’s restaurant in New York.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_02
Array.english: Back then, I was nothing but an inexperienced apprentice cook. I was lucky to be hired by your father.
Array.indonesia: Back then, I was nothing but an inexperienced apprentice cook. I was lucky to be hired by your father.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_03
Array.english: My first job was cooking omelets.
Array.indonesia: My first job was cooking omelets.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_04
Array.english: Although egg is a pretty common ingredient,\nit is one of the hardest to master.
Array.indonesia: Although egg is a pretty common ingredient,\nit is one of the hardest to master.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_05
Array.english: It’s very hard to time the perfect moment to flip the omelet in a frying pan. I was struggling to figure that out.
Array.indonesia: It’s very hard to time the perfect moment to flip the omelet in a frying pan. I was struggling to figure that out.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_06
Array.english: And...
Array.indonesia: And...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_07
Array.english: Someone tapped my shoulder with a smile on his face.
Array.indonesia: Someone tapped my shoulder with a smile on his face.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_08
Array.english: <size=33>It was your father, <color=#F1DC2B>Nolan Crawford</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It was your father, <color=#F1DC2B>Nolan Crawford</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_09
Array.english: He kindly taught me when and how to better flip the egg.
Array.indonesia: He kindly taught me when and how to better flip the egg.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win_VincentTalk_10
Array.english: He, the restaurant owner, didn’t mind spending his precious time teaching a new hire.
Array.indonesia: He, the restaurant owner, didn’t mind spending his precious time teaching a new hire.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_01
Array.english: His passion and creativity toward food were truly inspirational.
Array.indonesia: His passion and creativity toward food were truly inspirational.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_02
Array.english: He was always looking for new tastes and experimented with new recipes. He failed more times than I can remember, but he would succeed in the end.
Array.indonesia: He was always looking for new tastes and experimented with new recipes. He failed more times than I can remember, but he would succeed in the end.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_03
Array.english: I see...
Array.indonesia: I see...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_04
Array.english: He is now an entrepreneur of a large corporation,\nbut I believe his passion would never change. I can feel it.
Array.indonesia: He is now an entrepreneur of a large corporation,\nbut I believe his passion would never change. I can feel it.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_05
Array.english: Ms. Lois.\nWhy don’t you try Bancho’s pasta yourself?
Array.indonesia: Ms. Lois.\nWhy don’t you try Bancho’s pasta yourself?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win2_06
Array.english: Well, if you insist.
Array.indonesia: Well, if you insist.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_01
Array.english: <size=34>…I admit I was prejudiced.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>…I admit I was prejudiced.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_02
Array.english: <size=36>This pasta is... incredible.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>This pasta is... incredible.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_03
Array.english: It’s not just the visual.\nIt carries the natural flavor of each ingredient.
Array.indonesia: It’s not just the visual.\nIt carries the natural flavor of each ingredient.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_04
Array.english: And I criticized his dish without even trying it.
Array.indonesia: And I criticized his dish without even trying it.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_05
Array.english: I am not worthy to be a restaurant critic.
Array.indonesia: I am not worthy to be a restaurant critic.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_06
Array.english: <size=34>Don’t blame yourself.\nWe just have a different philosophy about food.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Don’t blame yourself.\nWe just have a different philosophy about food.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_07
Array.english: <size=32>Bancho?\nI know it’s a rather abrupt offer, but...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Bancho?\nI know it’s a rather abrupt offer, but...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_08
Array.english: <size=35>Would you be interested in opening a <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Would you be interested in opening a <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_09
Array.english: <size=40>A branch?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=40>A branch?</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_10
Array.english: Yes.\nAnother <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.
Array.indonesia: Yes.\nAnother <color=#F1DC2B>BANCHO SUSHI</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_11
Array.english: Clearly there are many people who\ndon’t understand your food philosophy.
Array.indonesia: Clearly there are many people who\ndon’t understand your food philosophy.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_12
Array.english: But if they taste your food at least once,\nthey will wake up to a new dimension of food.
Array.indonesia: But if they taste your food at least once,\nthey will wake up to a new dimension of food.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_13
Array.english: I want them to have that mind-blowing opportunity.
Array.indonesia: I want them to have that mind-blowing opportunity.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_14
Array.english: <size=33>But your current restaurant is too small.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>But your current restaurant is too small.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_15
Array.english: It’s big enough for me.
Array.indonesia: It’s big enough for me.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_16
Array.english: Your restaurant is already widely known.\nPeople will visit your place in droves sooner or later.
Array.indonesia: Your restaurant is already widely known.\nPeople will visit your place in droves sooner or later.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_17
Array.english: You need to be prepared to maintain the quality \nof the food you serve.
Array.indonesia: You need to be prepared to maintain the quality \nof the food you serve.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_18
Array.english: But if he opens a branch, it will be harder for him \nto control the food quality.
Array.indonesia: But if he opens a branch, it will be harder for him \nto control the food quality.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_19
Array.english: He has staff members\nwho sincerely follow his philosophy, right?
Array.indonesia: He has staff members\nwho sincerely follow his philosophy, right?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_20
Array.english: They can be the <color=#1DFEAF>manager</color> of the branch.
Array.indonesia: They can be the <color=#1DFEAF>manager</color> of the branch.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_21
Array.english: Manager you say...
Array.indonesia: Manager you say...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_22
Array.english: Don’t worry. Trust your staff. They know what to do\nto live up to the reputation you built.
Array.indonesia: Don’t worry. Trust your staff. They know what to do\nto live up to the reputation you built.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_23
Array.english: Trust your staff and let more people taste your food.
Array.indonesia: Trust your staff and let more people taste your food.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_24
Array.english: But I don’t have a management system and\nfunds to open a branch yet.
Array.indonesia: But I don’t have a management system and\nfunds to open a branch yet.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_25
Array.english: <size=34>That... I can help you with.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>That... I can help you with.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_26
Array.english: I know how to operate a franchise. I was well educated in that matter by my father. I have the skills and the money for this.
Array.indonesia: I know how to operate a franchise. I was well educated in that matter by my father. I have the skills and the money for this.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_27
Array.english: And I won’t ask anything in return.\nConsider this your reward for winning the contest.
Array.indonesia: And I won’t ask anything in return.\nConsider this your reward for winning the contest.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_28
Array.english: Well, I am not sure if this is right... \nBANCHO SUSHI without me...
Array.indonesia: Well, I am not sure if this is right... \nBANCHO SUSHI without me...

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_29
Array.english: <size=36>Bancho, I think you should give it a try.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Bancho, I think you should give it a try.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_30
Array.english: This will be a good challenge for the staff to grow further.
Array.indonesia: This will be a good challenge for the staff to grow further.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_31
Array.english: Um, if that's what everyone thinks, I have no other choice.
Array.indonesia: Um, if that's what everyone thinks, I have no other choice.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_32
Array.english: Okay. I will open a <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>.
Array.indonesia: Okay. I will open a <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_33
Array.english: What am I supposed to do though?\nOrder wooden planks or something?
Array.indonesia: What am I supposed to do though?\nOrder wooden planks or something?

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_34
Array.english: Don’t worry about the construction.\nB&C Company will take care of it.
Array.indonesia: Don’t worry about the construction.\nB&C Company will take care of it.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_35
Array.english: You just name the <color=#1DFEAF>manager</color> and\ndecide what to serve with what ingredients, Bancho.
Array.indonesia: You just name the <color=#1DFEAF>manager</color> and\ndecide what to serve with what ingredients, Bancho.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_36
Array.english: Well, it’s about time for the nightshift.\nThe construction will be completed by tomorrow morning.
Array.indonesia: Well, it’s about time for the nightshift.\nThe construction will be completed by tomorrow morning.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_37
Array.english: <size=36>She must be kidding...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>She must be kidding...</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_38
Array.english: Anyway, I realized that I was closed-minded about \nnew approaches to food.
Array.indonesia: Anyway, I realized that I was closed-minded about \nnew approaches to food.

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_39
Array.english: <size=35>I apologize for my poor review of your dish in the past.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>I apologize for my poor review of your dish in the past.</size>

Array.name: dialog_VIPMission_Pastro_Win3_40

Array.name: dialog_Bowheadwhales_FirstEncounter01_001

Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wow…Whales this deep in the glacial area?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Bowheadwhales_FirstEncounter01_002
Array.english: Was that a <color=#F1DC2B>Bowhead Whale</color>…?\nLooks pretty unique!
Array.indonesia: Was that a <color=#F1DC2B>Bowhead Whale</color>…?\nLooks pretty unique!

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_001
Array.english: Phew... The fog is really thick today.
Array.indonesia: Phew... The fog is really thick today.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_002
Array.english: <size=34>Oh...who…are you?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh...who…are you?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_003
Array.english: <size=33>I'm a traveller and a merchant, all rolled into one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I'm a traveller and a merchant, all rolled into one!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_004
Array.english: I ended up here while I was out hunting for <color=#F1DC2B>aberrated</color> fish.
Array.indonesia: I ended up here while I was out hunting for <color=#F1DC2B>aberrated</color> fish.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_005
Array.english: <size=35><color=#F1DC2B>Aberrated</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35><color=#F1DC2B>Aberrated</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_006
Array.english: Ah…You don't know, do you? <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrations</color> refer to sea species that have strangely mutated or changed in some bizarre way.
Array.indonesia: Ah…You don't know, do you? <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrations</color> refer to sea species that have strangely mutated or changed in some bizarre way.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_007
Array.english: They appear at specific locations on days when the red mist rolls in.
Array.indonesia: They appear at specific locations on days when the red mist rolls in.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_008
Array.english: There are creatures called <color=#F1DC2B>Hooded Figures</color> who feed on these abberated fish…
Array.indonesia: There are creatures called <color=#F1DC2B>Hooded Figures</color> who feed on these abberated fish…

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_009
Array.english: If you bring them aberrated fish, they will compensate you well!
Array.indonesia: If you bring them aberrated fish, they will compensate you well!

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_010
Array.english: I have no idea what you are talking about…
Array.indonesia: I have no idea what you are talking about…

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_011
Array.english: Hooded Figures are sure to visit a nearby <color=#F1DC2B>restaurant</color> during the evening.
Array.indonesia: Hooded Figures are sure to visit a nearby <color=#F1DC2B>restaurant</color> during the evening.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_012
Array.english: By the way, you seem like a fisher. In that case, can you help me catch some <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>?
Array.indonesia: By the way, you seem like a fisher. In that case, can you help me catch some <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_013
Array.english: <size=34>What? I can't sail in this fog!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What? I can't sail in this fog!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_014
Array.english: Now, don't you worry. I'll lend you a <color=#1DFEAF>special light</color> that helps you sail through fog.
Array.indonesia: Now, don't you worry. I'll lend you a <color=#1DFEAF>special light</color> that helps you sail through fog.

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_015
Array.english: <size=34>It's called the <color=#1DFEAF>Sky Fire</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>It's called the <color=#1DFEAF>Sky Fire</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_016
Array.english: You'll be able to navigate through the red fog with this.\n<size=27><color=#C3C3C3>Though, you won't see very far.</color></size>
Array.indonesia: You'll be able to navigate through the red fog with this.\n<size=27><color=#C3C3C3>Though, you won't see very far.</color></size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_017
Array.english: <size=35>Haha! Aberrant fish? That sounds fun!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Haha! Aberrant fish? That sounds fun!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_Merchant_Appear_018
Array.english: For now, we could use that <color=#1DFEAF>light</color> of yours.\nAs it is, we won't even be able to reach BANCHO SUSHI!
Array.indonesia: For now, we could use that <color=#1DFEAF>light</color> of yours.\nAs it is, we won't even be able to reach BANCHO SUSHI!

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_001
Array.english: <size=35>Alright! Now we should be able to navigate these waters.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Alright! Now we should be able to navigate these waters.</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_002
Array.english: Oh, by the way, about the <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>…
Array.indonesia: Oh, by the way, about the <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_003
Array.english: Those <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> may eat them, but for sure the regular guests won't.
Array.indonesia: Those <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> may eat them, but for sure the regular guests won't.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_004
Array.english: <size=34>What should we do with the leftover fish, Miss?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What should we do with the leftover fish, Miss?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_005
Array.english: Haha. I'll come and buy whatever's left once you close up shop.
Array.indonesia: Haha. I'll come and buy whatever's left once you close up shop.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_006
Array.english: After all, they'll go bad the very next day if you store them like any other fish.
Array.indonesia: After all, they'll go bad the very next day if you store them like any other fish.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_007
Array.english: Well, if that's the deal…
Array.indonesia: Well, if that's the deal…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_008
Array.english: <size=35>Shall we give it a try, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Shall we give it a try, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_009
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>, huh…\nShould be pretty interesting stuff for a diver like you!
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>, huh…\nShould be pretty interesting stuff for a diver like you!

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_010
Array.english: I do want to see them, but I have a feeling they won't be easy to catch.
Array.indonesia: I do want to see them, but I have a feeling they won't be easy to catch.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_011
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! But you've got yourself a mighty harpoon!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! But you've got yourself a mighty harpoon!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_AfterLightChange_012
Array.english: <size=35>For now, let's sail!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>For now, let's sail!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_BoatControl_001
Array.english: <size=34>Hmm… The fog is thick…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hmm… The fog is thick…</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_BoatControl_002
Array.english: Dave, days like this can be a dangerous one. I recommend brushing up on how to steer the boat.
Array.indonesia: Dave, days like this can be a dangerous one. I recommend brushing up on how to steer the boat.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_001

Array.indonesia: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Bzz…</color><i>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_002
Array.english: It seems like it's smooth sailing for you.
Array.indonesia: It seems like it's smooth sailing for you.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_003
Array.english: There's one thing I forgot to mention.
Array.indonesia: There's one thing I forgot to mention.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_004
Array.english: Where there's a <color=#F1DC2B>small vortex</color>, there's sure to be aberrant fish.
Array.indonesia: Where there's a <color=#F1DC2B>small vortex</color>, there's sure to be aberrant fish.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_005
Array.english: Hmm… A small vortex.
Array.indonesia: Hmm… A small vortex.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_006
Array.english: Oh, and you'll also see some <color=#F1DC2B>spots foaming with bubbles</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, and you'll also see some <color=#F1DC2B>spots foaming with bubbles</color>.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_007
Array.english: It won't be easy diving in those areas, but there's <color=#1DFEAF>valuables</color> you can dredge in those areas.
Array.indonesia: It won't be easy diving in those areas, but there's <color=#1DFEAF>valuables</color> you can dredge in those areas.

Array.indonesia: You might find rare materials or items that will fetch a good price, so keep an eye out for them.

Array.indonesia: <size=34>Valuables? Now that's something we can't miss! Haha!</size>

Array.indonesia: Talk to you later.\nSee you at the restaurant.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_PointDesc_011

Array.indonesia: <i><color=#C3C3C3>Bzz…</color><i>

Array.indonesia: <size=34>Dave! Look over there!\nThose must be the <color=#F1DC2B>bubbles</color> the merchant mentioned!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DredgingPoint_002

Array.indonesia: <size=34>Woah… It does look like something is there.</size>

Array.english: Let’s see… There should be equipment for dredging in this boat…
Array.indonesia: Let’s see… There should be equipment for dredging in this boat…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DredgingPoint_004
Array.english: <size=35>Let's sail to the <color=#F1DC2B>bubbles</color> for now!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let's sail to the <color=#F1DC2B>bubbles</color> for now!</size>

Array.english: <size=35>There! That looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>small vortex</color> that the merchant mentioned!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>There! That looks like the <color=#F1DC2B>small vortex</color> that the merchant mentioned!</size>

Array.english: It looks like it.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_003
Array.english: <size=34>Ready to go in, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_004
Array.english: Umm… It looks even more dangerous up close…
Array.indonesia: Umm… It looks even more dangerous up close…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_005
Array.english: We can't come all the way here only to leave empty handed…
Array.indonesia: We can't come all the way here only to leave empty handed…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_DivePoint_006
Array.english: <size=34>With your skills, there shouldn't be any problems.\nNow let's catch some <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>With your skills, there shouldn't be any problems.\nNow let's catch some <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color>!</size>

Array.english: <size=34>Already leaving, Dave?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Already leaving, Dave?</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_Barricade01_002
Array.english: Aren't those <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> going to visit BANCHO SUSHI for some aberrant fish tonight?
Array.indonesia: Aren't those <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> going to visit BANCHO SUSHI for some aberrant fish tonight?

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_Barricade01_003
Array.english: And the money will be worth it, if I recall correctly.
Array.indonesia: And the money will be worth it, if I recall correctly.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_Barricade01_004
Array.english: <size=35>It'll be a shame to miss such an opportunity!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It'll be a shame to miss such an opportunity!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Tutorial_Barricade01_005
Array.english: <size=35>Let's find the <color=#F1DC2B>small vortex</color> that the merchant mentioned!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Let's find the <color=#F1DC2B>small vortex</color> that the merchant mentioned!</size>

Array.indonesia: <size=33>The fog is too thick. I'm not sure if we can go any farther…</size>

Array.indonesia: The <color=#F1DC2B>fog</color> sure is thick today…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_MorningTalk_003

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_EveningTalk_001
Array.english: <size=35>The <color=#F1DC2B>fog</color> is even redder now that it's the evening!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>The <color=#F1DC2B>fog</color> is even redder now that it's the evening!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_EveningTalk_002
Array.english: <size=34>Well… How creepy!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Well… How creepy!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_FirstFog_EveningTalk_003
Array.english: Huh? There's some light that's approaching us…

Array.english: The fog is thick today.
Array.indonesia: The fog is thick today.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_MorningFog_002

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_EveningFog_001
Array.english: Red fog is in the air, meaning there'll be <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color> in the waters.
Array.indonesia: Red fog is in the air, meaning there'll be <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color> in the waters.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_EveningFog_002
Array.english: The <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> will be visiting BANCHO SUSHI soon. You gotta serve them something, right?
Array.indonesia: The <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> will be visiting BANCHO SUSHI soon. You gotta serve them something, right?

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_EveningFog_003
Array.english: Well, it's not easy steering a boat in this weather…
Array.indonesia: Well, it's not easy steering a boat in this weather…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_FishLeft01_001
Array.english: <size=33>I see the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> have left!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I see the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> have left!</size>

Array.indonesia: This is worth <color=#F1DC2B><myinfo=GoldDredgeRemain/></color> Gold. Here you go.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_FishLeft02_002
Array.english: The <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> will come visit again the next time there's red fog.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> will come visit again the next time there's red fog.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_FishLeft02_003
Array.english: Make sure you have aberrant fish to keep them happy.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_FishEmpty_001
Array.english: <size=33>I see the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> have left!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I see the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> have left!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_FishEmpty_002
Array.english: Let's see…
Array.indonesia: Let's see…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_FishEmpty_003
Array.english: You don't have any leftover <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color> today.
Array.indonesia: You don't have any leftover <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color> today.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_FishEmpty_004
Array.english: Those Hooded Figures…\nThey eat like they've been starving for days.
Array.indonesia: Those Hooded Figures…\nThey eat like they've been starving for days.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_FishEmpty_005
Array.english: …Maybe they really have.
Array.indonesia: …Maybe they really have.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_FishEmpty_006
Array.english: Anyway, please keep this up on the days we get red fog!
Array.indonesia: Anyway, please keep this up on the days we get red fog!

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_NoCatchFish_001
Array.english: <size=33>I see the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> have left!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I see the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> have left!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_NoCatchFish_002

Array.english: You didn't catch any <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color> today…
Array.indonesia: You didn't catch any <color=#F1DC2B>Aberrant Fish</color> today…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_NoCatchFish_004
Array.english: No wonder the Hooded Figures seemed on edge…
Array.indonesia: No wonder the Hooded Figures seemed on edge…

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_NoCatchFish_005
Array.english: It's important to keep them well fed. After all, they're dangerous.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_NoCatchFish_006
Array.english: <size=34>Make sure to catch some next time!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Make sure to catch some next time!</size>

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_LobbyComeback_001
Array.english: Wow. That was some dense fog.
Array.indonesia: Wow. That was some dense fog.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_LobbyComeback_002
Array.english: Sure was...Good thing you made it back!
Array.indonesia: Sure was...Good thing you made it back!

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_LobbyComeback_003
Array.english: Ah! Did that merchant lady mention something about <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> coming to the restaurant?
Array.indonesia: Ah! Did that merchant lady mention something about <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> coming to the restaurant?

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_LobbyComeback_004
Array.english: Let's go to <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color></size>!
Array.indonesia: Let's go to <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color></size>!

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_GotoSushiBar_001
Array.english: How about we check out those <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded FIgures</color>?
Array.indonesia: How about we check out those <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded FIgures</color>?

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_GotoSushiBar_002
Array.english: Let's go to <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color></size>!
Array.indonesia: Let's go to <size=34><color=#F1DC2B>Bancho Sushi</color></size>!

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_MyNumber_001
Array.english: Ah! If a visit from the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> is inconvenient for you...
Array.indonesia: Ah! If a visit from the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> is inconvenient for you...

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_MyNumber_002
Array.english: Please give me a call.\nI will suggest a different restaurant for them.
Array.indonesia: Please give me a call.\nI will suggest a different restaurant for them.

Array.name: dialog_Dredge_Merchant_MyNumber_003
Array.english: <size=36>Save my number!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=36>Save my number!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Dredge_SushiBar_Warning_001
Array.english: There's nothing on the menu for our regular guests.
Array.indonesia: There's nothing on the menu for our regular guests.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_Start_001
Array.english: Oh…Dave. What can I do for you?
Array.indonesia: Oh…Dave. What can I do for you?

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_Start_HoodieON_001
Array.english: Well, when the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> come to the sushi restaurant, customers don't seem to like it much.
Array.indonesia: Well, when the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> come to the sushi restaurant, customers don't seem to like it much.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_Start_HoodieON_002
Array.english: Oh, I see. Hm...
Array.indonesia: Oh, I see. Hm...

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_Start_HoodieON_003
Array.english: Shall we stop the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figuress</color> from coming? We can introduce them to another restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Shall we stop the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figuress</color> from coming? We can introduce them to another restaurant.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_Start_HoodieOFF_001
Array.english: The <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> may be a bit intimidating, but I still think having them order the aberrated fish could be good for business in the end.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> may be a bit intimidating, but I still think having them order the aberrated fish could be good for business in the end.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_Start_HoodieOFF_002
Array.english: Alright! Shall we call the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> back to the sushi restaurant?
Array.indonesia: Alright! Shall we call the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> back to the sushi restaurant?

Array.name: dialog_Call_Dredge_Merchant_option1
Array.english: Have them come
Array.indonesia: Have them come

Array.name: dialog_Call_Dredge_Merchant_option2
Array.english: Don't have them come
Array.indonesia: Don't have them come

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieON_Stay_001
Array.english: Okay! Then, I won't say anything to them for now.
Array.indonesia: Okay! Then, I won't say anything to them for now.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieON_Stay_002
Array.english: Let me know if you change your mind!
Array.indonesia: Let me know if you change your mind!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieON_Stay_003
Array.english: Then I'll see you again on the day the crimson mist descends. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Then I'll see you again on the day the crimson mist descends. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieON_TurnOFF_001
Array.english: Got it. If other customers feel uncomfortable, I'll tell the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> to go to a different restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Got it. If other customers feel uncomfortable, I'll tell the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> to go to a different restaurant.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieON_TurnOFF_002
Array.english: Let me know if you change your mind!
Array.indonesia: Let me know if you change your mind!

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieON_TurnOFF_003
Array.english: Then I'll see you again on the day the crimson mist descends. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Then I'll see you again on the day the crimson mist descends. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieOFF_TurnON_001
Array.english: Got it. Then I'll have the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> come back again.
Array.indonesia: Got it. Then I'll have the <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> come back again.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieOFF_TurnON_002
Array.english: Then I'll see you again on the day the crimson mist descends. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Then I'll see you again on the day the crimson mist descends. Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieOFF_Stay_001
Array.english: Okay. Then, <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> will not come like they do now.
Array.indonesia: Okay. Then, <color=#9E7BFF>Hooded Figures</color> will not come like they do now.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieOFF_Stay_002
Array.english: Don't worry. I'll buy the <color=#F1DC2B>aberrated fish</color> from you.
Array.indonesia: Don't worry. I'll buy the <color=#F1DC2B>aberrated fish</color> from you.

Array.name: dialogue_Call_Dredge_Merchant_HoodieOFF_Stay_003
Array.english: Then I'll see you again on the day the crimson mist descends. Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Then I'll see you again on the day the crimson mist descends. Hehe.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Carrot
Array.english: A vegetable with high sugar content.\nBecomes soft when boiled or stir-fried for a long time.
Array.indonesia: A vegetable with high sugar content.\nBecomes soft when boiled or stir-fried for a long time.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Rice
Array.english: Rice suitable for making sushi.\nIt is mainly produced in Northeastern Asia, and because it is stickier and glossier than Annam rice, it bunches together easily.
Array.indonesia: Rice suitable for making sushi.\nIt is mainly produced in Northeastern Asia, and because it is stickier and glossier than Annam rice, it bunches together easily.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Bean
Array.english: Sometimes called “beef of the land” due to its high protein content.\nWatch out though, it has a bunch of calories to go along with it...
Array.indonesia: Sometimes called “beef of the land” due to its high protein content.\nWatch out though, it has a bunch of calories to go along with it...

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Flour
Array.english: A grain grown all over the world. Used to make bread and noodles.
Array.indonesia: A grain grown all over the world. Used to make bread and noodles.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_CherryTomato
Array.english: Very small tomatoes, but with significant nutrient content.\nIt’s a low-calorie food and popular for weight-loss diets.
Array.indonesia: Very small tomatoes, but with significant nutrient content.\nIt’s a low-calorie food and popular for weight-loss diets.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Mesclun
Array.english: Vegetables consumed at a very early stage in their growth. They are more nutritious than normal vegetables\nand are mainly used for salads.
Array.indonesia: Vegetables consumed at a very early stage in their growth. They are more nutritious than normal vegetables\nand are mainly used for salads.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Chicory
Array.english: A vegetable originally grown in Northern Europe. Both its root and leaves are used as food ingredients.
Array.indonesia: A vegetable originally grown in Northern Europe. Both its root and leaves are used as food ingredients.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Onion
Array.english: A popular food ingredient that has been grown for over 4,000 years.\nIt is crunchy, sweet, and also very spicy.
Array.indonesia: A popular food ingredient that has been grown for over 4,000 years.\nIt is crunchy, sweet, and also very spicy.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Paprika
Array.english: A type of pepper that comes in various colors.\nIt has a mild flavor and is popularly used in stir-fry and salad recipes.
Array.indonesia: A type of pepper that comes in various colors.\nIt has a mild flavor and is popularly used in stir-fry and salad recipes.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Chili
Array.english: A vegetable containing spicy capsaicin in its skin and seeds.\nRich in vitamins A and C.
Array.indonesia: A vegetable containing spicy capsaicin in its skin and seeds.\nRich in vitamins A and C.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Cucumber
Array.english: A vegetable originally grown in India. It has a very high water content of 95%.\nOpinions vary regarding its taste.
Array.indonesia: A vegetable originally grown in India. It has a very high water content of 95%.\nOpinions vary regarding its taste.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Eggplant
Array.english: The speculated country of origin is India. The preferred breed varies country by country.\nThe soft flesh inside a hard shell offers a diverse texture.
Array.indonesia: The speculated country of origin is India. The preferred breed varies country by country.\nThe soft flesh inside a hard shell offers a diverse texture.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_Garlic
Array.english: As it is vulnerable to extreme heat or cold, it is usually cultivated in temperate regions.\nIt is commonly used as a spice for its uniquely sensational flavor.
Array.indonesia: As it is vulnerable to extreme heat or cold, it is usually cultivated in temperate regions.\nIt is commonly used as a spice for its uniquely sensational flavor.

Array.name: Crop_Desc_ChiliPepper
Array.english: A small pepper that ranges from 2cm to 6cm in size. It grows well in high-temperature environments. It was once listed as the most spicy pepper in the world in the Guinness Book of Records.
Array.indonesia: A small pepper that ranges from 2cm to 6cm in size. It grows well in high-temperature environments. It was once listed as the most spicy pepper in the world in the Guinness Book of Records.

Array.name: Fertilizer_Grow_Desc_1
Array.english: A fertilizer that accelerates plant growth.\nThe effect of a fertilizer lasts a day and you can use only one kind of fertilizer at a time.
Array.indonesia: A fertilizer that accelerates plant growth.\nThe effect of a fertilizer lasts a day and you can use only one kind of fertilizer at a time.

Array.name: Fertilizer_Grow_Desc_2
Array.english: A fertilizer that makes plants more resistant to pests.\nThe effect of a fertilizer lasts a day and you can use only one kind of fertilizer at a time.
Array.indonesia: A fertilizer that makes plants more resistant to pests.\nThe effect of a fertilizer lasts a day and you can use only one kind of fertilizer at a time.

Array.name: Fertilizer_Grow_Desc_3
Array.english: A fertilizer that increases the grade of a plant.\nThe effect of a fertilizer lasts a day and you can use only one kind of fertilizer at a time.
Array.indonesia: A fertilizer that increases the grade of a plant.\nThe effect of a fertilizer lasts a day and you can use only one kind of fertilizer at a time.
