Array.name: ClownFish_desc
Array.english: At about 15cm long, it lives among sea anemones in coral reefs or rocks, finding shelter when threatened during the night. Females of the species are larger than males.
Array.indonesia: At about 15cm long, it lives among sea anemones in coral reefs or rocks, finding shelter when threatened during the night. Females of the species are larger than males.

Array.name: Comber_desc
Array.english: Has a long body with a pointed snout. Typically grows to around 30 cm. Its brown to reddish orange body is covered in horizontal stripes.
Array.indonesia: Has a long body with a pointed snout. Typically grows to around 30 cm. Its brown to reddish orange body is covered in horizontal stripes.

Array.name: Ruby_CardinalFish_desc
Array.english: Usually found in shallow water near rocks. 5 to 20 cm long and features two fins on its back, a big mouth, and big eyes. Many varieties are red or ruddy in color.
Array.indonesia: Usually found in shallow water near rocks. 5 to 20 cm long and features two fins on its back, a big mouth, and big eyes. Many varieties are red or ruddy in color.

Array.name: SquareSpot_Anthias_desc
Array.english: The male has a purple square outlined on its side and a long dorsal fin. It can be yellow to orange in color and has two purple stripes that connect its cheeks to its stomach.
Array.indonesia: The male has a purple square outlined on its side and a long dorsal fin. It can be yellow to orange in color and has two purple stripes that connect its cheeks to its stomach.

Array.name: Pyramid_butterflyFish_desc
Array.english: Has a large white triangle outlined on its body that connects its tail fin, ventral fin, and pectoral fin. The rest of its body is yellow.
Array.indonesia: Has a large white triangle outlined on its body that connects its tail fin, ventral fin, and pectoral fin. The rest of its body is yellow.

Array.name: Yellow_Tang_desc
Array.english: A herbivorous saltwater fish known for its vivid yellow coloring. Feeds on algae and sometimes eats moss and other parasites clinging to the skin of large marine creatures.
Array.indonesia: A herbivorous saltwater fish known for its vivid yellow coloring. Feeds on algae and sometimes eats moss and other parasites clinging to the skin of large marine creatures.

Array.name: Blackspot_Seabream_desc
Array.english: Has a greyish-blue body with several horizontal stripes that appear to be connected to yellow or grey spots in the center of each scale. Its ventral fin and cloacal fin are yellow.
Array.indonesia: Has a greyish-blue body with several horizontal stripes that appear to be connected to yellow or grey spots in the center of each scale. Its ventral fin and cloacal fin are yellow.

Array.name: Juvenile_Circular_BatFish_desc
Array.english: Has a very thin, disk-like body, with bow-like ventral and stomach fins. Its fan-shaped tail accounts for a fifth of its body length.
Array.indonesia: Has a very thin, disk-like body, with bow-like ventral and stomach fins. Its fan-shaped tail accounts for a fifth of its body length.

Array.name: Bluetang_desc
Array.english: Lives in groups in coral reefs and is used to clear waters and strong currents. Many fish owners covet the blue tang, as it's one of the most popular aquarium fish.
Array.indonesia: Lives in groups in coral reefs and is used to clear waters and strong currents. Many fish owners covet the blue tang, as it's one of the most popular aquarium fish.

Array.name: Seahorse_desc
Array.english: Grows to up 21.5 cm in length, but most are around 12 cm long. Has a thin body with a long snout and a hanging tail. These carnivorous creatures eat tiny crustaceans, larva, fish eggs, and assorted plankton.
Array.indonesia: Grows to up 21.5 cm in length, but most are around 12 cm long. Has a thin body with a long snout and a hanging tail. These carnivorous creatures eat tiny crustaceans, larva, fish eggs, and assorted plankton.

Array.name: Mediterranean_Rainbow_Wrasse_desc
Array.english: Tends to be small in size and has a spindle-shaped body. Like many of its family, it goes through many color changes in its lifetime. Males have a greenish back and a yellow belly.
Array.indonesia: Tends to be small in size and has a spindle-shaped body. Like many of its family, it goes through many color changes in its lifetime. Males have a greenish back and a yellow belly.

Array.name: Reef_Triggerfish_desc
Array.english: The colorful mosaic patterns formed by its scales has earned it the nickname Picassofish. Has a pointed snout and three to five large scales behind its gills.
Array.indonesia: The colorful mosaic patterns formed by its scales has earned it the nickname Picassofish. Has a pointed snout and three to five large scales behind its gills.

Array.name: Smallspotted_dart_desc
Array.english: Once it reaches about 15 cm in length, one to five black spots begin to appear on its side. As the dart gets older, more spots appear.
Array.indonesia: Once it reaches about 15 cm in length, one to five black spots begin to appear on its side. As the dart gets older, more spots appear.

Array.name: Yellowback_Fusilier_desc
Array.english: Its dorsal fin is yellow in its youth. As it ages, the yellow parts of its body disappear and blue becomes its dominant color.
Array.indonesia: Its dorsal fin is yellow in its youth. As it ages, the yellow parts of its body disappear and blue becomes its dominant color.

Array.name: Ornate_Wrasse_desc
Array.english: Ranges from 20 cm to 25 cm in length and lives in subtropical waters between 18 and 22 degrees Celsius, usually 1 to 50 meters deep. Typically found living alone in coastal algae or rocky areas, but may sometimes form small colonies.
Array.indonesia: Ranges from 20 cm to 25 cm in length and lives in subtropical waters between 18 and 22 degrees Celsius, usually 1 to 50 meters deep. Typically found living alone in coastal algae or rocky areas, but may sometimes form small colonies.

Array.name: Longfin_BatFish_desc
Array.english: Has an extremely wide and flat body with a tiny mouth that contains rows of even tinier conical teeth on each jaw. The edges of its bony skull crest are soft.
Array.indonesia: Has an extremely wide and flat body with a tiny mouth that contains rows of even tinier conical teeth on each jaw. The edges of its bony skull crest are soft.

Array.name: Mediterranean_Parrotfish_desc
Array.english: Found in warm waters and near rocky coral reefs, where they usually eat algae and coral, but sometimes also eat small invertebrates. The females are red with yellow stripes.
Array.indonesia: Found in warm waters and near rocky coral reefs, where they usually eat algae and coral, but sometimes also eat small invertebrates. The females are red with yellow stripes.

Array.name: Redtoothed_Triggerfish_desc
Array.english: Has a blue body and two protruding fang-like red teeth. It's often called the "vampire triggerfish" for its resemblance to the mythical bloodsucking creature. Despite its nickname, it's relatively docile for a triggerfish.
Array.indonesia: Has a blue body and two protruding fang-like red teeth. It's often called the "vampire triggerfish" for its resemblance to the mythical bloodsucking creature. Despite its nickname, it's relatively docile for a triggerfish.

Array.name: Black_and_White_Snapper_desc
Array.english: An aggressive carnivore with black eyes and fins.
Array.indonesia: An aggressive carnivore with black eyes and fins.

Array.name: Green_Humphead_Parrotfish_desc
Array.english: The largest fish that lives in coral reefs. Grows up to 150 cm long and can weigh more than 75 kg. With its powerful beak-like mouth, it breaks apart and eats coral.
Array.indonesia: The largest fish that lives in coral reefs. Grows up to 150 cm long and can weigh more than 75 kg. With its powerful beak-like mouth, it breaks apart and eats coral.

Array.name: Barrel_Jellyfish_desc
Array.english: A large, cylindrical jellyfish shaped like a giant mushroom or bell. Has eight wrinkled tentacles. A favorite food of the world's largest sea turtle, the leatherback.
Array.indonesia: A large, cylindrical jellyfish shaped like a giant mushroom or bell. Has eight wrinkled tentacles. A favorite food of the world's largest sea turtle, the leatherback.

Array.name: Fried_Egg_Jellyfish_desc
Array.english: Generally less than 17 cm wide, but can grow up to 40 cm in diameter. As its name suggests, they resemble a fried egg. The most common jellyfish in the Mediterranean Sea.
Array.indonesia: Generally less than 17 cm wide, but can grow up to 40 cm in diameter. As its name suggests, they resemble a fried egg. The most common jellyfish in the Mediterranean Sea.

Array.name: Loggerhead_Sea_Turtle_desc
Array.english: The largest of the hard-backed sea turtles. Weighs up to 364 kg and reaches up to 1.1 meters long. Aside from laying its eggs, it rarely comes ashore.
Array.indonesia: The largest of the hard-backed sea turtles. Weighs up to 364 kg and reaches up to 1.1 meters long. Aside from laying its eggs, it rarely comes ashore.

Array.name: Whitetip_Reefshark_desc
Array.english: A slim, medium-sized shark characterized by its white-tipped dorsal and tail fins. It is an agile swimmer well suited for its mostly reef habitat existence.
Array.indonesia: A slim, medium-sized shark characterized by its white-tipped dorsal and tail fins. It is an agile swimmer well suited for its mostly reef habitat existence.

Array.name: Blackfin_Barracuda_desc
Array.english: Has around 20 gleaming stripes that stretch from its back to below its lateral line. The top half of each stripe is slanted, with the lower half of each stripe becoming perpendicular to the body. Its dark caudal fin has a black rear edge.
Array.indonesia: Has around 20 gleaming stripes that stretch from its back to below its lateral line. The top half of each stripe is slanted, with the lower half of each stripe becoming perpendicular to the body. Its dark caudal fin has a black rear edge.

Array.name: Stellate_Puffer_desc
Array.english: Oval-shaped with a relatively long and thin body. Has spines instead of scales. Its dorsal fin and cloacal fin are small, symmetrical, and can be found at the rear of its body.
Array.indonesia: Oval-shaped with a relatively long and thin body. Has spines instead of scales. Its dorsal fin and cloacal fin are small, symmetrical, and can be found at the rear of its body.

Array.name: Moray_eel_desc
Array.english: Has a long, slender body with a wide, thin tail. Its entire body is covered with a thick, scale-less, armor-like hide. Most of its body can hide between rocks, with its head barely peeking out, on the lookout for prey.
Array.indonesia: Has a long, slender body with a wide, thin tail. Its entire body is covered with a thick, scale-less, armor-like hide. Most of its body can hide between rocks, with its head barely peeking out, on the lookout for prey.

Array.name: Red_Lionfish_desc
Array.english: A fish measured at around 47cm with many poisonous spines resembling the mane of a lion and patterns similar to that of a zebra.
Array.indonesia: A fish measured at around 47cm with many poisonous spines resembling the mane of a lion and patterns similar to that of a zebra.

Array.name: Boss_Crab_Hermit_desc
Array.english: A huge hermit crab found in the Blue Hole. It lives in an abandoned truck under the sea and is only active at night.
Array.indonesia: A huge hermit crab found in the Blue Hole. It lives in an abandoned truck under the sea and is only active at night.

Array.name: Titan_Triggerfish_desc
Array.english: A huge triggerfish measured at around 75cm with a yellow body, dark spots around its eyes, and sharp teeth. It is found in coral reefs and steep surfaces of submerged rocks and feeds, on coral, sea urchins, and so on.
Array.indonesia: A huge triggerfish measured at around 75cm with a yellow body, dark spots around its eyes, and sharp teeth. It is found in coral reefs and steep surfaces of submerged rocks and feeds, on coral, sea urchins, and so on.

Array.name: Blacktip_ReefShark_desc
Array.english: The blacktip reefshark has clear black spotting on its fins and snout. It dwells at shallow depths and sometimes hunts in groups.
Array.indonesia: The blacktip reefshark has clear black spotting on its fins and snout. It dwells at shallow depths and sometimes hunts in groups.

Array.name: Copper_Shark_desc
Array.english: The copper shark is one of the most common man-eating sharks with a long, round snout. It grows up to 3m and is found in the Pacific and Indian Oceans.
Array.indonesia: The copper shark is one of the most common man-eating sharks with a long, round snout. It grows up to 3m and is found in the Pacific and Indian Oceans.

Array.name: Box_Jellyfish_desc
Array.english: This jellyfish is actually not classified as a jellyfish. It has a poison so strong that it’s referred to as a “sea wasp.” It has eyes and will sometimes chase after prey.
Array.indonesia: This jellyfish is actually not classified as a jellyfish. It has a poison so strong that it’s referred to as a “sea wasp.” It has eyes and will sometimes chase after prey.

Array.name: Tuna_Dummy_desc
Array.english: (Dummy) Not In Use
Array.indonesia: (Dummy) Not In Use

Array.name: Bluehead_Tilefish_desc
Array.english: A thin, long fish with a blue head, green body, and yellow tail. It is usually around 15cm long and lurks near coral reef inclines, coral debris, and so on.
Array.indonesia: A thin, long fish with a blue head, green body, and yellow tail. It is usually around 15cm long and lurks near coral reef inclines, coral debris, and so on.

Array.name: Warty_Frogfish_desc
Array.english: A fish measured at around 15cm, its skin is covered in spines and protuberances. It has a mouth that protrudes outward like a frog’s. It will slowly change color to match its surroundings.
Array.indonesia: A fish measured at around 15cm, its skin is covered in spines and protuberances. It has a mouth that protrudes outward like a frog’s. It will slowly change color to match its surroundings.

Array.name: Painted_Comber_desc
Array.english: A gray-colored fish with a thin body and sharp nose. About 25cm long, it has 5-7 vertical brown stripes and blue spots. It hides in rock caverns and feeds on cephalopods, clams, crustaceans, fish, and worms.
Array.indonesia: A gray-colored fish with a thin body and sharp nose. About 25cm long, it has 5-7 vertical brown stripes and blue spots. It hides in rock caverns and feeds on cephalopods, clams, crustaceans, fish, and worms.

Array.name: Spiny_Seahorse_desc
Array.english: A seahorse sized at around 15-17cm. It has a head resembling that of a horse, a long snout, and a thorny, long body. It is found near submerged rocks, soft corals, and seaweed at 15m or below.
Array.indonesia: A seahorse sized at around 15-17cm. It has a head resembling that of a horse, a long snout, and a thorny, long body. It is found near submerged rocks, soft corals, and seaweed at 15m or below.

Array.name: Bigeye_Scad_desc
Array.english: A fish about 38cm long with a bluish green body, white belly, and large eyes. It belongs to family of Carangidae and can be found in schools in tropical waters.
Array.indonesia: A fish about 38cm long with a bluish green body, white belly, and large eyes. It belongs to family of Carangidae and can be found in schools in tropical waters.

Array.name: Red_Mullet_desc
Array.english: A fish measured at around 30cm with a reddish brown and long body. It has a pair of feelers below its mouth. This species is found at 5-400m and feeds on insects or crustaceans on sandy sea bottoms.
Array.indonesia: A fish measured at around 30cm with a reddish brown and long body. It has a pair of feelers below its mouth. This species is found at 5-400m and feeds on insects or crustaceans on sandy sea bottoms.

Array.name: Mackerel_Scad_desc
Array.english: A fish with bluish-green fins, a white belly, and black spots above its gills. It has a long body and has been measured at around 46cm. It lives in groups at 20-200m in subtropical waters.
Array.indonesia: A fish with bluish-green fins, a white belly, and black spots above its gills. It has a long body and has been measured at around 46cm. It lives in groups at 20-200m in subtropical waters.

Array.name: Harlequin_Hind_desc
Array.english: This fish has a light green body and bright blue lateral stripes. It is found in caves at depths of 30-120m in waters off island coasts in the Indian and western Pacific Oceans and feeds on fish or crustaceans.
Array.indonesia: This fish has a light green body and bright blue lateral stripes. It is found in caves at depths of 30-120m in waters off island coasts in the Indian and western Pacific Oceans and feeds on fish or crustaceans.

Array.name: Bigeye_Trevally_desc
Array.english: An oblong fish with a bluish-green back, silver-white belly, and small spots on its gills. It is found at depths up to 100m in tropical and subtropical waters and feeds on small fish.
Array.indonesia: An oblong fish with a bluish-green back, silver-white belly, and small spots on its gills. It is found at depths up to 100m in tropical and subtropical waters and feeds on small fish.

Array.name: Coral_Trout_desc
Array.english: A fish measured at around 60cm with a reddish-brown body and small blue spots. It is mainly found in warm coral reefs, where it will hide itself as it hunts other fish.
Array.indonesia: A fish measured at around 60cm with a reddish-brown body and small blue spots. It is mainly found in warm coral reefs, where it will hide itself as it hunts other fish.

Array.name: Grey_Triggerfish_desc
Array.english: A triggerfish measured at around 44cm, with a light gray body and broad, black vertical stripes. It has thick lips and sharp teeth. Usually found among corals and on rocky bottoms at depths less than 55m, it feeds on invertebrates.
Array.indonesia: A triggerfish measured at around 44cm, with a light gray body and broad, black vertical stripes. It has thick lips and sharp teeth. Usually found among corals and on rocky bottoms at depths less than 55m, it feeds on invertebrates.

Array.name: Atlantic_Bonito_desc
Array.english: A fish with a silver body, a bluish-green dorsal fin, and diagonal stripes on its back. It has been measured at around 75cm, lives in groups in shallow waters, and feeds on fish and squid.
Array.indonesia: A fish with a silver body, a bluish-green dorsal fin, and diagonal stripes on its back. It has been measured at around 75cm, lives in groups in shallow waters, and feeds on fish and squid.

Array.name: White_Trevally_desc
Array.english: A fish with a yellow body, yellow fins, and dark spots above its gills. It is around 30cm long. It can be found in most oceans and feeds on plankton and underwater invertebrates.
Array.indonesia: A fish with a yellow body, yellow fins, and dark spots above its gills. It is around 30cm long. It can be found in most oceans and feeds on plankton and underwater invertebrates.

Array.name: CuttleFish_desc
Array.english: A mollusk with an egg-shaped body, wrinkled fins, eight arms and two long tentacles, and a unique internal shell called the cuttlebone. It feeds on sea creatures like shrimps, crabs, clams and can spout ink.
Array.indonesia: A mollusk with an egg-shaped body, wrinkled fins, eight arms and two long tentacles, and a unique internal shell called the cuttlebone. It feeds on sea creatures like shrimps, crabs, clams and can spout ink.

Array.name: Dusky_Grouper_desc
Array.english: A fish with a dark reddish brown body and irregular yellow and silver spots. It is around 90cm long. Found at depths less than 300m around submerged rocks, it has a broad mouth and protruding jaw.
Array.indonesia: A fish with a dark reddish brown body and irregular yellow and silver spots. It is around 90cm long. Found at depths less than 300m around submerged rocks, it has a broad mouth and protruding jaw.

Array.name: Atlantic_Mackerel_desc
Array.english: A fish with a long, sharp snout, a long, spindle-shaped silver-white body, a blue back, and vertical stripes resembling black ripples. Measured at 30-60cm, it can be found at around 200m in cold waters.
Array.indonesia: A fish with a long, sharp snout, a long, spindle-shaped silver-white body, a blue back, and vertical stripes resembling black ripples. Measured at 30-60cm, it can be found at around 200m in cold waters.

Array.name: Giant_Trevally_desc
Array.english: A huge trevally with a silver body and many small black spots all over its body. It has been measured at 150cm, is found in broad areas of tropical and subtropical oceans, and feeds on other fish, cephalopods, or crustaceans.
Array.indonesia: A huge trevally with a silver body and many small black spots all over its body. It has been measured at 150cm, is found in broad areas of tropical and subtropical oceans, and feeds on other fish, cephalopods, or crustaceans.

Array.name: Australian_Spotted_Jellyfish_desc
Array.english: A jellyfish sized at around 50cm, it has a round and slightly flat bell and small reflective areas that resemble white spots. It lives in the western Pacific between Australia and Japan and has a weak poisonous sting.
Array.indonesia: A jellyfish sized at around 50cm, it has a round and slightly flat bell and small reflective areas that resemble white spots. It lives in the western Pacific between Australia and Japan and has a weak poisonous sting.

Array.name: Tiger_Shark_desc
Array.english: A shark 3-4m long with blue skin, a white belly, and stripes on its body. Usually found at approximately 350m in tropical and subtropical oceans. It will eat anything it can find.
Array.indonesia: A shark 3-4m long with blue skin, a white belly, and stripes on its body. Usually found at approximately 350m in tropical and subtropical oceans. It will eat anything it can find.

Array.name: tuttle_gr_desc
Array.english: A turtle with a waterdrop-shaped shell. It swims through the water with its flat arms and legs in a motion resembling flight. It grows up to 160cm and can be found in almost any ocean on Earth.
Array.indonesia: A turtle with a waterdrop-shaped shell. It swims through the water with its flat arms and legs in a motion resembling flight. It grows up to 160cm and can be found in almost any ocean on Earth.

Array.name: Great_Barracuda_desc
Array.english: A fish with a bluish gray back with a cross-bar pattern on it and a silver-white belly with black spots. Measured at 60-100cm, it can be found in coral reefs at depths up to 110m and hunts fish and cephalopods with its sharp teeth.
Array.indonesia: A fish with a bluish gray back with a cross-bar pattern on it and a silver-white belly with black spots. Measured at 60-100cm, it can be found in coral reefs at depths up to 110m and hunts fish and cephalopods with its sharp teeth.

Array.name: Cow_Pattern_Snapper_desc
Array.english: A rare fish requested by Ellie. It is spotted and lives at 60m near white corals.
Array.indonesia: A rare fish requested by Ellie. It is spotted and lives at 60m near white corals.

Array.name: Narrow-barred_Spanish_mackerel_desc
Array.english: A type of mackerel with a clear blue body, a silver and bluish-gray belly, and vertical spots on its sides. It grows up to 200cm and mainly feeds on shrimp, squid, and small fish.
Array.indonesia: A type of mackerel with a clear blue body, a silver and bluish-gray belly, and vertical spots on its sides. It grows up to 200cm and mainly feeds on shrimp, squid, and small fish.

Array.name: Boss_Giant_Squid_desc
Array.english: An abnormally large squid. Despite its soft body, it has sharp teeth. It reeks of ammonium chloride, making it difficult to eat.
Array.indonesia: An abnormally large squid. Despite its soft body, it has sharp teeth. It reeks of ammonium chloride, making it difficult to eat.

Array.name: LongNoseSaw_Shark_desc
Array.english: A sawshark usually found off the coast of Australia. It uses the sharp teeth on its saw-like snout to slash and eat crustaceans or fish.
Array.indonesia: A sawshark usually found off the coast of Australia. It uses the sharp teeth on its saw-like snout to slash and eat crustaceans or fish.

Array.name: Atlantic_Anglerfish_desc
Array.english: It uses the ray on its head to lure smaller fish and eat them. It will eat mostly anything it comes across in the depths and has very soft flesh despite its ugly appearance.
Array.indonesia: It uses the ray on its head to lure smaller fish and eat them. It will eat mostly anything it comes across in the depths and has very soft flesh despite its ugly appearance.

Array.name: Sally_Lightfoot_Crab_desc
Array.english: It lives on the Pacific coasts of Mexico to northern Peru. It is very deft and can even jump. It devours everything, plant or animal.
Array.indonesia: It lives on the Pacific coasts of Mexico to northern Peru. It is very deft and can even jump. It devours everything, plant or animal.

Array.name: Chambered_Nautilus_desc
Array.english: A cephalopod with a white spiral-shaped shell that has red stripes. It is around 20cm long, lives on coral reef inclines at 700m, and uses its many appendages (it has over 90) to eat crustaceans or dead fish.
Array.indonesia: A cephalopod with a white spiral-shaped shell that has red stripes. It is around 20cm long, lives on coral reef inclines at 700m, and uses its many appendages (it has over 90) to eat crustaceans or dead fish.

Array.name: Fangtooth_desc
Array.english: A black fish with a large jaw and sharp teeth. Its body tapers off towards its tail, and is measured at around 16cm. It lives at depths of 200m or greater and feeds on zooplankton, squid, and deep-sea fish.
Array.indonesia: A black fish with a large jaw and sharp teeth. Its body tapers off towards its tail, and is measured at around 16cm. It lives at depths of 200m or greater and feeds on zooplankton, squid, and deep-sea fish.

Array.name: ElephantFish_desc
Array.english: A silver cartilaginous fish with a long hoe-shaped snout and irregular spotting on its sides and fins. Measured at 70-150cm, it is found on continental shelves up to 200m deep and searches the sandy bottoms with its snout to eat invertebrates.
Array.indonesia: A silver cartilaginous fish with a long hoe-shaped snout and irregular spotting on its sides and fins. Measured at 70-150cm, it is found on continental shelves up to 200m deep and searches the sandy bottoms with its snout to eat invertebrates.

Array.name: Frilled_Shark_desc
Array.english: A shark with a long, eel-like body, wrinkled belly, flat head, and short and round snout. Measured at around 2m, it dwells at depths of 50-200m in the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans. It swims about with its mouth hanging open.
Array.indonesia: A shark with a long, eel-like body, wrinkled belly, flat head, and short and round snout. Measured at around 2m, it dwells at depths of 50-200m in the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans. It swims about with its mouth hanging open.

Array.name: Stargazer_desc
Array.english: A fish about 35cm long with large eyes and mouth, a flat head, and a body that thins towards the tail. It will hide itself in sand or mud and hunt shrimp, crabs, and other fish.
Array.indonesia: A fish about 35cm long with large eyes and mouth, a flat head, and a body that thins towards the tail. It will hide itself in sand or mud and hunt shrimp, crabs, and other fish.

Array.name: Viperfish_desc
Array.english: A fish about 60cm long with transparent, long, and needle-shaped lower teeth and hinged lower jars. Found at depths of 1,000-5,000m, it has light-producing organs inside the mouth and belly and feeds on fish lured by the light.
Array.indonesia: A fish about 60cm long with transparent, long, and needle-shaped lower teeth and hinged lower jars. Found at depths of 1,000-5,000m, it has light-producing organs inside the mouth and belly and feeds on fish lured by the light.

Array.name: Rhinochimaeridae_desc
Array.english: A silver cartilagious fish with a long, elephant-like snout and poison in its first fin. Measured at around 140cm, it dwells at depths of 200-2,000m in temperate and tropical waters and feeds on small fish.
Array.indonesia: A silver cartilagious fish with a long, elephant-like snout and poison in its first fin. Measured at around 140cm, it dwells at depths of 200-2,000m in temperate and tropical waters and feeds on small fish.

Array.name: Great_Spider_Crab_desc
Array.english: A crab with long legs, an orange color, and white spots. It has rough and sharp projections on its body and will grow up to 3.7m long. An omnivore found at 50-500m, it will feed on dead fish and other food sources.
Array.indonesia: A crab with long legs, an orange color, and white spots. It has rough and sharp projections on its body and will grow up to 3.7m long. An omnivore found at 50-500m, it will feed on dead fish and other food sources.

Array.name: Spiny_Red_Crab_desc
Array.english: A king crab covered with spines. Also called the porcupine crab. It has four pairs of legs including its pincers and lives on deep sea bottoms at 150-730m. An omnivore, it will feed on dead fish and the like.
Array.indonesia: A king crab covered with spines. Also called the porcupine crab. It has four pairs of legs including its pincers and lives on deep sea bottoms at 150-730m. An omnivore, it will feed on dead fish and the like.

Array.name: Megamouth_Shark_desc
Array.english: A deep-sea shark measured at 5m, it will use its flexible skin to extend its mouth forward and open it up to 1.3m across. Found at 200-4,600m, it swallows plankton with its extended mouth.
Array.indonesia: A deep-sea shark measured at 5m, it will use its flexible skin to extend its mouth forward and open it up to 1.3m across. Found at 200-4,600m, it swallows plankton with its extended mouth.

Array.name: Cookiecutter_Shark_desc
Array.english: A Cookiecutter Shark has a long oval body, black necklace patterns, and sharp teeth. It is about 56cm large and is found at depths of 1-3.7km. It will bite chunks out of large sea creatures in its vicinity.
Array.indonesia: A Cookiecutter Shark has a long oval body, black necklace patterns, and sharp teeth. It is about 56cm large and is found at depths of 1-3.7km. It will bite chunks out of large sea creatures in its vicinity.

Array.name: Clione_desc
Array.english: A mollusk with a transparent cylindrical body, wing-like appendages, and a horned head. About 10cm long, it is found at around 200m in the Arctic and northern Pacific Oceans and feeds on phytoplankton and small sea animals.
Array.indonesia: A mollusk with a transparent cylindrical body, wing-like appendages, and a horned head. About 10cm long, it is found at around 200m in the Arctic and northern Pacific Oceans and feeds on phytoplankton and small sea animals.

Array.name: Oarfish_desc
Array.english: A large fish with a thin silver-white body, red fins, and sky-colored vertical stripes alternating on the upper and lower parts of its body. It is 3-11m long and leads a solitary existence at 200-1,000m in warm waters.
Array.indonesia: A large fish with a thin silver-white body, red fins, and sky-colored vertical stripes alternating on the upper and lower parts of its body. It is 3-11m long and leads a solitary existence at 200-1,000m in warm waters.

Array.name: Sea_Toad_desc
Array.english: A dark brown fish with a large, round body, short tail, and many spines. It is around 30cm long, lives on continental inclines at depths up to 2,400m, and walks about on its fins to prey on passing animals.
Array.indonesia: A dark brown fish with a large, round body, short tail, and many spines. It is around 30cm long, lives on continental inclines at depths up to 2,400m, and walks about on its fins to prey on passing animals.

Array.name: Salmon_Snailfish_desc
Array.english: A tadpole-shaped fish with a gelatinous pink skin. It grows up to 54cm but is usually much smaller and dwells in very deep waters (5,000m or greater).
Array.indonesia: A tadpole-shaped fish with a gelatinous pink skin. It grows up to 54cm but is usually much smaller and dwells in very deep waters (5,000m or greater).

Array.name: Coelacanth_desc
Array.english: An ancient species of deep-sea fish with 8 fins and hard scales. It measures 1-2m. Many similar species lived all over the world in the Paleozoic and Mesozoic eras, but only two such species are left at present in the underwater caves near islands in Coromos and the depths of the Celebes Sea.
Array.indonesia: An ancient species of deep-sea fish with 8 fins and hard scales. It measures 1-2m. Many similar species lived all over the world in the Paleozoic and Mesozoic eras, but only two such species are left at present in the underwater caves near islands in Coromos and the depths of the Celebes Sea.

Array.name: Pacificfanfish_desc
Array.english: A silver fish with a thin body measured at 40cm. It has fins larger than its body on both the top and the bottom. Its young live in the shallows, while the adults are presumed to live in the depths.
Array.indonesia: A silver fish with a thin body measured at 40cm. It has fins larger than its body on both the top and the bottom. Its young live in the shallows, while the adults are presumed to live in the depths.

Array.name: Threetooth_Puffer_desc
Array.english: A fish with a yellow-brown body and black spots, it has a huge belly flap that can be opened and closed. It usually dwells near continental shelves at 100m or deeper and feeds on sponges and creatures in the phylum Cnidaria.
Array.indonesia: A fish with a yellow-brown body and black spots, it has a huge belly flap that can be opened and closed. It usually dwells near continental shelves at 100m or deeper and feeds on sponges and creatures in the phylum Cnidaria.

Array.name: Comb_Jelly_desc
Array.english: A colorless, transparent, and glowing jellyfish. It has wing-like protuberances and eight cilia that give off colorful light. They live at 600-1,100m in the northern Pacific and feed on small crustaceans or zooplankton.
Array.indonesia: A colorless, transparent, and glowing jellyfish. It has wing-like protuberances and eight cilia that give off colorful light. They live at 600-1,100m in the northern Pacific and feed on small crustaceans or zooplankton.

Array.name: Bloodbelly_Comb_Jelly_desc
Array.english: A red glowing jellyfish. Its cilia give off light of many different colors and it measures at 1.5-16cm. It mainly lives at 300-1,000m and feeds on crustaceans and zooplankton.
Array.indonesia: A red glowing jellyfish. Its cilia give off light of many different colors and it measures at 1.5-16cm. It mainly lives at 300-1,000m and feeds on crustaceans and zooplankton.

Array.name: Shortfin_Mako_desc
Array.english: The shortfin mako is a large shark with big black eyes and sharp snout. It inhabits tropical and temperate oceans at depths of 0-50 meters.
Array.indonesia: The shortfin mako is a large shark with big black eyes and sharp snout. It inhabits tropical and temperate oceans at depths of 0-50 meters.

Array.name: Thresher_Shark_desc
Array.english: The thresher shark has a caudal fin that is longer than its body. It uses this long fin as a whip to stun a shoal of small fish.
Array.indonesia: The thresher shark has a caudal fin that is longer than its body. It uses this long fin as a whip to stun a shoal of small fish.

Array.name: Smooth_Hammershark_desc
Array.english: It has a head that looks like a hammer. Its head contains sensory organs so its detection ability is excellent.
Array.indonesia: It has a head that looks like a hammer. Its head contains sensory organs so its detection ability is excellent.

Array.name: Zebra_Shark_desc
Array.english: The zebra shark has zebra-like stripes when it is young but they become spots as it grows. This nocturnal shark can commonly be found in the tropical Indo-Pacific region at depths of 0-60 meters.
Array.indonesia: The zebra shark has zebra-like stripes when it is young but they become spots as it grows. This nocturnal shark can commonly be found in the tropical Indo-Pacific region at depths of 0-60 meters.

Array.name: White_Shrimp_desc
Array.english: The white shrimp has a light grey body and a pair of long antennae. An adult white shrimp may be as long as 10 cm in length (or even longer). It is commonly found in the coastal areas of the Gulf of Mexico and the South Atlantic Ocean.
Array.indonesia: The white shrimp has a light grey body and a pair of long antennae. An adult white shrimp may be as long as 10 cm in length (or even longer). It is commonly found in the coastal areas of the Gulf of Mexico and the South Atlantic Ocean.

Array.name: Humboldt_Squid_desc
Array.english: The Humboldt squid inhabits the Pacific Coast. It can grow as big as 2 meters in length. Its suckers have sharp claws. This aggressive squid is known to prey on its own members.
Array.indonesia: The Humboldt squid inhabits the Pacific Coast. It can grow as big as 2 meters in length. Its suckers have sharp claws. This aggressive squid is known to prey on its own members.

Array.name: Devil_ScorpionFish_desc
Array.english: One of the most dangerous fish with its potent venom. Hiding in the environment, it quickly snatches anything that comes close to it.
Array.indonesia: One of the most dangerous fish with its potent venom. Hiding in the environment, it quickly snatches anything that comes close to it.

Array.name: Striped_Marlin_desc
Array.english: The marlin is a fast and very violent swimmer that can swim up to a speed of 100 km/h. It swings its spear-like upper jaw to hit or slash its prey.
Array.indonesia: The marlin is a fast and very violent swimmer that can swim up to a speed of 100 km/h. It swings its spear-like upper jaw to hit or slash its prey.

Array.name: Sword_Fish_desc
Array.english: The swordfish is a fast and very violent swimmer that can swim up to a speed of 80 km/h. Its upper jaw is long and broad and looks like a sword.
Array.indonesia: The swordfish is a fast and very violent swimmer that can swim up to a speed of 80 km/h. Its upper jaw is long and broad and looks like a sword.

Array.name: Sail_Fish_desc
Array.english: The sailfish looks like a marlin, but its dorsal fin resembles a sail. It can swim up to a speed of 110km/h and inhabits tropical and temperate oceans.
Array.indonesia: The sailfish looks like a marlin, but its dorsal fin resembles a sail. It can swim up to a speed of 110km/h and inhabits tropical and temperate oceans.

Array.name: Boss_Wolffish_desc
Array.english: An enormous version of the deep-sea wolf eel. It has powerful jaws and teeth that can crush any crustacean.
Array.indonesia: An enormous version of the deep-sea wolf eel. It has powerful jaws and teeth that can crush any crustacean.

Array.name: Boss_Clione_desc
Array.english: An enormous version of the clione, which lives in cold waters. Despite its cute appearance, it turns into a monstrous creature when it hunts prey.
Array.indonesia: An enormous version of the clione, which lives in cold waters. Despite its cute appearance, it turns into a monstrous creature when it hunts prey.

Array.name: Boss_John_Watson02_desc
Array.english: John Watson just got scarier with the enhanced diving suit.
Array.indonesia: John Watson just got scarier with the enhanced diving suit.

Array.name: Boss_MantisShrimp_desc
Array.english: An unrealistically large mantis shrimp. Its ultrasonic punch can easily knock out its prey with a single blow.
Array.indonesia: An unrealistically large mantis shrimp. Its ultrasonic punch can easily knock out its prey with a single blow.

Array.name: Boss_Klaus_desc
Array.english: One of the biggest and fiercest species among Great White Sharks, the apex predators of the marine ecosystem. Clara Cruz is looking for this one to take revenge for her husband who got eaten by it 36 years ago.
Array.indonesia: One of the biggest and fiercest species among Great White Sharks, the apex predators of the marine ecosystem. Clara Cruz is looking for this one to take revenge for her husband who got eaten by it 36 years ago.

Array.name: Boss_GiantGardon_desc
Array.english: It is a huge Gadon locked inside the Glacial Passage for so long.
Array.indonesia: It is a huge Gadon locked inside the Glacial Passage for so long.

Array.name: NormalGardon_desc
Array.english: The Gadon used to be one of the ordinary Sea People, now turned into an insentient monster. The mutation seems to have wiped out all memories.
Array.indonesia: The Gadon used to be one of the ordinary Sea People, now turned into an insentient monster. The mutation seems to have wiped out all memories.

Array.name: Boss_Helicoprion_desc
Array.english: The helicoprion is a fish that lived in the Permian period of the Paleozoic era. Scientists speculate that the fish hunted cephalopods using its teeth that grow in a helical form.
Array.indonesia: The helicoprion is a fish that lived in the Permian period of the Paleozoic era. Scientists speculate that the fish hunted cephalopods using its teeth that grow in a helical form.

Array.name: Boss_Phantom_Jellyfish_desc
Array.english: The largest invertebrate predator in deep waters. It devours its prey while entangling it with long tentacles.
Array.indonesia: The largest invertebrate predator in deep waters. It devours its prey while entangling it with long tentacles.

Array.name: Boss_Kronosaurus_desc

Array.indonesia: A plesiosaur named after the Greek mythological character, Kronos. It is speculated to have been the top predator of the seas during the Cretaceous period, and has a body length of over 10 meters.

Array.indonesia: A legendary monster in Blue Hole. It has the upper body of a shark, and the lower body of an octopus.

Array.indonesia: A type of berycid fish that lives among submerged rocks in the depths. It has large golden eyes.

Array.indonesia: A shark that can grow up to 7 m long. It extends its jaws rapidly when eating a prey. Although it has a wide global distribution, it is rarely seen.

Array.name: Spotted_Moray_eel_desc

Array.name: Turtle_Magma_desc
Array.english: The magma turtle blows out intense heat from its shell. One can catch it only if they know how to cool down the heat.
Array.indonesia: The magma turtle blows out intense heat from its shell. One can catch it only if they know how to cool down the heat.

Array.name: Stingray_Ice_desc
Array.english: The ice stingray is covered in ice and a chunk of ice is attached to its tail. Its icy body parts might be weakened when exposed to heat.
Array.indonesia: The ice stingray is covered in ice and a chunk of ice is attached to its tail. Its icy body parts might be weakened when exposed to heat.

Array.name: Prism_Mirror_Pacificfanfish_desc
Array.english: The prismatic fanfish has beautiful swimming fins and creates mirror images by reflecting the light it generates. It’s hard to distinguish the real fish from its mirror images.
Array.indonesia: The prismatic fanfish has beautiful swimming fins and creates mirror images by reflecting the light it generates. It’s hard to distinguish the real fish from its mirror images.

Array.name: Gladiator_Coconut_Octopus_desc
Array.english: The gladiator coconut octopus is highly intelligent and well known to use tools. It protects itself with a spear and a shield made of seashells.
Array.indonesia: The gladiator coconut octopus is highly intelligent and well known to use tools. It protects itself with a spear and a shield made of seashells.

Array.name: Blackpowder_Vampire_Squid_desc
Array.english: A squid that shoots ink containing an explosive substance. It can restore its HP by sucking the blood of a victim.
Array.indonesia: A squid that shoots ink containing an explosive substance. It can restore its HP by sucking the blood of a victim.

Array.name: Ocean_Sunfish_desc
Array.english: The largest bony fish in existence, it has an enormous, flat body with sharp fins on top and bottom. It lives in temperate and tropical waters and feeds on fish, newly hatched fish, squid, and crustaceans.
Array.indonesia: The largest bony fish in existence, it has an enormous, flat body with sharp fins on top and bottom. It lives in temperate and tropical waters and feeds on fish, newly hatched fish, squid, and crustaceans.

Array.name: Mission_Seahorse_01_desc

Array.indonesia: Crowned Seahorse ranaway from Game Parlor.

Array.name: Mission_Seahorse_04_desc
