Array.indonesia: Hedgehog Seahorse ranaway from Game Parlor.

Array.name: BlackTiger_Shrimp_desc
Array.english: Widely reared in Southeast Asia, it is approximately 30 cm long. Thanks to its savory flavor, it is a popular food ingredient.
Array.indonesia: Widely reared in Southeast Asia, it is approximately 30 cm long. Thanks to its savory flavor, it is a popular food ingredient.

Array.name: Whiteleg_Shrimp_desc
Array.english: A species of kuruma prawn that grows to a maximum length of 20 cm. Commonly farmed for food, it is popular thanks to its taste and affordability.
Array.indonesia: A species of kuruma prawn that grows to a maximum length of 20 cm. Commonly farmed for food, it is popular thanks to its taste and affordability.

Array.name: Striped_Catfish_desc
Array.english: This fish is about 20 to 30cm long and has 4 pairs of whiskers around its mouth. It tends to move around in groups.
Array.indonesia: This fish is about 20 to 30cm long and has 4 pairs of whiskers around its mouth. It tends to move around in groups.

Array.name: Purple_Sea_Urchin_desc
Array.english: Spiny purple sea urchin.\nUsed as a food ingredient.
Array.indonesia: Spiny purple sea urchin.\nUsed as a food ingredient.

Array.name: Baby_Humpback_Whale_Desc
Array.english: This whale is about 15 m long, and traverses distances of thousands of kilometers depending on the season. It is characterized by a lump on the head and jaw. Its lifespan is approximately 50 to 100 years.
Array.indonesia: This whale is about 15 m long, and traverses distances of thousands of kilometers depending on the season. It is characterized by a lump on the head and jaw. Its lifespan is approximately 50 to 100 years.

Array.name: Pink_Dolphin_Desc
Array.english: Part of the dolphin family. Appears to have a pink skin from lack of pigment, due to being albino.  Although its colors are different it gets along well with its pod of fellow dolphins.
Array.indonesia: Part of the dolphin family. Appears to have a pink skin from lack of pigment, due to being albino.  Although its colors are different it gets along well with its pod of fellow dolphins.

Array.name: Leatherback_Turtle_Desc
Array.english: The largest existing tortoise species, weighing up to 900kg, and has the fastest movement speed among the tortoise families. The shell on its back is made of skin, so it can't retract its head.
Array.indonesia: The largest existing tortoise species, weighing up to 900kg, and has the fastest movement speed among the tortoise families. The shell on its back is made of skin, so it can't retract its head.

Array.name: Manta_Ray_Desc
Array.english: This is the largest species of stingray, and is a long-distance pelagic fish. Due to its gentle nature, it mainly feeds on plankton.
Array.indonesia: This is the largest species of stingray, and is a long-distance pelagic fish. Due to its gentle nature, it mainly feeds on plankton.

Array.name: Opah_Desc
Array.english: Although it is a fish, it has the characteristics of a warm-blooded animal. It can maintain a body temperature of 4.8 degrees higher than its surroundings, so it can survive in the deep and cold sea.
Array.indonesia: Although it is a fish, it has the characteristics of a warm-blooded animal. It can maintain a body temperature of 4.8 degrees higher than its surroundings, so it can survive in the deep and cold sea.

Array.name: BlueFin_Tuna_desc
Array.english: A member of Scombridae, the bluefin tuna is the most common ingredient of tuna sashimi. It can swim up to a speed of 70-90 km/h and will suffocate if it stays in place.
Array.indonesia: A member of Scombridae, the bluefin tuna is the most common ingredient of tuna sashimi. It can swim up to a speed of 70-90 km/h and will suffocate if it stays in place.

Array.name: YellowFin_Tuna_desc
Array.english: The yellowfin tuna spawns all year long and takes approximately 2 years to become an adult.
Array.indonesia: The yellowfin tuna spawns all year long and takes approximately 2 years to become an adult.

Array.name: Peacock_Squid_desc
Array.english: The peacock squid, as its name suggests, has long and fabulous tentacles that look like the feathers of a peacock. One can see its organs clearly as the squid has transparent skin.
Array.indonesia: The peacock squid, as its name suggests, has long and fabulous tentacles that look like the feathers of a peacock. One can see its organs clearly as the squid has transparent skin.

Array.name: Dumbo_octopus_desc
Array.english: The dumbo octopus inhabits deep and cold waters and has ear-like swimming fins. Its name comes from these fins that make the octopus look like Dumbo, the baby elephant.
Array.indonesia: The dumbo octopus inhabits deep and cold waters and has ear-like swimming fins. Its name comes from these fins that make the octopus look like Dumbo, the baby elephant.

Array.name: Barreleye_desc
Array.english: A small deep-sea fish. It has big, spherical eyes inside its transparent skin.
Array.indonesia: A small deep-sea fish. It has big, spherical eyes inside its transparent skin.

Array.name: Blobfish_desc
Array.english: The blobfish has almost no muscle and has a jelly-like body that can freely adjust its density to control buoyancy. It has been chosen as the ugliest creature in the world.
Array.indonesia: The blobfish has almost no muscle and has a jelly-like body that can freely adjust its density to control buoyancy. It has been chosen as the ugliest creature in the world.

Array.name: Vampire_Squid_desc
Array.english: The vampire squid looks like a vampire, but it merely consumes organic matter floating in the deep sea. It can generate a special light that disrupts the equilibrium of the prey.
Array.indonesia: The vampire squid looks like a vampire, but it merely consumes organic matter floating in the deep sea. It can generate a special light that disrupts the equilibrium of the prey.

Array.name: Pelican_Eel_desc
Array.english: The pelican eel is commonly found in warm waters of the world where the water is deep. It can swallow prey larger than itself, as its mouth is bigger than its body.
Array.indonesia: The pelican eel is commonly found in warm waters of the world where the water is deep. It can swallow prey larger than itself, as its mouth is bigger than its body.

Array.name: Arctic_Cod_desc
Array.english: It is commonly found in the Arctic Ocean at depths of 0-900 meters. Its main diet is plankton and krill.
Array.indonesia: It is commonly found in the Arctic Ocean at depths of 0-900 meters. Its main diet is plankton and krill.

Array.name: Gelatinous_Snailfish_desc
Array.english: The gelatinous Snailfish inhabits the Antarctic Ocean at a depth of up to 300 meters. It has dark stripes on its body and normally swims at the bottom of the sea.
Array.indonesia: The gelatinous Snailfish inhabits the Antarctic Ocean at a depth of up to 300 meters. It has dark stripes on its body and normally swims at the bottom of the sea.

Array.name: Antarctic_Octopus_desc
Array.english: It has blue blood and lives in the Antarctic Ocean. It can survive in warmer oceans as well.
Array.indonesia: It has blue blood and lives in the Antarctic Ocean. It can survive in warmer oceans as well.

Array.name: Greenland_Shark_desc
Array.english: The Greenland shark inhabits the coldest waters among the sharks. It grows very slowly, at a rate of 1 cm a year and it takes about 150 years to become an adult.
Array.indonesia: The Greenland shark inhabits the coldest waters among the sharks. It grows very slowly, at a rate of 1 cm a year and it takes about 150 years to become an adult.

Array.name: Polar_Eelpout_desc
Array.english: It inhabits the coastal waters of the Arctic Ocean. It has short and hard barbs along its dorsal fin.
Array.indonesia: It inhabits the coastal waters of the Arctic Ocean. It has short and hard barbs along its dorsal fin.

Array.name: Porbeagle_Shark_desc
Array.english: The porbeagle shark grows up to 6 meters, but the average length is 3 meters. It is known to attack swimmers and divers.
Array.indonesia: The porbeagle shark grows up to 6 meters, but the average length is 3 meters. It is known to attack swimmers and divers.

Array.name: Ice_Fish_desc
Array.english: The ice fish has transparent skin due to low hemoglobin in its blood. It has a rather large heart compared to its body.
Array.indonesia: The ice fish has transparent skin due to low hemoglobin in its blood. It has a rather large heart compared to its body.

Array.name: Capelin_desc
Array.english: A member of Osmeridae, the capelin is a rather small fish. It begins reproducing 2-6 years after birth. Males have a high mortality rate after spawning.
Array.indonesia: A member of Osmeridae, the capelin is a rather small fish. It begins reproducing 2-6 years after birth. Males have a high mortality rate after spawning.

Array.name: Narwhal_desc
Array.english: The narwhal has a long tusk that can take up half the length of its body. Stories say that swindlers sold the fang of a narwhal as ‘the horn of a unicorn’ in the past.
Array.indonesia: The narwhal has a long tusk that can take up half the length of its body. Stories say that swindlers sold the fang of a narwhal as ‘the horn of a unicorn’ in the past.

Array.name: Haddock_desc
Array.english: The haddock is a beautiful fish with a snow-white belly, purple back, and silver-grey sides.
Array.indonesia: The haddock is a beautiful fish with a snow-white belly, purple back, and silver-grey sides.

Array.name: Antarctic_Starry_Skate_desc
Array.english: It has 27 thorns from the ventral to the dorsal fins. The thorns can also be found in the middle and both sides of its tail.
Array.indonesia: It has 27 thorns from the ventral to the dorsal fins. The thorns can also be found in the middle and both sides of its tail.

Array.name: Waptia_Fieldensis_desc
Array.english: An ancient arthropod that lived during the mid-Cambrian period. Its head is protected by a thick plate and it can grow up to about 7 cm.
Array.indonesia: An ancient arthropod that lived during the mid-Cambrian period. Its head is protected by a thick plate and it can grow up to about 7 cm.

Array.name: Pikaia_desc
Array.english: An ancient fish that resembled a contemporary eel. It is called the ancestor of the vertebrates.
Array.indonesia: An ancient fish that resembled a contemporary eel. It is called the ancestor of the vertebrates.

Array.name: Allenypterus_desc
Array.english: An ancient fish featuring a small tail and side stripes. It is known to grow up to a size of 15 cm.
Array.indonesia: An ancient fish featuring a small tail and side stripes. It is known to grow up to a size of 15 cm.

Array.name: Qingmendous_desc
Array.english: Coelacanth-like ancient fish that lived 400 million years ago. They are known to be the ancestor of fish species that came up to the land from the sea.
Array.indonesia: Coelacanth-like ancient fish that lived 400 million years ago. They are known to be the ancestor of fish species that came up to the land from the sea.

Array.name: Falcatus_desc
Array.english: A carnivorous fish thought to inhabit the coastal waters of North America in the past. Males had prominent fin spines that curve anteriorly over the head.
Array.indonesia: A carnivorous fish thought to inhabit the coastal waters of North America in the past. Males had prominent fin spines that curve anteriorly over the head.

Array.name: Drepanaspis_desc
Array.english: Drepanaspis is characterized by its single pair of swimming fins and heavily armored ray-like body, and lack of jaws. It is thought to grow up to 30 cm.
Array.indonesia: Drepanaspis is characterized by its single pair of swimming fins and heavily armored ray-like body, and lack of jaws. It is thought to grow up to 30 cm.

Array.name: Dunkleosteus_desc
Array.english: Placoderms lived in the primeval oceans of North America, Europe, and North Africa. They are thought to grow up to about 10 meters long and weigh up to 4 tons.
Array.indonesia: Placoderms lived in the primeval oceans of North America, Europe, and North Africa. They are thought to grow up to about 10 meters long and weigh up to 4 tons.

Array.name: Megalograptus_desc
Array.english: Megalograptus was an aquatic arthropod that lived from Late Ordovician to Katian. Its body was covered with a thick layer of armor and its forelegs were covered with sharp barbs.
Array.indonesia: Megalograptus was an aquatic arthropod that lived from Late Ordovician to Katian. Its body was covered with a thick layer of armor and its forelegs were covered with sharp barbs.

Array.name: Baby_Anomalocaris_desc
Array.english: Young Panarthropoda that used to live in the oceans during the Cambrian period of the Paleozoic era. It is thought to swim like a cuttlefish or ray by waving its side fins.
Array.indonesia: Young Panarthropoda that used to live in the oceans during the Cambrian period of the Paleozoic era. It is thought to swim like a cuttlefish or ray by waving its side fins.

Array.name: Boss_Anomalocaris_desc
Array.english: A gigantic, evolved marine creature. Able to swiftly move and catch its prey using its pincers, it reigned as the top predator in the Cambrian seas.
Array.indonesia: A gigantic, evolved marine creature. Able to swiftly move and catch its prey using its pincers, it reigned as the top predator in the Cambrian seas.

Array.name: Flame_AngelFish_desc
Array.english: Its body is mainly bright red and orange, but has a bluish part at the end of the anal fin.
Array.indonesia: Its body is mainly bright red and orange, but has a bluish part at the end of the anal fin.

Array.name: Asian_Sheepshead_desc
Array.english: It has a high forehead that resembles a lump. With its sharp teeth, it mainly feeds on crustaceans.
Array.indonesia: It has a high forehead that resembles a lump. With its sharp teeth, it mainly feeds on crustaceans.

Array.name: Emperor_AngelFish_desc
Array.english: White and blue in color in its juvenile period, but it develops into another color as it becomes an adult. It rarely mingles with other fish, preferring to stay alone.
Array.indonesia: White and blue in color in its juvenile period, but it develops into another color as it becomes an adult. It rarely mingles with other fish, preferring to stay alone.

Array.name: Red_Stingray_desc
Array.english: It is mainly found in shallow waters of 10 m below surface or river estuaries in the West Pacific. A sawtooth-shaped spine on its tail holds deadly poison that can cause humans to pass out or even die when they are stung.
Array.indonesia: It is mainly found in shallow waters of 10 m below surface or river estuaries in the West Pacific. A sawtooth-shaped spine on its tail holds deadly poison that can cause humans to pass out or even die when they are stung.

Array.name: Sarcastic_Fringehead_desc
Array.english: A species of perciformes that is aggressive enough to eat up any living things that enter its territory with its enormous mouth. When two gunnels fight, they wrestle by pressing their distended mouths against each other.
Array.indonesia: A species of perciformes that is aggressive enough to eat up any living things that enter its territory with its enormous mouth. When two gunnels fight, they wrestle by pressing their distended mouths against each other.

Array.name: Marbled_Electric_Ray_desc
Array.english: An electric stringray found from the Eastern Atlantic to South Africa. Mainly nocturnal and hides in the ground, then emits 70-80V of electricity when hunting prey.
Array.indonesia: An electric stringray found from the Eastern Atlantic to South Africa. Mainly nocturnal and hides in the ground, then emits 70-80V of electricity when hunting prey.

Array.name: SnubNosedSpiny_Eel_desc
Array.english: A type of eel that lives in the deep waters of the polar regions. It is characterized by its up to 12 small hard spines on it back.
Array.indonesia: A type of eel that lives in the deep waters of the polar regions. It is characterized by its up to 12 small hard spines on it back.

Array.name: LumpFish_desc
Array.english: A fish with no scales, a leathery surface, and a bumpy body surface. It can be found near the Arctic Ocean and is a popular substitute for caviar.
Array.indonesia: A fish with no scales, a leathery surface, and a bumpy body surface. It can be found near the Arctic Ocean and is a popular substitute for caviar.

Array.name: Arctic_TelescopeFish_desc
Array.english: A fish that lives in the polar deep sea. It is characterized by its telescopic eyes that have developed the ability to search for food in dark spaces.
Array.indonesia: A fish that lives in the polar deep sea. It is characterized by its telescopic eyes that have developed the ability to search for food in dark spaces.

Array.name: Alaska_Pollock_desc
Array.english: A fish widely distributed in Alaska and the Arctic Ocean. With its mottled appearance, it blends in well into its surrounding environmnent and hidden well from the sight of predators.
Array.indonesia: A fish widely distributed in Alaska and the Arctic Ocean. With its mottled appearance, it blends in well into its surrounding environmnent and hidden well from the sight of predators.

Array.name: Xenacanthus_desc
Array.english: An ancient fish species that is believed to have inhabited many parts of the world. It has elongated fins and is characterized by sharp venom spines on the back of its head.
Array.indonesia: An ancient fish species that is believed to have inhabited many parts of the world. It has elongated fins and is characterized by sharp venom spines on the back of its head.

Array.name: Red_Bbanded_Lobster_desc
Array.english: A type of lobster that lives in the Pacific region. It has relatively small pincers for a lobster and has a light orange color throughout its body. There are 4 distinct red band patterns on its legs.
Array.indonesia: A type of lobster that lives in the Pacific region. It has relatively small pincers for a lobster and has a light orange color throughout its body. There are 4 distinct red band patterns on its legs.

Array.name: Norway_Lobster_desc
Array.english: It is characterized by a slender appearance as a whole, including the claws. It is sensitive to light and is active in the dark.
Array.indonesia: It is characterized by a slender appearance as a whole, including the claws. It is sensitive to light and is active in the dark.

Array.name: California_Spiny_Lobster_desc
Array.english: A type of spiny lobster found in the Pacific Ocean. Unlike common lobster species, it does not have large claws, but has two small hook-like claws.
Array.indonesia: A type of spiny lobster found in the Pacific Ocean. Unlike common lobster species, it does not have large claws, but has two small hook-like claws.

Array.name: American_Lobster_desc
Array.english: It is mainly found along the North American Atlantic coast and is known as the heaviest and longest species in the world. It primarily has a brownish body and inhabits the rocky areas of cold seas at depths of up to 40 meters.
Array.indonesia: It is mainly found along the North American Atlantic coast and is known as the heaviest and longest species in the world. It primarily has a brownish body and inhabits the rocky areas of cold seas at depths of up to 40 meters.

Array.name: Fan_Lobster_desc
Array.english: It is characterized by having a deformed head like a fan, and inhabits soft sea beds like sand or mud on the continental shelf. It's nocturnal, using its shovel-like modified appendages to dig into the ground and hide during the day.
Array.indonesia: It is characterized by having a deformed head like a fan, and inhabits soft sea beds like sand or mud on the continental shelf. It's nocturnal, using its shovel-like modified appendages to dig into the ground and hide during the day.

Array.name: Blue_Lobster_desc
Array.english: An American lobster crayfish with a blue body due to lack of pigment. It occurs with a probability of 1 in 2 million and is considered to bring luck due to its rarity.
Array.indonesia: An American lobster crayfish with a blue body due to lack of pigment. It occurs with a probability of 1 in 2 million and is considered to bring luck due to its rarity.

Array.name: Golden_King_Crab_desc
Array.english: Mainly found in cold waters such as Alaska. It is characterized by a golden shell composed mainly of calcium and its spines on the back.
Array.indonesia: Mainly found in cold waters such as Alaska. It is characterized by a golden shell composed mainly of calcium and its spines on the back.

Array.name: Horsehair_Crab_desc
Array.english: It inhabits the underwater mud and sandy bottoms of the North Pacific, including the Okhotsk Sea and the Bering Sea. It is characterized by soft spines covering the hard shell.
Array.indonesia: It inhabits the underwater mud and sandy bottoms of the North Pacific, including the Okhotsk Sea and the Bering Sea. It is characterized by soft spines covering the hard shell.

Array.name: Snow_Crab_desc
Array.english: It inhabits the cold waters of the northernmost regions of the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans, including the Arctic Ocean. It feeds on clams, small crustaceans, and performs the role of underwater cleaner by consuming organic matter.
Array.indonesia: It inhabits the cold waters of the northernmost regions of the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans, including the Arctic Ocean. It feeds on clams, small crustaceans, and performs the role of underwater cleaner by consuming organic matter.

Array.name: Crystal_Lobster_desc
Array.english: A type of American Lobster that has a translucent white body due to albinism. It occurs with a probability of 1 in 100 million and is the rarest lobster in existence.
Array.indonesia: A type of American Lobster that has a translucent white body due to albinism. It occurs with a probability of 1 in 100 million and is the rarest lobster in existence.

Array.name: European_Lobster_desc
Array.english: A lobster that can be found at depths of up to 150 meters throughout the northern Atlantic Ocean and west of the Mediterranean Ocean. Its shell is mainly blue, and its belly is yellow or white.
Array.indonesia: A lobster that can be found at depths of up to 150 meters throughout the northern Atlantic Ocean and west of the Mediterranean Ocean. Its shell is mainly blue, and its belly is yellow or white.

Array.name: Tropical_Rock_Lobster_desc
Array.english: A lobster that can be found in shallow seas with depths of 50m or less. It lives throughout the Pacific Ocean of Australia and India. Its shell is of a turquoise color, and it has stripes of various colors all over its body.
Array.indonesia: A lobster that can be found in shallow seas with depths of 50m or less. It lives throughout the Pacific Ocean of Australia and India. Its shell is of a turquoise color, and it has stripes of various colors all over its body.

Array.name: Eastern_Rock_Lobster_desc
Array.english: A lobster mainly found in the southeast of Australia and the northern seas of New Zealand. It has even been discovered at depths of up to 200 meters. It is known as one of the longest crustaceans, along with the American Lobster.
Array.indonesia: A lobster mainly found in the southeast of Australia and the northern seas of New Zealand. It has even been discovered at depths of up to 200 meters. It is known as one of the longest crustaceans, along with the American Lobster.

Array.name: Dollocaris_Ingens_desc
Array.english: An arthropod with large compound eyes that lived in the Jurassic era. It has a rigid shell like a crab, and three pairs of legs. It likely caught and fed on small organisms at the seabed or ambushed its prey.
Array.indonesia: An arthropod with large compound eyes that lived in the Jurassic era. It has a rigid shell like a crab, and three pairs of legs. It likely caught and fed on small organisms at the seabed or ambushed its prey.

Array.name: Tokummia_Katalepsis_desc
Array.english: An arthropod presumed to have lived during the Cambrian period. It has 50 legs, 2 pincers, and little eyes near its antennas. It is 10cm long and lived in the bottom of tropical oceans.
Array.indonesia: An arthropod presumed to have lived during the Cambrian period. It has 50 legs, 2 pincers, and little eyes near its antennas. It is 10cm long and lived in the bottom of tropical oceans.

Array.name: Longspine_Porcupinefish_desc
Array.english: Inhabits coral reefs in tropical and subtropical oceans around the world, and can grow up to 50cm. It secretes powerful toxic substances from its spines to protect itself.
Array.indonesia: Inhabits coral reefs in tropical and subtropical oceans around the world, and can grow up to 50cm. It secretes powerful toxic substances from its spines to protect itself.

Array.name: Longspine_Squirrelfish_desc
Array.english: A pelagic species that forms schools and is found in the Indian-Pacific region and near tropical areas. It primarily inhabits coastal rocky areas and mainly feeds on crustaceans.
Array.indonesia: A pelagic species that forms schools and is found in the Indian-Pacific region and near tropical areas. It primarily inhabits coastal rocky areas and mainly feeds on crustaceans.

Array.name: Clearfin_Lionfish_desc
Array.english: A nocturnal species that primarily hunts crabs and shrimps. It has 12 to 13 long venomous spines on its dorsal fin, and unlike the lionfish, it lacks stripes on its spines.
Array.indonesia: A nocturnal species that primarily hunts crabs and shrimps. It has 12 to 13 long venomous spines on its dorsal fin, and unlike the lionfish, it lacks stripes on its spines.

Array.name: SpearSquid_desc
Array.english: A carnivorous mollusk with an elongated cone shape. The legs are usually in the pouch and extend when catching prey.
Array.indonesia: A carnivorous mollusk with an elongated cone shape. The legs are usually in the pouch and extend when catching prey.

Array.name: Dredge_Fanged_Cod_desc
Array.english: Deviantly sharp teeth, with chunks of smaller fish lodged between. A hunger in its eyes.
Array.indonesia: Deviantly sharp teeth, with chunks of smaller fish lodged between. A hunger in its eyes.

Array.name: Dredge_Three_Headed_Cod_desc
Array.english: Three heads writhe and struggle in unison. Three mouths hang agape, then close shut together. Three lives lived as one. One fate bound to many.
Array.indonesia: Three heads writhe and struggle in unison. Three mouths hang agape, then close shut together. Three lives lived as one. One fate bound to many.

Array.name: Dredge_Grotesque_Mackerel_desc
Array.english: Corrupted scales and bulbous eyes - like nothing you've ever seen before.
Array.indonesia: Corrupted scales and bulbous eyes - like nothing you've ever seen before.

Array.name: Dredge_Many_Eyed_Mackerel_desc
Array.english: Gill plates dotted with eyeballs. Superfluous but scanning, frantically. All eyes see right through you.
Array.indonesia: Gill plates dotted with eyeballs. Superfluous but scanning, frantically. All eyes see right through you.

Array.name: Dredge_Tusked_Grouper_desc
Array.english: Pig-like tusks protrude from the mouth of this ravenous brute. With no eyes to speak of, it attacks indiscriminately.
Array.indonesia: Pig-like tusks protrude from the mouth of this ravenous brute. With no eyes to speak of, it attacks indiscriminately.

Array.name: Dredge_Voltaic_Grouper_desc
Array.english: An unknown green energy arcs and crackles over this fish's scales. It thrashes ceaselessly, even hours after being pulled from the water.
Array.indonesia: An unknown green energy arcs and crackles over this fish's scales. It thrashes ceaselessly, even hours after being pulled from the water.

Array.name: Dredge_Barbed_Eel_desc
Array.english: A spine broken with sharp angles and crooked curves. A row of teeth bent on revenge.
Array.indonesia: A spine broken with sharp angles and crooked curves. A row of teeth bent on revenge.

Array.name: Dredge_Host_Eel_desc
Array.english: Numerous glowing shapes flicker and squirm behind a distended ribcage. The rest of the fish is withered and drained.
Array.indonesia: Numerous glowing shapes flicker and squirm behind a distended ribcage. The rest of the fish is withered and drained.

Array.name: Dredge_Bloodskin_Shark_desc
Array.english: Tendons and sinews stretch over the fins of this bloodied predator. Powerful jaws are clad in exposed muscle.
Array.indonesia: Tendons and sinews stretch over the fins of this bloodied predator. Powerful jaws are clad in exposed muscle.

Array.name: Dredge_Sallow_Sailfish_desc
Array.english: A sickly, pallid color coats the scales of this normally sleek and shiny fish. Clouded eyes belie the disease spreading underneath.
Array.indonesia: A sickly, pallid color coats the scales of this normally sleek and shiny fish. Clouded eyes belie the disease spreading underneath.

Array.name: Dredge_Cerebral_Crab_desc
Array.english: A turquoise mass swells from within this small crab. The growth pulses, quickening in the light of the sun.
Array.indonesia: A turquoise mass swells from within this small crab. The growth pulses, quickening in the light of the sun.

Array.name: Dredge_Malignant_Pincer_desc
Array.english: Teal tumours secrete a slimy substance over cracks and joints. Its massive claw shudders as it fights for control.
Array.indonesia: Teal tumours secrete a slimy substance over cracks and joints. Its massive claw shudders as it fights for control.

Array.name: Dredge_Scouring_Bass_desc
Array.english: Shapes swirl inside bulging, clouded eyes. Blinded by the light of the surface, but perfectly suited to searching the depths.
Array.indonesia: Shapes swirl inside bulging, clouded eyes. Blinded by the light of the surface, but perfectly suited to searching the depths.

Array.name: Dredge_Gnashing_Perch_desc
Array.english: Eyeless and mindless. Driven only by the desire to consume. A purpose satiated many times over.
Array.indonesia: Eyeless and mindless. Driven only by the desire to consume. A purpose satiated many times over.

Array.name: Dredge_Shattered_Wreckfish_desc
Array.english: A cracked husk of scaly plates sliding atop pulsing miscoloured flesh.
Array.indonesia: A cracked husk of scaly plates sliding atop pulsing miscoloured flesh.

Array.name: Dredge_Bony_Wreckfish_desc
Array.english: Encased in bony protrusions and struggling to move its encumbered fins. Its gills are almost sealed shut by the growths.
Array.indonesia: Encased in bony protrusions and struggling to move its encumbered fins. Its gills are almost sealed shut by the growths.

Array.name: Dredge_Gelatinous_Stonefish_desc
Array.english: Flesh and scales intent on shuffling away from a creature struggling to maintain its mortal form.
Array.indonesia: Flesh and scales intent on shuffling away from a creature struggling to maintain its mortal form.

Array.name: Dredge_Enthralled_Stonefish_desc
Array.english: A hollowed husk, hosting a hostile dweller. The eyes inside begin their search for a safer vessel.
Array.indonesia: A hollowed husk, hosting a hostile dweller. The eyes inside begin their search for a safer vessel.

Array.name: Dredge_Sprouting_Eel_desc
Array.english: An eruption of crystalline growths burst from its skin. Sharp shapes clatter and resonate together.
Array.indonesia: An eruption of crystalline growths burst from its skin. Sharp shapes clatter and resonate together.

Array.name: Dredge_Translucent_Sturgeon_desc
Array.english: The simple clockwork mechanisms of life laid bare as a tenuous, skeletal existence.
Array.indonesia: The simple clockwork mechanisms of life laid bare as a tenuous, skeletal existence.

Array.name: Dredge_Withered_Ray_desc
Array.english: Rotten webbing spans the wings of this large ray. Sinews stretch and snap as it thrashes in futility.
Array.indonesia: Rotten webbing spans the wings of this large ray. Sinews stretch and snap as it thrashes in futility.

Array.name: Dredge_Decorator_Crab_desc
Array.english: Having covered itself in detritus, this creature hardly resembles a crab at all.
Array.indonesia: Having covered itself in detritus, this creature hardly resembles a crab at all.

Array.name: Dredge_Cortex_Decorator_desc
Array.english: Folds of orange tissue tower from its head. Scything limbs administer the structure.
Array.indonesia: Folds of orange tissue tower from its head. Scything limbs administer the structure.

Array.name: Dredge_Aurora_Jellyfish_desc
Array.english: Illuminating the netherworld with a dull glow. With few predators, this species is spreading rapidly.
Array.indonesia: Illuminating the netherworld with a dull glow. With few predators, this species is spreading rapidly.

Array.name: Dredge_Parhelion_Jellyfish_desc
Array.english: Two spires of light shine from within its hood. Stinging spiked tentacles trail below.
Array.indonesia: Two spires of light shine from within its hood. Stinging spiked tentacles trail below.

Array.name: Dredge_Radiant_Squid_desc
Array.english: A beacon from the depths below. A glimpse of a new sky.
Array.indonesia: A beacon from the depths below. A glimpse of a new sky.

Array.name: Dredge_Seizing_Snailfish_desc
Array.english: Fingers of flesh hold teeth on their tips, a grasping grip that feels through the dark depths.
Array.indonesia: Fingers of flesh hold teeth on their tips, a grasping grip that feels through the dark depths.

Array.name: Dredge_Perished_Loosejaw_desc
Array.english: A few ragged scraps of skin hang like cobwebs from its fins. Its exposed muscles are riddled with small white worms.
Array.indonesia: A few ragged scraps of skin hang like cobwebs from its fins. Its exposed muscles are riddled with small white worms.

Array.name: Dredge_Bursting_Anglerfish_desc
Array.english: The deep faces its own consequences of creation. In the darkness, brutality becomes the ultimate filter.
Array.indonesia: The deep faces its own consequences of creation. In the darkness, brutality becomes the ultimate filter.

Array.name: Dredge_Savage_Barracuda_desc
Array.english: It thrashes about ruinously, jaws snapping and tearing its own flesh apart. A body sundered by ravenous hatred.
Array.indonesia: It thrashes about ruinously, jaws snapping and tearing its own flesh apart. A body sundered by ravenous hatred.

Array.name: Dredge_Concertina_Barracuda_desc
Array.english: Its body extends, then collapses together with each gasping breath. Nature dissected into mechanical motion.
Array.indonesia: Its body extends, then collapses together with each gasping breath. Nature dissected into mechanical motion.

Array.name: Dredge_Gazing_Shark_desc
Array.english: Huge bulbous eyes move about on large fleshy stalks, siphoning energy from its body. Its search is not over.
Array.indonesia: Huge bulbous eyes move about on large fleshy stalks, siphoning energy from its body. Its search is not over.

Array.name: Dredge_Imperious_Lobster_desc
Array.english: Iridescent purple feelers recoil from the dry air. Sacs of violet fluid embedded in its carapace begin to drain.
Array.indonesia: Iridescent purple feelers recoil from the dry air. Sacs of violet fluid embedded in its carapace begin to drain.

Array.name: Dredge_Entangled_Crab_desc
Array.english: Glistening purple strings sprout from solid rock, tying and untying themselves. They fall way and whither, making way for new knots.
Array.indonesia: Glistening purple strings sprout from solid rock, tying and untying themselves. They fall way and whither, making way for new knots.

Array.name: Dredge_Splintered_Crab_desc
Array.english: Amber glue holds shattered fragments. A deep dweller cracked from the pressure.
Array.indonesia: Amber glue holds shattered fragments. A deep dweller cracked from the pressure.

Array.name: Green_Turtle_desc
Array.english: Growing up to a length of 1.8 meters with an average shell length of 1 meters, this omnivorous turtle inhabits the tropical and subtropical waters of the world.
Array.indonesia: Growing up to a length of 1.8 meters with an average shell length of 1 meters, this omnivorous turtle inhabits the tropical and subtropical waters of the world.

Array.name: Indo_Pacific_Bottlenose_Dolphin_desc
Array.english: This dolphin has a long and balanced snout. Its back is dark grey and its belly light grey. It tends to live in groups.
Array.indonesia: This dolphin has a long and balanced snout. Its back is dark grey and its belly light grey. It tends to live in groups.

Array.name: Beluga_desc
Array.english: Belugas live in the Arctic and subarctic waters. They are known to migrate by season. As one of the most sociable sea creatures, they were among the first animals to be domesticated by humans in history.
Array.indonesia: Belugas live in the Arctic and subarctic waters. They are known to migrate by season. As one of the most sociable sea creatures, they were among the first animals to be domesticated by humans in history.

Array.name: Manatee_desc
Array.english: Manatees inhabit tropical and subtropical waters where coral reefs are formed. They are herbivores. They are often mistaken for mermaids when they come to the shore at night once in a while.
Array.indonesia: Manatees inhabit tropical and subtropical waters where coral reefs are formed. They are herbivores. They are often mistaken for mermaids when they come to the shore at night once in a while.

Array.name: Stubby_Squid_desc
Array.english: A type of Sepiolida inhabiting the North Pacific. Known to live up to 2 years, both males and females perish after mating.
Array.indonesia: A type of Sepiolida inhabiting the North Pacific. Known to live up to 2 years, both males and females perish after mating.

Array.name: Trumpetfish_desc
Array.english: Found throughout tropical waters around the world, this tube-like fish grows up to nearly 1 meter. It is known to stalk its prey without being detected and attack from behind.
Array.indonesia: Found throughout tropical waters around the world, this tube-like fish grows up to nearly 1 meter. It is known to stalk its prey without being detected and attack from behind.

Array.name: Whale_Shark_desc
Array.english: One of the largest living vertebrates, the whale shark has a big mouth that can be as wide as 1.5 meters and 300-350 small teeth. Its main diet is plankton.
Array.indonesia: One of the largest living vertebrates, the whale shark has a big mouth that can be as wide as 1.5 meters and 300-350 small teeth. Its main diet is plankton.

Array.name: Yellowfin_Puffer_desc
Array.english: A cylinder-shaped fish with a pair of eyes spreading wide. Unlike other puffer fish, its body is rather slim and has yellow fins.
Array.indonesia: A cylinder-shaped fish with a pair of eyes spreading wide. Unlike other puffer fish, its body is rather slim and has yellow fins.

Array.name: Ribbon_Eel_desc
Array.english: A type of moray eel inhabiting the Pacific and Indian Oceans. Its body changes colors as it grows, but its yellow fins stay the same.
Array.indonesia: A type of moray eel inhabiting the Pacific and Indian Oceans. Its body changes colors as it grows, but its yellow fins stay the same.

Array.name: Knobsnout_Parrotfish_desc
Array.english: The blue humphead parrotfish inhabits coral reefs or rocky areas. It is known to grow up to a length of 90 cm. It crushes and consumes coral and excretes deposits that play a key role in coral formation.
Array.indonesia: The blue humphead parrotfish inhabits coral reefs or rocky areas. It is known to grow up to a length of 90 cm. It crushes and consumes coral and excretes deposits that play a key role in coral formation.

Array.name: Lemon_Shark_desc
Array.english: The lemon shark grows up to 4 meters and inhabits warm and shallow waters. The name comes from its coloration of yellowish hue that reminds the color of lemon.
Array.indonesia: The lemon shark grows up to 4 meters and inhabits warm and shallow waters. The name comes from its coloration of yellowish hue that reminds the color of lemon.

Array.name: Common_Octopus_desc
Array.english: Devil fish inhabit the Mediterranean and the African coasts at a depth of 100 meters. They have a coloration of reddish brown and feature net-like patterns.
Array.indonesia: Devil fish inhabit the Mediterranean and the African coasts at a depth of 100 meters. They have a coloration of reddish brown and feature net-like patterns.

Array.name: Great_Hammerhead_Shark_desc
Array.english: The great hammerhead shark has a larger head and body than its cousins. Its diet consists of fish, cephalopods, and crustaceans. It has wide vision as its eyes are spread wide to the sides of its head.
Array.indonesia: The great hammerhead shark has a larger head and body than its cousins. Its diet consists of fish, cephalopods, and crustaceans. It has wide vision as its eyes are spread wide to the sides of its head.

Array.name: Orcinus_Orca_desc
Array.english: Characterized by a black back, a white belly, and white spots around the eyes, Orcas hunt in a pack, so they are often called the Wolves of the Sea.
Array.indonesia: Characterized by a black back, a white belly, and white spots around the eyes, Orcas hunt in a pack, so they are often called the Wolves of the Sea.

Array.name: Firefly_Squid_desc
Array.english: A squid that glows in bluish white light due to 1,000 photogenic organs in its body. The squid uses this light to threaten enemies and hide its shadow.
Array.indonesia: A squid that glows in bluish white light due to 1,000 photogenic organs in its body. The squid uses this light to threaten enemies and hide its shadow.

Array.name: Red_Lipped_Batfish_desc
Array.english: This fish has red lips and lures prey by wagging its nose-like dorsal fin. It is not a good swimmer and is known to walk the bottom of the sea using its fins. If it has to swim, it will use the fins like the hind legs of a frog.
Array.indonesia: This fish has red lips and lures prey by wagging its nose-like dorsal fin. It is not a good swimmer and is known to walk the bottom of the sea using its fins. If it has to swim, it will use the fins like the hind legs of a frog.

Array.name: Arandaspis_desc
Array.english: An ancient jawless fish. The name means “Aranda’s shield.” A bony plate covers its head and the front half of its body. It is thought to be the predecessor of armored fish.
Array.indonesia: An ancient jawless fish. The name means “Aranda’s shield.” A bony plate covers its head and the front half of its body. It is thought to be the predecessor of armored fish.

Array.name: Southern_RightWhale_Dolphins_desc
Array.english: The southern right whale dolphin, found in cold waters of the southern hemisphere, has a black, sleek back and white belly.
Array.indonesia: The southern right whale dolphin, found in cold waters of the southern hemisphere, has a black, sleek back and white belly.

Array.name: Giant_Isopod_desc
Array.english: One of the larger isopods, growing up to a length of 50 cm. This scavenger is known for its good appetite.
Array.indonesia: One of the larger isopods, growing up to a length of 50 cm. This scavenger is known for its good appetite.

Array.name: Yeti_Crab_desc
Array.english: This crab is covered by a fur coat like a Sasquatch. First found in the deep water of Easter Island in the Southern Pacific at a depth of 2,200 m. Its main diet is the bacteria living off hydrothermal vents.
Array.indonesia: This crab is covered by a fur coat like a Sasquatch. First found in the deep water of Easter Island in the Southern Pacific at a depth of 2,200 m. Its main diet is the bacteria living off hydrothermal vents.

Array.name: Sea_Spider_desc
Array.english: Typical sea spiders are as small as 1-2 cm, but in cold areas, they can grow up to 90 cm. As the legs take up most of its body proportion, major organs are located inside its legs.
Array.indonesia: Typical sea spiders are as small as 1-2 cm, but in cold areas, they can grow up to 90 cm. As the legs take up most of its body proportion, major organs are located inside its legs.

Array.name: LIons_Mane_Jellyfish_desc
Array.english: As the second largest jellyfish known to date, the big ones of this species can grow up to 37 meters. Unlike its terrible appearance, its venom is not so potent.
Array.indonesia: As the second largest jellyfish known to date, the big ones of this species can grow up to 37 meters. Unlike its terrible appearance, its venom is not so potent.

Array.name: Not_Available_EA
Array.english: ※ This species will show up in the full version.
Array.indonesia: ※ This species will show up in the full version.

Array.name: Normal_BasicRifle_Desc
Array.english: A gun that can be fired underwater.\nIt’s an old model and not that powerful.
Array.indonesia: A gun that can be fired underwater.\nIt’s an old model and not that powerful.

Array.name: Normal_ShotGun_Desc
Array.english: A gun that fires three bullets at once.\nIts shots are powerful, but cannot pierce.
Array.indonesia: A gun that fires three bullets at once.\nIts shots are powerful, but cannot pierce.

Array.name: Normal_SniperGun_Desc
Array.english: A sniper rifle with a laser sight.\nThe laser sight allows for accurate shots on even distant targets.
Array.indonesia: A sniper rifle with a laser sight.\nThe laser sight allows for accurate shots on even distant targets.

Array.name: Normal_SleepGun_Desc
Array.english: A non-lethal tranquilizer gun.
Array.indonesia: A non-lethal tranquilizer gun.

Array.name: Normal_PowerRifle_Desc
Array.english: The most recent model of the underwater rifle.\nSpecialized for underwater use, its destructive power and range have been greatly enhanced.
Array.indonesia: The most recent model of the underwater rifle.\nSpecialized for underwater use, its destructive power and range have been greatly enhanced.

Array.name: Normal_GrenadeLauncher_Desc
Array.english: This gun fires a grenade that will explode underwater.\nThe grenade travels along an arc and will cause a powerful explosion upon impact.\n<color=#1DDB16>Explosion range: 2M</color>
Array.indonesia: This gun fires a grenade that will explode underwater.\nThe grenade travels along an arc and will cause a powerful explosion upon impact.\n<color=#1DDB16>Explosion range: 2M</color>

Array.name: Normal_NetGun_Desc
Array.english: This gun fires a net capable of capturing multiple creatures.\nThe captured creatures can have a high grade.\n<color=#1DDB16>Net durability: 1</color>
Array.indonesia: This gun fires a net capable of capturing multiple creatures.\nThe captured creatures can have a high grade.\n<color=#1DDB16>Net durability: 1</color>

Array.name: Normal_StickyBombGun_Desc
Array.english: This gun fires a sticky bomb that will stick to the target or terrain.\nThe sticky bomb will explode succeeding a certain time after being installed.\n<color=#1DDB16>Explosion range: 1.5M</color>
Array.indonesia: This gun fires a sticky bomb that will stick to the target or terrain.\nThe sticky bomb will explode succeeding a certain time after being installed.\n<color=#1DDB16>Explosion range: 1.5M</color>

Array.name: Normal_UziSMG_Desc
Array.english: A submachine gun capable of continuous fire.\nMany rounds are fired automatically when the trigger is pulled.\n<color=#1DDB16>Continuous rounds fired: 3</color>
Array.indonesia: A submachine gun capable of continuous fire.\nMany rounds are fired automatically when the trigger is pulled.\n<color=#1DDB16>Continuous rounds fired: 3</color>

Array.name: Enhanced_OldToyGun_Desc
Array.english: An enhanced Old-Fashioned Underwater Rifle.\nIts attack power has been generally enhanced.
Array.indonesia: An enhanced Old-Fashioned Underwater Rifle.\nIts attack power has been generally enhanced.

Array.name: Enhanced_VolletJet_Desc
Array.english: An enhanced Triple Axel.\nIts range has been enhanced and its magazine expanded.
Array.indonesia: An enhanced Triple Axel.\nIts range has been enhanced and its magazine expanded.

Array.name: Enhanced_RedSniperGun_Desc
Array.english: An enhanced Red Sniper Rifle.\nIts destructive power has been enhanced, and recoil suppressed.
Array.indonesia: An enhanced Red Sniper Rifle.\nIts destructive power has been enhanced, and recoil suppressed.

Array.name: Enhanced_TranquilizerGun_Desc
Array.english:
An enhanced Hush Dart.
Its magazine has been expanded.
<color=#1DDB16>Captures creatures of the highest grade
Tranquilizer concentration: 20</color>
Array.indonesia:
An enhanced Hush Dart.
Its magazine has been expanded.
<color=#1DDB16>Captures creatures of the highest grade
Tranquilizer concentration: 20</color>

Array.name: Enhanced_APSRifle_Desc
Array.english: An enhanced APS Underwater Rifle.\nIts attack power has been generally enhanced.
Array.indonesia: An enhanced APS Underwater Rifle.\nIts attack power has been generally enhanced.

Array.name: Enhanced_GrenadeLauncher_Desc
Array.english: An enhanced grenade launcher.\nIts explosion range has been expanded.\n<color=#1DDB16>Explosion range: 2.5M</color>
Array.indonesia: An enhanced grenade launcher.\nIts explosion range has been expanded.\n<color=#1DDB16>Explosion range: 2.5M</color>

Array.name: Enhanced_NetGun_Desc
Array.english: An enhanced small net gun.\nIts magazine has been expanded.\n<color=#1DDB16>Net durability: 1</color>
Array.indonesia: An enhanced small net gun.\nIts magazine has been expanded.\n<color=#1DDB16>Net durability: 1</color>

Array.name: Enhanced_StickyBombGun_Desc
Array.english: Enhanced Sticky Bomb Gun.\nIts destructive power has been enhanced.\n<color=#1DDB16>Explosion range: 1.5M</color>
Array.indonesia: Enhanced Sticky Bomb Gun.\nIts destructive power has been enhanced.\n<color=#1DDB16>Explosion range: 1.5M</color>

Array.name: Enhanced_UziSMG_Desc
Array.english: A submachine gun capable of continuous fire.\nMany rounds are fired automatically when the trigger is pulled.\n<color=#1DDB16>Continuous rounds fired: 3</color>
Array.indonesia: A submachine gun capable of continuous fire.\nMany rounds are fired automatically when the trigger is pulled.\n<color=#1DDB16>Continuous rounds fired: 3</color>

Array.name: Dredge_Normal_DrainGun_Desc
Array.english: A gun that uses the mysterious energy of aberrant fish to absorb a certain amount of a target's Health and convert it to oxygen.
Array.indonesia: A gun that uses the mysterious energy of aberrant fish to absorb a certain amount of a target's Health and convert it to oxygen.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10013009
Array.english: I want to have the <color=#4AFFDB>Vegetable Sushi</color> that I used to have when I was young.\nThe taste of fresh vegetables, yeah!
Array.indonesia: I want to have the <color=#4AFFDB>Vegetable Sushi</color> that I used to have when I was young.\nThe taste of fresh vegetables, yeah!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10013010
Array.english: Deliver the food to MC Sammy!
Array.indonesia: Deliver the food to MC Sammy!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10013011
Array.english: Chinese cuisine is no problem. Just bring me <color=#4AFFDB>Stargazers</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Wheat</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Olive Oil</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Eggs</color>.
Array.indonesia: Chinese cuisine is no problem. Just bring me <color=#4AFFDB>Stargazers</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Wheat</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Olive Oil</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Eggs</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10013012
Array.english: <color=#4AFFDB>Wang Pang</color>, right? It’s time to decide who is the best.
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>Wang Pang</color>, right? It’s time to decide who is the best.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10012031
Array.english: Duwa's coughing won't stop… Is there any food that will help him?
Array.indonesia: Duwa's coughing won't stop… Is there any food that will help him?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10012033
Array.english: Someone is trapped inside the Glacial Cave! I have to save them.
Array.indonesia: Someone is trapped inside the Glacial Cave! I have to save them.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10012034
Array.english: Selgio, that rascal… Did he go off chasing Shining Jellyfish again? I think I saw him around the Glacial Passage.
Array.indonesia: Selgio, that rascal… Did he go off chasing Shining Jellyfish again? I think I saw him around the Glacial Passage.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10015012
Array.english: The legendary monster of Blue Hole… It sounds scary, but I can't ignore Sato's request…
Array.indonesia: The legendary monster of Blue Hole… It sounds scary, but I can't ignore Sato's request…

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050030
Array.english: This earthquake has destroyed the sushi restaurant I worked so hard for!\nIt will require <color=#4AFFDB>100 gold</color> for repairs. Help me out!
Array.indonesia: This earthquake has destroyed the sushi restaurant I worked so hard for!\nIt will require <color=#4AFFDB>100 gold</color> for repairs. Help me out!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050003
Array.english: With <color=#4AFFDB>Rope</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>Scrap Iron</color>, I can make a simple gun, yes.
Array.indonesia: With <color=#4AFFDB>Rope</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>Scrap Iron</color>, I can make a simple gun, yes.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050001
Array.english: I need more ingredients to run the sushi bar.\nCatch about <color=#4AFFDB>7</color> more.
Array.indonesia: I need more ingredients to run the sushi bar.\nCatch about <color=#4AFFDB>7</color> more.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050004
Array.english: My assistant tells me that he saw an artifact at <color=#4AFFDB>70m</color>... Please go take a look!
Array.indonesia: My assistant tells me that he saw an artifact at <color=#4AFFDB>70m</color>... Please go take a look!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050008
Array.english: Judging from how strong the kick was, it should be at around <color=#4AFFDB>30m</color>.
Array.indonesia: Judging from how strong the kick was, it should be at around <color=#4AFFDB>30m</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050029
Array.english: Get me <color=#4AFFDB>2 Agar</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>2 Red Starfish</color> for my ecological research.
Array.indonesia: Get me <color=#4AFFDB>2 Agar</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>2 Red Starfish</color> for my ecological research.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050009
Array.english: I heard someone’s seen a mutated Striped Snapper<color=#4AFFDB>near the White Corals at 60m</color>...
Array.indonesia: I heard someone’s seen a mutated Striped Snapper<color=#4AFFDB>near the White Corals at 60m</color>...

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050031
Array.english: Bancho is working alone. He could use some help.
Array.indonesia: Bancho is working alone. He could use some help.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050010
Array.english: I need <color=#4AFFDB>Olive Oil</color> and the head of the <color=#4AFFDB>Whitetip Reef Shark</color>, which lives at the right most part of the ocean. Don’t forget you’ll also need <color=#4AFFDB>Cooking Research</color>.
Array.indonesia: I need <color=#4AFFDB>Olive Oil</color> and the head of the <color=#4AFFDB>Whitetip Reef Shark</color>, which lives at the right most part of the ocean. Don’t forget you’ll also need <color=#4AFFDB>Cooking Research</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050013
Array.english: I need to cook something to suit Michael Bang's taste.
Array.indonesia: I need to cook something to suit Michael Bang's taste.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050014
Array.english: Get me <color=#4AFFDB>SeaGrape</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>White Spotted Jellyfish</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Salt</color> from the stalactite cave in the depths.
Array.indonesia: Get me <color=#4AFFDB>SeaGrape</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>White Spotted Jellyfish</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Salt</color> from the stalactite cave in the depths.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050015
Array.english: Take this <color=#4AFFDB>Sea-flavored Jellyfish Sushi</color> to Vincent.
Array.indonesia: Take this <color=#4AFFDB>Sea-flavored Jellyfish Sushi</color> to Vincent.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050016
Array.english: Take this <color=#4AFFDB>Sea-flavored Jellyfish Sushi</color> to Vincent.
Array.indonesia: Take this <color=#4AFFDB>Sea-flavored Jellyfish Sushi</color> to Vincent.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050017
Array.english: I’ve made a Radar for checking sea people signals.\nTry following it!
Array.indonesia: I’ve made a Radar for checking sea people signals.\nTry following it!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050018
Array.english: How can we pierce the blocked rock pile...\nAsk Cobra!
Array.indonesia: How can we pierce the blocked rock pile...\nAsk Cobra!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050019
Array.english: We’ll need drones to bring things back...\nPlease check out <color=#4AFFDB>where the currents flow</color>!
Array.indonesia: We’ll need drones to bring things back...\nPlease check out <color=#4AFFDB>where the currents flow</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059020
Array.english: Use the Bomb from Cobra to get behind\nthe <color=#4AFFDB>Rock Pile</color>.
Array.indonesia: Use the Bomb from Cobra to get behind\nthe <color=#4AFFDB>Rock Pile</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050020
Array.english: Use the Bomb from Cobra to get behind\nthe <color=#4AFFDB>Rock Pile</color>.
Array.indonesia: Use the Bomb from Cobra to get behind\nthe <color=#4AFFDB>Rock Pile</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050021
Array.english: Use the Bomb from Cobra to get behind\nthe <color=#4AFFDB>Rock Pile</color>.
Array.indonesia: Use the Bomb from Cobra to get behind\nthe <color=#4AFFDB>Rock Pile</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050022
Array.english: The explosion blew it open!\nPlease check inside!
Array.indonesia: The explosion blew it open!\nPlease check inside!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050023
Array.english: Goodness! A Sea People Record Chamber...\nInvestigate the interior!
Array.indonesia: Goodness! A Sea People Record Chamber...\nInvestigate the interior!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059021
Array.english: A sea people mural...\nI need you to take a picture of it!!
Array.indonesia: A sea people mural...\nI need you to take a picture of it!!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059022
Array.english: That appears to be a <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Artifact</color> on the floor...\nBring it back for analysis!
Array.indonesia: That appears to be a <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Artifact</color> on the floor...\nBring it back for analysis!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059023
Array.english: That should be enough to research.\nNow come back to the boat!
Array.indonesia: That should be enough to research.\nNow come back to the boat!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050024
Array.english: We need a light to go into the depths...\nCall Duff and ask if he has a<color=#4AFFDB>Headlamp</color>.
Array.indonesia: We need a light to go into the depths...\nCall Duff and ask if he has a<color=#4AFFDB>Headlamp</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050025
Array.english: I need the <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>. Search near the yellow delivery shipwreck.\nLeahs-chan is trapped inside.
Array.indonesia: I need the <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>. Search near the yellow delivery shipwreck.\nLeahs-chan is trapped inside.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050026
Array.english: Leahs-chan has been abducted and taken below the wreck...\nUse the <color=#4AFFDB>Gas Cutter</color> to get inside the wreck.
Array.indonesia: Leahs-chan has been abducted and taken below the wreck...\nUse the <color=#4AFFDB>Gas Cutter</color> to get inside the wreck.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050027
Array.english: Use the open door to get to the <color=#4AFFDB>Shipwreck Interior</color>.\nLeahs-chan... she’s in danger!
Array.indonesia: Use the open door to get to the <color=#4AFFDB>Shipwreck Interior</color>.\nLeahs-chan... she’s in danger!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050033
Array.english: My destiny... She’s at risk.\nFind the <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>.
Array.indonesia: My destiny... She’s at risk.\nFind the <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050028
Array.english: The squid has an eye for beauty, I’ll give it that...\nRetrieve my <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>!
Array.indonesia: The squid has an eye for beauty, I’ll give it that...\nRetrieve my <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050032
Array.english: Cut off the Squid Tentacle and extract the <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>.
Array.indonesia: Cut off the Squid Tentacle and extract the <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059033
Array.english: Get me the <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>, Dave.
Array.indonesia: Get me the <color=#4AFFDB>Pink Delivery Box</color>, Dave.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050034
Array.english: Ugh... It stinks...\nI’ll have to call Bancho and ask what I should do with the Squid Tentacle.
Array.indonesia: Ugh... It stinks...\nI’ll have to call Bancho and ask what I should do with the Squid Tentacle.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050035
Array.english: Go to Bancho’s Sushi Bar.
Array.indonesia: Go to Bancho’s Sushi Bar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050036
Array.english: Phew. What a hectic few days. I haven’t had this much free time in a while.\nI should talk with some people.
Array.indonesia: Phew. What a hectic few days. I haven’t had this much free time in a while.\nI should talk with some people.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050037
Array.english: There’s my Beer mug.\nI should pick it up for a toast!
Array.indonesia: There’s my Beer mug.\nI should pick it up for a toast!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050038
Array.english: With the <color=#4AFFDB>Headlamp</color>, you should be able to venture into the depths.\nFollow the signal!
Array.indonesia: With the <color=#4AFFDB>Headlamp</color>, you should be able to venture into the depths.\nFollow the signal!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050039
Array.english: It’s the one that tried to pick a fight before...\nDefeat him first!
Array.indonesia: It’s the one that tried to pick a fight before...\nDefeat him first!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050040
Array.english: John Watson... What a violent man. Try going into the depths again.\nYour <color=#4AFFDB>Headlamp</color> will come on automatically!
Array.indonesia: John Watson... What a violent man. Try going into the depths again.\nYour <color=#4AFFDB>Headlamp</color> will come on automatically!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059040
Array.english: To think sea people actually exist... It seems like it has something to say...\nCome up to the boat for now!
Array.indonesia: To think sea people actually exist... It seems like it has something to say...\nCome up to the boat for now!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050005
Array.english: We have a strange customer here at the sushi bar... It’s troublesome.\nPlease come over.
Array.indonesia: We have a strange customer here at the sushi bar... It’s troublesome.\nPlease come over.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050006
Array.english: Can’t you make me <color=#4AFFDB>Morray Curry</color>? I’ve tried it at an Indian fishing village.\nMoray Eels are only found at night, by the way!
Array.indonesia: Can’t you make me <color=#4AFFDB>Morray Curry</color>? I’ve tried it at an Indian fishing village.\nMoray Eels are only found at night, by the way!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050007
Array.english: I’ve prepared a special gift in the empty lot behind the sushi bar.\nCome by when you have the time.
Array.indonesia: I’ve prepared a special gift in the empty lot behind the sushi bar.\nCome by when you have the time.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050041
Array.english: Get a <color=#4AFFDB>Microphone</color> beneath the shipwreck, a <color=#4AFFDB>Stone Slab</color> from the Sea People Record Chamber...and a <color=#4AFFDB>Amethyst</color> from the depths, and I’ll be able to make a Translating Device!
Array.indonesia: Get a <color=#4AFFDB>Microphone</color> beneath the shipwreck, a <color=#4AFFDB>Stone Slab</color> from the Sea People Record Chamber...and a <color=#4AFFDB>Amethyst</color> from the depths, and I’ll be able to make a Translating Device!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050042
Array.english: The <color=#4AFFDB>Translation Device</color> will let you speak to sea people!\nTry going to see them.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#4AFFDB>Translation Device</color> will let you speak to sea people!\nTry going to see them.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050043
Array.english: The <color=#4AFFDB>Translation Device</color> will let you speak to sea people!\nTry going to see them.
Array.indonesia: The <color=#4AFFDB>Translation Device</color> will let you speak to sea people!\nTry going to see them.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050044
Array.english: Ramo is sick!\nHurry up and make food with <color=#4AFFDB>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>Lily Coral</color>!
Array.indonesia: Ramo is sick!\nHurry up and make food with <color=#4AFFDB>Feather Coral</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>Lily Coral</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050045
Array.english: I’ve gathered all the ingredients for treating the sea person,\nso I should ask Bancho to prepare them.
Array.indonesia: I’ve gathered all the ingredients for treating the sea person,\nso I should ask Bancho to prepare them.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050046
Array.english: You’re late! Give the <color=#4AFFDB>Coral Porridge</color> to Ramo immediately!
Array.indonesia: You’re late! Give the <color=#4AFFDB>Coral Porridge</color> to Ramo immediately!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050047
Array.english: Time to head back to the village...\nI haven't fully recovered, so you need to escort me, human!
Array.indonesia: Time to head back to the village...\nI haven't fully recovered, so you need to escort me, human!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059047
Array.english: Their path to the village is blocked, huh...\nI think I know a way. Come on up!
Array.indonesia: Their path to the village is blocked, huh...\nI think I know a way. Come on up!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050048
Array.english: The way back to the village is blocked!\nPull the <color=#4AFFDB>Stakes</color> to topple the rock piles.
Array.indonesia: The way back to the village is blocked!\nPull the <color=#4AFFDB>Stakes</color> to topple the rock piles.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050049
Array.english: The way back to the village is blocked!\nPull the <color=#ff4dbd>Stakes</color>to topple the rock piles.
Array.indonesia: The way back to the village is blocked!\nPull the <color=#ff4dbd>Stakes</color>to topple the rock piles.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050050
Array.english: Hmm... This won’t be enough to open a path.\nThere’s a rock pile over there, too... Go and check, human!
Array.indonesia: Hmm... This won’t be enough to open a path.\nThere’s a rock pile over there, too... Go and check, human!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050051
Array.english: I think you can pull that to topple the pile!\nPull on the <color=#4AFFDB>Stake</color> inside, human!
Array.indonesia: I think you can pull that to topple the pile!\nPull on the <color=#4AFFDB>Stake</color> inside, human!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050052
Array.english: Alright, the path is open.\nI’ll go on ahead, so come down through the hole.
Array.indonesia: Alright, the path is open.\nI’ll go on ahead, so come down through the hole.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050053
Array.english: It’s... kind of spooky!\nGo and check for any dangers, human!
Array.indonesia: It’s... kind of spooky!\nGo and check for any dangers, human!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050054
Array.english: It’s a gigantic Wolf Eel... Oh, whatever! I’ll try and fight it.
Array.indonesia: It’s a gigantic Wolf Eel... Oh, whatever! I’ll try and fight it.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059054
Array.english: Is there anything worth salvaging from the <color=#5dd3bb>Wolf Eel</color>? Let's investigate.
Array.indonesia: Is there anything worth salvaging from the <color=#5dd3bb>Wolf Eel</color>? Let's investigate.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050055
Array.english: Our village is past that gate.\nCome to the gate, human.
Array.indonesia: Our village is past that gate.\nCome to the gate, human.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050056
Array.english: Should I follow the dolphins?
Array.indonesia: Should I follow the dolphins?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050057
Array.english: A Pink Dolphin is trapped! I should cut the <color=#4AFFDB>Net</color> to rescue it.
Array.indonesia: A Pink Dolphin is trapped! I should cut the <color=#4AFFDB>Net</color> to rescue it.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050058
Array.english: Research dishes that can utilize <color=#4AFFDB>White Rice</color>.
Array.indonesia: Research dishes that can utilize <color=#4AFFDB>White Rice</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050059
Array.english: In order to make special sushi, I’ll need the <color=#4AFFDB>Starry Puffer</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>White Rice</color>.\nCan you get them for me?
Array.indonesia: In order to make special sushi, I’ll need the <color=#4AFFDB>Starry Puffer</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>White Rice</color>.\nCan you get them for me?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050060
Array.english: Register Starry Puffer Sushi to the Menu and serve it to the customers.
Array.indonesia: Register Starry Puffer Sushi to the Menu and serve it to the customers.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050061
Array.english: I’ve prepared a gift for you at the Farm.\nCome by when you can.
Array.indonesia: I’ve prepared a gift for you at the Farm.\nCome by when you can.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050093

Array.indonesia: The increased <color=#008c6f>Moray Eel</color> population has contributed to a rise in night diving accidents at night.\nHunt them to cull their number.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050094

Array.indonesia: <color=#008c6f>Fangtooths</color> are disrupting the deep-sea ecology.\nHunt them to cull their number.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050095
