Array.indonesia: There are too many <color=#008c6f>Stargazers</color> and <color=#008c6f>Viperfish</color> in the depths.\nHunt them to cull their number.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050096
Array.english: We have a peculiar girl as a customer...\nI should first prepare <color=#4AFFDB>White Trevally</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Kelp</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Soy Sauce</color>.
Array.indonesia: We have a peculiar girl as a customer...\nI should first prepare <color=#4AFFDB>White Trevally</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Kelp</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Soy Sauce</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050100
Array.english: I wish to see a <color=#4AFFDB>Clione</color> from the depths in person...\nCould you collect about five?
Array.indonesia: I wish to see a <color=#4AFFDB>Clione</color> from the depths in person...\nCould you collect about five?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059100
Array.english: What a huge clione..!! I think I need to defeat her to get out…!
Array.indonesia: What a huge clione..!! I think I need to defeat her to get out…!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059101
Array.english: What is this <color=#4AFFDB>frame</color>? Let's take it up to the boat.
Array.indonesia: What is this <color=#4AFFDB>frame</color>? Let's take it up to the boat.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059102
Array.english: I need to go to the Sushi Bar and Meet Maki.
Array.indonesia: I need to go to the Sushi Bar and Meet Maki.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059103
Array.english: Is there anything worth salvaging from the Giant Clione? Let's investigate.
Array.indonesia: Is there anything worth salvaging from the Giant Clione? Let's investigate.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050097
Array.english: There’s something strange about that <color=#4AFFDB>Coral</color>.\nI should try and approach it.
Array.indonesia: There’s something strange about that <color=#4AFFDB>Coral</color>.\nI should try and approach it.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050098
Array.english: Ugh... That nasty octopus...\nI’m going to chase him and teach him a lesson!
Array.indonesia: Ugh... That nasty octopus...\nI’m going to chase him and teach him a lesson!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050099
Array.english: Bring Dish to Michael Bang
Array.indonesia: Bring Dish to Michael Bang

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050103
Array.english: The dolphin seems to want me to follow.\nI should try following.
Array.indonesia: The dolphin seems to want me to follow.\nI should try following.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050104
Array.english: A Pink Dolphin has been caught in an illegal fishing net!\nCut the <color=#4AFFDB>Rope</color> before it’s dragged up!
Array.indonesia: A Pink Dolphin has been caught in an illegal fishing net!\nCut the <color=#4AFFDB>Rope</color> before it’s dragged up!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050105
Array.english: Otto said I should visit the <color=#4AFFDB>Empty Lot</color>.\nI should go by boat.
Array.indonesia: Otto said I should visit the <color=#4AFFDB>Empty Lot</color>.\nI should go by boat.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050106
Array.english: Pirates! You keep torturing the dolphins!\nI’ll teach them a lesson today.
Array.indonesia: Pirates! You keep torturing the dolphins!\nI’ll teach them a lesson today.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050107
Array.english: Hmm! Humans can’t be trusted.\nI’ll think about it if you first build up some <color=#4AFFDB>trust</color> with the villagers.
Array.indonesia: Hmm! Humans can’t be trusted.\nI’ll think about it if you first build up some <color=#4AFFDB>trust</color> with the villagers.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050108
Array.english: I think I’ve grown quite close with the villagers now.\nLet’s go back to Tenzhin.
Array.indonesia: I think I’ve grown quite close with the villagers now.\nLet’s go back to Tenzhin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050109
Array.english: Deliver <color=#4AFFDB>Lunch Boxes</color> to the gatekeepers Awang and Nawang!\nThey’ll be upset again if their food is late.
Array.indonesia: Deliver <color=#4AFFDB>Lunch Boxes</color> to the gatekeepers Awang and Nawang!\nThey’ll be upset again if their food is late.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059109
Array.english: I’ve delivered the Lunch Boxes, so I should tell Mima.
Array.indonesia: I’ve delivered the Lunch Boxes, so I should tell Mima.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050110
Array.english: I have guests to serve, and I haven’t been able to acquire <color=#4AFFDB>Tube Corals</color>.\nCould you look for some in the depths?
Array.indonesia: I have guests to serve, and I haven’t been able to acquire <color=#4AFFDB>Tube Corals</color>.\nCould you look for some in the depths?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050111
Array.english: Mima said she wanted to try human food, right?\nI should ask Bancho.
Array.indonesia: Mima said she wanted to try human food, right?\nI should ask Bancho.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050112
Array.english: Take the salad Bancho made to Mima.
Array.indonesia: Take the salad Bancho made to Mima.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050113
Array.english: I can’t speak with someone who doesn’t respect King Long.\nGo offer a flower or something first!
Array.indonesia: I can’t speak with someone who doesn’t respect King Long.\nGo offer a flower or something first!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050114
Array.english: I’ve offered a flower, so I should speak to Kazhin at the Seed Shop.
Array.indonesia: I’ve offered a flower, so I should speak to Kazhin at the Seed Shop.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050115
Array.english: Get <color=#4AFFDB>Cucumbers</color> and return to Kazhin at the Seed Shop.
Array.indonesia: Get <color=#4AFFDB>Cucumbers</color> and return to Kazhin at the Seed Shop.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050116
Array.english: These special <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Seeds</color>...\nThey could probably grow on the surface, too. Try planting them!
Array.indonesia: These special <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Seeds</color>...\nThey could probably grow on the surface, too. Try planting them!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050117
Array.english: Try growing <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Seeds</color> at the Farm.
Array.indonesia: Try growing <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Seeds</color> at the Farm.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050118
Array.english: Wow! To think sea people plants grow on land as well!\nI should go and tell Kazhin.
Array.indonesia: Wow! To think sea people plants grow on land as well!\nI should go and tell Kazhin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050119
Array.english: A Megamouth swallowed our <color=#4AFFDB>Ball</color>...\nCan you get it back for us?
Array.indonesia: A Megamouth swallowed our <color=#4AFFDB>Ball</color>...\nCan you get it back for us?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050120
Array.english: The Stone Slab with the wedding song is broken...\nRecords should be left in the <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Record Chamber</color>... Please help me.
Array.indonesia: The Stone Slab with the wedding song is broken...\nRecords should be left in the <color=#4AFFDB>Sea People Record Chamber</color>... Please help me.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050121
Array.english: This must be the Stone Slab with the wedding song...\nI should take it to Niamo at the Sea People Village.
Array.indonesia: This must be the Stone Slab with the wedding song...\nI should take it to Niamo at the Sea People Village.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059122
Array.english: Kinglong’s statue is... broken.\nDo you think a human might know how to repair it?
Array.indonesia: Kinglong’s statue is... broken.\nDo you think a human might know how to repair it?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059123
Array.english: Alright. I should take the <color=#4AFFDB>Adhesive</color> from Cobra\nand go back to Niamo in front of the Kinglong statue.
Array.indonesia: Alright. I should take the <color=#4AFFDB>Adhesive</color> from Cobra\nand go back to Niamo in front of the Kinglong statue.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050122
Array.english: Use your human tool to reattach\nKinglong’s arm... Please.
Array.indonesia: Use your human tool to reattach\nKinglong’s arm... Please.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050123
Array.english: <color=#4AFFDB>4</color> Seahorses ran away from the Seahorse Racecourse...\nCould you find them for me? They should be in various parts of the village.
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>4</color> Seahorses ran away from the Seahorse Racecourse...\nCould you find them for me? They should be in various parts of the village.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050124
Array.english: Talk to <color=#4AFFDB>Yami</color> at the Seahorse Racecourse.
Array.indonesia: Talk to <color=#4AFFDB>Yami</color> at the Seahorse Racecourse.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050125
Array.english: Come to the <color=#4AFFDB>Village Elder’s Place</color> when the day breaks.\nI will tell you how to get to the Abandoned Cave.
Array.indonesia: Come to the <color=#4AFFDB>Village Elder’s Place</color> when the day breaks.\nI will tell you how to get to the Abandoned Cave.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050126
Array.english: So, the key to the Glacial Area is in this <color=#4AFFDB>Deep Storehouse</color>? It’s creepy...
Array.indonesia: So, the key to the Glacial Area is in this <color=#4AFFDB>Deep Storehouse</color>? It’s creepy...

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050127
Array.english: I heard that I could find the key to the Glacial Passage in the room where the <color=#4AFFDB>mural</color> is.
Array.indonesia: I heard that I could find the key to the Glacial Passage in the room where the <color=#4AFFDB>mural</color> is.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050128
Array.english: This is where the <color=#4AFFDB>mural</color> is, but I can’t find any key here. Should I take a closer look at the symbol in the picture?
Array.indonesia: This is where the <color=#4AFFDB>mural</color> is, but I can’t find any key here. Should I take a closer look at the symbol in the picture?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059128
Array.english: All right! I found the <color=#4AFFDB>Glacial Passage Key</color>! I’ll bring it to Tenzhin.
Array.indonesia: All right! I found the <color=#4AFFDB>Glacial Passage Key</color>! I’ll bring it to Tenzhin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050129
Array.english: Ah, the earthquake let loose all the monsters. I must escape them without being detected.
Array.indonesia: Ah, the earthquake let loose all the monsters. I must escape them without being detected.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050130
Array.english: <color=#4AFFDB>John Watson</color> again! He’s relentless. I will teach him a lesson this time!
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>John Watson</color> again! He’s relentless. I will teach him a lesson this time!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059130
Array.english: John Watson’s gear looked incredible.\nMaybe I should pick up the <color=#4AFFDB>debris</color> in case there’s anything useful.
Array.indonesia: John Watson’s gear looked incredible.\nMaybe I should pick up the <color=#4AFFDB>debris</color> in case there’s anything useful.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050131
Array.english: Whew, that was a close call. I found the key anyway. I should deliver this to <color=#4AFFDB>Tenzhin</color>.
Array.indonesia: Whew, that was a close call. I found the key anyway. I should deliver this to <color=#4AFFDB>Tenzhin</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050132
Array.english: A mother whale is crying... I think it’s trying to say something. Should I call <color=#4AFFDB>Ellie</color> and ask?
Array.indonesia: A mother whale is crying... I think it’s trying to say something. Should I call <color=#4AFFDB>Ellie</color> and ask?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050133
Array.english: A baby whale got lost. I should look around to see if I can hear it <color=#4AFFDB>cry</color>.
Array.indonesia: A baby whale got lost. I should look around to see if I can hear it <color=#4AFFDB>cry</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050134
Array.english: Wait! I just heard a <color=#4AFFDB>baby whale cry</color>! It should be around here somewhere.
Array.indonesia: Wait! I just heard a <color=#4AFFDB>baby whale cry</color>! It should be around here somewhere.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050135
Array.english: The sound is coming from the inside... I can’t get through because of the <color=#4AFFDB>rocks</color>. Is there any way to get rid of them?
Array.indonesia: The sound is coming from the inside... I can’t get through because of the <color=#4AFFDB>rocks</color>. Is there any way to get rid of them?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050136
Array.english: There should be a baby whale in here. I should look for the baby whale.
Array.indonesia: There should be a baby whale in here. I should look for the baby whale.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050137
Array.english: The baby whale is scared. I’ll have to soothe it to bring it out of here.
Array.indonesia: The baby whale is scared. I’ll have to soothe it to bring it out of here.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050138
Array.english: All right! Now I’ll bring it back to its mother. It should follow me if I go up to the <color=#4AFFDB>surface level</color>.
Array.indonesia: All right! Now I’ll bring it back to its mother. It should follow me if I go up to the <color=#4AFFDB>surface level</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050139
Array.english: Suwam told me that he’d wait in front of Tenzhin’s place.
Array.indonesia: Suwam told me that he’d wait in front of Tenzhin’s place.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059139
Array.english: Now that I have the key, I can open the door to Glacial Passage.
Array.indonesia: Now that I have the key, I can open the door to Glacial Passage.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050140
Array.english: The door is open.\nLet’s get inside the Glacial Passage.
Array.indonesia: The door is open.\nLet’s get inside the Glacial Passage.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050141
Array.english: The door leading down is blocked. I must find another way.
Array.indonesia: The door leading down is blocked. I must find another way.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050142
Array.english: It will be handy if the central passage is open. I should look around.
Array.indonesia: It will be handy if the central passage is open. I should look around.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050143
Array.english: A big chunk of ice is blocking the passage. I must find a way to melt it. I should look around to see if there is anything useful.
Array.indonesia: A big chunk of ice is blocking the passage. I must find a way to melt it. I should look around to see if there is anything useful.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059143
Array.english: I think I have to remove the rock from the mirror...\nBut I don’t have any tools right now. I’ll go back to the boat.
Array.indonesia: I think I have to remove the rock from the mirror...\nBut I don’t have any tools right now. I’ll go back to the boat.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050144

Array.english: There must be something on the other side of this door.\nHow am I supposed to open it?
Array.indonesia: There must be something on the other side of this door.\nHow am I supposed to open it?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059170
Array.english: T-There are sea people bones...!\nWhat on earth happened...?!
Array.indonesia: T-There are sea people bones...!\nWhat on earth happened...?!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050171
Array.english: I must bring the artifact for further study.
Array.indonesia: I must bring the artifact for further study.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050172
Array.english: Pirates! Are they here to raid?\nWe should run for our lives!
Array.indonesia: Pirates! Are they here to raid?\nWe should run for our lives!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050173
Array.english: Sea Blue deploys scouting drones at night.\nFollow one of them and I might find the base.
Array.indonesia: Sea Blue deploys scouting drones at night.\nFollow one of them and I might find the base.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050174
Array.english: That must be one of those drones.\nI should follow it without being noticed.
Array.indonesia: That must be one of those drones.\nI should follow it without being noticed.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050175
Array.english: This is the base of Sea Blue?\nThey’re processing dolphins!
Array.indonesia: This is the base of Sea Blue?\nThey’re processing dolphins!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050176
Array.english: There must be a part somewhere here.\nI should hurry before I am noticed.
Array.indonesia: There must be a part somewhere here.\nI should hurry before I am noticed.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050178
Array.english: Will you go to Tsuchi’s house? He’s a seaweed collector. There should be <color=#4AFFDB>traces of jellyfish</color> his turtle had been eating.
Array.indonesia: Will you go to Tsuchi’s house? He’s a seaweed collector. There should be <color=#4AFFDB>traces of jellyfish</color> his turtle had been eating.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050179
Array.english: Are these the traces of jellyfish that Tsuchi’s turtle had been eating? I’ll have to follow them.
Array.indonesia: Are these the traces of jellyfish that Tsuchi’s turtle had been eating? I’ll have to follow them.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050180
Array.english: Argh...! The giant leatherback turtle is going crazy! I’ll have to hold it and calm it down.
Array.indonesia: Argh...! The giant leatherback turtle is going crazy! I’ll have to hold it and calm it down.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050181
Array.english: So it was because of the plastic bag... People shouldn’t be throwing this into the ocean. Now I’ll go back to <color=#4AFFDB>Mima</color>!
Array.indonesia: So it was because of the plastic bag... People shouldn’t be throwing this into the ocean. Now I’ll go back to <color=#4AFFDB>Mima</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050182
Array.english: Will you please find my pet squid Selgio? It once got lost trying to follow a <color=#4AFFDB>shining jellyfish</color>.
Array.indonesia: Will you please find my pet squid Selgio? It once got lost trying to follow a <color=#4AFFDB>shining jellyfish</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050183
Array.english: Hmm, I think it should be here somewhere. Maybe inside that hole...?
Array.indonesia: Hmm, I think it should be here somewhere. Maybe inside that hole...?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050184
Array.english: Okay, it looks good now... I’ll use Linchen’s <color=#4AFFDB>food</color> to lure it out!
Array.indonesia: Okay, it looks good now... I’ll use Linchen’s <color=#4AFFDB>food</color> to lure it out!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050185
Array.english: Now! I’ll capture Selgio!
Array.indonesia: Now! I’ll capture Selgio!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059185
Array.english: So Selgio was hiding here...I need to take him to Linchen.
Array.indonesia: So Selgio was hiding here...I need to take him to Linchen.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050186
Array.english: Maro went out to see the Underwater Lake but hasn’t come back... You’ll find Maro if you follow the <color=#4AFFDB>signs</color> in the deep waters!
Array.indonesia: Maro went out to see the Underwater Lake but hasn’t come back... You’ll find Maro if you follow the <color=#4AFFDB>signs</color> in the deep waters!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059186
Array.english: I can’t get in because the rocks collapsed... I think a <color=#4AFFDB>pickaxe</color> might get me through.
Array.indonesia: I can’t get in because the rocks collapsed... I think a <color=#4AFFDB>pickaxe</color> might get me through.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050187
Array.english: The sea child should be inside. Look around carefully!
Array.indonesia: The sea child should be inside. Look around carefully!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059187
Array.english: Underwater Lake... Fascinating. Maybe I should take a <color=#4AFFDB>picture</color> of it.
Array.indonesia: Underwater Lake... Fascinating. Maybe I should take a <color=#4AFFDB>picture</color> of it.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059188
Array.english: I think I heard some screams from inside. That's kinda scary...but I guess I should go in.
Array.indonesia: I think I heard some screams from inside. That's kinda scary...but I guess I should go in.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050188
Array.english: Argh...! I’ll have to defeat the <color=#4AFFDB>Goblin Shark</color> to save the child!
Array.indonesia: Argh...! I’ll have to defeat the <color=#4AFFDB>Goblin Shark</color> to save the child!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059190
Array.english: Is there anything worth salvaging from the <color=#4AFFDB>Goblin Shark</color>? Let's investigate.
Array.indonesia: Is there anything worth salvaging from the <color=#4AFFDB>Goblin Shark</color>? Let's investigate.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050189
Array.english: Borrow me a book from the <color=#4AFFDB>temple</color>!\nAsk Niamo about the details.
Array.indonesia: Borrow me a book from the <color=#4AFFDB>temple</color>!\nAsk Niamo about the details.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050190
Array.english: I hope this is the right book. I’ll go back to the Seed Shop.
Array.indonesia: I hope this is the right book. I’ll go back to the Seed Shop.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050191
Array.english: I won’t farm seaweed for humans. Unless there’s a <color=#4AFFDB>cook</color> who makes a decent seaweed dish.
Array.indonesia: I won’t farm seaweed for humans. Unless there’s a <color=#4AFFDB>cook</color> who makes a decent seaweed dish.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050192
Array.english: A seaweed dish... I can do that. Bring me <color=#4AFFDB>seaweed</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>white rice</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>sea urchin</color>.
Array.indonesia: A seaweed dish... I can do that. Bring me <color=#4AFFDB>seaweed</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>white rice</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>sea urchin</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050193
Array.english: All right! I’ll deliver this sea urchin and seaweed bibimbap to <color=#4AFFDB>Gumo</color>.
Array.indonesia: All right! I’ll deliver this sea urchin and seaweed bibimbap to <color=#4AFFDB>Gumo</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050194
Array.english: You need <color=#4AFFDB>feather coral</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>lily coral</color> to make Coral Porridge... But can a human make it? *Coughs*
Array.indonesia: You need <color=#4AFFDB>feather coral</color> and <color=#4AFFDB>lily coral</color> to make Coral Porridge... But can a human make it? *Coughs*

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050195
Array.english: Ask Bancho to cook <color=#4AFFDB>Coral Porridge</color>.
Array.indonesia: Ask Bancho to cook <color=#4AFFDB>Coral Porridge</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050196
Array.english: All right! I’ll deliver <color=#4AFFDB>Coral Porridge</color> to the sick sea person at the Workshop.
Array.indonesia: All right! I’ll deliver <color=#4AFFDB>Coral Porridge</color> to the sick sea person at the Workshop.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050197
Array.english: I need 5 <color=#4AFFDB>opals</color> to reopen the workshop... Will you bring them to me, human?
Array.indonesia: I need 5 <color=#4AFFDB>opals</color> to reopen the workshop... Will you bring them to me, human?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050198
Array.english: I need <color=#4AFFDB>Divine Tree fruit</color> for smelting... Will you come with me? *Coughs*
Array.indonesia: I need <color=#4AFFDB>Divine Tree fruit</color> for smelting... Will you come with me? *Coughs*

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050199
Array.english: Pick Divine Tree fruit and drop it in Duwa’s basket. I need 5 of them!
Array.indonesia: Pick Divine Tree fruit and drop it in Duwa’s basket. I need 5 of them!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050200
Array.english: Junak took my Beluga Whistle! Retrieve it for me, human!
Array.indonesia: Junak took my Beluga Whistle! Retrieve it for me, human!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050201
Array.english: Hm, win a game of cards and I can have the whistle back? All right, nothing to lose here.
Array.indonesia: Hm, win a game of cards and I can have the whistle back? All right, nothing to lose here.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050202
Array.english: I am unbeatable when it comes to fried food. Bring me <color=#4AFFDB>Cookiecutter Shark</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Vampire Squid</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Barreleye</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>kelps</color>.
Array.indonesia: I am unbeatable when it comes to fried food. Bring me <color=#4AFFDB>Cookiecutter Shark</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Vampire Squid</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Barreleye</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>kelps</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050203
Array.english: It’s time to decide who’s the real maestro of fried food, <color=#4AFFDB>Alex</color>.
Array.indonesia: It’s time to decide who’s the real maestro of fried food, <color=#4AFFDB>Alex</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050204
Array.english: Pasta... It’s not something I am familiar with. Bring me <color=#4AFFDB>Humboldt Squid</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>White Shrimp</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Wheat</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Garlic</color>.
Array.indonesia: Pasta... It’s not something I am familiar with. Bring me <color=#4AFFDB>Humboldt Squid</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>White Shrimp</color>, <color=#4AFFDB>Wheat</color>, and <color=#4AFFDB>Garlic</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050205
Array.english: It’s time to decide the winner, <color=#4AFFDB>Pastro</color>!
Array.indonesia: It’s time to decide the winner, <color=#4AFFDB>Pastro</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050206
Array.english: Whew, it was a close call. I should deliver this <color=#4AFFDB>mechanical part</color> to Dr. Bacon.
Array.indonesia: Whew, it was a close call. I should deliver this <color=#4AFFDB>mechanical part</color> to Dr. Bacon.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050207
Array.english: Good. Now, to put on the suit Dr. Bacon made and visit the <color=#4AFFDB>Glacial Area</color> again.
Array.indonesia: Good. Now, to put on the suit Dr. Bacon made and visit the <color=#4AFFDB>Glacial Area</color> again.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050208
Array.english: Wow, I never imagined that there could be such a large frozen area in the deep sea. I should explore the area.
Array.indonesia: Wow, I never imagined that there could be such a large frozen area in the deep sea. I should explore the area.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050209
Array.english: The content of this <color=#4AFFDB>Stone Slab</color> needs to be deciphered. I must take a picture of it.
Array.indonesia: The content of this <color=#4AFFDB>Stone Slab</color> needs to be deciphered. I must take a picture of it.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050210
Array.english: An ancient stone slab found in the Glacial Area. I wonder if Dr. Bacon can decipher the texts?
Array.indonesia: An ancient stone slab found in the Glacial Area. I wonder if Dr. Bacon can decipher the texts?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050211
Array.english: I should ask Niamo about the text on the stone slab.
Array.indonesia: I should ask Niamo about the text on the stone slab.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050212
Array.english: This door opens only by casting an ancient spell. Suwam will help you.
Array.indonesia: This door opens only by casting an ancient spell. Suwam will help you.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050213
Array.english: I am exhausted from casting the spell. You go alone, human.
Array.indonesia: I am exhausted from casting the spell. You go alone, human.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050214
Array.english: Hm. I heard that I must activate the contraption inside to cool down the water temperature.
Array.indonesia: Hm. I heard that I must activate the contraption inside to cool down the water temperature.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050215
Array.english: I must report back to Tenzhin.
Array.indonesia: I must report back to Tenzhin.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050216
Array.english: The Beluga went missing. I hope it didn’t wander all the way to the <color=#4AFFDB>Glacial Area</color>.
Array.indonesia: The Beluga went missing. I hope it didn’t wander all the way to the <color=#4AFFDB>Glacial Area</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050217
Array.english: That <color=#4AFFDB>Antarctic Octopus</color>’s venom immobilized the Beluga. Let’s punish that octopus.
Array.indonesia: That <color=#4AFFDB>Antarctic Octopus</color>’s venom immobilized the Beluga. Let’s punish that octopus.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050218
Array.english: This looks like an antidote. I should give it to the Beluga.
Array.indonesia: This looks like an antidote. I should give it to the Beluga.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050219
Array.english: The second cave looks inaccessible because of the strong current. Should I check the place again?
Array.indonesia: The second cave looks inaccessible because of the strong current. Should I check the place again?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050220
Array.english: Wow, the Beluga can swim against the current! Let me activate the contraption.
Array.indonesia: Wow, the Beluga can swim against the current! Let me activate the contraption.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050221
Array.english: Yikes! A giant jellyfish! That squishy part is impervious to attack.
Array.indonesia: Yikes! A giant jellyfish! That squishy part is impervious to attack.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050222
Array.english: Good. Let’s activate the second contraption.
Array.indonesia: Good. Let’s activate the second contraption.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050223
Array.english: The water temperature has stabilized a lot. I can go down further now.
Array.indonesia: The water temperature has stabilized a lot. I can go down further now.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050224
Array.english: The cave is a mess. You should come with me, human.
Array.indonesia: The cave is a mess. You should come with me, human.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050225
Array.english: Something is wrong with the Divine Tree. It absorbed all the water around it. We must reopen the waterway.
Array.indonesia: Something is wrong with the Divine Tree. It absorbed all the water around it. We must reopen the waterway.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050226
Array.english: Wow, that shark has a sawblade in its mouth. You go fight it. I will support you with the <color=#4AFFDB>Divine Tree Fruit</color> from behind you!
Array.indonesia: Wow, that shark has a sawblade in its mouth. You go fight it. I will support you with the <color=#4AFFDB>Divine Tree Fruit</color> from behind you!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059224
Array.english: *Sighs* A shark with a saw blade?\nLet's see if there's anything worth keeping.
Array.indonesia: *Sighs* A shark with a saw blade?\nLet's see if there's anything worth keeping.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059225
Array.english: Enter the door that the Helicoprion broke. There should be a third switch there!
Array.indonesia: Enter the door that the Helicoprion broke. There should be a third switch there!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059226
Array.english: Okay. let's activate the third switch.
Array.indonesia: Okay. let's activate the third switch.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050227
Array.english: I am not sure if my weapon will be still effective in the Glacial Area. I should give Duff a call.
Array.indonesia: I am not sure if my weapon will be still effective in the Glacial Area. I should give Duff a call.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050228
Array.english: Oh, I remember seeing a <color=#4AFFDB>Workshop</color> at the Sea People Village. I should drop by the place.
Array.indonesia: Oh, I remember seeing a <color=#4AFFDB>Workshop</color> at the Sea People Village. I should drop by the place.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050229
Array.english: A way to lure a Manta Ray... Hm, I think <color=#4AFFDB>Ellie</color> should have a better idea.
Array.indonesia: A way to lure a Manta Ray... Hm, I think <color=#4AFFDB>Ellie</color> should have a better idea.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050230
Array.english: I need to collect 5 kelp. But what does that have to do with Manta Rays?
Array.indonesia: I need to collect 5 kelp. But what does that have to do with Manta Rays?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050231
Array.english: Good. I got a <color=#4AFFDB>Lure Capsule</color> now. I should give Woodo a call.
Array.indonesia: Good. I got a <color=#4AFFDB>Lure Capsule</color> now. I should give Woodo a call.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050232
Array.english: I installed lighting fixtures to help you take better pictures. At a depth of about <color=#4AFFDB>20 meters</color>.
Array.indonesia: I installed lighting fixtures to help you take better pictures. At a depth of about <color=#4AFFDB>20 meters</color>.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050233
Array.english: The lighting fixtures are scattered all over the ground. I can’t take pictures as they are. I need to stand them up.
Array.indonesia: The lighting fixtures are scattered all over the ground. I can’t take pictures as they are. I need to stand them up.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050234
Array.english: So, I am supposed to use the <color=#4AFFDB>Lure Capsule</color> here?
Array.indonesia: So, I am supposed to use the <color=#4AFFDB>Lure Capsule</color> here?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050235
Array.english: As long as I am exposed like this, <color=#4AFFDB>Manta Rays</color> won’t come. I need to find a place to hide.
Array.indonesia: As long as I am exposed like this, <color=#4AFFDB>Manta Rays</color> won’t come. I need to find a place to hide.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050236
Array.english: Wow, it’s so big! It’s my chance to take pictures of the <color=#4AFFDB>Manta Ray</color>!
Array.indonesia: Wow, it’s so big! It’s my chance to take pictures of the <color=#4AFFDB>Manta Ray</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059237
Array.english: I activated all three switches, so the door must have opened. Should I head to the control room entrance?
Array.indonesia: I activated all three switches, so the door must have opened. Should I head to the control room entrance?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050237
Array.english: <color=#4AFFDB>John Watson</color>... You brought a submarine? You will pay for your foolishness now!
Array.indonesia: <color=#4AFFDB>John Watson</color>... You brought a submarine? You will pay for your foolishness now!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050238
Array.english: A dinosaur? It can't be easily defeated. I should use John Watson’s <color=#4AFFDB>Missile Launcher</color> against it.
Array.indonesia: A dinosaur? It can't be easily defeated. I should use John Watson’s <color=#4AFFDB>Missile Launcher</color> against it.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059238
Array.english: *Sighs* I almost got burned. I should check if there's anything useful on the body.
Array.indonesia: *Sighs* I almost got burned. I should check if there's anything useful on the body.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050239
Array.english: This branch was so thick that I barely managed to cut it. Come back to the <color=#4AFFDB>Entrance to the Control Room</color>!
Array.indonesia: This branch was so thick that I barely managed to cut it. Come back to the <color=#4AFFDB>Entrance to the Control Room</color>!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050240
Array.english: The door to the <color=#4AFFDB>Control Room</color> is now open. I should explore inside.
Array.indonesia: The door to the <color=#4AFFDB>Control Room</color> is now open. I should explore inside.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050241
Array.english: The Divine Tree turned into something totally new! I should find another way to go through the door.
Array.indonesia: The Divine Tree turned into something totally new! I should find another way to go through the door.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050242
Array.english: Good! The door is now open. It’s creepy, but I should explore the area.
Array.indonesia: Good! The door is now open. It’s creepy, but I should explore the area.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050243
Array.english: OMG...Weird eggs are hatching!! I'll have to figure out how to clear the way!
Array.indonesia: OMG...Weird eggs are hatching!! I'll have to figure out how to clear the way!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050244
Array.english: Whew, they’re gone now. Let me go inside!
Array.indonesia: Whew, they’re gone now. Let me go inside!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10059244
Array.english: There's a bunch of ancient creature offspring attached to the core of the Divine Tree. Better get rid of them first...!
Array.indonesia: There's a bunch of ancient creature offspring attached to the core of the Divine Tree. Better get rid of them first...!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050245
Array.english: The creature modified by the ancient Sea People grew so huge! The creature was the reason for the earthquakes! Please, take care of that thing, Dave.
Array.indonesia: The creature modified by the ancient Sea People grew so huge! The creature was the reason for the earthquakes! Please, take care of that thing, Dave.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050246
Array.english: Yawie... That creature is the cause of the earthquake...! This is our only chance! Let's chase it!
Array.indonesia: Yawie... That creature is the cause of the earthquake...! This is our only chance! Let's chase it!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050247
Array.english: It's amazing to see the Sea People come to our aid... Let's utilize the <color=#4AFFDB>firing device</color> to finally take down Yawie.
Array.indonesia: It's amazing to see the Sea People come to our aid... Let's utilize the <color=#4AFFDB>firing device</color> to finally take down Yawie.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050248
Array.english: Go to Bancho’s Sushi Bar.
Array.indonesia: Go to Bancho’s Sushi Bar.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050249
Array.english: Phew. What a hectic few days. I haven’t had this much free time in a while.\nI should talk with some people.
Array.indonesia: Phew. What a hectic few days. I haven’t had this much free time in a while.\nI should talk with some people.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050250
Array.english: There’s my Beer mug.\nI should pick it up for a toast!
Array.indonesia: There’s my Beer mug.\nI should pick it up for a toast!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050251
Array.english: Gumo said the baby manatee was gone, right? \nMaybe it's at the <color=#4AFFDB> Glacial Area</color>...?
Array.indonesia: Gumo said the baby manatee was gone, right? \nMaybe it's at the <color=#4AFFDB> Glacial Area</color>...?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050264
Array.english: Duwa's coughing won't stop… Maybe Mima has some advice?
Array.indonesia: Duwa's coughing won't stop… Maybe Mima has some advice?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050265
Array.english: Otto used to be a diver. He should know how to catch Horsehair Crabs.
Array.indonesia: Otto used to be a diver. He should know how to catch Horsehair Crabs.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050266
Array.english: Haha. Crafting a <color=#4AFFDB>Crab Trap</color> isn't hard at all. Just get me the materials!
Array.indonesia: Haha. Crafting a <color=#4AFFDB>Crab Trap</color> isn't hard at all. Just get me the materials!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050267
Array.english: Alright! I gathered all the materials for the <color=#4AFFDB>Crab Trap</color>. I should go back to Otto.
Array.indonesia: Alright! I gathered all the materials for the <color=#4AFFDB>Crab Trap</color>. I should go back to Otto.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050268
Array.english: Let's catch a <color=#4AFFDB>Horsehair Crab</color> at the Glacial Area with the Crab Trap made by Otto.
Array.indonesia: Let's catch a <color=#4AFFDB>Horsehair Crab</color> at the Glacial Area with the Crab Trap made by Otto.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050269
Array.english: Alright! I caught a <color=#4AFFDB>Horsehair Crab</color>! I should give this to Mima.
Array.indonesia: Alright! I caught a <color=#4AFFDB>Horsehair Crab</color>! I should give this to Mima.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050270
Array.english: So, <color=#4AFFDB>Steamed Horsehair Crab</color> is good for coughs. I should give this to Duwa.
Array.indonesia: So, <color=#4AFFDB>Steamed Horsehair Crab</color> is good for coughs. I should give this to Duwa.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050271
Array.english: Someone seems to be trapped inside the Ice Cave. I should lure the <color=#4AFFDB>narwhal</color> to break the ice wall.
Array.indonesia: Someone seems to be trapped inside the Ice Cave. I should lure the <color=#4AFFDB>narwhal</color> to break the ice wall.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050272
Array.english: Alright! I broke the ice wall. I should go inside.
Array.indonesia: Alright! I broke the ice wall. I should go inside.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050273
Array.english: The current is stronger than I thought. I should avoid any sharp icicles.
Array.indonesia: The current is stronger than I thought. I should avoid any sharp icicles.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050274
Array.english: Another ice wall. I'm sure Dona can break through it.
Array.indonesia: Another ice wall. I'm sure Dona can break through it.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050275
Array.english: The ice wall is down! I should exit through the open passage.
Array.indonesia: The ice wall is down! I should exit through the open passage.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050276
Array.english: I'm sorry to ask again, but...could you please find Selgio for me? I saw a shining jellyfish near the\n<color=#4AFFDB>glacial passage</color> and I wonder if he may have followed it…
Array.indonesia: I'm sorry to ask again, but...could you please find Selgio for me? I saw a shining jellyfish near the\n<color=#4AFFDB>glacial passage</color> and I wonder if he may have followed it…

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050277
Array.english: Alright! This must be the jellyfish. I should follow it!
Array.indonesia: Alright! This must be the jellyfish. I should follow it!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050278
Array.english: Oh… This looks pretty complicated. Still, I have to follow it!
Array.indonesia: Oh… This looks pretty complicated. Still, I have to follow it!

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050279
Array.english: Selgio must be nearby. I should search every nook and cranny.
Array.indonesia: Selgio must be nearby. I should search every nook and cranny.

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050280
Array.english: Selgio is hiding behind the ice. How do I get him out?
Array.indonesia: Selgio is hiding behind the ice. How do I get him out?

Array.name: Mission_Group_Desc_10050281
Array.english: Alright! I got Selgio. I should take him to Linchen.
Array.indonesia: Alright! I got Selgio. I should take him to Linchen.

Array.name: NPC_Name_Mxmtoon
Array.english: mxmtoon
Array.indonesia: mxmtoon

Array.name: Sushi_ZoneE_Stage_mxmtoon_Name
Array.english: Small stage
Array.indonesia: Small stage

Array.name: Sushi_ZoneE_Stage_mxmtoon_Desc
Array.english: This is a stage for mxmtoon. On days she is not around, it will play the instrumental version of her songs.
Array.indonesia: This is a stage for mxmtoon. On days she is not around, it will play the instrumental version of her songs.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_001
Array.english: Hello. Is this a sushi restaurant?
Array.indonesia: Hello. Is this a sushi restaurant?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_002
Array.english: Yes, it is. Sorry, but I have to mention…
Array.indonesia: Yes, it is. Sorry, but I have to mention…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_003
Array.english: I feel like I have seen you before.
Array.indonesia: I feel like I have seen you before.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_004
Array.english: That's good to hear! My name is mxmtoon. \nI am a singer-songwriter.
Array.indonesia: That's good to hear! My name is mxmtoon. \nI am a singer-songwriter.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_005
Array.english: Oh, so that's how I know you! \nIsn't one of your songs?
Array.indonesia: Oh, so that's how I know you! \nIsn't one of your songs?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_006
Array.english: <size=33>Aww! I am so happy you know my song!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Aww! I am so happy you know my song!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_007
Array.english: Actually... my album is coming out soon and I am so nervous...
Array.indonesia: Actually... my album is coming out soon and I am so nervous...

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_008
Array.english: I think eating my favorite food would help to ease my heart a bit.
Array.indonesia: I think eating my favorite food would help to ease my heart a bit.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_009
Array.english: What kind of food is it...?
Array.indonesia: What kind of food is it...?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_010
Array.english: It's a dish called <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>…\nCould you make some for me?
Array.indonesia: It's a dish called <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>…\nCould you make some for me?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_011
Array.english: <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color> is not a difficult dish at all.
Array.indonesia: <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color> is not a difficult dish at all.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_012
Array.english: But... this isn't just any Chirashi Sushi, I am looking for one made with a special ingredient.
Array.indonesia: But... this isn't just any Chirashi Sushi, I am looking for one made with a special ingredient.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_013
Array.english: <size=33>Do you know what a <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchin</color> is?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Do you know what a <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchin</color> is?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_014
Array.english: Yes, of course. The finest of all sea urchins.
Array.indonesia: Yes, of course. The finest of all sea urchins.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_015
Array.english: But...
Array.indonesia: But...

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_016
Array.english: This sea urchin is very hard to find, as it hides in the crevices of rocks. That makes it even more valuable.
Array.indonesia: This sea urchin is very hard to find, as it hides in the crevices of rocks. That makes it even more valuable.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_017
Array.english: Between rocks…\nI'd just have to dig around a bit.
Array.indonesia: Between rocks…\nI'd just have to dig around a bit.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_018
Array.english: Ah...! What if...</size>
Array.indonesia: Ah...! What if...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_019
Array.english: Yes? What is it?
Array.indonesia: Yes? What is it?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_020
Array.english: <size=33>Can I go into the sea and look for them myself?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Can I go into the sea and look for them myself?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_021
Array.english: <size=35>What…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>What…?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_022
Array.english: You see... I've learned a bit of diving too, hehe.
Array.indonesia: You see... I've learned a bit of diving too, hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_023
Array.english: If you could help me a little, I think I might be able to catch them myself...\nIs there any way you could?
Array.indonesia: If you could help me a little, I think I might be able to catch them myself...\nIs there any way you could?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_024
Array.english: But... the Blue Hole is a dangerous place.
Array.indonesia: But... the Blue Hole is a dangerous place.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_025
Array.english: If you do me this favor, I will come and perform here! For free!
Array.indonesia: If you do me this favor, I will come and perform here! For free!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_026
Array.english: Dave, perhaps you should agree.
Array.indonesia: Dave, perhaps you should agree.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_027
Array.english: There's something special about eating a dish made with ingredients you caught yourself.
Array.indonesia: There's something special about eating a dish made with ingredients you caught yourself.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_028
Array.english: And I am sure that eating a dish made from <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchin</color> she caught herself will boost her confidence.
Array.indonesia: And I am sure that eating a dish made from <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchin</color> she caught herself will boost her confidence.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_029
Array.english: Well, if even Bancho agrees, I guess I can't refuse.
Array.indonesia: Well, if even Bancho agrees, I guess I can't refuse.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_030
Array.english: Woah! So that means you will go into the sea with me?\nThank you!!
Array.indonesia: Woah! So that means you will go into the sea with me?\nThank you!!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionStart01_031
Array.english: I'll have the diving gear ready, so please give me a <color=#F1DC2B>call</color>!
Array.indonesia: I'll have the diving gear ready, so please give me a <color=#F1DC2B>call</color>!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall01_001
Array.english: Mr. Dave! Can we go catch <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color> now?
Array.indonesia: Mr. Dave! Can we go catch <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color> now?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall01_002
Array.english: Yes, I am still anxious, but a promise is a promise.
Array.indonesia: Yes, I am still anxious, but a promise is a promise.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Haha! Thank you! I will be right there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Haha! Thank you! I will be right there!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall02_001
Array.english: Hehe, don't worry. I recently went on a diving trip with my friends.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, don't worry. I recently went on a diving trip with my friends.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall02_002
Array.english: This is not a tourist attraction. There are aggressive fish, so you must be very careful.
Array.indonesia: This is not a tourist attraction. There are aggressive fish, so you must be very careful.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionCall02_003
Array.english: Well, if they show up, I am sure you'll protect me! Hehe.
Array.indonesia: Well, if they show up, I am sure you'll protect me! Hehe.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_NotReady_001
Array.english: Hm? Are you really going to go catch <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color> this late?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Are you really going to go catch <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color> this late?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_NotReady_002
Array.english: Ah... now that you mention it, it is pretty late.\nI will call you again soon!
Array.indonesia: Ah... now that you mention it, it is pretty late.\nI will call you again soon!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WrongPlace_001
Array.english: Are you ready to go catch some <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color>?
Array.indonesia: Are you ready to go catch some <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WrongPlace_002
Array.english: I should probably get ready, too.
Array.indonesia: I should probably get ready, too.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WrongPlace_003
Array.english: I will give you a call later from the boat!
Array.indonesia: I will give you a call later from the boat!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WatingFood_001
Array.english: Oh! Is <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color> ready?!
Array.indonesia: Oh! Is <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color> ready?!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WatingFood_002
Array.english: Not yet. I also need ingredients other than green sea urchins, so...
Array.indonesia: Not yet. I also need ingredients other than green sea urchins, so...

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WatingFood_003
Array.english: It should be ready soon! I just need a little more time...
Array.indonesia: It should be ready soon! I just need a little more time...

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_WatingFood_004
Array.english: Haha, I don't want to rush you.\nI will see you at the sushi restaurant!
Array.indonesia: Haha, I don't want to rush you.\nI will see you at the sushi restaurant!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_AfterMission_001
Array.english: Mr. Dave. You can play the instrumental version of my songs if you install the <color=#1DFEAF>Mini Stage</color> I gave you in the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Mr. Dave. You can play the instrumental version of my songs if you install the <color=#1DFEAF>Mini Stage</color> I gave you in the restaurant.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Call_AfterMission_002
Array.english: I have some free time on the weekends, so... I'll come sing for you in person!
Array.indonesia: I have some free time on the weekends, so... I'll come sing for you in person!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_BoatTalk_001
Array.english: I have to admit, it's a bit nerve-wracking now that I'm about to go in.
Array.indonesia: I have to admit, it's a bit nerve-wracking now that I'm about to go in.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Diving01_001
Array.english: <size=33>Wow! So this is the Blue Hole! It's beautiful!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Wow! So this is the Blue Hole! It's beautiful!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Diving01_002
Array.english: Don't get too distracted by the scenery. Always be on the lookout for…
Array.indonesia: Don't get too distracted by the scenery. Always be on the lookout for…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Diving01_003
Array.english: <size=34>I have a feeling we might find them over there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I have a feeling we might find them over there!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_Diving02_001
Array.english: <size=34>You can't just go off like that...!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>You can't just go off like that...!!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_001
Array.english: <size=33>I think we'll find <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color> under that pile of rocks.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>I think we'll find <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color> under that pile of rocks.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_002
Array.english: <size=32>How do you know?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>How do you know?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_003
Array.english: <size=33>It's just…a hunch!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>It's just…a hunch!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_004
Array.english: <size=34>I will go search, hehe!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I will go search, hehe!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone01_005
Array.english: Um... I don't think it's safe…
Array.indonesia: Um... I don't think it's safe…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone02_001
Array.english: Oh no, dangerous fish are heading that way!
Array.indonesia: Oh no, dangerous fish are heading that way!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindStone02_002
Array.english: I knew it...\nI must go help her.
Array.indonesia: I knew it...\nI must go help her.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindUni01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Yeah! I found them, <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Yeah! I found them, <color=#1DFEAF>Green Sea Urchins</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindUni01_002
Array.english: <size=35>Woah, they're actually there?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Woah, they're actually there?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindUni01_003
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>(Maybe she has a hidden talent for diving?)</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(Maybe she has a hidden talent for diving?)</color>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindUni01_004
Array.english: <size=34>Ah, don't use your bare hands!\nLet me help you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Ah, don't use your bare hands!\nLet me help you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoSecondPoint_001
Array.english: Hm? Why do you look so tired?
Array.indonesia: Hm? Why do you look so tired?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoSecondPoint_002
Array.english: …Because I was protecting you from dangerous fish…
Array.indonesia: …Because I was protecting you from dangerous fish…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoSecondPoint_003
Array.english: Oh, did you? Hehe. I didn't know because I was so focused on finding sea urchins!
Array.indonesia: Oh, did you? Hehe. I didn't know because I was so focused on finding sea urchins!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoSecondPoint_004
Array.english: <size=34>Shall we go that way this time?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Shall we go that way this time?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondStone01_001
Array.english: <size=34>How about that pile of rocks?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>How about that pile of rocks?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondStone01_002
Array.english: She knows the fish will attack her again...\nThere's no stopping her, is there?
Array.indonesia: She knows the fish will attack her again...\nThere's no stopping her, is there?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondUni01_001
Array.english: <size=34>See? Found more here.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>See? Found more here.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondUni01_002
Array.english: Huh, she really has a talent for finding things…
Array.indonesia: Huh, she really has a talent for finding things…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindSecondUni01_003
Array.english: <size=34>Alright. Let me pick them up!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Alright. Let me pick them up!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoLastPoint_001
Array.english: One more and we'll have enough.
Array.indonesia: One more and we'll have enough.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoLastPoint_002
Array.english: Already? I was having so much fun...\nbut alright.
Array.indonesia: Already? I was having so much fun...\nbut alright.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindLastStone01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Look, there's another pile of rocks!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Look, there's another pile of rocks!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindLastStone01_002
Array.english: <size=33>My intuition tells me that's the place. I will search there!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>My intuition tells me that's the place. I will search there!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FindLastUni01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Woohoo! I found another one!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Woohoo! I found another one!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_001
Array.english: Whew, I think this will be enough.
Array.indonesia: Whew, I think this will be enough.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_002
Array.english: Hehe, thank you, mister.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, thank you, mister.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_003
Array.english: <size=34>I can finally have my <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I can finally have my <color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_004
Array.english: I need to get some additional ingredients besides sea urchins.
Array.indonesia: I need to get some additional ingredients besides sea urchins.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_005
Array.english: <size=33>You return to the boat first.\nI will give you a call later!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>You return to the boat first.\nI will give you a call later!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_After_001
Array.english: Well, it's a relief we found the Green Sea Urchins without too much trouble.
Array.indonesia: Well, it's a relief we found the Green Sea Urchins without too much trouble.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_After_002
Array.english: Let's see... I need some <color=#1DFEAF>Bluefin Tuna Ootoro</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Cuttlefish</color> as well to make Chirashi Sushi.
Array.indonesia: Let's see... I need some <color=#1DFEAF>Bluefin Tuna Ootoro</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>Cuttlefish</color> as well to make Chirashi Sushi.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_GoToBoat_After_003
Array.english: Do I have them in the inventory? \nIf not, I should get some more.
Array.indonesia: Do I have them in the inventory? \nIf not, I should get some more.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>! You really prepared it for me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow...<color=#F1DC2B>Chirashi Sushi</color>! You really prepared it for me!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete01_002
Array.english: <size=34>Let me give it a try…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Let me give it a try…</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_001
Array.english: <size=35>Wow! It's super delicious!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Wow! It's super delicious!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_002
Array.english: <size=34>This has the flavor I was searching for—the best taste in the world!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>This has the flavor I was searching for—the best taste in the world!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_003
Array.english: I feel energized! I even feel like I can perform right now!
Array.indonesia: I feel energized! I even feel like I can perform right now!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_004
Array.english: Oh, is there any open space around here?
Array.indonesia: Oh, is there any open space around here?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_005
Array.english: I would like to have a small performance, if you don't mind. To relax a bit.
Array.indonesia: I would like to have a small performance, if you don't mind. To relax a bit.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_006
Array.english: Oh, can we go watch?
Array.indonesia: Oh, can we go watch?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_007
Array.english: Of course! I would more than love to invite you all.
Array.indonesia: Of course! I would more than love to invite you all.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_008
Array.english: Awesome. I think the farm behind this building would be nice for that.
Array.indonesia: Awesome. I think the farm behind this building would be nice for that.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_MissionComplete02_009
Array.english: Hehe. Alright, I’ll get ready for the performance! See you at the farm after the restaurant closes for the day!
Array.indonesia: Hehe. Alright, I’ll get ready for the performance! See you at the farm after the restaurant closes for the day!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_001
Array.english: <size=34>Wow! You really came! Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Wow! You really came! Thank you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_002
Array.english: Though I seldom listen to this style of music, I find the songs to my liking. I would like to hear them in person.
Array.indonesia: Though I seldom listen to this style of music, I find the songs to my liking. I would like to hear them in person.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_003
Array.english: A ukulele song? It's perfect for the farm here!
Array.indonesia: A ukulele song? It's perfect for the farm here!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_004
Array.english: Hehe, thank you! Well then…
Array.indonesia: Hehe, thank you! Well then…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_005
Array.english: This one is called , one of my songs.
Array.indonesia: This one is called , one of my songs.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert01_006
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! I am excited!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! I am excited!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_001
Array.english: Wow! So touching...!\nI feel part of my heart warming.
Array.indonesia: Wow! So touching...!\nI feel part of my heart warming.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_002
Array.english: Hehe, thank you.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, thank you.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_003
Array.english: <size=34>I can sing one more if you want.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>I can sing one more if you want.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_Select1
Array.english: Ask for encore
Array.indonesia: Ask for encore

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Encore_Select2
Array.english: Call it a day
Array.indonesia: Call it a day

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Sing02_001
Array.english: Of course! We'd love to hear more.
Array.indonesia: Of course! We'd love to hear more.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Sing02_002
Array.english: My pleasure.
Array.indonesia: My pleasure.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Sing02_003
Array.english: Now, this is my most recent song.
Array.indonesia: Now, this is my most recent song.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_Sing02_004
Array.english: It's called . This is a lighthearted one, so enjoy!
Array.indonesia: It's called . This is a lighthearted one, so enjoy!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_001
Array.english: So that's it for today's performance!
Array.indonesia: So that's it for today's performance!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_002
Array.english: It was excellent. Easy to listen to, yet full of rich emotion... It would be great to put on in the restaurant.
Array.indonesia: It was excellent. Easy to listen to, yet full of rich emotion... It would be great to put on in the restaurant.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_003
Array.english: Hooray! It would make me so happy to hear my music being played at BANCHO SUSHI!
Array.indonesia: Hooray! It would make me so happy to hear my music being played at BANCHO SUSHI!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_004
Array.english: This <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Stage</color> is my gift for you.
Array.indonesia: This <color=#F1DC2B>Mini Stage</color> is my gift for you.

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_005
Array.english: If you install this at BANCHO SUSHI, you'll be able to play the instrumental accompaniment of my songs anytime…
Array.indonesia: If you install this at BANCHO SUSHI, you'll be able to play the instrumental accompaniment of my songs anytime…

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_006
Array.english: ...and I can even perform at your place on the weekends!
Array.indonesia: ...and I can even perform at your place on the weekends!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_007
Array.english: <size=35>Whoa! Live performance?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Whoa! Live performance?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_008
Array.english: <size=35>Hahaha! My customers would love it! Thank you!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Hahaha! My customers would love it! Thank you!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_FarmConcert_End_009
Array.english: I got my confidence back thanks to you. I really appreciate it!
Array.indonesia: I got my confidence back thanks to you. I really appreciate it!

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_SelectMusic_001
Array.english: How about a different song?
Array.indonesia: How about a different song?

Array.name: dialogue_Mxmtoon_SelectMusic_End_001
Array.english: Good! I will sing you this one!
Array.indonesia: Good! I will sing you this one!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_001
Array.english: Are the ingredient preparations going well?\nGet the menus ready before the <color=#F1DC2B>operating hours</color>.
Array.indonesia: Are the ingredient preparations going well?\nGet the menus ready before the <color=#F1DC2B>operating hours</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_002
Array.english: I know things are busy during the day... But if the ingredients aren’t ready, we’ll only be able to sell Norimaki. \r<size=34>Be sure to get things ready.</size>
Array.indonesia: I know things are busy during the day... But if the ingredients aren’t ready, we’ll only be able to sell Norimaki. \r<size=34>Be sure to get things ready.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_003
Array.english: Food with a high <color=#1DFEAF>Taste Score</color> will increase customer satisfaction. Never stop learning.
Array.indonesia: Food with a high <color=#1DFEAF>Taste Score</color> will increase customer satisfaction. Never stop learning.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_004
Array.english: No matter how busy you are you need to do <color=#F1DC2B>cooking research</color>.\nThere will be customers looking for new menu items.
Array.indonesia: No matter how busy you are you need to do <color=#F1DC2B>cooking research</color>.\nThere will be customers looking for new menu items.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_005
Array.english: Operation costs increase the more employees there are.\nYou may end up running at a loss if you only sell cheap dishes.
Array.indonesia: Operation costs increase the more employees there are.\nYou may end up running at a loss if you only sell cheap dishes.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_006
Array.english: If you are low on seasoning, you can send staff to get it.\nIt may take a while, so prepare ahead of time.
Array.indonesia: If you are low on seasoning, you can send staff to get it.\nIt may take a while, so prepare ahead of time.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_007_001
Array.english: I don't like farmed fish, but…
Array.indonesia: I don't like farmed fish, but…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_007_002
Array.english: Otto's farmed fish are said to be of high quality.\nWhen it's not convenient to fish, stop by the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Farm</color>.
Array.indonesia: Otto's farmed fish are said to be of high quality.\nWhen it's not convenient to fish, stop by the <color=#F1DC2B>Fish Farm</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_008_001
Array.english: You can manage your restaurant on your phone?\nThat’s neat.
Array.indonesia: You can manage your restaurant on your phone?\nThat’s neat.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_008_002
Array.english: I am not familiar with new technologies. Why don’t you utilize the <color=#F1DC2B>Management</color> app?
Array.indonesia: I am not familiar with new technologies. Why don’t you utilize the <color=#F1DC2B>Management</color> app?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_009_001
Array.english: It was difficult to secure fresh vegetables, so it is nice to have a <color=#F1DC2B>Field</color> to grow them.
Array.indonesia: It was difficult to secure fresh vegetables, so it is nice to have a <color=#F1DC2B>Field</color> to grow them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_009_002
Array.english: <size=34>Don’t forget to visit the farm and sow some seeds.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Don’t forget to visit the farm and sow some seeds.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_010_001
Array.english: Hm... A <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>?\nI have never thought about it.
Array.indonesia: Hm... A <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>?\nI have never thought about it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_010_002
Array.english: You should not be distracted from cooking, so it’s important to assign someone who can be trusted as a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color>.
Array.indonesia: You should not be distracted from cooking, so it’s important to assign someone who can be trusted as a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_010_003
Array.english: Oh, and you should carefully determine your <color=#F1DC2B>Operation Policy</color>.
Array.indonesia: Oh, and you should carefully determine your <color=#F1DC2B>Operation Policy</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_010_004
Array.english: Hm, it doesn’t sound easy at all.\nDave, please take care of the branch for me.
Array.indonesia: Hm, it doesn’t sound easy at all.\nDave, please take care of the branch for me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_011_001
Array.english: Bancho? You know that you need to manage the <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients at the branch</color> as well?
Array.indonesia: Bancho? You know that you need to manage the <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients at the branch</color> as well?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_011_002
Array.english: Yes, that’s what I’ve heard.
Array.indonesia: Yes, that’s what I’ve heard.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_011_003
Array.english: Well, once you get immersed in cooking you don’t care about anything else, so...
Array.indonesia: Well, once you get immersed in cooking you don’t care about anything else, so...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_011_004
Array.english: I will keep monitoring the <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients at the branch</color> for you!
Array.indonesia: I will keep monitoring the <color=#F1DC2B>ingredients at the branch</color> for you!

Array.english: Hm... A <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>?\nI have never thought about it.
Array.indonesia: Hm... A <color=#F1DC2B>branch</color>?\nI have never thought about it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_BranchTutorial_002
Array.english: You should not be distracted from cooking, so it’s important to assign someone who can be trusted as a <color=#F1DC2B>manager</color>.

Array.indonesia: Oh, and you should carefully determine your <color=#F1DC2B>Operation Policy</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Bancho_BranchTutorial_004
Array.english: Hm, it doesn’t sound easy at all.\nDave, please take care of the branch for me.
Array.indonesia: Hm, it doesn’t sound easy at all.\nDave, please take care of the branch for me.
