Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_001
Array.english: Come to think of it, it’s already been...\naround eight years that we’ve known each other!
Array.indonesia: Come to think of it, it’s already been...\naround eight years that we’ve known each other!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_002
Array.english: I was having fun diving back then near Richelieu Rock.
Array.indonesia: I was having fun diving back then near Richelieu Rock.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_003
Array.english: You suddenly wanted to get your suitcase that fell off the boat…
Array.indonesia: You suddenly wanted to get your suitcase that fell off the boat…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha!\nI thought I was in real trouble back then!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha!\nI thought I was in real trouble back then!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_005
Array.english: I was working as a weapon dealer,\nand there were important blueprints in the suitcase...
Array.indonesia: I was working as a weapon dealer,\nand there were important blueprints in the suitcase...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_006
Array.english: Luckily, you saved them before they could be ruined!
Array.indonesia: Luckily, you saved them before they could be ruined!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_007
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>I have no idea how I would have fought Hans Lindemann\nwithout the blueprints...</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>I have no idea how I would have fought Hans Lindemann\nwithout the blueprints...</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_008
Array.english: <size=37>Hans Lindemann?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=37>Hans Lindemann?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_01_009
Array.english: <size=34>Oh, I was talking to myself.\nDon’t mind me!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh, I was talking to myself.\nDon’t mind me!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_001
Array.english: By the way, Dave,\nhave you been making good use of your <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color>?
Array.indonesia: By the way, Dave,\nhave you been making good use of your <color=#F1DC2B>Gun</color>?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_002
Array.english: Yes, but...\nI get less meat if I kill with a gun…
Array.indonesia: Yes, but...\nI get less meat if I kill with a gun…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_003
Array.english: That’s often the case with smaller fish.
Array.indonesia: That’s often the case with smaller fish.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_004
Array.english: But with stronger, bigger fish,\nit’ll be easier to weaken them a bit first.
Array.indonesia: But with stronger, bigger fish,\nit’ll be easier to weaken them a bit first.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_005
Array.english: If they’re weakened, they’ll show changes like bleeding or swaying. Observe them carefully.
Array.indonesia: If they’re weakened, they’ll show changes like bleeding or swaying. Observe them carefully.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_006
Array.english: I see.\nI’ll have to consider the timing carefully.
Array.indonesia: I see.\nI’ll have to consider the timing carefully.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_02_007
Array.english: If you need good guns, you can craft them at \n<color=#F1DC2B>Duff’s Weapon Shop</color> on your phone. Don’t forget it!
Array.indonesia: If you need good guns, you can craft them at \n<color=#F1DC2B>Duff’s Weapon Shop</color> on your phone. Don’t forget it!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_001
Array.english: My package hasn't arrived, and its been a while.
Array.indonesia: My package hasn't arrived, and its been a while.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_002
Array.english: I wonder what's wrong?
Array.indonesia: I wonder what's wrong?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_003
Array.english: Recently picked it up from the floating remnants of \na wrecked boat…
Array.indonesia: Recently picked it up from the floating remnants of \na wrecked boat…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_004
Array.english: There must have been some kind of accident.\nA sudden accident in this isolated blue hole.
Array.indonesia: There must have been some kind of accident.\nA sudden accident in this isolated blue hole.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_005
Array.english: I think I saw a huge squid a while ago.\nIt's not because of that is it?
Array.indonesia: I think I saw a huge squid a while ago.\nIt's not because of that is it?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_006
Array.english: <size=34>A <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color>…</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>A <color=#F1DC2B>Giant Squid</color>…</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_03_007
Array.english: Just about anything can happen here.\nAlways stay on your toes!!
Array.indonesia: Just about anything can happen here.\nAlways stay on your toes!!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_001
Array.english: Dave, \nalways have your gear ready before diving.
Array.indonesia: Dave, \nalways have your gear ready before diving.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_002
Array.english: Can't I just use what's already in the sea?
Array.indonesia: Can't I just use what's already in the sea?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_003
Array.english: Sigh. Do I have to tell you again?
Array.indonesia: Sigh. Do I have to tell you again?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_004
Array.english: Weapons are destroyed as soon as you come out of the sea.
Array.indonesia: Weapons are destroyed as soon as you come out of the sea.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_005
Array.english: You can only keep weapons that have been crafted by Duff.
Array.indonesia: You can only keep weapons that have been crafted by Duff.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_006
Array.english: Yeah.\nIt's tough because you never know what's out there.
Array.indonesia: Yeah.\nIt's tough because you never know what's out there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_007
Array.english: <size=34>Hahaha! So why wouldn't I open the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color>!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Hahaha! So why wouldn't I open the <color=#F1DC2B>Cobra Shop</color>!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_008
Array.english: <size=32>As you know…\nI give you the best prices, so come often!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>As you know…\nI give you the best prices, so come often!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_04_009
Array.english: …Just get some good stuff to sell….
Array.indonesia: …Just get some good stuff to sell….

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_001
Array.english: <size=32>A sudden attack by John Watson!?....</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>A sudden attack by John Watson!?....</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_002
Array.english: Sea Blue is a group that utilizes strange methods to protect the sea.\nBut weapons…?
Array.indonesia: Sea Blue is a group that utilizes strange methods to protect the sea.\nBut weapons…?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_003
Array.english: And particularly powerful weapons at that….
Array.indonesia: And particularly powerful weapons at that….

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_004
Array.english: Hm. They are famous for using particularly aggressive methods.\nBut using weapons in the sea is something I couldn't forsee.
Array.indonesia: Hm. They are famous for using particularly aggressive methods.\nBut using weapons in the sea is something I couldn't forsee.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_005
Array.english: I guess you might be pretty concerned hanging around this place.
Array.indonesia: I guess you might be pretty concerned hanging around this place.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_006
Array.english: <size=35>Something smells fishy….</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Something smells fishy….</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_05_007
Array.english: Anyway, be careful! \nEspecially with that John Watson guy around. That guy is dangerous!
Array.indonesia: Anyway, be careful! \nEspecially with that John Watson guy around. That guy is dangerous!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_001
Array.english: <size=34>Sea People…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Sea People…!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_002
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Dr. Bacon was right!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Dr. Bacon was right!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_003
Array.english: You have to promote this to attract customers.
Array.indonesia: You have to promote this to attract customers.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_004
Array.english: But Dr. Bacon said that poachers would come.
Array.indonesia: But Dr. Bacon said that poachers would come.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_005
Array.english: Well, yeah that's true…
Array.indonesia: Well, yeah that's true…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_06_006
Array.english: <size=33>Well let's keep an eye out!\nAnyway, the number of customers is increasing at Bancho Sushi!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Well let's keep an eye out!\nAnyway, the number of customers is increasing at Bancho Sushi!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_001
Array.english: You went to the Sea People village right?
Array.indonesia: You went to the Sea People village right?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_002
Array.english: Yeah. It's wild that such a place exists in the sea.
Array.indonesia: Yeah. It's wild that such a place exists in the sea.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_003
Array.english: It seems like something dangerous was going on.
Array.indonesia: It seems like something dangerous was going on.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_004
Array.english: Hm. It's probably related to all the recent earthquakes.
Array.indonesia: Hm. It's probably related to all the recent earthquakes.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_005
Array.english: Hm. Yeah. There sure have been a lot of earthquakes \naround here lately.
Array.indonesia: Hm. Yeah. There sure have been a lot of earthquakes \naround here lately.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_006
Array.english: If there is an earthquake as big as the one that happened \nwhen Bancho Sushi opened…business is done for!
Array.indonesia: If there is an earthquake as big as the one that happened \nwhen Bancho Sushi opened…business is done for!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_07_007
Array.english: There are some favors the Sea People asked for…\nSo I'll get some info from them as I help.
Array.indonesia: There are some favors the Sea People asked for…\nSo I'll get some info from them as I help.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_001
Array.english: <size=33>John Watson attacked you again?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>John Watson attacked you again?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_002
Array.english: Yes, he was wearing some thick, improvised suit.
Array.indonesia: Yes, he was wearing some thick, improvised suit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_003
Array.english: I don’t know where Sea Blue earns all their money,\nbut I heard that they got some high-tech stuff.
Array.indonesia: I don’t know where Sea Blue earns all their money,\nbut I heard that they got some high-tech stuff.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_004
Array.english: I also don’t understand why they'd be targeting you.
Array.indonesia: I also don’t understand why they'd be targeting you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_005
Array.english: As if you’re sniffing out some Blue Hole <color=#F1DC2B>secrets</color> they don’t want you to know about.
Array.indonesia: As if you’re sniffing out some Blue Hole <color=#F1DC2B>secrets</color> they don’t want you to know about.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_08_006
Array.english: It’s all good since you’re safe.\nBe careful, though!
Array.indonesia: It’s all good since you’re safe.\nBe careful, though!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_001
Array.english: I always thought there was something fishy about Sea Blue.
Array.indonesia: I always thought there was something fishy about Sea Blue.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_002
Array.english: They claim that they protect nature, \nbut they’re too heavily armed to be environmentalists.
Array.indonesia: They claim that they protect nature, \nbut they’re too heavily armed to be environmentalists.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_003
Array.english: Especially that guy named John Watson...\nHe is probably more of a warmonger than a peacemaker.
Array.indonesia: Especially that guy named John Watson...\nHe is probably more of a warmonger than a peacemaker.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_004
Array.english: I infiltrated and messed up their base. They must be so mad at me right now.
Array.indonesia: I infiltrated and messed up their base. They must be so mad at me right now.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_005
Array.english: Still, they will want to keep a low profile for some time.\nAnd they need time to recuperate.
Array.indonesia: Still, they will want to keep a low profile for some time.\nAnd they need time to recuperate.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_09_006
Array.english: I will keep an eye on them, too!
Array.indonesia: I will keep an eye on them, too!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_001
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! What a suit!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! What a suit!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_002
Array.english: It feels warm to the touch.\nMaybe it’s because the suit is made of the Divine Tree Fruit Cloth?
Array.indonesia: It feels warm to the touch.\nMaybe it’s because the suit is made of the Divine Tree Fruit Cloth?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_003
Array.english: It’s just warm, not hot. I can wear this in a hot place like this.
Array.indonesia: It’s just warm, not hot. I can wear this in a hot place like this.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_004
Array.english: It feels like the suit itself is regulating temperature.
Array.indonesia: It feels like the suit itself is regulating temperature.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_005
Array.english: That’s why the Sea People can withstand the cold.
Array.indonesia: That’s why the Sea People can withstand the cold.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_006
Array.english: The water temperature became unstable these days and many Sea People got sick.
Array.indonesia: The water temperature became unstable these days and many Sea People got sick.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Cobra_10_007

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_dislike_002

Array.indonesia: But this <color=#F1DC2B>passage</color> has been blocked for a while…\nNobody knows what state it's been in during that time.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_like_001
Array.english: Um…Human, you say you are going to go to the Glacial Area down there?
Array.indonesia: Um…Human, you say you are going to go to the Glacial Area down there?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_like_002
Array.english: It's gonna be freezing down there…\nYou can't go in clothes like that.
Array.indonesia: It's gonna be freezing down there…\nYou can't go in clothes like that.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Our village stays pleasantly warm all year round thanks to the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: Our village stays pleasantly warm all year round thanks to the Divine Tree.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: But recently, the temperature has been fluctuating wildly.\nIt's strange.
Array.indonesia: But recently, the temperature has been fluctuating wildly.\nIt's strange.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: These earthquakes keep occurring…\nSomething must have happened to the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: These earthquakes keep occurring…\nSomething must have happened to the Divine Tree.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_Ending_001
Array.english: I thought I was just getting old and achy, but now that the water temperature has stabilized, I feel invigorated!
Array.indonesia: I thought I was just getting old and achy, but now that the water temperature has stabilized, I feel invigorated!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman08_Ending_002
Array.english: Exactly! I feel like I have enough vitality to live another 200 years at least!
Array.indonesia: Exactly! I feel like I have enough vitality to live another 200 years at least!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_dislike_001
Array.english: Even though we pray, earthquakes keep coming…\nIs faith really enough to solve this problem?
Array.indonesia: Even though we pray, earthquakes keep coming…\nIs faith really enough to solve this problem?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_dislike_002
Array.english: <size=32>Don't say such things!\nThe reason we are all still okay is all thanks to King Long!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=32>Don't say such things!\nThe reason we are all still okay is all thanks to King Long!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_like_001
Array.english: If you want to stop the earthquakes, you need human technology!\nI know this.
Array.indonesia: If you want to stop the earthquakes, you need human technology!\nI know this.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_like_002
Array.english: Technology is just an aid. You can't lose faith!
Array.indonesia: Technology is just an aid. You can't lose faith!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: I heard tales that we Sea People used to wander the Glacial Area freely back in the day.
Array.indonesia: I heard tales that we Sea People used to wander the Glacial Area freely back in the day.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Legends tell us our technology was more advanced at that time.
Array.indonesia: Legends tell us our technology was more advanced at that time.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: Personally, I'm content now! Back then, they wouldn’t have had anything like Mima’s Dumplings!
Array.indonesia: Personally, I'm content now! Back then, they wouldn’t have had anything like Mima’s Dumplings!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_Ending_001
Array.english: See? We offered our prayers to King Long and peace has returned.
Array.indonesia: See? We offered our prayers to King Long and peace has returned.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_Ending_002
Array.english: Who would’ve known if the two events were related?\nThis time, humans also stepped in to help.
Array.indonesia: Who would’ve known if the two events were related?\nThis time, humans also stepped in to help.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman09_Ending_003
Array.english: Don't lose faith! King Long wouldn't be pleased!
Array.indonesia: Don't lose faith! King Long wouldn't be pleased!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_dislike_001
Array.english: The ice of the Divine Tree is melting little by little...\nThere are more and more getting sick….
Array.indonesia: The ice of the Divine Tree is melting little by little...\nThere are more and more getting sick….

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_like_001
Array.english: I have a bad feeling.\nHelp us, human!
Array.indonesia: I have a bad feeling.\nHelp us, human!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: It feels like the water temperature has dropped recently... It's a bit chilly.
Array.indonesia: It feels like the water temperature has dropped recently... It's a bit chilly.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Or was it warmer before?\nHmm, something feels off!
Array.indonesia: Or was it warmer before?\nHmm, something feels off!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman10_Ending_001
Array.english: I felt a bit unwell, but I'm feeling better now.
Array.indonesia: I felt a bit unwell, but I'm feeling better now.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_001
Array.english: Yep. The food at Mimame's is so good!
Array.indonesia: Yep. The food at Mimame's is so good!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_002
Array.english: It's really different than the food at home.\nWhere do you get your ingredients?
Array.indonesia: It's really different than the food at home.\nWhere do you get your ingredients?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: How in the world do you make these dumplings so tasty!
Array.indonesia: How in the world do you make these dumplings so tasty!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_Ending_001
Array.english: Now that the water temperature in the Glacial Area has stabilized...\nMaybe I should try making some dumplings myself?
Array.indonesia: Now that the water temperature in the Glacial Area has stabilized...\nMaybe I should try making some dumplings myself?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman11_restaurant_Ending_002
Array.english: No, there's no way I could make them taste this good!
Array.indonesia: No, there's no way I could make them taste this good!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman12_restaurant_001
Array.english: I've been coughing a lot lately.\nHot soup is just right for this.
Array.indonesia: I've been coughing a lot lately.\nHot soup is just right for this.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman12_restaurant_002
Array.english: How do you eat soup in water?\nHumans ask such strange things….cough*
Array.indonesia: How do you eat soup in water?\nHumans ask such strange things….cough*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman12_restaurant_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: <size=35>Ouch! Don't talk to me when I’m eating! I burned my mouth!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Ouch! Don't talk to me when I’m eating! I burned my mouth!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman12_restaurant_Ending_001
Array.english: Even when I get mad at my husband, eating dumplings here cheers me right up…
Array.indonesia: Even when I get mad at my husband, eating dumplings here cheers me right up…

Array.indonesia: Would you like a little live music?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten02_001
Array.english: Hehe, I hope you enjoyed it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, I hope you enjoyed it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: With the ground being so unstable, it's hard to get inspired to compose.
Array.indonesia: With the ground being so unstable, it's hard to get inspired to compose.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten_Ending01_001
Array.english: But now that the Divine Tree's power is returning, I feel my inspiration coming back.
Array.indonesia: But now that the Divine Tree's power is returning, I feel my inspiration coming back.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten_Ending01_002

Array.indonesia: Let me give you a sneak peek of the piece I'm working on.\nIt's a song dedicated to the Divine Tree.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Merman13_Wooten_Ending02_001
Array.english: Hehe, I hope you enjoyed it.
Array.indonesia: Hehe, I hope you enjoyed it.

Array.indonesia: I've been gambling a lot to blow off steam.\nI should skip a few meals.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: You're hunting down the cause of the earthquakes, huh?
Array.indonesia: You're hunting down the cause of the earthquakes, huh?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: I was about to demand my Beluga Whistle from you...\nbut you can keep it.
Array.indonesia: I was about to demand my Beluga Whistle from you...\nbut you can keep it.

Array.indonesia: With the temperature swings, there's not much to do outside and I have no use for it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne_Ending_001
Array.english: Now that the temperature's steady, roaming around is kind of fun.
Array.indonesia: Now that the temperature's steady, roaming around is kind of fun.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Daphne_Ending_002
Array.english: You can keep the Beluga Whistle.
Array.indonesia: You can keep the Beluga Whistle.

Array.indonesia: If an earthquake happens while patrons are enjoying the entertainment, it can nullify their progress, inevitably leading to their discontent.

Array.indonesia: For the happiness of the Sea People residents, I hope these earthquakes cease soon.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Linchen_Ending_001
Array.english: Whenever you're feeling down and need some comfort,\nor when you're in high spirits and want to share your joy,
Array.indonesia: Whenever you're feeling down and need some comfort,\nor when you're in high spirits and want to share your joy,

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Linchen_Ending_002

Array.indonesia: Yes. That's correct.

Array.indonesia: <size=33>Whoa! I guess you need to have a round shape like that to survive on land!</size>

Array.indonesia: I told you, it's a scary place.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_FirstMeet_005
Array.english: No...Guys...
Array.indonesia: No...Guys...

Array.english: Did you hear that the path to the Glacial Area is open?
Array.indonesia: Did you hear that the path to the Glacial Area is open?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Wow, it seems like fun!
Array.indonesia: Wow, it seems like fun!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_AfterGlacial_003

Array.indonesia: You! You must not go down there, okay?\nIt was very dangerous down there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_AfterGlacial_004
Array.english: Hehe… I know. Just trying it out.
Array.indonesia: Hehe… I know. Just trying it out.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_Ending_001
Array.english: Did you hear about the Control Room?
Array.indonesia: Did you hear about the Control Room?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_Ending_002
Array.english: Suwam told me! It sounded really fun!
Array.indonesia: Suwam told me! It sounded really fun!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_Ending_003
Array.english: <size=34>What're you guys chattering about now?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What're you guys chattering about now?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Maro_Ending_004
Array.english: Oh, haha! Nothing at all!!
Array.indonesia: Oh, haha! Nothing at all!!

Array.english: Recently, it feels like more villagers are falling sick.
Array.indonesia: Recently, it feels like more villagers are falling sick.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Padeuma_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: The inconsistent water temperature is quite disconcerting.
Array.indonesia: The inconsistent water temperature is quite disconcerting.

Array.english: I feel like my pain has been washed away!
Array.indonesia: I feel like my pain has been washed away!

Array.english: This village has never really had a good clinic.
Array.indonesia: This village has never really had a good clinic.

Array.english: Huh? You, a human, are planning on venturing into the glacial area?
Array.indonesia: Huh? You, a human, are planning on venturing into the glacial area?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Yese_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: It'll be extremely cold… Are you sure you're up for it?
Array.indonesia: It'll be extremely cold… Are you sure you're up for it?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Yese_Ending_001
Array.english: There's a heated region underneath the cold area?
Array.indonesia: There's a heated region underneath the cold area?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Yese_Ending_002
Array.english: It's truly astonishing that\nall of this is controlled by the Divine Tree.
Array.indonesia: It's truly astonishing that\nall of this is controlled by the Divine Tree.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_FirstMeet_001
Array.english: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh…Nobody is here.\nI guess I'll have to come back later.</color>
Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>Oh…Nobody is here.\nI guess I'll have to come back later.</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Our ancestors used to traverse the Glacial Area with ease.
Array.indonesia: Our ancestors used to traverse the Glacial Area with ease.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: But ever since we settled in this place, we became weaker and the Glacial Area has become a dangerous place.
Array.indonesia: But ever since we settled in this place, we became weaker and the Glacial Area has become a dangerous place.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: We need your help, Dave.
Array.indonesia: We need your help, Dave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_001
Array.english: The contraption built by our ancestors is difficult to operate.
Array.indonesia: The contraption built by our ancestors is difficult to operate.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_002
Array.english: And it seems that something caused the contraption to malfunction.
Array.indonesia: And it seems that something caused the contraption to malfunction.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_003
Array.english: I know it’s not right to get you involved in matters of ours,\nbut please do help us.
Array.indonesia: I know it’s not right to get you involved in matters of ours,\nbut please do help us.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_004
Array.english: The earthquakes are not only your problem. Humans are suffering from them, too.
Array.indonesia: The earthquakes are not only your problem. Humans are suffering from them, too.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_005
Array.english: I will find out the cause.
Array.indonesia: I will find out the cause.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_AfterDungeon01_006
Array.english: Thank you.\nMay the blessings of King Long be with you.
Array.indonesia: Thank you.\nMay the blessings of King Long be with you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: Fortunately, the water temperature has stabilized a bit.
Array.indonesia: Fortunately, the water temperature has stabilized a bit.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_7ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: But we need to find the main cause to prevent it from recurring.
Array.indonesia: But we need to find the main cause to prevent it from recurring.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_001
Array.english: Dave... You did a great job.
Array.indonesia: Dave... You did a great job.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_002
Array.english: I heard about the situation in the Control Room from Tenzhin...\nThe moment I heard it, I...
Array.indonesia: I heard about the situation in the Control Room from Tenzhin...\nThe moment I heard it, I...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_003
Array.english: <size=50>!!!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=50>!!!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_004
Array.english: I made this face.
Array.indonesia: I made this face.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_005
Array.english: Phew, it was quite a scene.\nBut thanks to the help of the Sea People, we managed to handle it.
Array.indonesia: Phew, it was quite a scene.\nBut thanks to the help of the Sea People, we managed to handle it.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_006
Array.english: The collaboration between humans and the Sea People in this incident will surely go down in history.
Array.indonesia: The collaboration between humans and the Sea People in this incident will surely go down in history.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Niamo_Ending_007
Array.english: Thank you once again...\nMay King Long's blessings always be with you.
Array.indonesia: Thank you once again...\nMay King Long's blessings always be with you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: So the giant mirror that goes to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> is working?
Array.indonesia: So the giant mirror that goes to the <color=#F1DC2B>Glacial Area</color> is working?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Suwam, that guy...\nI think he went around town saying he did it all by himself.
Array.indonesia: Suwam, that guy...\nI think he went around town saying he did it all by himself.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: He's incorrigible...
Array.indonesia: He's incorrigible...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: The Divine Tree in the Control Room mutated, you say?
Array.indonesia: The Divine Tree in the Control Room mutated, you say?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_7ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: What is happening?
Array.indonesia: What is happening?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_Ending_001
Array.english: If you had declined my initial request to visit our Sea People Village,
Array.indonesia: If you had declined my initial request to visit our Sea People Village,

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_Ending_002
Array.english: our village might still be stuck in the same situation, right?
Array.indonesia: our village might still be stuck in the same situation, right?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_Ending_003
Array.english: Honestly, even thinking about it now gives me chills.
Array.indonesia: Honestly, even thinking about it now gives me chills.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Ramo_Ending_004
Array.english: But on a positive note, everything is fine now, haha!
Array.indonesia: But on a positive note, everything is fine now, haha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: I heard that you found a way inside the Glacial Area, human.
Array.indonesia: I heard that you found a way inside the Glacial Area, human.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: But don't put on airs!
Array.indonesia: But don't put on airs!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: For us, who keep the town safe,\nit's one more thing to worry about.
Array.indonesia: For us, who keep the town safe,\nit's one more thing to worry about.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterGlacial_004
Array.english: I think that no sane person would enter such a cold place, though.
Array.indonesia: I think that no sane person would enter such a cold place, though.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterBeluga_001
Array.english: You resist the cold quite well, human.
Array.indonesia: You resist the cold quite well, human.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_AfterBeluga_002
Array.english: Oh, that is because of the Divine Tree fruit we gave you, heh.
Array.indonesia: Oh, that is because of the Divine Tree fruit we gave you, heh.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: A Control Room below the glacial area, huh…
Array.indonesia: A Control Room below the glacial area, huh…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_7ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: It feels like I've seen it in an old document. So it really did exist.
Array.indonesia: It feels like I've seen it in an old document. So it really did exist.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_7ChapterProgress_003

Array.indonesia: Don’t touch anything. It could be dangerous, human.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_Ending_001
Array.english: You know, I think I might actually be able to trust you, but...
Array.indonesia: You know, I think I might actually be able to trust you, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_Ending_002
Array.english: A while back, a human caused a ruckus in the village with some round contraption.
Array.indonesia: A while back, a human caused a ruckus in the village with some round contraption.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_AwangNawang_Ending_003

Array.indonesia: Humans are always unpredictable.\nWe have to stay on guard.

Array.english: <size=34>Tips on fighting the Gadons?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Tips on fighting the Gadons?</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeGlacialPassage_002
Array.english: *Laughing* Of course, it’s only natural for you to seek a piece of advice from a great warrior and strategist like myself.
Array.indonesia: *Laughing* Of course, it’s only natural for you to seek a piece of advice from a great warrior and strategist like myself.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeGlacialPassage_003

Array.indonesia: <size=34>not to encounter them in the first place.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_BeforeNewSuit_001

Array.indonesia: Go find a way into the Glacial Area.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_AfterDungeon01_001
Array.english: You took so long, human.
Array.indonesia: You took so long, human.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_AfterDungeon01_002
Array.english: I would have done it myself if my back was not injured.
Array.indonesia: I would have done it myself if my back was not injured.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_AfterDungeon01_003
Array.english: I feel sorry for everyone in the village, haha.
Array.indonesia: I feel sorry for everyone in the village, haha.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: Don’t forget that thanks to me, you could activate the last switch.
Array.indonesia: Don’t forget that thanks to me, you could activate the last switch.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_7ChapterProgress_002

Array.indonesia: Argh...\nThe scars I received from that thresher shark still hurt.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_7ChapterProgress_003

Array.indonesia: Cool! I can practically envision another statue standing tall beside the statue of King Long!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Suwam_Ending_004

Array.indonesia: <color=#C3C3C3>(...Well, let him bask in his glory for now.)</color>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_4ChapterProgress_001

Array.indonesia: I need the key to the passage leading to the Glacial Area.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_4ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: Can you bring it to me? It’s in the <color=#F1DC2B>Abandoned Cave</color>. Suwam will go with you.
Array.indonesia: Can you bring it to me? It’s in the <color=#F1DC2B>Abandoned Cave</color>. Suwam will go with you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_4ChapterCleared_001
Array.english: Get some rest on land and come back tomorrow.
Array.indonesia: Get some rest on land and come back tomorrow.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterBeforeGlacialPassage_001
Array.english: The key has been handed over to Suwam. You should meet him.
Array.indonesia: The key has been handed over to Suwam. You should meet him.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: The Glacial Passage has long been sealed.
Array.indonesia: The Glacial Passage has long been sealed.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: It’s a pity that we don’t have enough strength or weapons to explore the area.
Array.indonesia: It’s a pity that we don’t have enough strength or weapons to explore the area.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterProgress_003
Array.english: Suwam claims that he’s the best warrior among you, is that true?
Array.indonesia: Suwam claims that he’s the best warrior among you, is that true?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterProgress_004
Array.english: <size=33>Hahaha! Hm...\nWell, I admire his confidence!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Hahaha! Hm...\nWell, I admire his confidence!</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterCleared_001
Array.english: Use the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit Cloth</color> to craft a suit and you can enter the Glacial Area as well.
Array.indonesia: Use the <color=#F1DC2B>Divine Tree Fruit Cloth</color> to craft a suit and you can enter the Glacial Area as well.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_5ChapterCleared_002
Array.english: Of course, you will need to find a human tailor or something for the task since our attire is different from yours.
Array.indonesia: Of course, you will need to find a human tailor or something for the task since our attire is different from yours.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterAfterDecript_001
Array.english: Hm, a stone slab found in the Glacial Area?\nI can roughly translate the text, but...
Array.indonesia: Hm, a stone slab found in the Glacial Area?\nI can roughly translate the text, but...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterAfterDecript_002
Array.english: If you want to know the details, ask <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color>.
Array.indonesia: If you want to know the details, ask <color=#F1DC2B>Niamo</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: You need to activate three switches and enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> to find out what is causing the earthquakes.
Array.indonesia: You need to activate three switches and enter the <color=#F1DC2B>Control Room</color> to find out what is causing the earthquakes.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: The water temperature is unstable and making \nour health deteriorate.
Array.indonesia: The water temperature is unstable and making \nour health deteriorate.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_6ChapterProgress_003
Array.english: I am sorry to pester you, but we don’t have much time.
Array.indonesia: I am sorry to pester you, but we don’t have much time.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_7ChapterProgress_001
Array.english: As I feared, the Divine Tree is not in good condition.
Array.indonesia: As I feared, the Divine Tree is not in good condition.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_7ChapterProgress_002
Array.english: I hope we can somehow help you with this.
Array.indonesia: I hope we can somehow help you with this.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_001
Array.english: You have put in significant effort in assisting our Sea People.
Array.indonesia: You have put in significant effort in assisting our Sea People.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_002
Array.english: It's nothing really. It was a problem affecting the land as well.
Array.indonesia: It's nothing really. It was a problem affecting the land as well.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_003
Array.english: I've been biased, having seen the darker side of humans for so long.
Array.indonesia: I've been biased, having seen the darker side of humans for so long.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_004
Array.english: There are still so many humans with greedy intentions,\nbut there are also plenty of good ones.
Array.indonesia: There are still so many humans with greedy intentions,\nbut there are also plenty of good ones.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_005
Array.english: For the time being, I'll ensure the Sea People's territory remains a secret!\nHowever, I will be dropping by occasionally!
Array.indonesia: For the time being, I'll ensure the Sea People's territory remains a secret!\nHowever, I will be dropping by occasionally!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Tenzhin_Ending_006
Array.english: <size=34>Thank you. Feel free to visit anytime.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Thank you. Feel free to visit anytime.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_FirstMeet_001
Array.english: Why is a human here...
Array.indonesia: Why is a human here...

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_FirstMeet_002
Array.english: I need to have some peace and quiet. Please leave.
Array.indonesia: I need to have some peace and quiet. Please leave.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_FirstMeet_003
Array.english: <size=34>…cough.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>…cough.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Cough... Cough…
Array.indonesia: Cough... Cough…

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Are you okay?
Array.indonesia: Are you okay?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_003
Array.english: The water temperature keeps changing so rapidly. \nI am not feeling well.
Array.indonesia: The water temperature keeps changing so rapidly. \nI am not feeling well.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_004
Array.english: It’s not just me. Many of us got sick.
Array.indonesia: It’s not just me. Many of us got sick.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_AfterGlacial_005
Array.english: We must find what caused this and quickly resolve the issue.
Array.indonesia: We must find what caused this and quickly resolve the issue.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_001
Array.english: *Coughing*
Array.indonesia: *Coughing*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_002
Array.english: Duwa, you still not feeling well?
Array.indonesia: Duwa, you still not feeling well?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_003
Array.english: Don't sweat it... I'm a lot better than before.
Array.indonesia: Don't sweat it... I'm a lot better than before.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_004
Array.english: I've got a longstanding illness.\nJust flared up recently.
Array.indonesia: I've got a longstanding illness.\nJust flared up recently.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Ending_005
Array.english: I see...\nIf you ever need help, just let me know, okay?
Array.indonesia: I see...\nIf you ever need help, just let me know, okay?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_ShopNormal_001
Array.english: Our people do not wield weapons except the guards.
Array.indonesia: Our people do not wield weapons except the guards.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_ShopNormal_002
Array.english: So, this Workshop mostly crafts production tools.
Array.indonesia: So, this Workshop mostly crafts production tools.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_ShopNormal_003
Array.english: You should bring the materials to land to create a weapon. *Cough*
Array.indonesia: You should bring the materials to land to create a weapon. *Cough*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_Wating_Shop_001
Array.english: Today, I'll do my best to prepare the blacksmith shop, so come by <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color>.
Array.indonesia: Today, I'll do my best to prepare the blacksmith shop, so come by <color=#1DFEAF>tomorrow</color>.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_001
Array.english: *Coughing*
Array.indonesia: *Coughing*

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_002
Array.english: Your coughing hasn't stopped yet.
Array.indonesia: Your coughing hasn't stopped yet.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_003
Array.english: It hasn't…\nBut the Steamed Horsehair Crab made me feel a lot better.
Array.indonesia: It hasn't…\nBut the Steamed Horsehair Crab made me feel a lot better.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_004
Array.english: Still, I may have overdone it, heh. Must've been the crab working its magic on me.
Array.indonesia: Still, I may have overdone it, heh. Must've been the crab working its magic on me.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_005
Array.english: You haven't completely recovered yet. You need to take care of yourself.
Array.indonesia: You haven't completely recovered yet. You need to take care of yourself.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Doowa_CrabPotComplete_006
Array.english: Thank you. I will.
Array.indonesia: Thank you. I will.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: I am sure that I will be able to find new ingredients for my dumplings in the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: I am sure that I will be able to find new ingredients for my dumplings in the Glacial Area.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: I will prepare some energizing dumplings for you. Godspeed!
Array.indonesia: I will prepare some energizing dumplings for you. Godspeed!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_Ending_001
Array.english: I heard you visited a really scorching place…!
Array.indonesia: I heard you visited a really scorching place…!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_Ending_002
Array.english: You're probably not in the mood for hot dumplings right now, eh?
Array.indonesia: You're probably not in the mood for hot dumplings right now, eh?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_Ending_003
Array.english: Not at all!\nMima's dumplings are always delicious, no matter when I eat them.
Array.indonesia: Not at all!\nMima's dumplings are always delicious, no matter when I eat them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_ShopNormal_001
Array.english: Hoho! I modified them for humans to enjoy.\nBon appetit!
Array.indonesia: Hoho! I modified them for humans to enjoy.\nBon appetit!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotMaking_001
Array.english: Steamed Horsehair Crab is good for coughs.
Array.indonesia: Steamed Horsehair Crab is good for coughs.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotMaking_002
Array.english: I have a steamer at my place. Just get me a <color=#F1DC2B>Horsehair Crab</color>!
Array.indonesia: I have a steamer at my place. Just get me a <color=#F1DC2B>Horsehair Crab</color>!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotMaking_003
Array.english: How do I catch it?
Array.indonesia: How do I catch it?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotMaking_004
Array.english: You have to use a <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>, haha!\nA Horsehair Crab can be lured with some bait!
Array.indonesia: You have to use a <color=#F1DC2B>Crab Trap</color>, haha!\nA Horsehair Crab can be lured with some bait!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotDeliver_001
Array.english: Wait, you still haven't delivered the <color=#F1DC2B>Steamed Horsehair Crab</color> to Duwa?
Array.indonesia: Wait, you still haven't delivered the <color=#F1DC2B>Steamed Horsehair Crab</color> to Duwa?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Mima_CrabPotDeliver_002
Array.english: He should be waiting for you.
Array.indonesia: He should be waiting for you.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_AfterGlacial_001
Array.english: Corals and seaweeds can be found even in the coldest Glacial areas.
Array.indonesia: Corals and seaweeds can be found even in the coldest Glacial areas.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_AfterGlacial_002
Array.english: Bring me their seeds and I will cultivate them with care.
Array.indonesia: Bring me their seeds and I will cultivate them with care.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_Ending_001
Array.english: Did you perhaps notice any seaweed sprouting in that Control Room?
Array.indonesia: Did you perhaps notice any seaweed sprouting in that Control Room?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_Ending_002
Array.english: Mm... it didn't seem like anything could grow there.
Array.indonesia: Mm... it didn't seem like anything could grow there.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_Ending_003
Array.english: That’s a shame. There's always a thrill in nurturing new seaweed.
Array.indonesia: That’s a shame. There's always a thrill in nurturing new seaweed.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_ShopNormal_001
Array.english: I still can’t believe that humans also eat seaweed.
Array.indonesia: I still can’t believe that humans also eat seaweed.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Gumo_ShopNormal_002
Array.english: I remember the food on land was quite tasty too...\nYou humans have such diverse cooking ingredients.
Array.indonesia: I remember the food on land was quite tasty too...\nYou humans have such diverse cooking ingredients.

Array.english: I pray every morning but the earthquakes still continue.
Array.indonesia: I pray every morning but the earthquakes still continue.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial01_002
Array.english: Human, why don’t you join me in reading the morning prayer?
Array.indonesia: Human, why don’t you join me in reading the morning prayer?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial01_003
Array.english: <size=34>What? But I don’t read your language.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>What? But I don’t read your language.</size>

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial01_004
Array.english: Ah, right...\nI have no use for you then.
Array.indonesia: Ah, right...\nI have no use for you then.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial02_001
Array.english: There are plants inhabiting the Glacial Area.
Array.indonesia: There are plants inhabiting the Glacial Area.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_AfterGlacial02_002

Array.indonesia: I procured some of their seeds. You may purchase some of them from Gumo and try cultivating them.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_ShopNormal_001

Array.indonesia: Reading a book amidst plants gives me inner peace.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_ShopNormal_002
Array.english: The stories about the great feats of King Long never get boring.
Array.indonesia: The stories about the great feats of King Long never get boring.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_ShopNormal_003
Array.english: My favorite is...\n<size=26>the story about him when our people were wandering in search of a new home.</size>
Array.indonesia: My favorite is...\n<size=26>the story about him when our people were wandering in search of a new home.</size>

Array.english: Oh? The Sea People Translator is not working!\nMaybe next time, haha!
Array.indonesia: Oh? The Sea People Translator is not working!\nMaybe next time, haha!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_001
Array.english: I heard about your exploits, human!\nSome unbelievable stuff, eh?
Array.indonesia: I heard about your exploits, human!\nSome unbelievable stuff, eh?

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_002
Array.english: Yeah, it's a lot to put into words.
Array.indonesia: Yeah, it's a lot to put into words.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_003
Array.english: Bahaha! We should swap stories over a cup of seaweed wine sometime.
Array.indonesia: Bahaha! We should swap stories over a cup of seaweed wine sometime.

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_004
Array.english: I can fill you in on King Long, too!
Array.indonesia: I can fill you in on King Long, too!

Array.name: NPC_Talk_Kazhin_Ending_005
Array.english: Sure. Let's do that someday.
Array.indonesia: Sure. Let's do that someday.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Oarfish_001
Array.english: The giant oarfish sure was huge.\nNo wonder it’s called the lion of the ocean.
Array.indonesia: The giant oarfish sure was huge.\nNo wonder it’s called the lion of the ocean.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160004
Array.english: It’s the baby humpback whale that had gone missing.\nStay close to your mother, now.
Array.indonesia: It’s the baby humpback whale that had gone missing.\nStay close to your mother, now.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160005
Array.english: It’s the pink dolphin I helped out last time.\nI wonder how it’s going with the boyfriend dolphin.
Array.indonesia: It’s the pink dolphin I helped out last time.\nI wonder how it’s going with the boyfriend dolphin.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160006
Array.english: A turtle is the highlight of an underwater photo!\nI was lucky enough to see the loggerhead sea turtle.
Array.indonesia: A turtle is the highlight of an underwater photo!\nI was lucky enough to see the loggerhead sea turtle.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_UnderwaterLake
Array.english: A lake located underwater... It was fascinating! \nBut I ran into a scary shark...
Array.indonesia: A lake located underwater... It was fascinating! \nBut I ran into a scary shark...

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_RecordRoom_WallArt01
Array.english: The Record Chamber, with the murals and writings of the Sea People.\nFascinating…
Array.indonesia: The Record Chamber, with the murals and writings of the Sea People.\nFascinating…

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160007
Array.english: The leatherback turtle that seaweed collector Tsuchi had with him…\nWhat was her name…?
Array.indonesia: The leatherback turtle that seaweed collector Tsuchi had with him…\nWhat was her name…?

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_14160008
Array.english: It's astounding that this fish could be so flat…\nEvery time I look at the Sunfish I'm still amazed.
Array.indonesia: It's astounding that this fish could be so flat…\nEvery time I look at the Sunfish I'm still amazed.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_GA_Dungeon01_Gate
Array.english: The stone slab in front of the Glacial Area. Its text could be important.
Array.indonesia: The stone slab in front of the Glacial Area. Its text could be important.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_MantaRay
Array.english: The picture of a Manta Ray at night that took me a lot of effort. I saw this several times, but it still looks awesome.
Array.indonesia: The picture of a Manta Ray at night that took me a lot of effort. I saw this several times, but it still looks awesome.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Southern_RightWhale_Dolphins
Array.english: Dolphins in the Glacial Area? Nice to see a school of dolphins here.
Array.indonesia: Dolphins in the Glacial Area? Nice to see a school of dolphins here.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Arandaspis
Array.english: A school of Arandaspis. They look like tadpoles.
Array.indonesia: A school of Arandaspis. They look like tadpoles.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Firefly_Squid
Array.english: It was a really pretty glowing squid. They have an organ that makes them luminous. Amazing!
Array.indonesia: It was a really pretty glowing squid. They have an organ that makes them luminous. Amazing!

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Giant_Isopod
Array.english: That thing looks like a giant sow bug. But is it munching on a carcass? Ooh... that’s gross!
Array.indonesia: That thing looks like a giant sow bug. But is it munching on a carcass? Ooh... that’s gross!

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Red_Lipped_Batfish
Array.english: Its lips are red, and its face looks like a person...It's incredible that there is a fish like this.
Array.indonesia: Its lips are red, and its face looks like a person...It's incredible that there is a fish like this.

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_Coelacanth
Array.english: Is this a living fossil? How did it survive for so long without evolving?
Array.indonesia: Is this a living fossil? How did it survive for so long without evolving?

Array.name: Photozone_Desc_LIons_Mane_Jellyfish
Array.english: To think that such a large jellyfish could exist in the glacial area. Does it have enough to eat?
Array.indonesia: To think that such a large jellyfish could exist in the glacial area. Does it have enough to eat?

Array.name: Menu_RainbowCap_Triggerfish_Fishroll_Desc
Array.english: A dish made with finely minced Triggerfish meat wrapped around Rainbow Cap and steamed with seaweed. Dip the fishcake in Rainbow Sauce and you can feel the galaxy in your mouth.
Array.indonesia: A dish made with finely minced Triggerfish meat wrapped around Rainbow Cap and steamed with seaweed. Dip the fishcake in Rainbow Sauce and you can feel the galaxy in your mouth.

Array.name: Menu_RainbowCap_Pacificfanfish_Ochazuke_Desc
Array.english: An Ochazuke adorned with carefully grilled Pacific Fanfish and colorful Rainbow Cap. The salty, crispy fish fillet and the fluffy, flavorful Rainbow Cap go together as if they were meant to be.
Array.indonesia: An Ochazuke adorned with carefully grilled Pacific Fanfish and colorful Rainbow Cap. The salty, crispy fish fillet and the fluffy, flavorful Rainbow Cap go together as if they were meant to be.

Array.indonesia: Grilled Rainbow Cap and Snub-nosed Spiny Eel skewers. A single dish that captures a multitude of flavors.

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_RainbowCap_Triggerfish_Fishroll
Array.english: Count one star in the night sky, eat one fishcake... That's the life! \n<color=#3a8ed6> #ILove #RainbowCap #Fishcake #bancho_sushi</color>
Array.indonesia: Count one star in the night sky, eat one fishcake... That's the life! \n<color=#3a8ed6> #ILove #RainbowCap #Fishcake #bancho_sushi</color>

Array.name: Cooksta_Content_Menu_RainbowCap_Pacificfanfish_Ochazuke
Array.english: It feels like firecrackers popping on the tip of my tongue! Very thrilling! But... there's no way it's poisonous, right...? .\n<color=#3a8ed6>#bancho_sushi #RainbowCap #Ochazuke</color>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_001
Array.english: *Winks*
Array.indonesia: *Winks*

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_002
Array.english: Um... Who...are you?
Array.indonesia: Um... Who...are you?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_003
Array.english: They call me the <color=#F1DC2B>Mushroomer</color>.
Array.indonesia: They call me the <color=#F1DC2B>Mushroomer</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_004
Array.english: The Fellow Alchemist told me you guys helped him. *Winking*
Array.indonesia: The Fellow Alchemist told me you guys helped him. *Winking*

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_005
Array.english: Mushroomer... so does that mean you sell mushrooms?
Array.indonesia: Mushroomer... so does that mean you sell mushrooms?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_006
Array.english: Yes! And I have some very fine mushrooms.\n*Winks with the other eye*
Array.indonesia: Yes! And I have some very fine mushrooms.\n*Winks with the other eye*

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_007
Array.english: Have you ever heard of <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color>?
Array.indonesia: Have you ever heard of <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color>?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_008
Array.english: I cannot say that I have.
Array.indonesia: I cannot say that I have.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_009
Array.english: So indeed, I figured it would be quite difficult to find them in this world…
Array.indonesia: So indeed, I figured it would be quite difficult to find them in this world…

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete01_010
Array.english: To thank you for helping my friend, the Fellow Alchemist, I will give you some <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>recipes</color>.
Array.indonesia: To thank you for helping my friend, the Fellow Alchemist, I will give you some <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color> and <color=#1DFEAF>recipes</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_001
Array.english: <size=34>Oh…! That's a very mysterious color…!</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>Oh…! That's a very mysterious color…!</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_002
Array.english: But, they say colorful mushrooms are poisonous and shouldn't be eaten...
Array.indonesia: But, they say colorful mushrooms are poisonous and shouldn't be eaten...

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_003
Array.english: Haha, do not worry. *Winking*
Array.indonesia: Haha, do not worry. *Winking*

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_004
Array.english: These are safe mushrooms that taste delicious no matter how you cook them.
Array.indonesia: These are safe mushrooms that taste delicious no matter how you cook them.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_005
Array.english: <size=33>Try preparing some of the recipes I've given you.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>Try preparing some of the recipes I've given you.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_Mission_Complete02_006
Array.english: I will also teach Jango how to find this <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color>.
Array.indonesia: I will also teach Jango how to find this <color=#1DFEAF>Rainbow Cap</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_006
Array.english: <size=34>A <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color>?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=34>A <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color>?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_007
Array.english: Yes, it's a cauldron needed to craft magic potions…but a big wave struck.
Array.indonesia: Yes, it's a cauldron needed to craft magic potions…but a big wave struck.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_008
Array.english: Do you know anyone who can swim and help me?
Array.indonesia: Do you know anyone who can swim and help me?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_009
Array.english: Well, I do know how to swim, but…
Array.indonesia: Well, I do know how to swim, but…

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_010
Array.english: Haha! Excellent! Then please help me.
Array.indonesia: Haha! Excellent! Then please help me.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_011
Array.english: Okay then, tomorrow morning I will…
Array.indonesia: Okay then, tomorrow morning I will…

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_012
Array.english: <size=35>Oh…! My <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color> cannot be found during the day...</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Oh…! My <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color> cannot be found during the day...</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_013
Array.english: <size=35>It glows only at night.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It glows only at night.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_014
Array.english: My friend, can you find my precious <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color> for me?
Array.indonesia: My friend, can you find my precious <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Cauldron</color> for me?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_015
Array.english: Mm, diving at night is dangerous... but alright.
Array.indonesia: Mm, diving at night is dangerous... but alright.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_016
Array.english: Thank you!\nI think I saw something glowing <color=#F1DC2B>near a broken wooden boat</color>.
Array.indonesia: Thank you!\nI think I saw something glowing <color=#F1DC2B>near a broken wooden boat</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Mission_01_017
Array.english: <size=35>Thank you, my friend.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>Thank you, my friend.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_001
Array.english: Oh... I see something glowing in your restaurant.
Array.indonesia: Oh... I see something glowing in your restaurant.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_002
Array.english: You found it for me, my friend?
Array.indonesia: You found it for me, my friend?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_003
Array.english: Yes. It was quite heavy, and bringing it back wasn't easy.
Array.indonesia: Yes. It was quite heavy, and bringing it back wasn't easy.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_004
Array.english: Oh, I can't thank you enough. And it's in such pristine condition...
Array.indonesia: Oh, I can't thank you enough. And it's in such pristine condition...

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_005
Array.english: It was for one of my clients. You saved me from a lot of trouble, haha.
Array.indonesia: It was for one of my clients. You saved me from a lot of trouble, haha.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_006
Array.english: I would like to give you something as a token of my gratitude.
Array.indonesia: I would like to give you something as a token of my gratitude.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_007
Array.english: <size=35>It's a <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Mortar</color>.
Array.indonesia: <size=35>It's a <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Mortar</color>.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_008
Array.english: <size=35>A <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Mortar</color>…?</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=35>A <color=#1DFEAF>Magic Mortar</color>…?</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_009
Array.english: Hmm. A mortar, it is a tool to pound or grind ingredients.
Array.indonesia: Hmm. A mortar, it is a tool to pound or grind ingredients.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_010
Array.english: Correct. But this one is used to craft <color=#F1DC2B>Potions</color> rather than cooking.
Array.indonesia: Correct. But this one is used to craft <color=#F1DC2B>Potions</color> rather than cooking.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_011
Array.english: Potions, you say... What are they for?
Array.indonesia: Potions, you say... What are they for?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_012
Array.english: They can temporarily boost the imbiber's stats.
Array.indonesia: They can temporarily boost the imbiber's stats.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_013
Array.english: Especially the ones made with <color=#F1DC2B>Seaweed</color> can boost stats underwater.
Array.indonesia: Especially the ones made with <color=#F1DC2B>Seaweed</color> can boost stats underwater.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_014
Array.english: Oh...! That would be helpful!
Array.indonesia: Oh...! That would be helpful!

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_015
Array.english: Hm. Can I craft potions with fish as well?
Array.indonesia: Hm. Can I craft potions with fish as well?

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_016
Array.english: Meat isn't exactly the right ingredient for potions, given its nature...
Array.indonesia: Meat isn't exactly the right ingredient for potions, given its nature...

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_017
Array.english: <size=33>However, you can pound fish to make <color=#F1DC2B>Paste Baits</color>.</size>
Array.indonesia: <size=33>However, you can pound fish to make <color=#F1DC2B>Paste Baits</color>.</size>

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_018
Array.english: Hm. <color=#F1DC2B>Paste Baits</color>... They could be useful for Crab Traps.
Array.indonesia: Hm. <color=#F1DC2B>Paste Baits</color>... They could be useful for Crab Traps.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_019
Array.english: Haha, I’m sure it’ll be useful somewhere.
Array.indonesia: Haha, I’m sure it’ll be useful somewhere.

Array.name: dialogue_PotionCraft_FellowAlchemist_Complete01_020
Array.english: Thank you again. Now, if you will excuse me...
Array.indonesia: Thank you again. Now, if you will excuse me...

Array.name: Menu_RedtoothedTriggerfish_Set_Desc

Array.indonesia: Menu offered with grilled redtoothed triggerfish.\nNicely cooked rice with grilled triggerfish on top will offer you a taste of heaven.

Array.name: Menu_BlueTang_SquareSpotAnthias_Pasta_Desc

Array.name: Menu_LongfinBatFish_JuvenileCircularBatFish_RiceBowl_Desc

Array.indonesia: Rice topped with meat from the Orbicular batfish as well as mature female longfin batfish.\nSoft meat, aged meat, and slightly cooked egg form a warm harmony on the tongue.

Array.name: Menu_DuskyGrouper_Stake_Desc

Array.indonesia: A steak made from the belly of the dusky grouper.\nThe flesh of the dusky grouper, which has persevered in the rough ocean waters, has a lovely supple texture.

Array.name: Menu_CuttleFish_Gratin_Desc
Array.english: A gratin featuring plenty of chewy cuttlefish.\nBecause cuttlefish don’t have much meat once the bones are removed, and shrink as they are cooked, large amounts are needed.
Array.indonesia: A gratin featuring plenty of chewy cuttlefish.\nBecause cuttlefish don’t have much meat once the bones are removed, and shrink as they are cooked, large amounts are needed.

Array.name: Menu_SeahorseSeaGrapes_Salad_Desc

Array.indonesia: A salad topped with deep-fried seahorse.\nSeahorses are not considered suitable for consumption, but they have been turned into a crunchy, flavorful dish through Bancho’s skilled hands. They go splendidly with the crunchy salad.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_01_Desc
Array.english: A cute and small Seahorse born in a specific color.\nVery popular as a pet.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_03_Desc

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_04_Desc
Array.english: A cute and small Seahorse born in a specific color.\nVery popular as a pet.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_05_Desc
Array.english: A cute and small Seahorse born in a specific color.\nVery popular as a pet.\nPink is considered a rare variant.
Array.indonesia: A cute and small Seahorse born in a specific color.\nVery popular as a pet.\nPink is considered a rare variant.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_06_Desc
Array.english: A cute and small Seahorse born in a specific color.\nVery popular as a pet.\nWhite is considered a very rare variant.
Array.indonesia: A cute and small Seahorse born in a specific color.\nVery popular as a pet.\nWhite is considered a very rare variant.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_07_Desc
Array.english: The biggest Seahorse, it grows up to 18-35cm.\nIts beautiful coloration and body give it much visual appeal and popularity.
Array.indonesia: The biggest Seahorse, it grows up to 18-35cm.\nIts beautiful coloration and body give it much visual appeal and popularity.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_08_Desc
Array.english: This Seahorse seems to be wearing a crown on its head.\nIt is small (6-10.5cm) and seldom breeds, and not much information is available yet.
Array.indonesia: This Seahorse seems to be wearing a crown on its head.\nIt is small (6-10.5cm) and seldom breeds, and not much information is available yet.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_09_Desc
Array.english: As the name suggests, this is a very small Seahorse (maximum size 5cm).\nIt has spotted skin like a dwarf and is covered with black spots and warts.
Array.indonesia: As the name suggests, this is a very small Seahorse (maximum size 5cm).\nIt has spotted skin like a dwarf and is covered with black spots and warts.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_10_Desc
Array.english: This Seahorse grows up to 10cm and isn’t as large as a giraffe, contrary to its name.\nIt is short, but patterned like a giraffe at least.
Array.indonesia: This Seahorse grows up to 10cm and isn’t as large as a giraffe, contrary to its name.\nIt is short, but patterned like a giraffe at least.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_11_Desc
Array.english: A Seahorse with spines like a hedgehog.\nIt loses its spines as it matures.
Array.indonesia: A Seahorse with spines like a hedgehog.\nIt loses its spines as it matures.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_12_Desc
Array.english: This Seahorse grows up to 14cm and lives among seaweed, marine plants, and rocks.\nIt hides itself expertly.
Array.indonesia: This Seahorse grows up to 14cm and lives among seaweed, marine plants, and rocks.\nIt hides itself expertly.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_13_Desc
Array.english: It’s also called the northern or spotted seahorse.\nIt can be found anywhere between northern Canada and Venezuela in Latin America.
Array.indonesia: It’s also called the northern or spotted seahorse.\nIt can be found anywhere between northern Canada and Venezuela in Latin America.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_14_Desc
Array.english: This Seahorse grows up to 12-21.5cm. It is slim with a long tail.
Array.indonesia: This Seahorse grows up to 12-21.5cm. It is slim with a long tail.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_15_Desc
Array.english: This Seahorse is the only one found in the eastern Pacific.\nIt is sized 12-19cm, but larger entities have been found.
Array.indonesia: This Seahorse is the only one found in the eastern Pacific.\nIt is sized 12-19cm, but larger entities have been found.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_16_Desc
Array.english: This Seahorse is the only one found in the eastern Pacific.\nIt is sized 12-19cm, but larger entities have been found.
Array.indonesia: This Seahorse is the only one found in the eastern Pacific.\nIt is sized 12-19cm, but larger entities have been found.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_17_Desc
Array.english: Also known as the yellow seahorse.\nAs you can see, black ones also exist.
Array.indonesia: Also known as the yellow seahorse.\nAs you can see, black ones also exist.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_18_Desc
Array.english: Grows up to 18.5cm, with a tail resembling that of a tiger.\nIt is not aggressive, however.
Array.indonesia: Grows up to 18.5cm, with a tail resembling that of a tiger.\nIt is not aggressive, however.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_19_Desc
Array.english: This swift-looking Seahorse resembles a zebra.\nIt grows up to 11-15cm and is currently an endangered species.
Array.indonesia: This swift-looking Seahorse resembles a zebra.\nIt grows up to 11-15cm and is currently an endangered species.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_20_Desc
Array.english: This Seahorse has many thorns on its body and grows up to 15-17cm.\nIt can be found anywhere in the Pacific and Indian Oceans.
Array.indonesia: This Seahorse has many thorns on its body and grows up to 15-17cm.\nIt can be found anywhere in the Pacific and Indian Oceans.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_21_Desc
Array.english: Lives in the Indian Ocean and off the coast of Australia. It is difficult to distinguish from seaweed when seen in rock crevices. Grows to a maximum of 45 cm, and its tail is not curled, making it a distinct species from seahorses.
Array.indonesia: Lives in the Indian Ocean and off the coast of Australia. It is difficult to distinguish from seaweed when seen in rock crevices. Grows to a maximum of 45 cm, and its tail is not curled, making it a distinct species from seahorses.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_22_Desc
Array.english: A species that only lives in some parts of Australia. Its body has grass-like fins, making it easily camouflaged. It hides in the grass and feeds on small plankton.
Array.indonesia: A species that only lives in some parts of Australia. Its body has grass-like fins, making it easily camouflaged. It hides in the grass and feeds on small plankton.

Array.name: SeahorseRace_SeahorseType_23_Desc
Array.english: A very rare species of sea dragon that lives in the deep sea. The entire body is red, making it stand out from other species.
Array.indonesia: A very rare species of sea dragon that lives in the deep sea. The entire body is red, making it stand out from other species.

Array.name: Seadragon_desc
Array.english: Due to its resemblance to a dragon, it is called the 'Dragon of the Sea.' Since it is very sensitive to its environment and what it feeds on, it is said to be difficult to raise in captivity.
Array.indonesia: Due to its resemblance to a dragon, it is called the 'Dragon of the Sea.' Since it is very sensitive to its environment and what it feeds on, it is said to be difficult to raise in captivity.

Array.name: o2_tank
Array.english: Air Tank
Array.indonesia: Tabung Udara

Array.name: o2_tank_desc
Array.english: An oxygen tank that allows Dave\nto breathe underwater.\nUpgrades increase its capacity.
Array.indonesia: Tabung oksigen yang memungkinkan Dave\nbernapas di bawah air.\nPeningkatan meningkatkan kapasitasnya.

Array.name: o2_tank_upgrade
Array.english: You can dive longer.
Array.indonesia: Anda dapat menyelam lebih lama.

Array.name: diving_suit
Array.english: Diving Suit
Array.indonesia: Pakaian Selam

Array.name: diving_suit_desc
Array.english: A diving suit that maintains \nDave's temperature underwater.\nUpgrades make Dave less visible to fish.
Array.indonesia: Pakaian selam yang menjaga \nsuhu tubuh Dave di bawah air.\nPeningkatan membuat Dave lebih sulit terlihat oleh ikan.

Array.name: diving_suit_Lv2
Array.english: Cold-resistant Diving Suit
Array.indonesia: Pakaian Selam Tahan Dingin

Array.name: diving_suit_Lv2_desc
Array.english: A diving suit that can withstand the cold Glacial Area.\nUpgrade it to dive deeper.
Array.indonesia: Pakaian selam yang dapat menahan suhu dingin di Area Gletser.\nTingkatkan untuk menyelam lebih dalam.

Array.name: diving_suit_upgrade
Array.english: You can dive deeper.
Array.indonesia: Anda dapat menyelam lebih dalam.

Array.name: inventory
Array.english: Cargo Box
Array.indonesia: Kotak Barang

Array.name: inventory_desc
Array.english: Box that stores things obtained while diving.\nUpgrading it increases storage capacity.
Array.indonesia: Kotak untuk menyimpan barang-barang yang diperoleh saat menyelam.\nMeningkatkan levelnya akan menambah kapasitas penyimpanan.

Array.name: inventory_upgrade
Array.english: You can bring more fish.
Array.indonesia: Kamu bisa membawa lebih banyak ikan.

Array.name: harpoon_gun
Array.english: Harpoon Gun
Array.indonesia: Senapan Harpun

Array.english: A Harpoon that can be used to capture fish.\nUpgrade it to inflict more damage to fish.
Array.indonesia: Senapan harpun yang dapat digunakan untuk menangkap ikan.\nTingkatkan levelnya untuk memberikan kerusakan lebih besar pada ikan.

Array.indonesia: Pisau bertahan hidup yang digunakan di bawah air.\nKamu juga dapat mengumpulkan bahan jika memutakhirkannya.

Array.name: basic_knife_Lv3_desc

Array.indonesia: Pisau bertahan hidup yang digunakan di bawah air.\nKamu dapat mengumpulkan bahan dari area gletser jika memutakhirkannya.

Array.name: DLC_GGST_Desc
Array.english:
Guilty Gear -Strive- crossover content,
previously exclusive to the Dave the Diver Anniversary Edition physical release, is now free on mobile!
Array.indonesia:
Konten kolaborasi Guilty Gear -Strive-,
yang sebelumnya eksklusif untuk edisi fisik Dave the Diver Anniversary Edition, kini tersedia gratis di perangkat seluler!

Array.name: DLC_Jungle_Title
Array.english: In the Jungle
Array.indonesia: In the Jungle

Array.name: DLC_Jungle_Desc
Array.english: In the Jungle, the game's first major DLC, adds about 10 hours of new content! Take a break from the Blue Hole and venture deep into the jungle with Dave, where a new story and adventure await in Utara Village!
Array.indonesia: In the Jungle, DLC besar pertama dalam game ini, menambahkan sekitar 10 jam konten baru! Beristirahatlah sejenak dari Blue Hole dan jelajahi hutan belantara bersama Dave, di mana cerita dan petualangan baru menanti di Desa Utara!

Array.name: DLC_Dredge_Title
Array.english: DREDGE
Array.indonesia: DREDGE

Array.name: DLC_Dredge_Desc
Array.english: Characters and aberrations from the eerie fishing adventure Dredge have washed ashore in Dave the Diver!
Array.indonesia: Karakter dan makhluk aneh dari petualangan memancing yang menyeramkan, Dredge, telah terdampar di Dave the Diver!

Array.name: DLC_MuseDash_Title
Array.english: 《Muse Dash 喵斯快跑》
Array.indonesia: 《Muse Dash 喵斯快跑》

Array.name: DLC_MuseDash_Desc
Array.english: 梦中演唱会迎来特别嘉宾，超人气美少女跑酷音游《Muse Dash 喵斯快跑》手机专属联动尽在《潜水员戴夫》。
Array.indonesia: Konser dalam Mimpi menyambut tamu istimewa, kolaborasi eksklusif untuk ponsel dari game parkour musik gadis cantik super populer 《Muse Dash 喵斯快跑》 tersedia di 《Dave the Diver》.

Array.name: DLC_Godzilla_Title
Array.english: 《哥斯拉》
Array.indonesia: 《Godzilla》

Array.name: DLC_Godzilla_Desc
Array.english: 《哥斯拉》免费扩展包限时上架至2027年2月7日！传奇怪兽登陆蓝洞，搭乘特制潜艇，对抗深海巨兽，收集怪兽模型！
Array.indonesia: Paket ekspansi gratis 《Godzilla》 tersedia untuk waktu terbatas hingga 7 Februari 2027! Monster legendaris mendarat di Blue Hole, naiki kapal selam khusus, lawan raksasa laut dalam, dan kumpulkan model monster!

Array.name: DLC_Like_A_Dragon_Title
Array.english: 《一番的假日》
Array.indonesia: 《Liburan Ichiban》

Array.name: DLC_Like_A_Dragon_Desc
Array.english: 《一番的假日》扩展包限时上架至2027年2月7日！全新横版卷轴动作玩法，与一番并肩作战，联手揭开蓝洞背后的阴谋！
Array.indonesia: Paket ekspansi 《Liburan Ichiban》 tersedia untuk waktu terbatas hingga 7 Februari 2027! Gameplay aksi side-scrolling yang benar-benar baru, berjuang bahu-membahu bersama Ichiban, dan bekerja sama untuk mengungkap konspirasi di balik Blue Hole!
